title: FLOWERS -Le volume sur hiver-
description: Suou/[spoiler]Mayuri: "Is there someone in your life whom you want to be with, forevermore?" "Tell me the key necessary to arrive at the [spoiler]Goddess of Truth," challenged Suou after becoming [spoiler]the president of Council of Nicaea and overcoming the trials from [spoiler]Yatsushiro Yuzuriha. As promised, the name given was "[spoiler]The Seven Wonders of the Beginning of the End," directly linking [spoiler]Kousaka Mayuri, her amity who disappeared in Spring. A number of even more bizarre events arise in Saint Angraecum Academy during the season of Winter. With the help of her friends, Shirahane Suou will stand up against many obstacles, but… the words she prayed to God, "Please forget about me," still overwhelms her. The reemergence of her step-mom's shadow, passing thoughts, unexpected continuations… Just what will it all bring about to Suou? The final wintry season will melt eve

characters.name: Shirahane Suou
characters.description: A quiet, anxious, timid girl— However, she is misunderstood; her beauty, which sets her apart from the herd, and her silence is seen as cool, and the timidity that prevents her from mixing with everyone is seen as independence. Before she came to the academy, she went to live with her grandfather due to her family situation, and was homeschooled, therefore she is not good at interacting with people. However, it is not because she hates people; her desire to make friends is double that of most people. Also, she is extremely shy, and this in combination with her anxiety means that she always blushes when she gets nervous. Because books and movies are her friends, she has a habit of quoting lines from books and movies in her conversations. Her Amitie partners are Mayuri and Rikka. Her interests are literature, music, and film. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Kousaka Mayuri
characters.description: Although she doesn’t show it, she is a hard worker who can achieve surprising things when she puts her mind to it. It was her own wish to enter the academy, but this wish stemmed from certain woes. She is quite social but takes care even with her Amitie partners so as not to let her troubles be known. Her interests are making sweets and art appreciation She is one of Suou’s Amitie partners. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Hanabishi Rikka
characters.description: A very serious, calm girl who is good at taking care of others. She is like the mother of the class; she is not only kind but when someone does something bad, she will say so, like a mother who is kind yet strict. Cherished for her thoughtfulness toward others, she stands at the heart of class with Mayuri Kousaka in terms of influence. Because she was the top scoring student on the entrance exam, along with her caring and her ability to make things happen, she was named the class president. She takes pride in the fact that she can handle all that is expected of her, takes initiative, and devotes herself to the role. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Sasaki Ichigo
characters.description: A troublemaker brimming with curiosity. It isn’t that she intentionally brings on disaster; her sheltered life means that she knows nothing, and so she naturally invites misunderstandings and trouble. She started life at the boarding school with her twin sister, and overall is satisfied with all the novelty at the academy. She is cheery, so she speaks openly with the people around her, and gets along well with her classmates. She is especially close with Mayuri Kohsaka. Her interests are the latest fashions and collecting frog memorabilia. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Sasaki Ringo
characters.description: She is often thought to be the laidback opposite of her bubbly sister... but in truth she is just a bit lazy. People who know her for a long time come to see her eccentric personality. Perhaps because she is an eccentric and is not afraid of anything, she speaks freely with Suoh, who most people regard as unapproachable, and the two quickly became acquaintances. Perhaps they are drawn to each other because of their love of books… Her interests are reading and ghost stories. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Yatsushiro Yuzuriha
characters.description: Eccentric and dynamic. Because of her way of speaking and the randomness of the things she says, she is thought to be strange, but that is her world. She is thought to be egotistic, but perhaps because she is the president of organizations, she is good at looking out for and taking care of others. Though her words and actions are theatrical, her position as the president of the Council of Nicaea gives her a kind of dignity. She is well trusted by all students at the academy. She is childhood friends with Nerine Komikado, the vice president of the Council of Nicaea, whom she calls Neri. Although she belongs to the cooking club, she is terrible at cooking. Her interests are sports and photography. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Komikado Nerine
characters.description: A virtuous and gentle Catholic girl who is good with people. Her otherworldly beauty and the fact that she is half-European builds a natural wall around her, making her a bit unapproachable. She likes to be spoiled but she does not show this side to just anybody. She is the vice president of the Council of Nicaea and childhood friends with the Council’s president, Yuzuriha Yatsushiro. Their closeness is such that at one point there were unsubstantiated rumors that she and Yuzuriha Yatsushiro were in a relationship. She belongs to the choir and is the club president. She is a soprano. Her interests are scary stories and walking while eating. She is a bottomless pit when it comes to sweets. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Dalia Basquiat
characters.description: One of the nuns at Saint Angraecum Academy. She is a mild and tolerant teacher, and is more like a laidback older sister than a mother. Because she is a strict follower of Catholicism, she has a tendency to apply her religion to things that have nothing to do with it. She is in charge of the ballet lessons for the first year students and is well trusted by them. Thinking that she should turn her attention toward something other than religion, she has recently been raising her namesake flower, the dahlia, in the greenhouse and creating new varieties by her own hand. Her interests are ballet and gardening. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Yaegaki Erika
characters.description: A strange, asocial girl. She talks like a man, but this is her way of building a wall between herself and others. Generally she likes to be by herself, though she will speak to others to tease them. Her whimsical cat-like character makes her elusive. What part will she play in the tale… She is known as the girl in the wheelchair. Unable to move her legs due to illness, she lives her life in a wheelchair. Her interests are reading and finding people’s weak points. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Takasaki Chidori
characters.description: An eccentric ballet celebrity. Thought of as unapproachable since her emotions don't show on her face, she often causes unnecessary drama because of her tendency to ask questions about things she shouldn't. She'll express herself honestly when it comes to things she's interested in. Other than that, she doesn't do anything unnecessary. Before entering the academy, she was involved in the entertainment industry, predominantly theater, and so is one of the best in the school at ballet and singing She is assigned as Erika's Amitié partner, but their mutual eccentricities lead to them often being at odds with one another. Her hobbies are classical ballet and voice training. [Benichidori (Rosaceae family)] Language of Flowers: [How Lovely] [Refinement] [Nobility] [Devotion] [From English official page and Japanese official page]

title: Sakura Fantasy
description: Sakura Fantasy is an exciting visual novel fantasy adventure where you decide the development of the story by the choices you make. It is the tale of an aspiring novice who wishes to aim to become a knight. Her life suddenly changes when she meets the mysterious empress and a burning star falls from the heavens. [From Steam]

title: Oshi no Love yori Koi no Love
title_original: 推しのラブより恋のラブ
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Support Character
description: "—I wanna marry you." Those simple words set in motion a ♀ yuri ♀ game of cat and mouse! "As a child, there was a love story that captivated me. In the story, an alien came down from space and extravagantly proclaimed her love to an Earthling man. I never imagined that, decades later, I'd be living out that story for myself..." Akuru Hayahoshi is an unlucky otaku office worker who just can't pull her husbando in the gacha game she's obsessed with, no matter how much money she throws at it. Until one day, she runs into the garishly gorgeous and freakishly lucky Ren Furutachi. A series of misunderstandings lead to a proposal, and Ren starts to full-on pursue Akuru. One thing leads to another, and in order to bring her husbando home, she ends up... bringing Ren home?! Now they're sharing a house... and a bed?! To unpresuming Akuru this cool, lady-loving girl might as well be an alien! Akuru

characters.name: Hayahoshi Akuru
characters.description: An office worker who spends her days pursuing her 2D husbando. Yet somehow she has the worst luck, and he's the only one she never brings home. She's so obsessed with the gacha game, she's heading toward financial ruin... But a chance meeting with Ren sets her life tumbling down a totally different path.

characters.name: Furutachi Ren
characters.description: She loves cute things, shiny things--basically anything she can squeal over. When she meets Akuru it's love at first sight--this woman is totally her type! In an attempt to win her heart, she ends up pushing her way into Akuru's home. [spoiler]Her real name is Love, writen with the same Kanji as 'Ren' (恋).

characters.name: Nishiki Shino
characters.description: Akuru's childhood friend, coworker, and fellow otaku. She's a hardcore fujoshi who's in three doujin circles and is a terrible influence on Akuru. From Ren's point of view she's an annoyance who keeps trying to hook Akuru up with gross guys, but she's actually quite enjoying the whole drama.

characters.name: Tachibana Eiji
characters.description: Modest and nondescript, Eiji Tachibana is the unlikely protagonist of the game. A recent transfer student to his school, his lonesome life becomes convoluted when his curiosity leads him to become apart of a sexual, underground student group disguised as a harmless club. Despite his careless behavior, Eiji is an honest, friendly and especially introspective person, able to sense the mood of other people; though he himself is as easily readable. Eiji prefers the indoors and enjoys watching television. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Takahata Rumi
characters.description: The president of Eiji's class. A bright, high-spirited and popular girl, her father is a newly rich self-made man and her family is tremendously wealthy. Thanks to her personality this upper class "princess" status of hers doesn't particularly show, though. Born as a futanari, she got over her dislike for her body at an early age and came to be curious about all things sexual. With Natsuki as a partner she's been researching her sexuality almost nightly in the school infirmary. While already fully sexually experienced, she is constantly in search of further stimulus and pleasure. While Rumi is a naturally effervescent and outspoken co-ed, she can at times be particularly authoritative, sadistic and intolerant, especially during group activities. [From J-List and Wikipedia]

characters.name: Azumi Shizuko
characters.description: Eiji's classmate. She sits next to him in class, and seems like a kind enough person. Due to trauma suffered in a sexual harassment incident in the past she became an obsessive-compulsive neat freak, and was violently ill-disposed toward members of the opposite sex; recently she has largely recovered and is fine with men around. Her personality has a cool and high-handed side, but once she takes to someone (boy or girl) she becomes quite intimate. Regarding sex she knows what she's read in magazines and heard from the idle chatter of other girls, which sparked her interest in the subject. She has many hidden interests in this area, which it's up to Eiji to find out! [From J-List]

characters.name: Misawa Natsuki
characters.description: Eiji's classmate. Taken into Rumi's family by her father as a child, Natsuki was raised as his second natural daughter. However, her fierce devotion to Rumi has given her the appearance more of her maid than her sister. At a glance she's the inscrutable, mysterious type. She doesn't talk much and doesn't let her emotions show, but due to the development of her body at Rumi's hand when she enters "H" mode she undergoes a complete change, to a brazen, dirty talking girl. Because Rumi has focused on her anal training, Natsumi is still a virgin. She alternates between sadistic and masochistic personalities at Rumi's command. She is initially discontent with Eiji and his blossoming friendship with Rumi, viewing it as a rivalry; over the period of her acquaintance with him however, she grows fond of and closer to him herself. Given her openness to partners, Natsuki is also bisexual. [From J-Li

characters.name: Takahata Masayoshi
characters.description: Rumi's step-brother, a year younger than the protagonist. His frail constitution, slender build and pale skin make him look remarkably girlish. In love with his sister, in the past she caught him stealing her panties to use for dubious purposes and since then has been blackmailed into her service. He is now at her beck and call in her quest for sexual stimulation. He's still a virgin in all senses of the term, but is experienced in "petting level" play along with Natsuki and Rumi.

title: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Tenshi no Hanabira Zome
title_original: その花びらにくちづけを 天使の花びら染め
description: The eighth Sono Hanabira game, featuring the series' fifth couple. While class representative Kirishima Shizuku has foreign exchange student Shitogi Eris under her wing, a faintly glowing love settles into her heart. However, Shizuku, worried sick thinking her nagging personality landed her on her crush's bad side, actually gets a confession straight to her face from Eris?! Shizuku: "D-D-D-Don't misunderstand! I-I-I don't feel anything at all for you! (etc)" This is the romantic comedy of Shizuku, the tsundere Yamato Nadeshiko, and Eris, the cool, blonde foreign exchange student not afraid to show her feelings, and their flirtatious, madly-in-love-with-each-other yuri relationship. [Translated from official website by Procyon of Yuri Project]

characters.name: Shitogi Eris
characters.description: A half-Japanese and half-European third year high school student. She has come to Japan to learn Japanese culture at St. Michael's, where she has attracted many girls due to her looks, including Shizuku. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Kirishima Shizuku
characters.description: A very traditional Japanese girl in her third year of high school. Having traits of a Yamato nadeshiko, she is very skilled at calligraphy and flower arrangement. She falls in love with Eris after meeting her. [From Wikipedia]

full_description: The eighth Sono Hanabira game, featuring the series' fifth couple. While class representative Kirishima Shizuku has foreign exchange student Shitogi Eris under her wing, a faintly glowing love settles into her heart. However, Shizuku, worried sick thinking her nagging personality landed her on her crush's bad side, actually gets a confession straight to her face from Eris?! Shizuku: "D-D-D-Don't misunderstand! I-I-I don't feel anything at all for you! (etc)" This is the romantic comedy of Shizuku, the tsundere Yamato Nadeshiko, and Eris, the cool, blonde foreign exchange student not afraid to show her feelings, and their flirtatious, madly-in-love-with-each-other yuri relationship. [Translated from official website by Procyon of Yuri Project]

title: Hanahira!
description: The story revolves around four girls who attend Saint Michael Girls’ School and highlights all their cute dokidoki yuriyuri love for one another during and after school. The story is quite lighthearted and follows the four girls at school, shopping, hanging around and coming together for a pajama party. [from Micchi's review]

characters.name: Hanemura Kaori
characters.description: Kaori is a tsundere who can’t be honest about her deep love for Amane. She lives next door to Amane and goes to Saint Michael Girls’ School together. Very responsible and straightforward. She fulfills the tsukkomi role very well. However, when Amane’s repeated loving advances breaks down her tsundere wall, she becomes very cute and doting. She’s not that good at cooking, but at least it’s better than Amane. [Taken from Micchi's review]

characters.name: Yuuki Amane
characters.description: Amane is basically the opposite of Kaori. She’s airheaded, very lively, glomps Kaori at every opportunity and generally lazy. She fails at studying and cooking, and would rather stay up playing games than anything else. [Taken from Micchi's review]

characters.name: Uozumi Koharu
characters.description: Koharu is the mascot character among the four friends. Soft-spoken and pure, she emits an iyashi-kei charm that captures Makoto’s heart. She thinks she is too childish and hence, greatly admires Makoto since she is so much more mature than her. She is a wonderful cook (especially sweets) and very handy around the house, so she would be a great housewife. Very hardworking. [Taken from Micchi's review]

characters.name: Toudou Makoto
characters.description: The most mature of the group, Makoto is normally very cool and reserved. However, she is a girl after all and is weak for cute things, like Koharu. Dreams about being with Koharu a lot. [Taken from Micchi's review]

description: The story follows the conclusion of Risa and Miya’s storyline from A Kiss For The Petals – Snow White’s Knight. The season is fall… as the uniforms transition from summer to winter garments, Risa suddenly has a pang of nostalgia. It was this very uniform she was wearing on her first day at St. Michael’s… The day she met her future girlfriend Miya. Now the two of them share a passionate life as a couple living in Risa’s apartment, but there was a time in their relationship when the very sight of one another would be enough to set off an endless bout of arguing. From Risa’s point of view, it all started with her just trying to get Miya to come to class… And even now with the two of them going out, the chronically truant girl has failed to mend her ways. Remembering those days elicits a faint laugh from Risa. Miya, sitting alongside her, questions Risa’s sudden outburst with a puzzled expre

characters.name: Azumi Risa
characters.description: Class Representative of the Year 1 "Snow" class, and a classmate of Miya's. Has an earnest and hardworking personality. As a hard-nosed person, she often finds herself in leadership positions. She’s what you might call a high-class tsundere girl. While she naturally does well academically and has common sense, whenever she gets into it with Miya, she always gets outreasoned and frequently stomps her feet. Having an unusually strong sense of shame, she gets flustered and briefly digs herself into a hole when thrust into a romantic relationship. The half-Japanese daughter of a foreign company with a British mother. Built like a model, and the owner of enormous breasts. [Translated from Getchu and Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Ayase Miya
characters.description: A student of the Year 1 "Snow" class, and a classmate of Risa's. A prominent genius on campus, but has difficulty in social situations. Doesn’t really take issue with people other than Risa, and socializes as little as possible. Whenever she speaks with Risa it's always abusive, but she's actually covering her own embarrassment. Her speech and behavior always keep others at a distance. She rarely shows her soft side and is unflappable. When she does show her soft side, she becomes timid and casts nervous glances from beneath her lashes. Although you wouldn’t guess it from the way she talks, her behavior is actually quite ladylike. Possessing one of the most prominent intellects on campus, she has been offered the chance to study abroad and even skip grades, but she hates interacting with others, so she enrolled in the not particularly academically demanding school for high-class girls, S

Ichika, the diligent, stubborn older twin, and Futaba, the childish, sociable younger twin, are an inseparable pair. But there's more to their love for each other than first meets the eye. Growing up, the two did everything together. No matter where they went, the twins were never apart. And even now that they've grown up, their personalities diverging and leading them to different hobbies, they're still as close as can be. For Ichika, the responsible big sister, looking out for childish, spoiled Futaba has become an everyday occurance, both at home and at school. But one day, worried that the twins are growing too close, their mother chastises them, explaining that there's a difference between being supportive of each other and being codependent. characters.description: "You can’t tell anyone else about us kissing and sleeping together, okay? It’s our little secret." A kind, responsible girl with endless patience, Ichika is an exemplary student and a member of the Student Council. More down-to-earth than Futaba, she tends to stubbornly consider only the facts rather than consulting her feelings when making decisions. Taking care of Futaba has long since become part of Ichika's daily routine, and the sight of Futaba's smile is always enough to make Ichika smile in return. Although Futaba and Ichika are twins, Ichika sees herself as the older sister. Since she mostly acts on logic rather than her own feelings, she has trouble facing her love for Futaba. Ichika has secretly been fretting that, even though she and Futaba are twins, they won’t be able to stay together forever, so her mother's warning sets Ichika on a path of distancing herself from Futaba. characters.description: "I’m going to show you just how much I love you, so don’t take your eyes off me, okay?" A happy-go-lucky ball of energy who doesn’t let common sense get in the way of her feelings, Futaba is not the brightest bulb in the box. Futaba always trusts her emotions, so she makes no attempt to hide her love for Ichika, showing it in word and deed. Whether in the privacy of their house or in the school hallways, Futaba will hold Ichika’s hand, or give her a hug, or even lick her ear at times. Fortunately, Futaba's friends and family tend to dismiss that as part of her outgoing nature, so they don’t think much of it. Futaba is a natural athlete and a member of the tennis club. Her grades aren’t the best, but that doesn’t bother her much since she can always rely on Ichika for help. Ichika starts to distance herself from Futaba after their mother’s warning, but this only leaves Futaba confused. Wh

characters.name: Mikage Yuri
characters.description: "Saki and I have been best friends with you two since kindergarten. So, you know, we pick up on these things." The twins’ childhood friend and a classmate of Ichika', Yuri is the easygoing, freewheeling sort, though her jokes make her sound like a dirty old man. She enjoys ogling girls' panties and takes great pride in her role helping along the development of Saki's breasts. Gifted with keen intuition, Yuri is always there for her friends when they need her, even if they themselves don’t know it. She’s a smart girl, but she conks out after the slightest bit of exercise. Yuri is a member of the literature club and something of an otaku. Yuri is the darling of their all-girls school, especially to the underclassmen, and often finds love letters in her locker. She enjoys--no, she revels in being so popular. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Kohinata Saki
characters.description: "It's not every day you see such close sisters. You two look more like a pair of lovers." The twins' childhood friend and a classmate of Futaba's, Saki is a talented cook who pampers her friends with all the love and warmth of a new bride. Her deep concern for her friends leads her to being overprotective, and she can be as fierce as a mother cat with her kittens when it comes to any perceived threat. Saki is a member of the tennis club, and despite her docile appearance, she’s a gifted athlete. Since they're in both the same club and the same class, Saki looks out for Futaba when Ichika isn’t around. [From MangaGamer]

title: Hate Plus
description: Hate Plus is a sequel to Analogue: A Hate Story that continues directly from the end of that game, and explores, over the course of three days, the events leading up to year 0. If Analogue was the backstory of *Hyun-ae, then Hate Plus is the backstory of *Mute. It’ll continue from your Analogue save file, so each ending will have its own route with equal focus. It plays similarly to Analogue, but instead of your AI companion simply showing you files they’ve picked, you’ll have to investigate yourself, and discover what happened together! It features new art and costumes, an all new soundtrack (plus theme song “It’s Not Ero!!”) from Isaac Schankler, a whole new and improved UI, and more writing than Analogue did.

characters.name: *Hyun-ae
characters.description: An AI on the Mugunghwa. A helpful girl with a romantic mindset who also enjoys cosplay. She does have her own secrets though. [spoiler] Her real name is Kim Hyun-Ae, also called the Pale Bride. She was a girl who downloaded her mind into a computer (nearly killing *Mute) to avoid her complete death when she completely wiped out the entire population of the Mugunghwa in an act of revenge. She was a very sick girl in life so her father put her into stasis until a future where she could be treated was made. It didn't work out.

characters.name: *Mute
characters.description: The security AI for the Mugunghwa who was created on Earth. She was the Councillor of Security, and thus in charge of the security forces of the Mugunghwa, until an incident caused things to change. Remained in charge of security even after the incident though. She's more than 1600 years old. After the incident with the Pale Bride, many years after the first incident, she has had to spend the many years since then shut down due to damage she took. [spoiler]She tried to overthrow the Mugunghwa Council, which she was part of, when she felt that they were jeopardizing the ship's security and stability, but she failed and her memory was wiped as a result.

title: Kodoku ni Kiku Yuri
description: She gave her love, and tenderness. First with a kiss... It was first year in high school. The budding of summer. Fusa Konno met a shut-in girl named Seri. Persecuted by her yearning eyes, her heart opened... [From DLsite english]

characters.name: Konno Fusa
characters.description: [From Yoru no Hitsuji] Fusa is a diligent high school student. But, she thinks she is naive and wants to change that characteristic. One day her teacher asks her to bring some handouts to a classmate, Seri Aeba. That encounter changes... She often feels lonely, but pretends not.

characters.name: Aeba Seri
characters.description: [From Yoru no Hitsuji] Seri is a Hikikomori, but she is actually an outgoing and extroverted person. She doesn't care about the fact that she doesn't go to school although she is a student. She really hates the rules people impose to her. But, she sometimes asks herself...?

title: Sakura Dungeon
description: Sakura Dungeon is a first-person dungeon crawling RPG set in a fantasy world where monsters and humans have been at war with one another for generations. However, a new battle is brewing.... In this story players will assume the role of Yomi an ancient fox spirit who awakens after several hundred years of deep sleep to find that possession of her lovingly made dungeon has been taken from her! As if that wasn’t enough cause for alarm, she has also been robbed of her power, leaving her weak and vulnerable. She soon discovers that it was a heroic knight who woke her from her slumber, and after a brief fight and “negotiation,” the knight decides to join her on an adventure to reclaim the dungeon! Together, they will unearth great treasures, reveal secrets and hidden rooms, and recruit monster girls to fight by their side...all while avoiding traps, fighting off dangerous enemies and bosses a

characters.name: Yomi
characters.description: After awakening from a deep sleep, she finds herself powerless and her dungeon taken away from her. With the help of a knight who awakened her, she sets off to reclaim her dungeon.

characters.name: Ceri
characters.description: An adventurer who was tasked to clear out a dungeon of its monsters. Forced to work with Yomi, the former dungeon keeper, the two set off on a common goal to explore the dungeon taken from Yomi.

characters.name: Isabella
characters.description: The innkeeper of a local inn above the dungeon. She knows Yomi.

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.description: "Welcome back, my humble master!" Charlotte is the shopkeeper in Yomi's town, as well as a craftsperson. Having known Yomi for so long, she is used to her master's perverted and unusual ways and possesses quite a calm demeanor. The only time Charlotte truly expresses anger towards anyone is when a Warrior teleports into her shop and endangers her merchandise. Her loyalty to Yomi runs considerably deep, even making her feel the need to [spoiler]hide her love for Isabella; when Yomi eventually discovers their relationship, the two express immense guilt over slacking off from their work before Yomi reassures them. [spoiler]She is a devoted follower to the goddess Fortuna, lamenting that unlike her other followers long ago, she has still not abandoned her.

characters.name: Sylvi
characters.description: A well-read, albeit inexperienced, magician from the Elven Metropolis.

characters.name: Spear Warrior
characters.description: "A tired and bored guardsman, quite gifted with a spear." - In-game description Spear Warrior is a type of monster encountered early on in the dungeon. They take their guard duty quite seriously, with the one captured by the player admitting to having stood guard at a previous post for several years. However, she has a clear desire for battle, accepting Yomi's recruitment offer due to severe boredom with her current work. Floor(s): 5-7

characters.name: Abyssal Cow
characters.description: "Changed by the Abyss and armed with a strange backpack, this cow girl is a dangerous monster." - In-game description Abyssal Cow is the first type of demon encountered in the dungeon, their appearances altered by high concentrations of magic and the Abyss. They are laid-back and rude, with one calling Yomi's party "losers" before their fight. Despite this, the Abyssal Cow captured by the player will readily join the party out of boredom and wanting to be on the winning side. In order to proceed to the Abyssal Gateways, the player must capture three Abyssal Cows and milk them. The milk then needs to be given to Anubis, who will inform Yomi's party on how to advance to the lower floors. Floor(s): 20-23, 25

characters.name: Panda
characters.description: "Fuzziness bestowed upon the most ill fitting creature it could be, the panda is far from docile." - In-game description Panda is a monster encountered around mid-way through the dungeon. Upon seeing her, Ceri is incredibly enamored by her cuteness, to the point where she later personally recruits her into the party; fortunately, she is rather easily won over with the promise of all the bamboo she can eat. Yomi notes that Ceri's attempt to persuade Panda to join their side has left her the most nervous she's ever seen her. If the player chooses to walk around the Bamboo Forest outside of town, Yomi and the party will encounter a Panda who has been robbing unfortunate travelers. Upon her defeat, plant fibers are obtained to create a new outfit for Ceri.

characters.name: Tribeswoman
characters.description: "Despite her primitive trappings, this woman can easily stand toe-to-toe with any fighter." - In-game description Tribeswoman is a monster that can first be encountered on the ninth floor, but cannot be captured until reaching the tenth. If the party discovers the Tribeswoman in the secret grotto, she is quite protective of her home and will not let the party explore it without fighting her; upon her defeat, the player must select one of three nearby bushes to collect upgrade seeds from. Following her capture, the Tribeswoman Yomi recruits laments that although she and her fellow tribe members can sense something wrong with the dungeon, they have not been able to figure out what. Floor(s): 10-19

Oosachi Asuka was a high school girl who lived life in a carefree, easygoing way while holding the nickname "Jellyfish Club Leader." But as graduation approaches, her classmates started to seriously think about college and their futures, which made Asuka feel uneasy. The self you want to become... Dreams of the future... Unable to answer those two thoughts, Asuka wandered in her closet for a change of pace and discovered an old picture book. The writing was faded, but enough to make out the meanings behind the words. "I will become a nurse." Without a doubt, those were her letters she herself wrote down inside that favorite picture book of hers growing up. characters.name: Oosachi Asuka
characters.description: The honest, simple, relaxed, fluffy and somewhat sluggish older sister. She's not dumb, but her memory could use some work. Nicknames during high school: "Jellyfish Club Leader", "Lazy Sis." In general, she's pretty much hopeless, but she has a knack for being loved by others. When it really counts, her ability to get things done and decisiveness shines through. Doesn't have memory of the first 8 years of her life, but she's not too worried about that. She heard from her parents that she was being mischievous at one time when she was a kid, climbed up a tree and fell off. But she doesn't remember any of it. Up until her high school career inquiry, she hasn't given much thought to her future, but from the words "I'll be a nurse!" written in the final page of her favorite picture book in elementary, she decided to aspire to be one. She currently doesn't have a clear reason on why she chose

characters.name: Oosachi Nao
characters.description: The kind, flawless younger sister who loves her older sister Asuka a lot, devoting everything of herself to support her. The self-proclaimed "Responsible Imouto", "Onee-chan's Special Medicine." While they're born one year apart and in the same grade level, Nao has cared about Asuka (who's not good at studying) to the point where she helped her sis get accepted into the Imperial Capital Nursing Technical School, even enrolling herself to the very same school just to be with Asuka. [Translated from Official Site]

characters.name: Oohara Kaede
characters.description: Former registered nurse and Asuka's nurse instructor. Born in the "Oohara" family known for their exceptional influence in medicine. Chose to go to the Imperial Capital Nursing Technical School to work as a teacher after serving as an RN. She's the "White Robe Angel", according to Asuka. [Translated from Official Site]

characters.name: Amatou Itsuki
characters.description: Asuka's classmate. Daughter of a distinguished family known for its traditional Japanese dance. She's a refined, charismatic, and stylish girl. Her personality is open-minded and mischievous (ecchi topics and sexual harassment are her specialties). Favorite phrase: "I'm lying." Currently going out with Sakuya. [Translated from Official Site]

characters.name: Takeda Sakuya
characters.description: Asuka's classmate. Comes from a wealthy family. Has a strong sense of responsibility, is prideful, stubborn and lives by the concept of the so-called noblesse oblige. For some reason, she acts cold towards Asuka when they first meet. Currently going out with Itsuki. [Translated from Official Site]

title: Wolf Tails
tags: Modern Day Setting in a Fictional World
description: Moving far away from civilization, you hoped to live a life of solitude in a snowy cabin. Just as you begin to adapt to your peaceful new life, you discover an intruder; a wolf-girl, alone and shivering in your storeroom. Fearful for her life, you take the girl in for the night, offering her a place to stay until she recovers. Once she has recovered, however, the wolf-girl shows no sign of leaving. In fact, she seems quite content to move in. Soon after, yet another wolf-girl shows up, loudly accusing the “Princess” of running away from her duties to the pack. She wants nothing more than to bring the Princess back home with her and restore order - and despite your best wishes, you're now stuck in the middle of it. [From Steam]

characters.description: A kindhearted girl who is running away from her duties to her pack.

characters.name: Fuyu
characters.description: A brash and loud-mouthed girl who is wary of human culture and its "influences".

characters.description: Warm and supportive, Kael is the glue that keeps the 'family' together. He's the most responsible of the demons, and is a good listener. Pastimes include cooking, sleeping, and music.

characters.name: Mirari
characters.description: The one who crashed Claire's lazy spring break, Mirari is known to be spontaneous. She's easygoing and loves to socialize. Hobbies include board games and gardening.

characters.name: Claire
characters.description: A dutiful student who prefers the company of home or her close friends. Her self-consciousness makes it hard for her to be outgoing, and she has insecurities surrounding dating and sex. Disappointed that university didn't turn out as exciting as she hoped for, she predicts spring break will be no different...

characters.description: Orias wants nothing more than to curl up with a good book and a cup of tea. He may seem stoic, but he's very sensitive to the people around him. Practices light BDSM, and usually takes a Dominant role.

characters.name: Akki
characters.description: A cheerful and happy-go-lucky demon who has a penchant for human food and video games. Like Claire, he's also shy when it comes to sex. Despite that, he's eager to please.

title: Lilium x Triangle

description: Haruka, a succubus from the demon world, came to the human world with one goal: To kiss tons of cute human girls and suck their vital energy! However, she’s had no luck with that and ends up collapsing in the street, only to be found by sisters Yuuna and Sana. She immediately latches onto them and ends up as a freeloader living in their home. Haruka is more than happy being in this predicament, but everything changes when Sana, the younger of the two sisters, confesses to her. Finally awakened by her romantic desires, Haruka comes to a realization that’s going to turn her world upside-down: “It’s a feeling of wanting to be together with someone forever. Spending every day together... That’s why... I can’t hold it back any longer. Because I love...” [From JAST USA]

full_description: Haruka, a succubus from the demon world, came to the human world with one goal: To kiss tons of cute human girls and suck their vital energy! However, she’s had no luck with that and ends up collapsing in the street, only to be found by sisters Yuuna and Sana. She immediately latches onto them and ends up as a freeloader living in their home. Haruka is more than happy being in this predicament, but everything changes when Sana, the younger of the two sisters, confesses to her. Finally awakened by her romantic desires, Haruka comes to a realization that’s going to turn her world upside-down: “It’s a feeling of wanting to be together with someone forever. Spending every day together... That’s why... I can’t hold it back any longer. Because I love...” [From JAST USA]

description: You have been invited to attend a magical school. Here you can make new friends, learn dozens of spells, face exams in the school dungeons, run for class office, and try to find a date for the May Day Ball. But be careful! You might end up in detention, be lured into a secret society, be forced to marry your professor, or even be expelled! Every puzzle has multiple solutions, and the path you choose is up to you. Are you a good witch or a bad witch? [From Official site]

characters.description: Pure unadulterated trouble. According to rumor, Damien is half-incubus, a scheming lothario who love 'em and leaves 'em. What would it take to beat him at his own game? Hall: Falcon [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Ellen Middleton
characters.description: A wildseed student from a non-magical family, Ellen is curious and eager to research how magic actually works. Shy and quiet, but extremely stubborn when her mind is set on a goal. Digging into the secrets of wizards may get her into trouble. Hall: Horse [From Kickstarter]

characters.description: An extremely shy and fairly nerdish girl. She is also Sara's cousin and is very protective of her. Second year student of St. Michael's Girl's Academy. She has been elected as class president two years in a row.

characters.name: Kitajima Sara
characters.description: A popular teen model who has return from overseas to attend St. Michael's to be with her cousin Kaede. Sara has harbored feelings for Kaede ever since childhood. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.description: A second-year high school student. She is smart, attractive, popular and rich girl who is admired by the students of St. Michael's. Yet she falls in love with the clumsy and average Nanami. [Edited from Wikipedia]

Smart, mature and highly charismatic for her age, Runa has won many fans in her class but she is very interested with her teacher Takako and declares she belongs to her. [spoiler]Runa harbors resentment over her older sister Rena, yet unseen in the story, who frequently leaves her alone while she goes out on business trips. Runa's older sister is Takako's former crush, which leads to the relationship between Runa and Takako once they meet for the first time in St. Michael's. [Edit from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Suminoe Takako
characters.description: A former graduate of St. Michael's who is now a teacher at the school's primary division. Takako is very embarrassed that Runa can easily dominate her while stealing her first kiss. [spoiler]She was once in love with Runa's older sister, Rena. [Edit from Wikipedia]

characters.description: A first-year high school student. Despite being a pretty average girl with bad luck, she has caught the attention of the famous Yuuna. [From Wikipedia]

characters.description: A very responsible second year high school student who has some tomboy tendencies. She falls in love with Reo after getting to know a different side of her. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Kawamura Reo
characters.description: A short second year high school student. She is antisocial, a tsundere and in love with Mai. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.description: A half-Japanese and half-European third year high school student. She has come to Japan to learn Japanese culture at St. Michael's, where she has attracted many girls due to her looks, including Shizuku. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Kirishima Shizuku
characters.description: A very traditional Japanese girl in her third year of high school. Having traits of a Yamato nadeshiko, she is very skilled at calligraphy and flower arrangement. She falls in love with Eris after meeting her. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Azumi Risa
characters.description: Class Representative of the Year 1 "Snow" class, and a classmate of Miya's. Has an earnest and hardworking personality. As a hard-nosed person, she often finds herself in leadership positions. She’s what you might call a high-class tsundere girl. While she naturally does well academically and has common sense, whenever she gets into it with Miya, she always gets outreasoned and frequently stomps her feet. Having an unusually strong sense of shame, she gets flustered and briefly digs herself into a hole when thrust into a romantic relationship. The half-Japanese daughter of a foreign company with a British mother. Built like a model, and the owner of enormous breasts. [Translated from Getchu and Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Ayase Miya
characters.description: A student of the Year 1 "Snow" class, and a classmate of Risa's. A prominent genius on campus, but has difficulty in social situations. Doesn’t really take issue with people other than Risa, and socializes as little as possible. Whenever she speaks with Risa it's always abusive, but she's actually covering her own embarrassment. Her speech and behavior always keep others at a distance. She rarely shows her soft side and is unflappable. When she does show her soft side, she becomes timid and casts nervous glances from beneath her lashes. Although you wouldn’t guess it from the way she talks, her behavior is actually quite ladylike. Possessing one of the most prominent intellects on campus, she has been offered the chance to study abroad and even skip grades, but she hates interacting with others, so she enrolled in the not particularly academically demanding school for high-class girls, S

characters.name: Houraisen Rena
characters.description: A new teacher at St. Michael's who is also Runa's older sister and Takako's former tutor. Stylish and stunningly beautiful — the perfect woman. Outgoing and easygoing. Although she’s blunt and untidy, for some reason she has the kind of likable personality that’s impossible to hate. Rena is an alumnus of St. Michael's, and at the time, the teachers all praised her for being a well-behaved lady. But in actuality, she was chasing skirts left and right, regardless if they were seniors or juniors. It’s rumored her lovers numbered at nearly a hundred. [Translated from Getchu and Yurin Yurin]

title: WE KNOW THE DEVIL
description: Anyone can kill the devil; that’s why they always make teens the vampire slayers, the magical girls. But some kids can’t even get that right; and that’s why meangirl Neptune, tomboy Jupiter, and shy shy Venus have to endure one more week of summer camp and each other, singing boring songs about jesus, doing busywork for adults, and hoping god’s radio can’t hear them. description: “It seemed like the start of something new. Something that would change.” You play the role of a senior in high school along with your two best friends, Naomi Patterson and Suzu Cappini. You are also the granddaughter of Harold Anderson, the CEO and founder of Anderson Toys, a toy company sworn to give children amazing products and give a large part of their profit to charity. One day, you get called home to attend your grandfather’s funeral. After the funeral, you learn that you have inherited his large estate. Your father suggests you move in immediately, so the next day, you move out of your parents home and into your estate. When you enter your new home, however, you see five injured, yet very handsome men on the lobby floor. characters.description: The eldest of the incubi brothers. Very smart and nonchalant, he acts as a father figure to the family of brothers. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Erik
characters.description: The second eldest brother and, as Suzu calls him, the ‘Ball of Sex’. He is a giant flirt and loves to keep that fact well-remembered. [From Kickstarter]

characters.description: The middle brother. A hard-ass guy who seems to constantly have a chip on his shoulder. However, he does have good intentions even though he doesn't discreetly show it. [From Kickstarter]

characters.description: The second youngest brother. He is funny, outgoing, and loves to entertain people. He, however, hates to be thought of as a ‘little boy’. [From Kickstarter]

characters.description: Your father, who is very strict with you. Love does not come easily from him, which puts you and him in an odd father-daughter relationship. It’s not very clear why exactly he acts that way, but the whole situation seems to be connected to your grandfather. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Harold Anderson
characters.description: Your grandfather and the deceased CEO of Anderson Toys. He cared for you like his own daughter, and you always helped him with creating toys. A question still remains with the situation with you and your father, though: was there more to your grandfather than you had thought? [From Kickstarter]

characters.description: The leader of the devil boys, a gang of devils set on taking down the incubi boys. [From Kickstarter]

title: It gets so lonely here
description: You are running through a forest. It is late at night and the sky is as black as pitch. The trees which surround you, jutting out of the earth like eerie monuments to a foreign god, are blotting out most of the moonlight. You do not know where you are going. You have no map; no route; no plan. You have no desire, as you run, save to escape. You cannot let yourself be caught. All you can do is run, on and on and on... But, despite all of your hard work, your best efforts will, invariably, be in vain. It’s already too late for you. After all... You’ll never be able to escape from me. [From Itch.io]

description: The game follows a female protagonist named Hannah, as you/she are suddenly thrust into the role as manager of the lingerie store 'Negligee' in a small Beach Front Town. The owner agrees to find her some girls to join her in the shop, but it is down to you to decide who can work at the shop. Making such decisions can be a tricky and fun process. As Hannah must get to grips with managing the store, it's staff and making key decisions to ensure it's success. [From Steam]

characters.description: Favorite undies: Lace Favorite season: Spring Hobby: Working Favorite color: Red Hannah has worked at the store since she was eighteen, hoping to one day use her experience to get a management position herself, always a little unsure about herself and what to try. With the original manager's sudden disappearance, Hannah finally has a chance to prove herself as the new manager at the Negligee store. [Taken from Character Bio Sheet]

characters.description: Favorite undies: Cute Favorite season: Summer Hobby: Basketball Favorite color: Blue Charlotte is a shy young woman. She recently suffered a heartbreak and is looking for a job to take her mind off it. Charlotte enjoys playing basketball and used to be a center in her college team. Now looking to meet new people and find something new, she walks into the shop looking for a job. [Taken from Character Bio Sheet]

Looking for some peace from all her troubles, she enters the school chapel. Within the holy sanctuary, she encounters Naomi and Midori making love. She's immediately taken aback -- "What are they doing? Girls aren't supposed to touch each other like that!" Yet, she can't find the willpower to look away, and a warmth fills her panties as they grow increasingly wet. Before she knows what's happening, she's become the new plaything for the two girls as they teach her about the wonders of sex. [From JAST USA]

characters.name: Komatsuzaki Rie
characters.description: Newly transferred to St. Yale Academy, Rie is a girl who is sad and confused after learning the truth about her stepmother's affair with her first love. Broken hearted, she transferred to the prestigious Catholic girls' school to forget herself. [from J-List]

characters.name: Omamori Midori
characters.description: A girl in Rie's class who is mischievous, Midori is the lover of Naomi. When Rie accidentally spies Midori and Naomi making love in the school chapel, she gets back at her by turning the girl into her personal plaything. [from J-List]

characters.name: Hayakawa Naomi
characters.description: Known as the "Madonna of the School," Naomi is beloved by all the other girls in the school. When Rie spies her playing with Midori in the chapel, her attentions turn to the new arrival at the school. She carries a deep secret inside her. [from J-List]

characters.name: Sister
characters.description: The head nun at the school, Sister is also the teacher of Rie and Midori. A woman with a pure heart on the surface, she also bears a secret she can never tell to another. [from J-List] [spoiler]The mother of Naomi and Rie.

full_description: Rie Komatsuzaki has just transferred to the prestigious St. Yale Academy, a Catholic school for girls, but it's not her choice. After finding her mother romancing her private home tutor, she is now forced to attend this boarding school to keep the incident secret. Sad and confused, she finds herself alone and without friends. Looking for some peace from all her troubles, she enters the school chapel. Within the holy sanctuary, she encounters Naomi and Midori making love. She's immediately taken aback -- "What are they doing? Girls aren't supposed to touch each other like that!" Yet, she can't find the willpower to look away, and a warmth fills her panties as they grow increasingly wet. Before she knows what's happening, she's become the new plaything for the two girls as they teach her about the wonders of sex. [From JAST USA]

title: Harumade, Kururu.
description: A Certain Situation. Of course, even if I put it that way there’s no way I can explain the situation I’m in… In any case, I find myself with 4 other girls on a long spring break far away from civilization. To emphasize how middle of nowhere this is, there isn’t even a convenience store here. I don’t have a cell phone and despite having some rather good laptop computers, I have no way to connect to the internet. All that’s here is a large dormitory the likes you’d see at a hot springs resort and a school that looks like it’s on the verge of closing down. There’s a farm that’s closed and fields with ripening winter vegetables. In the distance you can see snow capped mountains and the beautiful, clear waters of the sea. …and out in the distance stood a tower of unimaginable height who’s purpose was anyone’s guess which stretched into the depths of the sky. This wasn’t a fantasy, or somethin

characters.name: Kazuha Shizuka
characters.description: A girl who speaks in an ojou-sama (young lady) tone. She has a strong-willed, pushy personality and a natural leader-like disposition. Because of her forceful nature, she can come across as hard to approach, but in reality, she cares about others more than anyone. She tends to think things through carefully before acting, but her timing is often abrupt, so she's frequently seen as eccentric or out of sync with those around her. She absolutely loves eating, and mealtimes are always a source of happiness for her. There's nothing she truly dislikes—she even finds joy in poorly made dishes, searching for little moments of happiness in them.

characters.name: Nitou Harumi
characters.description: A really serious committee chairman type of girl. She strives to make everyone have a disciplined life. She's in charge of cooking, and does her best with few ingredients. Since she's very knowledgable on plants, she fetches vegetables from fields as well as edible wild plants from the mountains. She tries to take on the role of mediator for the group, but has problems with what to say to everyone.

characters.name: Miki Akio
characters.description: A girl who uses the masculine first-person pronoun "boku." She has a refreshing personality and loves her solitude—but on the inside, she's a maiden at heart and secretly lonely. She doesn't want to be influenced by others, yet she also hates being left alone. She absolutely loves fishing. Her daily routine is to take her fishing rod to the sea and catch something. She's passionate about improving everyone's diet, which tends to lack animal protein. She's also a voracious reader, and right now she's deeply immersed in the Sherlock Holmes series she found in the school library.

characters.name: Shiren Fuyune
characters.description: A girl who's always cracking silly jokes. She has a disposition that isn't fazed by anything. She sometimes puts on a weak or timid front, but most of the time it's an act— she does it on purpose to lighten everyone's mood and put their hearts at ease. On the other hand, she's oblivious to her own emotional pain, and by the time she notices it, things have already become serious. She's also well-versed in literature—for instance, she lectures Kozakura on the proper order to read the Sherlock Holmes series.

characters.original: アストロラーベのオートマトン

characters.description: Shizuka's Mom and in Charge of the Project of the Story. Picture is from the Updated 17+ Version of Harukuru by Sekai Project.

description: 9th installment in the popular SonoHana yuri eroge series. Suminoe Takako and Houraisen Runa's first date.

characters.name: Houraisen Runa
characters.description: A fifth/sixth grade primary school student and recent transfer at St. Michael's. Smart, mature and highly charismatic for her age, Runa has won many fans in her class but she is very interested with her teacher Takako and declares she belongs to her. [spoiler]Runa harbors resentment over her older sister Rena, yet unseen in the story, who frequently leaves her alone while she goes out on business trips. Runa's older sister is Takako's former crush, which leads to the relationship between Runa and Takako once they meet for the first time in St. Michael's. [Edit from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Suminoe Takako
characters.description: A former graduate of St. Michael's who is now a teacher at the school's primary division. Takako is very embarrassed that Runa can easily dominate her while stealing her first kiss. [spoiler]She was once in love with Runa's older sister, Rena. [Edit from Wikipedia]

full_description: 9th installment in the popular SonoHana yuri eroge series. Suminoe Takako and Houraisen Runa's first date.

description: It was the end of summer, a pleasant smell flaoted in the air. Two girls whose name is Han Hui and He Jia met in the mountains by chance, and they had a wonderful journey which belonged to themselves. [From Steam]

characters.description: Freshman with an introverted personality.

characters.name: He Jia
characters.description: A cheerful, friendly junior high school student.

description: A delicate tale of coming-of-age, with cell phones, and friends in far-off places, and the first blush of unrequited love ... [From insani]

title: Kotonoha Amrilato
title_original: ことのはアムリラート
description: High schooler Rin was just buying a snack in her hometown’s shopping district一but she gets a shock when her surroundings suddenly transform. "...Why is the sky pink...?" She should know this area well, but the unreadable letters on the signs and the strange language the people are speaking have made things unrecognizable. ...Just then, Ruka, a girl so cute she could be an idol, appears and extends a helping hand. Rin, a high schooler who claims to have positivity in spades, and Ruka, a supportive girl who speaks just a smattering of Japanese. This is the story, pure and sometimes frustrating, of two girls intertwined by their fumbling efforts to communicate. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Takatoo Rin
characters.description: A high school student who got lost in another world. Her main charm is... positive thinking! Not really good at studying, but in order to communicate with Ruka, she attempts to learn Juliamo, the language used by people in the parallel world. "...Potatoes were apples?!" [Translated from Official Site]

characters.name: Ruka
characters.description: A middle school student(?) who's taking care of Rin, despite the language barrier. "No... I... re... ally... wa... nt ... to... h... ear... your Japan... ese, Rin." [Translated from Official Site]

characters.name: Rei
characters.description: A woman who works for "Visitant" administration (a bureau that specialises in handling new arrivals from other worlds. Japanese translation of the term is 訪問者) She normally works as a librarian at a library close by. [Translated from Official Site]

characters.description: One of Ruka's classmates

characters.name: Helena

title: Blackberry Honey
description: Set in England during the mid-19th century, Blackberry Honey is a tale about maids, music, and unexpected romance. The story begins when our heroine, Lorina Waugh, is fired from her previous position as a maid in the stately home of Hartwell. With a large family back in Liverpool to support and a string of unsavoury comments circulating about her rather sudden dismissal, Lorina’s search for a new place of employment leads her to Bly. Bly is an old, tumbledown building owned by the Lennard family, situated in the middle of the English countryside. Bly is dreary, remote, and isolated, and is veiled under an almost constant downpour of rain. As might be expected, Lorina hates it immediately. Forced to work for fourteen hours a day, with little chance to rest, Lorina is bullied by the senior maids and, most embarrassingly of all, by the twelve-year-old daughter of the Lennard family, Lady Co

title: Negai no Kakera to Hakugin no Agreement
title_original: 願いの欠片と白銀の契約者
description: For as long as anyone knows, beings called "Puppets" have been an invisible part of our world. They operate in service of a force unknown, quietly manipulating the course of history. Hajiro Mina is an ordinary high-school girl and the protagonist of this story. One day, she has a chance encounter with one of these Puppets, setting her on a trajectory to meet three girls—and ultimately changing her life forever. The girls belong to an organization that specializes in the extermination of Puppets. They have been granted extraordinary powers by a doll named Ruka, and their job is to locate and eradicate the inhuman enemies lurking in the crowds. As Mina finds herself entangled in this supernatural conflict, it becomes clearer with each passing day that there are greater forces at play. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Jack F Munemori
characters.original: ジャック・F・ムネモリ

characters.name: Jessica Francois Magritte
characters.original: ジェシカ・フランソワ・マグリット
characters.description: Ten years old, daughter of an English diplomat and a renowned French violinist. She attends an international school not far from Mina’s high school. Because her parents frequently travel out of the country, Jessica is a lonely girl who covets a more ordinary family. Consequently, she has a propensity to condescend to those around her. She’s keenly perceptive to others’ emotions, often unconsciously empathizing with someone’s anxieties, loneliness, or other emotional distress. She never seems able to express her empathy compassionately, however, which is a source of much of her frustration and self-loathing. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Hajiro Mina
characters.description: Fifteen years old, a first-year high-school student, and the story’s protagonist. Mina is an ordinary girl attending a public school. Her father passed away when she was a child, and she was raised by her mother. Shortly after entering elementary school, she began helping her mother prepare food and do chores. At a glance, Mina seems frail and delicate, stimulating the protective instincts of those around her, but at her core is an intractable spirit of innocence. This pureheartedness inspires trust in people she interacts with. Mina has taken to visiting a doll gallery most days on her way home from school, and it is there she meets the Eidos called Ruka. Inadvertently resonating with Ruka, Mina becomes her fourth emissary and finds herself entangled in a conflict with the Puppets. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Sumerami Riko
characters.description: Sixteen years old, a first-year at the same school as Mina. She has no parents and lives alone—save for one butler—in the largest, most historic mansion in the city. Riko is a quiet girl, reclusive and disinterested in the world around her. She expends no effort to make friends at school, and she actively avoids interacting with the other students. A family secret seems to be at the heart of her antisocial tendencies, however. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Yang Li-Ling
characters.description: Twenty-one years old, owner of the best high-class Chinese restaurant in Chinatown, and member of a massive Chinese business conglomerate. She is the only daughter of Yang Li-Fang (a.k.a. Grandma), owner and curator of the doll gallery Pygmalion. Her mother taught her the truth about the world from a young age, but an event in their past damaged their relationship, and presently, they are on less-than-friendly terms. As a result, she sometimes has trouble keeping her emotions in check. [From MangaGamer]

description: The 10th installment in the widely known series Sono Hanabira, featuring the 5th couple. Shizuku is the embodiment of pure and gracious Japanese womanhood, to whom all fashions become. Eris is a platinum blonde beauty from overseas. Their long-awaited union is here, and it's passionate!! The yuri pair dance tsundere coy vs. direct and cool, with Eris ever more obsessed, while Shizuku gently resists... "Wa-- Wait, Eris, ahhnn, not now... you can't touch me like this now... ahhhhnnn...!" [Edited from DLsite English]

characters.name: Shitogi Eris
characters.description: A half-Japanese and half-European third year high school student. She has come to Japan to learn Japanese culture at St. Michael's, where she has attracted many girls due to her looks, including Shizuku. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Kirishima Shizuku
characters.description: A very traditional Japanese girl in her third year of high school. Having traits of a Yamato nadeshiko, she is very skilled at calligraphy and flower arrangement. She falls in love with Eris after meeting her. [From Wikipedia]

title_original: ツユチル・レター～海と栞に雨音を～
description: The prestigious private girls' school, Kikyou Academy, educates young ladies from elementary age to university. With cell phones forbidden on school grounds, letter writing is a pastime for many of the girls. One day, Shiori Minato is asked out by an older girl she doesn't know--Mikoto Kurahashi. Shiori: "She's confessing to me... But why does she look so angry?" Still, she says yes, thinking of it as an opportunity to build something between them. One day, popular student Mikoto Kurahashi receives a blackmail letter, threatening to harm her sister, Yumi Kurahashi, unless she asks out a first-year student named Shiori Minato. At first, Mikoto thinks it's a prank--until Yumi gets hurt. So, she asks Shiori out in order to protect her sister. Mikoto: "Was so she desperate to date me that she'd resort to blackmail?" Mikoto starts dating Shiori believing her to be the blackmailer. At the same

characters.name: Minato Shiori
characters.description: Class: Chrysanthemum, First Year Club Affiliation: Sewing Club A quiet, gentle, nondescript girl. However, she's quick-thinking and has a strong sense of self. She enjoys sewing and crocheting, and has a tendency to get lost in her own little world. When Mikoto asks her out, she senses something guarded about her that intrigues her. Although she doesn't understand Mikoto's true intentions, she decides to do her best to make things work between them. Aoi seems to like her and often talks to her, but she doesn't know what her intentions might be, either. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Kurahashi Mikoto
characters.description: Class: Camellia, Second Year Club Affiliation: None One of the prettiest and most popular girls in school. She receives a lot of love letters, but dislikes how many people ask her out based on her looks alone. Cool and aloof, she prefers to be on her own, and isn’t often found hanging out with other girls. She cares deeply for her sickly younger sister, Yumi, and has always felt a strong duty to protect her. However, she herself seems to rely on Yumi in some ways. She starts dating Shiori in order to keep Yumi safe, despite suspecting that Shiori is her blackmailer. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Kurahashi Yumi
characters.description: Class: Lily, First Year Club Affiliation: None Mikoto's younger sister. She's been sick from a very young age. When at school, she spends most of her time in Infirmary Room 2, studying on her own, although she's often absent from school altogether due to hospitalizations and appointments. Since no one else spends as much time in the infirmary as she does, she treats the room as her own, decorating it with her personal things. She usually has her nose in a book and, having had to grapple with her own mortality, has a more mature personality than her elder sister and a more philosophical outlook on life. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Aiba Maho
characters.description: Class: Chrysanthemum, First Year Club Affiliation: Social Issues Society Shiori's good friend and classmate, she's a kind and caring girl with a bubbly personality and a penchant for gossip. She puts others before herself and is a late bloomer when it comes to romance. As Yumi's confidante, she sometimes visits her in the infirmary and delivers letters on her behalf. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Tachibana Aoi
characters.description: Class: Wisteria, Third Year President of the Student Council, Aoi is a responsible, hardworking student. Although she's rumored to have been linked to many girls, she's actually single. She likes to flirt with Shiori. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Fushimi Nagisa
characters.description: Class: Camellia, Second Year A tomboyish girl who's friends with Mikoto. She doesn't like to hang around in big groups, making her and Mikoto a well-matched pair. She's not much of a gossip herself, but due to working on the school newspaper, all kinds of rumors find their way to her ears. Still, she hates when people assume she knows everything that's going on. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Younger student
characters.description: First year student who shows Shiori to Minato at the beginning of the story.

title: Kimihane: Kanojo to Kanojo no Koi Suru Ikkagetsu
title_original: きみはね 彼女と彼女の恋する１ヶ月
description: Hina, Rin and Fumi are new roommates at Seiba Girls’ School. Even though they had different personalities and upbringings, they had one thing in common: they recall seeing an angel when they were small. They each suspected that one of the other girls was actually an angel. [Edited From Hau~ Omochikaeri!]

characters.name: Natsume Hina
characters.description: "I won’t allow any deviancy in this room as long as I live!" A pure-hearted, uncomplicated girl. Though she can be childish, she tends to take charge and enjoys caring for others. She's a bit of a prude, but when she falls in love, she's the type to devote herself completely to her partner. The jealous type. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Ogata Rin
characters.description: "I'll marry Asou and we'll keep Hina as our pet! That's my ideal life!" A nihilistic pedant. Everyone in her class thinks of her as a cool beauty, but that image completely falls apart at home. The awkward type who understands love in theory but has trouble putting it into practice. A lonely pushover and a natural bottom. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Asou Fumi
characters.description: "If you're going to marry me, you'd better treat me right." Kind and sweet, the conscience of the room. She used to be in the Home Ec Club, and gets plenty of use out of those skills in her dorm room. Takes on a mothering role, including making everyone's lunch every morning. She projects serenity, but is steadfast at heart. She's able to see through people and discern what they really want, and will use that to her advantage. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Takaoka Sachiko
characters.description: "Wanna model for me? If you do it nude, I'll throw in another 10,000!" A half-ass. Carefree, footloose, and uninhibited. She's in charge of the dorm, but doesn’t take the job too seriously, sending the students to buy her cigarettes and such. Her hobbies are loving cute girls and painting. She’s asked the three girls to model nude for her, but none of them have taken her up on it. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Takaoka Miyako
characters.description: A beautiful, mysterious girl who joins the three as their new roommate. She's pure-hearted and easily moved, demure yet forward. A snooze-monster who sleeps a ton. [From MangaGamer]

title: Mugen Renkan ~Chijoku ni Mamireshi Fushiki no Rinbu~
title_original: 無限煉姦～恥辱にまみれし不死姫の輪舞～
description: A girl blessed with immortal life and cursed with a cruel fate seeks a future for herself. The protagonist lived in a world with a strict and ever present class system. She was the slave of a deformed, vulgar master, and endured his mental and physical abuse each and every day. However, she accidentally received eternal life from the king of their world, and was stripped of what little rights remained to her. The people descended upon her with cruelty and malice. They played with her, knowing that she could not die. The protagonist wanted to be free of such an eternity, but could not even commit suicide... However, someone told her that if she killed the king, she could also die. She attempted such a murder, failed, and had to escape from the town, her pursuers hot on her heels. An unfathomable length of time would then pass in which she would meet other people and have to part from them

characters.name: Protagonist
characters.description: A white-haired woman. She has no memory of her past and doesn't know how old she is. In the game's first chapter, she was a slave owned by Geg, a tentacle monster.

characters.name: Putin
characters.description: A native American girl living with her tribe members. She holds a grudge against the protagonist.

characters.name: Mary
characters.description: A friend, [spoiler]companion, and mentor of the protagonist. She is one of the mistresses of Gustave. Gentle but strong-willed, she has supported the protagonist in many ways during her long journey.

characters.name: Mildiom
characters.description: An upper-class woman in the King's World. She felt jealous of the protagonist when the King enjoyed and praised the latter's dance performance. She has been trying to find ways to humiliate the protagonist since then.

characters.name: Little
characters.description: A white-haired, mysterious girl.

characters.name: Roana
characters.description: An innocent village girl. She was saved by Gustave one day. After the incident, she has lived in his castle with other Gustave's mistresses.

characters.name: Tokie
characters.description: A girl living in a remote, secluded village. She takes care of her sick mother and tries to save her life by using the protagonist's blood. She is a competent swordsman.

characters.name: Shizuka
characters.description: An exorcist. She asked the protagonist for help when she was assigned to remove a strong, evil spirit living in a forest.

characters.name: Miyuki
characters.description: A girl who looks like the protagonist. She likes dancing and considers to make it professional.

characters.name: Di-pu
characters.description: A crazy scientist, a former resident of the King's World.

characters.name: Revash
characters.description: The king's loyal servant and a chivalrous warrior. He sees the King as a god-like figure and obeys the King's every order. Despite being a skilful swordsman, he doesn't like violence and avoids conflicts as much as possible.

characters.name: Zowabo
characters.description: A mysterious young man who helps the protagonist from time to time. He is a big fan of the protagonist's dance.

characters.name: King
characters.description: An immortal king. Rumour said the King has created the world by [spoiler]herself.

characters.name: Geg
characters.description: A frog-like creature with tentacles. He is a slave master of the protagonist in the King's World. Dim-witted and timid, he has tried to please the King but to no avail. He blames his failure to the protagonist and lashes out at her.

full_description: A girl blessed with immortal life and cursed with a cruel fate seeks a future for herself. The protagonist lived in a world with a strict and ever present class system. She was the slave of a deformed, vulgar master, and endured his mental and physical abuse each and every day. However, she accidentally received eternal life from the king of their world, and was stripped of what little rights remained to her. The people descended upon her with cruelty and malice. They played with her, knowing that she could not die. The protagonist wanted to be free of such an eternity, but could not even commit suicide... However, someone told her that if she killed the king, she could also die. She attempted such a murder, failed, and had to escape from the town, her pursuers hot on her heels. An unfathomable length of time would then pass in which she would meet other people and have to part from them

title: A Summer's End - Hong Kong 1986
description: Michelle is a young professional working woman living in Hong Kong during the heydays of the 1980s. She meets Sam, a free-spirited woman and an unconventional entrepreneur, by chance after an incident involving a broken heel. They share a mutual attraction. As their relationship progresses, Michelle is forced to make a decision between traditional propriety and her newfound feelings. A Summer’s End is a modern romance. It is a story about seeking identity and meaning in a rapidly changing world where conflicting worldviews and cultures collide. It is a new media homage to Asian cinema and Hong Kong’s golden age of entertainment. [From The Official Site]

characters.name: Sam Wong
characters.description: A free-spirited woman who runs a video shop.

characters.name: Michelle Cheung
characters.description: A young professional living in Hong Kong. She has lived a relatively sheltered life, thanks in part to her conservative mother, and her life is little more than a routine of home, work, and back again. She is content with her life and one day knows she will marry a suitable man and settle into a perfectly acceptable life as a wife and mother—but fate has other plans.

characters.name: Joey
characters.description: Michelle's co-worker. He was studying at an American University, and currently, he came home to search for a wife.

characters.name: Cecilia
characters.description: Owner of the nightclub Ruby. Sam's friend and former boss.

characters.name: Mrs. Cheung
characters.description: Michelle's mother. She has a high expectation of her daughter and places a strict restriction on Michelle's social life, aka. a tiger mother.

characters.name: Mr. Wong
characters.description: Sam's father. A cobbler.
