full_description: The protagonist Tsukioka Akira is a normal guy living his usual life, except for one thing. His twin sister is sickly and is in the hospital and can’t go to school. Problem is that she’s been sick for too long and she may have to repeat the year, or worse drop out of school. So their parents being the most clever people in the world, decided to send him, the splitting image of his sister, over to the all-girls prestigious school to go undercover as his sister, and live her life for a while so that when she comes back, she can take his place without dropping out of school or repeating. Of course it’s a stupid idea and he resisted, but him, being someone who is easily swept away, gave in. So thereon starts his incredible life in an all girls school. [From Accany's Review]

title: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Atelier no Koibito-tachi
title_original: その花びらにくちづけを　アトリエの恋人たち
description: The second visual novel featuring Azumi Risa and Ayase Miya. The dust has settled from the boisterous Best Couple's events, the graduation ceremony of the third-year students has passed without incident, and Risa has returned to her laid-back daily lifestyle. Although Miya continues to flaunt her chronic truancy in Risa's face, now that the two are passionate lovers, their days are full of joy. Today, once again, they find themselves passing the time in the attic of the old school building, in the secret atelier known only to them as has become their habit. The overly-serious Risa is feeling a slight twinge of guilt at their appropriation of this room. She asks Miya to tell her the story of how she discovered this place, but in this atelier hides a sweet, sweet romance that Risa couldn't begin to imagine... [Excerpt from translated synopsis]

characters.name: Azumi Risa
characters.description: Class Representative of the Year 1 "Snow" class, and a classmate of Miya's. Has an earnest and hardworking personality. As a hard-nosed person, she often finds herself in leadership positions. She’s what you might call a high-class tsundere girl. While she naturally does well academically and has common sense, whenever she gets into it with Miya, she always gets outreasoned and frequently stomps her feet. Having an unusually strong sense of shame, she gets flustered and briefly digs herself into a hole when thrust into a romantic relationship. The half-Japanese daughter of a foreign company with a British mother. Built like a model, and the owner of enormous breasts. [Translated from Getchu and Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Ayase Miya
characters.description: A student of the Year 1 "Snow" class, and a classmate of Risa's. A prominent genius on campus, but has difficulty in social situations. Doesn’t really take issue with people other than Risa, and socializes as little as possible. Whenever she speaks with Risa it's always abusive, but she's actually covering her own embarrassment. Her speech and behavior always keep others at a distance. She rarely shows her soft side and is unflappable. When she does show her soft side, she becomes timid and casts nervous glances from beneath her lashes. Although you wouldn’t guess it from the way she talks, her behavior is actually quite ladylike. description: Frankel was hated as a wicked necromancer and an abhorred man. But he was not evil, he was just an unpopular, socially awkward loser who liked the undead. However, society thought poorly of him as a necromancer, and he was shunned, hated, and finally defeated by the heroes Cain and Flora. Just before death, Frankel invoked a forbidden curse that would make him the King of the Dead. However, the magic failed, and he thought he would simply die...but for some reason, he is reborn as Yuricia, daughter of Cain and Flora, with the memories of his previous life! A love for the undead! All women—be they malicious bullies or not—are goddesses! Inside this dainty, pretty girl lies abnormal principles. characters.original: ユリィシア・アルベルト
characters.description: This work's protagonist. Female. The reincarnated form of a necromancer originally known as the [King of the Abyss]. He failed in the secret technique to become an undead king, but succeeded in reincarnating himself into the womb of the nearby Flora. She has a fairly unique code of ethics that is as follows: - Healing magic is used to strengthen her magical ability - She judges others based on their compatibility with the undead - Hot guys should die - Using powerful magic is ecstasy She possesses a fairly destructive nature. However, for whatever reason, what she does and achieves benefits the world and people, so those who adore her are endless. Therefore, she is called Light of Endeside and Angel of Reunir. She maintains a lot of cheat abilities, but her combat ability is basically nonexistent. [From Steam]

title: Seisai no Resonance
description: Otofuse Island is a remote island located south of the mainland. While it is a beautiful sightseeing place surrounded by clear seas and lush forests, it is also bound by tradition. A long time ago, a giant fireball came down from the sky, burning the island for three whole days. Since the men were out fishing, it was up to the women to control the flames and protect the island. They sealed the fire so that it would not ravage the island again. Even now, a sealing ritual is performed by a selected pair of mikos. Kanae came to Otofuse Island looking for her mother who was formerly a miko there, but had went missing 7 years ago. She also had an acceptance letter into Sakihana all-girls academy. However, she was attacked by a girl from the island’s secret organization Shouraikai which is in charge of the rituals, then found out that her enrollment had been revoked. Leaving the school grounds

characters.description: Eccentric woman whose mission in life is to solve crimes of passion. [spoiler]Her real name is Rose. She is very sensitive about her eyes and always keeps them hidden behind sunglasses. Chrys is the first person she's shown them to in years.[spoiler] [From in-game profile]

characters.name: Romance Cop
characters.description: Polite, sensible young member of the police force. [spoiler]As a child she was quite the troublemaker. She has since changed her ways - instead of always breaking the rules, she enforces them. [From in-game profile]

characters.name: Lupin
characters.description: A guy with no self respect. This fact alone makes him dangerous. He's a genius when it comes to things like building rockets, but even that can't make up for his attitude toward other people. [From in-game profile]

characters.name: Flower Shop Owner
characters.description: Large man whose passion in life is taking care of flowers. He's quite popular with women and children; especially little old ladies! He always says he's taken, but his one true love is botany. [From in-game profile]

characters.name: Police Chief
characters.description: Petite and robust woman who runs the Lovebloom Police Department. [spoiler]Rose's first real friend. Feels strong affection toward her and Romance Cop.[spoiler] [From in-game profile]

characters.name: Cupid
characters.description: Winged being who oversees romantic love throughout the world. [spoiler]Often referred to by different names and genders, but isn't at all concerned with what mortals call them. [From in-game profile]

characters.name: Romance Thief
characters.description: Small child who prides herself in her ability to sneak around undetected. She's very nimble, but not too bright. She has a crush on Stephan. [From in-game profile]

title: Amaranto
description: Amaranto is a yuri visual novel by Trifolium Garden. Set in a post apocalyptic world, the plot has a somewhat fantastic and mysterious vibe. The story follows Mio, who tries to unravel the rumors behind several murders happening in her district. Set in a world split into various districts, the story begins with Mio and her childhood friend, Shizuku, going to school. At school, they talk to their friend, Yuki, about rumors regarding several recent “vampiric” murders and a girl in white. [Summary edited from Listless Ink]

characters.name: Mio
characters.description: Mio is a brave orphan girl who lives with her childhood friend Shizuku in the city ruled be Queen's Crescent. She is a bit lazy, carefree and bad at cooking but caring and quite mature. Mio always carrying the rapier with her and is quite good in fencing.

characters.name: Shizuku
characters.description: Mio's childhood friend. Most of the time quite timid and calm girl she could be quite stubborn than it comes to necessary things. She is good at cooking and very emphatic. [spoiler]She lost her trust in the people in past. She was the part of small sect but other members threated her badly because of Shizu's foreign look. Mother protected her from bullying but after her death situation worsened and Shizu had to run away. Shizuku was a loner till she met Mio.

characters.name: Ayaka
characters.description: Ayaka is the mysterious woman from rebel organization Atheista. [spoiler]Her real name is Ayaka Fehde Falcon. She is Atheista's supervisor and current Leader of Sect Falcon. She wants to take a revenge on Queen and Queencroiz because of her parents death despite the fact that Sect Falcon started the war 7 years ago.

characters.name: Azoth
characters.description: Vampire girl who serves the Queencroiz and claimed to be the barer of the End. She is Queen's lover. [spoiler]She was the daughter of alchemists. After her parents death Azoth was raised in a church orphanage. Than some bandits attacked the church she was saved by Ria and Queen. Soon she fell in love with the Queen and left with her. Azoth was killed during the attack on Sect Falcon's palace and resurrected later by Nero.

characters.name: Ria
characters.description: Main heroine of the story. Ria is the mysterious fighter who observes Sect Queencroiz. [spoiler]She was the former member of Queencroiz, Queens best friernd and oldest of the Four Heavenly kings. But left the sect after her twin-sisters death cause she can't bare the new Queens politic and behavior.

characters.name: Queen
characters.description: Fine, known as Queen is the head of Sect Queencroiz and formal antagonist of the story. She wishes to bring the End and rebuild the world there would be no fighting. [spoiler]Her parents died during the Last war. After that Fine decided to gather her own group and end all the fighting. But after the war with Sect Falcon her personality start to change quite drastically.

characters.name: Maki
characters.description: One of the Ayaka's subordinates who likes to tease Ayaka and Mio. [spoiler]In fact Maki is Sect Falcon's capitan of the Royal Guard and Ayaka's personal bodyguard.

characters.name: Mana
characters.description: Ria's younger twin-sister. She died during the fight in Sect Falcon's palace. It's hinted that she had a crush on the Queen.

characters.name: Nero
characters.description: Queen's personal aide. Nothing is known about her past. [spoiler]She is the one who resurrected Azoth and the Triad and put the power to bring the End in Azoth. Nero is quite skilled fighter and could control other people with her power.

characters.name: Yuuki
characters.description: Mio's and Shizuku's best friend. She known as Yuuki the Informant because of her ability to get any information and rumors about the events in the city. [spoiler]In fact she is the Atheista Leader's daughter and quite skilfull fighter.

characters.name: Troy
characters.description: One of the Triad(or Three Heavenly Kings) as they called. Troy is the calm girl with quite boyish look, who admired Ria a lot in the past but wants to defeat her now. [spoiler]She was Ria's apprentice and it's hinted that she had a crush on her. She died during the fight in Sect Falcon's palace but was resurrected by Nero.

characters.name: Sion
characters.description: Sect Falcon's general. Appears only in Ayaka's route.

characters.name: Master
characters.description: The owner of the cafe there Atheista's main base located. He is good at cooking but has some unnatural love for strawberries so add them in any new dish he created. Ayaka mentioned that he is quite a good fighter too.

characters.name: Anne
characters.description: One of the Triad. She has a severe interest in Mio. It's hinted that she had yuri relationships with her twin-sister Thue. [spoiler]She was killed during the battle for Sect Falcon's palace and resurrected by Nero.

characters.name: Thue
characters.description: One of the Triad. It's hinted that she had yuri relationships with her twin-sister Anne. She always challenges with her sister but likes her a lot. [spoiler]She was killed during the battle for Sect Falcon's palace and resurrected by Nero.

characters.name: Leader
characters.description: Leader of the rebel group The Breakers. [spoiler]She had a grudge on Ria but decided to help her in Azoth and Shizuku's routes

She depends on Saeka a lot, and since the latter always comforts her in times of need, Yuno can feels as though she can talk about her problems without a care in the world. Tamaki wishes with all her might that she could keep watching over Yuno, who’s always been number one in her heart... but the circumstances around her are changing, little by little. It's not only one girl she has to keep watch over now, after all. Saeka has always been dependable and supportive, and Tamaki's has begun to feel confused... “Sigh... Looks like she always needs someone by her side too...” Saeka still has a crush on Yuno, but has been enraptured by Tamaki's aura, and finds that she can’t leave her alone. Although having the appearance of a kid, she tries to act like an adult towards the girls, but things don't turn out the way she expects it to. At her core, she's optimistic, positive, and somewhat clumsy. A graduate from Ayanan high school and former student council president before Natsuki and Mio, she worries about whether or not she's seen as a kid but tries to ignore that fact. Because of that, she admires Yuuno's cheerfulness and Tamaki's friendliness. Her home is of ninja lineage, her grandmother being a ninja herself. characters.description: "Tama-chan, you should always look at me more! Don't you think so too, Sae-chan?" She's an energetic girl who'll take a stab at anything. She has faith beyond that of a normal friend towards Saeka who looks after her. They're complete opposites of each other, but both get along strangely enough. Yuuno's desire from when she was a kid… of wanting to have Tamaki to always look at her… has made her want to be an idol. characters.description: "Ayame-chan… always be by my side. Promise me…" Height: Short Figure: Fair Appearance: Mature Hobbies: Reading, watching movies, doing things alone in her room Slightly reserved and shy around people, Hina met Ayame after transferring middle schools in her 3rd year. Thanks to her, she was able to fit in with everyone in class. They even shared the same classes together. Because of her genuine adoration of Ayame's cheerfulness and sociability, Hina has been gradually holding special feelings towards her -- even now. Lately, her shyness has lessened a bit while hanging out with her and the other girls to the point where she can be assertive to Ayame. She can be lost and worried at times, but her love for Ayame grows by the day. It would mean the world to her if she could answer Hina's feelings. Featured in Drama CD Vol. 1 "Koigokoro Furenzu" (Love Friends) [Translated from Official Site]

characters.name: Segawa Ayame
characters.description: "If it's for your sake, Hina, I'll do whatever I can! I mean it!" Height: Average Figure: So-so Appearance: Boisterous Hobbies: Window shopping for clothes and jewelry (If I can afford it, I'll buy!) Energetic, lively, and popular, Ayame is the life of the party with many thoughts of Hina in mind. Although optimistic and resilient, she has her share of worries and can be relatively lonely. Her grades slip since she's always looking at Hina. Thanks to this, Ayame considers herself lucky to receive her tutelage. Naturally, she'll do her best whenever Hina cheers her on. She's into fashion but has been more interested in tampering with Hina's hair, choosing her clothes, and things of that nature. As long as she's happy, so too is Ayame. Featured in Drama CD Vol. 1 "Koigokoro Furenzu" (Love Friends) [Translated from Official Site]

characters.name: Shiina Mayu
characters.description: "I'm happy that I like Mai… but it's not because of her, okay...?" Height: Average Figure: Slender Appearance: Lovely Special Skills: Feigning friendliness, drawing art Mai's older sister. Graceful as ever and popular with the boys, in reality, however, she's lazy and sees the world around her as bothersome. Her adoration from other girls has gone up of late, but she has no eyes for anyone else except for Mai. After knowing that her sister will support her whatever the circumstances may be, Mayu has gotten more confident about being her true self. Despite trying to thank Mai for that, she still can't be honest with herself yet… Since she pushes her tedious, everyday necessities on Mai (doesn't mind it at all), Mayu is pretty bad at the basics of domestic chores but has been helping Mai out lately and has even reached a point where she can cook on her own, though her room is a mess. Mayu

Height: Tall Figure: Supple Appearance: Cool Special Skill: Sports in general (specifically running types) Mayu's younger sister. Talented in sports and always popular with the ladies, because she knows in her heart that the one she likes the most is Mayu, Mai doesn't worry about what other people think. Despite looking after her older sister, she gets really excited sometimes over their closeness so much that Mayu ends up scolding her. Mai likes that side of her too and even thinks about how much more she can pamper her. Internally, she's a bit drawn to the feminity of girls. One of her specialties is cooking since she takes care of the house chores and cooking in place of Mayu. Recently, she went shopping with Mayu and became very interested in pumps that she usually doesn't wear,

characters.description: "I hate it when Ibu acts like a perv. But… I do kind of like that side of her in a way…" Height: Short Figure: Chagrin Appearance: Tiny yet cute Favorite Things: Any sweet candy, any doll given by Ibuki The only daughter of the Kugayama household and the so-called upper class girl, Alice acts like a total tsundere specifically to Ibuki, but likes her nonetheless. She's completely frank with her friends and is quite diligent. Looking up to Ibuki who's watched over her since she was a kid, Alice has grown to love her, wanting to spoil her when given the chance but doesn't know how to be honest with herself. At times she can be in a pouty mood, to which Ibuki uses this as an opportunity to mess with her. Her feelings of wanting to be with the one she loves is true indeed, but there's absolutely no way she herself would reveal something so embarrassing. Alice has called Ibuki as "Ibu," a nic

characters.name: Oribe Ibuki
characters.description: "I love you so much, Alice. So that means it's perfectly legal to squeeze and kiss you all over, huh!" Height: Tall Figure: Plump Appearance: Fluffy Onee-san Hobbies: Messing with Alice, being messed with by Alice, collecting cute things Alice's childhood friend who lives and works as a maid in the Kugayama household. Alice always finds her annoying, but Ibuki sees that as her way of showing love. Everyone knows she's quite polished in the art of perversion, although she doesn't consider it like that. She likes Alice so much that Ibuki's every move is centered around her. She's always smiling, able to complete anything at will but can't handle scary things in general, like ghost stories, rollercoasters, and thunder. Another nickname she calls Alice by besides Milady is "Awe-chan," which she came up with when they were young. Alice would shy away upon hearing that name. Featured in Drama

characters.name: Ayasaka Ayumi
characters.description: "Hehe. Waka-chan, you're so cute. Even when you get a bit too lively, you're still cute~." Height: Average Figure: Fairly good Appearance: Tense Hobby/Skill: Sewing, knitting, collecting cute, small things Although normally cheerful and calm, Ayumi has such a serious and caring personality that she can't help herself from taking an obedient role when Waka comes into the picture. Waka has been tagging along with her since they met in middle school. Ayumi doesn't hate the fun she has or the clamor she makes, but is rather grateful to Waka that she's let her discover new sides of herself that she had never known about. Compelled by Waka who has thrown her feelings straight at Ayumi, they've reached a point where they can share in each other's feelings. Ayumi's room is held captive by dolls she made herself. She's currently in the handicrafts club. Featured in Drama CD Vol. 4 "Himitsu Rireis

characters.name: Uzaki Waka
characters.description: "Ayumi-senpa~i! I love you so muchhh! Ayuumi-senpa~~~i!!!" Height: Short Figure: TBD Appearance: Kerfuffle Favorite Things: Ayumi, meat, and cute, small things Ayumi gives her (despite dropping them often) A simplistic dork of a girl whom people find loving yet irritating at the same time, even though she has lots of friends. characters.name: Kagami Hare
characters.description: "Seira, show me some more of that shyness of yours. I'll do the same for you. Sound good…?" Height: Tall Figure: Reasonable Appearance: Frank Special Skills: Cramming overnight before tests, taming animals, sports in general (specifically ball game ones) Cheerful, sociable, and having lots of friends, Hare is the student council president. Seen as candid and reliable, she's good at dealing with things and is at the ready when called on. Although attracted by Seira, who progresses forward and faces things head on, Hare does worry about her, but thanks to the time she's spent with Seira, they both were able to throw their feelings at each other, making their true intentions heard. Hare does the big jobs of the student council (and lets Seira handle the minor stuff). Featured in Drama CD Vol. 5 "Zawameki, Tokimeki, Yappa Suki" (lit. Commotion, Throbbing, Love Nevertheless) [Translated from

characters.name: Hitsuji Seira
characters.description: "Hare, you're always, always showing off. Why… can't you just do that to only me?" Height: Average Figure: Distinguished Appearance: Sparkling Special Skills?: Decorating small things with peace signs, memorization, simple stuff involving mental arithmetic, making a smile at work Hardworker, confident, and somewhat of an airhead, Seira is the student council vice president, who is often seen as sociable and tries to act that way, though she's nervous around strangers. She doesn't want to accept that truth, however. She always sees Hare as her rival but losses to her in the slimmest of margins. She does, nonetheless, maintain her straightforwardness of saying what she wants. Seeing Hare flustered gives her a slight sense of superiority. She's at peace of mind when Hare accepts her challenges, no matter what it is. Seira is in charge of the minor details left over by Hare during student co

characters.name: Mariya Natsuki
characters.description: "Ahh~…Mio's fluffiness is too awesome~…" Height: Short Figure: Could be better Appearance: Lazy Favorite Things: Napping while laying head on Mio's lap, games (mainly smartphone apps), fish sausage Natsuki, who is lazy and finds most things bothersome, is Mio's childhood friend. She doesn't have the energy to do basic tasks but is quick-witted when it comes to planning out fun stuff to do. Her relationship with Mio, who she relies on, hasn't changed so much, even after confirming each other's feelings, but being together with her has made her happy more than ever. She'll go at her own leisurely pace while having those kinds of thoughts in mind. Since her mom is a fashion magazine editor, Natsuki will sometimes work as a part-time amateur model in there (is actually made to), though she doesn't have the self-awareness for the job. Featured in Drama CD Vol. 6 "Beside You" [Translated from

characters.name: Kasugai Mio
characters.description: "My goodness, you're so spoiled, Nat-chan~ But that makes me happy~♪. Height: Tall Figure: Fair Appearance: Fluffy Favorite Things: Natsuki's frizzy hair, spicy food (Natsuki would die if she ate that) Even if agitated by others, Mio, Natsuki's childhood friend, will always maintain her smile with a calm, gentle demeanor. She goes at her own pace and is overprotective of Natsuki, though some might see this as a curse than a blessing. Although she would like Natsuki to be a little bit more responsible, Mio can't stop herself from wanting to help her out. After having the confidence of realizing each other's feelings, the two have been pretty much inseparable. It kind of bothers Mio when she's seen as someone older due to her plain clothes, and she has some worry about her weight as well. Featured in Drama CD Vol. 6 "Beside You". [Translated from Official Site]

full_description: Yuno loves Tamaki’s smile, and wants her to witness her dreams coming true.... though having not seen much of Tamaki lately, Yuno’s been feeling somewhat down. She depends on Saeka a lot, and since the latter always comforts her in times of need, Yuno can feels as though she can talk about her problems without a care in the world. Tamaki wishes with all her might that she could keep watching over Yuno, who’s always been number one in her heart... but the circumstances around her are changing, little by little. It's not only one girl she has to keep watch over now, after all. Saeka has always been dependable and supportive, and Tamaki's has begun to feel confused... “Sigh... Looks like she always needs someone by her side too...” Saeka still has a crush on Yuno, but has been enraptured by Tamaki's aura, and finds that she can’t leave her alone. description: Welcome to the Volcano Kingdom! The Volcano Goddess has blessed the land of her people. She brought prosperity to a country flourishing in a medieval era. After the death of your late wife, you are left alone to parent your daughter. So the question remains, how will you raise her, and what kind of life will the choices you make lead her to? [from Steam]

characters.name: Rose Fryberg
characters.description: An earnest girl born in Volcano Kingdom. Yearning to be like the legendary hero Lebsa, she knocks on the door of the prestigious St. Elmore Knight Academy in Volcano Kingdom. Her only family is her kindly father and a strange pet bird called Lily. With the help of her father, she makes her way through the world, working toward a knighthood while dealing with her unusual classmates. [Taken from English Official site] Her name, birthdate, and blood type are all customizable.

characters.name: Wood Fryberg
characters.description: The player character. A widowed father living in a corner of Volcano Kingdom, raising his only daughter alone after the passing of his wife, Luca. Once a knight of some renown, his only goal in life now is to see his daughter grow up strong and hale. While he dreams of a tranquil life where she's called "a normal girl," his daughter has decided to take up a chivalric path. He watches over her while offering whatever support he can. [Taken from English Official site]

characters.name: Kenneth Claremont
characters.description: The Prince of Volcano Kingdom and brother of Gwyneth. He was kidnapped when he was little and accidentally damaged his brain and speaking ability. As a result, he tends to stammer when speaking, but he has a kind heart. He has many scars on his body and wears turtlenecks daily to cover them. He was trained in the forest to fight, although the skill came to him naturally. Due to his time spent in the forest, he claims to have met the Owl Princess and gained an affinity for magical creatures. Upon returning back to the Palace, he proactively takes a part in integrating with society once again. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Gwyneth Claremont
characters.description: The Princess of Volcano Kingdom, but she hates to be addressed as such. She is working hard to become the heir and proactively participates in both politics and military affairs. The only person she trusts around her is her brother. She doesn't expect him to ever be completely normal again but still hopes he has a safe life. She rarely has time for fun; when she isn't studying she's accomplishing missions. She hopes she can find a way to lead the Kingdom into a better future through history and hopes Rose can be part of her journey. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Hackett Munster
characters.description: A knight in Volcano Kingdom who possesses outstanding skills. He grew up on the lakeside of Wild Horse Lake and helped with farm work every and then. He always has a bountiful harvest because of his love for nature and animals. He used to be an orphan who lived among other refugees, who all helped raise him. He was later adopted by the same woman who adopted Benson. He likes to go into the forest because it seems he has something big planned. He has an extreme distaste for pocahers. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Ze Lake
characters.description: A bounty hunter who travels the world. He is exceptionally proficient with bows and enjoys practicing with them in his spare time. He is particularly fixed on becoming stronger. He doesn't like to talk about himself and often goes into the Forgotten Forest to hunt. He comes from the ancient battle family Rick. His father's death rankles in his mind, and he was even the boss of the Back Street for a short time because of it- of course, he sees this a dark history and doesn't talk about it at all. He prefers to speak to animals more than humans and owns a horse named Raven. His father used to say to him: "I will only pass my bow to the one who can shoot down St. Elmo's fire." This sentence resonates in his head, and he hopes one day he will be able to find out the truth behind his father's death and seek revenge. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Lon Hill
characters.description: The genius scholar at St. Elmo's academy. He was born into the ancient knight family, the Hills. His family recommended he participate in research for magical creatures since he was young. His father is the head knight; he loves hearing his parents talk about the stories they heard. He is childhood friends with Craig. He accidentally stumbled into the land of magical creatures when he was a kid and witnessed an extraordinary scene, which infused his curiosity for magical creatures. He likes to write scripts in his spare time and hopes one day he will be able to write a story demonstrating the truth of this world. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Craig Wheel
characters.description: He was born into the famous music family of Wheel and brought up to be a pianist, making him exceptionally talented. He is childhood friends with Lon. Always practices the piano until late, so he is always sleepy during the day. He majors in music at school and hates mathematics. His father expects them to enroll at the top music academy, Moriland, but this is something painful for him. Everyone in the family performs outstandingly, and that's why Craig always feels a lot of pressure. He hopes one day he can stand on stage without fear. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Mona Albrecht
characters.description: The owner of a family restaurant who loves cooking and socializing and has a keen heart to succeed. She has known Nina since she was a kid and sees her as a little sister. She likes to stay close yet distant with everyone. She seems to have a complicated history with the Handels. Her mother passed away a long time ago. She has witnessed Nina growing up but seems to have a love-hate relationship seeing Nina living a carefree life. She doesn't want Nina to find out about her dark side, so she wants to protect Nina's innocence. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Nina Handel
characters.description: The fourth daughter of the Handels who majors in theology at school. She spends most of her time studying with the archbishop at the altar and even occasionally works as a priest. She is not as popular as her brothers and sisters and hates the lying atmosphere back at home. However, she's pretty outgoing in front of Mona and Rose and relies on Mona quite a lot. Nina's father passed away when she was still young. Although her mother is quite strict with her, she still has a lot of respect for her. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Benson Muller
characters.description: The royal painter of Volcano Kingdom. Him demonstrating his outstanding ability in painting has led them to become an apprentice of a royal painter at a young age. He earns a living through making commercial paintings in his spare time. As a former refugee of the Heathrott War, he has witnessed horrible things that make him hate war. He often prays for peace to continue. He is tired of commercial paintings and hopes to have enough money saved one day to travel everywhere and paint about the things he is interested in. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Lebsa Lorace
characters.description: Lebsa was adopted by the Handels when she became an adult and became a Lord due to her excellent battle ability and reputation. Her battle ability is truly astounding; according to her, she is the disciple of Hero Asbell. Her looks and status allowed her to be popular among teenagers. But underneath all that, she has occasional outbursts of emotional instability and seems like she has an unknown past... [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Claude Bryan
characters.description: The Principal of St. Elmo's and the youngest principal in history. One of the three Lords of Volcano Kingdom, but has personally expressed greater interest in research. He wasn't the brightest as a child but demonstrated amazing ability when he entered the research institute and published many vital papers on magical creatures with his team. He is always kind to his students and no one has ever seen him angry. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Basilou
characters.description: When he was younger he lived in the nearby village and moved to Wild Horse Lake because his parents operate a mill. He used to admire a girl and had always watched her from afar, but gradually lost interest in love as he grew older. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Luca Fryberg
characters.description: The player's wife and Rose's mother. She passed away prior to the story's start.

characters.name: Derrick Schofield
characters.description: Wandered from the Harris Kingdom, he now makes a living out of telling stories in Handel's Restaurant. He loves to listen to all kinds of stories and buys Stories from others. He eloped with a girl when he was young and snuck into Volcano Kingdom to settle here. However, they broke up because Derrick is more used to a nomadic life. After Derrick settled down, he learnt to make a living by telling stories, but he never met another girl who understood him better than she did. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Rebecca Ira
characters.description: She migrated from the Diamond Kingdom and now runs a clothing store in Central Plaza. She has a strong passion for designing and making clothes and would often head to the farm to pick the materials herself. She used to be an opera singer and still sometimes sings in front of her shop. She fell in love with a soldier in the Volcano Kingdom and they settled there together, but he never returned after heading to the forest. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Jermaine Tholson
characters.description: He started learning about weapon crafting with his father when he was young. He is hardworking and knows how to care for others around him. Following his father's passing, he took over his business. Although he still misses him, he and his mother now rely on one another. Jermaine kept in mind that his father always said he wanted to go to the seaside back home after retiring, so he wants to take his mother back home once he finds a successor for the weapon shop. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Mary Rogen
characters.description: The owner of the Bath. She grew up in the central district and loved to stroll around different towns when she became an adult. She is a distant relative of Benson and has had a talent for painting since birth. Her painting was on the same level as the royal painters when she was 16. She worked as a royal painter for a few years, then lost all her creativity and resigned with sickness as an excuse. Nowadays, she likes to date different people in her spare time and hopes one day she can find a love that will reactivate her passion for life. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Connie Facio
characters.description: She strongly believes in theology and respects Pontiff Claire's wisdom; she often asks him questions about theology. She loves children and is saving money to build an orphanage one day. She was born into a wealthy family in the central district but had witnessed many poor men suffer. Becoming a nun was her way of escaping an arranged marriage. [Edited from in-game bio]

characters.name: Mark Barry
characters.description: He constantly boasts about having an older brother who became a knight, but no one has ever met them. He is responsible for the morning duties and has a general passion for his job. He is always working hard when chief is here and hopes he will become a knight one day. At the same time, he is saving up for the expensive armor and war horse. He creates poems in this spare time and often sings them to strangers, especially ladies walking past. A few hearts fell for him, but he never noticed. [Edited from in-game bio]

description: The kingdom of Ellerald, where stretch the roots of sacred Sephirot, is under attack by monsters that ravage the land and its people. The royal priestess Cecily sustains the hearts of the populace through her kindness and piety, while the well-endowed warrior Noein and her soldiers keep the beasts at bay. The enemy Lustfiends seem as dumb as they are vile, so their pincer assault comes as a shock. When the city’s remaining defenses prove too meager, only Princess Cecily can save the kingdom... but how can this sheltered damsel fend off nightmarish waves of sex-craved creatures when she can’t lift a sword to save her life? Cecily harnesses the power of Eden to becoming the titular (and titillating) divine warrior, Eden’s Ritter Lucifel! With powerful forbidden magics, she becomes a one-woman army—a guardian angel to her people. But these powers come at a cost, for the longer she uses them

characters.name: Cecily Ellerald
characters.original: セシリィ・エルアラド
characters.description: As heir to the throne and royal priestess of the Elleraldian faith, Cecily is a well-loved and well-endowed figurehead of her kingdom. Though she cares deeply for her people and wishes to help them in any way she can, she secretly resents her own weakness and envies the brave warrior Noein. Seizing the chance to gain power and defend her subjects, she becomes Eden’s Ritter Lucifel, a powerful magic-wielding warrior. But due to the forbidden nature of her new abilities, she must keep her identity a secret from the people she has sworn to protect. [From Steam]

characters.name: Noein
characters.description: The leader of the Holy Guard, Noein is a hardened war veteran, adored by people far and wide. Not only has she devoted her blade to Princess Cecily, but the two have been close friends since childhood; to this day, to this knight, no sacrifice is too great to protect her princess. As the bulwark and buttress of the capital's defenses, her reluctant absence has left a gaping hole. How long can the city stand until she makes her return? And will her sword alone suffice for her to safeguard what she loves? [From Steam]

characters.name: Luxeria
characters.description: A mysterious nun with a bewitching smile. Though she adorns herself with a necklace bearing the symbol of the Elleraldian faith, her actions are unusual for a woman of her perceived status. What mysteries is she hiding in the darkness underneath her robes? [From Steam]

characters.name: Rudolf
characters.description: The archbishop of the Elleraldian faith. When the king falls ill with a mysterious ailment, Rudolf must accept the heavy burden of leading the kingdom during this time of peril—most reluctantly, of course. Though his leadership is admired by most members of the kingdom’s war council, others remain unconvinced, Noein included. [From Steam]

characters.name: Xenoarachne
characters.description: One of the numerous lustfiends that terrorize the kingdom. Half spider, half demon, all sadist, Xenoarachne is a cruel and malicious seductress, capable of hypnotizing her prey and trapping them in her webs. No amount of forbidden power can prepare Cecily for the transformative consequences of their encounter. [From Steam]

title: Catch Canvas
description: You start your adventure as you arrive at your uncle's cabin. Your uncle, a world-renowned artist, has agreed to take you under his wing and help push your art to the next level. Under his tutelage, your work may even be put on display at a prestigious, upcoming art exhibition, known for the instant fame it brings anyone lucky enough to participate. After your arrival, however, you discover that it won't be so straightforward. Your uncle is nowhere to be found, and he has left you with the task of getting three young girls, all aspiring artists, to finish their Mars sculptures in a mere two weeks; or no exhibition for you! Worse yet, the girls are highly unmotivated, and have no desire to listen to you, a complete stranger. [From Kickstarter campaign]

characters.name: Estelle
characters.description: Estelle comes from a loaded family in a small town. Many of her family members are high profile members of the community, including prominent artists and big business tycoons. Estelle herself is also talented with her art ranking similar to her uncle's but only on the rare occasion when she wants to apply herself.

characters.name: Nao
characters.description: Nacchan is a fun-loving girl with a passion for manga. The backgrounds for her manga are amazing but her work is sullied by her horrible characters and story lines.

characters.name: Dawn
characters.description: Dawn is a quiet girl who is very shy, and cannot concentrate on her work when other people are watching. Her sketches are fast and professional, but she can only work in solitude, fitting the image of a reclusive artist which she had expected of Miyuzaki-sama.

characters.name: Kyle
characters.description: The renowned artist Miyazuki's nephew or niece.

title: Sakura Gamer
description: When she was a young girl, Nekohime dreamt of being a video game developer. Now in her early twenties, she’s abandoned that dream to focus on her uninspiring job as a computer repair technician. There’s not enough time in the day to focus on game development – and anyway, isn’t she too old to entertain such unrealistic notions? That is, until her childhood friend, Clover, introduces her to the seductive Suki. Suki is determined to turn Nekohime’s dream into a reality and finally develop a game – and she refuses to let Nekohime’s self-doubt stop her. Whether she wants to or not, Nekohime’s pulled into a brand new world, alongside these two bubbly, optimistic girls. Will they be able to make a hit game together, or will it all be for nought? And, in the end, will Nekohime manage to find true love? [From Steam]

characters.name: Tsukiko
characters.description: A mischievous, vixen-like girl from Nekohime’s past, infamous for encouraging her elderly grandmother to feed her laptop’s D-Drive rice for a ‘Shinto purification ceremony’. Suki flirts with almost everyone, to such an extent it’s hard to tell whether she really means it. She also enjoys teasing people – particularly uptight people like Nekohime who get flustered easily. She grew up in a shrine, but is worlds apart from the image of a ‘traditional Japanese beauty’. She can be loud and obnoxious and incredibly pushy, but she’ll apologize when she realizes she’s gone too far. She’s also a competent digital artist, who spent a large portion of her life drawing and uploading her pictures online. After all, there’s not much else to do at a shrine. [From Steam.]

characters.name: Matsuoka Chika
characters.description: One of Nekohime’s closest friends. Her real name is Chika. Though she loves revealing cosplay and dressing in tightly-fitting spandex, she’s actually an elementary school teacher. She’s warm, cheerful, bubbly, and loves playing around with finger paints, which makes her a surprisingly good fit for her job (and no, she doesn’t dress quite so outlandishly when she’s at work). Being creative, she enjoys experimenting in the kitchen and composing music. She nominates herself as the composer for her video game venture. [From Steam.]

characters.name: Sayo
characters.description: The unwilling heroine of the story. Her real name is ‘Sayo’, but her friends refer to her by her internet handle - much to her embarrassment. Though she dislikes being referred to by a silly nickname she made up on the spot when she was a kid, she exhibits a lot of catlike traits. She’s always seen in her cat-eared jacket, she likes taking naps, and she can be rather ‘catty’. She lacks purpose in life, and is bored by her tedious, unrewarding job. Maybe making a video game is exactly the kind of diversion she needs. [From Steam]

title: Sakura Sadist
description: Music student Azusa is completely obsessed with the campus queen, Matsubara Mamiko, and for good reason. Mamiko is beautiful, intelligent, compassionate… and completely out of Azusa’s league! Azusa has long since resigned herself to the cold, hard reality that Mamiko will never return her feelings, and she’s fine with it! At least, that’s what she tells herself – until she receives a text message one night from the mysterious ‘Venus’. Word around the campus is that Venus can use her perplexing powers to bring any two people together, irregardless of how incompatible they may seem. Before Venus will help Azusa, however, our heroine needs to prove her unyielding affection towards her crush. And how is Azusa going to do that…? She has to take a candid photograph of Mamiko’s panties, of course! Will Azusa succumb to Venus’ devilish temptations? Will Mamiko ever fall in love with her? Or are

characters.name: Uzui Azusa
characters.description: Azusa may be a student at the prestigious Victoria Academy of Music, but she doesn’t take her studies seriously. She would far rather stare at the cute girls in her local maid café than practice the cello. Azusa’s father is incredibly famous in the world of classical music, and Azusa has a lot to live up to. The professors at her university constantly compare Azusa to her father, much to our heroine’s chagrin, and she’d really rather be judged on her own merits than those of her father’s. Unfortunately, Azusa’s only positive qualities are her exuberant energy and her unerring optimism. [From Steam]

characters.name: Suminoe Marilyn
characters.description: Azusa’s childhood friend. Mari – or ‘Marilyn’ - has stood by Azusa’s side through thick and thin. Mari routinely waking Azusa up in the mornings, reminds her about impending deadlines, and helps Azusa study in the university library. Despite everything Mari does for Azusa, Azusa regards her as a bit of a nag, and wishes she would just lighten up a little. Mari's father is obsessed with Western culture, and named her after the actress Marilyn Monroe. [Edited from Steam]

characters.name: Matsubara Mamiko
characters.description: The object of Azusa’s affections, and the most beautiful girl on the school campus. Mamiko is something of a musical genius, who can play the piano, the clarinet, and the harp, but she never boasts about her great accomplishments. All the girls in the Victoria Academy want to be like Mamiko, all the boys wish she was their girlfriend, and vice versa. Unfortunately, Mamiko is simply too perfect, and most people are intimidated by her goddess-like demeanour. Though Mamiko has a large number of fans, she doesn’t have many friends... That is, until Azusa begins to pursue her. [From Steam]

title: Ladykiller in a Bind
description: Forced to pretend to be her twin brother on a cruise ship full of his classmates and enemies, the Beast finds herself thrown into a game of complex social, as well as literal bondage. An erotic visual novel by the creators of Analogue: A Hate Story about social manipulation, crossdressing, and girls tying up other girls. [From the press kit of the Official Website]

characters.name: The Beast
characters.description: You're a super cool dyke with a sweet motorcycle and a reputation for being a ladykiller... but you owe your twin brother a huge favour for helping with your failing grades, forcing you to take his place on his high school graduation celebratory cruise. [From the Official Website] [spoiler]Real name Lilian "Lily" Smith.

characters.name: The Beauty
characters.description: Your only true ally on the cruise, she'll help put all your mistakes right... in exchange for taking out her hidden sadistic side on your boyish body, of course. Pursuable?: Every night [From the Official Website]

characters.name: The Stalker
characters.description: A shy virgin computer geek with a huge crush on the Prince, and her own high-tech way of giving you an advantage. That is, if she'll ever stop squirming... Pursuable?: Every night [From the Official Website]

characters.name: The Swimmer
characters.description: Your brother's ex-girlfriend, but... you don't know that, do you? All you know is she obviously wants you bad, and every time you look at her, you swear she just got out of the pool. Doesn't believe in diplomacy. Pursuable?: As a fling [From the Official Website]

characters.name: The Prince
characters.description: Your twin brother, the favoured child of your wealthy media magnate father, attends a much nicer high school than you do. Can you really pretend to be a man you hardly even know anymore...? Pursuable?: UGH, GROSS [From the Official Website] [spoiler]His real name is Laurence Smith, Jr.

characters.name: The Photographer
characters.description: The one-woman yearbook committee and casual mastermind of school politics, she really does just want to be everyone's friend. She plays her cards close to her chest... but speaking of close to her chest, what she really needs there are your hands. Pursuable?: As a fling [From the Official Website]

characters.name: The President
characters.description: The President of the Student Council and sworn rival of the Prince, he hates his cavalier attitude and thinks he should take things more seriously... you're probably not going to like him much, either. Pursuable?: He wishes [From the Official Website]

characters.name: The Nerd
characters.description: The dour and humourless lieutenant behind the President—if you want to get on his good side, you'll have to get on hers, first. And as the center of all social politics, you might have to. Pursuable?: Too flustered at even the thought [From the Official Website]

characters.name: The Athlete
characters.description: A cousin on your estranged mother's side of the family. You haven't seen him in years, but... is he really the sort who can keep a secret? Pursuable?: No [From the Official Website]

characters.name: The Boy
characters.description: The center of a terrifying love hexagon who intensely admires the Prince... you're a lesbian, but even you have to admit he looks cute in a skirt. Pursuable?: He wishes [From the Official Website]

characters.name: The Maid
characters.description: Seems to be present no matter where you go on the ship, she's somehow the ally of the Prince... but how does she factor into his grand plot, exactly? Whatever she's up to, she's more interested in making sure it runs smoothly than helping you. Pursuable?: No [From the Official Website]

full_description: Forced to pretend to be her twin brother on a cruise ship full of his classmates and enemies, the Beast finds herself thrown into a game of complex social, as well as literal bondage. An erotic visual novel by the creators of Analogue: A Hate Story about social manipulation, crossdressing, and girls tying up other girls. [From the press kit of the Official Website]

title: Kimihane Couples ~Kanojo to Kanojo no Koi Suru Nikagetsu Chotto~
title_original: きみはねCouples ～彼女と彼女の恋する二ヶ月ちょっと～
description: Come, and let's go to the other side of happy endings. [Slogan translated from Official Site]

characters.name: Natsume Hina
characters.description: "I won’t allow any deviancy in this room as long as I live!" A pure-hearted, uncomplicated girl. Though she can be childish, she tends to take charge and enjoys caring for others. She's a bit of a prude, but when she falls in love, she's the type to devote herself completely to her partner. The jealous type. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Ogata Rin
characters.description: "I'll marry Asou and we'll keep Hina as our pet! That's my ideal life!" A nihilistic pedant. Everyone in her class thinks of her as a cool beauty, but that image completely falls apart at home. The awkward type who understands love in theory but has trouble putting it into practice. A lonely pushover and a natural bottom. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Asou Fumi
characters.description: "If you're going to marry me, you'd better treat me right." Kind and sweet, the conscience of the room. She used to be in the Home Ec Club, and gets plenty of use out of those skills in her dorm room. Takes on a mothering role, including making everyone's lunch every morning. She projects serenity, but is steadfast at heart. She's able to see through people and discern what they really want, and will use that to her advantage. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Takaoka Sachiko
characters.description: "Wanna model for me? If you do it nude, I'll throw in another 10,000!" A half-ass. Carefree, footloose, and uninhibited. She's in charge of the dorm, but doesn’t take the job too seriously, sending the students to buy her cigarettes and such. Her hobbies are loving cute girls and painting. She’s asked the three girls to model nude for her, but none of them have taken her up on it. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Takaoka Miyako
characters.description: A beautiful, mysterious girl who joins the three as their new roommate. She's pure-hearted and easily moved, demure yet forward. A snooze-monster who sleeps a ton. [From MangaGamer]

full_description: Come, and let's go to the other side of happy endings. [Slogan translated from Official Site]

title: Fukai ni Nemuru Oujo no Abaddon
title_original: 腐界に眠る王女のアバドーン
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: 'I could still live in peace... if I never learned the truth...' This tale is set in the haunted Ayakoji Mansion, nestled away deep in a dense, dark forest. Professor Yamanobe, a close friend of the mansion's owner, arrives at the mansion with a small group of his students to explore and learn the truth behind its many rumors and mysteries. However, they too are engulfed by the innumerable horrors lurking within before long... It is then that Homura, Professor Yamanobe's son, arrives with a small group of his friends in search of his father. Will they be able to find his father and escape alive? Or will they suffer an unthinkable, sinister fate...?

characters.name: Yamanobe Homura
characters.description: He's the son of the archaeologist who investigates the mansion. PET bottles: he can reduce the fear bar 3 times. You can refill them with water. Fears: nothing. [spoiler]He changes to Ayakouji Homura in Yuki's route. Family: father (Yamanobe, university professor); mother (deceased).

characters.name: Suzumori Mia
characters.description: Homura's friend. She seems to have a crush on him. First-aid kit: she can cure some illnesses, such as poison or injuries/sprains. Fears: bugs, spirits, guts. Family: father; mother.

characters.name: Kazama Kippei
characters.description: Homura's best friend. Backpack: he can save a maximum of 6 items. Fears: spirits. [spoiler]He likes Yachika. He will enter in 'desperation mode' if he watches Yachika's corpse. Family: father; mother; little sister (6 years).

characters.name: Mizuishi Rikana
characters.description: A member of Homura's father's team. Dictionary: she can read certain documents that the others can't. Fears: humanoids. Family: father; mother; older brother. However, she lives alone.

characters.name: Domon Seijirou
characters.description: A member of Homura's father team. Lighter: he can light up dark places and use it against enemies. Fears: bugs, beasts, guts. [spoiler]Rikana is his favourite workmate. He will enter in 'desperation mode' if he watches Rikana's corpse. Family: father (doctor); mother; older sister.

characters.name: Hino Yachika
characters.description: Mia's closer friend. Hairpin: she can open certain chests or door's locks with her hairpin. Fears: bugs, humanoids, guts. [spoiler]Mia is more than her best friend. She will enter in 'desperation mode' if she watches Mia's corpse. Family: father (carpenter); mother; older brother.

characters.name: Kaneda Seita
characters.description: A member of Homura's father team. Shima's best friend. Flashlight: he can light up dark places.

characters.name: Shima Tetsurou
characters.description: A member of Homura's father team. Kaneda's best friend. First-aid kit: he can cure some illnesses, such as poison or injuries/sprains. [spoiler]He likes secretly Rikana that's why he looks Seijirou like his rival.

characters.name: Ayakouji Yuki
characters.description: Homura finds her in the mansion. She looks like a mysterious girl...

characters.name: Yamanobe Shoukei
characters.description: Homura's father. He's an archaeologist and the leader of his team. He forgot the key which open the door he wanted in the mansion so called his son to bring it to him. Pipe/Hammer: he can break some walls if he has the hammer. [spoiler]In the true ending he reveals he's Yuki's twin brother (Ayakouji Homura) but she didn't believe him.

characters.name: Ayakouji Mizuki
characters.description: [spoiler]She's Homura's older sister and the woman who chases you in the haunted house.

characters.name: Presence of Fear
characters.description: She chases you in the haunted house. She always calls Homura, it makes him nervous... [spoiler]Later is revealed she actually is Ayakouji Mizuki, Homura's older sister.

title: Roommates
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You play as Anne or Max and the game takes place in a house on-campus, the Latin House. Max is a singer and a rebel, his plan is to stay in school long enough to save up enough money through part-time jobs to get by without his parent's financial support, then drop out and start a ska band. Anne a small-town girl, studious but very shy and easily embarrassed, Anne thinks that college could be the fresh start she needs to break out of her shell. Her goal is to make at least three new friends while keeping her grades up.

characters.name: Isabella
characters.description: A flirtatious Latina with a hardcore edge, she likes to party and have a good time, no strings attached. She wants to try everything at least once. Works at the coffee shop on campus. Openly pansexual.

characters.name: Max
characters.description: Max is a singer and a rebel, his plan is to stay in school long enough to save up enough money through part-time jobs to get by without his parent's financial support, then drop out and start a ska band.

characters.name: Anne
characters.description: Anne a small-town girl, studious but very shy and easily embarrassed, Anne thinks that college could be the fresh start she needs to break out of her shell. Her goal is to make at least three new friends while keeping her grades up.

characters.name: Sally
characters.description: A bleeding-heart, vegan activist girl with a cheerful demeanor, she's always picketing or putting solar panels on roofs or out getting people to sign petitions. She has a weak stomach for horror movies or anything with gore and can't say no to strays, even when you're technically not supposed to keep animals in your dorm room. Works on the college farm.

characters.name: Rakesh
characters.description: A chill Indian exchange student that doesn't let much get to him, he is an artist that believes that everything has the potential to be a canvas. Unfortunately, he doesn't always remember to ask for permission before making things into art, leading to some disasters involving other peoples' personal property. The male bi character.

characters.name: Dominic
characters.description: The RA (Resident Advisor, basically the person who makes sure people in the dorm aren't breaking major school rules) and a former child prodigy, he considers college serious business and disapproves of most of what the wilder members of the house would consider fun. His rule is iron-fisted, but his ability to keep everyone corralled is probably the only thing stopping the place from burning to the ground. Works as a Teaching Assistant for the lower-level Physics classes.

characters.name: Memphis
characters.description: Max's bandmate.

characters.name: Chad
characters.description: Isabella's boyfriend. He plays on the school football team.

characters.name: Prof. Tasque
characters.description: An eccentric professor.

characters.name: Slim
characters.description: The drummer in Max's band.

characters.name: Jerry
characters.description: The other guitarist in Max's band.

characters.name: Vegemite
characters.description: The puppy Sally rescued.

characters.name: Prof. Merriweather
characters.description: Anatomy professor.

characters.name: Roxanne
characters.description: Anne and Max's classmate.

characters.name: Butch
characters.description: Max and Anne's classmate. Prefers to be called by his middle name, Terrence.

characters.name: Carmen
characters.description: Max and Anne's classmate. In the pub she mentions knowing the DJ there.

characters.name: Marvin
characters.description: Max and Anne's classmate.

title: Amelie
description: In the middle of a field, far out in the countryside, sits a lone manor. Inside that manor, in the middle of the field, far out in the countryside, lives Amelie and her dear friend Lilika. Forbidden from leaving the house, Amelie awaits the arrival of her long time penpal, Sofia, to Lilika’s dismay. What secrets will Sofia unravel that were best kept buried? And will she manage to survive the night? Play as three different protagonists to uncover the full story and discover the truth about the lone manor. [From Itch.io]

title: Please Be Happy
description: Born as a fox in the forest of Korea, Miho carries with her the memory of a traveler who showed her kindness and spoke of home. Now more human than fox, Miho has spent a long, long time searching for her person. She arrives by airship to Wellington Skyport, one of the jewels of the floating island of New Zealand. Despite her years spent observing humans, she still has a lot to learn about their culture and society. She's made a living so far as a thief, her heightened senses allowing her to easily take advantage of people. She's also seen a lot of the worst of what mankind has to offer. It's only after meeting Juliet, the owner of a small library, and Aspen, an aspiring novelist, that Miho starts to understand what kindness is, and that there's more than just the bad stuff when it comes to people. [From the official website]

characters.name: Miho
characters.description: Likes: Sugar Dislikes: Rainy days Miho's earliest memories are of her time as a fox, and the kind human she met back then. Now more than just a fox, she's spent her life searching for that person. Her journey has brought her to a new life in Wellington, New Zealand. She changes her name every time she goes to a new country. Her previous names include Gumi, Migu, and Mimi. [From official website]

characters.name: Aspen
characters.description: Likes: 18 shots of espresso Dislikes: Dog-eared book pages Aspen is a human girl in love with words and stories. A barista at the Bellhouse Café, she dreams of being a popular author someday. She tries to take a little inspiration from every person that she meets. She has an hour long phone call with her mom every weekend. [From official website]

characters.name: Juliet
characters.description: Likes: New Zealand Breakfast Tea Dislikes: Bugs As a vampire, Juliet is one of Wellington's oldest residents. She's made the treasures of her life open to all in the form of a library. Aside from books, she also provides wisdom, kindness, and shelter to those who need it. She dislikes having to resort to echolocation to find her reading glasses. [From official website]

characters.name: Lena
characters.description: Never one to back down from a challenge, Lena is one of Wellington's more sporty residents and a barista at the Bellhouse Café with Aspen. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Mr. Kim
characters.description: As an avid fisherman, Mr. Kim knows all the best spots for exciting sights in Wellington. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Tommy
characters.description: Tommy is one of the youngest citizens of Wellington that you'll meet and is eager to show off his bug collection. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Gwen
characters.description: Gwen is Tommy's mother and an eternally tired painting instructor trying to balance her work, family, and school life. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Olive Penn
characters.description: Pessimistic and guarded, Olive lacks much in the way of friends, relying only on their sense of self-reliance to push them through life until now. While college life never came naturally to Olive, confronting their possible dropout is a trial all on its own. That said, they're not entirely alone: they do their best to keep a brave face for the sake of their mother, who tirelessly cheers them on from the sidelines. Having put their life's worries to one side of the sake of their mom for so long, Olive must now take charge of their life. [From Website]

characters.name: Cyrus
characters.description: Cyrus may sound standoffish at first, but he's just rather tired most of the time (all of the time). [From Twitter]

characters.name: Elijah
characters.description: Elijah is a journalist with a carefree and relaxed attitude who loves playing with his son and learning more about the locals. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Cello
characters.description: Cello is a middle schooler visiting Wellington for a class trip to complete a project about the town. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Armand
characters.description: Armand is a middle schooler visiting Wellington for a class trip to complete a project about the town. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Pippa
characters.description: Pippa is a middle schooler visiting Wellington for a class trip to complete a project about the town. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Lyra
characters.description: Lyra is a young girl who finds herself alone in Wellington. [From Twitter]

[From the official website]

title: Shuuten Kyoudan
description: “168 remaining until the end of the world...” Humanity is approaching its end. In a world steeped in despair and chaos, a strange religious organization called Shuten Order emerges, yearning for the end of humanity. The group rapidly gains followers, eventually forming a small nation state called Shuten. Tragedy strikes during the grand festival celebrating their nation’s founding—the leader of the Shuten Order is murdered. Soon after, the protagonist awakens with no memory, greeted by two self-proclaimed "angels". They reveal a shocking truth: the protagonist is the murdered Founder, revived by divine power. However, the resurrection is incomplete—their memories are gone, and their life limited to a mere four days. To survive, the protagonist must overcome "God's trial": identify and kill their murderer. With the clock ticking, the protagonist, given the alias Rei, dives into the tumult

characters.name: Shimobe Rei
characters.description: "I want you to tell me everything you know about the Founder's murder." Founder of the Shuten Order who was resurrected in a “temporary body”. All memories prior to being murdered were lost. ”Rei Shimobe” is a temporary name to hide their identity as the Founder. Disguised as a detective to find the murderer within the given time limit: dawn, four days from now… [From official website] [spoiler]Rei is actually a hive-mind droid with multiple spare bodies. Her "Power of God" abilities allow her to hack other droids, and her "resurrections" are spare bodies activated upon her death. Five different spare bodies were activated at the same time to investigate each Minister, which Rei mistook as 5 different timelines (routes).

characters.name: Himeru
characters.description: "You can't remember anything? Not even how you died?" One of the two self-proclaimed “angels,” God’s messengers. Seemingly, their role is to guide Rei...? Impatient and prone to panic, she is the driving force that compels Rei to move forward when reluctant. For some reason, she has clear malice and hatred toward Shuten. [From official website] [spoiler]In truth, she is a spyware program made by humans to hack the Founder and infiltrate Shuten. Her appearance is modeled off the human Himeno from within the Founder's memories.

characters.name: Mikotoru
characters.description: "Fate has a way of forcing on the worst situations. But it's not all bad..." One of the two self-proclaimed “angels,” God’s messengers. Seemingly, their role is to guide Rei...? Calm, knowledgeable, and highly analytical, he steadily guides Rei. However, he deflects when asked questions that get to the core of the matter. [From official website] [spoiler]In truth, he is a spyware program made by humans to hack the Founder and infiltrate Shuten. His appearance is modeled off the Founder's human creator, Mikoto, from within her memories.

characters.name: Inugami Kishiru
characters.description: "Ah, it's times like these where theories really come in handy." Head of the Ministry of Justice, which administers the law. A free spirit who often says random things and acts spontaneously. He is a knowledgeable and flexible thinker, unrivaled when it comes to resolving disputes. Also known as the “Ghost White Arbitrator." Addicted to legal drugs. [From official website]

characters.name: Ushitora Yuugen
characters.description: "Come on... I must have everything be extracted..." Head of the Ministry of Health, which is in charge of medical care. Also the director of Shuten General Hospital, a medical institution under his control. Known as the “Gatekeeper to the Afterlife” because of his proven medical skills. He appears to be hearty and compassionate, but pathologically meticulous. He loves his younger sister. [From official website]

characters.name: Ion Teko
characters.description: "Sigh... they say 'fools never differ...'" Head of the Ministry of Science, which controls all aspects of science and technology. Though charmless in both words and action, he is a genius with an unmeasurable IQ, and in charge of designing most of the country's technology. Also known as the “Prodigy”. [From official website] One of the main protagonists of the Ministry of Science route.

characters.name: Kokushikan Honoka
characters.description: "This must be destiny. His death and our meeting!" Head of the Ministry of Education, which is in charge of education and information. Nicknamed the “Conjurer of Words” for her ability to manipulate information and confuse the public. Many things about her, including her true face, are shrouded in mystery. She's typically quiet, but there are rumors about her ambition to become the next Founder... [From official website] [spoiler]For her "romance game", she dons the disguises of Mii, Kikka, Yua, Shikka, and the entirety of the "Shuten Academy" student body.

characters.name: Fushichou Manji
characters.description: "I'm gonna destroy every one of them! I'm gonna wipe them off the face of the earth!" Head of the Ministry of Security, which maintains public order. Short tempered and aggressive. Particularly hostile to heretics (enemies of the order) and is known as the “Queen of Heretic Hunting”. Wishes for peace in this country more than anyone and tries to protect it. [From official website]

characters.name: Kokushikan Yua
characters.description: "Transfer boy, I love you. Be my boyfriend." A mysterious girl with unique sensibilities. In addition to her strange way of thinking, she is unable to converse properly with others. The things she says are hard to understand. She communicates through puppets (a boy and a girl). [From official Twitter] [spoiler]She and her "sisters," Mii and Kikka, are alternate personas and disguises for Honoka Kokushikan.

characters.name: Kokushikan Mii
characters.description: "N-No! I-I can't reciprocate your feelings!" Tsundere. Intelligent and resolute. Professor-like. Usually cool, but the slightest trigger can make her go wild with erotic fantasies. [From official Twitter [spoiler]She and her "sisters," Kikka and Yua, are alternate personas and disguises for Honoka Kokushikan.

characters.name: Kokushikan Kikka
characters.description: "I-It's your fault... for throwing my heart into disarray like this..." Energetic and friendly. Emotional and gets tensed over the smallest things. Cannot control her emotions. Overreacts to everything and is noisy. [From official Twitter] [spoiler]She and her "sisters," Mii and Yua, are alternate personas and disguises for Honoka Kokushikan.

characters.name: Nephilim
characters.description: "Hmph... Hehehe..." A legendary killer who appears out of nowhere. He wears a tattered costume that was once an amusement park mascot. Cruel and violent. Uses a grotesque jackhammer as a weapon. [From official Twitter] [spoiler]There are two Nephilims. This one is a hallucination caused by the drug "Virus" that induces violence and self-mutilation in victims, emulating the Nephilim murders. The other is Fushicho Kagura, who drugs these victims.

characters.name: Kukuri Miki
characters.description: "Perfect! We're going to be rich!" Yoichi's wife. A celebrity with bad taste who dresses flashily. An unpleasant person who looks down on everyone. Greedy and selfish. She is the greediest person in the Kukuri family. [From official Twitter]

characters.name: Kururi Kiyomasa
characters.description: Kukuri Estate Head. Deceased. Former chairman of Kukuri Pharmaceuticals. He left behind a vast inheritance. There is no doubt about his death, and murder seems unlikely. The will outlining his inheritance is currently held by Kishiru Inugami. [spoiler]The inheritance conditions written in his will are ominous... There are suspicions he was secretly manufacturing tobacco in the greenhouse and selling it to heretics. He was worried about his sons getting the inheritance after his death. He appeared to hold a deep appreciation for Mizuno. A hidden lab in the greenhouse basement was used to manufacture "Virus", using tobacco as the base. The refined "Virus" was illicitly sold by Miyabi. Culprit of the serial murders at the Kukuri estate. Three victims died by traps Kiyomasa had set in advance. The traps were meant to test whether the four inheritance candidates were worthy of inheriting his

characters.name: Mizuno Yori
characters.description: "But... someone like me..." Maid for the Kukuri family. A kind-hearted woman. She cared for the head of Kuruki family, Kururi Kiyomasa. Everyone in the Kukuri family takes advantage of her and bullies her. [From official Twitter]

characters.name: Otsuki Kuu
characters.description: "I can't! I can't die here!" Former leader of a team of kids from the slums. Loyal and caring towards his friends. A spirited delinquent boy. Rides a motorbike. A few years ago, he was arrested and imprisoned for a hit-and-run, but now works at Teko's research lab. [From official Twitter] One of the main protagonists of the Ministry of Science route. [spoiler]He is a digital copy of the real Ku Otsuki, implanted into the body of Seren Ezaki as a split personality.

characters.name: Kukuri Youichi
characters.description: "Why are you staring at us, boy?" The eldest son of the Kukuri family. Also an executive at the company run by the Kukuri family. An unpleasant guy who looks down on everyone but himself. He also disliked his father, Kiyomasa. Arrogant and self-centered. [From official Twitter]

characters.name: Arale
characters.description: "I'm scared, Teko. Scared that you might do something cruel." A partner robot created by Teko. Though timid, he's quick to make bluffs. His emotions are always fluctuating. Will do anything to protect Teko, but also scolds Teko if he does something wrong. [From official Twitter]

characters.name: Sakaki Tabemaru
characters.description: "Don't hate me. I was just luckier than you. That's all." Participant in the death game. Ministry of Health employee. Grows flowers at home. He can't die because he needs to go home and water the flowers. [From official Twitter]

characters.name: Shironekoyama Ayu'myu
characters.description: "AAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!! ♡" Participant in the death game. Addicted to love. Emotionally unstable. Likes "landmine-style" fashion and has a dramatic personality. [From official Twitter]

characters.name: MI5-Type 4
characters.description: "That's not the case… Despite what you might think, I'm a germaphobe." Manji's favorite bike. Equipped with AI. Polite but rude. Sometimes talks back to Manji, but all things considered, he cares about her. [From official Twitter]

characters.name: Fukune Noa
characters.description: A mysterious idol who organized and live-streams the death game.

characters.name: Shiratori Miyabi
characters.description: "Geez... I wish everyone would hurry up and die." Personal doctor of the Kukuri family. Intelligent, but psychopathically ruthless. He looks down on the stupid and greedy heirs to the Kukuri estate. [From official Twitter]

characters.name: Otohime

Sneaky and self-centered. [From official Twitter

characters.name: Fuyuno Suzushiro
characters.description: "Would you die with me?" Participant in the Death Game. Ministry of Health employee. A trainee nurse at the hospital. A fan of the Founder who wants to follow the doctrines, and as a result, is not enthusiastic about the Death Game. [From official Twitter] The youngest Fuyuno sister.

[From in-game suspect profile]

characters.description: The human equivalent to Mikotoru, the foremost expert in droid engineering. He created SMB-Type 0 and adopted his niece Himeno.
