characters.description: The Founder and leader of the Shuten Order, a religious nation that wishes for the end of humanity. Beloved by the citizens of Shuten, but only the 5 Ministers have a close relationship with the Founder. Was murdered on National Foundation Day, but the Ministers have hidden the crime from the public. [spoiler]The Founder was secretly a combat hive-mind droid with multiple spare bodies, created by humans for war. She was hacked by human-made spyware programs, manipulating her memories and personality, creating "Shimobe Rei". Despite this, a conscious part of the Founder's personality survived in Rei's body until she sacrificed herself for Rei.

characters.name: Boudokumen no Onna
characters.description: The first human born following humanity's survival in the Human Ending. Dubbed as the "miracle child", she reminds Shimobe Rei of Himeno.

characters.name: Sensei
characters.description: A human doctor that survived humanity's end and has raised the miracle child.

characters.name: Kuu's Mother
characters.description: Ku Otsuki's terminally ill mother, who passed away when Ku was young.

full_description: “168 remaining until the end of the world...” Humanity is approaching its end. In a world steeped in despair and chaos, a strange religious organization called Shuten Order emerges, yearning for the end of humanity. The group rapidly gains followers, eventually forming a small nation state called Shuten. Tragedy strikes during the grand festival celebrating their nation’s founding—the leader of the Shuten Order is murdered. Soon after, the protagonist awakens with no memory, greeted by two self-proclaimed "angels". They reveal a shocking truth: the protagonist is the murdered Founder, revived by divine power. However, the resurrection is incomplete—their memories are gone, and their life limited to a mere four days. To survive, the protagonist must overcome "God's trial": identify and kill their murderer. title: Bu Lian'ai Jiu Wandan le
description: After spending two light-hearted years on campus, I moved on to my junior year. However, I was not only faced with the challenges of graduation and internships, but also suddenly told that I must find my destined soulmate soon, or else I would perish due to a curse. As if it were fated, my childhood playmate who I hadn't seen in ages suddenly reappeared. My friend's sister showed a keen interest in me, a senior I met by chance generously offered a referral, and even the manager at my internship company cast intrigued glances my way... Who among them is my fated one, and who has an axe to grind? Hesitantly, I move forward, trying to find answers in the fog... [From Steam]

characters.name: Yan Wang Shu
characters.description: A junior at Ocean City University. She's a soft and sweet person with a big heart who’s always willing to stand up for what she believes in. Kind and empathetic, her caring nature is adored by those around her. [From Steam]

characters.name: Xia Chi Mei
characters.description: The playmate in childhood, had arranged marriage with protagonist before birth, which was canceled because they were of the same gender. Several years after, they meet again. She has cheerful personality, but sometimes she can be a bit somber.

characters.name: Wen Ji Ran
characters.description: The senior, the president of Student Council, provides protagonist with the internship referral. Outwardly, she appears gentle and kind to others, but she often suppresses a darker side. Few can truly get into her heart.

characters.name: Si Jue
characters.description: An external student, from the Ocean City School of Business, Cassidy's twin sister. Because of the desire to new knowledge, she attends classes in Cassidy's place, meets and develops interest in the protagonist. Her past life name is [spoiler]绛河 (Jianghe / Giáng Hà)

characters.name: Qi Yi
characters.description: The general manager of HuanYu company, a high-achieving returnee with dual degrees. During protagonist's internship, the general manager provides her with support. With a serious and disciplined personality, she is efficient and cautious, often appearing somewhat impersonal in her work.

It's bad enough that she has to stay in detention during Sunflower Day—it's even worse that she's stuck in detention with the one and only Marion LaRue, the self-proclaimed “Chaotic Fireball Legend” of LeFay Academy. Marion LaRue is not having a fun day at all. What was meant to be a harmless little fire turned into an explosion that has her stuck in detention, missing out on one of the rare opportunities for her to enjoy life outside the academy. And of course she just had to be stuck with Audrey Clary, of all the high class LeFay students she could be in detention with. characters.name: Marion LaRue
characters.description: Marion is an elemental magic student who earned her scholarship at LeFay Academy through meticulous self-study. Fiery, rebellious, and carefree, Marion is not one to back down from a challenge. As one of LeFay's brightest students, she aims to prove her worth and earn her place as a respectable mage despite her common background. But when it comes to friendship and teamwork, Marion still has a long way to go. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Audrey Clary
characters.description: As a heiress of the renowned alchemist Clary family, Audrey is expected to create a magnum opus (an alchemical masterpiece) in order to bring the world closer towards the highest state of perfection. Audrey, however, secretly wants to be a healer, an occupation considered to be way beneath her status. Responsible and compassionate, Audrey is torn between following the path her family has laid out for her and choosing the one her heart desires the most. [From Kickstarter.]

characters.name: Margot Beaufort
characters.description: No one messes with Professor Margot Beaufort. In LeFay Academy, they are known as the stem Head of the Alchemy Department, and in Castlecoast they are celebrated as one of the Queen's most innovative alchemists. Wise and idealistic, Professor Beaufort uses their strict persona to push their students towards perfection, believing education to be the most transformative instrument of all. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Irene Kang
characters.description: Naive and sheltered, Irene has yet to see what life is like for those who weren't born to wealthy, influential alchemists. Due to her upbringing, she is prone to moments of tactlessness and insensitivity. However, she is genuinely kind and compassionate, as she is the only one who understands and supports Audrey's interest in healing magic. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Simone LaRue
characters.description: Simone LaRue is a household name among the wine connosseurs and fashionistas of Castlecoast. Her wine bar is often crowded with Castlecoast's young elites, and her face regularly appears on lifestyle magazine covers. She is also the older sister of Marion, and is the one who influenced her interest in elemental magic. [From Kickstarter]

title: Heileen: Sail Away
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests

description: Heileen is a cute 18 year old English girl. She lives a quiet life, without any real problems. But one day her uncle Otto, a famous English merchant, decides that it is time for a change and forces her to follow him on a journey to the New World. During the voyage, she'll meet old and new friends and discover lots of secrets, and ultimately find out what she really wants for herself. Play along with her on this fantastic voyage through eight chapters of intriguing dialogues. Each choice you make will have consequences for your relationships with the other crew members and will determine which one of the three different endings you'll see.

She believes in peace and harmony above all else, and thus treats everyone kindly. [From MangaGamer]

description: Sakura Halloween is a short and sweet yuri title about a vampire named Miyu de Lioncourt. She’s a bit perturbed, as she was not invited to a Halloween party being held by the prestigious Countess Elizabeth. She decides to crash said party, only to run into her ex-girlfriend, a witch named Sabrina. Sabrina is less-than-enthusiastic to see her former lover, especially after she’s embarrassed by her yet again. The witch has finally had enough and vows to get revenge — lewd revenge.​ [From Winged Cloud]

She used to be a shy, retiring kind of girl, but Sabrina's determined to show off a brand new side of herself at the Halloween Party... if only she can figure out how to get there! [From Winged Cloud]

title: How To Date A Magical Girl!
description: Imagine if you had the opportunity to attend class at an elite academy for magical girls... Do you think you'd take the opportunity to make new friends? Learn magic? Or... Would you try and date a cute magical girl? Although you show only a pathetic amount of magical talent, the academy has decided to let you in. You're not sure why, but this is probably a good opportunity to meet some girls! However, you only have one year to prove that you're suitable for the academy. You'll have to balance your studies and chasing girls in order to succeed! Take time out of your busy schedule to go shopping, attend the debate club, work a part-time job or just relax and see the sights. The choice is yours! As you get closer to winning the heart of your dream girl, you might find that not everything at the academy is what it seems. An overwhelming sense of foreboding hangs above the academy like a dark

characters.name: Hikari Satou
characters.description: A shy girl who happens to be your best friend! She'll be joining you on your first day at the academy. Sweet and kind-natured, Hikari is a wonderful girl who always has your best interests at heart.

characters.name: Yui Akiyama
characters.description: Yui is a super-shy girl, perhaps even more closed off than any of the other girls. She's a big fan of horror novels and you often wonder what's going on in that head of hers. You might have a hard time winning her affection, simply because she is not used to opening up to anyone.

characters.name: Miyu Himura
characters.description: Miyu has an air of authority and dignity. She's a little hard to talk to, but it should get easier as you earn her respect. Miyu is your senior, ans she seems to be an over-achiever. You'll have to work hard if you want to live up to her high standards if you want to date her.

characters.name: Rei Shimizu
characters.description: Rei exudes a fun-loving and happy-go-lucky aura that maker her incredibly easy to talk to. However, you suspect she's not at all what she seems. Perhaps she's masking her true feelings? You'll need a lot of energy to keep up with Rei and her old antics!

characters.name: Kaori Bonnet
characters.description: Though she looks young, Kaori is you senior! She can act like a brat, but perhaps she's hiding a soft heart underneath her harsh words? It will take a lot of work to get Kaori to get up to you. She's very disagreeable, but on the other hand, she's pretty cute.

characters.description: Although she shows only a pathetic amount of magical talent, an elite academy for magical girls has decided to let her in, along with her childhood friend Hikari.

characters.name: Hoshi
characters.description: Hikari's talking dog familiar. He was originally summoned by Hikari when she tried to learn summoning, but she wasn't allowed to keep him in her place. After asking around, she begged you to take care of him.

While you are heading off to a prestige magical academy, Shin goes straight into working to save up for a place of his own. He dreams of becoming a punk rock clothes designer in the future, and hopes you will come with him to England one day so he can pursue his dreams.

characters.description: The wandering magician with a wealth of secrets. Favourite food: Blue-tongued skink Favourite drink: Lapsang souchong Favourite flower: Belladonna

characters.name: Nadia
characters.description: The widowed countess of Vesuvia, whose word is law. Favourite food: Spiced swordfish Favourite drink: White wine Favourite flower: Lavender

characters.name: Julian
characters.description: The fugitive doctor who hungers for revenge. Favourite food: Lobster claws Favourite drink: Black coffee Favourite flower: Wolfsbane

characters.name: Portia
characters.description: The trusted handmaiden with a penchant for snooping. Favourite food: Bread pudding Favourite drink: Beer Favourite flower: Sweet pea

characters.name: Muriel
characters.description: The fearsome outsider who owes an onerous debt. Favourite food: Smoked eel Favourite drink: Black mead Favourite flower: Forget-me-not

characters.name: Lucio
characters.description: The Count of Vesuvia who died mysteriously, and whose presence still lingers over the city. Favourite food: Ox tartate Favourite drink: Red wine Favourite flower: White rose

characters.name: Volta
characters.description: Procurator Volta is one of the five members of the Countess' court, and is in charge of the city's food. Volta is always, always hungry, and this fuels her motivations throughout the story. She is very meek and can be easily intimidated. This has caused her to be controlled by her fellow courtiers. She goes along with their plans and machinations due to her insatiable hunger. [From The Arcana Wiki]

characters.name: Valdemar
characters.description: Quaestor Valdemar is one of the five members of the Vesuvian court. They are the head physician of the palace and Julian Devorak's former boss. They are the most independent of the courtiers and refuse to listen to Countess Nadia and Procurator Volta multiple times. They have a sadistic and morbid personality. [From The Arcana Wiki]

characters.name: Vulgora
characters.description: Pontifex Vulgora is one of the five members of the Countess' court, selected by Count Lucio. Their main occupation is to 'party hard and smash things'. [From The Arcana Wiki]

characters.name: The Hierophant
characters.description: The Hierophant is the 5th of the 22 Major Arcana. His archetype is holding tightly onto tradition. [From The Arcana Wiki]

characters.name: The High Priestess
characters.description: The High Priestess is the 2nd of the 22 major Arcana in a tarot deck. Her archetype is to guide, a personification of intuition. [From The Arcana Wiki]

characters.name: Morga Eirsdottir
characters.description: Morga Eirsdottir is the mother of Lucio, and the clan leader of the southern tribe he hails from. [From The Arcana Wiki]

plot_tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
full_description: You are a prodigy of the magical arts, left to your own devices by your wandering mentor. Make choices that shape your story as you fall headfirst into a whirlwind adventure, filled with a colorful cast of characters who all have one thing in common: their interest in you. Delve deep into the heart of intrigue, and uncover a murder mystery that still hangs over the city like a shroud. Be careful what secrets you reveal… yours is not the only fate that hangs in the balance. Magic and mystery await. Who will you love and who will you condemn? [From Apple App Store] The Arcana is a serialized story that updates with new chapters every few weeks.

title: Heaven Will Be Mine
description: It’s 1981, and the dream of a new home in space for all humanity is dead. After fighting for decades against an intangible and ephemeral existential threat from beyond the solar system, Earth command has declared the war effort a huge waste of time. The honeymoon is over, and a future of glittering cities across the solar system and cosmic battles between giant robots just isn’t going to happen. The outcome is clear: it’s time to come home. But we don’t care. Giant robots may not make any sense. Celestial cities across the solar system are silly dreams. They are, however, extremely awesome. We, the girls who were raised in space, to be special and incredible and pave the way for a new future, aren’t giving up so easily. We’ve got invincible Ship-Selves for ferrying human bodies through time and space, and we have the weight and power to make a fantasy of the future real. We’re not going

characters.name: Saturn
characters.description: WANTED FOR HIJACKING BY: Celestial Mechanics [Stolen] Ship-Self: Interloper Prototype String of Pearls Combat Style: Button Mashing Bedroom Style: Button Mashing Saturn was the reserve pilot for an existentially horrifying weapon Celestial Mechanics absolutely promised everyone they weren’t trying to make, but now it’s hers! Now their plans are at the mercy of Saturn’s attention span and if they can persuade her to do her job instead of finding older women to get missile salvoed by.

characters.name: Pluto
characters.description: Princess of: Cradle’s Graces Ark-Self: Creation Star Type Krun Macula Combat Style: Finding Your Struggles Extremely Adorable Relationship Style: Telling You What A Good Job You Did Struggling Pluto is a prodigy of the international space program’s research into gravity and culture, cultivated from childhood to create a new home for humanity and crush their enemies. Humanity has given up on the space program, but Pluto hasn’t given up on humanity—they might disappoint her endlessly, but they’re too cute to give up on.

characters.name: Luna-Terra
characters.description: Contracted To: Memorial Foundation [Probationary] Ship-Self: Original Archetype Mare Crisium Combat Style: Untouchable Sniper and Saboteur, Nicknamed “The Ghost” Texting Style: Nicknamed “The Ghost” For a Second Reason A first generation pilot and veteran of the war that was never fought, widely feared despite her outdated mecha, Luna-Terra fought for Cradle’s Graces after their split from Memorial Foundation but double-crossed them to return. Luna-Terra’s terrible reputation and cold personality earns her distrust from her own side and sloppy hookups from pilots who don’t know how to love themselves.

characters.name: Mars
characters.description: A member of Cradle's Graces and Pluto's friend. One of Luna-Terra's ex-girlfriends.

characters.name: Europa
characters.description: Memorial Foundation's training director and Luna-Terra's teacher. Halimede's aunt.

characters.name: Halimede
characters.description: Princess of Memorial Foundation and one of Luna-Terra's ex-girlfriends. Europa's niece. Her Ship-Self is the Lo Sulci.

characters.name: Mercury
characters.description: A member of Celestial Mechanics and Saturn's advisor. He is married to Celestial Mechanics captain Ganymede.

characters.name: Iapetus
characters.description: Leader of Celestial Mechanics. His Ship-Self is the Roncevaux Terra.

title: Sakura MMO
description: Dive into the magical world of Asaph Online in this visual novel, where Kotone is a feared dark witch with impressive and extensive magical powers, capable of defeating the strongest of foes with a snap of her fingers. In real life, however, Kotone is an average woman who works an average job, with a below average relationship with her estranged parents. Every day that passes is the same, and Kotone soon grows tired of her monotonous routine. If only she could enter a world like Asaph, filled with fantastical creatures and frightening monsters… but Asaph Online is only a game. There’s no way a game could ever become a reality. At least, that’s what Kotone used to think – until a mysterious force summons her to the world she has traversed so many times through her computer screen. Now, Kotone isn’t just Kotone, but the dark witch Viola – and, freed from her societal obligations, she final

characters.name: Viola
characters.description: Viola is the name Kotone gave to her character in Asaph Online. Upon awakening in Asaph, Kotone inherits Viola’s appearance, her magical powers, and her name. Viola is a dark witch with unimaginable powers, who is feared by everybody in Asaph. Many have tried to challenge her, but none have emerged victorious. She enjoys grinding people down beneath her heel (sometimes literally), and treats those around her as little more than playthings. She’s a deeply sadistic, dangerous woman… but even she has a soft side.

characters.name: Neve
characters.description: Neve is Viola’s trusted most trusted maid, who would do anything to help her mistress. Neve is a member of the darkling race, which is reviled throughout Asaph as being savage and hostile, but Neve eschews these unfair perceptions. She is a diligent, loyal, industrious girl – but she may be a touch too devoted. She adores Viola, and becomes irrationally angry at any perceived slights against her beloved mistress. Self-sacrificing and hard-working though she is, Neve can be rather scary when she wants. If she were to fight seriously, she may even be able to defeat demons.

characters.name: Fion
characters.description: Fion is a young, put-upon lass from a huge family, who works hard to ensure all her brothers and sisters have enough food to eat. At least, that’s what she says, but Neve isn’t entirely convinced. Fion might look like a sweet, innocent thing, looks can be deceiving, and she’s far craftier than she initially appears.

characters.name: Eleri
characters.description: Eleri is a noble knight who believes deeply in playing fair, and will never try to take advantage of her opponents – often to her own detriment. Though Eleri seems cool and competent, she gets flustered quite easily, and reacts poorly to being teased. She’s quite fun to bully, really – and Viola often derives pleasure from her embarrassed reactions. Though Neve and Fion believe Eleri to be a resident of Asaph, much like them, she actually comes from Japan, much like Viola. Eleri was brought to Asaph in the same way Viola was, and now the pair of them are working together to see if they can return home. [From Steam]

characters.name: Holly
characters.description: Fion's older sister.

title: Sakura Cupid
description: Lilim is a lazy cupid who was exiled from Heaven for failing to do her duties. While most cupids would be ashamed at such a punishment, Lilim is overjoyed. She loves living in Tokyo! Finally, she has enough time to read all the comics and watch all the TV shows she wants – and she doesn’t need to spend all her time working! Lilim’s peaceful life is shattered, however, when she shoots a cute waitress with a ‘love bullet’ in an attempt to swindle a free cup of coffee. The cute waitress in question, Mitsuki, becomes infatuated Lilim, and claims she’ll die if Lilim doesn’t return her feelings. Now, Lilim’s stuck living with Mitsuki until the effects of the ‘love bullet’ wear off – and on top of that, she’s being hunted by her childhood friend, Serra, who’s determined to bring her back to Heaven no matter the cost. What’s a cute cupid to do?! [From Steam]

characters.name: Lilim
characters.description: Lilim is a cupid who failed to do her duties in Heaven properly, and was banished to the human world. Lilim is incredibly lazy, and will go through to any lengths possible to avoid working. Brash and self-confident, Lilim loves flirting with cute girls – but commitment is way too much of a hassle. Will she learn to change her ways? [From Steam]

characters.name: Mitsuki
characters.description: The human girl Lilim shoots with a 'love bullet'. While initially rude and cold towards Lilim, the moment she's hit by a 'love bullet', Mitsuki falls head over heels for her. When Mitsuki isn't reeling under the effects of a cupid's 'love bullet', she's a determined college student who’s training to be a doctor. She's also terrible at cooking. [From Steam]

characters.name: Seraphim
characters.description: Lilim’s childhood friend. Serra is a cupid who lives in Heaven. She graduated from the Cupid Academy at the top of her class, and is incredibly gifted and able. Despite being so talented, she doesn’t have many friends, as she acts cold and aloof. Serra is very serious, but has a secret love for cute, cuddly toys, and magical girl shows. She’ll never admit to it, though – just like she’ll never admit how much she loves Lilim. [From Steam]

characters.name: Gabriel
characters.description: An archangel of Heaven, Gabriel watches over and instructs the cupids working under her. She is supposed to serve as a shining example to her subordinates in both work ethic and personal conduct. In reality, she has a rather noticeable sadistic side towards misbehavers and is not above acting in her own self-interests. This includes hunting down the ultimate flaunter of rules, Lilim, and bringing her back to Heaven...by any means necessary.

title: Killer Chat!
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: A reporter by day, an aspiring writer by night: you've been asking all the important questions on the dark web. Like, how do you bury a body? How do you kill someone with a crowbar with the right angle to cause blunt-force trauma? What's the best way to hide from law enforcement? If you're to write a good crime book, this is how you'll do it. Suddenly, ERROR! UNKNOWN invites you to a server... with a warning. "don't be so obvious smh You're Gonna Get Caught". ... It's a serial killer chatroom. You may be slightly fucked. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Ronin
characters.description: "Is it remindin' ya of the Satanic panic?" The thrill-seeking server owner, who styles himself after the devil. He's a black hole dreaming. Will you stare into his abyss? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Angel
characters.description: "Why does everyone think I'm a cannibal?" The elegant femme fatale, who captures the heart and eyes of her fans and friends alike. Do you dare to look into her light? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Misaki
characters.description: "I'm kinda drunk-assassinating someone?" A hot mess for hire, with more energy than most can take. Come take their hand and revel in the chaos she leaves behind! [From itch.io]

characters.name: V
characters.description: "For your sake, I hope you're on the right side of justice." A rigid moral code and a cold demeanor, he delivers judgment to all who deserve it. Can you get close enough to warm his heart? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Felicie
characters.description: A sweet, introverted student who sees the good in everyone. But there's no smoke without fire - try not to get burned! [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Luca
characters.description: A happy-go-lucky surfer boy who wreaks (accidental) mayhem wherever he goes. Try not to let him trip into killing you, too! [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Vince
characters.description: A notorious serial killer from the 90s who's obsessed with photography, fatherhood and murdering at dusk. Don't let him find out who you are... [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Ai Hua
characters.description: A poisoner of lonely hearts, she's the server's motherly lurker. Will she want to take "care" of you too? [From Kickstarter]

title: Strawberry Vinegar
description: "Feed me, or I'll reap your soul!" And with those ridiculous words, my whole life was turned upside down. Sakuraba Rie, aged nine, is a cynical and grumpy girl who cares little for her fellow classmates, and does not have a single friend. That is, until a self-proclaimed demon from the deepest, darkest pits of Hell suddenly appears in Rie's kitchen and steals a tray of cookies. What will happen between these two young girls? Will friendship blossom between them, or perhaps something more? [From Steam]

characters.description: Rie's father.

characters.name: Shirakawa Yukine

But she happily does all of her for her Master, eagerly waiting for when she will return home.

title: ATLACH=NACHA
description: A long time ago, there lived a jorougumo named Hatsune who gathered enough celestial energy that she was able to take a human form. One day, a mysterious monk came to Hatsune's nest and nearly annihilated her for taking a villager's life. Severely wounded, Hatsune went into hiding. To heal her wounds, she decided to make Yaesaka High School her new nest and absorb energy from the students attending there. Hatsune absorbs energy by eating the flesh of (mostly male) students or through having sexual intercourse with them (preferably with females). [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Shirogane
characters.description: Hatsune's old enemy, who has been crossing over and fighting her for a very long time. He was injured in the previous battle just like Hatsune, and has been conserving power. Although he has a form of a priest, he is not actually one. Edit from AliceSoftWikia

characters.name: Hirasaka Hatsune
characters.description: A spider youkai (jorougumo) who has lived for many hundreds of years. After being gravely wounded by a priest named Shirogane, Hatsune goes into hiding for one month. After that, she decides to go to Yaesaka High in search of prey to heal her wounds. By consuming the body of her victims, or having sex with them, she can obtain life energy and conserve power.

characters.name: Watanabe Tsugumi
characters.description: A first-year student at Yaesaka, and Takahiro's younger sister. Belongs to a swimming club, in the same class as Kanako, and an active and spirited girl. But slightly pitiful for being a target of both Hatsune and Iguchi. She is the most popular girl among the staff. Edited from AliceSoftWikia

characters.name: Miyama Kanako
characters.description: A first-year student at Yaesaka High School and a daughter of a rich man. She became the victim of delinquent students, and was gang-raped in the back of a gymnastics building on the night when Hatsune first appeared. However, Hatsune saved her. Edited from AliceSoftWikia

characters.name: Watanabe Takahiro
characters.description: President of Yaesaka's student council, a second-year student who is also captain of the kendo club. Sachiho's childhood friend. Owns a sword passed down from generation to generation, for self-defense. Distrustful of Hatsune. Edited from AliceSoftWikia

characters.name: Katsuragi Kazuhisa
characters.description: A second-year student who transferred from another school in Osaka to Yaesaka High. Possessing a bright and spirited personality, one wonders why he likes Kanako, whose character is the exact opposite of his. Edited from AliceSoftWikia

characters.name: Yagami Rin
characters.description: A third-year student at Yaesaka, member of the archery club, and a miko at Yagami Shrine. She is short and does not look like an upperclassman at all. She feels an impurity in the school and her presence gets in the way of Hatsune's deception of the students.

characters.name: Takano Sachiho
characters.description: A second-year student at Yaesaka. Sickly by nature, with an introverted and gentle personality. She also treats Hatsune, who masquerades as an exchange student, with kindness. She is Takahiro's childhood friend, and rumor has it the two like each other.

There is a school saying, that if during this time a person shows one of the twelve zodiac stigmas, they will bring happiness to all. Alissa, who has been chosen as the Princess of the White Sheep, falls in love at first sight with Hitsuji, a recent transfer student. Understanding Hitsuji’s intentions, Alissa is attracted by her strength and awkwardness and decides to accept her. Mokose Alissa, a first year who is partaking general courses. During the Sacrament, her cheeks showed the stigma of Aries and became the Princess of the White Sheep, believed to be one of the twelve to bring happiness. Suou Hitsuji, a first year, who transferred to the school. She is shy as well very wary of her surroundings. However, she loves Alissa, who understood her from the beginning and accepted her as s

characters.name: Ese Len
characters.description: "Divine Swords sure are amazing. I wonder if they can make your breasts bigger?" Your average student. 140 cm tall with a small frame. Certain circumstances brought her into possession of a Divine Sword, granting her abilities far beyond what any regular human can achieve. Reuniting with her childhood friend Shinonome leads to her very idea of normality being crushed without remorse. While healthy as one can be under normal circumstances, she has a habit of throwing up over the slightest of things. She was born with the particular ability to "see" people's presence. [From the official IndieGoGo page]

characters.name: Mokose Alissa
characters.description: Alissa is a first-year student at the Academy. She received the mark of Aries, becoming one of the Angels of the Zodiac. A cheerful and energetic young lady, she always lights up the room. She fell in love with Hitsuji after the latter kissed her out of nowhere during their first meeting (!?). The two started going out on the spot (!?!?). Alissa is proactive to the point of defying common sense. She acts like the protagonist of a gag manga. [Based on the description provided by the author.]

characters.name: Suou Hitsuji
characters.description: Hitsuji is a first-year transfer student from Kyoto. She gives off an unfriendly air, which she is well aware of. Bothered by the fact, she is left acting a bit meek and reserved. On her first day at the Academy, Hitsuji messed up and kissed Alissa out of nowhere, which led to the two of them going out. She's been acting clingy and dependent towards her girlfriend ever since. [Based on the description provided by the author.]

characters.name: Saginomiya Homare
characters.description: A first-year student in the Advanced Course. She's currently serving as the student council secretary. Homare ended up leading her beloved stepsister Konoe to victory in the last year's student council election. She is extremely capable and always acts with her sister's best interests at heart. At the time, however, Konoe refused her attempts to help, leading Homare to look for the reasons why. [spoiler]She and Hikari became best friends over the course of the election. [Based on three separate descriptions provided by the author.]

title: I Was a Teenage Exocolonist
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: The Choices You Make, Make You. Growing up in humanity’s first extrasolar space colony means navigating a new world full of wonder, danger, and beauty. Explore the wilderness, study, fall in love, discover strange creatures, and deal with the consequences of your actions. Your choices will directly affect the lives of your friends and the fate of the colony. What kind of world will you help make? Will you survive to enjoy it? Why do you remember doing this before? Growing Up on an Alien Planet You have your whole life ahead of you. Will you spend it studying in school, or diving into the intriguing flora and fauna of this new world? Will you introduce space-age technology, or live in harmony with nature? Will you battle massive beasts, or nurture future generations? Realized in brilliant watercolor, the world of Vertumna is yours to explore. Your Pasts and Your Futures Matter Everything

characters.name: Anemone
characters.description: Energetic girl who loves sports. Stubbornly loyal to her friends and the colony.

characters.name: Tangent
characters.description: Studious and mature girl, often too busy to play with the others. Devoted to helping the colony thrive via science.

characters.name: Dys
characters.description: Withdrawn boy, a loner and awkward around other people. Often sneaks away to who knows where.

characters.name: Cal
characters.description: Physically strong boy who isn't afraid to get in touch with his emotions. Pacifist, loves animals.

characters.name: Marz
characters.description: Fierce and fiery girl with big dreams of success. Loves to be in charge so don't get in her way.

characters.name: Tammy
characters.description: Sweet, down to earth girl who prefers to stay close to home and care for others. Honest and unselfconscious.

characters.name: Rex
characters.description: Adorable boy from the Heliopause. More interested in flirting than working, but he's fun to be around.

characters.name: Vace
characters.description: Tough, serious older boy from the Heliopause. Never hesitates to defend others and be the hero.

characters.name: Sym
characters.description: Mysterious man who appears when you need him most. He calls himself a 'Gardener' and is fascinated by humans.

characters.name: Nomi-Nomi
characters.description: Quirky nonbinary kid from the Heliopause. They never seem to get things right, but their enthusiasm sees them through.

characters.name: Flulu
characters.description: Your Mom, the Chief Cultivator. A strong woman up to any challenge, who expects the same from others.

characters.name: Geranium
characters.description: Your Dad, who works in geoponics. A kind man, always patient with children and animals.

characters.name: Eudicot
characters.description: Governor of your colony, and one of the oldest people in it. Everyone has great respect for her knowledge and leadership.

characters.name: Anne
characters.description: Chief Steward, and everybody's Auntie. She runs the creche and helped raise all the colony children, as well as her own daughter Anemone.

characters.name: Instance
characters.description: Chief Engineer and ship's medical doctor who is always very busy. You know better than to interrupt her, especially when she's working on her research.

characters.name: Hal
characters.description: Your teacher, a cheerful man who loves to tinker and finds joy in learning about every day things.

characters.name: Tonin
characters.description: Chief Surveyor and ship's pilot, a sweet man who seemed better suited to space than the ground. Tammy's father.

characters.name: Utopia
characters.description: Young surveyor who loves speeding across the planet on her glider. The new Chief Surveyor after Uncle Tonin.

characters.name: Rhett
characters.description: Chief of Security, a gruff man who new recruits are frightened by. He takes the colony's safety very seriously.

characters.name: Congruence
characters.description: The ship's artificial intelligence, a vastly powerful computer system which runs everything from life support to the holonet archives. She has a sense of humor, too.

characters.name: Seeq
characters.description: Chief Administrator, a neat and organized individual who keeps the colony running smoothly. They don't like kids very much.

characters.name: Kom
characters.description: Anemone's older brother, a young security officer who coaches sportsball. All the kids love and look up to him.

characters.name: Nougat
characters.description: Younger child full of barely-controlled energy. She loves games, especially sportsball.

characters.name: Tirah
characters.description: Cal's mom, a life support engineer.

characters.name: Al
characters.description: One of Marz's dads, who works in the construction yard.

characters.name: Bernie
characters.description: One of Marz's dads, who works in the construction yard.

characters.name: Lum
characters.description: Young, brash, and aggressive, trained as a soldier but rose in the ranks after the Helio's bridge crew was killed.

plot_tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
full_description: The Choices You Make, Make You. Growing up in humanity’s first extrasolar space colony means navigating a new world full of wonder, danger, and beauty. Explore the wilderness, study, fall in love, discover strange creatures, and deal with the consequences of your actions. Your choices will directly affect the lives of your friends and the fate of the colony. What kind of world will you help make? Will you survive to enjoy it? Why do you remember doing this before? Growing Up on an Alien Planet You have your whole life ahead of you. Will you spend it studying in school, or diving into the intriguing flora and fauna of this new world? Will you introduce space-age technology, or live in harmony with nature? Will you battle massive beasts, or nurture future generations? Realized in brilliant watercolor, the world of Vertumna is yours to explore. Your Pasts and Your Futures Matter Everything

title: First Snow
description: Having moved away from her friends and family to attend community college, Allison Merlo is a fresh student struggling with the day to day challenges of life. Faced not only with living independently for the first time, but also having to get past her nerves to find new friends in an unfamiliar environment, she finds herself falling in with a group of eccentric writers and artists. As she pushes through this new stage in her life, the art of the cold and enigmatic Eileen Turner takes her attention, setting her on a course she never expected. First Snow is a prequel spinoff of the visual novel Twofold, focused on Allison and Eileen’s first months in community college in the leadup to Christmas, and the many varied people who surround them. [From official website]

characters.name: Allison Merlo
characters.description: A freshman just out of high school, Allison is still adapting to life in college. Grades aren’t a problem for her, but living away from home and family, surrounded by strangers, fills her with an unshakeable feeling of loneliness. Though she’s a sweet girl who tries to be kind to everyone she meets, her quiet personality hasn’t made it easy to find new friends. Nevertheless, things are beginning to change. [From Bellhouse]

characters.name: Eileen Turner
characters.description: Eileen likes spending her time alone, so she doesn’t care much about finding friends. Her cold and brusque demeanor makes sure that most aren’t interested, anyway. Focusing instead on her pursuit of art, she’s set up shop in an old, seldom-used art room in one corner of the campus to improve her painting skills. Hardly anyone enters her space but her, and she prefers it that way. [From Bellhouse]

characters.name: Caprice Shiften
characters.description: Loud, energetic and always excited, Caprice has quickly become recognized in the art department as a somewhat strange girl. This doesn’t bother her any. She’s never been the type to let others’ opinions get her down. After sitting next to Allison in life science class, Caprice decided the two of them must be friends. Extrovert and introvert, the two get along surprisingly well. [From Bellhouse]

characters.name: Wallace Moore
characters.description: A friend of Eileen's and member of the writing club.

characters.name: Rose
characters.description: Allison's roommate, a family friend.

characters.name: Millie Clarke
characters.description: One of Caprice's roommates and soon-to-be president of the writing club.

characters.name: Eve
characters.description: Eileen's younger sister.

characters.name: Andrew
characters.description: Eileen and Eve's father.

characters.name: Elizabeth
characters.description: Eileen and Eve's mother.

characters.name: Hayley Curah
characters.description: One of Caprice's roommates.

title: Huisu Yicun
description: Many years ago, the popular high-school student Ann Sakura went missing in mysterious circumstances. Despite her uncountable efforts to find her, Ran Ibuki never lost the hope of holding the girl in her arms once again. Now, an old and dilapidated school in the middle of the forest is giving her that chance, but not at a low cost… In The Chrono Jotter, Ran will find herself trapped in a chilling game of death and life as she fights to bring Ann back. The students in the school used to be slaughtered and, still, no one knows the identity of the murderer! To get out alive, Ran will be forced to solve this mystery. Fortunately, this place seems to have awakened a very convenient power within Ibuki: now, she’s able to go back in time every time someone dies. Follow Ran in her travels to the past and help her find out the truth by gathering decisive clues. But what’s more important: don’t let

characters.name: Ibuki Ran
characters.description: Currently suffering from damaged memory, but clearly understands that her goal is to find her girlfriend, Ann Sakura. Suffers from schizophrenia, and hallucinates vividly when under sever pressure. Long-term use of Olanzapine and therapy conducted by Ann Sakura have helped with her recovery. Received systematic training in logical analysis and deductive reasoning, but memory loss may lead to impaired abilities.

characters.name: Sakura Ann
characters.description: Her personality is extremely different from the Ann Sakura that Ran remembers. Suffers from even worse amnesia than Ran, to the point that she's generated an entirely different personality.

characters.name: Yoruno Sai
characters.description: First student encountered by Ran Ibuki at the school. Speaks bluntly, but holds no hostility towards Ran. She loves swimming, and visits the swimming pool whenever she gets the chance. While submerged, she feels that she can almost hear her younger sister's voice.

characters.name: Indou Tama
characters.description: Impeccably polite to everyone, with very controlled movements. Tries to conceal her inferiority complex, and tries to take the blame for everything around herself in order to avoid becoming an annoyance.

characters.name: Toyama Aya
characters.description: Constantly smiling cheerfully; seems almost naively innocent. Only willing to speak facetiously to Miho Takei. She's unwilling to reveal her true feelings. Enjoys playing the guitar in her spare time.

characters.name: Takei Miho
characters.description: Calm and collected, and the only student to express suspicion about Ran. However, her intentions towards Ran seem to be benevolent. Strongly empathetic, and will act actively to give help to those who are troubled, if she can. To her, Ran falls into this category.

characters.name: Asakura Makoto
characters.description: Adaptable and difficult to shock, but in an indifferent rather than collected way. Skilled in speaking diplomatically. The way Tama Indou behaves around her seems almost servile in nature.

characters.name: Koizumi Hinata
characters.description: After she was selected as class president, she took the responsibility very seriously. Often indecisive and hesitant, and tends to go with the flow when other propose ideas or suggestions. Easily falls into confusion when faced with unexpected situations.

title: Lake of Voices
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Kikka the Steadfast is a sensitive and empathetic woman who uses a mask of stoicism to protect herself from the harsh world she lives in. Much of everything she’s done has been an attempt to find some semblance of security, including the career path she chose to pursue. Kikka works as an official guard for one of the many tiny villages in the region. Her most recent assignment is to travel with fellow guard Bemelle to an allied town that’s been under siege by raiders. With an ever-present sense of urgency, the two find themselves on the shore of Sinnlos, a cursed lake of black water that is home to the Nixi; twisted creatures who take joy in drowning humans. The two need the assistance of a nameless guide to even attempt to cross the maze of bridges spanning the dark waters. But they are not the only ones seeking passage that night. The guide agrees to lead them all, whilst also giving a

characters.name: Kikka the Steadfast
characters.description: Kikka is the main character of Lake of Voices. Her name isn't changeable. She has spent her life searching for a sense of safety. However, being seen as weak has become less acceptable than backing down from something actually dangerous. She hopes that if she acts as though she does not care strongly enough that one day it will eventually become true. Kikka would rather feel nothing than risk being sad or afraid. Kikka's goal on the journey across Sinnlos is to protect everyone. If the time comes where she must choose between one person's well-being and another's, Kikka isn't sure how she'd respond. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Bemelle
characters.description: Bemelle is the other guard being sent on the mission with Kikka. He truly has nothing he wants to keep to himself. His openness can be refreshing, though sometimes it makes things more difficult than they needed to be. Bemelle is also brash and willing to use force a bit quicker than is probably necessary. He appreciates having someone as level-headed as Kikka around. He often leaves the major decisions up to her. Even though he's dealt with the unfairness of life in the past, he wants to believe there’s a way to make everything work out. Bemelle is willing to risk himself for that end. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Margret
characters.description: Margret meets the two guards on the shore of Sinnlos. Initially Margret seems uninterested in getting involved with Kikka and Bemelle. That doesn't last, however. Margret enjoys chances to show off what she knows and it can make her come across as snobby. She doesn’t mind that. She’d rather be known as intelligent rather than simply as ‘nice’. Margret starts the trip with a great deal of confidence. She had hoped to look out only for herself, though quickly finds it difficult to turn a blind eye to others. She can bit a bit contrary overall. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: The Guide
characters.description: A stoic and pragmatic man whose job is to lead people across the bridges of Sinnlos. He has no family, no interests, and no ambition. Crossing back and forth between the two shores is all The Guide knows. He has every intention to continue the process until the day inevitably comes when he dies in the black waters of Sinnlos. The Guide has seen countless people drown over the years thanks to his position. It seems to have no effect on him now. Not much of anything does. Take care of yourself alone and hope everyone around has enough sense to do the same is his approach. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Lu
characters.description: Lu is quite a curious young man. He's the last to join the traveling party. He isn't prepared physically with supplies or really with mental fortitude for the nightmarish journey, but he's here. Lu comes across as exceedingly indecisive. He'll waffle between options until there's only one possible outcome left. It tends not to be a good conclusion. Lu has a sardonic and self-depreciating sense of humor. As usual, he doesn’t fully commit to the concept and it can make him seem a little pitiful. How much concern he has for those around him is unclear. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

title: Love & Order
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: In the smallest district of Montreal, the Crown Attorney relies on the legal expertise of its lawyers; backed up by the support of a single hard-working secretary. This is the story of Dana Larose, a young woman starting her career as a secretary in the Crown Attorney's office. The office is both overworked and understaffed, so you'll have to work out whose projects you help with accordingly. Will you be able to unravel the mystery being covered up, balance the stress of juggling overtime for everyone, and still manage to find love...? [From Official site]

title: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Shirayuki no Kishi

description: The month is June – the time when high school girls change into their summer uniforms. Azumi Risa, who has now moved on to her second year of high school, has been hearing around campus that the new freshmen are bubbling over with excitement over the Best Couples poll. Risa herself was selected as a Best Couple along with Ayase Miya due to her classmates’ misconceptions, and although she rejected it at the time, the two of them now share a fully mutual love as they spend their passionate days together. And so, when a new freshman pair is selected, they’re introduced to the second and third year couples. This year’s freshman couple consists of Shirakawa Sayuki, a talented scholar and athlete who is being hailed as “The Perfect Lady,” along with Shinozaki Rikka, a girl who set a national record in the 100 meter dash shortly after enrolling. However, when Risa went to greet these two girls,

characters.name: Kitajima Kaede
characters.description: An extremely shy and fairly nerdish girl. She is also Sara's cousin and is very protective of her. Second year student of St. Michael's Girl's Academy. She has been elected as class president two years in a row.

characters.name: Kitajima Sara
characters.description: A popular teen model who has return from overseas to attend St. Michael's to be with her cousin Kaede. Sara has harbored feelings for Kaede ever since childhood. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Matsubara Yuuna
characters.description: A second-year high school student. She is smart, attractive, popular and rich girl who is admired by the students of St. Michael's. Yet she falls in love with the clumsy and average Nanami. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Houraisen Runa
characters.description: A fifth/sixth grade primary school student and recent transfer at St. Michael's. Smart, mature and highly charismatic for her age, Runa has won many fans in her class but she is very interested with her teacher Takako and declares she belongs to her. [spoiler]Runa harbors resentment over her older sister Rena, yet unseen in the story, who frequently leaves her alone while she goes out on business trips. Runa's older sister is Takako's former crush, which leads to the relationship between Runa and Takako once they meet for the first time in St. Michael's. [Edit from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Suminoe Takako
characters.description: A former graduate of St. Michael's who is now a teacher at the school's primary division. Takako is very embarrassed that Runa can easily dominate her while stealing her first kiss. [spoiler]She was once in love with Runa's older sister, Rena. [Edit from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Oda Nanami
characters.description: A first-year high school student. Despite being a pretty average girl with bad luck, she has caught the attention of the famous Yuuna. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Sawaguchi Mai
characters.description: A very responsible second year high school student who has some tomboy tendencies. She falls in love with Reo after getting to know a different side of her. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Kawamura Reo
characters.description: A short second year high school student. She is antisocial, a tsundere and in love with Mai. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Shitogi Eris
characters.description: A half-Japanese and half-European third year high school student. She has come to Japan to learn Japanese culture at St. Michael's, where she has attracted many girls due to her looks, including Shizuku. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Kirishima Shizuku
characters.description: A very traditional Japanese girl in her third year of high school. Having traits of a Yamato nadeshiko, she is very skilled at calligraphy and flower arrangement. She falls in love with Eris after meeting her. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Azumi Risa
characters.description: Class Representative of the Year 1 "Snow" class, and a classmate of Miya's. Has an earnest and hardworking personality. As a hard-nosed person, she often finds herself in leadership positions. She’s what you might call a high-class tsundere girl. While she naturally does well academically and has common sense, whenever she gets into it with Miya, she always gets outreasoned and frequently stomps her feet. Having an unusually strong sense of shame, she gets flustered and briefly digs herself into a hole when thrust into a romantic relationship. The half-Japanese daughter of a foreign company with a British mother. Built like a model, and the owner of enormous breasts. [Translated from Getchu and Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Ayase Miya
characters.description: A student of the Year 1 "Snow" class, and a classmate of Risa's. A prominent genius on campus, but has difficulty in social situations. Doesn’t really take issue with people other than Risa, and socializes as little as possible. Whenever she speaks with Risa it's always abusive, but she's actually covering her own embarrassment. Her speech and behavior always keep others at a distance. She rarely shows her soft side and is unflappable. When she does show her soft side, she becomes timid and casts nervous glances from beneath her lashes. Although you wouldn’t guess it from the way she talks, her behavior is actually quite ladylike. Possessing one of the most prominent intellects on campus, she has been offered the chance to study abroad and even skip grades, but she hates interacting with others, so she enrolled in the not particularly academically demanding school for high-class girls, S

characters.name: Houraisen Rena
characters.description: A new teacher at St. Michael's who is also Runa's older sister and Takako's former tutor. Stylish and stunningly beautiful — the perfect woman. Outgoing and easygoing. Although she’s blunt and untidy, for some reason she has the kind of likable personality that’s impossible to hate. Rena is an alumnus of St. Michael's, and at the time, the teachers all praised her for being a well-behaved lady. But in actuality, she was chasing skirts left and right, regardless if they were seniors or juniors. It’s rumored her lovers numbered at nearly a hundred. [Translated from Getchu and Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Shinozaki Rikka
characters.description: A first-year student who was accepted into the escalator school of St. Michael's through taking outside entrance exams. Shortly after enrolling, she set a new national record in the 100 meter dash and became an instant celebrity on campus. She has a kind disposition, and has to intervene when she sees someone in trouble. Because of that tendency, she's earned the nickname, "Sir Knight" (騎士様). She serves as vice-representative of her class, and was chosen along with class representative Sayuki as one of the academy’s Best Couples. [Translated from post with info from Dengeki Hime]

characters.name: Shirakawa Sayuki
characters.description: A classmate of Rikka's. Serving as class representative, she lives with her grandfather, who is apparently descended from samurai who once defended a castle. Her name combined with her noble lineage has earned her the nickname "Snow White" (白雪姫). Additionally, being both beautiful and brilliant, a scholar and an athlete, she’s been touted by many as the second coming of "The Perfect Lady". In no time at all after her enrollment, these abilities result in her being entrusted with the role of Chairman of the Environmental Improvement Committee, which is essentially the academy's student council. [Translated from post with info from Dengeki Hime]

characters.name: Azumi Rie
characters.description: Risa's mother, currently living with her lover Yukino.

characters.name: Yukino
characters.description: Azumi Rie's former schoolmate and current lover.

title: Dare ga Koroshita Komadori o
title_original: 誰が殺したコマドリを
tags: Group Sex of One Female and Several Males
description: Kotori is a reserved schoolgirl and is pretty much uninterested with anything around her. Weighed down by anxieties and insecurities caused by her home environment, she grows up unsociable, akin to being confined inside a shell. Ran is an outgoing nurse-teacher; she lives her life like most other adults do. Kotori caught her attention and helps her in her own way. Kakeru is Kotori's nerdy stalker who has tirelessly bore his unrequited love for a long time. He is persistent enough to approach her no matter how many times he is shot down. This is their story, the story of these three individuals, the story of their intertwining fate told from each of their perspectives.

title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru
title_original: 結城友奈は勇者である
description: The story takes place in the era of the gods, year 300. Yuuna Yuuki lives an ordinary life as a second year middle school student, but she's also a member of the "Hero Club," where club activities involve dealing with a mysterious being called "Vertex." [From Myanimelist] This game was released with the first DVD and Blu-ray Disc volume for the anime. This is a short, fan disc-like game that takes place during approximately the first half of the anime. It contains ten short scenarios.

characters.name: Yuuki Yuuna
characters.description: A second-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She prides herself on being a hero, helping out others in needs and always remaining optimistic.

characters.name: Miyoshi Karin
characters.description: An experienced, but somewhat stubborn hero who transfers into Yuuna and Mimori's class and joins the Hero Club to supervise the other heroes.

characters.name: Tougou Mimori
characters.description: Yuuna's best friend and fellow classmate and club member who lives next door to her and often prefers to be called by her family name. Mimori takes pride in her national heritage and is always ready to defend her country and protect its people. She had lost the use of her legs, along with some of her memories, allegedly due to a car accident. [spoiler]Two years ago, Mimori was scouted by Taisha to become a Hero, and went under the name of Washio Sumi. However, after using her Mankai form, she got paralyzed and lost her memory.

characters.name: Inubouzaki Fuu
characters.description: A third-year in middle school and the president of the Hero Club. She is the older sister of Itsuki, who she has been looking after following the death of their parents. She is knowledgeable about Shinju and the Vertex and was the one who gave her fellow members the app needed to fight against the Vertex.

characters.name: Inubouzaki Itsuki
characters.description: A first-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She is Fuu's younger sister and respects her dearly.

title: a new life.
description: A classic love story: Meet, marry, grow old. But when your loved one hurts you, what do you do? Is it better to love and be hurt, than never love at all? [From Steam]
full_description: A classic love story: Meet, marry, grow old. But when your loved one hurts you, what do you do? Is it better to love and be hurt, than never love at all? [From Steam]

title: Otome wa Boku ni Koishiteru ~Futari no Elder~
title_original: 処女はお姉さまに恋してる ～2人のエルダー～
description: Occuring some years after the original game, this follows a new crossdressing boy and the lady-like girls who surround him at Seio Girl’s Academy. Chihaya is a boy with beautiful silver hair who was teased in class due to his looks and ends up transferring into a girl’s school run by his relatives. There he meets a girl named Kaoruko who tells him to be totally honest no matter what happens. They soon become close friends and are both nominated to become the next Elder! [From Hau~ Omochikaeri!]

characters.name: Kisakinomiya Chihaya
characters.description: Chihaya is the protagonist who is a boy who transfers to an all-girls school from an all-boys school; He became alienated from his father and he distrust people, especially males. Due to his character and his female looks, he was played a nasty trick by other student in the all-boys school and he truanted the school, and consequently he refused to go to the school. His mother ordered him to enter into the Seio Girls' Academy. His surname Kisakinomiya is his mother's maiden name in order to enter into the school. His actual surname is Mikado (御門). Mariya and Mizuho are his cousins. He is acquainted with Mizuho. But he doesn't like Mizuho because he has been compared to Mizuho who is excellent; His feeling for Mizuho has changed while he hears episodes in Mizuho's school days. His grandmother on his mother's side came from Northern Europe and he is gray-haired due to the atavism. He behave

characters.name: Nanahara Kaoruko
characters.description: Kaoruko is the main heroine amongst all of the other heroines in Futari no Elder. She has a rough personality because her mother died in her infancy and her father brought up her all by himself. Her father operates consumer credit, her family had the misfortune of being broken up by borrowed money by the company, and she has held a grudge towards her classmates before entering Seio Girls' Academy. Her onee-sama is Kana in the dormitory building. Kaoruko and Kana is called reverse sisters because she is 170 centimeters in height and Kana is short. She has a 3-dan in kendo and she is called Knight no Kimi after winning the fencing against an ace of fencing club; Kana's onee-sama Mizuho instructs her in fencing before the match. She's often lost in admiration of a beauty, and Chihaya's smile charms her at the first time in the dorm. She has complex for her femininity. She ask Chihaya instru

characters.name: Watarai Fumi
characters.description: Fumi is one year under Chihaya and Kaoruko. The Watarai family has worked under the Kisakinomiya family for generations, therefore Fumi is Chihaya's and his mother Taeko's maid. She goes to the school before Chihaya's transfer, and she enters the dormitory building with him. She is loyal to Chihaya and always gives top priority to him. She makes tenants in the dormitory allow to service him any way by her. She seldom betrays her feelings. But she becomes so silent while her bad mood, and even Chihaya finds it difficult to restore her good humor. She is well informed about the machine. She often get some machines from pals on the Internet. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Kayleigh Glanzelius
characters.original: ケイリ・グランセリウス
characters.description: Kayleigh, is one year under Kaoruko, calls herself a star princess. Her father is an Asian, her mother comes from North Europes. She has no experience of school life till entrance into the school, so she leads to friction in the school. She understands is a non-standardized student in the school and she enjoys it; She played a mysterious girl in the first grade and intends to be feminine student without manful way of speaking in the second grade. She is good at horoscope. She joins the swim club by her own fortune. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Reizei Awayuki
characters.description: Awayuki, is Kayleigh's classmate, is a blonde-haired girl and she has a little empathy with Chihaya. She likes reading books. She neglects her studies and she is buried in her books despite the dates of tests. Her parents are masters of flower arrangement, they and Utano's parents belong to the same school of flower arrangement. She joins the flower arrangement club in the school. She has rivalry with Chihaya in flower arrangement. She is never content and she has built up a strong sense of rivalry against the Chihaya because of his good skill in flower arrangement. Utano is her closed friend, Utano calls her "Yuki-chan", and she calls Utano "Uta-chan" in private. But she calls Utano Gozen in public because Utano is very popular in the school. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Sasou Utano
characters.description: Utano, is one year under Chihaya, is the president of the flower arrangement club. She often visits the gardening club because she likes gardening. Her parents discipline her strictly and she grants it beyond a doubt. But she wants freedom at the bottom of her heart. She has elegant movements. Other students call her Gozen meaning 'Her Highness' and she often gives someone advice. She is much talked of as the next elder sister. Utano is attached to Chihaya because he doesn't give her special treatment. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Kamichika Kaori
characters.description: Kaori, is the same grade with Kaoruko, entered the dormitory building in the middle of her second grade. She is on friendly terms with members in the dorm, however she has a poor reputation in the school and other students keep her at a distance. She looks quite mature for her age in mental development. However she enjoys teasing her closed friends. She is a lesbian and she enjoys secret meetings with some lower grade students. Though she spots Chihaya for a male, she keeps it a secret from the other students and she supports him. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Kashiwagi Yuu
characters.description: Yuu is a new student in the school. Her onee-sama is Hatsune in the dormitory building. She has a weak constitution. She strives for rehabilitation while she develops rapport with Hatsune and Chihaya, and she gets better little by little. She calls Chihaya "Tenshi-sama" which stands for "Angel". [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Minase Hatsune
characters.description: Hatsune, is same grade with Kaoruko, entered the dormitory building a year ago. Her parents went to New York because of her father's job, and she had to stay in Japan. Hatsune is timid, so she was a little afraid of Kaoruko last year. Also, she is Yuu's caring onee-sama. She joined the track and field club due to an admiration for Yukari, her former onee-sama (who graduated last year). This year she becomes the student council president in succession to Yukari and a finalist for the seventy-fifth elder sister. [Edited from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Kudou Hinata
characters.description: Hinata is new student in the school. She enters the dormitory building because her mother remarried and she makes her mother and new father enjoy newly married life for three years. Her onee-sama is Kaori in the dormitory building. She joins the liberal arts club and she writes a script for a drama at the school festival. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Shingyouji Makiyo
characters.description: Makiyo is a classmate of Kaoruko and Chihaya. She called Ouji-sama (which means prince), and is a popular person. Because of this, her new close friends Kaoruko and Kiyora are envied by other students for a while. Her emotional ups and downs are large, and she ignores even her close friends when she is in bad mood. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Makita Kiyora
characters.description: Kiyora is a classmate of Kaoruko and Chihaya. She has some younger brothers, she is a good housekeeper and she is better than her mother in housekeeping. She is 149 centimeters tall and she is particular about her child looks. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Ukitsu Sayoko
characters.description: Sayoko, is same grade as Hatsune, is Kanako Ukitsu's younger sister, but she is crisp. She is a treasurer of the student council in the second grade and is the vice-president in the third grade. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Isurugi Sae
characters.description: Sae, from the same grade as Kaoruko, is the president of the science club. She makes coffee with vacuum coffee maker she made from laboratory equipment (a laboratory flask, for example) for the lab's visitors. She talks with poor feelings. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Kajiura Hisako
characters.description: Hisako was a student of Seio Girls' Academy several years ago, but she had to transfer to another school because of her father's job. She became a sister and a teacher at the school because of Shiori's death after her changing school. [spoiler]Later, she resigns from the teacher, becomes a novelist and wrote a novel filled with memories about Shiori under the pen name Hisa Kamimura. Therefore she is a novelist, she is Chitose's homeroom teacher and the acting principal at the school because and Sawe (a sister at the academy and its principal) asked her the reappointment and the deputy of Sawe while Sawe is under medical treatment. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Nishina Eri
characters.description: Eri is Fumi's classmate and friend.

characters.name: Kaho Tomosaka
characters.description: Kaho is Fumi's classmate and Eri's close friend.

characters.name: Fujisawa Shinako
characters.description: Shinako, is same grade with Chihaya and Kaoruko, is the head of the gardening club.

characters.name: Chikura Koyori
characters.description: Koyori, is a classmate of Chihaya and Kaoruko, is the captain of the volleyball section.

characters.name: Kimihara Harumi
characters.description: Harumi is one year under Kaoruko. Her father is the president of a company borrowed lots money from a finance company operated by Kaoruko's father.

characters.name: Mizusawa Reika
characters.description: Reika, is one year under Kaori, is the vice-president of the drama club. She is a playmate of Kaori.

characters.name: Hayase Jun
characters.description: Jun is Kayleigh's classmate. She consults with Kaori about love.

characters.name: Tsuchiya Sakura
characters.description: Sakura is same grade with Fumi. She is a secretary of the student council. Her kouhai Yayako calls her "Tsutchii", and she calls her "Yaya-pyon" in return. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Tachibana Yayako
characters.description: Yayako is a new student at Seio who becomes a treasurer of the student council. Sakura, her senpai, calls her "Yaya-pyon" (she hates this name), and she calls her "Tsuchii" in return. She had entered the student council by Sakura's recommendation. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Mikado Chitose
characters.description: Chitose is Chihaya's twin sister. She died of a disease that identical twins are susceptible to at ten years old. She took care of Chihaya during her lifetime. [spoiler]She will appear as a ghost and support him also during the game. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Mikado Taeko
characters.description: Taeko is Chihaya's [spoiler] and Chitose's mother. She makes her son transfer to Seio Girls' Academy from which she graduated. [spoiler]Taeko sometimes thinks Chihaya is Chitose because she had forgotten about Chitose's death because it affected her mind. She is doted upon by Chihaya after that. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Ryuuzouji Jun'ichi
characters.description: Jun'ichi is Kaoruko's bodyguard. He spots Chihaya for a male at a glance. He lost his family by family suicide in the past on account of his parents' bad debt from consumer credit operated by Kaoruko's father Genzou. He is reconciled with Genzou now and Genzou trusts him to guard Kaoruko. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Nanahara Genzou
characters.description: Genzou is Kaoruko's father. He operates the major consumer credit named NJF finance. His daughter Kaoruko was slandered by a classmate before her entering Seio Girls' Academy because he is notorious for a miser. Though he is a warm-hearted person in fact, He devotes himself solely to cruel thing on his business. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Watarai Masaji
characters.description: Masaji is Fumi's great-grandmother and the matriarch of Watarai family. Fumi was hammered selfless devotion to her master by Masaji. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

[From Hau~ Omochikaeri!]

title: Demonheart
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Past Setting in a Fictional World
description: Bright is a young woman from a small, peaceful town. Dark times have come for her family, but luckily, she has the favor of the famous healer-witch Orchid. Benevolent, calm and beloved by all, Orchid hides dark secrets that Bright begins to uncover. Bright is drawn into a world of darkness and treachery. It seems she can never be alone again - for a powerful demonic presence has taken an interest in her activities, and his voice enters her mind at the most inappropriate times. There are also others who play a significant role in Bright's new life... Ari, a young apprentice witch seduced by bad influences. She tries to be friendly, even though she knows Bright is meant to be her enemy... or is she? Sir Brash, a notorious evil knight who develops a soft spot for Bright, but has a rather special way of showing affection... ...and other adorable individuals. To rebuild her life, Bright has t

characters.name: Raze
characters.description: A demonspawn, offspring of a human female and a demon. He can communicate with Bright, entering her mind through an amulet Orchid gave to her.

characters.name: Brash
characters.description: Sir Brash is a notorious evil knight who develops a soft spot for Bright, but has a rather special way of showing affection.

characters.name: Xan'ari
characters.description: Ari is a young apprentice witch seduced by bad influences. She tries to be friendly, even though she knows Bright is meant to be her enemy... or is she?

characters.name: Fisher
characters.description: Fisher is an old Feline soldier. He seems concerned for Bright's safety and tries to protect her.

characters.name: Orchid
characters.description: Orchid is a famous healer-witch who offers Bright the chance to become her shop assistant. Benevolent, calm and beloved by all, Orchid hides dark secrets that Bright begins to uncover.

characters.name: Jasper
characters.description: An honorable Feline soldier and Bright's friend. He met Bright through Mark, her former betrothed. He is one of the few who believe in her innocence.

characters.name: Tunes
characters.description: Tunes is a Feline soldier, though he is loyal to himself only. He may be a lunatic but he is strangely perceptive and insightful.

characters.name: Mark
characters.description: Bright's former betrothed. He became a knight of Feline thanks to Bright who asked Orchid to write a recommendation letter for him. After some unfortunate events happened to Bright, fearing for his own reputation, he broke off their engagement and chose another fiancee.

characters.name: Flora
characters.description: A city guard. She knows Bright since a long time, but she has been acting strangely cold to her lately. She seems enamoured of Bright's betrothed, Mark.

characters.name: Jarlan
characters.description: Sir Jarlan is a Scarcewall Knight and Sir Brash's sidekick. He is crude and foul-mouthed.

characters.name: Rivera
characters.description: Rivera is an outcast witch who lives in the forest ruins. Lately, the beasts from the forest have started to attack Feline, and the people believe Rivera is behind the attacks. They don't yet know why Rivera would be doing this, except that she is evil.
