title: Lilja to Natsuka no Junpaku na Uso
title_original: リルヤとナツカの純白な嘘
description: The world is illuminated by your light, and the flowers you hold give it color. There's a rumor spreading quietly across the internet: "An anonymous painter will paint anything you request." They do not want money or fame. Capricious and eccentric, the painter only accepts requests that pique their interest. Those lucky enough to meet this mysterious criteria will be chosen to meet with Lilja—a beautiful girl with long, fairy-like silver hair and eyes that shine like gemstones. Even though she is blind and wheelchair-bound, this does not hinder her genius. "From this day forward, I'm going to become your new eyes and legs!" Natsuka is her energetic live-in assistant. She acts as Lilja's eyes and legs, using her instinct and intuition to find the inspiration and information beyond what's necessary that Lilja seeks. "I don’t [i]know for sure, but I can [i]feel it!" Her words resound within

characters.name: Lilja Meri
characters.description: "My little dove has brought me an olive leaf! It's now my turn to take care of the rest." A blind, wheelchair-bound girl born into royalty in a country in northern Europe. Though she's tall and wise beyond her years, she's still in her teens. She moved to Japan, where her grandmother is from, in order to get away from her overprotective family. Rationality and efficiency are her mottos. With her long, silver hair, she possesses the beauty of a snow fairy. She has an incredible talent for painting, and it's said that her paintings are able to change the world for anyone who sees them. [From official website]

characters.name: Utsugi Natsuka
characters.description: "Your paintings are truly incredible, Lilja-san. They have the power to change the world of anybody who sees them." An energetic girl who works as a live-in assistant for Lilja. She dedicates her days to being Lilja's new eyes and legs and bringing inspiration to the painter, who is blind and can't walk. Her short stature and youthful looks make it easy to mistake her for an elementary schooler, but she's actually a full-grown adult. She tends to make decisions based on intuition and wild instinct alone. She's strong, stubborn, and has a healthy appetite. [From official website]

characters.name: Sasanami Mahiru
characters.description: "I admit that I'm not a 24-hour security system, since I have to sleep at some point. But I try to keep an eye out seven days a week, anytime, anywhere." A shut-in whose hobbies include e-commerce, video games, and celebrity gossip. She works as a security guard at Lilja's condominium to guarantee Lilja's safety while she lives alone. Her room is filled to the brim with all sorts of goods, but she doesn't seem to mind the mess. When Lilja offered her a bonus, Mahiru requested that Lilja paint a picture of a monster that can make even eternal love grow cold. [From Official Website]

characters.name: Togetsu Yoru
characters.description: "Fame brings nothing good with it. You get a bunch of things you never really wanted, and you lose everything you did want..." An up-and-coming actress and model who primarily works in Europe. She is a breathtaking beauty with a sharp gaze that always seems to be filled with anger. She has returned to Japan to promote her new movie. [From Official Website]

characters.name: Kasugai Yuu
characters.description: "Memories are strange things, aren't they? When I think back to the fun times I had in school, my weary heart warms up, and it gives me the energy to keep going." A kind, gentle lady who works for a confectionery manufacturer in Tokyo. Yuu has a laid-back attitude and enjoys baking sweets. She especially loves visiting cafes and bakeries with her friend Takano, and her social media feed is chock-full of beautiful pictures. She is getting married soon, and she requests a painting of the train station from her high school days to decorate the new apartment she'll be sharing with her partner. [From Official Website]

characters.name: Hanegasaki Mariko
characters.description: "I'm sure we're going to be happy. Father and Mother, and now Yoshino, too, are watching over us from heaven. We have to move on with our lives and be happy." The eldest daughter of the long-standing, noble Hanegasaki family. She is a dignified lady who charms people with her elegant looks and her open-minded and refined demeanor. She and her twin sister, Miyako, have been together with their childhood friend Yoshino since they were born. She loves to dote on her younger twin sister. [From Official Website]

characters.name: Shiranui Lila
characters.description: "I want to know... I need to know." The caretaker of the storehouse where the Meri family's paintings are stored. She is a somber, elderly woman who's often seen wearing a classic black dress and lives a quiet life by herself in the living quarters attached to the storehouse. [From Official Website]

characters.name: Inui Saarijärvi
characters.original: イヌイ・サーリヤルヴィ
characters.description: "It's my job to provide Lilja-sama with the information she needs." An extremely capable detective and researcher who works at the Japanese branch of the detective agency "Antero Research," which has deep ties to the royal family. She is a mature woman who seems to have a permanent smile and is always one or two steps ahead of her clients. Whatever they need, she will procure it. [From Official Website]

characters.name: Hanegasaki Miyako
characters.description: The younger Hanegasaki twin is an introverted and shy girl who can normally be found hiding behind her older sister. Humble and kind, she evokes in others the desire to protect her. She's still in shock after losing her childhood friend in the car accident that she managed to survive. She has since confined herself to her room while she recovers from her injuries. [From Official Website]

characters.name: Kuzumi Yoshino
characters.description: A heroic, gallant girl and the eldest daughter of the Kuzumi family, which has served the Hanegasaki family as doctors for generations. She is extremely loyal and often protected the twins like a knight. Her excellent grades, athletic skills, and great reputation have earned her tons of popularity among the other students at school. However, she died in a traffic accident while protecting Miyako. [From Official Website]

characters.name: Takano Akira
characters.description: A calm, confident, and dependable woman who works at a jewelry company in Tokyo. She is a close friend of Yuu's. The two often go out together, and they can talk to each other about almost anything. [From Official Website]

title: Highway Blossoms: Next Exit
tags: Modern Day United States of America
description: Return to Las Vegas with Amber and Marina in this new Highway Blossoms story! A couple months after the events of the first game, the two girls return to the desert city for an alien-themed convention and to see Tess for her birthday. They also end up reuniting with Cassi, the candy shop girl, who's determined to start following her own dreams. [From Steam]

characters.name: Amber Golley
characters.description: A quiet cynic with a short temper, Amber is a lifelong loner, wrestling with the recent death of her only real family, her beloved grandfather. To cope, she drives through the desert in her inherited RV, drifting towards a music festival with nothing but her memories to keep her company. But things start to take a turn when she stumbles upon a bubbly girl broken down on the side of the road. Amber is initially skeptical of her, but maybe by helping this strange girl search for treasure, Amber can find what she's looking for as well. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Marina Hale
characters.description: Marina was born and raised in the state of New Mexico, and until recently, was afraid she might die there too. But when the story of a gold miner's hidden treasure takes the nation by storm, she uses the opportunity to bring some excitement into her sheltered life. Bubbly and naïve, Marina might be in a bit over her head, but with the help of her new friend, Amber, she may just get the adventure she always wanted. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Mariah Pastorius
characters.description: An abrasive alcoholic and overall terrible human being, Mariah has devoted her entire miserable existence to finding the gold miner's mythical treasure. She claims to be the best treasure hunter around, but the only thing she seems to excel at is leaving a path of chaos and destruction in her wake. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Joseph Nowell
characters.description: One might think being the great-great-grandson of the famous gold miner would give Joe a vested interest in the hidden treasure, but that can't be further from the truth. Joe wants nothing more than to spend his days sinking into the couch and taking afternoon naps. Unfortunately, someone needs to be Mariah's wrangler, and as her lifelong (and only) friend, the responsibility falls to him. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Tess Pastorius
characters.description: Life isn't easy when you're Mariah's little sister - just ask Tess. When she's not getting dragged across the country to look for treasure, she's busy trying not to be swallowed whole by her sister's bombastic personality. Tess has learned to make the most of it though, choosing to quietly devote herself to crafts and her fascination with Americana. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Cassi Bell
characters.description: A cashier at a candy shop. After years of spinning her wheels, Cassi's decided to make a change in her life. Rather than be stuck at a cashier for a store she doesn't care about forever, she’s decided to follow her passion into sweetsmaking and try to make it on her own. When Amber and Marina walk in her door one day, Cassi's pretty sure it must be destiny. [Edited from official site]

title: Sakura Maid 3
description: Sena’s master has yet to return home, but another mysterious guest has appeared at her front doorstep. Supposedly hailing from the Iron Cliffs, Ladon is an ambassador of dragonkind, a species that has long thought to be little more than a myth. Ladon intially desires to speak with Sena’s master, but due to The Master’s absence, she chooses to wait for her at the manor instead. The two of them gradually grow closer as they spend time together, eventually desiring each other’s company in a far more intimate way. [From DenpaSoft]
full_description: Sena’s master has yet to return home, but another mysterious guest has appeared at her front doorstep. Supposedly hailing from the Iron Cliffs, Ladon is an ambassador of dragonkind, a species that has long thought to be little more than a myth. Ladon intially desires to speak with Sena’s master, but due to The Master’s absence, she chooses to wait for her at the manor instead. The two of them gradually grow closer as they spend time together, eventually desiring each other’s company in a far more intimate way. [From DenpaSoft]

title: Himitsu no Kiss wa Amaku Yasashiku
title_original: 秘密のキスは甘くやさしく
description: “Sensei… how does it feel to love someone?” In an empty classroom, Konami Izuho, a teacher-in-training, is suddenly kissed by her student Ema Serizawa. Ema is a popular illustrator who Konami admires, and asks Konami to help with her draw new illustrations. Konami was hoping to get a sneak peek at some new illustrations and says yes to the task. But the requests from Ema were heart-pounding ones like getting kissed, sharing a bath, and sleeping in the same bed. “I… didn’t expect helping meant kissing and sharing beds.” Konami’s meeting with Ema lifts the curtain on a love drama in which Konami’s feelings go back and forth between “admiration” and “love”. [From Gematsu]

characters.name: Izuho Konami
characters.description: Izuho Konami was assigned to a certain prestigious prep school as a student teacher. She’s a little clumsy, but cheerful, sociable and friendly. She has never experienced romance. She has two younger brothers and has certain level of skill when it comes to housework. As she had to take care of her younger brothers, she didn’t have a lot of freedom growing up. As a result, she is a little envious of people who behave freely. Her hobbies are reading manga, looking at illustrations online, and playing games. She’s kind of an indoor person. She is currently disappointed that her favorite illustrator hasn’t uploaded any new illustrations recently. She also has mixed feelings about cooperating with Ema’s requests. ”I just don’t want to do it to see the illustrations... I think.” [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Serizawa Ema
characters.description: Serizawa Ema transferred to the school as a second-year student. She is quick-witted, nimble, and is an outstanding student. She doesn’t like exercise very much but is very athletic. She doesn’t usually show her emotions and isn’t good at expressing herself. It’s not that she thinks she doesn’t need friends, but she is often alone. She is an only child, so she feels she has missed out on being close with others, That’s why she likes being mischievous and making physical contact. She’s actually a popular illustrator and is famous online. She keeps that a secret to those around her, though. Also, she hasn’t released a new illustration recently. In her private life, she isn’t careful about what she eats. On the contrary, she is always neat and cleans her room properly. She also prefers wearing sexy underwear. [From MangaGamer]

title: Fatal Hearts
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Dreams... Ice-blue eyes calling to you in the night... The howls of wolves echo across empty streets. A young women found dead, violently murdered. Love and loneliness. In Fatal Hearts you play the role of Christina Robinson and help her to uncover the secrets behind her dreams. As the story unfolds you will be forced to make choices of who to trust and who to declare an enemy. Solve puzzles and conquer challenges, but be careful, or Christina may become another victim... [From Hanako Games]

characters.name: Christina Robinson
characters.description: Sign: Aquarius The main character, controlled by the player. A shy dreamer, who loves fantasy novels and pretty dresses. Her parents are divorced, and she lives with her mother. [From the official strategy guide]

characters.name: Lucy Torvill
characters.description: Sign: Libra Lucy is Christina's best friend. She's a spunky, energetic girl who is always getting in and out of trouble. Loves videogames and wants a fast car. [From the official strategy guide]

characters.name: Randy Gardner
characters.description: Sign: Leo A cheerful, athletic guy with shaggy hair and a friendly smile. He comes from a wealthy family and loves dogs. But when he gets angry... [From the official strategy guide]

characters.name: Tim Davies
characters.description: Sign: Aries A smart-aleck with a quick wit and an equally quick temper. Likes to tell crazy jokes and goof off. His friends say he's crazy like a fox. [From the official strategy guide]

characters.name: Jeremy Bowman
characters.description: Sign: Gemini Just out of high school and planning for his future. He comes from a poor, uneducated family and is driven to make something better for himself. [From the official strategy guide]

characters.name: Elizabeth Sumners
characters.description: Sign: Virgo An old friend of Christina's, who looks younger than she really is. Her parents don't pay much attention to her. Loves books and has trouble dealing with people. [From the official strategy guide]

characters.description: Lucy's father.

title: The Waters Above: Prelude
description: A giant dome called the Vault of Heaven covers the earth, separating it from the vast ocean of the heavens. In this world, sea nymphs care for the stars in the sky, dedicating their lives to it. However, magic is fading, the stars are dying, and no one knows why. No one even speaks of it, carrying on like they have for tens of thousands of years, as if nothing has changed. In these circumstances, three sea nymphs and the living embodiment of a star struggle to find meaning in their lives and their fading world. [From itch.io] The Waters Above: Prelude was a prequel story to a planned game called 'Starkeeper: The Waters Above', but the latter has since been canceled.

characters.name: Maera
characters.description: A young and well-respected starkeeper. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Apple
characters.description: The star in Maera's care, and the first in ten thousand years to have a human form. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Clio
characters.description: Maera's girlfriend and the head of maintenance for the Celestial authority. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Iris
characters.description: The assistant archivist and researcher trying desperately to save the stars. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Iris
characters.description: [spoiler]Iris' clone. Star material was injected into her while she was growing.

At that moment, the bell of the clock tower, which was rusty and always silent, rang out. "When the bell of the clock tower rings, the end of this school will come soon." Like the gossip had hinted, it was the beginning of a nightmarish turmoil in Puellarium. Alouette who had became a student after many complications, violated curfew and left her room. Create your own OC as either a human or custom furry species and test your charisma skills by exploring and approaching various characters, each with their own story progression and intimate scenes that you can unlock by completing all of their date paths! [From Itch.io]

title: Yumeutsutsu Re:After
tags: Protagonist's Full Sister as a Heroine
Protagonist's Younger Sister as a Heroine
description: Yumeutsutsu Re:After includes the following character after stories: - Kokoro After Story: “Yumeutsutsu Re:Unification” - Saki After Story: “Deadline Rather than Paradise” - Nana After Story: “Ghosts of the Past” - Marie After Story: “Married Life” - Honoka Episode: “Love Story, With Her and the Dog”

characters.name: Oohara Kaede
characters.description: Former registered nurse and Asuka's nurse instructor. Born in the "Oohara" family known for their exceptional influence in medicine. Chose to go to the Imperial Capital Nursing Technical School to work as a teacher after serving as an RN. She's the "White Robe Angel", according to Asuka. [Translated from Official Site]

characters.name: Ootori Ai
characters.description: Assistant Director (Trainee) Ai adores her younger sister, Kokoro. She's meek and diligent, but thinks she's a boring person. She has a gloomy, negative temperament, but is a bit of an airhead. People around her think she's interesting. When she gets excited, her hometown accent colors her speech. She used to enjoy making art, but she fell into a slump and currently isn't drawing. Following her sister, she moved to Tokyo alone and got hired by Eureka Software. [From Official site]

characters.name: Yanagiya Kokoro
characters.description: Game Director Back when she was still in her hometown with her older sister Ai, before she joined Eureka Software, she was a cheerful, friendly, puppy-like girl. Now that she's become an adult, Kokoro is cool young woman who says whatever is on her mind. It's unclear why she's so harsh toward her sister Ai. As she's still a novice director, her job is demanding day-in and day-out, leaving her constantly in a bad mood. [From Official site]

characters.name: Mugendou Saki
characters.description: Narrative Writer Eureka Software's lead narrative writer. Always wearing headphones, Saki is a self-centered girl who doesn't listen when people talk to her and goes about things the way she feels like. She always wears a track suit and looks younger than she is due to her short height and cute looks. She was the writer for the original version of Dreams and Reality - Nie, the Witch, and the End of the World that they are remaking now and is a veteran of Eureka Software. She's always going "roar!!" so people call her Tinysaurus. [From Official site]

characters.name: Tachibana Nana
characters.description: Office Staff (Voice Actor) Part-time worker who does administrative work other than Eureka Software development, like answering phones and making tea. Nana is actually a struggling voice actor who can't pay the bills yet on acting alone. She creates a pleasant atmosphere at Eureka. Her bright personality lets her join in on any fun and she's friendly and open with everyone. A self-professed "Banana Maid." Cosplaying is just her hobby. [From Official site]

characters.name: Marie Mahler
characters.description: Illustrator/Keyframe Artist A Greek illustrator who ended up working at Eureka Software. A straightforward person with unwavering conviction. She has the wits to quickly grasp the true essence of any matter. Her military clothes are her "uniform." Marie loves Japanese culture. [From Official site]

characters.name: Daigo Honoka
characters.description: President and Programmer and Marketing A gentle boss who is like an older sister to her staff. When she starts drinking, however, she gets a little out of hand. She founded Eureka Software and started development on a commercial remake of the doujin game Dreams and Reality - Nie, the Witch, and the End of the World. Possessing a shrewd hidden side, she is called various disquieting nicknames in the game business world. [From Official site]

title: Once on a Windswept Night
description: Once upon a time, a long, long time ago, there was a traveller... Our protagonist, a mysterious traveller, wanders the far-off land of Desservir searching for patrons to buy their wares. Upon hearing about a large annual market in the village of Castella, the traveller decides to set up a stall and try their luck. Life, however, is not so easy. After being double-crossed by a goblin and left in the middle of the cold, wet moors to die, the traveller almost gives up hope. That is, until they stumble upon a mysterious church in the middle of nowhere, and meet the two nuns who attend to it. What are these two nuns doing on their own, and why is there such a melancholy atmosphere in the air? The traveller has only one windswept night to uncover these mysteries and learn the truth. [From Steam]

characters.name: Lycoris
characters.description: [spoiler]Her real identity is Wisteria, Lycoris's lover.

title: Magical Princess
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: In Magical Princess, step into the shoes of a single, widowed father as he brings up his only beloved daughter from early childhood all the way to graduation at the magical academy. With her whole life ahead of her across a variety of different paths, how she grows up and matures is entirely your responsibility. Steer her towards an upright academic career as an ace student, a life of excitement on the stage as an idol, the way of the mighty warrior who takes up the sword, or even pure villainy as the demon queen. With every choice and decision you make, her future changes dramatically! [From Steam]

characters.name: Queen Cornelia
characters.description: Cornelia is the young queen who rules the kingdom of Panetelia. With outstanding political skills, she has led her kingdom to prosperity and is widely beloved by her people. However, when Alice first speaks with Cornelia, she receives a harsh glare and cryptic words delivered in a condescending tone. This event puzzles Alice greatly, yet there seems to be some deeper reason behind it...? [From Steam ]

characters.name: Fran Bluebell
characters.description: Fran is Alice's classmate at the Royal Magic Academy. Born into the prestigious Bluebell family, Fran quickly rose through the ranks to become a knight of the kingdom at a young age, earning a position as one of the Queen's closest aides. Currently, under a secret order from the Queen, Fran attends the academy as a student. Coming from a lineage of knights and burdened by an inferiority complex due to her exceptionally talented elder brother, Fran has chosen to disguise herself as a boy, rigorously training in swordsmanship and magic. Yet beneath her stoic exterior, she secretly dreams of wearing cute outfits and some good old-fashioned girly fun...? [From Steam ]

characters.name: Crois
characters.description: When Alice is walking through town, she finds a mysterious girl collapsed by the roadside ─ this is Crois. She works as a close aide to the queen, secretly carrying out various investigations under her orders. However, Crois is also a natural-born criminal who repeatedly steals without remorse. Taking bread from bakeries when hungry and emptying shop registers when she's broke. After repeatedly stealing, Crois found herself banned from every shop in town, eventually collapsing from hunger. It was Alice who came to her rescue. Ever since, Crois seems to hold special feelings for Alice, who regularly feeds her... On dates with Crois, gently accepting her outrageous behavior and enjoying lots of bread together may bring you closer to her. [From Steam ]

characters.name: Chocolat
characters.description: Chocolat is a healer working at a clinic in the royal capital. They first met when Alice fell and injured herself in the street, and Chocolat used her healing magic to help her. Usually gentle and beloved by everyone, Chocolat can become quite frightening when angered, concealing an intense severity that might lead her to say things like, "Anyone who doesn't value their life can die!" On dates with Chocolat, you'll discover her many charming facets: a kind and dependable older sister figure, her strict expression when scolding you, and even her unexpectedly clumsy moments. [From Steam ]

characters.name: Hasis
characters.description: Hasis is a mysterious young man whom Alice meets in the church. He is a highly skilled assassin. Raised from childhood as a member of an assassin organization, his life has revolved around executing targets in a dark and narrow world. To Hasis, Alice’s smile was a ray of hope. How will encountering her change the life of this young man who has only known darkness? On dates with Hasis, you'll discover that he's not merely emotionless, but that there’s another side hidden deep within him. Gently help him reveal the true feelings he keeps hidden inside. [From Steam ]

characters.name: Noah
characters.description: Noah is a prodigy who entered the Royal Magic Academy through academic acceleration. Having grown up entirely dedicated to his studies, Noah excels academically but knows very little about practical subjects, physical activities, or leisure. After meeting Alice, Noah finds himself frequently invited on outings to various places. Despite his initial resistance claiming, "I have to study!," he eventually ends up getting dragged around by Alice anyway. During dates with Noah, you can expect plenty of heartwarming moments as this usually serious boy's eyes sparkle or as he panics in response to new experiences. [From Steam ]

characters.name: Shail
characters.description: Shail is Alice's senior at the Royal Magic Academy. As the son of a noble family with exceptional musical talent and striking good looks, he's become the object of admiration among female students. Though Shail avoids social interaction and speaks coldly, there seems to be a hidden reason behind his behavior...? On dates with Shail, quiet conversations gradually bridge the gap, allowing you to catch glimpses of his sensitive inner feelings.

title: Itsuka no Memorajxo ~Kotonoha Amrilato~
title_original: いつかのメモラージョ ～ことのはアムリラート～
description: Not all endings are happily ever after, and language isn't the only barrier to understanding. After choosing to remain in Ruka's world, Rin begins to doubt her decision, haunted by memories of her best friend Yuuzu and others she's left behind. Ruka, too, is troubled by Kanako, a classmate who seems to have it out for her. Unspoken thoughts, assumed feelings, and misunderstandings threaten to pry them apart as they face the challenges of communication involved in becoming more than just friends. This is the story, pure and sometimes frustrating, of two girls intertwined through their fumbling efforts to communicate. A heartwarming, and educational yuri visual novel that teaches readers Esperanto, as well as the meaning of communication. [Edited from Steam]

characters.name: Takatoo Rin
characters.description: A high school student who got lost in another world. Her main charm is... positive thinking! Not really good at studying, but in order to communicate with Ruka, she attempts to learn Juliamo, the language used by people in the parallel world. "...Potatoes were apples?!" [Translated from Official Site]

characters.name: Ruka
characters.description: A middle school student(?) who's taking care of Rin, despite the language barrier. "No... I... re... ally... wa... nt ... to... h... ear... your Japan... ese, Rin." [Translated from Official Site]

characters.name: Rei
characters.description: A woman who works for "Visitant" administration (a bureau that specialises in handling new arrivals from other worlds. Japanese translation of the term is 訪問者) She normally works as a librarian at a library close by. [Translated from Official Site]

characters.name: Yuzu
characters.description: Rin's classmate at the real world

characters.description: Kanako's mother

title: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Anata ni Chikau Ai
title_original: その花びらにくちづけを　あなたに誓う愛
description: Shizuku and her girlfriend Eris enjoyed their vacation with the other Best Couples from St. Michael’s… But after getting tangled up with Rena, who still has some summer vacation left, they’ve lingered on the tropical island. However, Eris continues to be a hit with the ladies, and Shizuku is feeling a little let down. But when she decides to consult with Rena about her anxiety… [Translated from Petals' Garden]

characters.name: Houraisen Runa
characters.description: A fifth/sixth grade primary school student and recent transfer at St. Michael's. Smart, mature and highly charismatic for her age, Runa has won many fans in her class but she is very interested with her teacher Takako and declares she belongs to her. [spoiler]Runa harbors resentment over her older sister Rena, yet unseen in the story, who frequently leaves her alone while she goes out on business trips. Runa's older sister is Takako's former crush, which leads to the relationship between Runa and Takako once they meet for the first time in St. Michael's. [Edit from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Suminoe Takako
characters.description: A former graduate of St. Michael's who is now a teacher at the school's primary division. Takako is very embarrassed that Runa can easily dominate her while stealing her first kiss. [spoiler]She was once in love with Runa's older sister, Rena. [Edit from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Shitogi Eris
characters.description: A half-Japanese and half-European third year high school student. She has come to Japan to learn Japanese culture at St. Michael's, where she has attracted many girls due to her looks, including Shizuku. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Kirishima Shizuku
characters.description: A very traditional Japanese girl in her third year of high school. Having traits of a Yamato nadeshiko, she is very skilled at calligraphy and flower arrangement. She falls in love with Eris after meeting her. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Houraisen Rena
characters.description: A new teacher at St. Michael's who is also Runa's older sister and Takako's former tutor. Stylish and stunningly beautiful — the perfect woman. Outgoing and easygoing. Although she’s blunt and untidy, for some reason she has the kind of likable personality that’s impossible to hate. Rena is an alumnus of St. Michael's, and at the time, the teachers all praised her for being a well-behaved lady. But in actuality, she was chasing skirts left and right, regardless if they were seniors or juniors. It’s rumored her lovers numbered at nearly a hundred. [Translated from Getchu and Yurin Yurin]

title: Without a Voice
description: In the depths of a dark and unforgiving forest, an exiled princess whiles her time in solitude. For a girl raised in the lap of comfort, the woods are impossibly harsh, and day-to-day survival is the most she can manage. One day, however, a mysterious, beautiful maiden appears, throwing her world out of its already delicate alignment. The princess is instantly captivated by this stranger, and begins to fancy herself the heroine of a fairytale, even as the maiden proves herself to be less and less of a fantasy. Foolish princess. She should know by now that her life is no fairytale. In seven days, the wheel of fate will splinter. Seven days, for better or worse… [From official website]

characters.name: Cassidy
characters.description: An exiled princess and the eldest child of the Veromere royal family. Cassidy is nice, but rather clueless and struggles to live on her own due to her pampered upbringing. [From official website]

characters.name: Elowen
characters.description: The mysterious beauty who appears before Cassidy one day. While at a glance she is graceful and beautiful in an otherworldly way, she is also quick to anger and rather self-centered. Sometimes, she becomes quiet and a little gloomy when staring out at the woods outside the cottage windows... [From official website]

characters.name: Alexander
characters.description: Cassidy's younger twin brother, the king of Veromere.

title: Futanari Haha to Goumon Musume
description: At first glance the Amashiro family seems like any other ordinary, happy family. However, the mother, Miki, is a masochist, the father is a mad scientist, and the daughter, Misaki, never shows any sign of emotions. On top of that, a clone of Miki lives together with them, all of which makes the family more than a bit peculiar. One day, Misaki witnesses her mother masturbating to the scent of her underwear. As she confronts her about it, Misaki and Miki's sexual preferences gradually begin to align...​ [Edited from F95Zone]

characters.name: Amashiro Miki
characters.description: She was transformed into a futanari by her classmate. She is now his wife, living with him and their daughter, Amashiro Misaki. Due to the her futanari transformation her sexual desire is vigorous and sexually she is an extreme masochist.

title: Rituals in the Dark
description: Six months ago, Aspen Draper’s elderly neighbour, Mrs Leigh, died from a heart attack. Aspen was the last person to see Mrs Leigh alive, and she was the first person to find the old woman’s body. After this unfortunate discovery, Aspen becomes something of a celebrity in her dreary seaside home town, Scarborough. She’s bombarded with intrusive questions about Mrs Leigh’s death every day, and her friends are insatiably curious about the incident. Despite Aspen’s best efforts, she’s unable to move on from the past, even as time passes. The winter months segue into the summer, but Mrs Leigh’s home remains unsold. Eventually, the house is boarded up, and rumours begin to spread that it’s haunted by her restless ghost. Then, during a sleepover with her friends Pippa and Lakhi, Aspen is made to confront her fears all over again. Pippa dares Aspen to break into Mrs Leigh’s home to search for th

characters.name: Aspen Draper
characters.description: Aspen is the unwilling heroine of this story. She’s an awkward teenage girl, and she has difficulty expressing her true feelings. Shy, and something of a pushover, Aspen caves easily to pressure, and is easily manipulated by her best friend, Pippa. When she was younger, Aspen studied ballet. She quit before she started secondary school, however, and she hasn’t practised in a long time. [From Lemma soft]

characters.name: Althea
characters.description: Althea is a mysterious girl who Aspen encounters inside Mrs Leigh’s old home. Aspen has no idea why Althea is so intrigued by Mrs Leigh's home, or what connection she has to the elderly Mrs Leigh… But she has quite the vested interest in Aspen. Cheerful and irreverent, Althea is quite the charming companion… But she’s fond of twisting the truth to suit her own means, and she always tells lies. [From Lemma soft]

characters.name: Pippa
characters.description: Pippa is Aspen’s best friend. The pair met in primary school, and they’ve known one another for a decade. Though Pippa and Aspen are close as can be, they’re polar opposites. Pippa is loud and boisterous where Aspen is quiet and reserved, and Pippa has no qualms about speaking her mind. Though Pippa could be described as the life of a party, she’s also something of a bully, and she can turn nasty when she doesn’t get her own way. [From Lemma soft]

characters.name: Lakhi
characters.description: Lakhi is Pippa's and Aspen’s friend. She was born in India, though her parents moved to England when she was a young child. Mature for her age, Lakhi is cool and aloof. She acts like a princess, and expects to be treated as such. She doesn’t always approve of Pippa’s rowdy behaviour, and the two sometimes butt heads. [From Lemma soft]

title: Rising Angels: Reborn
description: Despite brilliance and skill, Natalie Puccile, a Special Investigations and Tactics officer with the Katajion Directorship, has spent her career watching over a listening post in the middle of deep space. After the orders that she has always dreamed of finally arrive, she finds herself in charge of a small destroyer and tasked with discovering the fate of a missing research team investigating an ancient civilization. As situation falls apart around her, it is up to Natalie’s brilliance and the dedication of the crew of the KSS Nimross to avert a galaxy-shattering event that could spell the end of all space travel. With determination in her heart, Natalie rises to the chance to beat back the danger and perhaps find love in the twinkling lights of the distant stars. [From Official site]

characters.name: Natalie Puccile
characters.description: The protagonist. A brilliant mind who always excelled at schooling, Natalie won numerous awards growing up for academic excellence. When she graduated, Natalie immediately joined the space force to work as a Special Investigations and Tactics officer. During training, she rapidly overtook her peers. However, few people wanted to associate with her due to her brazen nature and elitism. After a whistleblowing incident, Natalie was assigned to manage an outpost in the middle of nowhere with only a couple of robots. Nevertheless, Natalie worked hard and was finally award a chance to prove herself to command.

characters.name: Zuri
characters.description: The security officer of the KSS Nimross. In high school, Zuri was a track star, admired galaxy-wide for her speed. When she graduated, she accepted a commission to the academy to become a security officer. Spunky and determined, Zuri’s fearless and optimistic nature serves as a rallying point to those around her. While she questions herself, there is nothing more important to her than striving to be a true warrior and protect her friends.

characters.name: Sol Hackett
characters.description: A fighter pilot who has spent the last couple years fighting in the war. After losing the love of his life to a non-human, Sol’s bitter hatred for non-humans has only amplified. While fighting in the war, Sol’s constant loss of loved ones and friends has led him to become pessimistic and depressed. Tough on his fellow pilots, Sol knows it is only a matter of time before they leave him as well.

description: Three monsters found love and acceptance in each other. What happens when an unknown element is mixed in? A continuation of Alice’s and Chloe’s routes from the first game.

characters.name: Shoujo
characters.description: [Spoiler]Her real name isn't Kana, she just pretends to be her. She used to be Hanami's classmate in an all-girls school. After the rape incident, she got kicked out and her life started to spiral. She decided to take revenge on Hanami, since Hanami never got punished for anything. Before that, however, she decided to "test her skills" and, together with Somari, make sure that Hanami gives up Yuuki.

title: spring leaves no flowers
description: Manami is talking to her boyfriend Tatsuya, when he asks her why she didn't tell him that her two friends were dating. Manami thinks he just has the wrong idea, but... SPRING LEAVES NO FLOWERS is a visual novel. Play as Manami, a young woman with a boyfriend named Tatsuya, and join her as she spends the weekend with her friends. Help Manami come to an understanding about herself as she thinks about what friendship and romance mean to her. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Nagata Erika
characters.description: Manami's other best friend. She's a laid back, fashionable woman who comes across as insensitive at times due to how blunt she is.

characters.name: Watanabe Tatsuya
characters.description: Manami's boyfriend.

title: Taarradhin
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Past Setting in a Fictional World
description: A seven-year drought plagues the entire region surrounding the country of Nishtif, leading people to wonder if their goddess Scheknt has abandoned them. In contrast, young noblewoman Neqtia has lived a comfortable life insulated from hardship and suffering. One of the poorer surrounding countries, Djedi, sends their usual tribute of natural resources and livestock to Nishtif in exchange for the larger country's aid and protection. Rumors that two attractive slaves are among the cargo intrigue Neqtia. What lies in store for her after the slaves are brought to live at her family estate …?

characters.name: Neqtia
characters.description: Daughter of a wealthy noble, she is kind-hearted and sweet, but also naive about anything outside of her personal world. She can come across as self-centered due to her sheltered upbringing, but she is well-meaning.

characters.name: Jyrik
characters.description: One of the two slaves from Djedi, he was chosen from among the commoners because of his youth and handsome looks. Smooth, confident, and knowledgeable, Jyrik works in the garden of Neqtia's estate, but as he and Araerda are meant to be trophies, he's more like an exotic plant himself.

characters.name: Araerda
characters.description: The other slave brought from Djedi, she is considered one of the most beautiful women of her country. Araerda works as one of Neqtia's handmaids and is a kind, patient listener who takes to Neqtia instantly and showers her with compliments and attention.

title: When the Night Comes
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You are a renowned Hunter, a creature slayer who has been called to the quiet, strange little town of Lunaris to assist the local Enforcers with an investigation into a series of unsettling and unexplained supernatural murders. Immerse yourself in the world of witches, vampires, demons and lycans as you slowly unravel the dark mystery that lies deep within the roots of the town. The question is, are the creatures of the night the ones you should really be afraid of? You might even fall in forbidden love along the way. [From itch.io]

characters.description: Species: Vampire Occupation: Clan Leader Height: 6'4 [From itch.io] Finn can be romanced on his own or as part of a polyamorous route with Ezra.

characters.description: Species: Human Witch Occupation: Shopkeep + Healer Height: 5'9 [From itch.io] Ezra can be romanced on his own or as part of a polyamorous route with Finn.

characters.description: Species: Human Witch Occupation: Enforcer Height: 6' [From itch.io]

characters.description: Species: Lycan Hybrid Occupation: N/A Height: 6'2 [From itch.io] Alkar can be romanced on his own or as part of a polyamorous route with Omen.

characters.name: Aurora Woodridge
characters.description: One of the leaders of a pro-monster/anti-human cult headquartered at the Aibek, alongside her twin brother Armaros. She is much more assertive and usually the one to interact with others.

characters.name: Armaros Woodridge
characters.description: One of the leaders of a pro-monster/anti-human cult headquartered at the Aibek, alongside his twin sister Aurora. He is timid and usually lets her do the talking. [spoiler]Unbeknownst to his sister, he is courting the demon princess Elaine Morningstar. At the end of the game, he proposes to her and they become engaged to be married, and leaves the Aibek.

characters.name: Elaine Morningstar
characters.description: Omen's sister and princess of Hell. [spoiler]She is secretly courting Armaros Woodridge, and they become engaged to be married at the end of the game.

characters.name: Fiero
characters.description: A long-time member of Clan Kazimir. He is an empath who is extremely sensitive to the emotions of others.

characters.name: James Addington-Lane
characters.description: Harry's husband, a Hunter, and the most recent victim of the killings plaguing Lunaris. He appears as a ghost who communicates with the protagonist.

characters.name: Lux
characters.description: A guard hired to protect the Aibek. Raven is her partner.

characters.name: Raven
characters.description: A member of Clan Kazimir; she was turned by Finn several hundred years ago, and she considers him a father figure. Lux is her partner.

title: Arcade Spirits
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: In the alternate future year 20XX, video games and arcades are still thriving and surviving. Within a tiny vintage arcade, a number of pro gamers, scorechasers, operators, and cosplayers seek to live out their dreams within that tiny community. But as you discover on joining this motley crew of dreamers, life on the edge of pixels and scanlines can be a pretty crazy business, indeed. Find employment, find love, find whatever it is you're looking for... or it's game over.

characters.name: Ari Cader
characters.description: With a long family history of failure and compromise behind you, can the Funplex really help you find your true dream…?

characters.name: Naomi Fairchild
characters.description: Circuit boards, cathode ray tubes, joysticks, buttons, pixels… Naomi loves arcade games with deep affection, bringing good cheer to the Funplex. She’s shy around crowds but perfectly happy to tinker away in solitude.

characters.name: Gavin Cooper
characters.description: Sharp, observant, and extremely direct with his feelings. Gavin keeps the Funplex’s financial numbers afloat, while trying to support his friends… even if he has trouble compromising between hope and pragmastism.

characters.name: Juniper Quinn
characters.description: Juniper, your best friend from high school and current roommate, has cheered you on in good times and bad. Although she does her best to help you out, with a good heart, she’s not very GOOD at helping.

characters.name: QueenBee
characters.description: A fierce champion of Fist of Discomfort, the premiere arcade eSports title, QueenBee is ready to lay waste to all comers in her journey to the top. But exactly where is the top of her craft?

characters.name: Teo
characters.description: The warm center of the Spotlight Stage universe, Teo organizes the community around this mega-popular dance game. Despite being at the core of it all… he prefers to avoid the metaphorical spotlight whenever possible.

characters.name: Ashley Wolf
characters.description: Buried within the felty depths of Pinky the Funplex Flamingo is Ashley, aspiring cosplayer and friendly companion… seeking something she doesn’t fully understand through costumed self-expression.

characters.name: Percy Sinclair
characters.description: 3.75 million points. That’s the goal of this retro game aficionado, quietly reaching for that world record. But what sad story lies at the heart of why this silly old game matters so much to him?

title: slime feet
description: In the sub-zero temperatures of the Arctic stands The Amoninsula Research Facility, a bunker housing the world's top scientists dedicated to studying and containing “Hazards”, anomalies which defy the laws of physics, as well as common sense. After a streak of unlucky incidents, Estelle Mcclendon finds herself in an encounter with a Hazard, becoming a “Host” for “Miasma”, an amorphous floating cloud that seeks to subsume living organisms. Miasma will gradually spread through the body, deteriorating bone and tissues alike until the weakened internal organs can no longer sustain the human functions necessary for life. With no known cure for a Host infected by Miasma, Estelle spends the remainder of her days exchanging messages with her closest coworker, Abbi. Together, they do their best to feel intimacy by being perverts together while staring the looming, macabre regression toward death

title: senescence
description: Beyond that LCD resides something inexplicably sinister: A black hole poised as authentic innocence -- the absence of moral pretension and consciousness of cruelty whatsoever. Under the guise of objective omnipresent observation, the facades' appeal is the dedication it implies, the need to serve humanity's wellbeing. Feeding lies like panning flames, not to ‘us,’ but to our gelded brains that were once actually capable of judgement. Hence robots are the pinnacle of lewdness. [From itch.io]

title: Seduce Me 2: The Demon War
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Mika Anderson is suddenly thrown into the Abyssal Plains right before she is about to get married to one of the five Incubi Brothers featured in the first game. What’s even worse is that she is thrown there in the middle of a Rebellion against the Evil Demon Lord and must not only assist Diana and the Rebel Leaders in the war, but must watch as the man she loves fights alongside them after he comes to rescue her. [Edited from Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Mika Anderson
characters.description: A quiet girl in her senior year of high school. At the start of the game, she inherits the estate of her recently passed grandfather and as a result meets the incubi, who drastically change her life. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: James
characters.description: The eldest of the incubi brothers. Very smart and nonchalant, he acts as a father figure to the family of brothers. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Erik
characters.description: The second eldest brother and, as Suzu calls him, the ‘Ball of Sex’. He is a giant flirt and loves to keep that fact well-remembered. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Sam
characters.description: The middle brother. A hard-ass guy who seems to constantly have a chip on his shoulder. However, he does have good intentions even though he doesn't discreetly show it. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Matthew
characters.description: The second youngest brother. He is funny, outgoing, and loves to entertain people. He, however, hates to be thought of as a ‘little boy’. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Naomi Patterson
characters.description: One of your best friends. Although she seems to be a little ditzy at first, she’s actually diligent and very calculating. She sometimes can be a pain in the rear, but she always means well. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Suzu Cappini
characters.description: Another one of your best friends. This tiny Italian lives in a world of a laid-back lifestyle and spicy food. She is outgoing and a little vulgar, but she cares for her friends more than anything. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Malix
characters.description: The leader of the devil boys, a gang of devils set on taking down the incubi boys. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Damien
characters.description: The youngest brother of the incubi. Quiet and soft spoken, he is kind and gentle. However, compared to his other brothers, he has the darkest past. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Saero
characters.description: A demon who somehow looks and sounds human at first glance, but shows his demon colors in battle. He has served Ezaeur his entire life and has fallen in deep love with her. However, because Ezaeur is a pure Demon of Lilith, she is convinced that this love is false. His breed is unknown, but he has proven to holster dark demon magic. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Fae
characters.description: A Fae Demon who is playful, but surprisingly wise despite speaking like a child. They are the most vocal of the Fae demons in the Rebellion, so they were the chosen representative for the race. However, Fae cares little for who will rule the Demon World in the end. They only care about keeping the Fae Demons free. Fae also is genderless. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Rabbit
characters.description: An Animal Demon with mystic powers. Animal Demons are the lowest tier of Demons, only gifted with animal instincts and magic abilities based in nature. Rabbit fully believes that magic will help win the war, but knows that she is not as powerful or on equal ground as her rebel allies. She’s quiet and passive unless a plan or conversation involved magic. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Shadow
characters.description: A Shadow Demon who dons his race as his nickname for Mika. He is smart and quick-tongued, often getting into battles with Sergeant simply because of a hidden insult under his words. However, he isn’t cruel or heartless; he just doesn’t see strength as a benefit when he sees shadows and stealth as the dominant powers in life. He likes to give advice that revolves around the army assassins. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Sergeant
characters.description: The last pureblood Brute Demon besides the Demon Lord himself. He barely escaped from the Mass Genocide of his kind and vowed to bring down the Demon Lord and his reign, even if that meant siding with a Demon of Lilith (Succubus) and others. He believes brute strength is the only thing needed to win a war, often blinded by ideals of strength to agree with logic, but he is not stupid. [Edited from Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Aezera
characters.description: Matthew’s mother.

title: Galaxy Girls: Starlight Blossoms Bloom Brightest
tags: Future Setting in a Fictional World
description: One day you wake up on a spaceship, with several other women, each one given a different job on board ship, doctor, engineer and you as Captain. Can you complete the mission that has been forced upon you... And save humanity. [From official website]

characters.name: Erica Matthews
characters.description: The captain of the ship Blossom. Although she is very considerate, she sometimes has difficulty expressing herself. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Sara Evans
characters.description: The doctor of the ship. Much to her dismay, she left behind a fiancé on Earth. All in all, she resents that she was forced into her current situation. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Kotoha Ichinose

characters.description: Viola is the name Kotone gave to her character in Asaph Online. Upon awakening in Asaph, Kotone inherits Viola’s appearance, her magical powers, and her name. Viola is a dark witch with unimaginable powers, who is feared by everybody in Asaph. Many have tried to challenge her, but none have emerged victorious. She enjoys grinding people down beneath her heel (sometimes literally), and treats those around her as little more than playthings. She’s a deeply sadistic, dangerous woman… but even she has a soft side.

characters.name: Neve
characters.description: Neve is Viola’s trusted most trusted maid, who would do anything to help her mistress. Neve is a member of the darkling race, which is reviled throughout Asaph as being savage and hostile, but Neve eschews these unfair perceptions. She is a diligent, loyal, industrious girl – but she may be a touch too devoted. She adores Viola, and becomes irrationally angry at any perceived slights against her beloved mistress. Self-sacrificing and hard-working though she is, Neve can be rather scary when she wants. If she were to fight seriously, she may even be able to defeat demons.

characters.name: Fion
characters.description: Fion is a young, put-upon lass from a huge family, who works hard to ensure all her brothers and sisters have enough food to eat. At least, that’s what she says, but Neve isn’t entirely convinced. Fion might look like a sweet, innocent thing, looks can be deceiving, and she’s far craftier than she initially appears.

characters.name: Eleri
characters.description: Eleri is a noble knight who believes deeply in playing fair, and will never try to take advantage of her opponents – often to her own detriment. Though Eleri seems cool and competent, she gets flustered quite easily, and reacts poorly to being teased. She’s quite fun to bully, really – and Viola often derives pleasure from her embarrassed reactions. Though Neve and Fion believe Eleri to be a resident of Asaph, much like them, she actually comes from Japan, much like Viola. Eleri was brought to Asaph in the same way Viola was, and now the pair of them are working together to see if they can return home. [From Steam]

characters.name: Aislinn Chastain
characters.description: Aislinn is a young lady who lives in the city of Lynton. Her family, the Chastains, are one of the two families that govern the city and its people – but Aislinn is woefully unequipped for the task. The young lady’s parents died when she was very young, leaving behind their family home, expensive bits of jewelry, and crippling debts. Aislinn is unsure of how to support herself and her household, let alone the people, and it hardly helps that her maid, Aoife, coddled her so much in her youth. Aislinn desperately needs somebody to help her manage the burdens heaped upon her shoulders – but could it already be too late? [Edited from Steam]

characters.name: Maidie
characters.description: Maidie is the guild mistress at Lynton. Cheery and irreverent, she's an incorrigible lover of gossip. She's often thinking up get rich quick schemes, and has a particular interest in maids. [From Steam]

Despite her shy personality, from time to time she tends to show her stubborn side. She got saved by Itsuki in junior high school; since then she's been determined to return the favor in any way she can.

characters.description: Hana and Aoi's friend and former member of the track team. A girl of bubbly and energetic personality, she often comes up with the craziest of ideas and shows a wide variety of emotions, from laughing to pouting and crying. Still, she is a caring person in a subtle way and doesn't go too far in her whims.

title: Iwakura Aria
description: [i]Iwakura Aria is a brand-new original visual novel from MAGES. It is a suspenseful human drama set in Japan during a period of rapid economic growth. The rich story, which follows the complex and sometimes contradictory emotions of each character, and the turbulent developments brought about by their emotions, invites players back to “that summer” of 1966. Concerned about Ichiko's situation, whom he had only just met, he decided to welcome her into the Iwakura household as a maid. He dotes on his daughter, Aria, and spoils her. The cards have the power to change both her dreams and her reality, and will help Heileen discover many hidden things from her past: - How exactly did her parents die? description: Something new is hitting the mobile markets and taking the world by storm! An augmented reality game called Dragon Connection (DraCo) allows players to become trainers, collecting and battling with hundreds of dragons! Dulce, after spending a few weeks saving up for a new phone, can finally participate in the craze! Though she's a little behind the curve, she’s soon immersed in the world of the game and its community. As she builds her collection of virtual dragons, and a circle of new friends grows with it, how will her summer vacation unfold? [From itch.io]

She recently graduated from high school, and is uncertain about the future. [From itch.io]

characters.description: "I’m going to claim every Territory in this town!” A hot-headed player who loves battling and exploring. She knows all about the mechanics of the game, but not much about the lore, and doesn’t believe in the ‘heart of the dragon’ nonsense. To her, stats and winning are all that matter. Recently graduated from high school, and already has plans to dominate her future campus. [From itch.io]

characters.description: "Please buy something if you're going to battle here." Supportive(?) part-timer at the ice cream parlor, The Latest Scoop. Since the shop is wedged between two DraCo visit points, players tend to hang around without paying. He’s often seen chasing loiterers off with a broom. All he wants to do is work peacefully to afford his college tuition. Pretends he’s not dead inside. [From itch.io] Brin's cousin.

Rinko is serving at the disciplinary committee, so she often scolds Akira and lectures her about public morals because of her boobs obsession. characters.description: Hobbies: Watching Anime. Likes: Anime in general. Dislikes: Live-action series in general. Relation to the protagonist: A character from her new work is very similar to Akira. She is good at lightly naughty text depictions, especially the depiction of tits (and character with big tits in particular). Akira fully approves of her works. [Translated from Getchu.]

She also has been keeping an eye on the vice principal. Although she hides it well, her true nature is that of a sadistic lesbian. Kotomi loves violating cute female students. She is especially interested in Akira; she is pleased to mischief her by pressing own boobs against her while she's tutoring her. title: Hiveswap Friendsim
description: You just crash-landed on Alternia, and you’re DESPERATE for friendship! Anyone will do...wait, who are those two trolls approaching you? The Hiveswap Friendsim is a quick, loosely-canonical visual novel adventure following the efforts of the unnamed protagonist (that’s you!) to survive and maybe even thrive on the harsh surface of ALTERNIA. Set in the time of Hiveswap: Act 1, this episodic visual novel’s opening volume, written by Homestuck creator Andrew Hussie, is sure to satisfy Homestuck and Hiveswap fans who are eager for a darker stroll across the Alternian landscape. [From Steam]

title: Kangokutou Mary Skelter 2
title_original: 神獄塔 メアリスケルター2
description: 'Jail,' an impregnable asylum referred to as "a living prison." Birthed several decades ago, it was controlled by "Marchens," monsters led by insane beings known as "Nightmares." Tsuu and Little Mermaid, members of the "Dawn" organization with the goal of escaping the prison, rescue Alice and her partner Jack after being captured. In the midst of an expedition to the city, Alice was dyed in madness and ran amok slashing through anything and anyone at sight. In an attempt to protect Tsuu from one of Alice's attacks, Little Mermaid and Jack fell off a cliff with her. After regaining consciousness, Little Mermaid's first sight was a dying Jack. The bloodstained story of Tsuu, Little Mermaid and Nightmare Jack trying to escape the tower and their fate begins.

characters.name: Michiru
characters.description: The leader of a religious cult called "Taiyou" ("The Order of the Sun" in English version) inside the Jail which claims that "Some day, the Sun God will burn down the ceiling and we'll be able to leave this place." While she is known by the name of "Oohime" in the cult, she still calls herself by her real name, Michiru. She always talks mysteriously, like a real divine being.

characters.name: Jack
characters.description: The protagonist. A boy who spends his days as an inmate in Jail. He’s a little timid, but also has a strong side. He is a kind-hearted soul who occasionally tries to protect his friends by throwing his own life on the line. He’s taken by Akazukin, who came to save Alice, to break out of jail. As support for the Chishiki Girls Squad, girls who fight while wounded and wish to become women of power, they attempt to escape Jail. Although, he’ll later also obtain a blood-type (Chishiki) ability and be discovered a “Chishiki Boy”…

characters.name: Hitsuka
characters.description: A calm guy who is a member of the religious cult "Taiyou". He is loyal towards the cult's leader Michiru and is always next to her, explaining the things she says to others. Hitsuka also works as a security guard who guards off-limited areas and ensures that nobody enters them.

characters.name: Haru
characters.description: One of the few blacksmiths in Prison who makes weapons for the Chishiki Squad. While he has a bad attitude with an equally bad mouth and loves taking breaks, he also likes giving Jack and the girls advise sometimes.

characters.name: Ueshima Miko
characters.description: A doctor who is regarded as everyone's older sister. She keeps up a clinic called Rescue Center in which the Chishiki Girls can purify themselves from blood, decrease their madness gauge and get their wounds treated. She is always ready to listen and give advice to anyone in need of. She's also fond of working with the professor on his research of the Jail.

characters.name: Dr. Toojima
characters.description: A researcher living in the Jail, he is more knowledgeable of the place than any of the other people in there.

characters.name: Tsuu
characters.description: Nickname "Otsuu", one of the Chishiski Girls who is a member of Daybreak and the protagonist of the second game. When she and Ningyohime were younger, Tsuu promised to become the "little mermaid's true prince", and thus, has always acted like a prince. Tsuu is very courageous, though underneath her shell she also has a slightly weak and girlish personality that contrasts her boyish appearance. She is also the only one who can understand and interact with Jack.

characters.name: Ningyohime
characters.description: A beautiful girl who values others' happiness more than her own and works hard to make sure the people around her happy. Though she has both a gentle personality and way of speaking, Ningyohime has a stubborn side to her as well. She is madly in love with Tsuu who told Ningyohime she'll be her "prince" when they were younger.

characters.name: Nightmare Jack
characters.original: ナイトメア・ジャック
characters.description: After sacrificing himself in order to save Little Mermaid and almost dying, Jack's body got covered in vines, which transformed him into his current state. Despite his current appearance and his intelligence dropping down an infant's level, he still retains his kindness, which helps him support the Chishiki Girls during battles.

characters.name: Alice
characters.description: Jack's childhood friend whom she was stuck together in a cell with until they were saved by Tsuu. Along their escape way however, Alice's abilities as a Chishiki Girl awakened. She loves Jack and such, is greatly concerned over him turning into a nightmare so she often tries to talk to him, even if he possibly doesn't understand what Alice is telling him.

characters.name: Rapunzel
characters.description: The youngest and most energetic girl of the squad. During her first meeting with Ningyohime she mistakes her for emergency rations and fish and attempts to gnaw her. Her pure energy and honesty lifts the other members' spirits up and keeps them motivated and positive.

characters.name: Oyayubihime
characters.description: The eldest of the three girls who are members of the religious cult "Taiyou". She used to be a member of the Daybreak but after a certain incident with Taiyou, she returns to it with her younger sisters Sleeping Beauty and Snow White. After reuniting with Tsuu's squad she instantly starts suspecting them, and because of her sudden change in personality both of her younger sisters are worried about Thumbeline so they fight often. She's so obsessed with keeping her sisters safe that it's begun to push them away.

characters.name: Nemurihime
characters.description: The youngest of the three sisters who are members of the religious cult "Taiyou". She wants to be of help to her sisters and do her best as one of the Hitsukas (aides of the leader) but as Nemu has a hard time speaking up, nothing really goes her way. Due to her aimless manners, there are many scenes where she bewilders both Ningyohime and Tsuu but she also extends a hand when they are troubled. Through her interactions with friends, she begins to think about who she really is.

characters.name: Akazukin
characters.description: The first-discovered Chishiki Girl whom Daybreak discovered. Due to this she acts like an older sister towards the other Chishiki Girls, even if her hotblooded nature sometimes ends up doing more damage than good.

characters.name: Shirayukihime
characters.description: The middle of the three sisters who are members of the religious cult "Taiyou". She is a very kind girl, but due to her slightly timid nature she ends up in getting trouble with the other members of the cult who misunderstand her. She trusts her older sister Thumbelina, but tends to get into fights with her often because of their contrasting personalities and due to Snow White often not knowing what to say in front of Thumbelina without angering her.

characters.name: Kaguyahime
characters.description: A Chishiki Girl who was lost but then found. She has a carefree personality but can be quite firm when it comes to the other Chishiki Girls, and rides a big vehicle called "Bamboo No. 1" both when she moves and fights, rarely moving her body on her own. She quickly responds to both words "useless" and "inactive" quite negatively and fast.

characters.name: Hamelin
characters.description: A Chishiki Girl Tsuu's squad met at an underground cave. Though she's tremendously strong Hamelin can be quite clumsy at times. At first she called herself the "Devil Lord" as she kept defeating stronger and stronger Märchen in the underground cave, but when she joined Tsuu's squad she started calling herself the Great Hero Hamelin.

characters.name: Gretel
characters.description: A Chishiki Girl living in a cell area together with her brother Hansel. A very curious and intelligent girl, she loves researching the environment and people around her, but what doesn’t interest her is met with a lack of emotion. She has a habit of speaking without moral views. She keeps a close eye on her teammates, inspecting each of their actions during their travels and also having fun. Gretel also loves teasing Hamelin.

characters.name: Cinderella
characters.description: A Chishiki Girl who went missing when she was younger. Some suspect she's the culprit behind a mysterious murder…

characters.name: Kurara
characters.description: A girl Tsuu's squad met while exploring the cell area. She sells the girls different kinds of tools and weapons.

characters.name: Hikari
characters.description: A girl whom Tsuu's squad found while investigating the underground caverns. She has the ability to instantly lighten up the atmosphere around her. She is also childhood friends with Mamoru. She is often found at the rescue center where she tends to the survivors and the Märchens working under Hameln.

characters.name: Mamoru
characters.description: Hikari's childhood friend whom Tsuu's squad also found while investigating the underground caverns. Though his eyes give an aggressive first impression, Mamoru is a kind and thoughtful boy who gets along with everyone, and becomes an important to ally to Tsuu's squad. He is usually found guarding the base as the gatekeeper, and supports the Blood Maidens as a handyman of sorts. He is also the protagonist for the prequel novel.

characters.name: Kadowaki Towa
characters.description: The gatekeeper guarding the entrance to the Liberated District. His kind face is always smiling, but there’s a strange sense of pressure in his expression. Despite being a normal human, he's strong enough to hold off Märchens.

characters.name: Kaede
characters.description: A girl found during Outsuu's exploration in the underground caverns. She's a bit of a spitfire who's quick to pick fights, but is also very reliable and supports the Blood Maidens at their time of need. She is often found at the store where she sells a variety of goods. She can't seem to stop pestering Itsuki, constantly teasing him as if he was a kid.

characters.name: Itsuki
characters.description: A young man found during Otsuu's exploration in the underground caverns. Though not as strong as the others, he makes up for it with his intelligence, analyzing tense situations for solutions. He is often found at the laboratory, and is constantly conducting research on the Blood Maidens and the Jail. He is a long time friend of Kaede, who still, to this day, treats him like a kid.

characters.name: Takumi
characters.description: A young man found during Outsuu's exploration in the underground caverns. Somewhat of a narcissist and eccentric, he likes changing speech patterns for some reason. In fact, he changes his way of speech so often that it's hard to tell what his true personality is like. He is often found at the factory where he crafts and strengthens the Blood Maidens' weapons. He acquired this skill after his tenure working at Dawn's factory.

title: Ninja Girl and the Mysterious Army of Urban Legend Monsters! ~Hunt of the Headless Horseman~
tags: Modern Day United States of America
description: In a world where monsters thrive and wraiths run wild, and ghouls and ghosts roam the streets,there exist those who hunt the creatures that do humans harm. The setting is a Japanese cafe in the suburbs of present-day America. Inside, there are two girls. One—Kiri Hattori—runs the store, while the other—Mary—is its poster girl.Their true identities, however, are that of a ninja descendant and a fire-hurling ghost. Together, they protect the town and hunt the Dark Beings that disturb its peace. On a certain stormy night, they offer shelter to a girl they find in front of Kiri's store. Appearing before them at the same time is the vengeful spectre—the Headless Horseman—whose story is inextricably linked with theirs. The two of them take in the mysterious girl, Lily, and continue on with their lives. As they handle the day-to-day affairs of the cafe, a friendship begins to bloom between the

characters.name: Hattori Kiri
characters.description: Kiri is a member of the Hattori, a clan of ninjas that traces back to ancient times. She has been receiving ninja training ever since she was a child, having their techniques drilled into her as part of her upbringing. Both her skills and her mental constitutional are exceptional. She is a peerless hunter of Dark Beings. Though she had been living in Japan, she has come to America with a certain goal in mind. She spends her days running a Japanese cafe in the suburbs while fighting to protect the town's peace from monsters. She enjoys a good binding—that is, with rope, and doing it to someone else—from time to time, which seems to suggest she has a slightly sadistic side. She also finds pleasure in teasing her partner, Mary. Whenever Mary makes a mistake, the whip-like crack of Kiri's rope sends a shiver down her spine.

characters.name: Mary
characters.description: Three hundred years ago, Mary was wrongfully accused of being a witch and executed. As the sole bearer of her entire family's vengeful rage, she turned into a vicious ghost that terrorized all those around her until she was saved by Kiri. She has made Kiri the center of her existence ever since. She commands fire at will, and can send them lashing out at her enemies. Though the intensity of the flames is usually under her control, when her emotions run high, she can go berserk. For a berserk Mary, the line between medium and well-done can be particularly thin. When the sun is up, she works as a waitress in the Japanese cafe. During the night, in true ghost-like fashion, she lives in a mirror in Kiri's room. Her favorite food is cold pizza, and anyone who dares tease her about it will surely have a taste of her fiery temper.

characters.name: Lily
characters.description: One stormy night, Kiri finds her collapsed in front of her store. Different from Kiri’s, she uses wind-style ninjutsu. She has partial amnesia, having lostpart of her memories, and is now a live-in employee at Kiri’s café causing a bit of trouble. Eventually, she opens up to Kiri and Mary, who also learn to trust her. She has a certain goal: what could it be...?

characters.name: Horseman of Sleepy Hollow
characters.description: A towering, powerful being of the darkness that can easily swing his two-meter long zweihänder, he has enough magical strength to easily regenerate any minor damage immediately. Lost his head hundreds of years ago from one of Kiri’s ancestors. His intense, deep-seated grudge keeps him alive as a being of the darkness. It seems that he also has some kind of connection with Mary...

title: Witches x Warlocks
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Hero
description: Seven days until Halloween! Seven days until the final exams! Seven days until Fay Nightshade gets booted out of school for being the only witch unable to cast a single spell. Take control of Fay and help them cram a semester's worth of studying in the last week before the exams! How many spells can you learn? And will you manage to find Fay a date for the Halloween festivities afterwards? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Fay Nightshade
characters.description: Cheerful and optimistic, Fay thinks there are many things that can be achieved with a few witty words. Sadly, passing the upcoming exams doesn't belong into that list so it's time to hit the books. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Lawrence
characters.description: Despite belonging to one of the physically strongest races, werewolf Lawrence gets often mistaken for a cat. Deadpan as he may look, Lawrence is surprisingly silly and lazily efficient. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Zero
characters.description: One may say this poltergeist is short-tempered. Honestly speaking, it's just Fay's personality that's taking years off his undead life. Still, Zero would float a thousand miles and more for his childhood friend... [From itch.io]

characters.name: Carmilla
characters.description: Charming and adorable beyond words, this vampire is a prone victim of baseless flattery. Harmless as she may come across, Carmilla is second to none when it comes to the magic of seduction. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Damion
characters.description: Perhaps too gentle to be a monster, this Frankenstein creature acts as Fay's anchor and helps them whenever needed. One may wonder how the shy Damion and Fay can be best friends. But opposites attract after all. [From itch.io]
