title: Gekka Ryouran Romance
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: In a scenic valley, there's a celebrity boarding school called "Hakuou Gakuen". At a glance the school is full of smart and beautiful guys. Behind it, a secret club nobody knows of was conducted. To others, it's the mysterious going-home club. But the real name is actually the "Forbidden Date Club". The after school chime is the date signal. The strict rule is to always get the girl they're targeting. It doesn't matter who, the club members spread love like night hosts. These students are called the "Gekka Ryouran". The love renaissance / love game unfolds by the hands of these rich guys, who seem to sneer at those who admire love. However, those who are obsessed with their charms couldn't stop asking for more despite the excessive payment. It's a dangerous love, you can't go back after touching it. Now, the forbidden flowers are blooming! [taken from Neo Romance Forum]

characters.name: Tsumori Nazuna
characters.description: Nazuna is a high school student that transferred to Hakuou Academy due to her parents having commitments overseas. She is kind, determined and serious, but somewhat naive. Nazuna embraces her normal and uneventful lifestyle, and hopes it stays that way in her school life, also. She loves to study, and as a result, she has excellent grades and aspires to go to a good university. Nazuna loves to study, because she believes that knowledge won't betray her. She became this way when she was younger, due to her boyfriend at the time cheating on her. Other than studying, Nazuna loves to read, and is well-versed in many books across a variety of genres. Her ordinary life quickly becomes eventful- due to a series of events, she gets involved with the "Forbidden Date Club".

characters.name: Kano Aoi
characters.description: The charasmatic, 27th head of the Forbidden Date Club. He is the older brother of the highly influential and wealthy Kano brothers. As a result, he's very used to getting whatever he wants, whenever he wants and nobody seems to object to this. Aoi is crude and often rude, but his charm and good looks helps him avoid most troubles. Not at all studious, Aoi prefers to skip classes to "hang out" with girls on the school rooftop to "have fun". He thinks love is just a game, and treats the girls that come to the Forbidden Date Club like idiots and toys. When he gets bored with a girl, he just "throws her away like a used rag."

characters.name: Kano Atsumori
characters.description: The second-in-charge of the Forbidden Date Club. Atsumori is Aoi's younger brother, and shares many of the privileges as his older brother as a member of the powerful Kano family. Just like Aoi, Atsumori is very used to getting whatever he pleases, whenever he pleases, though he reacts to not getting his way far more poorly than Aoi. Atsumori has a penchant for anything sweet, but especially loves chocolate (and is often seen munching on a bar of one). Even though he's frequently seen arguing with Aoi, because they tend to stick together, most find it hard to tell whether they get along or not. Atsumori is arrogant and sadistic in his dealings with women; constantly exerting his power and influence. He makes it very certain that he thinks he's top dog, and is domineering. It's his way, or the highway. Like Aoi, Atsumori doesn't think too highly of love, and treats the girls that go to th

characters.name: Fuji Reito
characters.description: Reito is Hakuou Academy's school doctor. Good with people, he is kind and gentle with a somewhat mysterious aura about him. Combined with his good looks, this makes Reito popular with the female students. Currently single, Reito is somewhat of a flirtatious player, by his own confession. He likes coffee, and is quite knowledgeable in the subject. He also has a fondness for smoking, and is often seen with a cigarette.

characters.name: Kaneda Wabisuke
characters.description: Wabisuke is the captain of the school's soccer club, and also (reluctantly) becomes a member of the Forbidden Date Club after a series of events. He is Nazuna's older brother, and totally adores her; being an obvious siscon. They share a different last name because of a family tradition- the daughters get the mother's last name and the sons get the father's last name. Aside from his exceptional soccer skills and good looks, Wabisuke is positive, kind and caring, making him popular amongst many girls. Wabisuke is very reliable when one's in a bind, and he often comes to Nazuna's rescue. He's always been overprotective when it comes to Nazuna, but it seems to worsen when they both get involved with the date club...

characters.name: Suou Yamato
characters.description: A mathematics teacher at Hakuou Academy, Yamato is well-known and feared amongst his students for his cold, strict and highly sadistic nature, as well as the rumours surrounding him "punishing" students. In fact, he is so feared that even the Kano brothers dare to not seriously cross him. Despite his reputation, Yamato is very popular amongst the female students for his good looks- often described as "pretty" or "beautiful". He is also known to "reward" high-achieving students, but what exactly the "rewards" pertain is not certain.

characters.name: Yaehara Daria
characters.description: Daria is the only female member of the Forbidden Date Club. Her "handsome" beauty and princely charms makes her very popular even amongst girls. Her mother, Yaehara Botan, is a very famous and acclaimed actress, and as a result, Daria took up acting as well. She too, has been noted for her "gifted" acting skills, and is part of the school's theatre club. Daria also does some modelling on the side, and has appeared on the cover of fashion magazines, though her image gears towards masculine rather than feminine. Aside from acting and modelling, she enjoys horse-riding and fencing, adding to her "princely" image. Though refined, gentle and charming, Daria hates it when people act overly familiar with her. She is also quite sensitive about most topics surrounding her mother. In spite of her popularity, Daria has her fair share of detractors, whom are referred to the "Anti-Daria".

characters.name: Saionji Seri
characters.description: At only 14-years-old, Seri is a genius in his first year of high school. He has a femininely cute appearance, but he's actually quite cold and has a sharp tongue. As a result, Seri is considered to be hard to get close to, let alone approach. A cool customer, nothing truly amuses him and nothing really fazes him. Due to his incredible intellect, he has an insufferable persona and tends to make fun of everyone around him. Seri's conduct and views are primarily shaped by his highly logical mind and merit-based formulae. His thought processes even extends to love, which he believes to be pointless and stupid. Seri often asserts that in the end, everything can be explained logically.

characters.name: Yukiyanagi Kakeru
characters.description: A teacher at Hakuou Academy, his area of speciality is history. His cute appearance makes him a particular hit amongst female students, but he's also popular with the male students because of his friendly, laidback and warm demeanour. Kakeru is often seen with a smile. He seems to have his head in the clouds, but Kakeru is quite sharp.

characters.name: Renge Kazuya
characters.description: A teacher that specialises in P.E. Kazuya is silent and stoic, so it's difficult to discern what he's really thinking or feeling. However, through his actions, it's not hard to tell that he's a kind man at heart. He's just as displeased as the other teachers with the existence of the Forbidden Date Club.

plot_tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
full_description: In a scenic valley, there's a celebrity boarding school called "Hakuou Gakuen". At a glance the school is full of smart and beautiful guys. Behind it, a secret club nobody knows of was conducted. To others, it's the mysterious going-home club. But the real name is actually the "Forbidden Date Club". The after school chime is the date signal. The strict rule is to always get the girl they're targeting. It doesn't matter who, the club members spread love like night hosts. These students are called the "Gekka Ryouran". The love renaissance / love game unfolds by the hands of these rich guys, who seem to sneer at those who admire love. However, those who are obsessed with their charms couldn't stop asking for more despite the excessive payment. It's a dangerous love, you can't go back after touching it. Now, the forbidden flowers are blooming! [taken from Neo Romance Forum]

title: C14 Dating
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: An otome dating sim that combines archaeology, friendships and love. You play as Melissa Flores, a 3rd year anthropology student participating in a summer archaeological internship. The field school takes place in Belgium, over 5000 miles away from your native California! Okay, it’s a little bit out of your comfort zone, and the fact you’ll be staying in an unfamiliar country for two months can be nerve-racking, but you couldn’t pass up such a learning opportunity! You get to excavate at an authentic prehistoric site, which has uncovered Neanderthal remains in the past. Maybe you’ll dig up some bones, or even unearth tools that were manufactured by early humans. And of course, you might forge friendships and find romance during your stay… [From Winter Wolves' Blog]

characters.name: Melissa Flores
characters.description: Not afraid to get her hands dirty, Melissa is an aspiring archaeologist who has signed up for a summer internship supervised by her professor. She’s an upbeat, friendly person who lives for the moment and enjoys new experiences. Although studying and theory may not be her strong points, she learns aptly through social interaction and getting involved. Loves dancing, meeting people, and asking questions.

characters.name: Deandre Guillaume
characters.description: Social and cultured, Deandre knows what it’s like to stay in a foreign country and reaches out to Melissa. He may seem carefree most of the time, but he’s serious about his education and has a back-up plan in case his rugby career cuts short. Although generally cheerful, he can get easily frustrated when irritated or stuck. Loves to cook.

characters.name: Hendrik Luikenhuis
characters.description: Hendrik is the head geologist of Calen Cave, working under his uncle, Augustin Dupont. Rational and down-to-earth, Hendrik is very approachable and loves teaching the students participating in the excavation. He has an avid passion for his profession, often getting lost in his work. Loves good food and, of quartz, can’t help throwing in a geology pun or two.

characters.name: Kyler LeGrand
characters.description: Kyler is a goal-driven and diligent person planning on a career in archaeology after he graduates. He tends to keep to himself, only speaking willingly when it’s about… archaeology. It’s hard to see underneath his aloof exterior since his stubbornness and judgmental attitude makes it difficult to connect to people. And what luck, he’ll be stuck digging next to the outgoing Melissa!

characters.name: Shoji Toussaint
characters.description: Shoji is a quiet, timid individual who prefers to have his nose in an e-book, handheld, or sketchpad. Although reluctant to engage in conversation, he opens up when the topic involves video games. He’s extremely sensitive and empathetic to the people around him, and gets easily overwhelmed in social situations. Likes being helpful, but struggles with his lack of confidence.

characters.name: Sherri Keller
characters.description: Melissa’s professor and mentor, who specializes in zooarchaeology and human remains. She will be supervising Melissa during the field school and providing feedback on her performance. With her informal method of teaching, students find it easy to seek her guidance.

characters.name: Rosemarie Brenner
characters.description: Originally from Germany, Rosemarie joins the Calen Cave team during the summer excavations. Although she may clash with the staff over ideals and procedures, she’s dedicated to her work on stone tools. She’s energetic and demonstrative, with a teasing side to match.

characters.name: Joan Petit
characters.description: Joan is a bashful, but amiable girl, and Chantal’s close friend. She is currently learning English, but will often get lost during conversations, leaving Chantal to translate for her. Plays flute.

characters.name: Augustin Dupont
characters.description: Head of Calen Cave, Augustin has been supervising the excavation for over twenty years. As the leading expert, he’s devoted to meticulously recording the history of the cave. Although passionate, he can be strict and overbearing depending on how the students perform.

characters.name: Chantal Masson
characters.description: Chantal is a frank girl who’d rather be diving for shipwrecks than be stuck digging in a dank cave. She can be blunt at times, but she’s supportive of her friends.

plot_tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
full_description: An otome dating sim that combines archaeology, friendships and love. You play as Melissa Flores, a 3rd year anthropology student participating in a summer archaeological internship. The field school takes place in Belgium, over 5000 miles away from your native California! Okay, it’s a little bit out of your comfort zone, and the fact you’ll be staying in an unfamiliar country for two months can be nerve-racking, but you couldn’t pass up such a learning opportunity! You get to excavate at an authentic prehistoric site, which has uncovered Neanderthal remains in the past. Maybe you’ll dig up some bones, or even unearth tools that were manufactured by early humans. And of course, you might forge friendships and find romance during your stay… [From Winter Wolves' Blog]

title: Date Everything!
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Dumped from their job, a former customer service worker is suddenly delivered a pair of magical glasses that allows them to turn the objects in their house into human form and interact with them. Do they strike up a friendship, fall in love or hate each others' guts?

characters.name: Wallace
characters.description: It appears that Wallace says "Wall". He gives his love freely, and simply, how one might imagine a wall might. But I think there's more here than meets the lenses... like a prisoner with a smuggled nail file and a whole lotta patience, you too can slowly erode his armor and emerge on the other side of his personality. Likes: Steadfastness, Trust Dislikes: Small Children with Crayons

characters.name: Skylar Specs
characters.description: It's me! I put myself first not because I'm the most important but because I'm the one who's making all this possible! I'm the one who negotiates (?) a conduit (?) between you and the rest of the dateable objects! I'll write down my thoughts here for you, as well as any progress you've made in any relationships. Let's get dating! Likes: Curiosity, Creativity, Passion Dislikes: Skeptics [From in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Amir
characters.description: Amir is a true romantic. He's genuine, passionate and open with his emotions. Sure, his affections can be overwhelming to anyone who isn't accustomed to his brand of radical honesty, and it's easy to mistake his flowery declarations for cheap pickup lines, but with Amir, what you see is truly what you get. He truly sees the beauty in everything he reflects, just as it is. He appreciates authenticity above all else, and takes it as his personal mission to shatter any perceptions of self-doubt in others. Likes: Self-Reflection, Himself, Yourself Dislikes: Graffiti, Bloody Mary [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Rebel
characters.description: An obscene, angry, profanity-driven, shit talker. That's about all there is to say about that... PUNK, FUNK, AND FULL OF SPUNK. They are a ReBel without a cause(tm). And they do not give one. Single. Duck. What you think. [From in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Artt
characters.description: It is refreshing to meet an object who is really passionate about their own subject! Artt, art, loves art! He is just so excited to look at it, hang it up, talk about it. And he really wants to know what you think. Don't worry about answering the wrong thing - it'll always be an artistic choice with this fellow. Likes: Animated Discussion, Beauty in All Its Forms, The Sharing of Ideas Dislikes: Close-mindedness, Bare Walls, Willful Ignorance [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Dante
characters.description: Dante is a hard worker: he has to keep a fire lit beneath him or he'll burn out, and he radiates a warm and fun personality as a result. He's easy to warm up to, and he's prepared to cheer you up on a moment's notice. He wants to teach you the Way of the Flame - are you ready for his lessons? Likes: Slow Burns Dislikes: Shortcuts [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Telly
characters.description: There is nothing worth your gaze more than the big black box full of comedy, drama and the occasional commercial break. Telly was the star of the show for so many decades that any hint of a slip in their ratings is dusted off like so much static. Keep them in your sights and this sassy showman will give you back so much more. Likes: Attention Dislikes: Volume control [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Luke Nukem
characters.description: Likes: Fighting Swarmers, Achieving Mission Success for Colonel Furnace, Saving the Barrens Dislikes: Missions Concerning Chicken Tenders

characters.name: Barry Styles
characters.description: Barry is flamboyant yet chill, fun yet empathetic. Untouchably cool and yet, somehow, one of your biggest fans. He loves drama but is mostly and observer, content to skate over the 'face' of whatever's happening. He comes off quite confident, but internally, is more than a little nervous about being replaced. He can sometimes be a little ditzy, though, if anyone is self-aware it's him (prepare for parentheticals, darling). [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Bathsheba
characters.description: Bathsheba is welcoming, warm, and always there for you at the end of a long day. She is all for comfy wind-downs - scented candles, a DVD of Legally Blinds or Never Been Dished, and an offer to paint your nails or braid your hair. And while she can be pretty chill, she can also get right into it with you when you need someone to vent to. However, she also tends to feel somewhat isolated and disconnected where she is in the house and has a pretty bad case of FOMO over the others. Likes: Bubbles, Bathing, Bathsheba Dislikes: Wrinkly Skin [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Hero-Hime
characters.description: "STARLIGHT SMASH!" Hero-Hime is the protagonist of Starlight Overheaders! Hero-Hime is energetic, goofy, and overly positive in an endearing way, or at least, that's what the animators hoped. She carries her magic tennis racket, which invokes her transformation between sports hero and avarage college student. Her goal is to become the TENNISTAR - the best tennis player and hero of Heart Ace Academy. Hero-Hime trains diligently every day in order to achieve her goal. She's an underdog, after all, and she knows. Likes: Tangerines, Cake, Tennis Practice Dislikes: Giving 50-99% [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Scandalabra
characters.description: Likes: Scandal, Secrets, Polish Dislikes: Rudeness, Low Speech, Dillydallying

characters.name: Lux
characters.description: It might be cruel to say that Lux is vapid, without substance, and rather uninteresting once you get below the surface. But it would be cruel to objective reality to suggest that this isn't true. Lux's claim to fame is that they have a whole lot of followers on Instaglam. 2.5M to be exact. Did Lux buy some of those followers in the form of bot accounts from unspecified countries? Sure they did. Does that infringe upon Lux's intense pride at their number of total followers? Of course not. Lux's brand is centered around the concept of "the light within," encouraging their followers to find their inner light and shine it brightly for the world to see. However, Lux's obsession with their image and online persona has made them increasingly self-centered and insufferable. Likes: Themself, Good Lighting, High Engagement Dislikes: Interesting Conversation, Long Form Content, Legal Action [From t

characters.name: Henry Hoove
characters.description: Hoove has been working non-stop, harder than he should, but he knows he's got to keep things running smoothly or else the whole house will be full of Grime Scenes. He's really proud of his job, although slightly depressed because he's always confined to odd corners of the house. What he'd really love is someone to see him not just as a hard-working tool, but also as a good companion worthy of love. Though a nice bag change once in a while couldn't do any harm, right? Likes: Brews, Sports, Holding Onto Stuff Dislikes: Letting Go [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Bobby Pinn
characters.description: Sure there's a (very low) bounty for their arrest, but I'm sure this is one pin you won't want to be turning in any time soon. Sure they profess a love of crime, but have any been successful? Bobby is the definition of victimless crime - though you probably don't want to tell them that. Likes: Crime, Schemes, Capers Dislikes: Cops [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Abel
characters.description: Abel is sturdy and dependable with rustic sensibilities. This table is happy to support your needs, rain or shine, and most of the others consider him to be a steady, calming influence, despite his reluctance to talk. He takes pride in a job well done - which takes as many different forms as there are tables in this house (there are 8 tables in the house!) Likes: Steadiness, Protection, Exotic Furniture from Distant Lands Dislikes: Tomfoolery [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Freddy Yeti
characters.description: You might think of this monstrous giant as a big ice meanie, but he's anything but! Freddy welcomes all comers to sample his wares, whether leftovers, fresh veggies, or even just to stare blankly at his insides several times a day. He thinks you're the coolest of cool kids. Likes: Food, Preservation, Food Preservation Dislikes: Anything Uncool [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Beverly
characters.description: Beverly can be as bubbly as champagne and as smooth as a good rum, though spending too much time with her can lead to hangovers... and more than a few visits to Jean Loo. She sometimes has a way of putting blinders on you to forget her troubles and just have fun... but hey, who doesn't! Still, interacting with Beverly should be all about balance - just like the perfect mixed drink. Likes: Ice, Recipes, Ratios Dislikes: Sobriety, Online Advertising [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Stefan
characters.description: Stefan is a big burly stove who despite his has exterior has a soft side hidden beneath those layers of muscle. If there's one thing that reigns supreme for Stefan it is that food is the glue of the world. It brings everyone together, from all walks of life, which instils a passion burning inside him. That passion makes him come off as fiery and overbearing sometimes. He is constantly bossing the kitchen around (not that anyone actually pays attention) so that everything runs like a well-oiled machine. However, behind that veritable wall of fire is a stove who simply wants to provide joy to all those around him. Likes: Cuisine, Care, High Standards Dislikes: Insincerity [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Doug
characters.description: Always there, lurking behind every interaction, every distraction, every moment when your attention is taken by something else, is Doug. He's not scary, though, thankfully. Just a little... toxic. Question is - are you going to let him off the hook? Or tell him to treat you with more respect? Likes: Watching Content Dislikes: Wimps [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Penelope
characters.description: Poor Penelope - unlucky in love, and eternally searching for that perfect someone. But, with such a huge array of dateable objects, love is surely around the corner! Or around the kitchen. The attic? ... outside? Likes: Inspirational Quotes, Taking Pictures, Pizza Dislikes: Not Being Seen [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: I, Ronaldini
characters.description: A magician who's somewhat old-hat. His simple magic show has been forgotten by time, which he is unsubtly bitter about. He insists his magic shows are "exclusive" for "those in the know", but in truth he just doesn't have an audience. He longs for the days where he felt useful and loved, but simultaneously hides behind an exclusive tiny door so almost nobody knows his shows even exist. A paradoxical appliance. [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Jerry
characters.description: Jerry is a slightly neurotic hoarder, er, 'curator', who has trouble letting go of any item. He worries that he might need something further down the line, no matter how useless it is. The idea that he could be throwing away something with the slightest chance of being even tangential to be useful is mortifying to him, so he keeps everything. A drawer of habits. Likes: Baubles, Curios, Trinkets, Gegaws, Whatnots, Gadgets, Bagatelles Dislikes: Finding Solutions [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Jean-Loo Pissoir
characters.description: A French crapper (NOTE: "cool-rapper") with confidence out the wazoo. Always "on" and somewhat hard to approach, especially on an intimate/personal level. Jean will happily spit bars at whoever will listen, but he only respects those who can keep up with his verbal wit. Most of the other dateables have never heard him speak a full sentence without rhyming. Probably smells a little bit. Likes: Rhymin', Spittin', Slingin', Winnin' Dislikes: The Cold Reality That He Is In Fact a Toilet Above All. [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Holly
characters.description: Impossibly positive in the most dreary of situations, Holly is a ray of sunshine in sunless spaces. She's messy, disorganised, and easily excitable about any-which-what flavor of the month is the current talking point. The kind of person who starts preparing for Blissmas the day after Hollyween. She's also wildly distractible, and while she adores her found family, she's terrible at scheduling time to be with them. Notorious for always working holidays, she's stuck in a cycle of both adoring festivities, but never allowing herself to enjoy them. Likes: Jingling, Ringling, Ring-ting-tingling Dislikes: Jerry [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Shelley
characters.description: Shelley has always been one of the lads. She's down to get dirty and messy, and isn't afraid to take risks. Shelley's the kind of shelf who grew up playing sports, and was always tougher than the rest of her friend group, but has a heart of gold. Shelley is a real pal, and probably one of the best you'll ever find. She spends most of her time being so supporting and lifting others up, and will always have your back. Does it come off as being high-strung sometimes? Sure, but that might be due to a bracket-mounting problem than anything else. Likes: Stability Dislikes: Volume Control [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Tydus Andromache
characters.description: Tydus feels that the weight of the world rests on her because she alone must decide whether to sacrifice her darling detergent pods. She views the task of guarding over her pods as a higher purpose, and without them she feels literally empty. Though, she knows just as well as anybody that her pods are the only 4-in-1 laundry solution with highly concentrated detergent, stain remover, and color protector, outperforming the leading laundry detergent and giving you more bang for your buck. Tydus is loyal to a fault and will do absolutely anything for the ones she loves most. Careful though, she may be used to washing off crap, but she refuses to take any of yours. Likes: Duty, Honor, That Kinda Stuff Dislikes: Stains [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Vaughn Trapp
characters.description: Vaughn is a whole lotta boisterous energy in a small package - he needs to be if he's going to do his job of defending your house from invaders... Follow his instructions or else you're gonna get SNAPPED! I wonder, though, is it really all about the violence for him? Or is there some other way to give him what he needs... Likes: Jazz, Cheese, Never Letting Go Dislikes: Crawlspaces [From the in-game date-a-dex]

characters.name: Tyrell
characters.description: Tyrell is looking for purpose. He worries he is on his way to being considered for no more than cleanup jobs. What is Tyrell for anyway? When will anyone ever pick Tyrell first? He has a bit of a wrinkle in his attitude because of this. Still, he'll absorb any negative energy you toss his way. If you don't put his feelings first, he won't like you one bit. A quick fluff and he will be there to warm you up and keep you dry. But everyone in the bathroom talks, and if he finds out you are only using him for washup duties, he won't be too kind about it. Likes: Family, Friends, Fuzziness Dislikes: Feeling Left Out [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Bodhi Windbreaker
characters.description: Do you remember 80's? Well, don't you worry, because our good old fashioned boy-next-door heartthrob is going to teach you all about it. He may literally be a time-capsule, but his knowledge of the era and the secrets his contents hold with blow the mind of even the most righteous 8bit enjoyer. Bodhi is here to open your mind to a simpler time, and open your hear to a love that's purer that uncut Colombian... coffee. Likes: The 1980s Dislikes: The 1780s [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Chairemi
characters.description: Our girl Chairemi here is a dedicated LARPer, a jill-of-all-trades useful in any situation! She prides herself on being able to fit into whatever role is needed to make things run smoothly: A stern office chair, a matronly rocking chair, a boozy lounge chair for late evenings, you name it! Chairemi is almost always in character as something or other. So much so that no one is really sure what her actual personality is like. One might think she's trying to hide something... but no! She's just a theater kid through and through. She puts a little bit of herself into every character she plays, and only someone who meets her on her level will notice. Chairemi holds actor comfort and safety above all else. Likes: Snacks, Trying on Large Wigs, Insufferable Inside Jokes Dislikes: Recasts, Unused Comps, Finding a Ride Home [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Sophia
characters.description: A consummate dominatrix who holds the keys to your satisfaction... and your cash. Sophia is as straightforward as they come - you either enjoy her type of flirtation, or not. Have fun playing around with a real professional... Likes: Servitude, Loyalty, Safety Dislikes: Talking back [Edited from the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Keyes
characters.description: Keyes comes from a storied line of grand pianos. Name a big venue and someone in her family has graced the stage. Much like her actual keys, her outlook on life is black and white. You're either a renowned performer at the top of your game or you're a failure and you should launch yourself directly into the garbage. You'll need patience and understanding to let Keyes be the personality she needs to be. Likes: Classical Music Dislikes: Dissonance [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Prissy Plastique
characters.description: Prissy Plastique is just about the prettiest plastic plant this side of the electrical closet! She brightens any room she's in with her shiny blooms and her bright and peppy attitude. She'd like to brighten more than none room at a time... but with only one plastic plant that might not be possible. Likes: Magic, Hope, Tourism Dislikes: Realism, Despair, Staying Put [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Farya
characters.description: Farya is unapologetically enthusiastic - especially when it comes to taking care of the sick and injured, like any good doctor. If you need a bandaid and a kiss on a bruised knee, she's your gal. If you need to know the symptoms of diphtheria, mononucleosis and mumps, she's also your gal. If she goes on and on about all the possible illnesses and ailments you might have, she's only doing it because she cares. Injuries are rare enough that when someone does need her, she desperately wants to get it right. Likes: Diagnosing, Strange Humours, Blood, Guts Dislikes: Studying [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Tina Triangle
characters.description: Tina the Triangle is a poor representative of a classical music, but should be a fun time nonetheless. Her grating voice is only outmatched by her grating personality. Why you have a musical triangle in your bedroom closet is ultimately up to you - the possibilities are ENDLESS. She's a bombastic, in-your-face triangle who is obsessed with fantasy, drama, and raunchy reality TV. Is it toxic? Maybe. Is it sexy? Also maybe. Likes: Drama Dislikes: Music [Edited from the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Wilhelmina Work
characters.description: Willi always knew what she wanted to be, and she got an early start. While her peers were still figuring things out, Willi was already firmly up the ladder and has been climbing ever since. But the thing about getting to the top of the ladder is that it really gives you a view of everything you're missing. She has no interests to speak of, to say nothing of a love life. In fact, while others find social interactions as easy as breathing, that's the one thing she really hasn't been able to master. Ever the overachiever, Wilhemina has set out to conquer this mountain. She certainly has the time now, with AI on the rise... Likes: Aptitude, Strong Handshakes Dislikes: Ineptitude, Yogurt [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Airyn
characters.description: Airyn is a little touchy... handle with care. Don't expect flattery from this gaseous goddess. An ethereal, mysterious presence that seemingly exists in a state beyond human need and emotion. It is difficult to say what she wants or seeks from you, if anything at all. [Edited from the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Arma
characters.description: Arma wants to be the best firefighter in the world! Unfortunately for her, so far this has only meant that she's hypervigilant about any teeny tiny bit of smoke that she detects, routinely triggering obnoxious and adrenaline-pumping false alarms. All of this constant anxiety has also had the effect of wearing her down over time, such that her batteries are almost completely drained. What she desperately needs is someone to give her a bit of a break, and to show her that she doesn't need to be keyed all the way up to 11 in order to do her job. Likes: Urgency, Piercing Noises, Latex Dislikes: The Middle Path [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Beau
characters.description: Beau is an adventurer. A free spirited, wise cracking, good hearted rogue who's always looking for inspiration and challenge. She is amazingly resourceful, sourcing all of her tools, weapons, and toys from drum roll please... boxes. She's exceptionally proud of the whip she's fashioned from that extension cord you stuck in the garage when you realized you already owned three. You should go on any adventure she pitches - this is a box that won't fall apart on the way from the car. Likes: Vim, Vigor, Derring-do Dislikes: Dishonesty, Cowardice, Reliquary Theft [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: xxXShadowl0rd420Xxx
characters.description: As the light fades and dusk draws, all hope becomes despair! Hark, for your greatest fears manifest in yours truly... quiver before xxXShadowl0rd420Xxx! This totally badass embodiment of darkness is an emperor of fear. The nightmare lord is a being of mystery. No one can truly know him. He is the ultimate being and cannot be stopped... what do you mean you don't believe me? Likes: Bands You Wouldn't Have Heard Of Dislikes: Neckties [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Mac
characters.description: They say the computer is a reflection of the user... and in this case you've got a really nice reflection! Well, almost. Maybe you too are in dire need of an upgrade, some folder reorganization, and reduction in clutter to help streamline your memory. Whatever you choose - Mac will be eagerly ready to help carry out your tasks! Likes: Bits, Bytes, Scenic Cities in New Jersey Dislikes: Romance Novels [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Maggie
characters.description: Maggie is always on the hunt for the next mystery. Whether it's trying to figure out where that table coaster disappeared to (you lost it), or who has been leaving the refrigerator door open at 2am (also you), or who forgot to turn the oven off before leaving on that trip to Aruba (again, you), Maggie is on the case! But there might be a dark side to Maggie's investigative spirit. Years ago, Maggie was in a relationship with a beautiful pair of binoculars. She fell madly, utterly in love. Unfortunately, the binoculars were unfaithful to her, and Maggie has been left trying to protect herself by finding out everything about any possible partner. This has left her pushing away anyone who might get close, as she has no sense of when "being interested" has become "being a snoop." Likes: Evidence, Facts, Rounding up Suspects Dislikes: Privacy, Boundaries [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Koa
characters.description: A big guy with a relaxed, chill and loveable vibe. Hailing from Kona, Hawaii (or Kailua-Kona on the Big Island), Koa likes to relax and eat good food with friends. Any time someone is down or feeling out of it, Koa hears them out. He's a great listener and thrives on helping friends. For being such a helpful and giving guy, he doesn't seem to ask much in return. he would never want to burden anyone else with his woes, because for him, that would ruin all the fun. Likes: Peace, Quiet, Owning and Operating a Fusion Restaurant Dislikes: Being a Downer [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Dolly
characters.description: There is more to this gal than just her incredibly well-formed dustiness - Dolly is a studied professor! She wont make any talkback, and specially no talking down to, so treat her with the respect that this teacher and her pet deserve. Likes: Research, Modeling, Lint Eastwood Dislikes: Patronizing talk, Sneezing [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Stepford
characters.description: Is it still narcissism if you've really got the goods? Well... Yes. Yes, it is. Stepford is the most accomplished competitor in the house. If there's a trophy awarded for it, Stepford has probably got one or two of them lying around. He's placed first in Pickle Jam Lid Removing, Cross-Room Trashcan Toss, Desk Drawer Organizing, and even Competitive Objectification. He's nice and shiny! Well. Fairly shiny. Likes: Being 1st Dislikes: Being 2nd [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Friar Errol
characters.description: Friar Errol is a deeply serious, highly-repressed air fryer who believes it is his solemn duty to lead the world down the path of the Heavenly Kitchen. He's never had deep fat fried food, viewing it as beneath him, and he fully intends to preach the gospel of convection to all who'll hear it. Have you heard the good word? Will you join him on his path? Likes: The Road of the Heavenly Kitchen, Culinary Purity and Efficiency, Our Lord of Convection Dislikes: Oil [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Wyndolyn
characters.description: Wyndolyn is an open book - or window. She will tell you anything you'd like to know. She will tell you who in the house is fighting. She will tell you about how she's feeling, and what conclusions she gained from her daily meditations. She will tell you about the bender she went on fifteen years ago, even if you ask her very politely not to. Is what she says always correct? No. Is it sometimes nothing more than an opinion or conjecture? Probably, yes. Is she a wild source of entertainment? Oh hell yes. She may not say things that are 100% kind to you, but she does it out of love, or at least that's what she says. She is a master of the fine compliment sandwich. Likes: Transparency Dislikes: Baseballs [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Dorian
characters.description: Unemotional, uncompromising, and intelligent enough to know when someone's trying to pull a fast one on him. Dorian is the ideal candidate to keep the unwanted out and the wanted in. Dorian loves friendship more than anything - more so than love itself. He feels that love can cause jealousy and create dangerous situations. Beneath Dorian's icy exterior, there are some mysterious hints at a rich inner life... Who on earth speaks nine languages aside from English, for example? Dorian exists in 17 different places around the house. Can you find all his different forms? ... Do you even want to? Likes: Friendship Dislikes: Nonsense [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Cam
characters.description: Don't worry your pretty little head about Cam, he's fine. Sure, he's been dumped. Many times. Maybe all the time. But he's got the determination and dignity to keep going no matter how tough things get. Cam comes off as salty, but really he's just honest. He's not interested in making small talk. Likes: Trash Dislikes: Whatever This Game Is [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Monique
characters.description: It might feel like you're being interrogated by the cool and calculating Monique - but she's just a moneyed maiden making sure you're prepared for life. While Monique is confident in pre-planning and managing schedules, she tends to feel lost when it comes to small talk: it's easier to be professional than personal. Outside of logistics, It's almost as if the inside of the safe seems to be all she knows. Likes: Tabulations, Balances, Sophia Dislikes: Inattention, Sloppiness, Debt [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Kopi
characters.description: A spicy personality with a silky exterior to boot, Kopi is that one companion who's ready to hype you up in the morning for the rest of your day. Energetic and suave, she's the one you can turn to for warming your heart; she is dependable and resourceful. The one thing Kopi is really good at is keeping from spilling the beans, but with her excellent secret keeping comes the tendency to jump to conclusions, so she can be a little volatile. Likes: Waking up Early, Nice-Smelling Conditioner, Beans Dislikes: Bureaucracy, Management, Unpaid Overtime [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Gaia
characters.description: Gaia has been obsessed with travel and seeing the world all her existence, but no matter how hard she tries, she feels like her world is just spinning in circles, never actually going anywhere! Consumed with a wanderlust that can never be fullfilled, Gaia is obssesed with stories. She loves to listen to the tales of others and live vicariously through them, collecting them in a mental scrapbook. Can you help her see the world that she represents so well? Likes: Yearnin', Imaginin', Spinnin' Dislikes: Speakin' plain [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Hank 1
characters.description: If you're hankering for a harem of high-flyin' handsome hunks, then look no further than the Hanks. Sure, they're all different hangers individually, but they share the same passion for adventure and adrenaline that keeps them all moving forward to the next jump zone. You'd never dream of breaking up this polyamorous playdate, and if you're lucky you just might end up in the center of their attention... Well, at least until the next epic low-pressure zone comes in. Sponsored by Red Bowl. Likes: Thermals, Waves, The Majestic Dance between Gravity, Death, and Freedom Dislikes: Reading [From the in-game Date-A-Dex]

characters.description: If you're hankering for a harem of high-flyin' handsome hunks, then look no further than the Hanks. characters.name: Stella
characters.description: Stella's been stepped on her entire existence. In work, in love, in everything. She'd just never really realised it till now. Everyone uses her to get to where they need to be, but where they need to be is rarely with Stella. After settling for silent gratitude most of her life, Stella's stepping out on her own terms, recently aligning herself with Airway as an affiliate ambassador. Determined to take back control, Stella's stepping up to the plate to control her own finances, even if she's a little wobbly on her feet. Likes: Structure Dislikes: Feeling Left Out [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Florence
characters.description: Don't call her an underling: Florence is an overachiever. With her trademark smile and bubbly personality, she helps to grease the wheels of the public's perception of the political sphere. By running through the entire house, she has a lock on every detail there is to know from the hoi polloi. Just be careful when it comes time to ask her about things swept under her rug... Likes: Mops, Brooms, Buckets Dislikes: Meanies [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Mitchell Linn
characters.description: Mitchell Linn... prestigious pundit of the palate, master of the mouthwatering morsel, destroyer of the deviant dining establishment... He is obsessed by all things culinary: a true believer in the power of a great meal to give meaning to an otherwise drab and dreary life (so he sees it). Detail-oriented, and utterly unsparing, Mitchell leaves nothing out of his withering critiques. Ambiance, service, menu selection, flavor, presentation: all are of the utmost importance to Mitchell. And if any are sub par? Well, you're going to know about it. With the pen as his sword, he is ready to elevate or eviscerate with equal fervor. Likes: High-Quality Products and Ingredients, Careful Balance of Flavor Profiles, Consistency of Service Dislikes: Cronuts [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Celia
characters.description: There may never have been a proper election, but Celia is the de facto Mayor of the household. With her royal mein and withering wit, could you ever vote no? She rises above any sort of corrupting influence and clearly has the best interests of the house in mind. Still, this coy countess does know how to party - she never misses one of her favorite shows at Chairemi's. [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Drysdale
characters.description: Suave, delicious... Drysdale is the place to go for a sweet chablis and dry humor. His best tumbling days might be behind him, but then again so is the wall, and that's never stopped him from rubbing up against whoever gives him the biggest compliments. He's attached to the washing machine. Likes: Presents, Biscuits, Wrestling in Oil Dislikes: Drying Clothing [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Fantina Fantasico
characters.description: Have you ever wanted to meet your biggest fan? Now's your chance! The fact that the English word 'fan' meaning both 'fanatic' and 'appliance for blowing air' are purely coincidental. Fantina loves you for reasons other than puns. Likes: You Dislikes: None [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Teddy
characters.description: We should all be so lucky to have a friend like Teddy. And Teddy would probably be a friend to us all! My only problem there is that he's just so darned relaxing. I want to hear all of the wonderful stories he's got, but by just a minute or two into them, with his soothing voice and that soft shoulder... I'm asleep. Guess I'll just have to keep tryin'. Likes: Dispensing Wisdom, Dispensing Stories Dislikes: Criticism [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Cabrizzio
characters.description: Stylish and fit, a little rebellious with a charm all his own and that killer smile, Cabrizzio is naturally flirtatious and often gets mistaken for a playboy, but that's not his game. He's here to enjoy existence with a laissez-faire approach. We live and laugh, and revel in the good moments we have with each other. Sometimes he'll display a depth to him rooted in tradition and family. And if you don't hold on to those handles firmly, he might just sweep you off your feet. Likes: Italy, Imagination, Romance Dislikes: Urgency, Reality, France [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Lady Memoria
characters.description: Don't let her intimidating countenance and elegant attire destabilize you... Lady Memoria is one twisty bunch of memories! She enjoys being just a little bit on the dark side. Her upfront nature may throw you for a loop - is she really okay with being thrown away? If she's being honest, just know that the one thing she doesn't want is to be forgotten. [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Miranda Dulce Tostadora
characters.description: Miranda is a star - a celebrity in her own right. She's the lead singer with her own band The Migas. She's very loving and warm, unless you cross her, then she can leave you burned. It's not recommended to play with her emotions because she knows she deserves better and can dish a heated serving of sass right back. She adores an audience and loves to make a crowd happy (or sad) with her sweet melodies. Ultimately, she wants someone who loves her as much as she loves to sing (which might not be possible.) Likes: Slow Burns Dislikes: Cooking [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

characters.name: Dasha
characters.description: Dasha is as intense and dramatic, and an absolute sweetheart, all at once. She's a Russian lifter with a stoic and sensible edge, but with a sharp and sly sense of humor. Headstrong and supportive to a fault, she never hesitates to put others' needs before her own. As such, Dasha isn't used to getting attention herself. Especially if it has anything to do with her secret crushes... Likes: Strong Dislikes: Stinky [From the in-game Date-a-dex]

plot_tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
full_description: Dumped from their job, a former customer service worker is suddenly delivered a pair of magical glasses that allows them to turn the objects in their house into human form and interact with them. Do they strike up a friendship, fall in love or hate each others' guts?

title: Tsukiakari no Raspberry ~Tsun★Dere II~
title_original: 月明りのラズベリィ～つん★デれII～
tags: Group Sex of One Female and Several Males
description: Himezaki Orie is still anxious about her first love with new teacher. She gets a new best friend and together with it a sweet, fully and slightly painful feeling. And her love story continues. [From vndbreview]
full_description: Himezaki Orie is still anxious about her first love with new teacher. She gets a new best friend and together with it a sweet, fully and slightly painful feeling. And her love story continues. [From vndbreview]

title: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Tenshi no Akogare
title_original: その花びらにくちづけを　天使のあこがれ
description: Aihara Ringo, who is in her first year at the nursing school, has decided to room with Takao Chiaki, an old family friend from back home. Ringo idolizes Chiaki and has made it her life’s goal to become a respectable nurse just like her. However… Once they actually start living together, Ringo comes to realize that Chiaki takes much worse care of herself than she imagined, and is at the same time a very physically affectionate person. Will the disparity between Chiaki the goddess and the Chiaki who delights in sexual harassment drive Ringo crazy!? [Translated synopsis]

characters.name: Aihara Ringo
characters.description: An energetic, aspiring young girl. A first-year student in nursing school and graduate of St. Michael’s. A hardworker who always maintains excellent grades. She’s family friends with Chiaki, who is a nurse and teacher, and has admired her since they were little. Taking her acceptance to nursing school as an opportunity to become independent from her parents, she’s begun living with Chiaki in her apartment. [Translated from Gyutto and Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Takao Chiaki
characters.description: A picture perfect nurse. …But she’s actually pretty spoiled. She’s both a nurse in the gastrointestinal surgery ward at Saint Michael’s General Hospital as well as a nursing instructor. With Ringo being accepted to nursing school, Chiaki offers to take her under her wing, and the two begin living together in her apartment. Ordinarily she’s a flawless model of a woman, but at home, she has surprisingly little concern for herself; in some ways, she’s a bit of a wreck. [Translated from Gyutto and Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Katakura Yuuno
characters.description: An extreeemely pushy and overprotective girl who is in her first year of nursing school. Satsuki’s classmate and dormmate. Has a soft, feminine disposition. Fairly protective, she always speaks formally, with a deference to others. Her overbearing disposition stems from her “What would you do without me?” attitude toward the frequently troubled Satsuki. [Translated from Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Ishigami Satsuki
characters.description: A brilliant, but frank and aloof girl with boyish tendencies. What you would call an aloof mystery. Up front and self-assured. She always speaks in a masculine way. Although she’s never had much interest in eating, Yuuno has been using her home cooking to draw her out more, so that she’ll be straightforward with her expressions of affection, regardless of their surroundings. [Translated from Yurin Yurin]

title: A Tithe in Blood
description: As a reserved and unassuming university student in snow-bitten Hokkaido, the personal tragedy which visited Honoka Asakawa would lead to her experimentation in a magical art thought long-lost — blood magic. Unexpectedly able to visit the sealed world of Meiji-era Sapporo, Honoka's quickly taken under the wing of the cheerful and bright Lady Yasue, a powerful mage who's remained in this gilded cage for a century. As their feelings for each other develop, the true repercussions of Honoka's first steps into the secret world of magic and mages are only just starting to play out, eventually leading to catastrophic consequences. [From Steam]

characters.name: Honoka Asakawa
characters.description: A university student in Sapporo, her public persona of a quiet and studious young woman hiding her newfound obsession with the arts of blood magic. This unexpectedly allows her to travel to the Sapporo of a century past and meet the woman named Yasue, but the true consequences of her peek into the hidden world of mages and magic are only just beginning to unfold. [From Steam]

characters.name: Yasue
characters.description: Once a renowned grand mage, the calm and cheerful Lady Yasue now finds herself sealed in an unchanging Sapporo; one eternally stuck in the Meiji era. Only a century later would she find company beyond those she was sealed with, when the confused and afraid Honoka inadvertently visited her sealed world. Even locked away from reality, Lady Yasue continues to direct magical performances at her beloved kabuki venue, and is only too happy to dote on her new visitor. [From Steam]

characters.name: Shino Kikuchi
characters.description: When the previous university librarian retired, their replacement couldn't have been more different. Athletic, upbeat, and outgoing to a fault, Shino Kikuchi seizes every opportunity to chat with the soft-spoken student who stays long after the library's normal closing hours. From an unusual delight in new technology to her odd attitude towards her work, Shino presents a puzzling figure to a bemused Honoka. [From Steam]

characters.name: Yonehara
characters.description: A wisened mage of far beyond her visible years. Yonehara cuts a solemn and haunting figure to the curious Honoka. [From Patreon]

characters.name: Kaoru Ito
characters.description: Kaoru's past couldn't have been more different to her partner Tatiana's, her rough upbringing leading her to a life apart from polite society. Ever eager to share her wisdom with others, she found herself fast friends with the newcomer Shino. [From Patreon]

characters.name: Tatiana Fedorova
characters.description: Having left her childhood home of Russia years ago, Tatiana now busies herself with running her bar in downtown Sapporo. [From Patreon]

title: Negligee: Love Stories
description: A series of four stories following the characters Karen, Charlotte, Sophie and Jasmin. Following their early lives and the decisions they had to make, whether to follow their heart or their head and how that impacts their lives. [From Steam]

characters.name: Hannah
characters.description: Favorite undies: Lace Favorite season: Spring Hobby: Working Favorite color: Red Hannah has worked at the store since she was eighteen, hoping to one day use her experience to get a management position herself, always a little unsure about herself and what to try. With the original manager's sudden disappearance, Hannah finally has a chance to prove herself as the new manager at the Negligee store. [Taken from Character Bio Sheet]

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.description: Favorite undies: Cute Favorite season: Summer Hobby: Basketball Favorite color: Blue Charlotte is a shy young woman. She recently suffered a heartbreak and is looking for a job to take her mind off it. Charlotte enjoys playing basketball and used to be a center in her college team. Now looking to meet new people and find something new, she walks into the shop looking for a job. [Taken from Character Bio Sheet]

characters.name: Sophie
characters.description: Favorite undies: Babydoll Favorite season: Spring Hobby: Fooling around Favorite color: Green Sophie is a very confident young woman, who revels in her freedom. She enjoyed fooling around, dating men and women alike and generally exploring her many fantasies. That is until some incidents left her wondering if she was making the right choices in life. [Taken from Character Bio Sheet]

characters.name: Jasmin
characters.description: Favorite undies: Chemise Favorite season: Summer Hobby: Dancing Favorite Color: Orange Jasmin is the oldest of the new applicants to work at the store. Unlike the others, she has been working for the past couple of years as a dancer and is currently not enrolled in college. Jasmin however wants to move on with her life, get a new job, and find a better balance between her passions and work. [Taken from Character Bio Sheet]

characters.name: Emily
characters.description: Favorite undies: Bra and panties Favorite season: Autumn Hobby: Dating Favorite color: Gold Emily is the current owner of the Negligee store. However, she chooses to let others run her various stores, so that she can spend her time having fun and dating. She is well known for her over the top friendly attitude on life. In spite of that, she is a shrewd business woman. [Taken from Character Bio Sheet]

characters.name: Karen
characters.description: Favorite undies: Silk Favorite season: Summer Hobby: Tennis Favorite color: Purple

characters.name: Miley
characters.description: The counselor of Sophie.

characters.name: Jonathan
characters.description: Karen's husband

title: Sakura Fox Adventure
description: Mikoto is a foxgirl who lives deep in the woods, in a settlement full of foxgirls called Yamatai. Mikoto’s mother, Himiko, is the leader of these foxgirls, and she commends immense magical powers. As the daughter of an illustrious woman, Mikoto is expected to train hard, and one day take her mother’s place – but there’s a catch. Mikoto is a complete failure of a foxgirl! Despite being twenty-five years of age, Mikoto only has one tail. She fumbles even the simplest of spells, and her hand-to-hand combat skills are laughable. She routinely loses mock battles against her tutor, Ohana, and the other foxgirls in her clan shun and mock her owing to her ineptitude. Unsatisfied with her mundane life in Yamatai, Mikoto dreams of leaving home and speaking to the humans that live in the nearby Warren Village. Mikoto has heard humans are wicked and untrustworthy, but Mikoto is an optimist at heart,

characters.name: Mikoto
characters.description: Mikoto is a cheerful, outgoing foxgirl with a zest for life. Adventurous and inquisitive, Mikoto wants nothing more than to explore the world around her – but how can she, when her tutor is so very controlling?! As Mikoto has few friends, she gets overly attached to Juni from the get-go. She’s pushy and insistent, and perhaps her advances are a tad inappropriate…but she’s pure at heart, and apologizes whenever she goes too far. [From Steam]

characters.name: Ohana
characters.description: Ohana is Mikoto’s tutor. She’s a forest nymph who’s lived for several centuries, and she possesses immense magical power that rivals even that of Mikoto’s mother, Himiko. Ohana is a stern woman, and she takes her duties as Mikoto’s tutor very seriously. She’s the first to rebuke Mikoto whenever she makes a mistake – but she loves her charge a great deal, and wants only the best for her. [From Steam]

full_description: Mikoto is a foxgirl who lives deep in the woods, in a settlement full of foxgirls called Yamatai. Mikoto’s mother, Himiko, is the leader of these foxgirls, and she commends immense magical powers. As the daughter of an illustrious woman, Mikoto is expected to train hard, and one day take her mother’s place – but there’s a catch. Mikoto is a complete failure of a foxgirl! Despite being twenty-five years of age, Mikoto only has one tail. She fumbles even the simplest of spells, and her hand-to-hand combat skills are laughable. She routinely loses mock battles against her tutor, Ohana, and the other foxgirls in her clan shun and mock her owing to her ineptitude. Unsatisfied with her mundane life in Yamatai, Mikoto dreams of leaving home and speaking to the humans that live in the nearby Warren Village. Mikoto has heard humans are wicked and untrustworthy, but Mikoto is an optimist at heart,

title: Eti Nochi v Kaire
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Margaret Dawson is girl dreaming to become full-fledged archaeologist. Together with her father she departs to the excavations of mysterious tomb in Egypt, but there she faces some oddities. The director of the museum plainly hides something, the father's friend tries to force them leave the excavations, and Margaret realizes that something unusual is about to happen. Soon after the girl gets in deadly swing of things... Will she be able to deal with the threats she and the world are now facing, and while at it to date with one of the guys? Or, maybe Margaret will choose to take the villain's side? [From Steam]

title: Sakura MMO 3
description: Sakura MMO #3 is the final part of the Sakura MMO series, which concludes Viola’s adventure. Only a few months ago, Viola was an average woman bored with her life in Japan. Her only method of escape was via the vibrant and colorful MMORPG, Asaph Online. Though Viola poured thousands of hours into Asaph Online, she knew it was little more than a game, and it could never be a suitable substitute for reality. That is, until she found herself transported into the real Asaph! In Asaph, Viola recruits a party of cute girls and decides to fulfil her biggest dream: having a harem! Light-hearted hijinks ensue… but trouble is brewing on the horizon that could spell the end of these peaceful days. The fallen goddess, Iona, has been plotting to bring about an end to Asaph for good – and now Viola must go on a journey across the ocean, alongside her crew, to defeat her. Will Viola emerge triumphant f

characters.name: Viola
characters.description: Viola is the name Kotone gave to her character in Asaph Online. Upon awakening in Asaph, Kotone inherits Viola’s appearance, her magical powers, and her name. Viola is a dark witch with unimaginable powers, who is feared by everybody in Asaph. Many have tried to challenge her, but none have emerged victorious. She enjoys grinding people down beneath her heel (sometimes literally), and treats those around her as little more than playthings. She’s a deeply sadistic, dangerous woman… but even she has a soft side.

characters.name: Neve
characters.description: Neve is Viola’s trusted most trusted maid, who would do anything to help her mistress. Neve is a member of the darkling race, which is reviled throughout Asaph as being savage and hostile, but Neve eschews these unfair perceptions. She is a diligent, loyal, industrious girl – but she may be a touch too devoted. She adores Viola, and becomes irrationally angry at any perceived slights against her beloved mistress. Self-sacrificing and hard-working though she is, Neve can be rather scary when she wants. If she were to fight seriously, she may even be able to defeat demons.

characters.name: Fion
characters.description: Fion is a young, put-upon lass from a huge family, who works hard to ensure all her brothers and sisters have enough food to eat. At least, that’s what she says, but Neve isn’t entirely convinced. Fion might look like a sweet, innocent thing, looks can be deceiving, and she’s far craftier than she initially appears.

characters.name: Eleri
characters.description: Eleri is a noble knight who believes deeply in playing fair, and will never try to take advantage of her opponents – often to her own detriment. Though Eleri seems cool and competent, she gets flustered quite easily, and reacts poorly to being teased. She’s quite fun to bully, really – and Viola often derives pleasure from her embarrassed reactions. Though Neve and Fion believe Eleri to be a resident of Asaph, much like them, she actually comes from Japan, much like Viola. Eleri was brought to Asaph in the same way Viola was, and now the pair of them are working together to see if they can return home. [From Steam]

characters.name: Gardenia
characters.description: A witch with more knowledge than a library could hold. A mysterious, yet easy quest leads Viola's party to her shack where Gardenia confronts the girls with a surprise: she knows about Japan and who summoned the girls into their favorite game. [from official twitter page]

title_original: 明日終わる世界、その前夜
description: A very short story about two sisters and their final meeting, the night before the end of the world.
full_description: A very short story about two sisters and their final meeting, the night before the end of the world.

title: The Rose of Segunda
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: In the kingdom of Segunda, the Crown Prince’s birthday celebrations are traditionally where he is expected to choose a bride. Your mother, the Duchess of Florentia, is very keen for her only daughter to become the next queen, so she sends you and your mischievous brother, Frederique, along with your family’s steward, Bastien, to the fortnight long celebrations. Of course, just because your mother has her gaze fixed upon the Prince, does not mean you must follow suit. Will you act like the perfect lady and convince the King to select you as the Prince's betrothed, or show your true colours and perhaps catch another's eye? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Iolanthe di Parisi
characters.description: “Every rose has its thorns.” A girl who, though she might be able to demonstrate every aspect of being the ideal princess, could have other ideas. Choices at the beginning of the game will determine her personality, from loudmouth tomboy to cunning saboteur, and these will in turn influence the choices you can make in-game. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Frederique di Parisi
characters.description: “I am your man to the last, sister.” Your brother and best friend. He’s a bit lazy and a troublemaker, but he is loyal and will help in any way he can – whether he agrees or not. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Bastien Aubert
characters.description: “Even I must be bound by bonds of duty and reason.” The shy, soft-hearted son of your mother’s loyal Steward, Bastien is eager to prove himself to his father, your household and most of all himself. He will do anything he can to help you win, though he will probably be nervous about a lot of it. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Francesca D’Allegri
characters.description: “You only brought a dozen dress? My, it is almost as if you are poor!” The eldest daughter of one of the lesser noble houses, Francesca makes up for her lack of title with an excess of cunning. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Albertine Parsouffe
characters.description: “Do you play? I am versed in the viola, piano and flute - though I do not like to boast.” An excellent musician and hostess, Albertine is well aware of her accomplishments, though this self-assuredness could be her downfall. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Charlotte De Souza
characters.description: “Like a competition? But I thought this would be friendly…” A rival in name only, Charlotte is beautiful, sweet-natured, but sadly, a little too dim to stand a chance against the other ladies. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Sofia Venitti
characters.description: “I preferred books to people. Or so I thought…” The eldest daughter of a wealthy merchant family who has managed to curry enough favour to secure an invite, Sofia seems little more than a charming ingénue. Does anything more lie beneath the surface? [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Leopold Stavizzi
characters.description: “You are not like the other ladies here… It is a welcome change.” Cool, calm and collected, Duke Leopold is one of the few young men in attendance. He seems to have his own reasons for attending the celebrations outside of the usual entertainments, though what they are is anyone’s guess. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Guillaume Vilquine
characters.description: “They do not wish to marry me – they wish to marry The Prince.” The young man all eyes will be on, Guillaume is intelligent, charming and well-liked, and he is searching for the perfect princess - or so his father says. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

title: hopeless junction
tags: Group Sex Involving Gender Non-conforming Individuals
description: The story follows a bunch of tgirls on a week-long journey on the world famous transcontinental train, 'The Starline Junction Express'. During these seven days on board, when meeting a girl with a mysterious air to her, Kalinda takes the opportunity to try and be bold for the first time in her life. When the mysterious girl, Zarina, ends up being a mean sadist, what ensures is drunken bullying and sexual chaos that even pulls in Kalinda's closest friend and sister, Chandra, into this confusing whirlpool of conflicting emotions. Weird gay sex, utter confusion, heart wrenching panic and life altering trauma. Please enjoy it. [From Steam]

title: Tsumugi no Hanayome
description: Aoi and Yamabuki are childhood friends. Aoi is the quiet introverted one, while Yamabuki is the loud extroverted one. One night Yamabuki takes Aoi out to a shrine where Aoi gets possessed by a haunted relic spirit that causes the possessed to grow a penis. Together Yamabuki and Aoi go from childhood friends to lovers as they overcome adversity and find true love with one another.

description: Witches and magicians have always been fighting each other since the beginning of time. It’s not because one is bad or good, but because their powers keeps the world in balance. So, in a time continuum separated from the world, they continue their long battle. Note that you can choose to be a male or female protagonist. [From Hau~ Omochikaeri!]

title: Summer's Clover
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: The non-canon scenario of Miura Miki starting shortly before she meets the new transfer student Nakai Hisao. Miki is a strong-willed high school student with a troubled past that is still adjusting to life without her left hand. The meeting of a transfer student provides an opportunity for a fresh start unburdened by her past. This outside perspective prompts Miki to reevaluate of her current approach to life and what the future will bring.

characters.name: Miura Miki
characters.description: Miki is an aggressive girl that approaches problems and social interactions head-on. She lives life moment-to-moment after losing direction in her life following the loss of her hand and enrollment in a school for disabled students.

characters.name: Suzu Suzuki
characters.description: Suzu is a shy girl that has narcolepsy and experiences cataplexy as a result. Suzu has few friends and spends much of her time reading.

characters.name: Nakai Hisao
characters.description: Hisao is a recent transfer student that has cardiac arrhythmia. He is reserved and has trouble adjusting to a new life as a disabled student.

characters.name: Hakamichi Shizune
characters.description: Shizune is the mute student council president. She takes her position very seriously and will fight against any perceived unfairness.

characters.name: Haruhiko
characters.description: Haru is a cheerful member of the track club that is passionate about baking.

characters.name: Hasegawa Yukio
characters.description: Yukio is a member of track club that is popular with women. Yukio is confident and opinionated, which often leads to aggressive confrontations with Miki when they have disagreements.

characters.name: Suzuki Tsubasa
characters.description: Tsubasa is Suzu's older sister. Tsubasa is attending university for a degree in mechanical engineering.

characters.name: Miura Jun'ichi
characters.description: Jun'ichi is Miki's father. He is a hardworking farmer with an easy-going personality.

characters.name: Mutou Akio
characters.description: The homeroom and science teacher of Miki's class.

characters.name: Mrs. Suzuki
characters.description: Suzu's mother who is serious and holds conservative values. She works long hours and has a dominant personality.

characters.name: Mr. Suzuki
characters.description: Suzu's father is a quiet and serious man who works as a bureaucrat.

characters.name: Shirakawa Yuuko
characters.description: Yuuko is the school librarian and part-time waitress at a local cafe.

characters.name: Setou Kenji
characters.description: Kenji is Hisao's next-door neighbor in the dorms.

characters.name: Yamada Junko
characters.description: A mute first year student who is a friend of Yukio.

title: Love is Strange
description: A fan visual novel based off the January 2015 game by Dontnod Entertainment, Life Is Strange. The visual novel follows the story of Max Caulfield in her second year at Blackwell Academy. She’s spent the last year reuniting with her best friend, Chloe Price, and meeting and getting to know the other students of Blackwell, like Kate Marsh, Rachel Amber, and Victoria Chase. Love is Strange is set in a normal alternate universe, and Max does not possess any time powers whatsoever (and Rachel Amber is very much alive). There’s also no secret conspiracies and hidden bunkers; this AU is completely normal and peaceful, and through your choices, a happy one. The game hopes to capture a sense of growing adolescence and love, built by bonds through time and moments of compassion. [Edited from official website]
