title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Shadows of New York
tags: Modern Day United States of America
description: You’re a nobody. An outcast in your own vampiric sect. A political prisoner of no particular value. An immigrant who never found her roots in a city of immigrants. A chainsmoker whose favorite pastime is staring blankly at the streets through the windows of a fast food joint at 4AM. The sinking feeling in the pit of your stomach tells you that you’re doomed, and distorted voices from the shadows seem to agree. The curse of your clan makes interacting with everyday technology difficult. Dissociation is your natural state. But when New York’s Anarch leader meets a gruesome end, out of all the bloodsuckers in the metropolis, you’re the one picked to investigate. Make no mistake: this is obviously a trap, yet another move in the horrible game of Jyhad, the eternal struggle for power between warring vampire generations. But you’re Lasombra, and if there’s one thing you know, it’s this: if the

characters.name: Julia Sowinski
characters.description: One day Julia's perspective on the world is changed, when she's [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Embrace_(VTM)]Embraced into the fatalistic [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Lasombra]Lasombra. She is thrust into this new world, cut off from her mortal life in more ways than one. She is denied any reliance on technology that could help her cope, and finds that she has to remain an outsider in death as she was in life. An immigrant from Poland, she already found adapting to life in NYC difficult prior to her Embrace and that was before she lost her job, realized she had almost no friends to rely on, and was made part of a society that would ultimately look down on her through no fault of her own. Now a Lasombra member of the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla, her official role - being an immigration officer of sorts - carries little recognition or

characters.name: Hellene Panhard
characters.description: Hellene Panhard is the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Childe]childe of [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Michaela]Michaela, the previous Camarilla Prince of New York City. Her sire met [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Final_Death]final death at the hands of the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Sabbat]Sabbat. Out of all the potential candidates, it is she who managed to secure her claim to Princedom after the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Ivory Tower spread and secured their domain. Her previous status as a court mainstay allowed her to pull many strings and call in many favors, but it was one secretive ally who tipped the scales in her favor... [Edited from the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook]

characters.name: Qadir al-Asmai
characters.description: Qadir's loyalty to the sect is the sole reason why he took on the role of [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Sheriff_(VTM)]Sheriff at the behest of [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Calebros]Calebros, the leader of the local [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla during the Battle of New York. He hoped for another to take over his post after a new [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Prince_(VTM)]Prince was established, but [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Hellene_Panhard]Panhard decided to keep him - and his sense of honor made him remain, though he feels his [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Humanity_(VTM)]humanity slowly dissipating every night. He believes himself on the path to damnation, and has taken a defeatist view of his prospects. Although there is a more altruistic part of him that shines through occasionally, his increasing cru

characters.name: Hope
characters.description: Most vampires fall out of touch with modern trends not long after their [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Embrace_(VTM)]Embrace, but Hope's trajectory was the exact opposite - instead of shying away from technology, she doubled down on her mortal practices. The [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla might be critical of Kindred using the internet after several high-profile Second Inquisition interventions, but if you ask Hope, those events stemmed from insufficient mastery of the digital. Hiding behind dozens of online handles, some of which have become ingrained in her psyche, this [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Malkavian_(VTM)]Malkavian feels secure in her nightly escapades into the Web for profit... and fun. [Edited from the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook]

characters.name: Gianni D'Angelo
characters.description: D 'Angelo fancies himself an undead detective. With a knack for gathering information and getting into places he's not supposed to be, and a habit of verbally narrating his own actions, he's the spitting image of a neo-noir private eye. He has a few ties to the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla structures - chief among them an occasional ally in [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Qadir_al-Asmai]Qadir Al-Asmai - but most often, he works alone. One reason is that he does not shy away from cases presented to him by the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Anarch]Anarchs, or the much maligned thin-bloods. Like the detectives that he models himself on, D'Angelo might seem crude or cynical, but he's more empathetic than he lets on. [Edited from the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook]

characters.name: Valerie Duval
characters.description: Another connection D'Angelo has to the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla, and one that's more than a little surprising, is the current [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Scourge_(VTM)]Scourge, Valerie. The two share some history, and each will often leverage this against the other. [From the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook]

characters.name: Thomas Arturo
characters.description: A designer whose skill and talents have been preserved by [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Charlotte_Hansard]his sire, and who has since found himself to be quite an influential figure in the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla court. He does not hold an official title, but having a [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Haven_(VTM)]haven planned out by this undead celebrity is a mark of status, and one that was paid with far more than exorbitant sums of money in the past. [Edited from the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook]

characters.name: Mia Sorrento
characters.description: Mia is [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Torque]Torque's right hand. Another member of the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Anarch]Anarchs who previously led her unlife in the shadow of Boss [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Douglas_Callihan]Callihan, and was trying to maintain a level of independence from the old [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Baron_(VTM)]Baron. Naturally, this made her gravitate more and more toward Torque, thus beginning their long-term cooperation. Mia sees in Torque everything an Anarch Baron should be, and she's eager to recruit new [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Kindred_(VTM)]Kindred to their cause. However, she's painfully aware that spies - both Callihan's and the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla's - may be waiting for an opportune moment to uproot all of what the two Anarchs have spent so many year

characters.name: Douglas Callihan
characters.description: Even by the standards of immortal beings hopelessly stuck in their ways, Douglas Callihan is behind the times. His style of leadership and outlook on the modern world both obviously belong in the 19th century, when the Anarch [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Baron_(VTM)]Baron of NYC was [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Embrace_(VTM)]Embraced. It took the NYC [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Anarch]Anarchs many decades, but the 21st century seems to be the time when their discontent with the current (supposed) torchbearer of their cause is finally boiling over. Callihan himself is no fool, either - ever concerned about his own continued survival, he realizes that his grasp on the local sect members has grown unstable. A firm grasp will have to become a stranglehold if the old Boss is to maintain his position in the city. [Edited from the [Url=https://store.steampowered.c

characters.name: Torque
characters.description: Torque, the unofficial "[Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Baron_(VTM)]Baron of the Bronx" is a World War 2 veteran who was [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Embrace_(VTM)]Embraced into the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Brujah]Brujah clan shortly after coming home from Europe. He rooted himself in the local [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Anarch]Anarch community, slowly becoming a trusted ally of many of his [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Kindred_(VTM)]Kindred compatriots - but always remaining in Boss Callihan's shadow. Torque was patient, knowing that any action he took against the Baron of New York City would surely create an uphill struggle. The events of Operation Lights Out, and the loss of his [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Childe]childe to what seemed, at best, Callihan's cowardice (and at worst an overt betrayal), embittered him - but als

characters.name: Kaiser
characters.description: Kaiser is New York City's eminence grise, the kind of [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Kindred_(VTM)]Kindred you want to avoid, but can't. Sooner or later, you'll need some obscure detail or piece of clandestine info, and it's this [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Nosferatu_(VTM)]Nosferatu you'll have to contact. He doesn't play sides, but he never shares anything for free. Over the years, he became embedded in the city's population, foiling any attempts to oust him by either Prince Panhard or Baron Callihan. He travels around the city in a limo that serves as his mobile fortress, in addition to allegedly keeping multiple [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Haven_(VTM)]havens at inconspicuous locations around New York City. [Edited from the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook]

characters.name: Dakota
characters.description: Julia's mortal friend, stylist, and confidante. Dakota comes from a wealthy household and thinks of herself as artistically driven, despite recently mostly sticking to monotonous contracted work. She thinks of herself as the Sun to Julia's Moon, which carries over to her appearance and the "opposites attract" vibe of their relationship. She's also an optimist who carries herself with a natural, free-spirited magnetism and self-assured confidence a counterpoint to Julia's constant pessimism. While such close contacts with [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Kine]kine are frowned upon by the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla, Julia's and Dakota's relationship is tolerated, if not encouraged. After all, it can be used as grounds for coercion [Based on the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1405990/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Shadows_of_New_York_Artbook]Art

characters.name: Adelaide Davis
characters.description: A mysterious, long-lived vampire[Spoiler], who used to be a serial killer since she was a child. She still continues her killing sprees, but now at the behest of Thomas Arturo.

characters.name: Tamika
characters.description: It's t's not easy being a [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Gangrel_(VTM)]Gangrel in the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla. Ever since the clan unofficially quit the sect at the turn of the century, its members had to choose their loyalties carefully. For Tamika, a restless soul born on the West Coast but [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Embrace_(VTM)]Embraced on the East, a grace period was ensured by her lineage - she is the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Childe]childe of [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Jezebelle]Jezebelle, a noted member of the Clan of the Beast in New York City. This time is coming to an end, however. With her [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Sire]sire having moved on from the city some years ago, Tamika will now have to decide her own path. On the one hand, the Ivory Tower offers nominal safety at the co

characters.name: Katherine Wiese
characters.description: The Keeper of [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Elysium_(VTM)]Elysium at the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Art_Hole]Art Hole has been an important persona in NYC since at least the early 2000s. Wiese is a rather mysterious figure who rarely appears among other [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Kindred_(VTM)]Kindred, but when she does, it's usually for a memorable occasion. She covers the lower part of her face due to some kind of accident from before her [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Embrace_(VTM)]Embrace, and she typically finds any questions on this topic to be tasteless. These nights, her custody of the Elysium is mostly in name only, but her status as a well connected and relatively well liked socialite helps maintain her position. [From the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1405990/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Shadows_of_New_York_Artbook]Artbook]

characters.name: Addison Payne
characters.description: One of the key [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla figures in NYC. In life, he was a ruthlessly brilliant political and economic theorist, a free market ideologue. Towards the end he became driven by the fear of death, prolonging his life using every possible medical procedure and using all measures at his disposal to find the key to immortality. Unlike many who tried, he actually succeeded. A powerful [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Ventrue_(VTM)]Ventrue representative found him on his deathbed, his body broken down in nearly every way, but decided his mind was worth preserving. Of course, his immense wealth, privilege, contacts, and access didn't hurt — he remains one of the most valuable assets Panhard has on Wall Street. Eternally tying Addison to his broken-down state was just an added twist of cruelty, a reminder for Payne about how close he was

characters.name: Aisling Sturbridge
characters.description: Aisling Sturbridge is the High [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Regent_(Tremere)]Regent of the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Chantry_of_the_Five_Boroughs]Chantry of the Five Boroughs, which makes her, in theory, the most influential [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Tremere_(VTM)]Tremere in New York City. [Spoiler]Her prior focus on research and furthering the Pyramid's plans is losing ground to politics, and her position could become less and less stable with time. She is compromising not just her personal interests, but also, occasionally, a bit of dignity, which is briefly put into focus during the Celebrations of Power. [Edited from the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1405990/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Shadows_of_New_York_Artbook]Artbook]

characters.name: Agathon
characters.description: Agathon's parents were murdered in what the police called a random act of violence, but he saw it as a sign of something more nefarious. Pushing his only surviving relative, his grandmother Silvia for information, as well as his own research led him to uncover part of the truth. The rest would be revealed after the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Tremere_(VTM)]Tremere [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Regent_(Tremere)]High Regent of New York City, Aisling Sturbridge took him in as her retainer, and then eventually [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Embrace_(VTM)]Embraced him into the clan. Agathon's passion for knowledge and introverted nature make him the perfect scholar, and a valuable asset to the Warlocks. [Based on the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook]

characters.name: Carter Vanderweyden
characters.description: The most powerful [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Malkavian_(VTM)]Malkavian in the city, he holds the position of his Clan's [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Primogen_(VTM)]Primogen and is biding his time for the opportunity to finally become [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Prince_(VTM)]Prince. The Vanderweydens were one of the original Dutch merchant families to settle in the New York region - it is this legacy that makes Carter believe princedom is his birthright. He thinks of himself as a modern-day Kennedy. Masquerading as a lawyer in a well-established family practice, and flourishing with a series of high-profile cases, he is intricately familiar with the workings of New York City elites, human and vampire alike. [From the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1405990/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Shadows_of_New_York_Artbook]Artbook]

characters.name: Samira
characters.description: As the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Banu_Haqim]Banu Haqim representative, Samira is sure to have some interesting things to say about the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Lasombra]Lasombra clan joining the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla. She sees a bit of a potential kindred spirit in Julia, perhaps an ally at some point... if only the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Neonate]neonate would show some actual interest in politics instead of seemingly wasting her time. Samira is in close contact with Hellene Panhard. There is no friendship between the two, but she enjoys having the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Prince_(VTM)]Prince's ear, and is worried that weak leadership might disrupt the local Camarilla - it's not like there's an obvious candidate for Princedom other than some [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Primogen_

plot_tags: Modern Day United States of America
full_description: You’re a nobody. An outcast in your own vampiric sect. A political prisoner of no particular value. An immigrant who never found her roots in a city of immigrants. A chainsmoker whose favorite pastime is staring blankly at the streets through the windows of a fast food joint at 4AM. The sinking feeling in the pit of your stomach tells you that you’re doomed, and distorted voices from the shadows seem to agree. The curse of your clan makes interacting with everyday technology difficult. Dissociation is your natural state. But when New York’s Anarch leader meets a gruesome end, out of all the bloodsuckers in the metropolis, you’re the one picked to investigate. Make no mistake: this is obviously a trap, yet another move in the horrible game of Jyhad, the eternal struggle for power between warring vampire generations. But you’re Lasombra, and if there’s one thing you know, it’s this: if the

title: DesperaDrops
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: In the summer of 2028, Mika Amamine, studying abroad at a university in Bologna, Italy, visits Rome for a short trip with friends to celebrate the end of exams. However, during that trip, she encounters a murder incident and is subsequently arrested as a suspect. While being transported in a police vehicle, it suddenly overturns in an accident, freeing Mika along with six other criminals and they all become fugitives. Mysterious attackers appear, targeting the unique “power” that Mika possesses, and the group finds themselves pursued by both the police and the attackers. The secret hidden within Mika’s power, the identity of the attackers, and the truth behind the murder incident that started it all… Can they unravel these mysteries and reclaim a normal life? [From Aksys]

characters.name: Amamine Mika
characters.description: She's a Japanese student studying abroad at an Italian university. She gets involved in a murder incident in Rome, is framed as the murderer, and arrested. A good person at heart who doesn’t forgive bad deeds, she is reluctant to live on the run as a fugitive. Having the power to read people's strong emotions and memories when she touches them with her hands from birth, she always wears gloves to avoid reading people's hearts inadvertently. Hometown: Yokohama [Japan]

characters.name: Ash Meyer
characters.description: A young man who abandoned his hometown and is always on the move from place to place. He prefers to be alone and does his best to avoid speaking to others—a quiet lone wolf. Due to his surly appearance, he's constantly getting involved in fights, leading a life of never-ending violence. He likes to drive vehicles and has a particularly strong attachment to motorcycles. He has amazing driving technique, but with how wild his driving is, it's a miracle he hasn’t been in an accident. Hometown: Baden [Switzerland]

characters.name: Hamiel Luís
characters.description: A con man with the air of a playboy. Although he's good with people and excels at manipulating their minds with his eloquent words, his sarcasm and sharp tongue often bleed into his speech. Due to his strong self-assertion, he often gets himself into trouble with other people. He also excels at disguising himself and cheating when gambling. Hometown: Blanes [Spain]

characters.name: Gib Baltzer
characters.description: A former police officer who is on the run as a suspect in the murder of a colleague. As a member of the special forces during his time as a police officer, he was a sniper who excelled at handling firearms. Always calm and collected, he fills the role of leader in the group. He can make decisions from an objective point of view, but due to his serious personality, he often can't relate to younger people. He was married once but is now a widower. Hometown: Rothenburg ob der Tauber [Germany]

characters.name: Ramie Carrière
characters.description: The self-proclaimed “Ramie, the Great Phantom Thief of the Century.” He is a thief who mainly targets the wealthy. He excels at both picking pockets and picking locks with his dexterous fingers. He also makes great use of his acrobatic skills, using his cat-like agility to scale walls. He’s friendly and always looks to brighten the mood, but he hates being touched by others. Hometown: Annecy [France]

characters.name: Camu Einhard
characters.original: カミュ・アインハルト
characters.description: Calling himself "The Earth Warrior of Love," he is a revolutionary who fights for the preservation of the environment. An engineering student who loves Japanese comics, he has a strong interest in Japanese culture and anime. In addition to always being immersed in his own world, his social anxiety prevents him from having friends his age. He is pure of heart and generally dislikes arguments. Hometown: Hallstatt [Austria]

characters.name: Sally Del Testa
characters.original: サリィ・デル・テスタ
characters.description: A genius hacker who loves Japan's Harajuku fashion. Gaining illegal access to information through the internet, she has committed numerous cyber crimes. However, having no sense of the wrongness of her actions, she dislikes being called a cracker. Because of an incident in her past, she avoids elevators. Hometown: Chiusa [Italy]

characters.name: Carlos Léon
characters.description: The reportage writer who appears wherever the main characters go. Working as a freelancer, he writes for a third-rate magazine. He acts unnaturally for a journalist who helps and tests the main characters, all while saying it's to get the scoop. He’s a mysterious person who's tough to pin down as either an enemy or an ally. Hometown: Spain

characters.name: Rebecca Rosso
characters.description: A news reporter for a news channel called Canale Zero, which is broadcast throughout Europe. Along with her cameraman, Luca, she travels across Europe, focusing on investigating and reporting stories. She doubts the police statements surrounding the incident the main characters are involved in. To uncover the truth, she decides to get closer to the main characters and hear their stories in the name of investigation. Hometown: Italy

characters.name: Luca Salvadori
characters.original: ルカ・サルヴァドーリ
characters.description: A TV cameraman for a news channel called Canale Zero. Since he recently became Rebecca’s assistant, he’s the unlucky young man who'd to jump headfirst into the world of journalistic investigation. Since he has a timid and less assertive personality, he can't stand up to Rebecca. Hometown: Italy

characters.name: Antonino Dolce
characters.original: アントニーノ・ドルチェ
characters.description: A veteran investigator for Europol, an organization that provides assistance between EU agencies. Confident and prideful in his investigative skills that rely on footwork and intuition, cultivated during his time with the Italian police force, he relentlessly pursues the main characters to corner them. His subordinate, Noel, refers to him as "Police Inspector," his role in his previous workplace. Hometown: Italy

characters.name: Alphonse Noël
characters.original: アルフォンス・ノエル
characters.description: A young investigator for Europol, an organization that provides assistance between EU agencies. He’s an intelligence expert who excels at hacking, data restoration, and gathering intel. He often butts heads with Dolce on investigation methods, but they share a strong, trusting bond with each other. He has a strong sense of justice and sometimes displays a passionate side of himself that can't be called rational. Hometown: France

characters.name: Aida Falcone
characters.original: アイーダ・ファルコーネ
characters.description: The protagonist's best friend from college. She's cheerful and lively, with a bright personality that can make anyone feel better just by being around her. She came to Rome with the protagonist to celebrate the end of their college exams, but she was called over by a relative who lives in Rome, and ends up doing her own thing. Hometown: Italy

characters.name: Edward Heartfield
characters.original: エドワード・ハートフィールド
characters.description: The unidentifiable old gentleman who is killed in front of the protagonist. Losing all memories of his past and where he's from, he contacts the protagonist, who can look into the memories of people, in order to help him regain his memories. However, he is murdered by someone. Hometown: Unknown

characters.name: Chancellor
characters.description: The second-in-command of the mysterious secret society known as C.R.O.W.N. that's pursuing the protagonist. He normally resides in the old castle that serves as the base of operations and almost never appears outside. He does whatever it takes to accomplish his mission and views everything as a tool to achieve his goals. Hometown: Liechtenstein

characters.name: Child Nurse
characters.original: 子守《チャイルド・ナース》
characters.description: One of the pursuers from C.R.O.W.N., a secret society that's chasing after the main characters. Her main role is that of an assassin, but she doesn’t like blending with the crowds, so she dyes her hair and wears clothes in a unique way. She uses box cutters as her weapon of choice and enjoys taking her time with her targets, tormenting them as she slowly kills them. Hometown: France

characters.name: House Steward
characters.original: 家令《ハウス・スチュワード》
characters.description: One of the pursuers from C.R.O.W.N., a secret society that’s chasing after the main characters. He also serves the Chancellor as his butler. An elderly gentleman who takes politeness very seriously, but he's a professional assassin who eliminates his targets with respect. Hometown: England

characters.name: Concertmaster
characters.original: 指揮官《コンサート・マスター》
characters.description: A member of the secret society known as C.R.O.W.N. that's chasing after the main characters. They’re the cracker in charge of manipulating information. Using the top floor of a high-end hotel as their hideout, they never leave their room and manipulate information from there. They believe the world’s information is their plaything. They’re selfish and a sore loser. Hometown: Germany

characters.name: Christel
characters.description: The protagonist meets this mysterious girl when she is abducted and held captive in an old castle by the secret society C.R.O.W.N. Because of an accident in her past, she can't utter a single word. Hometown: Liechtenstein

characters.name: Enforcer
characters.original: 執行人《エンフォーサー》
characters.description: The ultimate weapon for the secret society known as C.R.O.W.N. that's chasing after the main characters. As a result of being shot in the head, he lost his sense of pain. Due to this, he isn't afraid of getting injured and is unrivaled in hand-to-hand combat. Because of a previous near-death experience, he commits murders with "love" to save his victims. Hometown: France

However, during that trip, she encounters a murder incident and is subsequently arrested as a suspect. The secret hidden within Mika’s power, the identity of the attackers, and the truth behind the murder incident that started it all… Can they unravel these mysteries and reclaim a normal life? [From Aksys]

title: The end of an obsession
description: You feel groggy when you finally wake up. The back of your head is throbbing and your mouth feels dry, as though it has been stuffed full of wool. With bleary eyes, you glance about. What time is it? Where are you… And, perhaps more importantly, who are you? Try though you might, you can’t remember. This could very well be your end — but wait. Who is that woman standing by your bedside, who looks like a rose? Perhaps she can help you. Now, why don’t you open your heart up to her? Learn how to love her, and perhaps this story might even have a happy ending. [From itch.io]

Learn how to love her, and perhaps this story might even have a happy ending. [From itch.io]

title: Sweet Volley High
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Sweet Volley High is the story of Aya Mizuki in her senior year at high school, as she pursues a dream of becoming a professional volleyball player. Will she find romance and success, or rejection and heartbreak? Your choices will affect the outcome in one of 5 endings.

characters.name: Aya Mizuki
characters.description: Aya Mizuki is a quiet, but lazy girl. She's not very social, and tends to spend most of her time with her nose in a book. She spends some of her evenings warming the bench for the school's volleyball team, as having club activities always looks good on a college resume. After a tragic accident injures one of the team's star players, Aya is called upon to step in, and with her Grandpa's help, finds a passion for volleyball that extends past her senior year in high school as she pursues a career.

characters.name: Yuichi Hiyama
characters.description: Yuichi Hiyama is the star of the school's soccer team and is tipped for great things in the future. Yuichi and Aya become fast friends over their shared love of beef bowls. However as tryout season approaches, Yuichi comes to Aya with an offer she may not be able to pass up...

characters.name: Nanami Ebihara
characters.description: Nanami Ebihara is the volleyball team captain, and hates the fact that Aya isn't taking things seriously. Quiet, shy and unassuming, Nanami is far from a typical high school sports star, instead she dedicates her life to her craft.

characters.name: Yuka Saito
characters.description: Yuka Saito is one of the most popular girls in school, pretty and with a sharp sense of humour she's the life of the party, so to speak. She flirts with and befriends Aya, introducing her to the local bar scene.

characters.name: Eri Toyama
characters.description: Eri Toyama is one of Nanami's oldest friends, and joins the volleyball team after meeting Aya. She looks up to Aya as a big sister, and though she has a lot of problems in her home life, she's always optimistic, cheery and cute.

characters.name: Ryoko
characters.description: Aya's mother.

characters.name: Satoshi
characters.description: Aya's grandpa Satoshi lives in the countryside and takes care of Aya in the summer. Satoshi had an oddball sense of humour, an equally oddball laugh and loves his family very much. Maybe it's all the tea he drinks. What Aya doesn't know is that he was once an athlete too. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Chiaki Nozawa
characters.description: The principal of Kumaji Gakuen.

characters.name: Yumiko
characters.description: A bartender at Grunge Soul.

characters.name: Coach Makino
characters.description: The coach of the Tokyo Red Wings professional volleyball team.

characters.name: Daisuke Chiba
characters.description: The star player of the Tokyo FC soccer team.

plot_tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
full_description: Sweet Volley High is the story of Aya Mizuki in her senior year at high school, as she pursues a dream of becoming a professional volleyball player. Will she find romance and success, or rejection and heartbreak? Your choices will affect the outcome in one of 5 endings.

title: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Tenshi-tachi no Harukoi
title_original: その花びらにくちづけを 天使たちの春恋
description: Yuuno had just been admitted to nursing school and was filled with a desire to watch over her classmate and roommate, Satsuki. Satsuki was a brilliant girl who was admitted to nursing school with top marks; however, she wasn’t very aware of her surroundings, and her ability to get by on her own was extremely poor… She was kind of eccentric. From that time on, Yuuno spent her days feeling fulfilled in the role of an accomplished older girl taking care of an inept younger sister… “I feel like we’ve become more than friends. No, I’d go as far as to say I love you.” How will Yuuno react to Satsuki’s sudden confession…? [Translated from Getchu and Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Aihara Ringo
characters.description: An energetic, aspiring young girl. A first-year student in nursing school and graduate of St. Michael’s. A hardworker who always maintains excellent grades. She’s family friends with Chiaki, who is a nurse and teacher, and has admired her since they were little. Taking her acceptance to nursing school as an opportunity to become independent from her parents, she’s begun living with Chiaki in her apartment. [Translated from Gyutto and Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Takao Chiaki
characters.description: A picture perfect nurse. …But she’s actually pretty spoiled. She’s both a nurse in the gastrointestinal surgery ward at Saint Michael’s General Hospital as well as a nursing instructor. With Ringo being accepted to nursing school, Chiaki offers to take her under her wing, and the two begin living together in her apartment. Ordinarily she’s a flawless model of a woman, but at home, she has surprisingly little concern for herself; in some ways, she’s a bit of a wreck. [Translated from Gyutto and Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Katakura Yuuno
characters.description: An extreeemely pushy and overprotective girl who is in her first year of nursing school. Satsuki’s classmate and dormmate. Has a soft, feminine disposition. Fairly protective, she always speaks formally, with a deference to others. Her overbearing disposition stems from her “What would you do without me?” attitude toward the frequently troubled Satsuki. [Translated from Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Ishigami Satsuki
characters.description: A brilliant, but frank and aloof girl with boyish tendencies. What you would call an aloof mystery. Up front and self-assured. She always speaks in a masculine way. Although she’s never had much interest in eating, Yuuno has been using her home cooking to draw her out more, so that she’ll be straightforward with her expressions of affection, regardless of their surroundings. [Translated from Yurin Yurin]

title: Tales of Aravorn: Seasons Of The Wolf
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Welcome back to Aravorn! In this role-playing game, set in the same fantasy world as the award-winning Loren the Amazon princess, you'll play as Shea or Althea, twins from the far-away village Ninim. In just the course of one year, you will experience many storylines and sidequests; situations and events where your own choices influence the very end of the game. The twins' tale starts on a day like many others, when one of the siblings finds a young wolf and decides to take it with him/her. Thus begins the long journey which will take the siblings from the ice-shrouded Ninim to the desert-wrapped city of Dingirra to the storm-shrouded port of Shacklesplit. Explore the-corruption riddled halls of Dingirra, and contest with the crimelords who claim it as their own domain. Sail the high seas, battle mighty pirates, and discover their hidden treasures!

characters.name: Amukiki
characters.description: The Champion of the Arena, Amukiki is the most renowned gladiator of Grimoire. He will pledge his loyalty to Loren. Romanceable by Saren or Elenor.

characters.name: Jariel
characters.description: Elven bard. In elven culture, bards are not only entertainers but also keepers of lore and wisdom. In that respect, Jariel is a paragon: he is currently in the twenty-fourth year of his Century Journey, a hundred years of his life he exclusively devoted to the exploration of the world and the gathering of new knowledge. A seasoned traveler, Jariel is not only an important asset in any fight but has considerable social skills that often help him talk his way out of dangerous situations with diplomacy and intelligence. He often accompanies groups of adventurers he believes will experience interesting things on their travels. However, what is interesting to Jariel may prove deadly to his fellow travelers... [From Winter Wolves]

characters.name: Riley
characters.description: Human illusionist. Riley considers himself an entertainer, first and foremost. If he didn't have any magical talent, he would be juggling, or singing, or performing acrobatic feats at carnivals or in traveling shows. But he was born with considerable arcane skills, and to him, that meant he was destined to be the greatest illusionist the world had ever seen. He has a charming and witty nature and easily wins people over. However, he would gladly sell his own mother for fame, fortune and the riches that come with it. Riley's gotten into trouble because of that more often than he can count -- and for everybody who happens to be in the same room as him, that means trouble as well... [From Winter Wolves]

characters.name: Chalassa
characters.description: Bloodskin assassin. Most other species consider the bloodskins an offshoot of the human race, though there is not a single human who wouldn't loudly protest this allegation. Fact is, aside from their home region in the deserts and savannahs, nothing much is known about bloodskins, and Chalassa is no different. She is an enigma: highly skilled in the art of killing, though she doesn't seem to be proud of her talents and almost reluctant to use them. She definitely has some sort of dark past, thought it is anyone's guess what that may be and whether she has left it behind by now. Only one thing is for sure: you may not want Chalassa as your ally, but you certainly never want her as your enemy... [Edited from Winter Wolves]

characters.name: Krimm
characters.description: Human barbarian. From the Age of Fallen Kingdoms, a few barbarian tribes still wander the world, and Krimm is a member of one of the proudest, the Clan of the Stalking Sabertooth. She is a fierce and strong woman, in combat a challenge for even the greatest warriors -- but at the moment, she is nothing but a lone wolf, having lost her honor and thus fallen from grace with her clan. She would give anything were she able to redeem herself, though she knows that this may well be impossible, and that thought makes her heart heavy and her mood glum. Maybe she can find solace in rage, for it is rage that powers her prowess in battle -- and there may be much to be angry about in her future... [From Winter Wolves]

characters.name: Vaelis
characters.description: Snow elven mercenary. Having felt the call of adventure early in his life, Vaelis was one of the few snow elves ever to leave his home town. He was once friends with Althea's and Shea's father Morran, and the twins like him as they would a favorite uncle. However, his many years fighting for a great many causes have left him bitter and disappointed in the world, as nothing he ever fought for turned out to be worth it in the end. Even though he is hardly old for a snow elf, his years on the battlefield have left their marks on his body, and he now looks tired and exhausted. But don't underestimate him: that seemingly worn-out sword arm still packs quite a punch, and there is no weapon he isn't dangerous with. [From Winter Wolves]

characters.name: Rowinda
characters.description: Human warlock. Not many people know Rowinda well. Half of those who do claim she lost her mind to old age; the other half claim she was never sane to begin with. Whatever the truth may be, Rowinda is certainly a very strange person. She dresses much too flamboyantly for a person of her age, laughs too loud in public, apparently has no sense of common decency, but still somehow manages to live among other, more normal people. Some whisper that this is simply because everybody is afraid of her strange and terrifying magical powers which can supposedly sap the strength out of even the most powerful people, but no one has ever seen her cast a single spell. Or at least no one who lived to tell the tale... [Edited from Winter Wolves]

characters.name: Jul
characters.description: A succubus; servant of Fost.

characters.name: Daronas
characters.description: Guard captain. Always loyal to the Human Empire, he chose to be assigned in the cold, far north regions because of his past. A man of honor, he doesn't always approve of the Empire's methods, in particular towards the other races that populate Aravorn. [Edited from Winter Wolves]

characters.name: Leif
characters.description: He had his father's skill and speed but lacked the strength of Krimm who dishonored him by throwing him on his back when they wrestled.

characters.name: Laroneas
characters.description: Ninim's tanner, always willing to give the twins bad prices for their pelts.

characters.name: Yeldin
characters.description: Owner of the Arena in Dingirra.

plot_tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
full_description: Welcome back to Aravorn! In this role-playing game, set in the same fantasy world as the award-winning Loren the Amazon princess, you'll play as Shea or Althea, twins from the far-away village Ninim. In just the course of one year, you will experience many storylines and sidequests; situations and events where your own choices influence the very end of the game. The twins' tale starts on a day like many others, when one of the siblings finds a young wolf and decides to take it with him/her. Thus begins the long journey which will take the siblings from the ice-shrouded Ninim to the desert-wrapped city of Dingirra to the storm-shrouded port of Shacklesplit. Explore the-corruption riddled halls of Dingirra, and contest with the crimelords who claim it as their own domain. Sail the high seas, battle mighty pirates, and discover their hidden treasures!

title: A Wild Catgirl Appears!
description: A Wild Catgirl Appears follows the story of Ami, a loner at high school, as she joins the school's coding club and sets about making her first video game. They create Starla, an awesome catgirl ninja and create a figure to interact with their game. The figure doesn't quite work, but the next day Starla is quite real! [From itch.io] Created for the Yuri Game Jam.

description: When a young alchemist apprentice is unwillingly bound to an illegal spirit, they suddenly find themselves tied up in a war between humanity and magic, and must join a group of unlikely heroes to escape their own doom, hopefully saving the world along the way. [From Steam]

title_original: モテモテだったはずの俺がレズの母親にヒロイン全員寝取られてマゾ堕ちした話
description: Everyone was supposed to like me, but before I knew it, I was being cuckolded by my mother in this NTR story! Living in the same house as her, I was turned into a masochist in this depressing lesbian NTR story of despair! [From DLsite]

characters.name: Maibara Mitomo
characters.description: A girl who has a slight crush on the protagonist. She is a devoted childhood friend who has known the protagonist for a long time. Ayaka teaches her the pleasures of lesbian bonding, corrupting her both physically and emotionally. [From DLsite]

characters.name: Merazuka Rena
characters.description: The protagonist's childhood friend. She used to have a neat appearance but made her debut as a gyaru in a very flashy way. She is kind and playful. She is jealous by the relationship between the protagonist and Mitomo, however, she tries hard to bring them together... [From DLsite]

characters.name: Suzakuin Ayaka
characters.description: The mother of the protagonist. They were separated for a time due to his mother's infidelity, but she was assigned to the protagonist's school as a guest teacher. After the protagonist grew up, she turned her back on her family and became a career woman in the business world. Her real name is Sawamura, but she calls herself Suzakuin, her maiden name because it is more convenient. She is requested to be a special lecturer and is assigned to the protagonist's school. That was the beginning of all the tragedy...... [From DLsite]

characters.name: Komiyama Noe
characters.description: The protagonist's homeroom teacher, who is supposed to be getting married soon. She is kind to everyone and is very popular among students, especially among the boys. [From DLsite]

characters.name: Maibara Satoko
characters.description: Maibara Satoko is the mother of Maibara Mitomo. She lives next door to the protagonist's house. She is an ordinary housewife. She has a good relationship with her husband and there is nothing suspicious about her...... [From DLsite]

title: Escape from the Princess
description: A young girl Rosetta dreams of becoming a magician, but she isn't cut out for magic at all. By the time she is ready to give up a mysterious eastern witch, Zara appears beside her. The witch claims that she is stalked by the princess herself and that she needs Rosetta's help to flee the city. In return, Zara offers something that the girl cannot resist: magic powers. Although Rosetta realizes that the witch did not tell her the whole story, she still agrees. What cunning witch hides, why is she being pursued by the princess, and most importantly ... what will happen if the heroine develops feelings for her unlikely guest? [From Steam]

title: Mizuchi
tags: Heroine Based on a Fictional Person
Heroine Based on a Mythological Character
Past Setting in a Fictional World
description: "Is there a true path to happiness?" Abruptly finding herself at the bottom of a snake pit, an impoverished girl named Linh is bound and helpless for a crime she did not commit. Left to the mercy of the village snake god, a mysterious entity appears before her, offering to save her in exchange for her soul. Finding herself in a new reality, she is torn between staying with the beautiful temptress, Ai, who had rescued her from death, and the resourceful wanderer, Jinhai, who promises to set her free. Who is the real savior? Will Linh discover the strength to change her own fate? Journey with Linh as she is forced to question her understanding of life, happiness, and what it means to be human. Every decision matters in this tale about identity, friendship, love and loss. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Linh
characters.description: Growing up in poverty, she does what she must to survive. She's learned to keep her emotions and opinions in check to protect herself. She is extremely loyal to those she cares about, which gets her into trouble.

characters.name: Ai
characters.description: A serpent who reveals itself to be a shapeshifter with magical powers. Blunt, with a hatred for humans.

characters.name: Jinhai
characters.description: A former nun, she is open and friendly to everyone. She finds the most joy in cooking and making medicine for others. She also has a pet chicken that has yet to leave her side.

title: The Fairy's Song
description: Marnie is a young goth girl with a less-than-cheery disposition. Her parents are going away for a week of sun and surf in Bordeaux, and Marnie has been palmed off in her grandmother’s care in the backwater English village Fenchapel. Marnie isn’t much looking forward to her week in the sticks. Fenchapel is a small village with a population below 500, without any shops or cinemas. Marnie’s sure she’ll be bored out of her skull – and then, there’s her grandmother’s continued ravings about fairies. “Don’t venture too far into the forest,” Grandma Iris warns. “There are strange creatures in there, and if they find you, they’ll never let you leave.” Of course, Marnie ignores her grandmother’s warnings. Fairies don’t exist, after all – and Fenchapel is so tiny, what can she do other than explore? And so, Marnie wanders into the forest… While exploring, Marnie happens upon a young female knight

characters.name: Marnie
characters.description: Marnie is a young goth girl with a less-than-cheery disposition. Her parents have gone away for a week of sun and surf in Bordeaux, and Marnie has been palmed off in her grandmother’s care in the backwater English village Fenchapel.

characters.name: Leofe
characters.description: A young female knight who has been sleeping for many centuries, but Marnie (inadvertently) awakes her. Leofe does not know why she went to sleep, but she knows that the forest itself is plagued by a horrible curse, and she is the only one who can lift it. [spoiler]Her real name is Lisbeth.

characters.name: Iris Lennox
characters.description: Marnie's Grandmother on her father's side. She lives in a very rural part of England. Marnie is forced to stay at her grandmother's house while her parents go on holiday to France. She is convinced that the forest behind her house has fairies. Everyone else thinks she's gone senile because she always brings this up.

characters.name: Linette
characters.description: A mysterious ghost-like character who shows up and seems to antagonise Marnie and Leofe

title: Koi to, Guitar to, Aoi Sora.
description: Amanda Etheridge is an ordinary woman; a closeted lesbian working at an advertising agency in New York...at least until the huge project she was in charge of collapsed through no fault of her own. As a result, the former workaholic has been put on paid leave, but without her work, what is there for her to do? Well, her boss did tell her to get out there, meet new people, and expand her horizons.... Guided by the sweet sound of country songs playing on the radio, she travels to Nashville alone. Reluctantly leaving her old life behind, she arrives in this colorful, musical city-- and hears the whisper of an angel: "Hello, Nashville. Would you like to hear a song about love?" [From Official site]

characters.name: Juliet Sutherland
characters.original: ジュリエット・サザーラド

title: malcatras' maiden
description: On a particularly isolated estate lies a grand mansion that serves as a haven for poor lost girls taken in as daughters by the benevolent Lady Francesca Malcatras to serve as her esteemed maids in a life of privilege. Yet, as the high expectations and frequent disciplining weigh heavily on the loyalty of the girls, the long-held commandment of the manor is questioned; Are these walls surrounding the paradise truly there to keep her daughters safe from the world? Accept the tender beauty of despair, pain, and love. This is MALMAID. [From Steam]

characters.name: Liliana Malcatras
characters.description: Liliana Malcatras is an adoptive daughter and Special Maid (servant and bodyguard) of Lady Francesca Malcatras. She has the magic ability "Dual Attraction" which allows her to touch two targets (objects or lifeforms) and telekinetically draw them together or repel them from eachother.

characters.name: Francesca Malcatras
characters.description: Lady Francesca Malcatras is the owner of a isolated estate with a large staff. She adopts orphaned children, and has them trained to work on her estate as maids and other servants.

characters.name: Noelle
characters.description: Noelle is a nurse at the Malcatras estate, who creates potions and heals maids' wounds. She has previously had sexual relations with Liliana and flirts with her, much to the latter's annoyance.

characters.name: Imogen
characters.description: A former maid at the Malcatras estate, who was re-assigned to a different group of masters. She learned the truth behind Francesca and formed a secret plan with Millarca to take her down.

characters.name: Nanda
characters.description: A living doll and a loyal servant of Lady Malcatras, she has the ability to turn people's limbs into doll limbs.

characters.name: Marcelline
characters.description: A child adopted by Lady Malcatras, Liliana sees her own child self in Marcelline.

characters.name: Aihara Ringo
characters.description: An energetic, aspiring young girl. A first-year student in nursing school and graduate of St. Michael’s. A hardworker who always maintains excellent grades. She’s family friends with Chiaki, who is a nurse and teacher, and has admired her since they were little. Taking her acceptance to nursing school as an opportunity to become independent from her parents, she’s begun living with Chiaki in her apartment. [Translated from Gyutto and Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Takao Chiaki
characters.description: A picture perfect nurse. …But she’s actually pretty spoiled. She’s both a nurse in the gastrointestinal surgery ward at Saint Michael’s General Hospital as well as a nursing instructor. With Ringo being accepted to nursing school, Chiaki offers to take her under her wing, and the two begin living together in her apartment. Ordinarily she’s a flawless model of a woman, but at home, she has surprisingly little concern for herself; in some ways, she’s a bit of a wreck. [Translated from Gyutto and Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Katakura Yuuno
characters.description: An extreeemely pushy and overprotective girl who is in her first year of nursing school. Satsuki’s classmate and dormmate. Has a soft, feminine disposition. Fairly protective, she always speaks formally, with a deference to others. Her overbearing disposition stems from her “What would you do without me?” attitude toward the frequently troubled Satsuki. [Translated from Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Ishigami Satsuki
characters.description: A brilliant, but frank and aloof girl with boyish tendencies. What you would call an aloof mystery. Up front and self-assured. She always speaks in a masculine way. Although she’s never had much interest in eating, Yuuno has been using her home cooking to draw her out more, so that she’ll be straightforward with her expressions of affection, regardless of their surroundings. [Translated from Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Nozomi
characters.description: Narumi's room mate.

title: Sakura Gamer 2
description: A year has passed since the events of Sakura Gamer. Nekohime and her friends have since released their debut visual novel, MikoMaid, to great success. With an even bigger budget than before, and a rapidly growing fanbase, Nekohime sets out to make and sell a hotly anticipated sequel: MikoMaid 2. Unfortunately, every silver lining has a cloud. MikoMaid’s acclaim was by no means universal, and the negative press the first title garnered is staring to get our heroine down. Nekohime’s self-confidence begins to flag, and she soon starts to doubt all her life choices. Was it a mistake to become a visual novel writer? Maybe she should’ve stayed a computer repair technician instead! Nekohime’s doubts are further compounded when she runs into Kurumi, a hot-headed young woman who despises MikoMaid (and lewd visual novels in general). What will Nekohime do?! Will she be able to maintain her bonds w

characters.name: Tsukiko
characters.description: A mischievous, vixen-like girl from Nekohime’s past, infamous for encouraging her elderly grandmother to feed her laptop’s D-Drive rice for a ‘Shinto purification ceremony’. Suki flirts with almost everyone, to such an extent it’s hard to tell whether she really means it. She also enjoys teasing people – particularly uptight people like Nekohime who get flustered easily. She grew up in a shrine, but is worlds apart from the image of a ‘traditional Japanese beauty’. She can be loud and obnoxious and incredibly pushy, but she’ll apologize when she realizes she’s gone too far. She’s also a competent digital artist, who spent a large portion of her life drawing and uploading her pictures online. After all, there’s not much else to do at a shrine. [From Steam.]

characters.name: Matsuoka Chika
characters.description: One of Nekohime’s closest friends. Her real name is Chika. Though she loves revealing cosplay and dressing in tightly-fitting spandex, she’s actually an elementary school teacher. She’s warm, cheerful, bubbly, and loves playing around with finger paints, which makes her a surprisingly good fit for her job (and no, she doesn’t dress quite so outlandishly when she’s at work). Being creative, she enjoys experimenting in the kitchen and composing music. She nominates herself as the composer for her video game venture. [From Steam.]

characters.name: Sayo
characters.description: The unwilling heroine of the story. Her real name is ‘Sayo’, but her friends refer to her by her internet handle - much to her embarrassment. Though she dislikes being referred to by a silly nickname she made up on the spot when she was a kid, she exhibits a lot of catlike traits. She’s always seen in her cat-eared jacket, she likes taking naps, and she can be rather ‘catty’. She lacks purpose in life, and is bored by her tedious, unrewarding job. Maybe making a video game is exactly the kind of diversion she needs. [From Steam]

characters.name: Kurumi
characters.description: Kurumi is a brand new character in the Sakura Gamer universe, and she acts as an antagonist towards our three main girls. Brash and short-tempered, Kurumi hates MikoMaid with a passion that seems almost personal. She makes quite a poor first impression, but at least she wears cute panties! [From Steam.]

title: Who is the Red Queen?
tags: Heroine Based on a Fictional Person
Protagonist Based on a Fictional Person
description: Alice falls down the rabbit hole into a Wonderland not quite right. Meeting an eclectic collection of people, animals, and somethings in between, she sets out on an adventure in this odd new place to find the missing Red Queen. Or, more specifically, to find the pieces of the dismembered queen whose body has been strewn across the land.

characters.name: Alice
characters.description: The main character. Based off the titular protagonist from Carroll's [i]Alice in Wonderland. She falls down a rabbit hole into Wonderland as if having forgotten something very important. Alice's goal is to find a way out of Wonderland, leading her to search for the Red Queen's pieces. ...Yet who is Alice? [From official website]

characters.name: Mad Hatter
characters.description: Based off of the Mad Hatter from Carroll's [i]Alice in Wonderland. She is mad, stuck in teatime with her two dearest friends, the Dormouse and March Hare, puppet facsimiles on her hands. She aids Alice on a quest to collect them all—limbs that is! The Hatter's goal is to get revenge on the Red Queen, but how can she do it with the Red Queen dismembered? [From official website]

characters.name: White Queen
characters.description: Based off of the White Queen from Carroll's [i]Through the Looking-Glass. She is a self proclaimed precog who directs Alice to find the Red Queen. Perhaps she is the one who loves 'Alice' the most in this world... The White Queen's goal is simply to help Alice, but what secrets does she hide behind her calm eyes? [From official website]

characters.name: White Rabbit
characters.description: A supporting character. The right hand to the Red Queen, she is subservient to those who she views as higher than her and rude to those she views as lower. She acts like a messenger and helper to Alice. Why does she seem to recognize Alice as someone else? [From official website]

characters.name: Cheshire
characters.description: A supporting character. The cat is a cat, coming and going as she wants. Shackles adorn her limbs from an imprisonment known yet unknown to Alice. While she has features of a human, her eyes and grin are like those of a beast. Is this cat a friend or foe? [From official website]

title: Graveyard Girls
description: "Grief isn’t a low. It’s a terrifying high, atop a mountain I never climbed." Visiting her father's grave on Halloween was never the plan, but inexplicably, Elle finds herself drawn to the local cemetery. Hoping to find a semblance of closure, she arrives at his graveside with a notebook clutched to her chest. Sitting against his headstone, Elle talks to her dad for the first time in years. Drowning in a downpour of memories, she closes her eyes and focuses on breathing. Daylight slips away, but before Elle can leave, a stranger approaches. When Elle and Lucia meet on Hallows Eve, two grieving worlds collide... [From itch.io]

full_description: "Grief isn’t a low. It’s a terrifying high, atop a mountain I never climbed." Visiting her father's grave on Halloween was never the plan, but inexplicably, Elle finds herself drawn to the local cemetery. Hoping to find a semblance of closure, she arrives at his graveside with a notebook clutched to her chest. Sitting against his headstone, Elle talks to her dad for the first time in years. Drowning in a downpour of memories, she closes her eyes and focuses on breathing. Daylight slips away, but before Elle can leave, a stranger approaches. They will partake in filling meals cooked over an open flame, kayak in beautiful rivers, and see wild, yet friendly, creatures native to the forest. Their week will be spent in utter bliss, with campers taking home naught but fond memories… It's a shame you won't be joining them. description: The year is now 2117. You are a second generation ship-born researcher studying inter-dimensional travel. Your choices change the fortunes of all aboard the Everett. Friendship and love lay waiting at your feet, but you should be wary. The road to the stars is full of hardship. A malprogrammed A.I. dedicated to preserving resources pulls you into a twisted, murderous game. When tensions are high, who knows what even the kindest crew member will do? How will you protect those you love? Will you betray friends to save yourself? Will you be slaughtered in cold, empty space? Will you slaughter? It's time to ask yourself: what would you do to survive? [From Lemma Soft thread]

full_description: Henrietta likes fairy tales. She peacefully lives with the Grimm brothers in a small village. But one day, Henrietta has a dream of being lost in the forest. When she wakes up, the world has completely changed.... There are only Henrietta and Ludwig, the youngest brother of the Grimm brothers, in the village! They decide to go on an adventure to look for other two brothers.... [From Himeya Shop]

title: East Tower
description: Sakuya Morita always thought that her situation would be better if she had been born as a man. One day, her cousin Daiki asked her to participate in a virtual theme park's presentation by testing one of the new attractions, West Tower. Sakuya would like to go, but she has more interest in testing the other new attraction - East Tower, which is specifically designed for boys. At first, Daiki does not let her, but in the end he gives in when she expresses her strong desire. Unfortunately, an accident happens during the presentation and all the participants end up trapped in the virtual world. What actually happened? Can they find a way out? Things are not as simple as how they look.

characters.name: Morita Sakuya
characters.description: A girl who has always wished to be born as a boy. When she was young, she failed from saving a little boy from his kidnapper. This incident made her wish to be a strong man whom everyone can rely on. She hates to dress like a girl, because she thinks it made her look like a wimp. She transforms into a boy inside the virtual theme park.

characters.name: Kagurazaka Akio
characters.description: One of the sponsor's son, and a representative of his father's company. He is cold and taciturn. Everyone treats him well just to please his parents. He hardly trusts anyone besides his himself.

characters.name: Yasuda Takashi
characters.description: He is the younger brother of the Dream World's manager. He is cheerful and optimistic.

characters.name: Kuon
characters.description: One of the sponsor's son. A shy boy who looks younger than his actual age. He always worries about everything, and gets nervous easily.

characters.name: Kurenai
characters.description: A man with a body full of tattoos and piercings. He appears inside the virtual world as one of the participants, and chooses to act on his own.

characters.name: Morita Daiki
characters.description: Sakuya's cousin, who is also in charge of the new attractions, East and West Tower. He sees Sakuya as his own sister, and wishes for her to act like every other girls.

characters.name: Yasuda Yoshimi
characters.description: The manager of the virtual theme park, Dream World. She is disciplined and reliable - an ideal superior.

title: Ecchi Sketch: Draw Cute Girls Every Day!
description: Ecchi Sketch: Draw Cute Girls Every Day follows the story of Yume Akiyama, a girl in her mid twenties who works at a real 'dead-end' job - at a funeral company. Her real passion, however, is anything girl x girl - manga, anime, videogames; if it has cute girls romancing other cute girls, then she's a fan. A talented amateur artist, Yume is suddenly given the opportunity of a lifetime - to be a mangaka at a manga studio! But with so many other attractive girls at the office... will she be able to concentrate? [From Steam Greenlight]

characters.name: Yume Akiyama
characters.description: Yume Akiyama, the heroine of our story, is a graphic designer at a funeral company. She’s also a highly talented manga artist and is a superfan of anything girl x girl, be it manga, anime or video games. Yume’s mother died while she was young, so now she lives with her Dad, a high powered executive at Miyuhara Industries. [From Steam]

characters.description: Shirayuri Media's accountant.

characters.name: Kyoko Miyuhara
characters.description: Kyoko Miyuhara is heir to the Miyuhara fortune. Her father is the president of Miyuhara Industries, a national company on the Nikkei stock exchange. After a chance meeting with Yume, Kyoko reveals she runs her own company - Shirayuri Media who create girl x girl manga and doujinshi. [From Steam]

characters.name: Rin
characters.description: Rin is the jack of all trades at Shirayuri Media. From shading, to cleaning and colouring, Rin handles the odd jobs. Obsessed with pink, magical girls, and all things cute, Rin often comes across bratty and immature. Underneath, however, she hides a heart of gold. [From Steam]

characters.name: Megumi
characters.description: Megumi is a talented storyteller, a hobbyist musician and deep thinker. She often loses herself in her own thoughts... sometimes in the midst of conversation. She often questions her place in the world, and can come across a little abrasive. Her personal life is a closely guarded secret. [From Steam]

title: Night Cascades
description: Diane Carter never expected her folklore degree to get her a job offer from the local police department, but when a rash of occult-themed fires sets the city on edge, she is called in as a special consultant on esoteric religion to help find the culprit. There's just one problem: the woman she's assigned to work with. She's cocky, beautiful, and far too familiar. Can Diane and Jackie overcome the obstacles of their past and find the truth? Set in an alternate New Age 1980s where belief in paranormal powers and secret Satanists is at its peak, but same-sex love is still taboo. [From Itch.io]

title: Sakura Knight
description: The land of Lemuria was once in turmoil. Ruled over by the evil demon queen, Gunhild, the people lived every day in fear and strife… until the brave female knight, Cressida, destroyed her. For the last thirty years, Lemuria has been at peace. Knights like Cressida are no longer needed to protect the masses – but Cressida’s daughter, Estelle, is determined to follow in her mother’s footsteps. Not content to spend the rest of her days in her parents’ bakery, our young heroine vows to take up the sword and go on a fantastic adventure… But things don’t quite work out that way! Despite her lofty ambitions, Estelle is sheltered and naïve. Less than a week into her adventure, she’s hoodwinked by a crafty catgirl, and then she has to content with a wildly flirtatious elven princess who keeps making advances on her! How will Estelle ever manage to make her dream come true?! [From Steam]

characters.name: Estelle
characters.description: Though a young adult in her early twenties, Estelle has spent most of her life sheltered and coddled by her overprotective parents. She dreams of being a knight like her mother, the famous Cressida, who defeated the wicked demon queen, Gunhild. She wants to become a brave knight, but her clumsiness often gets the better of her. Estelle wants dearly to be brave and strong, but she's a shy girl with self-esteem issues. Kind-hearted to a fault, she puts others before herself, and often works herself up unnecessarily. She's naïve and a little too trusting, but has a great capacity for love, and is surprisingly good at settling arguments. [Edited from Steam]

characters.name: Felicia
characters.description: Felicia is a seductive elven princess who hails from the land of Gris. As per elven custom, Felicia must travel across the land and help those in need, in order to prove herself as a worthy successor to her mother’s throne. Felicia comes from a vast family with dozens of siblings. As the oldest, she’s also the loudest, and she almost never stops talking. She’s perpetually cheerful and optimistic, and more than a little airheaded, but her skills with a sword are impeccable. [From Steam]

characters.name: Rune
characters.description: Rune is a wolfgirl who lives deep in the Lemurian forest. Her grasp of common Lemurian is somewhat shaky, and she finds it hard to communicate, but her passion always shines through. Serious and dutiful, Rune is a good ally to have. Like a guard dog, she’ll fiercely defend those she considers her comrades – but if you get on her bad side, she’ll hold a grudge for years. [From Steam]

characters.name: Tart
characters.description: Tart is a self-proclaimed 'magical cat witch'. Though she looks sweet and unassuming, she possesses incredible magical powers. Tart is mischievous and deceptive by nature. She makes a living through thievery, swindling, and stealing. She particularly loves taking advantage of cute girls – especially if she gets to see them cry. [From Steam]

title: LIP! Lewd Idol Project Vol. 1
description: Kairi is a young and cheerful girl with a dream... Becoming the best and most popular Idol ever! She recently moved to Akihabara in order to achieve this, but she's been rejected by around fifteen different agencies so far. Already short on money, with some increasing debt, and feeling defeated and frustrated after another failed audition, she meets Ranko, a self-proclaimed "producer" that introduces the innocent Idol wannabe to her most recent and most ambitious project... Lewd Idol Project. Join Kairi, explore the amazing city of Akihabara, meet and recruit new girls for the project, and help her fulfill her dream in this new Lewd Adventure! [From Steam]

characters.name: Kairi
characters.description: In order to pursue her lifetime dream of being a famous Idol, Kairi just moved to Akihabara, where she's been rejected by around fifteen Idol agencies already. On the brink of depression and with a lot of debts to pay already, a very weird and unconventional lifetime opportunity seems to appear right before her eyes... [From Steam]

characters.name: Ranko
characters.description: Self proclaimed producer and manager, Ranko is a mature former Idol that couldn't make it big in her early twenties. Now, with the fears of adulthood haunting her, she bets it all in her latest idea..."Lewd Idol Project." She'll try to introduce Kairi into the world of "lewd idols" in order to fulfill her frustrated dream. [From Steam]

characters.name: Yuki
characters.description: A girl of few words, Yuki spends most of her time in the Game Centers of Akihabara beating records and winning prizes. She also loves to collect retro video games. Although she's not interested in Idol culture at first, Ranko sees potential, and will do the impossible to convince her to join the Lewd Idol Project. [From Steam]

title_original: 闇夜ト星ノ冥土館～ぷにゅぷりXX～
description: This is the story of Kristina, a girl who lost everything and was hired as a maid in a cursed mansion. It is a world where time repeats itself, wandering endlessly through eternity. Memories are caked in rust and worn to shreds. Scared of that she is losing, her existence is nothing but twisted thrift. Her body is used solely for their purposes... Wettened and used as a vessel to reconnect with time. Fallen into despair from being constantly raped... Another girl has lost her way. Bound by her sad fate, Olivia [The Child Servant] watches eternity begin to tremble again as love blossoms in her heart. The clouds that cover the night sky are sadness. That which is reflected in opened eyes is freedom.

description: After many years in captivity, Ada, a young slave girl, attempts to escape from her captors. She kills one of her guards and steals his gold, then desperately runs away from the slums, seeking to journey to the city of Libertad. As she begins to run towards freedom, however, Ada's hopes are quickly dashed. A trio of slavers catch up to her, cornering her in an alleyway and threatening to put her through hell once more before killing her. Realizing herself that she has no chance of defeating them, Ada closes her eyes, surrendering herself as she braces for her final moments. But is it not Ada who is fated to die that day. When Ada opens her eyes, she finds her slavers on the ground, felled in a heartbeat and laying in pools of their own blood. The two girls grow together from a preposterous agreement and little do they know, they soon start catching feelings. But will the two be able to stay together when secrets leak out and egos are at stake? [From Itch.io]

description: Alex is a college student studying nursing and recently freed from her unbearable helicopter parents. Far from home and trying to get through classes as quickly as possible, she’s grown burnt out and quite lonely. However, she hears about a mysterious social media account filled with images of ruined buildings, rooftop views, and rooms trapped in time, framed by a challenge: “Feeling adventurous? Come find us.” Her curiosity piqued, a spark of rebellious energy stirs within her. She sets out to find the origins of the photos and finds three urban explorers, each of them unearthing something new and unfamiliar in her heart. [From itch.io]

[From itch.io]

He has a soft spot for animals and while he comes across cold, is genuinely kind (to anyone that isn't himself, anyway). [From itch.io]

He likes various latte concoctions. He would never describe himself as a people person though... Why could that be? [From itch.io]

She loves to take photos and ride her motorcycle! She'd be a very reliable person if not for her tendency to ghost her friends out of nowhere. [From itch.io]

full_description: Alex is a college student studying nursing and recently freed from her unbearable helicopter parents. Far from home and trying to get through classes as quickly as possible, she’s grown burnt out and quite lonely. However, she hears about a mysterious social media account filled with images of ruined buildings, rooftop views, and rooms trapped in time, framed by a challenge: “Feeling adventurous? Come find us.” Her curiosity piqued, a spark of rebellious energy stirs within her. She sets out to find the origins of the photos and finds three urban explorers, each of them unearthing something new and unfamiliar in her heart. [From itch.io]

title: The Moon Looks Beautiful Tonight
description: A year ago, the Moon was sent violently flying off course by a catastrophic explosion, depriving Earth of its steady stream of resources. Less importantly, the two maintenance workers on there when the explosion occurred have been stranded ever since. It's not so bad, honestly. The Heart provides for everything, a practically infinite source that gives them water, food, and powers their satellite as they wait with ever dwindling hopes for rescue. Really, it's boring, but there's no reason to stress out so long as- The Heart has stopped. A game about fear of the unknown. [from itch.io]

title: Highschool Romance: Magi Trials
description: Arriving at a new school can be daunting, even more so when it's a school of magic... Fortunately you have found something that might increase your chances of successful entrance, a ritual that should greatly enhance your innate magical ability. Now you must deal with the repercussions of the spell, as you begin your training to join the ranks of the Royal Academy of Magi. [From Steam]
