title: Otome Crisis
description: This is a story of Laurier, who makes girls small like dolls and add them to her collection, and Hiiro, who pursues her across dimensions. Just when Hiiro captures her, she tries to go to another dimension. Hiiro tries to stop her, but Laurier disappears. A while later, several girls suddenly come out of a crack! They are the girls Laurier keeps in her collection. She jumps into the crack to save them... [From Himeya Shop] Otome Crisis is a branching adventure game with 2D action/fighting elements.

characters.name: Sawaki Rinna
characters.description: A second-year transfer student. Wataru meets her at Takashi's bar while he's drunk. They chat and then leave. The next morning, Wataru awakes to find her asleep in his room wearing only bra and panties. She wakes, he tells her he can't remember a thing from the night before, she slaps him and leaps from his second-story window. She officially enters his school, joining his class and dorm the next day. She acts sullen and obstinate to both students and faculty. She skips the welcome party that the other dorm residents arrange for her, telling them that she doesn't want to make friends and faces the pain of parting with them in only a years' time. Wataru shouts to her his vow to that he will force her to become friends with them. Takashi informs Wataru that he and Rinna first met in his bar. Realizing that Rinna's general aloofness emanates from his having forgotten about her, he challenge

characters.name: Hayama Umi
characters.description: A second-year student just like Wataru. She is Wataru's childhood friend. She is good at cooking and is the one that cooks breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the people who live in the Tsugumi Dormitory. She had a crush for Wataru ever since they were kids, but he seems not to notice. When Umi was a child, she was very shy. She doesn't like to be alone and she always sticked with Wataru when they were little. She goes almost everywhere with Wataru. Some people dislike Umi and her father because her mother and Wataru's father had an intimate relationship a long time ago. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Asakura Naoko
characters.description: A third-year student who gets high grades. She is the student council president at Takamizuka High School. She seems to be an excellent and friendly person when she is with teachers and students, but it's all put on. She enjoys teasing the boarders of Tsugumi dorm. She is like a big sister and she is more reliable than Saeri. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Rokujou Miyaho
characters.description: A freshman who is a granddaughter of previous chairman of the board of directors of Takamizuka High School and owner the Tsugumi dorm; Miyaho is the acting chairman and the owner of it temporarily. She is a girl brought up with tender care in the Rokujou family that is the founder of Demizugawa Heavy Industry, but her fate was changed after she met Wataru at Tsugumi Dorm on last New Year's Day. She is clumsy at everything she does. Has a habit of counting her steps on the stairway to their dormitory as seen in Rinna's Arc. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Fujimura Shizu
characters.description: A new student who is bashful in front of strangers. Her parents left her and she seldom showed her feelings when Wataru met her at first; Saeri stood for her and she began to live on the Tsugumi dorm, and she gradually shows her feeling. She is quiet and small, but she is a good athlete. [Taken from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Kirishima Saeri
characters.description: A Japanese language teacher, the homeroom teacher of the class 2-A, the dormitory manager of the Tsugumi dorm and the adviser of the student council. She is called Sae-chan by her students. She has a sense of rivalry for Naoko because she is more reliable than her. [From Wikipedia]

characters.original: ミュリエル・シアフィールド

characters.original: ダリア・クラフォード

characters.name: Shezall
characters.description: [spoiler]Shezall is Berio's brother-in-law (non-blood-related brother).

characters.name: Takeuchi Yuka
characters.description: Birthplace / Origin: Tokyo metropolitan area. Occupation: 3rd-year (senior) at city academy "T", part-time waitress (Hanna Miller's). Likes / Loves: Fruits, video games. A refreshing "sports girl" with a strong sense of justice. Yuka is liked both by her classmates and underclassmen. She uses "Boku" (a Japanese pronoun) when referring to herself. Yuka has a 4-dan full contact karate skills and a black belt. She won a V.G. tournament in the past. [Translated from Getchu.]

characters.name: Rebecca Plushenko
characters.original: レベッカ・プルシエンコ
characters.description: Birthplace: Russia. Affiliation: The D battalion, the special mobility squadron, the HAWS platoon and the BT squad. Rank: Corporal.

characters.name: Carna Abitbol
characters.description: Birthplace: France. She is silent and expressionless most of the time. A mysterious enemy ace pilot.

title: Sketchbook: Schoolgirls in Love and Other Assorted Heartbreak
description: A slice-of-life melodrama that's all about the important parts of growing up: falling in love with another girl, impeaching a corrupt student council president, uncomfortable sex, and not colouring within the lines.

title: Kangokutou Mary Skelter Finale
title_original: 神獄塔 メアリスケルターFinale
tags: Heroine Based on a Fictional Person
Protagonist Based on a Fictional Person
description: The Jail—a living prison that feeds on the humans trapped within its confines. The Jail appeared a number of years ago with the caving of the city around it. Now twisted creatures known as Marchens and treacherous Nightmares roam its halls. The Blood Maidens, reincarnations of old stories and folk tales led by Jack, successfully escaped the Jail and managed to make it from the underground prison to the surface… Although they had hope for the surface, the scene Jack and company first saw when they emerged… was thousands of dead bodies submerged in a sea of blood, and the maniacal laughter of “Genocide Pink” (executioner girls). Scattered by the overwhelming slaughter and mayhem of Genocide Pink, their only ray of hope was seemingly destroyed. Scorched Pillar, a member of Genocide Pink born to kill humans; Jack, a Blood Youth who would give even a drop of a blood to save a friend; Mary, a

characters.name: Alice
characters.description: Initial Class: Fighter Jack's childhood friend who was kidnapped by the Marchen and thrown into the Jail together with Jack when they were younger. Ever since then, they have been kept alive there as inmates. Though calculative and serious most of the time, Alice lets her emotions free when she talks to or talks about Jack. After getting rescued by Akazukin, she finds out that she is one of the Chishiki Girls, meaning that she reacts uniquely to the Marchens's blood and is able to fight against them.

characters.name: Oyayubihime
characters.description: Initial Class: Magician The eldest of three sisters belonging to the Chishiki Girls Squad. Given that she is the eldest, she is strict with Jack and is often seen scolding him. Even when she wants to compliment Jack when he’s done something praiseworthy, she has a hard time doing so, as she can be quite bashful at times. She left a single cell floor before meeting Jack and company, and assumed she completed her mission successfully, but…

characters.name: Shirayukihime
characters.description: Initial Class: Scientist The middle child of the three sisters who is kind and gentle to anyone she comes into contact with. She speaks kindly to Jack, who is wrapped around the fingers of the girls, and tries to lend a hand, but her clumsy nature often has an undesirable result. Whether it’s her lack of self-confidence or a result of cause and effect, there is a side to her that’s afraid to look in the mirror.

characters.name: Nemurihime
characters.description: Initial Class: Archer The youngest of the three sisters, she has a mysterious manner of behaving. Due to her aimless manners, there are many scenes where she bewilders Jack, but she also extends a hand (or breast) to Jack when he is troubled. She rarely speaks words, but often conveys her intentions by nodding or shaking her head instead. When she does speak, her voice sounds drowsy.

characters.name: Akazukin
characters.description: A powerful girl who boldly traverses through the Jail. She likes that Jack has guts and enjoys having something to manipulate, in other words enjoy dragging him around. She is said to be the first-discovered Chishiki Girl and though rough, acts as an older-sister type that watches over the girls. However, her hot-blooded instincts can sometimes cause a panic.

characters.name: Kaguyahime
characters.description: Initial Class: Sniper A girl who is always holed up in her room, who won’t fight unless her demands are satisfied. She is extremely lazy, and rides a big vehicle called "Bamboo No. 1" both when she moves and fights, rarely moving her body on her own. When she first met Jack, she thought of him as a convenient errand boy who will go out to get the things she wants, but as they overcome all sorts of difficulties together, her heart will gradually open up to him. She may or may not have the ability to release the “Truant Seven Tools” from the hem of her skirt…

characters.name: Rapunzel
characters.description: Initial Class: Pierrot The youngest of the girls who has very long blond hair. At first, she mistakes Jack as the emergency rations and attempts to gnaw him, but as he cares for her by feeding and playing with her, they gradually become attached to one another. Rapunzel likes to sleep on Nemurihime’s chest and is often witnessed napping with her.

characters.name: Gretel
characters.description: Initial Class: Mimic A very curious and intelligent girl, she loves researching the environment and people around her, but what doesn’t interest her is met with a lack of emotion. She has a habit of speaking without moral views. She seems to hold an interest towards Jack, viewing him as a good-natured person. Because Gretel lacks common sense, she often makes quite frank and weird remarks at the other girls around Jack which make them cringe, but she seems fine with that, and may even enjoy their reactions. She also likes manipulating people on a certain level, such as managing to make Rapunzel give most of her candies to her.

characters.name: Cinderella
characters.description: Initial Class: Marshal A prideful young girl who exaggeratedly talks and acts like a rich lady. She has a tendency to lose track of what she says when speaking with Jack. Despite this, Cinderella has sudden mood bursts at times and is actually very modest. She also gets easily depressed when she's called out, thinks she may have worried someone or when somebody attacks her "mask". This also happens when she loses any part of her clothing and starts thinking she is nothing but a useless and ugly human. It also seems she's not used to being praised by others.

characters.name: Michiru
characters.description: The leader of a religious cult called "Taiyou" ("The Order of the Sun" in English version) inside the Jail which claims that "Some day, the Sun God will burn down the ceiling and we'll be able to leave this place." While she is known by the name of "Oohime" in the cult, she still calls herself by her real name, Michiru. She always talks mysteriously, like a real divine being.

characters.name: Jack
characters.description: The protagonist. A boy who spends his days as an inmate in Jail. He’s a little timid, but also has a strong side. He is a kind-hearted soul who occasionally tries to protect his friends by throwing his own life on the line. He’s taken by Akazukin, who came to save Alice, to break out of jail. As support for the Chishiki Girls Squad, girls who fight while wounded and wish to become women of power, they attempt to escape Jail. Although, he’ll later also obtain a blood-type (Chishiki) ability and be discovered a “Chishiki Boy”…

characters.name: Hitsuka
characters.description: A calm guy who is a member of the religious cult "Taiyou". He is loyal towards the cult's leader Michiru and is always next to her, explaining the things she says to others. Hitsuka also works as a security guard who guards off-limited areas and ensures that nobody enters them.

characters.name: Kurara
characters.description: Haru's assistant. She also sells all kinds of tools at her shop.

characters.name: Haru
characters.description: One of the few blacksmiths in Prison who makes weapons for the Chishiki Squad. While he has a bad attitude with an equally bad mouth and loves taking breaks, he also likes giving Jack and the girls advise sometimes.

characters.name: Ueshima Miko
characters.description: A doctor who is regarded as everyone's older sister. She keeps up a clinic called Rescue Center in which the Chishiki Girls can purify themselves from blood, decrease their madness gauge and get their wounds treated. She is always ready to listen and give advice to anyone in need of. She's also fond of working with the professor on his research of the Jail.

characters.name: Hamelin
characters.description: Initial Class: Necromancer The tenth Chishiki Girl who appears as a secret boss in the first area of the first game. After beating her, she joins the team. Hameln is brash and loud, referring to herself as the Demon King, though her slur will occasionally mess up her words. Her struggle in articulating ideas disrupts the aura of fear she attempts to convey. For some reason, she's fixated on Alice, calling her "m'lady" and abiding by her words with stuttering obedience.

characters.name: Tsuu
characters.description: Nickname "Otsuu", one of the Chishiski Girls who is a member of Daybreak and the protagonist of the second game. When she and Ningyohime were younger, Tsuu promised to become the "little mermaid's true prince", and thus, has always acted like a prince. Tsuu is very courageous, though underneath her shell she also has a slightly weak and girlish personality that contrasts her boyish appearance. She is also the only one who can understand and interact with Jack.

characters.name: Ningyohime
characters.description: A beautiful girl who values others' happiness more than her own and works hard to make sure the people around her happy. Though she has both a gentle personality and way of speaking, Ningyohime has a stubborn side to her as well. She is madly in love with Tsuu who told Ningyohime she'll be her "prince" when they were younger.

characters.name: Mamoru
characters.description: Hikari's childhood friend whom Tsuu's squad also found while investigating the underground caverns. Though his eyes give an aggressive first impression, Mamoru is a kind and thoughtful boy who gets along with everyone, and becomes an important to ally to Tsuu's squad. He is usually found guarding the base as the gatekeeper, and supports the Blood Maidens as a handyman of sorts. He is also the protagonist for the prequel novel.

characters.name: Mary
characters.description: A girl who used to live in the same cell as Jack and Alice - however, because of her weak powers, she has been always alone and never gotten recognized by others. Despite this she is not bothered by it, and each time she lights up a match and sees a delusion, she just ends up laughing, grinning and enjoying the loneliness. The only person she truly cares for is Charlotte, who also gave Mary her name.

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.description: Another mysterious girl who also lived in the same cell as Jack and Alice. She is a Chishiki Girl as well, but instead of working with Daybreak, she worked from the shadows together with Mary.

characters.name: Shira
characters.description: The youngest member of Genocide Pink who has a hard time hurting people. Her real name is "Scorched Pillar", but everybody just calls her Shira.

characters.name: Iron Maiden
characters.description: A member of Genocide Pink who loves beauty, and also loves breaking down beautiful things.

characters.name: Guillotine
characters.description: The leader of Genocide Pink. While she speaks in a polite way, she thinks that all humans are garbage and they deserve to die.

characters.name: Gallows
characters.description: A member of Genocide Pink who is very twisted, easily gets obsessed with others, and then tends to dispose of them when she gets bored.

characters.name: Zyu
characters.description: An amnesiac boy who has a calm and rational personality, but can also act ruthlessly when the situation requires it. The only fragments he has of his memories are "I need to find my wife whom I treasured a lot" and "I am a Tower Base". Just like Jack he is a Chishiki Boy.

characters.name: Kunai
characters.description: A girl who used to random chores at Daybreak. She is bad at remembering things, but does her best every day and never gives up. She also has an untimely nature, and tends to end up seeing things she shouldn't.

characters.name: Sukui
characters.description: A member of the religious cult "Taiyou". She joined the cult because she admired and wanted to be like Michiru.

characters.name: Javabaok
characters.description: A mysterious old man who appeared suddenly.

characters.name: Kadowaki Towa
characters.description: The gatekeeper guarding the entrance to the Liberated District. His kind face is always smiling, but there’s a strange sense of pressure in his expression. Despite being a normal human, he's strong enough to hold off Märchens.

characters.name: Kaede
characters.description: A girl found during Outsuu's exploration in the underground caverns. She's a bit of a spitfire who's quick to pick fights, but is also very reliable and supports the Blood Maidens at their time of need. She is often found at the store where she sells a variety of goods. She can't seem to stop pestering Itsuki, constantly teasing him as if he was a kid.

characters.name: Itsuki
characters.description: A young man found during Otsuu's exploration in the underground caverns. Though not as strong as the others, he makes up for it with his intelligence, analyzing tense situations for solutions. He is often found at the laboratory, and is constantly conducting research on the Blood Maidens and the Jail. He is a long time friend of Kaede, who still, to this day, treats him like a kid.

characters.name: Takumi
characters.description: A young man found during Outsuu's exploration in the underground caverns. Somewhat of a narcissist and eccentric, he likes changing speech patterns for some reason. In fact, he changes his way of speech so often that it's hard to tell what his true personality is like. He is often found at the factory where he crafts and strengthens the Blood Maidens' weapons. He acquired this skill after his tenure working at Dawn's factory.

full_description: The Jail—a living prison that feeds on the humans trapped within its confines. The Jail appeared a number of years ago with the caving of the city around it. Now twisted creatures known as Marchens and treacherous Nightmares roam its halls. The Blood Maidens, reincarnations of old stories and folk tales led by Jack, successfully escaped the Jail and managed to make it from the underground prison to the surface… Although they had hope for the surface, the scene Jack and company first saw when they emerged… was thousands of dead bodies submerged in a sea of blood, and the maniacal laughter of “Genocide Pink” (executioner girls). Scattered by the overwhelming slaughter and mayhem of Genocide Pink, their only ray of hope was seemingly destroyed. title: Crimson Spires
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Modern Day United States of America
description: The small mining town of Bataille, Missouri has been cordoned off from the outside world for six months. The inhabitants have no idea why. All they know is that ever since the so-called "Contingency," planes no longer fly overhead, strange creatures have been glimpsed beyond the perimeter, and large mechanical towers will gun down anyone who tries to escape. As Sheriff Erika Wright searches for the truth, she must listen to the advice of a serial killer, mingle with extreme conspiracy theorists, and negotiate with vampires. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Liam
characters.description: Adopted by the Bataille family at a young age, Liam Bataille has always struggled to feel like he fits in with the family. He’s easily the nicest member of the Batailles with an optimistic attitude, and he regularly urges to Erika to relax and have fun. But his loyalty is frequently torn between his personal virtue and his desire to please Julian and Charlotte.

characters.name: August Flynn
characters.description: Before the towers rose, August Flynn was a philosophy professor accused of 7 murders, coined the “Heartbreaker” for removing the victims’ hearts. Erika doesn’t believe his claims of innocence, but she might need his expertise against darker forces.

characters.name: Julian Bataille
characters.description: Julian Bataille seems calm, polite, and practical on the surface. He claims to maintain order in Bataille with his wealth and influence. He does like to maintain order and peace. But is he actually manipulating everyone for his own personal gain?

characters.name: Maddy Gray
characters.description: Growing up as a lesbian in a conservative, rural town often made Maddy Gray feel like an outsider in her own home. The Batailles were the only people who fully accepted her, so she feels loyal to them. But as she learns the real truth of the Batailles, she’ll have to fight for the greater good.

title: Mai-HiME - Unmei no Keitouju
description: You are Takamura Kyouji, a university undergraduate of archeology (and still in school). By help from Sears Association, you got a temporary teaching intern job at Fuuka Gakuen class 1-3 (Miyu, Natsuki, Mai and Akane's class) teaching History. In reality, you're at Fuuka to research the Hime Legend. [Edited from Animesuki forums]

title: Tamjeongjeon
description: [b]Lady in Mystery is a [i]Yuri mystery visual novel set in [b]18th-century Korea, where disguise, love, and truth intertwine beneath the strict Confucian order. Once an ordinary noble girl, [b]Heesoo lost everything when her family was executed under false charges. Disguised as a man, she escapes to the capital and opens an information shop called Jeonghuso, gathering whispers and solving cases to survive. Five years later, just as she begins to rebuild her life, a runaway noblewoman named [b]Juhee appears— and Heesoo’s carefully constructed world begins to crack. [From Steam]

characters.name: Gim Hui-su
characters.description: Main protagonist who works as a detective in the capital. Disguised as a man to escape the unjust death penalty put upon her family, she is determined to uncover the one who led her family to ruin and seek revenge on them. Born in 1768.

characters.name: Je Seoyeon
characters.description: A servant of the era's police force, she upholds the rules and presents her self calm and collected. She is loyal to those close to her and is initially unhappy with the trust her boss places in Heesoo. Born in 1766.

characters.name: Sim Ju-hui
characters.description: Spirited daughter of a renowned noble family, she runs away in order to avoid an arranged marriage with a man. She threatens Heesoo into helping her so. She is homosexual. Born in 1770.

characters.name: Iljimae
characters.description: The Robin Hood in Hanyang. Born in 1768.

characters.name: Gang Yu-rin
characters.description: A born trader, she is a powerful merchant who supports Heesoo. Kind on the surface but merciless in an instant, she will not hesitate to be ruthless when it comes to profit. Born in 1759.

characters.name: Gim U-seong
characters.description: Born in 1765

title: Huayu: Baihe
description: Lingua Fleur: Lily is a tale of a rather unlikely friendship between the introverted Yuyi and the sociable Yile. This is not your typical yuri romance story, but one which focuses more on personal growth. Unlike many visual novels, this story is set in a Chinese college. While not obvious from first glance, this is a Chinese-language visual novel. [Excerpt From NookGaming.com]

characters.name: Lin Yile
characters.description: "When you're in a bad mood, you have to laugh more! Come on, it'll bring you good luck! Smile! Hehe~" Yuyi's classmates with such an optimistic personality it can clear a cloudy sky. As the public relations person of the faculty, she's organized many activities and is the rising star of the volleyball team. Her direct and straightforward character can be somewhat offensive at times though. But her upbeat and innocent nature is hard to stay angry at.

characters.name: Yuyi
characters.description: "I've always hoped to be someone just like her. Someone as reliable and gentle as her..." The introverted protagonist of the story, an excellent university student. She really admired the tutor she had in middle school. After four years of hard work, no matter in coursework, cooking, or temperament, she did it impeccably. Her only obvious weakness shows when she plays sports... Dreaming of meeting someone just like in her otome comics, she's gradually realized just how different they are from reality.

characters.name: Yian
characters.description: "I'm happy you've come to ask me. Hopefully we can chat a bit afterwards too." Yuyi's middle school tutor, giving off a very gentle impression. The two were very close, but because of some reasons... After Yuyi graduated, they never met again. They only talk now through social media...

title: Shenshe de Baihexiang
description: “From now on… Marisa… you have move on…” “No… Reimu…Don’t go…” I take a bite of an apple… A taste of rotten apple permeated in my mouth… How long since Reimu gone? Three days? A week? Two weeks? I don’t even want to think about it… I close my eyes and fall into the river of thoughts… And yet, I cannot forget that moment… [From Steam]

characters.name: Murasawa Itsuki
characters.description: Her parents died in a car accident, and she was raised by her grandparents. Not wanting her to cause any trouble, her grandparents enrolles her in an all-girls boarding school. Her mind has trouble processing the trauma of losing her parents-- Itsuki, formerly an ordinary girl, has shut off her heart completely and tries her best to avoid any sort of relationship with others. In her new school, she always spends her time alone and doesn't make any friends, and her classmates don't seem to want to have much to do with her either. Her hobby is reading, and her grades are a little bit above average.

characters.name: Shinjou Rui
characters.description: Though her public appearance is that of a part-timer working as a teacher, her true profession is solving paranormal phenomena using ancient techniques-- that is, an exorcist. She was hired to examine the school after a certain person told her about a nest of parasitic creatures that have infested it. She has a silent and cool personality, and only ever talks when it's necessary.

title: Max's Big Bust - A Captain Nekorai Tale
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Max's Big Bust is a Life Sim/Visual Novel that follows the story of two cops, Max and Brad, as they investigate a shady new drug that's been circulating the mean streets of Axon City. So far their drug busts have turned up nothing, but after a run-in with a mysterious artefact, Max is transformed into a blonde bombshell, and he's not happy about it. How is this linked to the new synthetic drug, and where did this artefact even come from? Will Max find a way to change back, or will he be stuck as a chick for the rest of his life? [From Humble Store]

characters.name: Lorilynn
characters.description: Hailing from the neighbouring town of Siren's Point, Lorilynn is a geneticist who was transferred to Magical Response Unit due to her experience in dealing with magical based threats. Oh, and did we mention that she's also a mermaid?

characters.name: Brie
characters.description: After failing to take a magical entity seriously, Brie sarcastically asked to be able to summon cheese sandwiches out of thin air. She could have asked for heat vision or the ability to fly or any other awesome power, but she thought the whole thing was a joke and now she's stuck with quite possibly the worst power set ever invented. Brie feels understandably ripped off about the whole situation, especially considering she can't even summon different types of sandwiches, they specifically have to be grilled cheese. She's still committed to fighting evil and saving the world, but she's going to need a hell of a lot of help if she's even going to stand a chance against these invading octopus girls.

characters.name: Alluna
characters.description: Alluna was a bit luckier in the powers department, and she was blessed with the power of the moon. She fights with divine based abilities, and can do everything from punching enemies with staggering force to leaping across the room in an instant. She's a damned good fighter too, which just makes Brie feel even more useless. Even though there's a massive difference in their skill levels, the two girls are great friends, and have been ever since they went to highschool together. But fighting tentacle monsters is stressful work, and there's bound to be some bumps in the road. Especially when there's guys involved...

title: Love Tangle
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You are a credited scientist and researcher of wildlife conservation in Kaleido City. Your story begins when you move in to the luxurious apartment called Lilac Court where many celebrities reside. You take a position in a new workplace, Kaleido National Animal Institute, to save endangered species. Once you’ve moved in, you get to know many handsome and mature residents. Then, two men get close to you and begin to fight over your heart. As your heart wavers, you’ll make a decision to choose one, whom you can chase your dreams together with. Untangle the bittersweet knot of a love triangle, and find your best man! [from English Otome Games]

title: Yoru, Tomosu
description: Taisho era. This is the story of a boarding school for young ladies that stands quietly on the outskirts of town. The students there are “caged birds,” restricted from leaving the school grounds even on days off. The girls shared everything, from their loneliness and joy to their teenage melancholy. Eventually they created the “Pseudo Sisters” system—a special relationship in which two girls would exchange each other’s most valued possessions and form a sister contract until graduation. But one day, two girls who formed a contract to become “Pseudo Sisters” committed a double suicide. The two died holding the “valued possessions” said to be a symbol of the bond between them, but the teachers returned those “symbols” to their original owners and treated it as an accidental death. If we die, we can stay together forever. The wishes of these two girls who committed suicide were trampled so

characters.name: Izayoi Suzu
characters.description: A girl who lost her parents at a young age and is now living with her grandmother. She is the ace of the koto music club at Kagurahara Girls Academy and next in line to be its president. She has a cheerful personality and can get along with anyone. On the first day of summer vacation—the day everyone shared ghost stories—she started having strange dreams of herself and a “sister.”

characters.name: Sumeragi Yuuka
characters.description: A transfer student who joined the koto music club. Because her home was once a school that boasted the largest number top disciples in the koto music world, her own skills are second to none. As emotional support, she cherishes a diary about Kagurahara Girls Academy that she found when she was young. She is the spitting image of the “sister” that appears in Suzu’s dreams.

characters.name: Aoyagi Maya
characters.description: Suzu’s childhood friend who is usually reliable, but occasionally messes up. She loves Suzu and cherishes her above all else. Not only did she go attend this school because of Suzu, she also started playing koto music because of her. She is good at making sweets, but is also very timid and easily gets scared.

characters.name: Maihara Rui
characters.description: A cheerful and energetic girl who for better or worse can be quick-tempered. She was once the rising star of the track and field club, but retired after she injured her leg and joined the koto music club. She loves the club president that welcomed her in.

characters.name: Takusari Reiko
characters.description: A girl who does things calmly and at her own pace. Despite that, she is a realiable older sister-type who watches over everyone. Her grandmother is the school president.

characters.name: Kanno Tae
characters.description: The adviser for the koto music club that oversees the students. Also known as Taechan-sensei.

characters.name: Takezawa Marino
characters.description: The current president of the koto music club, who runs it under the motto, “Music is to Enjoy.” She is a dependable senpai who believes one should enjoy playing music above all, and even taught music novice Rui how to play from scratch.

characters.name: Izayoi Myouren
characters.description: An old woman and distant relative of Suzu who she lives with at the temple. She took in Suzu after her parents’ death and taught to play koto, and is like a foster parent to her. She is a high priest who is well-trusted by the locals, and while old in age, she is lively and a major lover of junk food like pizza, meat, and fried foods.

characters.name: Sayoko
characters.description: A beautiful woman with black hair who appears in Suzu’s dreams as her “older sister.” In those dreams, Suzu often sees her playing the koto by the window, and while she is the spitting image of Yuuka, her expressions and tone are kinder and warmer. She seems to be in a classroom in Kagurahara Girls Academy, but Suzu does not recognize her uniform. What is the connection between Sayoko and Suzu…?

The two died holding the “valued possessions” said to be a symbol of the bond between them, but the teachers returned those “symbols” to their original owners and treated it as an accidental death. title: Sakura Knight 3
description: After spending a couple of months in the city of Grimoire, Estelle has begun to make a name for herself as an accomplished swordswoman. She, alongside the ditzy elf Felicia, the devious catgirl Tart, and the sweet wolfgirl Rune, has taken on dozens of quests at the local guild, and has completed them all. She's come a long way from her humble beginnings in a small village bakery... but soon, Estelle will have to brave her toughest challenge to date. Deep in the woods, in a withered glade where the grass is dead and nothing grows, a disturbance is lurking. The fierce half-dragon, Saga, once an underling to the feared demon queen who ruled over Lemuria, is beginning to gather forces to avenge her fallen leader. Will Estelle and her party be able to stop Saga - and will Estelle finally be able to settle down with a cute girlfriend or three? Find out in Sakura Knight 3! [From Steam]

characters.name: Estelle
characters.description: Though a young adult in her early twenties, Estelle has spent most of her life sheltered and coddled by her overprotective parents. She dreams of being a knight like her mother, the famous Cressida, who defeated the wicked demon queen, Gunhild. She wants to become a brave knight, but her clumsiness often gets the better of her. Estelle wants dearly to be brave and strong, but she's a shy girl with self-esteem issues. Kind-hearted to a fault, she puts others before herself, and often works herself up unnecessarily. She's naïve and a little too trusting, but has a great capacity for love, and is surprisingly good at settling arguments. [Edited from Steam]

characters.name: Felicia
characters.description: Felicia is a seductive elven princess who hails from the land of Gris. As per elven custom, Felicia must travel across the land and help those in need, in order to prove herself as a worthy successor to her mother’s throne. Felicia comes from a vast family with dozens of siblings. As the oldest, she’s also the loudest, and she almost never stops talking. She’s perpetually cheerful and optimistic, and more than a little airheaded, but her skills with a sword are impeccable. [From Steam]

characters.name: Rune
characters.description: Rune is a wolfgirl who lives deep in the Lemurian forest. Her grasp of common Lemurian is somewhat shaky, and she finds it hard to communicate, but her passion always shines through. Serious and dutiful, Rune is a good ally to have. Like a guard dog, she’ll fiercely defend those she considers her comrades – but if you get on her bad side, she’ll hold a grudge for years. [From Steam]

characters.name: Tart
characters.description: Tart is a self-proclaimed 'magical cat witch'. Though she looks sweet and unassuming, she possesses incredible magical powers. Tart is mischievous and deceptive by nature. She makes a living through thievery, swindling, and stealing. She particularly loves taking advantage of cute girls – especially if she gets to see them cry. [From Steam]

description: Meike is the daughter of the noble von Essen family. Once one of the wealthiest families in Germany, the von Essen name has since been tarnished after a string of bad business decisions led them to financial ruin. Desperate to be restored to their former wealth and glory, Meike’s parents try to marry their only daughter off to the self-made businessman Walter Gerhardt. title: Noel
description: Emanon, an organization run by special military forces. The protagonist is their top soldier, nicknamed the God of Death, her name is Noel. She is given a new mission, protecting a girl attending a prestigious academy for women while remaining undercover. To accomplish this, she infiltrates the school posing as a new student.

characters.name: Yoshikawa Noel
characters.description: Noel is the main character of this novel. She is one of the best agents in the secret organization "Emanon". She is especially skilled with knives and guns. She mainly uses pair of special knives. After she had lost her older sister when she was a child, her older brother Hiroki took care of her as if she was his own daughter, therefore he became her unofficial adoptive "parent". Hiroki was also the one who made her an Emanon agent. As an agent she had to become a test subject in genetic experiments that turned her into the perfect undercover agent. The experiments made her able to transform into a black coyote with a white mane. Noel is Riri's bodyguard and schoolmate. She has romantic feelings for her and intimate feelings for Hiroki. [Translated from the Russian Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Tenzaki Riri
characters.description: Riri is a high-school student and the daughter of a director of large pharmaceutical company. Riri is cheerful, energetic and nice. She loves to eat and sleeps a lot. Riri is a childhhod friend and schoolmate of Yukino Matsui. She has romantic feelings towards Noel, her bodyguard and schoolmate. [Translated from the Russian Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Yoshikawa Hiroki
characters.description: Noel's older brother and guardian who is also an "Emanon" agent. He arranges Noel's transferring to Riri's school so she could become her bodyguard. He is experiencing intimate feelings for Noel. [Translated from the Russian Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Mochimune Takahiro
characters.description: One of Aoi's henchmen. At the beginning he tries to kidnap and kill Riri, but later on he takes their side. [Translated from the Russian Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Aoi
characters.description: Aoi is a sexually anxious middle-aged woman who is also the main antagonist of the story. She is a criminal who has been hunted by Emanon's agents for a long time. She has many henchmen. Her main goal is to kidnap Riri and become the head of the criminal world. [Translated from the Russian Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Matsui Yukino
characters.description: Yukino is Riri's childhood frend and classmate. She is good at playing the piano, and has a fiancee. [spoiler]She is raped and killed by Aoi's henchemen during the story. [Translated from the Russian Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Kohinata Takako
characters.description: A student at the academy and the head of its disciplinary committee. She is the principal's niece. She always carry with her a golden sceptre with an eagle. [Translated from the Russian Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Kousaka Shiori
characters.description: Shiori is high school student. She is a very shy and quiet girl. [spoiler]She is raped by Aoi's henchemen during the story, but they don't kill her. [Translated from the Russian Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Murakumo
characters.description: Murakumo is a former "Emanon" agent who became Aoi's ally. She is Kusanagi's older twin sister. Both of them were test subjects in a genetic research when they were "Emanon" agents. Murakumo and Kusanagi had gained the ability to transform into coyotes with red mane as a result of these tests. Murakumo fights using brass knuckles with three long blades attatched to them. She has sexual feelings towards Kusanagi. [Translated from the Russian Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Kusanagi
characters.description: Kusanagi is a former "Emanon" agent who became Aoi's ally. She is Murakumo's younger twin sister. Both of them were test subjects in a genetic research when they were "Emanon" agents. Murakumo and Kusanagi had gained the ability to transform into coyotes with red mane as a result of these tests. Kusanagi is especially skilled with long knives, and is good at close combat. She has sexual feelings towards Murakumo. [Translated from the Russian Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Kohinata Yoshiko
characters.description: Yoshiko is Takako's aunt and the principal of the high school that she attends.

full_description: Emanon, an organization run by special military forces. The protagonist is their top soldier, nicknamed the God of Death, her name is Noel. She is given a new mission, protecting a girl attending a prestigious academy for women while remaining undercover. To accomplish this, she infiltrates the school posing as a new student.

title: Futaba☆Channel 3
description: The latest title in the Futaba☆Channel series by Yumemisou. Itsuki was spending his summer vacation doing nothing at his house when one day he found himself turned into a girl thanks to a bar of soap that his osananjimi Mii was carrying. She was delighted that it worked and wanted him to play with her for one day. He agreed, thinking that she knew a way to turn him back. However, nothing happened and his summer vacation of chaos has begun. [Taken from Micchi's blogpost]

characters.name: Imamura Aoi
characters.description: Yuuki's cousin. A bright and cheerful girl.

characters.name: Kishima Tomo
characters.description: Aoi's friend from school. She's more reserved than Aoi but enjoys playful teasing now and again.

characters.name: Shiina Yuuki
characters.description: After using some mysterious soap Yuuki becomes this young girl. She needs to be careful because the flavor of mint will change her back into a man while the flavor of lemon will turn her into a girl again. She manages to get into school with Aoi and Tomo.

characters.name: Futaba
characters.description: Futaba Yuuki's female form after Nee-chan's soap turns him into a girl.

characters.name: Itsuki
characters.description: A guy who works at a cafe. He has a crush on his young neighbor Mii

characters.name: Itsuki
characters.description: Itsuki as a girl after her friend Mii gave her magical soap. Because she was bathing with Mii when she used the soap the flavor of mint is not enough to change her back into a boy. She must have sex with Mii in order to become a boy again. The flavor of lemon will change her back into a girl.

characters.name: Mii
characters.description: Itsuki's friend and neighbor. She likes Itsuki but wishes he were a girl. When she meets Futaba, Futaba gives her magic soap so her dream of playing with Itsuki as a young girl can come true. She attends the same school as Aoi, Tomo, and Yuuki.

title: Cursed Lands
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: A mysterious mist spreads from the Castle of N'Mar. The Empire sent an army to investigate, but it was destroyed. You assume the role of the Envoy, secretly serving the Grimoire Council, and must assemble a small strike team to investigate what is happening, and put a stop to whatever evil is lurking in the Caste of N'Mar. With the help of Karen, Queen of the Amazons, you'll need to recruit a team of people, united by a common goal, from all corners of Aravorn. [From Steam]

characters.name: Loren
characters.description: The Amazon Princess, heir to the throne. She is beautiful and deadly, determined and apparently without time for romance. Romanceable by Saren or Elenor.

characters.name: Apolimesho
characters.description: The Archwizard of Grimoire is a powerful old mage who will ask Loren's help to retrieve a special item.

characters.name: Karen
characters.description: The Amazon Queen, she mysteriously disappeared from the Amazon Citadel. What are the secrets behind her disappearance? Romanceable by Elenor.

characters.name: Myrth
characters.description: One of the Elder Druids of GrandTree, she is one with nature and will seek Loren's help to fight the dark elves. Romanceable by Saren.

characters.name: Breza
characters.description: Amazon Captain of the guards.

characters.name: Nuala
characters.description: Nuala is a Dunemarcher, a nomad from the desert. She is a talented shaman and an accomplished hunter. She has never been outside of the desert but has a great curiosity for what lies beyond it and wish to discover the world.

characters.name: Galan
characters.description: Galan is a dwarven berserker. He used to be a mercenary, a sellsword, though he eventually came to favor axes and hammers over swords. He is doing the best he can to make up for the sins of his past.

characters.name: Kusho
characters.description: An elf assassin. Charming fellow, good with a bow. Has something of a code of honor, he's the kind to turn down a job on moral grounds. That policy makes him a bit polarizing, as assassins go. Kusho's usually the sort to leave a calling card when finishing a job. A corrupt nobleman here, a wanted criminal there, he'll leave a way for people to get in touch if they admire his work. And besides that, he likes the recognition. he has a bit of an ego.

characters.name: Vaeril
characters.description: A fallen druid who van take the life force from the trees and make it his own to fuel his magic. Rather than sharing energy with the forest, he saps it. Because of his sinister powers, the elves have banished him from their territory and he is now living in exile, alone, hiding in the woods. Those who have met him tell that he has the eyes of a sad man, one with more regrets than they're sure de'd care to share. He's hunted by Kusho, a talented assassin.

title: Hitori Korosu no mo Futari Korosu no mo Onaji Koto da to Omou kara
title_original: 1人殺すのも2人殺すのも同じことだと思うから
description: In January, Misuzu loses her house and mother to a fire. Because of that, she has to transfer schools in the third semester. Living alone. A new town, a new school, new friends. Full of anxiety, Misuzu's new life begins. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Inreki Misuzu
characters.description: A quiet girl with little self-confidence. She has a special place in her heart for her friends.

characters.name: Kasumi
characters.description: A member of the Occult Research Club. She has a cheerful personality and can get along with anyone.

characters.name: Tsurukawa Umemi
characters.description: Member of the Student Council, Swimming Club, and Class President. Helpful and caring towards others.

characters.name: Shin'yuri Kishun
characters.description: Kagetsu's younger sister. An obedient girl that loves to read.

characters.name: Shin'yuri Kagetsu
characters.description: Kishun's older sister. A strong-willed girl that loves her sister.

characters.name: Ikuta Koharu
characters.description: A mysterious girl that follows Misuzu around.

characters.name: Inreki Haruma
characters.description: A girl that seems to hate and fear Misuzu.

characters.name: Shibuya Satsuki
characters.description: Student council treasurer. A girl skilled at programming.

characters.name: Saginuma Matsuna
characters.description: [spoiler]Matsuna (松奈) is her original surname; Shuka (首夏) is initially revealed to be her given name, but later implied to be just another pseudonym she came up with, leaving her real name unknown.

characters.name: Inreki Mifuyu
characters.description: Haruma's quiet and shy twin sister.

characters.name: Nagatsuta Sakumo
characters.description: Koharu's ally. A specialist at gathering information.

characters.name: Sakurai Nanayo
characters.description: Vice-president of the student council. Stands at the top of her grade in terms of physical ability.

characters.name: Saginuma Haru
characters.description: [spoiler]She is one of several clones of Saginuma Haru. She is the Saginuma Haru of the 9th World.

characters.name: Inreki
characters.description: [spoiler]Her full name is Inreki Isuzu (陰暦弥涼). She is the 9th Isuzu, a clone of Inreki Misuzu in charge of the 9th World.

characters.name: Saginuma Haru
characters.description: [spoiler]Koharu and Haruma's child. She is the original Saginuma Haru.

title: Life After Magic
description: Being an adult sucks! Life was so much easier when Akiko was saving the world with her magical girl squad, the Sentinels. Now she's stuck working a boring retail job, watching the days creep closer to Y2K. She’s lost touch with her high school friends, her powers, and herself. Where has the magic gone? [From itch.io]

title: Yao Lai Dian Baihe Ma - Love Yuri
title_original: 要来点百合吗 Love Yuri
tags: Protagonist's Non-blood-related Sister as a Heroine
description: Shu Yu, a popular writer who has no romantic experience but loves writing yuri love stories, becomes sisters with Lu Xi, an otaku and experienced online voice actress. Although they share a strong bond, their relationship becomes awkward due to their own secrets. However, when Lu Xi accidentally discovers that her favorite yuri author is actually her sister Shu Yu, she becomes increasingly attracted to her personality and a forbidden romance unfolds between them... [From Steam]

title: Set Yourself on Fire
description: A quiet town awaits death. Stagnation is the default state of being. Those who dare to hope are seen as demented. Two aimless young women fall in love. I lost my soul somewhere along the line. It must have slipped, fallen into a storm drain, vanished. It dissipated in that putrid water. [From itch.io]

title: Heart of Fire
description: The three travellers had never met each other before being captured by monsters, but they now have one thing in common: their struggle to escape from hostile lands together. A goofy overblown love story about killing orcs and letting the fire in your heart keep you strong.

title: Gender Bender DNA Twister Extreme
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: On a peaceful summer day, no one expected this to happen. A freak accident in the Abbadon Pharmaceuticals lab left six lab employees and one innocent bystander exploring their lifes as the opposite sex. [From IndieDB]

title: The Elevator Game with Catgirls
description: The Elevator Game is a ritual that is said to give the player access to another world by following a strict set of rules. Motivated by a bet made with her classmate, Asahi's girlfriend Kirin decides to give the game a try. As Asahi waits outside of the building that Kirin chose to perform the ritual in, she starts to experience some confusing and unexplainable things... Kirin fails to return that day, or the day after. Feeling somehow guilty as though Kirin's disappearance might be her fault, Asahi determines to try and find her missing girlfriend... by playing the Elevator Game herself. Will your choices help find her? [From Itch.io]

title: Shut-in Vampire
description: Oh no! Mayu’s in a pinch! She’s woefully behind on paying the rent, and her scary landlady, Miss Himemiya, has issued an ultimatum. Mayu needs to earn ¥100,000 by the end of October, or she’ll be kicked out! Being evicted from her home would be bad enough, but Mayu has a secret: she’s actually a vampire. Mayu hasn’t been a vampire for a full year yet, and the church is keeping close tabs on her to ensure she’s been behaving herself. According to the stone-faced Sister Juriel, it’s the church’s standard policy to execute all vampires without a fixed address, lest they start roaming the streets causing chaos. If Mayu can’t pay the rent in time, she won’t just wind up homeless: she’ll be executed! What’s a fledgeling vampire to do? Assume control of Mayu and manage these tumultuous two weeks of her life. title: Konayuki Fururi ~Yuzuhara-chou Curling-bu~
title_original: こなゆき ふるり　～柚子原町カーリング部～
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: There is a small town located in the country. Tetsuya lives a boring life there. One day, he is appointed to a coach of a curling team. He doesn't want to do that, but he reluctantly accepts it. His players are all pretty, but older than him. Also, they are beginners like him. Like this, his busy life begins.... [From ErogeShop]

characters.name: Matsushima Koyuki
characters.description: Tetsuya’s neighbor and childhood best friend. Koyuki is a temperamental woman who isn’t afraid to speak her mind, although she finds it difficult to express her feelings properly. Koyuki was a talented competition ice skater of breathless caliber, but suffered a leg injury that dashed aspirations. [Taken from Nargrakhan's review.]

characters.name: Nakahara Asami
characters.description: Oblivious to her statuesque beauty, Asami is a quiet and emotionally reserved individual. While she maintains healthy interest in ice sports, Asami devotes most days and nights on her family’s private dairy farm. [Taken from Nargrakhan's review.]

characters.name: Kinoshita Tomomi
characters.description: An unwaveringly compassionate housekeeping genius, the maternal Tomomi draws attention from every man who catches a glimpse of her: Tetsuya being no exception. Much about Tomomi’s habits and personal life are well hidden, adding an air of mystique to her natural charisma. [Taken from Nargrakhan's review.]

characters.name: Midou Iori
characters.description: Class president of the graduating class, well-to-do Iori is daughter of the municipal councilman. Easily befriended and strongly devoted towards friends, her straightforward honesty is hard to disagree with. [Taken from Nargrakhan's review.]

characters.name: Yoshioka Saeko
characters.description: Secretly harboring romantic feelings towards him, Saeko is one of Tetsuya’s classmates. Due to her father’s line of work, the young student constantly finds herself moving from one town to another, yet always finds a means to adapt and persevere. [Taken from Nargrakhan's review.]

characters.name: Narashino Saki
characters.description: Saki is the captain of a rival out of town team, who has taken an unusual interest in Tetsuya and his skaters. [Taken from Nargrakhan's review.]

characters.name: Hoshino Rintarou
characters.description: Tetsuya’s stepfather and proprietor of the popular Snow Fairy Maid Café, Rintarou is an unusual fellow. His hobbies include sexually admiring other men, eavesdropping, bodybuilding, philanthropy, and offering advice. Fortunately his wildest eccentrics are strictly curbed by his wife. [Taken from Nargrakhan's review.]

characters.name: Takizawa Sasuga

title: Palais de Reine
description: The player acts as the young princess of a kingdom who never expected to ascend to the throne. In the last year, her father died, and her older brother went missing. During the coronation ceremony, some of the leaders of the 12 provinces in the kingdom say they don't believe she can lead the country, and refuse to give their allegiance. The aim of the game is to win over enough leaders over a year to be accepted as the kingdom's ruler. This can be accomplished through different ways, including sending gifts, having your knights challenge the leaders to jousting competitions, and trying to assassinate them. You must also keep your kingdom fairly prosperous and quell civil disturbances and unrest. While doing this, you can also 'romance' characters, including the 12 leaders and your knights. [From: Wikipedia]

characters.name: Filia
characters.description: The fifteen-year-old princess. The blood of the legendary King of Knights fills her veins, and her true abilities are yet unknown.

characters.name: Eclair
characters.description: Though a member of the royal family, she relinquished her right to succeed the throne to become the princess's lady in waiting. Everything she does, she does for the princess's happiness.

characters.description: A consul who is always beside the princess to support her. Devoting himself to the royal family like his father before him, he will not fold to any temptation.

characters.name: Astrad
characters.description: The young man thought to succeed the councilor. Though his skills are not yet up to par, he has the potential and a bright future.

characters.name: Evangile
characters.description: A flighty young knight who is always hitting on women. His skilled tongue makes him a master at winning hearts and minds.

characters.name: Elliot
characters.description: A boy knight who ascended to the head of one of the most prestigious families in the land at a young age. Though a child and lacking in health, he is skilled in combat and politics.

characters.name: Van
characters.description: A boorish youth who was the prince's bodyguard. His overwhelming toughness has people saying he is like a bull.

characters.name: Ilya
characters.description: A young man with a foreign air to him. Though noble and difficult to deal with, he has the abilities to make it worth it.

characters.name: Walter
characters.description: A veteran royal guard to the former king. Though well-loved by the people, his expenses are high. Hiring him will cost quite the sum of funds.

characters.name: Diktor
characters.description: The most powerful figure in the kingdom. Even key players in foreign lands respect his political abilities. His methods are insidious and precise.

characters.name: Kurokizoku
characters.description: Leader of the Dunkelheit in the outskirts of the land. Fickle and cruel.

characters.name: Wiginty
characters.description: The kingdom's representative of the mysterious organization, the Forum. "All for the future of the children of men."

characters.name: Silvestre
characters.description: Old friend to the king and self-appointed guardian of the princess. Though quick to draw the sword in his younger days, he has calmed down of late.

characters.name: Auberge
characters.description: Lord of a house particularly esteemed among the others. A captive to beauty and music, he sometimes lets his passions run wild.

characters.name: Epidote
characters.description: An old lord with a rather unpleasant personality. He has little interest in the affairs of the world and spends most of his time locked in his room.

characters.name: Bastian
characters.description: A lord who can depend only on the prestige of his old family and his connections to the councilor. Completely spoiled and unable to take care of himself. Though, he is kind to those he accepts...

characters.name: Willem
characters.description: A cowardly but gentle young knight. His abilities are limited, but his family is wealthy and he is able to support himself.

characters.name: Clemens
characters.description: A blind lord who rules over southern land. A vigorous learner, he boasts a deep knowledge. Combat is not his strong suit, however.

characters.name: Wenzel
characters.description: An earnest bodybuilder ever-looking to bulk himself up. Though loved by his people for his generous policies, some regard him with contempt...

characters.name: Lucien
characters.description: A boy who succeeded his fallen parents as lord. He has a sensitive side to him, and few have seen him smile.

characters.name: Orlov
characters.description: A werewolf knight. His kind boast combat potential surpassing human abilities, but he is still young and incomplete in body and mind.

characters.description: A genius knight blessed with high martial talent. He is sickly and often bedridden, but he is said to be the strongest young knight in the land when given a lance on a horse.

characters.description: Previously known as a lady's man, now he avoids the spotlight due to a bad leg.

characters.description: A warrior said to be a hero from a faraway kingdom to the south. Brought into our kingdom due to connections here, he lives as a knight.

characters.description: Not much stands out about this quiet knight-errant. He is looking for a stable employer to support his beloved family.

characters.description: A knight who is unmoved by the amount of infamy he has built up. If you hire him, be ready for the dishonor that he will bring.

characters.description: An easygoing, cheerful young knight. He is always with his beloved cat. He has average abilities, but is not so skilled that you can rely on him.

characters.name: Cornelius
characters.description: A young knight who is a bit lacking in etiquette. Although he hails from a good family, he seems to keep unfortunate company often.

characters.name: Lodvic
characters.description: A ghostly lord who works without rest. His unique attributes have given him a different outlook on life from most people, making him difficult to keep up with.

characters.name: Adelaide
characters.description: A sturdy woman who rules over her territory in her deceased husband's stead. She has the ability to joust as any other knight.

characters.name: Guy
characters.description: An isolated knight who always trains alone, seeking to reach the height of martial prowess. Rumored to be the strongest of humankind, he can be trusted with anything that requires muscle.

characters.name: Hugues
characters.description: A young knight who wishes to raise through the ranks. Though his abilities do not match his confidence and he lacks etiquette, there is something special about his ambition.

characters.name: Sigmund
characters.description: The hero who fought with Kurokizoku many years ago and rebuffed his invasion. Now elderly, he does not possess a fraction of his old strength.

title: Clockwork City
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Enter the world of Clockwork City. Follow a day in the life of Edyta a Roof Runner new to her job, and explore her blossoming friendships in a city full of intrigue and fantasy! The story begins with Edyta talking into a Chronodict, an audio recording device, leaving a message for her parents that she is safe, and about to being her work, when she is interrupted by Roz, a runner who has two metal hands and lower arms, and, who was the person who trained Edyta to run the rooftops. She is experienced and eager to see the woman do well, but has an intense dislike of those below the rooftops. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Edyta
characters.description: She's a Dray, she can be brave when it comes to threats of violence or danger, preferring to use her physical skills and strengths as she can rely on those, over her social skills which are lacklustre, thanks to her sheltered life, living with her parents. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Roz
characters.description: She is sarcastic but affectionate to other Dray, she sees them all as a large family. She will go out of her way to help a Dray, and to teach about Roof Running. She has been in Clockwork City all her life, and she has grown to dislike the humans below her. She had a terrible incident when she was a child, and it has forever coloured her image of humans. She has her burdens, but she masks them well, and she dotes on Edyta, treating her like a younger sister. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Nikolai
characters.description: He is a thief, but of the aladdin type. He is a scoundrel, but he won't hurt people or take from those that can't afford to have things taken. Naturally, it's left him a little worse off, but he takes his moral code seriously. He masks himself behind an upbeat air, pretending to be a gentleman thief, but in actuality, he's just a scared kid doing what he has to in order to survive. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

title: Quantum Conscience
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Within a galaxy of terraformed planets, a secret war rages between two intergalactic agencies. One of them—ARCHON—is developing the technology to invade people’s minds. They have already tyrannized a planet called Teballai, and hope to use their mind-reading technology to spread their power across the galaxy. A second organization—FOE (Freedom Organization of Elites)—wants to destroy ARCHON’s technology in the name of freedom. When a young FOE soldier (you choose the gender) named Blaire obtains the ability to read minds from an ARCHON experiment, she finds her loyalty torn between both sides. Whether Blaire helps the enemy or defeats them depends upon your use of her power.

characters.name: Veramus Polemai
characters.description: Veramus grew up on Teballai alongside Blaire as a privileged Cypher-P in the Q’s palace. While Blaire was mischievous and unruly, Veramus tended to follow the rules and behave with conservative elegance. He took pride in his station as a politician and sought to earn it rather than take it for granted. But despite–or perhaps because of–their differences, Veramus and Blaire grew up as close friends. However, Veramus was always jealous of Blaire’s ability to effortlessly synch with mind-meld machines, which made Blaire the Q’s favorite pupil. When Veramus was sixteen, Blaire vanished without a trace. Veramus was extremely distraught and fell into a deep depression. He didn’t understand what had happened or why, which threw everything he believed about the world into question. He made it his mission to maintain order and power so that nothing like that would ever happen again. [From officia

characters.name: Blaire Pollack
characters.description: Blaire Pollack grew up on Teballai as a Cypher-P: the second-highest rank in Teballaian society under the dictator (Cypher-Q) himself. As such, she lived a life of great luxury and privilege. She dwelt within the tall Q’s tower in the center of Jumeni, Teballai’s capital city. At any time, she could call upon helots or gorgans to do her bidding. If a helot disobeyed her, that person could be punished harshly–even killed for showing disrespect. Despite all her power, Blaire’s primary concerns in life were playing games, spending time with friends, and generally having fun. The dictator of Teballai, Delim Quallebus, prized Blaire above all his Cypher-Ps because she possessed an effortless ability to synchronize her thoughts with mind-meld machines. Blaire did not know or care that the ease with which she synched with machines made her the ideal candidate for a top-secret project called Qua

characters.name: Korah Tobiah
characters.description: Korah grows up as a slave of Teballaian society, or helot, working as a tailor. She spends her childhood in a factory with other Cypher-Ts mending clothes and running machinery. At the end of each day, she must allow her mind to be scanned by computers for thoughts of rebellion. Only if she is judged fully submissive will the Militar provide her with Sol-sickness medicine, a necessary supplement to survive the toxic atmosphere of Teballai. Korah is a young woman when she meets Veramus, a powerful Cypher-P who has lost his best friend. The two bond unexpectedly, and Veramus goes to her for companionship while providing some protection. Their tenuous relationship is strained when Blaire appears after missing for six years, and tells them both that he can help them escape from the planet altogether. [From official site]

characters.name: Amalek Nikat
characters.description: Amalek is a high-ranking commander, or Lead, within the FOEs. He grew up on the water planet of Alqualin, where most people live within underwater cities. When he was old enough, he wanted to escape the cold dark depths of the ocean and sail the high seas. After doing that for a few years, he wanted to ascend further and explore the galaxy. Soon after that, he learned of the FOEs and eagerly joined their cause. [From official site]

characters.name: Mierol Deya
characters.description: Mierol was born on Ludebba, also known as the Planet of Quiet. Thick black clouds reign over the entire atmosphere of Ludebba, casting a dark web of shadows on the landscape underneath. Once a year on different times across the planet, the clouds part to flood the land beneath with sunlight. The plants that grow in Ludebba soak up the solar energy and store enough of it to sustain them for the rest of the year. This is known as a Sun Bath. When darkness returns, the plants and flowers glow enough to cast some light on the landscape. Because the plants of Ludebba are so good at storing solar energy, they are extremely valuable to outsiders. When Mierol was eight years old, her home city was raided by a group of space pirates known as the Pilfyres. They came to collect the precious plants of Ludebba shortly after a Sun Bath, mercilessly killing anyone who stood in their way. One of the Pil

characters.name: Crain Orso'an
characters.description: Crain Orso’an is an engineer and mechanic who works for the FOEs. His love for machines surpasses all else in his life, and he is much more interested in them than other people. For this reason, he can often come across as anti-social. [From official site]

full_description: Within a galaxy of terraformed planets, a secret war rages between two intergalactic agencies. One of them—ARCHON—is developing the technology to invade people’s minds. They have already tyrannized a planet called Teballai, and hope to use their mind-reading technology to spread their power across the galaxy. A second organization—FOE (Freedom Organization of Elites)—wants to destroy ARCHON’s technology in the name of freedom. When a young FOE soldier (you choose the gender) named Blaire obtains the ability to read minds from an ARCHON experiment, she finds her loyalty torn between both sides. Whether Blaire helps the enemy or defeats them depends upon your use of her power.

characters.description: The debonair face of the Harlowe empire is more than he seems on the surface. Behind the glittering man who has it all lurks a terrifying darkness. He would destroy anything and anyone who gets in his way. Can you earn a higher place in Vincent's heart than his ambition?

characters.description: When they turn their passion toward you, the cracks in their lifelong bond threaten to destroy them. Only with your help can wounds they left on one another heal. Can you survive the depth of their love, or will you dance into the abyss too? [From Itch.io]

characters.description: The well-bred Will has come to Los Angeles for the films, the culture, the weather, and, of course, the jazz. After leading a tightly prescribed life as a firstborn English aristocrat, Will desperately seeks the freedom he has been denied. Will you accept your fates or rebel against them together?

characters.description: Milo is known throughout the Los Angeles underworld as an alluring figure, but one not to cross twice. Fiercely loyal to those close to him and ready to do anything to protect them, Milo falls for you right away. Can you make him see you as more than a possession? [From Itch.io]

characters.description: Abandoned as a baby in the woods to the south of Icesilia, Amber was found and raised by a witch called Vin. She spent all her life in the woods, never venturing beyond its borders at the insistence of her adoptive mother. The Dark Elf grew up wanting to be a witch like her mother but Vin would not allow her to practice magic, instead concentrating on teaching her how to brew potions and other aspects of alchemy. When Amber turned sixteen, her mother announced it was time for her to see the world and she had arranged an apprenticeship with the legendary mage Haros of Icesilia to help her become a true master alchemist. Amber has a natural talent for Alchemy. She has a knack for finding ingredients and a phenomenal memory that allows her to remember anything she has read. As a person, she tends not to show her emotions all that much and her natural expression tends to give the impression

characters.description: Despite her age in human years, Ruby is regarded as extremely young for a vampire and still clings to her humanity because of that. Despite these things, she and her brother are well respected in the small vampire community that live in Icesilia. Her word carries a lot of weight and she’s not afraid to use her influence to get what she wants. Outside of vampiric politics, Ruby finds herself fascinated by Amber and strikes up a friendship with her after a few chance encounters. Over the years, she finds it harder to resist the urge to feed of mortals and so asks Amber to find a way to return her to human form. Such a request is not without its perils but she knows without a cure she will soon lose what humanity she has left. Ruby is an extremely outgoing person who enjoys flirting with members of any sex. As a human, she was a dancer and she still shows signs of that in the way she moves

description: Buffalo Seer is an eccentric Abnormal with the ability to see the future. They’ve been living their life within an Abnormal Society, called the Walled Sanctuary, since they were a baby. While they generally can’t complain about their comfortable existence, Seer has one major issue in life: not being able to use their ability. Even within Abnormal societies future seeing is forbidden. Despite endless warnings of the misfortune future seeing can cause, Seer could not be swayed and after many years of petitioning they finally gained permission to take a relatively brief look into their own future, with a few stipulations. The story begins as Seer sees some years ahead and gets a rather unexpected vision. Not only are they no longer within the Sanctuary, they're married to someone they've never met. After that was achieved there was no plan, Seer simply expected to be satisfied with life. However, upon seeing what the future holds Seer immediately created a new goal, finding their future spouse. But then after finding them Seer decided they’d have to get married before they could be fully content. Once that inevitably occurs, who knows? Within the group Seer is generally considered a liability, but not for lack of ability. Because Seer dresses in such an attention drawing way and sides with their future spouse in nearly every situation regardless of whether it is a good idea or not, Seer doesn’t often make the trip easier. characters.description: [Pronounced ‘KAY’] Kea is a police officer who recently transferred to the capital of Vespen in order to work undercover. The job requires an officer to infiltrate a street gang that mainly recruits young teens off the street, hence the outfit they’ve got on. Kea was requested specifically due to their youthful stature and fitting personality, since in informal situations Kea is chatty, fast-talking, and can easily come across as rude or uncultured. While on the job Kea speaks and behaves (somewhat) more seriously. They are the reluctant leader of the ill-fated adventure. The responsibility of managing others is brand new to Kea and they tend to come across as more of a worrywart and sort of a nag than a boss. Despite technically being in charge, they are the black sheep of the group. While everyone else is perfectly comfortable bending or even out right breaking the law Kea is, naturall

characters.name: Piper
characters.description: Mapmaker and item collector extraordinaire Piper wouldn’t normally have a reason to be in the capital, however this is an unusual time for her. She is currently on hiatus. She chose to take a break because constant work had worn her down. Before she felt duty call and joined the adventure she had been spending her days wearing nice clothing and drinking tea while discussing good books with pleasant ladies. However, Piper has no intention of wasting time sulking over the loss of the last part of her time off from ruin trekking. In fact, she doesn’t seem to ever spend time being in a poor mood. Piper could be considered second in command of the tiny team, or the true leader if Kea isn’t listening. characters.description: January is a man of massive importance and wealth in the region of Vespen, though only due to inheriting it. He has been the Duke of a significant family ever since his mother passed away a few years prior. That title is no longer bestowed and every other house in Vespen that had the title at one point has had the lineage die out. With an heirless only child as a Duke, January’s family is currently one step away from joining those other houses in being stripped of their clout. The weight of being the last true noble in the region has not been lost on January. January lives on the surface and has only recently started making appearances on the land fractions. He is noticeably awkward in casual settings as he generally only has experience dealing with people in a business sense. Every employee has a set wage, time off, health coverage, etc. The reason this criminal gang functions this way is because Trinette’s background is mainly in finances. After working for many reputable companies she decided to start a company of her own. She chose a bounty hunting gang simply because it was a position that needed to be filled in the area. If you can look past all her wrongdoing and not take what she does in her job personally, Trinette is a rather amiable woman. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

title: Us Lovely Corpses
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: Marisol Flores is a girl with a curse. A bizarre and incredibly powerful monster has taken a liking to her, and is now obsessed with kidnapping her. Every so often it appears, takes over the Flores household, and holds her hostage in the attic. To be frank, it's all gotten a little old. Alejandra de Rosa is the girl with a cure. At the very least, she's a neophyte witch who has the power and knowledge to fend off weird beasts and save pretty damsels. She's served as assistant for years to her grandmother, a powerful witch who has walked these halls many times before, driving the monster back and saving Marisol. This time, however, Alex will be doing this on her own. It's a routine job... so why do things feel a little more dire than usual today? US LOVELY CORPSES is a short surreal-horror-romance visual novel about helping a friend. Go through the house, cut the roses, and save the girl.

[From itch.io]
