title: Sakura Forest Girls 2
description: Join Yaya and Aiyana in the second part of the Sakura Forst Girls series, as they continue to search for their missing friend, Koko. Locating her should be an easy task now they’ve enlisted the help of the witch Maia, but they soon find themselves in a sticky situation…

characters.name: Yaya
characters.description: Yaya is the main character of the story. Her parents were both hunters, and she prides herself on her skills with her spear. Cheerful and optimistic, Yaya is unfailingly certain that she'll find Koko again. She is fiercely protective of Aiyana, and will challenge anybody who dares make her uncomfortable - even a powerful witch like Maia.

characters.name: Aiyana
characters.description: Aiyana is a shy, softly-spoken girl born to a family of shamans. Her hair is pure white, which is unusual in the village from where she hails. As a result of her strange looks, she was often bullied during her youth. Aiyana has no fighting prowess, and has a weak constitution. She tires easily, and often needs to rely on Yaya, to her embarrassment. She worries frequently about burdening Yaya, but Yaya is quick to reassure her. Unbeknownst to Aiyana, it is because of her steadfast support that Yaya is able to remain so eternally optimistic.

characters.name: Maia
characters.description: Maia is a sneaky, devious witch of an indeterminable age. She speaks rarely of her past, and is shrouded in mystery, which makes her hard to trust. She is exceedingly powerful (or so she claims), and can accomplish truly impressive feats with her magic... But that is only if she feels like it. Maia loves flirting with cute girls more than anything, and she's very hands-on. She and Yaya often butt heads over this, and they can often be found bickering.

characters.name: Arie
characters.description: Arie is the young, inexperienced princess of the village where Yaya, Aiyana, and Maia find themselves in their search for Koko. She appears graceful and dignified, but gets flustered easily, and often worries about making a good impression upon others. Arie is highly respected among her people, but she has no genuine friends. Her subjects revere her too much to consent to using her first name, and insist upon calling her ‘your highness’. Arie tries to act as though this does not bother her, but deep down, she desperately desires a friend. [From Steam]

characters.name: Imala
characters.description: Imala is Arie's high priestess, and her chief advisor. Older than she appears, and significantly more experienced than Arie, Imala is well-poised to give sage advice whenever it is needed. Imala possesses a good deal of magical prowess, but how powerful she is remains a mystery. Imala is rarely seen without a smile, but there's something shadowy lurking beneath it. [From Steam]

characters.name: Koko
characters.description: Koko is Yaya and Aiyana's childhood friend. She's a kind, considerate girl who cares a good deal for her friends, and she's sensitive about the feelings of others. Koko is gifted at cooking and cleaning, but she's similarly skilled with a bow and arrow. Gentle though she is, she has no hesitation when it comes to hunting, and her skills might even rival those of Yaya's. She has something of a stubborn streak despite her sweet face, and she used to act as a mother figure to Yaya, chastising her whenever she made a nuisance of herself. [Edited from Steam]

description: BanG Dream! Girls Band Project 2022 April's Fools game. Uehara Himari is a normal high school girl attending Garupa Private Academy. At this academy, there is a cherry blossom tree which blooms once every ten years. They say that if you wish for happiness together with someone special to you under that tree, your wish will surely come true. Himari searches for her destined partner at this academy. "This is a very important choice to me. This moment comes only once in ten years. The one I want to spend it with is..." [From Official site]

characters.name: Uehara Himari
characters.description: A normal girl who believes in the legend of the cherry blossom tree. A second-year student at Garupa Private Academy and the main character of this game. Always cheerful, bright, and authentic with everyone, she has many friends at school. Her grades are as average as they come. A member of the Tennis Club. title_original: 吸血鬼の花嫁 The Novel Game
description: We set our scene in the Meiji era. Having lost her grandmother, Shirafuji Sana found herself completely alone. With nowhere else to go and nothing to eat, she turned to the Imperial Army and its strange 'bride thorn' program. Bride thorns are girls offered up as rations to the Vampdolls - blood-drinking women conscripted into the Army as its fiercest soldiers. Starved, desperate and completely unaware, Sana was made to sign an enlistment contract, only to be promptly introduced to Hanafusa Yukine, a beautiful, yet scornful Vampdoll. At first, the two were far from an ideal match. With time, however, little by little, they began opening their hearts to one another. On their first night, they learned just how exhilarating - physically, emotionally - sucking blood can be. This came as a shock, but the two, awkwardly, trustingly, successfully made it through their first feeding. Not long aft

characters.name: Shirafuji Sana
characters.description: Sana is Yukine's bride thorn. The two first became acquainted in a meeting arranged by the Army, where she was ordered to attend to the Vampdoll. Initially, she had no idea how to handle the stubborn Yukine, but over time the two grew closer. Sana's a bit of a tomboy. Despite that, she is shy and tends to stutter, only feeling herself around those she's close to. She's the type who's surprisingly steady in a pinch, but just as flaky in fair weather. She's best friends with Ao and the only one who can keep Yukine in check. [Translated from the official description. Official translation can be found on Steam.]

characters.name: Hanafusa Yukine
characters.description: Yukine is a former noblewoman and a Vampdoll. She is brimming with confidence and is no less of a fighter than Ibuki, though she can be a bit naïve about the world sometimes. Talented and hardworking, she always sticks to her word. At heart, Yukine is a graceful and well-behaved lady. Nevertheless, the more she likes a girl, the more she ends up teasing her. Incidentally, she's head over heels for Sana. [Translated from the official description. Official translation can be found on Steam.]

characters.name: Shinokura Ao
characters.description: Ao and Ibuki were raised in the same orphanage, making her both Ibuki's childhood friend and bride thorn. While they were kids, the two played around in the forest and stumbled into a werewolf, managing to survive by the skin of their teeth. Ao's sense of smell is sharper than most, allowing her to track the enemy effortlessly. That said, put a gun in her hand and she struggles to hit the side of a barn. She's starting to develop romantic feelings for Ibuki, who remains blissfully unaware of the fact. [Translated from the official description. Official translation can be found on Steam.]

characters.name: Ninomiya Ibuki
characters.description: With the onset of vampiric symptoms, Ibuki turned into a Vampdoll and was conscripted into the Army. There, she showed herself to be gifted with the blade, amassing an impressive kill count while she was still a fresh recruit. Her marksmanship, however, is nothing much to write home about. She's beautiful, but straight-laced to a fault. Being bad with all things romantic, she tries to avoid sucking blood due to the accompanying arousal. This leaves her feeling peckish most of the time. Ibuki feels indebted towards her childhood friend Ao, who became her bride thorn. She tends to run her mouth about 'protecting her' as a result. [Translated from the official description. Official translation can be found on Steam.]

characters.name: Tsumugi Mio
characters.description: Mio is Shiina's bride thorn. Diagnosed with a genetic disorder, she seemed destined for an early grave. Being fed on by a Vampdoll, however, is helping her stay alive. She is the daughter of a noble family that earned their wealth and social status in the steel industry. This has left Mio with connections in the Army brass and various privileges on the one hand, and feeling disgusted with her family's obsession with money and power on the other. She's reliable, but can be a bit thorny at times. [Translated from the official description. Official translation can be found on Steam.]

characters.name: Samura Shiina
characters.description: Shiina is a Vampdoll. She's aloof and charming - and, when it comes to women, an unrepentant flirt. Shiina originally wanted to be a doctor, but the onset of vampirism made her give up on this dream. Later, in light of her military achievements (and good charms), she was given special permission to attend a medical school, where she successfully obtained a license. Truly, a woman of talent. She and the former noble Yukine are actually cousins, but since her father refused to recognise her as his daughter, she was left to grow up in poverty. She's a hard worker, but doesn't like others knowing about it. [Translated from the official description. Official translation can be found on Steam.]

Like this place, my sister closed herself off from the world long ago, drifting in space until gravity brought her down. She escaped with her life intact, but fell into a coma. And now I, Hoomuku Tooku, and my friend Mizuumi Shizuku, are looking for the reason that my sister fell -- [Edited from DLSite English]

title: Angel Wings
description: Angel Wings is a Kdrama-inspired visual novel exploring themes of isolation, dependence, and autonomy set in an unfamiliar new city. As the player, you begin your journey from rock bottom -- no job, no friends and no motivation — but upon answering a mysterious phone call, you awaken in an unknown place filled with new faces. Through intricate relationships and thoughtful introspection, you will experience love, catharsis, or heartbreak. Will you soar to new heights, or fly too close to the sun? [From Steam]

description: The Kingdom of Novus has been thrown into disarray, and it's up to you to decide if you’ll help to bring peace, or if you’ll stoke the fires of chaos. Enter a high fantasy world steeped in political intrigue; where magic touches the land and blood turns the wheels unseen. Dishonor & betrayal. Hope & despair. Pick a side, and meet your match. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Livia Vasile
characters.description: Occupation: Knight Commander Height: 5'8" Alignment: Lawful Neutral Star Sign: Aries Characteristics: Cool, calm, cold but not cruel, committed to her duty to an almost ruthless degree Affiliation: The Crown Livia is an imposing presence in the kingdom; Novus' dark knight suffers no fools, and she is unquestionably committed to her duty as newly appointed Knight Commander. Her loyalty to the crown is unwavering, but Livia has her weaknesses just like everyone else does. Feeling betrayed by her former commander's actions, she sets out to prove herself and ensure that she does not exist under his tainted shadow. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Erik Nyström
characters.description: Occupation: Bounty Hunter Height: 6'4 Alignment: Lawful Good Star Sign: Cancer Characteristics: Jaded, tired, wise, kind, patient Affiliation: None Erik has lost his way after being discharged from his duty as Knight Commander. He's been exiled from the palace, has lost the trust of those he held dear, and now he resides among the 'normal folk' of Novus. He makes coin by taking contracts as a bounty hunter, and he's damn good at it, as long as he's sober... or awake. [From Kickstarter] Erik can be romanced on his own or as part of a polyamorous route with Maja.

characters.name: Maja Olayinka
characters.description: Occupation: Court Magician Height: 5'7 Alignment: Neutral Good Star Sign: Capricorn Characteristics: Poised, polite, intelligent, kind Affiliation: The Crown Maja hails from a highly respected noble family, but has no interest in using her familiy's name to get places. She's her own person, and she's determined to serve the crown with poise and grace. Painfully smart and kind, Maja educates the magically inclined citizens of Novus and assists with research and ensuring that the kingdom is safe, no matter what. [From Kickstarter] Maja can be romanced on her own or as part of a polyamorous route with Erik.

characters.name: Raiden
characters.description: Occupation: Assassin Height: 6' Alignment: Chaotic Neutral Star Sign: Scorpio Characteristics: Flighty, playful, charming, distracted Affiliation: Hand of the Serpent Raiden, at first glance, is a strange, unassuming young man. Though, if the rumors are true, he's actually Novus' infamous 'Snake in the Shadows'; an assassin so deadly that even other assassins fear him. You can decide if you think the title is befitting of him, but there's no doubt that you'll have an incredibly interesting time in his company. characters.description: Shion is the best student in her class and the protagonist of the story. She won't let anyone near her because she was left disappointed in people a long time ago. Her life is boring and monotonous: during the day she goes to school, and in the evenings she sits by the window and listens to her favorite music. title: Snowed IN
description: The human body has limitations. Flesh is weak. In a world where even common citizens are enhanced to overcome their drawbacks, Sigma is a pioneer, an elite soldier more machine than human, as alluring as she is deadly. But not everybody sees this cyber-frenzy with a positive eye… Sigma gets tasked with supervising the final exam of a promising cadet. Seems easy enough. The problem? The two of them are polar opposites. While Sigma is an elite cyborg, Linde is all natural. Her body is slowed down by cold and hunger, and by desires… Don't opposites attract each other? What is that glint in Linde’s eyes every time Sigma catches her staring? Your choices determine the success of Sigma and Linde’s mission. Balance instinct with rationality to ensure its success, and you might bring cute Linde home. [From Nutaku]

title: Café Rouge
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Isis Black, your average American teenager, happens upon a part time job opening at Café Rouge. During the day, it is your normal quaint café and bakery. When night takes over, it is transformed into a five star restaurant theater café, with live stage performances and mysterious customers coming in the middle of the night. As Isis delves deeper into this strange café, she becomes tangled in the mystery of its haunted world. Will she find friend or foe? Will she follow fate or make her own destiny? Will she find love? That's for you to decide. [From Steam]

characters.name: Isis Black
characters.description: She is your average American teenager who is interviewing for a part time job at a mysterious establishment called "Café Rouge."

characters.name: Valen Michaels
characters.description: The protagonist's childhood friend. He is a naïve boy who goes to the same school as Isis, and has had a crush on her since childhood. He has a playful personality.

characters.description: The new student teacher who is teaching in the protagonist's history class. He is a graduate student from Boston University and has come to the protagonist's high school to train to become a full time high school teacher. Overall he has a shy personality.

characters.description: The mysterious owner of Café Rouge. He hires the protagonist as a waitress upon their first meeting, even though she's unqualified for the job. He holds a lot of secrets, and has a dark past. Most of the time he is on "business trips" and leaves his best friend Demian, head manager, to run the café.

characters.description: A waitress at Café Rouge. She is the first person the protagonist meets when she comes in for her job interview. Candice has been working at Café Rouge the longest out of all the other employees. She is very close with Demian.

characters.description: A cheerful waiter who is very nice to the protagonist. He doesn't get along very well with Demian, and sympathizes with the protagonist when Demian bullies her.

characters.description: The head manager of Café Rouge. He is Antoine's best friend, and knows about Antoine's dark past. He does not like the protagonist.

characters.description: The chef of Café Rouge. His nationality is unknown. Every time you see him he speaks a different language. One thing for sure is that he is European as he speaks only European languages.

characters.name: Diane
characters.description: A waitress at Café Rouge. Diane's personality is more blunt and to the point. She has a more quiet personality, but like Chris she is kind to the protagonist.

characters.name: Adeline
characters.description: A waitress at Café Rouge. She is of Scottish decent, and gets flustered very easily. She gets along with everybody at the café.

characters.name: Errol
characters.description: A waiter at Café Rouge. Like Diane, he is rather quiet. He doesn't talk much. He is also the bookkeeper of Café Rouge, and he does the taxes and other accounts payable and receivables for the café.

description: A revolutionary, romantic, visual novel where your choices change the course of history! It’s March 19th, 1789 and King Louis XVI rules over France from the gilded halls of Versailles. France is a country of elegance and poverty, of ancient tradition and unstoppable change. It is a country on the brink of revolution. Attend parties, mingle with the rich and powerful, learn their secrets, and use this to get the wealth and power you deserve. Find true love in an opulent world of ever-shifting alliances, that grows more dangerous by the day. Still, you must always keep your eye on the coming revolution. After all, it’s better to be on the right side of history, than the wrong side of the guillotine. [From [URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/949200/]Steam]

description: An Arbiter is a superhuman soldier, women with the ability to manifest their soul and transform into angels with boundless strength. They are the most powerful weapons the world has to offer, and the most reliable defense against Aberrations, tyrannical demons that descend to from the moon and leave nothing but destruction in their wake. Adelle Krouve —self-proclaimed “hero”— is an Arbiter with an indomitable sense of purpose. She's given the task of destroying the last Aberration standing: a ruthless steel hydra named ‘Edge Ixia Atlas SeigaRozen.’ Five years later, she wakes up in a body that is not her own: A shabby mechanical replica with only bits of her human self remaining—just enough to consider herself back from the dead. What's worse, the scientist who claims to have rebuilt her refuses to give her a reason why. [From itch.io]

title: Your glass heart in my hands
tags: Protagonist's Non-blood-related Sister as a Heroine
description: You are fast asleep. You are drifting through the darkness: a seemingly endless abyss from which there is no escape. There is nothing but the darkness: leagues and fathoms and feet of it... But you were a person once, you know, before you found yourself in this sorry state. You had a name — perhaps you had several names — and thoughts of your own; feelings, too. You had friends. A family, perhaps. You had a life. You might have had many lives. You are one, yet you are many. Fragmented, your past dances behind your eyelids like shards of glass: sharp to the touch, and yet... Will you reach out to touch these broken bits and pieces of your past? Do you dare? [From itch.io]

title: Ten Metre Tide
description: The era of border setting between the nation of Camden and its neighboring Maitland is long past. After nearly two centuries, just a single land dispute remains: Fort Colwyn, an insignificant island in the shared Bay of Fundy. So insignificant, in fact, that neither country ever cared to seriously stake its claim. But when a Maitlandish industry titan receives permission to use the island as an off-shore facility, a chain of events is set off which culminates in Fort Colwyn's final year of human settlement. A third-generation Colwynite struggles to envision life outside the only home she’s ever known. The ferryman’s daughter becomes an adult as the world of her childhood falls out of existence. A Maitlandish oil heiress attempts to reconcile her past with her past and with her future. Love, blame, memory, history. :: No love, no blame, no memory, no history. [From itch.io]

title: Kasane Teto and Hatsune Miku are Lesbians
Carmilla
description: Laura, narrator and heroine of the story, lives an idyllic life with her father in an old castle in Styria. Geographically isolated she is often lonely. A carriage accident delivers a mysterious young girl, named Carmilla, to the castle's doorsteps, hence putting a sudden end to Laura's solitude. The two girls grow close quickly, yet Laura occasionally feels overwhelmed and confused by Carmilla's passionate advances which ignite in her fascination and abhorrence in equal parts. However, these tense situations do little to tarnish the camaraderie that permeates their everyday life. Too soon this life is increasingly overshadowed as Laura starts to experience disquieting nightly visions and strange physical symptoms... [From itch.io]

characters.name: Ada Brunswick
characters.description: Ada, who had been carefully educated in metaphysics and theology never got the chance to practice either. Expelled from the Convent of the Sisters of the Blessed Sacrament, shortly before the end of her novitiate (for good reason, one might add) she had lost not only her calling but also her home. She has never been quite focused since and rarely spent more than a few weeks in the same place. During this aimless wandering she became acquainted with Dr. Martin Heselius, a wanderer like herself and an enthusiast. They bonded quickly over the works of Swedenborg, especially his Arcana Caelestia.

She is said to have wrecked the archery club's championship cup, but Alice didn't believe her best friend could do such a thing. description: Yaya, Aiyana, and Koko were childhood friends. Born in the same small village, they spent their days together, until their home was attacked by a multitude of strange, slimy creatures. After that night, Koko vanished into thin air, leaving Yaya and Aiyana alone. Three years later, Yaya and Aiyana set out to search Koko. They enlist the help of a mischievous witch, Maia, who helps them locate their missing friend with the use of her magic. After venturing across the land, and meeting several interesting people – including a sheltered princess, Arie, and her eerie priestess, Imala – Yaya and Aiyana are eventually able to reunite with Koko, but there is a catch. They might have found their childhood friend, but she has no intention of returning to her old village with them. She’s already in an established relationship with the fast-talking merchant Mika, and she seems more than content with

characters.name: Yaya
characters.description: Yaya is the main character of the story. Her parents were both hunters, and she prides herself on her skills with her spear. Cheerful and optimistic, Yaya is unfailingly certain that she'll find Koko again. She is fiercely protective of Aiyana, and will challenge anybody who dares make her uncomfortable - even a powerful witch like Maia.

characters.name: Aiyana
characters.description: Aiyana is a shy, softly-spoken girl born to a family of shamans. Her hair is pure white, which is unusual in the village from where she hails. As a result of her strange looks, she was often bullied during her youth. Aiyana has no fighting prowess, and has a weak constitution. She tires easily, and often needs to rely on Yaya, to her embarrassment. She worries frequently about burdening Yaya, but Yaya is quick to reassure her. Unbeknownst to Aiyana, it is because of her steadfast support that Yaya is able to remain so eternally optimistic.

characters.name: Maia
characters.description: Maia is a sneaky, devious witch of an indeterminable age. She speaks rarely of her past, and is shrouded in mystery, which makes her hard to trust. She is exceedingly powerful (or so she claims), and can accomplish truly impressive feats with her magic... But that is only if she feels like it. Maia loves flirting with cute girls more than anything, and she's very hands-on. She and Yaya often butt heads over this, and they can often be found bickering.

characters.name: Arie
characters.description: Arie is the young, inexperienced princess of the village where Yaya, Aiyana, and Maia find themselves in their search for Koko. She appears graceful and dignified, but gets flustered easily, and often worries about making a good impression upon others. Arie is highly respected among her people, but she has no genuine friends. Her subjects revere her too much to consent to using her first name, and insist upon calling her ‘your highness’. Arie tries to act as though this does not bother her, but deep down, she desperately desires a friend. [From Steam]

characters.name: Imala
characters.description: Imala is Arie's high priestess, and her chief advisor. Older than she appears, and significantly more experienced than Arie, Imala is well-poised to give sage advice whenever it is needed. Imala possesses a good deal of magical prowess, but how powerful she is remains a mystery. Imala is rarely seen without a smile, but there's something shadowy lurking beneath it. [From Steam]

characters.name: Koko
characters.description: Koko is Yaya and Aiyana's childhood friend. She's a kind, considerate girl who cares a good deal for her friends, and she's sensitive about the feelings of others. Koko is gifted at cooking and cleaning, but she's similarly skilled with a bow and arrow. Gentle though she is, she has no hesitation when it comes to hunting, and her skills might even rival those of Yaya's. She has something of a stubborn streak despite her sweet face, and she used to act as a mother figure to Yaya, chastising her whenever she made a nuisance of herself. [Edited from Steam]

characters.name: Mika
characters.description: Mika is a traveling merchant who roams the land selling her wares. Talkative and cheery, she's rarely seen without a wide smile upon her face, and nothing seems to perturb her. Mika is in a dedicated relationship with Koko, whom she dotes upon. She often calls Koko silly pet names, such as 'my little cocoa bean' – a fact which Koko finds incredibly embarrassing. She has a bit of a past with Maia, who seems to regard her with mild disdain. Mika, meanwhile, is impervious to this, and loudly proclaims that she and Maia are the best of friends. [From Steam]

A romance/psychological horror visual novel inspired by the Hanahaki disease trope. Immerse yourself in a romance with a sweetheart you can customize. But beware, as affection turns to obsession, the petals of love may suffocate. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Friend

title: Corona Borealis
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Modern Day United States of America
description: June Pinegar is forced to spend the summer working at her father’s quaint country café, far away from her urban home in New York City. Will romance spark with the dutiful barista or friendship form with the bubbly cashier? Or perhaps she’ll mend the strained relationship between her and her quirky father. One thing is certain: with each passing day, June is finding herself more and more charmed by the intoxicating mystique of the Southern town and its residents. Corona Borealis is a heartwarming story that shows the lasting effects our lives are capable of having on others, as well as their effects on us. Rather than just providing the player with romance options, it aims to explore the depths of non-romantic relationships, too.

characters.name: Logan
characters.description: The barista and dishwasher at the café. He is a hardworking and dependable employee that sets high standards for himself and places those same expectations on others. His interest in engineering proves to be a useful skill, as it gives him an uncanny ability to fix anything that breaks in the café. He plans on moving at the end of the summer to attend an out-of-state university.

characters.name: June Pinegar
characters.description: June is Basil’s daughter and the reluctant new employee at his café. At first, she prefers to keep her distance from the others, but she matures and opens up as the game progresses. Player’s choices will determine how hardworking or friendly she’ll be, which will in turn affect how other characters perceive and interact with her. However, she remains a sassypants throughout the game regardless of player decisions.

characters.name: Lacey
characters.description: The overly friendly cashier and dining room attendant. Incredibly optimistic, it seems nothing can put a damper on her good mood. She immediately takes an interest in June and goes out of her way to make her feel welcome. She loves to talk about her fiancé, Mason.

characters.name: Basil Pinegar
characters.description: June’s doting father and the owner and head chef of the café. Passionate and driven, he can sometimes get a little too lost in his work. His and June’s relationship is shaky at best, but he hopes to change that over the course of the summer. He has an unhealthy love for coffee and the classic TV show “Star Journey”.

characters.name: Noah
characters.description: Lacey’s introverted and awkward twin brother. Unlike his sister, he is rather pessimistic and reserved. Sometimes it seems like there’s something amiss between the two, but it’s difficult to know for sure. He spends most of his free time inside writing and sketching in his notebook.

title: My Sweet Zombie!
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: My Sweet Zombie! is about Sam Chen, a recent college graduate who loves to bake. However, she can’t remember the last time she touched an oven, unless you can count the conventional one they use at the cafe she works at. Sam’s job usually involves putting out fires at her store, so whether it's dealing with a annoying customer or fixing the leaky espresso machine, it’s Sam’s job to take care of it. Thus it's no surprise she finds herself exhausted from her job. However, now that Sam has graduated from college, her parents are pressuring her to get a "real" job. Will Sam be forced to take the path her parents want, a stable, but boring career as an accountant...? Or ... Will a cute girl with a bony arm change that? [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Samantha Chen
characters.description: Likes: Baking, small and cute stuff Dislikes: Disappointing others An overworked and stressed out barista. Sam's true passion is baking, but her controlling parents are pushing her to take a job in accounting. How does a chance meeting with a cute zombie change that? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Zombie Girl
characters.description: Likes: Sweets and sleeping Dislikes: Vegetables A mysterious zombie who appeared in front of Sam. It's unsure if she has any unfinished business left to do as she doesn't remember anything from when she was alive. All that Sam knows about her is that she loves to eat sweets. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Liam Garcia-Rodriguez
characters.description: Likes: Comics and coffee Dislikes: Coffee snobs and annoying customers Sam's friendly and nerdy co-worker who loves everything that is manga and video games. Always tried to lend a helping hand to Sam. Thinks Sam's new house guest is a cat instead of a rotting corpse. [From itch.io]

description: Shy and dorky May is the bottom rung of her class, and cool and terrifying Ember is her bully. But May has a secret: one that sends her on a dangerous (not really) and difficult (if you have trouble talking to strangers) mission to the bookstore, where the latest volume of her favorite series has just come out. Within that book is the answer to whether her beloved yuri ship has finally been canonized! Unfortunately for May, what seems like a simple task is about to get a whole lot more complicated when the last person she expected appears! [From Itch.io]

Everything seems to be going relatively well, but the world of adult entertainment never rests… The mission now is to find our second member! Enter Yuki. Our protagonist and her Lewd Producer will try their best to get Yuki on board! [From Steam]

characters.name: Kairi
characters.description: In order to pursue her lifetime dream of being a famous Idol, Kairi just moved to Akihabara, where she's been rejected by around fifteen Idol agencies already. On the brink of depression and with a lot of debts to pay already, a very weird and unconventional lifetime opportunity seems to appear right before her eyes... [From Steam]

characters.name: Ranko
characters.description: Self proclaimed producer and manager, Ranko is a mature former Idol that couldn't make it big in her early twenties. Now, with the fears of adulthood haunting her, she bets it all in her latest idea..."Lewd Idol Project." She'll try to introduce Kairi into the world of "lewd idols" in order to fulfill her frustrated dream. [From Steam]

characters.name: Yuki
characters.description: A girl of few words, Yuki spends most of her time in the Game Centers of Akihabara beating records and winning prizes. She also loves to collect retro video games. Although she's not interested in Idol culture at first, Ranko sees potential, and will do the impossible to convince her to join the Lewd Idol Project. [From Steam]

Everything is going well… But Marnie is worried about her elderly grandmother, Iris, who lives well off the beaten road in the small, scenic village of Fenchapel. Iris’s health has been failing her as of late, and Marnie worries, if she does not spend more time with her grandmother, she will later regret it. characters.name: Leofe
characters.description: A young female knight who has been sleeping for many centuries, but Marnie (inadvertently) awakes her. Leofe does not know why she went to sleep, but she knows that the forest itself is plagued by a horrible curse, and she is the only one who can lift it. [spoiler]Her real name is Lisbeth.

characters.name: Iris Lennox
characters.description: Marnie's Grandmother on her father's side. She lives in a very rural part of England. Marnie is forced to stay at her grandmother's house while her parents go on holiday to France. She is convinced that the forest behind her house has fairies. Everyone else thinks she's gone senile because she always brings this up.

characters.description: A typical girl you can find anywhere. Longs for a romance like in shoujo manga. Believes that it's wrong to judge people by their appearance or via rumors. (Can romance Asahi or Akira)

characters.name: Kagaya Sou
characters.description: Has fun manipulating people's thoughts and actions. Pretends to be a cheerful, good-natured guy. (Can romance Akira or Asahi)

characters.name: Nagamine Asahi
characters.description: Not talkative. Often looking far away blankly. Disinterested in others and not particularly active. Doesn't realize he's good looking. (Can be romanced by Chitose or Sou)

characters.name: Fujieda Akira
characters.description: Frustrated and hurt that she is always judged by her looks and aggressive tone, but struggles to change. Wants to have friends, but cannot be honest with herself. (Can be romanced by Chitose or Sou)

characters.name: Momose Arata
characters.description: A really nice, friendly guy liked by both guys and girls. Reads too much between the lines and often keeps his thoughts to himself. Quiet, but actually very passionate. (Can only romance Keiichi)

characters.name: Minami Keiichi
characters.description: Gentle and laid-back. Popular among students and trusted greatly by parents. Kind to everyone, but doesn't speak his mind. (Can only be romanced by Arata)

characters.name: Sakuraba Shino
characters.description: A very direct person. Although she doesn't bother herself with lots of things, she has a side to her with a strong sense of justice. Not a huge fan of talking about love lives. (Can only romance Asuka)

characters.name: Kiyomiya Asuka
characters.description: Serious with a gentle personality. Doesn't have a suspicious nature, and can't say no to anyone's request. Gives her best shot at everything from studying to playing sports. (Can only be romanced by Shino)

title: Repurpose
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You and several others have passed away. Rather than being sent to Heaven or Hell, the powers that may be are unable to decide where you should go. You wake up in the Garden of Eden who's new home has been made in Limbo. You have three options: either take the trials to earn your place in Heaven, live it up in Hell, or remain lost in Limbo for eternity. It's a lot to take in fresh off your death bed... but maybe you find each other's peace along the way. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Kalei Kanahele
characters.description: Kalei is your typical good-hearted angel that wants to help humans succeed in any way possible to get into Utopia. The role as Limbo's shepherd is one not many would endure but he takes on the task willingly and with a smile, though his ambitions may be even too much for him to bear alone.

characters.name: Ramón Rojo
characters.description: Picked by Lucifer himself, Ramón was chosen to be Limbo's escort. With his charismatic personality, he's made it so the majority of first arrived Limbo humans choose Hell over Utopia. He's even offering to help you find out the secret to yourself... but what if you discover [i]his first?

characters.name: DJ Roadkill
characters.description: Under the moniker "DJ Roadkill," this wacky, fun-loving masked musician is here to make a change in Limbo. Being the type to never shy away from danger, DJ Roadkill is going to need help in bringing a better future for Limbo and making sure they stay alive in doing so.

characters.name: Noel
characters.description: Noel quietly protects those that find themselves in Limbo so they can fight to join Utopia one day. He may seem cold on the outside, but on the inside, he cares for every human under his care. No matter how many geists he exorcises, he's still plagued by the ghosts of his past. Bartender, another round and make it double!

characters.name: Mitchelle Moore
characters.description: Since she was young, Mitts has had a thirst for knowledge and to bring change in the field of technology. She can build just about anything if she sets her mind to it... Though, she's going to need an extra hand if she wants to get to Utopia and accomplish her goals.

characters.name: Rosita Cardenas
characters.description: Rosita just can't seem to catch a break. One minute she's working her butt off just to get by in school, the next she's isekai'd and has to make the biggest decision of her afterlife! She doesn't think she's special like everyone else, but is being average a bad thing?

characters.name: Fayebael Noct
characters.description: Mysterious as she is beautiful, Faye has been visiting Limbo since before even Noel arrived. At the Twilight Church (a nightclub), she has provided a safe space for the people of Limbo to take a break from their troubled lives in this realm between realms. How bad can Hell really be if she's there?

characters.name: Cherubim
characters.description: Everything that has ever existed, from the mountains up high to the waters down below, are products of Cherubim's hard work. She is but one of 8 God Fragments that make up what we know as "God." Next to dinosaurs, humans are his favorite creation the joined Choir has created. They wish things were different between the realms, and are trusting you to make the right choices to see their plan through.

description: The main character is Satsuki. She lives in a town where an opera theater stands. One day, she visits the theater for the first time in five years with her friend and gets attracted to Hikari's performance. She has never fallen in love before, but... [From ErogeShop]

characters.name: Hayasaka Satsuki
characters.description: Satsuki is an unconfident, shy third-year high schooler afraid to fall in love (and of men to a small extent). Satsuki's negative attitude to romance was born from an event 5 years ago, during junior high school. She decided to pluck up her courage and confess her feelings to her first love and childhood friend, Kanade. However, she overhears Kanade saying to his classmate that he has no interest whatsoever in "a girl like her". To make matters worse, just before he was bound for Austria, Kanade told her that she was ugly and that she should keep her glasses on to hide her hideous face. In spite of her plain appearance, Satsuki has a great love for sewing and clothes. After seeing a Takarazuka (a Japanese musical where female actresses take on roles as male characters) performance, Satsuki is greatly moved by the show, and by Jun Hikari, whom acted as the male hero. Now an enthusiastic f

characters.name: Suzushiro Kanade
characters.description: The blunt and stand-offish childhood friend of Satsuki. The root of her aversion to romance, Kanade frequently called her ugly, and is the reason why she rarely removes her glasses. A gifted pianist, Kanade trained in Europe to further his skills. Out of the blue, he returns to Japan to perform in a concert, and seems to have changed very little, personality-wise. [Spoiler]After high school, he travels to Europe again to continue his musical studies. He becomes a famous pianist, under his performer alias, Tomokusa Sou

characters.name: Yanagi Touwa
characters.description: Touwa is the second-in-charge of the school's Theatre Club. Almost nothing like his loud and attention-seeking childhood friend, Sei'ichiro, Touwa is antisocial, blunt, stoic and somewhat of a sadist. His father is a well-respected director working for the Stella Theatre, where Jun Hikari performs. [spoiler]After high school, Touwa goes on to become a theatre director at the Stella Theatre.

characters.name: Azuma Seiichirou
characters.description: The president of the Theatre Club, although he passes on most of the administrative duties to Touwa. From a wealthy family, Seiichirou is somewhat spoiled, though not unpleasantly arrogant. Proud of his family's traditional Japanese roots, his likes and interests are all associated as such- e.g., Kabuki theatre, his preference for wearing Hakama (kimono for men) as opposed to western clothing (outside of school), and even commuting to school via a human-drawn carriage. [Spoiler]After high school, Seiichirou becomes a famous Kabuki actor, as well as a popular personality on a national quiz television show. His older cousin works alongside Jun Hikari as her Senpai

characters.name: Yuki
characters.description: A member of the Theatre Club, Yuki is energetic, friendly and positive, in direct contrast to most of its members. He openly shows his affection for Satsuki, though never laciviously. In spite of his child-like cheer, Yuki is surprisingly perceptive of everything that goes on around him. Since he works part time in the props department at the Stella Theatre during the day, he attends and studies at school in the evening. As a result, he can't attend the club as often as he'd like. He is self-conscious of his short height, and is quick to redeem himself as the physically strongest of the club. [Spoiler]Yuki suffered from memory loss, and was found by his current guardian. He later discovers that he is a partial entity of Misumi Kei, a scripwriter who is in a coma. Kei discovered that his master stole his script, and in despair, attempted to run away but fell off the stage. As a result of

characters.name: Kusakabe Haru
characters.description: Haru is a long-time member of the Theatre Club, and also Satsuki's classmate. Meek, quiet and very shy, Haru is a pacifist and tries to avoid directly stating his point of view- especially when Touwa and Sei'ichirou argue (though he finds himself getting involved anyway). He is the gentlest and kindest towards Satsuki and never orders her around. Haru enjoys creative writing, and does so at any spare moment he gets. Though from a vastly wealthy family, Haru has almost no interest in money or material possessions. In spite of his docile nature, everyone is careful not to overly upset Haru, as he is heavily hinted to be scary when he finally loses his patience. [Spoiler]After high school, Haru becomes a successful professional author. Beneath his gentle exterior lies a dark nature- deep down, Haru is dangerously possessive. His sexual desires are somewhat dark too, as he confesses to imagi

characters.name: Jun Hikari
characters.description: The handsome actress that inspired Satsuki to love theatre. Hikari is brave, confident and strong, but gentle and kind. Her popularity and rising talent threatens her senior acting peers, and as a result, Hikari is subject to their bullying. In spite of this, she remains strong and loves her job. [Spoiler]Her true name is Izumi Hikari. She intially enlists Satsuki to be her fan manager, but after Satsuki got her dream job of being in the costumes department, Hikari eventually re-enlists her as her stylist.

characters.name: Arima Hayata

characters.name: Perseus

title: Starlit Flowers
tags: Past Setting in a Fictional World
description: One night when Einar is traveling through the forest, she sees two stars descend from the sky. She inspects the crash site to find two strange girls that appear out of this world. Their names are Ailis and Cerise, they ask Einar to help them return home and claim they fell from the night sky. Einar is skeptical about their story, but she decides to help them out anyway. This is where their fun little adventure through the forest begins. As Einar gets to know the girls more, she starts to wonder if they're The Star guardians her deceased mother used to tell her stories about.

characters.name: Einar
characters.description: Einar is a traveling herbalist. She wishes to help people with her herbalism. She's a stern and cynical person despite her caring nature, but she wasn't always this way. The death of her mother changed her. As she gets to know Ailis and Cerise she starts to lighten up a little. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Ailis
characters.description: Ailis appears withdrawn and apathetic. She doesn't get along with her counterpart Cerise, but she seems to open up to Einar. She's shy and kindhearted. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Cerise
characters.description: Cerise is a bubbly and hot tempered girl who is constantly hungry. She enjoys teasing Ailis and at times Einar. She's a troublemaker, but a good friend at heart. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Cerilis
characters.description: The combined form of Ailis and Cerise. Stars like her are born from the soul of deceased humans, with her specifically being born from the soul of Einar's mother. Because of Einar's grudge against the stars for failing to heal her mother's illness, she was cursed to be born as two separate halves. Only by Einar accepting the two halves as they are could Cerilis become whole.

title: From Salt to Sugar
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Support Character
description: As Haruka Koyama strives to pursue her cake making career via her family's little bakery, she hits a little bump in the road. She meets Camille Amai, the granddaughter to a prestigious cake company. The two started off with a rocky beginning, but Haruka tries her best to prove her worthiness to this poker faced princess. Eventually, the two develop a bond through making cakes and showing each other the worlds they had never seen before. Play through this kinetic novel and see how a pinch of salt (or a lot) at the beginning of the baking process can lead to a sweet and delicious cake in the end ♥ [From itch.io]

title: This Winter of Ours
description: As day turns to night and the last of the grass is suffocated by snow, apprentice merchant Delia finds herself completely lost and alone. With no hope for survival, she finally lays to rest her dreams of learning magic and discovering the secrets of her world, allowing herself to be taken by the elements. Yet she awakens, and finds an unfamiliar figure lying next to her. A girl who is similarly yet uniquely alone. While she isn't forthcoming on any details of herself, the girl agrees to escort the merchant to safety, thus beginning their presumably short-lived adventure. Little do the two know, they both have what the other needs. Will they be able to find that hidden treasure within each other, or will doubts and secrets consume them both? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Delia
characters.description: An apprentice merchant traveling in her father's shadow. Cordial yet anxious, she struggles to fit in with the life of a trader, secretly yearning for her dead dream of studying magic and becoming a mage.

characters.name: Lux
characters.description: A short-spoken survivalist who calls the snowy forest her home. Initially a nameless stranger, she is given the name "Lux" when she encounters an estranged merchant in training. Despite her distrustful nature, something within her compels her to help the apprentice trader escape the forest.

title: Dai Akugyaku Reijou Strategy of Lily
title_original: 大悪逆令嬢 ストラテジーオブリリィ
tags: Past Setting in a Fictional World
description: In the rigid hierarchy of the Empire’s aristocracy, the free-spirited duchess Scarlet refused to conform, and was framed for Regicide, the assassination of the Emperor. With the help of Lily, the captain of the cutting-edge Stream Airship, Scarlet escapes the imperial capital and declares war against the Empire! As Scarlet’s recklessness and Lily’s cold pragmatism collide, the conflict soon engulfs the entire continent. Capture enemy generals, turn them into allies, and clear Scarlet’s name as you fight for the duo’s happy ending! [From Steam]

characters.name: Elizabeth Scarlet Penrose
characters.original: エリザベス・スカーレット・ペンローズ
characters.description: Born as a duchess, her exceedingly beautiful exterior hides the wild monster she was raised to be. Despite the fact that she was Prince Gwyn's betrothed, she causes problems non-stop, and is rather (in)famously known by the people as "that Lady Scarlet." She denies it, but she's believed to be the mastermind behind the fires in The City. Naturally, the engagement's been called off.

characters.name: Lily
characters.description: Technical officer from the Republic, Captain of the Stream Airship Rosebud, that's me! I came to do a demo stream of the engagement announcement at Prince Gwyn's request. Now everyone thinks I had something to do with the fires in The City... [From Digital Artwork book]

characters.name: Gwyn Grosvenor
characters.original: グウィン・グローベナー
characters.description: Serious and honest, he commands the Police Corps. He's the Empire's handsome prince, both refined and rugged! He cares about his subjects, keeps up with new technology, and of course, won't accept bribes. Everyone has high hopes for this rising star. Lady Scarlet has been giving him a hard time since they were students, but it looks like he finally lost his patience. Well, everyone probably saw that coming.

characters.name: Primula Graybolt
characters.original: プリムラ・グレイボルト
characters.description: The daughter of Marquis Graybolt. She's giving her all to improving the status of women in the aristocracy. I guess she's at least got that much in common with Lady Scarlet.

characters.name: Uisce Laurel
characters.description: Leader of the resistance against the Empire—the Elysian Liberation Front. He is also a master distiller of Elysian whiskey, a local specialty. His blend is known among The City's noble circles as the "Queen of Whiskey." He says he's rebelling because of how the Empire rules their subjects.

characters.name: Geena Pepper
characters.description: Governor of Elysia and Commander of the Elysian Field Army. She's dying to work in The City. Even though she's a woman, she was appointed as the commander and given a Colonel's rank. She must be super talented... Geena's a symbol of imperial colonial rule, but she's more compassionate than you'd assume. [From Digital Artwork book]

characters.name: Nicol Hazel
characters.description: Geena's childhood friend. Deputy Commander of the Elysian Branch Army. He's a Baron, like Geena, but has retained the rank of Major because he wants to assist Viceregent.

characters.name: Ciaran Grosvenor
characters.original: キアラン・グローベナー
characters.description: Gwyn's younger brother. In short, the second-in-line for the throne. He oversees the Great Wall, and commands the Second Division of the Imperial Army. The bigger, cooler, and stronger a thing is, the more he loves it. [From Digital Artwork book]

characters.name: Tyler Lamprush
characters.original: タイラー・ランプラッシュ
characters.description: Prince Ciaran's aide and the brains of the Second Division. He commands the Dragon's Nest, which is their supply depot. I hear he handles all of Prince Ciaran's day-to-day tasks.

characters.name: Rebecca Yellowbird
characters.original: レベッカ・イエローバード
characters.description: A village girl from Graybolt. She's not great at socializing without her mask. She has a really pretty voice, and all the hunting she does has made her legs crazy muscular. [From Digital Artwork book]

characters.name: Eldred Brown Penrose
characters.original: エルドレッド・ブラウン・ペンローズ
characters.description: Our esteemed Lady Scarlet's old man. He's a Duke, and the leader of the Imperial Army. His fierce loyalty to the Emperor and long list of military merits means that he's kinda worshiped. [From Digital Artwork book]

characters.name: Sanjay Maple
characters.original: サンジャイ・メイプル
characters.description: The commander of the Imperial Army's First Battalion. Duke Brown's prestige kinda overshadows him, but he's a sincerely stand-up dude. ...Okay, hang on. Is it just me, or does the Empire have a lot of party-poopers? [From Digital Artwork book]

characters.name: Carmine Maple
characters.original: カーマイン・メイプル
characters.description: Sanjay's little sister. A total lady of the Maple house. She signed up to be a soldier after seeing Lady Scarlet's stream. She's your run-of-the-mill medic, but she's doing her best. [From Digital Artwork book]

characters.name: Harold Morris
characters.description: A gentleman who serves in the Imperial Army's Reserve Forces. He's from the same generation as Duke Brown, and was previously in the same branch of the military. When he served as a commander, seeing the brutalities of war drove him to an early retirement. [From Digital Artwork book]

characters.name: Jane Snowflake
characters.original: ジェーン・スノーフレーク
characters.description: She used to be Primula's maid, and trusted bodyguard... Wait, what? Do those two jobs usually go together? She's, like, uber feminine, so I'm guessing she's into knitting, embroidery, gardening— you know. Those kinds of things. [From Digital Artwork book]

characters.name: Sapphirus Honeysuckle
characters.original: サピルス・ハニーサックル
characters.description: Police Corps Captain that serves the Crown Prince. I hear he's a cold-hearted machine with unwavering loyalty to his duties and the Imperial Family! The Prince's orders are absolute! That's the kind of guy he is. Apparently, he can go a little overboard trying to get things done. Seriously, the military is scary! [From Digital Artwork book]

characters.name: Rubeus Honeysuckle
characters.original: ルベウス・ハニーサックル
characters.description: Vice-Captain of the Police Corps, and Sapphirus's twin sister. She seems easier to communicate with than her brother, but she's as strait-laced as anyone in military uniform. Apparently the Imperial Times even wrote "When the Honeysuckle siblings pass by, everyone hangs their head and sighs." [From Digital Artwork book]

characters.name: Blaubeere Steinbach
characters.original: ブラウビア・シュタインバッハ
characters.description: This girl's stationed over at Great Wall HQ. She's a model commander, and handles anything gun-related. She's a legit walking calculator! She works out bullet trajectories in seconds, and she never misses. Like, could she get more gifted? [From Digital Artwork book]

characters.name: Erle Goldschmidt
characters.original: エーレ・ゴルトシュミット
characters.description: Commander of the Second Company, under the Imperial Army. Said to be Duke Brown's left arm. She acts like an old-school detached force, and mostly gets sent out on sneak attacks, or to lead pincer strikes. [From Digital Artwork book]

characters.name: Almeria Eisenhut
characters.original: アルメリア・アイゼンフート
characters.description: A kindly sister who belongs to the Imperial Church. There isn't a single citizen who doesn't adore her. She also serves as the Archpriest, and she's known Emperor Gwyn since his princely period. Apparently, they're pretty close. [From Digital Artwork book]

characters.name: Alex Grosvenor
characters.original: アレックス・グローベナー
characters.description: The assassinated Emperor, and Prince Gwyn's father. The world called him the "Feeble Emperor" for failing to clean up corruption among the aristocracy and doing little to stop the widening social inequality. He set up the infrastructure to stream the Prince's engagement across the whole Empire. I wonder why he was killed... [From Digital Artwork book]

characters.name: Noah Weidling
characters.original: ノア・ヴァイトリング
characters.description: The neighboring Republic's President. He eradicated poverty, stabilized politics, built a sustainable society, and boosted the nation's level of happiness, all on his own. As politicians go, he's pretty much perfect, and has a 100% approval rate. [From Digital Artwork book]

title: Yuriarisu
description: Arisu, Yuri's twin younger sister, died. Yuri was unable to accept that tragedy. One day, she had a dream. When she came to, Yuri found herself lying on a bed in a dark room. "I'm home, Yuri-chan." Yuri was overjoyed to be reunited with Arisu, who should have been dead. However, there was something different about Arisu—she seemed more alluring and mysterious than usual. Fearing that she might lose Arisu again, Yuri chose to spend a sweet honeymoon-like time with her. Unaware that she was merely being toyed with in the palm of a wicked god's hand...

characters.name: Yuri
characters.description: The older of the twin sisters. She had been blind since birth, and because of that, there were times when she envied her younger sister, Arisu. Since Arisu had cared for her in place of their parents, Yuri feels deeply indebted to her sister. Because of her condition, she was somewhat detached from ordinary society, but after her eyesight was restored, she became much more sociable. As for Arisu's excessive affection toward her, Yuri accepts it with an attitude of, "Well, I guess it can't be helped." However, she has also come to enjoy aspects of it that go far beyond what could reasonably be dismissed with "it can't be helped." She is able to transform her body to a "futanari" as well, though unlike Alice, she cannot produce tentacles. Unfortunately, she is perfectly suited to serve as the vessel for ■■■■, making her a one-of-a-kind existence in the universe—someone for whom there is no

characters.name: Arisu
characters.description: Yuri's twin younger sister. Since childhood, she has harbored feelings for her sister that go beyond ordinary love. The only person she is romantically interested in is Yuri. After coming into contact with an anomaly known as "Kami-sama" , she made a wish for Yuri's blindness to be cured. Originally, she had no interest in anyone except Yuri, and because she referred to herself by her own name ("Arisu") rather than using a normal first-person pronoun, she never managed to make a single close friend she could truly open up to. Although she loves pleasure and tends to take the initiative aggressively, she ultimately ends up being overwhelmed by Yuri. She is capable of transforming her body in unusual ways, such as becoming a "futanari" or growing tentacle-like appendages. She is compatible as a vessel for the wicked god ■■■■, but unlike Yuri, she is considered replaceable. As a result, the

characters.name: Kami-sama
characters.description: The Crawling Chaos.

full_description: Arisu, Yuri's twin younger sister, died. Yuri was unable to accept that tragedy. One day, she had a dream. When she came to, Yuri found herself lying on a bed in a dark room. "I'm home, Yuri-chan." Yuri was overjoyed to be reunited with Arisu, who should have been dead. However, there was something different about Arisu—she seemed more alluring and mysterious than usual. Fearing that she might lose Arisu again, Yuri chose to spend a sweet honeymoon-like time with her. Unaware that she was merely being toyed with in the palm of a wicked god's hand...

title: I Love You
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: A girl named Megumi transfers into an outstanding private school. She lived a normal life before; what will happen when she goes there? Inside the school, there is an Enchanted Forest. Whoever goes there disappears. Is this rumor true? Some say it's because of a student who went there. He kicked various plants and flowers which angered the Guardian of the forest. After that, he disappeared. Is this true? Or is this wrong? Megumi is also single. Help her find a boyfriend. [Edited from Lemma Soft Forums]

title: Serafina's Crown
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: The sequel takes place seven years after the end of the Serafina’s Saga visual novel. Grand Prince Robil Feldren dies of illness, and a few weeks later, Queen Belatrix Grandil dies in the midst of a “hunting accident.” Serafina Elborn and her husband Reuben Jeridar are posed to take the throne, except for one big problem: many nobles suspect Reuben Jeridar arranged the assassination of Belatrix Grandil. You play as a new character, Odell Perin, who is unwittingly thrust into a position of power amidst the chaos of court. Due to her neutral stance, Odell Perin is elected to serve as Regent long enough to settle the ongoing disputes, and therefore determine who will become the next King or Queen of Darzia. The gameplay will feature a dynamic debate system that allows Odell to argue certain points in court based on her accumulated stats. [From Official page]

characters.name: Odell Perin
characters.description: Odell never wanted to live the life of royalty in Castle Krondolee, even though her mother was an important House Leader. She hates politics and prefers to explore the world with no attachments. When Queen Belatrix dies and Odell’s mother steps down as House Leader of Perin, Odell has no choice but to assume a role of utmost importance in the Darzian government. How she handles her duties depends upon you! [From official blog]

characters.name: Kendal Terrace
characters.description: Kendal is a talented diplomat. Otherwise, he likes to spend as much time lounging or playing relaxing games as possible. In truth, Kindal is a spoiled aristocrat who simply believes that poor people deserve to be poor and that the noble class is truly superior to the lower class. But his desire to have fun and indulge himself can be highly contagious. He survives solely on his friendliness, charm, and ability to diffuse situations by helping people relax. [From Official blog]

characters.name: Roza Pajari
characters.description: Roza is a powerful warrior, leader of a House secretly affiliated with Belazar (god of wrath). She has no patience for bull shit, but she does enjoy a good challenge. She believes that strength and aggression are the keys to survival, and she would be lost without clinging to such traits at all times. Roza is determined to prove that Reuben assassinated Queen Belatrix. Might she have her own reasons for wanting to see him fall? [From Official blog]

characters.name: Picard
characters.description: Picard is technically the god of joy, but don’t let his title fool you. Being joyful does not equate to being nice. Picard is playful and silly, but he is also sadistic, as well as masochistic. He loves sex and he also loves torture. He’ll try to squeeze pleasure out of any situation. And if something fails to amuse him (rare but possible), he will destroy it. Because he now possesses the power of an ancient deity, who can influence the flow of the winds and the movement of the sun, he’s quite capable of destroying whatever he wishes. [From official blog]

characters.name: Lorenzo Dugarek
characters.description: Odell falls in love with Lorenzo when she meets him on her travels away from Darzia. Lorenzo appears to be little more than an idealist Vikand chief who likes swordplay and women. But there does seem to be something special about him, especially once he gives Odell a precious gift in the form of a magical necklace… [From Official blog]

characters.name: Lokke
characters.description: The god of guile.

characters.name: Serafina Elborn
characters.description: Serafina has come a long way since her childhood in the Darzian jungle. Now she is married to Reuben Jeridar with children, and the crown of Darzia is within her grasp. As rebels calling themselves the Red Scarves cause trouble throughout Darzia, Serafina seeks the crown so that she can spread peace and reform. But her husband, Reuben Jeridar, may have a different vision of their future together. [From Woodsy Studio]

characters.name: Arken Jeridar
characters.description: Arken has a dark past, including betraying his own family and raising Serafina Elborn in secrecy. But he has repaired old bridges; most people in the Darzian nobility respect him now, and he serves as an adviser to Odell when she has no one else to turn to. For a reason he's not eager to share, however, Arken seems intent on preventing Serafina from taking the crown of Darzia. [From Woodsy Studio]

characters.name: Kallias Jeridar
characters.description: Kallias is known to most as the greedy, careless king who led Darzia into economic ruin because he valued gold over natural resources. After his downfall, however, Kallias spent several years secluded on an island with as much gold as he desired. He realized that gold meant nothing without other people to believe in its value. He has now decided to abstain from gold for as long as he can and put the people first. He returns to Darzia a very changed man. [From Woodsy Studio]

characters.name: Reuben Jeridar
characters.description: Reuben is a man who uses flattery, seduction, and lies to obtain what he wants. A close descendent of Mallion, a god of chaos, Reuben can also change water into wine (literally). He rose from rags to riches and now sits two chairs from the throne of Darzia. The question is: what does he want now that his wife might become Queen? Many people suspect that Reuben secretly arranged Belatrix’s assassination to free the crown for Serafina. It will be Odell’s responsibility to uncover the truth. [From Woodsy Studio]

title: Double Exposure
description: Serena has worked for years to attain her invaluable position as a world-renowned photographer. She lives her life away from social situations, concerning herself almost exclusively with honing her craft. Her life takes an interesting turn when one morning a young and lively model named Lizzie starts working with her, bringing along foregone bagage that might be too heavy for Serena to handle. [From Itch.io]

title: Foul Play
description: You play as a straight-laced investigator who has always been bound to the rules and whose greatest concerns in life have been superficial, embarrassing moments. You're very efficient at solving crimes from behind a desk, but your world is turned upside down after being put in charge of an effort to throw a mercurial and sexy assassin behind bars. The assassin's services go to the highest bidder and she thrives in her chaotic, lavish lifestyle. She's unhinged, unfiltered and becomes obsessed with pushing you to your limits, trying to tap into your darkest secrets. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Winter
characters.description: No one knows why her codename is "Winter" but there's no doubt that it suits her. Her charming and alluring exterior masks her occupation as a cold-blooded contract killer. She's playful, witty, competitive and damn good at her job. She kills with as much remorse as taking out the trash and is proud of her work, taunting investigators with the displays of her masterpieces. Her style is eccentric and it strokes your zealous obsession.

characters.name: Cynthia
characters.description: Cynthia's determination and drive were the main factors that allowed such a hot mess to become a director. She's hot-headed and is constantly teetering on the edge of an outburst. She completed an impressive 34 minutes of anger management counseling before she stormed out of the room and threw a wall painting on the floor. She's willing to do whatever it takes to catch unlawful criminals and sometimes her temper comes in handy out in the field. She knows how to let loose on the weekends and fiercely defends those close to her but isn't afraid to hurt her colleagues' feelings with her brutal honesty. "Take it or leave it."

characters.name: Protagonist
characters.description: You play as a hard-working and studious investigator of the Public Security Intelligence Agency. You've always played by the rules and upheld conventional standards although you've always been curious about trying something more dangerous. You're probably not gay, you've just always thought that girls are just really gorgeous and so soft, especially when their hand grazes yours... It doesn't really matter what you fantasize about in your head, that's sooo not the real you... Right?

title: Suki Tokimeki to Kiss
description: "I love you with all my heart... and despise you with all my soul." After a haunting dream, an amnesiac Kurenai Akina wakes up in hospital to see a girl staring straight into her eyes. The girl's very presence repulses and frightens her, and yet her sweet perfume brings back a strange, contradictory affection. Akina must come to terms with her emotions as she recovers her memories piece by piece, and any misstep may cost her her life. Who shall be the deceiver, and who the deceived? The battle between them has just begun...

title: Ginga Ojou-sama Densetsu Yuna 2: Eien no Princess
title_original: 銀河お嬢様伝説ユナ2 永遠のプリンセス
description: This is the second game in the series about the school girl Yuna Kagurazaka, who fights crime in cosmic battles. Eien no Princess continues the story of the first game. Yuna has defeated the 13 Servants of Darkness, and their leader Lia has become a friend, fighting crime on her own in a superhero TV show. Life seems to continue normally, the only trouble being Erika, a snotty high school girl who sees herself as Yuna's biggest rival. She challenges Yuna to a fight, but both are spotted by the titular starship "Eternal Princess", commanded by the pretty Princess Mirage, whose task is to stop violence in the whole galaxy. What begins as a misunderstanding ends as a serious threat to the Earth... [From Mobygames]

characters.name: Kagurazaka Yuna
characters.description: Yuna is the main character of the series. At first, she was just another normal schoolgirl: a first-year student at Yokohama's Shiraokadai All-Girls' High School, enrolled in class 1-B, commuting from home to school each day via the local train route. Sometime prior to the first game, Yuna and several other girls entered the "Miss Ojousama Contest", an intergalactic beauty pageant, with Yuna herself being chosen as the winner. In doing so, she became an instant celebrity, and began a career as a popular idol singer. One night, the Matrix of Light Elner appeared to Yuna. She introduced herself as part of Yuna's personality (literally translated, "her other self"), and asked her to become the Savior of Light. Yuna then learned a great evil was about to invade the universe, and that Yuna herself had been charged with its protection. Thus began the first of Yuna's intergalactic adventures. Y

characters.name: Yuri Cube
characters.description: Yuri is an android created by a highly advanced race. She was discovered in some ancient ruins on the moon during the storyline of "Galaxy Fraulein Yuna 2: Eternal Princess". Yuri came home with Yuna and lives at her house, and then becomes Yuna's best friend. At some point, she becomes the Kagurazaka family's adopted daughter, making her full name Yuri Cube Kagurazaka. Yuri is best known for her insatiable appetite, which has led some fans to speculate that she may have a black hole for a stomach. Yuri is immensely strong though performing feats of strength depletes her energy reserves, at which point she must eat to regain her strength. Quite humorously, her appetite is also her biggest weakness, as Yuna has been seen bribing Yuri with food on more than one occasion. In combat, Yuri not only uses her super strength, but she uses a weapon called Twin Dragon Fangs that can interchange to

characters.name: Liabert von Neuestein
characters.original: リーアベルト・フォン・ノイエシュタイン
characters.description: Lia was the leader of The 13 Frauleins of Darkness, the 13 servants of the Queen of Darkness. She was defeated by Yuna in the first video game. Since her defeat, she has become one of Yuna's closest friends and a powerful ally. Her alter-ego is Lia the Phoenix. Lia is also Polylina the Masked Maiden, a mask wearing, crime-fighting superheroine with her own TV show. For some reason, Yuna never figures out that her friend Lia is also her beloved Polylina. Lia (and Polylina) has a robotic pet cat named Milky, who can transform into various weapons. (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Galaxy_Fraulein_Yuna)

characters.name: Princess Mirage
characters.original: プリンセス・ミラージュ
characters.description: Her real name is "Culture Computer No.3". She first appears in Galaxy Fraulein Yuna 2: Eternal Princess as a captain of an extremely powerful battleship, the titular "Eternal Princess". Scattered throughout the galaxy, hidden beacons are placed throughout every planet left eons ago, which monitors the level of conflict in the area. Whenever there is a strong level of conflict, such as interplanetary warfare, the beacon signals the Eternal Princess to go and stop the wars from reaching galactic scale by destroying the planets that are involved with its main cannon. When Yuna and Erika engaged into a cat-fight, they happen to be close to the beacon which signals the Eternal Princess to come and destroy Earth. Luckily, with the help of Yuri, Yuna managed to stop Earth's destruction and gained Princess Mirage's friendship. Now Princess Mirage orbits around Earth watching over Yuna, and givin

description: A fangame based on Cheritz's wonderful mobile game, Mystic Messenger. After Jaehee's business proposal, the two of you have started running a cafe together, but it's time you made a proposal of your own...! Marry Me, Jaehee! was created by fans for everyone who loved Jaehee Kang's route, but wished for a longer (and unambiguously romantic) ending. [From itch.io]

title: Dear My Abyss
description: One day Subaru receives a weird book from an anonymous sender. The book has a putrid smell and is sealed. Within it is a message stating that she should never read it and that it’s impossible to dispose of, even by burning or cutting it to bits. Rather than being disgusted or afraid, Subaru thinks of it as a good way to pass time and decides to show it off to Misuka and Kazumi. They decide to try burning it but not before Subaru reads a bit of it. A few days later, strange things start to happen; the nice teacher who was Kazumi’s only ally disappears, strange people appear all around town looking for a book, and a transfer student immediately takes an interest in Subaru. [Edited from hadlerblog]

title: When Aster Falls
description: When Aster the succubus is assigned to human Rohan as her target, it seems like a simple enough job. Humans are an easy assignment, after all. Turns out that when a succubus is more than a little burned out, and when their target happens to be a feisty, blunt asexual, an easy assignment gets a little more complicated. [From itch.io]

title: Secret Satiation
description: A vampire + a new office job = OL Vampire! *OL for Office Lady In a city where a society of vampires secretly live amongst humans, Ada tries her best to keep her vampire identity hidden. Starting at a new job means starting with a clean slate and Ada is determined to keep this job for once. She tries her best to fit in and stay under the radar. That is, until she slowly begins to fall for her human co-worker. With the duty of keeping her vampire identity a secret, will she be able to confess despite the taboo of a vampire being together with a human? Can Ada even be in a relationship hiding such a big secret from a lover?! Read through this kinetic novel made for the 2017 Yuri Game Jam to see if Ada will end up baring her fangs feelings and secrets, or keep them sealed like a nailed shut coffin! [From Itch.io]

title: Shoujo to Tsumi: Shiori Hen ~jalouse~
description: Holy Innocence Girls’ Academy. A Christian school located deep in the quiet mountains of K Town in Nagano Prefecture. A rumor floats through its halls: “If you offer a prayer to the Virgin Mary, she will grant any wish… but in exchange, something important will be taken from you.” When Shiori Kusakabe enrolls as a new student, she is immediately drawn to her roommate, Miki Chigasaki. But, one fateful day, she discovers something about Miki by chance, and the emotions within her begin to stir… -This is a story of desire and sacrifice- [Edited from [URL=https://denpasoft.com/product/fallen-maidens-jalouse-shioris-story/]Denpasoft]

title: Night of the Lesbian Vampires
description: What’s more pathetic than being alone on a Friday night? Being alone at work on Halloween night because of a stack of paperwork, of course. What’s a girl to do when she gets two visitors at midnight who both want her- and some blood? - - - The year is 1997. After a successful blood donation drive, Mina is left working the graveyard shift on Halloween to catch up on all the paperwork. In the middle of yearning for her cheesy VHS rentals and the comfort of her pet rats, she hears something - someone? - outside. It’s two people- or rather, two vampires, both demanding a bit of blood. Once that small, sorta shady, detail is over with... Mina thinks she can go back to work. However, the night isn't over yet! [From itch.io]

characters.name: Mina
characters.description: "Real blood was just not as fun as fake blood." Mina loves horror movies and her pet rats. She's fastidious, self-sacrificing, and a little shy. Super gay. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Carmilla
characters.description: "My love, we are not here to give blood. We're here to take it." Carmilla is flirty, carefree, and incredibly cool. She thinks humans are cute and can be a bit naïve. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Elizabeth
characters.description: "If we don't get the blood here, we'll have to get it another way." Elizabeth is a newer vampire trying to act cooler than she really is. A bit of a goof when no one is looking. [From itch.io]
