tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Past Setting in a Fictional World
description: Your enemies stole your kingdom, but now the time has come for you to raise an army, master magic, and reclaim your crown! - Form alliances to build your army. - Master unique weapons. - Choose between elegant ball gowns and powerful armor. - Crush your enemies in an epic battle. [From Choices Wikia]

characters.name: Kenna Rys
characters.description: Kenna Rys is one of the main characters in "The Crown & The Flame" series along with Dominic Hunter, and is the current and rightful queen of Stormholt, the smallest of the Five Kingdoms. She is the only daughter of King Marcellus and Queen Adriana Rys of Stormholt.

characters.name: Dominic Hunter
characters.description: Dominic Hunter is a fire-user, a Stormholt scout of Fydorian origin, and one of the main characters in "The Crown & The Flame" series along with Kenna Rys.

characters.name: Raydan Lykel
characters.description: Raydan Lykel is a spy-master of The Gilded City, Aurelia. He is a love interest of Kenna.

characters.name: Annelyse Adair
characters.description: Annelyse Adair is the Queen of the Gilded City, Aurelia. She is a love interest of Kenna.

characters.name: Tevan Drammir
characters.description: Tevan Drammir is the son and heir of King Amanth Drammir of Fydoria. After King Amanth is killed, he becomes King of Fydoria and is also one of Kenna's love interests if you saved him in Book 1.

characters.name: Val Greaves
characters.description: Valentina "Val" Greaves is a mercenary. It is unknown which of The Five Kingdoms she is originally from. She is a love interest for Kenna.

characters.name: Gabriel Amarne
characters.description: Gabriel Amarne is Kenna's bodyguard.

characters.name: Rose Blake
characters.description: Rose Blake is a servant in the castle of Stormholt. She is one of Dominic Hunter's love interests.

characters.name: Will Jackson
characters.description: Will Jackson is a Stormholt soldier. He is one of the love interests for Dom.

characters.name: Leon Stirling
characters.description: Leon Stirling is a knight and the former Captain of the Royal Guard of Stormholt. He served as the Crown Guardian and Protector of the Queen.

characters.name: Severin Cale
characters.description: Severin Cale is the leader of the mercenaries.

characters.name: The Bear
characters.description: The Bear appears to threaten Kenna and her invasion force, but by paying diamonds the player can calm her down by removing a thorn from her paw. The bear can be named by the player if chosen as an ally.

characters.name: Mechataur
characters.description: The Mechataur is the mechanical guardian of the Technocrat's labyrinth.

characters.name: Whitlock
characters.description: Whitlock is the leader of the Technocrats.

characters.name: Sei Rhuka
characters.description: Sei Rhuka is a fire-user and one of Dom's love interests.

characters.name: Luther Nevrakis
characters.description: King Luther Nevrakis is the main antagonist of the second book and, in a sense, the entire story. He was the king of Abanthus until he took over the Five Kingdoms by killing their rulers.

characters.name: Marco Nevrakis
characters.description: Marco Nevrakis is one of King Luther's sons. He is the main antagonist of Book 1.

characters.name: Helene Leventis
characters.description: Helene Leventis is a military officer in the Nevrakis army, the Captain of the Royal Guard.

characters.name: The Hawk
characters.description: The Hawk is Dom's pet and is used to send messages to Kenna in Book 1. The player can choose its name.

characters.name: Trystan Blake
characters.description: Trystan Blake is a castle servant of Stormholt.

characters.name: Adriana Rys
characters.description: Queen Adriana Rys is Kenna's mother and the former queen of Stormholt.

title: Veil of Secrets
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Your best friend vanished without a trace on the day of her wedding! Search the town of Birchport to solve the mysteries, but be careful... everyone has a secret. [From Choices Wikia]

characters.name: Katherine O'Malley
characters.description: Kate O'Malley is Your Character's best friend from college, as well as Flynn's sister. She is the fiancé of Tanner Sterling, though the relationship is tumultuous due to both Tanner's family and her brother not approving of it. Her disappearance at the end of the first chapter spurs the book's events into motion. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Grant Emerson
characters.description: Grant Emerson is a defense lawyer in Birchport and one of your love interests. He makes his first appearance in Chapter 1. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Scarlett Emerson
characters.description: Scarlett Emerson is Grant's sister. She is shown to be rude, condescending and hostile, making remarks about the main character's style and commenting on how Kate supposedly lives on the Sterling's money. If you ask her why she is so mean, she will answer that she is simply realistic and honest. She makes her first appearance in Chapter 1. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Bryce Sterling
characters.description: Bryce Sterling is the younger brother of Tanner Sterling and the son of Pierce and Margaret. Bryce - unlike his parents - is explicit and open about his contempt for Tanner's fiance, Kate O'Malley, whom he perceives to be a gold digger. He makes his first appearance in Chapter 1. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Jesse
characters.description: Your Character is shown to be friendly and trusting, although they can become assertive when others treat them or the people they care about poorly; thus, they are determined to keep things fair. Your Character is hinted at being clever, being characterized as a "Ravenclaw" while they were in college. They are also brave and dedicated to justice given that they spend days searching for Kate after it becomes clear that Walsh is corrupt and Duffy is incompetent. Your Character is also willing to take risks for others, such as [spoiler]stealing a piece of evidence rather than Naomi or Flynn so they wouldn't get in trouble. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Tanner Sterling
characters.description: Tanner Sterling is the heir to the Sterling family, the son of Pierce and Margaret Sterling, and the older brother of Bryce Sterling. To the dismay of his family, Tanner is engaged to Kate O'Malley, whom the rest of his family suspects is a gold digger given her working class roots. He makes his first appearance in Chapter 1. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Naomi Silverhawk
characters.description: Naomi Silverhawk is one of the deputies of the Birchport Police Department and one of Your Character's love interests. She makes her first appearance in Chapter 2. Despite her no-nonsense approach to solving cases, Naomi also has a soft side; this includes reading a lot of romance novels, which she admits to enjoying because of their happy endings. In a premium scene in Chapter 9, she mentions that she loves the helpful community aspect of Birchport, but feels frustrated by the elites due to their superior haughty attitudes. In Chapter 11, she mentions she's had trouble making friends in Birchport as the town's locals are unfriendly towards outsiders. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Jeff Duffy
characters.description: Jeff Duffy is one of the deputies of the Birchport Police Department. He makes his first appearance in Chapter 2. Duffy is timid and obedient towards his superior, Chief Walsh. He is also shown to be dimwitted, given his tendency to say or do things that make himself and Walsh look foolish. [spoiler]However, this is just a cover. It is revealed in Chapter 14 that he is The Birchport Killer and has been targeting the Sterlings for the death of his mother, Alanis Acosta. If Your Character chooses to save Nikolai, they can inform Duffy in Chapter 15 of his birth name, Taylor Acosta. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Tino Thompson
characters.description: Tino is a state investigator, making his first and only appearance in Chapter 14 to take over the case and bring [spoiler]Chief Walsh and Margaret Sterling into his custody. [spoiler]Before he can do this he is murdered by Jeff Duffy, who then proceeds to kill Tino's two prisoners and kidnap Kate O'Malley, declaring his intention to murder her as well. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Eleanor Harlenay
characters.description: Eleanor Harlenay is the innkeeper of the B-and-B in Birchport. She makes her first appearance in Chapter 1. Eleanor is shown to be helpful and giving, as she constantly offers her own outfits to Your Character. Eleanor is also blunt, the major example of which being when she tries to tell stories about her romantic experiences with various ex-spouses and ex-partners [spoiler](and later with her fiancée Samantha Winters) until Your Character stops her. She also finds all of Your Character's suitors attractive and says that if she was younger, she would pursue them herself. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Margaret Sterling
characters.description: Margaret Sterling is the wife of Pierce Sterling and the mother of Tanner and Bryce. Like the rest of her family, her main concern is her family's reputation and how to protect it. She does not hide her disdain for Kate or anyone who associates with her, [spoiler]calling her a "murdering whore" and wishing for her death in jail following Kate's arrest. Kate's disappearance is not much of a concern for her, even using the opportunity to further insult her when she isn't present to defend herself. [spoiler]Twenty-five years earlier, she used Nikolai Petrov's romantic feelings towards her to manipulate him into murdering Alanis Acosta, Pierce's mistress. However, Nikolai could not bear to leave Alanis's child, Taylor, to burn in the ensuing house fire and took him to safety. [spoiler]Shortly before Kate's wedding day, Taylor was informed by Nikolai of what happened to his birth mother. In r

Brother & Sister Siblings as Love Interests

full_description: Your best friend vanished without a trace on the day of her wedding! Search the town of Birchport to solve the mysteries, but be careful... everyone has a secret. [From Choices Wikia]

title: I ordered a cute child robot! (I don't like that term. I'm a household android.)
description: It's the future. You are a computer professional. You decide to customise and buy a childlike sentient android. Five years of service are included. After that, the android will be free to stay with you or move on. How you treat them will determine whether they stay and what sort of relationship may develop. They can be your servant. Your friend. Your ward. You choose. [Taken from Itch.io page]

title: Across the Void
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You're the new captain of a luxury space liner, and it's your job to make sure your passengers cross the galaxy safely -- in the middle of a galactic civil war! This romantic space opera is like nothing you've experienced! [From Choices Wikia]

characters.name: Zaniah
characters.description: Zaniah is the Senior Engineer of the Atlas and one of Pax Elara's love interests. She is first seen in Chapter 4. Like Deimos, she is a member of the alien race Thol.

characters.name: Kepler
characters.description: Kepler is the new security officer on board the Atlas and one of Main Character's love interests. She takes her job seriously and seems eager to inflict pain on other people. She mentions having a "favorite torture knife", implying that she has tortured people in the past. Race: Lektra [Edited from the Wiki]

plot_tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests

tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: A young man/woman believes that they meet their ideal partner through a dating service, but soon come to realize everything is not as it seems. [From Choices Wikia]

characters.name: Alana Kusuma
characters.description: Alana is an Interpol agent who happens to be Damien Nazario's ex-coworker and ex-girlfriend. She is [spoiler]one of your love interests in Book 2. She is first seen in Book 1, Chapter 11. Alana initially shows a hostile personality, wanting your character and their friends to leave the Berlin Safe House. She later allows them to stay, though only for a night. It is hinted that she is corrupt, as Damien states that a lot of her methods are illegal and she only cares for herself. [Edited from the Wiki]

title: Pirates Of Gensokyo
description: A short visual novel about 4 girls, one of which will discover who they are. Marisa rounds up a most unlikely crew, in search of adventure, and of course, treasure! Interpersonal conflict ensues among the crew, but in the end their stark differences bring clarity in their personal lives. The real treasure is the one you find within yourself! Featuring: Marisa, Sanae, Alice, and Satori.

characters.name: Alice Margatroid
characters.original: アリス マーガトロイド

title: After I met that catgirl, my questlist got too long!
description: Catgirl's Questlist is everything we love made into one game: an isekai with yuri romance, half RPG and half visual novel. Vera, the player character, is a charm witch with an everlasting love for all things of beauty, and an even bigger love for women. Catgirls, elves or humans... she doesn't discriminate. After her fateful meeting with the catgirl Téa, who claims to come from another world and to actually be a human, Vera decides to join forces with her and form a guild. That allows Téa to play dictator, and gives Vera the opportunity to meet cute girls and frolic around, discovering things about the world she could have never imagined before.

characters.name: Vera
characters.description: Vera, the player character, would keep a rose in her mouth, if that didn't making sweet-talking women--or simply talking--difficult. She has always wanted to be an adventurer, and doesn't mind long walks on the beach if there's a cute girl at the finish line. She likes to name her spells, but doesn't shout "Forbidden Bind!" or "Dangerous Lips!" in battle. Yet.

characters.name: Téa
characters.description: Téa claims to come from London. She was supposed to take a state exam to become a real estate agent when, somehow, she found herself at the feet of the Elder Tree. She would sell all the knowledge she has about the speed of light and other sciency things... if only she remembered the fine details.

characters.name: Reniel
characters.description: Reniel is one of the Ostmoor Elves. She will pet all the dogs. She will squeal at every cat. Giant monsters with sharp horns and bloodshot eyes? She thinks they're cute. She can't control her magic very well, and in order to wield it she gives it the shape of either a shield or a sword. She always makes the best of what she has.

characters.name: Sunny
characters.description: Sunny takes her oath seriously, and despite what you may want, she will heal you. Sure, her mixtures might sting, or burn like scalding water, or taste like pure, unfiltered lemon juice... but they're healthy. She's passionate about alchemy, but her work history is a big question mark, and she doesn't like to answer the many questions that come up about it.

characters.name: Lyra
characters.description: Lyra comes to your aid in the capital. Her words are blunt, yet her eyes betray a certain fondness for Vera. Who is she, and why does her name sound familiar..?

title: Death Becomes You
description: You find your best friend dead, and 4 suspicious students lingering around the scene. Who is the one that did it, and how come you never knew about their complicated history with your best friend? Who is lying about their intentions on that night? Death Becomes You is a mystery visual novel where you, the reader, untangle the reasons behind Lyra's death by building friendships with 4 of your fellow magic students. Choices matter and affect the 4 routes of the story. You find the truth - who had the motivation to kill Lyra? Or did Lyra have a secret that she was hiding? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Sidney
characters.description: She's a 1st year student at the Ira Royal Academy, and Lyra was her best friend and mentor. When the latter is found dead, she decides to investigate to find out who might have murdered her.

characters.name: Alice
characters.description: Alice specializes in Elemental magic. She enjoys lazing around on the Academy's grounds, soaking in the sun and nature, and pulls Sophie along whenever she has a chance. She openly dislikes Lyra, who was Sophie's mentor during 1st year. It's rumored that Alice doesn't study at all, due to the many 1st year courses she is retaking.

characters.name: Daniella
characters.description: Daniella is the Vice Head Mentor at the Ira Royal Academy, known for her strict demeanour and perfectionism. She is feared by most students in the university, apart from Lyra, the former Head Mentor, and Apolline. Daniella's specialization is Transmutation, and it rumored that she can turn under-performing mentees into crystal statues.

characters.name: Apolline
characters.description: Apolline is a rare magic user skilled at two specializations - Enchantment and Elemental magic. She is popular as a substitute mentor and instructor due to this, but for some reason, Lyra hasn't assigned her an office. Known for being kind and gentle, it's hard to understand how she could get along with Daniella. it is rumored that Apolline can summon wings and fly.

characters.name: Lyra
characters.description: The protagonist's best friend and devoted mentor. she is found dead at the beginning of the story. The protagonist, accused of her murder at first, will investigate to find the true culprit.

characters.name: Sophie
characters.description: Sophie specializes in Psychokinesis. she's known as a prodigy, being able to control not just objects, but pure energy. She enjoys painting and writing fiction, to test the limits of how her magic can alter the fabric of physical reality. It's rumored that she has been scouted for the Academy years prior, but delayed her start date to be the same as Alice's.

full_description: You find your best friend dead, and 4 suspicious students lingering around the scene. Death Becomes You is a mystery visual novel where you, the reader, untangle the reasons behind Lyra's death by building friendships with 4 of your fellow magic students. title: Dear Genny
description: On a quiet Saturday in September, Maria goes to her room to text her best friend, Genny, something very important. Only, it might be too late to tell Genny and Maria doesn't have much in the way of courage. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Maria
characters.description: A high-school student who recently discovered that she is lesbian. A bit shy and undecisive, she tries her best to express her feelings to Genny, her best friend since elementary school.

full_description: On a quiet Saturday in September, Maria goes to her room to text her best friend, Genny, something very important. Only, it might be too late to tell Genny and Maria doesn't have much in the way of courage. [From Itch.io]

title: Kiss the Demiurge
description: [i]"For the purification of humanity!" Kiss the Demiurge is a dark comedy yuri visual novel about magic, delusions, regret, and love. It follows the story of a girl named Minori, the mage who absolutely hates magic. As a child, she wished to become a magical girl like the heroes she saw on TV. One day, a mysterious voice offered to grant her magic powers and make her dreams come true. The young Minori eagerly accepted the stranger's gift, and was absolutely delighted as magic powers were bestowed upon her. But unfortunately for her, she soon came to realise that the gift of magic was actually a curse, a force of nature far beyond her control. Minori's magic misfired and both of her parents disappeared from this world because of it. She grew up wracked with guilt and declared that she would atone for her sins by ridding the world of all those who would seek magic. Minori investigates a fi

characters.name: Minori Nakahashi
characters.description: Minori works tirelessly to keep the world safe from magic. She considers herself to be a machine whose personal feelings are irrelevant. But even the stoic Minori has a sensitive side. She feels great attraction towards other girls, which she views as a distraction. But how long will she be able to suppress those feelings for? [From Steam]

characters.name: Akane Aoki
characters.description: Akane is the self-proclaimed leader of the club. She claims that she's descended from an ancient line of magical samurai and will proudly boast of this heritage to anyone who'll listen. She's certain that one day the world will understand her genius, and give her family the respect they deserve. [From Steam]

characters.name: Chitori Nozawa
characters.description: Chitori is a shy fortune teller. She would like for nothing more than the world to leave her alone with her books. Whether it's tarot cards, astrology, or a crystal ball, she'll use whatever she can to predict the future and avoid any unwanted surprises. [From Steam]

characters.name: Tomoko Tanaka
characters.description: The elegant and beautiful Tomoko claims to be a spirit medium who regularly speaks to the spirits of the dead. She's always eager to help people connect with the spirits of deceased friends and family. Perhaps a little bit too eager... [From Steam]

characters.name: Kasumi
characters.description: Minori's mother.

characters.name: Takashi Nakahashi
characters.description: Minori's grandfather.

characters.name: Cynthia
characters.description: Tomoko's mother.

title: Eldritch Idol
description: Some time after being fired from their idol agency, You (name changeable) stumbles upon a cute young girl with big, big dreams. She introduces herself as Cthulhu (aka Kuku), a Great Old One from the underwater ruins of R'lyeh. For many years, Kuku has whiled away her long, long life dreaming... But, during this time, her dedicated following has dwindled down to almost nothing! Determined to revitalize her cult and regain a brand new slew of worshippers, Kuku comes up with a masterful plan: namely, that she'll become an adorable idol and conquer the world through her singing, her dancing, and her charm! Work with Kuku as her producer to manage her schedule, raise her stats, and make decisions that will shape the trajectory of her career. Don't let her get too stressed, though: otherwise, the world might come to a watery end. [Edited from Itch.io]

characters.name: Karen Aoyagi
characters.description: Founder and manager of Aoyagi Productions, and You Yashima's friend since childhood. She has a lazy eye, which she covers with an eyepatch.

characters.name: You Yashima
characters.description: Former employee of Aoyagi Productions. After their friend Karen had let them go from the company on account of their poor performance, they're left searching for a purpose in life until they stumble upon Kuku, who requests that they help her become an idol and revitalize her dwindling following.

characters.name: Kuku
characters.description: A Great Old One hailing from the underwater city of R'lyeh. Aiming to revive her dedicated following of worshippers after her cult has dwindled down to almost nothing, she enlists the help of You Yashima to make her into the most popular and adorable idol ever known.

title: There's No Way I'd Fall in Love With a Womanizer, Right?
description: Being the type that cares too much to a fault, Asahina Umeko helps out a supposedly drunk girl one night, and she soon finds out that this girl is the hot new celebrity worker at the mall she works at. She's instantly attracted despite their weird first meeting, but all that goes down the drain when Umeko finds out that this girl is a serial womanizer that breaks one too many hearts and with everything pointing to red flags. Umeko swears off falling for her, but can she really resist getting swept up by this womanizer's charisma, or will she end up getting drunk off her? Grab a drink and read through "There's No Way I'd Fall in Love With a Womanizer, Right?" to find out! [From itch.io]

title_original: 百合の花学園寮 ～早春のカノン～
description: Set in their school dormitory, a sad story of a forbidden love hidden in a girl's heart.... The story takes on the 3 protagonists' perspectives as they each become entangled in the forbidden love triangle.

characters.name: Kudou Hatsumi
characters.description: A girl who was frail in the previous work. Years passed, and she returned to the school as a new teacher. She also takes care of the students in the dormitory.

full_description: Set in their school dormitory, a sad story of a forbidden love hidden in a girl's heart.... The story takes on the 3 protagonists' perspectives as they each become entangled in the forbidden love triangle.

title: Fermion ~Mirai kara no Houmonsha~
title_original: フェルミオン ～未来からの訪問者～
description: The future isn't so bright. Pollution has severely weakened Earth and all of it's children, including humankind. Human DNA is too weak to reproduce itself and scientists are desperately trying to revive the human DNA. But every attempt fails, even the desperate attempt to fuse Human and Animal DNA turns out to create mutants that run amok. Everything seems hopeless. But suddenly, scientists detect a space-time displacement, a gap in time. The gap will hold for a couple of days, and during which people may be sent through time. Your mission as a Half-Human, Half-Feline, mutant-hunter Conny, is to back in time to the present (the late 20th century) and recover samples of healthy human DNA. [From Anime Densetsu]

title: Mahou Shoujo Ai San
description: Ai and Akitoshi lose a battle against Sin and Megu, their friend, is kidnapped by him. They try to find her, but she is still missing.... One day, Yukari, Akitoshi's friend, appears in front of him and the story gradually goes forward.... [From Eroge Shop]

characters.name: Meg
characters.description: Rin and Ai’s senior, she is known as the strongest warrior, to the extent of being called a “demon god,” despite her gentle and soft appearance. She has a kind, “big sister” type personality. Her willingness to actively interact with humans makes her an outlier in her world. She comes to Akitoshi’s apartment as its manager. In truth, she is secretly tasked with a mission to kill Shin.

description: Naomi has entered a forbidden place, The House of Beautiful Women. What happens to innocent girls there? Come on and open the door! You control their fate! [translated from fandc.co.jp]
full_description: Naomi has entered a forbidden place, The House of Beautiful Women. What happens to innocent girls there? Come on and open the door! You control their fate! [translated from fandc.co.jp]

title: Lunatic Fantasy
description: The story starts with an amnesiac woman, who is only able to remember her name - Fab, waking up in the forest. With the help of local dryads Fab reaches a nearby town and stops at the tavern. Suddenly she is approached by a blind girl who proclaims: "Mommy, you finally returned"...

title: Itoshi no☆My Master
description: Once there lived a normal madam and maid in a village. They were perfectly normal. Normal life, normal relationship, but kind of abnormal. This is how things changed. [from DLsite English] Based on a series of short stories by the circle.
full_description: Once there lived a normal madam and maid in a village. They were perfectly normal. Normal life, normal relationship, but kind of abnormal. This is how things changed. [from DLsite English] Based on a series of short stories by the circle.

title: Natsuzora Asterism
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: [i]I wanted to feel yet more closely, the shine of those stars that seem within arm's reach. Beneath this sky unfolds an ordinary girls' summer. An ordinary summer spent by ordinary girls, who live in an ordinary town and attend an ordinary school, walking there down the usual road, at the usual pace, surrounded by the usual smiles. A single, unchanging summer woven together by these girls. This is the story of their love that you'll surely want to reach for.

characters.name: Tsubakisawa Shinano
characters.description: The gentle, positive protagonist who loves stars. The protagonist of Natsuzora Asterism. A girl whose strong point is her bright and energetic personality. She loves her friends, school and stargazing. Her friends call her Kano. Her greatest worry used to be her lack of worries, but it looks like this summer will be a bit different!?

characters.name: Hinata Hollyhock Seika
characters.description: The mascot of the Himawari Restaurant, gifted with both beauty and brains. Shinano's childhood friend. She's a quarter-blood, but she's only ever been overseas once. A put-together and caring girl who's a bit rough around the edges. She's been helping out around her family's Himawari Restaurant as of late.

characters.name: Hasekura Momiji
characters.description: The handsome shrine maiden apprentice at the Mikami Shrine. Shinano's childhood friend who's following in her family's footsteps and training to become a shrine maiden. She's a very well put-together and caring girl, but also has a bit of an eccentric side to her. She sometimes worries about her small breasts.

characters.name: Nabana Juna
characters.description: If she starts running she can't stop!? A girl who loves the track and field. Shinano's friend. In charge of being lively. She's totally full of life, vitality incarnated - and really, isn't that the most important thing? She's laid back, but surprisingly serious about her club activities. A girl who's at the age where she loves moving her body whenever there's time to spare.

characters.name: Utsugi Sarasa
characters.description: A class president who supports her class from behind the scenes. Shinano's class prez. She fits the role to a T - she's gentle, earnest, reliable and accomplished in her studies. She gives her all for the sake of the class every single day.

characters.name: Tsubakisawa Yuino
characters.description: "There's no little sister who's better than her older sister!!" Shinano's younger sister. She loves her older sister. Like Shinano, her strong point is her bright and energetic-- You'd think so, at least...

characters.name: Nishikigi Hana
characters.description: A soft, gentle and fluffy teacher. Shinano's homeroom teacher. Sometimes she's harsh, sometimes she's gentle, but fundamentally she's laid back and very popular among the students. An adult woman who lives a fulfilled life both in public and private.

characters.name: Hannari Mio
characters.description: An elusive, yet reliable onee-san who keeps the town's peace. A civil servant from a neighbouring town who works to keep the peace. She ran into Shinano and her friends while out on her rounds, and seems to get along with them. Sometimes you'll run into her in places you'd least expect, and sometimes you won't.

characters.name: Yotsuzumi Kokona
characters.description: A girl with a mysterious air to her.

title: Summer In Trigue
description: Sybil Harrison, struggling writer and connoisseur of dead-end jobs, at least believes she’s in a secure and happy relationship with Liz Fuentes, an ambitious but domineering young lawyer. Coming home early one day after being laid off yet again, she finds Liz in a compromising situation with another woman and her world falls apart. Angry at being betrayed, she sabotages the romantic holiday she and Liz were about to embark on together to the romantic yet mysterious island of Trigue and goes on her own. Once in Trigue, however, events quickly take a devastating turn and Sybil finds herself relying on four very different but captivating women to navigate her way through the mess she finds herself in. But can any of them be truly trusted? And why hasn’t Liz even contacted her after that fateful day? [From Steam]

characters.name: Grace
characters.description: A young woman who was born in and raised in California, Grace had a fairly sheltered life due to her somewhat overprotective parents and the fact that she was homeschooled since kindergarten. When the chance to do some seasonal work in Trigue alongside a friend came to her, she took it, partially to do something a bit daring and force herself to grow, and partially to get a reprieve from her parents’ hints about how much they’d just love some grandchildren. She has an introverted nature and struggles somewhat with social anxiety, but despite this, balances part-time jobs as both a waitress and a bartender. She far prefers the latter job, and has found an unexpected talent for mixing drinks, a previously unrealized love of booze, and a penchant for sensing people’s moods have all helped her excel at it. Her high level of patience has helped her with both jobs. Grace is a huge fan of ficti

characters.name: Mia
characters.description: Mia is an outgoing and athletic woman who works in Trigue as a tourist guide and instructor for several activities. This is much to Mia’s liking, for though the work can be tiring, it allows her to constantly experience the beautiful sites that can be found in Trigue. Mia loves the outdoors and is especially found of scuba diving, and so she is super happy to have been born and raised on an island like Trigue. She also likes living in Trigue because the island’s name lends itself to puns. Mia is a huge pun lover, and enjoys making her friends groan with them. Her overall sense of humor is a bit dark, and she often jokes about how her job lets her know the perfect places to hide a body. At least most people assume she’s joking. characters.name: Alex
characters.description: Alex is a cheerful young singer from Trigue. She started singing while a very young child and kept at it, initially simply because she enjoyed it so much. It was only after much practice that she discovered she had an innate talent for it as well. She later partnered with a friend of hers who was a skilled song writer, and with his help she is now able to make a decent living off of her voice. She spends a fair amount of time singing in bars and clubs, and really enjoys the more personal atmosphere of singing in such places. Alex is very confident in her abilities, her looks, and herself in general, though she is not particularly arrogant. She simply feels that people should properly recognize their own talents, and that when someone denies the abilities they have been clearly blessed with, it is very depressing and sometimes even a bit insulting. characters.description: Shiori is a Japanese woman in her mid twenties, and someone who has had a rather interesting life. Though much of those “interesting” parts involves things in her youth that she’d prefer never happened, her current life is very much to her liking. Thanks to a fairly large inheritance and some success in her photography career, she is able to indulge in her hobbies and travel frequently. And her most recent travels have taken her to Trigue for an extended stay. Shiori can be a bit sarcastic and blunt at times. She is fluent in Japanese, English, and French, and takes great pleasure in the fact that she knows insults and curses in multiple languages. Indeed, she specifically learned just the insults and curses of seven additional languages. characters.name: Sybil
characters.description: The protagonist of Summer in Trigue, Sybil is a young woman with a very particular view about fate. Back when she was a child, Sybil often noticed a lot of strange coincidences occurring in her life. Her friends told her it might be fate or destiny, but Sybil didn’t believe such things actually existed… not at first that is. Now that she is an adult, Sybil has become convinced that Fate with a capital F does exist, and that it hates her guts. Or, at the very least, she feels it enjoys playing oftentimes cruel jokes and tricks on her, as shown by the fact that the “strange coincidences” have continued to occur with alarming frequency throughout her life, and have often been unpleasant and oddly specific. full_description: Sybil Harrison, struggling writer and connoisseur of dead-end jobs, at least believes she’s in a secure and happy relationship with Liz Fuentes, an ambitious but domineering young lawyer. Coming home early one day after being laid off yet again, she finds Liz in a compromising situation with another woman and her world falls apart. Angry at being betrayed, she sabotages the romantic holiday she and Liz were about to embark on together to the romantic yet mysterious island of Trigue and goes on her own. Once in Trigue, however, events quickly take a devastating turn and Sybil finds herself relying on four very different but captivating women to navigate her way through the mess she finds herself in. But can any of them be truly trusted? And why hasn’t Liz even contacted her after that fateful day? [From Steam]

characters.description: The older half of fraternal twins (Kaitlyn is his younger sister), Brandon is a recent graduate with a degree in criminology who’s just now starting to take the first steps beyond university. Given his physique, most people assumed he played football while in college, but Brandon would explain that lifting weights actually helped him graduate. His friends would teasingly say that he must be a straight A student then. Long term, he’d like to attend law school, but that takes some serious money, and Brandon was feeling a little burned out with school anyways. So, he managed to line up a job, but it won’t start for another three months. As a result, Brandon is currently living at home and hopes to find enough work in the summer so he can afford a place of his own. However, all is not as good as it seems. characters.name: Kaitlyn Lawrence
characters.description: Kaitlyn, the younger fraternal twin of Brandon, just graduated with a degree in chemical engineering. She was fortunate to procure an entry level position at a pharmaceuticals company, but her new job won’t start for a few months. As such, Kaitlyn’s trying to earn what she can while staying at home, so she could have her own place. It isn’t that her parents minded her presence, but Kaitlyn wants to spread her wings, and show that she can make it on her own. Ultimately, she wants to be her own boss, but that dream is much further down the line. Now that she’s out of school, Kaitlyn would also like to relax a little. Especially during her last year of school, she had to give up much of her free time in order do as well as she did. Kaitlyn is now wondering whether all this studying was good for her, though. characters.name: Viktor Hammond
characters.description: Viktor is among the rarest of people, those who are aware of the supernatural, but remain essentially human. Often such individuals transcend their human self, whether by becoming something decidedly non-human, or else pick up torches and pitchforks to hunt it down. Viktor is neither; instead, he is a scientist, documenting all that he notices until he can reveal it at a later date. Initially, he was one of those skeptics who would laugh at someone if they mentioned believing in ghosts, or having seen a UFO. However, his certainty suffered its first crack when he went on a ghost-hunt and encountered a real ghost. At first, he assumed he was the butt of some elaborate practical joke, but his fellow classmates were just as astonished with what they witnessed. characters.name: Sabrina Trejo
characters.description: The first impression most people get when they meet Sabrina is a stubborn, contentious young woman, and they wouldn’t be wrong. It isn’t that she aims to piss anyone off, but that seems to be how things work out. Some think this behavior developed because Sabrina’s father remarried when she was quite young, but this is far from the truth. Sabrina loves her step-mother as much as she does her birth mother, and adores her step-siblings, Kaitlyn and Brandon. Others think her rebelliousness stems from a deep seated dislike of authority, as evidenced by her falling grades, and disruptiveness in the classroom. Further examination reveals Sabrina was an average student until the age of 16. What precipitated her change came one fateful night when she was supposed to spend time with her birth mother. What might be more surprising, however, is that Tyrone is also one of the top students trying to earn a business degree. Unlike many other athletes, Tyrone wants to take full advantage of his athletic scholarship since the odds are against any student making it into professional sports. Despite his athletic prowess, Tyrone is a bit aloof, keeping himself at arm’s length from a serious relationship…which makes him that much more desirable to people who want to break through his tough outer shell. This isn’t to say Tyrone is shy, but there is a reason he keeps himself apart…and that’s because he’s found himself in a bit of a predicament, one he doesn’t feel he can share with anyone else. title: Lovewood
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Lovewood is a cozy fantasy dating sim in which you play the new healer in the town of Liebwald. Healing physical injuries is like second nature to you, but can you be a balm to your neighbors' hearts as well? Features include circa 2 hours per playthrough, six romance options and a protagonist that can be named and whose pronouns can be chosen.

characters.name: Nord
characters.description: Nord is the first love interest you meet in Lovewood. He is the cheerful messenger to the royal court, serving as a general legman for Lord Oberon and helping out with chores around town. He also makes an appearance as one of the two main characters in When Trees Turn to Ice.

characters.name: Atlas
characters.description: Atlas is the second love interest in Lovewood. He is a strong and calm fairy who loves to cook and has a food delivery service with Nord, who frequently visits him. Atlas lives a little way off the main town, in a cottage in the forest. He is known to occasionally help out during events by cooking for the royal court. He also makes an appearance as one of the two main characters in When Trees Turn to Ice.

characters.name: Blossom
characters.description: Blossom is the third romance option in Lovewood. She is a farmer in the town of Liebwald, living next-door to the protagonist. She is shown to have a long-lasting friendship with Moth, the tailor, and takes a lot of pride in her wool bunnies.

characters.name: Moth
characters.description: Moth is the tailor in the town of Liebwald and the fourth romance option in the game. He takes a lot of pride in his craft and is shown to be quite a perfectionist. The animal parts of his appearance are based on the cross fox, a colour variation of the red fox.

characters.name: Aleth
characters.description: Aleth is the fifth romance option in Lovewood. They are the travelling merchant who frequently stops by Liebwald and is a good friend of Kaileen. Aleth has a curse that makes it impossible for them to speak out true statements, instead talking in a lie whenever they try. This curse was a result of an alchemy accident, and they get around it by speaking mainly through written text on a portable chalkboard, paraphrasing their sentences as questions, using sarcasm or using the occasional BSL sign as shorthand in conversations.

characters.name: Kaileen
characters.description: Kaileen is the sixth romance option in Lovewood. She is a botanist and alchemist who cares for a large garden, and she is a good friend of Aleth.

characters.name: Lord Oberon
characters.description: Lord Oberon is the ruler over the fairy settlement of Liebwald. He is married to Lady Titania and lives at the royal residence. [spoiler]He is shown to be the protector of the fairy territory, using a spear to fight off opponents when necessary, though it appears that he takes little pride in the process.

characters.name: Lyca
characters.description: Lyca is a wolf person who frequently "visits" Liebwald and the surrounding area, usually to cause trouble for the fairy population. The player can encounter her multiple times, depending on the choices they make.

characters.name: Protagonist
characters.description: The protagonist of Lovewood is named Quince by default if no other name is entered. While the name and pronouns can be chosen, some other characteristics about them are set in stone. They are a healer who freshly moves to the town of Liebwald in the beginning of the game, trying to start a life of their own. Their magical talents are healing physical injuries and creating light. They are a little socially anxious and draw and paint in their free time, and they are rather knowledgable in botany as well. They have not been in a romantic relationship before the beginning of the game, and it is suggested that they are in their early twenties. Most of their physical traits are hidden underneath their outfit, but their bear ears and the blonde tufft of hair is usually visible as poking out from underneath their hood. title: At Your Feet

description: After Kairi and Ranko convince the mysterious gamer girl Yuki to join the ranks of this peculiar idol project, two new relaxing trips are coming up next for our girls... It's time to take Yuki-chan out to the hot springs and the beach! title: RENAI BAKUDAN
description: Having just dealt with the roughest time in her life, Juri Kido's luck is finally turning around. At the invitation of her best friend, Juri moves to the small, coastal town of Akiyama; leaving behind the big city of Tokyo for good. But what Juri doesn’t know is just what kind of place this cozy locale really is... Because Akiyama is not only home to a massive red-light district, but also houses the biggest, hottest, and weirdest love hotel in the world; HOTEL BAKUDAN! After meeting seven beautiful ladies and scoring a job at the hotel, Juri knows that this is the golden opportunity she's been searching for. With so much sex, drama and romance at every turn, Juri has no doubt that living in Akiyama is going to change her life. Just what awaits her on these sunny shores? Welcome to HOTEL BAKUDAN. We hope you enjoy your stay! [From Steam]

However, she isn't a entrepreneurial juggernaut for nothing. When it comes to choosing an heiress to her life's work, all she sees are numbers. You'll be expected to outshine your five competitors in wit, intelligence, and wisdom as you all struggle to lay claim to a harem that would leave you financially secure for life. The men are socially and lawfully bound to be dutiful to the woman of the house and only the most profitable and long-standing woman may inherit Xuna's harem, fortune, and legacy. [From Itch.io]

title: Our Home.
tags: Modern Day United States of America
description: "Our Home." is a work of fiction that explores themes of escapism, self-determination, and the importance of deciding one's own path in life. What is important to you, and what do you wish to protect? What is home? Is it an idea, or a place to go? Emily Westenson is the oldest daughter in her family. Faced with mounting responsibilities and stress, a family tearing itself apart, and a sense of drive and creativity that have all but vanished from her, Emily faces each day with cynicism and exhaustion. Is this the way it has to be? Does she have to go it alone? Presented by a team of about 30 collaborating visual novel creators for NaNoRenO 2017 in a month's time, "Our Home." draws on challenges close to the heart of the creative soul. It explores mature subject matter, mixing wit, drama, romance, and heart.

title: Rising Angels: Fates Allegiance
description: It has been a month since the crew of the Katajion spaceship Nimross returned safely after a mission to recover a prized artifact went awry. Command's support of how everything transpired is weak and many of her crew face disciplinary actions for their part in the operation. It all weighs heavily on Major Natalie Puccile, whose investigation led them down that route, but not nearly as much as the knowledge that she was forced to decide between the woman she cared about and her mission. With only a tankard and a collection of games to distract her from her life, Natalie begins to question why she signed up in the first place. That's when the first ray of hope in the storm of her life begins to shine through. A charming woman, Aria, comes to the suffering major with a dire plea. When taking a prominent researcher to a campsite, her shuttle went down and Aria needs the help of the KSS Nimro

characters.name: Natalie Puccile
characters.description: The protagonist. A brilliant mind who always excelled at schooling, Natalie won numerous awards growing up for academic excellence. When she graduated, Natalie immediately joined the space force to work as a Special Investigations and Tactics officer. During training, she rapidly overtook her peers. However, few people wanted to associate with her due to her brazen nature and elitism. After a whistleblowing incident, Natalie was assigned to manage an outpost in the middle of nowhere with only a couple of robots. Nevertheless, Natalie worked hard and was finally award a chance to prove herself to command.

characters.name: Zuri
characters.description: The security officer of the KSS Nimross. In high school, Zuri was a track star, admired galaxy-wide for her speed. When she graduated, she accepted a commission to the academy to become a security officer. Spunky and determined, Zuri’s fearless and optimistic nature serves as a rallying point to those around her. While she questions herself, there is nothing more important to her than striving to be a true warrior and protect her friends.

characters.name: Sol Hackett
characters.description: A fighter pilot who has spent the last couple years fighting in the war. After losing the love of his life to a non-human, Sol’s bitter hatred for non-humans has only amplified. While fighting in the war, Sol’s constant loss of loved ones and friends has led him to become pessimistic and depressed. Tough on his fellow pilots, Sol knows it is only a matter of time before they leave him as well.

title: My Very Own Lith
description: My Very Own Lith is a text-based Flash game centered around an easily embarrassed cat boy (or girl) named Lith. You can befriend him, seduce him, submit to him, or dominate him, or combine these approaches as you like, and as you play the game, you will learn about Lith and help him to solve his own internal conflicts. Can you and Lith find happiness together, or will you linger forever in the Void? The VN is still being worked on by its creator Lithier, and new visual art is being added as soon as he is able to get it drawn. The written portions go far beyond the currently illustrated portions at the time of writing, with three main branches that themselves both branch out into more minor branches, both before and after the branch is completed. Furthermore, there are still more choices and opportunities only available depending on the settings chosen at the start of the game.

However, the ideal school life at Solana Academy is disrupted by the sudden appearance of grotesque monsters from the formerly sealed-off old dormitory. A chance discovery of magical “petals” leaves four students as the only line of defense against this threat. But as the girls investigate the old dormitory for a way to be rid of the monsters, they begin to uncover a sinister truth regarding their school… [From Itch.io]

She feels guilty about everything... but for the time being she just needs to hold it together while hanging outside with her best friends. [From itch.io]

title: Twin Blue Moons
description: At the beginning of the summer, Maya is brought to a remote forest area at her elder sister Nami's whim. Although discontented with the development at first, Maya's natural curiosity soon drives her to explore the new surroundings. Before long she has made a handful of new friends, among which are the forgetful girl at the lakeside, Lilia, and the eccentric alchemist, Kinoko. Strange things start happening at nighttime, yet Maya's dreams feel more realistic than ever. Who are those tattooed girls that keep appearing before her time after time? Nami seems to know something, but it is as challenging as ever to learn the truth from her. [From Steam]

characters.name: Maya
characters.description: Likes: Hot baths, Chatting, Exploration Doesn’t like: Insects, Bad endings The protagonist. Bright and rather bold girl with vivid imagination and curiosity of a cat. Like many young people, she is inseparable from her SMaRTPhone (Super Magic-Relayed TelePhone). The only family she knows is her elder sister Nami, who has taken care of her as long as she can remember. They have moved house many times, so Maya didn’t have any particular objection when Nami said that they would live in a different place this summer. “By ‘something dangerous’, are you referring to those things with way too many eyes and tentacles to be actually useful?” [From official website]

characters.name: Lilia
characters.description: Likes: Fishing, Meditation, Martial arts Doesn’t like: Getting fish, Kinoko A local girl, often found quietly fishing at the lakeside. Preferring silence over small-talk, Lilia rarely makes any effort to start a conversation. She pays attention to her surroundings nevertheless, and has a ranking for people, animals and other lifeforms she likes. Lilia practices martial arts to keep her body in shape and reflexes sharp. She believes that a well delivered roundhouse kick can solve most if not all troubling situations. “Hmm… you are currently at rank 274, just below that nice snail over there.” [From official website]

characters.name: Kinoko
characters.description: Age: 25? Likes: Mushrooms, pretty girls Doesn’t like: Strange green birds with fancy hairdos An alchemist living inside a huge mushroom. Eccentric and happy-go-lucky, she is hardly concerned about giving a good first impression to anyone. She generally attempts to flirt with any girl she encounters, although she is utterly disinterested in anyone older than her. Despite all the foolish charade, she occasionally makes very sharp remarks and displays her extensive knowledge of alchemy. She is often seen using her magical powers to control alchemical clouds. She calls them the Convenient Clouds. “Say, have you seen my skirt lying somewhere around here?” [From official website]

characters.name: Nami
characters.description: Age: ??? Likes: Flowers, History, Maya Doesn’t like: Inquisitive questions Maya’s elder sister and instructor in the Flower Dragon school of magic. Nami’s habit of wielding very powerful magic to do seemingly trivial chores has always fascinated her little sister. Well-versed in history, Nami sometimes talks of events of the far past as if she had firsthand experienced them. Her own life story is somewhat of a mystery even to Maya. “The legend tells that these flowers increased by the same number as there were casualties in the Great War.” [From official website]

title: The Yuri Club
description: Janieve High is your average all-girl high school. The only thing that makes it stand out is that it is the first school in the country to try out the bridge year initiative. Claudia Flaurance, great-granddaughter of the school’s founder, takes this opportunity to be part of the first wave of students for this optional seventh year of high school. Now that she finds herself alone and without friends in a class full of girls who have known each other for years, her new life at her ancestral school can begin. Two other girls, Gabriella and Michelle, won’t let Claudia be friendless for long though. Together they try to find a school club to join to solidify their friendship. But wouldn’t starting your very own club be the better option? And with that Claudia is not only the new girl, but also the president of the brand new book club. This new book club has something to hide though. Girl-gir

title: Best Friend Forever
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Modern Day United States of America
description: LIVE. LOVE. DOGS. Step off the bus at Rainbow Bay and start a new life with your furever friend! Adopt a dog, find true love and experience all the wacky hijinks this colourful city has to offer. Best Friend Forever is the world’s first simulation game to combine pet care and dating (just not necessarily at the same time). Train, pat and play with your very own dog to form a bond that will last the ages. With your four-legged companion by your side, meet, woo and cherish the many cuties of Rainbow Bay’s thriving singles scene.

characters.name: Anders Hamilton
characters.description: Partner in a successful local law firm, Anders has both smarts and good looks to win you over. An angel in the courtroom and a cheeky devil in the sheets, Anders has maybe a little too much love to share around. Known to a long list of ex-lovers as the resident Casanova of Rainbow Bay, potential suitors should know they’re in for a good time, not a long time. And what a time it’ll be! When he’s not helping wealthy socialites file length divorce settlements, Anders unwinds in the kitchen. Refusing to let his deteriorating eyesight stand between him and culinary delights, he’ll be sure to remind you he’s prepared to wake you up with perfectly poached eggs and immaculate coffee the morning after… well, you know. But let’s not forget about the dog behind the man. Or, well, in front of him. Hemingway is a beautiful labrador retriever and Anders’ loyal guide dog. He enjoys gourmet dog food and

characters.name: Astrid Brooks
characters.description: That’s right, THE Astrid Brooks! Former travelling ballet star turned figure skating champion-to-be, Astrid Brooks is the talk of the town here in Rainbow Bay. Not only does she have rhythm and grace, she’s packing all sorts of muscle in that tight little bod. There are few things Astrid asks for in a potential lover: ambition and perfection. That’s all! Can you believe it? When she’s not tearing up the skating rink, you can find Astrid down at the local market browsing the extensive range of natural dog treats, scented candles, tarot cards and tarot accessories. Rumour has it you can catch a special show of hers down at the Acoustic Chanteuse on Saturday nights… but you didn’t hear that from us! That enormous ball of fur next to Astrid is Laika. If you were ever to meet a dog who seems to be rainbows and sunshine incarnate, that’s Laika. She loves playing, chewing and being brushed — an

characters.name: Felix Greene
characters.description: Our youngest eligible bachelor, Felix may be “green”, but his cheeks are often red. This muscle-bound librarian is quick to blush despite his buff exterior. While Felix may spend most of his free time hitting the gym, don’t mistake his muscles for machismo. All those hours on the treadmill are set to a soundtrack of true crime podcasts, which fuel his ambitions for a career in forensics. Some even say he’s been working on a podcast of his own! When asked about his previous dating experiences, Felix quickly excused himself. We spoke to known associate Maribel Summers who quickly descended into a laughing fit. Felix’s best friend is the young, energetic German shepherd Mulder. Fit as a fiddle and full of youthful rebellion, Mulder is sure to be a handful for Felix as he adapts to life with a puppy.

characters.name: Maribel Summers
characters.description: Few people combine great intelligence and thighs that could crush your skull into one ball of unbridled, unrestrained chaotic energy. Maribel Summers is a ball of fire on an unstoppable course to your heart. As an up and coming urban planner, Maribel’s key ambition lies in launching an affordable housing scheme here in Rainbow Bay. Her priorities are safe, healthy and affordable homes — even if it means high density accommodation. Of course, all of this depends on if the people of Rainbow Bay will agree to losing their beloved views… Outside of town hall, Maribel is an avid runner and protein bar enthusiast. We asked her what protein bar was her favourite and she started listing products that don’t even sound like real things, so we’ve decided to exclude her answer and just say “chocolate”. But we can’t leave out that little Pomeranian! Gravedigger, or Gravy for short, is “the light of M

characters.name: Robin Savage
characters.description: Looking for love without the nonsense? Robin Savage has you covered. We interviewed Robin after five different bouts of rescheduling, because her busy lifestyle waits for no one! As the a charge nurse the Rainbow Bay hospital, Robin is used to managing other people — both nurses and patients alike. Her no-nonsense attitude means she’s quick to shut down disingenuous flirting and has no time for faithlessness. Give her everything or give her nothing at all! On the down-low, Robin is known to some as the Red Death: a popular streamer known for endless kill streaks in various first person shooter games. Noobs fear her, lovers want her. Robin is supported by Missile, the Australian shepherd. While Missile might look a little goofy, this good lass is one of the most well-behaved dogs we’ve ever met! Robin informs us she passed her Paws Academy training with full honours.

characters.name: Sacha Cross
characters.description: If you were to describe Sacha Cross as a type of food it would be cinnamon rolls covered in glitter. Few people are so openly welcoming and warm, not to be mention fiercely loyal to their values. As the founder and lead operator of a non-profit queer youth counselling service here in Rainbow Bay, Sacha is a staunch believer in the hearts of people. He tells us nothing matter more to him that the well-being of young queer people and the dismantling of the oppressive capitalist regime. Sacha is supported in life by his own network of wonderful friends, most of whom he lives with! In a flat of five people, you’d think life could get pretty hectic. Fortunately, Sacha tells us everyone in his flat gets along 90% of the time. The other 10%, well… I guess you’ll just have to find out for yourself! title: Oto-hime
tags: Heroine Based on a Mythological Character
description: Shimako, a socially anxious office worker, escapes the pressures of her company's beach retreat by fishing alone, only to stumble upon a trapped turtle by the shore. When she rescues it, Shimako is mysteriously whisked away to a hidden underwater palace, where she meets Oto-hime, a breathtakingly beautiful but enigmatic princess. Drawn in by Oto-hime's charm and her lavish hospitality, Shimako soon realizes there is something unsettling beneath the princess's kind façade. In this gripping Yuri Horror visual novel, you control Shimako's fate through a web of choices. Unravel the truth behind Oto-hime's strange motives, explore their deepening bond, and discover whether Shimako will escape the palace or be lured into staying forever... in the clutches of something far darker than she imagined. [From itch.io]

title: Our Bad Ending
description: Syira and Huimin once made a wish to a banana tree spirit. It was a silly, childish ritual they had found on a blog. They wished to stay best friends forever. Except that Syira wished… [i]“I wished she would be mine.” Years later, it turns out whatever demon or spirit they had spoken to doesn’t grant wishes. Huimin has been seeing a boyfriend for five years and they’ve even booked out a chalet to celebrate their anniversary. Syira’s wish might as well be a joke. Until a frantic phone call arrives in the middle of the night — a lover’s quarrel had turned violent. Huimin begs Syira for help and slowly, a dark and malicious desire begins to take root in her head. Maybe the spirit [i]does listen after all. [From itch.io]

tags: Modern Day United States of America
description: In 1994, a bitter labor dispute between Major League Baseball and the Players Association destroys a season and plunges the future of the sport into uncertainty. For two amateur scorekeepers, the end of baseball is the end of an escape. They can no longer hide their faces behind their scorecards and the troubles of their time haunt their fragile relationship. Amidst it all is a growing realization that baseball itself is subject to the same forces that cast shadows over their lives. What are scorecards good for? Every one is a mirror of its creator. Deep inside those cryptic grids of figures and diagrams are the thoughts scorekeepers can't put into words: the desire to be made new, an opaque sense of justice. Greed, hate, retribution, death. [From itch.io]

description: "Delete System": People are born with the right to "kill". The usage of Delete: 1. Each person can only use it once in their lifetime, and only one person will be deleted. 2. As a civil right, the one who used delete system won't be judged by the law. 3. It is not allowed to give this right to someone else. 4. People with criminal records are not allowed to use it. 5. People under 12 are not allowed to use it. 6. Delete must be applied for at the municipality with the verification ID of the applicant. 7. The target of Delete will be executed by shooting on the day of application. 8. After the execution, the applicant and the target will be shown on the government homepage. Half a century after the Delete system was spread, it has become a part of daily life. From discrimination, persecution to bullying, after the introduction of this system, all of those have been continuing to decline.

tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: The plan was supposed to be simple, almost ridiculously so. When her father, driven mad by years of grief, suddenly decided to force her into marrying him, Princess Kionna enlisted the help of her childhood friend. Together, they managed to contact her long-lost fairy godmother. Surely, her powers would save her from this hellish fate. Kionna would be able to escape the castle, a prince charming would find her, and they would live happily ever after. Alas, magic can only do so much. Things keep spinning out of control. Trapped in an endless nightmare, the princess ceaselessly rewinds time in a race with death itself. Is a happy ending truly waiting for her at the end of the tunnel? [From Steam]

characters.name: Lys
characters.description: A young and mysterious girl you met in Purgatory. Her duty is to guide wavering Shadows in the collection of the memories of their past life. characters.name: Kionna
characters.description: The young princess of the Donkeyskin’s tale. She’s innocent and smart but also quite haughty, due to her education. Being dependent on Nahima, she’s utterly lost when she suddenly has to find a way out of the castle by herself. She doesn’t know it yet, but it’s the beginning of a long nightmare that will take her to the edges of madness. [from Träumendes Mädchen's site]

characters.name: Nahima
characters.description: Kionna’s best friend and confident, she’s always there to take care of her. But when the King announces his desire to marry the princess, she finds herself powerless to help the one she loves the most. Slowly but surely, she can feel the girl drifting apart from her… [from Träumendes Mädchen's site]

characters.name: Médeia
characters.description: Médeia is not quite the traditional fairy godmother. She makes it abundantly clear she is not interested in becoming Kionna’s magical sidekick. The sooner she helps her, the sooner she can return to the magical realm. And that is all that matters as far as she is concerned. Or is it? For someone who always appears so unfazed, she seems to care an awful lot... [From Itch.io]

However, he is not ashamed of his background and prides himself in being self-sufficient. [spoiler]Once he opens up, Your Character begins to notice that he is observant, caring, and very loyal to his friends. If romanced, he is also self-deprecating, insecure, and vulnerable around Your Character. [Edited from the Wiki]

title: Love Shore
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Welcome to Love Shore, a city that transforms at night. The futuristic metropolis also just happens to also be populated with cyborgs, old gods hidden in the depths of a criminal underground, and humans eager to crawl their way to the top, no matter what the cost. After a fertility crisis changed the landscape of the city for good, a single company stepped in to help the residents: Life S. Incorporated, a biotech firm that claimed to be able to build life out of raw DNA, creating a fully formed human with thoughts, feelings, and morality of their own. Their minds, physical appearance, and personality would be drawn from their parents’ DNA, but the children would be ‘born’ using artificial bodies. This new generation would be called the S.Humans: a non-aging, tough form of new life. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Farah
characters.description: Horoscope: Taurus Skills: Determined, empathetic, diligent History: A S.Human veteran born and raised in Love Shore, Farah's biggest muscle is her heart. She's coping with life after prison and trying to re-adapt to civilian life when she's drawn into a war between the gods that could threaten the foundations of the city. Personality: The strong and silent type, Farah is quick to support her friends. Flaws: Unobservant, overly trusting Trivia: Farah's kitchen is pristine because she's the type of person who would burn ramen noodles. [From Steam]

characters.name: Sam
characters.description: Horoscope: Scorpio Skills: Perceptive, strategic, survivalist History: A S.Human born of one of the wealthier families in Love Shore. After the birth of his flesh and blood brother, Sam struggled to find a purpose for himself in his family. He turned to crime, scored big and fell from grace. He's now attempting to avoid any more trouble after his release from prison. Personality: Tongue like a dagger, but wit to back it up. Flaws: Inferiority complex, reluctantly sensitive, coping through cruelty Trivia: Sam's favorite brand of smokes are Shoreline Reds. [From Steam]

characters.name: Alyosha
characters.description: A handsome stranger who fell into Sam's life through a series of odd situations, Aly is smart and quick to adapt, but hungry for revenge for events in his past. Will you help him finish the job? Likes: - His family - Fashionable turtlenecks Dislikes: - Untrustworthy people - Contact lenses Sign: Cancer [From Kickstarter] Romance option for Sam.

characters.name: Aziz
characters.description: Aziz is a scumbag, a criminal...and he just happens to be Sam's most recent ex. When Sam is pulled back into work in crime, Aziz is right back there to welcome him with mostly open arms. Will you fall back into his embrace? Likes: - Cigarettes - Deep v-shirts - High-quality hair gel Dislikes: - Everything vanilla - Being roasted by Sam Sign: Leo [From Kickstarter] Romance option for Sam.

characters.name: Conrad
characters.description: An old acquaintance of Sam's, Conrad is an older gentleman still learning the ins and outs of Love Shore's underworld. He might be a little cold at first. Can you get him to warm up? Likes: - Coffee - Being good at his job - Neutral colors Dislikes: - Sam pointing out his age Sign: Pisces [From Kickstarter] Romance option for Sam.

characters.name: Maya
characters.description: Farah's local bartender turned regular flirtation, Maya has connections to the criminal world around Love Shore. She's a little shy, but wants to get to know you better. Will you let her? Likes: - Soft sweaters - High ponytail hairdos - Femme lesbians Dislikes: - Mess - Dark colors - Wonky eyeliner Sign: Virgo [From Kickstarter] Romance option for Farah.

characters.name: Talia
characters.description: Farah's spunky best friend. Prone to kindness, but with a pretty funny sense of humor, she's the girl next door who will be right next to you, no matter what path you choose to take. Will you initiate a friends-to-lovers romance? Likes: - Her best friend - MUA instagram - Watching the news Dislikes: - Laziness - Non-confrontational people - Basic fashion Sign: Libra [From Kickstarter] Romance option for Farah.

characters.name: Vivian
characters.description: Sam's best friend and confidante in the city, Vivian knows her way around an escape vehicle. Keep her trust, and she'll be driving you around in no time. Likes: - Leather - Good eyeshadow - The sound of a stolen engine Dislikes: - Traffic laws - Sam's bullshit Sign: Capricorn [From Kickstarter] Romance option for Sam.

characters.name: Imani
characters.description: A doctor and scientist who treated Farah in the past, Imani is a beautiful mystery to many. She and Farah are mutually intrigued by each other, but when she disappears, Imani asks you to find her. Will you chase after her, and help her with her latest experiment? Likes: - Quantitative evidence - A clean lab coat - Buff ladies Dislikes: - Nosy people - A lack of academic integrity - Poorly documented research Sign: Aquarius [From Kickstarter] Romance option for Farah.

characters.name: Jo
characters.description: An acquaintance of Farah's, Jo occupies all their free time by investigating Love Shore's underworld. They might be a little bit of a conspiracy theorist, but they might call it being 'critical of the establishment.' Can you get them to trust you, and maybe more? Likes: - UFOs - Urban exploration - Having a cryptid girlfriend Dislikes: - Clothing in shades other than black - Being misgendered Sign: Sagittarius [From Kickstarter] Romance option for Farah.

Fiona Syed says Jaylen is the starstruck, sweetheart ingénue who came from nothing, a fail-safe story that America will vote for. However, Your Character sees a different side of her depending on if the cameras are watching. According to record executives that Raleigh Carrera overheard, Jaylen's real personality is pretty abrasive and she went through multiple personas (including vintage indie queen, and good girl gone bad) to find one that would fit a public image and expectation. She is the first contestant on this week's One In A Million. She camped out since 9 PM the night before to be first in line. This is her fifth time auditioning; she also auditioned in Des Moines, Milwaukee and Tulsa. In Chapter 3, when she films her backstory, she says she entered her first tap-dancing competition when she was 2
