characters.description: __Grade__: Second-year high school __Height__: 159cm A second-year student in the Upper School at Stella Girls' Academy. She is of mixed heritage. Overflowing with a chivalrous spirit, she possesses a straightforward and earnest nature. In terms of sheer strength, she serves as the ace of Club C—a swift-footed attacker and a master of close-quarters combat.

characters.name: Honoka Mutsu
characters.description: __Grade:__ Second-year high school __Height:__ 157 cm __Weapon:__ G36K A2 A second-year student in the Upper School at Stella Girls' Academy. Possessing a cool and composed demeanor as well as a brilliant intellect, she is a flawless honor student who looks out for others. She serves as the Commander, directing tactical operations.

characters.name: Rento Kirishima
characters.description: **Height:** 172 cm **Weapons:** AK47, Glock 26 A first-year student at Stella Women's Academy High School. Member of the C3 Club—a naturally airheaded, soothing presence and a gentle mood-setter. Despite her appearance, she possesses surprising physical strength. A gunner who supports her teammates through covering fire.

characters.name: Yachiyo Hinata
characters.description: __Height:__ 147 cm A first-year student at Stella Girls' Academy High School. The team's energetic member—and a bit of a spoiled darling. She is the granddaughter of the Chairwoman of Stella Girls' Academy. A sniper who excels at long-range marksmanship.

characters.name: Rin Haruna
characters.description: A third-year student at Myojo Girls' Academy and the captain of the airsoft club. She was airsoft partner with [Sonora](https://anilist.co/character/80521/Sonora-Kashima) when they were overseas, but they have a history and she views Sonora as an enemy. She boasts strength equal to Sonora's in airsoft.

title: El Cazador
description: Ellis, a young girl suspected of murdering a prominent physicist Heinrich Schneider, is on the run from an underground society called "Hunters" when she is tracked down by the bounty hunter Nadie in a small Mexican town. However, instead of turning her in, Nadie impulsively decides to help her and the two girls embark on a journey to Ellis' hometown, where they plan on finding clues about her past. From there, they travel south to search for the mysterious Gemstone of the Inca Rose, the "Eternal City" of Wiñay Marka, and Ellis' own obscure destiny. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Ellis
characters.description: A girl wanted as a suspect for Dr. Heinz Schneider's murder. She heads south in order to seek the truth of the incident, as well as to find her birthplace; based on the vague memories she holds and an old fortune teller's advice. Ellis has "Witch DNA", but her abilities are accidental and incomplete. These include superhuman strength, temporary levitation, and heating as well as freezing of physical objects. She cannot control her abilities at will, usually becoming active only in times of need. She speaks whatever is on her mind in an almost expressionless way of talking, she could almost be classified as a comic relief character because of some of the things she does. Throughout the series Ellis falls in love with Nadie and is quite open about her feelings towards her. ~!It is revealed that Ellis did not kill Dr. Heinz Schneider and that she had a father-daughter li

characters.name: Nadie
characters.description: A maverick female bounty hunter and a top marksman, she carries an old Colt Government Model .45 pistol as her weapon of choice. She holds an optimistic attitude but in actuality, Nadie was the sole survivor of an attack on her hometown. Working for Hayward, Nadie accompanies Ellis on her journey. Before killing her opponents, Nadie has a habit of saying, "If you have any last words, say them now".

characters.name: Jodie Hayward
characters.original: ジョディ・ヘイワード
characters.description: Jody is part of the section in Central Intelligence Agency that is tasked with overseeing accounting practice of others. She is easily annoyed with the sloppy paperwork of Rosenberg. Jody has knowledge of the "Project LEVIATHAN" and is Nadie's current employer. She claims to be a descendant of witches.

characters.name: Douglas Rosenberg
characters.description: Director of the Central Intelligence Agency, "R-339" and a shrewd, politically well-connected agent. (Source: official website)

characters.name: Heinz Schneider
characters.description: A doctor of physics. A German immigrant. He has no family and thrives on his study. He is a key player in developing and researching the "Project LEVIATHAN". (Source: official website)

characters.name: Ricardo
characters.description: A taciturn bounty hunter who was hired by Douglas Rosenberg. He is a retired mercenary. In the later Episodes Ricardo and Nadie find themselves working together in order to thwart Rosenberg's plans to capture Ellis. He is generally quiet and would do anything to protect Lirio. It is possible that he either lived or worked in Australia as he is teaching Lirio to use a boomerang in the last episode.

characters.name: Lirio
characters.description: Lirio is a child taken care of by Ricardo. She is aware of Ricardo's bounty hunting profession and is not seemed to be bothered by it. Each time Ricardo goes out to hunt a bounty, she waits patiently for him to return. She is very fond of Nadie and Ellis as well. At the end of the series, Ricardo teaches her how to use a boomerang. She very rarely speaks and instead, communicates with other people by smiling, facial expressions and nodding or shaking her head.

characters.name: L.A.
characters.description: A mysterious young man who harbors a deep obsession for Ellis. L.A is always constantly watching her but he has a deep hatred for humans. ~!He and Ellis are the last survivors out of the five whom were artificially engineered with witch DNA. Though he doesn't have witch-like powers himself, he does possess superhuman agility and strength. L.A uses metal threads as a weapon.!~

title: GROTESQQQUE
description: Anthology movie consisting of three original animation segments: Q1 - ÆLIENS (エリィアンズ) Earth has entered an era of intergalatic exchange. Amidst swirling prejudice and fear of aliens, Elie, an alien girl, arrives as a space goodwill ambassador. She loves Earth's culture and its often absurd daily life, and has teamed up with a civil servant working at the space agency to search for "friends". Q2 - Yoroshiku★Shoujo (夜露死駆★少女) GALs TOKYO, a city where morning never comes. Night after night, girls who have lost their place in reality, known as "Gal P", gather here. Their goal is to become the winner, the "Queen" in a game called "Queen of Butterfly" or "QoB" for short. Q3 - Nocturne: Kono Grotesque na Yoru ni (ノクターン～このグロテスクな夜に～) A world after humanity has perished. Traveling in a van are Ayame, a pure-blooded vampire, and three girls who survived by being bitten and "infected" by her. There, they find a sky full of stars that illuminate the night as brightly as day, and fields of glittering golden grass—even a desolate world looks so beautiful through the eyes of a vampire. They enjoy a simple everyday life in this world left behind. (Souce: Official Website, translated)

characters.name: Elien Hoshigi
characters.description: An alien girl with the ability to absorb matter into herself, who came to Earth as a Cosmic Goodwill Ambassador. Elie adores Earth's culture, and aims to make as many friends as possible while she's there.

characters.name: Kento Kunikura
characters.description: A civil servant working for the Space Bureau. Due to his earnest personality, Kento is constantly getting pulled around by [Elie](https://anilist.co/character/403373)'s unconventional nature. He inadvertently gets caught up in helping her on her quest to make friends on Earth.

characters.name: Nanashi
characters.description: A mysterious player who wields an SSS-rank weapon and is rumored to be incredibly strong.

characters.name: STELLA
characters.description: A truant girl who decided to participate in QoB after hearing about a certain urban legend.

characters.name: Ayame
characters.description: A pure-blooded vampire, living eternally. She has the ability to turn humans into vampires. Currently she lives a quiet life with [Shion](https://anilist.co/character/404644/Shion), [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/404646/Momo), and [Canna](https://anilist.co/character/404645/Canna).

characters.name: Shion
characters.description: Shion was taken in by [Ayame](https://anilist.co/character/404640/Ayame) while still human, and began living with her, [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/404646/Momo), and [Canna](https://anilist.co/character/404645/Canna).

characters.name: Canna
characters.description: A vampire who lives a quiet life with [Ayame](https://anilist.co/character/404640/Ayame), [Shion](https://anilist.co/character/404644/Shion), and [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/404646/Momo). Canna is dependable and level-headed, acting like an older sister to the others.

characters.name: Momo
characters.description: A vampire who lives a quiet life with [Ayame](https://anilist.co/character/404640/Ayame), [Shion](https://anilist.co/character/404644/Shion), and [Canna](https://anilist.co/character/404645/Canna). She's chatty, self-centered, and is the emotional heart and soul of the group. She loves manga.

characters.name: Hikarin
characters.description: A mysterious girl rumored to be involved with the QoB urban legend.

characters.name: Sword
characters.description: A top-ranked QoB player and a holder of the Queen Badge, Sword is known for her dazzling sword skills that leverage high speed. She apparently has a secret fanclub.

characters.name: Papico
characters.description: A top-ranked QoB player who wields a scythe, Papico is a host club fanatic with an ear for gossip.

characters.name: GORGEOUS☆MIKA
characters.description: A top-ranked QoB player and a holder of the Queen Badge, MIKA is a boisterous, super-tall gyaru with superhuman strength.

title: Fairy Gone 2
description: After surviving the massacre of Suna Village and spending years hunting down her missing best friend, Veronica, Marlya Noel eventually found herself working for Dorothea, a government agency that works for the Unified Empire of Zesskia in hunting down rogue Fairy Soldiers. These individuals have bonded with the magical beings known as Faeries in order to obtain superhuman abilities, but they have been outlawed since the Unification War. In her time with Dorothea, Marlya has managed to reunite with Veronica, uncover conspiratorial plots against the government, and even survive all out war against powerful Fairly Soldier foes. However, Veronica still has her vengeful hatred of Ray Dawn, the Duke who ordered the massacre at Suna, and Ray's own mysterious schemes will have Dorothea on the front lines again, sooner or later. Marlya will have to fight to save not just her friend, but the whole of the Empire. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Veronica Thorn
characters.description: Marlya's childhood friend. She and Marlya were the sole survivors of their village being burned during the war. She swore revenge on Ray Dawn, the traitor general responsible for the burning of her village. She learned to excel in combat skills, and eventually became a cold-hearted assassin. Like Marlya, she can also control fairies without undergoing fairy organ implant surgery. Blood Daughter, Veronica's fairy. It has the power to enter bodies through wounds Veronica caused, and destroy them from the inside.

characters.name: Marlya Noel
characters.description: A new recruit in "Dorothea," an organization dedicated to fighting Fairy-related crime and illegal activity. She is a special case who has the ability to control fairies without undergoing fairy organ implant surgery. Her village was burned down during the war, leaving her and her childhood friend Veronica as the sole survivors. She was separated from Veronica, but eventually learned that Veronica became an assassin who wanted revenge. Maria joined Dorothea in order to stop Veronica. She was raised by a hunter, and knows her way around hunting rifles and blades in a fight. She is normally quite easy-going, but easily becomes emotional when the subject turns to Veronica. Ashclad, Maria's fairy. It has the power to generate extremely high heat from its hand, such that anything it touches is reduced to ash. Marlya has blue eyes and redish-brown hair. She wears the main Fairy Regulatory Doro

characters.name: Free Underbar
characters.original: フリー・アンダーバー
characters.description: The replacement commander of Dorothea's Unit 1. He encouraged Marlya to join Dorothea, and works with her on many investigations. During the war, he fought as a dual sword-wielding Fairy Soldier. While he can be blunt at times, he always means well, and he earns the affection of his colleagues. Red Hood, Free's fairy. It is an agile fighter that can use its claws and fangs, and even generate sonic attacks through screaming. He has dark brown hair, wears a raincoat and carries two swords.

characters.name: Wolfran Row
characters.description: Former Fairy Soldier who fought alongside Free during the war. The war claimed the lives of his wife and child, and he turned to vengeful terrorism in the aftermath. He is a pragmatic sort, who doesn't normally let his emotions show, but anyone can see the fire inside him when he talks about the war. Fitcher is Wolfran's fairy. With its six blades, it slices its enemies apart.

characters.name: Klara Kysenaria
characters.original: クララ . キセナリア
characters.description: She is a member of the First Unit of Illegal Fairy Regulatory Agency Dorothea. Her fairy is Tomereez. It possess special eyes, allowing him to see more things. It specializes in infiltration and surveillance.

characters.name: Jet Glaive
characters.original: ジェット . グレイブ

title: Mahou Shoujo ni Akogarete 2nd Season
title_original: 魔法少女にあこがれて 第2期
description: The second season of Mahou Shoujo ni Akogarete .

title: Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya 2wei!: Mahou Shoujo in Onsen Ryokou
title_original: Fate/kaleid linerプリズマ☆イリヤ ツヴァイ！魔法少女in温泉旅行
description: Bundled with the limited edition of the sixth Fate/Kaleid Liner Prisma Illya 3rei!! magical girl manga volume. (Source: AniDB)

characters.name: Illyasviel von Einzbern
characters.original: イリヤスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: **Height:** 133 cm **Birthday in [Fate/kaleid](https://anilist.co/manga/33526/): **Jul 20 A young Teutonic aristocrat, she traveled to Japan to participate in the Holy Grail War as a Master. Illyasviel has an angelic appearance and an unsurpassed degree of magical power. She lives in a castle on the outskirts of Fuyuki City, accompanied only by her Servant and two maids. Illyasviel asks those she feels comfortable around to simply call her "Illya".

characters.name: Miyu Edelfelt
characters.original: 美遊・エーデルフェルト
characters.description: __Height:__ 134 cm A young girl who serves under Luvia as a magical girl. Her origin is unknown, except that she has a brother who looks similar to Shirou, and she takes on the Edelfelt name after being taken in by Luvia. She lives in Luvia's mansion and acts as her maid to earn her keep. She uses Ruby's sister Kaleidostick, Sapphire, in order to transform, and she initially has a much better understanding of her abilities than Illya. She takes her role very seriously and treats Illya as a bothersome rival, though they eventually become close friends.

characters.name: Chloe von Einzbern
characters.original: クロエ・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: **Height:** 133 cm Kuro, initially referred to as Dark Illya, is a being created from [Illya](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel)'s hidden power and the Archer Class Card. ~!She comes into existence after Illya uses the Class Card in order to save herself, and afterward, she falls unconscious and wakes up to find the card missing and an exact duplicate of herself, with the exception of dark skin and the Archer outfit, in its place. Kuro immediately escapes and makes various attempts on Illya's life, stating that they cannot both freely exist. She is eventually captured and has a seal placed upon her that forces her to share all sensations with Illya, including injuries and pain. Unable to freely fulfill her goal, she attends Illya's school as her cousin, Kuro, though she still holds resentment towards Illya. She is at odds with [Miyu](https://anilist.co/character/21

characters.name: Shirou Emiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm Shirou is the main character of Fate/stay night. He is a serious yet helpful, hardworking, and honest teenager. His hobbies include fixing a variety of broken things, from VCRs to stoves, as well as cooking and cleaning. He is initially confused about the Holy Grail War and attempts to irrationally shield others from danger, including his own Servant, [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497)

characters.name: Rin Toosaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 124 cm (Fate/Zero), 159 cm (Fate/stay night) Rin is a model student and idol of [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s school. She barely talks to other students in her school and exhibits a desire to be left alone, as exemplified by her tendency to stay on the school's rooftop, away from the rest of the students. She is also secretly a Magus and a Master in the Fifth Holy Grail War. In the beginning of the anime, she summons [Archer](https://anilist.co/character/2087) for her Servant, although she originally wanted to summon Saber. Rin is reared as the successor to her family's magecraft, instructed by her father, [Tokiomi Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017), to prioritize sorcery over her own interests. After her father is killed, Rin continues to perfect her sorcery, with some guidance from her guardian, [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506). Sh

characters.name: Luviagelita Edelfelt
characters.original: ルヴィアゼリッタ・エーデルフェルト
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Daughter of the distinguished lineage of magi of the Edelfelt, Luvia is their young and talented family head. A student in Clock Tower, the Mage's Association academy, she is one of the candidates for the position of student's president for the current academic term. As long as [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin) is not nearby, Luvia's attitude is always graceful, never blaspheming and with a beauty similar to a swan. Of course, that is just a facade and she is actually very competitive and suffers with perfectionist tendencies. Luvia has long golden blonde hair styled entirely in large coils. She physically resembles Rin somewhat, furthering speculation that the younger Edelfelt sister from the Third Holy Grail War may have married into the Tohsaka family. She is from Finland.

characters.name: Leysritt
characters.description: Leysritt is a homunculus created by the Einzbern family to serve as a maid much like Sella. Despite her appearance, she is only about two years old. Regardless of her thin ego, she developed a sense of reason due to her alignment with Illya. As a result, Leysritt often says what she thinks without any consideration and this gets her often into a verbal conflict with Sella. She and Illya are actually very close friends and should Illya die, Leysritt would die as well. In contrast to Sella, she possesses a casual personality but has difficulty expressing her emotions and comes across as robotic at times. However, she appears to enjoy teasing Sella and also takes a liking to Shirou because his presence makes Illya happy.

characters.name: Sella
characters.description: Sella is a homunculus created by the Einzbern family to serve as a maid and to teach Illya sorcery. Despite her appearance, she is only about two years old. Sella is highly protective of Illya, whom she loves and cares for deeply, and thus is very suspicious of Shirou Emiya. Despite her apparent coldness to everyone but Illya, Sella is actually rather fickle and insecure, particularly about her body, and Leysritt and Illya often tease Sella for her harsh personality.

characters.name: Magical Ruby
characters.description: Originally the magical wand of Rin Toshaka. She broke up contract with Rin due to her personal conflict with Luviagelita Edelfelt and also for not cooperating together to fulfill the goal of capturing all magical cards of all classes. It then formed contract with Illya that made her a magical girl - A dream come true?

characters.name: Magical Sapphire
characters.description: The magical wand of Luviagelita Edelfelt who broke up contract with her with the same reason with Magical Ruby. It made contract with Miyu Edelfelt, who was then made to serve Luviagelita.

characters.name: Auguste
characters.description: Auguste is the personal butler of Luvia Edelfelt in Fate/kaleid liner PRISMA☆ILLYA. Auguste is very dutiful, undertaking a number of tasks, including less reputable responsibilities such as forging documentation for Miyu Edelfelt and Chloe von Einzbern. He has taken a specific interest in appraising Shirou Emiya due to Luvia's attraction to him, checking his physique, asking about how Shirou feels about his mistress, and asking him if he is "prepared."

title: Re: Cutie Honey
description: A mysterious organization known as Panther Claw make their presence known by terrorizing Tokyo and giving the cops a run for their money. Police are further baffled by the appearance of a lone cosplaying vigilante who thwarts all of Panther Claw's evil schemes before disappearing. That cosplayer is Honey Kisaragi, the result of the late Professor Kisaragi's prize experiment. A master of disguise, Honey can magically alter her physical appearance and outfits. But with a push of the heart-shaped button on her choker, she transforms herself into Cutie Honey, the scantily-clad, sword-wielding warrior of love and justice. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Honey Kisaragi
characters.description: Honey Kisaragi is a regular Catholic schoolgirl, until the day her father is murdered by the "Panther Claw" Organization. After his death, she learns she is actually an android created by him and within her is the Fixed System of Air Elements. By saying "Honey Flash!" she can transform into the sword-wielding red-haired superhero, Cutie Honey.

characters.name: Natsuko Aki
characters.description: As with many of the supporting characters in Cutie Honey, Aki has taken on many different roles. In the original manga she is Honey's friend and roommate at the all girls school they go to. In Re: Cutie Honey Aki Natsuko is a lead Investigator for the National Police Security Task Force – Branch 9. She is cold and controlling and is an absolute perfectionist. While she is an exceptional police officer she also has the bad habit of getting “in over her head” into trouble. She is an expert marksman. She tends to wear black a lot and lives alone in a small apartment. She has a passion for Japanese Sake and when she gets drunk loves to sing Karaoke. Hides her beauty by wearing non-prescription eyeglasses.

characters.name: Seiji Hayami
characters.description: Depending on the story Seiji takes on different roles but two things always stay the same, one he has the hots for Honey, and two he is always willing to help her out.

characters.name: Mayumi Takahashi
characters.description: The unfortunate student who has to deal with all the unjust penalties for either falling asleep in class or used as bait to lure out Kekko Kamen

characters.name: Scarlet Claw
characters.original: スカーレット・クロー
characters.description: One of the four generals of the organization known as Panther Claw.

characters.name: Sister Jill
characters.description: From story to story Sister Jill roles slightly differ, sometimes she is leader of Panther Claw and sometimes she is the head subordinate of the mysterious leader of Panther Claw.

characters.name: Black Claw
characters.description: One of the four generals of the organization known as Panther Claw.

characters.name: Cobalt Claw
characters.description: One of the four generals of the organization known as Panther Claw.

characters.name: Gold Claw
characters.description: One of the four generals of the organization known as Panther Claw.

characters.name: Shitsuji
characters.description: Sister Jill's loyal servant.

title: Bocchi the Rock! Re:Re:
title_original: ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！ Re:Re:
description: Compilation film of Bocchi the Rock! featuring new animation intro footage and additional scenes. The second of the Bocchi compilation movie duology.

characters.name: Hitori Gotou
characters.description: Gotou Hitori is a shy, gloomy high-schooler who started learning guitar after seeing rock bands on TV, in the hope that she too could become as popular as them. However, after 2 years she has yet to make a single friend or join a band. She instead sits in her closet at home, recording guitar covers and posting them to her YouTube channel, "guitarhero", on which she has amassed a reasonable following.

characters.name: Ikuyo Kita
characters.description: A bright and popular first year of high school. She is in charge of the guitar and vocals of Kessoku Band. She is a cheerful character who likes to interact with people and can talk to her with a smile without hesitation, even when she meets her for the first time. She longs for [Ryo](https://anilist.co/character/264529), and her feelings can go too far. She often takes photos and uploads to Isosta.

characters.name: Nijika Ijichi
characters.description: An energetic and cheerful second-year high school student. She is the drummer of Kessoku Band and the organizer who takes care of [Hitori](https://anilist.co/character/257562). She has an older sister, [Seika](https://anilist.co/character/289054), who is the manager of the live house "STARRY" and has a special feeling for the live house.

characters.name: Ryou Yamada
characters.description: A cool and solitary second year of high school. She is in charge of the bass of Kessoku Band. She's the best friend of [Nijika](https://anilist.co/character/261674). Her hobbies are out of the ordinary, and she rejoices when called a weirdo. She lives with a wealthy family, but she spends much of her money on instruments and always runs out of money. She occasionally eats weeds to get rid of her hunger.

characters.name: Seika Ijichi
characters.description: Nijika's older sister and manager of the live house "STARRY".

characters.name: PA-san
characters.description: __Height:__ 162cm Mysterious looking female PA engineer with a mouth piercing. In her private life, she is active as a virtual Youtuber under the name "Otogi Alto" producing gameplay videos.

characters.name: Jimihen
characters.description: The Gotou family dog.

characters.name: Naoki Gotou
characters.description: Hitori and Futari's father.

characters.name: Michiyo Gotou
characters.description: Hitori and Futari's mother.

characters.name: Futari Gotou
characters.description: Hitori's younger sister.

characters.name: Kikuri Hiroi
characters.description: Bassist and vocalist of the band "SICK HACK". Always drunk to forget about life's downsides.

title: Miru Tights: Cosplay Satsuei Tights
title_original: みるタイツ コスプレ撮影タイツ
description: 13th episode included in the BD release. Yua is asked to model an illustrator's designs as a costume for a photo collection the illustrator is producing. Concerned for Yua, Ren offers to accompany Yua to the photoshoot, and Homi somehow ends up rehearsing the photoshoot with Ren and Yua as models. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Ren Aikawa
characters.description: She is close to Yua Nakabeni and Homi Moegi where she attends a class together with them at Yaegasumi High School. Ren works at the bar. The Bar Master states that there weren't many clients before Ren started to work there. Now, when she works there, the place is extremely busy. Likes 60 denier tights (opaque).

characters.name: Yua Nakabeni
characters.description: Yua is an honor student who is great at sports. Although she doesn't speak that much, she has excellent communication skills. She has long back hair and black eyes. Yua loves cosplay and posts her images in costumes on social media. Ren follows her profile. Likes 30 denier tights (sheer).

characters.name: Homi Moegi
characters.description: She is a close friend with Ren Aikawa and Yua Nakabeni, she attends a class together with them at Yaegasumi High School. Homi is very carefree and clumsy. She has a brother, Rui Moegi. Homi is a bright and active teenage girl. Throughout the series, it's pointed out that Moegi is wealthy as she goes to school in a car with a driver. She also has a younger brother, Rui Moegi who is in junior high school. Moreover, she's a member of the school's swimming club. Her favorite tights are 110 denier.

title: Yuru Yuri,
description: Akari Akaza, Chinatsu Yoshikawa, Kyouko Toshinou, and Yui Funami return to commemorate an exciting occasion! Despite their initial bizarre celebration ideas, they decide to hold a party at their Amusement Club room. With the help of friends from the Student Council, they start preparing for the big day—with a surprise planned for a special someone. Join the girls as they work together to create an enjoyable and memorable party, all the while interacting with one another with their cute and unique quirks. (Source: MAL Rewrite) Note: The Blu-ray had an early release for crowdfunding backers, while the general release was set to November 13th.

characters.name: Kyouko Toshinou
characters.description: Toshinou Kyouko is the founder of the amusement club. Goes so wild that no one can keep up with her, but it's not as if anyone even tries in the first place, so it's ultimately no big deal. She is actually an otaku who creates her own doujinshi of Mirakurun, an anime character in Yuru Yuri. Her favorite ice cream is rum raisin.

characters.name: Akari Akaza
characters.description: Akari is a polite red-haired girl who is supposedly the main protagonist of the series. However, due to her rather small presence and plain personality, she is often forgotten about or pushed into the background. She is often thought of as having the ability to fire her hair dumplings and turn invisible whilst shouting "Akkari~n!". [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) and [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/35874) are her childhood friends, while [Chinatsu](https://anilist.co/character/35875), [Sakurako](https://anilist.co/character/35878) and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879) are her classmates.

characters.name: Yui Funami
characters.description: A cool-headed girl who often acts as the voice of reason, usually when it comes to keeping [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) in check. She is a reliable friend and usually lives alone in an apartment complex, but actually feels lonely without anyone else around. Although generally quiet, she will sometimes burst into laughter upon hearing [Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/35876)'s puns. She likes playing video games.

characters.name: Chinatsu Yoshikawa
characters.description: Akari's pink haired classmate who originally wanted to join the Tea Ceremony Club, but ended up joining the Amusement Club as the Tea Ceremony Club was already abolished. She is often chased after by Kyōko due to her resemblance to Mirakurun, though she herself has a passionate crush on Yui. She generally acts cute, especially in the presence of Yui, but she occasionally shows dark thoughts and a terrifying lack of artistic skills.

characters.name: Ayano Sugiura
characters.description: Sugiura Ayano is the vice president of the student council. Gallant and filled with a powerful sense of justice, she happens to be popular with other female students. She's always thinking about Kyouko... or, to put it more bluntly, she's a pure-hearted maiden who is falling in love.

characters.name: Chitose Ikeda
characters.description: __Height:__ 155cm Ikeda Chitose is a member of the student council. She is a helpful character whose extreme yuri fantasies make the yuri quotient of the story rise dramatically. While fantasizing, she removes her glasses to block her vision so she can concentrate, causing intense nose bleeds. She is really fond of the Ayano x Kyouko pairing. She speaks in soft Kansai dialect and likes tsukemono (pickled things).

characters.name: Sakurako Oomuro
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm She has a tsundere type personality and aims to be the next student council vice president. She and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Furutani-Himawari) are childhood friends.

characters.name: Himawari Furutani
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm A candidate for the student council vice-president. She has blue hair and large breasts. She always speaks in feminine and polite speech.

characters.name: Akane Akaza
characters.description: Akari's big sister. Akane has a huge obsession with her little sister, but Akari herself knows nothing about that. She collects anything related to Akari, in a result leaving Kyouko extremely shocked when she stumbled across Akane's room.

characters.name: Kaede Furutani
characters.description: [Himawari's](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Himawari-Furutani) sister.

title: Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi
title_original: いびってこない義母と義姉
title_en: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren’t Wicked
description: Miya is the illegitimate child of a prominent family. When her mother dies and her father’s estate agrees to take her in, she’s convinced she knows what awaits her in her new home: a life of servitude and misery at the hands of her wicked stepmother and stepsisters. Yet when she finally meets the women she expects to treat her like dirt, they actually end up being…sweet?! A hilarious and heartfelt comedy that’s sure to put a smile on your face! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Miya Kounokura
characters.description: __Height:__ 145cm Illegitimate child who was taken in by the Konoukura family after the death of her mother.

characters.name: Teru Kounokura
characters.description: __Height:__ 185cm The official wife of the prominent Kounokura family. Miya's stepmother.

characters.name: Marika Kounokura
characters.description: __Height:__ 157cm First-born daughter of the Kounokura family. Eldest stepsister.

characters.name: Arisa Kounokura
characters.description: __Height:__163cm The second daughter of the Kounokura family. Second elder stepsister.

characters.name: Gungnir
characters.description: Bodyguard of the Kounokura household

characters.name: Nago
characters.description: Head maid of the Kounokura household

characters.name: Yasu Nakamura
characters.description: [Miya's](https://anilist.co/character/327032) grandmother

title: Koukaku no Pandora
title_en: Pandora in the Crimson Shell Ghost Urn
description: In an age when large-scale natural disasters frequently happen all over the world, when cyborgs and autonomous robots are beginning to appear on the market in technologically advanced nations, and major world powers compete for technology and resources, the divide between rich and poor grows and the future for the poor looks bleak. In this transitional stage, everyone wanders around in a self-indulgent daze and the way out isn't clear... This is the story of how two cybernetically enhanced girls meet.

characters.name: Clarion
characters.description: Uzal's companion, who is a combat android, disguising as a full-body cyborg. Her body holds the Pandora Device, which temporarily grants Nene enhanced abilities. She is a skilled fighter who often finds herself at the mercy of Nene's admiration and hates having her cat-like ears touched.

characters.name: Nene Nanakorobi
characters.description: A full-bodied cyborg girl whose entire body is mechanical. She comes to Cenancle to live with her aunt and soon comes across Uzal and Clarion. By placing her fingers inside Clarion's body, she is able to use the Pandora Device, which allows her to master any skill for a short period of time, ranging from wielding firearms to cookery. She is also able to transfer her brain between different artificial bodies. (Source: MAL)

characters.name: Uzal Delilah
characters.description: A wealthy inventor who manipulates Nene into working with Clarion to solve the mystery behind the attack.

characters.name: Takumi  Korobase
characters.description: Nene's aunt who lives on Cenancle Island and is close friends with Uzal. Takumi is usually overwhemed with social anxiety and has to hide behind her Gertsecommas whenever somebody sees her face-to-face. She does all her work in cyberspace and never leaves her mansion.

characters.name: Bunny
characters.description: One of Uzal's discontent subordinates.

characters.name: B.U.E.R
characters.description: B.U.E.R (Base of Unearth Extra Resources). A giant boring robot owned by Uzal's company that possesses a giant laser. While its main body resembles a giant eyeball, its Central Nervous Unit, which detaches itself after the main body is shut down, takes the form a gentlemanly but perverted lion-esque creature with five legs. He tends to be injured by Clarion when acting perverted, or locked in a safe-box to stop Takumi from analyzing him, but the darkness traumatizes him. (Source: MAL)

title: Awajima Hyakkei
description: At Awajima Opera School, girls from across Japan strive to earn a place on stage. Wakana is driven by her love of musical theater, while Kinue studies with quiet discipline. Scholarship student Emi draws attention from all—but especially from Keiko, who struggles with admiration and comparison. Through shifting perspectives, their intertwined days explore ambition, friendship, and self-discovery. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Wakana Tabata
characters.description: A preparatory student at Awajima Opera School, originally from Gunma Prefecture. She entered Awajima aspiring to become a musical star. She has a friendly and straightforward personality. Dreaming of the day she stands on stage, she is fully committed to her rigorous yet fulfilling studies.

characters.name: Kinue Takehara
characters.description: A dormitory leader and undergraduate student at Awajima Opera School. She is also [Wakana's](https://anilist.co/character/379536/Wakana-Tabata) roommate. Since her days at Fujigaya Girls' Academy, she has poured her passion into theater, carrying the aspirations of her best friend [Ryouko](https://anilist.co/character/24086) as she forges ahead on the stage.

characters.name: Ryouko Ueda
characters.description: Ueda is a student of Fujigaya who befriends Akira in her second year of high school. She is very tall and is the same height as Fumi. Ueda always has a calm expression on her face, and it reflects her personality, as she is not very easily ruffled and is not outgoing or outspoken. She prefers to stay out of the spotlight though curiously, she does not shy away from people or doing things. Ueda is recruited by Oono Haruka to play a role in the Drama Club's new play despite her protests that she prefers to read plays rather than re-enact them. She however complies and takes a position on stage. She is Akira's newest confidante as Kyouko is in another class. Ueda is rather amused by Akira's antics and finds the shorter girl to be very cute. She reminds Akira of Fumi sometimes. Much to Akira's relief, Ueda is very considerate and caring as she revealed to Akira that she f

characters.name: Emi Okabe
characters.description: She enrolls as a scholarship student and attracts attention with her presence, but soon suffers from harassment from [Katsurako](https://anilist.co/character/382164/Katsurako-Ibuki) and others and becomes isolated.

characters.name: Katsurako Ibuki
characters.description: She is an elite third-generation Awajima native, and is a presence that the other students cannot ignore. She is jealous of [Okabe Emi's](https://anilist.co/character/382163/Emi-Okabe) talent and isolates her.

characters.name: Eri Fujisawa
characters.description: She was hurt by her relationships in middle school and moved to Awajima. Like [Sara](https://anilist.co/character/392503/Sara-Takanashi), she admires Takanashi Haru. Always thinking about what she wants to become, she trains hard with Sara and [Shizuka](https://anilist.co/character/392502/Shizuka-Gagakugawa).

characters.name: Shizuka Utagawa
characters.description: A calm and collected student in the preparatory course. She is a fan of Kaburagi Yuki (Saori Yamagata's stage name) and has secretly aspired to enter Awajima since middle school. Although she appears quiet at first glance, she also has a hidden passion in her heart.

characters.name: Sara Takanashi
characters.description: A bright and friendly preparatory student. Inspired by Takanashi Haru ([Kinuie's](https://anilist.co/character/379537/Kinue-Takehara) stage name), she decides to enroll at Awajima. She enjoys a cheerful dorm life as part of a close-knit trio with [Eri](https://anilist.co/character/392501/Eri-Fujisawa) and [Shizuka](https://anilist.co/character/392502/Shizuka-Gagakugawa).

characters.name: Fumi Manjoume
characters.description: A tall, dark haired, bespectacled girl. She is seen by other girls as being strong, refined and genteel, however they become surprised when they realise that Fumi is actually very gentle and shy. Others have noted her for having pretty eyes and a soft, lady-like voice. She is often said to make "scary faces" when she is upset or irked. Despite her size, mature aura and sometimes foreboding presence, Fumi is a reserved crybaby. After moving back to her home town, she makes fast friends with a girl from her youth: Okudaira Akira. Fumi used to live nearby to Akira growing up, and so they were best friends from the young ages of five or six. Fumi relied heavily on Akira in kindergarten, as she is seen incapable of doing anything but crying until Akira comes to "save" her and take care of her. This has not changed much as she got older, as noted by Akira. Fumi has had a cl

title: Kore Kaite Shine
description: First-year high school student Ai Yasumi lives on the island of Izu Oshima and loves reading manga. But after a certain turning point, she sets her sights on creating stories of her own! As she dives into the world of manga-making, Ai faces challenges, growth, and the excitement of chasing her creative dreams. Where will her creative journey take her? (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Ai Yasumi
characters.description: A high school first year who loves manga. The manga "Robota and Pokota" is the Bible of her heart.

characters.name: Rei Teshima
characters.description: Izu Oshima's high school Japanese teacher, and advisor for the manga research club.

characters.name: Kokoro Fujimori
characters.description: A member of the fine arts club, who's skilful at painting. Reserved, but thanks to Ai's invitation, she showed courage, and is now also part of the manga club. Daughter of the island's innkeep.

characters.name: Sachi Akafuku
characters.description: Ai's classmate. Used the manga club as a facade for her ambition to make a comfy clubroom. Her father owns the island's souvenir shop.

characters.name: Hikaru Sekiryuu
characters.description: Hikaru is a transfer student from mainland Tokyo and a popular doujin manga artist at Comitia.

title: Watashi ni Tenshi ga Maiorita! OVA
title_original: 私に天使が舞い降りた！OVA
title_en: WATATEN!: an Angel Flew Down to Me: You Never Let Us Down / Always Growing Closer / Let's Change You Into This! / I'm Your Big Sister
description: OVA bundled with the third BD/DVD release. Hinata Hoshino, Hana Shirosaki, and Noa Himesaka are off to the countryside for a camping trip. At Hinata's behest, her elder sister, Miyako, reluctantly tags along. Seeing how gloomy Miyako is, the trio do their best to get her to enjoy herself too. Besides the camping trip, Watashi ni Tenshi ga Maiorita! Special contains three more short stories of the girls. Although their lives seem normal, one thing is certain: there is definitely no shortage of cuteness here!

characters.name: Miyako Hoshino
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") A college student who is shy around strangers and spends most of her time indoors. She becomes smitten by [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476) and starts making her snacks in exchange for getting her to dress up in cosplay outfits she makes.

characters.name: Hana Shirosaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 142.3 cm (4'8") An elementary school student who is classmates with [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/131477). She is often disturbed by [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475)'s behavior but puts up with it in order to eat her snacks.

characters.name: Hinata Hoshino
characters.description: __Height:__ 140.7 cm [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475)'s younger sister and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476)'s classmate. She is particularly fond of her sister, who she nicknames "Mya-nee".

characters.name: Noa Himesaka
characters.description: __Height__: 142.7 cm (4'8") [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476) and [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/131477)'s classmate who moves next door to [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475) and Hinata. She constantly sees herself as cute, often becoming downhearted when someone else (usually Hana) is said to be cuter.

characters.name: Kouko Matsumoto
characters.description: __Height:__ 164.8 cm (5'4") A girl who was in a club with [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475) during high school. While Miyako hardly remembers her, she has been obsessively fixated on her, acting like a stalker.

characters.name: Koyori Tanemura
characters.description: __Height__: 138.6 cm (4'6") A class representative in Hana's class. She aspires to be someone that everyone can rely on, but is often unreliable herself.

characters.name: Kanon Konomori
characters.description: __Height:__ 141 cm (4'7") Another class representative in [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476)'s class and [Koyori](https://anilist.co/character/131478)'s best friend. She is kind and often seen as very reliable, much to Koyori's chagrin.

characters.name: Chizuru Hoshino
characters.description: Miyako and Hinata's mother.

characters.name: Yuuna Matsumoto
characters.description: Yuuna is [Kouko Matsumoto](https://anilist.co/character/136814)'s little sister who appears for the first time when [Miyako Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/131475) and [Hinata Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/131477) go outside to go shop.

title: Bakuretsu Tenshi
description: In a crime-ridden future Japan, Kyohei Tachibana is a peaceful student at a culinary school, dreaming of going to France for advanced study as a patissier (pastry chef). To afford the trip, he accepts a part-time job as private cook to a strange group of women - Sei, Meg, Jo and Amy. To Kyohei's astonishment, they turn out to be a band of violent mercenaries, and he finds himself in the line of fire.

characters.name: Jo
characters.description: Silver hair, red eyes, carries twin Desert Eagles and is known as "The Angel from Hell." She has superhuman abilities from her artificial creation, usually followed by the appearance of a purple glowing tattoo on her left arm and shoulder blade. They resemble wings and are often called "The Wings of the Devil" and will glow when Jo is put under a lot of stress when fighting. Jo also puts Meg over anything else, which she stated when telling Meg that she fights for her only. When she is not fighting, she enjoys watching horror or gore related movies. Ending spoiler: ~!Jo would eventually rediscover her past as a genetically engineered war machine in human form. After being forced to surrender with Meg and others held hostage, Jo returns to the secret labs for reprogramming and conditioning at RAPT R&D. Jo's counterpart, Maria, freed her to only prove who was the strongest; Jo managed

characters.name: Meg
characters.description: Meg has red hair, carries a small revolver, at times a large armor piercing rifle, and dresses like a cowgirl. Meg is highly prone to be captured and only to be rescued by Jo. She is the very best of friends with Jo and is 100% loyal to her only. It's suggestive throughout the series and manga that her feelings for Jo might be romantic, possibly bisexual since she's into men. She first met Jo in New York City, a year before the beginning of the series. Since then, Meg and Jo teamed up and became bounty hunters until Sei hired them. Meg enjoys eating and loves buffets. Her true hair color is not red, but actually black. She was once an orphan in New York City, but managed to encounter Jo. At first she was reluctant to keep Jo around because of her destructive capabilities, but after some time they learn to appreciate and trust each other. After they took Sei's offer as empl

characters.name: Sei
characters.description: Sei is the busty leader of the group and was the one who hired Jo and Meg to become members of it alongside Kyohei. She wears a long blue jacket, and has her black hair in a bun, but appears older than her stated age. Her grandfather runs Bai Lan and comes from a very powerful Chinese family. Born and raised as a traditional Chinese girl and trained in various ways of her clan/syndicate. After her grandfather stepped down as leader of the clan, their current clan members made a partnership with RAPT to preserve their clan. However such actions not only disgusted Sei, but she was forced to do many things for RAPT in Bai-Lan's name. She eventually rebelled against her own organization under the advice of her own grandfather. She was advised to walk her own path and so she chose to oppose RAPT and towards the end she was shot multiple times by a cyberoid. It is unknown if Sei survived the e

characters.name: Amy
characters.description: Amy is a Computer/Techno whiz. She was saved and recruited by Sei after Amy's hacking drew attention to the authorities. She often argues with Meg and also loves scarfing down Kyohei's various treats. She has a cult following in the cyberworld. She is often seen carrying what appears to be a pink stuffed animal that actually contains a laptop. ( Source : Wikipedia )

characters.name: Kyohei Tachibana
characters.description: A student attending a certified culinary school who is proficient in French, Chinese, Italian and Japanese cooking. Kyohei is often seen wearing his chef uniform and riding a small motor scooter which is destroyed by Jo on two occasions. He is hired by Sei as a cook for the girls because their last cook had left. He continues working for the team to save up to go to France and become a pastry chef.

characters.name: Maria
characters.description: A girl with a distinct resemblance to Jo who, like Jo, was artificially created. She expresses a desire to hurt Jo, and so attempts to take Meg for her own. She's discovered to be Jo's "sister" and when both fight their energies are capable of entering a pocket of alternate space and reality. After Jo defeated her, she lost the drive to fight and regains her humanity to save Jo and Meg from RAPT forces. She was killed in heavy gunfire from RAPT Cybots. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Angelique
characters.description: Appears only in episodes 5-6.

characters.name: Takane Katsu
characters.description: A loud-mouthed, bike-riding Police Officer from Osaka. Takane is often seen riding a chopper and wears a uniform resembling that of a schoolgirl. She carries a large wooden sword, which she swings around often; as it symbolizes her leadership of an all girl biker gang, who often act as her deputies. She's also efficient at throwing handcuffs and subduing her target. Takane is quick to lose her temper and hates being in debt to anyone. She is also the daughter of the Police Chief of Osaka. After crossing paths with the team, she becomes attached to the team and assists them anyway she can as debt to Jo even if it means disobeying her father. (Wikipedia)

characters.name: Leo Jinno
characters.description: Appearance wise, Leo is your typical middle-aged mechanic. He is Django's mechanic and hates it when Jo plays rough with it as well as Meg annoying him when he's working. He has trouble controlling his urges to act like a child as seen when the team goes to Fortune Island Artificial Beach resort. There, he smashes a go-kart out of the raceway and down the street. Despite being the team's mechanic, he has seen combat on several occasion wielding a pair of sub-machine guns. (source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Jei Kokuren
characters.description: A representative from Kokuren and Bai-lan's Japanese counterpart. His father and Sei's grandfather arrange for he and Sei to wed so that the white and black lotus can join together once again. However, Sei's grandfather respectfully declines Jei's request to have both the Bai Lan and Kokuren seals displayed together. Angry, he and his men attack Sei to try and obtain the Bai Lan seal by force. Jei obtains the seal and almost escapes, but he is stopped by Jo after shooting down the dragon head of the yacht making it crash onto Jei's boat. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Akio
characters.description: An old friend and classmate of Kyohei who always defended him. He is found on the streets by Eiji, a Yakuza member. He takes Akio in and has a doctor convert him into a Cyberoid. He goes on a one man war against the Yakuza. Eiji agrees to a deal with the right-hand man of the Yakuza boss to kill Akio. Eiji fails and ends up being shot several times by an enraged Akio due his betrayal. He tells Kyohei what happened to him and how he became a Cyberoid. After killing off the Yakuza and the Boss, Akio battles Eiji now being converted to a Cyberoid. Akio kills Eiji though he dies in the process leaving Kyohei crying at the loss of his friend. Profile on Wikipedia

title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha StrikerS
title_original: 魔法少女リリカルなのはStrikerS
description: Set 10 years after Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha A's, Nanoha, Fate, Hayate and the rest of the crew are now working full time in the Time-Space Administration Bureau. Nanoha is a combat instructor, Fate is a special investigator, and Hayate is a commanding officer. They must unite once again to save the dimensions. Introducing new characters as well: Subaru, Teana, Caro and Erio. Stand by. Ready. Set up!

characters.name: Fate Testarossa
characters.original: フェイト・テスタロッサ
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ [Bardiche](https://anilist.co/character/220250/Bardiche) Fate is introduced as an antagonist and rival to Nanoha Takamachi, she first encounters Nanoha during the Jewel Seed Incident while collecting the Lost Logia known as the Jewel Seeds on behalf of her abusive mother, Presea Testarossa. Despite their initial conflict, the two develop a close friendship that evolves into a lifelong partnership.

characters.name: Nanoha Takamachi
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ Raising Heart Excelion. Strike Cannon, Fortress __Rank:__ S+ __Rank (StrikerS):__ Captain of Stars Squad, part of the mobile sixth division __Code name (StrikerS):__ Stars 1 In Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha, Nanoha Takamachi is sweet if naive third-grader. However, she has always felt like she is missing something in her life: all the people around her have someone there​ are very close to but she lacks this. However, Nanoha is no longer an "ordinary" third grader when she meets and helps the wounded ferret, who just happens to be a mage from another planet, Yuuno Scrya. He has come to Earth to gather the "Jewel Seeds," mysterious artifacts containing great power. Nanoha agrees to help him, but the task seems harder than presented when she meets Fate Testarossa, another girl searching for the Jewel Seeds. In A's, six months after the first season, Nanoha still remai

characters.name: Hayate Yagami
characters.description: __Intelligent Device(s):__ Buch der Nachthimmel/Book of Darkness (Storage/Tome), Schwertkreuz (Rod), Reinforce II (Unison Device) A sweet and gentle orphan who is confined to a wheelchair, is cared for by the Wolkenritter, who deliberately keep their battles hidden from her. She knows that completing the Book of Darkness would grant her immense power, but she refuses to accept that power at the cost of innocent lives. Unbeknownst to her, however, the Book is already feeding on her life force, causing her paralysis and slowly weakening her. If it is not completed, the Book will eventually consume her life entirely.

characters.name: Subaru Nakajima
characters.description: Mid-childa native, private 1st class with a mage rank of "B". Subaru was rescued from from a burning airport by Nanoha four years prior. This incident inspired Subaru to join the armed forces with aspirations of becoming a powerful mage. By chance she was transfered into Mobile Section Six's Stars squad commanded by the very same person who rescued her. On the field, she is equipped with the rollerblade-like intelligent device Mach Caliber and the armed device Revolver Knuckle. ~!Like her sister Ginga she is actually a cyborg created on base of genetical material of Quint Nakajima!~

characters.name: Teana Lanster
characters.original: ティアナ・ランスター
characters.description: Mid-childa native, private 2nd class with a mage rank of "B". Teana was raised by her older brother through most of her childhood up to his death. Because of a mission in which her brother had failed to apprehend a wanted mage, the Lanster name was shamed and Teana made efforts to redeem herself and her dead brother throughout her time at the academy. She was assigned into the Stars squad under the TSAB Mobile Section Six with Subaru Nakajima. She is armed with the intelligent device Cross Mirage. Has rare magic specialization is Illusionist and Gunslinger

characters.name: Erio Mondial
characters.original: エリオ・モンディアル
characters.description: A boy whom Fate takes in and cares for, and the guard wing of the Lightning Squad. He uses an armed device named Strada. It is a spear (electricity attribute), similar to Signum's sword (flare attribute). He uses the modern-Belka magic system, but is also able to perform some Mid-Childa mobile magics like Sonic Move. Erio was adopted by Lindy Harlaown four years prior to StrikerS, as Fate was legally too young to do so. Erio shows signs of a romantic interest in Caro.

characters.name: Caro Ru Lushe
characters.description: A pink-haired little girl with jewels on her gloves (which may be a reference to Magic Knight Rayearth, as were the names of the Wolkenritter) that are actually a new type of device, a "Boost Device" named Kerykeion. She seems to have a magic circle that is light pink, but then it also shows that she has a magical square just like Lutecia. She first uses her magical square in episode 17 when she summoned the Dragon King to destroy. Though she is not proficient in attack magics, she is good at boost magics and can perform the unique summon magics. Her unique talent as a dragon summoner was frightening to the Ru Lushe clan, by which she was raised, and they banished her from their native land of Arzus. On the other extreme, the TSAB almost refused her because, though her talent was great, her skills were not refined. However, Fate T. Harlaown took her on herself. Caro appears to

characters.name: Vivio Takamachi
characters.description: (StrikerS), 10 (ViVid) __Eye color:__ Green & Brownish red __Hair color:__ Golden Blond __Handedness:__ Right __Intelligent Device:__ Sacred Heart aka Cris After being found by Caro and Erio during their break, she was taken into Nanoha and Fate's care. Her most visible feature is heterochromia. Quattro has referred to her as the "Vessel of the Saints". Also has Nanoha as her mother and Fate as her step-mother who is really her Godmother.

characters.name: Arf
characters.description: Fate's outspoken dog-woman familiar. Her distaste of Precia is mutual, but she cannot do anything to protect Fate from her mother. Arf instead takes out her anger on her enemies. She is very kind to Fate and rather protective of her. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Signum
characters.description: __Nanoha A's__ Signum enters the story when Vita has attempted to steal Nanoha Takamachi's Linker Core (a mage's source of magic) for the Book of Darkness. Since the arrival of Nanoha's cavalry, Fate Testarossa and Yūno Scrya, Vita is cornered and Signum must come to her rescue with Shamal. The Wolkenritter overpower the TSAB troupe with their use of high-powered magical cartridges, and Signum manages to snap Fate's staff, Bardiche, in half. The battle ends with Shamal finally managing to get Nanoha's Linker Core and Nanoha breaking Vita's barrier. Signum refuses to take a bath that night for fear of Hayate seeing the injuries sustained in her battle with Fate. Signum may appear emotionless, but she is completely dedicated to Hayate, and as the leader of the Wolkenritter, fights for the others as well. The Wolkenritter attack mages to steal their Linker Cores, their sources of magic, to

characters.name: Vita
characters.description: __Vita in Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha A's__ Vita enters A's on a hunt with Zafila for strong Linker Cores to absorb into the Book of Darkness. She targets Nanoha Takamachi, which she deems to be a juicy target, unlike the usual TSAB "redshirts" which can barely fill up a single page of the Book of Darkness. Nanoha puts up a decent fight, but Vita tilts the deck with two cartridges (bullet shaped things that contain high-pressure magic) manages to overpower her, obtaining a power superiority so vast that she heavily damaged the Raising Heart. However, before she could get the Linker Core, Fate Testarossa and Yūno Scrya come to the rescue. Vita fights them off with her fellow Wolkenritter, Signum and Shamal, and they declare themselves enemies. The battle ends with Shamal finally managing to get Nanoha's Linker Core and Nanoha breaking Vita's barrier. ~! Vita fights for the sake of protect

characters.name: Yuuno Scrya
characters.description: Before the start of the series, Yūno lived in Mid-childa, a magical world, as an archaeologist. He had no parents, so was raised by his entire tribe, the Scrya, from which he took his surname. He also obtained or created the intelligent device Raising Heart around this time, but his talents lay as a support mage, and so his attack abilities were low and he never made the device into a weapon. Yūno first appears running from a gigantic monster in the woods and attempting to seal the Jewel Seed inside it with Raising Heart. He fails, letting the monster get away, and collapses wounded on the ground. Yūno uses his remaining power to call out to the nearest magic user and turns into a ferret. His call was heard in Nanoha Takamachi's dream, and later that day, she found the ferret in the woods and took him to the veterinary hospital. He quickly recovered, taking a liking to Nanoha and recogni

title: Acro Trip
description: Chizuko is a normal otaku girl in Niigata Prefecture. She’s obsessed with Berry Blossom, a magical heroine who protects the city. But the battles with her inept nemesis, Chroma, have become so lackluster that they’re not even worth watching. Chizuko wants to see Berry’s full power, a desire that quickly leads this seemingly timid girl down a path of evil. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Chizuko Date
characters.description: A middle school student who likes [Berry Blossom](https://anilist.co/character/297362) a little too much.

characters.name: Chroma
characters.description: The leader of the evil organization, Fossa Magna, and an enemy of [Berry Blossom](https://anilist.co/character/297362/Berry-Blossom).

characters.name: Kaju Noichigo
characters.description: A magical girl who protects [Chizuko](https://anilist.co/character/297361/Chizuko-Date)'s city from threats.

characters.name: Mashiro
characters.description: A typical magical girl mascot supporting [Berry Blossom](https://anilist.co/character/297362/Berry-Blossom) behind the scenes.

characters.name: Baryuu Oomizo
characters.description: Mysterious CEO of the well known company Oomizo Technica who is hiding a secret.

characters.name: Kokoa
characters.description: A young looking girl who is interested in the magic powers of [Chizuko](https://anilist.co/character/297361/Chizuko-Date) and [Chroma.](https://anilist.co/character/313872/Chroma)

characters.name: Tsuki
characters.description: [Kokoa's](https://anilist.co/character/341029/Kokoa) attendant who is exceptionally skilled

characters.name: Hugh
characters.description: Member of the evil organization Fossa Magna who was suddenly sent by headquarters to replace [Chroma](https://anilist.co/character/313872/Chroma).

characters.name: Suikyou Date
characters.description: [Chizuko's](https://anilist.co/character/297361/Chizuko-Date) grandfather who is exceedingly active

characters.name: Kuma Kaijin
characters.description: Mysterious creatures summoned by [Chroma](https://anilist.co/character/313872/Chroma) who only communicate by saying "Bear" and making animal noises.

title: Otome wa Boku ni Koishiteru
title_en: Otoboku: Maidens are Falling for Me
description: Mizuho can't believe his ears when Grandpa's will is read out. Grandpa's final wish is for Mizuho to attend the same academy as Mizuho's mother. The catch is it's an all-girls school. With the help of friend Mariya however, he gets a makeover good enough to fool everyone at the academy. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Mizuho Miyanokouji
characters.description: Mizuho is the main protagonist who transfers to an all-girl's school per his grandfather's will and must crossdress in order to attend. He already looks very androgynous, so the change thankfully isn't obvious to the other members of the school. However, Mizuho is always nervous about being found out and constantly worries that it will happen. In spite of this, he was well received on his first day at school and has already become very popular among the students. At first he was shocked when he found out about the will, but with the help of his childhood friend Mariya Mikado, who also attends the school, he was able to resign himself to transferring to the school. Despite making the change, he still uses language which is usually only used by males in Japan such as boku (僕), meaning "I". When Mizuho was younger, he had very little self-confidence and in effect of

characters.name: Mariya Mikado
characters.description: Mariya is Mizuho's childhood friend who knows him very well. When it was decided that Mizuho would transfer to the all-girls school she also attends, she took it upon herself to transform him into a beautiful girl by use of makeup, the school uniform he was to wear and some prostheses. Mariya seemed to have a lot of fun dressing him up as a girl. Mariya has a very spirited personality which she uses often to make sure Mizuho is acting feminine in every way: appearance, mannerisms, and even speech. This often includes using mild violence. Also, she has a temper, of which she has little control and which sometimes causes her to do inadvisable things or carry grudges to an extreme - such as her grudge against Takako. During most of the time that Mariya has known Mizuho, she has always been there as his support whenever he needed her, though later on in the series she finds that without her

characters.name: Takako Itsukushima
characters.description: Takako is the student council president of the all-girls school where the story takes place. She tends to have a serious personality which compliments that of a student council president. As the president, she knows that she must be very decisive in her actions and thus cannot often hesitate with her decisions, since she knows the students would have trouble following her if she didn't act as such. As it is, Takako herself has stated how she almost never has confidence in herself. In contrast to her usual attitude, she has shown herself to have a more gentle side to her character. Eventually, she begins to form feelings for Mizuho, though while still under the belief that Mizuho is a girl, she is at first confused about what she has been feeling. She also has a high fear of ghosts. And she hates frogs, the latter fear having been worsened by a childhood 'prank' pulled by M

characters.name: Shion Juujou
characters.description: One of Mizuho's classmates who figures out that he is a boy almost immediately after their second meeting. Thankfully, she tells him that she will keep it a secret from anyone else. Shion becomes an advisor and a female role-model for Mizuho. She has a silent demeanor and voice, which helps to give her a gentle and appealing appearance to the rest of the students. One year previous, she had to leave school due to an illness and had to spend her time in the hospital, all which occurred right after she was elected as that year's Elder. She had come back this year in order to repeat her last year, even though she still isn't fully recovered.

characters.name: Yukari Kamioka
characters.description: Yukari is one of the first year students at the school who lives in the same dormitory building as Mizuho and Mariya, who also is her Onee-sama (お姉さま, meaning "Older sister"); it is a tradition for the underclassmen to serve their respective senpai any way they can. Much like Kana and Mariya, she is a very energetic girl, although unlike them, she is deathly afraid of ghost stories and anything scary - a fact which Mariya has often used for her own amusement and which initially caused some trouble when Yukari met Ichiko. Yukari is on the track and field team along with Mariya, though her main reason for joining was due to her older sister-in-law who had urged her to come to this school and who was also in track and field. However, Yukari soon comes to discover that she really does have a liking for track and field and continues activities in the club even after a time of losing

characters.name: Kana Suouin
characters.description: Kana is another one of the girls who lives in the same dormitory building as Mizuho, who becomes her Onee-sama. Kana is more than happy to serve Mizuho any way she can, since she admires him immensely. Kana, who like Yukari is a first-year student, has been waiting for the chance to have an Onee-sama as she has always been envious of Yukari having Mariya to fill that role. One of the defining features about her is that she often ends sentences with the phrase ~nanodesuyo. Kana wears a large pink ribbon in her hair which was given to her by the director of the orphanage she lived at for much of her life. Ultimately, the director, who loved Kana in place of her missing parents, died right after giving her the ribbon and due to this, she almost never takes the ribbon off. Kana has never seen her mother's or father's faces.

characters.name: Ichiko Takashima
characters.description: Ichiko is, in fact, a ghost. Her story begins 22 years ago: a previous Elder (actually Mizuho's mother) had a close relationship with an underclassmen who had a weak body. When that underclassman heard that the elder was graduating and getting married the same time, she had to see her before she left. The underclassman went to the Elder's room, and waited, but she died before she had the chance to talk with the Elder. That room has been deemed the "closed room" ever since, until Mizuho arrived and started living it, according to his grandfather's will. She is very energetic and hyperactive, often talking very fast. She took some time to understand that she is a ghost, and by that, dead. She says that Mizuho looks very much like her previous Elder love interest.

characters.name: Hisako Kajiura
characters.description: Hisako is Mizuho's homeroom teacher to his class of 3-A and is the one of the only people in the entire school who knows that Mizuho is in fact a boy, other than Mariya, the headmistress and later Shion and Ichiko. She has a helping personality and even told Mizuho to come to her if anything was bothering him. She often gives out candy to her students. Hisako makes an appearance again for the sequel Otome wa Boku ni Koishiteru 2: Futari no Elder, this time as Chihaya's homeroom teacher and the school's acting principal. She also knows his secret like Mizuho before him. Her appearance has changed since Mizuho's time at the academy, she has longer hair in particular.

characters.name: Kimie Sugawara
characters.description: Kimie is Takako's personal assistant and as such, she follows the student council president around almost all the time. When they are not together, Kimie will go around investigating various matters and report back to Takako. Much like Takako, she has a very serious personality and would not stop at sticking up for Takako when need be.

characters.name: Kei Takanashi
characters.description: Kei is a strange girl in Mizuho's class who usually has a quiet voice and doesn't show much emotion which often gives her a creepy visage. She is the director of the drama club and during times on stage she has to be very forceful in order to get a good response out of her actors. A character with the same name and similar appearance, appears in another one of Caramel Box's other games, Alicematic.

characters.name: Michiko Takane
characters.description: Michiko is also in Mizuho's class and is a good friend of Kei's as they are constantly seen hanging out together. Unlike Kei, Michiko usually has a smile on her face and is a fairly social person.

title: Ikkitousen: Great Guardians
description: Hakufu's dreams of participating in new fights and tournaments are put on hold as new obstacles block her path. Her friends have lost faith in her, new enemies appear, and a younger sister she never knew existed suddenly shows up on her doorstep. If Hakufu ever hopes to compete worldwide, she's going to have to deal with her issues at home first. (Source: FUNimation)

characters.name: Hakufu Sonsaku
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'3") The protagonist of the series, busty, light red haired and green-eyed and not terribly bright, but immeasurably powerful. Hakufu cares little for the politics of the series, only caring about fighting for the sake of fighting, but is staunchly against unnecessary violence and killing. Lately, however, with trouble brewing all around her she is beginning to take up the mantle of a leader to protect her friends and family. Hakufu possesses a unique gift for predicting enemy moves very accurately by reading the flow of chi (which proved useless against Ukitsu) around her opponents which occasionally makes her seem brighter than she is. She also inherited Master Chouchou's knowledge of chi magic, and, while currently unaware of this, is able to use it partially by instinct. Choushou passed it to her spiritually while Hakufu was unconscious, this is how she healed Ko

characters.name: Koukin Shuuyu
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'4") Hakufu's cousin and an attractive pretty boy, both Kanu and Ukitsu have both expressed exclusive interest in him. Although only a C-rank his lack of confidence and his short resume of victories (or battles for that matter) keep from becoming A-rank despite already having the power of one. He has a crush on his cousin and is generally shy and well-meaning making life very difficult for him. He was a virgin (presumably) until he was seduced by 3 hot girls from Kyosho after he was kidnapped. Oddly Hakufu doesn't seem to mind being naked around but is aware of and disapproves of sexual harassment showing how much she trusts him.

characters.name: Kan'u Unchou
characters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm Believed to be the most feared and powerful Toushi around, she even carries the nearly invincible Blue Dragon Crescent Blade from her predecessor as well as the legendary sword Kusanagi; she also has overwhelming chi. She believes her destiny is to die protecting Ryuubi. It is believed by many characters that Ryomou will one day kill her. Presumed to be an old friend of Kakouton and Kakuka. Despite this, however, she seems to have taken an interest in Koukin (this happens only in the "English Adaptation", it is not present in the original JPN manga).

characters.name: Shimei Ryomou
characters.description: Manga Powerful and a B-rank, she is one of the Four Devas of Nanyo. She has a habit of wearing a blue miniskirted French maid outfit and specialises in professional wrestling moves, throws, and joint attacks, which she uses in conjunction with a pair of handcuffs she carries; she is also very proficient in making chi blasts. Her earlier life before she became a Toushi is unknown but is hinted as being tragic and painful. She, Teifu, and Saji have been best friends long before the start of the series. Ryomou is in love with Saji and cares for Teifu (who loves her). Ryomou has always fought for the fun of it and considers herself no one's woman. Presumably because of her dragon she has a minor split personality; one is fairly shy and normal and the other is psychosexual. Her psycho side is not nearly as bad as Ryubi, Sousou and Hakufu. Three years prior to the start of the series Ryomou fo

characters.name: Genpou Saji
characters.description: __Height__: 177 cm __Three Kingdoms counterpart__: Zuo Ci __School__: Nanyou's Institute, 3rd Year __Toushi Rank__: A-Rank A third-year student at Nanyo Academy with blond hair and a light tan, and one of Nanyo's Big Four. He is one of Ryomou's oldest friends (whom he refers to as "Mou-chan"), and has feelings for both her and Housen Ryofu; even so, he is also a complete womanizer. His actual ranking as a fighter is unknown, as he never actually wears his magatama in public, but in fights he has shown himself to be an A-rank easily. One of his primary goals as Ouin was to remove Totaku from power, which, like his historical namesake, he accomplishes by convincing Ryofu to assassinate him. __Manga version__: In order to further Hakufu's mastery of the Water Dragon Fist, Saji fully donned the magatama and identity of Ouin, granting him great power and also slightly altering his appearance.

characters.name: Housen Ryofu
characters.description: __Height__: 166 cm __Three Kingdoms counterpart__: Lu Bu __School__: Rakuyou College, 3rd Year __Toushi Rank__: A-Rank A strong bisexual fighter with a very promiscuous personality and a habit for dressing skimpy. She was very skilled at making chi-blasts and was in love with both Saji and her best friend Chinkyuu. She had a love-hate relationship with Saji, who she claims once raped her (Saji only half denies this, claiming that she was not raped because she enjoyed it). Despite trying her best to escape her destiny, she ended up causing it anyway. Afflicted with a deadly illness that would kill her before adulthood, she ended up being manipulated by Saji into causing Toutaku's death. When she found out that Chinkyuu was raped, she went in search of revenge as her last living act. She was found by Myosai, and the two fought each other. Myosai's skill added with Ryofu's failing health wa

characters.name: Ekitoku Chouhi
characters.description: __Three Kingdoms Counterpart:__ Zhang Fei __Height:__ 161 cm Ryuubi's best friend and an avid snack-lover. Although quite weak and only a C-rank, history states that she will one day become so powerful that legends will tell of her matching ten thousand men (just like Zhang Fei, himself), which makes her well-known around town. She has already performed such a feat, although on a much smaller scale, when Kyosho first assaulted Seito to search for Ryubi.
