Mirai has a lot of questions, and Riko explains that she's searching for something. The two of them are wearing similar pendants. Then Batti, an ally of the dark magic user Dokurokushi, appears before them and demands the "Link Stone Emerald." Batti creates a monster called a "Yokubaru" and drives them into a corner. Mirai, Riko, and Mofurun join hands and speak the magic words "Cure-Up Rapapa," their pendants glow, and they become the legendary Precure. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Mirai Asahina
characters.description: Mirai is a thirteen-year-old girl who is just about to enter junior high. She's a strange, funny, lovely and energetic girl who is interested in various things. Her stuffed bear [Mofurun](https://anilist.co/character/125950/Mofurun) that she was given by her grandmother, [Kanoko](https://anilist.co/character/305042/Yuki-Kanoko), is very important to her and she admires [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/125949/Izayoi-Liko) a lot. Her goal is to study magic she loves while trying to gain Riko's admiration. Mirai's alter ego is the legendary Cure Miracle.

characters.name: Liko Izayoi
characters.description: Liko is thirteen years old and attends a school in the magic world. She is quite a shy girl with a lot of self-esteem. Even though she is great at studying her magic is quite weak. She puts a lot of pressure on herself because she wants to become a respectable witch like her sister. After meeting Mirai and becoming a Pretty Cure she starts to loosen up and becomes brighter and less worrisome. (Source: Pretty Cure Wikia)

characters.name: Haa-chan
characters.description: Haa-chan is a baby-like fairy who appears in Mahoutsukai Precure!. She comes from the Linkle Smartbook and it is a mystery as to why she comes from it. She acts a lot like a normal toddler, always wanting to play and getting rather moody when things don't go her way. She can get rather sleepy after eating or drinking something and goes back into the Linkle Smartbook for rest. ~!Ha-chan grows up into a young girl during episode 21.!~ ~!In episode 22, she debuts as her alter ego, Cure Felice, the final form that she transforms into. As a young girl, Haa-chan goes by the name Kotoha Hanami. She sometimes acts quite mature and yet still cheerful and sweet. Kotoha has been strongly influenced by both Mirai and Liko, and tend to behave in extremely similar behavior that bear resemblance of their personalities. She is optimistic and always believes in the good of people, despite her naivety get

characters.name: Mofurun
characters.description: A teddy bear who was given to [Mirai](https://anilist.co/character/125756/Mirai-Asahina) by her grandmother on her first birthday. She gained the ability to speak when Mirai became a Pretty Cure together with [Liko](https://anilist.co/character/125949/Liko-Izayoi). She ends her sentences with "~mofu". Mofurun is a warm-hearted, soft-spoken companion. She can be curious, gluttonous, and simple-minded, getting sad and worried during serious moments. She also has a responsible side, worrying about Mirai's well-being, looking after [Ha-chan](https://anilist.co/character/125937/Hachan), and helping out Mirai and Riko during their magic classes.

characters.name: Kouchou
characters.description: The headmaster of the magic school in the Magic World. His real name is unknown, and he is simply referred to as "Headmaster" by everyone, both inside and outside the school. Although he appears to be a handsome young man, he is actually quite elderly and speaks with the tone of an old man. His catchphrase is "Umai-shi" (Delicious!), which he utters whenever he tastes something. He possesses impeccable skill and leadership abilities, yet he has a very laid-back, nonchalant personality. He frequently leaves the headmaster's office without notice and makes bizarre decisions on his own, often exasperating the serious-minded vice-principal.

characters.name: Batty
characters.description: Batty is one of Dokuroxy's minions, tasked with finding the Linkle Stone Emerald.

characters.name: Yamo
characters.description: Yamo is Dokuroxy's second in command.

characters.name: Sparda
characters.description: Sparda is one of Dokuroxy's minions, tasked with finding the Linkle Stone Emerald.

characters.name: Gamettsu
characters.description: Gamettsu is one of Dokurokushe's minions, tasked with finding the Linkle Stone Emerald.

characters.name: Dokurokushe
characters.description: The wizard of darkness who seeks the "Linkle Stone Emerald" to plunge the world into darkness. He is a wizard shrouded in mystery. ~!His real name is Kushi. He used to be a professor at the magic school, and he was very close friends with the principal. He became Dokurokushe when he experimented with too much Dark Magic.!~

characters.name: Labut
characters.description: Labut is a mysterious villain who appears to be a sly genie, and is one of Deusmast's retainers. Deusmast instructed him to get rid of anyone who could pose a threat when Deusmast eventually comes down to bring chaos to the world and consume it. He was sealed in a gold lamp and is responsible for bringing Yamoh back to life. (Source: Pretty Cure Wiki)

title: Maebashi Witches
description: Welcome to Maebashi City, Gunma Prefecture. For first-year high school student Yuina Akagi, her middling life takes a wild turn the moment a mysterious frog named Keroppe shows up and asks her, “Why don’t you become a witch?” Alongside Azu Niisato, Kyouka Kitahara, Choco Mitsumata, and Mai Kamiizumi, Yuina and her friends are excited to make people’s dreams come true as the Maebashi Witches. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Yuina Akagi
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm She is a cheerful first-year high school student. She loves cameras and wants to take photos with a good vibe! She is a follower of trends and seems to be a bit uninformed about things. She sees things at a simple and broad perspective and unknowingly changes the people around her as she trains to be a witch.

characters.name: Azu Niisato
characters.description: __Height:__ 152.5 cm She loves fashion and make-up. She is very aware of recent fashion trends and never fails to find information of new fashion trends on social media. She has a very strong personality, is very clear about what she likes and what she dislikes and she is very outspoken. She is the most passionate out of the witch apprentices to complete her witch training and make wishes come true.

characters.name: Kyouka Kitahara
characters.description: __Height:__ 169 cm She is the most reasonable witch apprentice. She looks at situations from a bird-eyes view and often rebukes arguments between Yuina and Azu. She was born and raised in a wealthy family and attends a top school in the prefecture. While she is trustworthy, she also has high standards and and sometimes surprises people with her out-of-touch and naïve comments.

characters.name: Choco Mitsumata
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm She is cheerful and lifts the mood for those around her. While she usually acts wild and freely she is sometimes distracted, as if her batteries were dead, and sometimes dozes off during work.

characters.name: Mai Kamiizumi
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm She is a calm and logical, and is always concerned about her surroundings and appearance. She never tends to reveal her true feelings and follows the crowd when she is in trouble. She is usually blunt and direct and gets pushed around by the more quirky members of the group, leading her to often get the short end of the stick.

characters.name: Keroppe
characters.description: __Height:__ 35 cm A mysterious messenger who recruited the five witch apprentices. He wants the girls to collect magic points (mapo) by granting the wishes of the customers who visits the store, his true intentions is unknown however. He supports the witch apprentices whilst also sometimes making fun of them and makes unnecessary remarks - which he gets scolded by the witch apprentices for.

title: Hidamari Sketch Tokubetsu-hen
title_original: ひだまりスケッチ 特別編
description: Sequel of the Hidamari Sketch TV series.

characters.name: Yuno
characters.description: __Height:__ 144 cm Yuno is the main character in the story and it is mainly through her viewpoint that the story is told, each episode of the anime usually ends with her pondering her feelings about what has gone on during the day while taking a bath with her rubber duck. She lives in room 201, next to her best friend and classmate, Miyako. She is a skilled artist overall but considers painting and drawing her specialties.

characters.name: Miyako
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm [Yuno](https://anilist.co/character/2528/Yuno)'s classmate and good friend. She's very strange, but a very likable person. She has very good ears and is good at imitating other people. She is notorious for her appetite and love for food.

characters.name: Sae
characters.description: __Height:__ 167cm Sae is an upperclassman and good friends with Hiro. In the anime version, she has a younger sister, Chika. Her artistic specialties are photography and fiction writing; she writes fiction professionally under the pseudonym "Aya Tachibana" and enrolled at the school specifically so she could learn how to illustrate her own work. Sae, who is tall, athletic, and generally mature, has a playful side that can be at the same time enigmatic and cunning; she has a habit of giving Yuno just enough warning about potential problems for the younger girl to fail to avoid them. She also has a fondness for playing detective when faced with such anomalies as Miyako's apartment. She tends to get upset when Miyako refers to her as having masculine qualities. She also gets very uncomfortable when asked about her love life, frequently inventing a history for herself that even cursory exami

characters.name: Hiro
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Hiro is a year older than [Yuno](https://anilist.co/character/2528/Yuno) and [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/2627/Miyako), living directly under Yuno's apartment. Although she tries to be a supportive senpai to the girls, she tends to worry excessively about her weight, causing her to go on diets for periods while occasionally binging on sweets. A childhood friend of [Sae](https://anilist.co/character/3215/Sae), she is one of her neighbor's principal sources of support when she's involved with a deadline or other crisis.

characters.name: Yoshinoya
characters.description: __Height:__ 158cm Yoshinoya is Yuno and Miyako's homeroom teacher and art instructor. She is buxom, exuberant, and a cosplay maniac. So much so, in fact, that she will frequently wear incredibly complicated things that are at times truly inappropriate. She has a fondness for modeling for her class, displaying her latest outfits whenever she can, and showing off in general. It is later revealed that Yoshinoya still resides with her parents, and would often be criticized by them for not being mature. When asked her age, she will answer "eternally seventeen". (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kouchou-sensei
characters.description: The Principal at Yamabuki High School, with a stutter and an inability to stop shaking. Is a master gunfighter and ninja. Often scolds Yoshinoya-sensei for lack of satisfactory performance. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Natsume
characters.description: Natsume is a student from class B who acts like a tsundere character toward Sae, masking her strong affection for her by maintaining a generally antagonistic attitude. During her first day at Yamabuki, she faced a lot of troubles and was helped by Sae and touched by her kind nature, developing feelings for her. To her dismay, she was separated into another class and quickly became jealous and envious of Hiro's burgeoning relationship with Sae. Ever since, she has been trying to hide her feelings in Sae's presence by acting nonchalant, initially declaring herself to be her rival. Eventually, though she becomes less confrontational around her and occasionally visits Sae and the others at the apartment, when invited. She is also one of the few people who know of Sae's pen name and is an admirer of her books.

characters.name: Ume
characters.description: Ume is a Metapod that lives on the roof of the Hidamari Apartments and represents the manga's author, Ume Aoki. The character does not actually play any significant role in the story. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Oyasan
characters.description: The Landlady is the female owner of Hidamari Apartments. She has quite a few masculine characteristics as she often wears baseball cap, goes out for a fishing in her spare time, and is a heavy smoker. Although she has a very laid-back personality, she is often seen very busy doing various part-time jobs. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kuwahara
characters.description: The school nurse and a very good friend of Yoshinoya and the principal.

characters.name: Chika
characters.description: Chika is Sae's thirteen-year-old sister. She is more spontaneous and energetic than her older sister. She enjoys cooking and has an infatuation with a Kabuki actor. She has no artistic talent and prefers music and home economics to art. Initially only appearing in the anime adaptation, she made her first appearance in the manga in the June 2012 issue of Manga Time Kirara Carat.

characters.name: Chocoyama
characters.description: Stars in the afternoon melodrama Fashionable Detective Lovely Chocolat, where he is the assistant to the main character, a detective by the name of Chocolat.

title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha: The MOVIE 2nd A's
title_original: 魔法少女リリカルなのは The MOVIE 2nd A's
title_en: Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha: The Movie 2nd A's
description: Sequel of Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha The Movie 1st.

characters.name: Fate Testarossa
characters.original: フェイト・テスタロッサ
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ [Bardiche](https://anilist.co/character/220250/Bardiche) Fate is introduced as an antagonist and rival to Nanoha Takamachi, she first encounters Nanoha during the Jewel Seed Incident while collecting the Lost Logia known as the Jewel Seeds on behalf of her abusive mother, Presea Testarossa. Despite their initial conflict, the two develop a close friendship that evolves into a lifelong partnership.

characters.name: Nanoha Takamachi
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ Raising Heart Excelion. Strike Cannon, Fortress __Rank:__ S+ __Rank (StrikerS):__ Captain of Stars Squad, part of the mobile sixth division __Code name (StrikerS):__ Stars 1 In Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha, Nanoha Takamachi is sweet if naive third-grader. However, she has always felt like she is missing something in her life: all the people around her have someone there​ are very close to but she lacks this. However, Nanoha is no longer an "ordinary" third grader when she meets and helps the wounded ferret, who just happens to be a mage from another planet, Yuuno Scrya. He has come to Earth to gather the "Jewel Seeds," mysterious artifacts containing great power. Nanoha agrees to help him, but the task seems harder than presented when she meets Fate Testarossa, another girl searching for the Jewel Seeds. In A's, six months after the first season, Nanoha still remai

characters.name: Signum
characters.description: __Nanoha A's__ Signum enters the story when Vita has attempted to steal Nanoha Takamachi's Linker Core (a mage's source of magic) for the Book of Darkness. Since the arrival of Nanoha's cavalry, Fate Testarossa and Yūno Scrya, Vita is cornered and Signum must come to her rescue with Shamal. The Wolkenritter overpower the TSAB troupe with their use of high-powered magical cartridges, and Signum manages to snap Fate's staff, Bardiche, in half. The battle ends with Shamal finally managing to get Nanoha's Linker Core and Nanoha breaking Vita's barrier. Signum refuses to take a bath that night for fear of Hayate seeing the injuries sustained in her battle with Fate. Signum may appear emotionless, but she is completely dedicated to Hayate, and as the leader of the Wolkenritter, fights for the others as well. The Wolkenritter attack mages to steal their Linker Cores, their sources of magic, to

characters.name: Vita
characters.description: __Vita in Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha A's__ Vita enters A's on a hunt with Zafila for strong Linker Cores to absorb into the Book of Darkness. She targets Nanoha Takamachi, which she deems to be a juicy target, unlike the usual TSAB "redshirts" which can barely fill up a single page of the Book of Darkness. Nanoha puts up a decent fight, but Vita tilts the deck with two cartridges (bullet shaped things that contain high-pressure magic) manages to overpower her, obtaining a power superiority so vast that she heavily damaged the Raising Heart. However, before she could get the Linker Core, Fate Testarossa and Yūno Scrya come to the rescue. Vita fights them off with her fellow Wolkenritter, Signum and Shamal, and they declare themselves enemies. The battle ends with Shamal finally managing to get Nanoha's Linker Core and Nanoha breaking Vita's barrier. ~! Vita fights for the sake of protect

characters.name: Hayate Yagami
characters.description: __Intelligent Device(s):__ Buch der Nachthimmel/Book of Darkness (Storage/Tome), Schwertkreuz (Rod), Reinforce II (Unison Device) A sweet and gentle orphan who is confined to a wheelchair, is cared for by the Wolkenritter, who deliberately keep their battles hidden from her. She knows that completing the Book of Darkness would grant her immense power, but she refuses to accept that power at the cost of innocent lives. Unbeknownst to her, however, the Book is already feeding on her life force, causing her paralysis and slowly weakening her. If it is not completed, the Book will eventually consume her life entirely.

characters.name: Shamal
characters.description: Shamal, being Yuuno's counterpart, does not actually fight, but uses her ring devices to defend, create portals, absorb victims' Linker Cores into the Book of Darkness, and the like. Shamal acts as the 'mother' of the group, doing the shopping, worrying excessively over the others' well-being, and constructing excuses to Hayate as to why they're out so often ("The grocery store doesn't have our brand of olive oil"). She knows that Hayate does not want them to fight anyone for her, but it is still no question that they must. Now in StrikerS She is A soft-spoken member of the Wolkenritter that specializes in defense and healing. She is a medical officer.

characters.name: Zafila
characters.description: Zafila is dark skinned, only male, member of Wolkenritter, Guardians of the Book of Darkness. He is, like Arf, able to transform into a wolf, and he was called Familiar many times, although he negates it, saying that he is "Guardian Wolf" of his master. When not battling, Zafila is almost always in his wolf form, because his ears and tail stays visible while in human form. Zafila is original counter part of Arf, Fate's familiar. Later, Arf teaches him how to change to "Puppy form".

characters.name: Arf
characters.description: Fate's outspoken dog-woman familiar. Her distaste of Precia is mutual, but she cannot do anything to protect Fate from her mother. Arf instead takes out her anger on her enemies. She is very kind to Fate and rather protective of her. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yuuno Scrya
characters.description: Before the start of the series, Yūno lived in Mid-childa, a magical world, as an archaeologist. He had no parents, so was raised by his entire tribe, the Scrya, from which he took his surname. He also obtained or created the intelligent device Raising Heart around this time, but his talents lay as a support mage, and so his attack abilities were low and he never made the device into a weapon. Yūno first appears running from a gigantic monster in the woods and attempting to seal the Jewel Seed inside it with Raising Heart. He fails, letting the monster get away, and collapses wounded on the ground. Yūno uses his remaining power to call out to the nearest magic user and turns into a ferret. His call was heard in Nanoha Takamachi's dream, and later that day, she found the ferret in the woods and took him to the veterinary hospital. He quickly recovered, taking a liking to Nanoha and recogni

characters.name: Lindy Harlaown
characters.original: リンディ・ハラオウン
characters.description: Lindy, the kind-spirited captain of the spaceship Asura, works for the Time-Space Administration Bureau. She enjoys drinking green tea with sugar (and sometimes cream) added, which is ironic given her appreciation of Japanese culture. She is Chrono's mother.

characters.name: Chrono Harlaown
characters.description: Chrono is a young officer of the Time-Space Administration Bureau and wields the S2U,a storage device in the first season and an ice-type Intelligent Device named Durandal in A's. His personality is usually one who looks at things from a logical approach, but he has made jokes on occasion. His mother Lindy is his commanding officer and the Admiral of the Asura, while his father isn't mentioned (revealed in A's to be deceased.) Together they used thier influence within the TSAB to aid in Fate's trial,afterwhich he trained Fate in combat before her return in A's where she became his adopted sister. In the first season Chrono displays his control over shooting-type spells when he aids Nanoha during the attack on the Garden of Time,so much so that Nanoha is speechless at his skill. As of StrikerS he has become the Admiral of his own ship,the Claudia while his mother lives on Earth next to Na

characters.name: Reinforce II
characters.original: リインフォース・ツヴァイ
characters.description: __Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha A's :__ She appears briefly during the last seconds of the series. __Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha StrikerS :__ Reinforce II is a smaller version of Reinforce that has been accepted as a member of Hayate's task force in the Time-Space Administration Bureau; she even wears the uniform. She can be summoned as a hologram from the Schwertkreuz, and promotional pictures for StrikerS show a very solid Reinforce II accompanying Hayate as well. Reinforce II (pronouced "Zwei") is apparently solid, and needs to eat and sleep daily; she has a "room" of sorts in Hayate's bag. She holds the rank of Sergeant Major and serves as Hayate's SNCO/ Chief of Staff in Lost Property Management Division 6. In the anime, she is shown capable to unifying with other Wolkenritter members (Vita and Signum) to boost them in battle, although because of their incompatibility, their union is

title: Candy☆Boy: Side Story For Archive
description: The very first Candy☆Boy episode. Twin sisters, Yukino and Kanade Sakurai, room together in the dorms at their high school, enjoying school life with their friends and one another. One day, Sakuya Kamiyama, an underclassman, seeks out Yukino, while Kanade learns from a friend that Sakuya has admired Yukino for a very long time. This innocent revelation sets into motion a chain of events that eventually lead to Yukino expressing her feelings for her sister.

characters.name: Kanade Sakurai
characters.description: Kanade is a high school student currently sharing a dorm room with her twin sister [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/7325/Sakurai-Yukino). She is more pragmatic and less easy-going than Yukino and tends to get exasperated a lot, especially when it comes to the advances of her kouhai. She is also somewhat easy to ruffle emotionally. She often worries that Yukino is sacrificing herself for her benefit. Kanade is an artist and wants to pursue art studies, however, she understands that it would be difficult to pursue a career in the field and maintain a close relationship with Yukino. Her little sister [Shizuku](https://anilist.co/character/16153/Sakurai-Shizuku) is closer to her than she is to Yukino, however Kanade is more distant with the younger girl and does not make the same amount of effort as Yukino to be closer to Shizuku.

characters.name: Yukino Sakurai
characters.description: Yukino is the older amongst the two. She's very fond of snacks and Sakuya often trades snacks with Yukino for Kanade's pictures. She is a member of their school's swim team. ~!Later in the series, Yukino decides to work part time in order to be able to pay for Kanade's art cram school. However, Kanade refused at this because she felt that if Yukino started working part time and she attended the art cram school, they will get to spend less time with each other. Yukino insisted and started working anyway which in turn created a strain in their relationship.!~

characters.name: Sakuya Kamiyama
characters.description: A younger girl who is in deeply infatuated with [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/7324/Sakurai-Kanade) with the point that she is almost stalking her. She is extremely wealthy and often tries to spend her money after the twins. She likes collecting old paraphernalia, junk and pictures that belong to Kanade, most of which goes to her makeshift shrine. Despite her overwhelming presence, the twins seem to like her. [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/7325/Sakurai-Yukino) is amused by her and Kanade seems more irritated than anything, but they both seem to have some sort of affection for the girl. Initially, her presence was seen as a threat to Kanade as she assumed Sakuya was interested in Yukino. She became aware that Sakuya was madly in love with her when Yukino clears the situation up.

title: Valkyrie no Shokutaku
description: The highly anticipated HI3 anime is finally coming! Aren't you curious about how your favorite Valkyries fare in the kitchen, Captains? Join the table with Valkyries this summer for a feast of mouth-watering food and heartwarming memories.

characters.name: Jizi Wuliangta
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'6") __Honkai Impact 3rd:__ Murata Himeko is an A-rank Valkyrie, a teacher at St. Freya Academy, and the Captain of Hyperion. She's the leader of Squad V, supervising the team composed of [Kiana Kaslana]( https://anilist.co/character/142947/Kiana-Kaslana), [Raiden Mei]( https://anilist.co/character/142946/Mei-Raiden), and [Bronya Zaychik]( https://anilist.co/character/142948/Bronya-Zaychik). She is a strong and reliable leader at work, though she struggles with severe alcoholism and even drinks while teaching. She is brave and sometimes reckless in battle, never backing down when others' lives are at stake. Despite having no prior combat experience, she worked hard to become a member of the Assault Squad through grueling training. __Honkai: Star Rail:__ Murata Himeko is a part of the Astral Express crew in Honkai: Star Rail. She was born from Kallen Kaslana's genes and is a certified valkyrja with an unknown rank. ~!She was close friends with Kiana's parents- especially the late Cecilia Shania- and was asked to be the child's godmother.!~

characters.name: Mei Raiden
characters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'8") Raiden Mei is one of the main protagonists along with Kiana Kaslana, Bronya Zaychik, Theresa Apocalypse and Murata Himeko. She is the daughter of the Massive Electric Industries' CEO. When she was young, her father was arrested for fraud and most of her family assets were seized due to her father’s criminal activities, and was later captured to be part of a Honkai-related experiment. This event has caused her to be cold and distant towards others, though her friendship with Kiana has caused her to become more gentle and caring. ~!She also has a Ruler sealed within her, which was unleashed during the Choukuu City event, and later awakened as the 3rd Herrscher. characters.name: Kiana Kaslana

She is the 69th successor of the Kaslana family and daughter to Siegfried Kaslana and Cecilia Schariac. Her mother died when she was young and her father later abandoned her. She attended various schools before ending up in the same school as Mei and Bronya. She becomes a Valkyrie to find out what happened to her parents. Kiana also has rather open feelings for Mei, something that, among other things, sparks her rivalry with Bronya.

characters.name: Bronya Zaychik
characters.description: __Height:__ 147 cm (4'10") Bronya is a high-performance cyborg without emotions, who was raised to be a deadly assassin and led to her being the infamous cold-blooded sniper, the Silver Wolf until she got knocked out by Cocolia and met [Seele Vollerei](https://anilist.co/character/142952/Vollerei-Seele) at an orphanage, in which unbeknownst to them, was actually the supply of experimentation subjects of a project called the X-10 Experiment. Member of the Amber Project. Plunged into cryogenic sleep about fifty thousand years ago. Her goal after awakening in a new era is to guide people to the development of civilization and to help repel new attacks of the Honkai energy.

characters.name: Kallen Kaslana
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") The most famous Valkyrie warrior who has ever lived, and the ancestor of Kiana Kaslana, Kallen is an elegant Schicksal knight whose spirit lives on to fight the Honkai. She remains the object of the Overseer Otto's eye. ~!She was the most powerful among her fellow valkyries in her era and was Otto Apocalypse's first love interest but she did not return his feelings.!~ ~!Kallen wielded the Oath of Judah until her untimely death in the hands of a Honkai beast.!~

characters.name: Rita Rossweisse
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm The vice captain of "Immortal Blades" and the trusted adjutant of Durandal. Rita is one of the three S-rank valkyries in Schicksal. Diligent in her duties to be the ultimate maid, Rita will learn anything that might better fulfill her master's wishes from clearing enemies on the battlefield to playing video games.. Not much is known about Rita as she keeps her secrets hidden very well. Perhaps only Durandal and fellow valkyries of "Immortal Blades" would know anything about her.

characters.name: Sakura Yae
characters.description: __Height:__ 194 cm (including ears) Yae Sakura used to be the shrine maiden of Yae Village. Despite her devotion, hard work, and wishes for the village's well-being, her ill sister was ultimately sacrificed and used in a barbaric ritual to hopefully quell the houkai. Ironically, the ritual did not work and despite the sister’s last wish, but gradually began to feel hatred towards the village. ~!The two eventually started a relationship and loved each other, until Sakura got possessed by the will of the Houkai from the purple box and [Kallen](https://anilist.co/character/142943/Kaslana-Kallen) was forced to seal her loved one away.!~

characters.name: Seele Vollerei
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm (before X-10) An orphaned girl who became Bronya's closest friend at Cocolia's orphanage. ~!Her alter ego, Hei Seele Vollerei (黑希儿·芙乐艾), has control of her True Stigmata's power. Hei Seele's personality is drastically different from Seele's and is initially ruthless and unkind, but this later on changes as she learns to care for Seele, and eventually even her friends. She has a violent reaction with people she sees as a threat to herself or Seele, and is particularly overprotective of her, showing worry any time she battles. She also has the habit of staring at Seele's face while she is sleeping. A lot of the time she is quite dishonest about her feelings, putting up a tough act rather than admitting she cares deep down. characters.name: Siegfried Kaslana
characters.description: Heir of the Kaslana family, Siegfried was a small child with big dreams. The only specific details about his childhood is that he enjoyed the TV show Arahato. Siegfried ran away from his home in Schicksal at 15 years old. He spent the next 4 years traveling around the world, saving people from Honkai and pretending to be a ninja.

title: Gekidol
description: Five years after a mystifying disaster decimates cities across the globe, Seria Morino receives an invitation from a mysterious woman to join Alice in Theater, a small stage troupe that takes it upon themselves to brighten the world through their performances using 3D hologram technology. As Seria settles in, she begins to uncover unexpected truths about herself and the world around her… (Source: Funimation) Note: The BD box with all episodes was released on Mar 3, 2021. The regular broadcast ended on Mar 23, 2021 on AT-X.

title: Hirogaru Sky! Precure
title_original: ひろがるスカイ！プリキュア

A brave young girl, Sora, follows the princess through a mysterious hole. "TV"? "Cars"? Are those some kind of magic tools!?!? But there's no time to be surprised! She has to get the princess back to the castle...! Flying between two worlds! The adventure with the Pretty Cure begins now! It's hero time!

characters.name: Sora Harewataaru
characters.description: An athletic girl from the floating kingdom in the sky, Sky Land. Sora has trained hard everyday to become a hero like the person of her dreams who saved her when she was a child. She and [Eru](https://anilist.co/character/296120/) are staying at [Mashiro](https://anilist.co/character/296118/)'s house in Sorashido City. Sora transforms into the Precure of the Sky, Cure Sky.

characters.name: Mashiro Nijigaoka
characters.description: A girl who lives in Sorashido City. Mashiro is a gentle and kind girl, who knows a lot about cooking and nature. She lives with her grandmother, [Yoyo](https://anilist.co/character/301433/Nijigaoka-Yoyo), as her parents are working overseas. Mashiro transforms into the Precure of Light, Cure Prism.

characters.name: Ellee-chan
characters.description: A young princess from Sky Land. Ellee-chan came to Sorashido City with [Sora](https://anilist.co/character/296116/) after she had been kidnapped. characters.name: Ageha Hijiri
characters.description: Ageha is kindhearted, sisterly and has a soft spot for younger children. Her childhood friend is [Nijigaoka Mashiro](https://anilist.co/character/296118/Mashiro-Nijigaoka) and she acts as an older sister to her.

characters.name: Kabaton
characters.description: A tough guy from the Underg Empire. He believes that the strong are always right. His catchphrase is "I'm TUEEE!" He currently lives somewhere in Sorashido City.

characters.name: Kokuou
characters.description: The king of Skyland.

characters.name: Ouhi

characters.name: Yoyo Nijigaoka
characters.description: [Mashiro's](https://anilist.co/character/296118/Mashiro-Nijigaoka) grandmother, and a well known scholar back in Sky Land.

characters.name: Beryberie
characters.description: A member of Sky Land's Azure Guard. Beryberie is a hot-headed girl who doesn't like weaklings, as she thinks they'll get in the way. She is a hard worker, who did her very best to end up where she is today. However, she does respect those who treat her kindly with gratitude and admiration. When Beryberie was little, she injured her arm badly. This caused her to fail the test to join the Azure Guards for three years. But she worked harder than anyone, and became strong.

characters.name: Shalala
characters.description: Shalala is the captain of the Azure Guards, and the strongest swordfighter in Skyland. She has a very strong sense of justice, and takes her missions seriously. She is a calm and kind-hearted woman, who is sympathetic about others.

title: Cutie Honey Universe
description: Honey Kisaragi appears to be an ordinary girl attending St. Chapel Academy, but in reality she's the "Warrior of Love" Cutie Honey, a super-powered android created by Dr. Kisaragi. Honey and her allies investigate the evil schemes of Panther Claw, a criminal secret society, but Honey doesn't realize that the leader of Panther Claw is already closer than she thinks... (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Honey Kisaragi
characters.description: Honey Kisaragi is a regular Catholic schoolgirl, until the day her father is murdered by the "Panther Claw" Organization. After his death, she learns she is actually an android created by him and within her is the Fixed System of Air Elements. By saying "Honey Flash!" she can transform into the sword-wielding red-haired superhero, Cutie Honey.

characters.name: Natsuko Aki
characters.description: As with many of the supporting characters in Cutie Honey, Aki has taken on many different roles. In the original manga she is Honey's friend and roommate at the all girls school they go to. In Re: Cutie Honey Aki Natsuko is a lead Investigator for the National Police Security Task Force – Branch 9. She is cold and controlling and is an absolute perfectionist. While she is an exceptional police officer she also has the bad habit of getting “in over her head” into trouble. She is an expert marksman. She tends to wear black a lot and lives alone in a small apartment. She has a passion for Japanese Sake and when she gets drunk loves to sing Karaoke. Hides her beauty by wearing non-prescription eyeglasses.

characters.name: Seiji Hayami
characters.description: Depending on the story Seiji takes on different roles but two things always stay the same, one he has the hots for Honey, and two he is always willing to help her out.

characters.name: Sister Jill
characters.description: From story to story Sister Jill roles slightly differ, sometimes she is leader of Panther Claw and sometimes she is the head subordinate of the mysterious leader of Panther Claw.

characters.name: Panther Zora
characters.description: Panther Zora is a powerful witch who seems to be the head of Panther Claw but all might not be what it seems.

characters.name: Daemon Abashiri
characters.description: Seiji and Junpei's father, Naojiro's uncle in Cutie Honey. He is skilled with martial arts, and ninja-like skills. He becomes quite helpful in battle. He's very old school, and overly dramatic. Danbei acts as a parental figure to Honey. He also appears in UFO Robo Grendizer under the name Danbei Makiba.

characters.description: Junpei Hayami is the younger brother of Seiji Hayami and son of Danbei Hayami.

characters.name: Alphonne
characters.description: Teacher at St. Chapel Academy who is in love with Honey. In the manga and Universe she is Pochi's lover.

characters.name: Pochi
characters.description: The headmaster of St. Chapel Academy. In the manga and Universe she is Alphonne's lover.

title: Yami to Boushi to Hon no Tabibito
title_original: ヤミと帽子と本の旅人
title_en: YAMIBO: Darkness, the Hat, and Travelers of the Books
description: Hatsuki is a highschool student living with her sister, Hatsumi, who she has a huge crush on. On Hatsumi's 16th birthday, she is suddenly surrounded by a green light and disappears in front of Hatsuki. She manages to follow Hatsumi with the help of a being resembling a fat baby chick (literally), ending up in a place called "The Great Library", which is full of different worlds stored in books. Hatsumi wasn't there, though, so the search for Hatsuki's great love begins and involves traveling from book to book.

characters.name: Hazuki Azuma
characters.description: Hazuki is an obvious example of the "tall, dark bishōjo" archetype. Hazuki appears cold and unfriendly and is fiercely protective of Hatsumi. She is actually very vulnerable and romantic, even to the point of being submissive, but refuses to show weakness or depend on anyone but her adoptive sister, Hatsumi — unless she is forced to. One example of this is her first encounter with Lilith, where she initially refuses Lilith's help in looking for Hatsumi/Eve. Only when Lilith notes she won't be able to travel from world to world without her, does Hazuki agree to travel with her and even then, only tacitly. As soon as she no longer has any need for Lilith's help, she shows no regard for her or her wishes with regards to Eve. Hazuki idolizes Hatsumi extremely and, as such, considers her sexual attraction to Hatsumi vulgar and shameful.

characters.name: Hatsumi Azuma
characters.description: Hatsumi is Hazuki's adopted older sister and love interest, albeit Hazuki's love is one-sided. Hatsumi appears to be mute (though it is proven otherwise on several occasions) and communicates mostly through gestures and facial expressions. Despite being older, Hatsumi is much shorter and thinner than Hazuki. Childhood memory flash-backs show Hazuki as a small, sickly child who might not have lived if not for Hatsumi's care. Although it seems that Hazuki's love is one-sided, episode seven shows that Hatsumi does have feelings for Hazuki and was trying to express herself as best as she could with the knowledge that she cannot stay beyond her sixteenth birthday (suggestions of this were shown along the way by her sending Hazuki anonymous love letters — later expressed in full and in words toward the end of the anime). In the first episode, Hatsumi disappears in a b

In the anime, Lilith is attracted to Hazuki and flirts relentlessly, though she is always turned down. Lilith appears to dislike Eve and have interest only in her own ends, but her kind and vulnerable sides are sometimes shown, especially when she encounters children in trouble; adults do not seem to move her to compassion as much. Her more childish mannerisms are fairly constant, but Lilith sometimes shows considerable wisdom and knowledge. She claims that Eve left the duty of being Yami and went off to play in the book worlds, and so she wants to find Eve and return her to the library. Towards the end of the game, it is shown that Lilith misses the past, when she was close with Eve and Adam, or "Yami Yama". In the game, Lilith uses the main character's love f

He speaks in very heavy kansai-ben. Ken is loud, obnoxious, lecherous and perverted, as well as overly confident and a bit too slow to stay out of trouble. He usually ends up punched, squashed, beaten or otherwise violated, either as a result of tasks given to him by Lilith, or because of his big mouth and perverted tendencies. In the anime he claims to be cleaning up after Hazuki and Lilith. Also, he offers to perform repairs on Tamamonomae's Space Hall. He is the narrator of the story, and his short exits and introductions are often the only transition between stories. He is always cosplaying as some type of character or animal. ~!At the end of the anime series, he is shown closing a book that seems to contain the world of the Book Keepers.!~

characters.description: Kogechibi lives in the library, and looks like a four-inch (102 mm) -tall Eve, though with different colored eyes. "Koge" refers to the one-eyed cloak that covers all of her but the eyes. In the game, when the main character is occupying "Koge", the girl is referred to as "O-chibi-chan" ("o" being an honorific and "chan" an endearment). Kogechibi's vocabulary is composed of unintellible sounds akin to baby talk. In the anime, she has a disturbing love of fireworks and can say a few words if they have something to do with explosives; she builds miniature catapults and launch platforms, and fills hollow fountain pens with gunpowder and uses them as bottle rockets. She plays a small part in the plot, but is mostly comic relief in the anime. In the game, it is revealed that the guardians "fragment" when they overexert themselve

Set approximately 100 years after episode 3, she is an immortal magic user and appears no older than 25, despite being over a century old. Ritsuko travels the countryside performing healing miracles. She has never forgotten Jill or Gargantua, and carries small portraits of them in her locket. When she comes to the castle to heal Princess Mariel, she is taken in as the court alchemist. One day, while escorting the princess around the village, Ritsuko meets Gargantua, who is also immortal because of Jill's souma and has learned dark magic. He kidnaps Princess Mariel and tries to sacrifice her to Lilith, in order to be shown where Eve is. Ritsuko stops him only too late and is framed for the kidnapping and thrown into a dungeon. Ritsuko is a user of sexual magic in the game, and one

characters.name: Kuiru

She leads Hazuki and Lilith to her cave-village, where they notice an evil presence. A giant monster breaks out of the people's primitive shrine and Hazuki enters her first swordfight. The monster shrinks and disappears after its defeat. Quill loses the ability to communicate with Hazuki and Lilith after the defeat of the monster. It is suggested that Arya may have used magic to enable Quill to communicate with Lilith and Hazuki, possibly in a bid to make the two defeat the beast, which had been worshipped as a god. Quill does not appear in the game.

The player of the game meets Meirin after he enters a body, the previous owner of which she unintentionally kills. To make up for it, she takes him to Fujihime, who is another form of Eve. Fujihime lives deep in the mountains, but the humans are cutting down the bamboo forest dangerously close to her hut. Fujihime is good friends with both Meirin and the god of the mountain, who is in love with her. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Mariel
characters.description: A princess in Ritsuko and Gargantua's world. One day, when she is placed under Ritsuko's care, she meets Gargantua and eventually develops a crush on him. She is later kidnapped and sacrificed to Lilith by Gargantua, committing suicide by poison, but is reincarnated and employed as a maid by Tamamonomae. Toward the end of the anime, the incarnated Mariel accepts proposal from one of Gargantua's henchmen, who falls in love with her after she tends to his injury in a gentle and caring manner unlike his neglective master. (wikipedia)

characters.name: Youko Sumeragi
characters.description: A woman who appears in a book-world that corresponds to the Russo-Japan War era. She is an intelligence agent and an expert martial artist noted for sending three colleagues into hospital during training. Yōko arrives on a train somewhere corresponding to contemporary Russian Siberia, cross-dressing as a male diplomat and attempting to link up with fellow agent Kohtaro Nanbu, codenamed "Adam", for a film containing radio codes. ~!Due to her inexperience, however, she quickly becomes the subject of suspicion and is only rescued by Kazuo Saiga, another fellow agent known as "Tiger of Siberia". Although Kazuo turns out to be a double-agent whose henchmen end up killing Kohtaro, Yōko is able to defeat him and complete her mission with Hazuki's help.!~ (Wikipedia)

characters.name: Milka
characters.description: "Milka appears in episode six under the care of Seiren. She is a girl with a cruel past who is trapped in her five-year-old body. Milka lives on an island, and has no one to befriend but Seiren and her white tiger, Rascaless. Her initial caretaker was an older woman who used to whip the child as a punishment for such trivial offences as talking back to her. Eventually, the old woman is killed by Rascaless when Milka isn't watching. Initially afraid of Hazuki and Lilith, she warms up to them and has Seiren take them to the villa at the center of the island. Milka's world is subject to periodic reality shifts she calls "rip-rip", during which the sky and the ground rip open as if in an earthquake, only to close without a trace. characters.description: __Height: __ 172.72cm He is the leader of "Welter" (The Guardians)—the self-governing body of "Feste" (The Castle) located on "Mermaid," an artificial island where those infected with the Armed Virus are quarantined—and refers to himself as "Boku." Known as "Gouverneur" (The Governor), he wears a white, high-collared military-style uniform. As the only male on the island, he possesses both charisma and striking good looks; addressed as "Akira-sama," he is the object of admiration for the island's girls—including Shojo Mamori, who admires him enough to have a poster of him in her room. ~!In reality, she hails from the wealthy "Hiiragi Zaibatsu" (conglomerate). She had entered the island disguised as a male under orders from her mother, Yui. characters.description: An ex-Air Self-Defense Force soldier who becomes the Takanashi family’s maid. She claims to only be interested in girls who haven’t menstruated yet, forming a particular attachment towards Misha.

characters.name: Misha Takanashi
characters.description: A Russian girl who has become a rebellious recluse following her mother's death. She is fearful of Tsubame's behavior and often tries to find ways to get rid of her. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.description: Misha's father, who becomes over delighted when Misha shows her any kind of interest. (Source: Wikipedia)

Upon awakening, Malice finds out that she has become human and can pass on her humanity to her fellow machines. However, her gift soon becomes a curse when her fellow robots rage out of control after being exposed to the pleasures of life. (Source: Anime News Network)
