title_original: SHOW BY ROCK!!ましゅまいれっしゅ!!
description: Though she enjoys her peaceful life in the countryside, Howan dreams of music stardom, and gets the chance to achieve her dream when she passes the audition for a music competition in the big city. Meanwhile, the guitarist Himeko is equally passionate about music, but feels uncomfortable having been placed in a band with two other young artists. Under the glittering lights of Midi City, these two musicians will meet for the first time, and discover together what they could never reach alone. In this dazzling city of music, anyone can truly reach for the stars! (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Delmin
characters.description: __Height:__ 140cm __Group:__ Mashumairesh!! __Position:__ Vocals and Bass Devil Mint is a petite girl from the Oniryu clan. For certain reasons, she lives alone in an old apartment. She never lets go of her Onigiri Kumaman stuffed animal. Since she’s always pretending not to be home, she doesn’t have many friends. She excels at detailed work and games that require concentration. She’s a home cook, so she’s confident in her ability to cook perfect sunny-side-up eggs. She’s serious, cool, and studious. She can shoot beams from her horns.

characters.name: Howan
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm __Group:__ Mashumairesh!! __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar A girl of the pale fox tribe, born and raised in a small village in the northern lands. She dreams of one day heading to the big city in hopes that something wonderful awaits her there. Highly curious and always giving her absolute all, she struggles with numbers but excels at housework. She is good-natured, yet she isn't afraid to firmly say "no" to things she dislikes. Though she has a gentle, fluffy demeanor, she possesses a strong inner core and a fiercely competitive spirit. She loves to sing.

characters.name: Himeko Mashima
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm __Group:__ Mashumairesh!! __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar A girl from the Striped Cat Clan. Her striped twin tails are her signature look, and she has a great figure. She tends to avoid interacting with others. She loves music and has practiced playing instruments more than most since she was little. She’s strong-willed, stubborn, quick-tempered, but deep down she’s timid, sensitive, and prone to feeling lonely. Her grades are just average. Rumor has it she has a secret hobby she can’t tell anyone about.

characters.name: Ruhuyu
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm __Group:__ Mashumairesh!! __Position:__ Vocals and Drums A girl from the Wolf-Girl Tribe. She is bright, energetic, exceptionally healthy, and a model student. Devoted and overflowing with compassion, she enjoys the deep trust of those around her. However, she has begun to question the path her parents have laid out for her—a path she has dutifully followed until now. By her own admission, she is occasionally seized by an impulse to destroy everything around her; she struggles desperately to resist it, though there are times when she simply cannot hold back and ends up breaking things anyway. Rumors have even begun to circulate—or perhaps they haven't?—that she might be a bit of a "dangerous" girl.

characters.name: Rararin
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm __Group:__ REIJINGSIGNAL __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar A spirited and beautiful young woman from the Fierce Caracal Tribe. She serves as the group's earnest and justice-minded pillar. A true foodie, her personal motto is: "A sound mind comes from a hearty meal." Aspiring to become a top-tier artist, she has competed in countless contests since childhood, earning a reputation as an "audition whirlwind." She previously performed under a different unit name, but they failed to achieve commercial success. Determined to stay true to her dreams and uphold her sense of justice, she joined forces with her fellow members to achieve a self-produced re-debut.

characters.name: Sumomone
characters.description: __Height__: 160 cm (5'3") __Group:__ REIJINGSIGNAL __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar A beautiful, voluptuous flying squirrel girl. “Sexy healing” is Sumomone’s specialty. Her mother is a former actress, so she’s good at attracting the opposite sex because she has experienced the world of performing arts at an early age. She teases her opponents and has many other impish behaviors. She likes having control over others by using her charm as a weapon. Currently, she doesn’t understand the meaning of true love.

characters.name: Uiui
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm __Group:__ REIJINGSIGNAL __Position:__ Vocals and Bass (Lefty) A cool-headed beauty from the Ice Rabbit Tribe. She serves as the group's cold, calculating, and ambitious strategist. She grew up in a distant, far-off land of ice in the North, spending her days skating. In a region where entertainment was scarce, she developed a deep yearning for music after witnessing a live band performance—the very first she had ever seen in her life. She possesses translucent white skin, features as flawless as ice, and a perpetually expressionless demeanor. Having drifted across various nations, her manner of speaking is occasionally a bit peculiar.

characters.name: Yasu
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm __Species:__ Yatagarasu (A mythical crow) __Group:__ DOKONJOFINGER __Role:__ Vocals and Guitar A bento-loving member of the Yatagarasu clan. Born the son of a bento shop owner, he practically grew up alongside the boxed meals themselves. He is surly, sports a menacing glare, and is on the shorter side. Although he frequently gets picked on by delinquents, he repels them all using his signature move: the "Death Cross Counter." Before he knew it, he had become a local legend known by the moniker "The Yatagarasu Reaper Yasu." After repeated clashes with the members of DOKONJOFINGER, will he—slowly but surely—begin to open his heart to them? A first-year student in Class Black at DO Konjo North Academy. His personal recommendation is the Ginger Pork Bento.

characters.name: Hachin
characters.description: __Height:__ 173 cm __Group:__ DOKONJOFINGER __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar A stylish, delinquent-type male from the Bunbun Bee Tribe. Slender and lightning-fast, he tends to sting first and think later. Though impatient and short-tempered, he is pure-hearted deep down. Rebellious against his parents, he struts around the nightlife district acting tough. He views Yasu as his ultimate rival—a fated nemesis he absolutely refuses to lose to—more intensely than anyone else. His signature move is the "Supersonic Bunbun NEEDLE." A first-year student in Class Hana at DO-Konjo North Academy. His favorite treat is honey bread.

characters.name: Joe
characters.description: __Height:__ 184 cm __Group:__ DOKONJOFINGER __Position:__ Bass A physically frail young man of the Phoenix Clan. Although his body is weak, his fighting prowess and mental fortitude are exceptionally strong. Due to repeated hospitalizations and discharges, he has been held back in school multiple times and actually reached adulthood several years ago. Congratulations! He possesses a rugged, wild charm that commands the admiration of other men, along with an unwavering sense of loyalty—he would never betray his comrades. In the past, he has endured brutal betrayals and fallen victim to traps; yet, he has risen from the ashes time and again, ultimately forging a legend as the undefeated strongest of all. D.O. Konjo North Academy, 6th Year, Class Gray. His recommended remedy: plenty of sleep.

characters.name: Sojun
characters.description: __Height:__ 189 cm __Group:__ DOKONJOFINGER __Position:__ Drums An incredibly arrogant young man of the Komainu (Mythical lion-dogs) clan. His golden, tightly curled hair and emerald-shimmering eyes captivate all who behold him. A formidable powerhouse, he seized total control of the academy in a single day. Despite his immense strength, his fighting style is utterly ruthless. Tall and slender, yet possessing a lithe and resilient physique—and he smells absolutely wonderful. He stops at nothing to secure victory, remaining completely unbothered even when reviled as a coward. He simply cannot tolerate anyone stronger than himself. A third-year student in the "Scoundrel Class" at DO-Konjo North Academy, he serves as the Student Council Boss. His favorite dish is fried chicken. Rumor has it he has a younger brother close to him in age.

characters.name: Crow
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm __Species:__ Hedgehog __Group:__ ShinganCrimsonZ __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar Fearless and utterly convinced—without a shred of doubt—that he is "the coolest and most popular guy in the world." His signature style features a raw yet razor-sharp vocal delivery that sends shivers down the spines of listeners. He hails from a dairy farming family and absolutely loves milk.

title: Nekogami Yaoyorozu
title_en: The Everyday Tales of a Cat God
description: Koyama Yuzu is running an antique shop. Mayu, a cat god (nekogami), is living off Yuzu and leads an idle life playing games. Lots of other gods visit Mayu and enjoy merrymaking. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Mayu
characters.description: Mayu is a Cat God (Nekogami) who has the power to find lost items. Mayu is a really lazy Cat God, who likes to relax at home, play video games and of course sleep and eat. She also likes to tease everybody, and does anything for her games. Mayu has orange-yellow hair, brown eyes and cat ears. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yuzu Komiya
characters.description: Yuzu is the owner of Yaoyorozudou, and she lives together with Mayu. She has lavender colored hair and green eyes. Yuzu is very positive and almost all Cat Gods like her. Yuzu doesn't get angry really often, but when she does, she feels a little scary. Even though Yuzu doesn't sometimes like Mayu's little annoying attitude, she still cares about her. She addresses Mayu as 'Mayu-sama'. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Sasana Shousouin
characters.description: A black haired Cat God who is [Mayu](https://anilist.co/character/44190)'s fiancé, the reason for this being their fathers, who decided Sasana and Mayu would make a good 'couple' without considering the other child's gender. Sasana is usually content, but when she's close to Mayu she's really happy, calling her 'Mayu-sama' and always talking about how she is ready for marriage. She maintains a fierce rivalry with [Meiko](https://anilist.co/character/44214) for Mayu's love.

characters.name: Meiko
characters.description: Meiko is a blonde "princess" with grayish-blue eyes. Just like Sasana, she likes Mayu a lot, and the reason is probably about the past. When Meiko had no friends, one day Mayu invited that she could play with her and Sasana, but she refused. But Mayu told that she could come anytime she wanted to, and that left a little impression for Meiko about Mayu. Meiko has also little dramatic persona, and she blushes a lot too. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yoshino
characters.description: A minor goddess of Cherry Blossoms. She has pink pigtails and is easily the clumsiest of all the main characters. Her portfolio only allows her to control the blossoming of cherry trees and she is generally useless in combat for no-want of effort. She joined [Mayu](https://anilist.co/character/44190)'s circle of friends after accidentally mailing a special jar of magical ash used to make cherry trees bloom which Mayu threw away not knowing what it was. Mayu then helped Yoshino find it again and bolstered her self-confidence. Yoshino is scared of ghosts.

characters.name: Shamo
characters.description: She is also known as the God of Poverty and also a traveling performance auditor for the gods. Despite her childish look and her silent attitude, she is actually a very dangerous god of poverty. For example, she made a supermarket go bankrupt as she couldn't get the shaken drink she had bought replaced.

characters.name: Haruka
characters.description: A regular customer of Yaoyorozu-dou.

characters.name: Yurara Makuragi
characters.description: She is a Baku, one of the sacred beast who have lived for about a thousand year in China, around a thousand in India, and roughly a thousand year in Japan. She first came to Yaoyorozudou to specifically eat Makitarou's (Yuzu's Father) dream. She appears to enjoy torturing Mayu in her dream, claiming her dream to be completely lack of passion, ambition, thrill, suspense, content, and completely uninspiring and do not have any sort of imagination.

title: BLUE DROP: Tenshi-tachi no Gikyoku
description: Five years ago, something horrifying happened on Kamioki Island. Something so nightmarish that it stripped all memory from Mari Wakatake's mind even as it left every other human on the island dead in its wake! Now enrolled against her will at an isolated girl's academy, Mari is unaware that hidden eyes are watching her, waiting for her memory to return. Buried in her psyche is the most terrifying secret of all: while Mari was the only human who lived, she may not have been the only survivor! As something in a female skin invades Kaihou Academy, Mari's only hope may lie in a strange girl to whom she is inexplicably drawn yet cannot trust. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Mari Wakatake
characters.description: Five years ago, in the Kamikaku Island incident, she lost both her parents and her memory. The island was completely wiped out, and she was the only survivor. Her wealthy maternal grandmother took her in. Her grandmother was worried about her and did not want her to have to commute to school, so she had her educated at home by tutors. Eventually, knowing that she herself might not have long to live, her grandmother enrolled her in a girls' residential school, Kaihou Academy. Enrolled against her will, she misses her home, She can't hide how she feels distressed.

characters.name: Hagino Senkouji
characters.description: Class rep for the second year, "Ouka" class at Kaihou Academy, she is calm and collected, an excellent student and an all-round athlete. She has no weak points. Popular as she is, Hagino never shows emotion, surrounding herself with an aura of mystery.

characters.name: Michiko Kouzuki
characters.description: Mari's classmate. She was born and raised in Kaiou City, where the school is. Her family, although merchants, are not especially rich, nor are they a prominent family like many in the school. Unexpectedly When she passed the exam to get into the school, her parents were overjoyed, and stretched their finances to send her there. Perhaps because of her background, she is a shy person, and spends less time with her classmates than helping the caretaker, Gen, look after the gardens.

characters.name: Tsubael
characters.description: She holds the rank of Operator on Blue, # 5 ship of the Earth Survey Fleet. During the invasion five years ago, the main drive blew and the ship was severely damaged. Captain Ekaril has complete confidence in her, and put her in charge of the repair of the ship.

characters.name: Akane Kawashima
characters.description: Mari's classmate. Due to circumstances at home, she was held back a year. She loves milk, and never fails to have it every day. Although her home situation seems to have bent her character in some ways, she has become a reliable onee - san type. She likes cooking. Like Mari, Hagino, and Michiko, she lives in Aoumi House residence.

characters.name: Yuuko Sagawara
characters.description: Begins teaching at Kaihou Academy in April, at the beginning of the school year. Home-room teacher for Mari's Ouka class. Chemistry teacher. Appointed by the school's board of directors. A qualified counselor. But in fact ...

characters.name: Fukamachi
characters.description: Headmaster of the school. Rather Although he is a dandy, his warm, gentle nature - and the fact that there are so few males at the school - makes him very popular. He has a serious chronic illness that he has let no-one know about. He is divorced. Kawashima Akane's father.

characters.name: Hiroko Funatsumaru
characters.description: A senior, she is warden of the residence where Aoumi Mari and the others live. She is relaxed and open-hearted, and does not worry about little things, only occasionally imposing limits on the residents. Her family are well-to-do fishermen.

title: Meitantei Precure!
description: Anna Akechi is a second-year junior high student living in Makoto Mirai Town. On her 14th birthday, she has a chance encounter with a fairy named Pochitan, and a magical pendant caused her to travel back in time from 2027 to 1999! In the Makoto Mirai Town 28 years in the past, Anna meets Mikuru Kobayashi, a girl her age who wants to become a great detective. Meanwhile, people in town are in trouble as their prized possessions are being stolen from under their noses - the cause being a group of Phantom Thieves. To stop them, Anna and Mikuru turn into Precures! Maybe if they solve these mysteries, Anna can find her way back to her own time? (Source: Official Website, translated)

characters.name: Anna Akechi
characters.description: A second year middle school student who traveled back in time from 2027. She is straightforward, considerate, does not lie, and cannot ignore people in trouble.

characters.name: Mikuru Kobayashi
characters.description: A clumsy but straightforward second year middle school student. She aims to become a great detective and has a wealth of detective knowledge.

characters.name: Kurea Howa
characters.description: Pastry Chef at Patisserie Chuchu. ~!She regained her memories and made a comeback as Cure Eclair.!~

characters.name: Luluka Moria
characters.description: A mysterious girl who works as a member of the "Phantom Thieves" for some reason, despite being a Pretty Cure. She has a laid-back and unconventional personality.

characters.name: Jett
characters.description: A self-proclaimed genius inventor, who invented the PreKit that supports the Precure detectives.

characters.name: Pochitan
characters.description: The fairy companion of Cure Answer and Cure Mystique.

characters.name: Shushutan
characters.description: ~!Cure Eclair’s companion fairy. A “Fairy of Knowledge” who knows a great deal. Continued to watch over Kurea as she lost her memories of being Cure Eclair!~

characters.name: Mashutan
characters.description: Cure Arcana Shadow's fairy companion.

characters.name: Nijii
characters.description: Member of the "Phantom Thieves". A suave character who always carries a rose. A master thief who steals with dazzling disguises.

characters.name: Hanninda
characters.description: Monsters controlled by the Phantom Thieves group. They are described by Nijii as a "system newly developed by the Phantoms" and by Goemon as a "power bestowed by Lord Usonoir"*; they are created when a "Makoto Jewel" is corrupted by a "Lie" (a form of malevolent energy). In other words, while they possess a monster-like (biological) appearance, they are highly likely to be mechanical entities created through some form of technology.

characters.name: Eliza Kurusu
characters.description: A high school student who is a new mystery novelist.

characters.name: Taira Asai
characters.description: Owner of Patisserie Chuchu.

title: BIKINI WARRIORS: Genkai Toppa, Okite-Yaburi
title_original: ビキニ・ウォリアーズ 限界突破、掟破り
description: According to the official Hobby Japan website, an unaired episode of Bikini Warriors will be bundled with the Blu-ray volume to be released on December 9th, 2015. (Source: Hobby Japan)

characters.name: Mage
characters.description: The youngest and most timid member of the adventure party, the Mage is a petite purple-haired girl skilled in the art of sorcery.

characters.name: Paladin
characters.description: A beautiful blonde woman who (most unbecoming to her vocation) harbors closeted sexual desires.

characters.name: Dark Elf
characters.description: A member of the Dark Elf race who assists the party with a versatile combination of combat and magic-using skills. Initially quite haughty when she first joined, she has shed much of her attitude as the four of them have kept adventuring together.

characters.name: Fighter
characters.description: A redhaired, somewhat impulsive and stubborn woman, and the party's leader. She is also the daughter of a legendary warrior who saved the country in the past.

title: Uchuu no Stellvia
description: The year is 2356 A.D. - 189 years after a distant supernova caused a global catastrophe that wiped out 99% of the world population. To keep track on all space activities, mankind has built colossal space stations called "foundations" all over the Solar System. After passing the Space Academy entrance exams, Shima Katase embarks to the Earth-based foundation Stellvia to fulfill her dream of seeing the galaxy and to prevent another interstellar catastrophe from destroying Earth. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Shima Katase
characters.description: The hero of the story who joins the Stellvia foundation's space program so that she could "see the stars while looking forward, rather than having to look up". In the beginning, she fluctuates between complete confidence in her abilities and believing she couldn't do anything. The series depicts her as extremely diligent, although she is also a natural genius. As the series progresses, she learns to understand her mistakes and not think that she has to be perfect or else fail. For instance, after a rocky start to her training, during which she was dead last in her class at piloting, she takes the advice of [Kouta](https://anilist.co/character/195) and realizes she was trying to keep track of far too much information on her ship displays. Her piloting improves dramatically as a result. Despite her early setbacks as a pilot, her programming abilities are top notch from the very start, and

characters.name: Kouta Otoyama
characters.description: Kouta is an enigmatic character. He and [Shipon](https://anilist.co/character/194) develop a romantic relationship but there's still a lot about him that remains unknown. He has an older sister who runs an astronomical observatory in Japan. He often gives advice which is as enigmatic as himself. He consistently achieves rank C in every class, without exception, regardless of how easy or hard the subject is. And when he was warned of the possibility of [Ayaka](https://anilist.co/character/4185) attacking Shipon during training, he displays extraordinary piloting abilities beyond what his ship should have been capable of handling.

characters.name: Arisa Glennorth
characters.original: アリサ・グレンノース
characters.description: Alisa is [Shipon's](https://anilist.co/character/194) best friend at the Stellvia foundation. They meet on the shuttle going to the station from Earth at the beginning of the term, and find themselves rooming together and in the same class as well. Though Alisa is nowhere near Shipon in academic or piloting ability, she finds Shipon to be an inspiration to improve herself, and calls Shipon her "Star of Hope". ~!Later in the series, she begins focusing on becoming a mechanic, rather than a pilot.!~

characters.name: Yayoi Fujisawa
characters.description: Yayoi is one of the older students in [Shipon](https://anilist.co/character/194)'s class. Yayoi had been in Stellvia's training program 2 years before, but left after a flight training accident. She is saved by [Ayaka](https://anilist.co/character/4185), but it turned out the "accident" was also intentionally caused by Ayaka in the first place. Recognizing the signs of another "accident" when Ayaka took Shipon out to train alone, she warns [Kouta](https://anilist.co/character/195) of what might be about to happen. Kouta is able to prevent another tragedy. Despite the attacks on herself and Shipon, Yayoi defends Ayaka when it looked like she might face expulsion from Stellvia.

characters.name: Akira Kayama
characters.description: Akira is a quiet and somewhat taciturn member of [Shipon](https://anilist.co/character/194)'s class as well as [Yayoi](https://anilist.co/character/4183)'s roommate. Though she becomes irritated easily when around people too much, she learns to enjoy spending time with Yayoi, Shipon, [Alisa](https://anilist.co/character/196) and the others of their group. ~!Later in the series, she starts dating [JoJo](https://anilist.co/character/43362).!~

characters.name: Ayaka Machida
characters.description: One of the "Big 4" of Stellvia, (older students who are at the top of their classes), Ayaka is shown as competitive in the extreme. She has something of an inferiority complex which drives her to be the absolute best, and she can't tolerate seeing others better than her. Two years in the past, when [Yayoi](https://anilist.co/character/4183) was her classmate, she arranged an accident to ensure her own position at the top of the class. Things went a little out of hand, however, and it looked like Yayoi might lose her life, so Ayaka rescued her. Yayoi was hospitalized and traumatized, and left Stellvia for a time. Now with [Shipon](https://anilist.co/character/194) looking like she would surpass Ayaka as well, the same thing almost happened. Had Yayoi not returned to Stellvia and recognized the danger Shipon might be in, Ayaka might have seriously injured or even killed her. Due to Yayoi's

characters.name: Leila Barthes
characters.description: Instructor in charge of Pilot Training at Stellvia. She used to be an elite pilot, and spent some time wallowing in despair after losing the "elite" tag. However, she recovers from this (after an incident on a space station that was under construction) and chooses to become an instructor at Stellvia. She is tough toward the students because she wants them to succeed, she has a loving smile toward the childlike attributes of her students and is very scary when she is mad.

characters.name: Masaru Odawara
characters.description: One of [Shipon](https://anilist.co/character/194)'s classmates, he is seen hanging out with [Joey](https://anilist.co/character/43362) and Pierre.

characters.name: Rinna Kazamatsuri
characters.description: Rinna is a transfer student from the Ultima foundation, and considers [Shipon](https://anilist.co/character/194) to be both a friend and chief rival. Rinna is a few years younger than Shipon and most of the other students, but because there are few children at Ultima (it being the newest of the foundations, and still incomplete), she has little to do with herself but play with simulators. As a result, she's far better at piloting and zero-G movement than most people years older than her.

characters.name: Jinrai Shirogane
characters.description: Jinrai is another teacher at Stellvia's Space Academy; he appears to teach programming. He is particularly enthusiastic about the school's athletics carnival and Astroball (a game that has some similarities with Lacrosse), which he played in his student days at Stellvia. Passionate and determined, Jinrai is intent upon having the students' voices heard when no-one will listen. Jinrai has feelings for the flirtatious school nurse Ren.

characters.name: Chiaki Katase
characters.description: [Shima](https://anilist.co/character/194)'s mother.

characters.name: Richard James
characters.original: リチャード・ジェイムス
characters.description: Richard is the Head Teacher of Stellvia's Space Academy. He is also the one who conducted the entrance interview for [Shima](https://anilist.co/character/194). He is avuncular and usually takes the optimistic view of events. Richard also encourages his peers to put more trust in the prep students when events put them in critical situations. Richard plays a lot of chess with Hutter.

title: Maria-sama ga Miteru: Haru
description: The spring term is beginning for the students at Lillian Girls' Academy. Friends are reunited, but for the Yamayuri Council, it's a bittersweet time. Yoko, Eriko, and Sei are busy preparing to depart Lillian while Sachiko, Rei, and Shimako are doing their best to ensure that their dear sisters receive a memorable commencement. Sei's departure will leave a sizable hole in the White Roses, and filling it won't be easy. But is there anyone who could appeal to Shimako enough to become the next Rosa Gigantea en bouton? (Source: RightStuf)

characters.name: Yumi Fukuzawa
characters.description: She is the main character of the series. In the beginning of the series, Yumi is bashful beyond words, very timid and unsure of herself. She first met Sachiko, the star of Lillian School and had her tie fixed by Sachiko, which mortified Yumi. Yumi's friend, Tsutako Takeshima, took a cute picture of this and wanted to display it in the school festival. Tsutako got Yumi to ask permission from Sachiko. Other characters often comment on how her emotions 'show on her face'. ~!After Yumi first meets Sachiko, Sachiko is arguing with the Roses in the Rose Mansion. The Roses say that Sachiko cannot object to their plan, as she did not have a petite sœur. Sachiko runs out of the meeting and knocks Yumi over. She asks if Yumi has a grande sœur, and promptly offered Yumi her rosary. Sachiko thought that if she had a petite sœur, the Yamayurikai could not force her to play Cinderella alongside a male

characters.name: Rei Hasekura
characters.description: Rei, Yoshino's grande soeur, appears very tomboyish and "bishounen" on the outside but is in fact quite gentle despite her appearances. Her favourite books are shoujo, her favourite word is "sincerity" and her hobby is sightseeing. She is involved in kendo, but obsessively cares about Yoshino and prefers the domestic arts, like cooking. In the first season, Rei is Rosa Foetida en bouton, and her grande soeur was Torii Eriko. Her petite soeur is Shimazu Yoshino. In the second season, Rei becomes Rosa Foetida. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Touko Matsudaira
characters.description: A distant relative and fan of Sachiko. She arrives at Lillian during Yumi's second year. Touko is a member of the Drama club, and nicknamed Mechanical Drill by Satou Sei for her corkscrew pigtails. In the beginning of her first year Touko causes some strain in the relationship between Yumi and Sachiko. ~! However, it is apparent later on in the year that she may become Yumi's petite soeur.!~ (Source: Wikipedia) ~!Touko later wins the second card hunt when she half-accidentally makes Yumi uncover her card, thus winning the date with Yumi. She does so by basically asking Yumi to make her a petite soeur, and the recurring date practically ensures that Touko will become just that. In the same episode, we learn that Touko is also not the real daughter of the Matsudaira family, which made her the target for a lot of harsh words from the other close families. Despite this, her adopted

characters.name: Youko Mizuno
characters.description: Youko entered Lillian during her first year of middle school. Despite coming from an outside schooling system she was asked to give the welcome speech for first year students. She is characterized as being calm but sharp with a mischievous side, in the manga she is described to be "lily" like. Her greatest day was seeing the Rose Mansion filled with ordinary students during the Bouton's card hunt. During Youko's second year of high school, Rosa Gigantea and Rosa Chinensis (Sei and Youko's onee-sama's respectively) tricked Youko into taking an interest in Ogasawara Sachiko. Sachiko, Youko noted, always walked looked like she was fighting internally with something. With an endless desire to help (or meddle, as Sei put it) people Youko took Sachiko as her petite soeur. She had Sachiko quit her after school lessons (or in the novel, hinted about it) and once scolded her for not expressing he

characters.name: Noriko Nijou
characters.description: A young girl with a fascination with Buddhist statues and art. She enters Lillian Academy (a strictly Catholic institution) by mistake. She has a fierce temper that contradicts her calm exterior and becomes Shimako's petite soeur as Shimako enters her second year. (Source: Wikipedia) In the second season, Noriko becomes Rosa Gigantea en bouton, her grande soeur being Toudou Shimako.

characters.name: Sachiko Ogasawara
characters.description: Prim and elegant, Sachiko has a rough side and a very sweet side. She is very protective over Yumi and cares deeply about her. However, Sachiko often has the same problem as Yumi does — she does not share most of her problems with her sœur, causing many misunderstandings. Sachiko is slated to marry her cousin and fiancé Suguru after she graduates. This has caused her some distress since, because although she initially cared deeply for him, he did not reciprocate. They now have a complicated relationship. Sometimes, Yumi must teach Sachiko how to live informally, for example, helping her select her first pair of jeans. Despite her sometimes stern appearance, Sachiko has her own share of insecurities regarding her relationship with Yumi, not to mention emotional insecurities rising from her home life; both her father and grandfather openly have mistresses, unabashedly dividing their time b

characters.name: Sei Satou
characters.description: The exact opposite of most of the characters in the show: loud, rough-around-the-edges, she loves doing what she can to push other peoples' buttons. She enjoys mercilessly teasing or being mischievous, conducting most of her antics around Fukuzawa Yumi. Despite being a non-conformist in the ranks of the regular girls in Lillian Jogakuen, Sei is one of the wisest and caring characters on the show. Though seeming to have a playful and laid-back attitude, she has experienced many tragedies in her life, especially in her second year. Sei is known for doing things at her own pace, and dislikes being pressured into making decisions and taking action. She took Toudou Shimako as her soeur while in her third year. Her relationship with the first year is seen to one of mutual understanding and selective support. Sei however has an especially close relationship with Yumi. Sei becomes a source of co

characters.name: Yoshino Shimazu
characters.description: In the beginning of the series, Yoshino is a girl who was very ill and cared for constantly by her grande soeur, Rei. Yoshino, however, is very independent and in some ways tomboyish, despite her sickly status and feminine appearance. ~!After her heart surgery, she becomes more energetic through out the series. !~ In addition to being Rei's petite soeur, Yoshino is also her cousin and next-door neighbor. Theirs is a somewhat rocky relationship, since Yoshino is eager to spread her wings, whereas Rei would like to protect her from the world's hardships. In the first season, Yoshino is Rosa Foetida en bouton petite soeur, her grande soeur being Hasekura Rei. ~!In the second season, Yoshino becomes Rosa Foetida en bouton. She has no petite soeur yet. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Eriko Torii
characters.description: Rei's grande soeur; one of the most well-respected of the Yamayurikai. She is very gifted and good at almost everything, although she is also enigmatic and eccentric. She has a large forehead, which Sei made fun of when they were young, which began their rivalry. She said once that she chose Rei as her sœur to see if anything interesting would happen. She often has friction with Yoshino, as the younger girl is jealous of her bond with Rei. Eriko has four older brothers. After leaving Lillian, she studies Arts. She hates the dentist above all else. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shimako Toudou
characters.description: Prim, proper and very beautiful, Shimako is the most admired of the first-years. She is the petite soeur of Satō Sei at the beginning of the story and later her successor. Underneath Shimako's quiet, mannerly exterior lies a surprisingly strong resolve. However, Shimako is perhaps the most gentle of the three girls of her year in the Yamayurikai. In the first season, Shimako is Rosa Gigantea en bouton, her grande soeur being Satou Sei. In the second season, Shimako becomes Rosa Gigantea, her petite soeur being Nijou Noriko. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yuuki Fukuzawa
characters.description: The brother of Yumi (born one year apart), he loves her very much and tries to help her in everything he can. He has good relations with the students of Lillian and is somewhat popular. At the beginning of the series, he did not empathize with Suguru, but Suguru invites Yuuki to stay over for new year's in his house; subsequently Suguru begins to perturb Yuuki by giving him the nickname "Yukichi". Yuuki becomes the president of the Student Council of Hanadera due to his neutral personality. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shizuka Kanina
characters.description: Also known as Rosa Canina (for the Dog Rose), she is the star singer of the school choir. Yumi meets her without knowing that she was the candidate running against the Yamayurikai. She admired Sei greatly and it was revealed that she was in love with her schoolmate, yet she never tells Sei her feelings because she knows they will be met with rejection. Later on it is shown that she has also found an interest in Sei's petite soeur, Shimako. Possibly because she wanted to know what sort of girl the elusive and lonely Sei decided to choose as a soeur. Sei confronts her and asks Shizuka if she would have preferred to have been her soeur, and Shizuka sadly admits that she would not have, and wanted something else from Sei. She left Lillian at the end of her second year to pursue a singing career in Italy. Shizuka meets Yumi again in Italy during the Lillian school trip, and she takes her

title: Candy☆Boy EX01 - Mirai Yohouzu
title_original: Candy☆Boy EX01 - ミライヨホウズ
title_en: Candy☆Boy EX01 - Forecast of the Future
description: A DVD-only prequel to the Candy Boy series. Twin sisters, Yukino and Kanade Sakurai, move to a new school in the big city of Tokyo but not everything is quite like they expected.

characters.name: Kanade Sakurai
characters.description: Kanade is a high school student currently sharing a dorm room with her twin sister [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/7325/Sakurai-Yukino). She is more pragmatic and less easy-going than Yukino and tends to get exasperated a lot, especially when it comes to the advances of her kouhai. She is also somewhat easy to ruffle emotionally. She often worries that Yukino is sacrificing herself for her benefit. Kanade is an artist and wants to pursue art studies, however, she understands that it would be difficult to pursue a career in the field and maintain a close relationship with Yukino. Her little sister [Shizuku](https://anilist.co/character/16153/Sakurai-Shizuku) is closer to her than she is to Yukino, however Kanade is more distant with the younger girl and does not make the same amount of effort as Yukino to be closer to Shizuku.

characters.name: Yukino Sakurai
characters.description: Yukino is the older amongst the two. She's very fond of snacks and Sakuya often trades snacks with Yukino for Kanade's pictures. She is a member of their school's swim team. ~!Later in the series, Yukino decides to work part time in order to be able to pay for Kanade's art cram school. However, Kanade refused at this because she felt that if Yukino started working part time and she attended the art cram school, they will get to spend less time with each other. Yukino insisted and started working anyway which in turn created a strain in their relationship.!~

characters.name: Shizuku Sakurai
characters.description: Kanade and Yukino's much younger sister. Shizuku is a lot more level-headed than her sisters. She is deeply affected by the actions of Kanade, who she seems to care about more than Yukino. Unlike her sisters, she buries all her emotions deep down without expressing them but they later resurface in various ways, such as her cutting school. She also appears to be very passive-aggressive. Despite Yukino's attempts to become closer to her, Shizuku clearly spurns the attention of her older sister. This is possibly due to jealousy she feels, as Kanade spends more time with Yukino, and Shizuka would prefer that Kanade pays more attention to her instead. She seems quietly aware of the deeper relationship that her sisters may have.

title: Shamanic Princess
title_original: シャーマニックプリンセス
description: To retrieve the talisman stolen by her beloved, Tiara hunts the night, battling monsters with her awesome shamanic powers. Disguised as an ordinary schoolgirl by day, she arrives at his lair only to find her archrival on the scene... protecting the thief. Dark secrets unravel as Tiara faces these powerful opponents, and her one hope for survival may be to betray her mission. (Source: Media Blasters)

characters.name: Tiara
characters.description: A member of the Guardian World's royal family, Tiara is an agent charged with retrieving the Throne of Yord. She believes strongly in her duty and is well-known as one of the most powerful people in her world: she can both summon elemental beings and transform herself into a demon-like creature in battle. Tiara is hot-tempered and can be abraisive, but is more innocent and naïve than she likes to let on. She was Kagetsu's lover once. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Lena
characters.description: Lena is a childhood friend of both Sara and Tiara, and later, a rival to Tiara. She uses a flute to perform her magic. There is evidence that she is a princess like Tiara. She originally was sent to retrieve the Throne and Kagetsu, but eventually ended up joining him. Lena is calm and reserved, and while much admired for her accomplishments she harbors feeling of inferiority towards Tiara. With support from the Throne of Yord, she too can become a demon-like creature during battles.

characters.name: Sara
characters.description: Sara is Kagetsu's sister and Tiara's childhood friend. A sweet, gentle girl with a weak constitution, she has untapped ability as a Neutralizer. She mysteriously disappeared before the Throne of Yord incedent began. It is implied at the conclusion of the "Throne of Yord Saga" (and is indeed the thing that saves Tiara's life) that Sara is and always has been a part of the Throne of Yord, and that she was destined to joined to it from birth.

characters.name: Kagetsu
characters.description: Kagetsu is a Neutralizer from the Guardian World. Neutralizers can negate other people's magic and can borrow their power for a short time. They are also the caretakers of the Throne of Yord. He is now considered an outcast by the Elder of the Guardian World and is being pursued by Tiara and Japolo. Kagetsu and Tiara were former lovers.

characters.name: Leon
characters.description: Leon is Lena's "partner", capable of transforming into a ferocious beast and mirroring Japolo's powers. Leon has a preternatural attachment to Lena and will defend her regardless of the risk to himself. He is only moderately powerful, but Lena can lend him her powers via her flute. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Graham
characters.description: Graham is the first "partner" whom Tiara summoned, who appears in episodes 5-6. He was, however, disfigured in the process. Tiara had to fight long in order to possess him, as well as fighting off a demon formed from her own shadow, which now is the demon-like creature she can become in battle. Because of this Graham initially feared Tiara, but his fear soon gives way to a fierce loyalty. Graham feels that Tiara's love for Kagetsu is unhealthy and sees Kagetsu as the source of her pain, though most of those thoughts came from his own affection for her. ~!Graham attacked Kagetsu in the final episode when Kagetsu steals The Throne of Yord (containing the soul of his sister Sara). Unable to match Graham's superior physical strength, or just unwilling to use force against Tiara's partner, Kagetsu "neutralizes" Graham in the struggle. As Graham's physical form was perpetuated as an extension

characters.name: Japolo
characters.description: A small, ferret-like creature, Japolo appears in episodes 1-4. He is Tiara's "partner", according to Guardian World terminology. Despite this name, Tiara and Japolo are neither peers nor equals. Japolo serves Tiara as a familiar and acts as a battery-pack and backup to her powers. He is highly intelligent, and possesses much knowledge which Tiara doesn't about her mission and why the Throne was stolen. Japolo's powers include being able to freeze time by creating suspension fields (which allows battles to go in crowded cities without anyone noticing), and detecting other magical presences from his world. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Tiny Evil
description: Episode 1 & 2 Chapter 1: You Inma Miyu (幼淫魔・みゆ) A man who was very desperate and hopeless tries to call a Succubus. (Through internet media info, he tried to draw magic circles and rituals for calling Succubus.) One night, suddenly a little girl came to his house ringing the bell, amused to see a Succubus coming through the door of the house in the form of a little girl. He decides to let the succubus do her job so that he can feel better. (Source: Translated and Edited from Nekopoi)(revised) Episode 3 & 4 Chapter 2: Shoujo Ningyou Nina (少女人形・ニナ) One day a doll appeared in the room of our protagonist. The doll was in the form of a girl, cute but slightly off, in some way that he could not put his finger on. Eventually he attempted to get rid of it, but couldn't bring himself to. So he took care of the doll and suddenly he finds himself with extraordinary luck, everything is going his way! But then one night he thinks he hears the doll talking to him..what the hell is going on?!

title: Oni Chichi: Re-born
description: Based on the erotic game by Blue Gale. Continuing after the events of Oni Chichi: Re-birth... Airi, Marina, and their step father, Takami, leave for a trip to a hot springs resort. But Marina makes last minute plans and just the two of them go. Takami still constantly tries to drug Airi.

characters.name: Airi Akizuki
characters.description: The younger daughter. The main focus of episode 1 is on her.

characters.name: Marina Akizuki
characters.description: The elder step daughter.

characters.name: Kouzou Akizuki
characters.description: The male protagonist of the anime, who lust for his step daughters & best friends.

title: Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai: NEXT SKY
title_original: ラブライブ！虹ヶ咲学園スクールアイドル同好会 NEXT SKY
title_en: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club: NEXT SKY
description: A new Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai original video animation released in Summer 2023.

characters.name: Ayumu Uehara
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'2") Ayumu Uehara is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of A・ZU・NA, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her image color is light pink. She is hard working and believes that trying your best is the only thing to do. She is kind, sociable and wants everyone to succeed. Ayumu can also be rather clumsy at times.

characters.name: Yuu Takasaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Yuu Takasaki is the primary protagonist in Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club and one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is the manager, songwriter, and founder of Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her image color is black. Yuu is the budding school idol enthusiast of Nijigasaki High School, and is often seen with her characteristic thigh-high socks and twin-tails tips dyed green. She is Ayumu Uehara's inseparable childhood friend, having grown up as neighbors in the same apartment building near Odaiba.

characters.name: Shioriko Mifune
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Shioriko Mifune is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of R3BIRTH, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is jade. Shioriko is described as calm and academically gifted. She values Japanese tradition and has been trained in traditional dance and flower arranging. She has a talent for identifying people's strengths and weaknesses, and uses this to help students at Nijigasaki High School succeed in their club activities by offering advice. Although people are initially upset upon hearing her suggestions, they become thankful when it leads to them succeeding. And despite her somewhat stiff demeanor and lack of self-expression, Shioriko often yearns to connect with others, deep down.

characters.name: Mia Taylor
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Mia Taylor is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of R3BIRTH, a unit under Nijigaku. She is third year student and her image color is platinum silver. She recently transferred from New York and is fluent in both English and Japanese. Despite coming from a family of esteemed musicians, Mia would much rather prefer the life of a homebody and eat nothing but burgers. Mia is considered a 'music prodigy' by Lanzhu; she was an American college student before immediately transferring into Nijigasaki as a third year due to her skills, despite only being 14 years old.

characters.name: Lanzhu Zhong
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") Lanzhu Zhong is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of R3BIRTH, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her image color is rose gold. She recently transferred from Hong Kong and is fluent in both Mandarin and Cantonese. Despite showing herself as a charismatic girl, her unique personality tends to catch others off guard by how demanding she can be with them so that they achieve excellent results like her, which leads her to make questionable decisions and to treat people in a way that usually makes them feel insulted. Even so, she doesn't hesitate to seek every possible way to befriend others.

characters.name: Setsuna Yuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'0") Setsuna Yuki is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was the leader and founder of the original group and is a member of A・ZU・NA, a subunit under Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her color is scarlet red. The name "Setsuna Yuki" came from the characters of a light novel that she read. Setsuna is passionate and headstrong, but kind and mature. She has a habit of taking on too much work and not wanting to burden friends with her problems. Setsuna has an unwavering passion for school idols and her raw emotion combined with a powerful voice is her charm point. She is the student council president of Nijigasaki High School.

characters.name: Kasumi Nakasu
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") Kasumi Nakasu is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is pastel yellow. As Kasumin loves all things cute, her unrivaled love for idols is strong and inspired. With the goal to dominate and become number one, she's a sore loser when she comes anything other than first place, even to the point of sabotage or cheating. She hates the nickname Kasukasu (かすかす) which roughly translates to "just barely" or "not quite", and gets in a bad mood when referred to with it. You'll often find her scheming or thinking up new ways to ensure her own victory; however, these plans often fail or aren't as devious as she thinks.

characters.name: Karin Asaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'5") Karin Asaka is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of DiverDiva, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is royal blue. Karin is very mature and gives off a rather seductive vibe. She believes she is not a cute idol like the others and so confidently uses her more mature charm to capture an audience. Sometimes, she can be very petty and childish. She also has a hard time with directions and gets lost often.

characters.name: Shizuku Ousaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'1") Shizuku Osaka is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of A・ZU・NA, a subunit under Nijigaku. She is a first year and her image color is light blue. Shizuku is a polite, level-headed and diligent First Year student at Nijigasaki High with a passion for theatre and stage acting. She is a prolific member of the school's theatre club and it often shows in conversations where her enthusiasm for the subject surfaces.

characters.name: Ai Miyashita
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") __Favorite food:__ Nukazuke Ai Miyashita is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of DiverDiva, a unit under Nijigaku. Her image color is ultra orange. Ai has a "gyaru" sense of fashion, paired with a big heart and the will to help anyone with their problems. This makes her very popular at school and also as an idol. She is most commonly seen with Rina Tennoji, another member of the club whom she helps face and overcome her shy nature.

characters.name: Rina Tennouji
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm (4'10") Rina Tennoji is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is paper white, though often is represented with gray. Rina is a shy girl who says she is incapable of showing emotion on her face. She hides her face with the "Rina-chan Board", a piece of paper, notepad or electronic display on which she displays her emotions on. She is energetic, confident, and only able to perform when she has the "Rina-chan Board". Rina is very skilled with technology as she is regularly creating gadgets, using drones to shoot music videos, and makes an electronic headset version of her "Rina-chan Board" for use during performances.

characters.name: Kanata Konoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") Kanata Konoe is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is violet. Kanata is always giving everything her all... even if it doesn't seem that way when she dozes off in the middle of conversations. She cares deeply for her little sister Haruka and will find a bottomless well of energy in matters relating to her. An ideal performance, for Kanata, is a stage in which she sleeps and her fans watch. She also has an aptitude for cooking and home economics. While she loves to be doted on and spoiled, she also looks after everyone in the club as a big sister figure.

title: Queen's Blade: Utsukushiki Toushi-tachi
title_original: クイーンズブレイド 美しき闘士たち
description: Queen's Blade OVA. Contains short stories from the lives of the warriors after the Queen's Blade competition.

characters.name: Nanael
characters.description: An angel who descended to Earth with duty of "broadcasting" Queen's Blade fights. Because of her goofy actions, Head Angel put her on probation and exiled to the mortal world. She was given a vial of 'holy milk' twice by the Head Angel, which she must not allow even one drop to be spilled. First time served a test which, in which she spilled of it and tried to fool Head Angel by filling the vial with Earthly milk. Second vial was given to her when she was ordered to enter Queen's Blade tournament, but this time, the more she spills, the weaker she becomes. Since she completely failed to keep the milk safe last time, Head Angel is confident that this will serve as a handicap! Unwilling to treat dwellers of the "lower world" as equals, her combat technique involves the telekinetic manipulation of her celestial saber to keep opponents at bay. She is i

characters.name: Tomoe
characters.description: A Shinto priestess from the island of Hinomoto (an alternate reading of the kanji for Japan), she is a member of the elite society of priestesses that protect their homeland. She was designed and illustrated by the artist Eiwa.

characters.name: Elina Vance
characters.description: The daughter of Count Vance, and younger sister of Reina, a prominent Queen's Blade competitor. She was trained from a young age in all manner of martial arts, from stealth to strict military discipline, and acts as both bodyguard, spy, and assassin for her father. Unlike Reina Erina's personality is vicious. She was created by Hisayuki Hirokazu.

characters.name: Melona
characters.description: Melona is one of the four servants of The Swamp Witch and her strongest minion. Nicknamed "The Protean Assassin" due to her nearly unlimited ability to change form at will, she is skilled in obtaining information and assassination. It is assumed that she was ordered to bring about chaos to the Queen's Blade tournament. Seductive and alluring, she revels in humiliating her opponents and will not hesitate to kill them if given the opportunity. Despite her malevolent nature she hates being called a monster and becomes very upset, to the point of strangling someone to death for instance. Despite this, she can be reasoned with and is willing to work with her enemies as long as it benefits her and furthers her own goals. She is a shapeshifter not limited by shape or texture who can change the shape of her body freely and instantly. Her mimicry is so proficient that she can even imitate the tec

characters.name: Alleyne
characters.description: One of the oldest and most seasoned veteran warriors of a tribe of forest elves, Alleyne is taciturn and blunt in her dealings with others. She's had a long relationship with Echidna, who she often chastises for her loose ways but is mocked in return for her inexperience with men. The appearance of the half-elf Nowa in the forest elf community marked a turning point for Alleyne, who appointed her "guardian of the forest". The elf village elders did not approve however, and drove her from the village with the excuse that she must join the Queen's Blade tournament. Distraught, Alleyne secretly set out for the tournament as well, to protect the girl whose sudden appearance had awoken feelings long dormant in the veteran elven warrior. She is illustrated by Matsuryuu. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Nowa
characters.description: Described as the 'Guardian of the Forest', the half elf Nowa and her monkey companion protect the creatures who live there. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Airi
characters.description: A scythe-wielding ghost girl in a maid costume, Airi was given human form by the evil Swamp Witch in her quest for domination. Airi serves every whim of her mistress quite willingly. Used primarily for assassinations, she can literally suck the vitality of her enemies simply by touching them.

characters.name: Melpha
characters.description: A high-ranked priestess in a fundamentalist sect, Melpha is widely respected by her followers as a holy woman. Compared to the other competitors her fighting ability is minimal, but she possesses the ability to heal her own wounds and inflict divine punishment on her opponents through the use of provocative "holy poses". (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Aldra
characters.description: Aldra is the victor of the past two Queen's Blade tournaments and reigning queen. As the child of a priestess and the lord of the underworld, she is a cursed half-demon. She has the powers of "petrifying gaze" and "flesh-rending secret cleaver". (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Reina Vance
characters.description: The nomad warrior Reina is the direct heir to the house of Vance and Claudette's and Elina's sister. But, instead of accepting her father's heritage, she escapes and enters the Queen's Blade tournament. Her partially naive character and strong sense of justice gets her into trouble pretty often.

characters.name: Shizuka
characters.description: A kunoichi from Hinomoto, Shizuka is a money grubbing assassin. She couldn't care less about the affairs of the battle as long she gets paid; she just hates working hard in general and instead have a personal group of ninjas to aid her. Shizuka does not have a game book of her own, yet has been featured in the anime, voiced by Hitomi Nabatame, manga, collectible cards ver2.0, and even had a PVC figurine released. She was created by Eiwa - By Wesker_CDA

characters.name: Menace
characters.description: Thousands of years ago, in the ancient Amara, a princess was dethroned out of her kingdom. She would have been the next queen, but was betrayed by the high statesmen at the same time Amara fell into ruin after being invaded by an enemy kingdom. History tells that princess Menace's fate was the same as her collapsing kingdom. In the present the "Marshland Witch" managed to resurrect Menace with a powerful magic in her plan to conquer the continent. Despite that, Menace pridefully refused to serve anyone and fled. During her escape, she met a merchant who recommended participating in the Queen's Blade. Menace decided to enter the tournament with the goal of reviving the kingdom of Amara. Despite her gentle nature, Menace is a master of martial arts passed down by the royal family. Her punch emits a cursed aura that can drain her opponent's life with a simple touch. She also carries a myste

title: BIKINI WARRIORS OVA
title_original: ビキニ・ウォリアーズ
description: The first episode will focus on Hunter and Valkyrie, who were guest characters in the television anime, as well as two new characters: Cleric and Kunoichi. Hunter and Valkyrie meet Cleric and think she will join them as their healer, but something is strange about her. Then they are attacked by Kunoichi, who seeks legendary bikini armor. The second episode will focus on Fighter's party after they have overcome hardships, spoken with god, and earned the legendary bikini armor. However, the armor is invisible to idiots. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Hunter
characters.description: A survivalist with horrible cooking skills who becomes a very close partner of Valkyrie.

characters.name: Valkyrie
characters.description: A lady of noble birth who has decided to dedicate her life to fighting evil. Valkyrie is very arrogant and tsundere in nature.

characters.name: Cleric
characters.description: A petite-looking priestess of a war deity, whose specialty lies in combat-related magic at the expense of her clerical healing capacities.

characters.name: Kunoichi
characters.description: A young female ninja who intends to steal all the bikini armor she can find in order to eventually get her hands on the most legendary bikini armor.

characters.name: Mage
characters.description: The youngest and most timid member of the adventure party, the Mage is a petite purple-haired girl skilled in the art of sorcery.

characters.name: Paladin
characters.description: A beautiful blonde woman who (most unbecoming to her vocation) harbors closeted sexual desires.

characters.name: Dark Elf
characters.description: A member of the Dark Elf race who assists the party with a versatile combination of combat and magic-using skills. Initially quite haughty when she first joined, she has shed much of her attitude as the four of them have kept adventuring together.

characters.name: Fighter
characters.description: A redhaired, somewhat impulsive and stubborn woman, and the party's leader. She is also the daughter of a legendary warrior who saved the country in the past.

characters.name: Black Knight
characters.description: A very determined and strong fightress who likes to express herself with otherworldly (i.e., computer game-related) terms. However, despite her grimness, she is deadly afraid of the undead.

characters.name: Necromancer
characters.description: A demon-like, childish girl who can awake and control the dead with her magic, and even transform the living coming into contact with her into undead. A necro-fetishist, she wishes to attach herself to another girl, preferrably Black Knight, and make them her zombie companion.

title: Resort BOIN
description: Based on the game by Crossnet-Pie. On spring break, Daisuke is excited for his vacation on a tropical island for some well deserved relaxation and girl watching. He finds himself quite inexplicably popular with the ladies as well. Nao and Mitsugu follow him there as well competing, as usual, for his attentions. Meanwhile he meets his cousin Maya again after a long time as well as the wild Kanae and her friend Mika. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Nao Iihara
characters.description: She has strong feelings for Daisuke and seems to have no problem sharing him with others girls as long as he makes love with her equally as much.

characters.name: Maya Koromogae
characters.description: Cousin of Daisuke.

characters.name: Daisuke Ichijyo
characters.description: The male protagonist of the anime and visual novel.

characters.name: Mika
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm She tends to look down on people with courage, but she's sweet to obedient people. She answers various requests by saying "That's cute!".

characters.name: Mitsugu Tsukushino
characters.description: A rich girl who is very loyal to Daisuke, but seems to have no problem sharing him with other girls. She is rivals with Nao.

characters.name: Momona Amamiya
characters.description: Momona is a shy and clumsy girl who has strong feelings for Daisuke.

title: Hidamari Sketch × SP
description: Even though studying at a prestigious art school like Yamabuki is hard work, the girls who live at the Hidamari Apartments always manage to squeeze in time for a little fun and exploration. And when they actually get a day off? Watch out world! Yuno, Sae, Hiro, Miyako and new students Nori and Nazuna return to create another masterpiece of life as art, with all new adventures that include swimming, pajama parties, trips to the art museum and even an all-you-can-eat diner courtesy of the landlady! Of course, there’s always a little housework that has to be squeezed in, but with a pinch of resourcefulness and a dash of creativity, even the most onerous of chores can be turned into something magical. (Source: Sentai Filmworks)

characters.name: Yuno
characters.description: __Height:__ 144 cm Yuno is the main character in the story and it is mainly through her viewpoint that the story is told, each episode of the anime usually ends with her pondering her feelings about what has gone on during the day while taking a bath with her rubber duck. She lives in room 201, next to her best friend and classmate, Miyako. She is a skilled artist overall but considers painting and drawing her specialties.

characters.name: Miyako
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm [Yuno](https://anilist.co/character/2528/Yuno)'s classmate and good friend. She's very strange, but a very likable person. She has very good ears and is good at imitating other people. She is notorious for her appetite and love for food.

characters.name: Sae
characters.description: __Height:__ 167cm Sae is an upperclassman and good friends with Hiro. In the anime version, she has a younger sister, Chika. Her artistic specialties are photography and fiction writing; she writes fiction professionally under the pseudonym "Aya Tachibana" and enrolled at the school specifically so she could learn how to illustrate her own work. Sae, who is tall, athletic, and generally mature, has a playful side that can be at the same time enigmatic and cunning; she has a habit of giving Yuno just enough warning about potential problems for the younger girl to fail to avoid them. She also has a fondness for playing detective when faced with such anomalies as Miyako's apartment. She tends to get upset when Miyako refers to her as having masculine qualities. She also gets very uncomfortable when asked about her love life, frequently inventing a history for herself that even cursory exami

characters.name: Hiro
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Hiro is a year older than [Yuno](https://anilist.co/character/2528/Yuno) and [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/2627/Miyako), living directly under Yuno's apartment. Although she tries to be a supportive senpai to the girls, she tends to worry excessively about her weight, causing her to go on diets for periods while occasionally binging on sweets. A childhood friend of [Sae](https://anilist.co/character/3215/Sae), she is one of her neighbor's principal sources of support when she's involved with a deadline or other crisis.

characters.name: Nazuna
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm She lives in room 203. She has sandy blonde hair, braids, and large side bangs. She used to live in the neighborhood, but after entering Yamabuki Art High School her father was transferred somewhere for work and her mother followed with him. She appears very quiet and reserved, but has an inferiority complex. She is not in the art department.

characters.name: Nori
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Nori lives in room 103 and is in the art department and likes to play with computers. She is honest and straightforward, and seems to be the most level-headed and normal out of everyone and is usually the one to point out the others' weird ways.

characters.name: Yoshinoya
characters.description: __Height:__ 158cm Yoshinoya is Yuno and Miyako's homeroom teacher and art instructor. She is buxom, exuberant, and a cosplay maniac. So much so, in fact, that she will frequently wear incredibly complicated things that are at times truly inappropriate. She has a fondness for modeling for her class, displaying her latest outfits whenever she can, and showing off in general. It is later revealed that Yoshinoya still resides with her parents, and would often be criticized by them for not being mature. When asked her age, she will answer "eternally seventeen". (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Ume
characters.description: Ume is a Metapod that lives on the roof of the Hidamari Apartments and represents the manga's author, Ume Aoki. The character does not actually play any significant role in the story. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha: Reflection
title_original: 魔法少女リリカルなのはReflection
description: A pair of researchers remain on their dying planet of Eltria with their two daughters, Amitie and Kirie, in hopes of finding a way to revive the planet, but it was no use. Against her older sister's wishes, Kirie sets off with her childhood friend Iris to seek help from a distant alternate world. They arrive in Japan on Earth to search for the key to their planet's regeneration. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Fate Testarossa
characters.original: フェイト・テスタロッサ
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ [Bardiche](https://anilist.co/character/220250/Bardiche) Fate is introduced as an antagonist and rival to Nanoha Takamachi, she first encounters Nanoha during the Jewel Seed Incident while collecting the Lost Logia known as the Jewel Seeds on behalf of her abusive mother, Presea Testarossa. Despite their initial conflict, the two develop a close friendship that evolves into a lifelong partnership.

characters.name: Nanoha Takamachi
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ Raising Heart Excelion. Strike Cannon, Fortress __Rank:__ S+ __Rank (StrikerS):__ Captain of Stars Squad, part of the mobile sixth division __Code name (StrikerS):__ Stars 1 In Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha, Nanoha Takamachi is sweet if naive third-grader. However, she has always felt like she is missing something in her life: all the people around her have someone there​ are very close to but she lacks this. However, Nanoha is no longer an "ordinary" third grader when she meets and helps the wounded ferret, who just happens to be a mage from another planet, Yuuno Scrya. He has come to Earth to gather the "Jewel Seeds," mysterious artifacts containing great power. Nanoha agrees to help him, but the task seems harder than presented when she meets Fate Testarossa, another girl searching for the Jewel Seeds. In A's, six months after the first season, Nanoha still remai

characters.name: Hayate Yagami
characters.description: __Intelligent Device(s):__ Buch der Nachthimmel/Book of Darkness (Storage/Tome), Schwertkreuz (Rod), Reinforce II (Unison Device) A sweet and gentle orphan who is confined to a wheelchair, is cared for by the Wolkenritter, who deliberately keep their battles hidden from her. She knows that completing the Book of Darkness would grant her immense power, but she refuses to accept that power at the cost of innocent lives. Unbeknownst to her, however, the Book is already feeding on her life force, causing her paralysis and slowly weakening her. If it is not completed, the Book will eventually consume her life entirely.

characters.name: Amitie Florian
characters.original: アミティエ・フローリアン
characters.description: Amitie Florian, also known as the Guardian of Destiny, is a character introduced in Mahô Shôjo Lyrical Nanoha A's PORTABLE -THE GEARS OF DESTINY-. Amitie is hot-blooded, but sometimes her efforts prove futile for her hot-blooded personality. It is revealed in the game that she is an android, in which is important in the plot because it signifies that she is not human. (Source: Nanoha Wiki)

characters.name: Kyrie Florian
characters.original: キリエ・フローリアン
characters.description: Kyrie Florian, also known as the Right Hand of Time, is a character introduced in Mahô Shôjo Lyrical Nanoha A's PORTABLE -THE GEARS OF DESTINY-. By contrast to her sister Amitie Florian, her personality is cool and cynical. She is a natural airhead. She seemingly has no problems showing of her sexuality, often being depicted with an impish grin when under dressed. (Source: Nanoha Wiki)

characters.name: Iris
characters.description: Iris is Kyrie Florian's childhood friend who resides in an old church on Eltria. She is first introduced in Reflection. Iris is a cheerful and obliging girl who cannot leave people in trouble unhelped.

characters.name: Arf
characters.description: Fate's outspoken dog-woman familiar. Her distaste of Precia is mutual, but she cannot do anything to protect Fate from her mother. Arf instead takes out her anger on her enemies. She is very kind to Fate and rather protective of her. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Signum
characters.description: __Nanoha A's__ Signum enters the story when Vita has attempted to steal Nanoha Takamachi's Linker Core (a mage's source of magic) for the Book of Darkness. Since the arrival of Nanoha's cavalry, Fate Testarossa and Yūno Scrya, Vita is cornered and Signum must come to her rescue with Shamal. The Wolkenritter overpower the TSAB troupe with their use of high-powered magical cartridges, and Signum manages to snap Fate's staff, Bardiche, in half. The battle ends with Shamal finally managing to get Nanoha's Linker Core and Nanoha breaking Vita's barrier. Signum refuses to take a bath that night for fear of Hayate seeing the injuries sustained in her battle with Fate. Signum may appear emotionless, but she is completely dedicated to Hayate, and as the leader of the Wolkenritter, fights for the others as well. The Wolkenritter attack mages to steal their Linker Cores, their sources of magic, to

characters.name: Vita
characters.description: __Vita in Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha A's__ Vita enters A's on a hunt with Zafila for strong Linker Cores to absorb into the Book of Darkness. She targets Nanoha Takamachi, which she deems to be a juicy target, unlike the usual TSAB "redshirts" which can barely fill up a single page of the Book of Darkness. Nanoha puts up a decent fight, but Vita tilts the deck with two cartridges (bullet shaped things that contain high-pressure magic) manages to overpower her, obtaining a power superiority so vast that she heavily damaged the Raising Heart. However, before she could get the Linker Core, Fate Testarossa and Yūno Scrya come to the rescue. Vita fights them off with her fellow Wolkenritter, Signum and Shamal, and they declare themselves enemies. The battle ends with Shamal finally managing to get Nanoha's Linker Core and Nanoha breaking Vita's barrier. ~! Vita fights for the sake of protect

characters.name: Yuuno Scrya
characters.description: Before the start of the series, Yūno lived in Mid-childa, a magical world, as an archaeologist. He had no parents, so was raised by his entire tribe, the Scrya, from which he took his surname. He also obtained or created the intelligent device Raising Heart around this time, but his talents lay as a support mage, and so his attack abilities were low and he never made the device into a weapon. Yūno first appears running from a gigantic monster in the woods and attempting to seal the Jewel Seed inside it with Raising Heart. He fails, letting the monster get away, and collapses wounded on the ground. Yūno uses his remaining power to call out to the nearest magic user and turns into a ferret. His call was heard in Nanoha Takamachi's dream, and later that day, she found the ferret in the woods and took him to the veterinary hospital. He quickly recovered, taking a liking to Nanoha and recogni

characters.name: Lindy Harlaown
characters.original: リンディ・ハラオウン
characters.description: Lindy, the kind-spirited captain of the spaceship Asura, works for the Time-Space Administration Bureau. She enjoys drinking green tea with sugar (and sometimes cream) added, which is ironic given her appreciation of Japanese culture. She is Chrono's mother.

characters.name: Shamal
characters.description: Shamal, being Yuuno's counterpart, does not actually fight, but uses her ring devices to defend, create portals, absorb victims' Linker Cores into the Book of Darkness, and the like. Shamal acts as the 'mother' of the group, doing the shopping, worrying excessively over the others' well-being, and constructing excuses to Hayate as to why they're out so often ("The grocery store doesn't have our brand of olive oil"). She knows that Hayate does not want them to fight anyone for her, but it is still no question that they must. Now in StrikerS She is A soft-spoken member of the Wolkenritter that specializes in defense and healing. She is a medical officer.

title: COLORs
description: A short anime directed by Tetsurou Araki in collaboration with music by Hiroyuki Sawano and Motohiro Hata. Note: A part of the "TOHO animation: Music Films" project, in commemoration of the 10th anniversary of TOHO Animation.

title: Kanamewo
description: A story about a girl who finds a tree spirit in the rain.

title: Hidamari Sketch: Sae Hiro Sotsugyou-hen
title_original: ひだまりスケッチ 沙英ヒロ 卒業編
description: Sae and Hiro take their final exams while the rest of the Hidamari Apartment's residents cheer them on and prepare for their eventual graduation. (Source: Anime News Network)
