(Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kouchou-sensei
characters.description: The Principal at Yamabuki High School, with a stutter and an inability to stop shaking. Is a master gunfighter and ninja. Often scolds Yoshinoya-sensei for lack of satisfactory performance. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Natsume
characters.description: Natsume is a student from class B who acts like a tsundere character toward Sae, masking her strong affection for her by maintaining a generally antagonistic attitude. During her first day at Yamabuki, she faced a lot of troubles and was helped by Sae and touched by her kind nature, developing feelings for her. To her dismay, she was separated into another class and quickly became jealous and envious of Hiro's burgeoning relationship with Sae. Ever since, she has been trying to hide her feelings in Sae's presence by acting nonchalant, initially declaring herself to be her rival. Eventually, though she becomes less confrontational around her and occasionally visits Sae and the others at the apartment, when invited. She is also one of the few people who know of Sae's pen name and is an admirer of her books.

characters.name: Oyasan
characters.description: The Landlady is the female owner of Hidamari Apartments. She has quite a few masculine characteristics as she often wears baseball cap, goes out for a fishing in her spare time, and is a heavy smoker. Although she has a very laid-back personality, she is often seen very busy doing various part-time jobs. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Necronomico no Cosmic Horror Show
title_original: ネクロノミ子のコズミックホラーショウ
title_en: Necronomico and the Cosmic Horror Show
description: We all need a chance to change our lives! The story follows Miko Kurono, who began her dream career as a livestreamer under the name "Necronomico" after graduating middle school. Amidst spending her days with childhood friend Mayu Mayusaka and rival Kanna Kagurazaka, she's introduced to a new VR game project!? Upon encountering the game, the girls start pursuing the 'irreplacable now'. (Source: Official site, translated)

title: Candy☆Boy EX02 - Shiawase Kyouyuu Riron
title_original: Candy☆Boy EX02 - シアワセキョウユウリロン
title_en: Candy☆Boy EX02 - Theory of Happiness Sharing
description: Final episode (designated as Episode 8) of Candy Boy which came with DVD volume 2. The episode centres around a day at the pool.

characters.name: Kanade Sakurai
characters.description: Kanade is a high school student currently sharing a dorm room with her twin sister [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/7325/Sakurai-Yukino). She is more pragmatic and less easy-going than Yukino and tends to get exasperated a lot, especially when it comes to the advances of her kouhai. She is also somewhat easy to ruffle emotionally. She often worries that Yukino is sacrificing herself for her benefit. Kanade is an artist and wants to pursue art studies, however, she understands that it would be difficult to pursue a career in the field and maintain a close relationship with Yukino. Her little sister [Shizuku](https://anilist.co/character/16153/Sakurai-Shizuku) is closer to her than she is to Yukino, however Kanade is more distant with the younger girl and does not make the same amount of effort as Yukino to be closer to Shizuku.

characters.name: Yukino Sakurai
characters.description: Yukino is the older amongst the two. She's very fond of snacks and Sakuya often trades snacks with Yukino for Kanade's pictures. She is a member of their school's swim team. ~!Later in the series, Yukino decides to work part time in order to be able to pay for Kanade's art cram school. However, Kanade refused at this because she felt that if Yukino started working part time and she attended the art cram school, they will get to spend less time with each other. Yukino insisted and started working anyway which in turn created a strain in their relationship.!~

characters.name: Sakuya Kamiyama
characters.description: A younger girl who is in deeply infatuated with [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/7324/Sakurai-Kanade) with the point that she is almost stalking her. She is extremely wealthy and often tries to spend her money after the twins. She likes collecting old paraphernalia, junk and pictures that belong to Kanade, most of which goes to her makeshift shrine. Despite her overwhelming presence, the twins seem to like her. [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/7325/Sakurai-Yukino) is amused by her and Kanade seems more irritated than anything, but they both seem to have some sort of affection for the girl. Initially, her presence was seen as a threat to Kanade as she assumed Sakuya was interested in Yukino. She became aware that Sakuya was madly in love with her when Yukino clears the situation up.

characters.name: Shizuku Sakurai
characters.description: Kanade and Yukino's much younger sister. Shizuku is a lot more level-headed than her sisters. She is deeply affected by the actions of Kanade, who she seems to care about more than Yukino. Unlike her sisters, she buries all her emotions deep down without expressing them but they later resurface in various ways, such as her cutting school. She also appears to be very passive-aggressive. Despite Yukino's attempts to become closer to her, Shizuku clearly spurns the attention of her older sister. This is possibly due to jealousy she feels, as Kanade spends more time with Yukino, and Shizuka would prefer that Kanade pays more attention to her instead. She seems quietly aware of the deeper relationship that her sisters may have.

title: Yuri Seijin Naoko-san
description: Naoko-san is an alien from the planet Yuri, who is plotting to conquer the Earth by yurifying it. Misuzu is a junior high girl and is always troubled by Naoko-san, who lives on the roof of her house. They hear rumors that a molester is wandering around in the area, so they decide to investigate.

title: Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight: Rondo Rondo Rondo
title_original: 少女☆歌劇 レヴュースタァライト ロンド・ロンド・ロンド
description: A compilation film recapping the anime series.

characters.name: Futaba Isurugi
characters.description: Futaba Isurugi is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. A highly unorthodox Stage Girl who came to Seisho Music Academy along with her childhood friend Kaoruko. Kind-hearted despite her rough words, she takes care of Kaoruko while always griping. Tiny but athletic, she shows deadly aptitude for staged swordfights.

characters.name: Nana Daiba
characters.description: Nana Daiba is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. This Stage Girl is the de facto mother of the 99th class, kind and caring to her classmates. Nicknamed "Banana". Talented not only in singing and dancing but also as a director. Still delighted by the group performance of "Starlight" back in her first year.

characters.name: Kaoruko Hanayagi
characters.description: Kaoruko Hanayagi is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. Granddaughter of the head of a traditional Japanese dance school, this Stage Girl has refined skills in traditional song and dance. Raised in privilege, she is all too reliant on Futaba Isurugi. While she is always smiling, she is more calculating than anyone else. Speaks in the elegant Kyoto dialect.

characters.name: Junna Hoshimi
characters.description: Junna Hoshimi is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. A top student who serves as the class representative. Has great decision-making and analytical skills, but is prone to overthinking. After choosing to pursue acting against her parents' wishes, she now frets over the gap in skill between herself and those with natural talent like Maya.

characters.name: Claudine Saijou
characters.description: She is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class, as well as the second seat in the class. Born to a Japanese father and a French mother, this talented Stage Girl already has a long career as a child actress. Upon entering the school, she meets the brilliant [Maya Tendou](https://anilist.co/character/126666/Tendou-Maya) and immediately begins a staunch rivalry.

characters.name: Maya Tendou
characters.description: She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class, as well as head of the class. Practically born for the theater world, with a renowned stage actor and a prima donna for parents. Blessed with a good physique and a carrying voice, she refuses to rest on her laurels and always strives to reach greater heights.

characters.name: Mahiru Tsuyuzaki
characters.description: Mahiru Tsuyuzaki is the tritagonist in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. Though she sings and dances her heart out on stage, this Stage Girl is normally withdrawn and contemplative. She admires her roommate Karen's cheery and outgoing nature, but her feelings are put in a difficult place when Karen's old friend Hikari shows up.

characters.name: Hikari Kagura
characters.description: Hikari Kagura (神楽 ひかり, Kagura Hikari) is the deuteragonist of the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. Karen's childhood friend. A born performer who studied at an acting school in England. Her fate has been linked with Karen's since viewing a performance of "Starlight". Reuniting with her old friend, she is driven by a strong desire to join the mysterious Revue. (Source: Revue Starlight Wiki)

characters.name: Karen Aijou
characters.description: The protagonist of the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. She set out on the road to becoming a Stage Girl after being captivated by a performance of "Starlight" she saw as a child. She is always boisterous and cheerful but hates early morning lessons. She joins the mysterious Revue with Hikari Kagura, who crossed fates with her when they were young girls.

characters.name: Kirin
characters.description: The Giraffe is a talking, unnamed giraffe that oversees the Revues and controls the Stage of Fate.

title: Discipline
description: The story revolves around Takuro Hayami who transferred to the mostly female Saint Arcadia School. Seemingly all of the girls want to have sex with him because the school only recently started admitting male students. Takuro seems like a normal student, but what the girls later realize when they try to take advantage of him is that he has a secret. Dick Specs: Length: 36 cm Girth: 12 cm Ejaculation volume: ??cc On the DVD cover, Ellen is described as the "Futanari exchange student with phimosis." Thus many of the sex acts featuring Ellen prominently involve her foreskin. Ellen also has one of the largest penises in the series at 36 cm.

title: Majo no Tabitabi Movie
description: Sequel movie to Majo no Tabitabi .

characters.name: Elaina
characters.description: On her broom, she flies from country to country with her long, black robes adorning the lengths of her arms and trailing behind her with every weave and turn. Her purple-blue eyes peer out from beneath a black tricorn hat to reveal beautiful and silky ashen hair that flows down her back like clouds flowing through summer skies. On her chest is pinned a star-shaped brooch — signifying her status as a witch. Prior to the main story, she was a sheltered child who was greatly proficient in magic, innocent, and "not knowing what failure is."

title: Senran Kagura Specials
description: Special, unaired, episodes released with the Senran Kagura BD/DVDs.

characters.name: Ikaruga
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm A third year, Ikaruga is mature and supportive and takes her duty as a ninja very seriously. However, she sometimes loses her composure and acts more naturally. She is an adoptive daughter of a wealthy ninja family, however she was chosen to be the next head of her family over her brother, who is a failure as a ninja. Her summoning animal is the Chinese Phoenix. Her weapon of choice is the Katana, Hien which has been past down to her by her adopted father.

characters.name: Katsuragi
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm A third year, she is the perverted member of the group, who loves to fondle breasts, and especially Asuka's. However, she can be also serious when it concerns her friends. Her summoning animal is the dragon.

characters.name: Asuka
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm The main character, she is a second year, who barely passed the promotion exam. She wants to follow in her grandfather's footsteps and become a great ninja. She's an upbeat person, though she is naive at times and has a fear of frogs which is (unfortunately) also her family's summon animal.

characters.name: Yagyuu
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm A first year, she is a ninja prodigy. She cares very much for Hibari who she supports the most. She wears an eye patch over her right eye and carries an umbrella (armed with various weapons) at all times. Her summoning animal is the giant squid. ~!The biggest reason she is sticking together with Hibari because of her little sister; Yagyuu's little sister died due to illness a year before the series, and thought it was her fault that she died. At the start of high school, she saw a girl, Hibari, who looked like her sister. This is also why Yagyuu always promises to protect Hibari, no matter what.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Hibari
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm A first year of the group, she is very childish and clumsy and loves cute and sweet things. She is also really close to Yagyuu. Her summoning animal is a large pink rabbit. ~!Unlike the other girls of the cast, Hibari is the only one not to have a tragic or sad past.!~

characters.name: Homura
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm A second year and the leader of Homura Gurentai, the rival group. A second year, the leader of Homura Gurentai, and the main character in Senran Kagura Burst. She fights with 3 katanas in each hand, brandished like claws. ~! It is revealed in episode 9 that she was supposed to enroll in Hanzou Academy, but she killed someone and Hanzou Academy only accepts those with clean records.!~

characters.name: Kiriya
characters.description: The girls' ninja teacher. He has a habit of appearing in a puff of smoke. He trained Rin when she was a member of the Light Faction. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Hanzou
characters.description: Asuka's grandfather.

title: Aikatsu Friends!
description: "Let's go, together! Head for the goal, Diamond Friends!!" The new anime will have a theme of "Aikatsu with your friends!" and will center on a new protagonist named Aine Yuuki, who is good at making friends, and is enrolled in Star Harmony Academy's general education track. She befriends Mio Minato, the school's top idol, and becomes an idol herself. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Aine Yuuki
characters.description: A middle school second year who belongs to Star Harmony Academy's normal division. She's good at making friends, and her goal is to make a million of them. Lively and positive, Aine has a kind heart that takes into account other people's feelings. She is from a large family, and they own the "Penguin Cafe" supported by their neighbors. Aine herself enjoys helping around the house. While a very ordinary girl, her encounter with Mio triggers an interest in idol activities. She serves as the muse of her own brand, Sugar Melody.

characters.name: Mio Minato
characters.description: A middle school second year who belongs to Star Harmony Academy's idol division. She is active as a popular idol and is the featured model for "Aikatsu! Style Times". Mio has excellent fashion sense, and demonstrates her talents by serving as both the designer and muse of her own brand, Material Color. While Mio is smart, earns good grades and is able to do anything, she has always felt that she's missing something. However, her encounter with Aine seems to spark something inside of her, leading Mio to invite Aine into the world of Aikatsu! (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Mirai Asuka
characters.description: One of the Friends, "Love Me Tear", who won the Diamond Friends Cup. She is currently a high school second year, and is an alumni of Star Harmony Academy. Sensitive to the latest trends, Mirai is a bright girl who loves social media. She often takes pictures of her everyday life. She is a fashion leader who enjoys a not only cute, but poisonous sense of style that strays from traditional rules. As an idol, Mirai believes that it's bad to be the same as everyone else, and constantly puts an overwhelming amount of effort in searching for individuality and originality. She serves as both the designer and the muse of her own brand, Milky Joker. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Karen Kamishiro
characters.description: She is a graduate of Star Harmony Academy and a second-year high school student. She forms the unit "Love Me Tear" with Mirai Asuka; together, they won the Diamond Friends Cup. An elite who received gifted education from a young age, she is also a quintessential "high-class lady." While she has a gentle and refined personality, she also possesses a surprisingly wild side; for instance, the sight of her smiling while triggering traps during an event set on Karen Island is genuinely terrifying. She keeps wild beasts—specifically a bear named Choco, a wild boar named Maron, and a tiger named Mocha—whom she refers to as her "cute friends." She also keeps various other animals as pets. Having consistently reached the top in various fields, she initially pursued nothing but victory in the world of Aikatsu. However, meeting Mirai made her realize that Aikatsu is about more than just winning or

characters.name: Maika Chouno
characters.description: A middle school second year who belongs to Star Harmony Academy's idol division. A cool and mysterious girl who looks dignified and mature. Maika has loved festivals from a young age, and is the type of girl whose blood boils when it comes to competitions. She passionately supports local soccer teams on a daily basis. With her agile dancing as her weapon, Maika has good reflexes and is good at taking action, but while reliable, she's also afraid of ghosts.

characters.name: Ema Hinata
characters.description: A midde school third year who belongs to Star Harmony Academy's idol division. A senior one year older than Aine and the others, Ema is a caring older sister figure. An energetic and active girl, she belongs to the lacrosse club in addition to being an idol. Her lacrosse skills are to the point where she is a candidate to be a Japanese representative. Ema is not only good at singing with a great sense of rhythm, she is capable of playing musical instruments. Casually attentive, she is good at reading the atmosphere.

characters.name: Kaguya Shirayuri
characters.description: A student at Moonlit Night Academy and the younger twin sister of Sakuya Shirayuri. Kaguya is a cool-type idol whose preferred brand is Moon Maiden. Along with Sakuya Shirayuri, the two are a part of Reflect Moon.

characters.name: Sakuya Shirayuri
characters.description: She is a student at Moonlit Night Academy and is the elder twin sister of Kaguya Shirayuri. Sakuya is a cool-type idol whose preferred brand is Luna Witch. Along with Kaguya Shirayuri, the two are a part of Reflect Moon.

characters.name: Chiharu Hachiya
characters.description: Chiharu is stylist in idol branch of Star Harmony Academy and also designer of Aine's brand. She's very gentle and relaxed.

title: SHOW BY ROCK!! STARS!!
description: All the top bands like Plasmagica, SHINGANCRIMSONZ, Mashumairesh, and more are back in Midi City for an epic encore. But it's not all fun and games. This all-star battle of the bands is set to feature their cutest—*ahem*—toughest competition yet. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Retoree
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm __Group:__ Plasmagica __Position:__ Vocals and Bass A girl from the Dog Tribe who is a total internet otaku and smartphone addict. She usually puts on a cool facade, but deep down, she is incredibly shy. Whenever a topic she’s passionate about comes up, she gets so excited that she starts talking a mile a minute. Online, however, she’s quite the barker. She has an aversion to "normies" (people with active social lives) and clothing store clerks.

characters.name: Moa
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm __Group:__ Plasmagica __Position:__ Vocals and Drums A naturally eccentric, high-energy space-sheep girl who arrived from a distant galaxy on a research mission. Her musical sensibilities are truly cosmic—unrivaled among the group members. She has a habit of blurting out whatever crosses her mind, which occasionally lands her bandmates in trouble. Her signature verbal tic—ending her sentences with "pyuru"—is apparently a communication code from her home planet.

characters.name: Chuchu
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm __Group:__ Plasmagica __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar A rabbit-girl who embodies the "beloved class president" archetype: an honor student who is both dependable and organized, as well as sociable and charming. She serves as the de facto leader of the band and enjoys the deep trust of her fellow members. However, she also possesses an ambitious streak—secretly, and without the other members' knowledge, she is aiming to make a solo debut. She practices the guitar without fail every single day and takes a very earnest approach to her music.

characters.name: Cyan Hijirikawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar A cat girl who cherishes a heart-shaped guitar known as [Strawberry Heart](https://anilist.co/character/153391/Strawberry-Heart)—a legendary instrument rumored to possess extraordinary power. Her guitar talent was recognized by [Maple Arisugawa](https://anilist.co/character/153403/Maple-Arisugawa), leading to her recruitment as a member of Plasmagica. Through her band activities alongside [Chuchu](https://anilist.co/character/88975/Chuchu), [Retoree](https://anilist.co/character/88973/Retoree), and [Moa](https://anilist.co/character/88974/Moa), she continues to grow and mature.

characters.name: Delmin
characters.description: __Height:__ 140cm __Group:__ Mashumairesh!! __Position:__ Vocals and Bass Devil Mint is a petite girl from the Oniryu clan. For certain reasons, she lives alone in an old apartment. She never lets go of her Onigiri Kumaman stuffed animal. Since she’s always pretending not to be home, she doesn’t have many friends. She excels at detailed work and games that require concentration. She’s a home cook, so she’s confident in her ability to cook perfect sunny-side-up eggs. She’s serious, cool, and studious. She can shoot beams from her horns.

characters.name: Howan
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm __Group:__ Mashumairesh!! __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar A girl of the pale fox tribe, born and raised in a small village in the northern lands. She dreams of one day heading to the big city in hopes that something wonderful awaits her there. Highly curious and always giving her absolute all, she struggles with numbers but excels at housework. She is good-natured, yet she isn't afraid to firmly say "no" to things she dislikes. Though she has a gentle, fluffy demeanor, she possesses a strong inner core and a fiercely competitive spirit. She loves to sing.

characters.name: Himeko Mashima
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm __Group:__ Mashumairesh!! __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar A girl from the Striped Cat Clan. Her striped twin tails are her signature look, and she has a great figure. She tends to avoid interacting with others. She loves music and has practiced playing instruments more than most since she was little. She’s strong-willed, stubborn, quick-tempered, but deep down she’s timid, sensitive, and prone to feeling lonely. Her grades are just average. Rumor has it she has a secret hobby she can’t tell anyone about.

characters.name: Ruhuyu
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm __Group:__ Mashumairesh!! __Position:__ Vocals and Drums A girl from the Wolf-Girl Tribe. She is bright, energetic, exceptionally healthy, and a model student. Devoted and overflowing with compassion, she enjoys the deep trust of those around her. However, she has begun to question the path her parents have laid out for her—a path she has dutifully followed until now. By her own admission, she is occasionally seized by an impulse to destroy everything around her; she struggles desperately to resist it, though there are times when she simply cannot hold back and ends up breaking things anyway. Rumors have even begun to circulate—or perhaps they haven't?—that she might be a bit of a "dangerous" girl.

characters.name: Crow
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm __Species:__ Hedgehog __Group:__ ShinganCrimsonZ __Position:__ Vocals and Guitar Fearless and utterly convinced—without a shred of doubt—that he is "the coolest and most popular guy in the world." His signature style features a raw yet razor-sharp vocal delivery that sends shivers down the spines of listeners. He hails from a dairy farming family and absolutely loves milk.

characters.name: Aion
characters.description: __Height:__ 192 cm __Group:__ ShinganCrimsonZ __Position:__ Guitar He has a suspicious demeanor and cannot speak articulately unless he strikes a specific pose—yet, he is incredibly handsome. He is rumored to captivate his female fans with the genius-level guitar technique he displays during live performances.

characters.name: Yaiba
characters.description: __Height:__ 174 cm __Group:__ ShinganCrimsonZ __Position:__ Bass He respects the spirit of rock and the way of the samurai. His self-proclaimed bass technique is top-notch.

characters.name: Rom
characters.description: __Height:__ 186 cm __Group:__ ShinganCrimsonZ __Position:__ Drums The band's leader, he possesses a fiery personality—one where his fists tend to fly before his words—and serves as the driving force that holds the members together. He successfully balances his career as a company employee with his band activities.

title: Princess-Session Orchestra
title_original: プリンセッション・オーケストラ
description: The anime takes place in Alicepia, which is a mysterious country that has existed since ancient times. The inhabitants of Alicepia, the Alicepians, are a fun-loving people, but one day mysterious monsters called Jamaock appeared to threaten the peace of Alicepia. The story follows a trio of "princesses" who never forget the song in their hearts, even when facing such danger and step up to save the day with the power of music. (Source: Anime News Network, Crunchyroll News, edited)

characters.name: Minamo Sorano
characters.description: __Height:__ 158cm A girl who is a little shy but tough at heart. She likes to cheer people on who work hard. Her mother taught her how to make sweets and she is quite good at it. She transforms into Princess Ripple.

characters.name: Kagari Shirube
characters.description: __Height:__ 163cm A second-year junior high school student, considered the singing diva of Alice Pier. Her extraordinary singing captures everyone's attention. She also has quite the sweet tooth. She transforms into Princess Zeal.

characters.name: Nagase Ichijou
characters.description: __Height:__ 154cm Minamo and her classmates junior, and Alicepia's promising newcomer. She's a sensible person and trusts her intuition and searches for sparkling brilliance. Her only flaw is that she often acts without thinking. She transforms into Princess Meteor.

characters.name: Natsu Hinomoto
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm [Minamo](https://anilist.co/character/337849/Minamo-Sorano)'s childhood best friend and they're each other's strongest supporters. She's always dreamed about being an idol, and works hard at it every day in Alicepia. Her special skill is songwriting.

characters.name: Naviiyu
characters.description: __Height:__ 30 cm Their job is to guide and support Minamo and the other Princesses. Their ears are sensitive to the presence of evil. They are said to produce a soothing scent.

characters.name: Callisto
characters.description: __Height:__ 180 cm Leader of the group Band Snatch who unifies the other members, but has an unseen eerie side. His hobby is tea time, and he manages the health of the other members.

characters.name: Giita
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Member of Band Snatch, who is a childish and moody troublemaker. He likes anything that gets him excited and his special skill is irritating [Besu.](https://anilist.co/character/351961/Besu)

characters.name: Besu
characters.description: __Height:__ 183 cm A member of Band Snatch with a calm demeanor and good judgement, but also a high-strung personality. His hobby is getting lost in thought and his special skill is sleeping while standing.

characters.name: Doran
characters.description: __Height:__ 188 cm A member of Band Snatch who is usually easygoing, but becomes violent in battle. His hobby is muscle training, and his special skill is knitting using drum sticks.

characters.name: Aka no Joou
characters.description: The master of Band Snatch. The "one who rules over Alicepia" who exudes a majestic presence that overwhelms those who see her.

characters.name: Sumire Kazahana
characters.description: A third-year student and library committee member who is Minamo's senior. She's gentle and demure, with a mature, womanly air! ~!Despite her usual kindness, she stands in Minamo's way as the Flower Knight Sincere. What is her true intention...?!~

characters.name: Riri Kazahana
characters.description: Sumire's younger sister, a fifth-grade elementary school student. A quiet, mysterious girl who rarely shows her emotions. ~!She becomes the Flower Knight Purity, standing in the way of Minamo and the others. The passion hidden deep within her heart—for whom...?!~

title: Maria-sama ga Miteru 4th Season
title_original: マリア様がみてる 4thシーズン
description: Life for the young women at Lillian Girls’ Academy couldn’t be more exciting! The Yamayuri Council is working on a theater production with the all-boys Hanadera Academy, and the school festival is quickly approaching. But Yumi’s duties pale in comparison to the task assigned to her by Sachiko: choosing someone as a petite soeur! Will she be able to handle the pressure of such a monumental decision, or will Yumi crumble under the weight of the Council’s — and Sachiko’s — expectations? (Source: Maiden Japan)

characters.name: Yumi Fukuzawa
characters.description: She is the main character of the series. In the beginning of the series, Yumi is bashful beyond words, very timid and unsure of herself. She first met Sachiko, the star of Lillian School and had her tie fixed by Sachiko, which mortified Yumi. Yumi's friend, Tsutako Takeshima, took a cute picture of this and wanted to display it in the school festival. Tsutako got Yumi to ask permission from Sachiko. Other characters often comment on how her emotions 'show on her face'. ~!After Yumi first meets Sachiko, Sachiko is arguing with the Roses in the Rose Mansion. The Roses say that Sachiko cannot object to their plan, as she did not have a petite sœur. Sachiko runs out of the meeting and knocks Yumi over. She asks if Yumi has a grande sœur, and promptly offered Yumi her rosary. Sachiko thought that if she had a petite sœur, the Yamayurikai could not force her to play Cinderella alongside a male

characters.name: Rei Hasekura
characters.description: Rei, Yoshino's grande soeur, appears very tomboyish and "bishounen" on the outside but is in fact quite gentle despite her appearances. Her favourite books are shoujo, her favourite word is "sincerity" and her hobby is sightseeing. She is involved in kendo, but obsessively cares about Yoshino and prefers the domestic arts, like cooking. In the first season, Rei is Rosa Foetida en bouton, and her grande soeur was Torii Eriko. Her petite soeur is Shimazu Yoshino. In the second season, Rei becomes Rosa Foetida. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kanako Hosokawa
characters.description: A big fan of Yumi Fukuzawa, who only made a brief cameo appearance in the second season of the anime. She is 178 cm tall, and referred to by Marimite fans as Denpa. She is presented as one of the girls who may become Yumi's petite s�ur. She is introduced in the fourteenth novel, Suzukaze Satsusatsu. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Touko Matsudaira
characters.description: A distant relative and fan of Sachiko. She arrives at Lillian during Yumi's second year. Touko is a member of the Drama club, and nicknamed Mechanical Drill by Satou Sei for her corkscrew pigtails. In the beginning of her first year Touko causes some strain in the relationship between Yumi and Sachiko. ~! However, it is apparent later on in the year that she may become Yumi's petite soeur.!~ (Source: Wikipedia) ~!Touko later wins the second card hunt when she half-accidentally makes Yumi uncover her card, thus winning the date with Yumi. She does so by basically asking Yumi to make her a petite soeur, and the recurring date practically ensures that Touko will become just that. In the same episode, we learn that Touko is also not the real daughter of the Matsudaira family, which made her the target for a lot of harsh words from the other close families. Despite this, her adopted

characters.name: Noriko Nijou
characters.description: A young girl with a fascination with Buddhist statues and art. She enters Lillian Academy (a strictly Catholic institution) by mistake. She has a fierce temper that contradicts her calm exterior and becomes Shimako's petite soeur as Shimako enters her second year. (Source: Wikipedia) In the second season, Noriko becomes Rosa Gigantea en bouton, her grande soeur being Toudou Shimako.

characters.name: Sachiko Ogasawara
characters.description: Prim and elegant, Sachiko has a rough side and a very sweet side. She is very protective over Yumi and cares deeply about her. However, Sachiko often has the same problem as Yumi does — she does not share most of her problems with her sœur, causing many misunderstandings. Sachiko is slated to marry her cousin and fiancé Suguru after she graduates. This has caused her some distress since, because although she initially cared deeply for him, he did not reciprocate. They now have a complicated relationship. Sometimes, Yumi must teach Sachiko how to live informally, for example, helping her select her first pair of jeans. Despite her sometimes stern appearance, Sachiko has her own share of insecurities regarding her relationship with Yumi, not to mention emotional insecurities rising from her home life; both her father and grandfather openly have mistresses, unabashedly dividing their time b

characters.name: Sei Satou
characters.description: The exact opposite of most of the characters in the show: loud, rough-around-the-edges, she loves doing what she can to push other peoples' buttons. She enjoys mercilessly teasing or being mischievous, conducting most of her antics around Fukuzawa Yumi. Despite being a non-conformist in the ranks of the regular girls in Lillian Jogakuen, Sei is one of the wisest and caring characters on the show. Though seeming to have a playful and laid-back attitude, she has experienced many tragedies in her life, especially in her second year. Sei is known for doing things at her own pace, and dislikes being pressured into making decisions and taking action. She took Toudou Shimako as her soeur while in her third year. Her relationship with the first year is seen to one of mutual understanding and selective support. Sei however has an especially close relationship with Yumi. Sei becomes a source of co

characters.name: Yoshino Shimazu
characters.description: In the beginning of the series, Yoshino is a girl who was very ill and cared for constantly by her grande soeur, Rei. Yoshino, however, is very independent and in some ways tomboyish, despite her sickly status and feminine appearance. ~!After her heart surgery, she becomes more energetic through out the series. !~ In addition to being Rei's petite soeur, Yoshino is also her cousin and next-door neighbor. Theirs is a somewhat rocky relationship, since Yoshino is eager to spread her wings, whereas Rei would like to protect her from the world's hardships. In the first season, Yoshino is Rosa Foetida en bouton petite soeur, her grande soeur being Hasekura Rei. ~!In the second season, Yoshino becomes Rosa Foetida en bouton. She has no petite soeur yet. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shimako Toudou
characters.description: Prim, proper and very beautiful, Shimako is the most admired of the first-years. She is the petite soeur of Satō Sei at the beginning of the story and later her successor. Underneath Shimako's quiet, mannerly exterior lies a surprisingly strong resolve. However, Shimako is perhaps the most gentle of the three girls of her year in the Yamayurikai. In the first season, Shimako is Rosa Gigantea en bouton, her grande soeur being Satou Sei. In the second season, Shimako becomes Rosa Gigantea, her petite soeur being Nijou Noriko. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kintarou Arisugawa
characters.description: A classmate of Yumi's brother (Yuuki) at Hanadera Academy, "Alice" Born as a male but assumes feminine manners, pronouns and has androgynous looks. Alice is a good-natured and lively young girl whose only issue is that her inner, feminine identity is at odds with her male biological body and typically virile first name, Kintarou. She is a great fan of Sachiko's, and dreamed to be born as biologically female to enter Lilian High School just to be Sachiko's petite sœur. She seems to be good friends with Yuuki, and as a member of the Hanadera Student Council, gets to interact with the Yamayurikai for their respective school festivals. Sachiko's decision to switch the player's genders in the schoolplay at the Lilian Culture Festival overjoys her Alice, since it gives the opportunity for her to act a female part.

characters.name: Yuuki Fukuzawa
characters.description: The brother of Yumi (born one year apart), he loves her very much and tries to help her in everything he can. He has good relations with the students of Lillian and is somewhat popular. At the beginning of the series, he did not empathize with Suguru, but Suguru invites Yuuki to stay over for new year's in his house; subsequently Suguru begins to perturb Yuuki by giving him the nickname "Yukichi". Yuuki becomes the president of the Student Council of Hanadera due to his neutral personality. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Suguru Kashiwagi
characters.description: The cousin and arranged fiance of Sachiko; in order that a trusted man inherit the Ogasawara company, their engagement was arranged, although Sachiko detests it and denies that he is her fiancé. (It is later revealed that Sachiko once loved him and had her feelings spurned, which resulted in her disdain.) First introduced when he is given the role of the prince in Cinderella: the joint play put on by the Hanadera school and Lillian Jogakuen. He has prestige in the Hanadera school since he is president of the Student Council there. However, by the time Sachiko reaches her third year, Suguru has already graduated. ~!He is gay, and has a crush on Yumi's younger brother, Yuuki. He is often seen in the company of Yuuki, taking him along on trips and gatherings, doting on him much in the way that Sachiko dotes on Yumi. He is very arrogant, and is especially disliked by Satou Sei, as both are o

title: Maria-sama ga Miteru: 3rd Season OVA
title_original: マリア様がみてる～3rdシーズンOVA～
title_en: Maria Watches Over Us 3rd Season OVA
description: Summer has arrived at last, and with it comes the promise of summer break for the students of Lillian Girls’ Academy. Sachiko and Yumi retreat to the summer home of the Ogasawara family for a season of rest and relaxation, but their rosy trip soon sours when some old friends of Sachiko’s unexpectedly drop in. These wealthy snobs turn up their noses at Yumi and Sachiko’s relationship — and if Yumi isn’t careful, her blissful summer at Sachiko’s side could come to an abrupt and tearful end. (Source: Maiden Japan)
