characters.description: Rei, Yoshino's grande soeur, appears very tomboyish and "bishounen" on the outside but is in fact quite gentle despite her appearances. Her favourite books are shoujo, her favourite word is "sincerity" and her hobby is sightseeing. She is involved in kendo, but obsessively cares about Yoshino and prefers the domestic arts, like cooking. In the first season, Rei is Rosa Foetida en bouton, and her grande soeur was Torii Eriko. Her petite soeur is Shimazu Yoshino. In the second season, Rei becomes Rosa Foetida. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Touko Matsudaira
characters.description: A distant relative and fan of Sachiko. She arrives at Lillian during Yumi's second year. Touko is a member of the Drama club, and nicknamed Mechanical Drill by Satou Sei for her corkscrew pigtails. In the beginning of her first year Touko causes some strain in the relationship between Yumi and Sachiko. ~! However, it is apparent later on in the year that she may become Yumi's petite soeur.!~ (Source: Wikipedia) ~!Touko later wins the second card hunt when she half-accidentally makes Yumi uncover her card, thus winning the date with Yumi. She does so by basically asking Yumi to make her a petite soeur, and the recurring date practically ensures that Touko will become just that. In the same episode, we learn that Touko is also not the real daughter of the Matsudaira family, which made her the target for a lot of harsh words from the other close families. Despite this, her adopted

characters.name: Youko Mizuno
characters.description: Youko entered Lillian during her first year of middle school. Despite coming from an outside schooling system she was asked to give the welcome speech for first year students. She is characterized as being calm but sharp with a mischievous side, in the manga she is described to be "lily" like. Her greatest day was seeing the Rose Mansion filled with ordinary students during the Bouton's card hunt. During Youko's second year of high school, Rosa Gigantea and Rosa Chinensis (Sei and Youko's onee-sama's respectively) tricked Youko into taking an interest in Ogasawara Sachiko. Sachiko, Youko noted, always walked looked like she was fighting internally with something. With an endless desire to help (or meddle, as Sei put it) people Youko took Sachiko as her petite soeur. She had Sachiko quit her after school lessons (or in the novel, hinted about it) and once scolded her for not expressing he

characters.name: Noriko Nijou
characters.description: A young girl with a fascination with Buddhist statues and art. She enters Lillian Academy (a strictly Catholic institution) by mistake. She has a fierce temper that contradicts her calm exterior and becomes Shimako's petite soeur as Shimako enters her second year. (Source: Wikipedia) In the second season, Noriko becomes Rosa Gigantea en bouton, her grande soeur being Toudou Shimako.

characters.name: Sachiko Ogasawara
characters.description: Prim and elegant, Sachiko has a rough side and a very sweet side. She is very protective over Yumi and cares deeply about her. However, Sachiko often has the same problem as Yumi does — she does not share most of her problems with her sœur, causing many misunderstandings. Sachiko is slated to marry her cousin and fiancé Suguru after she graduates. This has caused her some distress since, because although she initially cared deeply for him, he did not reciprocate. They now have a complicated relationship. Sometimes, Yumi must teach Sachiko how to live informally, for example, helping her select her first pair of jeans. Despite her sometimes stern appearance, Sachiko has her own share of insecurities regarding her relationship with Yumi, not to mention emotional insecurities rising from her home life; both her father and grandfather openly have mistresses, unabashedly dividing their time b

characters.name: Sei Satou
characters.description: The exact opposite of most of the characters in the show: loud, rough-around-the-edges, she loves doing what she can to push other peoples' buttons. She enjoys mercilessly teasing or being mischievous, conducting most of her antics around Fukuzawa Yumi. Despite being a non-conformist in the ranks of the regular girls in Lillian Jogakuen, Sei is one of the wisest and caring characters on the show. Though seeming to have a playful and laid-back attitude, she has experienced many tragedies in her life, especially in her second year. Sei is known for doing things at her own pace, and dislikes being pressured into making decisions and taking action. She took Toudou Shimako as her soeur while in her third year. Her relationship with the first year is seen to one of mutual understanding and selective support. Sei however has an especially close relationship with Yumi. Sei becomes a source of co

characters.name: Yoshino Shimazu
characters.description: In the beginning of the series, Yoshino is a girl who was very ill and cared for constantly by her grande soeur, Rei. Yoshino, however, is very independent and in some ways tomboyish, despite her sickly status and feminine appearance. ~!After her heart surgery, she becomes more energetic through out the series. !~ In addition to being Rei's petite soeur, Yoshino is also her cousin and next-door neighbor. Theirs is a somewhat rocky relationship, since Yoshino is eager to spread her wings, whereas Rei would like to protect her from the world's hardships. In the first season, Yoshino is Rosa Foetida en bouton petite soeur, her grande soeur being Hasekura Rei. ~!In the second season, Yoshino becomes Rosa Foetida en bouton. She has no petite soeur yet. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Eriko Torii
characters.description: Rei's grande soeur; one of the most well-respected of the Yamayurikai. She is very gifted and good at almost everything, although she is also enigmatic and eccentric. She has a large forehead, which Sei made fun of when they were young, which began their rivalry. She said once that she chose Rei as her sœur to see if anything interesting would happen. She often has friction with Yoshino, as the younger girl is jealous of her bond with Rei. Eriko has four older brothers. After leaving Lillian, she studies Arts. She hates the dentist above all else. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shimako Toudou
characters.description: Prim, proper and very beautiful, Shimako is the most admired of the first-years. She is the petite soeur of Satō Sei at the beginning of the story and later her successor. Underneath Shimako's quiet, mannerly exterior lies a surprisingly strong resolve. However, Shimako is perhaps the most gentle of the three girls of her year in the Yamayurikai. In the first season, Shimako is Rosa Gigantea en bouton, her grande soeur being Satou Sei. In the second season, Shimako becomes Rosa Gigantea, her petite soeur being Nijou Noriko. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kintarou Arisugawa
characters.description: A classmate of Yumi's brother (Yuuki) at Hanadera Academy, "Alice" Born as a male but assumes feminine manners, pronouns and has androgynous looks. Alice is a good-natured and lively young girl whose only issue is that her inner, feminine identity is at odds with her male biological body and typically virile first name, Kintarou. She is a great fan of Sachiko's, and dreamed to be born as biologically female to enter Lilian High School just to be Sachiko's petite sœur. She seems to be good friends with Yuuki, and as a member of the Hanadera Student Council, gets to interact with the Yamayurikai for their respective school festivals. Sachiko's decision to switch the player's genders in the schoolplay at the Lilian Culture Festival overjoys her Alice, since it gives the opportunity for her to act a female part.

characters.name: Yuuki Fukuzawa
characters.description: The brother of Yumi (born one year apart), he loves her very much and tries to help her in everything he can. He has good relations with the students of Lillian and is somewhat popular. At the beginning of the series, he did not empathize with Suguru, but Suguru invites Yuuki to stay over for new year's in his house; subsequently Suguru begins to perturb Yuuki by giving him the nickname "Yukichi". Yuuki becomes the president of the Student Council of Hanadera due to his neutral personality. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Fault!!
description: Shuichi belongs to the tennis club. There are only five members in total, but he enjoys his school life with them. One day, the situation around him starts changing when Shuichi gets injured in an accident. While Ai, one of the members, takes a good care of him, Mio, his younger sister, stays grumpy. In such an ugly situation, a big accident happens which changes the whole situation...

characters.name: Mio Sugiyama
characters.description: The younger step-sister of Shuuichi. They have an incest relationship.

characters.name: Ai Saeki
characters.description: The tennis partner of Shuuichi. She also loves him.

characters.name: Reiko Date Wingfield
characters.original: 伊達・ウィングフィールド・黎子
characters.description: Senpai of the main character.

characters.name: Rika Hayama
characters.description: The teacher adviser of the tennis club.

characters.name: Kei Matsuoka
characters.description: The tennis partner of Mio.

title: Tatakae!! Iczer-1
description: Nagisa is a schoolgirl with schoolgirl tendencies, waking up late, rushing off to school and meeting up with friends upon the way. One morning Nagisa comes across a woman dressed in a strange uniform who seems to stare at her, unnerving Nagisa. Later that day, whilst staring out the window, Nagisa becomes aware of a ball bouncing by itself which flings itself towards her window seat, shattering the glass yet not harming her... Turning back to the front she finds a gaping mouth bristling with teeth inches from her face and no-one else about. She screams and the world returns to normal with her standing and the centre of curiosity of her class... why did she scream?

characters.name: Iczer-1
characters.description: Iczer One is a gynoid created by the Cthulhu (also known as Cthulwulf), to be their guardian. However, when the Cthulhu were taken over by Big Gold, Iczer One was jettisoned. She arrived on Earth and somehow got wind of the coming invasion by the Cthulhu, now under Big Gold's command. She was therefore forced to defend the Earth against those she was created to protect. To do this, she needed a partner to help her use the Iczer Robo, a giant fighting mecha which is somehow connected to her (a connection so profound, that when Iczer Robo's arm was cut off, Iczer One lost the use of her own, corresponding arm).

characters.name: Nagisa Kanou
characters.description: Nagisa is an ordinary schoolgirl who gets sucked into the battle between the Cthulhu and Iczer-1. It begins with Iczer-1 whispering her name in her dreams. That day, she encounters a strange, pointy-eared blonde (Iczer-1) on the way to school, who disappears before she can point her out to her friend. From there, things only get weirder, as she suffers what she believes are hallucinations in class, and is accosted by her classmates on the roof of her school, all wearing strange masks with eyes in the mouths. Strong emotions are usable by the Cthulhu and Iczer-1 as a power source. Nagisa is a very emotional girl, and therefore her emotions could be harnessed into a powerful weapon. This is demonstrated when she is incorporated into the Iczer Robo and becomes enraged over the deaths of her parents. This turbo-charges the robot with enough energy to kill Cobalt. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Sir Violet
characters.description: Sir Violet is the mind-controlled Cthulhu leader. Despite the masculine name, Sir Violet is in fact female, as is the entire Cthulhu race.

characters.name: Iczer-2
characters.description: Iczer-2 is a thoroughly evil gynoid created by Big Gold specifically to counter Iczer-1. She pilots Iczer-Sigma, and refers to Iczer-1 as "big sister". Her powers and weapons are identical to Iczer-1 save for not being able to travel in time; the Iczer Sigma is capable of controlling floating mines and can summon a very strong energy beam from the sky. In the sequel "Iczer Reborn" after Atros' repeated failures to kill Iczer-3 and destroy the Queen Fuji, Neos Gold starts to realize that the only one capable of defeating Iczer-3 is another Iczer gynoid, and resurrects Iczer-2 to that end. However, Iczer-2 refuses to submit to Neos' will, stating her only desire is to fight Iczer-1. In response, Neos Gold tells her that by killing Iczer-3, Iczer-1 is sure to return to avenge her little sister's death. When Iczer-2 and Iczer-3 finally meet in battle, Iczer

characters.name: Big Gold
characters.description: The creature who controls the Cthulhu through Sir Violet. He also controls a large space fortress called Nova and through it emits electrical shockwaves.

characters.name: Cobalt
characters.description: Cobalt was a Cthulhu soldier, pilot of the mecha Delos Theta and Sepia's lover, killed by Iczer-1 and Nagisa. Delos Theta's only power is emitting flashes that cause large explosions.

characters.name: Sepia
characters.description: Sepia is the commander of the Nova and lover to Cobalt. She becomes the partner of Iczer-2 in order to operate Izcer Sigma.

characters.name: Sayoko
characters.description: A child whom Nagisa befriends in the midst of the conflict against Big Gold. Nagisa protects Sayoko and her injured mother from a vedim disguised as a police officer, using a bracelet given to her by Iczer-1 for her own protection. Sadly, Sayoko's mother is later transformed, becoming a vedim herself, and a regretful Nagisa is forced to destroy her to protect Sayoko. Sayoko later encourages Nagisa to fight during the battle against Iczer Sigma, and nearly dies when Iczer-2 attempts to crush her underneath Iczer Sigma's massive foot. Fortunately, she is saved at the last minute by Iczer-1. Nagisa often refers to her as "Sayo-chan".

characters.name: Narrator
characters.description: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

title: Soukou no Strain
description: In the distant future, mankind is divided into two factions: Union and Deague. They have waged a war against each other for so long that no one remembers when it first began. The backbone of the Union military is the manned weapons system Strain, while the Deague uses an unmanned version, the Tumoru. Sara Werec, the daughter of a respectable family, is a 16-yearold girl who attends Grapera Space Armed Soldier Academy located in the Cranial Solar System, where she is training to become a full-fledged Reasoner (a Strain pilot). Her brother, Ralph Werec, had been sent to the frontline 130 light-years away to accomplish a special mission when she was 11 years old, a distance that requires 400 years of objective time to traverse by even the fastest Union spacecraft. However, in accordance with the theory of relativity, this corresponds to only two subjective years (time as experienced by those within the spacecraft). The two of them had lost their parents when they were young and the bond between the two is very close. It is Sara’s dearest wish to be reunited with her brother. To do that, she must travel to the battlefield where he is. One day, Sara’s planet is suddenly assa

characters.name: Sara Werec
characters.original: セーラ・ウィーレック
characters.description: She begins a happy, well-liked and bright girl, the star graduate student of the elite Grabera Spatial Armoured Infantry Research Institute. Her parents, James and Annie Werec, are dead and she clings to the notion of seeing her beloved brother again. However, when her friends, her teachers and her Mimic are destroyed by none other than Ralph himself, she becomes a brooding, blunt, taciturn girl reduced to piloting unremarkable Gambee units. She appears to suffer from post-traumatic stress syndrome. Despite her defeat and disgrace instigated by her traitorous brother (which she escapes by cutting her hair, renaming herself Sara Cruz and transferring to another academy) and the bullying she endures from the bitter and confused Gambee pilots, Sara is completely focused on learning the truth. Her most precious possession is a musical pendant given to her by Ralph, until it is stolen (presum

characters.name: Jessie Iges
characters.original: ジェッシイ・アイジェス
characters.description: Lottie's friend, who constantly goes along with whatever ideas she has, but not without complaint. She is quiet, unathletic, and generally an unaccomplished Reasoner, but is part of the renowned Space Squadron

characters.name: Lotti Gelh
characters.description: A Reasoner who uses her status 'above' the common Gambee pilots to interfere when justice is needed. She has a sharp mind and a wide network of friends, the closest of which are called the Space Squadron, of whom she is Queen; she is most often seen with Jessie. Lotti is determined to have her Space Squadron fight together as a team, and she tries various plans to convince Sara to cooperate in this as the series goes on. However, before Sara becomes a willing member of her team, which Lottie describes as "as close as family, partners in life and death," Lotti must realize that she, too, should work as a team member instead of a dictator. She seems to question who Sara was, but doesn't know Sara's real identity. Lotti notices that Sara "fights like a Reasoner". She hates Ralph Werec because he killed Lotti's older brother during his attack on G

characters.name: Isabella
characters.description: A blue-haired Gambee pilot in Basion, Isabella has an inferiority complex about her bad grades and takes it out on Sara, whom she deems an easy target and who refuses to follow her lead. She shies away, though, in the face of Lottie Gelh. Isabella's arrogance eventually becomes her downfall; having failed to listen to a warning she was given about the behaviour of Tumors in battle, she is quickly ambushed and killed during her first real fight. (wikipedia)

characters.name: Emily
characters.description: Not to be confused with Sara's Emily. Ralph also has an Emily, although she is a real little girl rather than a doll or Mimic, and she does not assist Ralph in his Strain. She sees herself as Ralph's new little sister. She strongly resembles Sara's Emily, except wearing a green dress rather than a red one, and she has strange blue markings on her face and hands. As a member of the alien race from which the E.M.L.Y. was developed, she is personally aware of everything that happens to the doll Emily and has developed an affection for Sara because of this. (wikipedia)

characters.name: Lavinia Reberth
characters.original: ラヴィニア・リベルス
characters.description: The lowest scoring Reasoner of the Space Squadron in Basion Academy. Unlike the novel's Lavinia, who tormented Sara Crewe when she could get away with it, this Lavinia is instantly infatuated with Sara "Cruz" and tries many ways to get close to her and attract her, although in a running gag, somebody will always get in her way and spoil her plans. Lavinia also has the tendency to get carried away. This is at first comedic, but becomes tragic as it leads to the death of one of her comrades and the exposure of Sara's identity. (wikipedia)

characters.name: Carrisford Radofrics
characters.description: One of the two boys in the Space Squadron, "Carris" has blue hair and a fondness for Sara. She begins to open up to him when he reminds her of Cedie. Like Cedie, Carris is eventually killed by Ralph Werec, for which Lavinia blames herself. Carris is originally from Gall, but is much younger than he should be due to sub-light speed travel. His younger brother is now much older than he is and is the chief administrator of Gall. His name comes from Mr. Carrisford, the employer of Ram Dass (the namesake of Sara Werec's Strain) and an old friend of Ralph's, who was initially accused of stealing Sara's fortune but comes back to restore it. "Radofrics" is an anagram of "Carrisford", missing one R, as his namesake had no first name.

title: Inugami-san to Nekoyama-san: Nekoyama-san to Onsen Ryokou
title_original: 犬神さんと猫山さん 猫山さんと温泉旅行
description: Unaired episode bundled with the Blu-ray/DVD Box-Set.

characters.name: Aki Hiiragi
characters.description: Yachiyo's friend and Suzu's classmate who often serves as the straight-man trying to bring Yachiyo and Suzu's relationship back down to reality. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai: Kanketsu-hen 1
title_original: ラブライブ！虹ヶ咲学園スクールアイドル同好会 完結編 第1章
title_en: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club The Movie – Finale – Chapter 1
description: The first in a trilogy of Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai films that continues the story beyond season two and the OVA. Ayumu, Kasumi, Shizuku, Kanata, Emma, and Lanzhu enter the School Idol GPX in Okinawa. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Shizuku Ousaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'1") Shizuku Osaka is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of A・ZU・NA, a subunit under Nijigaku. She is a first year and her image color is light blue. Shizuku is a polite, level-headed and diligent First Year student at Nijigasaki High with a passion for theatre and stage acting. She is a prolific member of the school's theatre club and it often shows in conversations where her enthusiasm for the subject surfaces.

characters.name: Kanata Konoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") Kanata Konoe is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is violet. Kanata is always giving everything her all... even if it doesn't seem that way when she dozes off in the middle of conversations. She cares deeply for her little sister Haruka and will find a bottomless well of energy in matters relating to her. An ideal performance, for Kanata, is a stage in which she sleeps and her fans watch. She also has an aptitude for cooking and home economics. While she loves to be doted on and spoiled, she also looks after everyone in the club as a big sister figure.

characters.name: Lanzhu Zhong
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") Lanzhu Zhong is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of R3BIRTH, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her image color is rose gold. She recently transferred from Hong Kong and is fluent in both Mandarin and Cantonese. Despite showing herself as a charismatic girl, her unique personality tends to catch others off guard by how demanding she can be with them so that they achieve excellent results like her, which leads her to make questionable decisions and to treat people in a way that usually makes them feel insulted. Even so, she doesn't hesitate to seek every possible way to befriend others.

characters.name: Ayumu Uehara
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'2") Ayumu Uehara is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of A・ZU・NA, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her image color is light pink. She is hard working and believes that trying your best is the only thing to do. She is kind, sociable and wants everyone to succeed. Ayumu can also be rather clumsy at times.

characters.name: Emma Verde
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") Emma Verde is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is light green. Emma is from Switzerland and has eight younger siblings. She formerly attended the Y.G. International Academy. Emma sometimes speaks in simple Italian, implying she is from an Italian-speaking part of Switzerland. While she sometimes struggles to adapt to Japanese culture, Emma is a kind and pure-hearted third year who acts as a big sister towards the rest of the group who always provides a shoulder to lean on in times of need.

characters.name: Kasumi Nakasu
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") Kasumi Nakasu is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is pastel yellow. As Kasumin loves all things cute, her unrivaled love for idols is strong and inspired. With the goal to dominate and become number one, she's a sore loser when she comes anything other than first place, even to the point of sabotage or cheating. She hates the nickname Kasukasu (かすかす) which roughly translates to "just barely" or "not quite", and gets in a bad mood when referred to with it. You'll often find her scheming or thinking up new ways to ensure her own victory; however, these plans often fail or aren't as devious as she thinks.

characters.name: Yuu Takasaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Yuu Takasaki is the primary protagonist in Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club and one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is the manager, songwriter, and founder of Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her image color is black. Yuu is the budding school idol enthusiast of Nijigasaki High School, and is often seen with her characteristic thigh-high socks and twin-tails tips dyed green. She is Ayumu Uehara's inseparable childhood friend, having grown up as neighbors in the same apartment building near Odaiba.

characters.name: Mia Taylor
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Mia Taylor is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of R3BIRTH, a unit under Nijigaku. She is third year student and her image color is platinum silver. She recently transferred from New York and is fluent in both English and Japanese. Despite coming from a family of esteemed musicians, Mia would much rather prefer the life of a homebody and eat nothing but burgers. Mia is considered a 'music prodigy' by Lanzhu; she was an American college student before immediately transferring into Nijigasaki as a third year due to her skills, despite only being 14 years old.

characters.name: Ai Miyashita
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") __Favorite food:__ Nukazuke Ai Miyashita is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of DiverDiva, a unit under Nijigaku. Her image color is ultra orange. Ai has a "gyaru" sense of fashion, paired with a big heart and the will to help anyone with their problems. This makes her very popular at school and also as an idol. She is most commonly seen with Rina Tennoji, another member of the club whom she helps face and overcome her shy nature.

characters.name: Rina Tennouji
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm (4'10") Rina Tennoji is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is paper white, though often is represented with gray. Rina is a shy girl who says she is incapable of showing emotion on her face. She hides her face with the "Rina-chan Board", a piece of paper, notepad or electronic display on which she displays her emotions on. She is energetic, confident, and only able to perform when she has the "Rina-chan Board". Rina is very skilled with technology as she is regularly creating gadgets, using drones to shoot music videos, and makes an electronic headset version of her "Rina-chan Board" for use during performances.

characters.name: Karin Asaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'5") Karin Asaka is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of DiverDiva, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is royal blue. Karin is very mature and gives off a rather seductive vibe. She believes she is not a cute idol like the others and so confidently uses her more mature charm to capture an audience. Sometimes, she can be very petty and childish. She also has a hard time with directions and gets lost often.

characters.name: Shioriko Mifune
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Shioriko Mifune is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of R3BIRTH, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is jade. Shioriko is described as calm and academically gifted. She values Japanese tradition and has been trained in traditional dance and flower arranging. She has a talent for identifying people's strengths and weaknesses, and uses this to help students at Nijigasaki High School succeed in their club activities by offering advice. Although people are initially upset upon hearing her suggestions, they become thankful when it leads to them succeeding. And despite her somewhat stiff demeanor and lack of self-expression, Shioriko often yearns to connect with others, deep down.

title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha Detonation
title_original: 魔法少女リリカルなのは Detonation
description: The film will delve into the history between Iris and Yuri, and the tragedy of Eltoria's "Planet Reclamation Committee."

characters.name: Fate Testarossa
characters.original: フェイト・テスタロッサ
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ [Bardiche](https://anilist.co/character/220250/Bardiche) Fate is introduced as an antagonist and rival to Nanoha Takamachi, she first encounters Nanoha during the Jewel Seed Incident while collecting the Lost Logia known as the Jewel Seeds on behalf of her abusive mother, Presea Testarossa. Despite their initial conflict, the two develop a close friendship that evolves into a lifelong partnership.

characters.name: Nanoha Takamachi
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ Raising Heart Excelion. Strike Cannon, Fortress __Rank:__ S+ __Rank (StrikerS):__ Captain of Stars Squad, part of the mobile sixth division __Code name (StrikerS):__ Stars 1 In Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha, Nanoha Takamachi is sweet if naive third-grader. However, she has always felt like she is missing something in her life: all the people around her have someone there​ are very close to but she lacks this. However, Nanoha is no longer an "ordinary" third grader when she meets and helps the wounded ferret, who just happens to be a mage from another planet, Yuuno Scrya. He has come to Earth to gather the "Jewel Seeds," mysterious artifacts containing great power. Nanoha agrees to help him, but the task seems harder than presented when she meets Fate Testarossa, another girl searching for the Jewel Seeds. In A's, six months after the first season, Nanoha still remai

characters.name: Hayate Yagami
characters.description: __Intelligent Device(s):__ Buch der Nachthimmel/Book of Darkness (Storage/Tome), Schwertkreuz (Rod), Reinforce II (Unison Device) A sweet and gentle orphan who is confined to a wheelchair, is cared for by the Wolkenritter, who deliberately keep their battles hidden from her. She knows that completing the Book of Darkness would grant her immense power, but she refuses to accept that power at the cost of innocent lives. Unbeknownst to her, however, the Book is already feeding on her life force, causing her paralysis and slowly weakening her. If it is not completed, the Book will eventually consume her life entirely.

characters.name: Amitie Florian
characters.original: アミティエ・フローリアン
characters.description: Amitie Florian, also known as the Guardian of Destiny, is a character introduced in Mahô Shôjo Lyrical Nanoha A's PORTABLE -THE GEARS OF DESTINY-. Amitie is hot-blooded, but sometimes her efforts prove futile for her hot-blooded personality. It is revealed in the game that she is an android, in which is important in the plot because it signifies that she is not human. (Source: Nanoha Wiki)

characters.name: Kyrie Florian
characters.original: キリエ・フローリアン
characters.description: Kyrie Florian, also known as the Right Hand of Time, is a character introduced in Mahô Shôjo Lyrical Nanoha A's PORTABLE -THE GEARS OF DESTINY-. By contrast to her sister Amitie Florian, her personality is cool and cynical. She is a natural airhead. She seemingly has no problems showing of her sexuality, often being depicted with an impish grin when under dressed. (Source: Nanoha Wiki)

characters.name: Yuri Eberwein
characters.original: ユーリ・エーベルヴァイン
characters.description: Yuri is known as the Leader of the Purple Sky, which comes from the Tome of the Purple Sky. Mahô Shôjo Lyrical Nanoha A's Portable -THE GEARS OF DESTINY-: Born in the Ancient Belkan ages, Yuri was originally a human. However, due to a program written with the aim of overwriting the Book of Darkness, Yuri was turned into Unbreakable Dark, aka System "Unbreakable Dark" (shortened as U-D) until the separation by the end of The Gears of Destiny. Mahô Shôjo Lyrical Nanoha INNOCENT : Yuri Eberwein, along Stern, Levi and Dearche, is a student studying abroad in Uminari City. (Source: Nanoha Wiki)

characters.name: Phil  Maxwell
characters.description: Phil Maxwell is one of the main antagonist introduced on Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha Detonation. He is the chief of Planet Eltria Reborn Committee Ground Laboratory.

characters.name: Iris
characters.description: Iris is Kyrie Florian's childhood friend who resides in an old church on Eltria. She is first introduced in Reflection. Iris is a cheerful and obliging girl who cannot leave people in trouble unhelped.

characters.name: Signum
characters.description: __Nanoha A's__ Signum enters the story when Vita has attempted to steal Nanoha Takamachi's Linker Core (a mage's source of magic) for the Book of Darkness. Since the arrival of Nanoha's cavalry, Fate Testarossa and Yūno Scrya, Vita is cornered and Signum must come to her rescue with Shamal. The Wolkenritter overpower the TSAB troupe with their use of high-powered magical cartridges, and Signum manages to snap Fate's staff, Bardiche, in half. The battle ends with Shamal finally managing to get Nanoha's Linker Core and Nanoha breaking Vita's barrier. Signum refuses to take a bath that night for fear of Hayate seeing the injuries sustained in her battle with Fate. Signum may appear emotionless, but she is completely dedicated to Hayate, and as the leader of the Wolkenritter, fights for the others as well. The Wolkenritter attack mages to steal their Linker Cores, their sources of magic, to

characters.name: Vita
characters.description: __Vita in Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha A's__ Vita enters A's on a hunt with Zafila for strong Linker Cores to absorb into the Book of Darkness. She targets Nanoha Takamachi, which she deems to be a juicy target, unlike the usual TSAB "redshirts" which can barely fill up a single page of the Book of Darkness. Nanoha puts up a decent fight, but Vita tilts the deck with two cartridges (bullet shaped things that contain high-pressure magic) manages to overpower her, obtaining a power superiority so vast that she heavily damaged the Raising Heart. However, before she could get the Linker Core, Fate Testarossa and Yūno Scrya come to the rescue. Vita fights them off with her fellow Wolkenritter, Signum and Shamal, and they declare themselves enemies. The battle ends with Shamal finally managing to get Nanoha's Linker Core and Nanoha breaking Vita's barrier. ~! Vita fights for the sake of protect

characters.name: Shamal
characters.description: Shamal, being Yuuno's counterpart, does not actually fight, but uses her ring devices to defend, create portals, absorb victims' Linker Cores into the Book of Darkness, and the like. Shamal acts as the 'mother' of the group, doing the shopping, worrying excessively over the others' well-being, and constructing excuses to Hayate as to why they're out so often ("The grocery store doesn't have our brand of olive oil"). She knows that Hayate does not want them to fight anyone for her, but it is still no question that they must. Now in StrikerS She is A soft-spoken member of the Wolkenritter that specializes in defense and healing. She is a medical officer.

characters.name: Zafila
characters.description: Zafila is dark skinned, only male, member of Wolkenritter, Guardians of the Book of Darkness. He is, like Arf, able to transform into a wolf, and he was called Familiar many times, although he negates it, saying that he is "Guardian Wolf" of his master. When not battling, Zafila is almost always in his wolf form, because his ears and tail stays visible while in human form. Zafila is original counter part of Arf, Fate's familiar. Later, Arf teaches him how to change to "Puppy form".

title: Oni Chichi: Refresh
description: Based on the erotic game by Blue Gale. Join Kuranaka Sana, Akizuki Airi and her dad as they take a trip to the beach.

characters.name: Airi Akizuki
characters.description: The younger daughter. The main focus of episode 1 is on her.

characters.name: Kouzou Akizuki
characters.description: The male protagonist of the anime, who lust for his step daughters & best friends.

characters.name: Sana Kuranaka
characters.description: Airi's best friend in class. She was the first that got 'addicted' to the male protagonist.

title: Umayuru
description: The Umamusume are up to their usual hijinks—in teeny-tiny chibi form! Each 3-minute short in this miniseries is packed with silly fun, where you can't help but cheer ALL the racers on! Posted on PakaTube!, the official Umamusume YouTube channel. (Source: PakaTube!, edited)

characters.name: Symboli Kris S
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm An international student from abroad who is emotionally unaffected and quiet, and who places a high priority on efficiency and winning percentage when it comes to racing– she is often feared because of her "workman's" appearance, but she is obsessed with results in order to fulfill her duty to those who have been closely involved with her. She is obsessed with results... In other words, she has a noble spirit.

characters.name: Tanino Gimlet
characters.description: __Height:__ 166cm Get drunk on her aesthetic! Peaky Aesthetic God of Destruction. She has a unique aesthetic and acts in accordance with it. She has a strong desire to be swift enough to rule a mile, and the strength to dominate the middle distance, while showing off her overwhelming talent. Vodka always seems to look at her with a sparkle in her eyes. She's also a God of destruction, who kicks down fences to appeal to others.

characters.name: Vodka
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Headstrong and full of life! A roadster with a heart of gold. Dedicated to being the coolest, this Umamusume tries her best to act like a delinquent. She takes after her motorcycle-loving father, emulating his hobbies and attitudes down to the letter. Her grandstanding nature sees her charge daringly into any challenge, never afraid of what she might face. She has a bit of a cat-and-dog relationship with her roommate, Daiwa Scarlet.

characters.name: Daiwa Scarlet
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm Beyond arrogant! This hothead hates to lose. Unyielding, strong-willed, and cheeky, she wants to be number one at everything she does. She usually plays the role of the perfect, mild-mannered honor student, but the truth is that she hates losing more than anything else. If it'll help her be number one, she'll go through any training—no matter how grueling. She sees her rather showy roommate Vodka as both her motivation and her rival.

characters.name: Fine Motion
characters.description: __Height__: 158 cm (5'2") A sheltered lady excited to make memories that will last a lifetime. A lady of a distinguished family that is rumored to be royalty, she has come to Tracen as an exchange student from Ireland. Perhaps due to a sheltered childhood, she's very curious about everything, which can lead to some sticky situations. She hopes to make a lot of memories while at the academy.

characters.name: Air Shakur
characters.description: __Height__: 168 cm Always takes the logical approach! A brilliant but eccentric racer.. A rebel who only trusts the data she has collected. If she is winning a race, it is due entirely to her calculations and is never due to chance. No matter how many times she's calculated it, she comes up seven centimeters short of winning the Triple Crown, and is currently searching for any possible error in her calculations to prove that it can be done.

characters.name: Narrator
characters.description: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

characters.name: Special Week
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm Rar'n to go! A pure-hearted girl focused on her dream. Born in Hokkaido, Special Week is a bright and cheery, hardworking Umamusume. After losing her birth mother, Special Week was raised by her mother's friend. Now, she hopes to make both her moms proud by fulfilling her promise of becoming Japan's top racer. Though she may falter along the way, her indomitable spirit ensures that she runs ever forward.

characters.name: Silence Suzuka
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm The silent runner aiming to break the sound barrier. An Umamusume seen as a prodigy who's always ahead of the pack, both figuratively and literally. She gets so absorbed with running that she comes off as aloof, but most know that she is dedicated. She is roommates with Special Week and many find themselves attracted to her authentic personality.

characters.name: Toukai Teiou
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm Unbeatable and adorable! A happy hoppin' racer. A bright, bubbly Umamusume with a natural knack for racing. She's long looked up to the student council president, [Symboli Rudolf](https://anilist.co/character/140844/Symboli-Rudolf), and this admiration serves as her ultimate motivation in becoming the number one racer. Fans can't get enough of Teio's boundless confidence, and have lovingly dubbed her upbeat march the "Teio Step."

characters.name: Mejiro McQueen
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm The crown jewel of the prestigious Mejiro clan. A classy and poised young lady. Born into a family of racing legends, Mejiro McQueen is a long-distance runner who is the envy of her peers. She has class and decorum befitting her prestige, and is determined to take first at the Tenno Sho, like many Mejiro racers before her. On her days off, she enjoys having afternoon tea with the many other residents of the Mejiro estate.

characters.name: Seiun Sky
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Does what she wants, when she wants. As free as a drifting cloud... As one of the most easygoing girls you'll meet, she lives life at her own pace. But on the inside, she's quite the schemer, and her laziness is just an act to get others to let down their guard... sometimes. Her hobbies include taking afternoon naps and fishing. She also loves cats and is often seen curling up with them outside on the grass. She's classmates with [Special Week](https://anilist.co/character/125299/Special-Week).

title: Saki: Achiga-hen - episode of side-A Specials
title_original: 咲-Saki-阿知賀編 episode of side-A スペシャルエピソード 13話～16話
title_en: Saki - Episode of Side A Specials
description: The final 4 episodes of Saki: Achiga-hen - Episode of Side-A.

characters.name: Shizuno Takakamo
characters.description: Shizuno Takakamo is a first-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and the main protagonist of the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". In her elementary school days, she befriended [Nodoka Haramura](https://anilist.co/character/17275/Haramura-Nodoka) and together played mahjong in Achiga's mahjong club. She was the club's second best player before it was disbanded. Upon seeing Nodoka on television as the middle school individual champion, she decides to re-establish the club upon entering high school. Her goal is to go to the national high school team tournament and play against Nodoka. ~!Her special ability allows Shizuno to block other players abilities. The more tiles is taken from the corner of the wall, the stronger her ability is. Literary "the deeper players go in the mountains, the closer they to her territory". That's why she was cal

characters.name: Kuro Matsumi
characters.description: Kuro Matsumi is a second-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and is a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". Before the club was disbanded, Kuro was its number one player. She kept the room clean in hopes that someone would eventually return to the club. She is the younger sister of Yuu Matsumi. ~!Kuro's abilities are briefly commented on. During a match with Nodoka Haramura, Ako states that it was never possible to her to get any dora because they all gather toward Kuro. Because of this she has earned the nickname The Dragon Lord. The downside to this is that she can't discard any dora. If she does, Kuro will not be able to get a single dora for several games.!~

characters.name: Ako Atarashi
characters.description: Ako Atarashi is a first-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She is an elementary school friend of Shizuno Takakamo and Nodoka Haramura. She was the third best player in Achiga's mahjong club as an elementary school student. When the club disbanded, she attended a different middle school in order to continue playing and intended on entering mahjong powerhouse Bansei High School. When Shizuno re-established the club, she decided to return to the school. ~! Ako likes to play fast and has a good sense for the flow of the game. Ako is the most skilled player on the Achiga team but is overlooked because of the upperclassmen's special abilites. !~

characters.name: Arata Sagimori
characters.description: Arata Sagimori is a second-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and a protagonist of the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She is a childhood friend of Kuro and Yuu Matsumi; her family owns a bowling alley in the area. As a kindergartener, she grew up playing mahjong with adults at the Matsumi inn but stopped playing after her first year of elementary school. She is an admirer of Harue Akado and thus lost interest in the game after Harue stopped playing following Achiga's loss in the national tournament. When Kuro informs her that Harue has begun playing mahjong again, Arata agrees to join Achiga's mahjong club. She was assigned on the position of Achiga mahjong club president by Harue as most level-headed member of the team.

characters.name: Yuu Matsumi
characters.description: Yuu Matsumi is a third-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She is Kuro Matsumi's older sister. When she was younger, she wanted to join others in Achiga's mahjong club but felt it would be awkward because she was older. Yuu is very sensitive to the cold and covers herself head to toe when she goes anywhere, even in the summer. ~! Yuu's ability is that she can draw alot of manzu and chun tiles, so her hand is manly composed of these tiles. She also draws these tiles because she feels warmer drawing in warm tiles. As a result, her tile possession distribution is generally skewed toward the character tiles. When that playing style fails, Yuu draws in all red tiles and becomes difficult to defend against. According to Kuro, Yuu is just as good as she is at mahjong. According to Toki

characters.name: Harue Akado
characters.description: Harue Akado is the mahjong club coach at her alma mater Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and is a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". Harue was once known as the "Legend of Achiga" for taking the school to the national high school team mahjong tournament. After the team's defeat, she lost confidence and stopped playing mahjong for some time, leading to the team's eventual disbandment. She was later scouted by a professional team but returns home several years later when the company decides break the team up. ~!Harue's defeat in the national semifinal came at the hand of Sukoya Kokaji, who would eventually become a professional player and commentator in subsequent national high school tournaments in the main "Saki" manga.!~

characters.name: Saki Miyanaga
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") __Position:__ Captain Saki Miyanaga is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and the title character of the manga "Saki". She grew up playing mahjong with members of her family but came to dislike the game because she would lose her _otoshidama_ (New Year's money) if she lost and be scolded if she won. Because of this Saki, developed the ability to end her games with a net score of ±0 in order to avoid winning and losing against them. Over the years, this playing style became a subconscious habit, and she no longer attempts to win a mahjong match. After her parents separated, Saki remained with her father in Nagano while her older sister Teru moved to Tokyo with her mother. She eventually lost touch with her sister but is aware that Teru has become a top mahjong player in her high school. Upon entering Kiyosumi, Saki is invited by her

characters.name: Koromo Amae
characters.description: Premier member of the reigning champion Mahjong team, Ryuumonbuchi, and one of the most idolized yet feared players in the game. She is said to be possessed by a demon when playing; she even outranked a professional Mahjong player at a previous tournament. She is also the key player that brings an end to Kazekoshi's winning streak. She has a bad habit of wanting to crush her opponent's pride. ~!Her mahjong playing style pressures her opponents and her abilities can prevent them from reaching tenpai. This, together with the mahjong move she favors most, Haitei Raoyue or "last tile win" is a combination that slowly drives her opponents into despair. Haitei Raoyue's literal meaning is "to scoop up the moon from the seabed." Her abilities include being able sense when her opponents are in tenpai and the approximate value of their hands. She usually goes for big hands.!~ She is Touka's cousin

characters.name: Hajime Kunihiro
characters.description: Hajime is a 2nd year student at Ryuumonbuchi High School and is Touka's personal maid. A level-headed cool girl, she, according to Touka, is a strong mahjong player, capable of accomplishing almost anything that she sets her mind to: indeed, Hajime is a proven skilled player, capable of beating any regular player save the "monster" players, such as Saki, Koromo, and Takei. In the past, Hajime used lived with her Father, both of whom who struggled to make a living working as magicians: it is because of this occupation that Hajime is skilled in performing magic tricks, in particular, the "sleight-of-hand" trick, which she used when she played for her school team when she was younger: Hajime utilized her magician skills to make an illegal move, seemingly winning the game for her team. However, later investigations revealed the violation, causing Hajime's team to lose and Hajime herself to q

characters.name: Teru Miyanaga
characters.description: Teru is a third year student at Shiraitodai High School. Teru is Saki's older sister, who went to live with her mother when their parents separated. She has since become a powerful mahjong player, rumored to display fearsome powers. She used to play with Saki Miyanaga and the rest of the family when they were younger. Saki dreams of progressing to the nationals and finally reuniting with her, but Teru denies her existence. It is still unknown as to why she is mad at Saki. Teru and Shiraitodai have won the past two individual and national team tournaments, and aim to repeat both wins this year. ~!In the first hand of games, Teru almost never wins as she surveys her opponents with her Shoumakyou or The Mirror ability. With this she is able to see her opponents' innate abilities. However, after this she goes on long win streaks with the hands increasing in value. The momentum of her wins bu

characters.name: Sukoya Kokaji
characters.description: Sukoya Kokaji is a professional mahjong player and a supporting character of the manga "Saki" and its spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She provides commentary alongside Kouko Fukuyo during the East Tokyo prefectural qualifying tournament and the national tournament. She is also a friend of professional player Yasuko Fujita. Although she is a skilled player, Sukoya does not play in many ranked tournaments, thus her world rank remains at number 973. She previously earned a silver medal in a freestyle tournament in Rio de Janeiro and was a member of the national high school tournament champion team ten years prior. She is the youngest person to hold eight titles in mahjong and was seen on the way to winning a record eight titles four years prior to the main story. ~!During her national high school tournament championship year, Sukoya Kokaji who plays for Tsuchiura Girl's

characters.name: Kouko Fukuyo
characters.description: Kouko Fukuyo is a broadcast announcer of mahjong tournaments and a supporting character of the manga "Saki". She provides commentary alongside Sukoya Kokaji during the East Tokyo prefectural qualifying tournament and the national tournament. Kouko possesses an eccentric personality and is very passionate in her work; however, she often overlooks details during her broadcasts, leaving Sukoya to correct her from time to time. ~!As a middle school student, Kouko watched Sukoya win the national high school team tournament ten years prior and became a fan of hers.!~

title: Kimi to Idol Precure♪
title_original: キミとアイドルプリキュア♪
description: The main character, Sakura Uta, is a second-year middle school student who loves to sing. One day, she meets the fairy Purirun that has come to search for the Legendary Protectors, Idol Precure! Purirun's hometown, KirakiLand has been plunged into total darkness by Darkine, the boss of the Chokkiri Gang. Meanwhile, the sparkles of the townspeople are being stolen by the Chokkiri Gang... it's a huge pinch! "I want to make it sparkle sparkly! Here is my song!" - With this determination, Uta transforms into the Legendary Protector, Cure Idol! She sings, dances, and gives fan service, making it sparkle no matter how pitch-black it is!

characters.name: Uta Sakura
characters.description: A second year junior high school student who loves to sing! She's always full of energy and conveys her thoughts through song. Likes “kirakkiran-ran” things that make her feel sparkly and full of joy!

characters.name: Nana Aokaze
characters.description: Second year junior high school student and in the same class as [Uta](https://anilist.co/character/353001). She is skilled at playing the piano and is described as a kind and intelligent girl.

characters.name: Kokoro Shigure
characters.description: A first year junior high school student, one year below [Uta](https://anilist.co/character/353001) and [Nana](https://anilist.co/character/353002/Nana-Aokaze). She is a determined girl who is good at dancing and keeps a lot of enthusiasm bottled up inside her.

characters.name: Purirun
characters.description: A fairy that came from Kirakiland in search for "Idol Precure". She has a laid-back and relaxed personality and ends her sentences with ~pri.

characters.name: Meroron
characters.description: A fairy from Kirakiland. She has a playful and assertive personality. She loves [Purirun](https://anilist.co/character/353004/Purirun) and ends her sentences with ~mero.

characters.name: Tanaka
characters.description: A fairy from KirakiLand. He is the manager of Idol Precure and works part-time at Cafe Glitter.

characters.name: Kaito Hibiki
characters.description: A legendary idol who has been attracting attention all over the world and is loved by everyone from babies to the elderly.

characters.name: Chokkirinu
characters.description: Darkines henchman. Leader of Team Chokkiri.

characters.name: Cutty
characters.description: One of the henchmen of Team Chokkiri.

characters.name: Zakkuri
characters.description: One of the henchmen of Team Chokkiri.

characters.name: Makkurandaa
characters.description: The main monsters from Kimi to Idol Precure♪. They are summoned by the generals of Team Chokkiri using stolen Kirakira that originate from human hearts.

characters.name: Darkiine
characters.description: ~!The queen of KurakuLand.!~

title: BanG Dream! MyGO!!!!! // Ave Mujica
description: Sequel series to BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! and BanG Dream! Ave Mujica.

characters.name: Tomori Takamatsu
characters.description: **Height:** 155 cm Tomori Takamatsu is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and the vocalist and lyricist of **[MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)**. Tomori is a kind but sensitive girl who has an awkward personality. She has a tendency to stutter while talking and not make eye contact. She also tends to blame herself for the conflicts that happen around her, even if they weren't caused by her. She is infamously known as "Haneoka's Weirdo Girl" due to her peculiar personality. She likes collecting all sorts of things, such as band-aids (especially ones with animals such as pandas or penguins on them), slippery things, just-the-right-size things, and even rocks and fallen leaves that she picks up from the ground. She also likes pill bugs and has been shown often drawing them in her notebooks.

characters.name: Uika Misumi
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") In addition to being the guitarist, Uika is also in charge of composing and writing lyrics for sumimi's songs. She is quite popular due to her cool appearance. She loves stargazing. ~!Born as Hatsune Misumi, she is the illegitimate child of [Sadaharu Togawa](https://anilist.co/character/352933/Togawa-Sadaharu) and one of the Togawa family housekeepers. She was raised on an island by her biological mother and foster father, alongside her half-sister Uika. Upon arriving in Tokyo, she was scouted and debuted as an idol using her sister's name.!~

title: Geu Yeoreum
description: In a small Korean town, two 18-year-old girls, Suyi and Yi-gyeong, fall in love, dreaming of moving to Seoul together after graduation. Note: The series was compiled into a movie and released in theaters on June 7, 2023.

title: Oomuro-ke: dear friends
description: A spin-off of the Yuru Yuri series featuring Sakurako and her sisters. The second film of the Oomuro-ke duology. (Source: Anime News Network, edited)

characters.name: Sakurako Oomuro
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm She has a tsundere type personality and aims to be the next student council vice president. She and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Furutani-Himawari) are childhood friends.

characters.name: Nadeshiko Oomuro
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Sakurako's older sister. She's always quiet and has a cool demeanor. ~!Nadeshiko is dating a girl, whose identity is currently unknown; it is one of the main mysteries of the Ohmuro-ke manga. It is hinted that the girlfriend might be one of her three classmates –with whom she is on good terms with– after a phone call that revealed that the two girls visit the same school.!~

characters.name: Hanako Oomuro
characters.description: __Height:__ 127 cm Sakurako's younger sister who is an elementary school student.

characters.name: Himawari Furutani
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm A candidate for the student council vice-president. She has blue hair and large breasts. She always speaks in feminine and polite speech.

characters.name: Kokoro Ogawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 125 cm

characters.name: Mirai Souma
characters.description: __Height:__ 127 cm

characters.name: Megumi Sonokawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm

characters.name: Misaki Takasaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 126 cm

characters.name: Ai Miwa
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm

characters.name: Miho Yaeno
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm

characters.name: Kyouko Toshinou
characters.description: Toshinou Kyouko is the founder of the amusement club. Goes so wild that no one can keep up with her, but it's not as if anyone even tries in the first place, so it's ultimately no big deal. She is actually an otaku who creates her own doujinshi of Mirakurun, an anime character in Yuru Yuri. Her favorite ice cream is rum raisin.

characters.name: Akari Akaza
characters.description: Akari is a polite red-haired girl who is supposedly the main protagonist of the series.
