characters.name: Madoka Kyouno
characters.description: __Affiliation:__ Jersey Club, Pharos __Ovid:__ Vox Aura (Midori) The sole member of a Jersey Club who often helps out other clubs and people in need and is passionate about her home town of Kamogawa. She has a habit of saying "maru" (meaning 'circle', the kind used to mark tests) when she finishes helping someone. She soon discovers she has the ability to pilot a strange robotic aircraft known as the Vox Aura, which she previously encountered ten years ago when she almost drowned. She names this Vox unit Midori, after its green color.

characters.name: Laffinty Fin E Ld Si
characters.original: フィン・エ・ルド・スイ・ラフィンティ, ラン
characters.description: __Affiliation:__ Le Garite, Jersey Club, Pharos __Ovid:__ Vox Rympha (Orca) An alien who was sent to protect Madoka and the aircraft. She is not used to earth culture and often picks up terms from the strangest sources. She was initially unable to properly utilize her Vox unit as the knowledge of a supposed fate concerning Vox pilots caused her to become afraid. However, Madoka helps her overcome her fear and she becomes able to use her Vox unit, Vox Rympha, which she names Orca. She is jealous of Muginami, who shows a lot of interest in Madoka, which leads to her to join the Jersey Club and begin living with Madoka. Due to her luxurious upbringing as princess of the planet Le Garite, Lan has little understanding of the commoners' lifestyle.

characters.name: Muginami
characters.description: **Affiliation:** Jersey Club, Pharos, KISS **Ovid:** Vox Ignis (Hupo) An Ovid pilot who transfers to Madoka's class and joins the Jersey Club. Although she appears to have a slow-witted personality, she is actually sharp and perceptive and appears to have a hidden agenda, particularly concerning the memoria on Madoka and Lan's bodies. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kirius Rakus Lestrine Ha
characters.original: ラクス・レストリネ・ハ・キリウス
characters.description: **Affiliation:** De Metrio, KISS **Ovid:** Libertas A De Metrio Ovid pilot whose comrades are Izo and Array. Despite his serious appearance, he has a comical fascination with Earth conventions, from which he draws peculiar conclusions. He applies to work at BWH with Izo and Array at the end of the first season.

characters.name: Izo Sofiro Karia Los
characters.original: ソフィロ・カリア・ロス・イゾ
characters.description: **Affiliation:** De Metrio, KISS **Ovid:** Voluntas A De Metrio Ovid pilot whose comrades are Kirius and Array. He appears brash, but is actually a thoughtful person. Madoka's classmates think he's her boyfriend when he shows up at her school and demands to see her. He applies to work at BWH with Kirius and Array at the end of the first season.

characters.name: Array Danon Ci
characters.description: __Affiliation:__ De Metrio, KISS, Novumundus __Ovid:__ Teneritas A De Metrio Ovid pilot whose comrades are Izo and Kirius. After being defeated by Madoka early in the series, he reappears later as Astelia's maid, complete with maid outfit. Despite being relieved from his duty, he has continued wearing the outfit because he doesn't have a change of clothes. However, Astelia has given him a credit card so he is not short on money, which caused Izo and Kirius to question why he hasn't bought new clothes with it. He applies to work at BWH with Izo and Kirius at the end of the first season.

characters.name: Youko Nakaizumi
characters.description: Madoka's cousin, though Madoka refers to Youko as her sister. She is a marine archaeologist researching the Vox. She is a pillar of strength for Madoka and always supports her. She's also the former club president of the Jersey Club, whom inspired a young Madoka to follow her steps.

characters.name: Astelia Lizamarie de Rochefort
characters.original: アステリア・リーザマリー・ド・ロシュフォール
characters.description: __Affiliation:__ Novumundus The acting chairman of Novumundus. She has substantial influence as shown by her ability to bring U.S. President to tears over the phone. She is the person behind Lan's "woof" greeting; she tricked Lan into believing that it was a normal greeting on Earth.

characters.name: Souta Serizawa
characters.description: Youko's assistant marine archaeologist, who is researching the relationship between the ancient language and legend of the Vox with her. He appears to have feelings for Youko.

characters.name: Shouzou Tadokoro
characters.description: Affiliation: Pharos The commanding officer of Pharos. A bachelor who dislikes formalities like neckties.

characters.description: Affiliation: Le Garite, Pharos A mysterious and superficially polite man stationed on Pharos. He seems to know more about the Rin-ne flower than he lets on. His favorite food is pudding a la mode, which he enjoys mixing together into a soup before eating.

characters.name: Hiroshi Nakaizumi
characters.description: Madoka's uncle and the owner of the surf shop/restaurant "Be With Hiroshi" (BWH).

This was due to the fact that her previous partner, Kanade, lost her life two years prior to the series after a Noise attack at their concert. Even more so since Hibiki's Gungnir has the same wavelength as Kanade's. Tsubasa even refused to sign an overseas singing contract, as she viewed herself as a weapon who only sings in the battlefield. However, during the

Hibiki is outgoing, friendly, and overwhelmingly optimistic. She treats everyone with kindness, even former enemies. She doesn't want to fight unless she necessarily has to and wouldn't want to have pointless battles when she believes the problem could be talked about calmly first.

characters.name: Miku Kohinata
characters.description: Hibiki's best friend, who shares a dorm with her and is often concerned for her safety. Miku is helpful and cheery, but constantly worries about Hibiki due to the danger she frequently finds herself in as a Symphogear user. She has a hidden possessive streak towards Hibiki, borne out of a desire not to see Hibiki get hurt; even so, Miku does all her best to support Hibiki and encourages her to fight for what she believes in and help others, even if it's born of selfish desire, and so Miku works hard to make sure that Hibiki has a warm place to come home to. ~!In AXZ, it is revealed that years before the series, Miku had difficulty considering other people's feelings in general. She only cared about getting ahead of others and winning, and saw others as her rivals, wishing not to "see them from behind", like in her track-and-field races. However, Miku made an exception for Hibiki, with he

However, Chris actually hates the thought of hurting innocent people. ~!Chris wishes to bring about world peace by putting a stop to the flames of war; with Finé's manipulation, Chris initially decides to go about this by destroying everyone else with the power and will to fight and willingly cooperates with Finé in order to achieve that goal, under the false impression that Finé is working for the same goal of bring peace to the world as her. characters.name: Kirika Akatsuki
characters.description: Kirika is another one of the mysterious Symphogear users. Although she has a very straightforward, cheerful, and cooperative personality, she harbors a shadowy past as one of the "Receptor Children" who was treated as an observation subject at a certain research facility along with Maria, Serena, Shirabe and others. The bonds between Kirika and her friends are so strong that she feels no fear from fighting against the entire world. ~!She cares very much for her teammates and is willing to do whatever it takes to save humanity. Her relationship with Shirabe in particular borders on the romantic, and she is extremely protective of her. After falsely coming to believe that she is the reincarnation of Finé, Kirika became increasingly unhinged out of panic at the loss of her identity, to the extent that she's driven to attempt suicide when she realized her mistake. She uses "death" (デス desu)

characters.name: Maria Cadenzavna Eve

Although it has a mysterious quality, her vigorous singing voice has crossed over international borders and garnered a large number of wild and enthusiastic fans throughout the world. To bring forth justice, she has risen as an enemy against all of humanity, clad in a Black Gungnir Symphogear that is outside of the Japanese government’s control.

characters.name: Shirabe Tsukuyomi
characters.description: Shirabe is a quiet and reserved, yet passionate and stubborn young girl. She is fiercely protective of who and what she holds dear, particularly Kirika. She claims to not be good at talking to other people, so she intentionally avoids getting too close to people who aren't Kirika. ~!At a very young age, Shirabe was caught in a traffic accident that took both her parents' lives, and she was the only survivor. Due to that accident, she lost most of her memories and any documents that explained who she was. Shirabe was then kidnapped by the F.I.S. and placed in the White Orphanage, as one of the Receptor Children who could potentially host Finé's soul. Her current name of 'Shirabe Tsukuyomi' was given to her by the FIS, as Shirabe could not remember how the kanji of her name was originally read; AXZ Episode 9 implies her first name was originally read as 'Tsuki'. After the death of Ryōko Sa

characters.name: Sakuya Fujitaka
characters.description: One of the assistants of Genjurou Kazanari.

characters.description: One of the assistants of Genjurou Kazanari.

characters.name: Elfnein
characters.description: A girl from the world of alchemy who bears a resemblance to Carol. She comes before the other Symphogear users to provide them with a means of combating the Alca-Noise. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Tsumamigui 3 THE ANIMATION
description: Based on the erotic game by Alice Soft. Akito Natsuki decides to spend his one month long summer holiday in his hometown after his workplace closes down for renovations. With no money and nothing to do he decides to take it easy. At home Miyuri, his sister-in-law he was once fond of, and Sayoko who always treated him like her own son, were waiting for him. Akito tried to hide his feelings as always and acted out the part of the brother-in-law, but after a slip of the tongue his real feelings are revealed. Then his stagnant relationships with Miyuki and Sayoko start to develop again, and eventually he gets deeply involved with them. (Source: Getchu, English)

characters.name: Akito Natsuki
characters.description: A normal company employee. Bachelor, and has no girlfriend. As he lost both parents, his only family left is his older brother. For himself, he can't do anything seriously, but for others, he'll give his all. An extremely softhearted person. After his brother married Miyuri, the woman he loves, he quit university and left his hometown. He works with undivided attention to try and forget Miyuri, but even until now he still has lingering affection towards her.

characters.name: Sumire Jinno
characters.description: The priestess of the temple near Akito's home and the mother of Ai. She's an enchanting cool beauty who has a gaze which seems to see through everything, as well as a pair of bountiful breasts. A kind, doting parent who always prioritizes her daughter over anything else. She shows no mercy to any man who tries to come close to her daughter. Akito, the only person who Ai likes aside from her mother, is treated a little harshly by Sumire. She needs to give birth to a man who can succeed the temple. However, her husband left the house and his whereabouts are currently unknown. Considering her age, conception is difficult and may soon become impossible, so her back is currently pressed against the wall.

characters.name: Ai Jinno
characters.description: An honor student who attends a famous all girls school. Has good grades, excels at sports and has a face and figure with no faults. She's like the leader of her school. She used to play with Akito when she was young, but after she went to school and lived in the dorm, they haven't met even once. She hates her father who left her and Sumire alone.

characters.name: Miyuri Natsuki
characters.description: Akito's sister-in-law, and the woman he is in love with. A perfect housewife who boasts a gorgeous body as well as superb cooking and housework skills. She dotes on Akito so much, and was excited with their life as a family of three after her marriage with Kazuto, but she was saddened because it became a dream which can never be realized.

characters.name: Sayoko Asatsuyu
characters.description: An alluring widow who runs a small pub named Sango (Coral). Sayoko has looked after Akito since he was a child, and is like a mother to him, as well as someone who can fully understand him and his worries. She made love with Akito once to comfort him after he was deeply dejected by Miyuri's marriage. She thinks of Miyuri as a friend, but Miyuri completely sees her as a rival.

characters.description: An easy going man who fell in love at first sight with Miyuri. He works in an office. Has a huge penis, and have lots of sex friends as well.

description: During the Civil War, the powerful landowner Carson had a beautiful daughter with an innocent heart. As Faye enjoys an intense sexual relationship with her friend John and her servant girl Sophia, the end of her innocent days draws near. The mysterious Lord Mark has set his eyes on her and will stop at nothing to get her. (Source: Anime-Legion)

title: Cleavage
description: From the authors of Bible Black and Discipline comes this new OVA based on a game with the same name. When their father is given a transfer, Todo Yuto and Todo Erika are left alone. They are siblings, but they are not blood related. When Yuto was a child, his mother died. His father remarried a woman who, herself, had a child from a previous relationship, Erika. His stepmother was quite gentle, but she, too, has since passed away. Living alone, they begin to love each other as a man and a woman. However, an art teacher, Sayaka, notices their relationship and... (Source: AnimeNfo)

characters.name: Erika Todou
characters.description: Yuuto's step-sister, who secretly has a crush on him. She expresses it through jealously and teasing of Yuuto's "oedipal" attraction to his step-mother. Their relationship changes after an argument in which Yuuto complains that Erika is too absorbed in her studies and no good at household chores. She ends up offering to help him in another way by giving him sexual favors which he readily accepts. They attempt to keep to their relationship a secret, but others notice the change in the siblings. Among them is Yuhi, a fellow female classmate, who is romantically interested in Erika.

characters.name: Yuuto Toudou
characters.description: Yuto is a teenager who's parents both left, leaving him to live with his step-sister, Erika. With no parents, the two eventually indulge into sexual activities. Later, Yuto begins the same kind of relationship with his teacher, Sayaka. He then faces the challenge of deciding between lovers.

title: Battle Athletess Daiundoukai (TV)
title_original: バトルアスリーテス大運動会
description: Akari Kanzaki has just joined an all-girls academy in hopes of entering the University Satellite, an elite sports training facility. She wants to win the title of Cosmo Beauty - a title held years ago by her mother. It's not an easy task for her as fear, doubt and peer pressure get in her way, but friends, rivals and fans slowly encourage her to overcome her obstacles and become the best of the Battle Athletes. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Akari Kanzaki
characters.description: Akari is the very protagonist of this series. Tomoe Midou's daughter, holder of many unbeaten record and seen as a symbol for the athletes living in the satellite-university, she fights every day with the promise made to the mother to be able to reach herself the satellite and becoming Cosmo Beauty, one day. Akari is of weak nature, always ready to cry and surrender, although this part of her personality will evolve mainly in the last episodes of the series.

characters.name: Jessie Gartland
characters.original: ジェシー・ガートランド
characters.description: Jessie is the most talented athlete of the terrestrial nation. Born and grown up in an American ghetto, she had to take care alone of her little brother, seeing as both their parents were dead. Jessie has therefore grown up in poverty until her little sister's death, caused by an incurable disease. Since then, a black priest of a local church took care of her, and he nurtured her running skills, that she had always used to run from her chasers after the stealing she did for surviving. Thanks to that priest and a meeting with Tome Midou, Jessie starts dedicating herself to athletics, with the intent to becoming Cosmo Beauty. She feels a strong resentment for Akari, who she deem as too weak and unworthy of being the daughter of her idol. She also feels an innate but sporty rivalry towards Ayla Roznovsky.

characters.name: Tanya Natdhipytadd
characters.original: ターニャ・ナティビタット
characters.description: Birthplace: Johannesburg, Africa Height: 153cm She enjoys hunting and fortune-telling, and has a voracious appetite; her personality is described as willful. She is very childlike, hyperactive, and even somewhat wild, and would occasionally run on all fours like an animal. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.original: クリス・クリストファ
characters.description: **Birth Place:** the Moon Kris reveals herself as the most talented one of her class on the satellite-university. Like in Battle Athletes, she belongs to a small community of men living on the lunar surface: the Biginners. Such community lives in a profound symbiosis with nature, and refuses every kind of technology, preferring to live in harmony in an environment unpolluted. Kris, especially, belongs to a family of priests, able to feel spirits and talk with them. On the satellite-university, Kris shares her room with Akari and Anna, as well as Gyubei, her cow brought from the moon and whose milk Kris believes she can't survive. Her feelings for Akari are clearly of romantic nature, or rather, after meeting the terrestrial athlete, she is struck by love at first sight. In the last episodes of the second series this feelings are reciprocated. Furthermore, during those last episodes, the

characters.original: ラーリ・フェルドナント

Living together with beautiful girls while trying to break the curse starts an erotic turn of events in his life.

One day, when he is asleep, she secretly gives him a blowjob and has sex with him. Two years later, she gets remarried.... One night, he accidentally sees Junko and his new father having sex. Two years later, she gets remarried and begin a new life. ~!Later is revealed that she have feelings for Ryouichi and feels that needs him back.!~

title: Aikatsu Friends!: Kagayaki no Jewel
title_original: アイカツフレンズ！～かがやきのジュエル～
description: Two years after the Diamond Friends competition, Aine Yuuki, now is in high school, have a unexpected encounter with the mysterious idol Hibiki Tenshou who wears the shining Jeweling Dress.

characters.name: Aine Yuuki
characters.description: A middle school second year who belongs to Star Harmony Academy's normal division. She's good at making friends, and her goal is to make a million of them. Lively and positive, Aine has a kind heart that takes into account other people's feelings. She is from a large family, and they own the "Penguin Cafe" supported by their neighbors. Aine herself enjoys helping around the house. While a very ordinary girl, her encounter with Mio triggers an interest in idol activities. She serves as the muse of her own brand, Sugar Melody.

characters.name: Mio Minato
characters.description: A middle school second year who belongs to Star Harmony Academy's idol division. She is active as a popular idol and is the featured model for "Aikatsu! Style Times". Mio has excellent fashion sense, and demonstrates her talents by serving as both the designer and muse of her own brand, Material Color. While Mio is smart, earns good grades and is able to do anything, she has always felt that she's missing something. However, her encounter with Aine seems to spark something inside of her, leading Mio to invite Aine into the world of Aikatsu! (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Hibiki Tenshou
characters.description: Hibiki Tenshou is one of the main characters of the Aikatsu Friends! Brilliant Jewel series. Hibiki is a sexy-type idol whose preferred brand is Heavenly Perfume.

characters.name: Alicia Charlotte
characters.original: アリシア・シャーロット
characters.description: Alicia has fair skin and sharp, steel blue eyes. She has short, fluffy milk blue hair that loosely frames her face with a curled strand on each side and a braid of hair tied at the side of her neck, one worn over the shoulder. She has two, thin, knee-length segments of hair that loosely flow, and her bangs curve inward, overlapping each other. She is the princess of the Sorbet Kingdom, and part of I Believe along with Hibiki Tenshou (source: Aikatsu Friends wikia)

characters.name: Maika Chouno
characters.description: A middle school second year who belongs to Star Harmony Academy's idol division. A cool and mysterious girl who looks dignified and mature. Maika has loved festivals from a young age, and is the type of girl whose blood boils when it comes to competitions. She passionately supports local soccer teams on a daily basis. With her agile dancing as her weapon, Maika has good reflexes and is good at taking action, but while reliable, she's also afraid of ghosts.

characters.name: Ema Hinata
characters.description: A midde school third year who belongs to Star Harmony Academy's idol division. A senior one year older than Aine and the others, Ema is a caring older sister figure. An energetic and active girl, she belongs to the lacrosse club in addition to being an idol. Her lacrosse skills are to the point where she is a candidate to be a Japanese representative. Ema is not only good at singing with a great sense of rhythm, she is capable of playing musical instruments. Casually attentive, she is good at reading the atmosphere.

characters.name: Mirai Asuka
characters.description: One of the Friends, "Love Me Tear", who won the Diamond Friends Cup. She is currently a high school second year, and is an alumni of Star Harmony Academy. Sensitive to the latest trends, Mirai is a bright girl who loves social media. She often takes pictures of her everyday life. She is a fashion leader who enjoys a not only cute, but poisonous sense of style that strays from traditional rules. As an idol, Mirai believes that it's bad to be the same as everyone else, and constantly puts an overwhelming amount of effort in searching for individuality and originality. She serves as both the designer and the muse of her own brand, Milky Joker. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Karen Kamishiro
characters.description: She is a graduate of Star Harmony Academy and a second-year high school student. She forms the unit "Love Me Tear" with Mirai Asuka; together, they won the Diamond Friends Cup. An elite who received gifted education from a young age, she is also a quintessential "high-class lady." While she has a gentle and refined personality, she also possesses a surprisingly wild side; for instance, the sight of her smiling while triggering traps during an event set on Karen Island is genuinely terrifying. She keeps wild beasts—specifically a bear named Choco, a wild boar named Maron, and a tiger named Mocha—whom she refers to as her "cute friends." She also keeps various other animals as pets. Having consistently reached the top in various fields, she initially pursued nothing but victory in the world of Aikatsu. However, meeting Mirai made her realize that Aikatsu is about more than just winning or

characters.name: Kaguya Shirayuri
characters.description: A student at Moonlit Night Academy and the younger twin sister of Sakuya Shirayuri. Kaguya is a cool-type idol whose preferred brand is Moon Maiden. Along with Sakuya Shirayuri, the two are a part of Reflect Moon.

characters.name: Sakuya Shirayuri
characters.description: She is a student at Moonlit Night Academy and is the elder twin sister of Kaguya Shirayuri. Sakuya is a cool-type idol whose preferred brand is Luna Witch. Along with Kaguya Shirayuri, the two are a part of Reflect Moon.

characters.name: Chiharu Hachiya
characters.description: Chiharu is stylist in idol branch of Star Harmony Academy and also designer of Aine's brand. She's very gentle and relaxed.

title: ICE
description: By A.D. 2010, all men have died off quickly due to a dramatic change in the environment and an unknown contaminant. The population decreased to the lowest number ever seen...until only the women were left alive. They live huddled in small corners of a world mostly reclaimed by nature. There are those who accept their inevitable extinction and live a carefree life... There are those who try to continue on the race with the help of science... It is a society of constant conflict over their differences of principles and policies. The story takes place in the center of Tokyo. It is one of the places left for them. The conflict over the specimen of "ICE" and the chance it may provide to save humanity begins. (Source: AnimeNfo)

characters.name: Hitomi Landsknecht

She is a Kisuragi daughter, but not by blood, and has long brown hair in pigtails. When she met the captain of the Guardswomen, she immediately wanted to be friends with her, as she saw this as a change of fate.

characters.name: Julia
characters.description: Commander of the Red Roses faction of Tokyo city, who secretly obtains ICE in order to seek out a future for the human race through science.

characters.name: Kisaragi
characters.description: As head of the Kisaragi Family and the spiritual leader of the Black Roses, Kisaragi believes that both science and foolish men (now extinct) have directly caused the downfall of the human species. Furthermore, if the world is on a course for ruin, the remaining women should simply let extinction run its course rather than look for hope in the science that caused those problems--instead electing to enjoy what remaining life they have. Kisaragi herself is a product of a genetic experiment, and is half human and half jellyfish. She has pale skin, long white hair, and gills down the sides of her body.

Yumi's friend, Tsutako Takeshima, took a cute picture of this and wanted to display it in the school festival. Tsutako got Yumi to ask permission from Sachiko. Her favourite books are shoujo, her favourite word is "sincerity" and her hobby is sightseeing. She is involved in kendo, but obsessively cares about Yoshino and prefers the domestic arts, like cooking. In the first season, Rei is Rosa Foetida en bouton, and her grande soeur was Torii Eriko. Her petite soeur is Shimazu Yoshino. In the second season, Rei becomes Rosa Foetida. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Youko Mizuno
characters.description: Youko entered Lillian during her first year of middle school. Despite coming from an outside schooling system she was asked to give the welcome speech for first year students. She is characterized as being calm but sharp with a mischievous side, in the manga she is described to be "lily" like. Her greatest day was seeing the Rose Mansion filled with ordinary students during the Bouton's card hunt. During Youko's second year of high school, Rosa Gigantea and Rosa Chinensis (Sei and Youko's onee-sama's respectively) tricked Youko into taking an interest in Ogasawara Sachiko. Sachiko, Youko noted, always walked looked like she was fighting internally with something. With an endless desire to help (or meddle, as Sei put it) people Youko took Sachiko as her petite soeur. characters.name: Sachiko Ogasawara
characters.description: Prim and elegant, Sachiko has a rough side and a very sweet side. She is very protective over Yumi and cares deeply about her. However, Sachiko often has the same problem as Yumi does — she does not share most of her problems with her sœur, causing many misunderstandings. Sachiko is slated to marry her cousin and fiancé Suguru after she graduates. This has caused her some distress since, because although she initially cared deeply for him, he did not reciprocate. They now have a complicated relationship. Sometimes, Yumi must teach Sachiko how to live informally, for example, helping her select her first pair of jeans. characters.name: Yoshino Shimazu
characters.description: In the beginning of the series, Yoshino is a girl who was very ill and cared for constantly by her grande soeur, Rei. Yoshino, however, is very independent and in some ways tomboyish, despite her sickly status and feminine appearance. ~!After her heart surgery, she becomes more energetic through out the series. !~ In addition to being Rei's petite soeur, Yoshino is also her cousin and next-door neighbor. Theirs is a somewhat rocky relationship, since Yoshino is eager to spread her wings, whereas Rei would like to protect her from the world's hardships. In the first season, Yoshino is Rosa Foetida en bouton petite soeur, her grande soeur being Hasekura Rei. ~!In the second season, Yoshino becomes Rosa Foetida en bouton. She has no petite soeur yet. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Eriko Torii
characters.description: Rei's grande soeur; one of the most well-respected of the Yamayurikai. She is very gifted and good at almost everything, although she is also enigmatic and eccentric. She has a large forehead, which Sei made fun of when they were young, which began their rivalry. She said once that she chose Rei as her sœur to see if anything interesting would happen. She often has friction with Yoshino, as the younger girl is jealous of her bond with Rei. Eriko has four older brothers. After leaving Lillian, she studies Arts. She hates the dentist above all else. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shimako Toudou
characters.description: Prim, proper and very beautiful, Shimako is the most admired of the first-years. She is the petite soeur of Satō Sei at the beginning of the story and later her successor. Underneath Shimako's quiet, mannerly exterior lies a surprisingly strong resolve. However, Shimako is perhaps the most gentle of the three girls of her year in the Yamayurikai. In the first season, Shimako is Rosa Gigantea en bouton, her grande soeur being Satou Sei. In the second season, Shimako becomes Rosa Gigantea, her petite soeur being Nijou Noriko. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Sei Satou
characters.description: The exact opposite of most of the characters in the show: loud, rough-around-the-edges, she loves doing what she can to push other peoples' buttons. She enjoys mercilessly teasing or being mischievous, conducting most of her antics around Fukuzawa Yumi. Despite being a non-conformist in the ranks of the regular girls in Lillian Jogakuen, Sei is one of the wisest and caring characters on the show. Though seeming to have a playful and laid-back attitude, she has experienced many tragedies in her life, especially in her second year. Sei is known for doing things at her own pace, and dislikes being pressured into making decisions and taking action. She took Toudou Shimako as her soeur while in her third year. title: DISCIPLINE Rei
description: Based on the game by Active The hit series Discipline is revived with this new original story set prior to the coming of Hayami Takuro, protagnist of the first series. Morimoto Leona and Otokawa Saori are newly arrived boarding students at St. Alcadia Academy. Morimoto Leona desires to subjugate every person within the school, severely punishing those who are of no use to her. Even the teachers are not spared. Fellow boarders Yuuki, Ruri and Maiko, who are oblivious of the situation, fall prey to the limitless sexual desires of the male students.

characters.name: Saori Otokawa
characters.description: A classmate of Takuro's, she's the first person he meets when arriving at his new home. In the original game she is just an ordinary student living in the same dormitory as Takuro (though she performs all of the household chores willingly). The anime series makes her the caretaker of the facility as well. Another change between game and anime series is the afterschool club she's a member of. In the game she is in a Biblical Studies group, whereas in the anime series she is a member of the Paranormal Research Club. She is a kind person by nature, but has a strong will when required. She also has feelings towards Takuro, but has a hard time expressing them. Unlike most of the women that Takuro has met, she is not out to exploit him. Her closeness to Takuro makes her a target in Leona Morimoto's schemes.

characters.name: Reona Morimoto
characters.description: The Head of the Social Club who is highly respected and feared. With the fact that most students are in debt to the Morimoto Financial Group and her sister is the headmistress, she practically controls the school and will do whatever it takes to get what she wants. When Takuro arrives at St. Arcadia, she goes to great lengths to make him a member of the Social Club and to make him her personal sex slave.

description: The second in the trilogy of Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai films that continues the story beyond season two and the OVA.

characters.name: Karin Asaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'5") Karin Asaka is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of DiverDiva, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is royal blue. Karin is very mature and gives off a rather seductive vibe. She believes she is not a cute idol like the others and so confidently uses her more mature charm to capture an audience. Sometimes, she can be very petty and childish. She also has a hard time with directions and gets lost often.

characters.name: Setsuna Yuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'0") Setsuna Yuki is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was the leader and founder of the original group and is a member of A・ZU・NA, a subunit under Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her color is scarlet red. The name "Setsuna Yuki" came from the characters of a light novel that she read. Setsuna is passionate and headstrong, but kind and mature. She has a habit of taking on too much work and not wanting to burden friends with her problems. Setsuna has an unwavering passion for school idols and her raw emotion combined with a powerful voice is her charm point. She is the student council president of Nijigasaki High School.

characters.name: Ai Miyashita
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") __Favorite food:__ Nukazuke Ai Miyashita is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of DiverDiva, a unit under Nijigaku. Her image color is ultra orange. Ai has a "gyaru" sense of fashion, paired with a big heart and the will to help anyone with their problems. This makes her very popular at school and also as an idol. She is most commonly seen with Rina Tennoji, another member of the club whom she helps face and overcome her shy nature.

characters.name: Rina Tennouji
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm (4'10") Rina Tennoji is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is paper white, though often is represented with gray. Rina is a shy girl who says she is incapable of showing emotion on her face. She hides her face with the "Rina-chan Board", a piece of paper, notepad or electronic display on which she displays her emotions on. She is energetic, confident, and only able to perform when she has the "Rina-chan Board". Rina is very skilled with technology as she is regularly creating gadgets, using drones to shoot music videos, and makes an electronic headset version of her "Rina-chan Board" for use during performances.

characters.name: Shioriko Mifune
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Shioriko Mifune is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of R3BIRTH, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is jade. Shioriko is described as calm and academically gifted. She values Japanese tradition and has been trained in traditional dance and flower arranging. She has a talent for identifying people's strengths and weaknesses, and uses this to help students at Nijigasaki High School succeed in their club activities by offering advice. Although people are initially upset upon hearing her suggestions, they become thankful when it leads to them succeeding. And despite her somewhat stiff demeanor and lack of self-expression, Shioriko often yearns to connect with others, deep down.

characters.name: Mia Taylor
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Mia Taylor is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of R3BIRTH, a unit under Nijigaku. She is third year student and her image color is platinum silver. She recently transferred from New York and is fluent in both English and Japanese. Despite coming from a family of esteemed musicians, Mia would much rather prefer the life of a homebody and eat nothing but burgers. Mia is considered a 'music prodigy' by Lanzhu; she was an American college student before immediately transferring into Nijigasaki as a third year due to her skills, despite only being 14 years old.

characters.name: Kasumi Nakasu
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") Kasumi Nakasu is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a first year student and her image color is pastel yellow. As Kasumin loves all things cute, her unrivaled love for idols is strong and inspired. With the goal to dominate and become number one, she's a sore loser when she comes anything other than first place, even to the point of sabotage or cheating. She hates the nickname Kasukasu (かすかす) which roughly translates to "just barely" or "not quite", and gets in a bad mood when referred to with it. You'll often find her scheming or thinking up new ways to ensure her own victory; however, these plans often fail or aren't as devious as she thinks.

characters.name: Shizuku Ousaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'1") Shizuku Osaka is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of A・ZU・NA, a subunit under Nijigaku. She is a first year and her image color is light blue. Shizuku is a polite, level-headed and diligent First Year student at Nijigasaki High with a passion for theatre and stage acting. She is a prolific member of the school's theatre club and it often shows in conversations where her enthusiasm for the subject surfaces.

characters.name: Kanata Konoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") Kanata Konoe is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is violet. Kanata is always giving everything her all... even if it doesn't seem that way when she dozes off in the middle of conversations. She cares deeply for her little sister Haruka and will find a bottomless well of energy in matters relating to her. An ideal performance, for Kanata, is a stage in which she sleeps and her fans watch. She also has an aptitude for cooking and home economics. While she loves to be doted on and spoiled, she also looks after everyone in the club as a big sister figure.

characters.name: Emma Verde
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") Emma Verde is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She was a member of the original group and is a member of QU4RTZ, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a third year student and her image color is light green. Emma is from Switzerland and has eight younger siblings. She formerly attended the Y.G. International Academy. Emma sometimes speaks in simple Italian, implying she is from an Italian-speaking part of Switzerland. While she sometimes struggles to adapt to Japanese culture, Emma is a kind and pure-hearted third year who acts as a big sister towards the rest of the group who always provides a shoulder to lean on in times of need.

characters.name: Ayumu Uehara
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'2") Ayumu Uehara is one of thirteen members of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. She is a member of A・ZU・NA, a unit under Nijigaku. She is a second year student and her image color is light pink. She is hard working and believes that trying your best is the only thing to do. She is kind, sociable and wants everyone to succeed. Ayumu can also be rather clumsy at times.

characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Yuu Takasaki is the primary protagonist in Love Live! Playing men for whatever she wants, the young high school model has a great life until she meets her current fling's new neighbors. Instantly Chizuru, a girl who has never known love, falls heavily for the young female neighbor, Azumi Yamada. Chizuru, refusing to admit it at first, quickly comes to realize she must be with Azumi at any cost. Now living with her fake boyfriend, Hiroyuki, just one apartment away from Azumi, she puts forth every effort to constantly be around her crush. (wikipedia)

characters.name: Azumi Yamada

At first the friendly Azumi tries to be nice to Chizuru, only to be harshly rejected. Eventually though, the two become friends, although Azumi fears that there might be something weird about Chizuru. Azumi, who wishes to become a screenwriter, one day attempts to join the drama club. There she befriends a young, amateur film maker named Ryuichi Kobayashi.

characters.name: Sushiaki Karasawa

He quickly falls in love with her after recognizing her as a model. After a little effort, Karasawa is able to trick Chizuru into admitting she is a model, infuriating her. She then convinces Karasawa to let her sleep at his apartment for the night, where she enacts vengeance through teasing him to some degree or another throughout the night.

characters.name: Hiroyuki
characters.description: A young Japanese rockstar, living in his parents mansion (a large Japanese apartment considered to be more like a suite) and on their money, he was yet another fling of the beautiful Chizuru. However, when his new neighbors moved in with their daughter Azumi Yamada, Chizuru quickly claimed him as her boyfriend. Hiroyuki, realizing that Chizuru has a crush on Azumi, but truly believing that she loves him, has formed a plan to seduce and sleep with Azumi, ruining her for Chizuru. (Wikipedia)

After searching for the long-lost treasured sword for many years, she makes a deal with the Duke of Blankenheim, a member of a powerful family of the empire that holds information concerning the treasured sword. In exchange for such information, the Duke orders her to capture his antagonist, the hero of the Wales Tributory Alliance, Sylia of the Silver. characters.description: Great granddaughter of either Nakahito or Kamihito, Nako is a soft-spoken, shy, and clumsy 9th grade student at an all-girls school. She lives at the old Kagura shrine with her mother, Misaki (which proves even further that dark blue hair just runs in the family), and lives next door to her very rich neighbor and best friend, Uruka. Nako is also a very skilled cellist, and may prove to one day be famous. The day she found Kurumi was the day she gave her first kiss(es), and from then on was blessed (or cursed) with being the new master of Steel Angel Kurumi. Now being the receiver of the same affection that was given to her great ancestor Nakahito, Nako is constantly chased and protected by Kurumi. -Wikipedia

characters.name: Uruka Sumeragi
characters.description: Best friend of Nako until Kurumi came along. Uruka is in love with Nako, and had originally hoped to be the one to take Nako's first kiss. On the day that Kurumi appeared, she was the first witness to see the fateful kiss, to which she could not get over for an entire day. Uruka now sees Kurumi as an obstacle to Nako and will try anything to remove Kurumi, even if it means asking her father to call upon the family's private army to take her down. When they find that Saki is a Steel Angel, the family army decides to use her as a weapon against Kurumi, the "source of Uruka-chan's unhappiness." On the day that Saki was to be awakened, Uruka was there to supervise the process, but got involved in a fantasy of her own, involving Nako, and ended up kissing Saki. Saki then falls in love with her new master, and Uruka wants nothing to do with her. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Issho ni H Shiyo
description: Episode 1 The energetic Miyazawa Akina is a member of a softball team. She becomes drunk during the post-game celebrations, hops onto a train, and arrives at the house of her childhood friend. Episode 2 Takai Haruka is an obedient girl whose long hair really suits her. Today is the first day that she is visiting the house of her boyfriend, a senior at school. Episode 3 Tsuji Suzuran, from the Worldwide Maid Organization, completely messed up her assigned household chores. To compensate, she uses her body to satisfy her employer. Episode 4 One night, the protaganist's sister-in-law, Hamada Yui, returns home bringing along her friend Fukunaga Aoi. The two are drunk and create such a fuss that the protaganist is unable to study. He goes to complain to them, but they have other plans... Episode 5 Yuuki decides to pay a visit to her step brother. He left home five years ago and hasn't been in contact with the family since then. Yuuki is worried that maybe some woman has been deceiving him, or worse! Episode 6 You dream of being a farmer. So maybe your cousin on the farm can help.

title: PriPara 2nd Season
description: In season two of PriPara the story continues with Laala and her friends Mirei and Sophy, who are part of the "SoLaMi♡SMILE" PriPara idol unit, which is rising in popularity. In the PriPara amusement park, a new zone called "Dream Theater" has opened, and it's said that when a fateful five-man team filled with charm that performs there, a new event called the "PriPara Dream Parade" will be held. However, it is not known which five people make up this team, and the PriPara idols scramble give the greatest performance in the new zone. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Laala Manaka
characters.description: Laala has a bright and cheerful personality, and is often seen bouncing off the walls. As her house is a restaurant, she has a habit of saying her informal catchphrase Capisce! (Kashikoma!) when taking requests. Laala has a very loud speaking voice which she is very conscious about; when she is singing, she tends to be very quiet due to this. It seems that she can only gain the courage to sing loudly when performing in PriPara.

characters.name: Mirei Minami
characters.description: Mirei Minami is a 7th grader at Paprika Academy. When performing, Mirei has lemon yellow hair that is partly tied up to two buns at the top with blue and yellow ribbons. Normally she has short lemon yellow hair that looks the same as her performance hair minus the buns and ribbons. She has bright blue eyes. She also tends to say "pri" at the end of her sentences. She is smart and very good at puzzles. Because of this, she is captain of the displicinary committee at school.

characters.name: Sophy Hojo
characters.description: Sophy has apparently been working in the idol industry since she was very young. She is also very popular at her school, and admired by many of the students. When she eats a Red Flash (pickled plum), her personality - likewise with her appearance - changes. Her public personality is cool and on top of things, while her other personality (aka 'Fancy Mode') is extremely disoriented and directionless. It is also hinted that she has low blood pressure. While she is in her Fancy Mode, she says "Pshu~" a lot. In Fancy Mode, she is quite naive and oblivious to what's around her, but since forming her friendship with Laala and Mirei, she has been working on improving herself.

characters.name: Sion Toudou
characters.description: Sion Toudou is a 6th grader at Paprika Private Academy. She is the only known 6th grader in the series. She is an idol at PriPara, and is also a Cool type idol. She is voiced by Saki Yamakita, a member of i☆Ris. Her preferred brand is Baby Monster. She is the last of the main six girls to debut, as Dorothy and Reona made cameo debuts in Episode 11 and Episode 12, respectively. Her name (Sion) is based on seventh note of the Solfège scale. Sion is really good at a game called Go. When thinking that other things as Go, she succeeds the task she needs to do. She is calm and reassuring on the surface, but her roots have a hot personality. She is currently in the unit Dressing Pafé, with Dorothy West and Reona West. (Source: PriPara Wiki, edited)

characters.name: Dorothy West
characters.description: Dorothy is the older twin sister of Reona West and is of Canadian (her father) and Japanese (her mother) heritage. She sometimes mixes English with Japanese when speaking. Her preferred brand is Fortune Party.

characters.name: Reona West
characters.description: Reona is the younger twin of Dorothy West and is of Canadian (father) and Japanese (mother) descent. Reona is quite shy and would wither away if not for Dorothy. Often Reona follows whatever Dorothy does as an example, such as pretending to faint if she would or dislike someone if she does. This changes as the season continues and Reona starts to gain more confidence to do more without Dorothy and also becoming slightly more outgoing. Reona is relaxed and can easily calm others, most notably young children. This is emphasized by the catchphrase "(Tension) relax!". Reona is also shown to be quite feminine. (Source: Pripara Wiki)

characters.name: Falulu
characters.description: Falulu is a mysterious vocal doll who appears in episode 1 and later makes her debut as an idol in episode 17. At the beginning of the series, she is very naive and doesn't know a lot of words so she tends to repeat the words and actions of others (even copies Laala's and Mirei's catchphrases and actions). Her voice sounds slightly robotic, and she tends to call certain things (like the Prism Voice and Laala) sparkling. Despite not knowing what emotions are, she still expresses anger, fear and happiness. She is also very smart, being able to solve long equation problems within seconds. Episode 37 spoilers ~!After her re-awakening in Episode 37, Falulu's personality becomes much more human-like and vivacious and her speaking voice, as well as her singing voice, loses its robotic quality. She also became more responsible and worrisome since she now has 100 little sisters to watch over.!~

characters.name: Aroma Kurosu
characters.description: Aroma is a Cool Type Idol whose brand is LOVE DEVI (previously Holic Trick Classic). Aroma is a troubling girl who acts like a devil. She is also portrayed as an evil person who will do anything to achieve her goals, including petty tricks and sabotage if it suits the situation. She is portrayed as blunt and somewhat cruel, but she also cares for Mikan very much and values her friendship, even when she doesn't act like it. This stems from the fact that they have been together since they were really little and Mikan's presence is part of the reason why Aroma is the way she is today. It was later revealed that Aroma acts this way to overcome her original personality - that of a shy and quiet young girl. By acting like a devil, she has been able to become more confident. However she is prone to breaking out of character, in which she abandons her archaic manner of speaking and speaks normal

characters.name: Mikan Shiratama
characters.description: Mikan Shiratama is a character who debuts in the second season of PriPara. She makes her anime debut in Episode 39. Her preferred brand is Silky Heart, and she is a Lovely Type Idol. Mikan is a happy-go-lucky girl with a cheerful personality, who acts like an angel. Even though at first it doesn't seem like it since all she does is follow Aroma around, she has a strong and close bond with her. (Source: PriPara Wikia)

characters.name: Gaaruru
characters.description: Gaaruru is a Vocal Doll and Mini-Falulu that represents the negative feelings of girls who believe they can't become idols. Gaaruru can be considered a little terror when she first debuts. She's mischievous and a troublemaker and causes many problems for those around her. She's very disobedient and is unwilling to listen as shown with her growling towards and her biting those around her when they try to talk to her. Gaaruru also appears to not be fond of others and would always be by herself according to Falulu. She also doesn't appear to like idols as well as dancing and singing. ~!Later, after eating one of Sophy's pickled plums, it's revealed that Gaaruru had swallowed a "Spiny Bug" which turned out to be the source of her bad behavior. She then became a lot nicer and felt bad for the way she acted towards everyone and later stated that she was jealous because she couldn't sing and da

characters.name: Fuwari Midorikaze
characters.description: Fuwari is a character who debuts in the second season of PriPara. Her preferred brand is CoCo Flower. True to her name, Fuwari is gentle and soft. She is free-spirited and isn't afraid to go about things her own way which tends to cause trouble for others. She's a friendly person and seeks to befriend everyone. She can also be seen with sheep and goats, and in fact has one that is with her very often. (Source: PriPara Wikia)

characters.name: Hibiki Shikyouin
characters.description: A first-year high school student and the grandchild of one of Paprika Private Academy's chairman investors. Their alter ego in PriPara is the Kaitou Genius, who makes their first appearance in Episode 57 stealing Dressing Flower's PriTickets. Their preferred brand is Brilliant Prince. Hibiki is fixated on finding the "Best Princess" for reasons that are currently unknown. They believe that not everyone can be an idol, which, given the nature of series, makes them appear nihilistic and cynical. Because many of their motives are shrouded in mystery, this, combined with their cunning and manipulative personality gives them an overall shady character. Hibiki hates sentence-enders, and whenever they hear one, they freak out. (Source: PriPara Wikia)

title: Ane☆Haramix
description: Since the early death of his parents, Takami Akitoshi has lived alone with his beautiful elder sister, Hitomi, while concealing his dirty desires for her. One day, a mysterious girl named Mina enters his room. She introduces herself as Death and explains that she came to take his soul because he had reached the end of his lifespan. Hearing his screams, Hitomi runs in and, after the situation is explained to her, asks Mina to spare him. Mina, moved by her earnestness, tells them that if Takami fathers a child within a week, she will let him live another 10 years. Hearing her condition, he turns his face to Hitomi… (Source: AnimeNfo)

characters.name: Hitomi Takami
characters.description: Akitoshi's older sister who took care of him since their parents died. ~!After Mina comes for Akitoshi's life, she reluctantly (at first) chooses to become pregnant with his child to extend his life. Soon she starts to see Akitoshi as more than a brother and has sex with him more frequently.!~

characters.name: Mina
characters.description: Mina is the personafication of Death who has come for Akitoshi's soul since he has reached the end of his life. However she will give him an extension of ten years if he fathers a child within a week. ~! Despite having come purely for his soul, she soon develops feelings for Akitoshi and makes love to him, but is soon caught by Hitomi. However, they soon have a threeway together, both getting pregnant with Akitoshi's children. !~

Jokingly, he offers to show her what she has not seen, and one thing leads to another... Things get complicated when Shinobu Fukuhara, the class president and Igawa's childhood friend, gets involved because she likes him. And later even their teacher Susie Fujikawa joins the fun...

On the verge of death, Takuji (seemingly) uses the last of his remaining strength to take over the body of Mamiya Tomosane, his elder brother. She considers her classmate Kimika to be her only friend, though their relationship appears to be occasionally ambiguous. ~!After constant bullying, she is completely driven to the brink of insanity, coming to believe that she is the reincarnation of an angel warrior sent to save the world. Tsukikawa Usami and Mizuo Ayumi who've gone through similar experiences as her claim that to get their angel powers back, they must have a near-death experience. characters.name: Asagi Igawa

She is generally calm and reserved but can hyperfocus on certain interests, sometimes becoming oblivious to how others would react to them. She often bikes and walks distances of 10s of kilometers, which she considers average.

She is a troublesome, laid-back person, and calls it a "hassle" when she talks about school rules. However, she's still strict while at the academy, and enacts calm and quick judgment without hesitation on the battlefield. Her fighting prowess is astounding and for that reason, any organization that opposes Gehenna is more afraid of her than anyone else from the Prefect Team.

characters.name: Yuuka Hayase

Yuuka has a mathematical acumen that is notable even among Millennium's high ratio of STEM students. She oversees the entirety of Millennium's budget. Her special talent is the abacus, and she has a habit of fiddling with the beads when dealing with emotional or mental conflicts.

She is good at cooking and housekeeping, and loves eating. As a Hero, Fuu wields a large greatsword. The size of her blade allows her to use it as a shield just as often as a sword. She can also use the power of her fairy, Inugami, to increase her sword's size and attack a wide area.

After searching for the long-lost treasured sword for many years, she makes a deal with the Duke of Blankenheim, a member of a powerful family of the empire that holds information concerning the treasured sword. In exchange for such information, the Duke orders her to capture his antagonist, the hero of the Wales Tributory Alliance, Sylia of the Silver. A catastrophic dilemma falls upon Sara as a result of this.

Thought to be the strongest knight in the galaxy, her skills as a knight surpass even Hans and Sara. The daughter of the powerful Bernstein noble family of Wales. She was forced to serve as general to protect the land of Wales. The lords of Wales don’t have territorial ambitions, and only wish for Wales’s safety. However, the Duke of Blankenheim believed that to be weak, and is the cause of him having his own territorial ambitions. Sylia realized this and began to plan to counter-attack the Duke of Blankenheim. During this time, though, the pirate Sara appeared before her.

title: Massara
description: Massara is an original short inspired from the song of the same name "Massara" by Kiyoe Yoshioka (of Ikimono-gakari). The song is Yoshioka's first solo single. The short is directed by Keita Nagahara, and animated by the studio ENISHIYA Inc. The anime's story centers on a singer-songwriter, Nazuna, who is about to stop chasing her dream, and a very shy girl, Yuna. They meet and influence each other to create their own future. (Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Idol Project
title_original: アイドルプロジェクト
description: Mimu Emilton is a cute fourteen-year-old who has come to the annual Starland Festival to become an idol, just like her role model, Yuri. It is the most celebrated event on a united Earth, and Yuri, now the President of Earth, has encouraged people to join the ranks of Excellent Idols. Unfortunately for Mimu, she can never seem to make it to her audition on time, as misadventure after misadventure lands her in situations (usually involving undergarment exposure, I might add) that she escapes with the help of the current Excellent Idols, whom she befriends. Just as she makes her place on the stage and begins her audition, though, an unknown group of aliens kidnaps her and the Excellent Idols. It is only the beginning of a wild interdimensional goose-chase that places Mimu in the position to save the world, if only she can believe in herself. (Source: AnimeNfo)

characters.name: Palpu Ranrang
characters.description: Palpu Ranrang (Palpurin for short) is an energetic 13-year-old martial arts expert with her own superhero show. Although she appears extremely tough, she has unusual soft spots, especially for her guitar (which she cannot sleep without) and Mimu, whom she believes to have extraordinary talent. Her advice for aspiring idols is "Guts!".

title: Renketsu Houshiki
description: Episode 1 Hold Keisuke's father has informed his mother as well as Keisuke and Misaki that he has been diagnosed with cancer. And so, Keisuke announces that he wishes to inherit the family's liquor business and be married to the daughter of his father's former colleague. However, Keisuke's sister Misaki does not give her blessing to the marriage. They are more than siblings. The both of them cross the threshold and make love all night and on the day that Keisuke's fiancé's family comes to meet with them. Misaki shows her desire for Keisuke and they mutually surrender themselves to each others' flesh. Keisuke must choose between a normal and successful life, or to follow his desires and submit himself to their forbidden relationship. (Source: BoxTorrents) Episode 2 School Episode 3 Blind

characters.name: Saki Miyanaga
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") __Position:__ Captain Saki Miyanaga is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and the title character of the manga "Saki". She grew up playing mahjong with members of her family but came to dislike the game because she would lose her _otoshidama_ (New Year's money) if she lost and be scolded if she won. Because of this Saki, developed the ability to end her games with a net score of ±0 in order to avoid winning and losing against them. Over the years, this playing style became a subconscious habit, and she no longer attempts to win a mahjong match. After her parents separated, Saki remained with her father in Nagano while her older sister Teru moved to Tokyo with her mother. She eventually lost touch with her sister but is aware that Teru has become a top mahjong player in her high school. Upon entering Kiyosumi, Saki is invited by her

characters.name: Nodoka Haramura
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") __Position:__ Vice captain Nodoka Haramura is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and a protagonist in the manga "Saki". She is also a supporting character in the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She has played online mahjong since a young girl and develops a eventually passion for it. Her father, who works as an attorney, disapproves of Nodoka's interest but does not prohibit it. Because of her mother's work assignment, her family usually moves to a different city every two to three years. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 原邑和加 instead

She is highly skilled, though cannot stay focused and makes more mistakes as the game progresses, so she is made the first to play at the mahjong tournament. She is often seen eating tacos, which increases her skill when playing mahjong. Additionally, food with names similar to tacos, like takoyaki can increase her skill partially as well. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 片丘優季 instead

characters.name: Mihoko Fukuji
characters.description: A third year student serving as the Captain of the Kazekoshi Mahjong Club as well as being the team's ace player. She has a very kind nature, being nice to everyone she meets regardless of who they may be; her kindness extends even to the point where she offers Yuuki, an opposing player from the contending school team, Kiyosumi, her bento so that she would calm down. She even becomes very teary when her teammates help her out, as she feels that it was her fault that her teammates had to work in her place because it was her responsibility. She has been revealed to be very ineffective when working with technology. ~!She keeps her right eye closed to hide her heterochromia from others; while her left eye is reddish-gold, her right eye is actually sapphire blue. She never opens her right eye unless confronted with a dire situation during a Mahjong game. With both eyes open, she is shown to a

characters.name: Touka Ryuumonbuchi
characters.description: One of Ryuumonbuchi's four heavenly kings. characters.name: Kana Ikeda
characters.description: Despite being a 2nd year, she is strong enough to be the clubs No 2. She loves and respects Mihoko so much, that she is prepared to give everything she has to win the prefectural preliminaries, occurring as they do in Mihoko's last season. Although her drive and focus to win can sometimes get in the way of her caring for others.

characters.name: Kaori Senoo
characters.description: Joined Tsuruga Academy's Mahjong Club as its fifth member. Although she is a novice at the game, by joining, it allowed the club to participate in the inter-high tournament.

characters.name: Momoko Touyoko
characters.description: Momoko is Yumi's friend, and a high school first year student. She has a lacking presence, and is often ignored by her friends despite her efforts to gain attention; as such, she soon gave up on building relationships with other people. After a match through LAN mahjong, Yumi acknowledges Momoko's skills and finds her; the two become friends afterwards. Her mahjong playing ability comes when she augments her negative presence into an advantageous stealth state, causing her opponents to miss her moves. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yumi Kajiki
characters.description: A third year student and captain of the Tsuruga Academy Mahjong team. She is a calm and very determined girl, an aspect that has shown itself in and outside of Mahjong. She is a very skilled Mahjong player, able to not only hold her own against both Saki and Koromo but she was even able to counter the former; she was able to figure out Saki's strategy within two Hands and counter her perfectly. Whilst she herself deemed that one moment as pure luck, she is shown to be a strategic player. She, like Hisa, is also able to grasp concepts at a fast pace, picking up on subtle things that others wouldn't notice immediately.

characters.name: Satomi Kanbara
characters.description: She is the president of Tsuruga's mahjong club. She is known for saying "Wahaha!" often.

characters.name: Mutsuki Tsuyama
characters.description: A member of Tsuruga's mahjong team. She was one of the members who played online with Satomi and Yumi when they found Momoko through the school's network. She is a serious player and a serious person. She later becomes the president of the mahjong team as both Yumi and Satomi are in their third year and will graduate.

description: After ten years of dormancy, Linia awakes from a capsule in the countryside of Japan. Without any memories, she wanders into a small research center staffed by three beautiful women. One of the researchers, Sayako, is entranced by the strange woman and leaves her present lover. Sayako takes Linea to bed, and finds that her abilities are beyond that of any ordinary woman. (Source: Anime News Network)

description: It's now winter in Kamakura. When Satsuki tells her friends that she'd seen Manatsu, Ichika at first doesn't believe it. But on the day before her 15th birthday, Manatsu's mirror fragment inside Ichika's desk drawer mysteriously disappears. That evening, a young girl calling herself "Mafuyu, Manatsu's identical twin" appears before Ichika with a mischievous smirk on her face. (Source: AniDB)

characters.name: Manatsu Kuroki
characters.description: __Height:__ 142 cm A young girl that [Ichika](https://anilist.co/character/2869) met in dreams and a mirror. Manatsu seems to be the polar opposite of Ichika in terms of personality. When Ichika is hesitant, Manatsu is carefree and assertive; where the former is reserved, the latter is cheerfully outgoing. She also has striking similarities to Ichika, namely, she knows and loves many of the same things Ichika does, and she shares the same fear of ghosts.

characters.name: Satsuki Takigawa
characters.description: Ichika introduces her friend Satsuki as "a very responsible and strong person. You can always count on her." She is a brash young girl who often takes the lead of Ichika and the other friends. A painful memory causes her to avoid most boys, despite her seemingly strong personality. Satsuki has an older brother, with whom she apparently gets along well, despite the fact that they bicker a fair bit. * Date of birth: 1990-05-20 * Height: 151cm * Blood type: B * Clubs: Basketball Club Satsuki appears to be jealous of Keiko's interest in a boy. She gets depressed after seeing Keiko kissing a boy she meets during a festival. However, during the course of the series, it is revealed that Satsuki may be secretly in love with Keiko, and her jealousy was not because she lost the boy to Keiko, but because she lost Keiko to that boy.

characters.name: Keiko Takamura
characters.description: Ichika describes her friend Keiko as "a proper young lady from a good family, gentle and kind." She is the type who is easily amused by simple things, such as shaking a duster in a sunbeam. Her parents appear to be rather controlling, however, which causes Keiko some distress with regards to a boy she liked. * Date of birth: 1990-12-09 * Height: 148cm * Blood type: O * Clubs: Baton Club It seems that the relationship between Keiko and Satsuki are tested throughout the series, and it is implied that Keiko is aware of Satsuki's feelings for her.

characters.name: Michiru Munakata
characters.description: __Clubs:__ Reading Club __Height:__ 145 cm [Ichika](https://anilist.co/character/2869/Tachibana-Ichika) says of her friend Michiru, "She's really into literature, and her instincts are amazingly sharp." She can allegedly see ghosts and spirits, and is a quiet, if not shy, person. Michiru has a younger sister named [Rui](https://anilist.co/character/77987/Munakata-Rui), of whose feelings she appears to be rather protective. Michiru is prone to making slightly odd comments and is not prepared to go into the sea, possibly due to some physical intolerance, although this is unconfirmed.

characters.name: Sei Toudou
characters.description: __Height:__ 183 cm Sei is one of [Ichika](https://anilist.co/character/2869/Tachibana-Ichika)'s tutors, and a high school student. He instructs her in grammar, literature, and social sciences. He is introduced as the twin brother of [Kai](https://anilist.co/character/6605/Toudou-Kai). Of the two, Sei usually seems to be the calmer, gentler one. Ichika has developed romantic feelings for him.

characters.name: Kai Toudou
characters.description: __Height:__ 185 cm Kai is [Ichika](https://anilist.co/character/2869/Tachibana-Ichika)'s other tutor. He teaches her math and science. He is introduced as the twin brother of [Sei](https://anilist.co/character/6604/Toudou-Sei). Of the two, Kai seems the more extroverted one and more physical in nature and seems to have developed feelings for his twin brother, Sei.

characters.name: Saya Kogure
characters.description: Saya is an enigmatic woman who is, at times, hidden from view of most people. She is the Tachibanas' next door neighbor, and is in the fashion industry. But this is only an illusion—she covertly pushes circumstances in Ichika's life to bring her to use the power of the Djinns. She can move anywhere at will, turn her scarf into a deadly scythe and other objects and keeps an eye on Ichika throughout the series. She strictly enforces rules concerning the activation of the stones: the current bearer must remain completely in the dark as to their true nature and purpose and no one may interfere with the bearer's decision whether to use the power. (from wikipedia)

The time will come when choices are to be made. Whatever shape it may take. The world will change. It must change. On the fate of those looked after. Kou, the protagonist, belongs to a family in charge of a derelict shrine. Along with his childhood friends Azusa and Yurina, who lives next door, and his best friend Souma, they live a life of little worries. When summer vacation is nearing, Miu, a female transfer student arrived in Kou's class. That night Kou saw Miu wandering around holding a long object, and he asks her about it. Until one day Ryo discovered that his stepmom was indebted to the Yotsuya family. In order to help her he offered to sell himself and work for Akie Yotsuya, the head of the family. But he had no idea what awaited him in the mansion... At first it was just Ryo, Akie, and Fumi, the maid. But soon two more people moved in: Reiko, Akie’s sister... and Madoka, Ryo's mother. characters.name: Laala Manaka
characters.description: Laala has a bright and cheerful personality, and is often seen bouncing off the walls. As her house is a restaurant, she has a habit of saying her informal catchphrase Capisce! (Kashikoma!) when taking requests. Laala has a very loud speaking voice which she is very conscious about; when she is singing, she tends to be very quiet due to this. It seems that she can only gain the courage to sing loudly when performing in PriPara.

characters.name: Amari Katasumi
characters.description: Amari was born in Papparajuku and is a 10th-grade high school student at Basilico Private Academy. She is a girl who sits at the corner of the class, living a school life where she always seems to be bothered. Her catchphrase is "Amari Katasumi, has been left out again today", and she is a lovely-type idol whose preferred brand is Hysteric Bunny. When Amari was young, it was her dream to become a sparkling idol, and she was very optimistic about it until her classmates laughed at her dream. Now older, Amari tends to always worry about how her peers view her, and she tries to hide her embarrassing things before anyone can find them. She is easily flustered and is a bit skittish and shy. At one point, Amari had somewhat of a dark phase, resulting in her designing Mario.

characters.name: Mario
characters.description: A dark idol who calls himself the Demon Lord. He suddenly appeared in DanPri and his true identity is shrouded in darkness. His appearance and personality imbue rock, being a person who acts without caring about others. His catchphrase is "Whatever". He also has a sharp tongue.

characters.name: Mirei Minami
characters.description: Mirei Minami is a 7th grader at Paprika Academy. When performing, Mirei has lemon yellow hair that is partly tied up to two buns at the top with blue and yellow ribbons. Normally she has short lemon yellow hair that looks the same as her performance hair minus the buns and ribbons. She has bright blue eyes. She also tends to say "pri" at the end of her sentences. She is smart and very good at puzzles. Because of this, she is captain of the displicinary committee at school.

characters.name: Sophy Hojo
characters.description: Sophy has apparently been working in the idol industry since she was very young. She is also very popular at her school, and admired by many of the students. When she eats a Red Flash (pickled plum), her personality - likewise with her appearance - changes. Her public personality is cool and on top of things, while her other personality (aka 'Fancy Mode') is extremely disoriented and directionless. It is also hinted that she has low blood pressure. While she is in her Fancy Mode, she says "Pshu~" a lot. In Fancy Mode, she is quite naive and oblivious to what's around her, but since forming her friendship with Laala and Mirei, she has been working on improving herself.

characters.name: Yui Yumekawa
characters.description: Yui Yumekawa is the main protagonist of Idol Time PriPara and a sixth grader at Avocado Academy. She is a Lovely-Type Idol who prefers the brand Fantasy Time. She often adds "yume" in the middle or ends of her sentences, or says "Yumekawa" as a catchphrase, like Laala's "Capisce!". She is also the team leader of MY☆DREAM.

characters.name: Shinya Ooedo
characters.description: A member of DARK NIGHTMARE, the number one idol unit in YamiPri alongside Ushimitsu. He is a ruffian who likes hard rock music.

characters.description: A member of DARK NIGHTMARE, the number one idol unit in YamiPri alongside Shinya. He comes from a noble family in Dapapur. He longs to become a ninja.

Upon reporting to Kiyosato, he learns that Dr. Takao (the doctor who was operating on Shuji’s father when he died) is now the assistant director of the hospital.
