After he learned about Suzu's status as an Ayakashi Maiden from his grandfather, he became an exorcist ninja in order to protect her from harm.

characters.name: Shirogane
characters.description: A powerful ayakashi and the king of the ayakashi. He is after Suzu Kanade, wanting to consume her to increase his power.

characters.name: Soga Ninokuru
characters.description: Soga Ninokuru is a ninja exorcist from the Ninokuru family and considers Matsuri Kazamaki as his rival.

characters.name: Lucy Tsukioka
characters.description: Lucy is a classmate and friend of Suzu Kanade. She's a more silent and shy type, but she loves taking postworthy pictures of everything. She is usually always with Yayoi Toba.

characters.name: Yayoi Toba
characters.description: Yayoi is a classmate and friend of Suzu Kanade. She always hangs out with Lucy.

characters.name: Reo Kourogi
characters.description: Reo Kourogi is a Ninja of the Korogi clan and creator of Matsuri Kazamaki's ninja gear.

characters.name: Garaku Utagawa
characters.description: Garaku Utagawa is a ayakashi born from an ink brush, who has a human form and identity as a famous painter.

characters.name: Rochka
characters.description: A snow spirit from Russia that tries to take the title of King of the Ayakashi.

characters.name: Haya Ninokuru
characters.description: She is Soga's younger sister who is still in training to be an exorcist ninja.

characters.name: Seigen Kazamaki
characters.description: He is a ninja exorcist from the Kazamaki family and the grandfather of Matsuri Kazamaki.

characters.name: Mei Hirasaka
characters.description: She is one of Suzu Kanade's past lives.

title: Amayo no Tsuki
title_en: The Moon on a Rainy Night
description: One day, while rushing to a piano lesson, a girl named Saki collides with someone on the street. As Saki collects herself, the stranger picks up the sheet music Saki dropped, hands it to Saki together with a band-aid, and continues on her way—all without saying a word. Saki is left wondering about the identity of the tall, lovely stranger, only to discover the next day that she is one of her classmates at her new high school. The girl’s name is Kanon, and though she is hearing impaired, she refuses any kind of support or “special treatment” from her teachers or classmates. Over the course of the year, Saki slowly grows closer to Kanon and begins to chip away at her cold exterior. (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Kanon Oikawa
characters.description: She was diagnosed with Sensorineural hearing loss when she was five years old. She isn't entirely deaf; if she has a hearing aid, the room is quiet, and she can see the other person's lips, she can hold on a conversation.

characters.name: Saki Kindaichi
characters.description: She accidentally runs into Kanon on her way to a piano lesson, and they eventually meet again as classmates.

title: Akarui Kioku Soushitsu
description: When Arisa loses her memories from the past three years, her girlfriend, Mari, worries it might mean the end of their budding relationship. A needless concern, it turns out, because when Arisa lays eyes on her, she falls in love all over again! Arisa’s not about to let a little severe brain damage get her down, because she has a chance to relive all their firsts for a second time—from dates, to kisses, and even beyond…!! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras.

characters.name: Arisa Suzuki
characters.description: Due to amnesia, she lost her memories of when she was with Mari.

characters.name: Mari Satou
characters.description: Arisa's lover. She was on the receiving end before Arisa's amnesia.

characters.name: Ken Maeda
characters.description: Mari's colleague.

characters.name: Rena
characters.description: Arisa's high school friend.

title: Gyemoinde, Ttari Neomu Gwiyeowo
description: Fairytale stepmothers are notoriously wicked. But after a children’s clothing designer is reborn as young Princess Blanche’s stepmom, she’s determined to break the mold and shower her daughter with love. Now she just has to convince the girl’s cold-hearted father to do the same. In her quest to make a happier home for Blanche, Abigail begins to uncover secrets and schemes within the palace. Will devious forces tear the Freidkins apart, or can Abigail stitch them back into a family? (Source: Tapas)

title: Helter Skelter
description: If you are aware of fashion in Japan, you must have seen Liliko's face. For the last few years, she has been at the top of the modeling world, with her face and body promoting the biggest brands. But as everyone who is in this world admits, staying on top is a constant and never ending battle. There are always new faces introduced to the public. Younger models and new looks are brought into the fold every season. And keeping that position means learning to adapt and learning to cope with change. To maintain her position Liliko has decided to go under the knife. This is not her first go with this service. It is yet another round of plastic surgery, all done to keep herself looking young and vibrant. However, in this case just a little nip and tuck was not enough. Liliko is bent on undergoing a full body makeover. From head-to-toe, every inch of her will undergo cosmetic surgery, and thus begins her madness. (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Haruko Hirukoma
characters.description: Liliko is about twenty and has accomplished a lot in the world of beauty. She is a model, singer and actress but can´t handle a thing without her assistant Hada. Though almost everybody envies her she is nothing more than a visual lie.

title: Geunyeoui Simcheong
description: Based on a Korean folktale, two very different women find themselves making the same wish - to leave this world behind. One is Shim Chong, a young beggar living off the kindness of others to support herself and her blind father. The other is the bride-to-be of old Chancellor Jang, sold off to him for the sake of her family. When Shim Chong rescues this new bride from the river, their relationship triggers both love and hidden intentions. But will these two women be able to find their way forth in a world that favors men? (Source: Tappytoon) Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

characters.name: Manim
characters.description: Madam is the new wife of the village minister. She is initially seen as a beautiful bride, but then is suspected to be a fox when her husband falls sick and the Indangsu river does not allow pass of ships. She is found and saved by Cheong in the river when she falls off a boat that her brother uses to catch 'the golden turtle' which they gift to the minister instead of a dowry. She invites Cheong to the mansion to help care for the minister, and the two begin to share a deep bond, becoming romantic over time. ~!The minister's son and his subordinates blamed her for bringing 'the golden turtle' out of the river which was fed to the minister who fell sick and eventually died. They claimed that it angered the Dragoon King which was why the Indangsu river would not allow for passage. She was to be sacrificed as a virgin bride for the Dragon King, but her nanny lied and said her marriage with

characters.name: Sim-Cheong
characters.description: Sim-Cheong is a beggar girl. She lost her mother when she was only 7 days old, and lives with her blind father, who she provides food for through her begging.

characters.name: Ppaengdeong Eomi
characters.description: A single mother whose son was severely burned in a fire that broke out while she was working. She looks after [Shim Cheong](https://anilist.co/character/147644/Shim-Cheong) and is a fortune teller.

title: Franken Fran
description: Somewhere, out in the sticks of rural Japan, there is a mysterious manor that is home to the greatest surgeon who ever lived. But when the surgeon goes missing, his reanimated daughter, Fran, takes up the family profession, and despite her Frankenstein-like ways, cares deeply for her patients and holds steadfast to the Hippocratic Oath. Fran’s creed? “All lives must be saved, no matter the cost!” Join Fran, her twisted sister Veronica, and the rest of her monstrous entourage in a gruesomely hilarious tale that would put Mary Shelley to shame! Because for Franken Fran, the ends always justify the means, no matter what ungodly creations emerge from her lab. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Fran Madaraki
characters.description: Fran Madaraki is an artificial creation and one of the most advanced, made by the greatest surgeon in the world, Dr. Madaraki Naomitsu. She's not human, but instead a creature akin to Frankenstein's Monster, and her body is able to add or lose pieces, like up to six arms or cut the lower half of her body without pain or danger. Fran has a fraction of the Dr's ability, but it's still able to raise the dead (If they have been dead less than 24 hours), create genetically altered creatures, rebuild complete human bodies in a matter of minutes and other medical miracles. She says that her abilities are nothing compared to Dr. Madaraki's and talks about him with admiration and perhaps love. She lives and takes care of the Madaraki estate, taking care of the Dr's experiments and home, and always waiting for his return. Fran doesn't understand humanity very well. She tries to explain and underst

characters.name: Veronica Madaraki
characters.description: Assassin bioweapon created by Dr. Madaraki for his own protection. In addition to her naturally high combat ability, she is trained in the handling of explosives and the setting of traps in the field. A large, X-shaped stitch marks her face. Because she was created after Fran, Veronica calls her “elder sister”. She wields a huge guillotine blade in her right arm and a sharp sword in her left. She also has sharpened daggers sticking out of the pommel. She follows her own battle etiquette: “To murder while causing as little suffering as possible”. In opposition to Fran, who believes that “regardless of the shape or form, if it can function as a living organism it is good”, Veronica supports the notion of “rather a painless death than a painful life”. She is the antithetical existence to Fran. She seems to be very protective of Fran, and will

characters.name: Okita
characters.description: The head of a handsome young man with the body of a cat. He often works along with Fran, supporting her or making fun of her. When attending parties he attaches a human body to his head, thus taking the form of a perfectly normal adult man. During operations when Fran goes too far, Okita is sometimes bewildered, but in general he supervises them in silence. Very rarely does he fall in love with female cats.

characters.name: Kaneda
characters.description: Kaneda was first introduced in chapter 2. Distracted by Tajima Kouichi's request to date him, she walks right in front of a oncoming vehicle and is hit. Fran comes to the rescue, originally, to answer Tajima's call for help but to harvest her organs before calling the authorities. Tajima was so desperate to help Kaneda that Fran takes pity and surgically revives her...and turns her into a caterpillar.

characters.name: Tajima Kouichi
characters.description: Tajima was confessing his love to "Kaneda-san" when she absentmindedly walked in front of a oncoming vehicle. Desperate to help her, he calls for help and Fran comes in. He pleads for her to help "Kaneda-san" and she agrees. Although his crush had a body of a caterpillar after the reconstructive surgery, he still had the heart to develop a relationship with her. *One Manga . Com

characters.name: Anju Morimura
characters.description: During chapter 6, Anju's family is putting on her birthday party on a boat full of "rich people". Okita and Fran notice that Anju is absent and Fran later informs the guests that she was cooked into the birthday meal. Anju's head (discovered in the freezer) was reattached to Okita's temporary body.

characters.name: Etou Susumu
characters.description: Fran discovers him in the forest. He tells Fran that he was going to kill himself and his girlfriend to preserve their relationship but only got halfway. Fran decides to revive his girlfriend by removing the head and modifying her so she evolves from a head, to a head with "finger legs" and, eventually, to a bigger body.

characters.name: Isao Urasawa
characters.description: A struggling artist whose eyesight is failing. Fran meets him when he's fallen in front of the bus she's riding, and is laying in the street. Fran promises him new eyes and he agrees, but gets more than he wished for.

characters.name: Molton
characters.description: A figure who appears in the 9th chapter. It seems he's in association with a fashion company that is really a mafia ring. He asks Fran for a new body double after his previous one is assassinated at the beginning of the chapter. Like all of her patients, he asked for too much and got too much in return.

characters.name: Adorea
characters.description: She is another one of Fran's companions who is always seen wrapped entirely in bandages. Her job is to collect and store the many organs Fran may need to take on the go. The organs are collected through her "face", which is nothing more than hundreds of tentacles used to tear and collect the organs from the "patient." The organs are stored through out her body and accessed by Fran through many zippers found all over her body. In one chapter, she becomes very important as Fran and her assassins get trapped and injured in a tunnel, where one of the assassins appears to admire and almost love Adorea, only to be "collected." Her origin was revealed in an extra chapter 'Memento'. Originally a beautiful, but terminally ill girl, she had a lover who was handsome, but also in a terminal condition. Due to their love for each other, they agreed to give

characters.name: Kouryuu
characters.description: A official who comes to check on Fran's progress. Raised in a sterile environment all her life, she acquired a sort of phobia to all things "filthy". When the collection of lab roaches demand the body of their instigator to be destroyed (to nourish the second generation), everyone turns to Director Kouryuu. After her associates and the roaches run after her and catch her in the nearby forest, they are all burned in a fire. The two men were revived as well as the Director, who gained artificial skin. Fran tells her what it was made out of and she goes crazy.

characters.name: Kaya
characters.description: Kaya met Fran outside of the hospital while it was snowing. When they went inside to visit her brother, who had a heart condition, the hospital director told Fran to leave immediately. Kaya's brother carjacks and shoots a doctor soon after. He travels to America to get a doctor that can help him live. Fran, naturally, follows him.

title: Jintian De Ta Yeshi Ruci Keai
title_original: 今天的她也是如此可爱
description: "I'm into someone." Cang Shu, a straight-A student who always indulges in learning and has no passion for social contact, actually announces in public that she likes the poor student Qi Lin?! Thanks to a misunderstanding, the two of them begin to get to know each other. When a girl who disdains to make friends meets another girl who desires to be loved, what will occur between them? (Source: Webcomics)

characters.name: Qi Lin
characters.description: __Horoscope:__ Aries __Class:__ Grade 10 Class G __Likes:__ Any sort of milk beverage, pop music, gaming __Dislikes:__ Piano __Best subject:__ Nothing, especially poor in Arts (but her lowest record is 4 marks for Maths)

characters.name: Cang Shu
characters.description: __Class:__ Grade 10 Class A __Likes:__ Milk, chocolate, classical music, chess __Dislikes:__ Fish with bones (any food that makes her ungraceful when eating) __Best subject:__ Everything, especially Arts

characters.name: Hang Wang
characters.description: Class C's Wang Hang. In a one-sided rivalry with Cui Xin.

title: Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Nai jan, Muri Muri! (※Muri ja Nakatta!?)
title_original: わたしが恋人になれるわけないじゃん、ムリムリ！（※ムリじゃなかった!?）
title_en: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless...
description: Renako Amaori is leaving her awkward and lonely junior high school life behind, determined to become a normal girl with normal friends in high school. Glamorous, confident Mai Ouzuka is Renako’s total opposite: wealthy, outgoing, and a literal fashion model. Against the odds, the two girls form an immediate connection. Renako thinks she may have found the best friend of her dreams…until Mai’s romantic confession sends her into a tailspin. Renako wants to prove to Mai that being BFFs is better than being girlfriends, but Mai is dead set on convincing Renako that they’re destined to be lovers. Let the love games begin! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

characters.name: Renako Amaori
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm (5'2") At school, Renako acts bright and sociable. However, while she enjoys talking with her classmates, this is only a front, and her "true self" is gloomy and negative. In middle school, Renako declined an invitation to go out with her classmates, causing them to reject her. Renako spent the rest of middle school as a hikikomori as a result of this. Because of what happened to her in the past, she has trouble declining invitations and requests from her classmates.

characters.name: Mai Ouzuka
characters.description: **Height:** 167 cm (5'6") Mai is gifted academically and athletically, and [Renako](https://anilist.co/character/196166/Amaori-Renako) describes her as the pinnacle of beauty. Mai is arrogant and forthright, owing to her status as the school's Madonna. Though she is polite in general, when she is alone with Renako, she is very open and persistent with her desires. She has a tendency to act on a whim. The day after meeting Mai, she confesses to Renako. Renako declines, but Mai persists. They both agree that when Mai wears her hair down, they are in "lovers mode," and when she ties it up, they are in "friends mode." Mai's mother is an internationally renowned fashion designer, and Mai is one of her models. As a result, her family is very wealthy.

characters.name: Satsuki Koto
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm (5'5") Satsuki is a blunt, serious, and headstrong person. Despite her beautiful appearance, she has a cold personality and an unapproachable aura that makes it difficult to connect with her. ~!Satsuki lives in a run-down apartment and works part-time to support her single mother.!~

characters.name: Ajisai Sena
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm (5'2") She is sometimes referred to as an "angel" because of her easygoing personality. Sena's parents frequently leave her home to care for her two younger brothers, Kou-kun and Kii-kun. Although she loves her brothers, she grows resentful of the restrictions it places on her freedom as she is left to look after them on a more regular basis.

characters.name: Kaho Koyanagi
characters.description: **Height:** 153 cm (5'0") As the group's mascot, Kaho has a playful and fun personality. She enjoys making jokes and has the ability to control the mood of the group. She is referred to as "everyone's little sister" because of her childish personality. ~!Renako is later revealed to be Kaho's childhood friend. Renako was unable to remember who she was because her surname had been changed from Minaguchi to Koyanagi.!~

characters.name: Haruna Amaori
characters.description: She is Renako's younger sister. She is a second-year junior high school student and a member of the badminton club. She is naturally extroverted and athletic, unlike her older sister.

title: Hourou Musuko
description: Fifth grade friends Shuichi Nitori and Yoshino Takatsuki have happy homes, loving families, and are well-liked by their classmates. But they share a secret that further complicates a time of life that is awkward for anyone: Shuichi is a transgender girl, and Yoshino is transgender boy. (Source: Fantagraphics)

characters.name: Shuuichi Nitori
characters.description: Shuuichi is a young trans girl who is one of two main protagonists. She is a fifth grader at the beginning of the series. As she grows up and hits puberty, she becomes increasingly concerned about the way her body is changing. Shuuichi has an honest and dutiful personality that generally makes it easy for her get along well with others, though she can also be quite sensitive at times. She is often described as cute, and is able to pass as a girl due to her feminine appearance and physical build; she enjoys wearing cute clothes, which her friends encourage. Shuuichi later becomes interested in writing stories, and joins the drama club as a writer.

characters.name: Yoshino Takatsuki
characters.description: Yoshino, the other protagonist, is a tall, masculine child who at the beginning of Wandering Son is a fifth grader in Shuichi's class. Otherwise known as Takatsuki-kun by their classmates, with an honorific used mainly with boys, Yoshino wishes to be a boy. Yoshino usually refrains from dressing in traditionally feminine clothes, such as skirts or dresses. Despite this, Yoshino's mother insists on buying such clothes for them. Shortly after becoming friends with Shuichi, Yoshino gets a boyish haircut, taking on the appearance of a boy their age, especially when Yoshino is dressed in a male school uniform. Like Shuichi, Yoshino becomes increasingly concerned and resentful about undergoing puberty, such as at the beginning of menstruation or the growth of breasts. Yoshino goes to buy a chest-flattening garment to escape the necessity of wearing a bra. Like Shuichi, Yoshino shows signs indi

characters.name: Saori Chiba
characters.description: Saori, nicknamed Saorin, is a girl who is a fifth grader in Shūichi's class at the beginning of Hōrō Musuko. From early on, she takes an interest in encouraging Shūichi to cross-dress, even going so far as to buy him an expensive dress for his birthday which he later returns, much to her displeasure. Saori finds it difficult to associate well with most others, and as such has very few friends, though she becomes close friends with Shūichi. She tends to tell others what is on her mind, disregarding how others may take what she says. As Saori grows up, she gradually becomes more standoffish and stoic; she even has bad relations with her teachers. Despite her self-centered attitude, she remains popular among the boys in her classes because of her physical attractiveness. She is a sensitive girl whose temper sometimes gets the better of her when reprimanding bullies that tease Shūichi becaus

characters.name: Makoto Ariga
characters.description: Makoto, known as Mako for short, is a trans girl who first appears when the cast is in sixth grade. She is Shuuichi's closest friend, and is an only child whose parents run a bakery. Mako is unusually mature for her age. She's a calm and rational thinker with good listening skills, which helps her to give good advice to her friends, and to get along well with her peers. She is also a romantic who dreams about being in a relationship with a cool, adult man.

characters.name: Chizuru Sarashina
characters.description: Chizuru is a tall girl who makes her first appearance as a classmate of Shūichi's upon their entering into junior high school and is nicknamed Chii-chan. She is a free spirit who enjoys doing unconventional, often outrageous things which surprise those around her, and she usually acts without thinking, resulting in her giving off a childish personality. Her impulsive attitude can often get her in trouble with other characters, but she quickly becomes ashamed when she realizes the consequences of her caprices. She has a stylish demeanor—highlighted by her stature and long hair—which captivates both Shūichi and Yoshino when they first meet her. She tries to be everyone's friend, though she is unable to break through Saori's distaste for her strange attitude. She quickly joins the girl's basketball team once in junior high. She is Momoko's childhood frie

characters.name: Maho Nitori
characters.description: Maho is Shūichi's older sister by one year who shares a room with him, and at the beginning of Hōrō Musuko, she is in the sixth grade of elementary school. Maho is a big fan of a teen model named Maiko, and because she deeply desires to meet her, Maho sends in her photo to a modeling agency and is soon hired as a young model in the same agency as Maiko. Maho shows a large interest in clothes, and spends a lot of her money on new apparel. After she starts to become recognized as a model, Maho enjoys the added attention from being asked her autograph by complete strangers. While initially starting out slow in modeling, Maho soon gains confidence in her abilities, and becomes friends with Maiko and two other models, Anna Suehiro and Tamaki Satō. In contrast to her younger brother, Maho is very out-spoken and tends to be rough with Shūichi, even hitting or slapping him on some occasions. Mah

characters.name: Shiina
characters.description: Shiina, otherwise referred to by his nickname Shii, is another adult friend of Shūichi and Yoshino. He was Yuki's classmate in elementary school, and he eventually became her boyfriend after her transition and due to her persistence. Unlike Yuki, Shii had many friends in school. He generally just watches over Shūichi and Yoshino with Yuki, but he does sometimes do bold and unexpected things, such as grabbing Yoshino's crotch when the two of them first meet because he feared that she, who was dressed as a boy at the time, might be Yuki's illicit lover in an affair.

characters.name: Yuki
characters.description: Yuki, born Hiroyuki Yoshida, is a tall and attractive trans woman living with her boyfriend Shiina. She takes an early interest in Yoshino when she believes Yoshino to be a boy, though remains on good terms with Yoshino even after learning of Yoshino's assigned sex, and gives Shuichi and Yoshino helpful advice when they are troubled. Despite the differences between their situations, Yuki sees much of herself in Shuichi: when they were growing up, Shiina was the only friend who stood by the young Hiroyuki, as she was called then, while girls teased her and the boys bullied her to change. Yuki always keeps up a positive attitude, and runs a gay bar. Since her transition, she has not been on good terms with her parents, who run a uniform store. Yuki is the main character of Takako Shimura's short story "Hana", in the collection Boku wa, Onna no Ko, in which her family—which consists of her

characters.name: Maiko
characters.description: Maiko is a classmate and best friend of [Anna Suehiro](https://anilist.co/character/29774/Anna-Suehiro). She is a singer and model. She has a large fan base among [Shuuichi](https://anilist.co/character/16055/Shuuichi-Nitori)'s classmates.

characters.name: Kanako Sasa
characters.description: Kanako is a girl who is a fifth grader in Shūichi's class at the beginning of Hōrō Musuko. Her nickname is Sasa-chan, but she is also called Kanabun by her younger brother and Chizuru. While she makes her first appearance in chapter two of the manga, she is not given a name until volume two. She is a short, energetic girl who likes to think of herself as everyone's friend, and easily becomes distressed when her friends fight amongst themselves. In such times, Kanako acts as a mediator between her friends, and tries not to leave anyone alone. She has been friends with Yoshino since pre-school, and later becomes close friends with Chizuru upon entering junior high school. Kanako comes off as an innocent, childish girl who does not have many worries aside from her friends' quarrels. She tends to be a handful for her mother who picks out her clothes for her, and even helps her get ready for

characters.name: Fumiya Ninomiya
characters.description: Fumiya is a boy one year older than Saori whom she first meets when she starts going to church. He takes an early interest in Saori, and he tries to get to know her better so as to become her boyfriend. Fumiya is a talkative boy whom Saori is easily annoyed by, especially when he brings her flowers from his parents' flower shop. After meeting Shūichi, Fumiya becomes jealous that Saori has an interest in him, especially when he is a cross-dresser, which Fumiya feels is gross. However, Fumiya lies to Saori and Shūichi, telling them he likes to cross-dress as well, in an effort to gain Saori's favor. This strategy backfires, as only Shūichi is interested in hearing more.

characters.name: Anna Suehiro
characters.description: Anna is a teen model who is a good friend and classmate of Maiko; she is similarly well-known and experienced in modeling. From early on, Anna makes it clear that she disapproves of Shūichi dressing as a girl, and even calls her a freak. Anna initially tells Maho she has no interest in her "weak" brother because of her femininity, though later dates Shuuichi for a time after she asks her out. Furthermore, Anna's opinion of Shuuichi's cross-dressing also changes, saying that it actually suits her, and the two even go out together on a date with Shuuichi dressed as a girl. She feels Shuuichi is an interesting person, and once says she is like a cute little sister. Anna spends a lot of money on clothes, and enjoys modifying them.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni Chiru Episode 8: Twilight of the Golden Witch
title_original: うみねこのなく頃に散 - Episode 8: Twilight of the Golden Witch
title_en: Umineko When They Cry Episode 8: Twilight of the Golden Witch
description: It's time once again for the annual family gathering on Rokkenjima! Ange Ushiromiya is just getting over a cold, but that won't dampen her excitement at seeing her cousins again! Granddad couldn't be more thrilled to see his beloved grandchildren and throws a special Halloween party where everyone gets lots of treats! By lunchtime on the first day, the aunts and uncles are chatting up a storm, and the cousins are eagerly planning the afternoon's fun. It's the very picture of a happy family-one that in no way resembles the bickering, bitter Ushiromiya clan! What is going on?! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

characters.name: Lambdadelta
characters.description: She is also known as the Most Powerful Witch in the Universe before losing to [Bernkastel](https://anilist.co/character/11840/Bernkastel-Frederica) and is feared by most other witches, including [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/10285/Beatrice). She is quite childish and holds a grudge against Bernkastel for finally beating her in their last game, although she actually cares for her. Her "Magic of Certainty" allows her to kill anyone without fail as an absolute result, which bends the basic rule of Umineko magic requiring a risk. Like Bernkastel, she is a Voyager. She wishes for [Battler](https://anilist.co/character/14040/Ushiromiya-Battler) and Beatrice to fight against each other for eternity as a part of a larger plot to have Bernkastel lose against her. She has lived for a thousand years. As a witch, she embodies the concept that 'hard-workers are rewarded', and is very respec

characters.name: Beatrice
characters.description: The Golden Witch and Endless Witch. She is affectionately referred to as "Beato" (ベアト). A witch who has lived for over a thousand years, she is said to appear as a cloud of golden butterflies, and has the power to summon higher demons among the seventy-two pillars to serve her. It is said that humans can summon her to have their wishes granted in exchange for compensation, though she often acts whimsically. She is the one rumored to have given [Kinzo](https://anilist.co/character/14041/Ushiromiya-Kinzou) ten tons of gold and served under him as the alchemic advisor to the Ushiromiya family. ~!She is one of the personalites of Yasu and was made as the ideal girl for Battler to fall in love with after [Shannon](https://anilist.co/character/15435/Shannon)'s feelings were made to be directed at [George](https://anilist.co/character/14042/Ushiromiya-George) instead of Battler!~

characters.name: Frederica Bernkastel
characters.original: フレデリカ・ベルンカステル
characters.description: A mysterious witch who appears to [Battler](https://anilist.co/character/14040/Ushiromiya-Battler) following the first game, providing advice and telling him she will support him in his endeavors to solve the mystery of the witch [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/10285/Beatrice). Although an ally to Battler, Bernkastel has a twisted personality and refers to herself as the "cruelest witch in the world", and is only interested in Beatrice's game as a chance to escape her own boredom. She is known as the Witch of Miracles, and she has the power to reset any situation and realize a goal, eventually securing victory even with a 0.0000000000001% probability, so long as it is not zero. Initially stoic, cold, and calm, she slowly reveals herself to be just as impish and cruel as her rival, [Lambdadelta](https://anilist.co/character/10196/Lambdadelta). ~!Bernkastel's true identity is stron

characters.name: Battler Ushiromiya
characters.description: Battler is the son of [Rudolf](https://anilist.co/character/14043/Ushiromiya-Rudolf) and his first wife [Asumu](https://anilist.co/character/259608/Ushiromiya-Asumu), and is generally considered to be the main protagonist of the series. He is extremely stubborn, and is afraid of "shaky" transportation, fearing he might fall off a boat. At first glance, he appears to be hotheaded, cocky, and even a little perverted. However, he has a heart of gold he isn't afraid to show when the situation calls for it.

characters.name: Ange Ushiromiya
characters.description: [Rudolf](https://anilist.co/character/14043/Ushiromiya-Rudolf) and [Kyrie](https://anilist.co/character/18673/Ushiromiya-Kyrie)'s daughter, and [Battler](https://anilist.co/character/14040/Ushiromiya-Battler)'s sister. ~!She could not come to the island in 1986 (at the age of six) due to a sickness. After the events of Banquet of the Golden Witch, she is raised by [Eva](https://anilist.co/character/14049/Ushiromiya-Eva) after she returns alive from Rokkenjima, and studies to become the next family head. However, she is put through many hardships particularly due to Eva's belief that her son [George](https://anilist.co/character/14042/Ushiromiya-George) should have been the next head, particularly after Eva's genuine desire to raise Ange as though she were her own daughter is poisoned when [Bernkastel](https://anilist.co/character/11840/Bernkastel-Frederica) manipulates a young Ange into

characters.name: Erika Furudo
characters.description: The main antagonist and self-proclaimed intellectual rapist of End of the Golden Witch and Dawn of the Golden Witch. She is a young detective introduced in End of the Golden Witch. A blue-haired girl estimated by [Genji](https://anilist.co/character/21086/Ronoue-Genji) to be about [Jessica](https://anilist.co/character/14044/Ushiromiya-Jessica)'s age, 18, she's highly intelligent and possesses a photographic memory. She's quite polite in public and shows a deep interest in mysteries. In reality, she's quite ruthless and cunning and only solves mysteries, so she can sneer at those who pose them. She does, however, possess a serious inferiority complex, since she emotionally breaks down whenever things aren't in her favor. ~!After the events of The Great Court of Illusions, Bernkastel grants Erika the title of The Witch of Truth as a reward for completely destroying the witch illusion of t

characters.name: Yasuda
characters.description: ~!Yasu is Kinzo and Kuwadorian Beatrice's child and was born due to the result of incest. Yasu is at the same time Kinzo's child and grandchild. It is implied that she was DMAB, but reassigned and raised as female upon the cliff incident. Yasu is the same person as Lion Ushiromiya, but only in the worlds where Natsushi rejected the infant given by Kinzo. Yasu plays the role of Shannon, Kanon, and Beatrice and is the true antagonist of the entire Umineko series. She is the true form of Beatrice and the true writer of the message bottles. Due to her belief that she is furniture, amongst other things, Sayo plans out the Rokkenjima Massacre. Yasu loves Battler, George and Jessica—that's Kanon's love, Shannon's love and real Yasu's love (Beatrice's feelings for Battler). It's expected that Battler's sin is forgetting Yasu and breaking a promise after six years. Yasu was the child that fell of

characters.name: Maria Ushiromiya
characters.description: Maria is Rosa's daughter, and is the youngest of the cousins. She has a habit of uttering 'uu-uu' at times, which frustrates Rosa greatly. Maria is also rather stubborn, and believes things easily, which isn't uncommon for someone her age. She has an interest in the occult, like her grandfather. She carries around a bag which is filled with occult items, such as a scorpion charm which wards off evil. She idolizes witches, and believes that they are there to bring people joy and happiness. In Maria's notebooks there are sketches of witches, and the witches are beautiful, fantastical creatures. It upsets Maria greatly when someone denies the existence of witches, especially Beatrice's existence. At certain times, Maria undergoes a personality change, and begins to laugh in an unnerving fashion. When she is in this mode, she acts rather condescendingly with reg

characters.name: Kinzou Ushiromiya
characters.description: The elderly head of the Ushiromiya family, and the owner of Rokkenjima. He is a rabid practitioner of black magic and the occult, his shelves lined with volumes upon volumes of grimoires. One of his most prominent obsessions is [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/10285/Beatrice), a witch he is said to have summoned and contracted for ten tons worth of gold. He rarely leaves his exceedingly vast study, which contains various commodities such as a bed, lavatory, and bath. Throughout the first four games, ~!Kinzo's body frequently turns up burnt in the incinerator of the mansion's underground boiler room, and is identified due to his polydactyly, distinguished by having six toes on each foot. In life, Kinzo held his children in contempt, viewing them as vultures ready to feast on his inheritance as soon as he died (or at least when word of his death spread out).!~ At the end of the 4th

characters.name: George Ushiromiya
characters.description: Eva and Hideyoshi's twenty-three-year-old son. He is the oldest of Kinzo's grandchildren, and an exceptional and diligent young adult. He was brought up by Eva specifically with the family headship in mind, and is also a skilled martial artist like his mother. He worked at his father's company as an apprentice throughout college, and respects his parents greatly, though he admittedly finds his mother overbearing. George is admired by everyone in his family, especially his cousins, who view him as their older brother and peacemaker. In his youth, however, he had been jealous of their more independent and impulsive lifestyles, particularly Battler, as unlike him, his mother made him do various things in his youth in order to shape him into the next head. As a result, he put up a more condescending mask towards his cousins, but has since outgrown this inferiority complex to a

characters.name: Rudolf Ushiromiya
characters.description: Kinzo's third child, and Battler's father. After his wife Asumu's death, he immediately remarried with Kyrie, leading to a falling out with his son, who ran away from home for six years. Rudolf is still known to chat up young women from time to time, though this does not seem to disturb Kyrie. He is an avid lover of Western films and an impressive marksman. He seeks Kinzo's fortune to settle a court case in America. ~! He was known as a philanderer in his youth and had impregnated his business partner and old girlfriend Kyrie with their son Battler before he married his first wife Asumu. He then deceived Kyrie and the other members of the Ushiromiya family into believing that Battler was actually Asumu's child, and that Kyrie's child was stillborn. !~

characters.name: Jessica Ushiromiya
characters.description: Krauss and Natsuhi's eighteen-year-old daughter. She is an energetic young girl, serving as the student body president at her school, and even leading a rock band. If her father inherits the family fortune, she will become the heiress to the Ushiromiya family, although the family's patriarchal hierarchy denotes her future husband will become the next head. Jessica is tomboyish, feisty, and rebellious, much to the dismay of her mother, who insists she act more refined and ladylike. She dislikes her parents at times for the pressures they place on her regarding the family inheritance, which she has no interest in. However, she still shows concern for them deep down. She was born with weak bronchi, and occasionally suffers from asthma attacks. ~!She is in love with Kanon, who tries to hide his own feelings from her, though she manages to reach out to him in Dawn of the Golden Witch, and the

title: Hana ni Arashi
description: Nanoha and Chidori are best friends who attend the same all-girls high school—and also share a heart-pounding secret: they're lovers. (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Nanoha Aoba
characters.description: She is secretly dating her best friend, [Chidori Fujimiya](https://anilist.co/character/210152/Fujimiya-Chidori).

characters.name: Chidori Fujimiya
characters.description: She is secretly dating her best friend, [Nanoha Aoba](https://anilist.co/character/210151/Aoba-Nanoha).

title: Tensei Oujo to Tensai Reijou no Mahou Kakumei
title_original: 転生王女と天才令嬢の魔法革命
title_en: The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady
description: Princess Anisphia may not be able to use magic, but she didn’t let that stop her from developing “magicology,” a unique theory based on memories from her past life. While testing out her new flying broom, she happens across Euphyllia, a magical genius, having her engagement unjustly and publicly broken off. Seeing the tears in Euphyllia’s eyes, Anisphia takes the obvious course of action—kidnapping the girl for herself! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Anisphia Wynn Palettia
characters.original: アニスフィア・ウィン・パレッティア
characters.description: Anisphia is the first Princess of the Kingdom of Palettia. Possessing memories of her past life, she longs to be able to fly in the sky with the power of magic. However, as she's unable to use magic herself, she spends her days conducting questionable research in hopes of fulfilling her dream. Her eccentric behavior earned her the nickname "Princess Peculiar".

characters.name: Euphyllia Magenta
characters.original: ユフィリア・マゼンタ
characters.description: The daughter of [Duke Magenta](https://anilist.co/character/261968/Ruomen). A genius beauty who not only excels at magic, but also well-versed in academics, politics and combat. As the fiancé of [Prince Algard](https://anilist.co/character/287676/Von-Palettia-Algard), she showed promise as the kingdom's next queen. But one fateful night would change the course of her life forever...

characters.name: Ilia Coral
characters.description: [Anisphia](https://anilist.co/character/203119/Wynn-Palettia-Anisphia)'s personal maid. Although a servant, she watches over Anisphia like an older sister. She was saved by Anisphia in the past and is deeply loyal to her. ~!Ilia was born into a low-ranking noble family. To improve their status, her parents intended to marry her off to an influential husband, basically treating their daughter as a political tool. All of this caused Ilia to grow up to become a fairly weak-willed person who did whatever she was told. However, before marrying her off, her family had her work at the royal palace as a maid. This led to her meeting Princess Anisphia, the Anisphia made Ilia her personal maid and permitted her to talk openly in her presence. All of this caused Ilia's personality to undergo a great change as she became much more blunt and willing to stand up for herself. Eventually, she cut all ti

characters.name: Sylphine Maise Palettia
characters.original: シルフィーヌ・メイズ・パレッティア
characters.description: Queen of the Kingdom of Palettia.

characters.name: Grantz Magenta
characters.description: Euphilia's father, the head of the ducal Magenta family, chancellor of the realm of the Kingdom of Palettia, and close friend to King Orphans.

characters.name: Algard Von Palettia
characters.original: アルガルド・ボナ・パレッティア
characters.description: Crown Prince of the Kingdom of Palettia. Engaged to [Euphilia Magenta](https://anilist.co/character/203120/Magenta-Euphyllia).

characters.name: Orphans Il Palettia
characters.original: オルファンス・イル・パレッティア
characters.description: King of the Kingdom of Palettia.

characters.name: Lainie Cyan
characters.description: The daughter of a commoner elevated to the rank of Baron. Despite her humble origins, she has succeeded in attracting the attention of the sons of several influential nobles at the aristocratic academy. ~!It is eventually revealed that Lainie is actually a vampire who constantly gives off a charm that makes people infatuated with her, which she herself was unaware of. Following this, she is taken in by Anisphia so she may learn to control her abilities, which she repays by working for her as a maid.!~

characters.name: Tilty Claret
characters.original: ティルティ・クラーレット
characters.description: The eldest daughter of the powerful Marquis Claret. She has withdrawn to a private residence, where she studies curses. Occasionally she conducts joint research with [Anisphia](https://anilist.co/character/203119/Wynn-Palettia-Anisphia), but they have a complicated relationship because of their different beliefs. ~!Tilty suffers from an incurable affliction that left her unable to properly release her magical energy, causing her physical and mental pain whenever she tries to use magic. Nonetheless, her family, being traditionalists blindly faithful to the spirits, forced her to learn to use her magic anyway. This continued until the pain finally caused Tilty to snap and lash out against her family.!~

characters.name: Chartreuse Hakushaku
characters.description: Count Chartreuse is the minister of magic and the father of Moritz Chartreuse who opposes any changes that might endanger the nobles' authority. ~!He had been secretly manipulating Algard Von Palettia for years to turn him into a puppet ruler under his control and played an active role in the prince's attempted revolution!~

characters.name: Moritz Chartreuse
characters.original: モーリッツ・シャルトルーズ

title: Ane no Tomodachi
description: Hina, Asahi's older sister's best friend, is always hanging around the house he shares with his sister. She's unbelievably beautiful, irresistibly cute... and has absolutely no sense of personal space. Before he knows it, Asahi—a nerdy high school boy—is completely swept up into her antics. A gorgeous trendy girl with no concept of boundaries and a dependable, doting high school boy... They're both hopelessly in love with each other, yet neither can bring themselves to confess in this sweet, frustratingly adorable romance! (Source: MANGA MILLION)

title: Maou-jou de Oyasumi
title_en: Sleepy Princess in the Demon Castle
description: Sshhh! Princess Syalis is trying to get a good night's sleep. Some shut-eye. Forty winks. Catch some Z's. Long ago in olden times when people and demons lived together in—well, disharmony, really – a demon king kidnaps a human princess and imprisons her in his castle. Bereft, the princess's subjects beat their chests in anguish…until a hero arises to spearhead Project Rescue Our Princess! While waiting for her knight in shining armor, what's an imprisoned princess to do …? Teddy-bear guards with bat wings are all very well, but her dungeon cell is bo-o-o-ring! So, she decides to wile away the long hours by sleeping. Now if only she could get comfortable…and didn't suffer from insomnia… (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Aurora Suya Rhys Kaymin
characters.original: オーロラ・栖夜・リース・カイミーン
characters.description: The princess of the human kingdom. Kidnapped by the [Demon King](https://anilist.co/character/181143/Maou-Tasogare), she spends her days waiting for the heroes to rescue her. At least, that's how it was supposed to be...

characters.name: Maou Tasogare
characters.description: He kidnapped [Syalis](https://anilist.co/character/129563/Kaymin-Aurora-Suya-Rhys) in her sleep, so he has hardly ever seen her awake and has never had a proper conversation with her. He is always thinking of ways to make the hero get to him and gets worried if he is going to lose, he even puts weapons and tools to make the hero's quest easier. Apart from that he is a good leader for the demons of the castle, but even he can't go against Princess Syalis, and is shown to care for her to a certain point.

characters.name: Akuma Shuudoushi
characters.description: The Demon Cleric might seem like a gentle young man, but he is actually the demon in charge of the Demon Temple inside the Demon Castle. The Demon Cleric is usually the one called upon to use magic to resurrect anyone who happens to die in the Demon Castle.

characters.name: Haritoge Majiro
characters.description: Quilladillo likes to complain a lot but is a good sport and thus has many friends. He is the type who can't say no when asked for a favor.

characters.name: Yuusha Akatsuki
characters.description: He is a hot-blooded and straightforward brave-type man, who stood up to save the kidnapped Princess Syalis. However, the princess calls him "A-Nantoka-kun" and is not able to remember his name and existence for a long time. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Debi Akuma
characters.description: A cuddly teddy bear often kept as a pet. They are easily susceptible to temptation. They live in the Demon Castle in large flocks and are huge fans of Princess Syalis's brushing. Teddy Demons are low-ranking monsters of the demon variety. (Source: Sleepy Princess Wiki)

characters.name: Red Siberian Kai
characters.original: レッドシベリアン・改
characters.description: Great Red Siberian is a monster of the beast species and is the Demon King's faithful dog. Great Red Siberian values discipline and wants Princess Syalis to act like the hostage she is. He has served the Demon King for a long time and enforces the Demon Castle rules through his troops of Red Siberians. (Source: Sleepy Princess Wiki)

characters.name: Yashiki Teshita Goblin
characters.description: The Castle Grunt Goblin believes himself to be the commonest of commoners. He hardly ever causes any trouble, but he often falls victim to the princess' schemes along with Quilladillo and Minotaur. (Source: Sleepy Princess Wiki)

characters.name: Frankenzombie
characters.description: Frankenzombie is a happy-go-lucky guy who laughs hysterically even when his friends are screaming due to the princess's shenanigans.

characters.name: Poseidon
characters.description: Poseidon is one of the Ten Elders and the reincarnation of the Greek god. He can float and create high-pressurized blasts of water from his hands, and wearing only a loincloth earns him the nickname "Nudist" from Princess Suya. After he was reincarnated due to humans straying from worshiping the gods, Poseidon had to start over with a childlike appearance and was taken in by the Former Demon King Oxenthree, who raised him alongside his own son (Twilight), and Poseidon's older brother who also reincarnated, Hades. Poseidon gets along reasonably well with his elder brother Hades, but sometimes he realizes he takes after him, and that annoys him, which is why he kicks Hades every time they meet. Even though Poseidon is less likely to tolerate Suya's eccentricities, he still falls for her tricks and schemes. Once a year, during Marine Day, the increase in magical energy allows him to take on

title: Sayonara Rose Garden
title_original: さよならローズガーデン
description: England, the early 1900s. Alice, a young noblewoman, has a Japanese maid named Hanako working in her household. The two have a fairly typical relationship…until the day Alice begs Hanako to kill her. As Hanako tries to figure out why her mistress would make such a terrible request, she and Alice grow closer until an entirely new feeling begins to blossom between them. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Chapter count includes an extra Intermission chapter in vol. 2.

characters.name: Alice Douglas
characters.description: A noblewoman who takes Hanako on as her personal maid after finding out that she is trying to find Victor Franks. Alice fears that rumors surrounding her once having an affair with her governess will cause disgrace to her family.

characters.name: Hanako Kujo
characters.description: An aspiring novelist who travels to England in hopes of meeting her favorite author, Victor Franks. She instead finds herself as a personal maid to the noblewoman Alice Douglas.

characters.name: Edward
characters.description: A nobleman who is arranged to marry Alice. He hopes their marriage will do away with any of the rumours surrounding Alice and is suspicious of her relationship with Hanako

characters.name: Eliza McGovern
characters.original: イライザ・マクガヴァン
characters.description: Hanako's colleague teacher and Alice's former tutor. She is also the one with whom Alice had a love affair. She separated herself from Alice in order to retain her aristocratic look and to save her from being publicly shamed. She is sent to Japan under the guise of promoting woman's education.

title: Naneun Amy-reul Saranghae
description: Bibi is a bubbly girl who's deeply obsessed with Peter, the cutest boy at her high school. So when she sees a random girl talking to him, Bibi invites her to a sleepover with malicious intent... only to have a surprisingly nice time! That's how she makes friends with Amy, a shy and sweet girl who agrees to help Bibi get with Peter. But as they cook up all sorts of love schemes to win Peter over, Amy's place in Bibi's heart grows bigger and bigger by the day... (Source: Tappytoon)

characters.name: Beatrice Redden
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") A classic Yandere, therefore she is stronger and more skilled than most girls. Bibi exhibits psychopathic traits, is bubbly and clingy and considers most people to be beneath her. ~!She is now married to [Amy Lee](https://anilist.co/character/295481/Amy-Lee) and has adopted two children with her, Jerry and Alice.!~

characters.name: Amelia Park Lee
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") A student with a timid personality.

characters.name: Camilla Connor
characters.description: A softie despite her tough exterior.

characters.name: Joy Park
characters.description: Amy's aunt who she lives with. She works at a publishing firm in the next town over.

characters.name: Peter Dales
characters.description: Peter is the most popular guy in school who Bibi has a crush on. He's an extremely outgoing and friendly people-person.

characters.name: Nana Nekota
characters.description: Nana is one of Camilla's friends. She is Jean's cousin.

characters.name: Gabriella Robinson
characters.description: Gabriella is one of Camilla's friends.

characters.name: Jean Mayday
characters.description: Jean is one of Camilla's friends. She is Nana's cousin.

characters.name: Sophia Connor
characters.description: Camilla's mother.

characters.name: Ian Connor
characters.description: Camilla's father.

characters.name: Nicholas Reden
characters.description: Bibi's uncle and guardian.

title: NEW GAME!
description: Aoba Suzukaze may look like a middle schooler, but she’s actually a character designer fresh out of high school. Not only is she working for the company that put out one of her favorite games, she also gets to spend her days modeling and creating characters. Follow her adorable shenanigans in this 4-panel slice of life as she learns the ropes of the industry and gets to know her co-workers. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes 30 extra chapters, 13 side chapters from volume 5, 12 color chapters from volumes 1-12 and 5 bonus chapters from volumes 1, 2, 9, 10, 11.

characters.name: Aoba Suzukaze
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Tokyo, Japan __Height:__ 149 cm A high school graduate who joins the Eagle Jump game company as a character designer, as they made her favorite game, Fairies Story. Due to her small stature, she is often mistaken for a middle school student.

characters.name: Kou Yagami
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Tokyo __Height:__ 164 cm The lead character designer of Eagle Jump. She spends a lot of time at the office, often sleeping there overnight in her underwear, and has a laid-back but stern attitude. She was the character designer for the game that inspired [Aoba](https://anilist.co/character/89641/Suzukaze-Aoba) to become one herself.

characters.name: Hifumi Takimoto
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Takimoto Hifumi is a character designer ~!(currently character team leader)!~ for Eagle Jump, a gaming studio located in Tokyo. Hifumi is especially shy to the point of avoiding talking to people or looking at them directly. As a result, in order to not make her feel uncomfortable, the other employees interact with her through the company's computer messenger system. Although, in later seasons she becomes more lively and goes out of her way to try to improve talking to people. Contrary to her normal personality, she becomes very lively, outgoing, and cheerful while texting or messaging, often using emoticons in chat. She secretly enjoys cosplay and owns a pet hedgehog named [Sojiro](https://anilist.co/character/158503/Sojiro). Some trivia about Hifumi: - Her favorite colors are Blue and Pink - Her favorite clothing style is "Sweet Lolita"

characters.name: Rin Tooyama
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Aichi prefecture, Japan __Height:__ 158 cm An art director and head of the background department. She joined the company at the same time as Kou whom she is very close friends with.

characters.name: Hajime Shinoda
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Tokushima Prefecture, Japan __Height:__ 167 cm A motion designer who works in the character design department as there are no open seats in the animation department. She enjoys sentai shows and owns various prop weapons.

characters.name: Yun Iijima
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Mie Prefecture, Japan __Height:__ 151 cm A character designer who designs monsters and often dresses in gothic clothing. She has two younger siblings.

characters.name: Nene Sakura
characters.description: **Birthplace:** Tokyo **Height:** 144 cm Aoba's friend from high school who is currently in university. She took an interest in programming and eventually became an intern at Eagle Jump after beta testing Fairies Story 3. Nene is described as childish, selfish, and goofy by Aoba, who can't stay focused on the task given to her, which is why she's often seen leaving her post. She is also an otaku and a fan of Faries Story Series.

characters.name: Umiko Ahagon
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Okinawa Prefecture, Japan __Height:__ 162 cm A programmer who often gets annoyed when she has to fix errors and is embarrassed by her surname. She is a military fan and has several airsoft weapons in her workspace.

characters.name: Shizuku Hazuki
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Tokyo, Japan __Height:__ 161 cm A game director with a strong interest in cute girls, hence why her department is entirely female. She owns a cat named [Mozuku](https://anilist.co/character/127138/Mozuku).

characters.name: Christina Wako Yamato
characters.original: 大和・クリスティーナ・和子
characters.description: Partially French Producer at Eagle Jump. Christina looks stoic outside but she tends worry a lot and she's a little bit of a crybaby. She easily blames herself to things she have no control over, easily embarrass and have a fear of being touch. (Source: Wikia)

characters.name: Hotaru Hoshikawa
characters.description: Aoba and Nene's friend from high school.

characters.name: Momiji Mochizuki
characters.description: A rookie at Eagle Jump who joins the character team. Joins at the same time as and is friends with [Tsubame Narumi](https://anilist.co/character/123370/Tsubame-Narumi).

title: Akebi-chan no Sailor Fuku
title_original: 明日ちゃんのセーラー服
description: Komichi Akebi lives out in the countryside with her family. She's won entrance to the prestigious Roubai Academy middle-school for girls and now she wants only two things -- to wear the school's sailor uniform and to make a hundred friends!

characters.name: Komichi Akebi
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 1. A girl who has a strong yearning for sailor uniforms due to a certain reason. She has a bright and straightforward personality, and is really looking forward to school life. She is very good at sports. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Erika Kizaki
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 5. The first classmate that [Komichi](https://anilist.co/character/159265/Akebi-Komichi) met. She has the air of a young lady, but also has an active side that likes fishing and mountain climbing.

characters.name: Touko Usagihara
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 2. She has good communication skills and a cheerful personality. She knows a lot of rumors about her classmates. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Tomono Kojou
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 6. She has a quiet and gentle personality, and loves to read. She started talking to [Komichi](https://anilist.co/character/159265/Akebi-Komichi) when she borrowed her handkerchief. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Hitomi Washio
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 16. She is the tallest girl in her class and has already become a promising member of the volleyball team. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Kei Tanigawa
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 9. She is a brilliant student who passed the entrance exam to the prestigious Shoume Gakuen. After meeting Komichi, she becomes interested in taking selfies. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Hotaru Hiraiwa
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 14. She is the smallest girl in the class, mysterious and unpredictable. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Riri Minakami
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 13. She is a good swimmer and speaks in a Kansai dialect. She doesn't talk much in class, but seems to be comfortable talking to Komichi. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Neko Kamimoku
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 4. She always looks sleepy and often dozes off in class, which the teacher often cautions her about. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Ai Tatsumori
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 8. A girl who aims to be the best at everything. She is the head of the school. She hates to lose and has a strong desire to improve. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Ayumi Togeguchi
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 10. She is careful not to speak in a dialect. Because of this, she doesn't talk much in class. However, when she gets emotional, she sometimes can't stop herself. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

characters.name: Riona Shijou
characters.description: Class 1-3, student number 7. She had been learning hard tennis all her life until she started studying for her exams. She has a certain complex. (Source: Official Site, Translated)

title: Kiss x Sis
description: Keita has two step-sisters who love him in a lustful way and have no problems expressing it, they even are in competition about that. Much to the laughs of his friends, he endures it but when one day they come to his school to give him his lunch, he gets annoyed and explodes on them, then they confess their feelings for him in front of everyone and leave. Feeling sorry he chases after them and says that he'll study hard in order to get in the same high school as them. (Source: MangaHelpers)

characters.name: Keita Suminoe
characters.description: Keita is a third-year junior-high school student studying for his high school entrance exams and although he is the younger brother, it is obvious he is the most mature of the three siblings. He wants to enter the same high school as his older twin step-sisters [Ako](https://anilist.co/character/8040) and [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/8041), and to do so must study hard while getting help from his sisters as well as he was originally planning on relying on his track running scholarship for another school. While at first he initially dislikes himself for becoming attracted to Ako and Riko, he later becomes proactive in his desires. It is later revealed he was in love with his sisters when they were kids, and even used all of his money that he saved up for a prayer that he could marry both of them. This changed when he found out from his father that polygamy is illegal and "grew up".

characters.name: Ako Suminoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 145 cm (OVA 7) Ako is the elder twin sister. A way to tell her apart from [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/8041/Suminoe-Riko) is that she wears a hair clip to keep the hair off her forehead. She has a reliable, level-headed personality, but can be sullen, moody, even a bit childish and is quickly embarrassed. She carries herself differently than her sister, is more skilled in cooking which she learned to help her mom out with the housework, and is strong with alcohol which she sometimes uses to her advantage to knock out Riko to have the livelier [Keita](https://anilist.co/character/8039/Suminoe-Keita) all to herself. She is a closet pervert and more often planning her seduction of Keita, even hiding porn magazines in her room. At school, she is on the school committee, but has a habit of abusing her authority to get Keita.

characters.name: Riko Suminoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 145 cm Riko is the younger twin sister. A way to tell her apart from Ako is that she wears her hair in a ponytail, and it is longer than her sister's hair. Also, she has a bandage below her left eye. She has a habit of answering truthfully but very bluntly, causing everyone else to jump to conclusions, even at one time about to honestly state that she and her sister wanted a computer solely for porn, however was quickly stopped by Ako. She is much shyer in person than her sister, as she could not kiss Keita in front of others. At school, she is on the disciplinary committee, where she uses a bokken/shinai to punish the students and she has more of a strict personality, yet just like her sister will abuse her authority to get Keita.

characters.name: Miharu Mikuni
characters.description: A teenage girl that was introduced in chapter 18 where she returned Keita's acceptance letter when she found her dog trying to bury it in her yard. Out of a combination of stress from believing he did not get in to the relief he found out he did get in, Keita hugs her out of the blue. After that action she has shown an attraction towards Keita, often blushing when they talk and feeling very comfortable when he hugs her, but overall states she has nothing to do with him. Though it is obvious she is attracted to him, keeping her distance because of his sisters as well as her own inexperience being around boys, even fantasizing him raping her and experiencing an orgasm from him giving her a piggy back ride. Even though she does not go after him, his sisters still see her as a possible threat for Keita's heart. It is noted from Keita that she has a bigger bust than his sisters when he recall

characters.name: Mikazuki Kiryuu
characters.description: She is an underclassman that is "chasing after him (Keita)". They were in the same sports club back at his old school. She is even more perverted than Ako and Riko when it comes to getting Keita's attention, with no qualms of flashing her privates at him in front of others. She is also a bit of an airhead, believing that Miharu and Keita are no longer virgins when she found them hugging. Yuuzuki's is her older sister, usually referring to her in private as "my otaku sister", who Mikazuki looks up to and loves very dearly, even stating once the visual novel she bought was for her to cover for her sister. However, she also enjoys taking lewd pictures of her sister in cosplay as compensation for covering for her. She was able to correctly assume that her sister has feelings for Keita. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yuuzuki Kiryuu
characters.description: She is Mikazuki's older sister, the new teacher to Gakushū Senior High and homeroom teacher to Keita and Miharu, who in an earlier chapter was a clothing store clerk because she liked western style clothing. Through bad timing and unaware that Keita and his sisters are not related by blood, she believes that he is a deviant who dates multiple girls while having an incestuous relationship with his sisters. She becomes excited by her exaggerated ideas of what he and his sisters do at home or with other girls. Through these beliefs, she tries to recruit Miharu, believing she is one of the girls Keita is dating, to have them go on a date to separate him from his sisters. She is a virgin, however after clearing everything up, she starts to have growing feelings for Keita as well that goes to a lustful desire, practically raping his P.E. clothes as she is addicted to the scent of his sweat and

characters.name: Suminoe no Haha
characters.description: Keita, Ako, and Riko's mother.

characters.name: Chichi
characters.description: Keita, Ako, and Riko's father. He completely supports his son having relations with any of the women in the story. Nothing shocks him and he is always rooting for Keita.

characters.name: Toda Edogawa
characters.description: Toda is one of Keita's many classmates who are jealous of him for living with Ako and Riko. Throughout the entire anime/manga he is seen admiring Ako and Riko or Bothering Keita about his love life.

title: Asumi-chan wa Rezu Fuuzoku ni Kyoumi ga Arimasu!
title_original: 彩純ちゃんはレズ風俗に興味があります！
title_en: Asumi-chan is Interested in Lesbian Brothels
description: Sweet but awkward college student Asumi never got over her childhood crush on her old friend Mai. She’s mortified by the memory of their first kiss, which couldn’t have gone worse. When she discovers that Mai may be working at a nearby brothel, she sees her chance for redemption. There’s only one catch: none of the girls on the brothel’s website use their real names. Goaded along by a more experienced friend, Asumi begins a journey of exploring her sexuality, trying new fetishes, and getting comfortable in her own skin as she sleeps with the brothel’s women one at a time in her search for Mai. Is it possible Mai is searching for her out there, too? And when they finally reunite, will Asumi be experienced and confident this time? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Asumi Kusumoto
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm She is looking for [Mai](https://anilist.co/character/231723), her childhood friend and crush.
