title: Anemone wa Netsu wo Obiru
title_original: アネモネは熱を帯びる
description: After failing to get into her desired high school, studious Nagisa is resolved to keep her chin up and move on. That is, until she meets a sickly girl named Mashiro at her new school, who throws a wrench into her plans—as she's the very reason Nagisa flunked her exams in the first place. But Nagisa decides she won't let it get her down, and to upend her negative feelings, she vows to warm up to Mashiro...Delve into this clever but clumsy girl's captivating love story. (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Nagisa Ootsuki
characters.description: Mashiro, who sits next to her, bothers her in a number of ways, and in order to improve herself, she pushes herself to confront Mashiro and "like" her. She had previously been unable to make it in time for her preferred school's entrance exam after helping a girl (Mashiro) who had collapsed, so she took an exam for a nearby private high school instead and enrolled there. When she reached high school, she changed her hairstyle and switched from glasses to contact lenses. Her family consists of her parents, younger brother, and two younger sisters.

characters.name: Mashiro Komiyama
characters.description: Her personality is bright and friendly, yet she is a frail person who needs to rest in the infirmary whenever she feels ill. She isn't particularly good at studying. She knows that people are worried about her health and she does her best to handle things on her own despite having a weak body. Her parents are her only family members.

characters.name: Mizuki Nanjou
characters.description: She is the student council president. She is in love with the school nurse and sees Nagisa and Mashiro's connection when she first met them in the school infirmary. She provides Nagisa helpful advice based on her own love life.

characters.name: Riri Kuori
characters.description: She is the vice president of the student council. She is in love with Mizuki Nanjo, the student council president, but she has problems convincing Mizuki, who is in love with the school nurse, to accept her feelings; as a result, she can occasionally come on to Mizuki too hard.

characters.name: Ami Uda
characters.description: Nagisa and Mashiro's classmate. She has an outgoing and outspoken personality. Nagisa and her friends refer to her as Uda-chan, whereas Uda refers to Nagisa as "Naginagi" and Mashiro as "Mashirochi". She dresses casually for school. The vice president of the student council, Riri Kuori, and her are close friends.

characters.name: Akari Hayama
characters.description: She's the school nurse. She is normally a cool person, yet she is always willing to support students that ask for for help. Mizuki's feelings for her extend beyond the teacher-student relationship.

characters.name: Shizuku Ootsuki
characters.description: Nagisa's little sister. She dearly loves her older sister Nagisa, and when she first met Mashiro, she and Saki competed to determine who was closer to Nagisa.

characters.name: Saki Ootsuki
characters.description: Nagisa's little sister. She dearly loves her elder sister Nagisa, and when she first met Mashiro, she and Shizuku competed to determine who was closer to Nagisa.

characters.name: Yuka
characters.description: Nagisa's cousin. She thinks Nagisa is a very different person now than she was before.

title: K-On!
description: When their high school's pop-music club is about to be disbanded due to lack of interest, four girls step up to fill the membership quota. Unfortunately, lead guitarist Yui Hirasawa has never played an instrument in her life. Ever. And although she likes the idea of being in a band, standing in front of the mirror posing with her guitar is a lot easier than actually playing it. It's gonna be a while before this motley crew is rocking out, but with their spunk and determination cranked to 11, anything is possible! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes five extra chapters.

characters.name: Yui Hirasawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Yui Hirasawa is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON!. She's also the main protagonist. She is the air-headed lead guitarist and vocalist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. Having misunderstood that "light music" equals "easy music" (like whistling), she joined the Light Music Club and picked up guitar with absolutely no prior experience. She plays a Gibson Pre-'08 Les Paul Standard '50s in Heritage Cherry Sunburst. She names it Giita, which quite literally means "guitar".

characters.name: Mio Akiyama
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Mio Akiyama is one of the five main characters in K-ON! She is a passionate and technical left-handed musician and writer who serves as the bassist, second vocalist and main lyricist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. She is a kind and warm girl, albeit very shy and sensitive. Despite her timid streak, she often finds herself as the voice of reason amongst her bandmates, who often rely on her sensibility when in trouble. She plays a left-handed Fender Japan '62 Reissue Jazz Bass in 3-Tone Sunburst.

characters.name: Ritsu Tainaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm Ritsu Tainaka, called Ricchan by [Tsumugi Kotobuki](https://anilist.co/character/19568/Tsumugi-Kotobuki) and [Yui Hirasawa](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON!. She is the self-appointed president of the Light Music Club and the drummer of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. She was the one who rebooted the Light Music Club when it was on the verge of being disbanded, and has become the natural leader of the club since then. Ritsu plays a yellow Rick Marotta Signature Yamaha Hipgig drum kit with an add-on floor tom (in the opening credits only) combined with a cymbal set from Avedis Zildjian, though is shown playing a white Yamaha Absolute Series drumkit in the anime's closing credits.

characters.name: Tsumugi Kotobuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm Tsumugi Kotobuki, otherwise known as Mugi is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON! She is a wealthy, cheery, cute girl with a gentle personality who plays the keyboard and is the main musical composer in the band Ho-kago Tea Time. Mugi plays a Korg Triton Extreme 76-key keyboard, though she is also seen playing a Korg RK-100 keytar in the closing credits of the first season.

characters.name: Azusa Nakano
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm Azusa Nakano, nicknamed "Azu-nyan" by [Yui Hirasawa](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), is a main character in the K-ON! series. She is a second year student at Sakuragaoka High School. She decided to join the Light Music Club after seeing the band's performance in the school festival, and thus became Ho-kago Tea Time's second guitarist. Azusa plays a Fender Japan '69 Reissue Mustang in Candy Apple Red.

characters.name: Sawako Yamanaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Sawako is the adviser for the wind instrument club at Yui's school. An alumna of the school and a former member of the light music club, she does not want people to know she was formerly a member of a heavy metal band, thus she covers up by being mild and gentle to her co-workers and especially to students. She is forced to be the adviser of the light music club, as Ritsu blackmails her after the girls learn of her past, though it is unknown whether she stopped being the adviser for the wind instrument club as the story progresses. Though she has a mature and gentle demeanor in the school, Sawako, affectionately addressed as "Sawa-chan" by both Ritsu and Yui, displays a totally different, completely authentic character when she is alone with the light music club. In reality, she is a rather wild, lazy and quite an irresponsible teacher who enjoys dressing up the light

characters.name: Nodoka Manabe
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm Nodoka is [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s childhood friend and confidant who is a member of the school's student council. As a normal, well-mannered and intelligent girl, she is generally taken aback by the light music club's odd behavior, and easily gets annoyed with [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) whenever she forgets to fill in the club's application forms. She shares the same class as [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama) in their second year, who appreciates her companionship tremendously, as being the only person [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama) knows in her class. In her third year, she becomes the student council president.

characters.name: Ui Hirasawa
characters.description: **Height:** 154 cm Ui is [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s younger sister, who begins the story as a third-year junior high school student, but later enters [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s high school the following year in the same class as [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano). Unlike her older sister, Ui is mature, responsible and handles household chores well, though she still shares a strong relationship with [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) and has a great deal of love and respect for her older sister. Despite being a year younger than [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), she is nearly identical to her with her hair down and is even once able to fool the club. She possesses some of her sister's musical gift, and has a great talent for playing the guitar—she became capable of p

characters.name: Megumi Sokabe
characters.description: Megumi was the president of the student council before [Nodoka](https://anilist.co/character/19570/Nodoka-Manabe) succeeds her in her third year, and she is also the president of [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama)'s fan club. She stalks [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama) during her last few days in high school because she wanted to see [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama) one more time. The band offers her a song as a graduation gift.

characters.name: Jun Suzuki
characters.description: **Role:** Bassist **Instrument:** Bass Guitar Jun is [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano)'s and [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa)'s classmate who often hangs out with the latter. Jun is generally a playful and easygoing girl, but she is sometimes rude without realizing it, compelling [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano) to reprimand her. [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa) tries to get her to join the light music club but ultimately fails due to a strange visit to the club room. However, she starts to regret it when she hears about all the activities the club does. She has a pet cat and plays the bass. Jun has an older brother, Atsushi Suzuki, nicknamed Acchan by her. He plays the bass at a university and helps Jun on "secret training sessions" because she apparently "still sucks at bass".

title: Akame ga Kill! Zero
description: They believed that every time they took a life, they brought happiness to another... Before becoming Night Raid's deadliest ally, Akame was a young girl bought by the Empire and raised as an assassin whose sole purpose was to slaughter everything in her path. Because that's what makes people happy...right? (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Akame
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'4") Akame is one of the members of the Assassin's group, Night Raid. She is the first member to attack [Tatsumi](https://anilist.co/character/64749), and comes very close to killing him. She initially appears very serious and cold-hearted, but she is actually caring and worries about the safety of her comrades. She has a younger sister named [Kurome](https://anilist.co/character/65297), who is a member of the Jaegers, and loyal to the Empire. Her Teigu is the One-Cut Killer: Murasame, a katana known for being coated in an immensely deadly poison that could kill those cut by it within seconds, as the poison itself has no antidote. ~!When she was a child, her parents had sold both her and Kurome to the Empire. There, they were placed and raised as Assassins from childhood. Akame in particular became infamous enough to earned the top rank in the Imperial Assassin Divis

characters.name: Kurome
characters.description: Kurome is a member of the Jaegers, and the younger sister of [Akame](https://anilist.co/character/63351/Akame). Like her sister, she has a big appetite and is often seen eating, usually candy. She stubbornly refuses to share her candy with even her comrades. Kurome wields an offensive Teigu like her sister, in the form of a sword named "March of the Dead: Yatsuhusa", which allows her to enslave up to 8 enemies killed with the Teigu. Also like her sister, she is extremely skilled in the art of the sword and assassination. ~!When she was a child, her parents had sold both Akame and her to the Empire.!~

characters.name: Natala
characters.description: Natala was a member of the Empire's assassination group Group of Terror appearing in the prequel series Akame Ga Kill!: Zero until his death. He is now serving as one of Kurome's main corpse puppets. Natala is one of the members of Kurome's group of assassins. He died some time before the main story and his deceased body was reanimated by Kurome using Yatsufusa. He is later use in a battle against Night Raid, defending Kurome from her enemies. After the battle, Natala became one of the last two puppets, the other being Dooya. Natala wielded Trisula. Mine mistakenly thought it was a Teigu, but it is in fact a Shingu. Because the weapon's design allows it to expand and contract at will, its style of killing is to cut the opponent's body in two. Natala bifurcated Chelsea with this weapon.

title: Himegoto: Juukyuusai no Seifuku
title_original: ヒメゴト ～十九歳の制服～
description: This is a story of a group of college-age people who struggle with gender and sexual identity. Yuki (nicknamed Yoshiki) is a girl, but she is terrible at 'being feminine.' She mostly dresses like a boy and is often mistaken as one. However, she has to wear a skirt and imagine being dominated by a guy in order to masturbate. Nagao Mikako seems young and innocent, and she uses that apparent innocence to sell her body as a fake 15-year-old. She knows her youthfulness can't last forever, but she enjoys tricking the men. Her friends have no idea of her sexual habits and believe her to be sweet and sheltered. Aiba Kaito is a pretty good-looking guy, but he wants to be Nagao Mikako. He often dresses as a girl, picking out clothes that mimic Mikako's style. Though he's into cross-dressing, he is still attracted to women. Will these young adults and their friends be able to handle their 'guilty secrets' and muddle their way through this confusing period of their lives? (Source: MangaHelpers)

characters.name: Mei Aihara
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Mei Aihara is an honor student, the chairman's granddaughter, and the stern and cold student council president. She is often calm and composed but she can be rather sensitive and mature to some extent. At first, there is little to know about her and a bad impression of Mei washes over [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/83367/Aihara-Yuzu), which causes Yuzu to take interest for Mei later on. Though Mei seems to be hard to approach, she is rather sensitive and lonely which makes Yuzu want to care for Mei more.

characters.name: Yuzu Aihara
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm The self-proclaimed Gyaru and only child, Yuzu transfers to an all-girls school after her mother is remarried. Yuzu is outspoken, daring, and shameless to some extent. She is often seen wearing her uniform that runs against the rules thus far. Unfortunately for her, she is bothered by the Student Council President's dress code enforcement. Yuzu eventually comes home to hear that she is now the older sister of the Student Council President, [Mei Aihara](https://anilist.co/character/83209/Aihara-Mei). Despite showing irritation towards Mei, she becomes concerned for her in which transitions into infatuation and deep care. Though she is rebellious in school, she means well and is often acting on behalf of Mei in a sense of protection. Also, her closest friend in school is [Harumin](https://anilist.co/character/83387/Taniguchi-Harumi).

She comes across Yuzu and Harumin at an arcade and invites them out to karaoke. Harumin is appears to be quite wary and suspicious of her. Upon deducing the nature of Yuzu's feelings toward Mei, Matsuri professes a romantic interest in Yuzu and kisses her in front of Mei. The two of them gradually became friends and began to spend a lot of time together. Adachi had an extremely introverted personality. Before meeting Shimamura, she never had someone whom she can call a friend. Adachi was said to be cold toward other people and didn't attempt to make friends with other people in the past. She also gets very jealous when Shimamura is together with her friends, and as a consequence usually ends up running away.

The two instantly took a liking for each other and began to hang out together all the time. Shimamura has tail-bone length, dyed brown hair, which she keeps out of her face with two clips on the right side. Her eyes are also brown. Despite playing basketball in middle school, Shimamura is on the shorter side. She has a slim figure. Hino has a bubbly personality and is known to add in sound effects, whether they're needed or not. She also enjoys fishing, though she often complains about not having any school fishing friends. Chikama wears a full body spacesuit. It has childish design elements, such as hearts and star patches.

title: Gakuen Alice
description: Young Mikan runs away to Tokyo to follow her best friend, Hotaru, who has been enrolled in an exclusive, secretive private school for geniuses. But it turns out that Alice Academy is a lot more than meets the eye. If Mikan wants to stay by Hotaru's side, she has to both pass the strange "entrance exam" and face the even greater challenge of befriending her very odd new classmates. Whether it's Hotaru's gift for inventing gadgets, the cranky Natsume's fire-casting ability, or Professor Narumi's control of human pheromones, everyone at the school has some sort of special talent. But what ability, if any, does Mikan possess? Mikan is going to have to rely on her courage and spunk if she's going to stay in school, or even stay alive! (Source: TOKYOPOP) Notes: - Volume 9 contains a side story; - Volume 10 contains the side story "Ibara no Sono" (いばらの園); - Volume 17 contains the side story "Hoshizora Obake" (星空おばけ).

She was accepted to Alice Academy by Narumi-sensei and could attend Alice Academy with Hotaru and many other children with extraordinary powers. Her Alice is Nullification, which can resist the effect of Pheromone type Alices and completely negate the powers of other Alices in close proximity to her. She also possesses the Stealing Alice, which she inherited from her mother. Both of her Alices are very rare and special.

She may treat Mikan unkindly most of the time, but it is apparent that she deeply cares for her. Somehow, she likes to bully people she likes. Hotaru is Mikan's best friend and the main reason why Mikan came to the academy. Her "stupid" points are her tendency of being a "pig" when it comes to food and her greedy side, this happens in a comical manner. Her Alice is Invention, which allows her to create unique and strange inventions. She belongs to the Technical Class. She is currently a Triple Star. Her name "蛍 - Hotaru" means "Firefly".

Hated and feared by a lot of students at the academy because of his dangerous Alice and cold attitude. Due to the isolation he feels from most of his classmates and hatred many student feel about him he is often bullied even though he comes to ignore it, although the class he is a part of holds him in very high regard and often follows his orders. He is thoroughly unhappy with the school and is always suspicious of the intentions of adults because he believes that they use their power over the younger students to hurt and abuse. He possesses the fire Alice. It is revealed early on that since Natsume has such a powerful Alice, it causes a lot of stress on his body to use and shortens his lifespan immensely.

He has a gentle and pleasant personality that balances out that of Natsume's. Even though he tries to hide his feelings for Mikan Sakura, the grown-ups already know about it and even teased Ruka many times by the Watching Over Ruka Group.He always carries around a rabbit and has a way with animals, they seem to attract to him. He is also the main target of Hotaru, who loves clicking funny pictures of him and selling them. He belongs to the Somatic class. He is a Triple Star student like Hotaru.

He teaches Japanese and often deals with Natsume when he gets in trouble or tries to break out. He has the human inclination pheromone Alice, which suits his personality. He is also the moderating teacher of the Somatic types. The author revealed in the character bio that Narumi is indeed a central character, and his past are yet to be discovered. Narumi gave Mikan a star when Sumire became good friends with her and because of her bravery during being trapped in a warehouse (with Sumire and Natsume). Even though he is a bit negligent as a teacher he loves his students and wants to protect them. In both the manga and anime Narumi allows Mikan to call him "Dad" which is ironic because Mikan is the daughter of his unrequited love Yuka Azumi.

She is shown to have good fighting abilities as she can easily beat up guys in a fight. In t

She has a dog-cat Alice which gives her enhanced smell and hearing capabilities, as well as making her sprout cat whiskers and dog ears and promoting the desire to walk on all fours. Mikan also knows her brother as ‘seaweed head'. Mikan also gave Sumire a nickname, Permy. However, only she, and occasionally Natsume, used it. Even though she has a crush towards both Natsume and Ruka, she is not romantically interested in them; rather she sees them as matinée idols. Though she sometimes bullies Yome Kokoro, her affections are meant for him, her long time partner and best friend. She initially disliked Mikan for many reasons, but later becomes on "good terms" with her, though she still considers Mikan a rival of sorts. Wh

characters.name: Nonoko Ogasawara
characters.description: **Alice:** Chemistry **Alice Stone Color:** Pink Nonoko is one of Mikan's companions and she is one academic year younger than her. She has the Alice of Chemistry and likes to experiment with dangerous chemicals. She is a member of the "3 geeky sisters." She is an elegant girl from a rich family (Explained in her profile in the manga).[7] She is close friends with Anna and has a crush on Misaki-sensei. There was a time in the radio drama entitled Chocoholic where her Alice got switched with Anna. In the Radio Drama, Love Potion, Nonoko made a Love Potion which can make a pair of lovers to love their partners even more. Sumire tricked Mikan to drink the potion and ended up falling for Tsubasa. Natsume and Ruka also got affected by the potion, which resulted with Ruka falling for Natsume and Natsume falling for Mikan. She belongs to the Technical Class. She is a Single Star stude

characters.name: Persona
characters.description: **Alice**: Mark of Death **Alice Stone Color**: Black Persona is a mysterious teacher who wears a mask at all times. He is the moderator for the Dangerous Ability Class. He seems to be the source of much of Natsume's troubles. His Alice is the Mark of Death. So far, in the series, he was seen without his mask three times. The first time was when Natsume spotted him (although he had sunglasses on) in Central Town in chapter 46. The second time he disguised himself as a substitute teacher named Serio in one of Natsume's exams to see who was the cause of Natsume's change (but he was found out easily by Natsume). The third time was when Mikan knocked off Persona's mask while trying to stop him from hurting Natsume in the Hana Princess arc. He also once held Natsume's sister captive in order to make Natsume behave. Persona also calls Natsume his "Best Student.&qu

characters.name: Yuu Tobita
characters.description: **Alice**: Illusion **Alice Stone Color**: Jade/Emerald Green Yuu is the class representative, or "Iinchō", as he is known by the majority of the class. He has the Alice of Illusion. During the Alice Festival, his illusions were a major hit in the Haunted House attraction of the Latent Ability Class. As stated by Mikan, Natsume, and Ruka, he is a force to be reckoned with. He has his hands full with taking care of Mikan and does not seem to get tired of it. According to the author, he fell in love with Mikan at first sight. ~!Mikan's mother steals his Alice in the manga causing Mikan, Natsume, Ruka, and Tsubasa to chase after them to get it back. Although, they were mainly after a cure for Hotaru. When Mikan and the others returned, they did not have Iinchō's Alice, but he regains it when Narumi brings it to him.!~ He is in the Latent Ability Class. He is currently a Triple Sta

characters.name: Reo Mouri
characters.description: **Alice:** Voice Pheromone Reo is a graduate from the Academy, who turned into an international celebrity. He is first seen in Episode 13. He came to Alice Academy to perform in the Opening Ceremony of the Alice Festival. During the performance, he faked an injury and took the chance to kidnap [Natsume](https://anilist.co/character/2394/Hyuuga-Natsume) in the hospital. After he failed to kidnap Natsume the first time, he manipulates [Ruka](https://anilist.co/character/5434/Nogi-Ruka) (episode 23) to do his bidding. His ability control device is the earing he has in his left ear. [Narumi](https://anilist.co/character/2396/Anjo-Narumi) was Reo's senpai when they were in the Academy, and out of both of them, Reo thought that Narumi would be the one that would retaliate against the Academy, but now he believes that Narumi had betrayed him.

title: Kyou wa Kanojo ga Inai kara
title_original: 今日はカノジョがいないから
description: Pent up and tired of her apathetic girlfriend, Asahina Yuni turns to an anonymous online account to let it all out. It’s just another day of doomscrolling after class when Asahina gets swept away in conversation with the beautiful, outgoing Taki. When Taki turns out to be following Asahina’s private account, it’s cute…right? Taki would never blackmail Asahina…right? With every new lie, the web of secrets and erotic desire grows ever-tighter! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Yuni Asahina
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") She is dating a classmate, [Nanase](https://anilist.co/character/308128/Natsume-Nanase), but keeps it a secret from everyone. She's the type of person who vents her frustrations on her private Twitter account.

characters.name: Nanase Natsume
characters.description: __Height__: 168cm Yuni's girlfriend. She is a member of the volleyball club.

characters.name: Fuuko Taki
characters.description: Yuni's classmate. Despite having never spoken to Yuni before, she knows about Yuni's secret social network account.

characters.name: Yuki
characters.description: Natsume's friend and volleyball teammate.

characters.name: Yuzuki
characters.description: Fuuko's childhood crush.

characters.name: Mashiro
characters.description: Fuuko's childhood friend.

title: Senpai wa Otokonoko
description: Can true love really overcome any obstacles? Saki, a high school student, confesses her feelings to Makoto. Taken aback, Makoto reveals his secret, but the sudden discovery doesn’t seem to bother Saki who is already head over heels for him. After being rejected, Saki asks Ryuji, Makoto’s childhood friend, for some advice on how to win his heart. A love triangle unfolds when Ryuji realizes that he might also have some feelings for his old friend. (Source: WEBTOON)

characters.name: Makoto Hanaoka
characters.description: A young man who dresses like a woman despite his mother's disapproval.

characters.name: Saki Aoi
characters.description: A first year student at the same school as [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/261092/Makoto-Hanaoka) and [Ryuuji.](https://anilist.co/character/261090/Ryuuji-Taiga) She is cheerful and naive, initially mistaking Makoto for a girl when she confesses her feelings. She lives with her grandmother.

characters.name: Ryuuji Taiga
characters.description: A second-year high school student who is childhood friends with [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/261092/Makoto-Hanaoka). He is good at taking care of others and always supports Makoto. However, he makes fun of Makoto getting closer to [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/261093/Saki-Aoi), as if he's guarding against something.

characters.name: Konatsu Taiga
characters.description: Ryuuji's sister.

characters.name: Kaede Hanekawa
characters.description: One of Makoto's classmates.

title: 2-ban Lee Hui-Su
description: Hui-Su’s world revolves around Chan-Young, his best friend and secret crush. He doesn’t mind cheering Chan-Yeong from the sidelines or listening to all his girl problems. He doesn’t care if people only know him as “Chan-Yeong’s friend.” Then one day, Hui-Su starts hearing his name everywhere. On the bus, in the halls, during lunch… Turns out, there’s a rumor going around school (Got a love problem? Find Hui-Su in Class 2 and he’ll tell you what to do!) and with that, Hui-Su suddenly finds himself the center of attention. But how could he give anyone advice? He doesn’t even know what to do about his own crush! (Source: Lezhin, edited) Note: Includes one prologue and ten side story chapters.

characters.name: Chan-Yeong Ju
characters.description: Hui-Su's best friend and crush.

characters.name: Ji-Yu Choi
characters.description: Seung-Won's pretend crush and best friend.

title: Zenbu Kowashite Jigoku de Aishite
title_original: ぜんぶ壊して地獄で愛して
description: Kurumi Yoshizawa is the student council president with excellent grades and good manners... but in private, she is stressed by her strict mother and the excessive expectations of her teachers. One day, Yoshizawa is asked by her homeroom teacher to check on her truant classmate Naoi, but Naoi only scorns Yoshizawa, as if seeing through her true feelings. On the verge of a mental breakdown, Yoshizawa makes a clumsy attempt at shoplifting, but Naoi records the whole thing... This is a violent coming-of-age story about two people struggling in everyday life with no escape. (Source: Ichijin Plus, translated)

title: X
description: Kamui Shiro is a young man who was born with the power to decide the fate of the Earth itself--a destiny he can barely bring himself to believe. But as other players in the prophesy begin to gather around him--the "Seven Seals," with the power to protect the Earth, and the "Seven Harbingers," who are fated to destroy it--he has no choice but to come to terms with his fate. (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Kamui Shirou
characters.description: __Powers:__ Powerful psychic, demonstrating telekinetic ability, the proverbial "power (authority) of God" __Kekkai (barrier field):__ Perfect sphere (anime only) __Relatives:__ Shirou Tooru / Magami Tooru (mother; deceased), Magami Tokiko __Romantic Interests:__ Monou Kotori __Closer Friends:__ Monou Fuma When the audience is first introduced to Kamui at the very beginning of X, he appears to be nothing more than a brooding and somewhat cocky fifteen year old from Okinawa who is gifted with extraordinary telekinetic powers. He has returned to the place where he spent his early childhood, Tokyo, for the first time in six years, prompted to do so by the mysterious dying words of his mother, Shirou Tooru, that his destiny awaited him in Tokyo. __Tsubasa: Reservoir Chronicle:__ ~!Kamui is leader of a group of survivors residing in the Tokyo Tocho building. Charismatic and mysterious, wieldi

characters.name: Fuuma Monou
characters.description: The primary antagonist and Kamui's dear friend. Fuuma is initially kind and gentle. He helps his father dutifully and dotes upon his younger sister Kotori, and excels at high-school sports. After Nataku attacks Kyogo and steals the first Shinken, Fuuma's dying father tells him that he is Kamui's twin star. ~!Accordingly, when Kamui chooses the Dragons of Heaven, Fuuma is forced to become a Dragon of Earth, immediately attacking Kamui. He proceeds to grant wishes to the characters with whom he interacts, in ways that often lead to their death or that of a loved one.!~ In __Tsubasa: Reservoir Chronicle__ ~!He is Seishirō's younger brother, a friend of Yuko Ichihara and de facto leader of the people of the Tower. In actuality, he's a treasure hunter who can travel across dimensions and often searches artifacts at Yuko's request. He is on friendly terms with the main characters in the series

characters.name: Sorata Arisugawa
characters.description: A dragon of heaven, Sorata is an upbeat, irreverent teenager possessing considerable occult abilities, raised by the Shingon Buddhist monks of Kōyasan after being taken away from his mother at a young age. A gourmand, he was frequently in trouble at the shrine for stealing food between meals (insisting that he couldn't wait until dinner), and is also a competent cook. It was prophesied that he would protect Kamui with his life, but that he would die for a woman; the first time he meets Arashi, he decides she will be the one. An incessantly friendly young man, he wears down the resistance of both Kamui and Arashi and worms his way into their affections, despite their initial coldness and his own unrefined Kansai dialect. In addition to generating powerful electrical discharges, he is also capable of calling upon a gohōdōji, a magical being similar to a shikigami manifesting as a mass

characters.name: Arashi Kishu
characters.description: A foundling girl raised by Shintō priests at Ise Jingū and the the Dragon of Heaven most immediately in touch with Princess Hinoto. Called the "Hidden Priestess of Ise", her specialty is sword fighting, a massive sword emerging from her left hand. Despite her cold, stoic front, Sorata falls in love with her, and ultimately she comes to reciprocate. __In Tsubasa Reservoir Chronicle__ ~! In the Republic of Hanshin, she's a retired miko married to Sorata. In Tokyo, she's a miko who can foresee disaster and is one of the seven fighters of the Tower faction. !~

characters.name: Yuzuriha Nekoi
characters.description: One of the dragons of Heaven, a fourteen-year-old schoolgirl descended from the keepers of Mitsumine Jinja, masters of inugami (dog-spirits), Yuzuriha is exceedingly energetic, often diffusing latent tension between Kamui and the rest of the Ten no Ryū. Yuzuriha is attended by her own personal inugami, Inuki, who can transform into anything she desires and who only others with occult powers can see. She was teased throughout much of her childhood as her classmates believed Inuki was her imaginary friend. Because of this, Yuzuriha made a vow that she would never fall in love with (or even date) a man who could not see Inuki. However, the first person outside of her family that she meets who can see Inuki is Shiyū Kusanagi—a Dragon of Earth. Yuzuriha falls in love with Kusanagi, regardless of their conflicting fates. __In Tsubasa Reservoir Chronicle__ ~! In Edonis country, she's

characters.name: Subaru Sumeragi
characters.description: Subaru is the younger of a pair of fraternal twins, his older twin being a girl named Hokuto. Their parents (who are never seen) were members of the Sumeragi, a clan of onmyouji who have served Japan and its emperors for hundreds of years. Subaru was trained from an early age to become the 13th head of the Sumeragi clan, replacing his grandmother. At the age of nine, he was separated from his sister Hokuto for a year of intensive training in Tokyo. On the day he ascended to the head of the clan, Subaru encountered a strange young man under a cherry tree. The meeting would subsequently be expunged from his memory. Subaru's grandmother ordered him to wear gloves from that day onwards, and never to allow anyone else to see his hands. The old onmyouji cast a spell that would repel any attempts by others to remove them. Subaru never removed his gloves, and was known to wear them even when sle

characters.name: Karen Kasumi
characters.description: A dragon of heaven, Karen is a Soapland call girl and devout Catholic, she was abused by her fundamentalist mother when her power to manipulate fire manifested in her childhood. She comes to admire Aoki. __In Tsubasa Reservoir Chronicle__ ~! In Shara-no, she's the leading actress in an entertainment troupe. In Tokyo, she's one of the seven fighters of the Tower faction. !~

characters.name: Seiichiro Aoki
characters.description: A dragon of heaven, Aoki is a mild-mannered copy editor with a wife and child, who is also a wind magician. In the TV series, upon discovering that the battle between the Seals and Angels is at hand, he secretly divorces his wife Shimako in order to spare her grief should he be killed. Although Aoki is very powerful, he rarely sees any action in battle for much of the first half of the story as he is quite busy editing manuscripts. He is a wind master, with the ability to conjure and control wind currents. This is his family's gift; his nephew Saiki Daisuke has the same ability, though he isn't as strong. __In Tsubasa Reservoir Chronicle__ ~! He's one of the seven fighters of the Tower faction, who live in the apocalyptic world of Tokyo. !~

characters.name: Yuuto Kigai
characters.description: One of the Dragons Of Earth, Yuuto is a bureaucrat working at the Ward Office. He never lets on to any of the happy couples turning in their marriage licenses that he is seeking to destroy humanity, assuming an air of bland cheerfulness which he maintains even in combat He is in a sexual relationship with Kanoe, and is amused by the knowledge that Satsuki has a crush on him; he sees the latter as a sort of younger sister and protegée, and attempts to educate her about emotions. In combat Yuuto wields a sai dagger capable of severing human hands with one swipe, and which bears a powerful whiplash attachment that can smash through concrete. He is also a water master capable of summoning floods and hurling water bolts, as well as arranging more benign fountain displays for the amusement of others. __In Tsubasa Reservoir Chronicle:__ ~!In Tokyo, he's one of the seven fighters of the City Hal

characters.name: Satsuki Yatouji
characters.description: One of the Dragons of earth, a complex and ingenious young woman with utter contempt for humans, and a love for the digital world. Even though being usually cold and emotionless, she develops feelings for Yuuto. __In Tsubasa Reservoir Chronicle:__ ~!In Tokyo, she's one of the seven fighters of the City Hall action. Unlike in X, she studies medicine and is more no-nonsense than apathetic or heartless. She initially receives Syaoran's group with suspicion, but later treats their wounds. !~

characters.name: Kusanagi Shiyu
characters.description: One of the Dragons of Earth, a member of the Japanese Self-Defense Force who is telepathically linked to the plants and animals of the Earth, and thus strongly resents humanity's pollution and destruction of the natural world. Although his punch carries the force of an earthquake, he is the least antisocial of the Dragons of Earth, and the least active in the destruction of Tokyo. He meets Yuzuriha (and is the first man she ever met who can see Inuki) and develops an affection for her; although she falls in love with him, his intentions remain platonic as she is still a child. __In Tsubasa Reservoir Chronicle__ ~! In Edonis country, he's a player paired up with Yuzuriha Nekoi. In Tokyo, he's one of the seven fighters of the City Hall faction. !~

characters.name: Seishirou Sakurazuka
characters.description: __In Tokyo Babylon:__ Seishirou is a kind veterinarian. He joins in with [Hokuto](https://anilist.co/character/3080/Sumeragi-Hokuto) in teasing [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/439/Sumeragi-Subaru) about them getting married, but always laughs it off as Subaru blushes furiously. ~!Seishirou is actually the Sakurazukamori (powerful assasin onmyouji), or the "Sakura Assassin" whose signature is cherry blossoms and the symbol of an inverted pentagram. He made a bet with Subaru long ago, which entails the climax of the series.!~ __In X:__ ~!Seishirou is one of the Dragons of Earth, where he reveales his true self as a cold-hearted assassin who killed Subaru's twin sister Hokuto. In their final battle at Rainbow Bridge, Seishirou arranges for Subaru to kill him realizing who really won the bet.!~ __In Tsubasa: Reservoir Chronicle:__ ~!A vampire hunter who chases after the vampire twins (

title: Still Sick
description: Makoto Shimizu is just an ordinary office worker, blending in seamlessly with her colleagues on the job... That is, until her coworker Akane Maekawa discovers her well-hidden secret: in her spare time, she draws and sells girls' love comics! Akane is the last person Makoto would think of as a nerd, but as the two grow closer, it starts to seem like Akane may have a secret of her own... (Source: TOKYOPOP) Note: Includes 3 bonus chapters.

characters.name: Makoto Shimizu
characters.description: __Height__: 168cm Works in R&D software design department.

characters.name: Akane Maekawa
characters.description: __Height__: 152cm Works in the Administration Department.

title: Haru no Noroi
description: After Natsumi's younger sister and best friend Haru dies at the age of 19, she begins dating Haru's fiancee Tougo - on the condition that he take her only to places he had taken her sister. Their relationship deepens as the seasons pass, but Haru's Curse lies between them... Will there be happiness after Haru's Curse is broken? (Source: Kodansha USA) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title: Vampeerz
description: Ichika's life has taken a sudden turn. Her grandmother has passed away, so as family and friends come from far and wide to pay their respects, she finds herself in the spotlight as many of these old faces have taken an interest in her youth. As a fourteen-year-old Ichika could be dating. She could be participating in extra-curricular activities. She could be looking to her future. ...But she hasn't done any of that. All of that will change, when a young guest who she does not recognize visits her home. Aria seems to know quite a bit about her family and property, and while she may be there to say goodbye, she may have found her way into Ichika's heart. (Source: Denpa)

characters.name: Aria
characters.description: A vampire that Ichika meets during a visit.

title: Dungeon Sok Sajeong
description: The revered Swordmaster Hoss sets out to defeat the formidable Shell Dragon! But when people find his cold dead body amidst the remains of a fierce battle, they make a shocking new discovery. Now, with monster hunters discovering new ways to utilize their spoils for more private (?) pleasures, a bizarre sexual hype sweeps through the lands - and Cheong, as innocent as she is, must make her way through this mess. Join Cheong as she embarks on her raunchy new adventure! (Source: Lezhin US)

characters.name: Cheong
characters.description: She is the main character of What Happens Inside the Dungeon. She is said to have left her hometown after being pushed away by her family, and is a fighter who can bite certain acupuncture points on her hands and fight with a strengthened body. She is innocent and naive to the sexually charged ways in these new lands.

characters.name: Chun-Ja
characters.description: She is also the main character with Chung. She seems emotionless, but she is very vulgar.

characters.name: Hoss
characters.description: An unrivalled knight who's private way of using monster parts sent the continent into a bizarre sexual hype.

characters.name: Lohen
characters.description: Previously second ranked among the executives of the Demon Tribe. She used power magic to fight against humans. But after she got tired of the demon king's obsession with fighting, she left her seat.

characters.name: Hyejin
characters.description: She is a bunny beast with blonde hair and light red eyes, and unlike her older sister, she has a shy and timid personality. Her main role in the group is to be the cook

title: Tokyo BABYLON
description: It's 1991, the last days of Japan's bubble economy, and money and elegance run through the streets. So do the currents of darkness beneath them, nourishing evil spirits that only the arts of the onmyoji—Japan's legendary occultists—can combat. The two most powerful onmyoji are in the unlikely guises of a handsome young veterinarian, Seishiro, and the teenage heir to the ancient Sumeragi clan, Subaru. (Source: Dark Horse)

characters.name: Subaru Sumeragi
characters.description: Subaru is the younger of a pair of fraternal twins, his older twin being a girl named Hokuto. Their parents (who are never seen) were members of the Sumeragi, a clan of onmyouji who have served Japan and its emperors for hundreds of years. Subaru was trained from an early age to become the 13th head of the Sumeragi clan, replacing his grandmother. At the age of nine, he was separated from his sister Hokuto for a year of intensive training in Tokyo. On the day he ascended to the head of the clan, Subaru encountered a strange young man under a cherry tree. The meeting would subsequently be expunged from his memory. Subaru's grandmother ordered him to wear gloves from that day onwards, and never to allow anyone else to see his hands. The old onmyouji cast a spell that would repel any attempts by others to remove them. Subaru never removed his gloves, and was known to wear them even when sle

characters.description: __In Tokyo Babylon:__ Seishirou is a kind veterinarian. He joins in with [Hokuto](https://anilist.co/character/3080/Sumeragi-Hokuto) in teasing [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/439/Sumeragi-Subaru) about them getting married, but always laughs it off as Subaru blushes furiously. ~!Seishirou is actually the Sakurazukamori (powerful assasin onmyouji), or the "Sakura Assassin" whose signature is cherry blossoms and the symbol of an inverted pentagram. He made a bet with Subaru long ago, which entails the climax of the series.!~ __In X:__ ~!Seishirou is one of the Dragons of Earth, where he reveales his true self as a cold-hearted assassin who killed Subaru's twin sister Hokuto. In their final battle at Rainbow Bridge, Seishirou arranges for Subaru to kill him realizing who really won the bet.!~ __In Tsubasa: Reservoir Chronicle:__ ~!A vampire hunter who chases after the vampire twins (

characters.name: Hokuto Sumeragi
characters.description: Tokyo Babylon: Hokuto is Subaru's twin sister. She is constantly teasing her brother about his relationship with Seishirou, and always has some crack about a wedding, which Seishirou always joins in on. She has an eye for fashion, and makes the most elaborate costumes. X: Here she appears in flashbacks of the memories of Subaru, Seishirou, and Kakyou Kuzuki. ~!7 years ago Hokuto was killed by Seishirou Sakurazuka as exchange for her brother's life. However her last spell has to be fulfilled...!~ Her name, Hokuto (北斗), is the Japanese name for the constellation Ursa Major, whose brightest seven stars form the Big Dipper (Hokuto shichisei); it complements her brother's name, Subaru being the Japanese name for the Pleiades star cluster (whose brightest stars resemble a smaller version of the Big Dipper).

title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Doujin-ban
title_original: かぐや様は告らせたい 同人版
title_en: Kaguya-sama: Love is War - Doujin Edition
description: Spin-off of Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai. The manga features raunchier scenarios that do not occur in the main story. It also has AU stories that imagine the characters in different roles (such as fairy tale characters or toddlers at a nursery school). Includes 2 extra chapters.

characters.name: Kaguya Shinomiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm The vice president of the student council of Shuchiin Academy, member of the wealthy Shinomiya family, she is a multi-talented genius who can do anything if she sets her mind to it. Due to the way she was raised, she instinctively looks down on others and thinks of ways to use them for her own benefit. Kaguya rarely interacted with other people before she joined the student council, but that has begun to change. She is an incredibly sheltered girl, resulting in her lacking in several pieces of what might be considered common sense. She still doesn’t understand love very well, and her main objective is to make [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) fall in love and confess to her. Later in the series: ~!She confesses her love to Miyuki Shirogane and they start dating.!~ ~!In a [Oshi no Ko special chapter](https://anilist.co/manga/153520), it was reveale

characters.name: Miyuki Shirogane
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm He is a second year student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the student council. Miyuki is a handsome young man with blond hair and blue eyes. Due to his constant sleep deprivation and nearsightedness, his eyes appear to glare. He usually wears the regular Shuchi'in Academy black male uniform adorned with the Aiguilette, the golden chain-like accessory around his neck. The Aiguilette symbolizes his authority as student council president. Shirogane is a diligent student who, despite his underprivileged background, climbed his way to the top of his class through hard work and determination. Shirogane holds himself in high regard, consistently working to maintain his perfect image. He is textbook workaholic, enjoying his part-time job and often putting his own health at risk for the sake of his work. Due to his poor background, Shirogane values money greatly and

characters.name: Ai Hayasaka
characters.description: Ai Hayasaka is a second-year student at Shuchiin Academy and a valet of the Shinomiya family. She is a member of the Hayasaka family, who have served the Shinomiya family for generations, gaining their trust. Having been personally assigned to enter Shuchiin Academy with her, Ai supports [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) in her high school life and has been a part of Kaguya's life for ten years. Because of their close relationship, Ai is one of the few people around to which Kaguya's amiability is not an act. Even if she demonstrates maturity as a valet, Ai still has the concerns of a young girl, such as caring to be in fashion and going out with friends, even if she does not have much time for herself due to work. Ai helps Kaguya with the struggles about her feelings for [Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101). ~!She later leaves her job as a maid to Kaguy

characters.name: Yuu Ishigami
characters.description: The treasurer of the student council of the Shuchiin Academy. He's extremely valued by [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101), given that he single-handedly manages all the school's funds. He's also terrified of [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649), though no one else is sure why that is. Yuu keeps to himself and rarely speaks up, often getting into trouble when he does. He has a depressed outlook on life while having an inferiority complex. In contrast to his attitude, he is willing to help those in need and will sacrifice his pride if need be. Unlike his high school self, he had a much different outlook and demeanor during middle school. Later in the series: ~!Ishigami develops a crush on Tsubame that he inadvertently confesses his feelings for her at the school's cultural festival. Ishigami does not realize that his actions were perceived as a confession by the rest of

characters.name: Chika Fujiwara
characters.description: The secretary of the Shuchiin Academy student council. She could not be predicted, her thoughts could not be read. A natural disaster who unconsciously threw everything into chaos simply by being present, also known as __Subject F__. ~!In chapter 222 of the manga, Chika reveals that she played piano because she wanted to be perfect, and she becomes a prodigy at the piano. The expectations of her family and her fans rose, forcing her to practice more. She quit piano after [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649/Shinomiya-Kaguya) told her to just quit if she didn't like the piano. Soon after Chika challenged Kaguya to a game battle and if she won, she would get to become Kaguya's friend. In the end, she becomes Kaguya's first friend.!~

characters.name: Miko Iino
characters.description: __Height:__ 147 cm (4'7") She is a freshman at Shuchiin Private Academy and the Auditor of the Student Council. Miko has a strong sense of justice and will correct others on what's right and wrong. Unfortunately, this led to her being bullied, though she still continues to uphold her idea of "right". She idolizes [Chika Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/121103), listening to anything she says, even if it's for Chika's enjoyment.

characters.name: Kei Shirogane
characters.description: Kei Shirogane is [Miyuki Shirogane's](https://anilist.co/character/121101) little sister. She attends Shuchiin middle school and is the treasurer for the middle school student council. She is a hard worker just like her brother and can be very prideful at times. She also inherited his sense of righteousness and hates it when someone doesn't do the right thing in a given situation. Like her brother, she likes helping out those who are in trouble even if it means going out of her way to do it. Since she grew up in a family that places emphasis on saving money, she normally carries coupons and works hard for the things she wants to buy. She developed a prickly attitude towards her brother due to his over protectiveness. She's also entered a rebellious phase and due to her pride and she cannot get herself to have a lighthearted conversation with Miyuki, leading into the similar mind games th

characters.name: Nagisa Kashiwagi
characters.description: Nagisa is a classmate who occasionally asks [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) about what to do in her relationships. [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/134327)'s girlfriend.

characters.name: Rei Onodera
characters.description: She is a supporting character in the series. She was a member of Shuchi'in's Red Cheer Team and is a classmate of Yu Ishigami and Miko Iino. She is a fairly calm girl under normal circumstances and is fairly open-minded, but when involved with the Cheer Team or the culture festival committee, she becomes far more energetic.

title: Netsuzou Trap: NTR
description: Yuma and Hotaru have been friends since childhood. It is only natural that when Yuma is nervous about her new boyfriend, she asks Hotaru and her boyfriend along for a double date. But when Hotaru offers herself to Yuma as “practice”, both girls realize that they’re more interested in each other than they are in their own boyfriends. With boyfriends in the foreground but a secret, passionate tryst in the background, will Yuma and Hotaru try to forget what happened between them or have they fallen into a trap of true love and betrayal? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: The chapter count includes 5 bonus chapters.

characters.name: Yuma Okazaki
characters.description: Yuma is in her second year of high school with her childhood and best friend Hotaru. She is in a relationship with Takeda, but she's very inexperienced as he's her first boyfriend and often times asks Hotaru for advice but gets unexpected responses instead.

characters.name: Hotaru Mizushina
characters.description: Hotaru is Yuma's childhood and best friend. Yuma was always around to protect her from various things such as bullying at school, but over time she has changed and even ended up having many boyfriends (though Yuma noticed she seemed uninterested).

characters.name: Fujiwara
characters.description: Fujiwara is Hotaru's ex boyfriend, and is friends with Takeda.

characters.name: Takeda
characters.description: Takeda is a classmate and friend of Hotaru, and is Yuma's first boyfriend. He comes across as a friendly, understanding guy who is aware of his girlfriend's shyness, and does his best to remedy the situation.

title: Soulmate
description: Qi went to sleep embraced by her girlfriend, Yuanzi. However, when she opened her eyes she realized that she had been transported 10 years back to the past, back when she was still in high school. While she sees this as an opportunity to save the love of her life, what she doesn't realize is that her teenage self is in her adult body, 10 years into the future, and has no clue about the life Qi has built or how precious the time she has left with Yuanzi is. No matter the time, no matter the age, their love resonates as they stand by each other's side. Will they be able to conquer fate? (Source: Monogatari Novels) Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title: Yoku Wakaranai keredo Isekai ni Tensei Shiteita You desu
title_original: よくわからないけれど異世界に転生していたようです
title_en: This is Screwed Up, but I Was Reincarnated as a GIRL in Another World!
description: Ren, a young orphan girl, has been sold off to a merchant with sinister plans for her. Suddenly, memories of her past life on a world called Earth come flooding back, and Ren remembers that she used to be a research scientist–and a grown man! As Ren escapes into the Dark Forest, magical powers awaken within her. In order to survive the harsh realities of this world, she must use her rekindled knowledge of Earth’s science as well as her newfound powers! Will her magical cheat powers and past-life knowledge be enough to keep her freedom, or is she doomed to a life of servitude? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Ren
characters.description: Yuuki Renjuro was a thirty-year-old researcher who died in an accident. He reincarnates as Ren, an orphan girl with latent magic abilities and sole survivor of a bandit attack. Disgusted by Ren's memories of an abusive merchant, she sets out to create a comfortable new life with her knowledge of modern science and newfound magical abilities.

title: Eommahanten Bimiriya!
description: A smart, kind boy heads to Seoul to attend college, and lives with his mom's friend and her daughter. A professor at his college is also his mom's friend. Sorry mom, but your friends are really hot! I'll get to know them a bit better... (Source: TOPTOON+)

characters.name: Hae-Seong Kang
characters.description: A studious student at a prestigious university.

characters.name: Su-Yeon Go
characters.description: A professor with an unrivaled figure and a friend of Hae-Seong mother's.

characters.name: Yeon-A Na
characters.description: A friend of Hae-Seong's mother.

characters.name: Na-Yeon Sin
characters.description: A beautiful student who likes bodybuilding. [Yeon-A](https://anilist.co/character/244699/)'s daughter.

title: Iljinnyeo Gwaoehagi
description: Bullied ruthlessly by girls in high school, Jinhoo’s done his best to put his past as a complete loser behind him. However, one day, he finds out that his newest tutee is his ex-bully, Yejin! Despite flunking the college entrance exam twice, Yejin’s only interested in her dildo and is adamant that she doesn’t need a tutor. However, as she starts to torture Jinhoo as per usual, Yejin realizes that there are some things that Jinhoo can teach her…but they’re going to have to find out the hard way. (Source: Lezhin) Note: Chapter count includes 35 after story chapters.

title: Fantasy Bishoujo Juniku Ojisan to
title_original: 異世界美少女受肉おじさんと
title_en: Life with an Ordinary Guy Who Reincarnated into a Total Fantasy Knockout
description: Tachibana Hinata and Jinguji Tsukasa are two young men who have been friends since childhood. After a disaster of a singles mixer, they’re sent flying into another world by a mysterious being–and now Tachibana is a beautiful blonde girl! When Jinguji angrily demands that they be returned home and go back to normal, they get cursed, and the only way out is for them to go on a quest and defeat the demon king. But…now the two friends can’t stop thinking about how hot the other is. Will they save the world before their lifelong bromance becomes a romance? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Ranked 19th place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

characters.name: Hinata Tachibana
characters.description: Hinata Tachibana is a beleaguered 32-year-old office worker, and he and his handsome best friend Tsukasa Jinguuji were summoned to another world by a naked goddess. However, because of the goddess's mischief, Tachibana was turned into a beautiful girl. To get his body back, he has to go on a journey with his best friend to defeat the demon king.

characters.name: Tsukasa Jinguuji
characters.description: Hinata's best friend who was transported to the fantasy world along with him.

characters.name: Tirolilo Lou
characters.original: ティロリロ・リリリ・ルー
characters.description: Head of an elf tribe.

characters.name: Vizzd
characters.description: A top officer of the Demon Lord army.

title: Hino-san no Baka
description: Class president and overall good girl Koguma is concerned that her classmate Hino often skips classes by spending her time behind one of the school buildings. Koguma feels it's her duty to guide Hino down a better path, even if it means going along with Hino's unusual requests.

characters.name: Koharu Koguma
characters.description: Koguma is the class president and overall a good girl. She is concerned about her classmate, Hino, who habitually skips classes, and gets her to attend by fulfilling her various strange and often perverted requests. She likes bears and collects bear figurines, in reference to her surname.

characters.name: Nagisa Hino
characters.description: She is a cool, delinquent kid who is often skipping class. Despite continuously toying with Koguma, Hino seems to have a slight crush on her.

characters.name: Chihiro Omi
characters.description: Koguma's childhood friend.

title: Aoi Hana
description: Fumi and Akira were best friends when they were little, with Akira always looking after the crybaby Fumi, but that all ended when Fumi's family moved away. Several years later, Fumi's family returned, and she and Akira happened to bump into each other on their way to school. They became friends again, quickly slipping back into old patterns. Shortly after, Fumi began dating a cool, attractive upperclassman who, coincidentally enough, had ties to Akira's current school, the prestigious Fujigaya Girls' Academy. (Source: Lililicious; updated from an early misreading of the school name Fujigaya, called Fujigatani in initial translations of the first chapters) Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

characters.name: Fumi Manjoume
characters.description: A tall, dark haired, bespectacled girl. She is seen by other girls as being strong, refined and genteel, however they become surprised when they realise that Fumi is actually very gentle and shy. Others have noted her for having pretty eyes and a soft, lady-like voice. She is often said to make "scary faces" when she is upset or irked. Despite her size, mature aura and sometimes foreboding presence, Fumi is a reserved crybaby. After moving back to her home town, she makes fast friends with a girl from her youth: Okudaira Akira. Fumi used to live nearby to Akira growing up, and so they were best friends from the young ages of five or six. Fumi relied heavily on Akira in kindergarten, as she is seen incapable of doing anything but crying until Akira comes to "save" her and take care of her. This has not changed much as she got older, as noted by Akira. Fumi has had a cl

characters.name: Akira Okudaira
characters.description: Akira is optimistic and supportive, always comforting those who need her and searching for ways to solve other people's problems, despite knowing that it would be best not to get involved. She is easily embarrassed but is not shy or reserved, often taking a more aggressive stance against situations. She dislikes seeing people hurt and in her own little ways, tries to avert and avoid potential distress for others. She saves Fumi from a pervert on the train ride to school on their first day of high school. She walks a little way with the tall girl, and finds her to be elegant and gentle and wonders if she will ever see her again. She later expresses shock when it turns out that the girl she saved was none other than her childhood friend. Her mother and Fumi's mother are good friends, and so their relationship is rekindled after Manjoume Yoshie visits Okudaira Shouko, bringing Fum

characters.name: Kyouko Ikumi
characters.description: A polite, refined girl who has attended Fujigaya since elementary school. Many people come to her for advice as she has an air of maturity that they others do not possess; despite this, she has a fairly immature side to her that only those who are very close to her are allowed to see. She is the first friend Akira makes in the Academy. She is seen as a great beauty (described as "sexy" by Akira) and has the attention of girls even from the middle school. Kyouko however seems very disinterested in other people save for her friends and for her love interest, who Akira correctly guesses is another female. It is revealed that the person who Kyouko is in love with is Yasuko, with whom she shares a history. However, not only are Kyouko's feelings spurned, but she is also unenthusiastically engaged to her cousin Kou who she treats coldly as she says they are connected by "na

characters.name: Yasuko Sugimoto
characters.description: Yasuko is a popular third-year senior at Matsuoka Girl's High School. She is a cool upperclassman and the captain of the basketball team, though Fumi mistakes her for being in the Literature Club when they first meet. She has almost a star status in Matsuoka and Fujigaya (more so in Fujigaya). She insists on involving Fumi in her visits to Akira's school. Her initial reason was to pawn off the role of Heathcliff to Fumi who is almost as tall as she is, but Yasuko soon grows a deeper interest in her. After visiting Fujigaya Girls' Academy and rejecting Kyouko's confession, she asks Fumi out, who accepts. Yasuko enjoys the arts immensely, as she is shown being a very good artist, is an exceptional actor and reads profusely. Her accomplished aura could be a result of the subconscious conditioning she received as a child. Being the youngest Sugimoto sister, she often had

characters.name: Miwa Motegi
characters.description: Motegi is one of Fumi's friends at Matsuoka Girls' High School. She, Yōko and Misako appear to be long-time friends giving one another the nicknames Mogi, Pon-chan and Yassan respectively. She belongs to the very tiny Drama Club and seems to enjoy theatrics. ~! Mogi begins dating Akira's older brother Shinobu later on in the series after meeting him and spending time with him during a trip to Kyouko's villa during the summer.!~

characters.name: Misako Yasuda
characters.description: Misako is one of Fumi's friends at Matsuoka Girls' High School. She, Yōko and Motegi appear to be long-time friends giving one another the nicknames Yassan, Pon-chan and Mogi respectively. Yassan is very energetic and is known for having a scrappy appearance and bushy eyebrows.

characters.name: Shinobu Okudaira
characters.description: Shinobu is Akira's older brother who attends university. He is constantly worried about his sister, and often takes her places in his car, though Akira often gets very annoyed at how protective her brother is towards her. He is often seen giving up a lot of his free time following her around, much to the chagrin of both his sister and mother. He is often told by his mother that he needs to get his own life in order before he could be concerned about his sister's life. He however claims that his overprotective nature is not as bad as their father's. Despite forcefully volunteering to chaperone Akira and her friends around, he is exasperated by them. He finds the group of girls to be tiresome, save for Fumi, who is not as exicitable as the rest. He eventually comes to find out that Fumi is a lesbian through a conversation he has with Yasuko, which surprises him. He shows int

characters.name: Chizu Hanashiro
characters.description: Chizu is Fumi's older cousin. She is present to see Fumi off for her first day at school. It is implied that she was a large part of Fumi's life in her old town. She is seen (in flashback) spending time with Fumi in her younger teenage years, such as teaching Fumi how to cook. Despite Fumi's attempts to convince Chizu to spend more time with her in Kamakura, Chizu sombrely and apologetically declines, her motives for doing so becoming clear later on. It is revealed that Chizu and Fumi have had a deeper side to their relationship, however, she neglected telling Fumi that she was engaged to be married. The shocking news later causes Fumi to avoid her cousin, stating that she is cruel. She seems very flirtatious, as she often makes comments to make Fumi blush, and she has an air of mature feminine authority to her that her younger cousin latches on to; Fumi is palpable even t

characters.name: Kaori Ueno
characters.description: She is the President of the Literature Club in Matsuoka Girls' High School. She is on good terms with Fumi as the club is rather small; they are seen together reading books and having tea as part of the club's activities. She is a close school friend of Sugimoto Yasuko and is very aware of her popularity, often making fun of Yasuko being "Mr. Matsuoka-sama". She is seen to be very exasperated at Yasuko's presence in the club, as potential members usually leave to follow Yasuko in the basketball club.

characters.name: Sakiko Okudaira
characters.description: Okudaira Sakiko is the mother of Akira and Shinobu. She is long-time friends with Fumi's mother and the Manjoume family. Her relationship with Fumi's mother is rekindled when they move back, and she is rather excited to have her friend again. She has a very close relationship with both her children as she is seen joking around with them and having conversations with them regularly. However, she is also rather stern and blunt. Whenever Akira and Shinobu fight, one glare from her is enough to quieten them. She often has to tell Shinobu to get a life and leave Akira alone. Akiko was considered to be the "outlaw" of the family by Keiko, her very disapproving relative in Yokohama, whom she makes Akira go visit.

characters.name: Shinako Sugimoto
characters.description: Shinako is the eldest Sugimoto sister. She is straight-forward and very blunt, though extremely perceptive and easy-going. She seems to dislike conflict finding it dull and unnecessary, and is rarely ever surprised by people's actions. She appears to enjoy being amused at other people's expense. She is an alumna of Fujigaya Girls' Academy, and during her high school years, she was very well known. Through flashbacks from various characters, it is revealed that Shinako's nature had not changed very much from when she was a teenager. She does not care about people's sexual orientation and openly asks Fumi if she's a lesbian or bisexual when she first meets her. She has said herself that she had many "girlfriends" growing up, though this may be only due to her being bored rather than personal attraction to other women. She is an unrelenting flirt thou

characters.name: Kuri Sugimoto
characters.description: The third eldest Sugimoto sister. Kuri is a rather cynical and dry character. She is the only one in the family who does not spoil Yasuko by letting her do whatever she wants. She is very aware of Yasuko's selfish nature and is concerned about her sister's relationship with Fumi as she knows Yasuko will eventually hurt the younger girl. She enjoys smoking. Kuri also attended Fujigaya as did all the elder Sugimoto sisters. She was also subject to admiration from other girls though she never indulged any of them and ignored them for the most part. Her best friend was in love with her, but she never was privy to this. Kuri was also in love with Kagami, though nobody except Kazusa and Yasuko seemed to be fully aware of this. Yasuko eventually, out of spite, lets the cat out of the bag and eventually even Shinako finds out about it. Unlike Yasuko, she never told Kagami how he felt a

title: Uleongkangdo
description: Ji Ho’s week has been, to put it simply, quite eventful. He’s still getting used to being back in university after a leave of absence, he manages to snag a killer offer for a place to rent in downtown Seoul, and on his first day in the new house, he runs into a robber! The strange thing about this robber(?) is that he doesn’t seem interested in any valuables, but is enamored by the story Ji Ho scribbled down in some old notebooks. So enamored that he offers to keep house for Ji Ho so that he can concentrate on writing more. Ji Ho initially refuses that odd proposition, but the more he thinks about it, the less he has to lose... (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Ano Ko ni Kiss to Shirayuri wo
title_original: あの娘にキスと白百合を
title_en: Kiss & White Lily for My Dearest Girl
description: Two girls, a new school, and the beginning of a beautiful friendship. In middle school, Ayaka Shiramine was the perfect student: hard-working, with excellent grades and a great personality to match. As Ayaka enters high school she expects to still be on top, but one thing she didn't account for is her new classmate, the lazy yet genuine genius Yurine Kurosawa. What's in store for Ayaka and Yurine as they go through high school...together? (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes 19 extra chapters.

characters.name: Yurine Kurosawa
characters.description: [Shiramine](https://anilist.co/character/131672)'s classmate, a lazy genius with no motivation to do anything until Shiramine comes along and declares that she won't lose to her, piquing Kurosawa's interest for the first time. A first year student at Seiran Academy High School. A so-called genius who, with an incredibly small amount of effort, surpasses other people and earns stellar grades. Those around her tend to maintain their distance from her, and Kurosawa herself has a habit of turning people down. She frequently takes cat naps, but she also sleeps very well. The reason she chose Seiran for high school was because, ''It's close to my house.'' She has a younger sister named Sumire.

characters.name: Ayaka Shiramine
characters.description: A popular student at Seiran Academy and the protagonist of Ano Kiss. Her relationship and dynamic with her school rival, [Kurosawa](https://anilist.co/character/131667/Yurine-Kurosawa), is the central focus of the story.

characters.name: Moe Nikaidou
characters.description: Manager of the Track team. It's hard to tell from her expression, but she's more positive and passionate than pretty much anyone else. She adores Mizuki. She collects both important and unimportant things related to her object of interest. She hates green peppers. She has a cat and an older brother.

characters.name: Ai Uehara
characters.description: 2nd year in Seiran High. A member of the astronomy club. A simple and quite airheaded girl, who has a lot of friends and acquaintances both in and out of the school. She isn't exactly a brilliant student, but she's aiming for the university her senpai [Hoshino Maya](https://anilist.co/character/131666/Maya-Hoshino) went to. It seems like her grades are gradually improving...?

characters.name: Chiharu Kusakabe
characters.description: First year at Seiran High. A composed and down-to-earth personality. Ai is her polar opposite, but they still get along, somehow. Her first love was her piano teacher, her second Hoshino-senpai; so you could say she likes older girls.

characters.name: Mizuki Senoo
characters.description: A second-year student at Seiran Academy High School. A short-distance runner on the track team. Because of her boyish looks and the fact that she is the team's fastest runner (although not as fast as Kurosawa), there are quite a few students who look up to her. However, because of her naturally timid personality, she disliked the inflated image people have of her. She is Shiramine Ayaka's cousin and childhood friend, and is an older sister figure to Shiramine.

characters.name: Itsuki Nishikawa
characters.description: Itsuki is a 1st-year student in Seiran High and an information committee member. Up until the first year of grade school, she used to be [Sawa](https://anilist.co/character/191741/Sawa-Itou)'s neighbour and they often played together. After she had to move, she met again with Sawa by chance when entering high school. But seeing that Sawa had forgotten everything, she held a grudge against her. She's an only child and has a dog as a pet.

characters.name: Sawa Itou
characters.description: Sawa is a 2nd-year student in Seiran High, like [Shiramine](https://anilist.co/character/131672). She's an average student who doesn't excel in any particular subject and has a few friends, and is an archery club and information committee member. She has a little sister and a little brother.

title: Sasameki Koto
description: Whispered Words is the story of two high school girls, Sumika and Ushio. One is in love with the other, but unable to confess. Both of them prefer girls, but Ushio likes cute and petite types while Sumika prefers the athletic outgoing girls. To complicate things, a cross dressing boy, Masaki, is in love with Sumika. What ever will happen to this mixed-up bizarre love triangle mess? (Source: One Peace Books) Includes oneshot "Kamisama to Dance" and a side story.

characters.name: Sumika Murasame
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm (5’9’’) Sumika is in love with her best friend, Ushio. Much to Sumika's dismay, Ushio only likes cute girls. While the athletic, sarcastic and long-legged Sumika is just not cute. She wishes she were born the kind of girl one wants to protect, while being a little shorter and maintaining a little clumsiness, but it's a lost cause. Sumika loves karate, but gave up practicing it formally because it was "uncute". She is prone to jealousy as she is forced to watch Ushio crush again and again on girls who cannot return a mutual feeling. Sumika always ends up patching up her broken heart as her feelings always end up unrequited. Despite her own feelings, Sumika wants Ushio to be happy and wishes her friend could find love, even if it's not with her.

characters.name: Ushio Kazama
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm (5’3’’) Ushio is the best friend of Sumika, the protagonist, and always has been —oblivious to Sumika's feelings for her (though she does at one point recognize that Sumika is in love, and feels guilty, even, for not realizing it sooner; she just doesn't understand that it's her Sumika feels that way with). Ushio has made it clear that Sumika isn't her type; Ushio's "type" consists of —cute— girl; small and feminine and innocently curious, the kind one would want to protect, and Sumika far from falls into that category. Ushio is constantly falling for girls like that —only to find her crushes unrequited again and again, leaving Sumika to end up consoling her when her heart breaks. She wishes just once that she could find a girl who would return her feelings. Her spirits are lifted, however, upon a lesbian couple in her class forming the Girls Club for women interested
