characters.name: Tomoe Hachisuka
characters.description: Tomoe is a classmate of Sumika and Ushio. The two don't pay much attention in particular to her until they walk on her kissing her girlfriend, Miyako, one day after school (though they don't realize the identity of the couple until later). Tomoe and Miyako one day catch Sumika and Ushio "practicing" kissing with a plastic mask (an idea suggested by Ushio upon realizing Sumika has feelings for someone - though Ushio doesn't know that someone is her) and draw the conclusion that they, too, are a couple. When they confront Sumika about the kiss, they learn that her feelings are one-sided. They still know, however, that Sumika and Ushio are interested in girls - and Tomoe seizes the opportunity to form a Girls Club, just for girls interested in girls. The two end up joining. Tomoe is not in denial about her sexuality nor ashamed of it, and she and Miyako are unsepera

characters.name: Miyako Tamae
characters.description: Miyako is a classmate of Sumika and Ushio's, who they don't pay much attention to until they walk in on her and her girlfriend, Tomoe, kissing in a classroom after school (though they don't realize the identity of the couple until later). When Miyako and Tomoe similiarly catch Sumika and Ushio kissing in the same classroom, the latter wearing a plastic mask and unaware of the former's feelings for her, they assume the two are a couple and Miyako snaps a picture of the kiss on her cell-phone. Upon confronting Sumika about it, they learn of her one-sided feelings. Miyako is not as tactful as Tomoe and thinks that Sumika should come right out and confess to her friend. She and Sumika often tease each-other about various things and may not seem to get along particularly well, but, in truth, Miyako and Tomoe are grateful for her and Ushio's friendship; the two, insepe

characters.name: Masaki Akemiya
characters.description: Akemiya is a classmate of Sumika's, though Sumika doesn't take notice of him until he one day tells her he thinks she's cute. This is a comfort to Sumika, who feels "uncute" but wants to appear that way in hopes that her best friend, Ushio, may return her feelings; Ushio makes it clear again and again that she likes "cute" girls. What Sumika doesn't realize until later is that Akemiya notices Sumika's insecurity to a great extent because he was a girl Sumika saw in a store the previous day and wanted to emulate because she looked like the type Ushio would crush on. Akemiya developed feelings for Sumika, but, once he realized that Sumika was in love with Ushio, his younger sister, amused, convinced him into cross-dressing to gain her attention. She sent a photo of him dressed as a girl to a magazine. The magazine hired him, and, before he knew

characters.name: Kiyori Torioi
characters.description: Kiyori is Sumika and Ushio's best school friend whom not much is known about. She is always seen with them at school, however, and accompanies them on various outings. She is in the music club in school, and she does not spend a lot of time outside with either Sumika or Kazama because of her club activities taking up most of her time. Kiyori has a cheerful demeanor and is always eating or snacking. She isn't interested in girls but is well used to the fact that her friend is a lesbian. She does seem exasperated (like most others) of Ushio's fleeting crushes and constant talk of wanting a cute girlfriend. She is supportive to Kazama and the formation of the Girls Club; doesn't enter but stays with them because "It might be fun". Her biggest complaint is that Sumika's occasional jealousy-induced awkwardness with, sadness around, and meanness towards Ushio

characters.name: Manaka Akemiya
characters.description: Manaka is Masaki's elementary-school-aged younger sister. She's a devious girl who first started having him dress up as a cute girll to impress Sumika and then sent pictures of him to a modeling agency that ended up hiring him. Despite her awareness of Sumika's feelings for Ushio, she fails to understand why Sumika rejected him and is angry with her for doing so, even going as far as to blackmail her to go on a date with Masaki. She doesn't take into much consideration Sumika's feelings or well-being nor her brother's embarassment, and her intentions motivating some of her schemes involving him are questionable...

characters.name: Azusa Aoi
characters.description: Aoi is a classmate of Sumika, Ushio and the rest's. She developes a crush on Sumika and starts hanging out with her and her friends when, after having her first kiss stolen by Tomoe and being ganged up on by her classmates, she's driven to run out of class. Sumika follows her and comforts her. Aoi is a gushing fan of the yuri light novels penned by Ushio's brother and a member of his fanclub (though she believes the author is a sensitve, beautiful woman and has no idea of his real identity. Sumika and Ushio desire to keep it that way). Aoi draws doujinshi for his books, but is inspired to create her own original yuri romance and wants to do so with Sumika. She becomes extremely saddened when Sumika at first is reluctant, to the concern of her parents, but ends up helped and again comforted by her in the end. At first, she is convinced that she and Sumika have a mutual love for each other

characters.name: Charlotte Munchausen
characters.description: Lotte is a German transfer student with an interest in Japan and a desire to capture its "spirit". She wears a boy's uniform, is interested in karate and at dresses as a maid for a couple of days at one point when Sumi convinces her that doing so is an important part of Japanese culture (as she was asked to by Ushio, who finds Lotte adorable). Her catchphrase is "Ossu".

characters.name: Chizuka Nishikigi
characters.description: A second-year that and Uisho's co-worker at the school library. She is very shy and talks very softly Uisho develops feelings for Chizuka, noticing that she is very cute and Uisho's "type." But Chizuka breaks her heart when she gets very angry and gives her a menacing, tear-filled glare. Uisho is heartbroken and breaks down crying in Sumika's arms. Uisho and Chizuka have felt uncomfortable around each other ever since.

characters.name: Koino Matsubara
characters.description: The junior in Sumika's high school. She likes Mayu secretly.

characters.name: Mayu Semimaru
characters.description: The junior in Sumika's high school. New member of karate club. She has a crush on Sumika.

title: Inu ni Nattara Suki na Hito ni Hirowareta.
title_original: 犬になったら好きな人に拾われた。
description: A little ecchi comedy where you are being kept by a cool, beautiful girl! When you woke up, you found yourself as the pet dog of a girl named Inukai-san! At school, Inukai-san has no expression on her face, but she's a dog lover who loves her dog to pieces! She loves dogs so much that she's going to turn you into a real dog, body and soul! An erotic comedy that makes you stop being human!

title: Machigatta ko wo Mahou Shoujo ni Shite Shimatta
title_original: 間違った子を魔法少女にしてしまった
title_en: Machimaho: I Messed Up and Made the Wrong Person Into a Magical Girl!
description: While searching for a brave candidate to become a magical girl and defend the world from evil, a mythical creature finds Kayo Majiba, a cute young lady who seems like the perfect fit. But when this newly turned magical girl proves to be a crude delinquent who goes berserk in a conflict, it becomes clear that this may have been a terrible mistake. Now evil—and any innocent bystanders—will face the rage of a magical girl gone wrong! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Kayo Majiba
characters.description: Kayo is the heroine of this series. She was changed into a magical girl by Myu in order to hunt stremons.

characters.name: Kyouka Sudou
characters.description: Nako's Vice President. She fused with an Atasunmo and was given vast, dark powers similar to Nako's.

characters.name: Annabelle Anderson
characters.original: アナベル・アンダーソン
characters.description: A transfer student and veteran magical girl.

title: Hime-sama, "Goumon" no Jikan desu
description: The princess who's been held captive by the Demon Lord's army is scheduled to be executed by the Demon Lord's relentless torture! Notes: - Includes 19 extra chapters. - Second place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category

characters.name: Hime
characters.description: __Position:__ Princess, Commander of The Third Legion of The Imperial Army Eldest daughter of the king, and commander of The Third Legion of The Imperial Army. While The Third Legion is only considered average, Princess herself would outskill even the top ranks of The First Legion in one-on-one combat, or so they say. Has a younger sister. Her special skills are sword techniques and swordsmanship in general as well as FPS games.

characters.name: Ex
characters.description: __Position:__ Legendary Holy Sword __Special Skills:__ Resonates with the wielder's magical power to increase sharpness. Can cut through any kind of magic. A holy sword that can only be used by the chosen one. Best in close combat out of The Three Great Holy Swords. The day before Princess was captured, the blade portion was detached and sent for repairs. The current blade is merely a temporary replacement.

characters.name: Tortura Torture
characters.original: トーチャー・トルチュール
characters.description: __Position:__ Grand Inquisitor (Supreme Torturer) __Favorite Food:__ Sake, Wine, Squid Shiokara, Anchovies, and Chocolate. __Special Skills:__ "Torture" with good, sewing. She was scouted to join Hellhorde after they witnessed her reaction to delicious food at a restaurant. She always visits her parents during every holiday. Her younger sister and her sister's husband live at her parents' house, so Torture has been telling them to just clear out and repurpose her old room. But if they actually went through with it, she'd secretly miss it.

characters.name: Maou
characters.description: **Favorite Food:** Beer, plum wine, mayonnaise, and curry. He is the most powerful and invincible three-eyed monster, standing at the pinnacle of all demons. He has a terrifying, charismatic presence and a dignified appearance, but his true face is that of a doting father who dotes on his only daughter, [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/151038/Maomao). He also has an otaku side, such as following voice actors and watching Sunday morning TV shows.

characters.name: Youki
characters.description: __Position:__ Lieutorment (Intermediate Torturer) __Special Skills:__ Reflex based games. Making potato chips from scratch. During her school years she was active in the Basketball Club. She received even more chocolate than the most popular boys did on Valentine's Day. Interested in silver accessories but can't afford them.

characters.name: Inki
characters.description: __Position:__ Lieutorment (Intermediate Torturer) __Favorite Food:__ Fugashi, okaki, and lobster. __Special Skills:__ Strategy games, claw machines. She joined The Basketball Club at Youki's invitation, but ended up quitting on the first day. Good at housework since both her parents have careers. She has two younger brothers.

characters.name: Krall
characters.description: __Position:__ Top-Class Warrior and Harm-Marshall (Senior Torturer) __Favorite Food:__ Trendy foods, Cute foods, Yakiniku. __Special Skills:__ Controlling fierce beasts at will. Learned to swim after taking lessons and now excels at long-distance swimming. Besides combat, she can use the power of beasts to plow wasteland into fields and demolish abandoned towns to free up the land. Never leaves leftovers if the food is good.

characters.name: Giant
characters.description: __Position:__ Class 4 Warrior and Junior Torturer __Favorite Food:__ Manju, Miso Soup, and Chikuzenni. __Special Skills:__ Coming up with travel plans, sauna. No one has ever seen Giant fight or perform a torture. She is great at maintaining and cleaning bathrooms. "When in doubt about travel plans, go to Giant" is a saying within the Hellhorde.

characters.name: Maomao
characters.description: __Position:__ Hyper Senior Apprentice Torturer __Favorite Food:__ French Fries, Chocolate Ice Cream, and Apple Juice. __Special Skills:__ Kendama. Hell-Lord's only daughter. She works as an apprentice torturer to gain experience, but since her rank is Hyper Senior Apprentice, she outranks even The Grand Inquisitor. Her salary is getting a piece of candy when going shopping with her mom.

characters.name: Lulune
characters.description: __Position:__ Bookstore Employee __Favorite Food:__ Chocolate Cake, Anything filled with Whipped Cream, Ramen, Karaage. __Special Skills:__ Cracking eggs with one hand. Doing the back hip circle. Quick at calculating multiples of seven. Great at playing tag. She's basically a housewife, but she occasionally helps out at her parents' bookstore. She likes landscape photography books and illustrated encyclopedias.

characters.name: Vanilla Peschutz
characters.description: __Position:__ Harm-Marshal (Senior Tourturer) __Favorite Food:__ Roast Beef, Scones. __Special Skills:__ Daughter of the illustrious Peschutz line. Excels at everything (self-proclaimed.) Good at needle felting to make small mascots (according to her parents.) The Vampire Clan has been around for a long time. Nowadays they don't suck blood directly but instead eat foods rich in iron for nourishment. Their clan is sensitive to the sun. If they spend a long time in sunshine, their skin will get red and irritated the next day.

characters.name: Kanadge
characters.description: **Favorite Food:** Steak and sushi. An excellent aide to the Demon King. Rumor has it that he is the second most powerful in the Demon King's army in terms of combat. He originally joined the Demon King's army as a part-time cleaner, but due to a manpower shortage he began helping out in various ways, eventually becoming a close aide to the Demon King.

title: Watashi no Yuri wa Oshigoto desu!
title_original: 私の百合はお仕事です！
description: Hime is a picture-perfect high school princess—she’s admired by all and never trips up! So when she accidentally injures a café manager named Mai, she’s willing to cover some shifts to keep her facade intact. To Hime’s surprise, the café is themed after a private school where the all-female staff always puts on their best act for their loyal customers. However, under the guidance of the most graceful girl there, Hime can’t help but blush and blunder! Beneath all the frills and laughter, Hime feels tension brewing as she finds out more about her new job and her budding feelings… (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Hime Shiraki
characters.description: __Height:__ 145cm A first-year high school student. A liar who is "loved by everyone" and keeps up a facade of friendliness with nearly everyone she meets. She rarely lets down her guard, even to those who know her true face. Hopes to marry rich. Plays the role of an innocent kohai and Mitsuki's "little sister" at the cafe.

characters.name: Mitsuki Ayanokouji
characters.description: __Height:__ 171cm A first year high school student. A serious girl who has social anxiety and difficulty understanding people's emotions. Cares about the integrity of the salon. Plays the role of a kind upperclassman at the cafe, and is Hime's reliable "big sister."

characters.name: Sumika Chibana
characters.description: __Height:__ 165cm A third year high school student. Dresses like a gyaru outside of work. Cares a lot about workplace harmony and dislikes seeing her coworkers get hurt because of romance. Plays the role of a cool, bespectacled upperclassman in the cafe, and is ~! Kanoko's "elder sister." !~

characters.name: Nene Nishidera
characters.description: __Height:__ 156cm Kitchen staff for the cafe. ~!Formerly worked out front as Sumika's "little sister", but after a complicated romance bloomed between her and another previous employee she came to work behind the scenes.!~

characters.name: Mai Koshiba
characters.description: __Height:__ 145cm The manager of Liebe who suffered an arm injury. Plays the role of a kohai character who also serves as the cafe's mascot. Watches over the staff as a mature adult, despite her childlike appearance.

characters.name: Kanoko Mamiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 156cm A first year high school student and Hime's best friend. Is fiercly protective of Hime and has romantic feelings for her, which she doesn't want to see returned. Comes across as soft-spoken, but is actually very blunt. Plays the role of a shy kohai and Sumika's "little sister" at the cafe. Usually wears glasses, except while playing her Liebe character.

characters.name: Youko Goto
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm ~!A former Liebe employee who disrupted the work environment due to her relationship with [Nene](https://anilist.co/character/253967/Nishidera-Nene). She played the role of a seductive, wicked older sister character.!~

characters.name: Haruko Shinooka
characters.description: __Height:__ 158cm Kitchen staff. Knows nothing about Cafe Liebe's setting and theme.

title: Guanyu Bei Banshang Lücha Weixie Na Jian Shi
title_original: 关于被班上绿茶威胁那件事
title_en: I Got Blackmailed by the Green Tea Bitch in Class
description: Green Tea Bitch (n.): A woman who pretends to be pure and innocent but in fact is manipulative and calculating. After school ends, a good honor student is threatened by the class's green tea bitch. "I never thought you wide-eyed goody-two-shoes would do something like this." "If you don't want me to expose your shameful secret..." A cute romance that stems from a misunderstanding begins in That Time I Was Blackmailed By the Class's Green Tea Bitch! Note: Originally completed with 41 chapters (including extras and bonus chapters) on 2022-02-28. A second season was announced on 2024-09-14.

title: Watashi no Kobushi wo Uketomete!
description: From back alley brawls to bashful bonds, two former-delinquents face their next fight: long-term relationships. During her high school years, Takebe was the top dog at her school. But with her old friends now living as happy adults, Takebe was faced with an impending sense of crisis. Takebe convinced herself to quit delinquency, but then she runs into her old rival, Soramori. After losing another fist-fight against Soramori, for some reason or other they reconciled by becoming a dating couple. What kind of relationship did the two of them have back in high school? And will Takebe ever manage to graduate from delinquency...!? Note: Includes four extra chapters.

characters.name: Ayako Takebe
characters.description: A former delinquent and current freeter who's trying to turn her life around and become a more acceptable member of society, like the other former members of her gang.

characters.name: Kirara Soramori
characters.description: A former delinquent with a crush on her old rival, Takebe.

title: Misu Misou
description: "My family was burned alive..." Liverleaf - a flower that blooms through the snow after enduring the harsh winter. When a young girl named Haruka transfers to a middle school in an isolated rural town, she faces relentless bullying. As her piling hatred becomes unbearable, the girl's psyche begins to unravel...!! (Source: emaqi)

characters.name: Haruka Nozaki
characters.description: A Tokyo transfer student who moved to Ootsuma half a year ago due to her father's new job. She endures the consistent harrassment of her classmates until one fateful day pushed and shattered her limits.

characters.name: Mitsuru Aiba
characters.description: One of Haruka's classmates at Ootsuma Middle School. A calm and independent boy infatuated with photography and the only one in their class to treat Haruka well...

characters.name: Kyouko Minami
characters.description: The homeroom teacher of Haruka's class.

characters.name: Rumi Sayama
characters.description: ~!Was a victim of bullying. Arranging the arson stopped her from being fearful of classmates. She is obsessed with Taeko.!~

title: Ura Sekai Picnic
description: In this sci-fi/fantasy survival thriller, the dangerous and deadly realm of the Otherside--where urban legends, cryptids, and folkloric legends roam--calls to two women, both in search of something. As they set out to sate their curiosity and explore this other world, will the most earth-shattering thing they discover on the Otherside be their feelings for each other? (Source: Square Enix)

characters.name: Sorawo Kamikoshi
characters.description: Sorawo is a shy, introverted person who usually prefers to be alone, not wanting to be bothered, and often keeps her distance from other people. There had been a time where she tried to make friends during her early years in university, attending a few parties, but in the end, she couldn't keep up, and it was too exhausting for her, so she decided to be on her own instead. When forced into a conversation or meeting people for the first time, she tends to end up flustered or talk excessively.

characters.name: Toriko Nishina
characters.description: Although she appeared mysterious at first, Toriko is known as upbeat and energetic most of the time, especially when around Sorawo Kamikoshi and Kozakura (to the point Kozakura finds her annoying). She was friendly upon meeting Sorawo, and dropped honorifics immediately after introducing herself to her. She'd been comfortable with Sorawo ever since, certain that they would get along well. She is carefree, not holding herself back when she and Sorawo explores the Otherside or when they celebrate post-expedition. She prefers addressing with no honorific to people she thinks she's friends or close with. She is also reliable and would often be the one to act or think fast during situations to aid Sorawo when needed.

characters.name: Akari Seto
characters.description: Akari Seto is a first year at the same university that Sorawo Kamikoshi attends, she is also a karate practitioner.

characters.name: Kozakura
characters.description: Kozakura is a reclusive researcher who lives near Shakujii Park and a college friend of Satsuki Uruma. Kozakura She also buys off the items that Sorawo and Toriko acquire from the Otherside and trades them to DS Lab later on. She is also their consultant regarding anything 'Otherside' related.

characters.name: Natsumi Ichikawa
characters.description: Natsumi Ichikawa is Akari Seto's childhood and best friend. After graduating from high school, Natsumi chose not to continue her studies and work at her family's car mechanic factory. After Sorawo and Toriko helped her, she undertook the modification of the AP-1.

title: Onna Tomodachi to Kekkon Shite Mita.
title_original: 女ともだちと結婚してみた。
description: Kurumi and Ruriko made a deal: if they were both single in five years, they would marry each other. Five years later, neither woman is attached, so it’s time for a wedding! Marriage is full of firsts, especially for two friends, so they have a lot to learn about each other in their newly shared home. But will they continue this arrangement like two especially close roommates…or will a different kind of love bloom between them? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Ruriko Aizawa
characters.description: She was the one who suggested that if they were both unmarried in five years, they should marry each other. She works at a Western-style bakery.

characters.name: Rio Arai
characters.description: She lived with Ruriko while they were both studying abroad.

characters.name: Inaho Suzuki
characters.description: Rio's friend.

title: Tsurezure Biyori
description: On the first day of high school, Koharu is struck speechless at the sight of the beautiful new transfer student, Mafuyu. It turns out that Mafuyu and Koharu have a deep connection, one going all the way back to their childhood. As the two friends reconnect, their feelings start to grow into love. This sweet love story that first gained popularity on Pixiv is now a series! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Chapter count includes 3 extra omake chapters.

title: Kuma Kuma Kuma Bear
title_original: くま クマ 熊 ベアー
description: Fifteen-year-old Yuna prefers staying home and obsessively playing her favorite VRMMO game to doing anything else, including going to school. When a strange new update gives her a one-of-a-kind bear outfit that comes with overpowered abilities, Yuna is torn: the outfit is unbearably cute, but too embarrassing to wear in-game. But then she suddenly finds herself transported into the world of the game, facing down monsters and magic for real, and the bear suit becomes the best weapon she has! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Yuna
characters.description: A fifteen year old girl who lives by herself. She became socially withdrawn at age twelve by her own choice because she wanted to play World Fantasy Online as much as possible. After she gave her parents 100 million yen, they left her to her own volition and only return home when they run out of money to spend, causing Yuna to secretly move out into a luxury apartment to hide from them. There, she spends nearly her entire day playing World Fantasy Online and the remainder only eating and sleeping. Yuna has a lazy personality and is socially withdrawn. She possesses a high level of intelligence, being able to make billions of yen from stocks allowing her to live a comfortable life in her home without ever having to leave. After getting transported into a world resembling the VRMMO World Fantasy Online, Yuna actively engages in the world, unlike in the real world, as she sees the current w

characters.name: Fina
characters.description: A ten-year-old girl and a resident of the town Crimonia. She lives with her [mother](https://anilist.co/character/193052/) and [younger sister](https://anilist.co/character/173792/). Fina's father died when she was still young, while her mother contracted a serious illness and is bedridden. In order to care for her family, Fina is forced to work at an early age to buy medicine for her mother and food for her family. Being only ten years old she is limited in what she can do and earns small wages through occasionally helping the guild with skinning monsters. Fina is kind, honest, hardworking, and very responsible and mature for her age. As noted by her mother and Yuna, Fina has a mentality that is abnormal for a ten year old. (Source: Kuma Kuma Kuma Bear Wikia, edited)

characters.name: Noir Fochrosé
characters.original: ノアール・フォシュローゼ
characters.description: A noble girl who resides in the town of Crimonia. Her father is the Feudal Lord of Crimonia and together they live in a mansion located there, while Noir's mother and sister live together at the Capital City. Noir has a slightly spoiled and prideful attitude, although not to the point of it being offensive but rather cute and childish. She doesn't seem to mind associating with people outside her social class to a certain degree and became friends with Fina even with their social status differences. (Source: Kuma Kuma Kuma Bear Wikia, edited)

characters.name: Shia Fochrosé
characters.original: シア・フォシュローゼ
characters.description: A noble girl who resides in the Royal Capital. Shia is the elder sister of Noir and the daughter of Cliff and Eleanora Fochrosé. She currently lives together with her mother and attends the Royal Academy, while her sister and father live together in Crimonia. Shia had a very prideful and arrogant personalty before meeting Yuna. Initially she believed that she is one of the strongest students at her school and that no girl is stronger than her, but after suffering a complete defeat at the hands of Yuna, she becomes less conceited. (Source: Kuma Kuma Kuma Bear Wikia)

characters.name: Gentz
characters.description: A guild staff member and a resident of Crimonia.

characters.name: Helen
characters.description: A female guild receptionist of Crimonia.

characters.name: Nelt
characters.description: Nelt is a owner of a dwarven smithy.

title: Yume de Furarete Hajimaru Yuri
title_original: 夢でフラれてはじまる百合
title_en: A Yuri Love Story That Begins with Getting Dumped in a Dream
description: Tsukushi has always admired her best friend Hinoka and cherishes their friendship over everything. But one night, she wakes from a startling dream—one where Hinoka rejects her romantically! Except, Tsukushi hadn’t ever thought of confessing feelings to Hinoka before, but this strange dream gets her thinking. Does she have feelings for Hinoka? Was the dream some kind of foreshadowing? What would Hinoka think if she knew? As Tsukushi becomes determined to figure things out, her hyperfocus actually causes her to miss signs of Hinoka’s own feelings! Will the stars align for these girls to become girlfriends? Or will they miss their chance at the perfect romance? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Picked up for serialization on 2022-04-22

characters.name: Serina Sugiyama
characters.description: Tsukushi's little sister.

characters.name: Rumi
characters.description: Sara's older sister.

title: Yamada to Kase-san.
description: Yamada is in heaven at her school’s horticulture department, and Kase-san is training hard at the sports university. With classes and a long train ride to keep them apart, hanging out together is tough. Can they beat their busy schedules and find time for one another? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Yui Yamada
characters.description: A quiet girl who is in charge of greenification. She's poor at sports and singing.

characters.name: Tomoka Kase
characters.description: A popular and handsome girl in the class next door to [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/125397)'s. She's the ace of the track and field club.

characters.name: Mikawa
characters.description: Yamada's classmate and best friend. She's in the tennis club. She can't handle the sight of blood well.

characters.name: Akane Inoue
characters.description: Akane Inoue, also known as Inoue-senpai, is a graduate and former member of the track and field club at Yui Yamada and Tomoka Kase's high school. ~!As a result of rumors, she is long believed by Yamada to be Kase's ex-girlfriend, although this is eventually proven to be false.!~

title: Dore ga Koi ka ga Wakaranai
title_original: どれが恋かがわからない
title_en: I Don’t Know Which is Love
description: Mei Soraike tries to confess her love to the best friend she has harbored a secret crush for…only to have her hopes crushed. But a little heartbreak is fine—because she’ll absolutely, definitely get a girlfriend in college! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Mei Soraike
characters.description: Mei is a first-year psychology major, she has an expressive and extroverted personality. At her high school graduation, she was about to ask her crush of three years to be her girlfriend, but before she could do so, she was told that her crush had gotten a boyfriend of her own. She was heartbroken, but she was determined to find a girlfriend in college.

characters.name: Minato
characters.description: Minato is third-year art student with a laid-back attitude. She has a thing for cute voices, and Mei's is her favourite. Despite her princely appearance in the theatre department, she is not an actress and appears to work in sound to capitalize on her fetish.

characters.name: Maria Todomeki
characters.description: Professor of psychology at Mei's university. She notices right away that Mei likes girls. She thinks Mei is cute.

characters.name: Riri Shirosawa
characters.description: Mei's first university friend. She was admitted on recommendation, so she can't study, but she's very innocent and good-natured. She is a gravure model.

characters.name: Kaoru Kunimasa
characters.description: A third-year political science student. She is Mei's dorm roommate. She is very sensitive to scents. She enjoys the smell of Mei's natural body scent. Because of her major, she is a very conscientious person.

characters.name: Karin Ajima
characters.description: Karin is third-year art student. Her nickname is Kiss Demon Senpai, and she enjoys kissing girls. However she hasn't been satisfied with girls other than Mei since she kissed her. She is the most forward of the harem members, not only stealing Mei's first kiss, but also declaring Mei her temporary girlfriend afterward.

title: Suicide Girl
description: A story where a girl of light fights against the darkness of the world.

characters.name: Akane Niyagara
characters.description: Akane is a A 15-year-old girl in the third year of middle school. She wants to find her "fated person" so they cam commit double suicide, which she believes is the biggest possible expression of love.

characters.name: Soru Asahina
characters.description: Kirari's childhood friend and fiancée.

characters.name: Enya
characters.description: Enya, also known as Mother, is the Megalophobia of Suicidal Ideation. She's the leader of the Megalophobias.

characters.name: Lucio
characters.description: Lucio, or simply Manager, is the owner and manager of the Suicide Cafe where he drives out the Phobias inside people to free them from their desire to commit suicide. He is the employer of the Suicide Girls and seeks out candidates through the Cafe.

characters.name: Yugame
characters.description: Yugame is a Harpy Megalophobia. She is a daughter of [Enya](https://anilist.co/character/215213/Enya) and sister of Mu and Kuzure.

title: Tsukuritai Onna to Tabetai Onna
title_original: 作りたい女と食べたい女
title_en: She Loves to Cook, and She Loves to Eat
description: Cooking is how Nomoto de-stresses, but one day, she makes way more than she can eat by herself. And so she invites her neighbor Kasuga, who also lives alone. What will come out of this dinner invitation? (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Yako Kaname
characters.description: An online friend of Nomoto's, she loves to eat but has no interest in cooking, so she eats out or eats at convenience stores. She has followed Nomoto's social media for several years, enjoying her food posts, but only begins chatting more directly with her after Nomoto writes about her interest in a recently released lesbian film. As Nomoto comes to understand her own sexuality, Yako gives her advice from her perspective as an asexual lesbian.

title: Tai-Ari deshita.: Ojou-sama wa Kakutou Game nante Shinai
title_original: 対ありでした。～お嬢さまは格闘ゲームなんてしない～
title_en: Young Ladies Don’t Play Fighting Games
description: Kuromi Girls’ Academy is a refined, elegant school that expects the very best in deportment from its young ladies. Aya got into this peerless rich-girls’ institution on a scholarship, and hopes to grow as lovely as her fellow student and idol Shirayui. But Shirayui hides a terrible secret: she’s a trash-talking, combo-chaining, newbie-stomping, ruthless hardcore gamer! Could a mutual indulgence in no-holds-barred video game combat grow into a deeper rapport between these two girls? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Aya Mitsuki
characters.description: Aya is a first year student attending Kuromi Girls’ Academy on a scholarship. She's a skilled fighting game player and joined the academy to learn how to become a proper young lady after abandoning her hobby.

characters.name: Mio Yorue
characters.description: Mio is a first year student at Kuromi Girls 'Academy. She excels at fighting games and attends the academy at her mother's request. Mio is addicted to fighting games and doesn't hesitate to break the rules of the academy to play. She cries easily when things don't go her way, but shows strong determination when she has a goal in mind. Fellow students call her Shirayuri-sama, a nickname that infuriates her.

title: Bad Thinking Diary
description: Min-Ji and Yu-Na have been best friends since high school, and Min-Ji counts herself lucky to have someone so pretty and kind in her life. She just knows that when she finally starts dating, she wants it to be with someone as amazing as Yu-Na! Everything seems perfect, but things start to change when Min-Ji begins having dirty dreams… ones starring Yu-Na herself! Min-Ji chalks it up to her own loneliness, but for some reason Yu-Na starts acting strangely when Min-Ji tells her about it… Is she upset, or could it be that Yu-Na has harbored feelings for Min-Ji all along? From unrequited love, excitement, and obsession, just where will these bad thoughts lead them? (Source: Lezhin US, edited)

characters.name: Ji-hoon Han
characters.description: Minji's old love interest. She thinks Jihoon looks just like Yuna.

title: Akumade Amai Watashi no Kanojo
title_original: あくまであまい私の彼女
description: Amatsuka Mai, a girl who loves sweets, is heartbroken after being dumped by her girlfriend. One day, she falls in love at first sight with Kurosaki Riri, a beautiful girl who has just arrived as a new waitress at the cafe she works at. However, Riri turns out to be a demon called a succubus? Mai shouldn't fall in love with her, but she can't forget her super sweet kiss! A cute and devilish Girls' Love comedy begins! (Source: Kodansha, translated) Notes: - Chapters 2 to 20 were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases. - Includes the one-shot "Tsukutte Agetai! Yomotsu Gohan (作ってあげたい! よもつご飯)" and one extra chapter.

title: Hiraeth wa Tabiji no Hate
title_original: ヒラエスは旅路の果て
description: After the death of her best friend, Mika is determined to follow her into the grave. But her suicide attempt introduces her to a world unlike any she's ever seen...full of gods and spirits and entities of which she could never have dreamed. But even with this world of wonder, can she find a way out of her sorrow? (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Mika Kashima
characters.description: Attempted suicide after being unable to process the death of her friend. Her reason for traveling is to meet her friend again in Yomi.

characters.name: Kami-sama
characters.description: A mysterious being traveling with Hibino to the land of Yomi.

characters.name: Hibino
characters.description: A man traveling on a journey in his sidecar motorcycle with Kami-sama. He is immortal, and his wounds heal instantly.

title: 100-man no Inochi no Ue ni Ore wa Tatteiru
title_original: 100万の命の上に俺は立っている
title_en: I'm Standing on a Million Lives
description: Ninth grader Yusuke Yotsuya is practical, friendless, and not active in any clubs. Then one day, he and two female classmates are suddenly sent to another world where they must work together to battle for their lives. Yotsuya is a lone wolf and has always lived his life according to his wants, but how will that work out now that he’s supposed to be a hero?! Get ready for a one-of-a-kind fantasy story that will challenge everything you thought you knew about fantasy! (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Glenda Carter
characters.description: She joins as a hero at the start of round 6.

characters.name: Habaki Futashige
characters.description: He's the hero that joins starting round 7: Kingdom of Black Labor

characters.name: Kahabell
characters.description: Ready to enforce justice no matter the common sense with her indomitable spirit, Kahabell's actions reflect that of a truly fanatical knight. She is also known to be rather sadistic as she enjoys the sensation of cutting the flesh of living things.

characters.name: Yana
characters.description: She's a character that appears in round 5. She's one of the Välkedaam's ritual dancers

characters.name: Calisto
characters.description: He's a character that appears in round 6, the Ihar-Nemore Drug War. He's one of the cartel bosses

characters.name: Aoiu
characters.description: She's a character that appears in round 5. She's one of the Välkedaam's ritual dancers

title: #Gal to Gal no Yuri
description: Two gals decide to be more than pals! (Source: VIZ) Note: Originally published as a one-shot, was then picked up for serialization.

characters.name: Yua Taooka
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm

characters.name: Yazawa Kokona
characters.description: Yua's childhood friend

title: Yoru to Umi
description: "I never really wanted good friends. I always thought I'd rather have things I'd be okay with leaving behind." Tsukiko is the new girl in school. One day, she catches a glimpse of her classmate, Utsumi, swimming in the school's pool. She becomes fixated. Tsukiko knew they were classmates, but beyond that, the two girls had no reason to cross paths. However, one rainy day turns all of that around. An emotional story about the everyday lives of the enigmatic new girl and the girl with no filter who happens to love swimming! (Source: MangaPlaza)

characters.name: Aya Utsumi
characters.description: Tsukiko's best friend.

characters.name: Tsukiko Yano
characters.description: She's a first year transfer student who doesn't find anything about her school particularly interesting until she sees Aya swimming in the school's pool.

title: Hello, Melancholic!
title_original: ハロー、メランコリック！
description: Asano Minato is a tall but stooping first-year high school student. Though she’s an awesome trombone player, she does everything she can to fade into the background. Despite her best efforts, however, Minato catches the attention of her bubbly and charismatic upperclasswoman Hibiki, who wants Minato to join the band she’s forming at school and won’t take no for an answer! Will Minato be able to let go of the past and play in a band again? Can polar opposites harmonize through music? Slow jam your way into this dulcet yuri series! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes 4 bonus chapters.

characters.name: Hibiki Sugawa
characters.description: Hibiki Sugawa is one of the main characters of _Hello Melancholic!_ She is a 2nd year at Minato's high school and loves music.

characters.name: Minato Asano
characters.description: She's tall, but awkward and shy. She prefers to stay hidden in the background at her new high school, until a certain classmate comes into her life.

characters.name: Chika Inagaki
characters.description: Chika Inagaki is one of the main characters of _Hello Melancholic!_ She plays the bass guitar, and is close to Sakiko Arita.

characters.name: Sakiko Arita
characters.description: Sakiko Arita is one of the main characters of _Hello Melancholic!_ She plays the flute and is close to Chika Inagaki.

characters.name: Ema Nonaka
characters.description: Ema Nonaka is a supporting character of _Hello Melancholic!_ She is tall, social, and busy. She plays a variety of instruments and is half Japanese and half Russian.

title: Prunus Girl
description: Maki-kun goes to look at the results of his high school entrance exam and meets a beautiful girl. Could this be a fated encounter? He's thrilled to find out that the same girl, Aikawa Kizuna, not only ends up going to his school, but is in his class. However, he's not so thrilled to find out that Aikawa is really a guy!

characters.name: Kizuna Aikawa
characters.description: He declares himself a boy at the beginning of the first chapter, despite his girly-looking appearance and personality. He's athletic but not a very good student, and has a sweet tooth. Aikawa wears the girls' school uniform at Midorinoka (he tried wearing the boys' uniform at one point, to the awe of his classmates, but found it didn't suit him as well), and cross-dresses outside of school, too. He's very girly and comfortable with this, but is quick to remind everyone of his true gender, and occasionally worries his cross-dressing is holding back his masculinity (he wonders if that's why he's stopped growing taller, for instance). People are often shocked or creeped out to learn Aikawa is male, but his classmates largely treat him like a girl. He's popular with boys and girls, and many of the boys leer at him and chase after him in the same way they treat their female classmates. He oft

characters.name: Maki
characters.description: Maki excels at studies and sports, He's extremely popular with the girls, but the only thing in the way of his judgment is that he is always yanked around by Aikawa leading him on.

characters.name: Shion Hanazaka
characters.description: A transfer student, she appeared in Chapter 8, Maki's other school Friend, she's "in the other's side team" former girlfriend of Kana Wakakusa who transfers to Midorigaoka seeking out Her. She and Wakakusa Kana are together now.

characters.name: Kei Sasakino
characters.description: Older twin sister of Ken and a classmate of Maki and Kizuna. She is close friends with Asami and Non. It is strongly implied that she has romantic feelings for her younger twin brother.

characters.name: Non Tachibana
characters.description: A classmate of Maki and Kizuna. She is close friends with Asami and Kei. She later develops feelings for both Shion and Kana.

characters.name: Kadoyama
characters.description: A friend of Maki.

characters.name: Asami Asakura
characters.description: A classmate of Maki. She seems to like him a bit.

characters.name: Haruko Satou
characters.description: Classmate of Maki who used to like him in a normal way. Became a fujoshi after she "lost" to Kizuna. Now into yaoi, she likes to see Kizuna and Maki together.

characters.name: Ken Sasakino
characters.description: The younger twin brother of Kei. He is friends with Maki and Kadoyama.

characters.name: Yaotome
characters.description: A strange, straightforward and deadpan female student who is the class president of Maki and Aikawa's class. She is also a high-ranking member of the Student Council and the chairperson of the Uniform Committee.

characters.name: Shizuya Asakura
characters.description: He is the older brother of Asami. He is the vice-president of the student council as well.

characters.name: Kana Wakakusa
characters.description: Maki's middle school classmate Friend and former girlfriend of Hanazaka Shion. She transfers to Midorigaoka seeking out Shion. She and Hanazaka Shion are together now.

title: Imasara desu ga, Osananajimi wo Suki ni Natte Shimaimashita
title_original: 今さらですが、幼なじみを好きになってしまいました
description: I've known Ta-kun ever since we were 10 years old. Even though we are now in high school, we still spend our days in his room, talking about nothing in particular. We are close, but our relationship is not quite as sweet as lovers… Why won't you notice me? I'm trying so hard to get closer to you! I am Hikari Shirasaka, 16 years old… It might be a little late for me to tell you this, but I think I've fallen in love with you, my childhood friend. (Source: ComicWalker, translated) Note: Originally self-published, it was picked up for commercial serialization starting 2025-02-17.

characters.name: Yuu Takamura
characters.description: [Hikari's](https://anilist.co/character/346295) childhood friend. Her nickname for him is "Ta-kun" (タ～君), a misreading of his name "Yuu" (夕) because in elementary school, she learned the kana タ before the similarly written kanji 夕.

characters.name: Himari Shirasaka
characters.description: [Hikari Shirasaka's](https://anilist.co/character/346295/Shirasaka-Hikari) mother.

title: Nickelodeon
description: This is a collection of one-shots from Douman Seiman. It contains 39 short stories about serial killers finding love, historical figures brought back from the dead, yaoi fan-girl ghosts making suggestions to the men she watches, and everything in between. Volume 1: Aka (赤, Red) 1. Heart Food (Heart Food) 2. Kopi Kopi Luwak (コピ・コピ・ルアク) 3. Funny Game (ファニーゲーム) 4. Kakuriyo Jaunte (カクリヨジョウント, Afterlife Jaunte) 5. Taketori Paradigm (竹取パラダイム, The Kaguya Paradigm) 6. Facehugger (フェイスハガー) 7. Heel to Sneaker (ヒールとスニーカー, High Heels and Sneakers) 8. Vigilante (ヴィジランティ) 9. Doubutsu Jikisei Renai Shugi (動物磁気性恋愛主義, Animal Magnetism Theory) 10. Warren=Wilson wa Futatabi Korosareru (ウォレン＝ウィルソンは二度殺される, Warren Wilson Dies Again) 11. Puuta no Mori (ぷう太の森, Poohta's Forest) 12. Paracelsus no Manadeshi-tachi (パラケルススの愛弟子達, Paracelsus' Beloved Desciples) 13. Kaishuu Iin to Genshitsuu (回収委員と幻肢痛, The Collector and Phantom Pain) Volume 2: Midori (緑, Green) 1. Columbine de Kyuushoku wo (コロンバインで給食を, Lunch at Columbine) 2. Futananoka (ふたなのか, Fourteen Days After Death) 3. Kawazu Curse (かわずカース, Frog Curse) 4. Inshu Banchou (飲酒番長, Delinquent Drinker) 5. Koiwazurai Rappart (恋わずらいラポール, Lovesick Rappart) 6. Yuusei yo

characters.name: Haruko
characters.description: Appears in "High Heels and Sneakers." She and her sister also appear in the Nickelodeon Red's front cover. One half of a conjoined twin. She and her sister share a pancreas and a liver. They work part-time at the university where Sugawara studies twins. She hates wearing high heels but is forced to wear them to be able to balance out. It is later revealed that she finds the job boring but still goes to the university because she likes Sugawara. ~!During an experiment, the twins were connected to a machine that would react when their thoughts are in sync. Haruko was thinking of Sugawara when the machine beeped, and she immediately realized that her sister also likes him. She promised to continue wearing high heels as "a small punishment" for all the things that her sister has to do for her.!~

characters.name: Haruna Ikejiri
characters.description: Appears in "Afterlife Jaunte." A younger girl who is in a relationship with her teacher Kiriya. She is said to be "a bit different than everyone else" and that her classmates avoid her. After the Agnes bill was passed, she decided to join Kiriya in fleeing the country. After using the "Take-You-Anywhere Door," her fate is unknown.

characters.name: Izumi
characters.description: Appears in "Afterlife Jaunte," "The Kaguya Paradigm," and "Love Before Planets." A genius inventor studying pseudo-science. His research in college was about the "Jaunte theory" and he was able to invent the "Take-You-Anywhere Door." He has feelings for his coworker Nayotake who frequently presents him "problems that can't be solved." He was later given the challenge of creating a komainu stew which, if solved, grant him Nayotake's hand for marriage. He also has knowledge of the planet bomb and the Planetary Gear Mechanism.

characters.name: Kiriya
characters.description: Appears in "Afterlife Jaunte." A teacher who is friends with Izumi. He is in a relationship with his student Haruna and asked for Izumi's help in fleeing the country. Because of an "Agnes bill," he might get a death penalty without trial if his relationship with Haruna is found out. After using Izumi's "Take-You-Anywhere Door," his fate is unknown.

characters.name: Kiyosubashi
characters.description: Appears in "Facehugger" and "Animal Magnetism Theory." She is a classmate of both Kuramae and Kototoi. Like Kuramae, she had watched movies from the "Alien" series, revealing her hatred for "Alien 3" which was Kuramae's favorite. She compared the appearance of her left hand to that of a facehugger's. She disliked being called a Hatsune Miku ripoff and decided to change her hairstyle.

characters.name: Kototoi
characters.description: Appears in "Animal Magnetism Theory" and "Lovesick Rappart." Kototoi is a classmate of both Kuramae and Kiyosubashi. She used to go out with Kuramae and initially kept their relationship a secret. In "Lovesick Rappart," she became a well-known hypnotist, and Azuma asked for her help to forget someone who broke her heart.

characters.name: Kuramae
characters.description: Appears in "Facehugger," "Animal Magnetism Theory," and "Lovesick Rappart." He is a classmate of both Kiyosubashi and Kototoi. He is also the object of their affections. He had seen movies from the "Alien" series, citing "Alien 3" as his favorite. He went searching for the "facehugger" with Kiyosubashi because he didn't have any reason not to. This made her call him a "good person." In "Animal Magnetism Theory," she was going out with Kototoi but was initially keeping their relationship a secret. He allows Kiyosubashi to order him around partly due to guilt, blaming himself for the loss of her hand.

characters.name: Natsuko
characters.description: Appears in "High Heels and Sneakers." She and her sister also appear in the Nickelodeon Red's front cover. One half of a conjoined twin. She and her sister share a pancreas and a liver. They work part-time at the university where Sugawara studies twins. Because of a sudden growth spurt, she was forced to wear sneakers while her sister wears her high heels in order to balance out. She acts as the big sister and is shown to be the more reasonable twin.

characters.name: Nayotake
characters.description: Appears in "The Kaguya Paradigm." Izumi's fellow researcher who is also studying pseudo-science. She loves presenting Izumi "problems that can't be solved." She eventually challenged him to make komainu stew, promising to marry anyone who succeeds. It is later revealed that Izumi was the only person she presented the challenged to.

characters.name: Reiko
characters.description: Appears in "Funny Game." A member of the track team. She is said to be the second-fastest person in the team next to Misa who had earlier departed. She lost the "last letter game" and was forced to run to the police station. Her fate is unknown.

characters.name: Sugawara
characters.description: Appears in "Kopi Kopi Luwak" and "High Heels and Sneakers." Taki's close friend. He went to the same high school as Taki. He later works at a university studying twins.

title: Sora Haena!
description: "Please help me get a boyfriend!!" "Okay, but in return, you have to get me into college." Sora is the top student at the prestigious Jaeil All-Girls High School but she suddenly finds herself lying to her classmates about a boyfriend she doesn't have, which leads her to accepting the near-impossible task of getting the delinquent Haena Woo into college. But in return, Haena will have to find Mr. Right for Sora so she doesn't get caught in her lie. Yet strangely, instead of some boy, Sora finds her heart beating for Haena... (Source: Copin Comics)

title: Futari Escape
description: Two young women–one an overworked manga artist, the other a complete slacker–try to escape the realities of adult responsibilities. Whether it’s running off on a day trip instead of being productive or going into debt for an epic meal, the two always have fun when they’re together! Enjoy this delightful (and relatable) slice-of-life tale about the little pleasures in ducking away from the hard stuff. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Notes: - Originally released at COMITIA 130 and 131, was then picked up by Ichijinsha for serialization. - Includes four extra chapters.

characters.name: Senpai
characters.description: A self-professed "pro" at escaping from reality (unemployed).

characters.name: Kouhai
characters.description: A deadline-plagued manga artist.

title: Araburu Kisetsu no Otomedomo yo.
title_original: 荒ぶる季節の乙女どもよ。
title_en: O Maidens in Your Savage Season
description: When Kazusa enters high school, she joins the Literature Club, where she leaps from reading innocent fiction to diving into the literary classics. But these novels are a bit more…adult than she was prepared for. Between euphemisms like fresh dewy grass and pork stew, crushing on the boy next door, and knowing you want to do that one thing before you die–discovering your budding sexuality is no easy feat! As if puberty wasn’t awkward enough, the club consists of a brooding writer, the prettiest girl in school, an agreeable comrade, and an outspoken prude. Fumbling over their own discomforts, these five teens get thrown into chaos over three little letters: S…E…X…! Note: Includes four extra chapters.

characters.name: Niina Sugawara
characters.description: Kazusa's friend, a melancholic girl who the guys call a "crane" because of her fragile beauty. Initially, Niina ignores the boys because of a harassment experience in her childhood but gradually begins to develop feelings for Izumi because of his caring and kindness. Thus, her loyalty to her friend and their common love of one boy quickly becomes one of the main conflicts of the story.

characters.name: Momoko Sudou
characters.description: A shy girl and Kazusa’s best friend. At first, like the other girls, she becomes interested in relationships with boys. However, as the story progresses, she gradually realizes her true feelings and growing attraction toward other girls. At first, she dismisses it as a misunderstanding about why girls like boys, but eventually she develops a one-sided crush on Sugawara.

characters.name: Rika Sonezaki
characters.description: The president of a literary club, a tall, prudish girl who is ashamed of her interest in the opposite sex because of her strict upbringing and serious nature. Nevertheless, in spite of her purism, she gets the most healthy relationship with guys compared to other girls. Over time she comes to realize that romantic affection and sexual attraction are not the same thing, thus she begins to lower her guard and starts a relationship with [Shun Amagi](https://anilist.co/character/141291/).

characters.name: Hitoha Hongou
characters.description: A blunt girl aspiring to publish erotica novels. Being a virgin, she relies on online adult chatrooms to get inspiration and feedback on her sexual writing. When her editor describes her first draft as if it was written by a virgin 40 year old man, she decides that she needs to go further on her journey for sexual knowledge.

characters.name: Kazusa Onodera
characters.description: Kazusa is the series main lead. Since childhood, she has been in love with Izumi, but all this time she was afraid to take a step forward, while the mockery of more popular classmates did not motivate her to be more active in an attempt to attract his attention. However, as the story progresses, she notices that Izumi is clearly sexually attracted to Sugawara’s outstanding beauty and tenderness. She is Sugawara's friend and is childhood friends with Izumi and Momoko.

characters.name: Izumi Norimoto
characters.description: Kazusa's childhood friend and the subject of interest from her and Sugawara. A kind and caring young guy, he doesn't have any sexual experience or knowledge about love in general, therefore his problems with the differentiation of love and sexual attraction quickly become the cause of a love triangle and a conflict between him and two girls.

characters.name: Hisashi Saegusa
characters.description: A famous director, who also works in acting classes for little children, including one Sugawara attended.

characters.name: Shun Amagi
characters.description: A boy infatuated with Sonezaki even when her class looked down on her.

characters.name: Tomoaki Yamagishi
characters.description: A young male teacher who is blackmailed into being the advisor for the Literature Club by [Hitoha](https://anilist.co/character/141294/), in the absence of their former advisor and imminent disbanding. He is given the nickname Milo-sensei by Hitoha and is called by that nickname by the rest of the club. Hitoha later seems to develop a relationship with him that he is highly reluctant.

characters.name: Satoshi Sugimoto
characters.description: A boy who attends the same cram school as Momoko and tries to start a relationship with her.

characters.name: Sonoe Juujou
characters.description: Juujou is one of the most popular girls in the school, and is initially what causes Rika Sonezaki to start having her own struggles with sex and relationships. Later in the series she befriends Sonezaki.

title: Satougashi no Dangan wa Uchinukenai: A Lollypop or A Bullet
title_original: 砂糖菓子の弾丸は撃ちぬけない A Lollypop or A Bullet
description: Yamada Nagisa is a bored teenager who finds everyday life extremely unappealing: thus her plans to join a military academy as soon she graduates. On the last term of middle school, a strange girl named Mokuzu Umino, who claims to be a mermaid, transfers into Nagisa's class and, much to her bewilderment, begins to follow her around incessantly. An annoyed and discomfited Nagisa initially strives to avoid these encounters, but then she begins to catch glimpses of the pain...

characters.name: Nagisa Yamada
characters.description: Aloof, apathetic middle-schooler who intends to join the JSDF after graduation.

characters.name: Mokuzu Umino
characters.description: A transfer student who claims to be a mermaid.

characters.name: Masachika Umino
characters.description: He's the father of Umino Mokuzu. He's a singer. ~!He's rumored to have abused his daughter Muzuko since she was a child.!~

characters.name: Tomohiko Yamada
characters.description: Nagisa's older brother. He's a hikikomori who likes collecting strange things although he used to be a straight A student.

title: Gwangyejichim
description: “Ugh! Life’s been miserable ever since that one stupid kiss! I NEVER should've done that! 'You wanna try?' she asked—It’s all her fault, and now she’s ignoring me! I can’t stop thinking about her!!!" Poor, unfortunate Ji-Won, stuck in a hormonal, teen game of cat and mouse. Kissed by her best friend, she’s left to her own devices to figure out what the hell is going on. Watch as cat turns to mouse, mouse to cat, and see how two childhood friends tiptoe the boundaries of their relationship. (Source: Tapas, edited)

characters.name: Myeong-In Lee
characters.description: __Height:__ 169 cm An exemplary student loved by her teachers. She is not good at expressing her emotions and tend to put others in an awkward situation due to her bluntness. However, she is a thoughtful person.

characters.name: Ji-Won Chae
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm A happy-go-lucky person who expresses her emotions a bit too well. She doesn't like complicated and thought-provoking things, so she prefers to look for fun things to do instead.

title: SANDA
description: In a near-future Japan, Christmas has faded into myth, and the birth rate has dropped so dramatically that children are now the most precious commodity. Society has artificially extended adolescence to preserve their youth, and traditional holidays, like Christmas, are a mere legend of the past. Volume 1 of SANDA introduces Sanda Kazushige, a middle-school student who unexpectedly becomes entangled in a strange and dangerous mystery. When his classmate, Fuyumura Shiori, accuses him of carrying a curse that could help find her missing friend, Ono Ichie, Sanda's life takes a dramatic turn. Together, they embark on an incredible adventure to unravel the truth behind Ichie's disappearance and uncover the hidden magic of Christmas itself. As they delve deeper into the mystery, the duo faces external threats and internal challenges—questions about loyalty, courage, and the power of belief. Along the way, they confront the true meaning of friendship, trust, and the possibility of magic in a world that has all but forgotten it. (Source: Titan Manga)

characters.name: Kazushige Sanda
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm A second year middle school student at Daikoku Aigo Academy who is a descendant of Santa Claus. He was determined to hide the curse of Santa Claus, but his powers were recently unleashed. When he transforms into Santa, he becomes a muscular old man who works hard to grant the wishes of children.

characters.name: Shiori Fuyumura
characters.description: __Height:__ 182 cm One of [Sanda's](https://anilist.co/character/246680/Kazushige-Sanda) classmates who is unusually tall for her age. She broke the seal on Santa Claus's powers in order to request his help in solving the mysterious disappearance of her friend [Ono](https://anilist.co/character/363834/Ichie-Ono).

characters.name: Saburou Yagiuda
characters.description: Captain of the Special Search Unit of The Red Coats.

characters.name: Niko Kazao
characters.description: Sanda's state-mandated marriage partner.

characters.name: Misuzu Hyouda
characters.description: Yagiuda's junior in the Red Coat Special Investigations Unit. She hates kids.

characters.name: Hitoshi Amaya
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm He is [Sanda](https://anilist.co/character/246680/Kazushige-Sanda)'s dorm roommate.

characters.name: Hifumi Ooshibu
characters.description: Principal of Daikoku Aigo Academy. ~!Underwent a total of 72 reconstruction surgeries to maintain his youthful appearance.!~

characters.name: Hajime Mogi
characters.description: One of [Sanda](https://anilist.co/character/246680/Kazushige-Sanda)'s dorm roommates.

characters.name: Ichie Ono
characters.description: [Fuyumura](https://anilist.co/character/246681/Shiori-Fuyumura)'s best friend who mysteriously went missing.

title: Inkya Gyaru Demo Ikigaritai!
title_original: 陰キャギャルでもイキがりたい！
description: Ichiko and Kulan are members of the pop-culture research club. They like pop culture. They like cute. These two "gals in the shadows" spend their days in a new kind of youthful moratorium. (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Genjitsu Touhi Shitetara Boroboro ni Natta Hanashi
title_original: 現実逃避してたらボロボロになった話
description: Nagata Kabi’s downward spiral is getting out of control, and she can’t stop drinking to soothe the ache of reality. After suffering from unbearable stomach pains, she goes to the hospital, where she is diagnosed with pancreatitis—and is immediately hospitalized. A new chapter unfolds in Nagata Kabi’s life, as she struggles to find her way back to reality and manga creation in the wake of her breakdown. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.name: Kabi Nagata
characters.description: [Staff Profile]( https://anilist.co/staff/120310/Kabi-Nagata)

title: Genkai OL-san wa Akuyaku Reijou-sama ni Tsukaetai
title_original: 限界OLさんは悪役令嬢さまに仕えたい
title_en: The Fed-Up Office Lady Wants to Serve the Villainess
description: Natori Midori has been giving it all at her hum-drum office job for three years now, only to have the rug pulled out from under her when she’s suddenly laid off. But just as she’s feeling lost and adrift, she is summoned to the world of the visual novel she’s currently playing, Fairy Tale of Jewels. And the person who summoned her there? None other than the game’s cruel villainess, Lapis Tenebrau, who’s trying to take down the main cast of the game. Driven into a corner, Natori pretends she’s psychic and uses her knowledge of the game to save Lapis from danger. Now Lapis has taken a shine to her, and is going to make Natori her private secretary?! Can Natori handle this new job, and her growing feelings for her villainess boss? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Midori Natori
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm After being terminated from her job, she was summoned to the game "Fairy Tale of Jewels" as [Lapis](https://anilist.co/character/285681/Tenebrae-Lapis)' retainer, and in acknowledgment of her abilities, she was officially appointed Lapis' secretary. She possesses no magical or special abilities, but because she played the game, she knows of the scenario that the game world would follow, and she falsely claims to others that she has foresight. She struggles to make changes to the games storyline in order avoid a future in which Lapis dies.

characters.name: Lapis Tenebrae
characters.description: **Height:** 185 cm She was the game's last boss, murdered by her fiancé after duping the protagonist. She has the extreme opinion that the aristocrats are the only group that is important and that the ordinary person is only a pawn. While she gets frustrated by [Natori](https://anilist.co/character/285680/Natori-Midori)'s meddling, she plans on using [Diana](https://anilist.co/character/306915/Diana)'s power to further her own ideals. She is the fiancée of [Gran Magnaresk](https://anilist.co/character/306914/Magnaresque-Gran), the first prince.

characters.name: Gran Magnaresque
characters.original: グラン・マグナレスク
characters.description: **Height:** 188 cm He is Lapis' fiancée, and Diana regards him as an admirable person who had previously helped her. If the story had followed the original scenario, he would have had a predestined reunion with Diana, but because he intimidated Natori, Diana is now wary of him.

characters.name: Diana
characters.description: **Height:** 163 cm She was the game's main character, and she is lively and pure. She was unsure how to control her power after wounding Natori in a mock battle with Lapis during the summoner's exam, but she regained her confidence after getting a "prediction" from Natori.

characters.name: Vino
characters.description: **Height**: 157 cm He is a spy working for Lapis. ~!He is able to read minds using magic.!~

title: Machikado Mazoku
description: Yoshida Yuko was living a perfectly normal (if poverty-stricken) life, but at the age of fifteen, she suddenly sprouts demon horns and a tail! Her mother explains that she's actually a demon named Shadow Mistress Yuko, once sealed away and cursed so that her family would remain poor for generations. Now Yuko can break that very curse if she defeats Chiyoda Momo, a magical girl who goes to her school…but Momo is stronger than she is, knows how to manage magical powers, and is so freaking nice that she's actually helping Yuko out of scrapes. Yuko's too weak and uncoordinated to straight-up kill Momo, even if she wanted to, but she can't just be buddies with this generous magical girl, either–she has to break the curse on her family somehow. What's a demon girl to do? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Momo Chiyoda
characters.description: **Momo Chiyoda** is the magical girl who is protecting the town of Seiiki Sakuraga-oka. As a magical girl, she is a maniac of muscle training, and her physical power overwhelmingly surpasses that of her rival [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461), the succubus in town. Her magical girl career is mysterious, including rumors that she had once saved the world.

characters.name: Mikan Hinatsuki
characters.description: **Mikan Hinatsuki** is a Magical Girl who arrives in town to support [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/141457). She suffers from a curse that brings misfortune to those close to her whenever she gets overly excited or anxious.

characters.name: Lilith
characters.description: **Lilith** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461)'s demon ancestor. She appears in her dreams one night and gives her demon powers, and tasks her on defeating a magical girl.

characters.name: Yuuko Yoshida
characters.description: Yuuko Yoshida is a demon whose power is suddenly awakened in her first year of high school; aims to overthrow the magical girl in town to break her family's spell. However, although she has the ability to sneak into others' dreams, her physical strength and stamina are much weaker than the ones of her rival, the magical girl [Momo Chiyoda](https://anilist.co/character/141457).

characters.name: Seiko Yoshida
characters.description: **Seiko Yoshida** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461) and [Ryouko](https://anilist.co/character/141462/Ryouko-Yoshida)'s mother.

characters.name: Ryouko Yoshida
characters.description: **Ryouko Yoshida** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461)'s younger sister. Ryouko's dream is to support her sister in becoming a fearsome demon.

characters.name: Anri Sata
characters.description: **Anri Sata** is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461/Yuuko-Yoshida)'s friend and classmate.

characters.name: Shion Ogura
characters.description: Shion Ogura is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/141461/Yuuko-Yoshida)'s friend and classmate.

characters.name: Lico
characters.description: Lico is a fox demon that serves as the waitress and the chef for Asura Cafe.

characters.name: Shirosawa Tenchou
characters.description: Shirosawa is a tapir demon, and the owner of the Asura Cafe. He is the creator of the character mascot for the Tamasakura shopping street, Tamasakura-chan.

title: After Hours
description: The club is hopping and Emi isn’t…so she ends up hiding in a corner after her friend ditches her to flirt with a guy! Emi figures the night is a bust, but then someone amazing comes to her rescue. Kei is a DJ, and her effortless self-confidence captivates Emi. Is this just a wonderful night out or the start of the rest of her life? (Source: VIZ Media)

title: Giselle-ssi-ui Pi
description: A rebellious spirit trapped in her marriage to a violent husband, Giselle leads a miserable life playing the role of a meek wife and lady. But one night, wandering her new home, Giselle discovers what seems to be a young boy trapped inside a cage. An inheritance from her husband’s eccentric father, the boy is considered a monster, an immortal “flower that feeds upon blood”. Despite her fear, Giselle begins to visit the boy nightly. Will these illicit meetings shatter life as she knows it? (Source: Lezhin US) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.name: Isaac
characters.description: An inheritance from the Giselle's husband’s eccentric father, the boy is considered a monster, an immortal “flower that feeds upon blood”.

title: Toumei Ningen no Hone
description: An emotional father. An indifferent older brother. A mother who silently endures. Aya Kinomiya is a young girl growing up in a broken household. One day, she wishes “I don’t want to be here…” and suddenly, she gains the ability to become invisible. This is the story of a girl’s journey to reclaim "normality" in her life—and to rediscover her pain. (Source: MANGA MILLION)

characters.name: Aya Kinomiya
characters.description: As a child, Aya bore witness to an abusive father towards her mother. Feeling that she had no place she could call a home, she awakens to a strange power that turns herself invisible at will. ~!One day, after an event where her father abusiveness pushes her mother to the point of almost killing herself, Aya uses her powers to murder her father. As a result, her family situation became a lot more peaceful, however, Aya continues to live her life with the heavy burden of being a murderer.!~ Despite the burden she carries, Aya is a fairly normal, albeit meek, and kind girl that can smile like anyone else as shown through her various interactions with her friends. However, she does not value herself as a human being nor does she feel that she deserves happiness.

characters.name: Shiori Nakayama
characters.description: Shiori is a second year in high school and is a senior to Aya and Kana. She loves creating music and singing, which is what draws Aya towards her, and her curious nature drives her to understand various emotions that she's never experienced herself so that she may turn them into songs, which is what draws her towards Aya.

characters.name: Kana Minakami
characters.description: Kana is a sweet girl in her first year of high school and is next door neighbors with Aya. It is said that she is Aya's "ideal self", a girl who is bright and enjoying life the fullest, the exact opposite of Aya.

title: CLOVER
description: Kazuhiko is a young, but already deeply wounded black ops agent of a baroque, retro-tech future - pulled out of retirement to escort Sue, a mysterious waif, to a destination she alone knows. Suu and Kazuhiko have never met . . . yet she knows him, having grown up since the age of four with her only human contact being two distant voices: that of her elderly "grandma," General Ko, and of Kazuhiko's dead girlfriend, Oruha. And Suu has been kept in that cage all these years because of what she is, and what the Clover Leaf Project found her to be -- a military top secret, and the most dangerous person in the world. (Source: Dark Horse)

characters.name: Suu
characters.description: Suu is the main character of the series. In the futuristic world that she inhabits, the military conducted a search for gifted children nicknamed "Clovers", who seemingly have the magical ability to manipulate technology. Demonstrations of their powers include teleportation and summoning weapons from thin air. Suu is one of these children. Being isolated from the rest of mankind, Suu craves for company, and as for her only wish, she asks to visit "Fairy Park." Her escort is Kazuhiko, an ex-military soldier who has been forced to undertake the task. It is later revealed that Kazuhiko and Sū are connected through Kazuhiko's deceased lover, Oruha. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Fay Ryu Kazuhiko
characters.description: Kazuhiko served in the army until Oruha was killed onstage on her birthday. he then swore to seek revenge for his lost lover, and is later assigned to protect Suu on her journey.

characters.name: Oruha
characters.description: Possessing a beautiful singing voice and the love of Kazuhiko, Oruha (also spelled "Ora" or "Oluha") has a secret. She also has amazing fashion sense. She is not seen until volumes 3 and 4 (which are prequels), though is referenced in volumes 1 and 2.

characters.name: Gingetsu
characters.description: Silence and calm is the charatcer of Gingetsu. After found Lan (Ran), he decided to live with him but of course it's not easy to get the permission from The Wizard. Since himself is the owner of two-leaf clover and Ran is three-leaf, if they combine their power The Wizard will sure cannot control them anymore. Gingetsu granted his life to The Wizard that they can kill him anytime if he try to do so. And that's the reason they let them stay together. (Source: Happiness)

characters.name: Lan
characters.description: Lan's actual name is simply C - it's Gingetsu who decides to name him Lan (Ran). He was called C because he was one of the three-leaf clovers that once existed, and those triplets' names were A, B and C. Now he's the only one living left, and as he's living away from the Clover Project research facility, he's aging quickly (that's why we can see Ran as a child in the last volume flashback, and as a boy in his late teens or even early twenties in the other volumes, even when two years have passed only since he met Gingetsu for first time). Actually, his life will end in five years - and though he knows it, he still wants to be away from the facility... and not only because he wants to be free - but specially because he wants to be next to the person who's most important to him. Ran's character isn't much developed until the last volume eit

characters.name: A
characters.description: He's the other twins of Ran. He loved Ran and he believe that Ran wouldn't be happy if he's not with him. When he know that Ran is happy with others person, A get angry and he try to kill Gingetsu (He killed B before because B and Ran get to close) in order to take Ran back to him. But then after he know that Ran wouldn't go back with him even with Gingetsu death. He leave Ran with Ran's promise that he will not love anyone else more that A. (Source: Happiness)

title: Doushitara Osananajimi no Kanojo ni Naremasu ka!?
title_original: どうしたら幼馴染の彼女になれますか！？
title_en: How Do I Turn My Best Friend Into My Girlfriend?
description: Minami and Yuzu have been inseparable since elementary school. But now that they’re in high school, Minami just can’t accept that Yuzu may someday get a boyfriend. How come some random guy gets to wake her up in the morning, feed her lunch, take baths with her…? It doesn’t take long for Minami to realize that her feelings can’t quite be described as “friendship” anymore, but how can she get Yuzu to see her the same way? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Murasakiiro no Qualia
description: Through the uncanny purple eyes of Yukari, all people appear to her as robots. Her talent is both a blessing and a curse. She is able to assist the police in sizing up threats, since her “skill” allows her to evaluate humans’ quirks and physical capabilities like cataloging the parts of a machine–yet her strange sight has cost her the friendship of her peers.
