Even though she flirts with him, Jin-Ho feels comfortable enough with her to confide his girl problems to her. There are also hints that Jin-Ho may have had rather deeper feelings for her while she was in high school. It seems that Jin-Ho has been rather more distant with girls since she left. There are implications that Jae-Kyung has romantic inclinations towards Jin-Ho, most prominent when she breaks up with her boyfriend, she seeks out Jin-Ho for comfort and acts very coldly towards Hae-Young after she finds out he was waiting for her. Caroline even states that Jae-Kyung is one of Hae-Young's rivals. It is later revealed that she was originally afraid of engaging with Jin-Ho in a romantic relationship

characters.name: Young-Gi Cha
characters.description: He is also a senior, who is Jin-Ho's friend and classmate. They have been placed together in the same class for the previous five years. Like his friend, he is skilled at fighting. It has been implied that he likes Ji-Soo; he is very protective of her and careful of how she perceives him. Young-Gi also has a strong sense of justice and, despite his tall athletic build, prefers to find the most peaceful resolutions to otherwise violent confrontations. In fact his first encounter with Jin-Ho was when Young-Gi was back in middle school when Jin-Ho, whom was a notable delinquent at the time, was harassing another student; the two fought and soon afterwards became close friends. (from Wikipedia)

title: Sawaranaide Kotesashi-kun
title_original: さわらないで小手指くん
description: Kotesashi Kouyou possesses outstanding skill as a masseur. He aspires to become a sports doctor and wants to get a scholarship in medical school. Starting spring, he attends the high school attached to Seiwa University, a sports powerhouse. Since his family is not wealthy, he has to work as a hostel manager, where he is also allowed to stay, to pay for his school expenses. There he encounters high school girl athletes with various problems. Kotesashi's job is to take care of them physically and mentally and be the hostel manager. (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Otome no Teikoku
description: An ensemble cast of high schoolers at an all girls school laugh their way through school life and the quirky relationships they develop with each other. Note: Includes 108 extras.

characters.name: Ai Okayama
characters.description: A strait-laced girl that gives the vibe of a lone wolf, and has a boyish behavior.

characters.name: Chie Kamizono
characters.description: A playful girl who speaks Kansai dialect. She is attached to [Okayama Ai.](https://anilist.co/character/141837/Ai-Okayama)

characters.name: Miyoshi Sakurai
characters.description: Curious, talkative and cheerful. Belongs to the cheerleading club.

characters.name: Ayano Kujou
characters.description: Intelligent and cunning, a cool beauty. Belongs to the go-home club.

characters.name: Mio Ichinose
characters.description: A dreamy poet from the literature club. Admires [Asami Shizuka.](https://anilist.co/character/141925/Shizuka-Asami)

characters.name: Shizuka Asami
characters.description: Provocative and mature, has a fondness for the fine arts. Belongs to the literature club, and her hobby is teasing her kouhai Ichinose Mio.

characters.name: Kaoru Yamada
characters.description: Elegant and gorgeous. Her relationship with [Shizuka Asami](https://anilist.co/character/141925/Shizuka-Asami) is complicated. She is [Honoka's](https://anilist.co/character/199534/Honoka-Yamada) older sister.

characters.name: Honoka Yamada
characters.description: [Kaoru's](https://anilist.co/character/141926/Kaoru-Yamada) sister. Honoka is a tall otaku who spends most of her time reading doujinshi. During lessons she draws yaoi about the historical men the lesson is about. She dislikes almost all of her classmates and everyone who can draw better than her.

characters.name: Yuu Asamine
characters.description: Though surprisingly delicate at times, this little devil is a total sadist

characters.name: Mari Otosawa
characters.description: Strong-willed in words and deeds but also eagerly submissive.

characters.name: Mahiru Ogi
characters.description: One half of the Mahi-Mahi duo with Mahiro is rumored to bring you happiness and good luck if you meet them. They are often mistaken for twins even though they are not related. Mahiru is the older one of the two but she sees Mahiro as the more reliable one of them, admiring her and her stylishness. They are super-duper good friends and love each other dearly.

characters.name: Mahiro Ooshita
characters.description: Mahiro forms the Mahi-Mahi duo together with Mahiru who are often mistaken to be twins even though they are not related. It is rumored to give you luck and happiness if you meet the two of them. Mahiro is shown to be the more mature and reliable one. She has darker hair, sharper eyes, and a skinnier body according to Mahiru. Mahiro and Mahiru are extremely close, making sure that the other is happy. This is shown in their first chapter appearance where they are shown to get upset at the idea that the other may be hurt by finding out that mistletoe is actually a Christmas tradition instead of Valentine's one and try to cheer each other up at the same time.

title: Ayaka-chan wa Hiroko Senpai ni Koishiteru
title_original: 彩香ちゃんは弘子先輩に恋してる
title_en: AYAKA is in LOVE with HIROKO!
description: Soft and bubbly office lady Ayaka is madly in love with her senior at work, Hiroko! Two lovestruck coworkers who both think the other is straight totally crush on each other... (Source: MangaPlaza) Notes: - Previously serialized under the title "Ayaka-chan wa Hiroko Senpai wo Otoshitai" (彩香ちゃんは弘子先輩を落としたい) - Includes nine extra chapters.

title: Eiyuu-ou, Bu wo Kiwameru Tame Tenseisu: Soshite, Sekai Saikyou no Minarai Kishi♀
title_original: 英雄王、武を極めるため転生す ～そして、世界最強の見習い騎士♀～
title_en: Reborn to Master the Blade: From Hero-King to Extraordinary Squire ♀
description: From his deathbed, all Hero-King Inglis wishes is to live again, for himself this time: a warrior's live he'd devoted himself to before his rise to power. His patron goddess, Alista, hears his plea and flings his soul into the far future. Not only is Inglis now the daughter of a minor noble family, but at her first coming-of-age ceremony at 6, she's found ineligible to begin her knighthood! However, for a lady of Inglis's ambition, this is less a setback and more the challenge she was (re)born to overcome. "It's not the blood that runs through your veins that makes a knight; it's the blood you shed on the battlefield!" The curtain rises on the legend of an extraordinary lady squire reborn to master the blade! (Source: J-Novel Club)

characters.name: Inglis Eucus
characters.original: イングリス・ユークス
characters.description: An apprentice knight—though in reality, she is a man who once made a name for himself as the Hero-King. Reincarnated as a lovely young girl, she hones her skills with the sole aim of becoming stronger. Nothing pleases her more than battling formidable opponents. Lacking the official qualifications to become a knight, she volunteers to serve her childhood friend, [Rafinha](https://anilist.co/character/193864/Rafinha-Bilford), as a squire. She regards Rafinha like a granddaughter and keeps a watchful eye on her, always on guard to ensure no "bad influences" get too close.

characters.name: Rafinha Bilford
characters.original: ラフィニア・ビルフォード

characters.name: Megami Alistia
characters.description: Alistia is the one that gives Inglis the chance to be reborn.

characters.name: Rahl Rambach
characters.description: Rahel Is an Highlander even tho he weren't born on the highland.

characters.name: Rafael Bilford
characters.original: ラファエル・ビルフォード
characters.description: Rafael is The Eldest Son Of Marquis Bilford's House.

characters.name: Irina Bilford
characters.original: イリーナ・ビルフォード
characters.description: Irina is Selena's Sister and Marquis' Wife.

characters.name: Marquis BillFord
characters.description: Marquis is Raphael and Rani's father.

characters.name: Ada
characters.description: Ada is The sub-leader of this city's chivalry Order.

characters.name: Ziony
characters.description: Lord Ziony Is The General Inspector.

characters.name: Serena Eucus
characters.description: Serena is Inglis's mother, aunt of both Rafael and Rafinha Bilford as well the younger sister of Irina.

title: Shoujo Manga Shujinkou x Rival-san
title_original: 少女漫画主人公×ライバルさん
description: Kimura-san wants to get close to her crush Mizushima-kun, but the beautiful and confrontational Hiyama-san has a problem with that... though it's not the kind of problem you'd usually expect from this scenario. Notes: - This is the serialized version published in Gangan Joker - Includes 1 extra chapter.

characters.name: Yurina Hiyama
characters.description: A rival in love who is both intelligent and always with Mizushima, and gets involved with Kimura at every turn.

characters.name: Honoka Kimura
characters.description: She is a plain and inconspicuous girl, like the protagonist of a girl's manga. She is in love with Aoi Mizushima, who is in the next class.

characters.name: Aoi Mizushima
characters.description: A friendly and popular boy. Kimura is secretly in love with him.

title: Keijo!!!!!!!! Hip Whip Girl
description: Kaminashi Nozomi (17) is an exceptional gymnast. So much so that colleges with some of the best gymnastic programs are trying to recruit her. Unfortunately for them, she has other plans. Due to her family being extremely poor, money is everything to her. That's why she wants to step into the world of "Keijo." "Keijo" is a type of gambling sport where girls stand on a small floating platform and compete against one another. The aim is to push the other contestant off of the platform into the water, but they are only allowed to use their butt or breasts to push the others off. Will Nozomi be able to compete in the intense world of "Keijo" and bring wealth and fortune for her family?

characters.name: Nozomi Kaminashi
characters.description: Nozomi Kaminashi is the main protagonist of Keijo!!!!!!!!. She was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She previously resided in Room 309 before being promoted to the Elite Class. ~!Upon graduating from Setouchi, Nozomi officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Hyougo Branch. After her winless start in the professional world of Keijo, Nozomi tries to seek a mentor to guide her. After meeting [Sumire Sakuragi](https://anilist.co/character/271330/Sakuragi-Sumire), Nozomi asks Sumire to become her mentor. Although Sumire initially refused, Sumire is later willing to become soeur with her.!~ ~!After her match with [Sayaka Miyata](https://anilist.co/character/90194/Miyata-Sayaka), Nozomi is able to advance to the A-Rank. Sometime later, Nozomi and Sayaka start to stay in the Garden Worth, a lodging for Keijo players, where they reunite with [Hanabi Kawai]

characters.name: Sayaka Miyata
characters.description: Kaminashi's first friend and rival. Before Keijo used to be a judo's athlete, she was the Japan's hope for a golden medal in the Olympics but threw it all away in the qualifications. She has a complex about her bust size and Kaminashi usually makes fun about it. She previously resided in Room 309 before being promoted to the Elite Class. ~!Upon graduating from Setouchi, Sayaka officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Hyougo Branch.!~

characters.name: Kazane Aoba
characters.description: She is a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School, a former resident of Room 309 and currently a member of the Elite Class. ~!Upon graduating from Setouchi, Kazane officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Chugoku's Hiroshima Branch. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.!~

characters.name: Non Toyoguchi
characters.description: Non Toyoguchi was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She previously resided in Room 309 before being promoted to the Elite Class. ~!Upon graduating from Setouchi, Non officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kyushu's Kagoshima Branch. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.!~

characters.name: Hanabi Kawai
characters.description: Hanabi Kawai was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She was ranked third in the Elite Class. ~!Upon graduating from Setouchi, Hanabi officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Kyoto Branch, and is mentored by Kyoko Shirayuki. After collecting enough points, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.!~

characters.name: Mio Kusakai
characters.description: She's a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School, and a member of the Elite Class in said school, where she ranked first place in the entrance exam. She's an infighter, and has a pretty wide range of special techniques at her disposal. She's also most likely lesbian, as she's often seen flirting with the other girls, as well as the fact that several of her specials have the intent of pleasuring her opponent, she also states at one point that she rather has cute girls than hot guys. ~!Upon graduating from Setouchi, Mio officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.!~

characters.name: Saya Kogatana
characters.description: Saya Kogatana was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She was ranked sixth in the Elite Class. ~!Upon graduating from Setouchi, Saya officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Kyoto Branch. After collecting enough points, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.!~

characters.name: Nagisa Ujibe
characters.description: Nagisa Ujibe is a former champion Keijo player. She is currently working at Setouchi Keijo Training School as an instructor. During her youth, she was able to attain the rank Prize Queen, and was nicknamed as the Siren.

characters.name: Kyouko Shirayuki
characters.description: Kyoko Shirayuk is an A-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Kyoto Branch. Her mentor was Sanae Kirieda. ~!She becomes Hanabi Kawai's mentor after Hanabi officially becomes a Keijo player.!~

characters.name: Maya Sakashiro
characters.description: Maya Sakashiro was a student at Suruga Keijo Training School. She was ranked second in Suruga. She is the adoptive daughter of Ayako Sakashiro, Suruga's coach and headmaster. ~!Kaya Sakashiro is the alternative personality of Maya Sakashiro, who only emerges in a threatening situation that can't be handled by Maya. Kaya was ranked first in Suruga. In other words, the strongest Suruga's student.!~ Upon graduating from Suruga, Maya officially becomes a Keijo player. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.

characters.name: Sanae Hououin
characters.description: Sanae Hououin was a student at Suruga Keijo Training School. She was ranked third in Suruga. She is also nicknamed as the Suruga's Black Beast (駿河の黒き獣, Suruga no Kuroki Kemono), and Cheater (チート女, Chīto Onna). Upon graduating from Suruga, Sanae officially becomes a Keijo player. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.

characters.name: Rin Rokudou
characters.description: Rin Rokudo was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She was ranked second in the Elite Class. Upon graduating from Setouchi, Rin officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Hyougo Branch. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.

title: Fuzoroi no Renri
description: Tanaka Iori is a worker for a company that sets unreasonable demands, on top of that she has a penchant for dating married men. What a recipe for disaster! One day she gets drunk with an acquaintance and wakes up the next morning by her side naked! What's Iori to do? Notes: - Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release. - Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

characters.name: Iori Tanaka
characters.description: An office worker at a "black company" who drinks to cope with work-related stress, she has affairs with married guys on a regular basis and "has never been the most important person in anyone's life." When Minami Sendou, a waitress at her favourite izakaya, brings an inebriated Iori home, Iori unconsciously clings to her, and they end up spending the night together. She is a cheerful and carefree person, and with a few drinks, she can put herself in a good mood and show her affection for Minami, but she also has a scary side when she gets angry and tries to wrestle Minami into submission.

characters.name: Minami Sendou
characters.description: She works in an izakaya. She has blonde hair, ear piercings, and large tattoos covering her shoulders and back. She is especially popular with her female part-time workers. She was raised in an institution since she was a child due to a difficult family situation; it was here that she met Nakano Shizuku. She worries that her happiness with Iori may only be temporary, possibly as a result of the challenging environment she has had gone through. She also occasionally behaves as if she has given up on life, which frustrates Iori.

characters.name: Shizuku Nakano
characters.description: Minami's friend. They were raised in the same institution. She was rather aggressive when she first met Minami, punching her before greeting her, and grabbing a female classmate by the head and chest when she got into a fight with Saori, but as as a result of Shizuku's and Saori's conversations, she gradually became less hostile.

characters.name: Saori Tanaka
characters.description: [Iori's](https://anilist.co/character/291133) younger sister. She has feelings for Iori that are a bit out of the usual for a younger sibling, and she gets frustrated with Minami for taking away her big sister. She is in the same class as Shizuku, and her relationship with Shizuku begins when her homeroom teacher asks her to visit Shizuku's house, because Shizuku refuses to attend school.

characters.name: Kujou
characters.description: She is a physical education teacher at the high school that Saori, Shizuku, and Sugimoto attend. She is romantically attracted in women and wants a girlfriend, so she tries to go inside a lesbian bar, but she never find the courage to do so, so she always goes to the maid café next door. There, she meets Sugimoto, a part-time maid, and receives advice on love. Her students dislike her strict teaching, and she is frequently regarded as having "nothing but a pretty face."

characters.name: Ayame Shinohara
characters.description: She's a manga editor and a former professional gamer who met Heke through FPS games. She enjoys playing games with Heke under the alias Lala. She is also Heke's editor, although she has yet revealed to Heke that Lala = Shinohara, and assumes that Heke is clueless. Despite her cold façade, Heke has a clumsy side that reveals her emotions, such as blushing or happiness, and is unable to take action on her own.

characters.name: Sugimoto
characters.description: She is a third-year high school student. While working part-time at a maid café, she met Kujo and made a promise to help her find a girlfriend. Other female students envy her beauty and popularity, and they gossip about her behind her back.

characters.name: Heke
characters.description: A manga artist. While she is a bad person who spends her time playing FPS games just before a deadline, she knows how to cook well and save money. She pretends to be unaware that Lala is her editor Shinohara, but she has known for quite some time, and she confesses in front of Shinohara in a roundabout way that she likes the person she gets along with in the game in a romantic sense, and watches Shinohara's reaction.

title: Gal-sen
description: When Sora enters high school, his homeroom teacher is a sexy gal with huge breasts and she's none other than the changed version of Suzune, the innocent girl next door who was his first love! As the teacher's "educational guidance" escalates day by day, Sora is awakened to pleasures he's never known before...!

title: Koutsugou Semi-Friend
description: "What if we became friends with benefits...?" Suuna, a gloomy high school student, leaves home to live in a dorm. But when she nervously enters her room, she finds her roommate, Ruka, feeling up another girl! She finds out Ruka needs a "friend with benefits," so Suuna takes charge and proposes they form a "(semi) friends with benefits" contract...? (Source: Yen Press) Notes: - Originally published as three chapters, was then picked up for serialization. - Includes five extra chapters.

characters.name: Suuna Kuruma
characters.description: She is a shy and withdrawn girl with no friends and poor communication skills.

characters.name: Ruka Hamanasu
characters.description: Ruka is Suuna's roommate. She is a popular and flirtatious girl who flirts with a different girl every day.

characters.name: Haku Kaneko
characters.description: Suuna's classmate who tries to protect the innocent girl from the flirtatious Ruka.

characters.name: Shino Saotome
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm A first-year student who's a fundamentally docile and introverted girl.

characters.name: Ren Shirayuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm An honest girl who's protective of [Shino](https://anilist.co/character/317252). She hates how cute her name is (last name "Snow White", first name "Love").

title: Shuuniichido Classmate wo Kau Hanashi: Futari no Jikan, Iiwake no Gosen Yen
title_original: 週に一度クラスメイトを買う話 ～ふたりの時間、言い訳の五千円～
description: Once a week, Miyagi pays 5,000 yen to her classmate Sendai to buy three hours of Sendai’s time, which allows Miyagi to give her orders. Miyagi is at the bottom of the school caste while Sendai is at the top. The two, who have nothing to do with each other at school, spend time together after school under this contract. Miyagi’s orders are determined by her mood that day, and Sendai cannot disobey. One day after school… Miyagi calls Sendai to her room and gives her an unusual order.

characters.name: Hazuki Sendai
characters.description: **Height:** 163 cm (5'4") A bright, worldly high school girl. She is at the bottom of the highest school caste and stands out in class since she is popular. On the other hand, she is compared to her brilliant sister and doesn't have a place at home. Looks irresponsible but is actually serious.

characters.name: Shiori Miyagi
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm (5'2") The type of high school girl who doesn't talk about herself much and only interacts with her few friends. She isn't at the bottom of the school caste system, but she is at the bottom of the second rank. Is the only child in a father-child household. Her father prioritizes work and doesn't come home often. She doesn't call people over to her house often, usually only Sendai. Truth be told, she's lonely.

title: Grace Gildeul-igi
description: Andrew is the only daughter of the famous Grace family. She also has an incurable disease. Due to her family's high status in society, Andrew grew up with no friends save for her maid, Herta, whom she has become intensely infatuated with. Little does she know, her family is responsible for ruining Herta's life. Can Andrew break the hierarchy and be with her? Or will Herta end her suffering first... (Source: Tapas)

title: Shoujo Kakumei Utena
description: Utena Tenjou had a tragic childhood - her parents died when she was young, and she almost drowned, had it not been for her prince who came and rescued her. Because of the impact this prince had on her life, Utena strives to be just like him - to grow up to be a prince, not a princess, and to spread nobility, ultimately finding her prince and bringing revolution. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Utena Tenjou
characters.description: Utena is a tomboyish, courageous and naïve character who lives to emulate the idealized prince figure from her childhood. She is forthright, honest, and friendly, and nearly all the girls in school adore her.

characters.name: Anthy Himemiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm A mysterious and shy dark-skinned girl whose sometimes vapid expression and superficial politeness seem to mask something deeper. Many people project their wants or desires onto her, and she's often the target of their eventual rage or hate. Her "doormat" behavior belies a far more complex personality. Anthy appears to house the Sword of Dios within her own body. At the beginning of a duel, she slips into a trance and the Sword manifests, protruding from her chest so that her champion may draw it from her. This Sword is said to be a key to reaching the goal of Revolution, and in her position as the Rose Bride Anthy is said to be the key to obtaining it.

characters.name: Akio Ootori
characters.description: Anthy's older brother, the acting chairman of the academy. Although barely present in the first season of the show, he later plays a pivotal role in the second and third seasons. His given name derives from the Japanese name for Venus, the Morning Star, which is identified with Lucifer.

characters.name: Chuchu
characters.description: Anthy's pet (whom she will only refer to as friend, but may be more properly described as a familiar). He is a small marmoset who acts as comedic relief. However, he also acts as an omen of bad fortune in certain episodes. ChuChu is drawn much furrier by Chiho Saito in the manga than he is drawn in the anime, the anime itself making him look more like a mouse than a monkey.

characters.name: Miki Kaoru
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Blue Rose Bride: Kozue Kaoru Sword: Épée Drive to Duel: To find "that which shines" Miki is a highly skilled and polite seventh grader who befriends Utena, despite their role as possible opponents in the duels. A piano player par excellence, Miki has fond memories of playing songs with his twin sister Kozue in his childhood, but her refusal to play with him in the present — the symbol of a much deeper rift — gives Miki a sense of loss. His crush on Anthy in the anime (but on Utena in the manga) develops when he realizes that they remind him of his estranged sister. In both adaptions, his drive to duel stems from a desire to find something to replace Kozue in his affections. All the females of the school, even older ones, idolize him, but Kozue threatens any girls who attempt to get too close to him. Likewise he is very protective of her, and so she tries to make him jealo

characters.name: Juri Arisugawa
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Orange __Rose Bride:__ Ruka Tsuchiya __Sword:__ Rapier __(Anime) Drive to Duel:__ To disprove the power of miracles The captain of the academy's fencing team, Juri is one of Ohtori's most highly respected students, and even the teachers appear to be in awe of her.

characters.name: Touga Kiryuu
characters.description: President of the Student Council, Touga is an arrogant and handsome young man whose desire to be powerful drives him to cruel and unscrupulous deeds. Although he says that he wishes to be noble, he has little empathy towards anyone, and his powers of manipulation are second only to Akio. He also shares his playboy attiude and has many female conquests. He is a childhood friend of Saionji, although their relationship took a turn for the worse at a point in their childhood that is the centerpiece of their respective personal journeys. ~!Toward the end of the series, however, Touga's facade of chivalry is replaced with an apparently truer concern for Utena, to the extent that he very subtly attempts to substitute his head for hers on Akio's chopping block. Arguably, this is also an example of Touga's inability to see Utena as who she really is, rather than in a stereotypical feminine role.

characters.name: Nanami Kiryuu
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Yellow __Rose Bride:__ [Touga Kiryuu](https://anilist.co/character/753/Kiryuu-Touga) __Sword:__ Scimitar (main) and Dagger (as main-gauche) __Drive to Duel:__ Her big brother's honor, her own self-worth, and validation of her relationship with Touga (Anime) Touga's little sister, the prototypical "queen bee" of the school. She is very fond of him to the point of their relationship having semi-incestuous edge, at least on her part. Nanami often makes various malicious attacks on students she deems inferior (or worse, those she suspects Touga is paying attention to).

characters.name: Kyouichi Saionji
characters.description: __Sword:__ Sword of Dios, Katana __Drive to Duel:__ To find something eternal, to claim Anthy as his Rose Bride, and to finally defeat Touga (Anime) Vice-president of the Student Council and captain of the kendo team, and is the first duelist Utena fights. He is temperamental, egotistic, prone to angry rages, often cruel, and extremely possessive of Anthy. His belief that they are destined to be together no matter what drive him to be physically violent towards her and continue to pursue her even after their engagement is broken. He and Touga practice kendo together, but Saionji is clearly very resentful of Touga, and especially cannot bear to be humiliated by him (a fact which Touga shamelessly exploits). Saionji is less perceptive, intelligent, and skilled as Touga, and despite his best efforts can never seem to best him. He is regardless affected by this estrangement from his childhoo

characters.name: Kozue Kaoru
characters.description: She's Miki's twin sister who feels overshadowed by his talent and dirtied by comparison with him. Kozue resents Miki's affection for Anthy Himemiya and is prone to acting out to grab her brother's attention, most notably by exercising loose sexual morals. Like Nanami, Kozue also seems to have an extreme brother complex. She is very protective of Miki and is the reason that he does not have a girlfriend (despite the affection of many of his schoolmates). Kozue considers herself a "wild animal," wanting to be freed from adult rules and restrictions (in reality, she is resentful of her father remarrying). ~!In Adolescence of Utena she is shown as being very possessive of Miki, even holding a razor to his throat and calling him a traitor when he refuses to divulge details of his personal affairs to her. A car with Kozue's name is also seen briefly, though the director merely states

characters.name: Ruka Tsuchiya
characters.description: A master swordsman, Ruka is former captain of the fencing team and occasional member of the Student Council. He considers Juri to be the most talented member of the club and considers himself her mentor. ~! * Rose: Blue * Rose Bride: Shiori Takatsuki * Sword: Rapier * (Anime) Drive to Duel: To give Juri, the one he loves, the power of miracles. In the manga, Anthy served as Ruka's Rose Bride on several occasions before he left the school due to an unknown illness. He reappears at the school after a prolonged absence, claiming that he has recovered, though still not well enough to duel. He pushes Juri to duel Utena once again, but she throws the match after overhearing what she thinks is Ruka discussing with Touga how he's manipulating her. When she refuses to duel, Ruka himself is forced to duel Utena, and the strain causes a relapse of his illness. As he lies on the dueling fi

characters.name: Souji Mikage
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Black __Sword:__ Sabre __Drive to Duel:__ ~!To make Mamiya Chida the Rose Bride. (Anime) To finally defeat Mamiya's sister, Tokiko.!~ Mikage is the head of the popular Mikage Seminar at Ohtori Academy.

title: Gunjou
description: "I want you to kill him..." Her husband abuses her on a daily basis. Unable to stand it any longer, she asks her lesbian friend to kill her husband for her. And unable to say no to the woman she loves, the lesbian kills him... Only 22 years old when the series began, Ching Nakamura offers up a work carved from flesh, blood, and bone. (Source: Kotonoha)

characters.name: Chiyomi Ootaka
characters.description: She is called les-san because she is a lesbian. She is madly in love with a girl she went to high school with, but the feelings were never requited. Many years after high school this woman asks her to kill her abusive husband.

characters.name: Souko Ezaki
characters.description: She is called Megane-san because she wears glasses. She had a difficult childhood, and eventually married a rich man that abused her frequently. To escape this, she uses a lesbian that had a crush on her in high school to kill her husband, even though she hates her.

title: Ani no Yome to Kurashiteimasu.
title_original: 兄の嫁と暮らしています.
description: Kishibe Shino, a high school student. 17 years old. Her parents died, and then six months ago, so did her older brother, her only remaining blood relative. Now she lives with her “brother’s wife,” Nozomi-san. “We might not be blood related, but we’re family.” The story they write is a bit clumsy but full of something inexplicable. Slowly but surely, they happily grow together through their sensitive daily life. (Source: MANGA UP!)

title: Shiawase Kanako no Koroshiya Seikatsu
title_original: 幸せカナコの殺し屋生活
description: When Kanako accidentally applies to work at an assassination agency, the timid office worker discovers that she has a knack for bumping people off. Will she ever earn the respect of Sakurai, her prickly and kinda hot co-worker–and why is she still having silly workplace problems when she’s employed with hitmen?! This full-color manga is dangerously funny! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Originally a doujin, it was later serialized in twi4 on April 26, 2019 where the story continued.

characters.name: Kanako Nishino
characters.description: Kanako unintentionally joins an assassin agency after leaving her previous job.

title: Yagate Kimi ni Naru Koushiki Comic Anthology
title_original: やがて君になる 公式コミックアンソロジー
description: Based on the hit manga, light novel, and anime series by Nakatani Nio. Experience the world of this beloved yuri romance through the perspectives of other creators! More tales of budding relationships featuring Yuu, Touko, Sayaka, and all your other faves! Maid outfits, kisses stolen during student council meetings, Touko cross-dressing, and bathtime with Riko and Miyako—all that and more can be found in this collection of stories about girls blooming into love…with each other! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Volume 1 (2018/12/25) Cover Illustration: Yuikawa Kazuno Color Illustration: Fly 1. Yagate Kimi ni Nareru ka na? (やがて君になれるかな?, Can I Bloom Into You Someday?) [Hiiragi Yutaka] 2. Arui wa Sonna Hoshi Moyou (或いはそんな星模様, Perhaps a Constellation Like That) [Canno] 3. Fuwatsuki Otome (ふわつき乙女, Floating Maiden) [Chomoran] 4. Onigiri Croquette Tamagoyaki (おにぎりコロッケたまご焼き) [Miyama Okara] 5. Chiisana Senpai (小さな先輩, Tiny Senpai) [tMnR] 6. In The Box (イン ザ ボックス) [Yuikawa Kazuno] 7. Matsuri no Yoru ni (まつりの夜に, Festival Night) [Mekimeki] 8. Kyakuhon wo Tsukurou! (きゃくほんをつくろう!, Let's Write a Script!) [Fumio Aya] 9. Anata wa Ashita Nani Kite Warau (あなたは明日何着て笑う, What Will You Wear Tomorrow?) [Mo

characters.name: Yuu Koito
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm (5'0") A first year high school student who has never experienced romantic feelings. She joins the student council, where she meets [Touko Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/123529). She lives above the family bookstore, where she occasionally works. ~! She later falls in love with Touko. !~

characters.name: Touko Nanami
characters.description: **Height:** 163 cm (5’4”) A second year high school student, and the busiest member of the student council. She consistently ranks number one with her test scores and grades, and excels in sports as well. Due to this, and her beauty, admirers frequently confess to her - only to be turned down, as the confessions never make her feel anything.

characters.name: Sayaka Saeki
characters.description: Sayaka is [Touko Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/123529/Nanami-Touko)'s best friend from her first year of high school. She is a second-year high school girl and the student council vice president.

characters.name: Koyomi Kanou
characters.description: Yuu's classmate and friend from middle school. She wants to become a writer.

characters.name: Seiji Maki
characters.description: Maki is a first-year high school boy and a member of the student council. He grew up surrounded by two older sisters and a younger sister, so he finds it easy to talk with girls.

characters.name: Akari Hyuuga
characters.description: Akari is Yuu's classmate and friend from middle school. She is a member of the basketball club.

characters.name: Miyako Kodama
characters.description: Owner of a small café. Riko's girlfriend.

characters.name: Riko Hakozaki
characters.description: A literature teacher and the student council's staff advisor. Miyako's girlfriend.

characters.name: Suguru Doujima
characters.description: Doujima is a first-year high school boy and a member of the student council.

title: Warui ga Watashi wa Yuri ja Nai
title_original: 悪いが私は百合じゃない
description: In an attempt to win her homeroom teacher's heart, Itsumi Toudou purchased a shady love potion, and tested it out on her stuck-up student committee president, Yomotsuka. Now, she has an uncharacteristically affectionate girl to deal with, and she's not even a lesbian! Right? Note: Began serialization in @vitamin on February 3, 2020.

characters.name: Itsumi Toudou
characters.description: An opportunistic and selfish girl whose attempts to drug her teacher with a love potion backfire when she accidentally drugs a female classmate instead.

characters.name: Makoto Yomotsuka
characters.description: Makoto is the class committee president, whom Itsumi initially despised, making her a perfect candidate for Itsumi's first trial of her love potion.

characters.name: Himari Kamisada
characters.description: Himari is introduced as a typical bully towards Itsumi, theoretically making her an excellent test subject for the love potion that Itsumi bought.

characters.name: Ruruka Kouno
characters.description: Itsumi's best friend. She is an otaku, and she is genuinely in love with Itsumi, even without the love potion. She's an even bigger scumbag than Itsumi, and she's not afraid to sell Itsumi out if she thinks she's in trouble; she values self-preservation over love. Cosplaying and dressing up her friends are two of her hobbies.

characters.name: Tsubasa Ookado
characters.description: Tsubasa is the most athletic and most prominent sports personality among the students. Tsubasa also is well-renowned for her princely charm.

characters.name: Rin Hanei
characters.description: Itsumi's kouhai from junior high school. She is a bully who will bring up Itsumi's black history and belittle her whenever she sees her. She has consistently rejected Itsumi's attempts to entice her to consume the love potion. ~!When it was revealed that Rin was a tsundere in love with Itsumi, her status was elevated to that of a cute junior.!~

characters.name: Kurohime Shirashiro
characters.description: She is the only person Itsumi calls by her first name. She enjoys dressing in gothic fashion. Her hobby is manga drawing, which she keeps hidden from others out of shame. ~!She initially has no special feelings for Itsumi, but as the story progresses, she becomes one of the three people who love her without the use of love potions!~

characters.name: Banryuu Sachie
characters.description: The daughter of a yakuza. She doesn't want to go to school, so when Yomotsuka goes to see her to persuade her, she challenges her to a game of cops and robbers. If she loses, she must willingly go to school.

characters.name: Yayoi Yanagi
characters.description: A delinquent who refuses to attend school. She's a scary-looking troublemaker who smokes excessively and constantly breaks school rules.

characters.name: Yuina Iwagaki
characters.description: She considers Himari as her best friend because she stood up for her when she was a sickly child who was bullied. But as Itsumi gets close to Himari, she starts to feel envious. When she attempts to beat Itsumi up, she is tricked by Itsumi's words when she tells her that she loves her. She believes that in order to keep Himari away from Itsumi, she must be the one to do something.

characters.name: Hana Kagaya
characters.description: A girl who is almost like a detective in that she is a source of information and knows everything about the life of any specific person. She appears to be a fortune teller, but her rate of accuracy is terrifying. It's unclear whether she uses the information to pass herself off as a fortune teller or whether she uses her fortune telling to obtain information. She has a sleazy side and will charge a lot of money to make money off of her abilities as a fortune teller.

characters.name: Arare Toudou
characters.description: Itsumi's little sister. She is the polar opposite of Itsumi, Arare is a gifted student who excels in sports and academics and is on the verge of succeeding as a TV celebrity, which is why her parents seem to have neglected Itsumi in favour of herself.

title: Uminekosou days
title_en: Days of Love at Seagull Villa
description: When Mayumi’s fiancé leaves her for another woman, Mayumi impulsively decides to move away and start over again by the seaside. Once there she meets Rin, a tough but kind single mother who runs the housing complex Seagull Villa. While the two women might not have a lot in common, they’re drawn to each other, and the relationship growing between them is deeper than they expected. Sail away on this tale of romance by the sea! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: chapter count includes three 4-koma extra chapters.

characters.name: Mayumi
characters.description: A shy teacher who has arrived from Tokyo. She finds it hard to interact with people, and her only friend betrayed her.

characters.name: Rin
characters.description: She is the cheerful and lively manager of an inn. When she lost her family, she took her niece under her care.

characters.name: Ashima
characters.description: A lonely girl who frequents the Umineko residence.

title: Majo no Tabitabi
title_en: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina
description: Ever since she was a little girl reading books of magic and adventure, Elaina has dreamed of following in the footsteps of her childhood idol, the witch Nique, and living a life of travel. Now a full-fledged witch herself, Elaina sets off on a journey without a destination, wandering far and wide to see the world. With each new place she sees and person she meets, Elaina's world grows a little bit richer. (Source: Square Enix)

characters.name: Elaina
characters.description: On her broom, she flies from country to country with her long, black robes adorning the lengths of her arms and trailing behind her with every weave and turn. Her purple-blue eyes peer out from beneath a black tricorn hat to reveal beautiful and silky ashen hair that flows down her back like clouds flowing through summer skies. On her chest is pinned a star-shaped brooch — signifying her status as a witch. Prior to the main story, she was a sheltered child who was greatly proficient in magic, innocent, and "not knowing what failure is."

characters.name: Saya
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Witch Saya is a character introduced in the [Majo no Tabitabi](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. She is an apprentice witch who [Elaina](https://anilist.co/character/125736/Elaina) meets in the Land of Mages as a novice. Saya has black hair tied back in a small tassel on the left side and blue eyes. She initially wears a charcoal grey outfit, black stockings, and white boots. Saya is a person with a kind personality on the outside, but is slightly manipulative in her thinking as shown when she manipulated Elaina to stay with her for a while. She also has a desire to have company and friends, which mostly stemmed from her younger sister returning back to her homeland without her.

characters.name: Fran
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Witch Fran is a character introduced in the [Wandering Witch](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. She is [Elaina](https://anilist.co/character/125736/Elaina)'s master and a witch. Fran has long black hair, blue eyes, and has a beauty mark underneath her right eye. She wears a midnight-blue hat with a red ribbon coiled around it and a matching color outfit both of which have a stary night pattern in the interior. She also wears beige-colored pants, red earrings, brown boots, and her witch's brooch on her right chest. She's portrayed as an elated and jocular woman. Compared to the other witches in Robetta, she's shown to be a non-judgemental person.

title: Kuzu no Honkai décor
description: As myriad seasons make their rounds, The scars of the past turn to memories. The spin-off serial of the painful and forlorn "distorted love story" has begun! (Source: Anime News Network) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.name: Hanabi Yasuraoka
characters.description: At the beginning of the story she's in love with [Narumi Kanai](https://anilist.co/character/120993/Kanai-Narumi), her childhood friend who is now her teacher. She immediately realizes that Narumi is in love with [Akane Minagawa](https://anilist.co/character/120991/Minagawa-Akane) and not her. She meets [Mugi Awaya](https://anilist.co/character/120990/Awaya-Mugi), who is in love with Akane, and starts a relationship with him to satisfy each other's loneliness. She has different attitudes with each character: she's cheerful with [Sanae Ebato](https://anilist.co/character/120992/Ebato-Sanae), her best friend, timid with Narumi Kanai and sincere with Mugi because she trusts him a lot.

characters.name: Mugi Awaya
characters.description: He falls in love with [Akane Minagawa](https://anilist.co/character/120991/Minagawa-Akane) accepting the fact he has no chance of making her his. He is shown to be emotionless and revealed minimum expression, but as the story goes on, things start to change. He also shows a caring side for the ones close to him. Moka, a childhood friend, has deep feelings for Mugi, but he denies her feelings for him because he knows well he would ruin her.

characters.name: Akane Minagawa
characters.description: Akane Minagawa is a music teacher at Hanabi's school. She hides her true personality with a "mask" at the beginning of the story, but it's clear to see that she is very manipulative and takes pride in hurting others. ~!She is a compulsive cheater who would sleep with anyone to make her feel better about herself. She likes the feeling of being wanted and needed by someone. With that being said, both Mugi and Narumi fall in love with her, she doesn't mind playing with men and toying with their feelings.!~

characters.name: Sanae Ebato
characters.description: Sanae is introduced to the series as the best friend of the main character, Hanabi. She is shown to be a supportive character in the beginning, but when they're alone, she tends to be very possessive. ~!Her ill feelings towards men began when she was almost molested by a man on the train, although saved by Hanabi, leaving her scared. Sanae begins to have romantic feelings towards Hanabi as the story progresses.!~

characters.name: Narumi Kanai
characters.description: Narumi Kanai is amicable and benign. He is also a teacher at Hanabi's school, who he cares deeply about but never views her relationship wise, more like a precious little sister. ~!Narumi appeared to fall in love with Akane, although he knew that she had a hobby of sleeping with other men. He is prepared to cherish her for the rest of his life even if she cheats on him, he just cares about her happiness.!~

characters.name: Noriko Kamomebata
characters.description: Noriko Kamomebata or as she likes to be called, Moka, is shown to be childish and whiney. Her appearance is intended to make her look like a princess who is in need of a "prince". Mugi is her childhood friend who she fell in love with. Although she may be annoying, she seems to care for others and like to see them happy. Her size makes her look younger than she actually is.

title: Android wa Keiken Ninzuu ni Hairimasu ka??
title_original: アンドロイドは経験人数に入りますか？？
title_en: Does it Count if You Lose Your Virginity to an Android?
description: Beautiful, brainy Tsuda Akane is indispensable at the robotics manufacturer where she works, but her colleagues never saw her private side. At home, Akane’s a hot mess with an apartment that looks more like a landfill than a living space. When she drunkenly orders a maid to help her tidy up, the lady android who arrives is a horny hottie who’s about to give Akane more service than she bargained for! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

characters.name: Akane Tsuda
characters.description: An office lady with a friendly and diligent personality. She works for a robotics manufacturer and is a member of the planning team for household robots.

characters.name: Nadeshiko
characters.description: The android that Akane purchased while she was drunk. She has a gentle and naïve personality.

characters.name: Jun Usami
characters.description: Akane's childhood friend.

title: Koushin Koinu ni Koibumi wo
description: The stage is a modern school that fosters female officers, "Girl's Only Army School". A girl, Indou Shinobu, who came out from the countryside, meets Kagami a high-class senior student. Contrary to her high-handed attitude, Kagami occasionally shows kindness to Indou.

title: Kakegurui Twin
description: As a first-year student of the renowned Hyakkaou Private Academy, Mary Saotome knows her future is set for a one-way cruise to the top... That is, until an encounter with an old-classmate-turned-housepet throws the newbie princess into the world of gambling! Can a normal girl like Mary make friends and survive debtless through only wit and luck? Find out in this prequel to the mega-popular Kakegurui! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Mary Saotome
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") Mary Saotome is a deuteragonist of _Kakegurui_, and also the main protagonist of the spin-off series _Kakegurui Twin_. She is a student at Hyakkaou Private Academy, and a classmate of [Yumeko Jabami](https://anilist.co/character/121889) and [Ryota Suzui](https://anilist.co/character/122688) who is the first character in the entire series that challenges Yumeko and loses against her. At first, Mary is shown to be incredibly sadistic and twisted, such as how she treats her classmate Ryota Suzui after he turned into a "housepet", due to his low social status within the academy, and is shown cruelly taunting her fellow opponents during their gambling matches. She's also shown to be extremely egotistical both in and out of matches, often being confident in her victory. Mary also possesses a habit of mocking her opponents and laughing at them, especially when match se

characters.name: Tsuzura Hanatemari
characters.description: In spite of coming from a wealthy family, Tsuzura could not gamble well, and was quickly turned into a housepet. Fortunately, thanks to Mary Saotome, whom she had known since elementary school, she learned about gambling and started believing in herself.

characters.name: Aoi Mibuomi
characters.description: Aoi is the former Student Council Executive. He gets along very well with Runa. He is seen in Kakegurui Twin.

characters.name: Yukimi Togakushi
characters.description: Yukimi is the Literature Club president and a member of the Supernatural Club. Her only appearance is in Kakegurui Twin. She used to own a gambling den, but it attracted practically no guests.

characters.name: Sachiko  Juraku
characters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm Sachiko is the former Vice-president of the Student Council before [Ririka](https://anilist.co/character/122777/Momobami-Ririka) took her place due to an unknown reason. She is the former Public Morals Committee Chairwoman of the Student Council. Sachiko is an extremely sadistic person with no empathy for others. It is her pleasure to hurt people both physically and mentally to the point of completely breaking their identity as humans, which is the reason why she keeps [Mikura](https://anilist.co/character/198341/Sado-Mikura) on a leash for the most part.

characters.name: Mikura Sado
characters.description: Before Mikura became a pet, she had bullied other students at the academy. After playing against Sachiko several times and losing, she realized that she did not want to bully others, but that she always wanted to experience that feeling herself.

characters.name: Kokoro Aiura
characters.description: Kokoro Aiura is a minor antagonist in Kakegurui Twin. She is a first-year student, and a classmate of Tsuzura Hanatemari, and Mary Saotome, being the first person to challenge Mary for a gambling match after her transfer.

characters.name: Chitose Inui
characters.description: Chitose Inui is a minor character in Kakegurui Twin. She is introduced during the Coupling Party event that Mary Saotome, and her friends attend, joining her group.

characters.name: Kurumi Kurume
characters.description: Kurumi Kurume is a supporting character in Kakegurui Twin. She is a member of Full-Bloom, but she is often acting on her own and she seems to anticipate a gamble between Mary Saotome and Aoi Mibuomi, although her true motives are unclear.

title: Happy!
description: One day the Yakuza comes knocking on the door of the orphaned Umino siblings. The oldest brother has gone into hiding after acquiring a huge debt. Afraid for her brother, Miyuki agrees to take responsibility for the loan. The yakuza wants her to become a ho, Miyuki wants to be a tennis pro. Turns out she used to be a very promising player before her parents died. However, becoming a pro is difficult when friends are few and everybody else conspires to make Miyuki's life hell. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Miyuki Umino
characters.description: The heroine of the story, Miyuki is a tennis prodigy, capable of beating one of the top tennis players in Japan even while when out of practice. She has a pure heart and is devoted to her family above all else, but her desperation and the schemes of those around her quickly give her a terrible reputation as a "bad girl of tennis". (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kaku Okiku
characters.description: A promising young tennis star who is Miyuki's first opponent and becomes a fervent advocate of the prodigy after losing to her. ~!Kaku is a lesbian who is at least somewhat in love with Miyuki and this is used to spread malicious rumours that Miyuki has seduced Kaku.!~

characters.name: Junji Sakurada
characters.description: The Yakuza debt collector who shadows Miyuki and her career was himself once an aspiring athlete and is alternately threatening, supportive and discouraging. He hopes Umino can succeed and drags his feet when his superiors pressure him not to give her a chance, but he regularly points out the almost certain futility of what she's doing. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Chouko Ryuugasaki
characters.description: Heiress to the Ryugasaki family and one of the top female tennis players in Japan. One of the primary antagonists to Miyuki.

characters.name: Keiichirou Ootori
characters.description: The son of one of the grande dames of Japanese tennis, he went to school with Miyuki and she turns to him for assistance getting her tennis career started. He is thoroughly under the thumb of his tyrannical mother however and this limits the assistance he will give her. He is a good tennis player but his mother decides he lacks the potential to be the best and forbids him to pursue a professional career in tennis.

characters.name: Thunder Ushiyama
characters.description: Miyuki's rather lecherous tennis coach. He used to train big-name tennis players but was banned from the sport for life when he was accused of rigging a game. Nonetheless, he is apparently an exceptional coach and was personally hired by Madame Ohtori to coach Miyuki.

characters.name: Alan Carrington
characters.description: Wendy Palmer's coach. He and Thunder Ushiyama have known each other since childhood.

characters.name: Wendy Palmer
characters.description: She's an american tennis player born in Pasadena, California and coached by Alan Carrington.

title: Majo ga Koisuru 5-byoumae
title_en: 5 Seconds Before a Witch Falls in Love
description: Solitary witch Meg likes to be mischievous and make trouble in the forest for her nemesis, Lilith the Witch Hunter. But when an altercation goes sideways, and Meg turns Lilith into a cat, a cascade of unfortunate events means witch is now responsible for saving witch-hunter! Sparks were flying between these antagonistic ladies before–what will their relationship be like after this cat-astrophe? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes one-shot: Demons Harem and one extra chapter .

characters.name: Meg
characters.description: A witch nicknamed as "The Untouchable Sorceress". She's solitary, and likes to be mischievous and make trouble in the forest for Lilith.

characters.name: Lilith
characters.description: A top-class Witch Hunter.

characters.name: Samael
characters.description: She is a fallen angel.

characters.name: Belphegor
characters.description: She is a demon

title: Akuma no Riddle
title_en: Akuma no Riddle: Riddle Story of Devil
description: At Myojo Private School, an elite all-girls boarding academy, the Class Black is comprised of thirteen students, twelve of whom are assassins. Their prey is the thirteenth student, Haru Ichinose, an upbeat girl who vows to survive school and graduate unharmed! Enter Tokaku Azuma, a cold-blooded killer who transfers from another school to kill Haru. What should have been a routine hit turns into a far more complicated affair as Tokaku is unable to pull the trigger on Haru. As Tokaku copes with her budding feelings, will she decide to protect Haru's life from the other assassins or to end it before they do? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Haru Ichinose
characters.description: __Height:__ 159cm (5'2") Haru is shown to be a bright and cheerful girl of Black Class. As claimed by Tokaku, Haru poses a naive character and trusts anyone without a single thought. She is shown to have a highly optimistic attitude, which is sometimes bothersome for Tokaku since she is not used to friendliness. All in all, Haru's rival classmates appreciate her gullible nature; deeming her as an easy target. She is very forgiving and doesn't mind anyone for bearing any kind of grudge towards her as seen when she still talks in a caring and friendly manner towards every other girl who loses their purpose after chasing her with killing intents. ~!Like the other women of her clan, Haru possesses the "Queen Bee" power of manipulating others to protect her and let her live the position of highest hierarchy; making others be simply a "worker bee". Haru inhibits and implies this power without

characters.name: Tokaku Azuma
characters.description: __Birthday:__ March 3 __Height:__ 170cm (5'6") Tokaku is a distant and cold girl. Even at first glance, she has the appearance of an assassin.She eventually grows to care for Haru in time, even coming to the point of calling herself Haru's protector. Azuma dislikes it when other people try to get close to her, and she especially hates being called by her first name, but Haru compromises and calls her "Tokaku-san". She is skilled with using knives, and has exceptionally quick reflexes. It is soon revealed that Azuma has never killed anyone before, despite possessing very useful skills as an assassin. Her family is a well known family of assassins. They say that the east's Azuma and the west's Kuzunoha are two assassination clans that existed in the country since ancient times. The Kuzunoha was the main branch and the Azuma is a branch family. However, interactions between these two clans

characters.name: Mahiru Banba
characters.description: A rather shy and mysterious-looking young woman who's a former assassin who's developed a second personality at some point in her past named Shin'ya Banba who's a quite more rude and violent personality than the actual Mahiru. Both are like two souls who share the same body, thus both never appear at the same moment throughout the plot, yet both are able to communicate with each other to a certain degree. Mahiru is a shy and timid girl who often has trouble speaking for herself. She is easily subject to bullying, and is often defenseless. However, when the sun sets, Mahiru's alternate personality, Shin'ya Banba, appears. Shin'ya is the complete opposite of Mahiru, and refers to herself (or even himself) as "ore (俺)", a masculine term. In contrast to her host personality, Shin'ya has an aggressive and borderline insane appearance cultivated to protect Mahiru. Shin'ya is able to enter a te

characters.name: Sumireko Hanabusa
characters.description: Sumireko is a high class, polite girl. She's considerably warmer to people than [Tokaku](https://anilist.co/character/86241/Azuma-Tokaku) is, but she's hinted to be one of the more dangerous members of Class Black.

characters.name: Nio Hashiri
characters.description: Hashiri Nio is an energetic and upbeat girl with a knack for peeping into other people's businesses. Despite being a part of the Black Class group, she is also affiliated with the academy in some way.

characters.name: Isuke Inukai
characters.description: Isuke is a truly sadistic girl who is always shown to be with clothing that show her stomach. She is also very blunt and quick to express her opinion, and likes to command other people, such as making [Haruki](https://anilist.co/character/88212/Sagae-Haruki) call her "Isuke-sama". Isuke's family includes her gay parents, who aren't related to her by blood at all.

characters.name: Kouko Kaminaga
characters.description: A girl with glasses who insists of being the 'rep' of everything, such as Black Class' class representative. She is shown to use grenades as a weapon.

characters.name: Shiena Kenmochi
characters.description: Shiena seems to have a normal personality compared to the rest of the members of Class Black. Although she is somewhat scatterbrained and forgetful, she is also strict at times, as shown when directing the play in Episode 5. She says she will do anything to protect the place she belongs to. Shiena is skilled at analysis, as seen when she is able to gather information about Hitsugi and Chitaru by simply watching them during rehearsals for the class play. She is also a skilled hacker as seen in the final episode where she successfully hacks into Myojo Academy's system. When she was younger she got bullied a lot. She had one friend whom she talked to on the phone called Yukarin, but one day she asked Shiena if she wanted revenge on the people who bullied her. Yukarin told Shiena about the group called Collective Dismissal and that they will give her her 'vengeance'. Shiena asks what they wa

characters.name: Hitsugi Kirigaya
characters.description: Kirigaya Hitsugi is a girl who has the body of an elementary school student. She has a bad sense of direction, as demonstrated when she gets lost on her way to Myoujou Academy. Although Hitsugi looks like the horribly unreliable type, she also has her reasons for being in the Black Group. She is also quite attached to Chitaru, as she is a nice and caring person.

characters.name: Ataru Mizorogi
characters.description: He is the homeroom teacher of Haru and Azuma for the Black Class. Ataru is a young and friendly teacher wanting his students to think of him as a big brother.

characters.name: Chitaru  Namatame
characters.description: Chitaru is a kind and caring girl who really looks out for others, especially those that appear to be heavily dependent (such as Hitsugi and Haru). She states early on that she has no plans to target Haru whatsoever. She appears to be quite attached to Hitsugi, but mainly in a motherly way.

title: Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e.
description: Hinase falls into an identity crisis when their coming of age clashes with societal expectations in this unique teen drama! In this world, people are born without a gender. Their bodies shift toward their desired gender when they reach twelve years old. Until Hinase's eighteenth spring, they lived content without a gender. But the bubbly girl Ritsu and thoughtful boy Shiori pull Hinase in opposite directions when they both confess their feelings on the same day! Romance was never on Hinase's mind, so how can they respond? Hinase may be forced to choose a new identity as they arrive at the cusp of adulthood. Who will they choose, and who will they become? (Source: Square Enix) Note: Twentieth place of the 6th Next Manga Award in the Web Manga Category in 2020.

title: Hayama-sensei to Terano-sensei wa Tsukiatteiru
title_original: 羽山先生と寺野先生は付き合っている
description: Hayama-sensei and Terano-sensei are two women who work at the same school…and just started going out. They’re a little shy about their budding relationship, but their co-workers–and even their students–are rooting for them as they bumble their way through love! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Asuka Hayama
characters.description: Hayama-sensei is a health and physical education teacher. Her normal personality can be a bit formal and stiff, but around Terano-sensei she is softer.

characters.name: Saki Terano
characters.description: Terano-sensei is a biology teacher. She is often mistaken for a student due to her small physique. Terano-sensei is beloved by her students and fellow teachers for her soft and kind personality.

characters.name: Rui Bandou
characters.description: Bandou-sensei is a Japanese teacher and a mutual friend of Hayama-sensei and Terano-sensei. She loves yuri romance and is a vocal supporter of Hayama-sensei and Terano-sensei's budding relationship. Bandou-sensei can frequently be found with Miyazawa-sensei.

characters.name: Elena Miyazawa
characters.description: Miyazawa-sensei is an English teacher and a mutual friend of Hayama-sensei and Terano-sensei. Miyazawa-sensei can often be found with Bandou-sensei. She often goes heavy on the teasing, but is also a supporter of Hayama-sensei and Terano-sensei's relationship.

title: King's Maker: Triple Crown
description: The King is back. With the defeat of his father, Wolfgang Goldenleonard has achieved all that he's sought -- the love of Shin Soo-Hyuk, the power of the throne, and vengeance over the kingdom's tyrannical ruler. But, Soo-Hyuk, a "possession" of the former king, views their rocky relationship as one of war trophy and victor, despite Wolfgang showering him with affection. As uncertainty grows in the royal courts, forces beyond their control are preparing a second coup d'etat. Will these two be able to keep a grasp on the throne and on each other? The saga of King's Maker continues in this official second season of the hit BL series! (Source: Tappytoon) Note: Includes three extra chapters.

characters.name: Randolph Goldenleonard
characters.description: Randolph is one of the many sons not recognized by the previous king.

title: Sakura Trick
description: Yuu and Haruka were inseparable during junior high but a cruel twist of fate put them on opposite sides of the class when entering senior high. Forced to spend more time with their other classmates, they decide to do something to keep their relationship special. A comedy 4koma. (Source: YuriProject)

characters.name: Haruka Takayama
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm Haruka is a student at Misato West High School and [Yuu's](https://anilist.co/character/86387/Yuu-Sonoda) best friend. Haruka also has a tendency to become jealous, especially when it comes to Yuu.

characters.name: Yuu Sonoda
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm Yuu is a student at Misato West High School and [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/86385/Haruka-Takayama)'s best friend. She tends to slack off at school. Her older sister is [Mitsuki](https://anilist.co/character/87710/Mitsuki-Sonoda).

characters.name: Kotone Noda
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Kotone is a student at Misato West High School and comes from a rich family. She gave [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/86385/Haruka-Takayama) the nickname "Harupoppo".

characters.name: Shizuku Minami
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Shizuku is a shy student at Misato West High School, who currently lives together with [Kotone](https://anilist.co/character/87706/Kotone-Noda).

characters.name: Kaede Ikeno
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Kaede is a student at Misato West High School, and also the class president. Her best friend is [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/87709/Yuzu-Iizuka). ~!Later in the manga it’s confirmed that Kaede has feelings for Yuzu.!~

characters.name: Yuzu Iizuka
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Yuzu is a student at Misato West High School. She goes to school on her moped. Her best friend is [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/87708/Kaede-Ikeno).

characters.name: Mitsuki Sonoda
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Mitsuki is a 3rd year student at Misato West High School and also the student council president. Her younger sister is [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/86387/Yuu-Sonoda).

characters.name: Sumi Otokawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 145 cm Sumi is a student at Misato West High School and a member of the student council.

characters.name: Rina Sakai
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Rina is a 3rd year student at Misato West High School and also the student council vice president.

title: Hana to Hoshi
description: Hanai is a junior higher and the best at table tennis. She's never lost, and she's won many tournaments, but after some freshman she's never heard of beats her like it was nothing, she starts losing every game after that and she can't get rid of that feeling of defeat. Now it's her first day of high school and she's decided to quit table tennis and live an ordinary high school life, but on the first day, she runs into the very girl that first defeated her. It turns out that she's also quit table tennis, but this girl always has a cold expression on her face and Hanai can't help but feel that this girl is always looking down on her and trying to mess up her perfect high school life. One day the girl falls asleep in class, and Hanai reaches over to wake her up. As she does so, the girl, still half asleep, looks up at her with a smile and almost kisses her. The girl later tells Hanai that she was having a dream about her, but Hanai coldly brushes it off thinking she's just messing with her and walks away - as the girl behind her looks down while blushing... Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

title: Ookami no Kawa wo Kabutta Hitsujihime
title_original: 狼の皮をかぶった羊姫
description: Aki Rikujo, a Wolfa, works as a butler at the royal castle in the land of Sheepa. Her quiet and peaceful days get shaken up when she saves the life of Princess Momo Shiudafaris. The shy sheep princess immediately latches onto Aki who, before she knows it, becomes the princess’s private tutor. Momo wants more than just math lessons from Aki, and even sneaks into the wolf-woman’s bedroom to seduce her! Aki soon realizes that, under the timid woolly exterior, Momo is a wild animal! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Aki Rokujou
characters.description: The responsible and serious wolf-woman who's working as a butler in the Land of the Sheep. She's appointed as the Third Princess's private tutor.

characters.name: Momo Siaudafares
characters.description: The third sheep Princess in the country of sheep. She's nicknamed as the "Ice Princess" by her maids because she rarely laughs or talks. She particularly never leaves her room, only her exclusive maids enter her room.

characters.name: Bluebell
characters.description: Momo's exclusive maid.

characters.name: Maribronde Siudafares
characters.original: マリベロンで＝シウダファレス
characters.description: Momo's mother.

characters.name: Kunya Lala
characters.description: The first princess of the Hyena kingdom.

title: Juingongi Villain-im
description: "Why did I turn into a character from an adult game?" The time has come now to take action! Lucius the loser character has transformed into a villain overnight. With his new found vengeance, Lucius will set out to enjoy the action packed, harem fantasy adventure!! (Source: TOPTOON+) Note: Includes four extra chapters.

characters.name: Eve Peta
characters.description: She is said to be as strong as the Demon King.

characters.name: Erina Ahildern
characters.description: She's the Princess of Ahildern.

characters.name: Elsie
characters.description: Werecat of the Marimba Clan.

characters.name: Eiei
characters.description: ~!He later gets turned into a woman by drinking The Forbidden Medicine!~

characters.name: Sonya Yaiban
characters.description: Exiled Magician.

characters.name: Karin Belix
characters.description: Dungeon Raid Party Member.

title: Ikemen Sugi desu Shiki Senpai!
title_original: イケメンすぎです紫葵先パイ！
title_en: The Girl I Want is so Handsome
description: When Hinami bumps into an older girl named Shiki, she falls head over heels. Shiki is sexy, easygoing, and has an amazing undercut. In order to get closer to Shiki, Hinami starts lurking around the basketball club. But though Hinami's crush is obvious to everyone else, it goes right over Shiki's head. When Hinami tries to confess her feelings to Shiki, Shiki thinks Hinami wants to become the club manager! Can Hinami get Shiki to understand her true feelings? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title: Shokei Shoujo no Virgin Road
title_en: The Executioner and Her Way of Life
description: The Lost Ones are strangers from another world, hailing from a place no one has ever heard of called “Japan.” These wanderers have been associated with catastrophes since many years ago and the solemn duty of exterminating them without remorse falls to Menou, a young Executioner. But when her mission is complicated by a Japanese girl named Akari who refuses to die, Menou embarks on a peculiar journey to find something that can slay even an immortal who insists on traveling with her would-be-killer! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Akari Tokitou
characters.description: The Lost One. She is affectionate and easy-going. Menou is unable to kill her because of her ability even though she is not aware of it herself. She begins her journey with Menou, without knowing her true intentions.

characters.name: Menou
characters.description: The Executioner. A young executioner girl who has exceptional magical talent. She is strongly dedicated to her mission and tries to finish off [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/161696) before her power gets out of hand. She gets close to her targets with friendly manner to grasp their ability before killing them. Her main weapons are short blade and sacred scripture.

characters.name: Momo
characters.description: Apprentice priestess working under [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou). She is deeply attached to Menou but has near zero religious faith. She is good at fighting with a fretsaw, but has poor skill with scripture magic.

characters.name: Ashuna Grizarica
characters.original: アーシュナ・グリザリカ
characters.description: Traveling Princess Knight. Princess of the Grizarica Kingdom, who is strong and beautiful. People call her the "Princess Knight" and she carries a sword with the royal crest as she always is ready for a fight.

characters.name: Mitsuki
characters.description: He was summoned from another world with the ability "nothingness" and was immediately thrown out of the castle. He wandered around aimlessly until he met [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou)

characters.name: Flare
characters.description: Skilled priest and executioner, who has killed the most Lost Ones from other worlds. She is [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou)'s mentor and Menou is considered her successor.

characters.name: Orwell
characters.description: The Archbishop. She is trusted by many people and has the greatest skill in magic of her era. She offers [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou) help in killing [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/161696/Akari-Tokitou) because in the central cathedral she controls a chamber that can contain and even kill otherworldly pure concepts.

characters.name: Manon Libelle
characters.description: Representative of the Libelle Family Head. Sole daughter of Count Libelle, who acts as the representative of the family after the Count fell ill. She is always dressed in a kimono and carries herself gracefully.

characters.name: Sicilia
characters.description: Priest of the port city Libelle. She works under Flare and they seem to be acquainted but further details are unclear.

characters.name: Shoujo
characters.description: ~!One of the four Human Errors, demon of the fog Pandemonium which was sealed away. She takes the form of a young girl, but her true body is still inside the fog. She has lost the memories and personality from before she became a Human Error.!~

title: Tada de wa Dakaremasen
title_original: タダでは抱かれません
description: Miyako Kirishima, a university student and aspiring teacher, is a poor girl who enjoys being frugal. One day, she has a meal with Yui Nakano, her friend whom she occasionally tutors. On the way home, Yui invites her to a love hotel. Miyako is reluctant, unwilling to have sex with a friend. However, Yui cuts her off, offering her 30000 yen for sex! Subsequently, Miyako ends up in more "transactions" with her other friends at her women's university!? The curtain rises on a tale of yuri, friendship, money, and sex♡. Note: Includes 9 extra chapters.

characters.name: Miyako Kirishima
characters.description: A university student and aspiring teacher, is a poor girl who enjoys being frugal.

characters.name: Yui Nakano
characters.description: The founder of "Nakano's Club" and Miyako's supporter. Has many friends with benefits.

characters.name: Mizuki Sayama
characters.description: A quiet and introverted let's player.

characters.name: Hina Asakura
characters.description: An otaku girl who loves VTubers.

characters.name: Chinatsu Matsushima
characters.description: The subject of Miyako's admiration, having helped her with studies since they were young.

characters.name: Kaoru Doumyou
characters.description: Ace of the press team. Has exposed various scandals.

characters.name: Emi Tonami
characters.description: A first year part of the swimming club. Gets horny when she sees swimsuits.

characters.name: Kyouko Iguchi
characters.description: She works at the Aisa stationary sales department.

characters.name: Rina Tachibana
characters.description: A first year university student and model.

characters.name: Juli Kakei
characters.description: Nakano's Club's number one showoff. Got her skin tanned at a salon.

characters.name: Akane Ootaka
characters.description: A super popular 4th year student, having won the miss beauty contest 4 years straight.

characters.name: Kyouka Hoshimiya
characters.description: A rich young lady from the house of a famous designer. Keeps her maids as pets.

title: K-On! highschool
description: As the only member of the pop music club not to graduate, the responsibility of recruiting new members has fallen to Azusa. Ui and Jun have agreed to help out their friend, but they might be more interested in having actual afterschool teatime than making music.
