She's fast and jumpy, likes to hide up in trees, and seems to disappear or appear all of a sudden in front of the group to bring them news of any of Taishakuten's armies who are on their trails. ~!It's revealed that she and Kendappa-ou are in love with each other.!~ ~!Souma is killed by Kendappa-ou. Kendappa-ou believed that Souma could not w

characters.name: Ashura-ou
characters.description: Ashura-ō is first introduced as the god of war and guardian of Heaven under the former Emperor, who died defending his lord against Taishakuten and is revered as a hero. However, it turns out at the end of the manga that he had, in fact, engineered Taishakuten's rebellion himself: Knowing through Kuy-oh's prophecy and his own visions of his future son's true nature as the "true Ashura", he nonetheless wished for his son to be born. To change destiny and prevent Ashura's awakening, he asked for Taishakuten's help, which Taishakuten promised in return for his body. Ashura-ō married Shashi so she, one of the priestesses bearing one of Ashura's seals on her forehead, would be his mother, whom Ashura presumably would not wish to kill. He had Taishakuten seize the throne and rule cruelly, to prevent the Six Stars from gathering. As a last safeguard, shou

characters.name: Taishaku-ten
characters.description: Taishaku-ten is the villain in the manga RG Veda. A strong-minded man and a fearsome warrior who gained the title of "thunder god". ~!He is in love with King Ashura and "will do anything to get what he wants." Therefore, Taishaku-ten made a deal with him: he could have the King Ashura, but had to fulfill his wish of preventing Ashura's son from becoming a God of Destruction. This leads to the painful act of him eating King Ashura later, as King Ashura himself said this is the only way for him to have strength to rebel against the Emperor. Taishaku-ten then successfully killed the Emperor and got the title himself, becoming a tyrant just to fulfill one wish of the man he loved. According to Taishaku-ten, living alone without your loved one is extremely painful, as he had always suffered being without Ashura-Ou.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shashi
characters.description: In the very beginning, Shashi was only a miko for Ashura-ou (along with her sister Kara), but well, it seems like being a miko for the great warlord wasn't good enough. So later she got married to Ashura-ou and became his wife. But it still wasn't good enough for her, so during the Holy War, she helped Taishakuten in his rebellion by telling Taishakuten all the secrets of the Ashura clan so he could win. She betrayed Ashura-ou and his whole clan, which was why they all got wiped out. She became Taishakuten's wife, "Empress" Shashi. Shashi gave birth to twins, one being Taishakuten's son and the other being a child of the Ashura clan (Ashura-ou's child). So she tries to kill her own child (Ashura) with her own hands. (source: Nishi's RG Veda Gallery)

characters.name: Ten-ou
characters.description: Ten-ou is the son of Taishakuten and Shashi, and little Ashura's twin brother. He is in love with Kendappa-ou. (Source: Nishi's RG Veda Gallery)

characters.name: Aizenmyo-ou
characters.description: She is a little princess whose clan was also killed in the Holy War, and she got possessed by a demon and has been living in her ice castle for 300 years. In the manga, she captures Yasha for power, and at the end, Kujaku kills her. In the anime, she captures Yasha because she was lonely and wanted a companion, and Ashura kills her. (source: Nishi's RG Veda Gallery)

title: Ouji-sama Nante Iranai
title_original: 王子さまなんていらない
description: Yukino is a new student enrolled in Douwa all-girls high. But this high school isn't a regular one since it's split into two divisions: Botan and Shakuyaku. The students from Botan and Shaku-Yaku are competing with each other in order to maintain their elite status. Because of some circumstances, Yukino, who is a student of Shakuyaku, will meet Nobara, a girl from Botan. Both Yukino and Nobara are caught up in the competition between these two divisions and will play a key role in this rivalry.

characters.name: Nobara Himezaki
characters.description: Botan student.

characters.name: Yukino Suzushiro
characters.description: Shayukaku student.

characters.name: Alice Kinoshita
characters.description: Botan student.

characters.name: Kokoro Okisaki
characters.description: Shakuyaku student.

characters.name: Kaguya Tsukimori
characters.description: Botan student.

characters.name: Maika Ookami
characters.description: Shakuyaku student.

characters.name: Mashiro Toyama
characters.description: Botan student.

characters.name: Reira Haizono
characters.description: Shakuyaku student.

characters.name: Raiha Akai
characters.description: Botan student.

title: Haru to Midori
description: Midori isn't good with people, and at 31 years old, she feels like she has no place in life. One day, she attends the funeral of a close friend of hers from junior high school, Tsugumi. Unable to forget about her, she has a vision of the young friend she knew standing above her — only it isn't the girl she once knew, but her daughter, Haruko. This is the story of the relationship between a woman without a place and a child without a mother. Note: Chapter count includes the bonus chapters "Haru and Midori Special 1" and "Haru and Midori Special 2."

title: Utsushicha Dame na Kao
description: The place is Shinjuku. A small bar in a corner of the city, where the night begins and ends. A young actress and a cabaret girl meet. At a bar where they can enjoy an anonymous one-night stand, where no man is allowed to enter, and what happens inside are kept within... (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

characters.name: Io
characters.description: A young up-and-coming actress with a secret masochistic side.

characters.name: Misa
characters.description: An incredibly popular cabaret girl, she grew up in Shinjuku's night life district and has never lived anywhere else.

characters.name: Hase
characters.description: Io's manager.

title: Mawangui Gobaek
description: What happens if you end up summoning the Dark Lord, the whole continent’s greatest enemy? Due to a battle that took place over a thousand years ago, cursed people become demon-like magicians, and those who are blessed become holy knights who protect the kingdom. Lapis, who hides her identity of being a magician and aspires to be a holy knight, accidentally ends up summoning the Dark Lord. Along with the Dark Lord’s puzzling confession, Lapis’ journey of becoming a holy knight begins! (Source: WEBTOON)

characters.name: Lapis
characters.description: A magician who hides her identity and infiltrates the Area Academy as an apprentice knight.

characters.name: Calla
characters.description: The Dark Lord who was accidentally released from her seal by Lapis and unintentionally confessed to by the latter.

title: Koharu to Minato: Watashi no Partner wa Onna no Ko
title_original: 小春と湊 わたしのパートナーは女の子
title_en: Koharu and Minato: Happy Life with My Girlfriend
description: Koharu and Minato are two women who met online. Despite there being a ten-year age gap between them, the two fall hard and fast. Before long, they decide to load up the moving van and move in together! Relationships aren’t always easy, but Minato and Koharu find a way to work things out. Whether it’s having a celebratory feast, taking a late-night stroll, or just enjoying their domestic bliss, the two make every minute together count! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: JK-chan to Tomodachi no Okan
description: Nakashima Yuka falls in love with her male classmate Toi Takuya's mother, Mihoko. Gay hilarity ensues.

characters.name: Mihoko Toi
characters.description: A mature and pretty, but also clumsy mother. As well as a cafe owner

characters.name: Yuka Nakashima
characters.description: High school senior. Known among classmates as the "cool beauty". Only ever loved older women since childhood.

characters.name: Takuya Toi
characters.description: Fairly popular since he's in the table tennis club.

title: Kyou, Koshiba Aoi ni Aetara.
title_original: 今日、小柴葵に会えたら。
description: Sahoko had lots of friends in high school, so there’s no shortage of people to catch up with at her reunion. But the one face she wants to see is missing: that of Aoi Koshiba, her classmate and first love. A star of the basketball team, Aoi caught Sahoko’s eye as an easy way to score social points. But when Aoi quits the team, an unexpected kiss pulls Sahoko closer to her than she intended to be. With a difficult home situation, Aoi is in need of more than just a cynical social climber. She needs a true friend, and something more… (Source: Kodansha USA) Note: Chapter count includes Chapter 0.

title: 7-kakan Gentei Kanojo
description: Party Gal x Serious Honors Student A yuri love comedy. Limited time only!? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

characters.name: Manatsu Akira
characters.description: __Height:__ 163cm

characters.name: Nagi Sumie
characters.description: __Height:__ 159cm

title: Shouraiteki ni Shindekure
description: A girl tries to "buy" her female classmate with money.

title: Jigojisun
description: "I... got a boner" is what Ji-Hyun blurts out the first time he lays eyes on Yo-Han's handsome face... It's easy to get laid when you're a pretty, sassy bartender working at a popular gay bar. This lifestyle suits Ji-Hyun just fine since he loves casual hookups without any intimacy… That is until he meets Yo-Han—his big, scary-looking classmate who's actually a pure-hearted sweetie. Can Yo-Han's simple love help commitment-phobic Ji-Hyun heal from the traumas of his past? (Source: Tapas)

characters.name: Yosef Han
characters.description: He's the older brother of Yo-Han Han.

characters.name: Dae-Sik Park
characters.description: He's majoring in education and is a classmate of Yo-Han and Ji-Hyun.

title: Opium
description: 1946 Choseon (Korea). Beautiful and brilliant Dr. Maria Arden returns to the country of her birth as the medical advisor to the U.S. Army—a stranger in an unfamiliar land ravaged by wars and corruption. There, she meets Dr. Kyeongju Lee, an alluring, mysterious woman shunned by society. Their innocent flirtations turn into a heated, forbidden love affair, as an illegal trade in opium threatens Choseon’s fragile stability. Two outsiders drawn helplessly to each other, but… everything was a lie. (Source: Tapas)

title: Kageki Shoujo!
description: Like the Takarazuka Revue, the young women who go to the arts academy Kouka Kageki High School play all the parts of musical theater, be they female or male. Narada Ai is a jaded former idol performing female roles—her roommate, playing male roles, is bright-eyed country girl Watanabe Sarasa. From the school to the stage to the rest of their lives, there is no challenge these young women can’t face with their passion for performance. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) The series was renamed to Kageki Shoujo!! Season Zero (かげきしょうじょ!! シーズンゼロ) in 2019.

characters.name: Sarasa Watanabe
characters.description: __Height:__ 5'10" She is a Kouka actress-aspirant at the Kouka School who stands out of the rest of the Centennial Class and the entire school, and not just because of her bubbly demeanor and being the tallest student in the school.

characters.name: Ai Narata
characters.description: A former idol expelled from her group because of her trust issues with men, she applied at the Kouka School to escape her past and men in particular. She finds Sarasa, her classmate and dorm-mate, to be annoying at first.

characters.name: Kaoru Hoshino
characters.description: She is the daughter of a second-generation Kouka actress and is in the same class as Sarasa and Ai.

characters.name: Sawa Sugimoto
characters.description: Being a huge Kouka fan, she enrolls at the Kouka School, skipping her chance to become a prima ballerina. She is the class representative of the Centennial Class.

characters.name: Sei Satomi
characters.description: The top star of the Kouka Winter Troupe, who is friends with Ai and Sarasa.

characters.name: Chika Sawada
characters.description: She is one half of the Sawada Twins. Inspired by a bunny lady twins they saw on a Kouka performance, she auditioned for the Kouka school with her twin sister, but delayed her admission when her other twin did not make it, which became a flashpoint in their relationship with each other.

characters.name: Ayako Yamada
characters.description: Timid, shy, and plagued with problems concerning her weight, she almost quit the school due to the pressure; but, despite being underrated, she is one of the most talented performers in the Centennial Class.

characters.name: Chiaki Sawada
characters.description: She is the more chipper half of the Sawada Twins. Inspired by a bunny lady twins they saw on a Kouka performance, she auditioned for the Kouka school with her twin sister, but because she did not make it on the first try at auditioning for the school, her sister had to delay her admission, which became a flashpoint in their relationship with each other.

characters.name: Taichi Narata
characters.description: Ai's uncle and the only male she trusts. He is an instructor at the Kouka School.

characters.name: Mamoru Andou
characters.description: He is known to Kouka school alumni and theater fans as "The Phantom" for his portrayal in The Phantom of the Opera. He is currently retired from acting after an accident during a performance, and is now an instructor at the Kouka School.

characters.name: Hijiri Nojima
characters.description: One of the second-year students, and is Ai's student-advisor. She would sometimes bully Sarasa a bit, but she is, in her own way, dedicated to guiding Ai.

characters.name: Risa Nakayama
characters.description: The second-year student who is Sarasa's student-advisor. She would stand for her ward whenever Hijiri becomes a bit malicious with her.

title: Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya 2wei!
title_original: Fate/kaleid liner プリズマ☆イリヤ ツヴァイ!
description: About a month after the events of the first manga, a new mission to normalize the Earth's pulsations come up. However, when Ilya tries to subdue the pulsations... Note: Includes an interlude and six extra chapters.

characters.name: Rin Toosaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 124 cm (Fate/Zero), 159 cm (Fate/stay night) Rin is a model student and idol of [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s school. She barely talks to other students in her school and exhibits a desire to be left alone, as exemplified by her tendency to stay on the school's rooftop, away from the rest of the students. She is also secretly a Magus and a Master in the Fifth Holy Grail War. In the beginning of the anime, she summons [Archer](https://anilist.co/character/2087) for her Servant, although she originally wanted to summon Saber. Rin is reared as the successor to her family's magecraft, instructed by her father, [Tokiomi Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017), to prioritize sorcery over her own interests. After her father is killed, Rin continues to perfect her sorcery, with some guidance from her guardian, [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506). Sh

characters.name: Illyasviel von Einzbern
characters.original: イリヤスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: **Height:** 133 cm **Birthday in [Fate/kaleid](https://anilist.co/manga/33526/): **Jul 20 A young Teutonic aristocrat, she traveled to Japan to participate in the Holy Grail War as a Master. Illyasviel has an angelic appearance and an unsurpassed degree of magical power. She lives in a castle on the outskirts of Fuyuki City, accompanied only by her Servant and two maids. Illyasviel asks those she feels comfortable around to simply call her "Illya".

characters.name: Luviagelita Edelfelt
characters.original: ルヴィアゼリッタ・エーデルフェルト
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Daughter of the distinguished lineage of magi of the Edelfelt, Luvia is their young and talented family head. A student in Clock Tower, the Mage's Association academy, she is one of the candidates for the position of student's president for the current academic term. As long as [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin) is not nearby, Luvia's attitude is always graceful, never blaspheming and with a beauty similar to a swan. Of course, that is just a facade and she is actually very competitive and suffers with perfectionist tendencies. Luvia has long golden blonde hair styled entirely in large coils. She physically resembles Rin somewhat, furthering speculation that the younger Edelfelt sister from the Third Holy Grail War may have married into the Tohsaka family. She is from Finland.

characters.name: Miyu Edelfelt
characters.original: 美遊・エーデルフェルト
characters.description: __Height:__ 134 cm A young girl who serves under Luvia as a magical girl. Her origin is unknown, except that she has a brother who looks similar to Shirou, and she takes on the Edelfelt name after being taken in by Luvia. She lives in Luvia's mansion and acts as her maid to earn her keep. She uses Ruby's sister Kaleidostick, Sapphire, in order to transform, and she initially has a much better understanding of her abilities than Illya. She takes her role very seriously and treats Illya as a bothersome rival, though they eventually become close friends.

characters.name: Chloe von Einzbern
characters.original: クロエ・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: **Height:** 133 cm Kuro, initially referred to as Dark Illya, is a being created from [Illya](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel)'s hidden power and the Archer Class Card. ~!She comes into existence after Illya uses the Class Card in order to save herself, and afterward, she falls unconscious and wakes up to find the card missing and an exact duplicate of herself, with the exception of dark skin and the Archer outfit, in its place. Kuro immediately escapes and makes various attempts on Illya's life, stating that they cannot both freely exist. She is eventually captured and has a seal placed upon her that forces her to share all sensations with Illya, including injuries and pain. Unable to freely fulfill her goal, she attends Illya's school as her cousin, Kuro, though she still holds resentment towards Illya. She is at odds with [Miyu](https://anilist.co/character/21

characters.name: Shirou Emiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm Shirou is the main character of Fate/stay night. He is a serious yet helpful, hardworking, and honest teenager. His hobbies include fixing a variety of broken things, from VCRs to stoves, as well as cooking and cleaning. He is initially confused about the Holy Grail War and attempts to irrationally shield others from danger, including his own Servant, [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497)

characters.name: Sakura Matou
characters.description: __Height:__ 120 cm (Fate/Zero), 156 cm (Fate/stay night) A student in her first year of high school, Sakura is the sister of [Shinji Mato](https://anilist.co/character/501). After [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s father [Kiritsugu](https://anilist.co/character/10010) died, Sakura often visited Shirou's home to help him with his daily chores. She is outwardly shy and timid, but possesses great inner strength. Sakura has a long standing and obvious crush on Shirou Emiya.

characters.name: Taiga Fujimura
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm She is an English teacher at [Shirou's](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou) school, homeroom instructor of Shirou's class and the supervising teacher for the archery dojo. After [Kiritsugu](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu) died, Taiga became Shirou's guardian and has been living with him for several years. Taiga and Shirou are very close, and she regards him as a younger brother. She's initially distrustful of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria), believing that "some strange woman was trying to take Shirou from her" as she put it. She becomes exasperated whenever a new girl appears at Shirou's house, thinking he stashes girls at his house. Taiga always shows up for breakfast and dinner at Shirou's house to have some of [Sakura's](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura) cooking, and always saves some scraps fr

characters.name: Gilgamesh
characters.description: __Height:__ 182 cm Gilgamesh is the King of Uruk, said to have reigned during the Sumer Dynasty in Mesopotamia 5000 years ago. He's the namesake Hero described in the Epic of Gilgamesh, making him the most ancient Hero on which all the others legends were modeled. This grants him the title of King of Heroes and, within his Gates of Babylon, the prototypes of all the Noble Phantasms of the Heroes yet to come. Born from the human Lugalbanda, the King of Uruk, and the goddess Rimat-Ninsun, he was a being so perfect and transcendent to the point that he was two-thirds deity and one-third human. He was the chosen one that would guide humanity on the earth that was slowly abandoning the Age of Gods, but instead he grew up to be a selfish and arrogant despot. His only friend and being he considered his equal was [Enkidu](https://anilist.co/character/60059). __In Fate/Zero:__ ~! Initially summon

characters.name: Kiritsugu Emiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm __Sidearm:__ Thompson contender in conjunction with his Mystic Code Origin Bullets [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s foster father and his savior from the aftermath of the massive Fuyuki fire. During his lifetime, Kiritsugu was disillusioned with becoming a Hero of Justice, a defender of humanity who could save everyone. Although he feels he failed to do so, his efforts were a source of inspiration for Shirou. Prior to his fateful meeting with Shirou, Kiritsugu was notorious as the "Magus Killer," a freelancer who would hunt down heretical magi. Although he was a magus with Magic Circuits and abilities he was considered unorthodox in that he would utilize modern technology and weaponry along with his magecraft to track down and kill magi. Although mentioned and seen in flashbacks in Fate/stay night, Kiritsugu is one of the main protagonists in its prequel Fa

characters.name: Irisviel von Einzbern
characters.original: アイリスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm Irisviel von Einzbern is the partner of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) as well as the intended vessel for the Holy Grail. She is the mother of [Illyasviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel). Like her daughter, Irisviel is a homunculus, an artificial being created by the Einzbern. She was raised to be a puppet with no desires, but found happiness in her existence when she gave birth to Illyasviel. She is married to [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu), the biological father of her daughter.

characters.name: Issei Ryuudou
characters.description: Issei is the Student Body President of Shirō's school, and another close friend of [Shirō](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou). Issei often asks Shirō to fix broken equipment for the Student Body to try and reduce save money on the school's bill. Issei and Shirō often have lunch together in the Student Body's office where they talk about what ever comes to mind. His father is the head priest of Ryūdōji Temple, and his brother was a classmate of [Taiga](https://anilist.co/character/505/Fujimura-Taiga) and [Neko-san](https://anilist.co/character/187774/Hotaruzuka-Otoko). He dislikes [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin) and seems to have some sort of fear of females, although he seems to be unusually at ease around [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria). ~!Issei unknowingly tells Shirō that [Caster](https://anilist.co/character/3440/Medea) is a

title: Kageki Shoujo!!
description: Watanabe Sarasa has a dream: she wants to play the role of Oscar as part of the Kouka Acting Troupe, an all-female acting troupe similar to Takarazuka Revue. But before she can do that, she has to attend two years at the Kouka School of Musical and Theatrical Arts. As Sarasa practices singing, dancing, and acting, she grows closer to the other girls in her year, including her roommate, the stoic former J-idol Ai. But though Sarasa is great at making friends, her outspoken nature and grand ambitions earn her lots of enemies as well. Can Sarasa keep her upbeat attitude and achieve her dream of stardom? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.description: Ai's uncle and the only male she trusts. He is an instructor at the Kouka School.

characters.name: Mamoru Andou
characters.description: He is known to Kouka school alumni and theater fans as "The Phantom" for his portrayal in The Phantom of the Opera. He is currently retired from acting after an accident during a performance, and is now an instructor at the Kouka School.

characters.name: Hijiri Nojima
characters.description: One of the second-year students, and is Ai's student-advisor. She would sometimes bully Sarasa a bit, but she is, in her own way, dedicated to guiding Ai.

characters.name: Risa Nakayama
characters.description: The second-year student who is Sarasa's student-advisor. She would stand for her ward whenever Hijiri becomes a bit malicious with her.

title: Shiro to Kuro: Black & White
description: Shirakawa Junko is an upstanding employee of a high-level bank. Her colleagues all respectfully admire her…except for Kuroda Kayo, a colleague who’s transferred to her department. Shirakawa is supposed to train Kuroda, and it does NOT go well. These women have a bizarre love-hate relationship that results in either violent office attacks or angry lesbian sex. When a sinister conspiracy seems to be afoot at their bank, can these two stop having bruised hate-sex on piles of documents and work together to investigate? This provocative LGBT+ drama is ready to rumble. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Keiyaku Shimai
description: Kasane Hayafuji cannot live without making trips to a certain eatery in order to see Aoyama, a waitress working there. One day, when seeing Aoyama standing out in the rain, getting soaked to the bone, Kasane lends her a hand… But the next thing she knows, Aoyama comes to her with a “sister contract”…?! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Kasane Hayafuji
characters.description: A beautiful yet bumbling OL.

characters.name: Meguru Aoyama
characters.description: Meguru works at “Royal Meals” where she meets Kasane. Outwardly, she is extremely reserved when it comes to expressing her personal emotions.

characters.name: Mimei
characters.description: Kasane's friend

characters.name: Toki Watanabe
characters.description: Meguru's classmate. Toki used to be a member of an idol group, but she abruptly quit without warning.

title: Ichikawa Haruko Sakuhinshuu
description: Two volumes of the author's best one-shots. Volume 1: Mushi to Uta (虫と歌, Insects and Songs ) 1) Hoshi no Koibito (星の恋人, Star Lover); Afternoon 2007-12 The odd relationship between a teenage boy and his uncle's "daughter." 2) Violight (ヴァイオライト); Afternoon 2008-07 A boy wakes up in an unfamiliar land, with only a strange, ethereal young man to accompany him on his journey to safety. 3) Kusaka Kyoudai (日下兄妹, The Kusaka Siblings); Afternoon 2009-12 A baseball player who's just quit the school team due to a shoulder injury and the adorable robot he adopts as his little sister. 4) Mushi to Uta (虫と歌); Summer 2006 Afternoon Four Seasons Award winner work; 2006-10 Appendix The story of a young man who builds models of insects for odd clients, and his siblings. Winner of the Shikitaishou award. 5) Secret ; kakioroshi A two-page oneshot. Volume 2: 25-Ji no Vacances (25時のバカンス, 25-Hour Vacation ) 1-2) 25-ji no Vacances (25時のバカンス, 25-Hour Vacation ); Afternoon 2010-09, 10 Marine biologist Nishi Otome takes time off and reunites with her brother, Kotaro, for the first time in a while. 3) Pandora nite (パンドラにて, On Pandora); Afternoon 2010-01 The meeting between a delinquent named Nana and a strange

title: Ayakashi Ko
description: 16 year old Miyatsuka Mahoro is the manager of a certain mansion located in downtown Asakusa. The name of the mansion, Ayakashi-sou is inhabited by a glutton Zashikiwarashi, a Kitsune who loves to play pranks and a Yukionna that likes to sleep in the refrigerator. Even though they are poor, they spend each day having fun and causing trouble. Welcome to the life of living with Ayakashi!

characters.name: Emi Takanashi
characters.description: She is the best friend of Mahoro and has a really energetic personality. She likes scary looking stuff and thinks of them as cute. She is very supportive to Mahoro in many ways and really values their friendship.

title: Vassalord.
description: Charley, a cyborg vampire who does the Vatican's dirty work, is the thrall of the local vampire playboy Johnny Rayflo. As the two fight crime--and each other--hilarity, violence and sacrilege ensue! But can Charley resist his own desperate cravings for blood? Find out as the devilish duo go up aginst a childlike vampire princess, a mysterious branch of the Unitarian Church...and one another. (Source: TOKYOPOP) Note: Volume 2 includes the side-story "ZOUL HALF", published in Comic Blade Masamune summer 2003.

characters.name: Johnny Rayflo
characters.description: Johnny Rayflo is a rich vampire playboy with a large mansion and several vampire maids. He was known in the past as "The Confined Elagabalus." Charles J. Chrishunds is his vassal. He acts as a food source for the devout Charley, who refuses to drink human blood. The two of them are constantly fighting, mostly due to Rayflo's perverse nature and tendency to refer to Charley as "Cherry." Johnny also has a "twin" by the name of Rayfell.

characters.name: Charles Chrishunds
characters.original: チャールズ＝J＝クリスフント
characters.description: Charles J. Chrishunds also known as Charley/Cherry who is a cyborg, and a vampire hunter for the Vatican, his master is Johnny Rayflo a vampire who lives the playboy life style. Solving crimes and fighting his lust for blood, who refuses to drink human blood. Cherry also fights lust for his own master while Johnny delights in nothing more so then seducing Cherry at every turn.

characters.name: Rayfell
characters.description: Rayfell is the supposed twin of Johnny Rayflo. Whether they are related or not isn't known. However, they do look and act very similar which is why they can be called twins. She is a Succubus and lives with a young human girl named Cheryl.

characters.name: Cheryl Shane Kates
characters.original: シェリルシェーンケイツ
characters.description: Cheryl is a young, human nun who shares very similiar features with Chris. She lives with the vampire, Rayfell. She is also a Vampire hunter.

characters.name: Harold Wayne
characters.description: A young boy who is a weak and sickly child, due to his legs being disabled since birth. He spends his days on a wheelchair. Harold says he is the only child of Alford Wayne; the owner of Utsurei, a pharmaceutical company that has gathered attention for their successive development of new drugs ... But Harold is secretly Alford himself.

characters.name: Detective Craig
characters.description: Craig is a detective on the police force and he is very untrusting of Charley and Rayflo. He is also the only policeman the Harold trusts.

characters.name: Barry
characters.description: Barry is an incubus created in the image of the demon who turned Rayflo. He hunts Rayflo in a "game", and can regenerate despite wounds that would be fatal to humans and vampires alike. ~!The real name of Barry is 'Belial'.!~

title: Sekai no Owari to Majo no Koi
title_original: 世界の終わりと魔女の恋
title_en: A Witch’s Love at the End of the World
description: In a world where sorcery rules from the shadows, young women adept in magical arts train at a mysterious academy. These budding witches diligently study, driven by generations of resentment after witch hunts decimated their kind long ago. Star student Alice has always strived to live up to the great expectations placed upon her, but her world is turned upside down when Mari, an inept recruit, enters the school...and her heart! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title: Double House
description: From the creator of Pieta comes the story of a connection between two women, Maho and Fujiko, who live in the same apartment building. Maho, a trans woman, saves Fujiko, a girl from a rich family who's left home and is living on her own, one night, and the two become fast friends. As they grow closer, Fujiko confesses to Maho that she has feelings for her... Note: Includes the one-shot "Tinker Bell no Hanzai".

title: EX-ARM
description: In the year 2014, machine-hating high schooler Akira Natume decides to take the first step towards changing himself… unfortunately, it’s right into the path of an oncoming truck! Fast forward to 2030 in the Port of Tokyo, where Officer Minami Uezono and her android partner Alma infiltrate a black market deal involving the mysterious “EX-ARM” weapons and steal EX-ARM No.00. When a foe wielding EX-ARM No.08 attacks them, they activate EX-ARM No.00 in a last ditch effort to turn things around…! (Source: MANGA MILLION) Note: The chapter count is based on the original release, which split chapters 69-98 into multiple parts.

characters.name: Akira Natsume
characters.description: Akira Natsume is the main protagonist of EX-ARM. Akira was a normal shy high school boy, however while he had a phobia of technology he also had the skill to easily repair broken devices. In 2014 after stepping up and saving a girl he was unfortunately run over by a truck. Sixteen years later the police duo [Alma](https://anilist.co/character/177225/Alma) and [Minami Uenozono](https://anilist.co/character/177226/Minami-Uezono) are on a mission to obtain EX-ARM No. 00, however they find themselves up against a group using EX-ARM No. 08, desperate they activate EX-ARM No. 00. Mysteriously, Akira's consciousness awakens within the super-weapon body and he must now co-operates with the police with the goal of getting his lost memories and body back.

title: Tonari no Heya kara Aegigoe ga Surun desu kedo
title_original: 隣の部屋から喘ぎ声がするんですけど…
description: Nakano moves to Tokyo to begin her life as a university student. The night she moves in, she's troubled by the weird noises coming from the flat next door. When she introduces herself to her neighbor, she's shocked to see that the source of the weird noises was... two women?! The story of a naive girl caught up in the erotic love between women. Note: Chapter count contains 2 bonus chapters.

title: Joshikousei no Mudazukai
title_original: 女子高生の無駄づかい
description: One day out of boredom, Tanaka decided to give her classmates nicknames based on their quirks. Her friend Kikuchi became "Ota" for her nerdy interests, and her other friend Saginomiya became "Robo" because of her expressionless personality. In retaliation, her friends decided to name Tanaka "Baka". These are the ridiculous days of three high school friends claiming (or not) the height of their youth.

characters.name: Masataka Sawatari
characters.description: The class's homeroom teacher. He is only attracted to female university students. He also regularly has consultations with [Yamai](https://anilist.co/character/131724/Yamamoto-Minami); a running gag involves his glasses breaking when Yamai mentions something regarding her chunibyo behavior. ~!Outside of school, he is secretly a Vocaloid producer who goes by the name Teishotoku-P.!~

characters.name: Kohaku Kujou
characters.description: The younger twin sister of [Hisui](https://anilist.co/character/131727/Kujou-Hisui) (Majo).

title: Kimi ga Hoeru Tame no Uta wo,
title_original: キミが吠えるための歌を、
description: A girl who is troubled by her voice that doesn't match her appearance, and a girl who feels she has reached her limits in songwriting. The story of two young musicians. (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Kuchibiru Tameiki Sakurairo
title_original: くちびるためいきさくらいろ
title_en: Kisses, Sighs, and Cherry Blossom Pink
description: Both volumes are a collection of seven short stories each, revolving around an all-girl's school. The first, fifth, sixth, and seventh chapter from the first volume and the first five chapters of the second volume feature the same protagonists. This entry will reflect the Futabasha edition (published in April 2012), which has some chapters re-ordered compared to the previous (incomplete) Ichijinsha edition. Volume 1: 1. Tomodachi ja Nakute mo (Even if We're Not Friends) About two girls who were friends in junior high but end up going to different high schools. 2. Tengoku ni Ichiban Chikai Natsu (The Summer Closest to Heaven) Tells the story of a ghost who accidentally possesses a girl, then takes advantage of the situation to interact with the woman she loves. 3. Kiss to Koi to Oujisama (A Kiss, Love, and a Prince) The main character is kissed by her sempai, who is playing opposite her in the school play, and freaks out because she always imagined her first kiss would be with a boy, preferably a dashing prince. 4. Itsuka no Kono Koi (This Love From I Can't Remember When) Tells the story of one girl's unrequited love. 5. Kusuriyubi ni Kiss Shitara (If I Kiss Her Ring Finger) Nana wa

characters.name: Narumi Abe
characters.description: A perky high school freshman who is in the Drama Club. She is considered very pretty and cute by girls in her year and upperclassmen. Narumi tends to daydream and speak of meeting a wonderful person who will change her life. She ends up crossing paths with her sempai Tachibana who accidentally takes her first kiss while they are rehearsing for a play. Narumi attends Sakurakai Girls' School. She is a classmate and a friend of Kobayashi Nana. She eventually starts dating Tachibana who she comes to care for deeply, and she seems a little possessive about the older, very popular girl.

characters.name: Nana Kobayashi
characters.description: A simple but pensive girl. Nana attends the Sakurakai Girls' School after much prompting from her best friend Fujimori Hitomi who she feels has grown apart from her. She is an average student whose work tends to be a reflection of her emotions. Her closest companion in school is Abe Narumi. Nana is earnest, emotional and insecure. She has low self-confidence, and is sometimes concerned about her looks. It is revealed that she is in love with Hitomi and confesses her love to her after having a long separation. Nana knew that Hitomi was in also love with her but pretended that she didn't know so that they could remain best friends instead. Nana shares a romantic relationship with Hitomi, and she spends her time trying to be a good girlfriend and keeping their relationship a secret. She has very little cooking skills.

characters.name: Hitomi Fujimori
characters.description: Hitomi is a freshman who attends Touhou Girls' High School. She is a beautiful girl who is very talented and is very charismatic. She used to be popular with both the boys and girls in middle school, however, she only paid any attention to her best friend Kobayashi Nana. Hitomi had fallen in love with Nana who she has known for many years, and kisses her during middle school. Nana rejects her and pretends as though it never happened, leaving Hitomi crushed. Hitomi is on the girls' basketball team and is a gifted player. She also dabbles in baking in which she is fairly skilled. She has good repertoire with her teammates and classmates, but nobody else matters to her but Nana. She is later shocked to learn that Nana returns her feelings, and they begin dating. Hitomi is much more conflicted than she lets on. She often worries that someday Nana will return to just being her frien

title: Onee-san ga Shinryakuchuu
description: Toono Ao failed to get into college and became a ronin, studying for next years exams instead. To better study for them, Ao moved out to live on his own into an apartment near his cram school. It's not much, but it's a place to call his own. But not long after moving in, a drunken lady finds her way into his new home! It doesn't matter how hard he tries, she just continues to make herself at home and take advantage of him. This is not okay! ...Or is it? His humble castle is no longer his own. Onee-san is invading!

title: Mejirobana no Saku
description: Ruby is a student at an elite European boarding school. Things are going pretty well for her until she finds out that she won’t be able to go home at Christmas. Instead, she’ll be stuck at school with only one other student–the aloof and beautiful Steph–for company. As Ruby tries to understand Steph, she becomes more and more interested in the other girl. But can she break through Steph’s icy exterior? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Ruby Canossa
characters.description: A cheerful year eleven student, she struggles with her own lack of agency surrounding her parents' inevitable divorce. Ruby becomes interested in Steph after they spend the Christmas holidays together at school.

characters.name: Stephanie Nagy
characters.description: A stand-offish year twelve student, her cool demeanour has gained her the nickname "Steel Steph", as well as a rumour that she has a metal prosthetic leg. Despite this she is still very popular among her peers.

title: Hana Monogatari
description: The manga centers on Hanayo, an elderly woman whose husband of many years has only recently died. After finishing a Buddhist service for her husband, she finds herself walking out in town alone for the first time in a long time. She stumbles onto a cosmetics store, and meets a beautiful woman named Yoshiko Doujima, and falls in love at first sight. Hanayo had long given up on makeup after her husband nagged her about it, but putting some on with Yoshiko's help brightens her heart. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Mane Mane Nichi Nichi
title_en: Mane Mane Nichi Nichi: Baseball Manager Everyday
description: Karina Ichinose, gal fashionista, became a team manager because she loves baseball. Yuki Himemiya became a team manager because her boyfriend was on the team. Akane Nagisa became a team manager because she’s popular—despite not knowing the first thing about baseball! Their managerial duties run the gamut—making rice balls for the team, cleaning lewd books(?) out of the clubroom, keeping a childhood friend company during his batting practice, and fretting over the team during their first nail-biting practice game! The bases are loaded with their exciting memories, and it’s time to play ball! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Akane Nagisa
characters.description: A first-year high school student and one of the team managers for the school baseball team

title: Gakeppuchi Reijou wa Kurokishi-sama wo Horesasetai!
title_original: 崖っぷち令嬢は黒騎士様を惚れさせたい！
title_en: Marrying the Dark Knight (For Her Money)
description: Clarice's younger sister is her whole world. In a world of monsters, born into a noble family that's gone broke, there's nothing Clarice wouldn't do for her. So when she gets sick, and there's only one way to save her, Clarice doesn't blink! She agrees to an arranged marriage with the Dark Knight, a ferocious warrior who goes everywhere in magical armor—even their wedding! Afterward, Clarice is ready to consummate the marriage and charm her new spouse into paying to save her sister's life. There's just one problem: The Dark Knight won't let her into the bedroom! And Clarice finally finds out why...she's secretly a woman! With female knights forbidden, the Knight seriously lacking in social graces, a household full of servants scared out of their wits, and monster fights breaking out constantly, Clarice realizes that this wedding of convenience is going to be more inconvenient than she bargained for! (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Frost von Galleria
characters.original: フロスト・フォン・ガレリア

characters.name: Clarice von Ducale
characters.original: クラリス・フォン・ドゥカーレ

title: Teiji ni Agaretara
title_en: If We Leave on the Dot
description: Yukawa comes into the office and always hangs up her coat on the rack; most others just sling it over their chairs. That may be because Yukawa is proper, but maybe because she loves receiving handwritten notes from her coworker Mizuki. Until recently, Yukawa only knew Mizuki and her sweet vanilla scent from afar, but one day she was able to befriend her after a mix up with their coats. Since then, Mizuki communicates with Yukawa and asks her to go out after work via pen, paper, and coat. They never make plans ahead of time, nor do they even know each other's phone numbers. As Yukawa navigates her feelings and learns more about Mizuki, will their relationship blossom into more than whatever it is right now? (Source: Manga Planet) Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title: Boku ga Yuusha de Maou mo Boku de
title_original: ボクが勇者で魔王もボクで
title_en: I'm the Hero, But the Demon Lord's Also Me
description: Yuuma Tsugari is an ordinary high school student whose family runs a bathhouse. He leads a peaceful, uneventful life-but that all changes when two beautiful women approach him, each certain he’s the legendary man she’s been searching for! But which of them is right? Is he the hero or the demon lord? Turns out he bears the marks of both, and neither woman is willing to give him up! Wanted by the forces of good and evil, what’s a guy like Yuuma to do?! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

title: Kiraware Majo Reijou to Dansou Ouji no Konyaku
title_original: 嫌われ魔女令嬢と男装皇子の婚約
description: Cursed by others as a "witch", Evris, the youngest daughter of the House of Bradley, is engaged to Mark, the fifth prince of the Kingdom of Klengel. When he abruptly announces that their engagement is broken off, Evris is plunged into despair. However, someone reaches out to her instead... The cross-dressing (female) crown prince of a neighboring country!? This is the story of a red-haired witch who manipulates shadows and a cross-dressing (female) crown prince who is serving as a body double for her missing older brother. The curtain rises on a fantasy romantic comedy of a girl being teased by a princess! (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

characters.name: Evris Bradley
characters.original: イヴリス・ブラッドリー
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm

characters.name: Ciel Alphard
characters.original: シエル・アルファルド
characters.description: __Height:__ 169 cm

title: Ame demo Hare demo
description: Nekozaki Ren abused her powers as school council secretary to secretly set up a Miko Club in her school’s abandoned shrine. All of this so she could spend time with her crush, Yamada Mikoto, after school. But this wasn’t meant to last. Before long some people caught wind of their little club site, and with the school’s club building fully occupied, they saw themselves fit to use the shrine for their own club activities instead! Will Ren be able to reclaim her paradise? Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

characters.name: Mikoto Yamada
characters.description: **Height:** 155cm **Likes:** Hot milk **Dislikes:** Somen High School Freshman The founding member of the Miko Club, a miko from Kansai who moved away, to a new city, and now, in a new school, struggles to make friends.

characters.name: Ren Nekozaki
characters.description: **Height:** 169cm **Likes:** Sweets, caramel **Dislikes:** Fizzy drinks High School Freshman The secretary of the student council. Because of her crush on [Mikoto](https://anilist.co/character/139904/Mikoto-Yamada), she abused her power to set her up with a one-person club using the Uchouten Shrine as its clubroom.

characters.name: Takuya Kumakura
characters.description: **Height:** 154cm Kumakura was a part of the Tokyo Fashion Club before becoming a part of The Uchoten Club. Apparently her stomach is the only strong part about her.

characters.name: Yozora Usagida
characters.description: **Height:** 161cm **Likes:** Convenience store food **Dislikes:** Spicy food High School Freshman Usagida was a part of the Shut-In Club before joining The Uchoten Club. She skips most of her classes and spends her time in a sleeping bag but is rather cute when she's not wearing it

characters.name: Airi Shishimaru
characters.description: **Height:** 156cm **Likes:** Fizzy drinks, anything tasty **Dislikes:** None High School Freshman One of the two members of the former Showa Ballad Record Club. She's very selfish and has quite the mean streak, and constantly fights with her clubmate and roommate, [Pengin](https://anilist.co/character/155735/Ritsu-Pengin).

characters.name: Ritsu Pengin
characters.description: **Height:** 148cm One of the two members of the former Showa Ballad Record Club. She's cheery and outgoing, but constantly fights with her clubmate and roomate, [Shishimaru](https://anilist.co/character/155734/Airi-Shishimaru).

characters.name: Tsubaki Kobayashi
characters.description: **Height:** 162cm **Likes:** Fruit **Dislikes:** The gross chahan her mother makes High School Freshman. The treasurer of the student council and [Nekozaki](https://anilist.co/character/155733/Ren-Nekozaki)'s ornery roommate.

characters.name: Mashiro Fujishiro
characters.description: A tactless, trashy adult whose ethics have gone out the window. Refrains from smoking when [Tsubaki](https://anilist.co/character/213594/Tsubaki-Kobayashi) is around.

title: Kaisou Toshi Danpenshuu
description: In a world approaching its end, humanity has built a colossal, multi-layered city that rises high into the sky through the power of advanced technology. As the city continues to expand, its inhabitants live their lives within and around the vast structure, creating new connections and leaving behind the fruits of human endeavor. Spanning different eras in this dying world, the story presents a series of snapshots that capture the lives, hopes, and everyday experiences of the people who inhabit the towering metropolis—a record of humanity and the traces it leaves behind. (Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Kimi ni Tsumugu Bouhaku
description: Two college students with a shared dream and opposite paths collide–will their ambitions bring them together or pull them apart? Haruka has abandoned her dreams of the theater, but finds herself still haunted by memories. Meanwhile, Nao chases her aspirations for the stage head-on, refusing to back down or let obstacles obscure her way. When the lives of these two women cross, despite their contrary feelings, they end up entangled…as romance sparks between them. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

characters.name: Nao Hayama
characters.description: A friendly and energetic first-year college student who aspires to be a professional actress.

characters.name: Haruka Tachibana
characters.description: A second-year college student who gave up on her dream of becoming an actress. She enjoys books and reading and aspires to be a librarian. She is calm and cautious.

characters.name: Jun Segawa
characters.description: Haruka's childhood friend.

characters.name: Yuki Misaki
characters.description: She is Nao's closest friend.

characters.name: Rei Shirashi
characters.description: Rei is a high school student, she and Yuki both work part-time at a bookstore.

title: Wolf in the House
description: After ending an on-again, off-again relationship of 10 years, Min-Suk decides to foster a Siberian husky named Bexan to mark the start of his new single life. He can’t wait to cuddle with his new furry roommate, take him on walks, and play fetch. But Bexan is no ordinary dog...and when night falls, Min-Suk is in for a surprise. (Source: Lezhin US) Note: Includes five extra chapters.

title: Kanojo no Kagi wo Akeru Houhou
title_original: 彼女の鍵を開ける方法
description: Haruma's first impression of the new transfer student, Chitose, would be striped panties. Running into her in the hallway, Chitose's panties greet Haruma before they even know each other. Immediately, Haruma finds himself attracted to this mysterious panty girl, only to find out that she is transfering into his class AND she's going to be the new house keeper at his apartment (Not to mention her little problem with a rather strong exhibitionism streak...). Let the skirt flying romance comedy begin!

title: IDOL×IDOL STORY!
description: Meet Mimi, a college grad working part-time at a convenience store. Once an aspiring idol, she abandoned her dream when her group failed to make it big. Enter Ibuki, a rising star inspired by Mimi’s past. Their unexpected encounters reignite Mimi’s passion for the spotlight. Together, they decide to audition for a high-stakes idol competition show. Can they achieve their dreams and forge an unbreakable bond, or will the intense rivalry tear them apart? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Mimi Nagisa
characters.description: __Height__: 158 cm __Home Town__: Tokyo An active idol for three years until her group broke up a year ago.

characters.name: Ibuki Nanakusa
characters.description: __Height__: 154 cm __Home Town__: Tokyo Spent a year as an active idol until she left the group.

characters.name: Hitoe Hitoto
characters.description: __Height__: 160 cm __Home Town__: Okinawa She has been an idol trainee at the OM agency since junior high.

characters.name: Ritsu Senba
characters.description: __Height__: 160 cm __Home Town__: Nagasaki Bounced around various idol academies from elementary through high school. Now a trainee at the OM Agency.

characters.name: Shiori Houryuu
characters.description: __Height__: 162 cm __Home Town__: Kyoto A former figure skater.

characters.name: Anon Kotomori
characters.description: __Height__: 143 cm __Home Town__: Okinawa

characters.name: Yuuri Futaba
characters.description: __Height__: 165 cm __Home Town__: Asahikawa, Hokkaido Prefecture Older sister of the other contestant [Tsumugi Futaba](https://anilist.co/character/310785). Only applied because her sisters begged her to try out.

characters.name: Michiru Aoi
characters.description: __Height__: 164 cm __Home Town__: Fukuoka A former child actress who has been performing on television ever since she could remember. Picked up singing and dancing from the pros she met during her acting career.

characters.name: Shuri Touma
characters.description: Her parents run a dance studio and she has been a dancer all her life. Dance contest winner.

characters.name: Karin Kokonoe
characters.description: __Height__: 164 cm __Home Town__: Nagoya The daughter of the manager of OM Agency. Has been a child model and actress since she was five.

characters.name: Hibana Akagiri
characters.description: __Height__: 161 cm __Home Town__: Hiroshima

characters.name: Urara Todoroki
characters.description: __Height__: 155 cm __Home Town__: Aomori A popular UTuber who posts videos of her singing and dancing.

title: Luminous = Blue
description: Kou Tarumizu transfers to the high school of her idol and 2 time photography contest winner, Uchiho Hayama, only to find that the photography club has been disbanded and Uchiho is in a photographic slump. To revive the club and get Uchiho out of her slump, Kou decides to enter a photography contest and chooses her classmates Nene and Amane as her subjects. But it turns out that the two of them used to be a couple... Note: Chapter count includes two extra chapters.

title: Lonely Wolf, Lonely Sheep
title_original: ロンリーウルフ・ロンリーシープ
description: Two women with the same name happen to meet each other when they're at the same hospital for the same injury. They want to become closer, but both must overcome their insecurities and self-loathing first.

characters.name: Imari Kakimoto
characters.description: Works for Nogihara Contractors doing interior finishing. She reads her horoscopes everyday and rides a motorbike she called Marie-Chan. She meets Little Imari after she falls off of a stepladder and breaks her finger. ~! She was an Office Lady for a big company but was bullied into quitting after they found out she was a lesbian. !~

characters.name: Imari Kakimoto
characters.description: An artist with lots of contracts. She reads her horoscopes everyday. She meets Big Imari after she accidentally breaks her finger painting. ~! She struggles with the pressure of painting and after accidentally breaking her finger decides to continually break it so she doesn’t have to paint. She later quits and gets a job with Big Imari. !~

title: Yume to Koi dewa Tsuriawanai
title_original: 夢と恋ではつり合わない
title_en: I Love You, Please Dump Me
description: "Love makes people go crazy." Hikaru's always been told to be wary of love—it can make you do stupid things. Like abandon your dreams, or worse, fail your exams! Which is exactly what happens when she falls in love at first sight with Kairi Kira. The problem is, Hikaru's dreams of one day living it up in an expensive penthouse apartment relies on her first achieving academic success. Which is why she's going to have to nip this little love problem in the bud. If Kairi rejects her and breaks her heart, she'll be able to get over her feelings and focus on her grades. Except Kairi insists on becoming her girlfriend, which is definitely not part of the plan! But this should be fine, right? She just has to get used to splitting her time and attention. Or... she could, if Kairi would let her! (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Wan Ren Zhi Shang
description: I keep saying that I don't have any spiritual power, but they won't believe me! The random doorkeeper claims that I'm the greatest martial artist in the world, and they take his word for it! Wake up guys! I'm really not the martial god you're looking for!! (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Wakaba-san Chi no Aoi Koi
description: The four sisters of the Wakaba family are all in the midst of their “first love” right now. The eldest sister, Kokoharu, is in love with a senior at her part-time job. The second sister, Manatsu, likes a guy in the Archery Club. The third sister, Akira, is interested in a club-mate the same age as her. The youngest, Chifuyu, likes a boy in her class. The four sisters, who are close friends, obsess over their love problems day and night. How do you tell someone you love him! (Source: Sunday Webry, translated) Note: - Includes the one-shot "Wakaba-san Chi no Aoi Koi Bangai-hen" - Includes sive extra chapters.

title: Himawari-san
description: Himawari-san is the owner of an old bookstore, and a highschool girl comes in and asks for a job. Their friendship starts from there. Note: Includes two omake chapters and a seven-chapter extra story.

characters.name: Matsuri Kazamatsuri
characters.description: A not-to-bright girl, Matsuri has a heart of gold. She loves helping people, especially those close to her like Fuuko and Himawari. Matsuri is often found in the Sunflower Bookshop puppying Himawari, her love, around.

characters.name: Fuuko Kazamatsuri
characters.description: Fuuko is the little sister of Matsuri. She is a bit rough on the outside but very soft on the inside, a tsundere of sorts. She loves cute things and, since her premiere in chapter six, has a liking for Himawari as well. She likes fantasy novels and is an adoring little sister as well.

characters.name: Sakura Asakura
characters.description: Sakura is a grade schooler with a knack for fantasy. She premieres by approaching Himawari to purchase a manga she ripped while fighting with her friend. She is without care, as most kids are, and very strange. If she's not trying to send out telepathic messages, she's saying something else that, in one way or another, is rather fantastical.

characters.name: Nanako Nanase
characters.description: Class president of Matsuri's class. She changes modes; On rainy days she sinks into negative mode, and she has a bad habit of scowling when she's nervous, her other mode is class prez mode, when she is realy serious. A big fan of Kuroizato Kaoru Sensei's books.

characters.name: Rin
characters.description: She's Sakura's friend.

characters.name: Ayame Kakitsubata
characters.description: She has a bookstore specialized in photography books at the Bookstore street. She loves taking photos.

characters.name: Kaoru Kuroizato
characters.description: Himawari-san's older brother. He's a light novel author. Kuroizato is not his real surname, it's his pen name.

characters.name: Ami Minami
characters.description: Matsuri's classmate. She likes reading manga.

title: Watashi ni Tenshi ga Maiorita!
title_original: 私に天使が舞い降りた！
description: The four-panel comedy manga's story centers on Miyako Hoshino, a shy college student and otaku. Miyako's younger sister Hinata, who is a fifth grader, has a classmate and friend named Hana. When they meet, Miyako falls for Hana at first sight. (Source: Anime News Network) Note: Includes 18 extra chapters.

characters.name: Miyako Hoshino
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") A college student who is shy around strangers and spends most of her time indoors. She becomes smitten by [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476) and starts making her snacks in exchange for getting her to dress up in cosplay outfits she makes.

characters.name: Hana Shirosaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 142.3 cm (4'8") An elementary school student who is classmates with [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/131477). She is often disturbed by [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475)'s behavior but puts up with it in order to eat her snacks.

characters.name: Hinata Hoshino
characters.description: __Height:__ 140.7 cm [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475)'s younger sister and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476)'s classmate. She is particularly fond of her sister, who she nicknames "Mya-nee".

characters.name: Noa Himesaka
characters.description: __Height__: 142.7 cm (4'8") [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476) and [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/131477)'s classmate who moves next door to [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475) and Hinata. She constantly sees herself as cute, often becoming downhearted when someone else (usually Hana) is said to be cuter.

characters.name: Koyori Tanemura
characters.description: __Height__: 138.6 cm (4'6") A class representative in Hana's class. She aspires to be someone that everyone can rely on, but is often unreliable herself.

characters.name: Kanon Konomori
characters.description: __Height:__ 141 cm (4'7") Another class representative in [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/131476)'s class and [Koyori](https://anilist.co/character/131478)'s best friend. She is kind and often seen as very reliable, much to Koyori's chagrin.

characters.name: Kouko Matsumoto
characters.description: __Height:__ 164.8 cm (5'4") A girl who was in a club with [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/131475) during high school. While Miyako hardly remembers her, she has been obsessively fixated on her, acting like a stalker.

characters.name: Chizuru Hoshino
characters.description: Miyako and Hinata's mother.

characters.name: Emily Himesaka
characters.description: Noa Himesaka's mother.

characters.name: Yuuna Matsumoto
characters.description: Yuuna is [Kouko Matsumoto](https://anilist.co/character/136814)'s little sister who appears for the first time when [Miyako Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/131475) and [Hinata Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/131477) go outside to go shop.

characters.name: Yamanaka-sensei
characters.description: The homeroom teacher of Class 5-3, which Hinata, Hana, Noa, Kanon, and Koyori are all in.

characters.name: Haruka Shirosaki
characters.description: Hana Shirosaki's mother.

title: Danshi Kokosei Dakedo Gal ni TS Shimashita
title_original: 男子高校生だけどギャルにTSしました
description: Junpei, a loner high schooler, became a gyaru after saving the god of gyaru from drowning. Through his mother's connections, he was able to transfer to an all-girls school, but it was stuffed to the brim with gyarus! Every day is a sensory overload for Shunpei, who's never even talked to a girl, let alone a gyaru. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Gekijouban Mahou Shoujo Madoka★Magica: Shinpen - Hangyaku no Monogatari
title_original: 劇場版 魔法少女まどか★マギカ [新編] 叛逆の物語
title_en: Puella Magi Madoka Magica: The Movie -Rebellion-
description: With Madoka Kaname's sacrifice, the hopeless cycle that once bound every magical girl to a terrible fate was broken at last. Still, the magical girls fight on against the dark magics that threaten the human world, which remains ignorant of the brave girl who saved them. Only Homura remembers her dear friend Madoka, a burden she has borne in all her battles since-right? Then how is Homura still going to school with Madoka, fighting alongside her, laughing as if nothing has happened? As her tragic memories return to her, Homura realizes she must not be in the real world, wonderful as it is to see her friend again. But if she is indeed trapped in a magical space, who among her magical friends could be the cause? (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Madoka Kaname
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") A 14-year-old girl whose life changes when she encounters the [Puella Magi Homura](https://anilist.co/character/38005/Akemi-Homura) and the familiar [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), who offers to transform her into a Puella Magi herself. She sees herself as a person without special qualities or talents, and after seeing [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) fighting against witches, wants to be a wonderful and cool Puella Magi like her. She is a rather selfless girl who wishes to be a magical girl simply so that she can help others. She allegedly has a large amount of magical potential within her.

characters.name: Homura Akemi
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 - 158 cm Homura is a magical girl who first appears in an apocalyptic nightmare of [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832). She transfers into her school the day after the dream. She is a beautiful, mysterious individual that performs exceptionally well in academics and athletics. This makes her instantly popular even though she is cold to others. She seems to know Madoka well and wishes to prevent her from becoming a magical girl. She attacks [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566) in the first episode, only to be stopped by [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194).

characters.name: Mami Tomoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-159 cm Mami Tomoe is a veteran magical girl and a third-year student at Madoka's school. She lives alone in a penthouse after her parents were killed in a car crash, which Mami survived after contracting with Kyuubey. Mami is particularly focused on saving, guiding, and protecting those around her, which is a traditionally selfless perspective on the role of magical girl. She is much like a maternal figure to Madoka and Sayaka, being the eldest among them. Her name could be considered a play on the word 'mommy', further supported in the third film, where she has a companion named "Bebe". Though Mami's outward disposition is cheery and confident, Mami feels deeply alone as she has no friends to confide in as she fights.

characters.name: Sayaka Miki
characters.description: __Height:__ 158-160 cm __Weapon:__ Cutlass [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832/Kaname-Madoka) classmate who, after helping Madoka rescue [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), ends up getting an offer to become a Puella Magi herself. She cares deeply for her friends, and wants to help an ill boy named [Kyousuke Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/39835/Kamijou-Kyousuke), whom she has a crush on. Before becoming a Puella Magi, Sayaka wields a baseball bat that [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) can enhance with magic to defend herself with while on witch hunts.

characters.name: Kyuubey
characters.description: Kyuubey is a familiar who can grant any wish to a certain girl, on the condition that she becomes a Puella Magi and fights against witches.

characters.name: Kyouko Sakura
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-158 cm __Weapon:__ Spear Kyouko is a veteran magical girl who comes to the city later in the story. Amusingly, she is always seen eating something, even while she is battling. Having grown up in a poor family, she often has to steal food and hates people who waste it, a logic she also applies to Grief Seeds, as she only goes after fully grown witches. Kyouko has been a Puella Magi much longer than the others, and thus is more skillful; she wields a spear which can extend itself, split into multiple sections, and produce a ball at the end of a chain, which can constrict and hit others at the same time. She also has the ability to put up barriers to protect others or keep them from interfering. She initially clashes with Sayaka, but after learning the truth about Soul Gems, she sympathizes with her and tries to help her.

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.description: The witch of desserts. Her nature is tenacity. What she desires is everything. She will never give up. Though she is capable of creating infinite amounts of any dessert she desires, she is unable to make the cheese that she loves most. If you have a piece of cheese, you can easily catch her off-guard. (Source: Puella Magi Wikia)

title: Ane no Shinyuu, Watashi no Koibito.
description: Sena is a novelist who has been dealing with romantic feelings for her sister, Yuuna. Upon learning that Yuuna is to be married, Yuuna's best friend and former partner Kiku asks Sena to be her lover. Note: Includes five extra chapters.

characters.name: Kiku Mamiya
characters.description: Freelance photographer. Considerate and caring, likes to keep things neat.

characters.name: Sena Sakikawa
characters.description: Novelist. Has some sort of romantic feelings for her sister.

characters.name: Yuuna Sakikawa
characters.description: Sena's older sister and Kiku's best friend.

title: Yuzumori-san
description: A pale, small, delicate, dignified elementary school girl and a timid high school girl. This story is about Yuzumori-san and Mimika, and their relationship with one another.

title: Iseong Yeon Aebagsa
description: Jung Erae has no clue about relationships and men to the point where she drives every man away. Desperate, she seeks help and ends up contacting a love doctor, Cha Yoon. Strangely enough, Erae starts developing newfound feelings for this so-called doctor. (Source: Lezhin)

characters.name: I-Rae Jeong
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm Jeong I-Rae is a second year student on the Department of Economics at Seoyeon University. She is very insensitive when it comes to relationships, so she is often misunderstood by her male students without even realizing it. In order to solve her problems related to romantic relationships with the opposite sex, she decides to get her relationship tutoring from [Cha-Yun](https://anilist.co/character/324795).

characters.name: Cha-Yun
characters.description: __Height:__ 171 cm Graduated from the Academy of Dance and Arts Management. She is a self-proclaimed doctor of love, and takes on the role of [Jeong I-re](https://anilist.co/character/324794/IRae-Jeong)'s love tutoring.

title: Hidamari Sketch
description: Accepted to a high school specializing in the arts, Yuno moves into a nearby apartment complex to make her commute easier. Just a few days into her new routine, she quickly discovers that creativity doesn't end with the art school bell! Her neighbors - Sae, Hiro, and Miya -are all fellow students, and each has her own hilarious quirks. And eccentricity clearly rules this school; Yuno's homeroom teach is a cosplay otaku and the principal is just...weird. Will the quiet Yuno be able to handle this creatively kooky cast of characters? (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Yuno
characters.description: __Height:__ 144 cm Yuno is the main character in the story and it is mainly through her viewpoint that the story is told, each episode of the anime usually ends with her pondering her feelings about what has gone on during the day while taking a bath with her rubber duck. She lives in room 201, next to her best friend and classmate, Miyako. She is a skilled artist overall but considers painting and drawing her specialties.

characters.name: Miyako
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm [Yuno](https://anilist.co/character/2528/Yuno)'s classmate and good friend. She's very strange, but a very likable person. She has very good ears and is good at imitating other people. She is notorious for her appetite and love for food.

characters.name: Sae
characters.description: __Height:__ 167cm Sae is an upperclassman and good friends with Hiro. In the anime version, she has a younger sister, Chika. Her artistic specialties are photography and fiction writing; she writes fiction professionally under the pseudonym "Aya Tachibana" and enrolled at the school specifically so she could learn how to illustrate her own work. Sae, who is tall, athletic, and generally mature, has a playful side that can be at the same time enigmatic and cunning; she has a habit of giving Yuno just enough warning about potential problems for the younger girl to fail to avoid them. She also has a fondness for playing detective when faced with such anomalies as Miyako's apartment. She tends to get upset when Miyako refers to her as having masculine qualities. She also gets very uncomfortable when asked about her love life, frequently inventing a history for herself that even cursory exami

characters.name: Hiro
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Hiro is a year older than [Yuno](https://anilist.co/character/2528/Yuno) and [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/2627/Miyako), living directly under Yuno's apartment. Although she tries to be a supportive senpai to the girls, she tends to worry excessively about her weight, causing her to go on diets for periods while occasionally binging on sweets. A childhood friend of [Sae](https://anilist.co/character/3215/Sae), she is one of her neighbor's principal sources of support when she's involved with a deadline or other crisis.

characters.name: Nazuna
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm She lives in room 203. She has sandy blonde hair, braids, and large side bangs. She used to live in the neighborhood, but after entering Yamabuki Art High School her father was transferred somewhere for work and her mother followed with him. She appears very quiet and reserved, but has an inferiority complex. She is not in the art department.

characters.name: Nori
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Nori lives in room 103 and is in the art department and likes to play with computers. She is honest and straightforward, and seems to be the most level-headed and normal out of everyone and is usually the one to point out the others' weird ways.

characters.name: Matsuri
characters.description: Matsuri is the newest addition to Hidamari Apartments who now occupies Room 101.

characters.name: Yoshinoya
characters.description: __Height:__ 158cm Yoshinoya is Yuno and Miyako's homeroom teacher and art instructor. She is buxom, exuberant, and a cosplay maniac. So much so, in fact, that she will frequently wear incredibly complicated things that are at times truly inappropriate. She has a fondness for modeling for her class, displaying her latest outfits whenever she can, and showing off in general. It is later revealed that Yoshinoya still resides with her parents, and would often be criticized by them for not being mature. When asked her age, she will answer "eternally seventeen". (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Chika
characters.description: Chika is Sae's thirteen-year-old sister. She is more spontaneous and energetic than her older sister. She enjoys cooking and has an infatuation with a Kabuki actor. She has no artistic talent and prefers music and home economics to art. Initially only appearing in the anime adaptation, she made her first appearance in the manga in the June 2012 issue of Manga Time Kirara Carat.

characters.name: Kouchou-sensei
characters.description: The Principal at Yamabuki High School, with a stutter and an inability to stop shaking. Is a master gunfighter and ninja. Often scolds Yoshinoya-sensei for lack of satisfactory performance. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Natsume
characters.description: Natsume is a student from class B who acts like a tsundere character toward Sae, masking her strong affection for her by maintaining a generally antagonistic attitude. During her first day at Yamabuki, she faced a lot of troubles and was helped by Sae and touched by her kind nature, developing feelings for her. To her dismay, she was separated into another class and quickly became jealous and envious of Hiro's burgeoning relationship with Sae. Ever since, she has been trying to hide her feelings in Sae's presence by acting nonchalant, initially declaring herself to be her rival. Eventually, though she becomes less confrontational around her and occasionally visits Sae and the others at the apartment, when invited. She is also one of the few people who know of Sae's pen name and is an admirer of her books.

characters.name: Oyasan
characters.description: The Landlady is the female owner of Hidamari Apartments. She has quite a few masculine characteristics as she often wears baseball cap, goes out for a fishing in her spare time, and is a heavy smoker. Although she has a very laid-back personality, she is often seen very busy doing various part-time jobs. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Maid-san wa Taberu dake
title_original: メイドさんは食べるだけ
title_en: The Food Diary of Miss Maid
description: What's a maid to do when she finds herself suddenly stuck in Japan for a year? Eat, of course! Follow maid-in-training Suzume Tachibana as she tries all sorts of Japanese food, from sweets like taiyaki and melon bread to savory snacks like takoyaki and onigiri! Be warned, though—while Suzume sates her appetite through delicious treat after delicious treat, she might just end up whetting yours! (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Suzume Tachibana
characters.description: She was a maid at a British mansion, but the mansion collapsed while she was in Japan, so she decided to stay in Japan for a while. She is interested in Japanese food and tries new foods every day.

characters.name: Ricotta Fresca
characters.description: A maid friend who works at the same mansion as [Suzume](https://anilist.co/character/192581/Suzume-Tachibana). She came to Japan to check on Suzume. She calls the old lady “Head Maid” and looks up to her.

characters.name: Nana Komatsu
characters.description: [Suzume's](https://anilist.co/character/192581/Suzume-Tachibana) apartment neighbor. A working adult enduring a grueling job, she finds comfort in her interactions with Suzume.

characters.name: Sora Endou
characters.description: A high school boy has been interested in [Suzume](https://anilist.co/character/192581/Suzume-Tachibana) ever since he met her on his way to school. Since then, he has had a connection with her in various ways.

characters.name: Anzu Shingetsu
characters.description: A college student living in Room 202 of the same apartment building as [Suzume](https://anilist.co/character/192581/Tachibana-Suzume). They become friends after Suzume saves her during a certain incident.

characters.name: Chun
characters.description: The mascot character for "Chun-Guide," the guidebook used by [Suzume](https://anilist.co/character/192581/Suzume-Tachibana). It explains—or guides—users through various details, such as what Suzume is eating and interesting trivia.
