title: Atarashiku Dekita Tomodachi ga Omotteta no to Chigatta Hanashi
title_original: 新しくできた友達が思ってたのと違った話
description: My new friend has an absolutely beyond super cool sense of style! One day, just after becoming a second-year high school student, Hinata found herself captivated by a lovely beauty named Yuzuki and called out to her. They hit it off and agreed to meet outside of school. But when Yuzuki showed up at the meeting spot, she was decked out in a fiercely rock-inspired fashion. Even her words and actions stood in stark contrast to the school's soft, fluffy atmosphere, radiating a smart, handsome charm... While tossed about by this intense gap, Hinata found herself increasingly drawn to Yuzuki's unwavering commitment to her own style. However, Yuzuki harbored a complex about her inability to conform to others... Notes: - The compiled edition published by Kadokawa was retitled Omotteta no to Chigau Ano Ko no Hanashi (思ってたのと違うあの子の話) - Chapter count includes 1 extra epilogue chapter.

characters.name: Hinata Nakamura
characters.description: **Height:** 162cm

characters.name: Seika Morihara
characters.description: **Height:** 166cm

characters.name: Yuzuki Mishima
characters.description: **Height:** 168cm

title: Living Will
description: Jeanne, a prostitute at address 74, took care of the fallen Janet. Jeanne wants to be friends with Janet, but Janet tries to get information out of her.

characters.name: Jeanne
characters.description: Jeanne, a prostitute at address 74. She is one of the main characters of the story.

characters.name: Janet
characters.description: Janet is cold, withdrawn, and works as an assassin.

title: Devilman Lady
title_original: デビルマン レディー
description: Fudou Jun is a highschool teacher and takes a trip with a group of students. While there, a group of martial artists staying nearby take a strange interest in the girls. These men are actually demons and after changing into their true form break into the cabin to rape the girls. One gets Jun and violates her. She feels her soul being torn apart and transforms into Devilman Lady. With newfound powers and strength she kills all the demons and protects the girls from any further harm. What are these demons and why did she turn into a hybrid of one? What does this mean for her and for the rest of humanity?

characters.name: Akira Fudou
characters.description: __Height:__ 182 cm Akira is a shy, soft spoken, and somewhat cowardly teen. His father has recently went to work in America so he is currently living with his friend Miki's family. He hasn't seen his best friend Ryo in over a month since moving in with Miki's family. When they reunite he is in for a big surprise that will forever change him, his life, and all of mankind. ~!Devilman is Akira Fudo after he merged with Amon in order to save mankind from the demons. While he usually stays in his human form, he turns into Devilman when he needs to fight seriously. Akira still retains his human heart after he becomes Devilman, meaning he can feel love and empathy unlike demons, but his personality changes drastically as a result of the merge.!~

characters.name: Jun Fudo
characters.description: Jun is a successful supermodel in Tokyo when the story begins. She is found by a woman, Lan Asuka who forces her to confront a werewolf-like monster called a Devil-beast. As it tears into Jun, her own powers awaken within her and she becomes a Devil-beast herself. She defeats the beast with her new powers and reverts back to her human form. Asuka then tells her that she is a member of a military unit known as the Human Alliance whose purpose is to hunt down and kill all those who are affected with Devil Beast Syndrome. Asuka gives Jun an ultimatum; if Jun doesn't hunt for them, she will be hunted by them. Jun has no choice but to obey Asuka from that point on. Jun is a very quiet and timid person who seems to avoid most social interactions, with two exceptions. She is generally open with her manager and outright friendly with an aspiring teen model named Kazumi. As the series progresses

characters.name: Asuka Lan
characters.description: Asuka is the woman who scouted Jun for the Human Alliance, and is a high-ranking government official. As far as her personality goes, she is a cold, aggressive, and manipulative woman, who cares nothing for the people who work under her. When she forced Jun to confront the Devil-beast Wolver, she had no concern for Jun's survival, her theory that Jun was a Devil-beast was based only on a hunch. As the series progresses, even though she is cruel to Jun, she cares about Jun's safety. She acts as Jun's liaison and tells her when and where a beast will appear. She seems to have different intentions from her organisation and does a great deal of work without their knowledge.

characters.name: Ryo Asuka
characters.description: The best friend of Akira Fudo, the main character of Nagai Go's classical horror manga Devilman. As Akira is the strength, Ryo is the brain. His father discovered the existence of demons in our world and decided to fight them. He asked his friend Akira for help. Ryo knew that to be able to beat a demon, one had to become a demon. He and Akira went through a ritual to fuse with demons, but in the end, only Akira was able to do so and became Devilman, leaving Ryo remain as a normal human. ~!Ryo's true identity was much more horrible, much more terrifying than he or Akira could've ever imagined. Ryo turned out to be Satan himself, who sought to destroy the world. Satan is depicted as a beautiful hermaphroditic Seraphim angel with twelve wings. However, it is later revealed by Zenon that Satan is in fact in love with Akira. The Devil's love for Akira was developed through the human relations

characters.name: Silene
characters.description: Once Amon's lover, Sirene is on a mission to destroy the being that took her beloved Amon away. Sirene has razor-sharp claws that can tear a man in two. She can also launch her arms at targets.

characters.name: Jinmen
characters.description: Jinmen is a devil with a shell like turtle. However, the shell has the faces of all the humans he's ever consumed. Instead of killing them, they remain alive as a part of him. In the manga, Sachiko, who used to be Akira's neighbor, falls victim to Jinmen. In the OAV, it is Akira's mother.

characters.name: Remi Takashima
characters.description: Remi Takashima is a four year girl. The building which Remi lived in had burned down. After going through the remains, firefighters found her buried under some rubble, and amazingly, she was still breathing. Assuming Remi possessed the beast gene, she was kept alive to be used as a guinea pig. ~!After being observed in the hospital, she once again unintentionally starts a fire. Jun is sent in to eliminate Remi. After being attacked by her fire, Jun transforms, but still tries to confront Remi without hurting her. We see a flashback, and learn that, after finding an interest in fire, Remi found that she had the power to start fires with her mind. Remi unintentionally started a fire in her room. Her mother came in to her room to get her, but after touching Remi's hand, she caught on fire and burned to death. Remi calls for her mother, and walks toward Jun, arms open. Jun hugs Remi, an

characters.name: Kaim
characters.description: Devil that sacrificed himself and merged with Silence in order to help her against Devilman.

title: Akuyaku Reijou no Oyome-sama
description: One day, Carina, a lady who has been groomed to be queen, suddenly has her engagement annulled by her fiancee, the prince. Now he is sending Carina into exile while standing beside her sister Aurora instead. Exiled to the far north, where demons are said to dwell, Carina ventures out to investigate the identity of a disturbing sound and has a fateful encounter in the snow…? A predatory love fantasy between a lady sworn to revenge and a strange girl seeking love! (Source: Comic Seasons, translated)

characters.name: Reshtoka
characters.description: Daughter of the wolf tribe, who dwells in Northern Lands.

title: Rock it, GIRL!!
description: Kaname likes playing her guitar and singing by the streets and can't believe her ears when a strange girl who's actually a music producer suddenly offers her a contract for a debut CD. However she tells Kaname that her voice is completely worthless and that she'll have to debut within a band and just be the guitarist. Furthermore, the vocalist who will sing the songs in her place is an arrogant girl full of herself who immediately starts bullying her; however...

characters.name: Kaname Suzuhara
characters.description: __ A guitarist.

characters.name: Misaki Seira
characters.description: __ A singer.

characters.name: Maggie
characters.description: A producer at Kathy’s Inc.

characters.name: Katsura
characters.description: Bassist.

characters.name: Haruko
characters.description: Drummer.

title: Gal Maid to Akuyaku Reijou: Ojoo-sama no Happy End shika Katan!
title_original: ギャルメイドと悪役令嬢 ～おじょーさまのハッピーエンドしか勝たん！～
description: The gal Selina is reincarnated in the world of an otome game that her otaku friends liked to play! Selina, reincarnated as an anonymous mob character, becomes a maid for the villainess Almeria. In this fantasy yuri romantic comedy, a maid with "previous life: gal" tries her best to make the villainess happy! (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Lilith
description: As far as anyone can tell, Jae-Hee is a shy, hard-working high school teacher. Once she's behind closed doors and drawn curtains, Jae-Hee enjoys spending her time kneeling at the end of a whip. And no one enjoys holding the handle more than her childhood friend, Hui-Lin. But when Sul-Hwa starts her position as a student-teacher at the school, secrets and feelings long buried start to surface. Now, Jae-Hee's about to learn just how much pleasure she can pull from pain. (Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title: Hayancheonsaege Nalgaeneun Eopsda
description: A Catholic school where everything seems tranquil and fine. But for Ayeon, a day doesn't pass without getting bullied until one day, Yeonhwa steps in against the bullies. Ayeon is grateful for Yeonhwa but what she doesn't realize is that there seems to be something more than just good intentions behind that beautiful smile. (Source: Lezhin US)

characters.name: Song-Yi Lee
characters.description: Bullies Ayeon. Is very short.

characters.name: Min-Hye Yang
characters.description: Dahye's older sister.

title: Ingineun Mueonga Jalmotdoeeotda
description: Si-Won Cha is obsessed with his popularity. Having transformed everything from his weight to his demeanor to remake himself into the perfect popular guy, he loves being the center of attention. What happens when he is challenged by over-eager and equally narcissistic rival Da-Un Hyeong? And why does Da-Un somehow think Si-Won has a crush on him?! (Source: Manta)

title: Hoshikuzu Telepath
description: Konohoshi Umika is a high-schooler who is very bad at communicating with others. Feeling almost like an alien trapped on Earth with nowhere to belong, one day she meets a girl who claims to be an actual alien! Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2021 Award in the Print Manga Category.

characters.name: Umika Konohoshi
characters.description: She is a first-year student of Fujino Misaki High School who was unable to make friends due to extreme fright, and she was escaping from reality, thinking that she could express her feelings to aliens living on planets other than Earth. She is extremely frightened and unable to communicate well with others. After meeting [Yu](https://anilist.co/character/300088/Yuu-Akeuchi), they set a goal to build a rocket to reach the stars in space. Her special skill is swimming.

characters.name: Yuu Akeuchi
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Yuu is [Umika's](https://anilist.co/character/288810/Umika-Konohoshi) classmate and a self-proclaimed alien. She has a telepathic ability called "Odekopathy", which allows her to read the thoughts of others by matching her forehead with theirs. She has an abysmal optimism and a bright personality, and she instantly melts away the anxiety and tension of others. She also tends to hate steady effort and studying. With her natural cheerfulness and energy, she can easily open up to her new classmates. Due to a spaceship malfunction, she crash-landed on Earth and possesses a diary written in cosmic language.

characters.name: Honami Konohoshi
characters.description: Honami is Umika's younger sister.

characters.name: Akane Emihara
characters.description: Emihara-sensei is the homeroom teacher of Umika and her friends.

title: Cutey Honey
description: Beautiful but unassuming schoolgirl Kisaragi Honey has a secret–she’s actually an android! Through her father’s amazing technology, she can transform into the unstoppable Cutie Honey. It’s a power that the nefarious criminal organization known as Panther Claw will stop at nothing to possess, even if it means destroying that which Honey loves the most. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Honey Kisaragi
characters.description: Honey Kisaragi is a regular Catholic schoolgirl, until the day her father is murdered by the "Panther Claw" Organization. After his death, she learns she is actually an android created by him and within her is the Fixed System of Air Elements. By saying "Honey Flash!" she can transform into the sword-wielding red-haired superhero, Cutie Honey.

characters.name: Natsuko Aki
characters.description: As with many of the supporting characters in Cutie Honey, Aki has taken on many different roles. In the original manga she is Honey's friend and roommate at the all girls school they go to. In Re: Cutie Honey Aki Natsuko is a lead Investigator for the National Police Security Task Force – Branch 9. She is cold and controlling and is an absolute perfectionist. While she is an exceptional police officer she also has the bad habit of getting “in over her head” into trouble. She is an expert marksman. She tends to wear black a lot and lives alone in a small apartment. She has a passion for Japanese Sake and when she gets drunk loves to sing Karaoke. Hides her beauty by wearing non-prescription eyeglasses.

characters.name: Seiji Hayami
characters.description: Depending on the story Seiji takes on different roles but two things always stay the same, one he has the hots for Honey, and two he is always willing to help her out.

characters.name: Sister Jill
characters.description: From story to story Sister Jill roles slightly differ, sometimes she is leader of Panther Claw and sometimes she is the head subordinate of the mysterious leader of Panther Claw.

characters.name: Panther Zora
characters.description: Panther Zora is a powerful witch who seems to be the head of Panther Claw but all might not be what it seems.

characters.name: Daemon Abashiri
characters.description: Seiji and Junpei's father, Naojiro's uncle in Cutie Honey. He is skilled with martial arts, and ninja-like skills. He becomes quite helpful in battle. He's very old school, and overly dramatic. Danbei acts as a parental figure to Honey. He also appears in UFO Robo Grendizer under the name Danbei Makiba.

characters.name: Tarantula Panther
characters.original: タランチュラパンサー
characters.description: Member of Panther Claw with Spider Abilities.

characters.name: Junpei Hayami
characters.description: Junpei Hayami is the younger brother of Seiji Hayami and son of Danbei Hayami.

characters.name: Alphonne
characters.description: Teacher at St. Chapel Academy who is in love with Honey. In the manga and Universe she is Pochi's lover.

characters.name: Bad Fly Claw
characters.description: Appears in episode 4

title: Love My Life
description: Ichiko Izumiya is a young student of English who would like to walk in the footsteps of her father as a translator of trendy American novels. She finally decides to confess to him that she is in love with Eriko, a law student. Ichiko will attempt to live out her homosexuality in peace and will be brought to wonder about the nature of her relationship: is she really homosexual or simply in love with a sensitive being who happens to be of the same sex?

characters.name: Ichiko Izumiya
characters.description: She studies English in a language school. Her mother grew ill and died 7 years ago, since then she's been living alone with her father.

characters.name: Eriko Joujima
characters.description: She's a student and Ichiko Izumiya's lover. She studies law and wants to become a lawyer.

title: Sayuri-san no Imouto wa Tenshi
title_original: 小百合さんの妹は天使
description: Sayuri-san no Imouto wa Tenshi follows the story of the Kobayashi siblings, Sayuri and her little sister Makoto. Due to a divorce they were seperated 13 years prior to the beginning of the story. One day Makoto suddenly appears near Sayuri's workplace, a flower shop, with wings on her back and a halo above her head. According to Makoto these angelic features were granted to her by god when she asked him to let her see Sayuri. She then begins living in Sayuri's apartment.

title: Kusanagi-sensei wa Tamesareteiru
title_original: 草薙先生は試されている
description: 15 years ago, Kusanagi-sensei gave up her love (♀). Now, her lost love's daughter is her student?! As she wavers under the pressure of her student's relentless attacks, Kusanagi-sensei's (♀/36) era of trial begins! Note: The web release had 360 short chapters that were compiled into 31 longer ones for the physical release.

title: Yuki Nee-chan no Kannou Gokko.
title_original: ゆき姉ちゃんの官能ごっこ。
description: First year Highschool boy Shin Yuki stumbles one day upon his naked childhood friend reenacting a sensual novel with an mannequin in an empty classroom. Yukino Kurose, a third year student, loved to reeanact stories with Yuki's help from books when she was a child, to discover how the characters in the story felt. This time she got herself a sensual novel and asks Yuki to help her out with her reenactment again. Otherwise she'll have to find someone else, because mannequins are not enough. After a quick deliberation Yuki decided to help her out, because he doesn't want anyone else to see her naked

title: Sadon Cheonyeodeul
description: I'm having an affair with my brother's wife. And a girl who I once had a crush on, actually likes my brother. I'm also living with three hot sisters-in-law that make my love life even more complicated. (Source: TOPTOON+, edited) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.name: Hyeong-Su Park
characters.description: Gyu-Tae's younger brother, who grew up hating his older brother.

characters.name: Bo-Yeong Da
characters.description: Gyu-Tae's wife.

characters.name: Bo-Jin Da
characters.description: Bo-Yeong's sister, who works at her brother-in-law's workplace.

characters.name: Bo-Jeong Da
characters.description: Bo-Yeong's sister, who works as a weather broadcaster.

characters.name: Bo-Hye Da
characters.description: Youngest among her sisters, who loves male idols.

characters.name: Eun-Gyeong Jeong
characters.description: Hyeong-Su's first love, who actually had a crush on his brother.

characters.name: Gyu-Tae Park
characters.description: Hyeong-Su's older brother.

title: Toshishita no Senpai
description: Nanasawa is a 25-year-old woman who can't let go of her crush for her high school senpai Sedo. Suddenly, she jumps back in time to 10 years ago! There, Nanasawa finds Sedo back in the second year of high school. Now in order to get together with the girl she loves, Nanasawa's "redo life" begins! A time-slip yuri ecchi comedy! (Source: Yanmaga Web, translated)

title: Ore ga Watashi ni Naru made
description: Serialization of the original doujinshi with the same title Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

characters.name: Akira Fujimiya
characters.description: He used to be a boy before one night, he turned into a girl. Now he struggles with adapting to his new lifestyle as a girl.

title: Kyochuu Rettou
description: Mutsumi Oribe is a high school student who drifts ashore to an island after her plane crashes on its way to a field trip. However, the island has become a nest for giant, carnivorous insects. Can these high school students, who have now become prey to these monsters, escape the hell that is this island?! (Source: Akita Publishing)

characters.name: Atsushi Kamijo
characters.description: Hooligan. He tries to dominate the group with violence, but it doesn't go well with the confluence with Amami and repeated attacks of giant insects. Team up with Misuzu and take a brute force to dominate the group.

characters.name: Ayumi Matsuoka
characters.description: A girl student from softball club with a distinctive jersey and hachimaki. She called "Captain" by Amami. She has physical strength, but little weak mental side. Homosexual.

characters.name: Chitose Naruse
characters.description: Amami's best friend and class chairman. An ace who belongs to the brass band and kendo club. She led a survivor group apart from Amami's group.

characters.name: Mami Miura
characters.description: A 2nd year Houshou Private High School student and an Idol.

characters.name: Kazuhiko Kai
characters.description: A male student with naturally curly hair. He familiar with mechanics and perform power restoration in hospital facilities. Good at lock-picking.

characters.name: Mirei Jinno
characters.description: She is good at leading someone around by the nose and has a physical relationship with male teachers and students. She think that only oneself will survive. Joins forces with Atsushi and takes aggressive measures to dominate the group.

characters.name: Mutsumi Oribe
characters.description: The main character of this work. Enrolled in the first class at Hoho Senior High School. Usually a quiet girl, but good at survival . He is also familiar with the ecology of insects, and when he encounters a giant insect, he quickly responds, but he has no resistance to killing insects. Don't let go of a waterproof rucksack called "Sesame husband" Insect knowledge was learned from Inaho, and was rather weak in the past.

characters.name: Inaho Enoki
characters.description: A woman who made Amami interested in insects. She is a Amami's master and familiar with the ecology of insects. She has a unique naming sense and calls Amami "girl".

characters.name: Ai Inou
characters.description: She belongs to the "Wonder Vogel Club" and works with Chitose to make island maps. Uses "boku" as first-person pronoun. Misuzu calls her “Wonder”.

characters.name: Marika Chuujou
characters.description: A homeroom teacher at Houshou Private High School.

characters.name: Emiko Miyazono
characters.description: A 2nd year Houshou Private High School student.

characters.name: Kayo Suzuki
characters.description: A 2nd year Houshou Private High School student.

title: Hikikomari Kyuuketsuki no Monmon
title_original: ひきこまり吸血姫の悶々
title_en: The Vexations of a Shut-in Vampire Princess
description: Though she was born into a prestigious vampire family, Terakomari Gandesblood, or Komari, is unable to use magic because she refuses to drink blood. After having chosen the life of a professional shut-in, a maid named Villhaze suddenly appears and informs Komari that she has been chosen as the newest General of the Moolnight Empire’s Seventh Battalion (comprising solely of mutinous ruffians)! (Source: Manga UP!)

characters.name: Terakomari Gandesblood
characters.original: テラコマリ・ガンデスブラッド
characters.description: One of the seven Crimson Lords, she is the commander of the 7th unit.

characters.name: Villhaze
characters.description: [Komari](https://anilist.co/character/295878/Gandesblood-Terakomari)'s personal maid, assigned as part of her position as a Crimson Lord.

characters.name: Karen Helvetius
characters.original: カレン・エルヴェシアス
characters.description: Empress of the Mulnite Empire. Hard to read and wanton in nature, she appoints the reclusive [Komari](https://anilist.co/character/295878/Gandesblood-Terakomari) as a Crimson Lord.

characters.name: Sakuna Memoir
characters.description: One of the seven Crimson Lords, she is the commander of the 6th unit.

characters.name: Millicent Bluenight
characters.original: ミリセント・ ブルーナイト
characters.description: A member of the terrorist organization "Inverted Moon".

characters.name: Meruka Tiano
characters.description: Reporter for the Six Countries, a newspaper considered by some to be untrustworthy.

characters.name: Gertrude Rainsworth
characters.original: ガートルード・ レインズワース

characters.name: Belius Cerberus
characters.original: ベリウス・イッヌ・ケルベロ

title: Seiyuu Radio no Uraomote
title_original: 声優ラジオのウラオモテ
title_en: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio
description: Yumiko Sato works as a voice actress with a stage name "Yasumi". She hides that she is a "Gyaru", plays an innocent character in front of the audience. She respects Yuhi Yugure, who is also a voice actress and a highschooler. Yuhi's popularity is on the rise, and she had even done a concert in front of her fans. Yumiko is anxious... it's her second year as a voice actress, and she has to be famous in a year or else she will have to quit this job. One day, she is offered to be a cohost to a weekly radio program with Yuhi Yugure. The director of the program is totally excited... just because he knew that they were classmates! Yumiko couldn't be more surprised--to know that Yuhi Yugure was Chika Watanabe, a grim-looking girl in her class! Note: Originally concluded with 3 volumes and 17 chapters on 2021-07-27, additional serialization started 2023-12-26, in support of the anime.

characters.name: Chika Watanabe
characters.description: She never talks to anyone in class, but when she does open her mouth, she’s incredibly sharp-tongued. An aggressive loner with piercing eyes peering out from behind her long bangs.

title: Ano Koro no Aoi Hoshi
description: One day, a mediocre high school girl, Koumoto Umi, falls in love with Segawa Shou, a beautiful girl in her next class. Although she was confused by her feelings, she wanted to get along with Segawa, who had a mysterious atmosphere somewhere...

title: Kenshi wo Mezashite Nyuugaku Shita noni Mahou Tekisei 9999 Nan desu kedo!?
title_original: 剣士を目指して入学したのに魔法適性9999なんですけど!?
description: Laura who had received special education to be a swordsman from her A-Rank adventurer father since a young age, enters the Royal Capital's Adventurer's school at the age of 9. Laura filled with expectation in her heart in hopes to make many swordsman friends. At the day of the entrance ceremony, Laura's sword aptitude value was measured at 107. Between normal students whose aptitude value is around 50-60, Laura was definitely a sword genius, but the magic aptitude that was measured after that was 9999! Laura was stunned, and while she didn't know what was even happening she was transferred to the Magic Department. Contrary to Laura's will, she exerts her super-genius, and instantly becomes stronger than anyone in the school. Note: Includes two extra chapters.

characters.name: Laura Edmons
characters.description: Daughter of two vanguards who hated magic, Laura was trained by her parents to be a warrior, but even though she has great compatibility with the warrior's division her magic compatibility was 9999 so she was transferred to the magic division.

characters.name: Charlotte Gazad
characters.original: シャーロット・ガザード
characters.description: Friend and rival of Laura, she is proud to be the daughter of a famous family of magicians. She is a genius and has high magic compatibility, between the students she is only below Laura's magic compatibility.

characters.name: Ana Arnet
characters.description: Laura's friend and rival in swordsmanship, she is admitted to the warrior division with scores only below Laura's. She wants to become an adventurer because she wants to earns money quickly. ~! Her parents died in a monster attack when she was still a baby, so she was taken by a local orphanage. The reason why she wanted money quickly is to pay the debts the orphanage has !~

characters.name: Misaki
characters.description: A Beastkin and priestess of the holy beast Haku, after the reincarnation of Haku gets attached with Laura she decides to moves to the capital to keep her duties as a priestess.

characters.name: Haku
characters.description: The holy beast which is worshiped by the beastkins of the Oise Village. When she is close to death she lays an egg and the newborn becomes the new holy beast and inherits the same name. After Haku's egg gets wash down by the river, Laura finds it and the newborn Haku thinks she is her mother.

title: Zhi Nü Xian Jing
description: Despite her notoriety as a tough boss, Ms. Zhou has a soft spot for Zhan Ying. And it's not like Zhan is complaining! On paper, Ms. Zhou is her perfect partner. There's only one problem: nobody in the office can quite nail down whether Ms. Zhou is straight or actually interested in Zhan. Desperate to find the answer for herself, Zhan begins traversing the minefield that is courting her superior. (Source: Tapas)

characters.name: Yuanyou Zhou
characters.description: Zhan Ying's boss.

characters.name: Ying Zhan
characters.description: Ying a massive crush on her boss who seems to pay the most attention to her.

characters.name: Lele Wang
characters.description: Zhan Ying's best friend.

title: Hana to Hina wa Houkago
description: Hana and Hina are two high school girls working at the same character goods shop, but they are completely different from one another. Hana is petite, uncertain and shy, while Hina is tall, confident, and trendy. Yet they share a secret: their school has a strict policy against taking part-time jobs. They also discover that both of them share an irresistible attraction to things that are cute, be it the uniforms at their all-girls’ school or…each other! Just how long will Hana and Hina be able to keep their afterschool jobs, and their feelings for each other, a secret? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Yuri de Naru♥Espoir
title_original: ゆりでなる♥えすぽわーる
description: After finding out she is to be forced into a marriage of convenience as soon as she graduates high school, Kokoro sees her life ending before her eyes at her father's wishes. And so in her final year of high school, she decides to indulge in her love of other women, and create an incredible sketchbook of lesbian romance to leave behind as her legacy. As she observes the young women of her town, she learns more about their desires, their struggles, and the unpredictable whims of love. (Source: TOKYOPOP)

characters.name: Kokoro Komadori
characters.description: A yuri-obsessed high school student from a wealthy and influential family. Her main hobby is daydreaming about romantic situations between women she happens to run into and drawing sketches for her "yuri sketchbook" using these fantasies as foundation. Per her father's decision, after graduation she will enter into arranged marriage with a man who rescued her father's company. Believing this situation to be equal to death, she has decided to spend her 'final moments working on the sketchbook.

characters.name: Amami
characters.description: Kokoro's friend, she is a third-year student and the only other member of the art club along with Kokoro. She collaborates with Yuri Sketchbook to help Kokoro, who is upset about her unwanted engagement. In comparison to Kokoro, she is a beginner at yuri, but this gives her a unique perspective on things.

characters.name: Souya Hanakago
characters.description: Kokoro's fiancée. He saved Kokoro's father's company from being bought out; he is the company director of Cuando Quieras Inc. When she first met him, Kokoro thought he was a "somewhat creepy person." He appears to be attractive, but his face is hidden the majority of the time.

characters.name: Mitsuru Hibari
characters.description: A first-year high school student at Kokoro's school. She joins the art club without hesitation after falling in love with Kokoro at first sight. She might seem to be a carefree, modern high school student, but she is the daughter of a wealthy company president and, like Kokoro, plans to get married after graduation.

characters.name: Yukiya Asahina
characters.description: He is the art club's advisor. He and Souya have been friends since elementary school. He hasn't denied the false rumour that he once inappropriately touched a female student because he thinks that doing so might prevent other students from flirting with him.

title: Furoufushi Shoujo no Naedoko Ryokouki
title_original: 不老不死少女の苗床旅行記
title_en: The Immortal Girl’s Breeding and Cultivation Travelogue ︀︀
description: ︀︀Pluto, a genius young mage, has given herself eternal life and youth in pursuit of her dream: to be a personal breeding ground for all kinds of different species! Brimming with carnal curiosity, she indulges herself with unorthodox creatures and beautiful ladies alike as she lets loose the monster(s) within her. (Source: Yen Press)

title: Onee-sama to Watashi: Ojou-sama ga isekai Tensei
title_original: お姉さまと巨人 ～お嬢さまが異世界転生～
title_en: Sister and Giant: A Young Lady Is Reborn in Another World
description: Reincarnated in another world, Hinako declines the abilities offered to her by the Goddess, and instead takes a vow of sisterhood with the giant Eiris, becoming known herself as “the smallest giant.” The two may be different species, born on different worlds, but they share one goal—searching for the precious siblings they lost. But they must be cautious, for just as their bond and strength win them fame, they also bring attention from the knights of the church… (Source: Yen Press)

title: Sake to Oni wa Ni-gou made
description: Naori Shida is a college student who loves making alcoholic drinks but has no friends to share them with. At a mixer, she meets Hinata Ibuki, who she ends up taking home with her. After making her a drink, Naori discovers that Hinata is an ogre-girl descended from Shuten-doji who needs alcohol to live, can only drink alcohol offered to her by humans, and grows horns whenever she drinks. Thus, Hinata decides to make Naori her personal bartender.

characters.name: Hinata Ibuki
characters.description: An oni who likes to drink.

title: Seolleneun Gibun
description: The story of two people brought together by the fluttering feelings that they know nothing about. Note: Discontinued due to author's death.

characters.name: Seol-A Baek
characters.description: Seol-A is an incredibly beautiful and exceptionally intelligent woman that later develop feelings for Kim No-Rae despite having only boyfriends in the past.

characters.name: So-Seol Kim
characters.description: He is Kim No-Rae's older brother. He works as a doctor in Kyung-Joo and has a daughter named Dong-Hwa.

characters.name: Hye-Gyeong Hwang
characters.description: No-Rae's best friend.

characters.name: Seong-Pyo Gu
characters.description: No-Rae's ex-boyfriend.

title: Dekoboko Majo no Oyako Jijou
title_original: でこぼこ魔女の親子事情
description: A witch who lives alone in the forest picks up a child. 16 years later, she grows up bigger than expected. Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

title: Kyuuketsuki-chan to Kouhai-chan
title_original: 吸血鬼ちゃん×後輩ちゃん
description: Ayafuji Sara transferred to the private Fujigamine Academy. She suffers from extreme blushing and dreamed of making friends at the academy and having an "ordinary student life". However, having met at the scene, Kagen Iris set her eyes on her. Will her dream crumble away? Note: Includes two extras from volume 2 and 3 respectively.

title: Kill Switch
description: “Don’t ever, ever get involved with her.” The warning Jeong Won receives is clear - stay away from Kim Jisoo at all costs. But the thing is, there’s just something so…intriguing about the other woman. Try as she might, Jeong Won can’t seem to tear her eyes away whenever Jisoo Is in the room. One night, Jeong Won misses the bus, and the only way to get home is the back of Jisoo’s motorcycle. It’s a thrilling ride, that’s for sure, but Jeong Won can’t say for certain whether it’s the rushing wind or the woman in front of her that’s making her heart race. As they get closer, Jisoo doesn’t seem like the bully she’s painted to be. Could the warnings have been a lie all along, or is Jeong Won in for the ride of her life…? (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Suicide Parabellum
title_original: スーサイド・パラベラム
description: From the creator of Voynich Hotel, the plot involves the main character chasing down a mysterious girl through various levels.

title: Mahou ga Tsukaenakutemo
description: A collection of stories featuring young adults navigating the workforce and trying to understand romantic relations as their lives are intertwine in unexpected ways. 1. It's nice to be young. [Originally published in the magazine as Dare Datte Skylark (誰だってスカイラーク)]. Kishi works in the anime industry but doesn't really like his job. During one of his regular disappearances, he runs into a rather mischievous cat who follows him home and begins stalking him wherever he goes! 2. Mahou ga Tsukaenakutemo (魔法が使えなくても) 3. Paradise! (パラダイス!) Mayu and Kiki are two middle school girls from Hokkaido who came to Harajuku as part of their school trip. Kiki ends up going to an Idol concert with her otaku friend Mayu. Will the happy-go-lucky Mayu and the left out Kiki be able to take a picture with her idol? 4. Suginami ku Nite (すぎなみくにて) Kishi, who had no hopes or dreams, suddenly quit his job at an anime company. Chiyo, the girl he was interested in, worked there. 5. Sweet Side A 6. Sweet Side B 7. Sweet Side C

characters.name: Tamaki Ookawa
characters.description: ~!Tamaki was revealed to be trans, saying that they are fine with being either a boy or girl.!~

characters.name: Kishi
characters.description: An animator.

title: Sabishisugiru Onna Shachou ga Lesbian Fuuzokujou ni Byou de Ochiru Hanashi
title_original: 寂しすぎる女社長がレズビアン風俗嬢に秒で落ちる話
description: Money, status, fame. She had it all, but it didn't help her loneliness. How can she find fulfillment......? So the lady CEO decided to call on...... "A lesbian prostitute"!? And as soon as they met, she fell in love......? (Source: ComicWalker, translated) Note: Originally published online in 15 chapters, the collected volume consolidated them into four chapters, plus one bonus epilogue chapter.

title: Fu-fu
description: We look into a day of the life of Suu and Kina that have recently moved in together.

characters.name: Kanana Himefuji
characters.description: Kinana's fractionally older twin sister. She is carefree about barging into Kinana's life, to Kinana's annoyance; it's revealed that she even had a spare key made for Kinana and Sumi's apartment without the couple's knowledge. She's a clothing designer by trade. With her charming appeal, she is shown capable of swooning most other women effortlessly. This has led to a life of mostly casual relationships. When Hotori Shirayuki doesn't immediately fall to her advances, she believes she is losing her edge. ~!It is revealed her preferences for other women stem back to a crush she developed as a child, onto her caretaker. Remembering this led her to remember what it was like to want to pursue a relationship, rather than to always be the pursued. With a new sense of determination, she is able to enter a steady, one-partner relationship with Hotori.!~

characters.name: Hayase Oomori
characters.description: One of Kinana and Sumi's next door neighbors. She lives together with Ogasawara Komugi, whom she is in a romantic relationship with. She is the carefree and socially honest half of the couple. Her job as an animal beautician sometimes leaves her with a physically roughed up appearance, leading to at least one instance where someone mistook her bandages as evidence of possible domestic abuse.

characters.name: Komugi Ogasawara
characters.description: One of Kinana and Sumi's next door neighbors. She lives together with Oomori Hayase, whom she is in a romantic relationship with. She is the aggressive and socially hostile half of the couple. When embarrassed by Oomori, she often attacks her physically but she controls herself to the point of never actually doing physical damage.

characters.name: Shirayuki Hotori
characters.description: A college student, who works part time at a bakery. She is the first woman to not immediately fall to Kanana's advances. ~!When Kanana shows her a stronger effort into pursuing a relationship, the two begin dating exclusively.!~

title: Boku wa Ohimesama ni Narenai
title_original: 僕はお姫様になれない
description: Shindou Rei (Cinderella) comes from a very poor family. Her only clothes are hand-me-downs from her brother, even her school uniform. So everyone always mistakes her for a boy. Even her close friend Hakuba Ouji (white horse prince), who starts developing confusing feelings toward her all the while believing she’s a boy. Tsukumo Yuki (Snow White) is the leader of a delinquent gang and falls in love with Rei at first sight, also believing her to be a boy.

characters.name: Rei Shindou
characters.description: She is often mistaken for a boy because she goes to school with a male school uniform which was a hand-me-down from her brother due to financial issues.

characters.name: Yuki Tsukumo
characters.description: A yankee.

title: Shiroi Heya no Futari
description: Resine, a rich girl whose parents died in an accident, leaves her selfish relatives in order to attend the boarding school that her mother went to. Once there, she meets her roommate Simone, a blunt, rude troublemaker and the kind of girl Resine would rather do without knowing. However, she finds herself strangely drawn to Simone nonetheless, and the turns their relationship takes could be dangerous for them both. Note: Also includes the one shots Tooi Sanbika (遠い讃美歌) and Mizu no Naka no Sora (水の中の空)

characters.name: Resine de Poisson
characters.original: レシーヌ・ド・ポアッソン
characters.description: The blonde, doll-like "good" girl Resine is a orphaned who decides, against her aunt's wishes, to attend the same boarding school as her mother. She finds it difficult to fit herself into the life of the school. Resine must also share a room with Simone, the rebellious daughter of a famous actress. Simone does not make Resine feel welcome, and Simone takes advantage of every chance she gets to cause trouble. Simone copies Resine's homework, and teases Resine every time she cries. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Simone d'Arc
characters.description: She's a rebellious girl who smokes and drinks. Simone is very rude to Resine, but she ends up falling in love with her later on.

title: Ishuzoku Joshi ni ○○ Suru Hanashi
description: The only human student at an all-girl school is on a mission to sexually harass monster girls. Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title: Samayoeru Tenseishatachi no Revival Game
title_original: さまよえる転生者たちのリライブルゲーム
description: When "Nice Guy" Asai Manatsu's marriage proposal gets rejected, he thinks his day can't get any worse, until a Knight in Skull helmet tries to kill him! He's saved by a beautiful, silver-haired swords-woman and told to flee, but his nice guy impulses are too strong and he saves her from an attack, getting himself killed in the process. As he dies he wishes to be reborn in a world where people won't judge him for taking care of others...

characters.name: Manatsu Asai
characters.description: **Skill:** Omni-Proficient

characters.name: Kikyou Amagahara
characters.original: キキョウ・アマガハラ
characters.description: **Class:** Raider

characters.name: Percival Lancaster
characters.original: パーシヴァル・ランカスター
characters.description: **Class:** Paladin

title: Himenospia
description: Abused like a slave by everyone at school, and battered by the single mother she lives with at home… That was the girl’s, Endou Himeno’s, everyday life. However one day, a ‘wasp’ that stung the girl, changed her fate. Her fate, and that of humanity… Piercing the ‘species’ known as humanity, a thrilling insect suspense story begins!

characters.name: Himeno Endou
characters.description: Himeno Endou is the main character of Himenospia.

characters.name: Rie Haraguchi
characters.description: The head of research at Fujimoto Institute of Biological Science.

characters.name: Rushia Adachi
characters.description: A popular stewardess who is known as the Queen of Ginza.

characters.name: Adachi Mizu
characters.description: An unpleasant, "allergic to kindness" girl who enrolls at Himenospia

title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon: Kanna no Nichijou
title_original: 小林さんちのメイドラゴン カンナの日常
title_en: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Kanna's Daily Life
description: After leaving her otherworldly home to find her fellow dragon, Tohru, young Kanna found herself unofficially adopted by Tohru and her human companion, Miss Kobayashi. From attending elementary school to making new friends, Kanna learns to adjust to the human world with the curiosity and cuteness that only a young dragon could have! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Riko Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Georgie Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120978/Georgie-Saikawa) (older sister) Riko Saikawa is [Kanna's](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui) friend and classmate in elementary school. A running gag involves her becoming overwhelmingly flushed with bliss every time she and Kanna make physical contact, along with her shiny forehead. At first glance, Riko seems bossy and mean, but over time, she seems nicer as shown with Kanna, and very polite around people like [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi), although she originally mistook Kobayashi for Kanna's mother. She has a crush on Kanna and enjoys being around her. When being touched by Kanna or when she receives praise from her, she tends to grin goofily and get red in the face, becoming overwhelmed with excitement. Though she initially tries to pick a fight with Kanna for her sudden p

characters.name: Kanna Kamui
characters.description: [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970)'s friend from the dragon realm who got exiled from her world and wound up living with [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969) as well. She is very young by dragon standards, equivalent to a primary school student, which she attends as a third-year student bearing Kobayashi's surname later in the series. She initially assumes that Kobayashi seduced Tohru into staying and wanted her to return to their original world. ~!She grows attached to Kobayashi as the series progresses, viewing her as a mother figure.!~ Kanna's basis and tribal attire are inspired by the culture of the indigenous natives of Hokkaido and claims to be from Ushishir. She bears feather-like horns and a thin tail ending in a bulb, and is capable of charging with electricity.

characters.name: Kobayashi
characters.description: Kobayashi is a computer programmer and office worker. She finds herself living with a dragon named [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). Even though Kobayashi maintains a cool demeanor, she has been regarded as kind-hearted and reliable among her friends and colleagues. Level-headed and pragmatic, she stands as the source of reason when dealing with her dragon friends. However, when intoxicated, she tends to become rowdy and aggressive, especially in her interests in maids, and is not above subjecting Tohru to her drunken whims. Before meeting Tohru, Kobayashi would don a stoic expression on her face. Now, she is more approachable and open to others, often seen smiling contentedly. Kobayashi often chastised Tohru for her lack of propriety on human standards. However, as time passes by, she grows accustomed to Tohru's quirks and would sometimes show small signs of affection

characters.name: Tohru
characters.description: __Faction__: Chaos __Relatives__: [Damocles](https://anilist.co/character/172721/Damocles) (father) Tohru is a female dragon with the ability to transform into a human girl. After [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) rescues her, she falls in love with her and decides to work for her as a maid. As a Chaos Dragon, Tohru was raised to hate humans and was supposed to be a fierce and dangerous force of evil with nothing other than destruction in mind. However, this all changed when she met Kobayashi. She is now cheerful and kind to every human she meets, except for those who are real, or as it is in most cases, imaginary, threats to her love interest Kobayashi (such as [Makoto Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Makoto-Takiya)). She is also quickly influenced by what she sees on television or the internet and shares a fiery relationship with her rival, [Elma](ht

characters.name: Fafnir
characters.description: An old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru), he is a male dragon with a strong distrust for humans which leads to him questioning much of Tohru's actions and ideals in his earlier appearances. He shares some resemblance to the traits of his namesake, such as his cold demeanour and disdainful mentality. He appears as a refined young man with long black hair and red eyes in his human form. ~!After Tohru's attempts to find a place to stay for him (under the name Takeshi Ooyama), Fafnir eventually comes to live with [Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Takiya-Makoto), becoming obsessed with video games and popular culture.!~

characters.name: Shouta Magatsuchi
characters.description: __Relatives:__ [Mr. Magatsuchi](https://anilist.co/character/248474) (father), Saori Magatsuchi (mother) Shouta Magatsuchi is a young boy born into a family of mages in the modern world. He has shown to possess enough knowledge on the arcane arts to attempt summoning a demon. [Lucoa](https://anilist.co/character/120975) came out of a summoning portal Shouta created and starts living with him. Shouta is an elementary school boy in 5th grade with both purple hair and eyes. His bangs reach well below his eyebrows. His appearance looks partly androgynous. Shouta is quiet and shy most of the time when seen with Lucoa. When Lucoa attempts to seduce Shouta, he would run away with embarrassment and accuse Lucoa of being a demon. As his father is [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s manager, she's asked to look after Shouta at times.

characters.name: Quetzalcoatl
characters.description: **Faction**: Spectation Quetzalcoatl often referred to as Lucoa, is a former dragon goddess and an old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). She was exiled from her seat after consuming cursed liquor that led her into a scandalous affair. As a member of the spectating faction, she does not interfere with any events involving the dragons or gods. She's by far the most powerful dragon in the series. Quetzalcoatl appears to be laid-back and carefree who is rarely seen without a smile. She is wise, kind, and nurturing who often has advice for her younger kin. As a former goddess, she is better tuned to human customs, as seen when she explains to Tohru why Kobayashi was not receptive to Tohru's initial cleaning regimen. Despite this, however, Lucoa seems to lack some sense of dignity severely. She is not above using her body as a means of getting what she wants, as sho

characters.name: Makoto Takiya
characters.description: [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s co-worker who is initially believed by [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) to be a rival for Kobayashi's affections, but is really just an otaku who likes to talk about maids with her. Kobayashi helps him set up during Comiket every year. ~![Fafnir](https://anilist.co/character/120971) eventually decides to live with him to stay in the human world.!~

characters.name: Elma
characters.description: **Faction**: Harmony Elma is a female dragon from the Harmony faction, the opposing faction of Chaos, which [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) belongs to. She adopts the name Elma Joui as her human alias after she finds that she is unable to return to her world. Elma is the only dragon of the main cast who lives on her own in the human world. Elma usually takes the form of a human woman with short black hair, large breasts, blue eyes, and a long spiral unicorn-like horn (which she can freely hide). In the anime and [Elma’s Office Lady Diary](https://anilist.co/manga/100756/Miss-Kobayashis-Dragon-Maid-Elmas-Office-Lady-Diary/), her hair also has purple tips. At work, she wears round glasses. She also wears a business suit which consists of a white shirt, light blue tie, a loose blue sweater, a grey blazer, and a dark grey knee-length skirt with light grey socks and black h

characters.name: Georgie Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Riko Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120972/Riko-Saikawa) (younger sister), unnamed parents Georgie Saikawa is the older sister of Riko Saikawa. Her real name is Nae Saikawa (才川苗). She likes to pretend to be a housemaid. Georgie wears an orange polka-dot maid outfit with a white apron. She also has a white cap and has her red hair in twin-pigtails. Her stockings are black striped. Georgie is a sweet and gentle lady. She always supports Riko and her family. She seems to know a lot about maids and has a huge passion for them. She mentions that she's wanted to be one since she was a kid when she read a book about maids, but no one accepted her job offers, so decided to be one for her family. Georgie and [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) automatically have a close bond as they both share an interest in maids. [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character

characters.name: Ilulu
characters.description: Ilulu is a female dragon who belongs to the Chaos Faction. Originally, she came to [Kobayashi's](https://anilist.co/character/120969) world to destroy [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) and then tries to drive Kobayashi away from Tohru. After a change of heart, she begins to live with Kobayashi as her third dragon resident. She has a caring personality and loves children. Later on, her personality leads her to taking over the running of a candy store from an old lady, who's looking for her replacement.

title: Yoarashi ni Warau
description: Class 2-C Homeroom Teacher, Ogino, is persecuted by her class. As part of her daily routine, she writes letters to a student who doesn't come to school, about her hopes for her ideal class. She filled the letters with lies to protect her mental image. Then one day, she receives a letter from the student; Yoarashi has come to school. While Ogino is anxious about her lies being exposed, Yoarashi tells her, "I came to help you, Ms. Ogino." Thus, beginning their "education!" (Source: MANGA MILLION)

characters.name: Ogino
characters.description: Ogino is the homeroom teacher of class 2-C and teaches biology. Her students relentlessly bully her.

characters.name: Kinu Yoarashi
characters.description: Yoarashi is a truant student in Ogino's class.

title: Nega Eopseosseumyeon Jokesseo
description: Chrissy—Chrysanthemum—Han met the love of her life as she hit rock bottom. Her boyfriend cheated with another woman and, worst of all, she was cute! When the other woman decides to pay off the debt of Chrissy's ex boyfriend, Chrissy can't help but slowly fall for her. Can a love like this last or will she wish she was gone like all the rest? (Source: Tapas)

characters.name: Jae-Hee Kim
characters.description: Kim Jaehee co-worker and a very close friend of Guk-Hwa in the same company. Is a shy girl with weak and humble personality. Admires Guk-Hwa since the very first day she saw her because of her bravery.

title: Kanojo ni Naru Hi: Another
description: Sagara becomes a girl in his third year of middle school, and has to deal with his crush on Kurosawa, a female classmate. Note: Includes 7 extra chapters

characters.name: Haruyuki Sagara
characters.description: Rinichi Sagara's uncle.

characters.name: Miki Mamiya
characters.description: Younger sister of [Nao Mamiya](https://anilist.co/character/126972) and childhood friend of [Yuu Narumi](https://anilist.co/character/126969).

title: Okiku-san wa Icha Tsukitai
title_original: お菊さんはいちゃ憑きたい
description: Okiku, an evil spirit that terrorized many during the Edo era, has been reborn after 360 years. Modern exorcists are helpless against its power, so they tried to negotiate. "You can have anything you want, if you will spare the lives of the common people." "In that case, I will take that pretty girl over there!" An occult yuri comedy between a beautiful girl exorcist and a slightly naughty evil spirit! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

characters.name: Ryouyo Hijiri
characters.description: She takes pride in her role as an exorcist and treats the spirits as equals, helping them to move on peacefully to the afterlife, no matter what kind of spirit she is dealing with. The resurrected Okiku haunts her.

characters.name: Okiku
characters.description: One of Japan's three great demons. She escapes after being sealed away for 360 years, and decides to haunt Ryouyo so she can flirt with a beautiful girl.

characters.name: Otsuyu
characters.description: One of Japan's three great demons. She takes on the look of a gyaru to fit in with the modern era.

characters.name: Oiwa
characters.description: One of Japan's three great demons. Her only wish after being resurrected is to live a peaceful life filled with manga, anime, and games.

characters.name: Meguru Hoshimi
characters.description: Ryouyo's first and only friend in highschool. She can partially sense spirits.

title: Shinozaki-san Ki wo Ota Shika ni!
title_original: 篠崎さん気をオタしかに!
description: With her beautiful looks and outgoing personality, Shinozaki Akina used to be the leader of a group of hotties on the top of the class hierarchy. After her high school debut was delayed, however, she finds herself isolated in the class. Next to Akina sits Sasamura Kaede, an otaku girl who can turn into a bishoujo when her glasses are off. Akina decides to get Kaede out of the otaku life and groom her for a perfect high school life, but the only way to get close to Kaede is for Akina to pretend to be a Precure otaku herself, much to her chagrin... Note: chapter count includes 8 extras from the volume releases

characters.name: Akina Shinozaki
characters.description: Akino pretends to be an otaku, only to change Kaede into the friend she wants, and occasionally, Akino starts to 'drift' onto the 'Otaku Side.' Akino becomes more and more determined to change Kaede, but as their relationship grows, she starts to question the objectives of her devious plans, and if bringing them to fruition is what her heart truly desires.

characters.name: Makoto Shinozaki
characters.description: Makoto is Akina's older brother and an otaku. Akina has an extremely negative perception of him, regularly calling him "gross," even though he is actually considerate and kind. Unbeknownst to either of them, the two bond in an online MMO, with Makoto giving useful life advice to his sister. He is a university student and is popular with many of Akina's friends, much to her exasperation.

title: she is beautiful
description: Esaka's original story centers on Kurumi, a girl who grew up in an institution, and is excited on the eve of her 10th birthday, when her vocation will be announced to her. But when she awakens, she is already 22 years old, and she is somehow living with Kiyoka, a friend with whom she did not get along too well in the past. She finds out that on the day of her 10th birthday, she had an accident, and she began to suffer from a condition that only lets her hold memories one day at a time, and that 12 years had passed since then. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Mizuno to Chayama
description: Mizuno, the daughter of a mayoral candidate, is desperate to escape the suffocating pressure and scrutiny of smalltown life. Chayama, the heiress of the tea company Chayama-en, is adamantly walking down the path laid out for her, despite being forced to atone for her family’s apparent misdeeds. Yet in the bubble of the school’s third floor guidance counseling room-away from rumors, watchful eyes, and their feuding families-they’re simply Mizuno and Chayama, two teenagers who find comfort and hope in each other. But when the outside world tries to tear them apart, the two must find a way to protect their relationship and, more importantly, themselves… (Source: Yen Press)

title: Amaesasete Hinamori-san!
description: Ichigo Hinamori has always looked up to her senpai Yaya Suou for her poise, impeccable grades, and kind heart. But that all changes the day Ichigo stumbles upon Yaya wailing like a little kid in the nurse’s office. It turns out everyone’s favorite honor student is desperate to get off her pedestal and be spoiled rotten instead—and now she’s hoping Ichigo will be the one to indulge her! (Source: Kodansha USA) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title: Ane no Yuujin
description: At the age of 14, her first lover was her sister's former best friend, Kyoko. It was a time where Noriko would meet Kyoko after school and be thrilled by the smell of her adult perfume and enchanting eyes, nothing like spending time with her boring classmates. But why did Kyoko and her sister stop being friends in the first place? This is the story of three women and their discovery of what true "love" entails. Note: The chapter count includes two bonus chapters from the physical release.

title: Toutoi. 4P Short Stories
title_original: 尊い。 4Pショート・ストーリーズ
description: A volume collection of sweet, short and fun 4 pages manga for everyone to enjoy and adore.

title: Muryoku Seijo to Munou Oujo: Maryoku Zero de Shoukan Sareta Seijo no Isekai Kyuukoku-ki
title_original: 無力聖女と無能王女～魔力ゼロで召喚された聖女の異世界救国記～
description: In this thrilling yuri fantasy, Nana’s just out of college, trying to make her way on a series of part-time jobs, when she finds herself whisked away from her bedroom into a parallel world of magic! To her shock, she’s told that she is the great Saintess who will bring peace and prosperity to the whole country. Except for one tiny problem—she soon discovers she has absolutely zero magical power—none! To make matters worse, the princess she’s been summoned to serve with can’t cast even a single spell. A Saintess with no magic power, and a princess who can’t use her own—a pair of failures, doomed to become a laughingstock…or a partnership that might deepen into something more? (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Haru Tsuzuru, Sakura Saku Kono Heya de
title_original: 春綴る、桜咲くこの部屋で
description: On her first day of university, Haruki had a fateful encounter with Sakura in the lecture hall. They were attracted to each other and lived together after graduation, but suddenly they had to part ways. Sakura had disappeared from this world. Five years have passed since then, and it is the fifth cherry blossom season. Haruki, who was still in a state of grief, happened to find a diary. It was the unfinished diary written by Sakura.

characters.name: Haruki Kawaragi
characters.description: She met Karin Sakura at the university entrance ceremony on Orientation Day, and they fell in love and started living together. ~!Sakura died unexpectedly 5 years ago, and Haruki hasn't been able to forget her.!~

characters.name: Sakura Karin
characters.description: She met Haruki and fell in love ten years ago during their university entrance ceremony. Sakura approached Haruki assertively and they started dating. ~!They began living together while they were both still in college, and they shared many happy moments until Sakura passed away five years ago.!~

title: Éclair: Anata ni Hibiku Yuri Anthology
title_original: エクレア あなたに響く百合アンソロジー
title_en: Éclair: A Girls' Love Anthology That Resonates in Your Heart
description: Full of beating hearts and fluttering feelings, this anthology of girls' love stories will leave you breathless. With contributors like Canno (Kiss and White Lily for My Dearest Girl), Sakuya Amano (Gosick), and Nio Nakatani (Bloom into You), this collection is sure to satisfy the desire for a sweet love story (or sixteen!). (Source: Yen Press) A collection of yuri one-shots by various authors. Cover illustration: Nakatani Nio #Illustration : Non #Illustration : Hiiragi Yutaka #Illustration : Minakata Sunao 1. Shiawase wa Kizu no Katachi (幸せは傷のかたち), Nakatani Nio 2. Clean Room no Namida (クリーンルームの涙), Nishio Shiori 3. Ningen teki na Emotion (人間的なエモーション), Amano Shuninta 4. intro. (intro.), Harumi Chihiro 5. Mushoku to JK (無職とJK), Canno 6. Kamiyui (かみゆい), Isaki Uta 7. Hakoniwa no Alice (箱庭のアリス), Amano Sakuya 8. 1/365 no Goshujin-sama (1/365のご主人様), Mekimeki 9. 2 Nen to 11 Kagetsu (2年と11か月), Kabocha 10. GAME OVER (GAME OVER), Tadano Kagekichi 11. Watashi no Kawaii Kuso Onna (私のかわいいクソ女), Kawanami Izumi 12. Zassou Hanashi (雑草譚), Yuikawa Kazuno 13. Futari de Ringo wo (二人で林檎を), Kitao Taki 14. Usagi no Bell to Ookami-san (うさぎのベルとオオカミさん), Itou Hachi 15. Kimi no Jinx (キミのジンクス), Takada Fumiko 16.

title: Renjian Baili Jin
description: Baili Jin, a fairy who was living in heaven, eating and drinking without a care, broke her Majesty’s colourful, stained-glass plate at her birthday and got banished to the mortal realm. Now she has to begin her adventures in the mortal realm with all of her spiritual powers gone! In order to survive, the former fairy has to deliver take-out.... An endearingly silly fairy, a gentle restaurant manager, a reserved top student, and a hard to resist two-faced girl, let the story of their beautiful friendship and youthful days begin! (Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Lucky Paradise
description: One very lucky morning, Ho-In accidentally bumps into Chun-Woo on his way sprinting full speed to class. To Ho-In's dismay, he also manages to spray pickle juice all over him later the same day. Ho-In follows Chun-Woo to his place to make up for his mistakes, but somehow wakes up in Chun-Woo's bed the next morning... Leading to one lucky (?) encounter after another! (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Tsuki to Suppin
description: When they’re on their sugar-sweet dates, Akari’s always dressed to the nines in the cutest, trendiest fashion… meanwhile, her dear Shiho always looks like she just rolled out of bed. Despite their differences, both of them are alike in exactly one thing – they want their girlfriend to be the happiest woman in the world! (Source: Manga Planet)

characters.name: Akari
characters.description: A cheerful and hardworking woman

characters.name: Shiho
characters.description: A shy and quiet woman that truly loves her girlfriend.

title: Watashi no Kawaii Koneko-chan
title_original: 私の可愛い子猫ちゃん
description: Rena and Yuna have been roommates since school, and decided to rent a place together after graduation. They’ve lived together as friends for five years, but things suddenly change the day Yuna adopts a kitten, even though their apartment doesn’t allow pets. When Yuna says she wants to move somewhere that will allow them to keep the kitten, Rena admits her true feelings: she wants to be more than friends. Yuna isn’t sure how to reciprocate, but she’s game to try! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kemokko Dobutsuen!
title_original: けもっ娘どーぶつえん
description: In order to save The Paradise Island Zoo that has lost all but the female animals, the Director has made it so when night falls, all the animals turn into cute girls! It's up to Taneda to mate with all of them and save the zoo!

title: trash.
description: The boss of the Iwashi yakuza gang is a high school girl named Minoko Konomi. But don’t let her appearance fool you; she has done and seen things normal citizens can’t even imagine. Under her control are two assassins who have gained legendary status for their deadliness and ability to get any job done. Lucia Ishikawa, codenamed Bullet, uses a modified handgun that uses a custom made hollow point bullet that explodes the target from the inside. Maine Shirato, codenamed Francesca, uses a original weapon that is a mix between a throwing axe and battle axe. Both of them are Minoko’s high school classmates and seem like normal teenagers but are two of the most feared killers in the underworld who take on missions often involving other assassins and underground groups.

characters.name: Minoko Konomi
characters.description: Minoko is a high school girl and 6th generation head of the Kantou-Iwashi yakuza family. She is Lucia and Maine's employer and takes her job as the head of the family very seriously.

characters.name: Lucia Ishikawa
characters.description: Lucia is Maine's partner. She is a brutal assassin that is working under the employment of Iwashi family, and tries to protect Maine with her life. (Source: MyAnimeList) Her weapon is a specialized gun that can blow up the insides of someone.

characters.name: Maine Shirato
characters.description: Maine is Lucia's partner in crime. She loves to take care of people that have been abandoned. For example, she has taken in Hiroshi (a stray child), a stray kitty, and Soo In (a girl who was sold off by her father). Maine has problems about her past in which she was abandoned herself, and that makes her want to protect everyone else who is abandoned. She works under the Iwashi family and is partners with Lucia, which codes names Francesca and Bullet, respectively. Her weapon of choice are two sharp and weirdly-shaped axes. Her body is made out of carbon steel which is why she has many stitches along her arms and her legs. In addition to her body modifications, her teeth are also made out of boron nitrate, making her bites very deadly. (Source: MyAnimeList)

characters.name: Nichimo Aikouchi
characters.description: Member of the Trigger Happies squad who attempted an assassination on Konomi Minoko's life during school. ~!A cross-dressing boy.!~

title: Qin Ai De Siduitou
description: Everyone in the company knows those two women as fierce competitors who fight all the time. But at the company new year's party, they managed to break the ice after a few too many drinks! After that accidental encounter, the sworn enemies begin to have strange feelings about each other… (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

characters.name: Aoqing Shen
characters.description: Shen Aoqing is the marketing director at the company.

characters.name: Xue Jiang
characters.description: Jiang Xue is the operations director at the company.

title: Shouwaru Tensai Osananajimi to no Shoubu ni Makete Hatsu Taiken wo Zenbu Ubawareru Hanashi
title_original: 性悪天才幼馴染との勝負に負けて初体験を全部奪われる話
title_en: Farewell, My Firsts: How My Heartless Childhood Friend Stole All My First Experiences One Bet at a Time
description: "I hate her. She says she hates me. Then why am I drawn to her......?" A love story of a delivlish girl who's too smart and an ordinary girl who hates losing! Komaki is Wakaba's oldest friend from her childhood. She is kind, athletic, smart...people even call her "a flawless beauty." However, Wakaba knows her real personality...evil, cruel, looks down on people. Wakaba wanted to show her that she is not special. They made a bet...the one who got the higher score in their midterm wins. The bet was Wakaba's idea, but it was Komaki's idea to put their dignity on the line. Wakaba lost. Komaki declared that on every bet after this, she will get to have Wakaba's precious things...first experiences. She asked for Wakaba's first kiss...then... Wakaba hates Komaki, but whenever she loses, she finds a new side of her feelings. What is this feeling...? And why does Komaki wants her so badly? (Source: Kadokawa)

title: Itsuwari no Marigold
title_original: 偽りのマリィゴールド
description: Kasumi Hana visits her late brother's pen pal, Urushizawa Lily, to inform her of his death. If she had been misleading her brother, she would have murdered Urushizawa Lily. However, Lily is a blind girl who genuinely cared about Hana's brother. For Lily's sake, Hana decides to become her brother.

characters.name: Hana Kasumi
characters.description: To avoid making Lily upset, she plays the role of her late brother Kaoru.

characters.name: Lily Urushizawa
characters.description: A blind girl who was Kaoru's pen pal.

title: Naraku no Futari
description: The bullied girl in class Sakura Rin and the honor student who doesn't want to make any waves, Komine Yuuya, were classmates and haven't once exchanged words with each other. Everything between them changes when Yuuya goes with the flow around him and tells her to go die. Rin jumps from the classroom window. She escapes death and claims that it was Yuuya's fault. The bewildered Yuuya tells Rin that he'll do anything as he begs for forgiveness. Rin tells him that what she wishes for is love. Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title: Goblin wa Mou Juubun ni Tsuyoi
title_original: ゴブリンはもう十分に強い
description: A goblin reached level 99... and now she keeps killing heroes. Note: Includes two extra chapters.

characters.name: Honwasabi
characters.description: A goblin who stumbled upon a dying hero and finished him off, gaining a level. She then stumbled upon another. Then another. Then another... This happened enough times that she was able to reach level 99. She's now considered on par with the Demon Lord in strength. Her goal is to live life like a goblin.

title: Rock wa Lady no Tashinami Deshite
title_original: ロックは淑女の嗜みでして
description: When her mother marries into high society, Lilisa Suzunomiya is forced to leave her commoner ways behind. Now enrolled at an elite all-girls academy, she’s expected to smile politely, sip tea, and hang up her beloved guitar for (ugh…) a violin. But when she hears drums echoing from the old school building, Lilisa is dragged into a jam session with the secretly rebellious young lady Otoha Kurogane, and her passion for music is reignited! High society better watch out—the academy’s most demure maidens are teaming up to form an elegant rock band the likes of which the world has never seen! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Lilisa Suzunomiya
characters.description: Lilisa was formerly from a commoner background. [Her mother](https://anilist.co/character/366741/Yuka-Suzunomiya) remarried Suzunomiya Tadashi, a real estate magnate in Kanto. She hides the fact that she was from a commoner background who liked rock and guitar only a month ago, and pretends to be a first-class lady, becoming the object of envy at school.

characters.name: Otoha Kurogane
characters.description: Beautiful and well mannered, she is the daughter of Kijuro Kurogane of the Kurogane family, which has produced many prime ministers since the Meiji era and whose influence extends to politics and business. She is a drummer.

characters.name: Tamaki Shiraya
characters.description: Tamaki is a 2nd year student at a sister school to Oushin Girls' Academy. She's well known as a skilled guitarist in her local area and repeatedly refuses offers to join bands. She is also [Otoha's](https://anilist.co/character/344565/Otoha-Kurogane) childhood friend.

characters.name: Tina Isemi
characters.description: Tina is a 2nd year student at Oushin Girls' Academy. She's referred to as Oushin's Prince due to her tall and androgynous appearance. In actuality, she has low self confidence and acts the way other people want her to be, and she wants to change that about herself.

characters.name: Alice Suzunomiya
characters.description: [Lilisa's](https://anilist.co/character/344566/) step-sister.

characters.name: Yuka Suzunomiya
characters.description: [Lilisa's](https://anilist.co/character/344566/Lilisa-Suzunomiya) mother.

title: Sylph no Hanahime
description: Natalia lost her family, and succeeded the throne to be the King of Ventfleur. She was known as the princess blessed by the spirits--people loved her. However, she was deep in her grief… the only thing that comforted her now was "Sylphide", the holy sword blessed by the wind spirit Sylph. The sword marked her succession to the throne, and it was said that the wielder could see the memories of the past kings by touching the sword. However, Natalia couldn't see anything… although she felt better by holding onto it. One day, a nun named Sara came to her and told her that she will make her healthy. Natalia rejected her first, but Sara won't give up. She was worried about Natalia, but also had a reason she must be by her side. (Source: Kadokawa) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

characters.name: Natalia
characters.description: Queen of the Imperial City of Van Fleur. She relies on the royal sword for emotional and spiritual support.

characters.name: Sara Lumière
characters.description: A nun from the royal capital. She approaches [Natalia](https://anilist.co/character/308677/Natalia) with a bright, mysterious smile, but for what purpose?

characters.name: Lewis
characters.description: The late king of the imperial city of Van Fleur. He had a very close relationship with his sister, Natalia.

title: Eyi Qianjin Yu Mowang Xiaojie
title_en: The Villainess and Miss Demon Lord
description: Transmigrated as the doomed villainess Aida Mortemer, Yao faces a peculiar challenge in a magical world. Enrolled in a magic academy without magical abilities, her plans to charm the main characters are slightly derailed when she encounters the demon lord's reincarnation. Desperate to survive and avoid her painful demise, Aida also befriends the formidable Miss Demon Lord, only to find her behavior increasingly...odd? Can Aida navigate this magical minefield and get these characters on her side? (Source: Tapas) Note: Includes 8 extra chapters.

title: Otome Danshi ni Koisuru Otome
title_original: 乙女男子に恋する乙女
description: Mayu Minakuchi, a girl who hates men, fell in love at first sight with a... "man-in-drag"!? Does she likes "girls"? Or does she likes "boys"? Find out in this heart throbbing pure love comedy! Note: Includes 7 extra chapters.

characters.name: Mayu Minakuchi
characters.description: A 15 year old girl who's afraid of men but may have accidentally fallen in love with one.

title: Ryuu to Yuusha to Haitatsunin
title_en: The Dragon, the Hero, and the Courier
description: Yoshida, a rookie half-elf courier, struggles day after day with troublesome assignments. Faced with stubborn mages, motley townsfolk swarming around the hero’s party, and corrupt forest wardens, can she safely carry out her duties? This fantasy tale does not concern heroes nor sages, but nameless working folk. Let the stories of the struggles of ordinary laborers unfold! (Source: MANGA MILLION)

characters.name: Yoshida
characters.description: Half-Elf worker at Idazig post office

title: Hae-Gu
description: Hae-Gu, a proficient and merciless hitwoman, executes a man in front of his own daughter and takes the child under her wing. She decides to name her Mian, the word for "sorry" in Korean, and gives her one mission: "Kill me when you can." From that moment on, Mian decides that she will do this by choking Hae-Gu with feigned love and emotionally manipulating her into submission. But as Mian grows into an adult, she's thrown into confusion as what was supposed to be pure revenge turns into lust... and possibly real love. Meanwhile, Hae-Gu grapples with her own feelings for Mian while continuing to carry out life-threatening missions. Can Hae-Gu and Mian ever learn to truly love each other, or are they doomed to drown in their toxic cycle of violence and revenge? (Source: Tappytoon, edited)

characters.name: Hae-Gu
characters.description: A proficient and merciless hitwoman.

title: Kunoichi no Ichi!
description: On a school trip to shinobi-themed Ninjatown, a young man named Ichi Kuno accidentally springs a mystical ninja trap which sends him back to the Age of the Ninja.
