Having no other path, he must pose as a girl and infiltrate an Kurenai Academy, a school of kunoichi students, to retrieve a mystical scroll that can return him to the future. But when everyone around him is already far better at stealth and infiltration than he could ever imagine being, it's not going to be easy. He'll need to employ his own special bag of tricks, and have a lot of luck, if he's going to last more than 5 minutes surrounded by hot kunoichi girls, every one of whom would happily kill him in a moment if he's discovered.

title: Honto no Kanojo
description: Moe confesses to Yuuka who rejects her harshly in a haughty manner different from her usual "good girl" personality... but Moe seemed to enjoy it?

title: Shoujotachi no Kizuato ni Kuchizuke wo
title_original: 少女たちの痕にくちづけを
title_en: Kiss the Scars of the Girls
description: “I’m sure someday, I’ll get you to look my way.” Danger and uncertainty are common for a young vampire, which is why Emille will be assigned a “Big Sister” on her fourteenth birthday, like all the girls at her school. Deep within a secluded forest, her sister will teach her how to hunt and safely feed on humans. Learning to rely on each other for survival cultivates a deep relationship comparable to that between family-but does theirs have the potential to evolve into something more? (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes two bonus chapters.

characters.name: Eve Winter
characters.description: She has a reserved and mature personality.

characters.name: Emielle Florence
characters.original: エミエル ・フローレンス
characters.description: She has a friendly and honest personality.

title: Yuri-Ota ni Yuri wa Gohatto Desu!?
title_original: 百合オタに百合はご法度です!?
description: Watanabe Fuyu is a diehard fan of yuri, so she studied hard to get into an all-girls private school and quietly observe the S-class setting of her fantasies. At first, it seems like heaven... until she meets Yoshiokari Rika, a cheery gyaru who reads more like an otaku's dream girl than the refined, demure ladies she's used to reading about. Thrown off by the outlier, Fuyu is reluctant to become friends with Rika - and with their clashing archetypes, she's hoping this odd couple doesn't graduate into a rarepair. Note: Chapter count includes three extra chapters.

title: Gunbured x Sisters
title_original: ガンバレッド×シスターズ
description: In a decaying gothic city, warrior nun Dorothy is tasked with hunting down and slaughtering supernatural creatures. A member of the elite Crimson Sisters, she seeks to rid the city of the vampire population that plagues it. One fateful night, she encounters a wounded woman, Maria, only to discover that she has fangs and a strange parentage. Dorothy offers the half-vampire her best and only chance at survival: become my pet. Together, Dorothy and Maria will dive into the secrets at the heart of the vampire scourge that threatens to overwhelm their home. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

characters.name: Maria Belford
characters.original: マリア・ベルフォード
characters.description: A half-human, half-vampire Dhampir. She seeks her younger sister who was captured by pure-blooded vampires.

characters.name: Dorothy
characters.description: A member of the Crimson Sisters. She seeks revenge for her nursing mother, who was killed by vampires.

characters.name: Shannon Grace
characters.description: An elite Knight of the Cross. They feel a sense of possessiveness over Dorothy, whom they've known since a young age.

title: Shimekiri Mae ni wa Yuri ga Hakadoru
description: Ayu Shirakawa left the countryside and set off for Tokyo. There, her cousin Miyako Shirakawa introduced her to the popular author, Hikari Kairou, and it was decided that she would work for her as both her caretaker, and as a warden. This is just the ordinary love story about how a lonely person became not alone.

characters.name: Yukari Ebiwara
characters.description: She is a well-known author with several novel adaptations to her name. She is the daughter of a prominent business family. Her pen name is Kairou Hikari. However, she is a regular deadline-breaker, frequently travelling far away from home to escape, much to the frustration of her editor, Miyako. Despite the fact that she considers herself to be straight, she develops feelings for Ayu...

characters.name: Ayu Shirakawa
characters.description: A high school student who moved to Tokyo from Ehime on her own. She is a lesbian, but she ran away from home due to discrimination from others around her. She moves in with the novelist Yukari Ebiwara as her housekeeper with the help of her cousin Miyako. She falls in love with Yukari at first sight, and her attraction to her grows as she gets to know Yukari better.

characters.name: Miyako Shirakawa
characters.description: Itsuki's former college classmate. Although she is not attempting to be a professional author like Itsuki is, she enjoys reading his works. She supports him, and Kani's work.

title: Urara Meirochou
description: The story is set in Meiro-chou, a town where all-female diviners (uranaishi) live and where girls from all over the country yearn to become the top diviner — "Urara." Today, a solitary girl named Chiya enters the town's gates. However, she has another purpose coming here, besides becoming the Urara. Chiya's days as an apprentice diviner begin as she meets three friends — the earnest Kon, Koume who is a fan of Western culture, and the shy Nono. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Chiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 154cm Chiya is the protagonist of Urara Meirochou. A girl who sometimes appears to have animal-like ears and a tail. She was raised in the woods by her mother's friend, Setsu. Having grown up alongside animals, she is quite agile and has a habit of exposing her stomach when apologizing. She wishes to become an Urara to find her mother.

characters.name: Nono Natsume
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm A shy girl who is the younger sister of the Natsumeya's owner, [Nina](https://anilist.co/character/124337/). She owns a doll named Matsuko given to her by her mother, who died when she was little, and often does ventriloquism with it.

characters.name: Kon Tatsumi
characters.description: __Height:__ 158cm A straight-laced girl who specializes in kokkuri fortune telling. Due to the way she wears her ribbon, she is often thought to be a fox girl.

characters.name: Koume Yukimi
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm An energetic girl who dresses like a witch and specializes in tarot fortune telling.

characters.name: Omi Nijou
characters.description: She studied in Tatsumi-Ya and is called a genius for passing the rank nine exam with the fastest time on record and on the first try. She is also a noble that has fallen, and wants to become an Urara to earn money for her family.

characters.name: Saku Iroi
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Captain of Meirocho's Bloque 10 Patrol Unit. She is strict in her duties and often embarrassed by [Chiya](https://anilist.co/character/121042/Chiya)'s shameless actions.

characters.name: Shiozawa
characters.description: Patrol officer working under [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/121043/), whom she has a secret crush on.

characters.name: Ooshima
characters.description: Patrol officer working under [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/121043/), whom she has a secret crush on.

characters.name: Nina Natsume
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm [Nono](https://anilist.co/character/121044/)'s older sister, a Rank 5 Urara who runs the Natsumeya teahouse and tutors the other Uraras.

characters.name: Marie Quispilquette
characters.original: マリ・キスピルクエット
characters.description: A witch from France who stays with Koume's family during her childhood. ~!She leaves the household on account of being suspected by the public for causing a mysterious epidemic.!~

characters.name: Tokie
characters.description: [Kon's](https://anilist.co/character/121046/) mother.

title: Tonari no Kyuuketsuki-san
description: High school girl Akari was lost in a forest when she was rescued by a vampire girl named Sophie. Since then, Akari has developed a liking for Sophie, who prefers to be alone. Note: Includes 7 extra chapters.

characters.name: Sophie Twilight
characters.original: ソフィー・トワイライト
characters.description: Sophie is a doll-like vampire who prefers to buy blood online rather than drinking it from humans. She's also an anime otaku.

characters.name: Akari Amano
characters.description: Akari is a high school girl who loves dolls. After meeting Sophie, who looks like a doll, Akari barges into her house and ends up living with her.

characters.name: Ellie
characters.description: Ellie is a vampire who is an old friend of Sophie's. She just recently woke up from a 100 year nap, so she doesn't know much about the modern world, and is bad with technology. Unlike Sophie, who purchases blood online, Ellie prefers to drink from cute young girls.

characters.name: Hinata Natsuki
characters.description: Hinata is Akari's childhood friend.

title: SCARLET
description: After ingesting an illegal drug that makes her hunger for blood, Finé Hera makes a pact with a beautiful but wolfish Red Riding Hood. Iris Redhood offers herself up to help Finé slake her bloodlust, but her…services come with a price. Now, the two are narcotics officers on the hunt for the very drug that changed Finé! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Finé Hera
characters.description: __Height:__ 169 cm Finé is devoted to Iris and would do anything for her. After taking an illegal magical drug Elixir, she becomes a bloodthirsty monster.

characters.name: Iris Redhood
characters.original: アイリス・レッドフード
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Iris is really devoted to [Finé](https://anilist.co/character/175557/Hera-Fin), and they've known each other for their whole lives. She'd do anything for her friend, even offering herself up to slake her bloodthirsty desires.

title: Goshujin-sama to Kemonomimi no Shoujo Meru
title_original: ご主人様と獣耳の少女メル
description: A story about a maid with animal ears and her mistress. Note: Includes the side story "Goshujinsama to Aki no Hi".

characters.name: Mel
characters.description: A girl who lives in a mansion with her master and works as a maid.

title: Seifuku no Vampiress Lord
title_original: 制服のヴァンピレスロード
description: Normal high school girl Irie Yuunagi suddenly has her blood sucked by a strange man one night. Yuunagi wakes up as a vampire and learns that she has been added to the man who bit her, Rin's, family. She begins to learn about the rules of the vampire world from Rin.

title: Yurigurashi
description: Cohabitating can make or break any relationship, but with a little luck, a lot of love, and a healthy dose of patience, living together can bring out the best in a couple! There’s a lot to navigate—clashing personalities, age gaps, business trips, conflicting feelings, jealousy, sex, and even the supernatural—but these women in love find a way to make it work! (Source: Yen Press) Includes: Yuruui Futari (ゆるーいふたり).

title: Bai Yueguang Nü Zhu Zong Xiang Duzhan Wo
title_original: 白月光女主总想独占我
title_en: Omega Heroine Wants Her Alpha Villainess
description: After a biking mishap, Willow Ji lands in an Omegaverse novel as a doomed Alpha villainess. To avoid a shark-infested fate, she navigates cautiously around Serena Wei, the Omega heroine, aiming to win her heart with kindness. Initially suspicious, Serena gradually warms up to Willow, even harboring feelings for her. As the lines between protagonist and antagonist blur, the question arises: when will Willow realize that their feelings are mutual, and her "foe" has also fallen deeply for her? (Source: Tapas)

title: Nengan no Last Boss no Karada wo Te ni Ireta zo!
title_original: 念願の悪役令嬢の身体を手に入れたぞ！
title_en: I Got My Wish and Reincarnated as the Villainess (Last Boss)!
description: A sickly girl named Elizabeth has been reincarnated as an otome game villainess! She begins her life anew, blissfully unaware that her fate is to be killed by the heroes. She might enjoy a healthy life now, but will she be able to turn fate on its head?! (Source: K MANGA)

title: K-On! Shuffle
description: There was once a high school band whose pop songs warmed and thrilled the hearts of all who listened. Now, three girls have been inspired to start a pop music club of their own, but will things turn out like they hope? It’s a new generation of slice-of-life hijinks from kakifly, the original author of K-ON! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Kaede Shimizu
characters.description: She was inspired to join her school's Light Music Appreciation Society and become a bassist after seeing a concert by Sakuragoaka High School's Light Music Club. Kaede seems like a cool beauty at first glance. In fact she is not easily influenced and she goes about things at her own pace.

characters.name: Yukari Sakuma
characters.description: She was inspired to join her school's Light Music Appreciation Society and become a drummer after seeing a concert by Sakuragoaka High School's Light Music Club. Yukari is also smart, has excellent grades, but also has a tendency to rush into things on impulse.

characters.name: Maho Sawabe
characters.description: A star basketball player who gets roped into joining her school's Light Music Appreciation Society and becoming a guitarist. Maho is serious and reliable.

characters.name: Riko Satou
characters.description: Riko a second year student, protected the Light Music Appreciation Society room all by herself. ~!Riko is also a drummer and is in a band with Shinano and Kano.!~

characters.name: Shinano Iwasaki
characters.description: Shinano is a second year student and plays guitar. She just returned from a short-term overseas exchange student program and rejoined the Light Music Appreciation Society. ~!Shinano plays guitar and is in a band with Riko and Kano.!~

characters.name: Ranka Ootake
characters.description: She is a first year student that joined the Light Music Club with her middle school friend Risa after watching Yukari, Kaede and Maho's performance at the First Year's Welcoming Ceremony.

characters.name: Risa Kawabe
characters.description: She is a first year student that joined the Light Music Club with her middle school friend Ranka after watching Yukari, Kaede and Maho's performance at the First Year's Welcoming Ceremony. Unlike everyone else she doesn't play an instrument and wants to do the vocals.

characters.name: Karin Shimada
characters.description: Maho's friend from the Basketball Club. Karin likes to drop by the Light Music Appreciation Society to see how Maho is doing.

characters.name: Kurumi Sakuma
characters.description: Yukari's older sister.

characters.name: Kano Yamamoto
characters.description: Kano is a second year student and bass player. Having conquered that one phrase she couldn't play, she can now come to the Light Music Appreciation Society again. ~!Kano plays bass in a band with Shinano and Riko.!~

characters.name: Yui Hirasawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Yui Hirasawa is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON!. She's also the main protagonist. She is the air-headed lead guitarist and vocalist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. Having misunderstood that "light music" equals "easy music" (like whistling), she joined the Light Music Club and picked up guitar with absolutely no prior experience. She plays a Gibson Pre-'08 Les Paul Standard '50s in Heritage Cherry Sunburst. She names it Giita, which quite literally means "guitar".

characters.name: Mio Akiyama
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Mio Akiyama is one of the five main characters in K-ON! She is a passionate and technical left-handed musician and writer who serves as the bassist, second vocalist and main lyricist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. She is a kind and warm girl, albeit very shy and sensitive. Despite her timid streak, she often finds herself as the voice of reason amongst her bandmates, who often rely on her sensibility when in trouble. She plays a left-handed Fender Japan '62 Reissue Jazz Bass in 3-Tone Sunburst.

title: Wo Bi Ni Weixian
description: When Jiang Wanshu met Ren Pingsheng, what she thought was her light, became the beginning of her nightmare. As a teacher, Ren Pingsheng seems gentle and considerate on the outside, but is secretly an extremely passionate reader of Jiang Wanshu's book. What seemed to be a "coincidental" first encounter was in truth calculated and planned. Behind the peaceful days, the crazy reader has begun her hunt... (Source: Bilibili Comics) Note: Includes four extra chapters.

characters.name: Wanshu Jiang
characters.description: A college junior majoring in Chemistry. She writes murder mysteries as a hobby.

characters.name: Pingsheng Ren
characters.description: She's a teacher in the Literature Department.

title: Tsubame Tip Off!
description: A new highschool student with a complex about her height - Tsubame. Being unathletic and clumsy she seeks to join a cultural club, and despite her height she gives off the persona of a small and shy girl. Enter her upperclassman, Ibis, a small girl with a big presence, who suddenly invites her to the basketball club?! Note: Originally published as a one-shot.

characters.name: Tsubame Haruno
characters.description: The protagonist of 'Tsubame Tip-Off!' and a first-year center in Shirasagi Girls' High School's Basketball Club. She is clumsy, but determined.

characters.name: Ibis Akikaze
characters.description: A short, second-year point guard at Shirasagi Girls' High School's Basketball Club. She previously played in the States.

characters.name: Yukiko Kaneta
characters.description: A second-year shooting guard & small forward at Shirasagi's Girls' Basketball Club, and former Archery Club member. Ibis' best friend. She enjoys risky shots.

characters.name: Chizuru Shiroki
characters.description: A center at Shirasagi's Girls' Basketball Club, and the team's only third year. Softspoken.

characters.name: Emi Asakawa
characters.description: A second-year small/power forward at Shirasagi's Girls' Basketball Club, as well as a member of the Art Club. She's sneaky and good at steals.

characters.name: Ruriha Sasaki
characters.description: A first-year point guard at Shirasagi's Girls' Basketball Club. She loves music, and usually doesn't speak. However, sometimes, when she does, it comes out like a rap.

characters.name: Riko Machida
characters.description: The manager of Shirasagi's Girls' Basketball Club and member of the Art Club. Tsubame's best friend and biggest supporter.

characters.name: Azuma Takano
characters.description: The coach of Shirasagi's Girls' Basketball Club. During his school days, he was a part of the Fuujin-Raijin (Wind God, Lightning God) combo with Fuuta Akikaze. His title was "Azuma of the Thunderbolt Passes".

characters.name: Machi Mizuha
characters.description: A third-year small forward and captain of Alexei Academy's Girls' Basketball Club. Incredibly cunning.

characters.name: Aya Unakami
characters.description: __Height__: 161cm A second-year point guard at Alexei Academy's Girls' Basketball Club. Prideful and hot-headed, with great passing ability.

characters.name: Sierra Okuta
characters.description: A second-year center at Alexei Academy's Girls' Basketball Club. She's as tall as Tsubame. While she also shares her awkwardness, on the court she's incredibly focused.

characters.name: Kanoko Sumitsuki
characters.description: A third-year power forward at Alexei Academy's Girls' Basketball Club. Her special move is the baby hook. She speaks so silently that she can't be heard at times.

title: Centaur no Nayami
description: Being a teenager is never easy… especially for a centaur! Himeno is a sweet, shy girl, who like many teens her age, struggles with the trials and tribulations of attending high school. The difference is she’s a centaur; but she’s not alone. In fact, all of her classmates are supernatural creatures, sporting either horns, wings, tails, halos, or some other unearthly body appendage. Yet despite their fantastical natures, Himeno and her best friends-the dragon-winged Nozomi, and Kyoko with her spiraled horns-are down-to-earth, fun-loving teenagers who grapple with issues of life and love in a mostly normal daily school setting. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Won the 8th Comic Ryujin Award. Anime starts at Vol 1, Chap 0 Anime ends at Vol 10, Chap 68

characters.name: Manami Mitama
characters.description: Race: angel/cat-man Appearance: angel Mother: angel Father: cat-man (specific species name unknown. Because of his appearance, cat-man used as a alternative name). Sisters (oldest to youngest): Chigusa, Chinami, Chiho, Suetsumi She is the class president of Nozomi's class. Her family runs a shrine and she works part-time as a shrine maiden. She has four sisters all younger than her own. The first three younger sisters are triplets and have the appearance of cat-man, despite being half-angel like Manami. The youngest sister has the appearance of both angel and and her father's species. Unlike Manami, Suetsumi does not have a halo. The halo of angels is not magical in any way. As a matter of fact, it is a hair decorated in a circular shape to promote the angel's culture, similar to how Christians wears crucifixes.

title: Vampire Knight: memories
title_original: ヴァンパイア騎士〈ナイト〉 memories
description: After a fierce battle between humans and vampires, a temporary peace was established, but Kaname continued to sleep within a coffin of ice… Yuki gave Kaname her heart to revive him as a human being. These are the stories of what happened during those 1,000 years of Kaname’s slumber and at the start of his human life. (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Kaname Kuran
characters.description: **Height:** 184 cm A pureblood vampire. He saved Yuuki from an attack by another vampire when she was little. Kaname is the class president of the Night Class, much feared and respected by the other Night Class students. While he is cold and authoritative towards his fellows in the Night Class, he is always kind and sweet to Yuuki. He has shown that he cares deeply for Yuuki ever since he saved her, and loves her in a romantic sense. As a Pureblood, Kaname is capable of controlling lesser vampires, but he chooses not to exercise his powers, thus earning the respect of the Noble vampires. He shares the Chairman's hopes for peace between vampires and humans. He worked with the Chairman to create the Night Class at Cross Academy and with his presence, allows the Night Class to be kept in check. But the real reason Kaname agreed to attend the academy is so that he can be near Yuuki and prote

characters.name: Ren Kiryuu
characters.description: An aristocrat vampire, daughter of Yuuki Kuran and the ex-human vampire Zero Kiryuu.

characters.name: Ai Kuran
characters.description: Ai Kuran is the pure blood vampire princess of the Kuran family, daughter of Kaname Kuran and Yuuki Kuran.

characters.name: Yuuki Cross
characters.description: __Height__: 156 cm The adoptive daughter of the headmaster of Cross Academy, Yuuki is a member of the school's disciplinary committee (public morals committee in Japanese), which is the 'front' for the Guardians. Ten years prior to the events of "Vampire Knight," Yuuki was attacked by a vampire, but was rescued by Kaname. She has lost all memory of her life before the attack, and Headmaster Cross took her in as his own daughter. Yuuki loves Kaname, and even though she has witnessed his vampiric nature when he bit Ruka, she still couldn't stop loving him. However, she has also started to let Zero, a childhood friend, drink her blood, hoping to save him from madness. Yuuki is cheerful and easygoing, and thanks to her work as a Guardian she is good at keeping her cool in sticky situations. There have been hints that she is special, given that vampires are especially drawn to her blood. Her

characters.name: Zero Kiryuu
characters.description: __Height__: 178 cm - 183 cm Yuuki's childhood friend, Zero is also a Guardian and likewise on the disciplinary committee. Yuuki has been taking care of him as her little brother since he was brought into their home (the Headmaster's). His family, a line of vampire hunters, was murdered by the pure blood vampire Shizuka Hio when he was young. He harbors a deep hatred for vampires and claims to have taken on the role of Guardian to learn to hunt them better. In truth, Zero was bitten during the attack on his family, and have kept the secret that he was a vampire from Yuuki until he was no longer capable of controlling his vampiric urges. Zero's body rejects the blood tablets that most vampires take to control their hunger. Drinking Yuuki's blood helps him maintain his sanity, but he is destined to become a Level E vampire eventually. He has started to accept his feelings towards Yuki and h

characters.name: Hanabusa Aidou
characters.description: Nicknamed "Idol" by the Day Class girls. Along with his cousin Akatsuki Kain, Hanabusa Aido is known among the Night Class as "Kaname-sama's right hand," and he has a fierce admiration for Kaname. He possesses an upper-class vampire ability to control ice. He knows that Zero is a vampire, but keeps quiet about it. Aido can seem cheerful and friendly one moment, and cold and vindictive the next. He is not fond of Yuuki, but he tolerates her because Kaname cares for her.

characters.name: Sayori Wakaba
characters.description: __Height__: 162 cm ~!Sayori's family is with the Vampire Hunters Association. Her Father is the Councillor.!~ Yuuki's dorm-mate and best friend since junior high, Yuuki often refers to her as Yori-chan. Yori seems to be one of the few girls who is not interested in the Night Class. She finds them a bit scary and stated that she would prefer someone from the day class. Yori is also very observant, as she notices a lot of things that happen to Yuuki, especially when she gets hurt or is very depressed. Yori's part in the story is relatively small. She spends a lot of time worried about Yuki not geting enough sleep and having nightmares. She teases Yuki when Ichiru reveals that Zero has feelings for Yuki and confirms Yori's suspicions, although the whole matter isn't clear to Yuki.

title: Malhal Su Eopneun Nammae
description: Hanmi told a lie on the first day of her new school just to get Lee Gun to notice her. But her shallow plan backfired and now everyone thinks she's dating Junhyuk...her actual cousin! (Source: Lezhin US) Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

title: Yuugai Shitei Doukyuusei
description: Yatsuhashi Miyako is a diligent class rep while the girl who sits next to her, Miyakonojou Reika, was discovered to not be wearing panties. Will Miyako be able to reform Reika into a normal high school girl?!

title: Kämpfer
description: High school life has rarely been an easy thing to endure for the typical teenager. Even more so for Natsuru Seno, an average teenage boy who one day finds himself transformed into a teenage girl. His transformation was caused by his being chosen to become a KÄMPFER (female fighters destined to battle each other). He has no idea how or even why he’s been thrust into such a predicament. Natsuru’s situation only grows more complicated when he realizes that attacks from other KÄMPFER can happen anywhere, and at any time. With potential dangers lying in wait around every corner, how will Natsuru maintain normalcy in his life? How can a teenage boy be normal with a newly acquired, randomly appearing, and greatly endowed female form?! (Source: DMP)

characters.name: Natsuru Senou
characters.description: __Height:__ 177 cm The series' main protagonist. Second year student of Seitetsu Gakuin High-school. He is chosen as a Blue Kämpfer by Moderator and setup as a Zauber type with power based on fire. In keeping with the rule that all Kämpfers are females, he turns into girl upon transformation. After a fight with Shizuku exposed his Kämpfer form to other students of the school, Shizuku arranged to have him enrolled in girl's class to fulfil public curiosity in a way that diverts attentions away from Kämpfer battle. His Kämpfer form has subsequently been ranked among the Three Beauties of Seitetsu (there used to be only two) and, much to Natsuru's own dismay, become subject of intense affections from Kaede Sakura (whom he has a crush on). Source: Wikipedia

characters.name: Akane Mishima
characters.description: School librarian and Natsuru's friend, she is also a Blue Kämpfer like Natsuru. Normally very shy (which might very well be attributed to her tendency of misunderstanding what others are trying to do in a borderline-erotic way) and soft-spoken, she has bipolar disorder upon transforming into a Kämpfer, becoming foul-mouthed, bitter, vindictive, and trigger-happy. She explained most of the rules of being a Kämpfer when Natsuru's own Messenger gave no such details. She is a Gewehr type Kämpfer who uses an 1911 .45 pistol and appears to be ambidextrous. In addition to having Natsuru as the first male to establish in-depth friendship with her, Akane eventually begins to harbor feelings for him, becoming jealous and easily irritable when he talks about another girl (most if not all of the time being Kaede) in front of her or when another girl takes an interest in

characters.name: Shizuku Sangou
characters.description: President of the Student Council and one of the Three Beauties of Seitetsu, she is a model student with perfect attendance record. In addition, however, she is also a Red Kämpfer fighting with the Schwert ability of wielding two chained daggers at will. She wants to expose Moderator's intentions but has no problem fighting Blue Kämpfers until that goal was accomplished. After being spared following a defeat by [Natsuru](https://anilist.co/character/24977), she enters a truce with Natsuru and [Akane](https://anilist.co/character/24978) and has since taken an interest in Natsuru in a slightly sly and teasing manner, throwing him off balance with embarrassing remarks/actions while maintaining a poker face in the process, despite being constantly treated with suspicion as a result. After being invited by [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/24581) to visit her home and then spend the night t

characters.name: Mikoto Kondou
characters.description: Natsuru's childhood friend who only recently reunited with him due to her father being an archaeologist who lives abroad, a way of live that already made her think little of doing things others would consider far too dangerous. Although having too much pride to explicitly admit, she has feelings for Natsuru and is more than a bit bothered by the presence of a girl with the same name as his (who in reality is Natsuru in his Kämpfer form). Even after the misunderstanding is later cleared up, the advances made by Akane and Shizuku on Natsuru (Mikoto apparently does not believe Kaede would reciprocate his feelings) subsequently makes her even more nervous about her chance with him as well. When she was seeing Miss Seitetsu contest of the school festival, she caught a bouquet that Kaede tossed with a Messenger hidden in it, consequently being turned into a Schwert-type Red Kämp

characters.name: Kaede Sakura
characters.description: Shizuku's childhood friend and one of the Three Beauties of Seitetsu, she has many admirers, Natsuru being one of them. She has a large collection of stuffed Zoumotsu Animal dolls and likes to present them to her friends; those who receive the dolls, however, tend to end up becoming Kämpfers. She began to develop a crush on Kämpfer Natsuru after being saved from Kämpfer Akane at the beginning of the series, later coming under the mistaken impression that the normal Natsuru is her rival for Kämpfer Natsuru's affection and consequently becoming somewhat hostile to him, a situation not helped after a misunderstanding in a very compromising situation leads her to think Natsuru is cheating on the female Natsuru. ~!Later she is revealed to possibly have something to do with the appearances of the White Kämpfers and may be manipulating Natsuru. It is eventually confirmed on separate occasions w

characters.name: Hiaburi Lion
characters.description: The oldest Messenger, its existence said to pre-date the Zoumotsu Animal toyline. The novel version of it does not have its guts hanging out of its body like the Zoumotsu Animals after it, but the anime version does. It has the same shape as a character which Kaede imagined before, with a voice similar to that of a voice actor who performs voice-overs for foreign movie stars. Kaede got it by mere chance though it is very scarce. In episode 11 of the anime, it reveals the reason behind the Kämpfer battles. From Wikipedia.

characters.name: Kanden Yamaneko
characters.description: The Messenger for Shizuku in the shape of a wildcat bristling hairs. [wikipedia]

characters.name: Seppuku Kuro Usagi
characters.description: Akane's messenger. According to Mishima Akane, this black rabbit has a voice similar to that of Tamura Yukari. Oh wait, that's the voice of the seiyuu!

characters.name: Rika Ueda
characters.description: A Schwert user armed with a kusarigama. Her weapon is quite similar like Shizuku's and It turned out to be that Rika is a White Kämpfer. ~!Rika appears in episode 7 and barges into Sakura's room and interrupts Akane while she was about to confess.!~

characters.name: Sayaka Nakao
characters.description: A Schwert user armed with a sabre.

characters.name: Ryouka Yamakawa
characters.description: A Gewehr user armed with a submachine gun resembling an Uzi.

characters.name: Harakiri Tora
characters.description: Natsuru's Messenger.

title: Syrup: Shakaijin Yuri Anthology
title_original: シロップ 社会人百合アンソロジー
description: This volume contains the following chapters: Cover illustration: Fly 1. Gozen 1-ji no Koi Laundry (午前１時のコインランドリー) by Yukiko 2. Daily Smile (^ ^) (デイリースマイル（＾ ＾）) by Kodama Naoko 3. Yowamushi Joou (弱虫女王) by Yoshimurakana 4. Watashi no Anoko (私のあの子) by Goumoto 5. Juku no Seinsei to Juku no Sensei (じゅくのせいんせいとじゅくのせんせい) by Mochi au lait 6. Yakan Hikou (夜間飛行) by Kawanami Izumi 7. Yakusoku (やくそく) by Shioya Teruko 8. Aru Hanaya to Suiyou 19-ji no Onna (ある花屋と水曜１９時の女) by Amano Shuninta 9. Sute Neko to Akari (捨て猫と灯) by Oi Pikachi 10. MAMA x HAHA (MAMA x HAHA) by Yoshidamaru Yuu 11. Rose Quartz (ローズクォーツ) by Kurogane Kenn 12. Watashi no Femme Fatale (わたしのファム・ファタール) by Matsuzaki Natsumi 13. Otona no Hatsukoi (おとなの初恋) by Itou Hachi 14. Tenshi to Oshigoto (天使とお仕事) by Morinaga Milk

title: Shitsurakuen
description: Himoto Sora is a transfer student with a sense of justice and dreams of becoming a knight. Upon arriving at Utopia Gakuen, she learns of a virtual reality-like game played by the male students in which they use girls as weapons in battles for status and treat them as commodities. Seeing one of these girls being abused she steps in and though some sort of error unwittingly becomes the first female participant of the game.

characters.name: Sora Himoto
characters.description: Himoto Sora is the main protagonist of the story. Ever since she was young, Sora always dreamed of being a knight and being able to save the princess, a fantasy that has a chance of coming to life when she enrolls in the school. Through a bug in the gaming program, Sora finds herself able to play as a male and not as a weapon and sets out on her mission to save the girls of the school by winning one match after another.

characters.name: Tsuki Aoi
characters.description: Sora's best friend. She is the reason behind Sora's goal to be a knight. She's strong and smart. She is El's possession, thus abling her to collect information about Exclan to help Sora. ~!She is also 'X'. The first weapon Sora used who wears a mask with a flower ornament and golden hair. Though later replaced by Shoujo to extract information from Sora. !~ ~!It is also hinted that she is the reason why Sora was able to play the game despite being a girl. It is assumed that she is the one who anonymously gave the glove to Sora.!~

characters.name: Koharu Izaki
characters.description: The first friend Sora met in Utopia Academy, and her first main weapon. They met in class. While some boy's were going to talk to Sora, Koharu accidentally bumped into them. This made one boy angry and he tried to punch Koharu but Sora protected Koharu by taking the punch.

characters.name: Karin Asagiya
characters.description: He is the student council president. He always wears a mask over his right eye. He befriends and theoretically tries to help Sora using his (presumably real) name Karin while trying to defeat her as El.

characters.name: Tomoko Oashi
characters.description: The third girl Sora saves. Despite being saved, she does not want to be special and stand out from the crowd by being linked to Sora. So that Tomoko can be safe by being owned by a boy, Sora searches for a boy who is an ally of the girls...

characters.name: Reiko Date
characters.description: She is a tsundere towards Sora. She wishes to stay in possession of Sumita, a Student Council member, in order to free the abused girls. That is her goal. In the past, she wanted help from others to free the girls but no one would help, leading her to work and depend on herself alone. That leads to her cold personality. ~!Sora defeats Sumita and recieves her. She's afraid it would stray her from achieving her goal, so she attempts to get back with Sumita. Later, Sora attempts to help her since they have a common goal. She realizes that Sora is a good person and doesn't want to get her involved. She ends up with Touga, a demented Student Council member who has destroyed many of his weapons and "plays" with his possessions. He was instructed by El not to release her, nor fight anyone using her. Sora comes to the rescue and comes up with a plan to free her using the pena

characters.name: Akane
characters.description: A reluctant but kindhearted friend of Sora. On her first day, he notices that Sora is new and offers to take ownership of her. Then, turning out to be one of the few decent boys in the school, he decides to help and protect Sora even though is is afraid of the consequences.

characters.name: Yuki Yagizawa
characters.description: Yuki is Sora's second princess. She was the first girl Sora observed in a battle, when Sora first arrived at Utopia Gakuen. She was afraid to stand up, but was given hope when she saw Sora and Koharu. She is physically characterized by her long, twin braids. Her weapon is a dagger and is considered rather weak.

characters.name: Shoujou
characters.description: A member of the student council. He is extremely obsessed at pleasing El.

characters.name: Hiyo Shishidou
characters.description: Shishidou Hiyo is a girl who was initially depicted as being madly in love with Sora after being rescued by her though this turned out to be an act. Hiyo has an older sister who always fought against the male dominance, resulting in injuries that forced her to drop out of school. Reiko mentions Sora was a lot like Hiyo's sister, because she was reckless and had similar ideals though this earns Sora Hiyo's contempt at her success. Eventually the gang finds out Hiyo stole the record of all the saved girls, ordering Tougyu to attack them. It later turns out she was manipulated by him to avoid the same fate as her sister. After Tougyu incapacitates himself, she becomes Sora's weapon. She is one of the six "stars", and her weapon is a large axe.

characters.name: Shiro Togyu
characters.description: Shiro Togyu is known as the "insane member of the student council". He is more brutal to the girls he possesses than any other owner.

title: Pyramid Game
description: Every Thursday afternoon, once a month, students at Love High cast their votes in a popularity poll. The result? A brutal ranking system that determines the entire social hierarchy of the school. After starting at the bottom, can new transfer student Suji make her way to the top of the pyramid? Or will she topple the game altogether? (Source: WEBTOONS)

title: School Ningyo
description: Two girls go hunting for mermaids to win their true love. Featuring very untraditional mermaids.

title: YuriCam: Yurika no Campus Life
title_original: ゆりキャン～ゆりかのキャンパスライフ～
description: Yurika attends a girls-only college with a long tradition of lesbian love, and according to rumors, she's been with over half of the 10,000 girls who attend the school! This rumor is mortifying to Yurika, and seriously damages her chances of ever getting a boyfriend. The truth is, for some reason, she's just completely irresistible to women, even women who claim to be straight. One day, Yurika gets a call from her Dad, letting her know that his company is bankrupt. He suggests that she get by on her charms, since he can no longer help her with money. Is it time for Yurika to actually start taking advantage of her unwanted persona as a masterful lesbian lover? (Source: MangaHelpers)

characters.name: Yurika Kamishiro
characters.description: Yurika Kamishiro wants to find a boyfriend, but rumors spread about how she slept with 5000 girls on campus.

characters.name: Saori
characters.description: Yurika's childhood friend and roommate.

title: Yoroizuka-san wo Baburasetai
title_original: 鎧塚さんをバブらせたい
title_en: I Want to Spoil Ms. Yoroizuka Rotten
description: Kurumi's finally in a relationship with the older lover of her dreams - cool, stoic Ms. Yoroizuka, who seems just as emotionless outside the office as she does within her department. You might think shy, younger Kurumi's the one getting spoiled here, but you would be wrong - Kurumi will do anything to spoil Ms. Yoroizuka with all the head pats, hugs, and kisses she deserves! (Source: Manga Planet) Note: - Includes 11 extra chapters. - Originally self-published and then collected into one commercial volume published on 2021-07-21. It was picked up for continued commercial serialization on 2022-08-06.

title: Yuri no Hajimari wa Dorei Kara
title_original: 百合のはじまりは奴隷から
description: Chiyoko Hanamura is a girl who has failed in her attempt to remake herself into a “gal” for her high school debut. While skipping class on the rooftop as usual, a kouhai girl, Sakine, comes to ask her for a favor, showing her an anonymous love letter. Sakine asks her, “Can you go turn down this confession for me?” For the sake of her cute kouhai and to maintain her dignity as a gal, Chiyoko accepts the request and sets out to decline the confession, not knowing who would be there… (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title: Her Pet
description: Gayoon decides to enroll into a high school far away from home just to be closer to Soha, her middle school heroine and idol. Gayoon finds out about Soha's loss and decides to help her by filling the role of Soha's once true friend - Happy, Soha's pet dog. (Source: Lezhin)

title: Ting Xing
description: Having failed in her attempts to become a voice actor, Chi Yu no longer talks about it with other people. Now she just listens to yuri drama podcasts in secret. One day, during a university lecture, she discovers that Yu Chen, a girl from another college, has the same voice as the main character in her favorite sexy yuri podcast… (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Sougou Tovarisch
description: Kanna who usually enjoys being at the top of her class is outscored by one point on the first aptitude test of her high school career by the high-level kuudere/low-level dandere Yuu. Unlike Kanna, Yuu is naturally talented and couldn't care less about getting high scores, so she throws away her test immediately after after getting it. This incredibly bothers Kanna, who then in front of the class, scolds Yuu for throwing away her "symbol of how hard she worked". This gesture of kindness(??) causes Yuu to fall for Kanna. And of course, all unbeknownst to Kanna, who's all about herself anyway. Note: Chapter count includes 14 extra chapters

title: Tachibanakan to Lie Angle
description: When Natsuno Hanabi went back to her hometown to study in high school, she thought that she will have a new wonderful life. But Tachibanakan, the dormitory she was going to live in, was not what she expected. Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

title: Yukidoke to Agapanthus
title_original: 雪解けとアガパンサス
description: Natsuki’s life is one that anybody would envy—she’s a star student and athlete, and has a whole fan club of girls swooning over her princely good looks! But even though she wants for nothing, she can’t help feeling like something is missing…until the new transfer student, Shun, turns her world upside down. Shun’s refreshingly blunt attitude and insistence on treating Natsuki as an equal lead her to crave Shun’s company more and more! As time passes, Natsuki starts to wonder whether this yearning is what she thinks it is… (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Natsuki Hinata
characters.description: The "prince" of an all-girls' school, who is athletically and academically outstanding, as well as having a kind personality.

characters.name: Shun Kuretake
characters.description: __Height:__ 149cm She is a tiny, energetic girl who is always smiling. She has a cheerful personality and easily gets along with anyone.

characters.name: Meiko Uchida
characters.description: The secretary of the student council.

characters.name: Miran Ayai
characters.description: Treasurer of the student council.

characters.name: Yua Ikeno
characters.description: President of the student council.

characters.name: Akane Kudou
characters.description: Founder and President of the "Hinata Natsuki Fan Club"

title: After the Curtain Call
description: Soyoung is devastated when her favorite musical actor is swallowed up by the world of TV. Just after she quits supporting him, she discovers charismatic actress Jaeyi in a theater performance of "Macbeth" and becomes a fan at first sight. By meeting Jaeyi after her shows and even doing her a favor, Soyoung goes from a mere fan to her good friend. But when Jaeyi has to work with celebrity actress Hyesun, who she has a troubled past with, it unexpectedly sours their friendship. All Soyoung wanted was to support her favorite actress... so why does this new development bother her so much? (Source: Tappytoon)

characters.name: So-Yeong Park
characters.description: She is an office worker who is a musical theatre fanatic.

characters.name: Jae-Yi Jang
characters.description: She is a musical theatre actress.

title: Kinjo no Nanako-san
description: A female author of lewd manga frequently finds herself without motivation to work. In those cases she calls over her married neighbour, Nanako-san. Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon: Elma OL Nikki
title_original: 小林さんちのメイドラゴン エルマのＯＬ日記
title_en: Miss Kobayashi’s Dragon Maid: Elma’s Office Lady Diary
description: Some people live to work, others work to live. But Elma works to…eat! Elma is a Harmony Dragon who came to the human world to bring fellow dragon Tohru back home. In order to stay close to Tohru, Elma has taken a job as an office lady (OL). This charming new series from the world of Miss Kobayashi’s Dragon Maid follows the 9-to-5 adventures of Elma as she learns to work and eat her way through the OL life. From mixed-up mixers to death marches, Elma learns that being an OL is just as hard as being a dragon… (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Elma
characters.description: **Faction**: Harmony Elma is a female dragon from the Harmony faction, the opposing faction of Chaos, which [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) belongs to. She adopts the name Elma Joui as her human alias after she finds that she is unable to return to her world. Elma is the only dragon of the main cast who lives on her own in the human world. Elma usually takes the form of a human woman with short black hair, large breasts, blue eyes, and a long spiral unicorn-like horn (which she can freely hide). In the anime and [Elma’s Office Lady Diary](https://anilist.co/manga/100756/Miss-Kobayashis-Dragon-Maid-Elmas-Office-Lady-Diary/), her hair also has purple tips. At work, she wears round glasses. She also wears a business suit which consists of a white shirt, light blue tie, a loose blue sweater, a grey blazer, and a dark grey knee-length skirt with light grey socks and black h

characters.name: Kobayashi
characters.description: Kobayashi is a computer programmer and office worker. She finds herself living with a dragon named [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). Even though Kobayashi maintains a cool demeanor, she has been regarded as kind-hearted and reliable among her friends and colleagues. Level-headed and pragmatic, she stands as the source of reason when dealing with her dragon friends. However, when intoxicated, she tends to become rowdy and aggressive, especially in her interests in maids, and is not above subjecting Tohru to her drunken whims. Before meeting Tohru, Kobayashi would don a stoic expression on her face. Now, she is more approachable and open to others, often seen smiling contentedly. Kobayashi often chastised Tohru for her lack of propriety on human standards. However, as time passes by, she grows accustomed to Tohru's quirks and would sometimes show small signs of affection

characters.name: Tohru
characters.description: __Faction__: Chaos __Relatives__: [Damocles](https://anilist.co/character/172721/Damocles) (father) Tohru is a female dragon with the ability to transform into a human girl. After [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) rescues her, she falls in love with her and decides to work for her as a maid. As a Chaos Dragon, Tohru was raised to hate humans and was supposed to be a fierce and dangerous force of evil with nothing other than destruction in mind. However, this all changed when she met Kobayashi. She is now cheerful and kind to every human she meets, except for those who are real, or as it is in most cases, imaginary, threats to her love interest Kobayashi (such as [Makoto Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Makoto-Takiya)). She is also quickly influenced by what she sees on television or the internet and shares a fiery relationship with her rival, [Elma](ht

characters.name: Fafnir
characters.description: An old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru), he is a male dragon with a strong distrust for humans which leads to him questioning much of Tohru's actions and ideals in his earlier appearances. He shares some resemblance to the traits of his namesake, such as his cold demeanour and disdainful mentality. He appears as a refined young man with long black hair and red eyes in his human form. ~!After Tohru's attempts to find a place to stay for him (under the name Takeshi Ooyama), Fafnir eventually comes to live with [Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Takiya-Makoto), becoming obsessed with video games and popular culture.!~

characters.name: Riko Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Georgie Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120978/Georgie-Saikawa) (older sister) Riko Saikawa is [Kanna's](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui) friend and classmate in elementary school. A running gag involves her becoming overwhelmingly flushed with bliss every time she and Kanna make physical contact, along with her shiny forehead. At first glance, Riko seems bossy and mean, but over time, she seems nicer as shown with Kanna, and very polite around people like [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi), although she originally mistook Kobayashi for Kanna's mother. She has a crush on Kanna and enjoys being around her. When being touched by Kanna or when she receives praise from her, she tends to grin goofily and get red in the face, becoming overwhelmed with excitement. Though she initially tries to pick a fight with Kanna for her sudden p

characters.name: Shouta Magatsuchi
characters.description: __Relatives:__ [Mr. Magatsuchi](https://anilist.co/character/248474) (father), Saori Magatsuchi (mother) Shouta Magatsuchi is a young boy born into a family of mages in the modern world. He has shown to possess enough knowledge on the arcane arts to attempt summoning a demon. [Lucoa](https://anilist.co/character/120975) came out of a summoning portal Shouta created and starts living with him. Shouta is an elementary school boy in 5th grade with both purple hair and eyes. His bangs reach well below his eyebrows. His appearance looks partly androgynous. Shouta is quiet and shy most of the time when seen with Lucoa. When Lucoa attempts to seduce Shouta, he would run away with embarrassment and accuse Lucoa of being a demon. As his father is [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s manager, she's asked to look after Shouta at times.

characters.name: Kanna Kamui
characters.description: [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970)'s friend from the dragon realm who got exiled from her world and wound up living with [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969) as well. She is very young by dragon standards, equivalent to a primary school student, which she attends as a third-year student bearing Kobayashi's surname later in the series. She initially assumes that Kobayashi seduced Tohru into staying and wanted her to return to their original world. ~!She grows attached to Kobayashi as the series progresses, viewing her as a mother figure.!~ Kanna's basis and tribal attire are inspired by the culture of the indigenous natives of Hokkaido and claims to be from Ushishir. She bears feather-like horns and a thin tail ending in a bulb, and is capable of charging with electricity.

characters.name: Quetzalcoatl
characters.description: **Faction**: Spectation Quetzalcoatl often referred to as Lucoa, is a former dragon goddess and an old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). She was exiled from her seat after consuming cursed liquor that led her into a scandalous affair. As a member of the spectating faction, she does not interfere with any events involving the dragons or gods. She's by far the most powerful dragon in the series. Quetzalcoatl appears to be laid-back and carefree who is rarely seen without a smile. She is wise, kind, and nurturing who often has advice for her younger kin. As a former goddess, she is better tuned to human customs, as seen when she explains to Tohru why Kobayashi was not receptive to Tohru's initial cleaning regimen. Despite this, however, Lucoa seems to lack some sense of dignity severely. She is not above using her body as a means of getting what she wants, as sho

characters.name: Makoto Takiya
characters.description: [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s co-worker who is initially believed by [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) to be a rival for Kobayashi's affections, but is really just an otaku who likes to talk about maids with her. Kobayashi helps him set up during Comiket every year. ~![Fafnir](https://anilist.co/character/120971) eventually decides to live with him to stay in the human world.!~

characters.name: Georgie Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Riko Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120972/Riko-Saikawa) (younger sister), unnamed parents Georgie Saikawa is the older sister of Riko Saikawa. Her real name is Nae Saikawa (才川苗). She likes to pretend to be a housemaid. Georgie wears an orange polka-dot maid outfit with a white apron. She also has a white cap and has her red hair in twin-pigtails. Her stockings are black striped. Georgie is a sweet and gentle lady. She always supports Riko and her family. She seems to know a lot about maids and has a huge passion for them. She mentions that she's wanted to be one since she was a kid when she read a book about maids, but no one accepted her job offers, so decided to be one for her family. Georgie and [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) automatically have a close bond as they both share an interest in maids. [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character

characters.name: Ilulu
characters.description: Ilulu is a female dragon who belongs to the Chaos Faction. Originally, she came to [Kobayashi's](https://anilist.co/character/120969) world to destroy [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) and then tries to drive Kobayashi away from Tohru. After a change of heart, she begins to live with Kobayashi as her third dragon resident. She has a caring personality and loves children. Later on, her personality leads her to taking over the running of a candy store from an old lady, who's looking for her replacement.

characters.name: Taketo Aida
characters.description: Taketo Aida is the grandson of Miss Aida, the owner of the candy store where Ilulu ends up getting a job. Although he starts off being suspicious of Ilulu they end up becoming friends after he's shown her kind side. He's shown to be supportive and kind as he's willing to go out of his way to lend a helping hand.

title: Kashimashi: Girl Meets Girl
title_original: かしまし ～ガール・ミーツ・ガール～
description: Being a girl is harder than it looks... For Hazumu, this couldn't be truer, because just the other day, she...was a he. Shunned by the girl of his dreams, Hazumu loses himself in the mountains and is promptly squashed by an oncoming space ship. The alien inside, feeling guilty, rebuilds Hazumu's body...but as the wrong gender! Now Hazumu must learn how to be the girl his parents always wanted while dealing with the trials and tribulations of being caught in a love triangle between two girls--his childhood friend, Tomari, and Yasuna, the girl who rejected him but is now strangely attracted to him/her! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment).

characters.name: Hazumu Osaragi
characters.description: The story begins with Hazumu, the main character, as a boy, who always seemed to have a crush on his friend and classmate Yasuna Kamiizumi ever since he first met her. He was not very masculine in either his appearance or his actions, and so as a child he would get teased for being so feminine. In addition, several flashbacks have been featured in both the manga and anime featuring Hazumu dressed like a girl at a young age. Whether he wanted to do this of his own accord or his mother just dressed him up is never specified but regardless he didn't seem to be bothered by it; indeed he was shown to enjoy it. Once in high school, he confesses his love to Yasuna one day, but is rejected. Afterwards, he climbs the nearby Mt. Kashima to clear his feelings. He is fatally injured by an alien spacecraft crash-landing on the mountain. In an attempt to rectify the accident, the alien pilot revives H

characters.name: Yasuna Kamiizumi
characters.description: Yasuna tends to be a quiet and often lonely girl compared to the rest of her friends. Since her parents are rarely around due to being overworked, she seems to depend on her close friends for love and support, especially when it comes to Hazumu, who unfortunately doesn't tend to show her the type of affection Yasuna desires from her. Yasuna and Hazumu first met as classmates, though they rarely ever talked with each other, which means that Hazumu was simply admiring Yasuna from afar. One day when on Mt. Kashima sometime before the main story began, Yasuna found that they shared an interest in gardening. It was also at this point where she pointed out how feminine Hazumu appeared, which is also the main reason she could see most of his figure minus his face, which as a male was always shown with his hair covering it. As fate would have it, Yasuna rejected Hazumu's first confession of love

characters.name: Tomari Kurusu
characters.description: Tomari is Hazumu's childhood friend who has been with Hazumu for a long time, and most importantly protected him often from bullies. In direct contrast to Hazumu, her most obvious quality is that she is a tomboy which is shown through her actions and lack of interest in traditionally feminine things such as clothing or shopping. Indeed, Tomari's friends of both genders consider her very masculine which often causes Tomari to get angry at such comments. Additionally, she is a member of the Track and Field Club and enjoys physical activities. Before Hazumu's change, she shows some latent interest in Hazumu and is at first just as shocked as everyone else when he is transformed into a girl. Tomari has always put a lot of effort into supporting Hazumu and defending him whenever he is in despair. Though Hazumu has always been grateful for Tomari's support, at times Tomari later seems to be je

characters.name: Ayuki Mari
characters.description: Ayuki is Tomari's best female friend, who, much like Yasuna, is quiet and reserved, though seems to be more social than Yasuna. Indeed, she serves to act as the voice of reason between the interactions of the other characters. Additionally, Ayuki seems to have an interest in observing the people around her and she enjoys learning about the sciences, though most specifically, biological sciences. It is suggested indirectly that Ayuki is also interested in Hazumu, and later in the anime, she also seems to be interested in Tomari. However, she says that she prefers not to get involved with the developing love triangle and simply observes from the sidelines.

characters.name: Asuta Soro
characters.description: Asuta is Hazumu's best male buddy before and after the UFO crash, though his opinion of Hazumu changes somewhat due to his taking interest in Hazumu's new female form and feminine personality. Asuta is a good deal more manly than Hazumu ever was, and was trying to find Hazumu to give him some adult magazines (which Hazumu hates) on the night of the Mt. Kashima incident as an attempt to try to console him for getting turned down by Yasuna. Asuta has found himself more and more attracted to Hazumu after the transformation, leaving Hazumu completely oblivious of this fact. Eventually, Asuta resolves to simply being Hazumu's best male friend and sees that her main interest is indeed with Yasuna.

characters.name: Namiko Tsuki
characters.description: She is the homeroom teacher of Hazumu's class who has an excessively cute style shown through her loud expressions of love towards Hitoshi Sora or her passion for protecting her students in her class. Also, she is extremely clumsy which gives rise to her being the butt of many jokes.

characters.name: Hitoshi Sora
characters.description: Hitoshi Sora is a cultural anthropologist and space alien. His research brought him to visit Earth, and he is currently in disguise as the biology teacher at Hazumu's high school. His unfamiliarity with human ways provides the series with an outside perspective on love - the focus of Sora's research. Additionally, his views on other subjects, such as friendly competition or war, provide a somewhat existentialist point of view. The alien's research, explained in the manga, is of great importance to the survival of his species as he fears that if his currently rather unemotional people do not rediscover passions like love, they may all eventually die out.

characters.name: Jan Puu
characters.description: Jan Puu is an artificial intelligence employed by Hitoshi Sora as the automatic pilot of his spaceship. Though Jan Puu is very enthusiastic about new people, she seems to have few social skills and often acts like a human child. Her human body is modelled after Hazumu's female body, whom she addresses as onee-nii-sama (お姉兄さま literally meaning "older sister-brother").

characters.name: Touru Osaragi
characters.description: He is Hazumu's father, who loves taking pictures of Hazumu. This often consists of him trying to get Hazumu in provocative poses and expressions which leads his wife to wrestle him down to the ground. Additionally, he repeatedly attempts to take a bath with his daughter but is always stopped.

characters.name: Kahoru Osaragi
characters.description: She is Hazumu's mother, who loves to buy new feminine clothes for Hazumu to wear. Usually she buys these clothes without consulting Hazumu herself and regardless Hazumu ends up wearing them, though Hazumu doesn't put up any resistance to her new and ever increasing wardrobe.

title: Kare to Kanojo no Sentaku
title_original: カレとカノジョの選択
description: Hokkaido and Tokyo: Seven years after being separated, the young man has been waiting for his best friend to meet again since middle school. What arrived at him was an email from a best friend who apologized for being late, and a mysterious beauty. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title: Dame Inu Kanojo
description: Sakurako Kuramochi has totally remade herself into a more popular girl since her debut in high school. However, deep down inside, she still bears the scars of being dumped by a girl she used to like. One day after school, while walking downtown, Sakurako bumps into another girl, who turns out to be that girl who rejected her in the past! For some reason, she proclaims that she's fallen in love with Sakurako at first sight, and asks if they can meet again. Sakurako gets angry at the girl for not recognizing her, and comes up with a plan to get revenge...? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Osananajimi BIG LOVE
description: I once had a childhood friend who was a cute angel. However, when we met again, many years later, she had become a flamboyant gal. A yuri story between two childhood friends. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published, it was collected for a commercial volume release on 2024-09-26.

title: Oshi to no Yuri wa Arienai!
title_original: 推しとの百合はありえない！
description: It's a yuri manga!! It's original!! A wholesome all-ages manga that definitely won't do anything illegal. (Source: Pixiv, translated) Note: Originally self-published on Pixiv, was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.

characters.name: Kaoru Kenzaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm A cheerful dumb gyaru who gushes over the class representative, Tsukamoto Anne, whom she perceives to be incredibly beautiful. Due to her poor grades and rule-breaking tendencies, as well as the possibility of being suspended or expelled from school, she was chosen to join Tsukamoto as a class representative so that Tsukamoto could assist her in changing her behavior. Tsukamoto, on the other hand, begins to assume she is a drug addict due to her lack of intelligence.

characters.name: Anne Tsukamoto
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm A class representative who is a perfectionist with an aggressive personality. Her perfectionist attitude prompts her to accept a teacher's offer to have her improve the conduct of Kenzaki Kaoru, a dumb gyaru who adores Tsukamoto and is also a type of person Tsukamoto despises, by appointing them both as class representatives. However, Kenzaki's weird and dumb behavior when she meets with her gives her the false impression that she uses drugs, and Tsukamoto discreetly tries to help her overcome her drug addiction.

title: Kyuuketsuki to Yobaretai
description: Aoi wants to go to the same school as her childhood friend Yuuna so she transfers to Vlad Academy, but everyone except Aoi is actually a vampire!? Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title: Watashi no Shumitte Hen desu ka?
title_original: 私のシュミってヘンですか?
description: Maiko Fujimiya is a second-year high school student whose hobby is admiring girls' butts.She likes to stand at the bottom of the stairway closest to the female-only train and stare upwards. However, she doesn't adore all butts equally; her type is a big, sexy, plump ass. Fortunately, she has noticed a girl with the perfect butt riding on the same train as her. Moreover, she also gets off at the same station as Maiko. Still, Maiko is content with admirng that ass from afar and fantasising about it, but her life is about the change when the girl suddenly approaches her. Included one-shot: Himitsu no Zettai Ryouiki (秘蜜の絶対領域)

title: Fatale Game
description: "If it means that I can read your work again, I'll even chase you to the ends of the earth." Seri Tainaka, writing under the pen name Nanakusa, is a mid-career manga artist living in the shadow of her only one-hit-wonder. Her series "To Hell and Back" was adored by fans, but despite now being a ten-year veteran, her successes ended there. So when Seri is told that she is being assigned a new editor, it only fuels her insecurities. When Seri meets the quirky Sumire Futami, she's both creeped out and captivated by the strange and overly forthright woman, who claims she'd go to hell and back to make her a success again. But just when Seri starts to think she and Futami might be an unstoppable duo, she meets the other manga artists Futami is assigned to, and a dangerous game of jealousy, envy, and femme fatales begins. It turns out that Futami has no qualms about going back and forth between which of her artists capture her attention the most, and they'll stop at nothing to win the number one spot in their fickle editor's heart! (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: mono
description: From Afro, the creator of Laid-Back Camp, comes a new comedy adventure manga! The Photography Club is in danger of shutting down?! And the Cinema Club too?! Fret not, for they shall merge and become…Cinephoto Club! Now club members Satsuki, An, and Sakurako are asked to be the main characters for manga artist Haruno's latest work that's centered around action cameras. The girls head out to capture the lovely sights of Japan, experimenting with gadgets beyond photography and film equipment, and of course, chomping on the local delicacies along the way! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Haruno Akiyama
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm (5′5″) **Camera:** Smartphone A 4-koma manga artist, using the pen name "Akino", and was a few steps shy of becoming a full-blown NEET. Lives with her grandmother who runs a cheap sweets shop.

characters.name: Sakurako Shikishima
characters.description: **Height:** 145 cm (4′9″) **Camera:** Smartphone The president of the Cinema Studies Club. When all the senior students graduated, she was left behind (alongside fellow member "Ms. Tajima"), and like the Photo Club, Sakurako's club is on the verge of being completely dismantled.

characters.name: Kako Komada
characters.description: **Height:** 175 cm (5′9″) **Camera:** Wide-angle action camera Kako is a motorcyclist who is into "motovlogging", often recording her scenic rides for people to watch on the Internet on WeTube — her "ISERIDER" account contains multi-part touring videos that might average 20,000 views.

characters.name: Satsuki Amamiya
characters.description: **Height:** 155 cm (5′1″) **Camera:** 360° camera A girl who adored her senpai so much that she joined her Photography Club. Unfortunately, after her senpai's graduation, Satsuki was left in ruins, until she finally made the initiative to buy not just a camera -- but one that captures the world in 360-degrees!

characters.name: An Kiriyama
characters.description: **Height:** 150 cm (4′11″) **Camera:** Wide-angle action camera An loves "Sacchan" (Satsuki) so much that she also joined the Photography Club. Her personal camera is a small, but tough-bodied action cam.

characters.name: Torayo Kurokuma
characters.description: Famous horror manga artist. She lives in a famous shrine and loves cats

characters.name: Fuuka Inomata
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm (5′5″) She is an alumnus and actress of the old Cinema Club.

characters.name: Nadeshiko Kagamihara
characters.description: A member of the outdoor crew at high school, she’s drawn into camping when she meets [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/124586/Shima-Rin) at a lake shore. She’s always cheerful and positive and loves anything fun.

characters.name: Sakura Kagamihara
characters.description: Sakura Kagamihara is the older sister of [Nadeshiko Kagamihara](https://anilist.co/character/124576). She often drives Nadeshiko to and from campsite destinations.

characters.name: Shuuichirou Kagamihara
characters.description: The father of [Nadeshiko](https://anilist.co/character/124576/Nadeshiko-Kagamihara) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/125023/Sakura-Kagamihara) Kagamihara.

title: Tai Sekaiyou Mahou Shoujo Tsubame
title_original: 対世界用魔法少女つばめ
title_en: Magical Girl Tsubame: I Will (Not) Save The World!
description: The world is in danger! Who will rise to protect it? Introducing Tsubame, an ordinary high school student who dreams of becoming a magical girl. But if she has to choose between the world and her friends... A new adventure from Mapollo 3, the creator of PPPPPP! Buckle up for some passion, magical girls, and a dash of madness! (Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Dachi no Imouto
description: A friend asked him to keep an eye on his friend's sister to keep her away from bad guys, but it backfires. Love at first sight and a secret relationship are filled with sweet immorality. A love story with a difficult road ahead. (Source: Hakusensha, translated) Note: Includes 33 extra chapters.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Gou
title_original: ひぐらしのなく頃に 業
description: Life couldn’t be better for Keiichi Maebara. Sure, not much happens in the sleepy mountain village of Hinamizawa…but in the three short weeks since moving here, he’s already found some amazing new buddies—who are all cute girls! However, when he discovers hints of Hinamizawa’s violent history, his dear companions insist on keeping him in the dark. Keiichi can’t escape his growing unease—will it be enough to shake his faith in his best friends? (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Rena Ryuuguu
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2'') Rena is a girl who returned from Ibaraki to Hinamizawa one year ago and now is in the same grade level as [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi). She is very kind and capable and takes care of Keiichi and her friends whenever possible, but is also naive and is usually subject to light teasing by Keiichi. She is distinguished by her obsession with things she perceives as adorable, calling them kāii (かぁいい), a slurred form of kawaii (かわいい) meaning "cute." Those tend to be moekko characters or items she finds while scouring the local dump, which are not considered cute by others. Despite this disarming trait, Rena is shown to be amazingly observant and perceptive about the things around her.

characters.name: Rika Furude
characters.description: Rika Furude is one of the younger students in [Keiichi's](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi) school, and is in the same grade level as [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko). Naturally, she is great friends with her, as they live together in the same house. She is revered by the villagers as the heir of the local shrine, and plays the role of a miko in the annual Watanagashi Festival. She has been the head of the Furude house since her parents died, but rarely attends town meetings due to her young age. While she does not speak a lot, she likes to say nonsense words such as "mi~" and "nipa~" and often ends her sentences with "-nano desu", which inflames [Rena's](https://anilist.co/character/1427/Ryuuguu-Rena) passion for cute things. Despite her young appearance, she is rather calm and reserved-usually serving as the voice of reason amongst the club mem

characters.name: Mion Sonozaki
characters.description: Mion is the oldest kid in [Keiichi Maebara](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s class. As the elder, she is the class president and everyone looks up to her as the leader. She acts like a perverted tomboy and calls herself old man, but has a hidden girlish side. Mion is next in line to be the head of the Sonozaki household, one of the Three Families which holds tremendous influence in Hinamizawa. Often when playing games with her fellow club members she is known for her ruthlessness, often coming up with the most embarrassing penalties for the losers. Mion also serves as the leader of the main characters' gaming club. ~!Mion is more stable than the other club members, and as such has never herself succumbed to Hinamizawa Syndrome!~

characters.name: Satoko Houjou
characters.description: Satoko is a younger classmate in [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s school. She has a distinctive style of speech, ending all of her sentences with 'wa' which, at times, is grammatically incorrect. In spite of her young age, she is quite clever in setting up traps, and likes to practice on Keiichi. Despite her extremely energetic and playful disposition she is actually quite the crybaby, which [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion) and Keiichi often tease her about. Satoko is also very close with [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika), who she lives with. ~!Although her personality is quite energetic and mischievous during the events of the games, Satoko's past was full of trauma; her parents died in an accident, she was abused by her foster parents (her aunt and uncle), and her beloved brother Satoshi disappeared. However, in M

characters.name: Keiichi Maebara
characters.description: Keiichi is the son of a famous and extremely wealthy artist and has recently moved to Hinamizawa after an array of unfortunate events in his hometown. His charismatic, lively attitude and talented tongue allow him to quickly fit in the town and make new friends and also win some club activities. Though he can be somewhat shy and is easily spooked at times. ~! In the first couple arcs, paranoia drives him to murder his friends and others, but in the other arcs, he gains inner strength and faith in his friends, enough to change the fate of Hinamizawa, sometimes by remembering the events of Onikakushi-hen.!~ When in need of a weapon, he wields Satoshi's old bat. Keiichi often receives the butt of the jokes in the club's activities from which he was the correct answer to some games they play, to wearing embarrassing costumes whenever he loses punishment games. Keiichi has brown hair with dar

characters.name: Shion Sonozaki
characters.description: Shion is [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion)'s identical twin sister, who currently resides in Okinomiya. In spite of their different personalities, she and Mion often switch places, and it can be difficult to distinguish between them. ~!Their first switch took place when they were little. Right before tattooing the symbol of an oni, which is reserved for the older sister, she was mistakenly identified as Shion, the younger sister, which means that she was actually born as Mion Sonozaki, the older sister. Since then, she switched her identity of Mion with Shion, the younger sister.!~ She was sent by the Sonozaki family to a private boarding school, but escaped and returned to live near her hometown, where she lives with [Kasai](https://anilist.co/character/14928/Kasai-Tatsuyoshi). In spite of all this, she and Mion maintain a close relationship. In most of the arcs, s

characters.name: Satoshi Houjou
characters.description: Satoshi is the older brother of [Satoko Houjou](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko). Although he is currently missing, his past influence is the key to the actions of several characters in Higurashi. Similar to Satoko, he cannot distinguish the difference between cauliflower and broccoli. Because of this, it can be inferred that both Satoshi and Satoko are color-blind. ~!It is revealed in Matsuribayashi-hen (Festival Accompanying Chapter), that Satoshi is in fact alive.
