At times, her storytelling can be very mysterious and chilling—she seems to enjoy putting people on edge. ~!In the first six arcs, she consistently disappears on the night of Watanagashi, and an incinerated body thought to be hers is found in the mountains. Later, however, it turns out that she is the mastermind of the events taking place in Hinamizawa who wants to murder [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) so she can prove her grandfather's research. Since her will and manipulations are so strong as to affect the people in the village both directly and indirectly, she infact fakes her death through the first six arcs of the story (the corpse in the barrel being a stolen corpse), and murders Rika in three of the arcs which she uses

title: Yueguo Chenshi de Ge
description: During troubled times, Weng Shaoying is one of the most famous singers in Dongping. Many people go to Song of Fairyland just to see her perform. However, under her glamorous facade, she has been controlled for more than 10 years. On the other side of Dongping is Bi Xing Tang, one of the most famous gangs there. After her father’s death, Yanchu became the young female leader of Bi Xing Tang, which caused a lot of rumors to spread. On one inevitably fortuitous night, the two happened to meet. At that time, neither of them knew that they would eventually become the most important person in the other’s life. Starting from that night onwards, the gears in Shaoying and Yanchu’s fate will forever be rotating together. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Kekkon Aite no Jouken ni Pittari datta no wa Shokuba no Kouhai Joshi deshita.
title_original: 結婚相手の条件にピッタリだったのは職場の後輩女子でした。
title_en: Mr. Right Turned Out To Be A Younger Woman!?
description: Still single at age 33, Haruki Shiina is standing at the biggest crossroads of her life. While unlucky in love, she's popular among her female coworkers for her laidback and boyish personality. The only one who gives her the cold shoulder is Risa Takagai, a beautiful and capable new hire who is already climbing her way up the corporate ladder. Haruki sees her as her biggest rival and is sure that the feeling is mutual, but why does Risa always seem to be watching her...? (Source: Renta!)

title: Candy boy
description: Based on the popular yuri ONA series, which is about the relationship between two fraternal twins and their daily life. Yukino and Kanade continue their schooling, and Kanade takes a late night art class in preparation for her future. As before, she usually ends up fooling around and drawing her sister in strange poses before finally getting her work done. Kanade begins to question the feelings she has for Yukino... does she feel a pure sisterly love for her, or are her feelings more perverted? Note: Also includes a seven chapter side story, Candy☆Boy: Young Girls Fall in Love, and two additional bonus chapters.

characters.name: Kanade Sakurai
characters.description: Kanade is a high school student currently sharing a dorm room with her twin sister [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/7325/Sakurai-Yukino). She is more pragmatic and less easy-going than Yukino and tends to get exasperated a lot, especially when it comes to the advances of her kouhai. She is also somewhat easy to ruffle emotionally. She often worries that Yukino is sacrificing herself for her benefit. Kanade is an artist and wants to pursue art studies, however, she understands that it would be difficult to pursue a career in the field and maintain a close relationship with Yukino. Her little sister [Shizuku](https://anilist.co/character/16153/Sakurai-Shizuku) is closer to her than she is to Yukino, however Kanade is more distant with the younger girl and does not make the same amount of effort as Yukino to be closer to Shizuku.

characters.name: Yukino Sakurai
characters.description: Yukino is the older amongst the two. She's very fond of snacks and Sakuya often trades snacks with Yukino for Kanade's pictures. She is a member of their school's swim team. ~!Later in the series, Yukino decides to work part time in order to be able to pay for Kanade's art cram school. However, Kanade refused at this because she felt that if Yukino started working part time and she attended the art cram school, they will get to spend less time with each other. Yukino insisted and started working anyway which in turn created a strain in their relationship.!~

characters.name: Sakuya Kamiyama
characters.description: A younger girl who is in deeply infatuated with [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/7324/Sakurai-Kanade) with the point that she is almost stalking her. She is extremely wealthy and often tries to spend her money after the twins. She likes collecting old paraphernalia, junk and pictures that belong to Kanade, most of which goes to her makeshift shrine. Despite her overwhelming presence, the twins seem to like her. [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/7325/Sakurai-Yukino) is amused by her and Kanade seems more irritated than anything, but they both seem to have some sort of affection for the girl. Initially, her presence was seen as a threat to Kanade as she assumed Sakuya was interested in Yukino. She became aware that Sakuya was madly in love with her when Yukino clears the situation up.

characters.name: Shizuku Sakurai
characters.description: Kanade and Yukino's much younger sister. Shizuku is a lot more level-headed than her sisters. She is deeply affected by the actions of Kanade, who she seems to care about more than Yukino. Unlike her sisters, she buries all her emotions deep down without expressing them but they later resurface in various ways, such as her cutting school. She also appears to be very passive-aggressive. Despite Yukino's attempts to become closer to her, Shizuku clearly spurns the attention of her older sister. This is possibly due to jealousy she feels, as Kanade spends more time with Yukino, and Shizuka would prefer that Kanade pays more attention to her instead. She seems quietly aware of the deeper relationship that her sisters may have.

characters.name: Isako Mikanagi
characters.description: Sakuya's calssmate. Always acts high and mighty; she proclaims herself as Sakuya's rival in conquering their Kanade Sakurai's heart. ~!It is later revealed that she is very poor since the death of her father. While she seemingly competes Sakuya for winning Kanade's heart, it the end it turns out that it is in fact Sakuya that Isako has feelings for.!~

characters.name: Eri Miyagi
characters.description: Sakuya's classmate. She seems to be the most level-headed of the group. She and Masumi are childhood friends. It is hinted that she might have a crush on Masumi.

characters.name: Masumi Kurasuma
characters.description: Sakuya's classmate and Eri's childhood friend. She is energetic and loves her stomach. It is hinted that she might have a crush on Eri.

characters.name: Yuriko Takanashi
characters.description: Kanade's classmate. She seems to be the voice of reason throughout the series, she is the one the sisters are consulting, when they have troubles regarding their relationship.

characters.name: Isako's Mother
characters.description: Isako's mother. She has been raising her daughter alone and has been doing multiple jobs, since Isako's father died.

title: Last Summer Vacation
title_original: ラストサマー・バケーション
description: I saw something in that girl from my class that she "didn't want anyone else to see..." Mizuki is a cute, bright, and popular girl. She is devoted to caring for her sick mother and seems like the perfect "good girl" in every way. Until Unno saw Mizuki in a situation she shouldn't have......? What happens when you try to escape from reality? A road movie about sad girls. (Source: Comic Bridge, translated)

characters.name: Mizuki Otonashi
characters.description: Mizuki is a cute, bright student who's loved by everyone. Outside of school, she spends her days caring for her sick mother.

characters.name: Ayumi Umino
characters.description: Ayumi is a gloomy student who sneaks alcohol into school and skips class. Her classmates all avoid her, except for Mizuki.

title: Uchi no Shishou wa Shippo ga Nai
title_original: うちの師匠はしっぽがない
description: Mameda is a tanuki who was born in the wrong era - all she wants is to trick humans, but that age of tanuki shenanigans is over. But one woman, a rakugo master named Bunko, shows Mameda it's still possible to cast magic on humans...only with words, not illusions. Mameda is determined to become Bunko's apprentice, but can she convince the stoic master to take her on...? (Source: Kodansha USA) Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

title: Iseikai Tensei
description: Noah is a youth that is the final survivor of Earth, sent out by his scientist mother in a spaceship to find a new world. He then encounters a planet where all living creatures have "magic." As he searches this new world, he meets a girl who calls herself, "the daughter of the Demon Lord?!" This is an isekai SF fantasy where a young cyborg travels to a mystery-filled world! (Source: Alpha Manga)

characters.name: Noah Yesterday
characters.description: A young, full-body cyborg who awakens in a new world after being put in stasis by his mother.

characters.name: Eve Yesterday
characters.description: Noah's mother-like creator. A scientist who keeps bringing up "fixing her own mistakes". ~!Capable of posessing others via mysterious means, giving her full control over their body, always indicated by putting on a hair tie.!~ ~!Ultimately revealed to have destroyed the world multiple times before using a program implanted into all demons which activates when civilization progresses too far. She keeps creating cyborgs in hopes one of them will finally defeat her one day and stop her from recreating the world ad infinitum.!~

characters.name: Ellie Claydoll
characters.original: エリー・クレイドール
characters.description: Lord Balor's daughter. An energetic, go-getter demon girl who befriends Noah.

characters.name: Balor Claydoll
characters.original: バロル・クレイドール
characters.description: The current king of demons. Very sentimental and, at times, overprotective of his daughter, Ellie.

characters.name: Kyoukou
characters.description: A mysterious cyborg leader building an army equipped with technologically advanced artifacts to exterminate demons. ~!He was one of Eve Yesterday's acquaintances and the first of her coworkers to witness the horrors of her civilization reset system.!~

characters.name: Anna
characters.description: A powerful psychic, capable of reading others' thoughts and leader of the resistance, aiming to create a society where demons and humans coexist. Claims kissing her target is absolutely necessary whenever she reads women's minds. ~!She's also revealed to be The Pope's daughter.!~

title: Slow Start
description: The story centers around 17-year-old Hana Ichinose, who unbeknownst to her classmates, was a year late in enrolling into high school. Although it may not seem like a big deal, it is a big deal to her. She wants to catch up with everyone else someday. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Kamuri Sengoku
characters.description: A childlike girl whose physical development greatly lags behind her actual age. She is an old friend of Eiko from elementary school, whom she adores, and becomes timid around others whenever Eiko is absent. Whenever she is addressed with a sensitive topic, she somehow manages to twitch her hair ribbon as an expression of her feelings. Her main hobbies are eating and sleeping (the latter of which is perhaps the primary reason for her belated development), although she is an extremely fast runner at sports. Her name is derived from _kamuriwashi._

characters.name: Tamate Momochi
characters.description: A bubbly, cheerful girl from [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/124746/Ichinose-Hana)'s class who likes to be friends with everyone she meets. She likes to be called "Tama" because she does not like her full name's association with the word _tamatebako._

characters.name: Hana Ichinose
characters.description: The main protagonist of the series, who just recently moved and now attends the Hoshio Private Academy in her first year of high school. Because she caught mumps and thus had to miss out on her high school entry exams, she was forced to repeat her entire final middle school year. As a result, she is very self-conscious about her current standing and that she does not have anyone of her old school friends in her company, and is therefore very glad to build up an immediate friendship with Eiko, Kamuri and Tamate.

characters.name: Eiko Tokura
characters.description: A tall, gentle, and level-headed girl with a natural charisma which has made her very popular with her peers without any effort.

characters.name: Shion Kyouzuka
characters.description: Hana's adult cousin and the landlady of a boarding house, where Hana resides for the duration of her high school period. She is pretty and extremely well-endowed, but behaves more like a teenager than an adult woman. Her favorite hobby is taking a close interest in Hana's private life.

characters.name: Kiyose Enami
characters.description: Hana's homeroom teacher, who summons up very little enthusiasm for her job.

characters.name: Hiroe Hannen
characters.description: A resident of the apartment building Hana and Shion live in. After an experience not dissimilar to Hana's led her to miss her university exams, the guilt of lying to her peers caused her to become a shut-in. She soon starts to become more confident after meeting Hana and is one of the few people who knows about her situation.

title: Baka ni Kokuhaku
description: Ayumu Otsuki is a space lover with an ambitious dream—to meet an alien. Lacking friends or romantic experience, she starts an Astronomy Club by herself, to create a place where she feels she belongs. One day after school, she was putting up a poster to advertise the club when an upperclassman stepped in to help. The upperclassman introduces herself as Hayami, and Ayumu immediately falls in love at first sight with her! Ayumu's mind is now consumed by romance, and she goes all out to share her feelings. However, Senpai seems to already have other interests. She fell for a fitness junkie?! A peculiar girl's straightforward romcom!!

characters.name: Ayumu Otsuki
characters.description: A space lover who dreams to meet an alien. Despite lacking experience with friendship or romance, she falls in love with Hina Hayami after Hina recognized her passion.

characters.name: Hina Hayami
characters.description: A cheerful upperclassman fitness junkie. Despite her not understanding romance, she feels drawn to Ayumu's passion.

title: Nameraretakunai Namekawa-san
title_original: ナメられたくないナメカワさん
description: After putting up with years of bullying in junior high, Namekawa-san decides to make a preemptive strike when she starts high school. Her plan? Become a delinquent! At first, everything seems to be going great–her classmates are terrified. However, the head of the disciplinary committee is unfazed. She’s got her eye on Namekawa-san, and she refuses to look away in this explosive yuri comedy! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: includes 11 extra chapters

characters.name: Saya Namekawa
characters.description: The main character, a girl that was bullied and tries to act like a delinquent but always fails. Tojo's obsession

characters.name: Sayuri Toujo
characters.description: The disciplinary committee chair, obsessed with Namekawa, always tries to harass her.

title: Shoujo Kakumei Utena: After The Revolution
title_original: 少女革命ウテナ After The Revolution
title_en: Revolutionary Girl Utena: After the Revolution
description: Utena has saved Anthy by defeating Akio in the final duel, but in doing so she has vanished from the world. Now the student council members at Ohtori Academy find themselves in their own revolutions. (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Miki Kaoru
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Blue Rose Bride: Kozue Kaoru Sword: Épée Drive to Duel: To find "that which shines" Miki is a highly skilled and polite seventh grader who befriends Utena, despite their role as possible opponents in the duels. A piano player par excellence, Miki has fond memories of playing songs with his twin sister Kozue in his childhood, but her refusal to play with him in the present — the symbol of a much deeper rift — gives Miki a sense of loss. His crush on Anthy in the anime (but on Utena in the manga) develops when he realizes that they remind him of his estranged sister. In both adaptions, his drive to duel stems from a desire to find something to replace Kozue in his affections. All the females of the school, even older ones, idolize him, but Kozue threatens any girls who attempt to get too close to him. Likewise he is very protective of her, and so she tries to make him jealo

characters.name: Juri Arisugawa
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Orange __Rose Bride:__ Ruka Tsuchiya __Sword:__ Rapier __(Anime) Drive to Duel:__ To disprove the power of miracles The captain of the academy's fencing team, Juri is one of Ohtori's most highly respected students, and even the teachers appear to be in awe of her.

characters.name: Touga Kiryuu
characters.description: President of the Student Council, Touga is an arrogant and handsome young man whose desire to be powerful drives him to cruel and unscrupulous deeds. Although he says that he wishes to be noble, he has little empathy towards anyone, and his powers of manipulation are second only to Akio. He also shares his playboy attiude and has many female conquests. He is a childhood friend of Saionji, although their relationship took a turn for the worse at a point in their childhood that is the centerpiece of their respective personal journeys. ~!Toward the end of the series, however, Touga's facade of chivalry is replaced with an apparently truer concern for Utena, to the extent that he very subtly attempts to substitute his head for hers on Akio's chopping block. Arguably, this is also an example of Touga's inability to see Utena as who she really is, rather than in a stereotypical feminine role.

characters.name: Kyouichi Saionji
characters.description: __Sword:__ Sword of Dios, Katana __Drive to Duel:__ To find something eternal, to claim Anthy as his Rose Bride, and to finally defeat Touga (Anime) Vice-president of the Student Council and captain of the kendo team, and is the first duelist Utena fights. He is temperamental, egotistic, prone to angry rages, often cruel, and extremely possessive of Anthy. His belief that they are destined to be together no matter what drive him to be physically violent towards her and continue to pursue her even after their engagement is broken. He and Touga practice kendo together, but Saionji is clearly very resentful of Touga, and especially cannot bear to be humiliated by him (a fact which Touga shamelessly exploits). Saionji is less perceptive, intelligent, and skilled as Touga, and despite his best efforts can never seem to best him. He is regardless affected by this estrangement from his childhoo

characters.name: Utena Tenjou
characters.description: Utena is a tomboyish, courageous and naïve character who lives to emulate the idealized prince figure from her childhood. She is forthright, honest, and friendly, and nearly all the girls in school adore her.

characters.name: Anthy Himemiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm A mysterious and shy dark-skinned girl whose sometimes vapid expression and superficial politeness seem to mask something deeper. Many people project their wants or desires onto her, and she's often the target of their eventual rage or hate. Her "doormat" behavior belies a far more complex personality. Anthy appears to house the Sword of Dios within her own body. At the beginning of a duel, she slips into a trance and the Sword manifests, protruding from her chest so that her champion may draw it from her. This Sword is said to be a key to reaching the goal of Revolution, and in her position as the Rose Bride Anthy is said to be the key to obtaining it.

characters.name: Akio Ootori
characters.description: Anthy's older brother, the acting chairman of the academy. Although barely present in the first season of the show, he later plays a pivotal role in the second and third seasons. His given name derives from the Japanese name for Venus, the Morning Star, which is identified with Lucifer.

characters.name: Kozue Kaoru
characters.description: She's Miki's twin sister who feels overshadowed by his talent and dirtied by comparison with him. Kozue resents Miki's affection for Anthy Himemiya and is prone to acting out to grab her brother's attention, most notably by exercising loose sexual morals. Like Nanami, Kozue also seems to have an extreme brother complex. She is very protective of Miki and is the reason that he does not have a girlfriend (despite the affection of many of his schoolmates). Kozue considers herself a "wild animal," wanting to be freed from adult rules and restrictions (in reality, she is resentful of her father remarrying). ~!In Adolescence of Utena she is shown as being very possessive of Miki, even holding a razor to his throat and calling him a traitor when he refuses to divulge details of his personal affairs to her. A car with Kozue's name is also seen briefly, though the director merely states

characters.name: Ruka Tsuchiya
characters.description: A master swordsman, Ruka is former captain of the fencing team and occasional member of the Student Council. He considers Juri to be the most talented member of the club and considers himself her mentor. ~! * Rose: Blue * Rose Bride: Shiori Takatsuki * Sword: Rapier * (Anime) Drive to Duel: To give Juri, the one he loves, the power of miracles. In the manga, Anthy served as Ruka's Rose Bride on several occasions before he left the school due to an unknown illness. He reappears at the school after a prolonged absence, claiming that he has recovered, though still not well enough to duel. He pushes Juri to duel Utena once again, but she throws the match after overhearing what she thinks is Ruka discussing with Touga how he's manipulating her. When she refuses to duel, Ruka himself is forced to duel Utena, and the strain causes a relapse of his illness. As he lies on the dueling fi

characters.name: Shiori Takatsuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 163.5 cm ~!__Sword:__ Juri's Rapier __Drive to Duel:__ To gain superiority over Juri.!~ Juri's childhood friend. ~!Shiori left the school after stealing the man she believed to be Juri's boyfriend in order to feel more powerful than her, leaving Juri devastated (contrary to Shiori's initial beliefs, however, Juri is hurt because of her love for Shiori). Shiori is in many ways an innocent character, in denial of her true feelings of admiration for Juri. Due to her inferiority complex, her attitude towards Juri is often downright sadistic (as her schemes are often designed to hurt Juri for no reason other than to see her suffer) and at the same time masochistic (as Shiori hurts herself every time she hurts Juri). Upon discovering Juri's love for her, Shiori becomes a Black Rose Duellist and pulls her duelling sword from Juri. In the movie her role as an anta

title: Angae Bada Wiui Sherbet
title_en: Sherbet Above the Sea of Fog
description: Sherbet knows she might run into pirates or sea monsters on her voyage, but what spooks her most is the ghost ship rumored to kidnap people. Although she’s relieved to hear that it only takes them for a special reason, she soon wakes up on the infamous vessel without any clue why! Despite her initial despair, however, Sherbet is delighted to find the grumpy but hot pirate, Granita, on board with her. On the other hand, Granita finds hell in the form of the bubbly little terror who can't seem to keep her hands and innuendos to herself... (Source: Tappytoon)

characters.name: Sherbet
characters.description: Sherbet is a young woman from a wealthy family. She’s bubbly, kindhearted, emotional, and often flirty towards women (especially [Granita](https://anilist.co/character/337789/Granita)). While on her way to meet her fiancé, Sherbet suddenly finds herself trapped on a ghost ship. Despite life on the ship being difficult and perilous, she actually enjoys her days there with Granita and the others, and seems to dread the idea of leaving. All her life, Sherbet has struggled with social interaction, especially with other women. She has trouble understanding social cues, reading other people’s emotions, and has a habit of taking things too literally. Because of this (and her tendency to flirt with girls), she’s seen as an outcast in high society: she is shunned, avoided, and called names. Although men are always flocking to her on account of her looks—something Sherbet hates, since she’s only i

title: Egao no Taenai Shokuba Desu.
title_original: 笑顔のたえない職場です。
description: New shoujo manga artist Nana Futami works hard every day while being supported by Kaede Satou, her female editor who is older than her, and Mizuki Hazama, her assistant. According to the girl herself, she sometimes drums up intense daydream delusions of occupational illness! A working girls comedy set in the entertainment industry, brought to you by an author who always draws various girls.

characters.name: Nana Futami
characters.description: A woman who writes a serialized manga about shogi (Japanese chess) in a girl's manga magazine. She is a rookie manga artist whose current work is her first serialization, and was Takizawa's assistant until the serialization was decided. She is shy and paranoid, and often receives various criticisms from her assistant Mizuki Hazama. She is trusted by Kaede Satou, the editor in charge of the series, because she always manages to produce work of a certain quality or higher even when the schedule is tight. She is also known as a "genius" among her collaborators such as Satou and Hazama, but she evaluates herself as "less than ordinary".

characters.name: Kaede Satou
characters.description: [Nana Futami's](https://anilist.co/character/298294/Nana-Futami) editor. She appreciates Futami's talent, but is shy and doesn't praise her much. Although she seems to be the one to lead, she often forgets to tell Futami important things, causing her trouble.

characters.name: Mizuki Hazama
characters.description: A talented assistant to [Nana Futami](https://anilist.co/character/298294/Nana-Futami). Although she has been the talk of the town on social media many times, she has given up on the idea of ​​being a manga artist and continues to work as an assistant. Futami calls her "Ha-san."

characters.name: Arisa Nashida
characters.description: Manga artist. Serialized a romantic comedy manga in a boys' magazine. A senior from [Nana Futami's](https://anilist.co/character/298294/Nana-Futami) assistant days who somehow ended up hanging around Futami's house constantly... Loves alcohol.

characters.name: Touko Kakunodate
characters.description: A female shogi player who supervises the shogi sections in [Nana Futami's](https://anilist.co/character/298294/Nana-Futami) manga. While she's good at giving compliments and is a people-pleaser, she sometimes worries about the world of shogi, which is her main job.

characters.name: Nekonote
characters.description: [Futami's](https://anilist.co/character/298294/Nana-Futami) assistant. A serious person who lives in Aomori and aims to become a manga artist. Her editor is [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/356303/Kaede-Satou).

title: Rakuen no Jouken
description: Collection of the following stories: 1. Rakuen no Jouken (The Conditions for Paradise) Two adult women figuring out the boundaries in their relationship--is too much freedom a bad thing? 2. Hoshi no Mukougawa (Beyond the Stars) Chapter 1 prequel. It's about how Sarina and Sumi first became more than friends. 3. Bathed in Sunlight Filtering Through the Trees A continuation of Sarina and Sumi's relationship. 4. 20-Musumex30-Otome About an art prep school teacher who feels like she can't compare to her new 20-year-old girlfriend. 5. The Opposite of "Seme" is "Protector" Chapter 4 sequel. Keiko wants to take things further. There are two more stories in this series in the Lapis Lazuli Dream collection. 6. We're Aiming For Love Now It's about two women who love each other just as they are. 7. Momo no Aji (Peach Taste) A girl struggles to convince the object of her affections to take her seriously. 8. Sakurahime Hanafubuki (Princess Sakura, Showered With Blossoms ) A story set in Japan's past about a cherry blossom that falls in love with a girl. The cherry blossom is granted a human body with the condition that if she nor the girl she loves are able to sacrifice everything for their lov

title: Naraku no Hanazono
description: Meari, a girl who moved from Tokyo to the countryside, meets the mysterious girl Colin in a "secret garden" up in the mountains. With nowhere to go, they share a "secret" in the garden that they can't tell anyone. They didn't realize the consequences of what they did....... (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Gal to Bocchi
description: "I don't need any friends." That was what the loner Hina told the gyaru Hayashibara, the only girl in class who would talk to Hina. In spite of that, Hayashibara persistently spent more time with her, and Hina's lonely school life gradually changes.

title: Osananajimi no Ijou Kawaii Imouto-chan
title_original: 幼馴染の異常可愛い妹ちゃん
description: Yanagi, a second-year high school student, has a faint crush on Mizuki, the younger sister of her childhood friend Momo. One day, while rummaging through Mizuki's personal belongings in her room, Yanagi discovers the truth about Mizuki...?

title: Blood: The Last Vampire (2002)
title_original: ブラッド ザ・ラストヴァンパイア 2000
description: Blood: The Last Vampire 2002 is a powerfully drawn original graphic novel narrative based on characters and situations from the 2001 anime Blood: The Last Vampire, once the fastest-selling title in the history of Manga Entertainment. Taken from a concept developed by Ghost in the Shell's Mamoru Oshii, one of the 21st century's hottest young comics artists, the violent, erotic Benkyo Tamaoki, updates the Vietnam War-era anime story to present-day, 2002 Japan. The immortal Saya returns - a generation later, but still clad in her trademark sailor suit and armed with ancient samurai sword - continuing her unholy war against the vampiric Chiropterans. Infiltrating a gang-ridden high school, Saya more than suspects the brutal set known as "ORGE" is just the latest mask of her blood-thirsty prey. (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Saya
characters.description: She hunts chiropterans using a katana. It is implied that she is the last remaining vampire and is called "the only remaining original." Saya has no weakness to sunlight but it is unknown if she has any of the other vulnerabilities of normal vampires. However, she becomes distressed when she encounters religious people and angry when people mention God in her presence. Saya displays superhuman senses and strength, as well as cunning, resourcefulness, and skill. The manga series suggests she was a human-vampire hybrid.

title: Spica wo Tsukamaete
description: Nekozuka Serina is a serious third-year high school student who’s studying hard to qualify for a scholarship. Her cute and stylish looks, however, don’t exactly meet the school dress code—which Tachibana Reiko, a member of the disciplinary committee, is always on her case about. Plus, no matter how much Serina tries, Reiko always bests her in grades and athletics. One day, however, Serina spots Reiko meeting with an unknown woman after school…and going to a love hotel! What will happen between Serina and Reiko now that they share a secret? (Source: Seven Seas Enterainment)

title: Jjaksarang Rendezvous
description: Han-Eul, self-proclaimed campus flirt, has big dreams of landing a relationship in college. But one day, he stumbles upon a grim-looking man in what seems to be a shady drug dealer—and bolts in terror. Fate, however, has other plans. Han-Eul runs into the supposed drug dealer, Choi Da-Jeong, once again in a club he only joined to follow his crush. But before he knows it, he ends up at his place! A fluffy, sweet whirlwind romance between the slightly airheaded Han-Eul and the unexpectedly charming Da-Jeong unfolds! (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Kyou mo Onnanoko wo Kouryaku shita.
title_original: 今日も女の子を攻略した。
description: Mayuzumi Kasumi is the school Idol. However, she doesn't realize this. She just wants friends, but that's difficult when she unconsciously seduces all the girls.

characters.name: Kasumi Mayuzumi
characters.description: **Grades:** Top-class, good at teaching She is the protagonist who is the very embodiment of this manga's title. Even though Kasumi is often called a ''prince,'' she really wants to be girly. However, without realizing it, Kasumi's charming personality is unmistakably the reason why the number of fangirls she has keeps increasing. She likes gardening and puzzle games, and she is a very quick learner. Due to certain reason, she has difficulties in understanding her own preferences. But there are things that she is subconsciously attracted to.

title: Watashi no Blue Garnet
title_original: 私のブルーガーネット
description: Kon, who worries about not being able to be "normal", and Ai, who searches for a certain person's whereabouts. The story begins when they meet. (Source: Melody, translated)

title: Ki wo Tsuke na yo, Onee-san.
title_original: 気をつけなよ、お姉さん。
description: The OL Tae Honda went swimming at the community pool, but her lack of exercise caused her to cramp up in the water, when she was saved by a tall, beautiful girl Mai Igarashi. Feeling attracted to her savior as she left the the pool, Tae saw Mai come out carrying an elementary school backpack… Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

characters.name: Mai Igarashi
characters.description: **Height:** 172 cm Mai Igarashi is a fifth grader at Momohana Elementary Schoo. She is quite tall for a 10-year-old elementary school student and has a mature physique in many ways. She refers to [Tae](https://anilist.co/character/308293/Honda-Tae) as "Onee-chan" and displays her affection for her in a variety of ways. She always acts tenaciously, but as is typical for a child, she occasionally reveals the more sensitive side of her mind.

characters.name: Tae Honda
characters.description: **Height:** 148 cm She is an office worker at Namino Trading Co. She was swimming in a public pool when [Mai Igarashi](https://anilist.co/character/308292/Igarashi-Mai) saved her, and she fell in love with Mai at first sight. She was initially disappointed that she had fallen in love with an elementary school student of the same sex, but she gradually begins to accept it.

characters.name: Hitomi Otori
characters.description: **Height:** 132 cm Hitomi is Mai Igarashi's classmate and swimming school friend. She is a quiet girl who stays close to Mai. According to Mai, she is the daughter of a company president and lives in a mansion with a limousine and an attendant. She occasionally shows her high-spec talents.

characters.name: Shino Azuma
characters.description: **Height:** 160 cm Tae Honda's coworker. She publicly admits that she loves elementary school students, and when she learns that there is a swimming school for elementary school students at the public swimming pool that Tae attends, she registers together with Tae. She spends a lot of time with Hitomi Otori.

characters.name: Ran Sakuma
characters.description: Yuki's friend. She has a childish personality and goes at her own pace. Yuki often spoils her. She tries to encourage Yuki's love together with Yukari.

characters.name: Yukari Midori
characters.description: Yuki's friend. She speaks with a Kansai accent and seems calm, but she has a dark side to her personality. When she learns that Yuki has feelings for Tae, she tries to encourage her.

characters.name: Madoka Tsutsumi
characters.description: Tae Honda's elementary school classmate, and a teacher at Momohana Elementary School. She is Mai Igarashi's and her classmates' homeroom teacher.

characters.name: Yuki Houjou
characters.description: Mai Igarashi's classmate. She is the granddaughter of Momohana City's mayor. She has always had a haughty attitude towards others and has been plotting to separate Mai and Tae. She develops a romantic crush on Tae after reconciling with her.

title: Collectors
description: Nishi Uko's Collectors is about two women in a relationship who disapprove of each other's spending habits. Note: Chapter count includes 21 extra chapters.

characters.name: Takako Kanzaki
characters.description: Takako loves collecting clothes

characters.name: Shinobu Nitou
characters.description: Shinobu loves collecting books

characters.name: Naomi Shiga
characters.description: Naomi her collection is glasses.

characters.name: Takayuki Kanzaki
characters.description: Takako's brother

title: Nappeunnamja
description: What if you meet the bully who hurt you at school again? "I'm not gonna end it like this. I'll make you want me and have my revenge." (Source: TOPTOON+)

characters.name: Dong-Hyun Seo
characters.description: He starts living anew after overcoming the trauma of the school days.

characters.name: Mi-Rae Chae
characters.description: Social media star, who bullied [Dong-Hyun](https://anilist.co/character/307894) in the past.

characters.name: Da-Hye Kim
characters.description: One of the bullies that [Mi-Rae](https://anilist.co/character/306594) hung out with when she was bullying [Dong-Hyun](https://anilist.co/character/307894).

characters.name: Mi-Hyang Won
characters.description: [Da-Hye](https://anilist.co/character/306595)'s mother, who is in debt because of her late husband.

characters.name: Min-Hee Kang
characters.description: [Min-Ah](https://anilist.co/character/307891)'s older sister who was [Dong-Hyun](https://anilist.co/character/307894)'s teacher at school.

characters.name: Min-Ah Kang
characters.description: [Min-Hee](https://anilist.co/character/307892)'s little sister who was [Dong-Hyun](https://anilist.co/character/307894)'s classmate at school.

title: Suimitsu Tou wa Shoujo ni Kajirareru
title_original: 水蜜桃は少女にかじられる
description: Momoka is almost thirty years old and has had no love experience. Frustrated with her situation, she looks up dating services online and stumbles upon a "lesbian brothel". Momoka decides to try it out and ends up having sex with "Riko", one of the girls from the brothel. Momoka becomes captivated by Riko but soon discovers that she is keeping a secret...? (Source: POCKET COMICS) Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title: Mai no Mushigurashi
description: A girls comedy in which the main character, Mai, who is looking for a leisurely job, plays with field crops and wild insects while helping her farming friend, Nanako. Nanako is a kind-hearted girl and when it comes to the field and her cherished Mai, the look in her eyes changes. The series also includes a specially drawn project that turns the insects that appeared in the chapters into beautiful girls. (Source: Comic Natalie, translated) Note: The chapter count includes one bonus chapter.

title: Akuyaku Reijou ga Sei Heroine wo Kudoki Otosu Hanashi.
title_original: 悪役令嬢が正ヒロインを口説き落とす話。
title_en: When the Villainess Seduces the Main Heroine
description: When the crown prince announces he's breaking off his engagement to the infamous Akuya, his spurned fiancée wastes no time turning her seductive words of passion to her actual target—Sei, a commoner who worked her way up through the ranks with her wit and charm alone…and the very girl the prince dumped Akuya for! Sei's about to get a taste of what a real lover is like in this steamy tale of two girls who traded in their Prince Charming for each other! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Akuya Jou
characters.description: The prince's fiancée. She prefers women, so she doesn't mind being ignored by her fiancé. She is the daughter of a duke and highly skilled in cooking and sword fighting.

characters.name: Sei Roin
characters.description: The adoptive daughter of Baron Roin, who was originally born in the countryside and has four younger siblings. She is very good at housekeeping and is talented at sewing. She loves to flirt but becomes shy when it's time to do something more.

title: Drunken My Boss
description: Cha Yiseul is rich, reckless, and completely unapologetic about it. With her looks, money, and an endless roster of casual flings, life is one big party—until her mother cuts her off and kicks her out. Just as she hits rock bottom, a mysterious woman named Kang Sori appears, offering her a lifeline…and stirring up blurry memories of a drunken night they may—or may not—have shared. Who exactly is Sori, and why does Yiseul keep thinking about her? (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Dear My Teacher
description: Fujimura Kaoru is the nurse at an all girl's school and, for the third time this year, she has been confessed to by a student. Naturally, she has turned down each offer in the kindest way she could. Isechi Mikoto is a student who has been ostracized by the school because of a rumor that she might be a lesbian. She also happens to remind Kaoru of her former lover.

title: Chotto Ippai!
description: 16 year old Miyahara Momiji starts working part-time at an izakaya called Koharuya.

title: Dolls Fall
title_original: DOLLS FALL ドールズ・フォール
description: Dolls Fall revolves around the lives of students at Jiaiin girls dormitory, an orphanage for middle school children without families. They are greeted with open arms by the matrons and other students, taught to accept their fellow orphans as sisters and the matrons as their mothers. Jiaiin is a safe haven for students, provided that they follow two simple rules: at night, lock your door and don’t leave the room, and never enter a matron’s room.

characters.name: Meiri Chibana
characters.description: Meiri is the main character of Dolls Fall. She was orphaned at the age of 13 when her house went up in flames along with her family. She gets relocated to the Jiaiin dormitory to stay with other girls who are now referred to as her sisters. The caretakers are referred to, similarly, as mothers. With a good heart she aims to help the other girls at the orphanage to make them as happy as they can be.

title: Chimamire Sukeban Chainsaw
title_original: 血まみれスケバン・チェーンソー
description: Geeko's weird, creepy, friendless classmate Nero has destroyed all of their mutual classmates, perverting them into her grotesque, monstrous minions. Now she's sending them after Geeko, the only survivor. However, Geeko is setting out, dressed in her skimpy school uniform and armed with a big chainsaw, to end Nero's mad science, no matter how many undead former friends she has to saw down on the way.

title: Makemasen kara to Iiharu Kao no Ii Onnanoko wo, Zenryoku de Kuppuku Saseru Yuri no Ohanashi
title_original: 負けませんからと言い張る顔のいい女の子を、全力で屈服させる百合のお話
description: Sara Kureha is the popular "big sister" of an all-girls academy. She has obtained her social position through her unflagging efforts. Rui Mareshino, who is widely recognized for her natural grace and beauty, offers Sara a certain game. Before the school's top-girl contest in two months' time, the two of them decide on a way to settle the matter beforehand....... “We should become lovers.” "Wha......?” The one who makes the other swoon is the girl who deserves to be at the top of the school! Now the two of them are in a secret relationship, as the mutual seduction battle begins...... Who will be the one to make the other surrender, body and soul? A fierce romantic comedy battle between two beautiful girls! (Source: Nico Nico Seiga, translated)

title: Succubus no Yuri na Hanashi
title_original: サキュバスの百合な話
description: The romantic story about two succubus and their daily life. Note: On July 29th 2020, the author announced they would be discontinuing the doujinshi to focus in its serialized version, "Watashi wa Succubus to Kiss wo Shita", instead.

characters.name: Konomi Nirasaka
characters.description: One succubus girl that had transfered schools recently

characters.name: Yukiko Ootsu
characters.description: A shy succubus.

characters.name: Fuwa Yanigahara
characters.description: Best friend of Yukiko since middle school

title: Komyushou VS Yuri
description: Hikage Nemoto, a young, shy and mousey part-time teacher finds herself unwittingly awakening some rather... fundamental feelings from all the women she meets... Will she prevail? Included chapters: 26.1

title: Oshi ga Tonari de Jugyou ni Shuuchuu Dekinai!
title_original: 推しが隣で授業に集中できない！
title_en: My Idol Sits the Next Desk Over!
description: Chiro-chan is a world-class idol...at least, to Sakiko Manaka, your run-of-the-mill hard-core idol fan. So when Chiro—real name Chihiro—ends up sitting next to her in school, Sakiko's world is turned upside-down, and all her brain cells vanish. After all, how can she concentrate when her absolute fav is just inches away?! But she needs to be on her A-game, because she may not be the only one who is totally gaga for Chihiro... (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Lily of the Valley
description: Lily’s family chose to sacrifice her freedom, but the infamous Duke Blake has set a trap to ensnare her heart instead. Lily is sent to the duke’s estate like an innocent lamb for slaughter...although Lily’s love already belongs to a handmaid named Anna. At the estate, an uneasiness gnaws at her mind...is there anyone in the world who truly loves her back? (Source: Tapas) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Suki na Onnanoko ga Watashi ni Dake Naze ka Kibishii
title_original: 好きな女の子が私にだけなぜか厳しい
description: Hina Kamiya falls in love at first sight with Honda-san, the seemingly perfect girl, who is a beautiful honor student and the student body president, too. When the class changed seats, Hina finds herself sitting next to Honda-san, which seems like the perfect opportunity to make friends with her. But for some reason, Honda-san, who is usually so nice to everyone, always acts cold and unfriendly with Hina.......? (Source: Manga Cross, translated)

title: Onii-chan wa Oshimai!: Koushiki Anthology Comic
title_original: お兄ちゃんはおしまい！ 公式アンソロジーコミック
description: An anthology comic of Onii-chan wa Oshimai! by various mangaka. Volume 1 (2021-05-27) Cover Illustration: Namori Color Illustration: Yui Hara, Shiromanta, Bell Izumi 1. 3-bai★Push! (3倍★プッシュ!) [Namori] 2. Onii-chan wa Umitai!? (お兄ちゃんはうみたい!?) [Koume Fujichika] 3. Mahiro to Minority (まひろとマイノリティ) [Natsu Tadano] 4. Mahiro to Keika Kansatsu (まひろと経過観察) [Taku Kawamura] 5. Himitsu no Hand Sign (秘密のハンドサイン) [Masakuni Igarashi] 6. A letter for you [Waka Kakitsubata] 7. Oyama Mahiro wo Kisekaetai! (緒山まひろを着せ替えたい!) [Norito Asazuki] 8. Wasurerarenai Kanshoku (忘れられない感触) [Nekoume] 9. Mahiro to Mahiri (まひろとまひり) [Tsuchii] 10. Mahiro to Imaginary (まひろとイマジナリー) [Misaki Mori] 11. Mahiro to Kyoufu no Misshitsu (まひろと恐怖の密室) [Kometsubu] 12. Mihari to Aibou (みはりと相棒) [Shinichi Yuuki] 13. Mahiro Love Letter (まひろラブレター) [Kina Kobayashi] 14. Mahiro to Dankatsu (まひろと男活) [Suzu Yuuki] 15. Mahiro to Kourei no Are (まひろと恒例のアレ) [Suka] Volume 2 (2022-04-27) Cover Illustration: bb Kuroda Color Illustration: Cool-kyou Shinja Volume 3 (2023-01-07) Cover Illustration: Yui Hara Color Illustration: bb Kuroda Volume 4 (2023-11-27) Cover Illustration: Hiroshi Hiroyama Color Illustration: Hori Volume 5 (2024-09-27) Cover Illustrati

characters.name: Mahiro Oyama
characters.description: He was a hikikomori neet and loner, until he woke up one morning as a little girl thanks to his [younger sister](https://anilist.co/character/130823/Oyama-Mihari) drugging him.

characters.name: Mihari Oyama
characters.description: [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822/Oyama-Mahiro)'s little sister. A genius scientist that skipped grades and is now attending college. She is responsible for drugging Mahiro, turning him into a young girl.

characters.name: Kaede Hozuki
characters.description: Kaede is a close personal friend of [Mihari](https://anilist.co/character/130823/Oyama-Mihari). They became friends in middle school. Mihari has progressed further in the academic system than Kaede, but they still are close, and see each other regularly.

characters.name: Miyo Murosaki
characters.description: Miyo-chan is a classmate of Mahiro in middle school. She is friends with [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822/Oyama-Mahiro) and [Asahi](https://anilist.co/character/130824/Ouka-Asahi). Miyo-chan is somewhat quiet and shy, and many times does not express herself verbally. However, she likes to hug and embrace her girl school friends, and takes a great interest in them and their activities. She has become particularly interested in Mahiro, although she is younger then her by a couple of years. Miyo-chan seems to be socially interested only in girls, and limits her time and attention to only select girls. She gives the appearance of showing her love and affection as a Shoujo Ai or Yuri shipping (girl with girl relationships). As such, Miyo-chan is always quick to ascribe a Yuri motive to any two girls talking or playing around with one another, as she likes to watch, on the side, su

characters.name: Momiji Hozuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm Momiji is the younger sister of [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/130819). She is in middle school, and is in the same class that [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822) enters when they reenter school. Momiji likes to dress, look, and act as a tomboy, and many times she is taken for a young teen/tween boy. However, Momiji gives no indication that she is in any way a transgender tween. She appears to only be gender non-conforming. However, she can be quite feminine in appearance on select occasions, like when she wears the middle school female uniform, a cute jumper dress, to school. She forms a strong friendship with Mahiro, and helps Mahiro navigate the middle school academic and social challenges of school. Many times she comes to Mahiro's defense when Mahiro is bewildered or frightened by somebody or something happening at school, or if it is perceived tha

characters.name: Asahi Ouka
characters.description: Asahi is a classmate of [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822/Oyama-Mahiro) in middle school. She befriends Mahiro, and the two become quite close to one another. Asahi talks with a pronounced Osaka accent. In the English language, such characters are usually given a heavy southern accent, similar to a southern, country girl drawl so reminiscent of a southern belle/dixie chick. She pronounces Mahiro's name as "Maa-high-row". She loves to hug people, especially her friends. Mahiro tells herself that Asahi always smells like the fresh, clean, morning sun! She likes to talk about sports, and is very good at girl's track and field. Asahi also has the curious conversational habit of always referring to herself in the third person, as if she is always on the outside looking in at herself. She is also not the least bit afraid or bothered by offering her thoughts and/or opinions in a rath

characters.name: Nayuta Tenkawa
characters.description: ~!Nayuta is one of 4 other characters to know about Mahiro's gender bending, not including Mahiro herself, the other 3 being Mihari, Mahiro's mother and Chitose.!~

characters.name: Chitose Azuma
characters.description: Chitose is [Mihari](https://anilist.co/character/130823)'s senpai from their college. She is supposedly related to [Nayuta](https://anilist.co/character/190203) in some way, whether it be by blood or some other way is yet to be confirmed.

title: Kuchibiru ni Saketa Orange
title_original: くちびるに透けたオレンジ
title_en: A Transparent Orange in the Lip
description: When a transfer student arrives from Tokyo, Chizuru immediately develops a crush. Surprisingly, the beautiful and stylish transfer student joins Chizuru's group of friends. Will a closer relationship develop between Chizuru and Kanae? (Source: Tranquil Spring) Also contains two short stories, Keep Your Heart Closed, about two cousins, and I Don’t Know If This Is Love, about two best friends.

characters.name: Kanae
characters.description: Kanae, an embodiment of beauty transfers to the country-side from Tokyo due to her father's business. Kanae is mature and wears make-up which Chizuru soon looks after. Though she is popular, she subsides with a 'simple' group including Chizuru.

characters.name: Chizuru
characters.description: Chizuru is meek, shy, and humble country girl. As she is introduced into the story, she is intrigued by beauty, particularly the transfer student straight from Tokyo- Kanae. At first, she wanted to be more like Kanae due to the lack of confidence in her appearance and the growing distance between her close friends after Kanae arrived. She becomes immediately mesmerized by Kanae's beauty in which admiration quickly turns into intense affection.

title: Araetjip Jeppangsa
title_en: The Baker on the First Floor
description: Sun Hwa is a BL artist using his room as a secret base to draw his work. One day, he gets caught working on his comic by a handsome blond man. Later, he finds out that this man is the new baker on the first floor. But there's just more to this man than simply his looks. (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Kimi Koi Limit
description: Back in high school Sono confessed her love to Sato, but she was turned down. Now she lives as a freeloader in an apartment shared with her girlfriend, Hiroko. However, she still hasn't forget about Sato and when she cries out her name while having sex with Hiroko, she finds herself in some serious trouble...

title: Nareul Hollin Iutjip Star
description: Soo-Jung hates romance—she’d rather spend her nights fangirling in her room. When a noisy neighbor is tests her patience she goes upstairs ready to fight, but the last person she expected is the scandalous celebrity she's supposed to hate. Love and hate, different sides of the same coin. Which will win? (Source: Manta)

title: Doukyuusei no Oshi Sakka ni Yuri Mousou ga Bareta Kekka
title_original: 同級生の推し作家に百合妄想がバレた結果
description: What happens when a classmate finds out about another girl's secret yuri obsession/feelings? A yuri comedy ensues!

title: Yuyushiki
description: This 4-koma style manga features three school girls as they hang out and chat. Friendly, clueless Yukari, enthusiastic, childish Yuzuko, and the more level-headed Yui hang out and talk about various subjects, like ketchup and mayonnaise, hands, the sun and more.

characters.name: Yuzuko Nonohara
characters.description: Yuzuko Nonohara is a member of the Data Processing Club. She seems to have an innocent personality, but she will sometimes break out in random bouts of outrageous behaviour.

characters.name: Yui Ichii
characters.description: Yui Ichii is a member of the Data Processing Club. Yui is generally shy, and she is often the target of Yuzuko and Yukari's antics since they like to tease her.

title: Guju
description: Wohn Ku is a vampire that needs human blood to survive. As a tenderhearted child, she led a tortured existence until a girl named Seyeon willingly became her steady blood source. Seyeon stood by Wohn throughout their school years, defending her from bullies. Fast forward to the present where they move in together ahead of their freshman year of college. Seyeon remains fiercely protective of her friend, but Wohn is ready for a fresh start. When a devoutly religious sophomore girl named Juyi showers her with kindness, Wohn emerges from her shell only to realize that Juyi had once been her father’s kidnapping victim, a potential blood source she had refused to bite. Juyi grows closer to Wohn without remembering the incident, fueling jealousy in Seyeon. Will Juyi prove to be a savior washing away Wohn’s guilt, or will she ruin a vampire’s dream of redemption? (Source: WEBTOONS)

characters.name: Won Gu

Her only friend is Oh Hyun-Woo, and their bond is often mistaken for a romantic relationship. However, everything takes an unexpected turn at the End-of-Year party she attends when she meets Lim Sun-Hwee, a young man who shows romantic interest in her. His new plan is to lead a quiet life while he figures out a way back to his world. But somehow, this isn’t going the way he planned. Can Jin-Su find his way back from his sister’s dating simulation game? (Source: POCKET COMICS, edited) Notes: - Includes seven side story chapters rated R19. - This was first published in English on POCKET COMICS (2023-01-24), but its first AniList-eligible publication was in Japanese by comico (2023-06-18), and its Korean release was not until 2023-11-10 on KakaoPage and Kakao Webtoon.

title: GUNSMITH CATS BURST
title_original: GUNSMITH CATS BURST-ガンスミスキャッツ・バースト
description: Rally Vincent and Minnie-May Hopkins are two regular American girls. Regular American girls who own a gun shop, and might have dabbled in prostitution, and who happen to be crack shots and explosives experts, too. Those might be odd skills for a couple of American girls, but these two happen to be Chicago's top bounty hunters. Rally can shoot the trigger off a gun from a good distance, and May generally wreaks havoc with explosions and cuteness. And together, with some very useful friends and associates, they make up the Gunsmith Cats. "Burst" finds our ladies back at work, back in action, and... back in trouble. (Source: Dark Horse)

characters.name: Rally Vincent
characters.description: Master gunsmith, highly successful bounty hunter, and all-around action girl, Rally Vincent's love of guns and fast cars came from her father. He vanished under mysterious circumstances when she was young, and she entered the bounty hunting profession to gain easier access to both sides of law, in an effort to find him. Over the years, she has made many close friends and even more committed enemies. She operates both her gunsmithing and bounty hunting business from a small shop in Chicago. _In Riding Bean, a prototype version of Rally was featured as Bean's partner. This version of Rally is portrayed as a fair-skinned blonde, but is still as equally-skilled in firearms as the Rally in 'Gunsmith Cats'._

characters.name: Minnie May
characters.description: Diminuative Minnie-May Hopkins was working as an under-age prostitute at a brothel in Chicago's China Town before her iron resolve, talent with explosives, and great demeanor with the customers at the Gunsmith Cat Gunshop caused [Rally Vincent](https://anilist.co/character/3821/Vincent-Rally) to hire her as her assistant. May can hide armed explosives in just about anything, and is therefore equally expert at finding and disarming bombs placed by others. She usually carries a variety grenades and explosives hidden about her person, ranging from harmless smokebombs to deadly fragmentation grenades. May learned her trade from Ken Taki (a.k.a. Takizawa) a special effects expert and infamous bomb maker. He is a former mob hitman who has gone straight.

characters.name: Goldie Musou
characters.original: ゴールディ・ムッソー
characters.description: Arguably the most ruthless of Rally's opponents. Of Italian ancestry, "Iron Goldie" is a high-ranking member of a mob family in Sicily. Many call her a Mafia Queen. She is an incredible hand-to-hand combatant, and is quite skilled at creating complex plans, which, though often successful, often make plain her cavalier attitude towards her subordinates. She is a pathological personality, the textbook definition of a "control freak." She is obsessed with controlling everything and everyone around her. People who resist her successfully, such as Rally, become even more attractive to her. She is a lesbian, though she tends to express it as a form of sadistic pedophilia. She keeps a trademark harem of young girls who have murdered their parents while under the influence of her drugs. She and Rally crossed paths many times, and the bounty hunter is usually quite lucky

characters.name: Misty Brown
characters.description: An expert sneak thief, cat-burglar and lockpick, she joins up with Rally and Minnie-May after having been caught by them and serving time for various criminal activities. She is prone to becoming a damsel in distress, and subsequently has to be bailed out by her friends. She is 15 years old when she first appears in the series. Misty doesn't carry any guns but is quite adept in the use of knives (wielded and thrown). She also has a crush on Rally, although at the end of the series she also expresses an interest in Bean Bandit.

characters.name: Bean Bandit
characters.original: ビーン・バンディット
characters.description: Bean Bandit, often referred to simply as Bean, is a professional courier, and the driver to call on when you need to make a quick getaway or have a critical delivery of a questionable nature that needs to be made. There are few jobs he will not undertake, but his high price needs to be met. Bean tries in all dealings to be a man of great honor. Once a client has paid his fee will give him or her his all, and when Bean is on the job, his custom-built, bullet-proof, teched-out muscle car is as unstoppable as he is. There are two things that Bean won't tolerate from a client. The first are attempts to betray him in any way--short-change him, re-neg on deals, lie about the nature of a job, and so on-- and the second are directly endangering or threatening children. Either of these will cause Bean to abandon his client in the worst way possible, or to simply turn on him or her immediately. Ge

characters.name: Becky Farrah
characters.description: Becky Farrah is a private detective who is one of Chicagoland's top information brokers. She has a reputaton of being able to dig up information on anyone and anything within even the tightest of time tables. She does not, however, come cheap and usually demands payment in advance, even from long-time clients and friends like Rally. Becky generally speaking likes to keep clear of dangerous situations, preferring to merely sell information to bountyhunters. However, part of the secret of her success is that she isn't afraid to conduct her own survellience operations and stakeouts if she is unable to get a clear picture of a situation from the safety of her office or through her network of informants. Source:BESM

title: Devilman G
description: When demons begin taking over the bodies of humans, only the strongest survive. When a practicing young witch named Miki Makimura asks her friend Akira Fudo for help with a ritual, the spell is interrupted and Akira is left on the brink of death. His body is overtaken by a powerful being named Amon. Now torn between his humanity and the demon within him, Akira uses his abilities to fight in the war between demons and humans for the future of the world itself! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) This entry includes: chapter 0 Persona and chapter 8.5 Wake Up Your Heart.

characters.name: Akira Fudou

His father has recently went to work in America so he is currently living with his friend Miki's family. He hasn't seen his best friend Ryo in over a month since moving in with Miki's family. When they reunite he is in for a big surprise that will forever change him, his life, and all of mankind. ~!Devilman is Akira Fudo after he merged with Amon in order to save mankind from the demons. While he usually stays in his human form, he turns into Devilman when he needs to fight seriously. Akira still retains his human heart after he becomes Devilman, meaning he can feel love and empathy unlike demons, but his personality changes drastically as a result of the merge.!~

characters.name: Amon
characters.description: Amon's original human appearance resembled a light skinned male with messy black hair and dark eyes that featured markings coming down from those eyes. When on duty, he is always seen wearing black form fitting armor with a helmet that featured horns and small wings. He also featured spikes on his arms and a cape. However after becoming a demon he grew far taller while still retaining his human appearance. His skin depended on the artwork with most being blue, turquoise, pale white, and least of all red with legs covered in black fur and a long thin tail with a spiked spade on the end. Amon has yellow eyes which depending on the story had black pupils or none at all. He had thin fangs in his mouth and large bat like wings in place of his ears with a bright red crest in the middle, he also had a pair of antenna connecting to the top of his head.

characters.name: Solomon
characters.description: ~!Ryou Utsugi is the founder of the Devilman Corps and leads them as Devilman Zennon after acquiring the power of his namesake. Unlike other incarnations of Ryou Utsugi, this one is unrelated to Dante who appears a separate character. The ending reveals that Utsugi is actually King Solomon. He is faced as the final antagonist of Devilman Grimoire.!~ (Source: Devilman Wiki)

What's to become of Akari now that she's a highschooler with the world's most unreliable roommate?

title: Koukaku no Pandora
title_en: Pandora In The Crimson Shell: Ghost Urn
description: When Nanakorobi Nene, a cybernetically-enhanced girl-next-door, heads to the island metropolis of Cenancle to live with her aunt, she has no way of knowing what’s in store for her. A chance meeting intertwines her fate with that of the super-rich inventor, Uzal Delilah, and her adorable and grumpy companion, Clarion, who happens to be a cyborg just like Nene. Nene is thrilled to make a friend, but there’s more to Uzal and Clarion – and the island of Cenancle itself – than meets the eye. When a super-powered terrorist threatens Cenancle, Uzal claims that the only way to avert disaster is for Nene to team up with Clarion and use their combined powers – abilities Nene never even knew she had! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes 26 extra chapters.

characters.name: Clarion

She is a skilled fighter who often finds herself at the mercy of Nene's admiration and hates having her cat-like ears touched.

characters.name: Nene Nanakorobi

By placing her fingers inside Clarion's body, she is able to use the Pandora Device, which allows her to master any skill for a short period of time, ranging from wielding firearms to cookery. She is also able to transfer her brain between different artificial bodies. (Source: MAL)

Meanwhile, in another world, the princess knight Reina has been captured by an enemy nation. The princess’ soul is removed–and Naruse is summoned into the empty husk of her body! Now that he’s taken over the form of this beautiful young woman, he’s doomed to her fate: being sold to a yuri brothel where he has to service female customers. He’s determined to learn more about Reina’s life before he took it over…while he finds a way to work the grind in her body! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

At her previous job, she was the victim of sexual harassment and has since found it difficult to be around other people, leading her to work freelance. Then she meets Rinko, the new delivery girl with a positive and cheerful personality. As their relationship begins to grow, so does Kei's curiosity for her. (Source: Renta!)

At school, Kureha's unassuming personality and looks render her practically invisible. Sometimes, it feels like no one notices her at all, until cute and outgoing transfer student Ginko asks Kureha to be her friend. With Ginko's encouragement and protection, Kureha starts to come out of her shell and realizes that, whether or not her new classmate really is a bear, her feelings toward Ginko might be stronger than friendship after all. After hearing of his situation, Nanjou decides to let him live in her home but under one condition: he will be an invisible man. He later discovers why: she will completely ignore his existence. Meet Kurokawa and discover the advantages (and disadvantages) of being an invisible man and unraveling the mysteries behind Asumi Nanjou.

When she helps an old woman to carry her bags home, the woman offers to put her up in one of her rooms. Keito accepts and starts to pick up the pieces of her life. When she's not drawing her own comic, which features a black jazz singer named Angie, the young woman works at a record shop. That's where she meets and falls in love with Niki, an attractive trumpeter in a funk band. They sleep with each other. Unfortunately for Keito, Niki then explains that she's not interested in a serious relationship, but Keito is not willing to give up that easily...

Her younger sister, Kira, is an idol (19 years old) who is rapidly gaining popularity with her cool, and mature character. However, the real Kira only ever think of her sister and tries to cheer her up in every possible way to help her sister with her mental health and anxiety.

title: Mahou Shoujo Homura★Tamura: Heikou Sekai ga Itsumo Heikou de Aru to wa Kagiranai no da.
title_original: 魔法少女ほむら★たむら ～平行世界がいつも平行であるとは限らないのだ。～
title_en: Puella Magi Homura★Tamura: Parallel Worlds Do Not Remain Parallel Forever
description: The life of a magical girl isn't all fighting witches and collecting grief seeds. When they aren't kicking butt, Homura Akemi and her friends face the same trials as normal high school girls! In this four-panel comedy, glimpse a sillier side of the girls from the bestselling Puella Magi Madoka Magica series! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Madoka Kaname
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") A 14-year-old girl whose life changes when she encounters the [Puella Magi Homura](https://anilist.co/character/38005/Akemi-Homura) and the familiar [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), who offers to transform her into a Puella Magi herself. She sees herself as a person without special qualities or talents, and after seeing [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) fighting against witches, wants to be a wonderful and cool Puella Magi like her. She is a rather selfless girl who wishes to be a magical girl simply so that she can help others. She allegedly has a large amount of magical potential within her.

characters.name: Homura Akemi
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 - 158 cm Homura is a magical girl who first appears in an apocalyptic nightmare of [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832). She transfers into her school the day after the dream. She is a beautiful, mysterious individual that performs exceptionally well in academics and athletics. This makes her instantly popular even though she is cold to others. She seems to know Madoka well and wishes to prevent her from becoming a magical girl. She attacks [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566) in the first episode, only to be stopped by [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194).

characters.name: Kyuubey
characters.description: Kyuubey is a familiar who can grant any wish to a certain girl, on the condition that she becomes a Puella Magi and fights against witches.

characters.name: Mami Tomoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-159 cm Mami Tomoe is a veteran magical girl and a third-year student at Madoka's school. She lives alone in a penthouse after her parents were killed in a car crash, which Mami survived after contracting with Kyuubey. Mami is particularly focused on saving, guiding, and protecting those around her, which is a traditionally selfless perspective on the role of magical girl. She is much like a maternal figure to Madoka and Sayaka, being the eldest among them. Her name could be considered a play on the word 'mommy', further supported in the third film, where she has a companion named "Bebe". Though Mami's outward disposition is cheery and confident, Mami feels deeply alone as she has no friends to confide in as she fights.

characters.name: Sayaka Miki
characters.description: __Height:__ 158-160 cm __Weapon:__ Cutlass [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832/Kaname-Madoka) classmate who, after helping Madoka rescue [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), ends up getting an offer to become a Puella Magi herself. She cares deeply for her friends, and wants to help an ill boy named [Kyousuke Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/39835/Kamijou-Kyousuke), whom she has a crush on. Before becoming a Puella Magi, Sayaka wields a baseball bat that [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) can enhance with magic to defend herself with while on witch hunts.

characters.name: Kyouko Sakura
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-158 cm __Weapon:__ Spear Kyouko is a veteran magical girl who comes to the city later in the story. Amusingly, she is always seen eating something, even while she is battling. Having grown up in a poor family, she often has to steal food and hates people who waste it, a logic she also applies to Grief Seeds, as she only goes after fully grown witches. Kyouko has been a Puella Magi much longer than the others, and thus is more skillful; she wields a spear which can extend itself, split into multiple sections, and produce a ball at the end of a chain, which can constrict and hit others at the same time. She also has the ability to put up barriers to protect others or keep them from interfering. She initially clashes with Sayaka, but after learning the truth about Soul Gems, she sympathizes with her and tries to help her.

title: Oujou Giwa no Imi wo Shire!
description: Ichimatsu Kairo's ex-girlfriend, Kusakabe Hiyori, who disappeared 7 years ago appears before him again one day. As someone who was converted into a devout follower of the Hiyori religion, he became unable to live in reality when she left. Reunited, she divulges to him her unreasonable demand, "Ichimatsu-kun, I want my childbirth recorded so give me your sperm."

title: Aa toka Uu shika Ienai
title_original: あーとかうーしか言えない
description: Serialisation of the original Pixiv comic. A reticent rookie artist and an editor desiring plot (and not just 'plot') team up to take on the eromanga industry together. Chaos and cohabitation ensue.

title: Hanayamata
description: Normal appearance, normal intelligence, normal in arts and sports... just normal. This is the entirely normal 14-year-old, Naru Sekiya. While she admires "Heroines" she continues to live a normal life until one moonlit night she meets a fairy. This foreign girl then guides her into the extraordinary world of the yosakoi dance. (Source: Manga Time Kirara)

characters.name: Hana Fountainstand
characters.original: ハナ・N・フォンテーンスタンド
characters.description: __Height__: 144cm __Favorite Flower__: Bluestar Hana is a transfer student from America. She is a very determined individual and stands out a lot because of her unique personality and her looks. She is, at first, mistaken for a fairy because of her foreign appearance by Naru. She is extremely passionate about yosakoi dancing after having seen a performance from when she visited Japan in the past. Although she continuously fails to recruit members into the yosakoi club, she refuses to give up as it is her dream. Eventually, her passion inspires Naru to help her out with the recruiting of the club.

characters.name: Tami Nishimikado
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Tami is Naru's childhood friend and a third-year middle school student. She is the student council vice president and a real ojou-sama. Tami is also Machi's best friend and classmate. She is an object of Naru's admiration as she believes Tami is more interesting and unique.

characters.name: Yaya Sasame
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm Yaya is Naru's best friend from elementary school. Since they were little, Yaya has been watching over Naru's timid character and understands her quite well. She is currently in the same grade as Naru. Yaya is very sociable and her appearance is very cute and pretty, making her to be popular amongst her peers. She is also in a band called "Need Cool Quality". She believes in chasing after what she wants to do and likes to take advantage of her youth while it lasts. As her best friend, Yaya is supportive of Naru and encourages her to work towards finding what she wants to do.

characters.name: Naru Sekiya
characters.description: **Height:** 150 cm Naru is a 14-year-old girl in her second year of middle school and has been best friends with Yaya since elementary school. She loves fairy tales and greatly idolizes the heroines in the stories. She sees herself as a girl who is average in every way possible, but desperately wishes to change herself to be more like the girls from the fairy tales she reads. She is timid by nature and is slightly jealous of some of her peers, including Yaya, Hana, and Tami, as she thinks of them to be more interesting than she is.

characters.name: Machi Tokiwa
characters.description: __Height:__ 163cm Machi is Tami's classmate and a third year middle school student. She is the student council president and works alongside Tami, who is the vice president. She has a rocky relationship with her older sister, Sari, who is a teacher at their school, and is against the idea of Sari becoming the teacher advisor of the yosakoi club.

characters.name: Ran Fueda
characters.description: **Height:** 146 cm **Favorite Flower:** Orchid

characters.name: Sari Tokiwa
characters.description: __Height:__ 165cm Naru, Yaya, and Hana's homeroom and English teacher and Machi's older sister, who is often nicknamed 'Sally-sensei'. She originally planned to take over her parents' hospital together with Machi, but after helping Machi with studying, Sally chose to leave home, inspired to become a teacher instead. She becomes the yosakoi's club advisor, initially showing little interest but soon becoming more involved, including trying to make the girls wear cosplay while performing, though she is occasionally shown to be lazy and forgetful. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Masaru Oofuna
characters.description: A 33 year old bachelor who runs the Yosakoi Masaru shop. Despite having an appearance like a bald yakuza, he is quite friendly and eager to help those learning yosakoi. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Arisa Kajiwara
characters.description: Arisa is a middle school sophomore and is a classmate of Yaya. She is the bass guitarist of the band Need Cool Quality. The band's nickname, Niku-Q, originated from her.

characters.name: Jennifer N. Fountainstand
characters.original: ジェニファー・N・フォンテーンスタンド

characters.name: Naomasa Sekiya
characters.description: Naomasa is Naru's 56-year-old father. He serves as an instructor of kendo. He is good friends with Tami's father.

title: Yuri Yuri Panic: Toutosugiru Jian ga Hassei Shiteimasu!
title_original: ゆりゆりぱにっく～尊すぎる事案が発生しています！～
description: On the day of her high school entrance ceremony, ordinary high school girl Akari receives a marriage license application from the strikingly beautiful Kiyozumi Runa. Akari is bowled over in shock, and that’s before Runa shows up at her house! A torrential downpour means Runa can’t go home, which means one thing: time for a sleepover! Add Mochi, Akari’s stuffed animal and imaginary friend who loves to ship people, into the mix, and things are sure to get even more complicated! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Hayancheonsaege Ansigeun Eobsda
description: Dahye is still haunted by the abuse she got from Yeonhwa. Fate has it, Dahye is able to carry out her revenge after so many years. In what ways will Dahye get her revenge, and will Yeonhwa be even affected by it? (Source: Lezhin US)

characters.name: Min-Hye Yang
characters.description: Dahye's older sister.

title: Sunami Yuuko to Yuri na Hitobito
title_original: 須波優子と百合な人びと
