description: Sunami Yuuko is surrounded by lesbians at her school.

title: Kimi ni Sukitte Iwasetai
title_original: 君に好きっていわせたい
description: A collection of Takeshima Eku's short yuri stories. 1. Kimi ni Suki tte Iwasetai (君に好きっていわせたい) Kei and Misaki have been best friends since they were kids. One day, Misaki confesses her feelings for Kei and the two of them start going out. To Kei, everything seems to be going alright but to Misaki... 2. Kimi ga Suki tte Ittekita (君が好きっていってきた) Continuation of Kimi ga Suki tte Ittekita. 3. Uchi no Neko ga Kawaii Youjo ni Naru Nante! (ウチの猫が可愛い幼女になるなんてっ！) 4. Super Maid ni Omakase Kudasai! (スーパーメイドにお任せください!) Kuro's mistress makes an impossible request to her. 5. NEET Na Oneesan Hiroimashita. (ニートなお姉さん拾いました。) An office lady encounters a homeless girl on the street and reluctantly lets her stay at her place. 6. Miyuri no Shiro-chan (みゆりのしろちゃん) Miyuri has made a snowman every winter. One year she puts her special scarf the one she made. A few days later, Shiro arrives at her door, wearing her scarf. 7. Hen Ai (へんあい)

title: Sora Haena! Oejeon
description: Three side stories arcs that have different pairings each of them. Note: While this has it's own page on Lezhin, in BomToon it starts after chapter 51.

title: Futago Yuri Ecchi Anthology
title_original: 双子百合えっちアンソロジー
title_en: Double Your Pleasure – A Twin Yuri Anthology
description: Each of these eight short erotic manga features a pair of twins. Sometimes they’re identical, sometimes they’re fraternal. Sometimes they play with others, sometimes they only have eyes for each other. Every story puts a different twist on the concept, with lush art in a variety of styles to explore one of erotica’s forbidden fantasies. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Sakura Namiki
description: Takahashi Makoto's The Rows of Cherry Trees is quite old—it's from 1957. It centers around three members of the table tennis club at an all-girl school. The story begins with the school tournament, where Yukiko faces off against first her rival, then her crush.

title: Ato wa Gojiyuu ni Douzo! Tutorial de Kami-sama ga Last Boss wo Taoshi Chatta node Watashi wa Suki Houdai Ikiteiku
title_original: あとはご自由にどうぞ！ ～チュートリアルで神様がラスボスを倒しちゃったので私は好き放題生きていく～

title: Hen na Nee-san
description: 1, 7. Ashita no Atashi (あしたのあたし, Tomorrow's Me); Vol.73, 78 (2012/1, 11) 2. Mienai Atashi (みえないあたし, Invisible Me); Vol.74 (2012/3) 3, 8, 10. Hen na Neesan (へんなねえさん, Odd Sister); Vol.75, 79, 81 (2012/5, 2013/1, 5) 4, 9. Hakase to Atashi (はかせとあたし, Professor and Me); Vol.76, 80 (2012/7, 2013/3) 5. Chiisai Atashi (ちいさいあたし, Little Me); Vol.77 (2012/9) 6. Hen na Kaasan (へんなかあさん, Odd Mother); Vol.78 (2012/11) 11. Atashi wa Lupina (あたしはルピナ, I'm Lupina); Vol.82 (2013/7) Note: Includes an extra chapter.

title: Vengeance
description: Having witnessed her "secret" love killed by a murderer, the normally calm and cool headed police officer, Seolah, is determined to find the bastard and avenge her love's death... (Source: Lezhin)

title: Ki ni Naru Ano Ko
description: Kisaki has a mysterious disease from childhood that turns her into half-tree, half-human.

characters.name: Youko Kisaki
characters.description: An introverted office worker with Woodman Syndrome, a rare condition that turns her into a human/tree hybrid. Ostracized by her coworkers, she lives in solitude until Chishiro, a new hire, chooses to befriend her.

characters.name: Hikari Chishiro
characters.description: A newcomer at Kisaki's company. Having once been bullied as a child, she was deeply touched when Kisaki helped her. Grateful, she now seeks to build a friendship with Kisaki.

title: Yuri Natsu: Minshuku Kagaya
title_original: ゆりなつー民宿かがやー
description: An all-female family manages a small inn on a small island. Mother, aunt and 4 daughters are all very intimate with each other and wish to help their (female) guests to unleash their own yuri feelings. Included chapters: 0, 7 Omake chapters

characters.name: Miki Kagaya
characters.description: The second of the Kagaya children. Rough, tomboyish, and rebellious, she has a soft spot for her older sister, Yoh, and is easily controlled by her.

characters.name: You Kagaya
characters.description: The eldest of the Kagaya children. Polite and graceful, she is fascinated by and encourages relationships between the women who come to the stay at the Kagaya Inn.

characters.name: Kuki Kagaya
characters.description: The third of the Kagaya children. Tall, shy, and extremely perverted, she spies on the Kagaya Inn's female guests using hidden cameras.

characters.name: Hana Kagaya
characters.description: The youngest of the Kagaya children. Despite her young age and apparent naivete, Hana is both a diligent worker and infatuated with her elder sister, Kuki, often blackmailing her into compromising situations.

characters.name: Nene Kagaya
characters.description: The matriarch of Kagaya Inn. She's middle-aged, divorced, and has five daughters. She inherited the inn with her sister, Yuu, when their mother passed away. She manages the front-end of the business.

characters.name: Ayumu Daidou
characters.description: The elder Daidou sister, an easygoing, perverted, and seemingly irresponsible girl who works in research and development for a big company. She fell in love with her younger sister, Sayo, when they were teenagers, but they grew apart after Ayumu devoted herself to her studies. Believing that her sister, who had grown distant, hated her, Ayumu decided not to confess after getting into university, as originally planned, and instead left for her classes, leaving her sister and first love behind. Years later, they reunite thanks to a dating website. While at university, Ayumu dated Tsubomi Kagaya for almost a year, but she was dumped because of her distant behavior and enduring infatuation for her younger sister.

characters.name: Tsubomi Kagaya
characters.description: The fourth of the Kagaya children. She doesn't work at the family inn, unlike her siblings, instead going to college in the city, dating Ayumu Daidou during this time.

characters.name: Saki Kamioka
characters.description: A famous, stuck-up actress staying at Kagaya Inn with her manager.

characters.name: Mitsuko Tsuchiyamada
characters.description: The manager of famous actress Saki Kamioka, who is staying with her at Kagaya Inn.

characters.name: Nazuki Yatagawa
characters.description: A guest at Kagaya Inn. ~!She's the heiress of a large company.!~

characters.name: Rei Oginouchihara
characters.description: A reckless womanizer who drops by the Kagaya Inn and immediately begins harassing every woman she runs into.

characters.name: Yuki Oginouchihara
characters.description: Rei's younger sister, a cruel, selfish girl hunting down her elder sister after being abandoned by her.

characters.name: Yuu Kagaya
characters.description: The aunt of the Kagaya children and not just the sister, but the lover of their mother, Nene, as well. She supports the family by working as a fisherwoman and has two children of her own.

characters.name: Sagiyama
characters.description: A mysterious woman disguised as a police officer and stalking Nazuki Yatagawa. ~!She was hired by Nazuki's mother, who sent her to abduct her and return her home.!~

characters.name: Kotoyo Hayashi
characters.description: A good friend of Tsubomi's, who offers her relationship advice. During high school, she got together with her English teacher.

title: Yuri Love Slave: Futari Dake no Houkago
title_original: 百合ラブスレイブ ふたりだけの放課後
description: Asakura is an ordinary high school girl. One day, she sees Reina, the cold and stuck-up class president, going into a bookstore. Asakura follows her in and discovers that the book Reina bought is a gay manga. Feeling shocked and slightly ashamed, Asakura opens the book, and as she reads, she starts feeling funny inside. The little devil in her head whispers to her, "Asakura-chan, do you want to try the things in this book? Do you feel turned on?" Ignoring the angel's warning on her right shoulder, Asakura's gives in to the devil's seduction, and her gay adventure with Reina begins...

title: Fujouri na Atashitachi
description: Emi Yamanaka is an office lady working in Tokyo. She's brash, opinionated, smokes, and likes girls. Having gone through various failed relationships with other girls, she resigns herself to cynicism. Her equilibrium is shattered by the appearance of a new worker at her office, Taneda-san.

title: Fate/Grand Order: Mortalis:Stella
description: The official adaptation of the TYPE-MOON phenomenon that has become one of the most popular mobile games in the world! The year is 2016, and glitches found in humanity’s past threaten the sustainability of its future. The Chaldea Security Organization—tasked with preserving human history for as long and as strongly as possible—has developed a new method of time travel to repair these events, stabilizing humanity’s future. But when an unknown threat pushes mankind to the brink of extinction, young recruits Mash Kyrielight and Ritsuka Fujimaru find themselves at the helm of the rescue mission: Obtain the Holy Grail in a face off against fate itself … (Source: Kodansha USA) Note: This manga adapts the first, second, fourth, sixth and final singularity from Part 1 of Fate/Grand Order.

characters.name: Ritsuka Fujimaru
characters.description: Ritsuka Fujimaru is the protagonist of Fate/Grand Order, acting as the Master of many Servants for the purpose of solving the Grand Order conflicts. He has absolutely no background details or connections to other people or events. He is simply "someone who just happened to see a recruitment flyer at a station, applied and got accepted into the job, and somehow ended up getting taken into the Chaldea Security Organization.'' He is a rather mediocre magus with skills comparable to Lord El-Melloi II. ~!After the events of First Order, Ritsuka is the only magus available to tackle the Singularities thus becoming the epitome of the everyday man tasked with saving the world!~

characters.name: Mash Kyrielight
characters.original: マシュ・キリエライト
characters.description: Mash Kyrielight is a clerk at Chaldea and a Shielder-class Demi-Servant contracted with [Ritsuka Fujimaru](https://anilist.co/character/120734/Fujimaru-Ritsuka) in Fate/Grand Order. The title Demi-Servant indicates that she's a human bonded with a Heroic Spirit's Soul. ~! In the year 2000, Mash was created through artificial fertilization and genetic editing. She is actually a Designer Baby, a magus genetically engineered under the orders of Chaldea's late director, ‎[Marisbury Animusphere](https://anilist.co/character/147492/Animusphere-Marisbury), to be a prime vessel for a Heroic Spirit's soul. Since she's not dissimilar to a Homunculus, her lifespan is limited.!~ ~! The Spirit possessing Mash is none other than [Galahad](https://anilist.co/character/136944/Galahad), Knight of the Round Table, the saint said to be the only one who obtained the Holy Grail only to return it to the Heave

characters.name: Artoria Pendragon
characters.original: アルトリア・ペンドラゴン
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1) Artoria Pendragon, better known as Arthur Pendragon and King Arthur, is regarded as a male in history but is actually female. She is the "Once and Future King" and a legendary hero of Britain known as the King of Knights. She used to wield the sword from the stone, Caliburn, but it was eventually destroyed and the Lady of the Lake gifted her with Excalibur and Avalon. __In Fate/Prototype:__ ~!He is presented as male instead, conserving his original name of Arthur Pendragon. Also called Prototype Saber, he is the Saber-class Servant under the control of [Ayaka Sajyou](https://anilist.co/character/54223).!~ __In Fate/stay night:__ ~!Saber is summoned in the Fifth Holy Grail War as the Servant of [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496). Shirou had been having dreams of Excalibur in the days leading up to the start of the Holy Grail War after receiving his C

characters.name: Cú  Chulainn
characters.description: Born as Sètanta from a mortal woman, Deichtine, and the Sun God Lugh he's a Hero from the Ulster Cycle of Irish Mythology. He took the name Cú Chulainn after he killed the guard dog of the blacksmith Culann, said to be stronger than 10 men, when he was only a child. To make up to the old blacksmith he offered himself as a guard dog and since then was called Cú Chulainn, "Culann's savage dog". Trained in the Arts of the Spear and magic Runes by Scáthach, he wields the cursed Gàe Bolg, the spear that inflicts wounds that never heal. __In Fate/Stay Night:__ ~! Originally the servant of [Bazett Fraga McRemitz](https://anilist.co/character/24332/Fraga-McRemitz-Bazett), he becomes the Servant of [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506/Kotomine-Kirei) after Kirei fatally wounds Bazett and remains under his command for the duration of the War. !~ __In Fate/Grand Order -First Order:__ ~

characters.name: Medusa
characters.description: ~!Medusa is a Greek mythological figure described as a winged human female with living venomous snakes in place of hair. Those who gazed upon her face would turn to stone. With her older sisters [Stheno](https://anilist.co/character/191058/Stheno) and [Euryale](https://anilist.co/character/191065/Euryale), they made up the three Gorgon Sisters who inhabited the Shapeless Isle. She came into existence thanks to the thoughts and prayers of humans, who desired a perfect goddess, but she was cursed for her beauty and turned into a monster hated by all. She is thus not a Heroic Spirit but a monster closer to a Divine Spirit. Due to her nature, she can manifest through different aspects depending on which disposition is predominant (more or less monstrous)!~ __In Fate/stay night:__ ~!She is the Rider-class Servant of [Shinji Matou](https://anilist.co/character/501/Matou-Shinji) in the Fifth Ho

characters.name: Archer
characters.description: __Height:__ 187 cm (6'1) __In Fate/stay night UBW:__ ~!He is the Servant of one of the series' main heroines, [Rin Tousaka](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin). Due to an incomplete summon, he apparently has no memory of his previous life or identity. Archer is sarcastic and cynical but under his hardened exterior lies a complex and dark personality that unfolds throughout the story. Though skilled with ranged weapons, he can hold his own in melee combat. Archer considers [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou)'s idealism to be weak and delusional, recognizing the mentality of "wanting to save everyone" as naive and impossible. Archer is actually a future version of Emiya Shirou, who became a hero through Emiya's wish to save innocent lives. After his death he became a Counter Guardian, a Spirit deployed to maintain balance and prevent humanity's extinctio

characters.name: Iskandar
characters.description: __Height:__ 212 cm __Master:__ [Waver Velvet](https://anilist.co/character/16023/Waver-Velvet) __Catalyst:__ Mantle once worn by Iskandar himself __Holy Grail War No.:__ 4th Holy Grail War In Fate/Zero ~!Rider was originally meant to be summoned by Lord Kayneth El-Melloi Archibald, but due to some circumstances, he ended up being Waver Velvet's servant. Iskandar, or how he refers to himself, the King of Conquerors is a noble and courageous man, who prefers to conquer his enemies by winning without killing and controlling without humiliating. He is known as a marvelous ruler who once almost conquered the whole known world. He is not pragmatic, but is a person who lets history run its course and acts according to his impulses. While he is wild and somewhat inconsiderate to others, his greed ultimately resulted in the happiness of the people he ruled over. In the new era, Rider is mostly am

characters.name: Gilles de Rais
characters.description: __Height:__ 196 cm In Fate/Zero ~!He is the Servant of Ryuunosuke Uryuu during the 4th Holy Grail War. Caster derives pleasure from first providing his victims with a moment of relief and hope, before killing them in a variety of horrific manners. Caster was summoned shortly before the Fourth Holy Grail War began. His Master was Ryuunosuke Uryuu, a serial killer who unwittingly performed a successful summoning ritual using the blood of a murdered family. Like his Master, he is almost devoid of any morality and has no interest in obtaining the Holy Grail. He enjoys offering his victims brief moments of respite, or even the hope of release or escape, before inflicting death through gruesome and horrific means. According to Caster, allowing his victims hope will amplify the despair and terror upon their moment of death, a fact that he revels in. He also uses his magic to warp and twist huma

characters.name: Zouken Matou
characters.description: A shrewd, powerful, but ancient sorcerer, Zoken is the patriarch of the Matou family and is known to be the grandfather of Shinji and Sakura. He has amassed a large and extensive library of sorcerous knowledge, yet his lessons are strict and harsh. Zoken considers Shinji to be a disgrace of a sorcerer and believes Sakura may have more potential than her brother.

characters.name: Siegfried
characters.description: Siegfried is the hero portrayed as the main character of the German Nibelungenlied epic. Prince of the Netherlands, he wields the precious sword Balmung which he received from the Nibelungen family and has fought in many campaigns and adventures. His most well-known feat is killing the evil dragon Fafnir. He then bathed in the blood of the dragon and has obtained an invincible body. In Fate/Apocrypha ~!He is the Servant of Gordes Musik Yggdmillennia as part of the Black Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War. He killed himself and gave his heart to Sieg so that he would be able to live a full life. Sieg named himself this to honor Siegfried's sacrifice. !~ (Source: Type-Moon Wiki)

characters.name: Nero Claudius
characters.original: ネロ・クラウディウス
characters.description: Nero Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus, the Fifth Roman Emperor, had the reputation of a notorious tyrant whose rule was made up of schemes and poison as she oppressed all religious forces, especially Christians, and the Roman Senate during the period from 50 to 60 AD. She was regarded in the same light as the devil, for the assumed Hebrew pronunciation of her name as emperor, Nero Caesar pronounced as "NRVN QSR", equates with the "Number of the Beast". __In Fate/Extra:__ ~!One of three Servants available to the protagonist of Fate/Extra. While she was notorious as a tyrannical emperor and for her arrogance as an artist with supremacy comparable to the gods, She is a kindhearted individual who wanted what was best for her subjects.!~

characters.name: Jack the Ripper
characters.original: ジャック・ザ・リッパー
characters.description: Jack the Ripper is a Servant of the Assassin class and one of the main characters in Fate/Apocrypha. She is a young girl who embodies contradiction itself, combining the dual natures of "day" and "night." She displays a childish manner of speech, but she is truly quick of thought. Rationality dominates her behavior, but there are many inherent weaknesses to her psyche. Her personality is both pure and cruel, and she is inclined to repay cruelty with cruelty and benevolence with benevolence. Her psyche is inherently broken, and mistreatment toward her may result in irreversible deterioration. While needing to feed on the souls of humans to keep herself in existence, she claims that she will only eat evil people because their souls "taste" better.

characters.name: Mordred Pendragon
characters.description: Mordred is the "son" of [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) though, in reality, she is a woman. [Morgan le Fay](https://anilist.co/character/239533/le-Fay-Morgan), Artoria's sister, created Mordred as a homunculus clone of the King. Morgan grew Mordred in secret, inculcating her the desire to usurp the King and ascend to the throne as the rightful heir. To achieve this objective Mordred was made to be one of the Knights of the Round Table. With time Mordred grew to idolize her "father", but the King refused to recognize her as a rightful heir. These clashing feelings of love and hate made Mordred play an important role in the fall of Camelot. __In Fate/Apocrypha:__ ~!Mordred is the Saber-class Servant of [Kairi Shishigou](https://anilist.co/character/122397/Shishigou-Kairi) as part of the Red Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War.!~

characters.name: Jeanne  d'Arc
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'3) Ruler's True Name is Jeanne d'Arc, the Saint of Orleans. A Catholic saint born in Domrémy, France, and the heroine of France who liberated Orléans in the Hundred Years' War. A Ruler Class Servant is the Standard-Bearer who Correctly Guides the Holy Grail War. Jeanne is a special Heroic Spirit summoned by the Holy Grail itself to act as the administrator of the Holy Grail War instead of the Church. Being summoned in the Ruler class also allows her to retain the memories of each repeating "game" unlike other Servants. Jeanne d'Arc was a common farmer's daughter. She claims she had received the command of God to fight. She heard the Lord’s lament that the world changed straight into hell. The Lord wept into sorrow as no one could stop it and people were not even allowed to live simply, and were compelled to become either beasts or food. Conflict never ended, and blo

characters.name: Elizabeth Bathory
characters.original: エリザベート・バートリー
characters.description: Lancer (ランサー) is an enemy Servant in the Moon Cell Holy Grail War in Fate/Extra CCC. She is unique in that she switches between four different Masters as a Lancer-class Servant, Rin Tohsaka, Rani VIII, Shinji Matou, and Hakuno Kishinami, and she later acts as the Berserker-class Servant of Meltlilith. She is one of the Servants of the Protagonist of the Grand Order conflicts of Fate/Grand Order under the Lancer, Saber and Caster class.

title: sweet guilty love bites
title_original: sweet guilty love bites-スウィートギルティラブバイツ
description: The series follows 4 hostesses at Club Rose and their relationships. It’s directed more towards an adult audience but manages to sneak in just enough cute to make it fun as well.

title: NakiNagi
description: A quiet witch meets a girl in love. Nakika was once a feared with of the deep sea, but has started a life on the surface to learn about "human emotions." Nagisa is a naive romantic and Nakika's best friend—and although she might not always understand Nagisa's infatuation, her compassion for Nagisa is deeper than the Pacific Ocean! As she uses her magical powers to support Nagisa's quest for love, she gradually learns about “human emotions. Follow the 1000% wholesome story of a girl in love and her watchful guardian! (Source: K MANGA)

title: Tensei Nanajo de Hajimeru Isekai Life: Bannou Maryoku ga Areba Kizoku Shakai mo Yoyuu de Ikirareru to Kiita no desu ga?!
title_original: 転生七女ではじめる異世界ライフ ～万能魔力があれば貴族社会も余裕で生きられると聞いたのですが？！～
description: A high school girl, Kanami Miria, reincarnated as the seventh daughter of an aristocrat. Since she had lived a miserable life, she dreamed of living peacefully in her second life. However, she reincarnated in a super-poor aristocratic family in the countryside. In order to achieve her goal to leave the house and live a peaceful life, she practiced magic and secretly went to the Royal Girls Academy. But, thanks to her omnipotent magical power, her evaluation became ridiculous. The easygoing Miria decided to ignore all invitations and aim for a relaxing life with her omnipotent magical power.

title: Tayutau Koi no Chirigiwa ni
title_original: たゆたう恋の散り際に
description: A girls' school, Hibiscus Academy, where only selected young women can attend. At this academy, there is a princess and a prince. The “Princess of Hibiscus,” student council president Suzuran, and the “Prince of Hibiscus,” vice president Emma. In public, they both play their roles as prince and princess perfectly, loved by everyone, but when they are alone, they are two trusted friends who joke around and talk naturally. However, their relationship takes a sudden turn due to a certain event. That event is... Suzuran's heartbreak. This twisted yuri story begins at an all-girls school! (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

characters.name: Emma Rosenthal
characters.original: 琥舞・グレイス・ローゼンタール

title: Kyou mo Hitotsu Yane no Shita
title_original: 今日も ひとつ屋根の下
description: A heartwarming autobiographical comic offering a peek into the daily life of Inui Ayu and her girlfriend, Kon-san. Note: Includes seven bonus chapters

title: Seishokuki
description: Nogawa Izumi is a good student, and a class representative, but she has an increasingly high libido. It's gotten to the point that she'll claim to feel bad during class, so she can run to the nurse's office and masturbate. When she learns that the Earth is being invaded by aliens that look like people dressed up as animals, it turns out her high sex drive may be able to help protect the Earth. The first time Izumi is attacked by the aliens, she is rescued by Usayama, a bunny alien whose race was their previous victim. Usayama gives her an outfit (a sexy swimsuit) that will allow her to fight the aliens, but which also sends her constant arousal through the roof. The scientific organization that Usayama is affiliated with think that Izumi, with her high erotic level, may be the person they've been looking for to fight the aliens. Will Izumi be able to save the Earth? (Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Zenryaku, Yuri no Sono yori
description: Yuri doesn't have any friends because of her personality. One day, the famous Fujiwara talks to her, but Yuri thinks that she's nothing but a fake person. Shinobu, her childhood friend and only friend, writes a story for a doujinshi which Yuri would do the art. On the story, the main character resembles Fujiwara a lot, but with a twisted personality. On that same day, Yuri sees the real Fujiwara and, as she had suspected, that girl wasn't so lovely as she appeared. Note: Includes 5 extras and 3 chapters "Koizome".

characters.name: Misono Fujiwara
characters.description: Daughter of a rich family and very popular at school for being the calm, composed and always-there-to-help kind of person. But that is not exactly her true self...

characters.name: Yuri Kurashiki
characters.description: Because of her natural blonde hair Yuri was always bullied as a child, what turned her in a tough kind of girl. Besides her childhood friend Shinobu, Yuri doesn't have any other friends.

characters.name: Shinobu
characters.description: Yuri's childhood friend. She writes the story for the mangas that Yuri draw.

title: Goshujin-sama ni wa Suwasemasen!
title_original: ご主人様には吸わせません！
title_en: I Won't Let Mistress Suck My Blood
description: While on the hunt for a new job and a place to stay, Matilda is pretty sure she hit the jackpot when she winds up in a large mansion known as the “Haunted House.” Not only does she have work, room, and board, but her new boss is absolutely gorgeous! August, owner of the haunting mansion, is a beautiful, soft-spoken woman who captured Matilda’s heart from the moment they met. But on her first night there, Matilda learns there’s much more to August than she could have ever imagined! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Agu
description: Friends, rivals... Lovers? Yeo Haon and Baek Rigon have clashed since the very first moment they met. For years, they straddled the line between enemies and friends, ignorant to what feelings had been developing deep below the surface. Yet just as soon are their eyes open to how much they mean to one another, events transpire to try keep them apart... (Source: POCKET COMICS) Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

title: Aikugui, Qing Cang Ni de Yanlei
title_original: 爱哭鬼, 请藏起你的眼泪
description: The life of two "normal" high school girls? Su Mu wants to overcome her anxiety to confess to Lin Dai Xue, on the other side Dai Xue keeps making opportunities for Su Mu to confess. Both of them know each other well but neither of them is willing to be truthful to the other.

title: Mondaiteiki Sakuhinshuu
description: Confidential Confessions is a shocking new manga series that deals with many of the hard-hitting issues that teens face today. Using emotionally moving story lines and multi-dimensional characters, each groundbreaking volume tackles such topics as teen prostitution, rape, HIV, stalkers, suicide, and sexual harassment. (Source: TOKYOPOP)

characters.name: Manatsu
characters.description: Manatsu is a high school girl that feels her life is boring and meaningless. Her father left, and her mother seemed to care more about school and studying than Manatsu's feelings and needs. While at school, Manatsu meets a bullied girl nicknamed Asparagus who cuts to relieve her pain. With Asparagus, Manatsu develops a friendship, and they begin to create a suicide pact. Manatsu enjoys her time with Asparagus and begins to feel alive again, as well as take an interest in death and the fragility of life.

title: Ore ga... Yuri!?
description: A miraculous account of a doubter who was turned into a woman by the one true god. "If you cannot make a girl fall in love with you as a woman, your punishment will be to remain a woman for the rest of her life." Thus spake INSR-sama - the powerful holy lesbian fox goddess who rules our lives - hallowed will be thy name.

title: Nagabe Tanpenshuu: Hentekona Ai
title_original: ながべ短編集 ーヘンテコな愛ー
title_en: Love on the Other Side: A Nagabe Short Story Collection
description: Love comes in many forms. A magnificent bird comforts a struggling girl; a vampire waltzes with a young lady at night; a blind girl lives with a monster of whom there is more than meets the eye. This six-story manga collection by masterful manga creator Nagabe explores fascinating relationships that refuse to be confined. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Zhiming Zhanyou
description: Shen Fan is determined to understand the inner world of the one she has secretly admired for three years. Her desperation draws her like a moth to a flame, even as she knows that her love may kill her. And what does the latter think? "This girl is very interesting, I suppose I could play with her a little."

title: Just right there!
description: Min Do Yeon is an art teacher and is happily engaged to her boyfriend when suddenly he broke up with her thru text. Desperately cried to her best friend Bo Kyung, she was asked by her if she's free and they went to a bar. Little did she knew it was a "Girls Only" bar and there she got drunk and kissed the girl who will change her life.

title: Finder Goshi no Ano Ko
title_original: ファインダー越しのあの子
description: Hajime, a girl who can’t seem to properly express her feelings into words, is worrying all on her own about the preparations for the cultural festival. This will be the last festival for her film club. There’s always been things she’s wanted to do for the festival, but like last year, she’s given up and the festival will probably end without her doing what she wants to do. That’s when she meets Kei Ichinose, another student at her schoolー (Source: Dogenzaka Shobo, translated) Note: Chapter count includes two extra chapters.

title: Gal Oshi JK wa Gal ni Naritai
title_original: ギャル推しJKはギャルになりたい
description: "Living as a gal is seriously the best!!" Mimiru was an introvert in middle school, but when she entered high school, she made her long-awaited debut as a gal, thinking, "Maybe I can become a gal too!?" She made friends with three girls: Yuuhi, a cool beauty with a calm and pretty look; Fuuka, a cute gal with a soft and fluffy look; and Kurumi, a cheerful and energetic gal who is good at sports. Now she has joined the gal group she has always admired! While she lives the sparkling life she has always dreamed of, she also pushes herself too hard to keep up with her friends. And she also notices new feelings growing within her...

title: Utsuro no Hako to Zero no Maria
title_original: 空ろの箱と零のマリア
title_en: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria
description: Kazuki Hoshino treasures nothing more than his ordinary life, and March 2 should have been an ordinary day. The arrival of a transfer student, the mysterious Aya Otonashi, shouldn't have shattered the world he knows. He's never seen this girl before in his life, but she says she's met him thousands of times--and declares war on him for a crime he can't even remember... As the truth begins to unravel, nothing is as it seems, and at the heart of it all is a wish powerful enough to change everything... (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: O
characters.description: A mysterious being introduced in the series as the one who distributes boxes. Always refered as they. They love playing with the protagonist Kazuki Hoshino.

characters.name: Kazuki Hoshino
characters.description: A completely ordinary high school student who loves idle chatter with his friends and Umaibōs, a Japanese snack. One day, he somehow suddenly antagonizes Aya Otonashi — even though he has never met her before. She threatens to “break” him.

characters.name: Daiya Oomine
characters.description: A self-centered and arrogant student who dyes his hair silver and wears three piercings in his right ear. He is also the class president and a shrewd friend of Kazuki’s. ~!Daiya used Kamiuchi and his box in order to learn how to master his own. He tricked Hoshino into believing that he was the real owner. He kills Kamiuchi which terminates the box.!~ (Source: Baka-Tsuki)

characters.name: Maria Otonashi
characters.description: An antisocial beauty with a resolute personality. She transfers into [Kazuki Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/87513/Hoshino-Kazuki)'s class on March 2nd—right before the end of the school year. Immediately upon her arrival, she announces her intent to “break” Kazuki. ~!Her life first intertwines with Kazuki when she sneaks into Mogi's box that created the recurring classroom. Being a box herself, she is able to keep her memories each recurrence. She spends years searching for the one who has the box and created the recurring classroom. During this time she also spent lots of time obtaining new skills, such as martial arts and how to ride a motorcycle.!~ ~!In the final volume Maria and Kazuki get married.!~

characters.name: Kokone Kirino
characters.description: A bright and beautiful girl who cares a lot for her friends, but can sometimes be meddlesome. She and Daiya have known each other since childhood, and their mutual verbal abuse has become legendary among their classmates ever since. She loves showing off her bust size. (Source: Baka-Tsuki)

characters.name: Kasumi Mogi
characters.description: The girl who has won Kazuki’s heart. She is docile, silent and expressionless. ~!She was actually the owner of the box that created the Rejecting Classroom. She used to be a bright and cheerful girl before but that was an act she put on for herself. Kazuki saw through her and that's why she fell in love with him. When she was hit by the truck she regretted not being able to tell Kazuki how she feels. This allowed her to create the Rejecting Classroom. Inside the classroom due to all the loops and other experiences, her personality changed to silent and expressionless.!~ ~!After the Rejecting Classroom was destroyed she was hit by that truck for the last time. She managed to survive but was severely injured and was confined to a wheelchair.!~

characters.name: Haruaki Usui
characters.description: A cheerful but frivolous baseball ace. He often hangs out with Kazuki and Daiya. (Source: Baka-Tsuki)

characters.name: Riko Asami
characters.description: A timid girl who is a big fan of Maria. Volume 2 spoiler: ~!She is actually [Ryuu Miyazaki's](https://anilist.co/character/87527/Ryuu-Miyazaki) younger sister and the owner of the box 'Week in the mud'. When their parents got divorced and her mother got in a relationship, their new father, Yuhei Ishihara, started beating Riko up because of her nature. At some point she snapped and she and Ryuu murdered their parents. During the opening ceremony at high school she was enchanted by [Maria Otonashi](https://anilist.co/character/87519/Maria-Otonashi) and wanted to be closest to her which led her to take hold of [Kazuki Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/87513/Kazuki-Hoshino) body as he was the closest to Maria. At the end of volume 2 Riko Asami drops out of high school and there is a rumor that she is living in Hokkaido and working in a farm.!~

characters.name: Ruka Hoshino
characters.description: Kazuki's elder sister.

characters.name: Koudai Kamiuchi
characters.description: A frivolous and jolly freshman who appears to be very fond of girls. ~!He is one of the 6 who got chosen as a participant for the Game of Indolence.!~ ~!It was later revealed that he was actually the owner of The Game of Indolence.!~ ~!He was later killed by Daiya Oomine as the latter asserted that it was the only way to destroy the box. !~

characters.name: Mother Kamiuchi
characters.description: Kamiuchi Koudai's mother. Raised him on her own after his father abandoned, upon finding out that she was not going to abort him. While raising him, she tried to teach him that "Violence can't solve anything!" and that he should "Never use violence".

characters.name: Miyuki Karino
characters.description: She is Daiya and Kokone's childhood friend and a year younger than them. She used to date Kamiuchi Koudai.

title: Kumo desu ga, Nani ka?
title_en: So I'm a Spider, So What?
description: I used to be a normal high school girl but in the blink of an eye, I woke up in a place I've never seen before and-and I was reborn as a spider?! How could something that's nothing more than a tiny spider (that's me) possibly survive in literally the worst dungeon ever? Are there no rules? There should be some rules! Who the hell is responsible for this? SHOW YOUR FACE! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Kumoko
characters.description: A high school girl of self-professed low standing who has reincarnated as a spider. In her former life, she lived as a shut-in and immersed herself in video games, but now she uses her remarkable mental strength to fight for survival. She uses battle tactics that make up for her low stats with her mastery of agility, spider thread, and poison fangs. ~!Kumoko later takes on the name of Shiraori after deification, becomes the Tenth Demon Army commander and the transcended protagonist of the series. After the events of the battle with the G-Fleet, Kumoko was forced to transcend the limits of the System and become a god, losing access to the System, but in return gaining an incredible amount of energy at her disposal as well as the ability to create unique magic.!~ ~!Shiraori came into being when Kumoko eats a GMA Bomb in a panic because it was going to explode, thinking maybe she could dige

characters.name: Wrath
characters.description: Wrath, formerly known as Sasajima Kyouya, is one of the students that reincarnated. After reincarnation, he found himself reborn as a Goblin in a Goblin Village with the special skill to create weapons. ~!He is the commander of the Demon Lord's eighth army.!~

characters.name: Sophia Keren
characters.description: Sophia Keren, formerly known as Negishi Shouko in her previous life, is one of the reincarnated students. She was reincarnated as a True Vampire in a noble human family, the Kerens. Her relatives are normal humans, so she hides the fact that she is a Vampire. ~!Sophia works for the demons as a soldier of the 10th Demon Army under direct orders of [Shiro](https://anilist.co/character/122124/Kumoko) to hunt the various clones of [Potimas](https://anilist.co/character/130480/Harrifenas-Potimas).!~

characters.name: Schlain Zagan Analeit
characters.original: シュレイン・ザガン・アナレイト
characters.description: The fourth prince of the Kingdom of Analeit. His name in his previous life was Yamada Shunsuke. He was a textbook example of the average high school student and retains that quality after reincarnating. However, he has a deep admiration for his older brother [Julius](https://anilist.co/character/196477/Julius-Zagan-Analeit), the hero, and spends every day working hard to catch up to him.

characters.name: Ariel
characters.description: The current Demon Lord. ~!She is the Origin Taratect, Ancient Divine Beast, and Ruler of Gluttony. She is the origin of all Taratects in the System, and thus all spiders can be considered her kin. The Queen Taratects and Puppet Taratects are her closest kin, having wills and personalities of their own, and are not dominated by Kin Control, even though she has this skill.!~

characters.name: Karnatia Seri Anabald
characters.original: カルナティア・セリ・アナバルド
characters.description: The daughter of Duke Anabald. In her previous life, she was a boy named Ooshima Kanata, but she reincarnated as a beautiful girl. She's a prodigy on par with [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit), and has been his best friend since their former life. Her speech is normally elegant and refined, but when talking with others who have reincarnated, she talks like a boy.

characters.name: Potimas Harrifenas
characters.original: ポティマス・ハァイフェナス
characters.description: Potimas Harrifenas is the elf patriarch and ambassador of the Elf Village. ~!Potimas is known for being extremely cunning and a brilliant inventor, due to his selfish pursuit and actions that constantly push the world into destruction, he is considered one of the main antagonist of the series. Using his extensive networks of spies, connections, magical gadgets and a league of followers makes him a troublesome foe to deal with.!~

characters.name: Filimøs Harrifenas
characters.original: フィリメス・ハァイフェナス
characters.description: In her previous life, she was Okazaki Kanami, homeroom teacher to the kids who were reincarnated, and they affectionately call her "Oka-chan." After reincarnating, she began attending school with [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit) and the others as their classmate. Since she reincarnated as an elf, she looks younger than she actually is. She's a caring teacher who continues to follow her students after their reincarnation, but she has many secrets.

characters.name: Feirune
characters.description: [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit)'s pet Earth Wyrm. In her previous life, she was a girl named Shinohara Mirei, but she reincarnated as a monster instead of a human. As a monster, her stats grow at a very fast rate, and she has excellent situational judgment. She has a cheerful, open personality, but she was a bully in her former life, and this shows in her behavior.

characters.name: Suresia Analeit
characters.original: スーレシア・アナレイト
characters.description: The second princess of the Kingdom of Analeit. As [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit)'s half-sister, born to a different mother not long after his birth, her talents rival his. Her obsession with her brother Shun is extreme enough to put others off, and she's noticeably hostile toward all girls who get friendly with him.

characters.name: Güliedistodiez
characters.original: ギュリエディストディエス
characters.description: Güliedistodiez, also known as Gyurie, Kuro, or Black, is one of the Administrators of the System. He is described by [Kumoko](https://anilist.co/character/122124/Kumoko) as "a very dark man."

characters.name: Ronandt Orozoi
characters.description: Ronandt is the chief of the imperial court wizards. He is the most prominent magic-user in the world and considered an amazing person who has even mastered Space Magic. He’s probably the strongest genuine human around. As Julius’s master, he was somewhat concerned about him.

title: Watashi no Oshi wa Akuyaku Reijou.
title_en: I’m in Love with the Villainess
description: The story of a reincarnated gamer pursuing her villainous lady love at a fantasy girls’ academy! Ordinary office worker Oohashi Rei has just woken up in the body of the protagonist of her favorite girls’ otome game, Revolution. To her delight, the first person to greet her is her favorite character, Claire Francois–who just so happens to be the main antagonist of the story. Now, Rei is determined to do what the game never allowed: romance Claire instead of one of the male leads. But how will her villainous lady love react to that?! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Notes: - Includes 12 extra chapters. - A print edition was released in Japan under the title Watashi no Oshi wa Akuyaku Reijou.: Revolution (私の推しは悪役令嬢。-Revolution-).

characters.name: Claire François
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm (5'2") Claire François is a proud noble who in the original [Revolution] is the villainess who bullies the heroine. ~!In the original Revolution game, she is doomed to be executed, along with the rest of nobility, as a result of the revolution.!~ Claire is prideful with a competitive side to prove her worth as well as her family name. Her threatening behaviour conceals her fragile heart that comes from her childhood experiences. Becomes more prone to jealously as people she cares for may leave her. Her arrogant personality is mainly influenced by her father doting on her in her childhood more than anything.

characters.name: Rae Taylor
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm (5'4") An ordinary office worker who finds herself in the body of the protagonist of her favorite otome game, Revolution. She aims to become a couple with her favorite character, [Claire François](https://anilist.co/character/149900/Claire-Franois). Rae deliberately plays herself up as being a foolishly happy-go-lucky girl who is obsessed with gaining Claire's affection. However, in reality, this is more of a coping mechanism brought about by her early experiences with exploring her sexuality. She is actually far less open with her true feelings, often bottling them up and covering it with humor.

characters.name: Aleah
characters.description: ~!Aleah is one of Rae and Claire's daughters, she was adopted along with her twin sister May.!~

characters.name: Misha Jur
characters.description: **Height:** 152 cm (5'0") Misha is Rae's best friend and roommate at the Academy. She is a noble from a house that fell from grace and became impoverished. Despite the Jur family's struggles with money, she still holds some reputation. She is accepting of her position and, rather than hold onto the noble status, portrays herself as equal among people with common background. This allowed for Rae and Misha to form their longstanding friendship.

characters.name: May
characters.description: ~!May is one of Rae and Claire's daughters, she was adopted along with her twin sister Aleah.!~

characters.name: Lene Aurousseau
characters.description: **Height:** 154 cm (5'1") Lene is the eldest daughter of a wealthy merchant family, Aurosseau. She loyally serves Claire François as her personal maid. Lene seems very patient, and comes off as meek and subservient, but in reality, she just knows how to handle Claire very well after years of serving her.

characters.name: Thane Bauer
characters.description: The second heir within the Bauer Kingdom's royal family. Thane is often stoic and feels his abilities are inferior to his brothers, giving him a complex about it. Thane is considered as the least popular capture target within the game.

characters.name: Yuu Bauer
characters.description: ~!Gender: Female!~ The third heir within the Bauer Kingdom's royal family. A charismatic and attractive prince type who uses charm to mask a cunning mind. Yu is the second most popular capture target within the game. ~!Later in the story it is revealed that Yuu was born as female, but she was raised as a boy. She wishes to live as a girl again.!~

characters.name: Rod Bauer
characters.description: The eldest heir within the Bauer Kingdom's royal family and first in line to the throne. He is a energetic young man who becomes interested in Rae, much to her dismay. Rod is the most popular capture target within the game.

characters.name: Manaria Sousse
characters.description: Manaria Sousse is the first crown princess of the kingdom of Sousse. She is a distant relative of Claire. She is the world's first confirmed quad-caster who possesses the highest aptitude in every element. ~!Manaria was Claire's first love, although she was first mistaken for a boy, and helped Claire overcome the trauma of losing her mother. They grew close after this incident and would continue writing to each other for years to come.!~

characters.name: Loretta Kugret
characters.original: ロレッタ・クグレット
characters.description: Loretta is from the House Kuguret, a family well known for their history of military service.

characters.name: Pipi Barlier
characters.description: Pipi is the daughter of the House Barlier, a family with deep-seated connections in Bauer’s business world. She is childhood friends with Claire François and Loretta Kugret.

title: Nekomonogatari: Shiro
description: A tale of heroine Tsubasa Hanekawa from her own perspective, in her own voice—if that can hold true for a damaged soul who, depending on who you’re asking, suffers from a split personality or a supernatural aberration. The bone-chilling brokenness of her household, where father and mother and daughter keep three separate sets of cookware in the same kitchen and only ever prepare their own meals, and the profound darkness nurtured in the genius schoolgirl’s heart, come to life, if that is the word, through her self-vivisection. (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Tsubasa Hanekawa
characters.description: __Height__: 158 cm She styles her hair into two braids and ties them with a hair ribbon that has a cat design. She is always seen dressed in the uniform of Naoetsu Private High School, even outside of school days, and is rarely seen on any other type of clothing, except for a set of sleepwear which she wore during Tsubasa Cat Arc. Hanekawa Tsubasa is [Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s classmate and the class president. Araragi describes her as "the class president of all class presidents". Her catchphrase is "I don’t know everything, I just know what I know". Hanekawa currently lives with her stepfather and stepmother. Hanekawa Family's Past: ~!Her biological mother was 17 years old when she got pregnant, the biological father is unknown because she apparently had many lovers. Before she gave birth to Tsubasa, she married another man who was a "workaholic". Ri

characters.name: Koyomi Araragi
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm A third year high school student who is close to failing every class except math. He is a laid-back person whose only real friend at school is [Tsubasa Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Due to events prior to Kizumonogatari and Bakemonogatari, Koyomi avoided having friends and seemed to have lost faith and trust in people and himself. ~!During spring break, he gave [Kiss-Shot](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Shinobu-Oshino) his blood and became a vampire. Although [Meme Oshino](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) helped him become human again, there are a few lingering side effects; he can see in the dark and far distances, and he heals faster than the average human. He is still scared of morning sunlight even though it no longer has any effect on him.!~

characters.name: Hitagi Senjougahara
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Hitagi, the main female character, is a weak-looking girl with an "incurable disease". She is in the same class as [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi), but he has almost never heard her speak. When she was in the first year of high school, she encountered a mysterious crab, after which she became weightless. Ever since, she has avoided contact with everyone else, threatening everyone who discovers her secret. She called herself a tsundere and always speaks in an abusive style. ~!At the end of Mayoi Snail, she admits that she loves Koyomi, and subsequently enters into a relationship with him.!~ ~!After the events in Tsukihi Phoenix, she overcame all of her trauma, and became a rather cheerful and normal girl. She starts calling Araragi with a cute nickname, chuckling at small things and sending e-mails full of Emojis, although her sharp t

characters.name: Mayoi Hachikuji
characters.description: Mayoi is a fifth-grade elementary school girl. She always carries a big backpack, wears a hairband, and sports ponytails. ~!Ten years ago she was involved in a traffic accident and died because of it. After that she became a ghost and considers herself a "lost snail". She will unwillingly cause the people around her to become lost and unable to find their way home. The only people who can see her are people who don't want to go home in the first place. However, after [Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) and [Senjougahara](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara) help her find the home she was looking for, she changed from an "earthbound spirit" to a "wandering spirit", a fact that she considers to be a bonus, as well as granting her to be free to wander wherever she desires. At the end of Nisemonogatari, she said goodbye to Koyomi, implying that she

characters.name: Suruga Kanbaru
characters.description: Suruga, the main character of Suruga Monkey, is [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s underclassman, ace of the school's basketball team and one of [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara)'s acquaintances from back in junior high school. Immediately after she entered senior high school, she became aware of Hitagi's secret and was threatened by her, just like Koyomi was. She's an admitted lesbian, fujoshi, lolicon and masochist. ~!Back in elementary school, she inherited what she thought was a Monkey's Paw but was actually a Rainy Devil from her mother. She started stalking Koyomi after she discovered he was dating Hitagi. She becomes friends with Koyomi and Hitagi after Koyomi rids her of the Rainy Devil.!~ She also has been growing her hair longer since. Her next story was revealed to be Suruga Devil.

characters.name: Karen Araragi
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm Karen, the main character of Karen Bee, is one of [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s sisters. She is older than [Tsukihi](https://anilist.co/character/24195/Tsukihi-Araragi) and always doing outdoor activities. Despite being younger, Karen is taller than Koyomi, much to Koyomi's dismay. ~!In Karen Bee, her hot-headed personality and her habit of acting before thinking lead her to be stung by a bee which leads to being poisoned with a terrible fever that lasted for 3 days. Like [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara), she refused any help from anyone which eventually leads to her and Koyomi fighting each other. Later it was revealed that it was set up by [Kaiki](https://anilist.co/character/53641/Deishuu-Kaiki). Karen and Tsukihi are nicknamed Tsuga no Ki Nichū no Fire Sisters (栂の木二中のファイヤーシスターズ, lit. Fire Sisters of Ts

characters.name: Tsukihi Araragi
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Tsukihi, the main character of Tsukihi Phoenix, is one of [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s sisters. She's the youngest of Araragi family. Unlike her sister, [Karen](https://anilist.co/character/24194/Karen-Araragi), she is always doing indoor activities. Contrary to her personality, she constantly changes her hair style and is short-tempered to the point that Koyomi describes her as having hysteria. ~!She is actually the reincarnation of a phoenix and has been since before she was even born. The phoenix entered the baby's body when it was still in the womb and by now both beings' minds have become one. She is immortal and the only thing that end her life is a natural death from old age. It was hinted that [Kaiki](https://anilist.co/character/53641/Deishuu-Kaiki) was the one who sent [Kagenui](https://anilist.co/character/57501/Yozuru-Kagenu

characters.name: Episode
characters.description: A young vampire hunter who wields a giant cross as a weapon. He stole [Kiss-Shot](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Oshino-Shinobu)'s left leg. Despite his physical appearance, he's only 6 years old. Episode often says, "Gotta love it," or, "That's hilarious," as a catchphrase. He has an aggressive and arrogant personality, and has a tendency to get carried away when fighting. ~!Episode is a half-vampire, he doesn't belong to humans or vampires; due to this, he is spiteful towards both sides.!~

characters.name: Izuko Gaen
characters.description: She is a young-looking woman who wears clothes that are too large for her. Izuko often boasts about her knowledge, coming off as somewhat arrogant. She claims to know everything, to the degree where she can predict the future; as a result, she likes to brag about this with her catchphrase, "There is nothing I don't know, I know everything." Izuko is also the younger sister of [Tooe Gaen](https://anilist.co/character/137496/Gaen-Tooe). When others get help from her, she wishes for something in return; usually ending up with them doing her a favour. ~!She was the senpai of [Oshino](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Oshino-Meme), [Kaiki](https://anilist.co/character/53641/Kaiki-Deishuu) and [Yozuru](https://anilist.co/character/57501/Kagenui-Yozuru) in their university years.!~ ~!It is implied that, while creating [Yotsugi](https://anilist.co/character/57499/Ononoki-Yotsugi), Izuko was cur

characters.name: Kako
characters.description: One of the many tiger aberrations, though like no other. The Kako will burn buildings down, and only wishes for things to burn. The tiger even has a catchphrase, "I don't know everything, but everything burns." ~!The Kako was created by Hanekawa unconsciously and is the manifestation of her envy. She later absorbs it and accepts her envy.!~

characters.name: Araragi no Haha
characters.description: The mother of Koyomi, Karen, and Tsukihi. She, along with her husband, have been cops for many years.

title: Adachi to Shimamura
description: Adachi and Shimamura, two young women who attend the same high school, are inseparable friends. Whether playing table tennis, chatting about favorite TV shows, or just relaxing together, they’re happy to share their days. When Adachi’s friendship turns into romantic attraction, the relationship begins to change, one day at a time. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Sakura Adachi
characters.description: Adachi Sakura is a high school student. She is found skipping class on the second floor of the gym by [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) one day. The two of them gradually became friends and began to spend a lot of time together. Adachi had an extremely introverted personality. Before meeting Shimamura, she never had someone whom she can call a friend. Adachi was said to be cold toward other people and didn't attempt to make friends with other people in the past. She also gets very jealous when Shimamura is together with her friends, and as a consequence usually ends up running away.

characters.name: Hougetsu Shimamura
characters.description: Shimamura Hougetsu is a high school student. She met [Adachi](https://anilist.co/character/144717/Sakura-Adachi) while skipping class on the second floor of the gym in her school when Adachi accidentally walks in on her one day. (In both manga adaptations, it was Shimamura who walked in on Adachi in the gym when they first met instead of the reverse.) The two instantly took a liking for each other and began to hang out together all the time. Shimamura has tail-bone length, dyed brown hair, which she keeps out of her face with two clips on the right side. Her eyes are also brown. Despite playing basketball in middle school, Shimamura is on the shorter side. She has a slim figure. Shimamura tends to think of interpersonal relationships as bothersome since she feels that it requires too much effort to maintain a balanced relationship. ~!During a summer break in their second year of high sch

characters.name: Akira Hino
characters.description: __Date of Birth:__ Unknown Akira Hino is a high school student and [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura)'s friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, where she is visiting a bookstore with [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) and [Nagafuji](https://anilist.co/character/167928/Taeko-Nagafuji). Hino has shoulder length hair, tied into low twintails. She is rather short, being shorter than Shimamura and Nagafuji. She also has big eyes. Hino has a bubbly personality and is known to add in sound effects, whether they're needed or not. She also enjoys fishing, though she often complains about not having any school fishing friends. (Source: Adachi and Shimamura Wiki)

characters.name: Yashiro Chikama
characters.description: Chikama Yashiro is a friend of [Hino Akira](https://anilist.co/character/167926/Akira-Hino), who met while they were fishing. Like Hino, Chikama makes her own sound effects, the most notably being the "breathing" sound for her space suit. In her introduction, she explains that she has come to Earth to find her brethren. Chikama wears a full body spacesuit. It has childish design elements, such as hearts and star patches.

characters.name: Taeko Nagafuji
characters.description: __Date of Birth:__ Unknown Taeko Nagafuji is a high school student and [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura)'s friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, along with [Hino Akira](https://anilist.co/character/167926/Akira-Hino), in a bookstore with [Shimamura](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura). Nagafuji has straight, shoulder length hair and wears glasses. She has a very mature figure. Nagafuji is described as having a very laid back personality. Though she sometimes just seems to be out of it. (Source: Adachi and Shimamura Wiki)

title: Majo no Tabitabi
title_en: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina
description: Once upon a time, there was a witch named Elaina, who set off on a journey across the world. Along the way, she would meet all kinds of people, from a country full of witches to a giant in love with his own muscles—but with each meeting, Elaina would become a small part of their story, and her own world would get a little bit bigger. (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Elaina
characters.description: On her broom, she flies from country to country with her long, black robes adorning the lengths of her arms and trailing behind her with every weave and turn. Her purple-blue eyes peer out from beneath a black tricorn hat to reveal beautiful and silky ashen hair that flows down her back like clouds flowing through summer skies. On her chest is pinned a star-shaped brooch — signifying her status as a witch. Prior to the main story, she was a sheltered child who was greatly proficient in magic, innocent, and "not knowing what failure is."

characters.name: Saya
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Witch Saya is a character introduced in the [Majo no Tabitabi](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. She is an apprentice witch who [Elaina](https://anilist.co/character/125736/Elaina) meets in the Land of Mages as a novice. Saya has black hair tied back in a small tassel on the left side and blue eyes. She initially wears a charcoal grey outfit, black stockings, and white boots. Saya is a person with a kind personality on the outside, but is slightly manipulative in her thinking as shown when she manipulated Elaina to stay with her for a while. She also has a desire to have company and friends, which mostly stemmed from her younger sister returning back to her homeland without her.

characters.name: Fran
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Witch Fran is a character introduced in the [Wandering Witch](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. She is [Elaina](https://anilist.co/character/125736/Elaina)'s master and a witch. Fran has long black hair, blue eyes, and has a beauty mark underneath her right eye. She wears a midnight-blue hat with a red ribbon coiled around it and a matching color outfit both of which have a stary night pattern in the interior. She also wears beige-colored pants, red earrings, brown boots, and her witch's brooch on her right chest. She's portrayed as an elated and jocular woman. Compared to the other witches in Robetta, she's shown to be a non-judgemental person.

characters.name: Sheila
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Witch Sheila is a character introduced in the [Majo no Tabitabi](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. Sheila has long blonde hair tied back in a ponytail and green eyes. She wears a white jacket with a navy blue interior over a brown dress shirt, brown pants, and brown shoes.

characters.name: Elaina no Haha
characters.description: Light Novel Volume 14 Chapter 4 & Anime Episode 10 Spoilers: ~!It is revealed that Elaina's Mother is Victorica (ヴィクトリカ) aka Fran no Shishou (フランの師匠), [Fran](https://anilist.co/character/149042) and [Sheila](https://anilist.co/character/177010)'s teacher. Her appearance is heavily similar to [Elaina](https://anilist.co/character/125736/Elaina). She wears a witch hat with a pink ribbon tied around it, a black jacket with pink collars and interior over a red vest. Furthermore, she wears long black socks and boots. Sometime before the main story begins, she trained [Fran](https://anilist.co/character/149042/Fran) to become a witch. (Source: Majo-no-tabitabi Wiki)!~ ~!She also uses the pen name Niké when writing her stories.!~

characters.name: Avilia
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Witch Avilia is a character introduced in the [Wandering Witch](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. Avilia has long white hair and green colored eyes. She wears a black ribbon, a white cape, over an eggshell-colored outfit, a black skirt, long black socks with white pinstripes, and white boots. (Source: Majo-no-tabitabi Wiki)

characters.name: Arte
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Student Arte is a character introduced in the [Wandering Witch](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. Arte has puce colored hair gray-colored eyes. She wears a black cloak with a red-colored interior over a beige sweater. (Source: Majo-no-tabitabi Wiki)

characters.name: Elise
characters.description: Elise is a character introduced in the [Wandering Witch](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. Elise has long sand brown hair and eyes, along with curled horns. She wears a navy cape, over a forest green outfit with two visible pockets, brown pants, white socks, and dirty light brown shoes. (Source: Majo-no-tabitabi Wiki)

characters.name: Monica
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Witch Monica is a character introduced in the [Wandering Witch](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. Monica has purple colored hair and eyes. She wears a black outfit, navy blue skirt, white stockings, and long laced boots. (Source: Majo-no-tabitabi Wiki)

characters.name: Lucera
characters.description: Lucera is a character introduced in the [Wandering Witch](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. Lucera has long ashen colored hair and light red eyes. She wears a black hat, a clear white top, and a black skirt. (Source: Majo-no-tabitabi Wiki)

characters.name: Prisira
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Witch Prisira is a character introduced in the [Wandering Witch](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. Prisira has long blonde hair and green eyes. She wears a black hat and a matching color outfit. (Source: Majo-no-tabitabi Wiki)

characters.name: Ekina
characters.description: Ekina is a character introduced in the [Wandering Witch](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. Ekina has long maroon colored hair and crimson-colored eyes. She wears a plum and black colored dress and a pearl necklace with a red brooch. (Source: Majo-no-tabitabi Wiki)

title: Yagate Kimi ni Naru Saeki Sayaka ni Tsuite
title_original: やがて君になる 佐伯沙弥香について
title_en: Bloom Into You: Regarding Saeki Sayaka
description: Saeki Sayaka has always been an old soul–serious and reserved, preferring to focus on her studies rather than make friends. Until, that is, a romantic confession from another girl in middle school turns her carefully ordered world upside down. Though none of her classes have prepared her for this, Saeki must now come to terms with her sexuality in this gentle, coming-of-age novel about grappling with first love, growing up, and relating to other people. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Sayaka Saeki
characters.description: Sayaka is [Touko Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/123529/Nanami-Touko)'s best friend from her first year of high school. She is a second-year high school girl and the student council vice president.

characters.name: Yuu Koito
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm (5'0") A first year high school student who has never experienced romantic feelings. She joins the student council, where she meets [Touko Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/123529). She lives above the family bookstore, where she occasionally works. ~! She later falls in love with Touko. !~

characters.name: Touko Nanami
characters.description: **Height:** 163 cm (5’4”) A second year high school student, and the busiest member of the student council. She consistently ranks number one with her test scores and grades, and excels in sports as well. Due to this, and her beauty, admirers frequently confess to her - only to be turned down, as the confessions never make her feel anything.

characters.name: Miyako Kodama
characters.description: Owner of a small café. Riko's girlfriend.

characters.name: Manaka  Yoshida
characters.description: Manaka Yoshida is a friend and classmate of Touko Nanami and Sayaka Saeki. She is usually seen with Midori Igarashi.

characters.name: Chie Yuzuki
characters.description: Chie Yuzuki is Sayaka's former middle school senpai and ex-girlfriend. Although not identified in the original manga, she is named in the spin-off light novel Saeki Sayaka ni Tsuite, in which she plays a major part.

characters.name: Haru Edamoto
characters.description: Haru Edamoto is Sayaka Saeki's girlfriend whom she started dating 3 years after the main events of the manga.

title: Isekai Goumon Hime
description: I AM THE TORTURE PRINCESS, ELISABETH LE FANU. I AM THE PROUD WOLF AND THE LOWLY SOW. A beautiful woman appears before Kaito Sena following his tragic death and rebirth into another world. Introducing herself as the Torture Princess, she orders him to become her loyal servant. Naturally, his response is..."Hard pass." And so Elisabeth presents him with two choices-become her butler or be tortured to death. After rethinking his hasty decision, Kaito is forced to wait on Elisabeth hand and foot, as well as aid her in her mission as the Torture Princess, which is the subjugation of the fourteen ranked demons and their contractors. But there's a catch. Once her mission is complete, Elisabeth is fated to die alone-forsaken by heaven, earth, and all of creation. (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes volume 7.5.

characters.name: Kaito Sena
characters.description: The male protagonist of the series. Brutally killed after a life of abuse. He was summoned by Elizabeth and made to work as her servant. Due to his experiences in life, strong emotions such as fear, anger and hatred cause him to become unusually calm.

characters.name: Elisabeth Le Fanu
characters.original: エリザベート・レ・ファニュ
characters.description: The female protagonist of the series. After Kaito is reborn in another world, she appears before his eyes and commands him to become her slave to help out with her mission.

characters.name: Hina
characters.description: She is a mechanical doll created by Vlad, which was unintentionally activated by Kaito inside Elisabeth's treasure room.

characters.name: Vlad Le Fanu
characters.description: Elisabeth's uncle and the original contractor of the Kaiser.

characters.name: Izabella Vicker
characters.original: イザベラ・ヴィッカー
characters.description: A Grandmaster Paladin tasked with the duty of overseeing Elisabeth's operations with the Church. Possesses powerful mana, a gallant spirit, and a deft sword arm. ~!Fought alongside Kaito and Elisabeth to drive back the Monarch, and the Grand Monarch, and the King in the capital.!~

characters.name: Jeanne de Rais
characters.description: ~!The Golden Torture Princess!~

characters.name: Nikuya
characters.description: A demi-human with chicken-like feet. Wears a black coat and carries around a blood-stained sack. Nobody has ever seen what's inside the sack. Can obtain any type of meat for you, no matter what it may be. Has no interest in anything besides meat, and thinks about nothing else... or so he says.

characters.name: Alice Carroll
characters.description: A new torture princess who came from Japan, like Kaito. She was created by Lewis, and was an avid fan of Lewis Carroll's 'Alice in Wonderland' book series in her past life.

characters.name: Lute
characters.description: A wolf beastfolk. He's the commanding officer of the first squad of Vyade Ula Forstlast's private army, a woman who in turn is the second imperial princess of the Forest King, one of the forefathers of all beastfolk. Lute also has a goatfolk wife.

characters.name: Vyade Ula Forstlast
characters.original: ヴャーデ・ウラ・ホウストラスト

characters.name: Vasilisa Ula Forstlast
characters.original: ヴァリシーサ・ウラ・ホウストラスト

characters.name: Lewis
characters.description: A mysterious man wearing a half-mask who is Alice's creator and "father".

title: Imouto sae Ireba Ii.
description: Itsuki Hashima is a novelist who's hopelessly enamored with the idea of little sisters and is constantly surrounded by colorful characters. A world class genius and love-guru who's beauty almost seems a waste on her. A girl who's constantly troubled by her friendships, love interests, and can't even find refuge in her dreams. A ridiculously talented illustrator. Each of them have as many problems and worries as the next and they never have a dull day together as they play games, travel, and work together. From the same author of the famous I Don't Have Many Friends , Yomi Hirasaka! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Nayuta Kani
characters.description: Nayuta is a genius novelist who is in love with [Itsuki](https://anilist.co/character/123942/Hashima-Itsuki). She debuted as a novelist after she won a newcomer prize. Nayuta Kani is her pseudonym and even Itsuki does not know her real name. She cannot write if she is not naked. Starting in junior high school, she refused to go to school after getting bullied.

characters.name: Chihiro Hashima
characters.description: Chihiro appears as Itsuki's younger step-sibling. Chihiro is a dependable person who looks after everyone and attends high school.~!It is later revealed that Chihiro is a girl.!~

characters.name: Miyako Shirakawa
characters.description: Itsuki's former college classmate. Although she is not attempting to be a professional author like Itsuki is, she enjoys reading his works. She supports him, and Kani's work.

characters.name: Itsuki Hashima
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Novelist Itsuki is the protagonist of the series who has an obsession towards younger sisters. He is a novelist who debuted when he was in high school; all of his novels feature younger sisters as the heroine. In the span of five years, he has published 20 books, some of which have ranked in the top 10 weekly rankings for light novels on Oricon. Despite his success, his irrational personality and writing style has led to mediocre success compared to his fellow writers.

characters.name: Haruto Fuwa
characters.description: Haruto is another novelist who debuted around the same time as Itsuki. He is 22 years old and often drinks alcohol with Itsuki. Despite his cool appearance, he loves maid characters and owns a lot of adult games and figurines. Haruto has a "persona" in his social media to gain fans for his novel series' popularity. He has a younger sister whom puts on a tsundere persona around him.

characters.name: Setsuna Ena
characters.description: A 16 year old illustrator who used to do the art for Itsuki's novels until he was told to stop, as Itsuki didn’t believe his series was worthy of Setsuna's art just yet. He is very easygoing and spontaneous.

characters.name: Ashley Oono
characters.description: Ashley is a 32-year-old tax accountant who wears a red lolita style dress. She is reliable but very sadistic; she makes her clients reveal their fetishes through their expenses, but raises their tax return in exchange. ~!She is currently Itsuki's only acquaintance who knows Chihiro is a girl.!~

characters.name: Kenjirou Toki
characters.description: Itsuki's editor at GF Bunko. He and Itsuki seem like they don’t get along well at first, but they are actually very close. He's normally seen nagging Itsuki and/or Setsuna about their deadlines.

characters.name: Kaiko Mikuniyama
characters.description: The girl who is in charge of adapting Itsuki's light novel series, Mahou Gakuen, (Imouto no Subete in the novel) into a manga. She is highly talented and looks up to Itsuki, as she also has a little sister fetish. She has an underwear fetish as well, and even goes as far as to wear panties in the shape of a bow on her head. When writing, she takes off the panty bow and puts the panties on her face.

characters.name: Yoshihiro Kiso
characters.description: Honorable mention in the 15th GF Bunko New Writers Contest for Sengoku Kenpuden .

characters.name: Nadeshiko Kiso
characters.description: Yoshihiro Kiso's granddaughter.

characters.name: Makina Kaizu
characters.description: A veteran novelist.

title: Shokei Shoujo no Virgin Road
title_original: 処刑少女の生きる道（バージンロード）
title_en: The Executioner and Her Way of Life
description: The Lost Ones are wanderers who come here from a distant world known as "Japan." No one knows how or why they leave their homes. The only thing that is certain is that they bring disaster and calamity. The duty of exterminating them without remorse falls to Menou, a young Executioner. When she meets Akari, it seems like just another job...until she discovers it's impossible to kill this girl! And when Menou begins to search for a way to defeat this immortality, Akari is more than happy to tag along! So begins a journey that will change Menou forever... (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Akari Tokitou
characters.description: The Lost One. She is affectionate and easy-going. Menou is unable to kill her because of her ability even though she is not aware of it herself. She begins her journey with Menou, without knowing her true intentions.

characters.name: Menou
characters.description: The Executioner. A young executioner girl who has exceptional magical talent. She is strongly dedicated to her mission and tries to finish off [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/161696) before her power gets out of hand.
