She gets close to her targets with friendly manner to grasp their ability before killing them. Her main weapons are short blade and sacred scripture.

characters.name: Momo
characters.description: Apprentice priestess working under [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou). She is deeply attached to Menou but has near zero religious faith. She is good at fighting with a fretsaw, but has poor skill with scripture magic.

characters.name: Ashuna Grizarica
characters.original: アーシュナ・グリザリカ
characters.description: Traveling Princess Knight. Princess of the Grizarica Kingdom, who is strong and beautiful. People call her the "Princess Knight" and she carries a sword with the royal crest as she always is ready for a fight.

characters.name: Mitsuki
characters.description: He was summoned from another world with the ability "nothingness" and was immediately thrown out of the castle. He wandered around aimlessly until he met [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou)

characters.name: Flare
characters.description: Skilled priest and executioner, who has killed the most Lost Ones from other worlds. She is [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou)'s mentor and Menou is considered her successor.

characters.name: Orwell
characters.description: The Archbishop. She is trusted by many people and has the greatest skill in magic of her era. She offers [Menou](https://anilist.co/character/161698/Menou) help in killing [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/161696/Akari-Tokitou) because in the central cathedral she controls a chamber that can contain and even kill otherworldly pure concepts.

characters.name: Manon Libelle
characters.description: Representative of the Libelle Family Head. Sole daughter of Count Libelle, who acts as the representative of the family after the Count fell ill. She is always dressed in a kimono and carries herself gracefully.

characters.name: Sicilia
characters.description: Priest of the port city Libelle. She works under Flare and they seem to be acquainted but further details are unclear.

characters.name: Shoujo
characters.description: ~!One of the four Human Errors, demon of the fog Pandemonium which was sealed away. She takes the form of a young girl, but her true body is still inside the fog. She has lost the memories and personality from before she became a Human Error.!~

characters.name: Sahara
characters.description: A nun that is a former colleague of Menou.

title: Tensei Oujo to Tensai Reijou no Mahou Kakumei
title_original: 転生王女と天才令嬢の魔法革命
title_en: The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady
description: Despite her supposed ineptitude with regular magic, Princess Anisphia defies the aristocracy’s expectations by developing “magicology,” a unique magical theory based on memories from her past life. One day, she witnesses the brilliant noblewoman Euphyllia unjustly stripped of her title as the kingdom’s next monarch. That’s when Anisphia concocts a plan to help Euphyllia regain her good name-which somehow involves them living together and researching magic! Little do these two ladies know, however, that their chance encounter will alter not only their own futures, but those of the kingdom...and the entire world! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes Volume 8.5

characters.name: Anisphia Wynn Palettia
characters.original: アニスフィア・ウィン・パレッティア
characters.description: Anisphia is the first Princess of the Kingdom of Palettia. Possessing memories of her past life, she longs to be able to fly in the sky with the power of magic. However, as she's unable to use magic herself, she spends her days conducting questionable research in hopes of fulfilling her dream. Her eccentric behavior earned her the nickname "Princess Peculiar".

characters.name: Euphyllia Magenta
characters.original: ユフィリア・マゼンタ
characters.description: The daughter of [Duke Magenta](https://anilist.co/character/261968/Ruomen). A genius beauty who not only excels at magic, but also well-versed in academics, politics and combat. As the fiancé of [Prince Algard](https://anilist.co/character/287676/Von-Palettia-Algard), she showed promise as the kingdom's next queen. But one fateful night would change the course of her life forever...

characters.name: Ilia Coral
characters.description: [Anisphia](https://anilist.co/character/203119/Wynn-Palettia-Anisphia)'s personal maid. Although a servant, she watches over Anisphia like an older sister. She was saved by Anisphia in the past and is deeply loyal to her. ~!Ilia was born into a low-ranking noble family. To improve their status, her parents intended to marry her off to an influential husband, basically treating their daughter as a political tool. All of this caused Ilia to grow up to become a fairly weak-willed person who did whatever she was told. However, before marrying her off, her family had her work at the royal palace as a maid. This led to her meeting Princess Anisphia, the Anisphia made Ilia her personal maid and permitted her to talk openly in her presence. All of this caused Ilia's personality to undergo a great change as she became much more blunt and willing to stand up for herself. Eventually, she cut all ti

characters.name: Lainie Cyan
characters.description: The daughter of a commoner elevated to the rank of Baron. Despite her humble origins, she has succeeded in attracting the attention of the sons of several influential nobles at the aristocratic academy. ~!It is eventually revealed that Lainie is actually a vampire who constantly gives off a charm that makes people infatuated with her, which she herself was unaware of. Following this, she is taken in by Anisphia so she may learn to control her abilities, which she repays by working for her as a maid.!~

characters.name: Sylphine Maise Palettia
characters.original: シルフィーヌ・メイズ・パレッティア
characters.description: Queen of the Kingdom of Palettia.

characters.name: Grantz Magenta
characters.description: Euphilia's father, the head of the ducal Magenta family, chancellor of the realm of the Kingdom of Palettia, and close friend to King Orphans.

characters.name: Algard Von Palettia
characters.original: アルガルド・ボナ・パレッティア
characters.description: Crown Prince of the Kingdom of Palettia. Engaged to [Euphilia Magenta](https://anilist.co/character/203120/Magenta-Euphyllia).

characters.name: Orphans Il Palettia
characters.original: オルファンス・イル・パレッティア
characters.description: King of the Kingdom of Palettia.

characters.name: Tilty Claret
characters.original: ティルティ・クラーレット
characters.description: The eldest daughter of the powerful Marquis Claret. She has withdrawn to a private residence, where she studies curses. Occasionally she conducts joint research with [Anisphia](https://anilist.co/character/203119/Wynn-Palettia-Anisphia), but they have a complicated relationship because of their different beliefs. ~!Tilty suffers from an incurable affliction that left her unable to properly release her magical energy, causing her physical and mental pain whenever she tries to use magic. Nonetheless, her family, being traditionalists blindly faithful to the spirits, forced her to learn to use her magic anyway. This continued until the pain finally caused Tilty to snap and lash out against her family.!~

characters.name: Chartreuse Hakushaku
characters.description: Count Chartreuse is the minister of magic and the father of Moritz Chartreuse who opposes any changes that might endanger the nobles' authority. ~!He had been secretly manipulating Algard Von Palettia for years to turn him into a puppet ruler under his control and played an active role in the prince's attempted revolution!~

characters.name: Moritz Chartreuse
characters.original: モーリッツ・シャルトルーズ

title: Shuuniichido Classmate wo Kau Hanashi: Futari no Jikan, Iiwake no Gosen Yen
title_original: 週に一度クラスメイトを買う話 ～ふたりの時間、言い訳の五千円～
title_en: Buying a Classmate Once a Week
description: Once a week, high schooler Shiori Miyagi pays her classmate Hazuki Sendai five thousand yen for the right to make the girl follow her orders for the afternoon. Their sessions start with normal activities like snacking and chatting…until a mood strikes Miyagi, and she gives Sendai commands that veer into risky territory. No matter the order, Sendai follows, even if it means licking Miyagi’s feet. Yet after half a year of engaging in this secret dynamic, neither girl calls the other a friend. So what does that make them? And with their last year of high school looming, is their relationship doomed to crumble? (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Hazuki Sendai
characters.description: **Height:** 163 cm (5'4") A bright, worldly high school girl. She is at the bottom of the highest school caste and stands out in class since she is popular. On the other hand, she is compared to her brilliant sister and doesn't have a place at home. Looks irresponsible but is actually serious.

characters.name: Shiori Miyagi
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm (5'2") The type of high school girl who doesn't talk about herself much and only interacts with her few friends. She isn't at the bottom of the school caste system, but she is at the bottom of the second rank. Is the only child in a father-child household. Her father prioritizes work and doesn't come home often. She doesn't call people over to her house often, usually only Sendai. Truth be told, she's lonely.

title: Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Nai jan, Muri Muri! (※Muri ja Nakatta!?)
title_original: わたしが恋人になれるわけないじゃん、ムリムリ! (※ムリじゃなかった!?)
title_en: There’s No Freaking Way I’ll be Your Lover! Unless…
description: Renako Amaori is leaving her awkward and lonely junior high school life behind, determined to become a normal girl with normal friends in high school. Glamorous, confident Mai Ouzuka is Renako’s total opposite: wealthy, outgoing, and a literal fashion model. Against the odds, the two girls form an immediate connection. Renako thinks she may have found the best friend of her dreams…until Mai’s romantic confession sends her into a tailspin. Renako wants to prove to Mai that being BFFs is better than being girlfriends, but Mai is dead set on convincing Renako that they’re destined to be lovers. Let the love games begin! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Renako Amaori
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm (5'2") At school, Renako acts bright and sociable. However, while she enjoys talking with her classmates, this is only a front, and her "true self" is gloomy and negative. In middle school, Renako declined an invitation to go out with her classmates, causing them to reject her. Renako spent the rest of middle school as a hikikomori as a result of this. Because of what happened to her in the past, she has trouble declining invitations and requests from her classmates.

characters.name: Mai Ouzuka
characters.description: **Height:** 167 cm (5'6") Mai is gifted academically and athletically, and [Renako](https://anilist.co/character/196166/Amaori-Renako) describes her as the pinnacle of beauty. Mai is arrogant and forthright, owing to her status as the school's Madonna. Though she is polite in general, when she is alone with Renako, she is very open and persistent with her desires. She has a tendency to act on a whim. The day after meeting Mai, she confesses to Renako. Renako declines, but Mai persists. They both agree that when Mai wears her hair down, they are in "lovers mode," and when she ties it up, they are in "friends mode." Mai's mother is an internationally renowned fashion designer, and Mai is one of her models. As a result, her family is very wealthy.

characters.name: Satsuki Koto
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm (5'5") Satsuki is a blunt, serious, and headstrong person. Despite her beautiful appearance, she has a cold personality and an unapproachable aura that makes it difficult to connect with her. ~!Satsuki lives in a run-down apartment and works part-time to support her single mother.!~

characters.name: Ajisai Sena
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm (5'2") She is sometimes referred to as an "angel" because of her easygoing personality. Sena's parents frequently leave her home to care for her two younger brothers, Kou-kun and Kii-kun. Although she loves her brothers, she grows resentful of the restrictions it places on her freedom as she is left to look after them on a more regular basis.

characters.name: Kaho Koyanagi
characters.description: **Height:** 153 cm (5'0") As the group's mascot, Kaho has a playful and fun personality. She enjoys making jokes and has the ability to control the mood of the group. She is referred to as "everyone's little sister" because of her childish personality. ~!Renako is later revealed to be Kaho's childhood friend. Renako was unable to remember who she was because her surname had been changed from Minaguchi to Koyanagi.!~

characters.name: Haruna Amaori
characters.description: She is Renako's younger sister. She is a second-year junior high school student and a member of the badminton club. She is naturally extroverted and athletic, unlike her older sister.

characters.name: Hitoe Hanatori
characters.description: [Mai's](https://anilist.co/character/196167/Mai-Ouzuka) personal driver and housekeeper.

title: Spy Kyoushitsu
description: Following a devastating military conflict, countries fight their wars in the shadows. One unusual spy, Klaus, has never failed on the job despite his quirks, and he is building a team to take on an Impossible Mission-one with over a 90 percent chance of failure. However, his chosen members are all washouts with no practical experience. They’ll have to use every trick in the book (and some that aren’t) to prove they’re up to the task! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Hanazono
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight **Skills:** She has a knack on concocting poisons that can either paralyze or kill her targets. Lily is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She is the team leader of Lamplight. She wants to become a spy due to her life being saved by one after she survived a poison gas attack during the Great War. Due to her concern for the Lamplight team and her own skills, she is designated by [Klaus](https://anilist.co/character/197206/Klaus) to be the team leader for Lamplight.

characters.name: Hyakki
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight **Skills:** She is good at stealing and is the most athletic member of the team. Sibylla is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She was born into a gangster family, and she and her younger siblings were forced to help in gang activities. She has a strong sense of justice and wanted to be a spy to protect her younger siblings.

characters.name: Manamusume
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight **Skills:** She is skilled in disguises, and can even disguise herself as a man without being detected. Grete is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She was the daughter of a politician but for some reason, she was forced out of her birthplace, and she seems to have decided to become a spy. Although she has an excellent brain, she has a deep-rooted distaste for men.

characters.name: Hyojin
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight **Skills:** She is a genius and excels in every skill, making her the most talented spy among the members of Lamplight Monika is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She is the daughter of an artist, she ran away from home to become a spy, and within a short period of time, she became the top student at the training school. However, for some reason, she rapidly loses her ambition and is scouted by Lamplight after failing her grades.

characters.name: Yumegatari
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight **Skills:** She is both a master negotiator and a professional seductress, able to use her charms to extract information and achieve her goals. Thea is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She is the oldest and most attractive member of Lamplight, and was the daughter of a newspaper company president and abducted when she was 11 as a hostage. However, she was saved by a spy who she admired and who became her inspiration to become one herself.

characters.name: Sougen
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight **Skills:** She has a talent for rearing and training animals, using her skills to train pet animals to perform tasks and assist her in various missions. Sara is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She is a timid but kind-hearted girl who tends to add "ssu" at the end of her words. She is the daughter of a chef and restaurant owner in a rural town.

characters.name: Bouga
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight **Skills:** She is a talented engineer and serves as the resident tech expert, though her inventions have been known to cause mayhem, especially during her time at her old school. Annette is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She has no memories from her past before she join training school, and she became a spy because of her special skills, without even knowing who she was.

characters.name: Klaus
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight, Inferno Klaus is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. He is the boss of Lamplight and a former member of Inferno, who re-established Lamplight after Inferno was wiped out. Self-proclaimed "the Greatest Spy in the World". Despite being "the Greatest Spy in the World", he is terrible at teaching as he does things intuitively.

title: Hanamonogatari
description: Our sorry hero, his reformed girlfriend, and the amnesiac class president have all graduated from their high school out in the boondocks, and self-described Sapphist and ex-basketball ace Kanbaru, retired by reason of an “injury,” is starting her senior year and the narrator of this volume—her voice far more introspective than the smutty jock’s we thought we knew. Bereft of the company of her beloved mentors, the only other person around her with any working knowledge of aberrations the junior Ougi Oshino, apparently a relative of the Hawaiian-shirted folklorist, she feels a bit alone and blue, and sick with dread that the devil residing in her left arm courtesy of the Monkey’s Paw might act up again while she sleeps. Investigating a rumour that she fears might lead back to her, the former star ends up peering into an abyss of negativity called Rouka. Trapped in a pit the like of which could only be escaped by the one girl who was able to pull off slam-dunks in her basketball nationals, can the penitent Kanbaru, however, still be aggressive? (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Suruga Kanbaru
characters.description: Suruga, the main character of Suruga Monkey, is [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s underclassman, ace of the school's basketball team and one of [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara)'s acquaintances from back in junior high school. Immediately after she entered senior high school, she became aware of Hitagi's secret and was threatened by her, just like Koyomi was. She's an admitted lesbian, fujoshi, lolicon and masochist. ~!Back in elementary school, she inherited what she thought was a Monkey's Paw but was actually a Rainy Devil from her mother. She started stalking Koyomi after she discovered he was dating Hitagi. She becomes friends with Koyomi and Hitagi after Koyomi rids her of the Rainy Devil.!~ She also has been growing her hair longer since. Her next story was revealed to be Suruga Devil.

characters.name: Koyomi Araragi
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm A third year high school student who is close to failing every class except math. He is a laid-back person whose only real friend at school is [Tsubasa Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Due to events prior to Kizumonogatari and Bakemonogatari, Koyomi avoided having friends and seemed to have lost faith and trust in people and himself. ~!During spring break, he gave [Kiss-Shot](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Shinobu-Oshino) his blood and became a vampire. Although [Meme Oshino](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) helped him become human again, there are a few lingering side effects; he can see in the dark and far distances, and he heals faster than the average human. He is still scared of morning sunlight even though it no longer has any effect on him.!~

characters.name: Karen Araragi
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm Karen, the main character of Karen Bee, is one of [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s sisters. She is older than [Tsukihi](https://anilist.co/character/24195/Tsukihi-Araragi) and always doing outdoor activities. Despite being younger, Karen is taller than Koyomi, much to Koyomi's dismay. ~!In Karen Bee, her hot-headed personality and her habit of acting before thinking lead her to be stung by a bee which leads to being poisoned with a terrible fever that lasted for 3 days. Like [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara), she refused any help from anyone which eventually leads to her and Koyomi fighting each other. Later it was revealed that it was set up by [Kaiki](https://anilist.co/character/53641/Deishuu-Kaiki). Karen and Tsukihi are nicknamed Tsuga no Ki Nichū no Fire Sisters (栂の木二中のファイヤーシスターズ, lit. Fire Sisters of Ts

characters.name: Deishuu Kaiki
characters.description: The white swindler who once deceived [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara) and the cause of [Nadeko](https://anilist.co/character/22050/Nadeko-Sengoku)'s curse. Kaiki is a capable conman, able to deceive multiple people to get the results he wants, usually being money. On one occassion, he has used the alias 'Suzuki'. Though he appears to be a deceitful man, Kaiki has tried to help others occasionally. In Nisemonogatari , ~!it is revealed that he was a university student alongside [Yozuru](https://anilist.co/character/57501) and [Meme](https://anilist.co/character/22552). Back in his college days, he had a crush on [Tooe Gaen](https://anilist.co/character/137496/Tooe-Gaen), so he now watches over her daughter [Kanbaru](https://anilist.co/character/22054/Suruga-Kanbaru) out of respect.!~ He is the narrator of Koimonogatari .

characters.name: Ougi Oshino
characters.description: Ougi appears to be a girl with short black hair, black pupils, and pale white skin. She is a junior of [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) at Naoetsu Private High School. Ougi often talks to Koyomi about oddities, and helping him remember what he knows. Her catchphrase is, "I don't know anything, Araragi-senpai. It's you who knows." Ougi is mysterious and can come off as spooky/creepy. She also speaks in a condescending tone towards Koyomi and [Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Furthermore, Ougi is capable of pulling off many things, despite what she says about what she knows. ~!As of Hanamonogatari and afterwards, chronologically, Ougi refers to himself as a boy. Others will question Ougi's identity when they first meet him as they knew him as a girl before, but they all shrug it off and seem to doubt themselves as to whether

characters.name: Rouka Numachi
characters.description: Rouka Numachi is the former basketball rival and supposed arch-nemesis of Suruga Kanbaru. Though she once shared an affinity for basketball akin to Suruga, albeit as a defensive player, she would go on to sustain a leg injury that would end her endeavor in sports. The two had a falling out in middle school due to Rouka's injuries causing a rift between the two. Rouka is characterized by the concept of "schadenfreude"; in which she derives pleasure from the misfortune of others. A self-proclaimed collector misfortunes, she enjoys listening to people's problems whilst offering empty promises of helping them out. Turning this form of counseling into a non-profit service, Rouka began to operate under the alias called "Lord Devil"; in which she promises her customers that she can solve anyone's problems with absolute certainty. Contrasting Suruga's virtuous nature, her desire for collecting m

characters.name: Tooe Gaen
characters.description: Tooe is [Izuko Gaen](https://anilist.co/character/87115)'s older sister. Like Izuko, Tooe used to be a specialist; unlike her sister, she created oddities, including the Rainy Devil. Tooe is [Suruga Kanbaru](https://anilist.co/character/22054)'s mother. When Suruga was young, Tooe and her husband died in a traffic accident; due to this, Suruga was given the Rainy Devil's left arm: the monkey's paw.

characters.name: Seiu Higasa
characters.description: Seiu is a member of the basketball team with Suruga Kanbaru. During her second year, she was the vice-captain. After Suruga retired due to the Rainy Devil's effects, Seiu became the captain. Seiu is a student at Naoetsu High and is in the same year as Kanbaru. She is often blunt, calling Kanbaru an idiot for having bad grades. As a friend of Kanbaru and fellow teammate of the basketball team, Kanbaru and Seiu are presumed to be somewhat close friends. As Kanbaru's friend, she has given her the nickname "Ruga." Initially, Seiu seems to be a background character, though she has a more prominent role in Monster Season. ~!In Shinobumonogatari, her name is read as "Seiu," though in Yoimonogatari, it is later read as "Hoshiame," where both having similar meanings. This was later brought up in Amarimonogatari, and it is said that, "both readings are correct, you can read them both ways." There

title: Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku
description: Sugar and spice--but not playing nice! The hit smartphone game Magical Girl Raising Project is not only free, but one in tens of thousands of players will win real-life powers. In N City, sixteen of these lucky girls help the city's citizens--until upper management announces that each week, the least productive magical girl will lose her gifts. But this is no ordinary contest, and as the rules become increasingly sadistic, the competition to keep their powers becomes a vicious battle for the girls' very lives... (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Koyuki Himekawa
characters.description: A middle school girl who had always dreamed of becoming a Magical Girl, sharing that dream with her childhood friend Souta Kishibe. She vowed to be a righteous and pure Magical Girl after transforming for the first time. Her ability allows her to hear the voices of anyone under distress. ~!She survives the elimination game without killing anyone. However, her ideology is shattered as a result of what she had seen. She now desires strength in order to prevent large scale conflicts.!~

characters.name: Kano Sazanami
characters.description: A high school student who lives alone. She wears ninja-style attire as her Magical Girl outfit. Her ability allows her to never miss a shot with her shurikens. ~!She lives through the events of the exam as a result of killing both Swim Swim and Fav, but loses both her left eye and arm.!~

characters.name: Souta Kishibe
characters.description: Souta Kishibe is a childhood friend of Koyuki's. He moved away from her school and became invested in playing soccer. He shares her love of Magical Girls and secretly wanted to be one. One day, his wish was granted and was transformed into La Pucelle. His magical ability is to alter the mass and size of his sword at will. ~!He is the third magical to die after being severely beaten by Cranberry and pushed in front of an oncoming car.!~

characters.name: Ayana Sakanagi
characters.description: Ayana Sakanagi is a quiet, young schoolgirl who idolizes Ruler, her Magical Girl mentor. She aspires to one day be just like her and is extremely obedient. As Swim Swim, her ability is to go through the ground and swim through it like water. ~!She is the fourteenth and final magical girl to die, killed by Ripple.!~

characters.name: Sanae Mukuou
characters.description: Sanae Mukuou is a Magical Girl (known as Ruler) that presides over four other Magical Girls (Swim Swim, Tama, Yunael, and Minael) in a temple. She is very strict and commanding, but deep down inside, she truly cares for her subjects. Her ability is to give a command that one must obey. ~!She is the second magical girl to die after being betrayed by Swim Swim and placing last in the second ranking.!~

characters.name: Tsubame Murota
characters.description: A former delinquent in her youth, Tsubame Murota is a Magical Girl with the ability to travel at incredibly high speeds on her broomstick Rapid Swallow. She often confides in Ripple and is friendly and outgoing. ~!She is the eighth magical girl to die after being stabbed in the back by Swim Swim. Her unborn child died with her.!~

characters.name: Ako Hatoda
characters.description: A young Magical Girl, she was recently chosen and became the 16th Magical Girl of N-City. She wears an Alice in Wonderland-style dress, draped in black as her Magical Girl Outfit. Her ability lets her regenerate any damage taken, allowing her to survive even beheading or dismemberment. ~!She picked up what she thought was her real bunny doll, turning out that it was Minael disguised as it. They used that to find her information, she was then followed and killed in her untransformed state by Swim Swim. She is the tenth magical girl to die.!~

characters.name: Fav
characters.description: The mascot character of the Magical Girl Raising Project social game and the familiar spirit who oversees the magical girl project.

characters.name: Nana Habutae
characters.description: A veteran N-City Magical Girl and Weiss Winterprison's lover. In real life, she is a sweet girl who lives with Shizuku. She has dedicated her career to protecting the city and bringing a message of peace. She wears a nun-like dress as her Magical Girl outfit. Her ability allows her to enhance a person's physical capabilities. ~!Following Winterprison's death, she commits suicide by hanging, becoming the ninth magical girl to die.!~

characters.name: Shizuku Ashuu
characters.description: A powerful N-City Magical Girl, as well as Sister Nana's lover. She wears a thick winter coat as her Magical Girl outfit. Her ability lets her create walls of any form, depending on the terrain. ~!She is the sixth magical girl to die due to blood loss, after being stabbed by Yunaelle and having her arm sliced off by Swim Swim.!~

characters.name: Makoto Andou
characters.description: A robotic Magical Girl who tends to care more about financial gain than helping others. Her ability allows her to obtain a random futuristic gadget from her backpack once per day, but even she cannot predict what it will be, and at the end of the day, it disappears. ~!After attempting to kill Snow White, she is killed by Hardgore Alice, becoming the fourth magical girl to die.!~

characters.name: Naoko Yamamoto
characters.description: A Magical Girl hired by the N-City's criminal underground. She wears a cowboy hat and has a wild-west style attire as her Magical Girl outfit. Her ability allows her to magically enhance any weapon she uses. ~!She is the seventh magical to die when she shot a piece of glass that Ripple threw at her, causing her to be impaled by the glass shards (in the anime, the shards were a distraction and she was killed by taking a shuriken to the head).!~

title: Watashi, Nouryoku wa Heikinchi de tte Itta yo ne!
title_original: 私、能力は平均値でって言ったよね！
title_en: Didn't I Say to Make My Abilities Average in the Next Life?!
description: When she turns ten years old, Adele von Ascham is hit with a horrible headache–and memories of her previous life as an eighteen-year-old Japanese girl named Kurihara Misato. That life changed abruptly, however, when Misato died trying to aid a little girl and met god. During that meeting, she made an odd request and asked for average abilities in her next life. But few things–especially wishes–ever go quite as planned. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Reina
characters.description: Also known as Crimson Reina, she is a mage specializing in fire magic. She was born to a travelling merchant, and became a hunter at an early age, giving her the most practical knowledge and experience amongst the Crimson Vow party members. She has a signature fire spell called Crimson Hellfire. Despite being fifteen years old at the start of the series, she is assumed to be a similar age to Mile, the youngest member of their group, due to her height and appearance which is a source of anger for her. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Pauline
characters.description: A mage specializing in healing and water magic, she is the daughter of a merchant and the resident bookkeeper of the Crimson Vow. Despite her miserly manner, she typically has a gentle appearance and demeanour but is known to show fits of rage when provoked. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Adele Von Ascham
characters.original: アデル・フォン・アスカム
characters.description: Adele von Ascham is the protagonist of the series. Before dying, she was a Japanese girl named Misato Kurihara. Though she had forgotten about her previous life for the first few years since her birth, one day when she was ten, she remembered everything with a strong headache. She is told about Nanomachines by The Creator, and realizes that she can talk with them. At that time, Adele's thought wave output is about half of the elder dragon species (about 6800 times as strong as the usual human), and the authority level to use Nanomachines is 5 (normal creatures are basically level 1). She entered Eckland Academy under the guise of living as an ordinary girl, but she failed to hide her ability. Due to this, Adele deserted Eckland Academy and left her home country. Signing up to be a Hunter, she gave herself the alias of Mile and proceeded to attend the Hunters' Prep School on the recommend

characters.name: Mavis von Austien
characters.original: メーヴィスフォンオースティン
characters.description: Mavis is a young knight part of the Crimson Vow and noble at birth. She decided to become a knight but her family strongly opposed her decision causing her to run away from home and attending the Hunter's Guild where she eventually joined the Crimson Vow. Mavis has a very dignified personality which really emphasizes her noble lineage. However, she has a hard time with sad and hard stories, often crying her eyes out.

characters.name: Lenny
characters.description: Lenny is a young girl and the inn owner of the Crimson Vow's base of operations. Although she has the appearance of a young girl, she is very capable of handling herself as she runs the inn without the help of others. Lenny is even known to be manipulative as she makes the Crimson Vow work for her in order to boost the inn's profit.

characters.name: Nano
characters.description: Nano is a tiny machine that produces magic for Adele. Nano converts thought pulses from Adele and converts them into magic.

characters.name: Monica
characters.description: The daughter of a merchant and a friend of Adele's. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Marcela
characters.description: The third daughter of a baron and a friend of Adele's. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Oriana
characters.description: A commoner. A friend of Adele in Eckland Academy.

title: Violet Evergarden Gaiden
title_original: ヴァイオレット・エヴァーガーデン 外伝
description: There are countless feelings that we wish to convey to you. From the Kyoto Animation Awards' first Grand Prize winning work, "Violet Evergarden", comes a Gaiden that contains six new episodes. It is a book that can allow people to enjoy the world of "Violet Evergarden" even more, with the heartwarming exchanges between Violet and her customers and stories in which familiar members of the CH Postal Service play a big part. "I rush anywhere my clients might desire. I am from the Auto-Memories Doll service, Violet Evergarden." Please accept the "sentiments" of the story that this beautiful Auto-Memories Doll narrates.

characters.name: Violet Evergarden
characters.original: ヴァイオレット・エヴァーガーデン
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm Violet is described as a very beautiful young woman, being almost doll-like in appearance, with light-blue eyes, a fair complexion, and a slender frame. She is noted for her womanly semblance. She has waist-length golden hair with locks that frame her face. She either has her hair untied, in a low ponytail, or, after becoming a Doll, pulled up into two braided buns with two red ribbons. Due to losing her arms in the war, Violet received maneuverable prosthetic arms made of adamant silver. After the end of the war and on normal occasions, Violet is often seen wearing a white blouse, a green skirt and a pair of heeled brown boots. ~!Growing up as an orphaned child soldier in the army who was treated as a mere tool, Violet was not educated like a regular human being and did not understand human feelings well. She was raised and grew up as a person who had feelings, but co

characters.name: Cattleya Baudelaire
characters.original: カトレア・ボードレール
characters.description: Cattleya Baudelaire is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. Being a figurehead Auto Memories Doll who works for the CH Postal Company, Cattleya never stops being requested and often takes on clients with love troubles. She works alongside [Violet](https://anilist.co/character/90169/Evergarden-Violet) and has been close with [Hodgins](https://anilist.co/character/124799/Hodgins-Claudia) since before the company was established, joining as one of its initial employees.

characters.name: Benedict Blue
characters.original: ベネディクト・ブルー
characters.description: Benedict Blue (ベネディクト・ブルー, Benedikuto Burū?) is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. He is a postman working at the CH Postal Company. He has known Hodgins since before the company's establishment and has had a brusque attitude towards him since he started working there.

characters.name: Gilbert Bougainvillea
characters.original: ギルベルト・ブーゲンビリア
characters.description: Gilbert Bougainvillea is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. He is a major in the Leidenschaftlich army who values Violet more than anything, seeing her as a human being rather than a tool. ~!Violet was "given" to Gilbert as a gift to commemorate his promotion, having being promoted to a major in light of his wartime achievements and expectations from his bloodline. Dietfried, not wanting to take care of Violet, pushed this task to his younger brother. Gilbert then decided to enlist her on a militant unit that he had been appointed to take overall command of in his promotion to major. He later received permission to conduct private experiments at the training grounds as to whether Violet could be officially classified as a "weapon."!~

characters.name: Claudia Hodgins
characters.original: クラウディア・ホッジンズ
characters.description: A former army commander. He founded the CH postal company and serves as president. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Charlotte Abelfreyja Drossel
characters.original: シャルロッテ・エーベルフレイヤ・ドロッセル
characters.description: She is the princess of Drossel, and the narrator for the 5th episode of Violet Evergarden.

characters.name: Isabella York
characters.description: Isabella York is the daughter of the York family that is closely related to the Drossel Royal Family. She had trouble fitting in with the nobility as she can't follow etiquette and mannerism of the nobles in her school, making her some sort of outcast. ~!She is an illegitimate daughter of the York family, she used to live in poverty with her adopted sister, Taylor Bartlett. Before becoming Isabella York, she goes by the name of Amy Bartlett. The condition she proposed to the York family is to take care of Taylor in exchange for her cooperation to become the daughter of York family!~

characters.name: Taylor Bartlett
characters.original: テイラー・バートレット
characters.description: Taylor Bartlett is Amy Bartlett's adoptive sister. Her sister, Amy picked her up from the streets despite barely managing to make ends meet for herself. ~!When Amy was taken as the York's daughter, Taylor was sent to an orphanage where she spent years apart from her sister, Amy. It's not until Benedict delivered Amy's letters to her that she start to reminiscence the day she spent with her sister, Amy.!~

characters.name: Damian Baldur Flugel
characters.original: ダミアン・バルドゥール・フリューゲル
characters.description: He is the prince of the Kingdom of Flugel who is set to marry princess Charlotte of the Kingdom of Drossel.

characters.name: Alberta
characters.description: A court lady in the service of the royal family of the kingdom of Drossel, she has been taking care of Charlotte since she was born, and she is more important to Charlotte than her own parents.

title: "Omae Gotoki ga Maou ni Kateru to Omou na" to Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou Sareta node, Outo de Kimama ni Kurashitai
title_original: 「お前ごときが魔王に勝てると思うな」と勇者パーティを追放されたので、王都で気ままに暮らしたい
title_en: ROLL OVER AND DIE: I Will Fight for an Ordinary Life with My Love and Cursed Sword!
description: Flum Apricot was never meant to be a hero. Despite zero stats across the board and a power she can’t even use, she somehow finds herself included in a party of heroes. But Flum’s life hits rock bottom when the party’s renowned sage, Jean Inteige, decides that the useless girl is dead weight, and arranges to have her sold into slavery. Tossed to monsters to be feasted upon for her master’s entertainment, Flum makes the desperate choice to reach for a cursed weapon…and something new awakens within her. A grimdark tale about one woman’s blood-soaked quest to reclaim her life! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Flum Apricot
characters.original: フラム・アプリコット
characters.description: A caring, determined, strong, slight yandere, and cruel young girl who will help anyone who needs it. She has reddish-brown hair, orange eyes, and a slave mark on her left cheek. Has the power of "Reversal"

characters.name: Milkit
characters.description: A shy girl with no magical powers, who is rescued by [Flum](https://anilist.co/character/219037/Apricot-Flum) from a slave trader. She insists on calling Flum her "Master". Her face is covered in bandages, with only a single blue eye peeking out. She carries a slave mark on her right cheek.

characters.name: Sara Anvillen
characters.description: A nun in training for the Church of Origin. In addition to being able to use curative magic, she is a talented melee fighter.

characters.name: Eterna Rinebow
characters.description: A powerful water magic user, and a member of the party of heroes.

characters.name: Ink Wreathcraft
characters.original: インク・リースクラフト
characters.description: A blind girl who [Flum](https://anilist.co/character/219037/Flum-Apricot) rescued. She claims to have run away from home... she is a very cheerful girl, and even though she is blind, she is always smiling. She also likes to play pranks.

characters.name: Gadhio Lathcutt
characters.original: ガディオ・ラスカット
characters.description: A member of the party of heroes, armed with a huge sword. ~!The sole survivor of his previous party, which included his wife, Tia.!~

characters.name: Cyrill Sweechka
characters.original: キリル・スウィーチカ
characters.description: Possessing the rare attribute "Hero" and high stats, she is a girl at the center of the journey to defeat the Demon King. When the Hero Party was first formed, she got along well with [Flum](https://anilist.co/character/219037/Flum-Apricot), who also comes from the countryside, but at some point their relationship became strained...

characters.name: Neigass
characters.description: **Height:** 170cm

characters.name: Ottilie Fohkelpi
characters.original: オティーリエ・フォーケルピー

characters.name: Welcy Mancathy
characters.original: ウェルシー・マンキャシー

characters.name: Leitch Mancathy
characters.original: リーチ・マンキャシー

title: Hikikomari Kyuuketsuki no Monmon
title_original: ひきこまり吸血姫の悶々
title_en: The Vexations of a Shut-In Vampire Princess
description: Three years into her life as a shut-in, vampire Terakomari Gandesblood (Komari for short), awakens to find she’s been appointed as a Commander in the Mulnite Imperial Army! The thing is, her new unit consists solely of belligerent ruffians who revolt against their superiors at the slightest hint of weakness. Although Komari hails from a line of vampires as powerful as they are prestigious, her refusal to drink blood has made her the picture of mediocrity—scrawny, un-coordinated, and inept at magic. With the odds stacked against her, will the help of her trusty (and slightly infatuated) maid Vill be enough for this recluse to blunder her way to success? Or will Komari rue the day she ever left the safety of her room? (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Terakomari Gandesblood
characters.original: テラコマリ・ガンデスブラッド
characters.description: One of the seven Crimson Lords, she is the commander of the 7th unit.

characters.name: Villhaze
characters.description: [Komari](https://anilist.co/character/295878/Gandesblood-Terakomari)'s personal maid, assigned as part of her position as a Crimson Lord.

characters.name: Karen Helvetius
characters.original: カレン・エルヴェシアス
characters.description: Empress of the Mulnite Empire. Hard to read and wanton in nature, she appoints the reclusive [Komari](https://anilist.co/character/295878/Gandesblood-Terakomari) as a Crimson Lord.

characters.name: Sakuna Memoir
characters.description: One of the seven Crimson Lords, she is the commander of the 6th unit.

characters.name: Millicent Bluenight
characters.original: ミリセント・ ブルーナイト
characters.description: A member of the terrorist organization "Inverted Moon".

characters.name: Meruka Tiano
characters.description: Reporter for the Six Countries, a newspaper considered by some to be untrustworthy.

characters.name: Gertrude Rainsworth
characters.original: ガートルード・ レインズワース

characters.name: Belius Cerberus
characters.original: ベリウス・イッヌ・ケルベロ

title: Heimin no Kuse ni Namaiki na!
title_original: 平民のくせに生意気な！
title_en: I’m in Love with the Villainess: She’s so Cheeky for a Commoner
description: Claire François has it all: beauty, brains, and the blood of nobility. As the daughter of a high-ranking noble, she takes her status and the according responsibilities with utmost seriousness—even as the king threatens to undermine his realm’s stability with his visions of “meritocracy.” Claire is nevertheless prepared to take this societal change in stride, until one of the new commoner students at her elite academy, Rae Taylor, turns her life upside down. Everything about Rae confounds Claire, from her behavior to her intellect to her bizarre fixation on Claire herself. Little does she realize just how much Rae will change her world, and how much she’ll change Rae in turn. A retelling of the original series from Claire's perspective. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Chapter count includes 8 main chapters, 18 intermission chapters, an epilogue, and 3 postscript chapters.

characters.name: Claire François
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm (5'2") Claire François is a proud noble who in the original [Revolution] is the villainess who bullies the heroine. ~!In the original Revolution game, she is doomed to be executed, along with the rest of nobility, as a result of the revolution.!~ Claire is prideful with a competitive side to prove her worth as well as her family name. Her threatening behaviour conceals her fragile heart that comes from her childhood experiences. Becomes more prone to jealously as people she cares for may leave her. Her arrogant personality is mainly influenced by her father doting on her in her childhood more than anything.

characters.name: Rae Taylor
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm (5'4") An ordinary office worker who finds herself in the body of the protagonist of her favorite otome game, Revolution. She aims to become a couple with her favorite character, [Claire François](https://anilist.co/character/149900/Claire-Franois). Rae deliberately plays herself up as being a foolishly happy-go-lucky girl who is obsessed with gaining Claire's affection. However, in reality, this is more of a coping mechanism brought about by her early experiences with exploring her sexuality. She is actually far less open with her true feelings, often bottling them up and covering it with humor.

characters.name: Lene Aurousseau
characters.description: **Height:** 154 cm (5'1") Lene is the eldest daughter of a wealthy merchant family, Aurosseau. She loyally serves Claire François as her personal maid. Lene seems very patient, and comes off as meek and subservient, but in reality, she just knows how to handle Claire very well after years of serving her.

characters.name: Thane Bauer
characters.description: The second heir within the Bauer Kingdom's royal family. Thane is often stoic and feels his abilities are inferior to his brothers, giving him a complex about it. Thane is considered as the least popular capture target within the game.

characters.name: Yuu Bauer
characters.description: ~!Gender: Female!~ The third heir within the Bauer Kingdom's royal family. A charismatic and attractive prince type who uses charm to mask a cunning mind. Yu is the second most popular capture target within the game. ~!Later in the story it is revealed that Yuu was born as female, but she was raised as a boy. She wishes to live as a girl again.!~

characters.name: Rod Bauer
characters.description: The eldest heir within the Bauer Kingdom's royal family and first in line to the throne. He is a energetic young man who becomes interested in Rae, much to her dismay. Rod is the most popular capture target within the game.

characters.name: Manaria Sousse
characters.description: Manaria Sousse is the first crown princess of the kingdom of Sousse. She is a distant relative of Claire. She is the world's first confirmed quad-caster who possesses the highest aptitude in every element. ~!Manaria was Claire's first love, although she was first mistaken for a boy, and helped Claire overcome the trauma of losing her mother. They grew close after this incident and would continue writing to each other for years to come.!~

characters.name: Loretta Kugret
characters.original: ロレッタ・クグレット
characters.description: Loretta is from the House Kuguret, a family well known for their history of military service.

characters.name: Pipi Barlier
characters.description: Pipi is the daughter of the House Barlier, a family with deep-seated connections in Bauer’s business world. She is childhood friends with Claire François and Loretta Kugret.

characters.name: Lilly Lilium
characters.description: Lilly is a meek and shy girl who is highly knowledgeable about the Spiritual Church and her religion. She often stutters and refers herself as "Lilly" when she speaks. In addition, she is prone to be easily startled and accidentally insult others whenever they act inappropriately. ~!She has a split personality. Normally, she is a shy individual who often stammers when she speaks. However, due to experiments done by her father when he was trying to artificially create a dual-caster, a second personality was embedded within her. This side of Lilly is a ruthless assassin who follows Salas.!~

characters.name: Ralaire
characters.description: Baby slime adopted by [Rae](https://anilist.co/character/171836/Taylor-Rae).

characters.name: Dole François
characters.description: Dole François is the Minister of Finance in the Bauer Kingdom and the father of Claire François.

characters.name: Catherine Achard
characters.original: カトリーヌ • アシャール
characters.description: She is the bastard child between Marquis Clement Achard and an unknown commoner woman, thus being the sister-in-law of Clement Achard, and is treated poorly by her father due to this. Catherine is Claire François's childhood friend, having known her since a very young age. She lost her left leg due to an accident and is sitting in a wheelchair.

title: Murasakiiro no Qualia
description: Through the uncanny purple eyes of Yukari, all people appear to her as robots. Her talent is both a blessing and a curse. She is able to assist the police in sizing up threats, since her “skill” allows her to evaluate humans’ quirks and physical capabilities like cataloging the parts of a machine–yet her strange sight has cost her the friendship of her peers. She does have one friend in her corner: Hatou “Gaku” Manabu, a girl at school who cares deeply for Yukari. When Yukari is recruited into a secret organization, the real trouble begins. Gaku is thrust into a realm of mystery, quantum experimentation, and alternate universes, with only her wits–and her love for Yukari–to guide her along the way. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Ousama no Propose
description: Saika Kuozaki is an all-powerful witch with looks to die for. She's also the only woman who can thwart the mysterious entities attempting to destroy the world once every 300 hours. When Saika is mortally wounded, however, she bequeaths both her powers and body to the normal high school boy who happens upon her, Mushiki Kuga. But just because Mushiki has her abilities doesn't mean he can control them. To stand a chance of saving the world, he'll have to attend an academy for mages as Saika—all while keeping his identity under wraps! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Saika Kuozaki
characters.description: Saika Kuozaki was the principal of the Void Garden. Currently, she has passed down her identity and powers to Mushiki Kuga. ~!She transfered her conscience a backup body named Kuroe Karasuma.!~

characters.name: Mushiki Kuga
characters.description: __Relatives__: [Ruri Fuyajou](https://anilist.co/character/267264/Fuyajou-Ruri) (Younger Sister), Ai Fuyajou (Mother) Mushiki Kuga is the main protagonist of King's Proposal. He is an ordinary high schooler who has inherited the body and identity of Saika Kuozaki and is assuming them to remain in order at Void Garden, he is also the older brother of Ruri Fuyajou. Due to an incident involving him and Saika, Mushiki's consciousness now resides in Saika's body, thus sharing her appearances. Mushiki has the personality of a typical teenager: getting flustered by unknown situations and girls, and becoming serious whenever needed to. He is also extremely soft-spoken and speaks in a very polite way of speaking. He notably has a strong admiration of Saika Kuozaki, describing himself to fall in love with her at first sight and described her in a flamboyant and excited manner whenever she is menti

characters.name: Erulka Flaera
characters.description: A medical teacher at Void Garden and a senior member of Knight Order.

characters.name: Enviette Svarner
characters.original: アンヴィエット・スヴァルナ－
characters.description: __Occupations:__ Teacher __Affiliations:__ Void Garden, Knight Order Enviette Svarner is a teacher at Void Garden and member of Knight Order . Enviette is a serious and kind individual, yet expresses himself in harsh manner. He harbors a one-sided adversary attitude towards [Saika Kuozaki](https://anilist.co/character/267261/Saika-Kuozaki), with his actions ranging from belittling Saika to seeking fight with her. His surname Svarner is a Sanskrit word for "Gold".

characters.name: Ruri Fuyajou
characters.description: __Relatives:__ [Mushiki Kuga](https://anilist.co/character/267263/Mushiki-Kuga) (Older Brother), Ai Fuyajou (Mother) __Occupations:__ Knight, Student __Affiliations:__ Knight Order, Void Garden Ruri Fuyajo is a prodigy student enrolled in Class 2-1 of , a member of and is the younger sister of Kuga Mushiki. As a prodigy member of the Knight Order, she is able to use up to Second Manifestation , though her first manifestation is still unknown. While using Rinkojin (Ruri's 2nd Manifestation), two glittering patterns of lapis lazuli appears above her head. A kabuto helmet shins above her head. A long naginata is shaped by a shimmering light, which she uses to cut down her targets. The blade of light generated at the tip of the long handle can become like a whip, drawing trajectories in every direction to slice her targets. __Her favorite:__ Crepe flavor is strawberry and cream. Friends are

characters.name: Kuroe Karasuma
characters.description: __Occupations:__ Kuozaki Saika's Attendant, ~!Void Garden Headmaster (Saika)!~ __Affiliations:__ Void Garden Kuroe Karasuma is an attendant of Saika Kuozaki. With the fusion of Saika's body and Mushiki's conscious, she serve as his attendant, and later a transfer student of Class 2-1 of Void Garden. Kuroe is highly collected and calculative. She is also highly responsible to her duty, and would go extended lengths when need be. While mostly reserved, she often responds to Mushiki Kuga's flamboyance over Saika Kuozaki with condescending sarcasm.

characters.name: Kurara Tokishima
characters.description: A student of the Shadow Tower, streamer and author of Clara Channel on video hosting website for magicians MagiTube.

characters.name: Hildergard Silber
characters.original: ヒルデガルド・シルベル
characters.description: Void Garden's head engineer and creator of it's AI: [Silber](https://anilist.co/character/326237)

characters.name: Ao
characters.description: __Occupation__: Hollow Ark's Headmistress __Age__: ~!200+!~ While meeting others, Ao typically keeps her face hidden underneath a long robe. ~!Her face is identical of her distant descendent, [Ruri Fuyajou](https://anilist.co/character/267264/Fuyajou-Ruri).!~

characters.name: Silber
characters.description: She´s the Void Garden's AI. Her appearence is modeled after her creator: [Hildergard](https://anilist.co/character/326235/Silber-Hildergard)

characters.name: Hizumi Nagekawa
characters.description: A student in Class 2-1, Ruri's classmate and best friend.

characters.name: Tomoe Kurieda
characters.description: She's the teacher of the history of magic in Class 2-1, where [Mushiki](https://anilist.co/character/267263/Kuga-Mushiki) and [Kuroe](https://anilist.co/character/267265/Karasuma-Kuroe) study.

characters.name: Surya Svarner
characters.original: スーリヤ・スヴァルナ
characters.description: A mysterious girl with ties to [Enviette](https://anilist.co/character/267262/Svarner-Enviette)'s past.

characters.name: Sara Svarner
characters.description: ~!Wife of [Enviette Svarner](https://anilist.co/character/267262/Svarner-Enviette), who died a century ago.!~

characters.name: Tanpopo Shishiyama
characters.description: She's the сommandant of girls dormitory №1 in Void Garden and student.

title: Yuri no Aida ni Hasamareta Watashi ga, Ikioi de Futamata Shite Shimatta Hanashi
title_original: 百合の間に挟まれたわたしが、勢いで二股してしまった話
title_en: Yuri Tama: From Third Wheel to Trifecta
description: Yuna Momose and Rinka Aiba were made for each other, and their whole school knows it. Between Yuna's princess-like elegance and Rinka's prince-like charm, all their classmates see them as the ideal couple. Yotsuba Hazama is no exception to that, but she is exceptional in another way: she's somehow managed to become fast friends with both of them! Having the whole school's favorite ship as her two best friends isn't exactly easy, though. Not only does it make everyone treat Yotsuba like a particularly obnoxious third wheel, it makes her feel like one too! Or at least it does, until one day, Yuna asks her out. And then Rinka asks her out too! And Yotsuba, whose social anxiety never seems to kick in until after she's already messed something up...says yes to both of them, without sparing so much as a single thought for the consequences. Oops! Now Yotsuba only has one choice: keep her accidental two-timing under wraps and make both of her new girlfriends as happy as she possibly can! (Source: J-Novel Club)

characters.name: Sakura Hazama
characters.description: The younger sister of Yotsuba and older sister of Aoi Hazuma.

characters.name: Aoi Hazama
characters.description: Younger sister of Yotsuba and Sakura Hazuma.

title: Tsukumodou Kottouten
title_original: 付喪堂骨董店―“不思議”取り扱います
description: The story centers around the so-called "Relics"—mysterious items with special powers that range from obviously lethal to deceptively harmless—and the damage they bring about. Again and again, Tokiya Kurusu and Saki Maino, both of which work at the Tsukumodo Antique Shop (FAKE), get into difficulties that involve Relics, and have to find a way out. Why do they seem to be haunted by such incidents and what kind of fate is awaiting them...? Very well, let us talk about the never-smiling girl and the death-seeing boy, and the strange incidents they become entangled in.

characters.name: Towako Settsu
characters.description: She is the owner of Tsukumodou Antique Shop (FAKE). She has seen a lot of people suffer because of Relics interference in the past, which made her want to collect all Relics to prevent disasters that's caused by them. Despite saying to customers that her shop is selling Relics, she only sells fake ones.

characters.name: Tokiya Kurusu
characters.description: The main protagonist of the novel. He is a high-school student who works as a part-timer in Tsukumodo Antique Shop. He owns a Relic named "Vision" which was planted in his right eye. His Relic possess an ability to foresee the death scene of someone close to him. He is shown to care about Saki, and owes Towako for something in the past.

characters.name: Saki Maino
characters.description: She is a girl who works as a part-timer in Tsukumodo, along with Tokiya. She has a difficulty to show her emotion, which sometimes causes some misunderstanding. She has a crush towards Tokiya.

title: Onna dakara, to Party wo Tsuihousareta no de Densetsu no Majo to Saikyou Tag wo Kumimashita
title_original: 女だから、とパーティを追放されたので伝説の魔女と最強タッグを組みました
title_en: Sexiled: My Sexist Party Leader Kicked Me Out, So I Teamed Up With a Mythical Sorceress!
description: Tanya Artemiciov is a talented Mage-class adventurer who just got kicked out of her party by a sexist scumbag. So what's a girl to do? Go to the wasteland and blow stuff up of course! One small problem though: she inadvertently frees a mythical Sorceress named Laplace who was sealed away for the past 300 years... Surprise! Turns out this so-called “wicked” Sorceress is actually pretty cool. Laplace wants to start a party of her own, Tanya wants revenge, and the solution is obvious: team up. It's time to kick ass, kiss girls, and dismantle the patriarchy!

characters.name: Tanya Artemiciov
characters.original: ターニャ・アルテミシオフ
characters.description: Tanya is a skilled mage who got kicked from her party for being a woman.

characters.name: Laplace
characters.description: Laplace is a Sorceress who was sealed away in the Western Wasteland under a mountain by Maxwell the Grand Mage 300 years ago. She was freed by Tanya when one of Tanya's spells broke the mountain under which Laplace was sealed away.

characters.name: Nadine Amaryllis
characters.original: ナディーネ・アマリリス
characters.description: Nadine is a level 3 Healer who worked for the Adventurers' Guild as a receptionist until Tanya invited her to join a party she created with Laplace.

characters.name: Katherine Foxxi
characters.original: キャサリン・フォキシー
characters.description: She joined the party Tanya used to be a part of before Ryan Daars kicked her out. She only joined the party to meet people in the hopes of finding a suitable man to marry.

characters.name: Ryan Daars
characters.description: Tanya's childhood friend and the leader of the party she used to be a member of. He told Tanya that he kicked her out of the party because she wasn't affectionate enough, and that female adventurers retire early in order to find a marriage partner.

characters.name: Arianora Aweigkorrt
characters.original: アリエノーラ・アウェイグコート
characters.description: The First Empress of the Nouhim Empire and the only direct descendant of the Emperor.

characters.name: Maxwell
characters.description: The legendary mage who sealed Laplace 300 years ago. He attained immortality and is still the Chief of the Royal Sorcerers for the Nouhim Empire 300 years later. ~!He is Laplace's biological father. He subjected his daughter to a variety of biological experiments in order to achieve his own immortality.!~

title: Strawberry Panic!
title_original: ストロベリー・パニック！
description: The setting is lush Astraea Hill, where three famous all-girls schools are built. It’s the first day of school, and the cherry blossoms are scattering to the ground. Nagisa meets Hanazono Shizuma, the top student in the school, and her breath is taken away by her beauty. But when Shizuma takes a liking to Nagisa, love and chaos soon follow... (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Shizuma Hanazono
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm (5’5’’) The current Etoile, she is a highly respected and much beloved person to most of the other students attending the three schools. She looks very mysterious and also seems to have a number of secrets to match this visage. This makes her a difficult person to figure out or to even talk to for someone just meeting her. She is very skilled on the piano and likes to play it constantly. Much of the time, she doesn't enjoy the dull work of the Etoile, so she often finds ways to skip on her duties, much to the annoyance of Miyuki Rokujō. However, Nagisa manages to persuade Shizuma to resume performing her duties.

characters.name: Nagisa Aoi
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5’1’’) Nagisa suddenly transfers to an all-girls school called St. Miator Girl's Academy because her parents went overseas for work, leaving Nagisa behind. Nagisa ended up transferring to Miator after her aunt, who is a past graduate of St. Miator, the oldest school of Astraea Hill, recommended she attend. She seems to have a peppy personality, which can usually cause her to get in trouble if it gets the best of her. At first, whenever Nagisa gazed into the eyes of Shizuma Hanazono, she was unable to move at all, as if she was completely paralyzed. Later on, she seems to have developed a strong attraction towards Shizuma; the Etoile may very well be Nagisa's first love. Other things about her include that Nagisa is easily frightened, making her tremble at even the slightest mention of something scary. This continues the theme that she tends to be more childi

characters.name: Tamao Suzumi
characters.description: Tamao is first introduced as Nagisa's roommate. She plays a major role in this anime, as she eventually falls in love with Nagisa. She is shown as overcheerful and takes a large interest in Nagisa. Tamao has a nice, helpful personality and sometimes enjoys gossiping about other people when it comes to matters of love and attraction. Highly literate, she is a member of the Literature Club and loves to write poems. She writes the script for Astraea's adaption of Carmen. She is well-regarded among her fellow Miator students; many of the first-years see her as a viable Etoile candidate.

characters.name: Kaori Sakuragi
characters.description: Kaori Sakuragi was a young girl who came to attend Miator starting off in her first year. Ever since she was young, Kaori has been physically weak due to an affliction which remains unnamed, but apparently affected her breathing and possibly her heart. She had a placid personality, and dealt with her condition with surprisingly good grace.

characters.name: Miyuki Rokujo
characters.description: Miyuki is the student council president of Miator, Miyuki tries her best at doing her job in keeping everything in line. Often, when Shizuma is neglecting her duties as the Etoile, she gets annoyed at her and scolds her about it, which makes them seem more like a mother-child pair than as classmates. The two have been rooming together since they arrived at Miator years earlier, but their "parent-child" roles were initially reversed. Nevertheless, the two seem to be friends and have considerable knowledge of and insight into each other. After the death of Kaori Sakuragi, Miyuki became Shizuma's assistant and has remained a confidante of some importance. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Chiyo Tsukidate
characters.description: Chiyo is a young girl who recently arrived at Astraea Hill, where she quickly became the "room temp" for Nagisa and Tamao, which incidentally is exactly what she wanted. Chiyo tends to be a very shy girl who is unable to articulate herself forcefully enough most of the time and is also rather a klutz. Additionally, she too seems to have a crush on Nagisa, which can also be construed as a form of admiration and idolism on her part. Also, she is a member of the Library Club and works as a librarian in Astraea's Library. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Hikari Konohana
characters.description: A rather shy and quiet girl most of the time, Hikari tends to not be very outspoken and it usually takes a lot for her to say what is really on her mind. Much like Nagisa Aoi, Hikari is also a transfer student, ariving at Spica in the second year. In that same year, she joined the St. Spica Choir (also known as the Saintly Chorus) with her best friend and roommate Yaya Nanto. Later, she starts to develop a crush on Amane Ohtori, and they begin showing intense feelings of attraction for one another. Hikari also seems to be very religious and can be seen praying within the church or at the Spica fountain with a statue depicting the St. Virgin Mary on the school grounds. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yaya Nanto
characters.description: Hikari's roommate. She is a somewhat forceful girl who also seems to look out for Hikari, who she is in fact in love with. Yaya is good friends with Hikari though they've only known each other for about a year once the story begins. Yaya got Hikari to join the St. Spica Choir the previous year, most likely in an attempt to give her more self-esteem which she seems to be lacking in, though Hikari did show interest in singing as well. Yaya is one of the most talented members of the choir, as noted by Tsubomi Okuwaka, though seems to need more dedication, as noted by Hikari. She also has a rebellious side, sometimes going against school rules or what is normally accepted. However, when it comes to matters of love, she seems to be very shy about her feelings, substituing words with actions, sometimes with adverse results. Also, she rather dislikes first year students - such as Tsubomi Okuwak

characters.name: Amane Ootori
characters.description: Amane appears to be a very loved and respected member of the school, much like Shizuma Hanazono, although she is more of a local celebrity of Spica. She is often seen riding a white horse named Star Bright, which makes her seem more like a prince (a title which Shizuma later marks her with) from a fairy tale. Furthermore, she looks very much like a guy and in effect, a lot of the students at St. Spica are her fans. She tends to have a silent demeanor, which also makes her seem intimidating, making her difficult to talk with or approach. She too has a crush on Hikari, showing her affection much in the way a man does for a woman. Amane, much like Yaya, looks out for Hikari and protects her when need be. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Tsubomi Okuwaka
characters.description: Tsubomi tends to act mature for her age, and is often capable of cowing senior students by pure force of personality. She also seems to have a crush on Hikari, although she calls it pure admiration. Also, she often lectures Hikari and Yaya when they do something wrong in regards to their school work and responsibilities. She is a member of the St. Spica Choir and it is believed that the reason she joined was because of Hikari, though Tsubomi denies this. There are some very faint indications that Tsubomi may be developing an interest in Yaya, later in the series. Tsubomi sometimes gets embarrassed when around Hikari due to either what Hikari says or of what others say. She tends to get angry or flustered easily, giving her an outspoken and very expressive personality. In effect, she can be loud in her opinions of others. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shion Tomori
characters.description: The student council president of Spica, she is a very shrewd girl and is constantly scheming something. However, despite her initial demeanor, she is moderate in personality and rather disinclined towards extreme measures and outright obstructionism. This is in contrast to her associates Kaname Kenjō and Momomi Kiyashiki. After the current Etoile graduates, she would like very much for an attendant of Spica to become the next Etoile and is constantly pushing for this to take place. Her best bet right now is to try to convince Amane Ohtori to consider the position. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kaname Kenjo
characters.description: Kaname is a very domineering, forceful, and devious girl who is also on the student council for Spica. She often likes to take matters into her own hands when Shion - or Kaname herself - doesn't get her way. Kaname apparently considers herself irresistible and has no interest in objections to the contrary. Much like Amane, her appearance and personality make her seem more masculine than feminine. She is later revealed to be jealous of Amane, who has effortlessly defeated her at everything since she first came to Spica. It is also suggested that she felt an attraction to Amane at one point, or at least that her self-comparison to Amane has become a central factor of her life. Her main friend and ally is Momomi Kiyashiki, who is very much like Kaname in personality. They share a sexual relationship and seem to be in love with each other. Together, they are the closest thing to antagonists

characters.name: Momomi Kiyashiki
characters.description: Somewhat of a snob, Momomi feels Spica as being superior to the other schools of Astraea. Being on the student council for Spica, Momomi helps by giving advice to Shion or agreeing with most of what Kaname says and suggests. When Kaname thinks up a plan, she helps her carry out it out, but tries not to get directly involved, watching from the sidelines instead. In Momomi's personal and sexual relationship with Kaname, she is ironically usually the most aggressive partner. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Chikaru Minamoto
characters.description: Chikaru has shown herself to be a natural leader as she is the president of several functions: the student council of Lulim, the Transformation Club (where members dress up in different costumes), the Secret Club (where members try to solve mysteries), and a variety of other clubs which she regularly creates, such as the Waiting First in Line Club. She has a friendly personality and enjoys helping others when they need it, which makes her an excellent candidate for the student council. Also, Chikaru tends to be very knowledgeable about the schools and their inner workings. When in Astraea student council meetings, she often lets the other two school representatives argue with each other while she sits back and observes their behavior. She is not easily perturbed and frequently helps out those who have trouble, regardless which school they attend. In the manga, Chikaru notes that she and

characters.name: Kizuna Hyuuga
characters.description: Kizuna seems very outgoing, hyper and, like Chiyo of Miator, a bit of a klutz. She spends a lot of time with Chikaru Minamoto and Remon Natsume, making her a part of the Transformation and Secret Clubs. She tends to be very expressive in her actions and words, not wasting any chance to introduce herself to someone new. Additionally, she may be in an intimate relationship with Remon, though this is still uncertain. What is certain is that they sometimes share a bed (which, admittedly, is no firm indicator of physical intimacy in this series), that they are often depicted holding hands or touching, and that they have kissed at least once in front of an unimpressed Chikaru. This latter act may have been no more than her way to cheat and win a thumb wrestling match, although the fact that this act distracted Remon sufficiently might be telling in and of itself. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Watashi no Hatsukoi Aite ga Kiss Shiteta
title_original: 私の初恋相手がキスしてた
description: Takasora Hoshi's life is upended when a girl from her class named Umi Mizuike and her mother temporarily move into her family's cramped apartment. From the outset of this arrangement, Takasora finds herself annoyed by Umi's behavior...and her good looks. And though the two girls initially agree to avoid interfering with each other's lives, Takasora can't help but start to wonder where Umi keeps wandering off to at night… From the author of Adachi and Shimamura comes the bittersweet tale of two high school girls whose lives are thrust together under the same roof. (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Hougetsu Shimamura
characters.description: Shimamura Hougetsu is a high school student. She met [Adachi](https://anilist.co/character/144717/Sakura-Adachi) while skipping class on the second floor of the gym in her school when Adachi accidentally walks in on her one day. (In both manga adaptations, it was Shimamura who walked in on Adachi in the gym when they first met instead of the reverse.) The two instantly took a liking for each other and began to hang out together all the time. Shimamura has tail-bone length, dyed brown hair, which she keeps out of her face with two clips on the right side. Her eyes are also brown. Despite playing basketball in middle school, Shimamura is on the shorter side. She has a slim figure. Shimamura tends to think of interpersonal relationships as bothersome since she feels that it requires too much effort to maintain a balanced relationship. ~!During a summer break in their second year of high sch

characters.name: Akira Hino
characters.description: __Date of Birth:__ Unknown Akira Hino is a high school student and [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura)'s friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, where she is visiting a bookstore with [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) and [Nagafuji](https://anilist.co/character/167928/Taeko-Nagafuji). Hino has shoulder length hair, tied into low twintails. She is rather short, being shorter than Shimamura and Nagafuji. She also has big eyes. Hino has a bubbly personality and is known to add in sound effects, whether they're needed or not. She also enjoys fishing, though she often complains about not having any school fishing friends. (Source: Adachi and Shimamura Wiki)

characters.name: Taeko Nagafuji
characters.description: __Date of Birth:__ Unknown Taeko Nagafuji is a high school student and [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura)'s friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, along with [Hino Akira](https://anilist.co/character/167926/Akira-Hino), in a bookstore with [Shimamura](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura). Nagafuji has straight, shoulder length hair and wears glasses. She has a very mature figure. Nagafuji is described as having a very laid back personality. Though she sometimes just seems to be out of it. (Source: Adachi and Shimamura Wiki)

characters.name: Yashiro Chikama
characters.description: Chikama Yashiro is a friend of [Hino Akira](https://anilist.co/character/167926/Akira-Hino), who met while they were fishing.
