Like Hino, Chikama makes her own sound effects, the most notably being the "breathing" sound for her space suit. In her introduction, she explains that she has come to Earth to find her brethren. Chikama wears a full body spacesuit. It has childish design elements, such as hearts and star patches.

title: Maria-sama ga Miteru
description: Maria-sama ga Miteru's story revolves around the students of the Lillian Catholic school for girls, and can be considered character-driven, focusing on interactions between the characters rather than any sort of ongoing plot or goal to attain. At Lillian Girls' School, there is a tradition known as the sœur system (sœur being French for "sister" ) , in which a second, or third-year student, the grande sœur ("big sister" ) , will give her rosary to a junior student, the petite sœur ("little sister" ) , and promise to look after them and guide them. When the story begins, Yumi Fukuzawa, a new first-year student admitted to Lillian, is praying in front of the Virgin Mary statue near the school entrance when she is suddenly approached by a cold second-year student named Sachiko Ogasawara who straightens Yumi's uniform ribbon. This seemingly simple act of kindness stays with Yumi the rest of the day, and she speaks of her meeting with Sachiko to her friends during class and lunch. After school is over, Yumi's classmate Tsutako Takeshima meets with Yumi to show her that she took a photograph of Yumi's meeting with Sachiko earlier that morning. Yumi asks if she can have the photo, but Tsu

characters.name: Yumi Fukuzawa
characters.description: She is the main character of the series. In the beginning of the series, Yumi is bashful beyond words, very timid and unsure of herself. She first met Sachiko, the star of Lillian School and had her tie fixed by Sachiko, which mortified Yumi. Yumi's friend, Tsutako Takeshima, took a cute picture of this and wanted to display it in the school festival. Tsutako got Yumi to ask permission from Sachiko. Other characters often comment on how her emotions 'show on her face'. ~!After Yumi first meets Sachiko, Sachiko is arguing with the Roses in the Rose Mansion. The Roses say that Sachiko cannot object to their plan, as she did not have a petite sœur. Sachiko runs out of the meeting and knocks Yumi over. She asks if Yumi has a grande sœur, and promptly offered Yumi her rosary. Sachiko thought that if she had a petite sœur, the Yamayurikai could not force her to play Cinderella alongside a male

characters.name: Rei Hasekura
characters.description: Rei, Yoshino's grande soeur, appears very tomboyish and "bishounen" on the outside but is in fact quite gentle despite her appearances. Her favourite books are shoujo, her favourite word is "sincerity" and her hobby is sightseeing. She is involved in kendo, but obsessively cares about Yoshino and prefers the domestic arts, like cooking. In the first season, Rei is Rosa Foetida en bouton, and her grande soeur was Torii Eriko. Her petite soeur is Shimazu Yoshino. In the second season, Rei becomes Rosa Foetida. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Youko Mizuno
characters.description: Youko entered Lillian during her first year of middle school. Despite coming from an outside schooling system she was asked to give the welcome speech for first year students. She is characterized as being calm but sharp with a mischievous side, in the manga she is described to be "lily" like. Her greatest day was seeing the Rose Mansion filled with ordinary students during the Bouton's card hunt. During Youko's second year of high school, Rosa Gigantea and Rosa Chinensis (Sei and Youko's onee-sama's respectively) tricked Youko into taking an interest in Ogasawara Sachiko. Sachiko, Youko noted, always walked looked like she was fighting internally with something. With an endless desire to help (or meddle, as Sei put it) people Youko took Sachiko as her petite soeur. She had Sachiko quit her after school lessons (or in the novel, hinted about it) and once scolded her for not expressing he

characters.name: Sachiko Ogasawara
characters.description: Prim and elegant, Sachiko has a rough side and a very sweet side. She is very protective over Yumi and cares deeply about her. However, Sachiko often has the same problem as Yumi does — she does not share most of her problems with her sœur, causing many misunderstandings. Sachiko is slated to marry her cousin and fiancé Suguru after she graduates. This has caused her some distress since, because although she initially cared deeply for him, he did not reciprocate. They now have a complicated relationship. Sometimes, Yumi must teach Sachiko how to live informally, for example, helping her select her first pair of jeans. Despite her sometimes stern appearance, Sachiko has her own share of insecurities regarding her relationship with Yumi, not to mention emotional insecurities rising from her home life; both her father and grandfather openly have mistresses, unabashedly dividing their time b

characters.name: Sei Satou
characters.description: The exact opposite of most of the characters in the show: loud, rough-around-the-edges, she loves doing what she can to push other peoples' buttons. She enjoys mercilessly teasing or being mischievous, conducting most of her antics around Fukuzawa Yumi. Despite being a non-conformist in the ranks of the regular girls in Lillian Jogakuen, Sei is one of the wisest and caring characters on the show. Though seeming to have a playful and laid-back attitude, she has experienced many tragedies in her life, especially in her second year. Sei is known for doing things at her own pace, and dislikes being pressured into making decisions and taking action. She took Toudou Shimako as her soeur while in her third year. Her relationship with the first year is seen to one of mutual understanding and selective support. Sei however has an especially close relationship with Yumi. Sei becomes a source of co

characters.name: Yoshino Shimazu
characters.description: In the beginning of the series, Yoshino is a girl who was very ill and cared for constantly by her grande soeur, Rei. Yoshino, however, is very independent and in some ways tomboyish, despite her sickly status and feminine appearance. ~!After her heart surgery, she becomes more energetic through out the series. !~ In addition to being Rei's petite soeur, Yoshino is also her cousin and next-door neighbor. Theirs is a somewhat rocky relationship, since Yoshino is eager to spread her wings, whereas Rei would like to protect her from the world's hardships. In the first season, Yoshino is Rosa Foetida en bouton petite soeur, her grande soeur being Hasekura Rei. ~!In the second season, Yoshino becomes Rosa Foetida en bouton. She has no petite soeur yet. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Eriko Torii
characters.description: Rei's grande soeur; one of the most well-respected of the Yamayurikai. She is very gifted and good at almost everything, although she is also enigmatic and eccentric. She has a large forehead, which Sei made fun of when they were young, which began their rivalry. She said once that she chose Rei as her sœur to see if anything interesting would happen. She often has friction with Yoshino, as the younger girl is jealous of her bond with Rei. Eriko has four older brothers. After leaving Lillian, she studies Arts. She hates the dentist above all else. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shimako Toudou
characters.description: Prim, proper and very beautiful, Shimako is the most admired of the first-years. She is the petite soeur of Satō Sei at the beginning of the story and later her successor. Underneath Shimako's quiet, mannerly exterior lies a surprisingly strong resolve. However, Shimako is perhaps the most gentle of the three girls of her year in the Yamayurikai. In the first season, Shimako is Rosa Gigantea en bouton, her grande soeur being Satou Sei. In the second season, Shimako becomes Rosa Gigantea, her petite soeur being Nijou Noriko. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shizuka Kanina
characters.description: Also known as Rosa Canina (for the Dog Rose), she is the star singer of the school choir. Yumi meets her without knowing that she was the candidate running against the Yamayurikai. She admired Sei greatly and it was revealed that she was in love with her schoolmate, yet she never tells Sei her feelings because she knows they will be met with rejection. Later on it is shown that she has also found an interest in Sei's petite soeur, Shimako. Possibly because she wanted to know what sort of girl the elusive and lonely Sei decided to choose as a soeur. Sei confronts her and asks Shizuka if she would have preferred to have been her soeur, and Shizuka sadly admits that she would not have, and wanted something else from Sei. She left Lillian at the end of her second year to pursue a singing career in Italy. Shizuka meets Yumi again in Italy during the Lillian school trip, and she takes her

title: Onna Doushi to ka Arienai deshou to Iiharu Onnanoko wo, Hyakunichi-kan de Tetteiteki ni Otosu Yuri no Ohanashi
title_original: 女同士とかありえないでしょと言い張る女の子を、百日間で徹底的に落とす百合のお話
description: “Girls dating each other? That can’t be!….That's how it should be! A popular high-school girl, Sakakibara Marika, one day she get one million offer from her beautiful classmate, Fuwa Aya. “Sakakibara-san, For 100 days I will give you 10,000 yen/day. I will buy you. Let me show you that it’s possible for two girls dating each other” “Ha..Haaa?!” From that day, it started, their after school xx time. (Source: SB Creative, translated)

title: Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyou Survival
title_original: 乙女ゲームのヒロインで最強サバイバル
title_en: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival
description: Orphaned by a monster attack on her village, young Alicia spends three horrid years in an orphanage before finally running away. When she flees, however, Alicia has a violent encounter with an older woman hell-bent on killing her. During their tussle, she comes into contact with a strange crystal that bestows upon her a wealth of knowledge, transforming her from an innocent child into a cool and calculated planner. Now aware that she was meant to be the protagonist of an otome game and disgusted with her supposed fate, Alicia decides to take matters into her own hands and become strong—by any means necessary. Using her newfound knowledge, and with some help from a stranger she meets in the woods, she learns to survive by herself in a world far too harsh and unforgiving for a girl her age. Ready or not, she’s determined to carve her own path. (Source: J-Novel Club)

characters.name: Alicia Melrose
characters.original: アーリシア=メルローズ
characters.description: The main protagonist, her real name is "Alicia Melrose". She is the heroine of the Otome game "Love on Silver Wings". She has a pinkish blonde hair with peachy tints. She lost her parents when the town where she lived was attacked by an outbreak of demons when she was four years old, and was sent to an old church orphanage in a small town. There, she spent her days in hell, being abused and mistreated by the caretaker, an old woman, and the elders. When she was 7 years old, she ran away from the orphanage thinking she was going to be sold, and was attacked by a mysterious woman who was planning to use a magic stone to replace herself from body and mind. She strikes back and kills the woman. When she realizes that this world is the world of Otome games "Ciel" and that her parents' death and her current situation are just scenarios, she becomes angry at everything as "nonsense" and decides

characters.name: Ayaka Aizawa
characters.description: **Height:** 152 cm

characters.name: Michiru Inaba
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm

title: Kämpfer
description: Kämpfer - One who exists to fight. Anyone chosen as a Kämpfer will be forced to fight until death. Our hero, Natsuru-san, awoke to find himself chosen as a Kämpfer. Only one thing for him changed. He is now a She!!! (Source: MangaTrader)

characters.name: Natsuru Senou
characters.description: __Height:__ 177 cm The series' main protagonist. Second year student of Seitetsu Gakuin High-school. He is chosen as a Blue Kämpfer by Moderator and setup as a Zauber type with power based on fire. In keeping with the rule that all Kämpfers are females, he turns into girl upon transformation. After a fight with Shizuku exposed his Kämpfer form to other students of the school, Shizuku arranged to have him enrolled in girl's class to fulfil public curiosity in a way that diverts attentions away from Kämpfer battle. His Kämpfer form has subsequently been ranked among the Three Beauties of Seitetsu (there used to be only two) and, much to Natsuru's own dismay, become subject of intense affections from Kaede Sakura (whom he has a crush on). Source: Wikipedia

characters.name: Akane Mishima
characters.description: School librarian and Natsuru's friend, she is also a Blue Kämpfer like Natsuru. Normally very shy (which might very well be attributed to her tendency of misunderstanding what others are trying to do in a borderline-erotic way) and soft-spoken, she has bipolar disorder upon transforming into a Kämpfer, becoming foul-mouthed, bitter, vindictive, and trigger-happy. She explained most of the rules of being a Kämpfer when Natsuru's own Messenger gave no such details. She is a Gewehr type Kämpfer who uses an 1911 .45 pistol and appears to be ambidextrous. In addition to having Natsuru as the first male to establish in-depth friendship with her, Akane eventually begins to harbor feelings for him, becoming jealous and easily irritable when he talks about another girl (most if not all of the time being Kaede) in front of her or when another girl takes an interest in

characters.name: Shizuku Sangou
characters.description: President of the Student Council and one of the Three Beauties of Seitetsu, she is a model student with perfect attendance record. In addition, however, she is also a Red Kämpfer fighting with the Schwert ability of wielding two chained daggers at will. She wants to expose Moderator's intentions but has no problem fighting Blue Kämpfers until that goal was accomplished. After being spared following a defeat by [Natsuru](https://anilist.co/character/24977), she enters a truce with Natsuru and [Akane](https://anilist.co/character/24978) and has since taken an interest in Natsuru in a slightly sly and teasing manner, throwing him off balance with embarrassing remarks/actions while maintaining a poker face in the process, despite being constantly treated with suspicion as a result. After being invited by [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/24581) to visit her home and then spend the night t

characters.name: Mikoto Kondou
characters.description: Natsuru's childhood friend who only recently reunited with him due to her father being an archaeologist who lives abroad, a way of live that already made her think little of doing things others would consider far too dangerous. Although having too much pride to explicitly admit, she has feelings for Natsuru and is more than a bit bothered by the presence of a girl with the same name as his (who in reality is Natsuru in his Kämpfer form). Even after the misunderstanding is later cleared up, the advances made by Akane and Shizuku on Natsuru (Mikoto apparently does not believe Kaede would reciprocate his feelings) subsequently makes her even more nervous about her chance with him as well. When she was seeing Miss Seitetsu contest of the school festival, she caught a bouquet that Kaede tossed with a Messenger hidden in it, consequently being turned into a Schwert-type Red Kämp

characters.name: Kaede Sakura
characters.description: Shizuku's childhood friend and one of the Three Beauties of Seitetsu, she has many admirers, Natsuru being one of them. She has a large collection of stuffed Zoumotsu Animal dolls and likes to present them to her friends; those who receive the dolls, however, tend to end up becoming Kämpfers. She began to develop a crush on Kämpfer Natsuru after being saved from Kämpfer Akane at the beginning of the series, later coming under the mistaken impression that the normal Natsuru is her rival for Kämpfer Natsuru's affection and consequently becoming somewhat hostile to him, a situation not helped after a misunderstanding in a very compromising situation leads her to think Natsuru is cheating on the female Natsuru. ~!Later she is revealed to possibly have something to do with the appearances of the White Kämpfers and may be manipulating Natsuru. It is eventually confirmed on separate occasions w

characters.name: Hiaburi Lion
characters.description: The oldest Messenger, its existence said to pre-date the Zoumotsu Animal toyline. The novel version of it does not have its guts hanging out of its body like the Zoumotsu Animals after it, but the anime version does. It has the same shape as a character which Kaede imagined before, with a voice similar to that of a voice actor who performs voice-overs for foreign movie stars. Kaede got it by mere chance though it is very scarce. In episode 11 of the anime, it reveals the reason behind the Kämpfer battles. From Wikipedia.

characters.name: Harakiri Tora
characters.description: Natsuru's Messenger.

characters.name: Chissoku Norainu
characters.description: Mikoto's Messenger.

characters.name: Masumi Nishino
characters.description: Class: 1-3 Grade: Average Club: Newspaper Hobby: Listen to Music while sleeping Akane's friend

title: Aku no Musume
description: A vast kingdom called Lucifenia, whose popular name was the "Kingdom of Yellow," was ruled by a tyrannical fourteen year-old princess named Riliane. Under her absolute monarchism, everything was exploited from people and the ones who did not obey her were executed without mercy. Allen, a servant who looked a lot like her, was always beside the princess whom Lucifenia's people called the "Daughter of Evil." The princess and the servant were the same age, since the two of them were actually twins who were separated shortly after their birth, with Riliane taking her mother's position as the country's ruler and Allen works in the palace as a servant since he was given up for adoption. The princess's selfishness and jealousy caused a war and many deaths, and their secret clockwork of fate was going to spin madly. (Source: Vocaloid Wikia)

characters.name: Riliane Lucifen d'Autriche
characters.original: リリアンヌ・ルシフェン・ドートゥリシュ
characters.description: Riliane Lucifen d'Autriche was the last Princess of the Kingdom of Lucifenia, regarded as The Daughter of Evil, and the twin sister of Prince Alexiel. Separated from her twin in a political dispute during childhood, Riliane grew up in a lavish lifestyle, ignorant of her past. The selfish Princess was unknowingly possessed by the Demon of Pride and, after her mother's death, became Lucifenia's monarch. An arrogant tyrant, Riliane became despised for her terrible regime, aided by her loyal servant, Allen, in exterminating any opposition.

characters.name: Allen Avadonia
characters.original: アレン・アヴァドニア
characters.description: Allen Avadonia, born Alexiel Lucifen d'Autriche and regarded as The Servant of Evil, was the last Prince of the Kingdom of Lucifenia and a servant to his twin sister, Princess Riliane. After the death of their father, the twins were separated in a political dispute. Pronounced dead and adopted by Leonhart Avadonia, "Allen" returned to the royal palace to serve as his sister's chamberlain, helping exterminate any opposition to Riliane's tyranny.

characters.name: Germaine Avadonia
characters.original: ジェルメイヌ・アヴァドニア
characters.description: Adoptive daughter of Leonhart Avadonia from the Three Heroes and foster sister of Allen. Following the assassination of her adoptive father, Germaine founded the Lucifenian Resistance to overthrow Princess Riliane's terrible regime.

characters.name: Kyle Marlon
characters.description: The young King of Marlon and the son of Empress Dowager Prim. After falling in love with Michaela and breaking up his engagement with Princess Riliane, Kyle unwittingly sparked the Lucifenia-Elphegort War. Having lost his beloved to Riliane, Kyle secretly supports the Lucifenian Resistance seeking to overthrow the tyrannical Princess.

characters.name: Elluka  Clockworker
characters.original: エルルカ・クロックワーカー
characters.description: Elluka Clockworker, regarded as the Sorceress of Time and the Eternal Sorceress, was a powerful mage. Awakening from Sin in the wake of the Levianta Catastrophe, the immortal accepted a quest from Held to collect the vessels of sin on a whim. She later became involved in numerous incidents and conflicts caused by the sin vessels over the centuries. ~!She was one of Levia and Behemo's reincarnations.!~

characters.name: Chartette Langley
characters.original: シャルテット・ラングレー
characters.description: Chartette Langley was a maid in service to Princess Riliane and a hero of the Lucifenian Revolution. After becoming disillusioned with the status quo, Chartette aided the resistance in acquiring crucial information from the royal palace. She later participated in the revolution, winning fame in her battle with Mariam Phutapie. Afterward, Chartette eventually joined the former resistance members as a Beelzenian soldier in opposition to King Kyle.

characters.name: Gerda
characters.description: Gerda was the head maid of the Freezis Family. Serving Keel and Mikina Freezis for years, the woman became one of the oldest and most trusted employees among the household staff.

characters.name: George Ausdin
characters.original: ジョルジュ＝オースディン
characters.description: George Ausdin was the general of the Kingdom of Lucifenia's first army.

characters.name: Arkatoir Marlon
characters.original: アルカトイル＝マーロン
characters.description: Arkatoir Marlon was a member of parliament of the Kingdom of Marlon and the half-brother of Kyle. Despite being a few years younger than him, Arkatoir strongly resembled Kyle, looking almost exactly like him save for the red hair he received from his mother.

title: Seiyuu Radio no Uraomote
title_original: 声優ラジオのウラオモテ
description: Yuuhi Yuugure and Yasumi Utatane, two high school voice actresses who just happened to attend the same school and coincidentally got placed into the same class, are the two hosts of a radio weekly program. As fellow classmates and voice actresses, they show all the listeners their great friendship! At least, on the surface. In reality, the quiet girl Chika and the gyaru Yumiko are complete opposites. And they absolutely cannot stand each other. Off air, chaos and insults erupt. On air, they're the best of friends. Just where will this tumultuous relationship lead them?

characters.name: Chika Watanabe
characters.description: She never talks to anyone in class, but when she does open her mouth, she’s incredibly sharp-tongued. An aggressive loner with piercing eyes peering out from behind her long bangs.

title: Isekai ni Saku wa Yuri no Hana
title_original: 異世界に咲くは百合の花
title_en: A Lily Blooms in Another World
description: Miyako Florence isn’t sad when her fiancée breaks off their engagement after two years. It’s all according to plan! Whisked to the world of her favorite otome game, Miyako frees herself from a dull noble to pursue her true soulmate: the game’s villainess Fuuka Hamilton. Proud Fuuka only has eyes for their mutual ex-fiancée! Miyako confesses her love to Fuuka and proposes that they run away together. Fuuka agrees on one condition: Miyako must make her say “I’m happy” in 14 days. With conniving nobles, strange diseases, and magical rituals pulling them apart, can Miyako win the villainess’s heart? (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Yoku Wakaranai keredo Isekai ni Tensei Shiteita You desu
title_original: よくわからないけれど異世界に転生していたようです
description: I am cute, but I was a middle-aged researcher in my previous life?! Surviving in another world with magic and sciences!! The orphan Ren was riding the carriage after being sold, when she got involved into an accident, and got her previous life's memories back! "I was... a middle-aged man!" Indeed, she was a researcher in his thirties in her previous life, and had been living as an orphan girl up to now! Ren will make use of her talents in magic and knowledge in science to survive in this harsh world in order to escape from the investor who bought her!

title: Watashi no Yuri mo, Eigyou da to Omotta?
title_original: わたしの百合も、営業だと思った？
title_en: Did You Think My Yuri Was Just for Show?
description: Suzune Senmiya, a young voice actress, has been struggling for six months to get over the retirement of her favorite idol, Karin Kanezuki. One day, Karin shows up as a new voice actress in Suzune's agency! While Suzune tries to play it cool and keep her distance, Karin aggressively closes the gap between them. And as Suzune starts to see unexpected sides of Karin, she begins to perceive her not just as an idol but as a woman. (Source: Yen Press)

title: Hitozuma Kyoushi ga Oshiego no Joshikousei ni Dohamari Suru Hanashi
title_original: 人妻教師が教え子の女子高生にドはまりする話
description: Itsuki Ichigohara is a married high-school teacher in her late 20's, who finds herself involved with a high school girl, her student, who is 10 years younger. The student's name is Rin Togawa. She is taller than Itsuki, with a beautiful face, mild-mannered but a little childish sometimes. Rin is a good girl, but she has problems in her family life, and as Itsuki tries to counsel her, they somehow end up kissing in bed together. This is an adulterous betrayal, not to mention a crime. How could she have got herself into such trouble that could only lead to her own destruction? — How could I have let this happen? It is a lewd and immoral, but somehow heartwarming relationship. A love story between a female teacher and her female student. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

characters.name: Itsuki Ichigohara
characters.description: Homeroom teacher for Rin's class. She is beautiful and popular with her students. She has a good relationship with her husband, but their sex life is a bit lacking, so they do not have any children.

characters.name: Rin Togawa
characters.description: A first-year high school student who was caught hanging out late at night by her teacher Itsuki.

title: VTuber nanda ga Haishin Kiri Wasuretara Densetsu ni Natteta
title_original: VTuberなんだが配信切り忘れたら伝説になってた
title_en: VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral After Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream
description: Twenty-year-old former wage slave Yuki Tanaka now works among her idols: the streamers of Live-On, one of Japan’s top VTuber companies. As the gorgeous, polite Awayuki Kokorone, she delivers only the most ladylike content. Unfortunately, her subscriber count and savings are at rock bottom. One evening, after Yuki thinks she’s ended her stream, she cracks a few cold ones—and more than a few crude jokes—while watching Live-On’s video archives. But her viewers hear it all, and clips of her bawdy, drunken commentary go viral overnight. Yuki thinks her career is over...until her manager reveals that everyone at Live-On has been waiting for her to snap all along and gives her free rein to drink on-stream. Now free of all feigned purity, she jumps right into her new “rowdy drunk” character and is welcomed into the fold by her fellow Live-On VTubers, who turn out to be just as crazy as she is! With her views and finances skyrocketing, Yuki’s work—for the first time in her life—is actually fun! (Source: J-Novel Club) Note: Chapter count includes 8 volume prologues and 10 epilogues.

characters.name: Awayuki Kokorone
characters.description: __Fanbase name:__ Marshmallows (マシュマロ ) __Affiliation:__ LiveOn (ライブオン) __Illustrator:__ [Noko Shiokazu](https://anilist.co/staff/197988) __Generation:__ 3rd Gen (LiveOn) [Twitter](https://twitter.com/kokoroneawayuki)

characters.name: Sei Utsuki
characters.description: A member of Live-On's second generation who lives up to her Succubus persona with her love of eroge and dirty jokes.

characters.name: Chami Yanagase
characters.description: A member of Live-On's third generation with a cheerful older sister persona despite her extreme social anxiety. Her core fanbase comes from her ASMR content.

characters.name: Hikari Matsuriya
characters.description: A member of Live-On's 3rd generation who is brimming with energy. She is always cheerful and innocent to the point that a lot of [Shuwa-chan's](https://anilist.co/character/317062/Awayuki-Kokorone) jokes go over her head.

characters.name: Mashiro Irodori
characters.description: Another member of Live-On's 3rd generation and [Awayuki's](https://anilist.co/character/317062/Awayuki-Kokorone) character illustrator. She is passionate about her artwork and came up with the nickname "Shuwa-chan."

characters.name: Nekoma Hirune
characters.description: A member of Live-On's second generation who is a cat girl with heterochromia. She is an avid player of terrible games.

characters.name: Shion Kannari
characters.description: A member of Live-On's second generation who acts as the team mom of the Live-On members. Her character concept is of a Nine-tailed fox shrine maiden with an older sister personality.

characters.name: Hareru Asagiri
characters.description: Live-On's founding member and an active staff member in the company. She is seen as the shining light who laid the foundations of the company, and all of the other members look up to her.

title: Adachi to Shimamura 99.9
description: As Adachi and Shimamura share life as adults, they’ve never been happier. Their relationship’s so close now, it may last into their golden years… maybe even for the next 3,700 years, in fact! Just how long can the pair stay the course together? Follow the galactic trajectory of their romance in this short story compilation. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Sakura Adachi
characters.description: Adachi Sakura is a high school student. She is found skipping class on the second floor of the gym by [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) one day. The two of them gradually became friends and began to spend a lot of time together. Adachi had an extremely introverted personality. Before meeting Shimamura, she never had someone whom she can call a friend. Adachi was said to be cold toward other people and didn't attempt to make friends with other people in the past. She also gets very jealous when Shimamura is together with her friends, and as a consequence usually ends up running away.

characters.name: Hougetsu Shimamura
characters.description: Shimamura Hougetsu is a high school student. She met [Adachi](https://anilist.co/character/144717/Sakura-Adachi) while skipping class on the second floor of the gym in her school when Adachi accidentally walks in on her one day. (In both manga adaptations, it was Shimamura who walked in on Adachi in the gym when they first met instead of the reverse.) The two instantly took a liking for each other and began to hang out together all the time. Shimamura has tail-bone length, dyed brown hair, which she keeps out of her face with two clips on the right side. Her eyes are also brown. Despite playing basketball in middle school, Shimamura is on the shorter side. She has a slim figure. Shimamura tends to think of interpersonal relationships as bothersome since she feels that it requires too much effort to maintain a balanced relationship. ~!During a summer break in their second year of high sch

characters.name: Yashiro Chikama
characters.description: Chikama Yashiro is a friend of [Hino Akira](https://anilist.co/character/167926/Akira-Hino), who met while they were fishing. Like Hino, Chikama makes her own sound effects, the most notably being the "breathing" sound for her space suit. In her introduction, she explains that she has come to Earth to find her brethren. Chikama wears a full body spacesuit. It has childish design elements, such as hearts and star patches.

characters.name: Akira Hino
characters.description: __Date of Birth:__ Unknown Akira Hino is a high school student and [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura)'s friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, where she is visiting a bookstore with [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) and [Nagafuji](https://anilist.co/character/167928/Taeko-Nagafuji). Hino has shoulder length hair, tied into low twintails. She is rather short, being shorter than Shimamura and Nagafuji. She also has big eyes. Hino has a bubbly personality and is known to add in sound effects, whether they're needed or not. She also enjoys fishing, though she often complains about not having any school fishing friends. (Source: Adachi and Shimamura Wiki)

title: Shoujo Kakumei Utena: Ao no Soujyu
title_original: 少女革命ウテナ -蒼の双樹-
description: Two light novels written by Ichiro Okouchi with illustrations by Chiho Saito, "Shoujo Kakumei Utena: Ao no Soujyu" and "Shoujo Kakumei Utena: Midori no Omoi" expand on material from the television series, with Ao no Soujyu focusing on the first five episodes of the series and Midori no Omoi focusing on Wakaba's Black Rose character arc.

characters.name: Utena Tenjou
characters.description: Utena is a tomboyish, courageous and naïve character who lives to emulate the idealized prince figure from her childhood. She is forthright, honest, and friendly, and nearly all the girls in school adore her.

characters.name: Anthy Himemiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm A mysterious and shy dark-skinned girl whose sometimes vapid expression and superficial politeness seem to mask something deeper. Many people project their wants or desires onto her, and she's often the target of their eventual rage or hate. Her "doormat" behavior belies a far more complex personality. Anthy appears to house the Sword of Dios within her own body. At the beginning of a duel, she slips into a trance and the Sword manifests, protruding from her chest so that her champion may draw it from her. This Sword is said to be a key to reaching the goal of Revolution, and in her position as the Rose Bride Anthy is said to be the key to obtaining it.

characters.name: Chuchu
characters.description: Anthy's pet (whom she will only refer to as friend, but may be more properly described as a familiar). He is a small marmoset who acts as comedic relief. However, he also acts as an omen of bad fortune in certain episodes. ChuChu is drawn much furrier by Chiho Saito in the manga than he is drawn in the anime, the anime itself making him look more like a mouse than a monkey.

characters.name: Miki Kaoru
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Blue Rose Bride: Kozue Kaoru Sword: Épée Drive to Duel: To find "that which shines" Miki is a highly skilled and polite seventh grader who befriends Utena, despite their role as possible opponents in the duels. A piano player par excellence, Miki has fond memories of playing songs with his twin sister Kozue in his childhood, but her refusal to play with him in the present — the symbol of a much deeper rift — gives Miki a sense of loss. His crush on Anthy in the anime (but on Utena in the manga) develops when he realizes that they remind him of his estranged sister. In both adaptions, his drive to duel stems from a desire to find something to replace Kozue in his affections. All the females of the school, even older ones, idolize him, but Kozue threatens any girls who attempt to get too close to him. Likewise he is very protective of her, and so she tries to make him jealo

characters.name: Juri Arisugawa
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Orange __Rose Bride:__ Ruka Tsuchiya __Sword:__ Rapier __(Anime) Drive to Duel:__ To disprove the power of miracles The captain of the academy's fencing team, Juri is one of Ohtori's most highly respected students, and even the teachers appear to be in awe of her.

characters.name: Touga Kiryuu
characters.description: President of the Student Council, Touga is an arrogant and handsome young man whose desire to be powerful drives him to cruel and unscrupulous deeds. Although he says that he wishes to be noble, he has little empathy towards anyone, and his powers of manipulation are second only to Akio. He also shares his playboy attiude and has many female conquests. He is a childhood friend of Saionji, although their relationship took a turn for the worse at a point in their childhood that is the centerpiece of their respective personal journeys. ~!Toward the end of the series, however, Touga's facade of chivalry is replaced with an apparently truer concern for Utena, to the extent that he very subtly attempts to substitute his head for hers on Akio's chopping block. Arguably, this is also an example of Touga's inability to see Utena as who she really is, rather than in a stereotypical feminine role.

characters.name: Kyouichi Saionji
characters.description: __Sword:__ Sword of Dios, Katana __Drive to Duel:__ To find something eternal, to claim Anthy as his Rose Bride, and to finally defeat Touga (Anime) Vice-president of the Student Council and captain of the kendo team, and is the first duelist Utena fights. He is temperamental, egotistic, prone to angry rages, often cruel, and extremely possessive of Anthy. His belief that they are destined to be together no matter what drive him to be physically violent towards her and continue to pursue her even after their engagement is broken. He and Touga practice kendo together, but Saionji is clearly very resentful of Touga, and especially cannot bear to be humiliated by him (a fact which Touga shamelessly exploits). Saionji is less perceptive, intelligent, and skilled as Touga, and despite his best efforts can never seem to best him. He is regardless affected by this estrangement from his childhoo

characters.name: Kozue Kaoru
characters.description: She's Miki's twin sister who feels overshadowed by his talent and dirtied by comparison with him. Kozue resents Miki's affection for Anthy Himemiya and is prone to acting out to grab her brother's attention, most notably by exercising loose sexual morals. Like Nanami, Kozue also seems to have an extreme brother complex. She is very protective of Miki and is the reason that he does not have a girlfriend (despite the affection of many of his schoolmates). Kozue considers herself a "wild animal," wanting to be freed from adult rules and restrictions (in reality, she is resentful of her father remarrying). ~!In Adolescence of Utena she is shown as being very possessive of Miki, even holding a razor to his throat and calling him a traitor when he refuses to divulge details of his personal affairs to her. A car with Kozue's name is also seen briefly, though the director merely states

characters.name: Wakaba Shinohara
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm ~! Sword: Saionji's Katana Drive to Duel: To become special and destroy those who already are special.!~ Utena's best friend. Wakaba's cheerful personality hides an enormous inferiority complex, and she attaches herself to Utena and other people to feel important. In the first episode ("The Rose Bride") she refers to Utena as her "boyfriend." Utena first dueled Saionji after he posted a love letter that Wakaba gave to him in order to humiliate her. ~!During the Black Rose Saga, it is revealed that she was harboring Saionji after his expulsion from school. When he returns due to his obsession with Anthy, she feels betrayed and seeks Mikage. Taking revenge, she pulls Saionji's katana out of his body to duel Utena. In the movie, Wakaba appears only briefly. In her first scene, she gives Utena a tour of Ohtori Academy. Towards the end of the m

characters.name: Dios
characters.description: The enigmatic prince from Utena's childhood. Dios's name, which means "God" in Spanish, as well as his presentation in the anime, suggest that he is to be considered Utena's guardian angel. During most of the duels, it is shown that his spirit enters Utena's body and aids her. This is an indication that Dios may have been a skilled swordsman before his imprisonment. Despite his limited screen time, Dios is a central figure in the anime and is at the center of the plot.

title: Love Live! School idol diary: Kousaka Honoka
title_original: ラブライブ！ School idol diary ～高坂穂乃果～

characters.name: Honoka Kousaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm Honoka is the main character, who is a second-year student at Otonokizaka Academy. Her family works in a japanese sweet shop named Homura. When Otonokizaka Academy is planned to be shut down due to lack of applicants, Honoka becomes determined to save it by starting up a school idol group. Honoka also has a knack for finding loose change on the ground. Since she was young, she has been friends with [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/46013/Minami-Kotori), and she befriended [Umi](https://anilist.co/character/46167/Sonoda-Umi) after inviting her to play hide and seek. ~!In Season 2, she becomes the new Student Council President by everyone's recommendation.!~

characters.name: Rin Hoshizora
characters.description: __Height:__ 155cm Rin appears to be a bit of a tomboy, though with a girly streak. She likes sports and is arguably the most athletic member of μ's, on par with Eli. Like Honoka, Rin is very energetic, hard-working and active. One key difference between her and Honoka, however, is that Rin is known for being very mindful of other people's opinions, as she puts their feelings first before taking action into something.

characters.name: Kotori Minami
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm Kotori is known for having her head in the clouds. Despite this, she is μ's designer along with [Nico Yazawa](https://anilist.co/character/46163/Yazawa-Nico). Kotori has a very huge aptitude for fashion and is very good at drawing costumes for the group. Kotori is shown to be very kind and supportive to her friends and genuinely cares about them, especially their feelings. However, this can go too far as Kotori usually backs [Honoka](https://anilist.co/character/46171/Kousaka-Honoka) up when she is scolded by [Umi](https://anilist.co/character/46167/Sonoda-Umi). Kotori is also shown as the most indecisive person among all nine members and tends to have her friends make decisions for her. She also has a hard time expressing her feelings, since she always takes other people's feelings into consideration.

characters.name: Hanayo Koizumi
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm A shy girl who dreamed of being an idol since she was very young; Rin and Maki finally convince her to join µ's.

characters.name: Nico Yazawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm Nico has been observing [Honoka's](https://anilist.co/character/46171/Kousaka-Honoka) new Idol group for a while but eventually joins them. She has past experiences as an amateur school idol. At first, she was secretly the President of the school's unknown Idol Research Club, but after an incident, the club was later joined together with Honoka's Idol Club. She likes bossing people around and acting superior, but she also has an energetic and cheeky personality.

characters.name: Maki Nishikino
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm Maki Nishikino is a first-year​ high school student in Otonokizaka High School. She has a beautiful voice and loves jazz music more than anyone else in the group. At first, she didn't want to join µ's because she had decided to inherit their family's hospital and take up medicine in college, but after joining forces with Rin to push Hanayo to join, she decides to follow the same path and join along with her two fellow first years.

characters.name: Umi Sonoda
characters.description: __Height: __159cm Umi is normally a shy girl, but she has a strong will and some qualities of a leader. Despite this, she is content to stay reserved and always thinks logically. Umi is uncomfortable with wearing short skirts but gets used to it after their first live. Although Umi tends to be hard on others, she is especially hard on herself. She doesn't do anything criminal and despises laziness.

characters.name: Nozomi Toujou
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm Nozomi is the vice-president of Otonokizaka High School. She is the best friend of [Eli](https://anilist.co/character/46173/Ayase-Eli). She is also a Shrine Maiden in a temple because she believes that a shrine is the source of people's faith. Eventually she will join the school idol club with Eli and will be one of the most successful school idols. (Source: Character Book)

characters.name: Eli Ayase
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Eli Ayase is the student council president of the Otonokizaka High School. Along with her best friend, [Nozomi](https://anilist.co/character/46169/Toujou-Nozomi), they do plans so the closure of the school could be prevented. She is partly Russian because her grandmother is a Russian. Alongside Nozomi, they join the school idol group for the prevention of their schools closure.

title: Satou Kashi no Dangan wa Uchinukenai
title_original: 砂糖菓子の弾丸は撃ちぬけない
description: Nagisa Yamada is a junior high school student who lives in the remote countryside town of Tottori. Her father has passed away years ago, and her mother does part-time jobs to support the family. She is a realist, and wants to graduate as soon as possible to live her own life. Mokuzu Umino is a melancholic and very mysterious transfer student. She claims to be a mermaid, come to land on a mission to find a true friend before the storm comes. At Tottori, the two girls meet, develop a unique friendship, and do what they can to keep living.

characters.name: Nagisa Yamada
characters.description: Aloof, apathetic middle-schooler who intends to join the JSDF after graduation.

characters.name: Mokuzu Umino
characters.description: A transfer student who claims to be a mermaid.

characters.name: Masachika Umino
characters.description: He's the father of Umino Mokuzu. He's a singer. ~!He's rumored to have abused his daughter Muzuko since she was a child.!~

characters.name: Tomohiko Yamada
characters.description: Nagisa's older brother. He's a hikikomori who likes collecting strange things although he used to be a straight A student.

title: Yuri Elf to Norowareta Hime
title_original: 百合エルフと呪われた姫
description: As long as we’re together, we’ll be happy. So begins a yuri adventure! Rem, an elven girl who had fled her home, arrived at a human town, where she met a cursed princess, Alferez. Sympathising with the other’s circumstances, the two women embark on a journey to break the curse! In their dangerous and obscene adventure, they learn more about the true nature of the curse, and about their own secrets…

title: Yuusha ni Naritai Boku to, Yuusha ni Narubeki Kimi
title_original: 勇者になりたい少女と、勇者になるべき彼女
title_en: The Girl Who Wants to Be a Hero and the Girl Who Ought to Be a Hero
description: After the Great Human-Demon War comes to a close, humans use a magical device known as the Gear to found the Hero Institute, a school for raising a new kind of hero. Ruchika, a wild and reckless demon girl, travels to the city in the hopes of joining the institute. There she meets Leonie, the serious- minded daughter of the Almighty Hero who defeated the Demon Lord. Taking a liking to her immediately, Ruchika proposes-right in the middle of their entrance exam! Do these two girls have what it takes to become heroes? And can love bloom between a human and a demon? (Source: Yen Press)

title: Yuri ni Hasamareteru Onna tte, Tsumi desu ka?
title_original: 百合に挟まれてる女って、罪ですか？

title: Zettai ni Derete wa Ikenai Tsundere
title_original: 絶対にデレてはいけないツンデレ
description: “Don’t get the wrong idea, okay. I definitely don’t like people such as you!” This template tsundere phrase marked the beginning of mine and Aotsuki Mifuyuu’s story. Because of her cold and indifferent attitude, she always stands out negatively in class. However one day, we ended up talking more and more with each other, and I started to see the warmth behind her cold words. Why is she so distanced and unaffectionate towards people despite being so kind? That seems to be related to her past that I don’t know about… This is a story about love, telling the coming along of a boy and girl until they finally act affectionately towards each other.

title: Furimukinasai, Watashi ni!
title_original: 振り向きなさい、わたくしに！
title_en: I'm In Love With the Villainess: Come on and Notice Me Already
description: Aleah, now 15 years old, advances to the girls' school created by Claire along with May, where she weaves the story together with Lilly and new characters.

characters.name: Aleah
characters.description: ~!Aleah is one of Rae and Claire's daughters, she was adopted along with her twin sister May.!~

characters.name: May
characters.description: ~!May is one of Rae and Claire's daughters, she was adopted along with her twin sister Aleah.!~

characters.name: Claire François
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm (5'2") Claire François is a proud noble who in the original [Revolution] is the villainess who bullies the heroine. ~!In the original Revolution game, she is doomed to be executed, along with the rest of nobility, as a result of the revolution.!~ Claire is prideful with a competitive side to prove her worth as well as her family name. Her threatening behaviour conceals her fragile heart that comes from her childhood experiences. Becomes more prone to jealously as people she cares for may leave her. Her arrogant personality is mainly influenced by her father doting on her in her childhood more than anything.

characters.name: Rae Taylor
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm (5'4") An ordinary office worker who finds herself in the body of the protagonist of her favorite otome game, Revolution. She aims to become a couple with her favorite character, [Claire François](https://anilist.co/character/149900/Claire-Franois). Rae deliberately plays herself up as being a foolishly happy-go-lucky girl who is obsessed with gaining Claire's affection. However, in reality, this is more of a coping mechanism brought about by her early experiences with exploring her sexuality. She is actually far less open with her true feelings, often bottling them up and covering it with humor.

characters.name: Lilly Lilium
characters.description: Lilly is a meek and shy girl who is highly knowledgeable about the Spiritual Church and her religion. She often stutters and refers herself as "Lilly" when she speaks. In addition, she is prone to be easily startled and accidentally insult others whenever they act inappropriately. ~!She has a split personality. Normally, she is a shy individual who often stammers when she speaks. However, due to experiments done by her father when he was trying to artificially create a dual-caster, a second personality was embedded within her. This side of Lilly is a ruthless assassin who follows Salas.!~

title: Tonikaku Imouto ga Hoshii Saikyou no Kyuuketsu-hime wa Mujikaku Gohoushichuu
title_original: とにかく妹が欲しい最強の吸血姫は無自覚ご奉仕中!
title_en: Seriously Seeking Sister! Ultimate Vampire Princess Just Wants Little Sister; Plenty of Service Will Be Provided!
description: Long ago, on the continent of Ephenia, there existed the feared tribe of vampires called "True Bloods," whose great strength allowed them to reign supreme over all other tribes. However, a millennium has passed, and any trace of them has vanished off the face of the planet. That is, until the youngest and most talented royal daughter of the True Bloods awakens in the modern day. Vampire Princess Ristia has only one wish—a cute little sister! Monstrously strong, skilled in magic, and incredibly beautiful, people regard her as an "angel," but she assures everyone she's just a normal girl. Can this "normal girl" be the elder sister she so desires? Follow this (unusual) vampire through a fanservice-filled sibling-searching fantasy adventure. (Source: J-Novel Club)

characters.name: Kaguya
characters.description: A mysterious girl from the Moon. Looking for fun, she decided to become a livestreamer in Tsukuyomi. She's energetic, outrageous and loves [Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/378972/Sakayori-Iroha).

characters.name: Iroha Sakayori
characters.description: A 17-year-old high school girl. A model student who excelles in both academics and sports. She works hard to pay her living expenses and tutition fees. She's a fan of [Yachiyo](https://anilist.co/character/378973/Runami-Yachiyo), Tsukuyomi's top livestreamer. She's also a talented musician, but doesn't compose anymore.

characters.name: Yachiyo Runami
characters.description: The top livestreamer of the virtual world "Tsukuyomi." A mysterious 8,000-year-old (allegedly) AI who can sing, dance, and even create clones.

title: Shimekiri Mae ni wa Yuri ga Hakadoru
description: Ayu Shirakawa, who has run away from home. Through her cousin Miyako, Ayu is introduced to the author Yukari Ebiwara (penname Hikari Kairou), and starts a part time job as her caretaker. Yukari often slacks off by playing games and going on trips, but Ayu really enjoys her new everyday life. And as the two live together and grow closer, Ayu starts to have feelings she never had before.

characters.name: Yukari Ebiwara
characters.description: She is a well-known author with several novel adaptations to her name. She is the daughter of a prominent business family. Her pen name is Kairou Hikari. However, she is a regular deadline-breaker, frequently travelling far away from home to escape, much to the frustration of her editor, Miyako. Despite the fact that she considers herself to be straight, she develops feelings for Ayu...

characters.name: Ayu Shirakawa
characters.description: A high school student who moved to Tokyo from Ehime on her own. She is a lesbian, but she ran away from home due to discrimination from others around her. She moves in with the novelist Yukari Ebiwara as her housekeeper with the help of her cousin Miyako. She falls in love with Yukari at first sight, and her attraction to her grows as she gets to know Yukari better.

title: Henjin no Salad Bowl
description: Sousuke Kaburaya, an impoverished detective, met Sara, a princess from another world with magical powers. Sara began living with Sousuke, and she quickly adjusted to life in modern Japan. Meanwhile, Livia, a female knight who came from the same world as Sara, found herself lost and homeless, but surprisingly enjoyed her days here. These two people, who live a positive life despite their situation, began to have an impact on Sousuke and the other oddballs in the neighborhood, including a devilish lawyer, a divorce agent, and a cult leader. (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

characters.name: Sousuke Kaburaya
characters.description: An impoverished man who runs a modest detective agency in Gifu.

characters.name: Sara da Odin
characters.description: A princess from another world that is proficient in magic. After her homeland gets destroyed, she flees to modern Japan through a magic portal. Influenced by manga, she aspires to become a great detective.

characters.name: Livia de Udis
characters.original: リヴィア・ド・ウーディス
characters.description: A knight from another world who serves as an aide to [Sara](https://anilist.co/character/318361/Odin-Sara). After being transported to modern-day Japan in pursuit of Sara, she becomes homeless. Through her overwhelming mental and physical strength, she manages to make the best of her situation.

characters.name: Asumi Yumisashi
characters.description: A runaway girl that aspires to become a professional musician. She works various part time jobs to fund her band activities.

characters.name: Yuna Naganawa
characters.description: After being helped to get back at her bullies, she becomes best friends with [Sara](https://anilist.co/character/318361/Odin-Sara).

characters.name: Haruka Neya
characters.description: She works at the largest detective agency in Gifu Prefecture and was Souske's junior while he still worked there. She specializes in breaking up couples.

characters.name: Takeo
characters.description: A punk that offers [Livia](https://anilist.co/character/321906/Woodis-Livia) shady jobs.

title: Adachi to Shimamura SS
description: From youth to maturity. From skipping school to sharing a bed. From classmates to lovers. This short story collection features dozens of fleeting scenes that illuminate the tumultuous relationship between Adachi and Shimamura, ordinary girls with an extraordinary connection.. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Sakura Adachi
characters.description: Adachi Sakura is a high school student. She is found skipping class on the second floor of the gym by [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) one day. The two of them gradually became friends and began to spend a lot of time together. Adachi had an extremely introverted personality. Before meeting Shimamura, she never had someone whom she can call a friend. Adachi was said to be cold toward other people and didn't attempt to make friends with other people in the past. She also gets very jealous when Shimamura is together with her friends, and as a consequence usually ends up running away.

characters.name: Hougetsu Shimamura
characters.description: Shimamura Hougetsu is a high school student. She met [Adachi](https://anilist.co/character/144717/Sakura-Adachi) while skipping class on the second floor of the gym in her school when Adachi accidentally walks in on her one day. (In both manga adaptations, it was Shimamura who walked in on Adachi in the gym when they first met instead of the reverse.) The two instantly took a liking for each other and began to hang out together all the time. Shimamura has tail-bone length, dyed brown hair, which she keeps out of her face with two clips on the right side. Her eyes are also brown. Despite playing basketball in middle school, Shimamura is on the shorter side. She has a slim figure. Shimamura tends to think of interpersonal relationships as bothersome since she feels that it requires too much effort to maintain a balanced relationship. ~!During a summer break in their second year of high sch

characters.name: Yashiro Chikama
characters.description: Chikama Yashiro is a friend of [Hino Akira](https://anilist.co/character/167926/Akira-Hino), who met while they were fishing. Like Hino, Chikama makes her own sound effects, the most notably being the "breathing" sound for her space suit. In her introduction, she explains that she has come to Earth to find her brethren. Chikama wears a full body spacesuit. It has childish design elements, such as hearts and star patches.

title: Savage Fang Ojou-sama Shijou Saikyou no Youhei wa Shijou Saikyou no Bougyaku Reijou to Natte Nidome no Sekai wo Musou Suru
title_original: サベージファングお嬢様 史上最強の傭兵は史上最凶の暴虐令嬢となって二度目の世界を無双する
description: The elegant warrior, Mylene, has a secret—inside her lurks the soul of the strongest mercenary in history, Savage Fang. This former sellsword will use her past experience and newfound powers to shape the world as she sees fit. (Source: Yen Press)

title: Shousetsu: Yoru no Kurage wa Oyogenai
title_original: 小説　夜のクラゲは泳げない

title: Kanojo no Kanojo to Fujun na Hatsukoi
title_original: 彼女のカノジョと不純な初恋
description: "In exchange for my help with your studies, you must stay let me stay at your house until summer vacation." If I get a failing mark again, my chance to live by myself will be over. So I'm forced to go along with the proposal from Tsukasa, the smartest and most beautiful girl in school. But then I saw them. I saw Tsukasa kissing a girl in the park. Tsukasa, who often annoys me with her abnormal invasions of my personal space, has a “girlfriend." Her yuri friend is against this arrangement because she thinks it's “cheating” even if it's between two girls, but Tsukasa is having none of it. After a while, my grades are improving and I'm beginning to enjoy living with Tsukasa. I know that “it's not cheating if you're not in love with them,” but… I'm okay with it. If I don't think about love, we can all get along and be happy, right? (Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

title: Douyara Watashi no Karada wa Kanzen Muteki no You desu ne
title_original: どうやら私の身体は完全無敵のようですね
description: On her deathbed, a sickly young girl wishes to be reborn with a strong body that will never succumb to anyone or anything. Lo and behold, her wish is granted! Upon reincarnating into another world as Mary Regalia, she discovers her new body has maxed-out attributes, from physical strength to defense—even magic. But wait! That isn’t what she really wanted! All she longed for was a normal life. Baffled by God’s choice to grant her wish in this most unexpected way, Mary tries to spend her days as uneventfully as possible. The hitch is...nothing’s harder than living a normal life when you’re absolutely invincible! (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Class no Hime wa Watashi no Wanko
title_original: クラスの姫は私のわんこ
description: I, Kurumi Nabana, and my classmate Seira Sorahashi aren't friends. In fact, we hardly ever talk in the classroom. I am a plain, ordinary girl, and she is widely considered to be the cutest girl in school, so our social circles do not intersect. Until one day, when Seira summoned me with a note to meet after school. "Kurumi,” she said, ”Would you like to be my master?" My daily life is dramatically changed because of this ridiculous “request." I tried to think of excuses, but I wouldn't want anyone else to hurt Sorahashi-san. So I said, “I'll do it....... I'll put it on." From today, I will be her master. Put a collar on her, train her, and take her for a walk behind closed doors. What in the world are we doing? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shouwaru Tensai Osananajimi to no Shoubu ni Makete Hatsu Taiken wo Zenbu Ubawareru Hanashi
title_original: 性悪天才幼馴染との勝負に負けて初体験を全部奪われる話
description: Yoshizawa Wakaba's childhood friend, Umezono Komaki, is perfect. She is a brilliant, well-behaved, honor student......, but beneath the surface, she is a vicious girl who looks down on others. I wanted to win over Komaki so badly that I tried to compete with her, even at the risk of losing "something important" - the result was my loss. And so Komaki said, "Wakaba, kiss me," and she stole away my first kiss. In order to regain my dignity, I challenge Komaki to another match, but she says that if she wins, she will take away another one of my most precious things.... Going on a date, sleeping in the same bed, even saying "I love you." I should have hated Komaki for taking all these first-times away from me, but what is this feeling that is filling my heart instead? (Source: Sneaker Bunko, translated) Note: Gold Prize winner in the 28th Sneaker Awards.

title: Yami Zokusei no Mahoutsukai daga, Naze ka Yuusha ni Natteshimatta: Sore wa Tomokaku Yome ni Ii Kurashi o Saseru Tame ni Ganbatte Nariagarou to Omou
title_original: 闇属性の魔法使いだが、なぜか勇者になってしまった ～それはともかく嫁にいい暮らしをさせるために頑張って成り上がろうと思う～
title_en: Busy Wizard: This Warlock Just Wants to Provide for his Wives!
description: After years of honing his magic deep in the mountains, eighteen-year-old Christophe dreams of making a name for himself in the imperial capital. But en route to the city where his fortune awaits, he meets a battered and beaten, yet surprisingly well-bred girl. (Source: Panty Press)

title: Gekitotsu no Hexennacht
title_original: OBSTACLEシリーズ 激突のヘクセンナハト
description: The earth is ruled by the Black Witch. The Black Witch was sealed in the moon and can only be judged once a decade on the night of Hexennacht. The ones who can fight the Black Witch are the chosen magical girls who have won their battles. Horinouchi Mitsuru, the Eastern Japan representative who aims to be the strongest, happens across a girl with strange power who says her name is Kagami Kagami. The girls "clash"! To save the world with their own power!!

title: Jussai no Saikyou Madoushi
description: A ten-year old girl named Ferris was a slave working in the magic stone mine. However, she was discovered to possess an astonishing amount of magical power, and she was enrolled in a magic academy. She is watched over by various people as her talent improved with tremendous speed. Every political faction made moves to try to control her power. Ferris was the only person who did not know she was a powerful magician. Ferris was satisfied as long as she had plenty to eat every day.

title: Miniskirt Uchuu Kaizoku
description: The story centers around a spirited high school girl named Marika. She keeps herself busy with the space yacht club and her part-time job at a high-class retro café. One day, two men suddenly appear and claim to be subordinates of her dead father. They demand that she assume command of the space pirate ship Benten Maru. A privateer ship's compact was made during a war of independence a century ago, and according to that compact, the ship must be inherited by the captain's next direct descendant. Marika finds herself embarking on a new life as a space pirate. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Yuusha Goroshi no Hanayome
description: In the light of day, Sister Alicia Snowell is a faithful and devoted bride of the gods, dedicated to serving the Holy Church and its followers. In the shadows, she’s one of the Church’s top inquisitors, tasked with hunting down and eliminating heretics by any means necessary. Alicia’s latest mission: assassinate the Hero Elcyon, slayer of the mighty Demon Lord, whose growing fame threatens to eclipse the Church’s political power. In order to kill the divinely protected, supposedly unkillable Hero, Alicia first needs to win Elcyon’s heart. There’s just one problem—Elcyon turns out to be a girl named Cion! Alicia’s at a loss for what to do, but while she tries to figure out how to seduce a girl, more trouble brews on the horizon. With remnants of the demon army still at large, Alicia and Cion face one deadly supernatural battle after another! Where will the two girls’ intertwining paths lead them? (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Suki na Ko no Imouto
description: The one who fulfills my desires is the younger sister of the person I love―. A love triangle between the perfect older sister and her care-free younger sister. I, Yuka Amamiya, confessed my feelings to my first love, Nagisa Hanabusa... but I was rejected. Unable to let go of my lingering feelings, Nagisa's younger sister and my friend, Mino-chan, made a surprising offer. "I'll help you forget all about my sister." She offered to let me do everything I had wanted to do with Nagisa — but do it to her instead. I saw the shadow of the person I loved in her younger sister, and I started going on dates with Mino-chan, dressed as Nagisa, and... "Yuka-senpai, you're about to kiss a dear friend who's like a little sister, right?" I indulged in my desires, almost drowning in them. As I spent more time with Mino-chan, who was supposed to be a substitute for Nagisa, I found myself gradually falling for her― (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Oboreru Bed de, Tenshi no Negao wo Mitai dake. #Futari de Okashita Himitsu no Kousoku Ihan
title_original: 溺れるベッドで、天使の寝顔を見たいだけ。 #ふたりで犯した秘密の校則違反
title_en: Watching the Angel Sleep, Drowning in Bed Together
description: Ayana Yukihira is a second-year in high school, and after her parents’ divorce, she’s looking for a new start in an apartment of her own. But when she receives the keys, she finds another girl already there—fresh out of the bath! Due to an administrative error, the apartment was also rented out to Yuu Fukami, one of Ayana’s classmates at her new school. But instead of forcing Ayana to find another place to live, Yuu invites Ayana to share the lease as a roommate. As it turns out, the girls also share a mutual attraction that grows with every touch, every passing day…until they’re virtually drowning in it. (Source: Yen Press)

title: Carneades
description: This is a world inhabited by angels, demons, vampires, beastmen, and humans. Each of the five races has its own secrets and desires. No one yet knows the truth hidden within. But the opening bell is about to ring. (Source: MF Bunko, translated)

title: Shoujo Seikan Hyouryuuki
title_en: The Girls Adrift Among the Stars
description: AN INTERGALACTIC VOYAGE FOR A PLANET TO CALL HOME A horse-drawn carriage races across the cosmos. Or rather, a spaceship made to look like one. At the helm are a pair of refugees who fled Earth after pollution rendered it uninhabitable: Ridley, a scientist and the designer of this peculiar spacecraft, and Watari, an accomplished martial artist with debilitating shyness. This eccentric duo has but one goal—to find a stable planet where they can settle down on! However, every world the two visit is a little off… A planet with a god that can revive the dead, a planet where lucky people reign supreme, a planet lined with endless libraries… Can the girls navigate the unique challenges posed by each bizarre world and live to reach the next leg of their journey? And is there really a replacement for Earth waiting to be found among the stars? (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes a volume-bonus chapter.

title: Kirai Doushi no Watashitachi wa Ichiya no Ayamachi de
title_original: 嫌い同士のわたしたちは一夜の過ちで

title: Howling Blaze: Souen no Kenshi to Fushi no Majo
title_original: ハウリング・ブレイズ 葬焔の剣士と不死の魔女

title: Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Nai jan, Muri Muri! (※Muri ja Nakatta!?) Tanpenshuu
title_original: わたしが恋人になれるわけないじゃん、ムリムリ!(※ムリじゃなかった!?) 短編集
title_en: There’s No Freaking Way I’ll Be Your Lover! Unless… Even More Stories to Love!
description: From Sena Ajisai's student council dreams to Satsuki's fangirling, see what else the crew is up to in this brand-new spinoff! While Amaori Renako panics over maintaining her image as a cool, popular girl who absolutely did not only recently stop shutting herself up in her room, the world keeps on turning. Sena Ajisai runs for the student council, Hitoe Hanatori joins the girls at the pool, and Satsuki writes a fan letter to her favorite author. It’s No Freaking Way, but this time, Renako’s sharing the spotlight! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Shino to Ren: Future
description: Lovebirds Ren and Shino have left their school days behind and set out into the world of working adults. Independence is exciting, but living on their own and starting their careers come with a whirlwind of challenges. Ren is struggling to make time in her busy modeling schedule for her girlfriend. Shino is happy about Ren’s success, but she can’t help but notice all the admiring gazes Ren attracts. Then when they’re finally alone, Shino shies from physical intimacy! And to top it all off, Shino gets along with her coworkers and students so well that it’s stoking Ren’s jealousy. Do these high school sweethearts have what it takes to clear these hurdles and build a future together? (Source: Yen Press)

title: Deatte Hitotsuki de Zecchou Jorei!
title_original: 出会ってひと突きで絶頂除霊！
description: Climax Exorcism. It is the obscene ability that forces anyone, dead or alive, to climax when penetrated. And as a side effect, it also causes evil spirits and monsters to become purified and exorcised when they cum. Haruhisa Furuya, the boy who possesses this unholy ability, is one of the lowest-ranking students at the Exorcist Academy. After all, if he uses his ability, it would destroy his social standing (among other things)... But then Haruhisa meets someone, a girl named Misaki Souya, a girl with an evil eye capable of exposing people's secrets. (Source: Gagaga Bunko, translated)

title: Senketsu Oujo, Mina Korosu
description: Mary is a princess who lacks the ability to use magic. Her arranged political marriage was set in stone, and she hoped to finally serve a purpose as a member of the royal family. However, during the engagement party, her engagement was abruptly broken off, and she was falsely accused of a crime and sentenced to execution. Betrayed by her own parents and brother, Mary manages to escape with her only ally, her older sister. Their attempt to flee is thwarted, and both Mary and her sister are killed by the most powerful mage known as the arcanist. But on the brink of death, Mary’s powers awaken. She possesses the arcana of the Death God, allowing her to devour corpses and augment her strength. With this newfound ability, Mary becomes determined to exact revenge on all those responsible for her sister’s death.

title: Himitsu: Kuro no Chikai
description: Rin, a young angel (presumed female, but angels don’t have clear genders) falls in love with a young human girl, Miku. However, their love is considered taboo, and so, Rin makes a deal with the devil to be reborn as the human boy, Len, in order to be with Miku. However, their happiness together is short-lived, and even that soon ends in tragedy.

title: Hataraku Watashi to Kanojo no Dousei
description: Mari is known as a "cold woman" who doesn't like to get involved with otherpeople. One day, Mari, who worked at a flower shop, was asked to take care of Sumirei, a high school girl who has lost her mother and has nowhere else to go due to her circumstances. Mari felt compelled to take her in. But Sumirei, who was still depressed with a broken heart, wasn't ready to talk, and they began to live together awkwardly. But over time, Mari got glimpses of Sumirei's family environment and school life. And as they spent time together, Sumirei gradually opened up to her. The more she learned about Sumirei's innocent lifestyle, the more Mari realized the weaknesses of her own emotional state. (Source: Fujimi L Bunko, translated)

title: Kenshi wo Mezashite Nyuugaku Shita noni Mahou Tekisei 9999 Nan desu kedo!?
title_original: 剣士を目指して入学したのに魔法適性9999なんですけど！？
description: Laura who had received special education to be a swordsman from her A-Rank adventurer father since a young age, enters the Royal Capital's Adventurer's school at the age of 9. Laura filled with expectation in her heart in hopes to make many swordsman friends. At the day of the entrance ceremony, Laura's sword aptitude value was measured at 107. Between normal students whose aptitude value is around 50-60, Laura was definitely a sword genius, but the magic aptitude that was measured after that was 9999. Laura was stunned, and while she didn't know what was even happening she was transferred to the Magic Department. Contrary to Laura's will, she exerts her super-genius, and instantly becomes stronger than anyone in the school.

title: Ashita no Sekai de Hoshi wa Kirameku
title_original: 明日の世界で星は煌めく
description: In a “ruined world” begins the adventures of two girls. A girl, who because of some special circumstances, was branded a “witch”, Yuki Minato. Even now that she’s in high school, her dark days are still not over. But on the second day of school, the world ended. The streets are now filled with lifeless beings, moving corpses, as humanity’s end approaches. A month later, Yuki managed to survive with a familiar and “magic” left by her missing father. One day, to replenish supplies, she went into the streets filled with moving corpses. On her way back, she heard a gunshot. Even though right now there’s no one in town that’s worth saving, in the past there was a kind girl she was close to. Remembering that girl, Minato decides to help the owner of the gun shot. When she arrives, in front of her was that girl, Honoka Sakaki. For Honoka’s goal, the two decided to work together, but… (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Yuri Kuma Arashi
description: Kureha Tsubaki is a shy second-year student at Arashigaoka Academy whose life takes a turn for the weird after she meets transfer student Ginko Yurishiro, who begins showing up in her dreams as a bear princess. Kureha becomes friends with Ginko only to discover that she is wrapped up in her own world and believes everything is made up of bears. When Kureha begins having feelings for Ginko, she decides to help her get to the bottom of her delusions. But are they really just delusions or something more…? (Source: Otakumode)

title: Kare nanka Yori, Watashi no Hou ga Ii Desho?
title_original: 彼なんかより、私のほうがいいでしょ？
description: That girl has a man she likes. I have to make it mine before I confess! "I think I have a favorite person ..." To that word, Kano Mizusawa's soul set out on a journey for a moment. Horimiya Oto is her childhood friend. She is attractive for her loose semi-long hair, has excellent grades except for exercise, is homely and attentive, and she has said that she has a man she likes. Even though we are girls, before I knew it, she was more than a close friend. Even so ... But even if the mind is impossible, if it is the body ...!" (!?) Thus, Kano's unreasonable and slightly radical [Sound capture strategy] begins! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kono Nukumori wo Kimi to Yobunda
title_original: このぬくもりを君と呼ぶんだ

title: Afternoon Tea wa Ikaga desu ka?: Watashi to Senpai no Fujun de Ichizu na Futarigurashi
title_original: アフタヌーンティーはいかがですか？ 私と先輩の、不純で一途なふたり暮らし

title: FLOWERS: Le volume sur printemps
title_original: FLOWERS ―Le volume sur printemps- フラワーズ〈春篇〉
description: Suoh: "Is it wrong if I fall in love with a girl?" Surrounded by immense walls in the middle of a forest, lies the prestigious all-girls school, Saint Angraecum Academy. It's a school that prides itself on growing bright and cultured young women. The school's Amitié program is designed to help foster new friendships that will last a lifetime. This is why Suoh Shirahane, a painfully shy girl with a mysterious past, has enrolled. As her first year of high school begins, she is filled with hopes of a new life. Follow her as she navigates her new friendships and attempts to unravel the many mysteries at the academy, including occult rituals and the mysterious disappearance of fellow students, all while trying to pass her classes. As spring warms into summer, so does Suoh's friendships until they too blossom into a love that is something more. More importantly, who will she choose?

title: "Hitokiri" Shoujo, Koushaku Reijou no Goei ni Naru
title_original: 『人斬り』少女、公爵令嬢の護衛になる
description: Shurine is a girl who has mastered the sword, having been raised to serve as a bodyguard. However, she is falsely accused of assassinating the person she is guarding and forced to goes on the run. Driven from her home, Shurine meets Lutecia, a duke's daughter whose life is in danger after being caught up in a battle over royal succession. As Lutecia is being attacked by an assassin, Shurine makes her an offer, "I'm a bit short on money. If you need a bodyguard, I'm available right now." Their encounter will determine the fate of the kingdom! A girls-love swordplay battle fantasy begins! Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Nai jan, Muri Muri! (※Muri ja Nakatta!?) SS-shuu
title_original: わたしが恋人になれるわけないじゃん、ムリムリ！（※ムリじゃなかった!?） SS集
title_en: There’s No Freaking Way I’ll Be Your Lover! Unless… More Stories to Love!
description: After a traumatic middle school life where she spent most of her time in her room playing video games, Amaori Renako set out to become the ideal version of herself in high school. Now, she’s a member of a group of popular girls called the Quintet, dating the most beautiful girl in school, and living the high school dream! Now her daily life is so exciting that you could even fill a book with all the stuff she and her friends got up to in between the drama and romance! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Gokumon Nadeshiko Koko ni Ari
description: The Gokumon clan - a bloodline from hell. Living in their mysterious stronghold in the ancient capital of Kyoto, they command fear not only from those who wield magic, but also monsters and demons.
