title: Penthouse Slaughterhouse
description: "So, why the hell are we having a party in a killer's penthouse?!" Lydia is a young woman who, infatuated with the rumor of a mysterious killer, takes this fictional man's place and becomes the Phantom Killer of the Penthouse. No matter how many warning signs she paints on the outside, people cannot stop breaking into her home for the thrill of meeting a masked murderer. One day, a group of girls attempts to break in to set up a party. Lydia, both curious as to where the night can go and somewhat in love with these girls, pretends to be another party-goer and lets them take up space in her penthouse. How will she charm one of these girls while killing off their friends? [From Itch.io]

title: R is for Rachel
description: Joan goes through tough times at school. She has a hard time integrating herself with her classmates. It doesn’t feel like she belongs there. When she falls for Rachel, everything changes. But Rachel’s hiding a deadly secret that could change Joan’s life forever. Will love be enough to overcome her fears? [From Steam]

title: In The Ember - Yujin zhi Zhong
title_original: In The Ember 余烬之中
description: Angelina Scarrot, a longtime member of the Adventurers Guild, was assigned an unusual and highly paid mission - to accompany a terminally ill girl on a journey around the world. As they traveled together, a special bond began to form between them... [Based on Steam]

title: Personal Chef to the Stars
description: Things are not going well for Chef Ayesha Rogers. Her Central London fusion restaurant “Memerang Berbulu” has just gone bankrupt, and her girlfriend has just left her. Newly single and heavily in debt she decides to take a meeting with one of London’s top talent agents who lines her up with a gig that will change her life forever. [From Steam]

title: Picta Mori
description: When first seemingly harmless achievement in technology turns into something sinister is not an unknown scenario to us. Picta Mori plays with the idea of what if AI image generator would start predicting people's deaths. [From Itch.io]

title: Small Town, Big Secrets
description: In small town investigator discovers secrets about a herself, her partner, and a cavern of monsters. [From Itch.io]

title: Mansplain Manipulate Manslaughter
tags: Past Setting in a Fictional World
description: Escape the clutches of an anthropomorphic snake and bird and manipulate your way to freedom by returning from death! Made in a day for October 2022 UPGRADE Game Jam (with theme "Trick") using the RenPy Visual Novel Engine. [From Itch.io]

title: Red Lilies
description: Irene is a young woman who is sent far away from her London home to attend Lady Lilianne’s Academy in the countryside. This school is lovely and has everything a young woman about to enter society could ask for: a strong emphasis on etiquette, her every need attended to by maids, gardens for fresh air and peaceful walks, other beautiful young women to be her bosom buddy as they brave the unknown together… [i][b]And it’s far out into the countryside, away from the smoke and fog, far away from the cities. When a horrific tragedy strikes the school just a day after Irene’s arrival, she and her new friends are terrified of who will be next. Because others [i]will be next. And with the headmistress not believing them, the doors locked at night, and no one around to help for miles, the girls are on their own… [From itch.io]

title: Useless Demon Lord
description: Lucille is an unemployed single woman living alone in her apartment, stewing in feelings of anxiety and inadequacy... but then without warning and due to a rather strange magical mix-up, she is summoned to be the new Demon Lord in another world! The demons aren't doing so well lately, and they're now relying on their new boss to return them to their glory days. Will Lucille be able to take this as an opportunity for a fresh start and thrive even in a world that wants her dead, or will she crumble under the pressure and return to her old shut-in ways? [From itch.io]

title: DEVIL'S LIMINAL
tags: Modern Day United States of America
Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: A yuri horror visual novel inspired by Azores folklore. Margo Silva has done everything she can to leave behind the trailer park in Arizona where she grew up. Now all she has to do is focus on her summer job until she can leave for college. Her illusion of a quiet summer is shattered when a hungry ghost enters her dreams. Two mysterious girls show up in town, claiming they can help her. Margo must contend with a demon's claim on her soul, and how to stop ghosts from this life and the past that want to take her future. [From Steam]

title: Chuxia Qingyu
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine

title: La Isla Perla
description: What if a castaway were to fall in love with the resident mermaid? Created alongside the Castaway Jam 2022! [From Itch.io]

title: i am feeling things too
description: This game tells the story of Lydia and Ophelia - two lesbians who experience their first date in person, after they have been talking online for a while. The scene takes place in Ophelia's place, after having had a date on a café in i am feeling things. [From Itch.io]

title: i am feeling things
description: This tiny bitsy game / visual novel tells the story of Lydia and Ophelia - two lesbians that experience their first date in person, after they have been talking online for a while. The scene takes place in a tiny café, on a rainy day. Both characters are adults and above the age of 21. [From Itch.io]

title: Dropped Connection
description: On a sleepless night, Kiki browses her message history and overthinks the hints she still isn't sure were actually hints, wondering what could have been. [From Itch.io]

title: Faceless Date
description: Suzanne is a 20-year-old stylist and her life cannot be more perfect by fulfilling her childhood dream of working backstage at Tantalus Theatre. But one thing she misses out on is finding lasting love. She's still young, yet she can't resist the thought that her opportunities are already running out in the already limited dating pool of women of her age. Then she received a DM in the dating app from the mysterious Evelyn. Yes, there are many red flags, like how Evelyn doesn't have any photos of her face. However, she seems to be a lovely person from the conversations they had and there's always that secret ability Suzanne can rely on, so what can go wrong? [From Itch.io]

title: Midnight Rendezvous
description: Yuna wakes up a couch in a dilapidated building lying across from a beautiful moth woman. What does she want? [From itch.io]

title: A Space In Between
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: "It pained me to hold this secret feeling for you ... yet the thought of losing you pained me even more." Lily and Andrea are best friends since childhood. Growing and facing all ups-and-downs in their lives together, they never leave each other's side since the first time they met. Even though physically separated after Andrea and her family moved away to another town, the two of them still as close as ever. Years after years, suddenly a crack appeared in their relationship as they drifted apart, and then Lily realized she had a different feeling for her best friend—a one-sided love that will never be reciprocated. A bittersweet short story about fear, courage, and overcoming it as a part of growing up. [From Itch.io]

title: Lin Zhong Nüwu
description: No one dares to go into the perilous Greywind Forest. According to legend, there are beings outside the norms and more dangerous than wild beasts. Once inside, there is no getting out. A wicked family of witches is rumored to reside in the depths of this woodland, using the blood of young girls as a source of material for black magic. The witch family is allegedly no longer in Greywind Forest, but one of the witches has just made a comeback. Nellie enters the Greywind Forest for her own reasons and encounters the stunning but dangerous witch there. What fate awaits her? [From Steam]

title: Transience of Strange Dream
description: A short visual novel about a bunch of girls finding themselves. Maybe they'll find something else along the way? [from Itch.io]

title: Echoing Hearts
description: "COCK-A-DOODLE-DOO!" Every day, Kyouko finds herself hiking up the same mountain trail to echo out the cry of the morning. As humans understanding has reached a point where echoes could be rationalized, she finds it's really the only thing worth echoing anymore. However silly a thought, she hopes to someday meet the person behind this mysterious voice. Echoing Hearts is a visual novel featuring a 14k+ word script filled with cuteness, humor, and heart, set in the world of Gensokyo. Follow Kyouko as she falls for the bird-brained Kutaka, with both girls finding more in common with each other every passing morning. [from Itch.io]

title: The Inverted Heart and Tongue
description: A visual novel where Seija Kijin tries to come to terms with her feelings. [from Itch.io]

title: Magnetism Rally
description: Rei's going on a date. In your experience, this tends to be pretty disastrous, so you need to do your best job as her dog to prevent her from screwing up too badly. [from itch.io]

title: Dear Rosalia
description: Bittersweet sapphic longing; the fictionalized and embellished retelling of an autobiographical moment. [from itch.io]

title: If You Stay
description: Two girls, Mika and Yara, realizing they’ve been outed by their school teacher to their parents and friends, spend their “final date” reconciling through the pain of hiding in the closet while navigating adolescence. Decide for them if they should run away together or ultimately split up. [from itch.io]

title: purple hemlock
description: A point-and-click game in which a lovelorn research assistant investigates her professor's study room.

title: Cassie
description: Cassandra is just a 16 year old girl wanting to experience the world at her own pace. However, she's the most sought after lady in her village. She has 12 suitors, and an overbearing mother trying to marry her off. But Cassandra doesn't feel anything for anyone, until the day she meets: "Cassie." [from itch.io]

title: Touhou: Heart of the Tiger
description: How does the highly revered Buddhist Monk Shou Toramaru spend her nights? ...By drinking at bars! Explore Shou's past and present as she helps different Touhou characters sort out their relationships in this visual novel (with minigames)! [from itch.io]

title: Morning Fun
description: Morning Fun is a free adult Visual Novel of a demon gilf, Lither, in which she is a Succubus in a failed and sad marriage, something that can be very frustrating for a lust demon. Lither believes she has been cultivating feelings for another demon lady, and finds herself thinking about her after a cult gathering. In this mini game you'll find out that Lither isn't too old to have fun! [from itch.io]

title: Head Over Heels
tags: Modern Day Setting in a Fictional World
description: Bezz is a dullahan who's been looking for love in all the wrong places. When her roommate suggests she checks out a speed dating service in the city, she's hesitant at first but eventually caves. Join her as she meets the monster girls of her dreams. [From itch.io]

title: Sea Fever
description: Marella and Dylan are girlfriends who live a quiet and self-sufficient life in paradise. But Dylan's dreams and ambitions are greater than a little house by the sea, and she is drawn to the city to pursue her acting career. Now, bound together only by letters, Marella must face not only the pressures of keeping up a long distance relationship, but a strange and growing sickness, and dark monsters from the only place she's ever considered home. Can Dylan and Marella's relationship survive? And what, exactly, is the monster plaguing her nightmares? [From itch.io]

title: Bloody Waters
description: After years of grunt lab work, Dawn is ready to make a real difference— and she's given the chance to do so when her friend gets her a job at a mysterious lab. But something about one of the creatures there is odd, and she can't seem to keep her head above water as a chance meeting spirals out of control. [From itch.io]

title: Bury Your Gays
description: It's the summer of 1986. The music is good and the perms are bad. Like real bad. It was meant to be the Best Summer Ever. That was what Gerald promised when he invited you all out here. To his family's cabin in the woods. That was before he veered off the road with you all in the car. That was before the first of your friends turned up dead. Forget college - your only life goal now is survival. Oh yeah... And this is probably your last chance to try it on with your crush. So, you know... priorities and whatever. [From itch.io]

title: House Of Chavez
description: Take on the role of Adriana, a twenty-one-year-old Texan grappling with the recent loss of her mother. Accompanied by her brother Bruno, they embark on a journey to Europe to explore the house they inherited from their grandmother, Maria Chavez. Located in a quaint tourist town in Spain, near the border with France, the logical choice would be to sell the property. However, Adriana and Bruno feel a lingering curiosity, wondering why their mother kept them away from the house all these years. It's as if she had a hidden motive for shielding them from its secrets. Upon their arrival, Adriana encounters Silke, a former caregiver of Maria Chavez who now works as a waitress in a local pub. Silke holds intimate knowledge of the house, having spent time with their grandmother during her final moments. The house is dusty and shrouded in mystery, and Adriana will gradually begin to uncover its secrets from years ago. And maybe, she'll even discover what's happening there in the present. What lies in store for Adriana as she navigates this enigmatic journey? Will her encounter with Silke blossom into a friendship or something more? Can she unravel the mysteries entwined within the House of Chavez? [From Steam]

title: Bellfall
description: Lyra's mundane life is suddenly interrupted by Isabelle Vega, the new girl at work. She gets dragged along for many different silly adventures and dates, and who knows, maybe they'll end up falling for each other... [From Itch.io]

title: United by Destiny
description: A shy girl meets her boyfriend's beautiful sister.

title: Pious Ari
description: Ariandra is a nun that's extremely dedicated to her god, Cira. However, her strict life changes one day as a mystery woman suddenly appears in her bedroom - and a new world is opened to her. [From Itch.io]

title: Lost Seed
description: The story takes place in Eden, a magical continent. Under the protection of the Saintess, its inhabitants live relatively peaceful lives. Node is a foreign doctor running a clinic in the bustling city of Ople. Monica is a talented student studying magic at an ancient academy. An encounter with a mysterious girl puts these two young magicians on a path they never imagined. However, this is only a brief moment of peace before devastating turmoil begins. Secrets about the continent's history, a conspiracy between the academy and the kingdom, and the mysterious girl's true identity begin to surface. Your choices will affect the girls fates and the story ending. [Translated from Steam]

title: Iced Tea at a Coffee Shop
description: A date turn sour in the rain. A conversation about habit. [From itch.io]

title: Jiaozhi de Yinji
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
Protagonist's Cousin as a Support Character
description: Due to an accident, Mei Yu was temporarily brought back to the village where she spent her childhood. She didn't think it was a good idea, but... she didn't feel like she had much of a choice. The places in her memory had faded, unable to recapture the feelings of the past, but some marks seemed to have ingrained themselves deep into her marrow, leaving Mei Yu feeling as though she might never break free. Yet, whether it was her childhood playmates she met again or the mysteriously encountered visitors, they all seemed to ripple through her once calm heart like a stone thrown into still water... [From Steam]

title: A Midnight Vending
description: an office worker stuck in routine an escapee from a lab come to the same sanctuary bonding over cans of soft drinks [From Itch.io]

title: You Are My Treasure
description: The year is 1720, the War of Spanish Succession has just ended and now the European Powers operating in the Caribbean are looking to eliminate the pirates that have taken advantage of the unrest to make a pretty penny for themselves. Captain Carmen “Cards” Rodriguez and her crew of buccaneers have fallen prey to such efforts and after a terrible battle against two Royal Navy Frigates, the Pirate Captain has found herself with neither crew nor ship. Through her wits and cunning she has eked her way to the Pirate hub of Nassau and learns of an opportunity that will help her turn her life around. Will this be her chance to score big and gain the booty that all pirates dream of? What capers and adventures will she go on along the way? Will she survive this perilous voyage or will her wit and charm help her survive? Might she even meet the woman of her dreams along the way? [From Steam]

title: We're Women, After All
description: The Ash Mermaid gives you a knife. She knows the pain your family gives you. Just kill them already. [From itch.io]

title: We Need Space
description: Obsessive planner Gwen, fresh from an explosive breakup with chaotic, scattered Amelia, vengefully signs Amelia up for a service that will temporarily launch Amelia into space on a rocket. But when Amelia signs Gwen up for the same thing and they wind up in space together, a malfunction causes the rocket to fail and they have to work together to make it back alive. Can you save them? [From Steam]

title: Across From You
description: Aspen and Evelina are long-time rivals, respectively scoring top #1 and #2 in their class in plant magic. Having lived across from each other for ten years, they both adorn beautiful, elaborate gardens, always trying to one-up each other in the process. But what happens when an unexpected discovery requires them to work together? Will this newfound cooperation lead to some discoveries about their relationship? Or will their animosity result in dire consequences? [From itch.io]

title: Love Me More
description: One day a strange girl came to find May in the university, and she seems to know May very well. When May recalls her memory, she found that this girl is the one May had a one night stand with one month ago. She persistently forces May to make their relationship become more complicated. But the biggest problem is that she is a high school girl. How will May handle these problems? [Edited from itch.io]

title: Of Fair and Flesh
description: "Vika" is the darling on everyone's mind—beautiful, talented, and the rising star of showbiz. She is untouchable, and Viktoire wants to keep it that way. However, one drunken encounter with a mysterious fan threatens her picture-perfect persona. As Viktoire becomes entangled with this enigmatic girl, she finds a kindred spirit in Noa. Will these two misfits be able to find a home in each other? [From itch.io]

title: interviewer
description: Friendly aliens are trying to help Essie, the sole survivor of Earth's destruction, regain her memories. But why should Essie remember the past when she feels so alone in the universe? The answer comes in the form of an enigmatic cyborg, Sol. [From itch.io]

title: Aquatic Grave
description: "It'll be fun," you said when you decided to go on a cruise ship. "It'll be easy," you said, when you decided to relax for once in your life. But of course... because this is YOUR mind numbing life, it isn't that fun or easy. After a little mishap at sea, you find yourself in the home of a strange sea lady. She seems pretty welcoming, but there's something really fishy about her... [From itch.io]

title: Catching Butterflies!
description: Maple and Celastrina are in the Nature Club and they have a presentation tomorrow on Leafae (fantasy equivalent of butterflies and moths). However, Celastrina starts sneezing tulip petals - turns out that it's due to a caterpillar's mischievous spell. According to an old saying, confessing your hidden feelings will quell it. As nervous tension bubbles up between the both of them, will they be able to resolve this in time? Or will other feelings surface in the process? [From itch.io]

title: Posui Lengjing
description: A sudden downpour shattered the planet’s tranquil routine. Twisted, monstrous fission creatures began to run rampant. Those who gained extraordinary powers to counter them were called: "Phelimatiya." Beneath the lighthouse stretched a mysterious black ocean, shimmering like polished ore. At its center stood an island-like sanctuary: [Black Reef.] Latitude 64°09' N, Longitude 21°56' W. Following the tides, they sought the rewritten truths of the world. "Welcome to our world." —BROKEN PRISM [Translated from steam]

title: Is it normal to be down bad for my friend?
description: Hana has a crush on her beautiful friend. When they decide to live together, Hana wonders if she'd be able to survive. A simple GL about a girl who's whipped for her best friend. [From itch.io]

title: All of us Flames
description: At first glance, Kaja and Tara have everything: fame, fortune, and, well, each other. But when the cameras stop following and the spotlights turn off, all the glamour disappears, leaving dread and questions behind. Should they be where they are right now? [From itch.io]

title: red eye
description: PLAY NOW! DESPAIR DAYDREAM NINETEEN. “DDN? oh yeah, i’ve heard of it. it’s kinda a like, cult classic? lol.” “i guess…? it got super popular on ticktock. people were trying it out because eternal nightmare fourteen was on a three day maintenance for the new expac.” “it’s really old so it’s kind of hideous but the designs are cute enough for commissioners.” You're looking for something to fill the void of every day monotony. The grindset. Whatever. Maybe she can help? Your O So Glorious Raid Leader. [From itch.io]

title: Watashitachi no Hitori Ecchi Jijou
title_original: 私たちのひとりエッチ事情

title: Love is in the Airship
description: It's your first time holding a real job. Like a real-deal job with a lot of responsibilities. You're an executive assistant aboard the U.S.S. Tibarn, the biggest airship in the world. It's embarking on its maiden voyage, a cruise around the world, and you're embarking on a not-so-maiden voyage of your own. Okay, so actually you're more like an underpaid janitor, but you still get to be on a luxury cruise in the sky, right? Whether it's helping clean the infinity pool, or lazing around after hours at the local lesbian bar, you're going to have the time of your life on the Tibarn. And, if you're lucky, you'll snag a girlfriend, too. Do your best. There's a ton of choices. Some tricky decisions. And a whole lotta paths the story can take. [From Steam]

title: God bless you
description: Romaine is deeply in love with her best friend, Juliet. But she is doomed to pining, considering Juliet is marrying in five days a wonderful man named Paul. But there is a more important barrier to this longing: Juliet and Romaine are both religious and believe in a God of peace, but who forbids homosexuality. But what good is there in looking at a rose one cannot touch? But perhaps Romaine can extend the arm and brush a petal with her fingers... [From itch.io]

title: Blast Damage Days
description: Explore a story about lesbian love and healing from trauma in this queer-themed furry visual novel. [From Itch.io]

title: Taking Over Her Heart!
description: I have a crush on my best friend, Amelie. I have a crush and I am so scared to ruin what we have. ...So scared that I'll probably never tell her that I love her. Not unless someone helps me. ...Will (you) help me? Taking Over Her Heart! is a short Kinetic VN about going on lots of cute dates with one very cute girl! Will (you) be able to take over her heart? [From itch.io]

title: The Gap Moe Mob Boss Wants to Win the Cute Barista's Heart!
description: Aster is a notorious mob boss that had just gotten out of jail. Her first stop: Chronicles of Coffee, a quaint bookshop and cafe. There resides the barista and Aster's true love, Solana. But Solana doesn't know she's Aster's true love. Aster is determined to confess. On the outside, Aster is an intimidating gangster. On the inside, she's a lovesick puppy. Will she be able to convey her feelings and win Solana's heart? [From itch.io]

title: Spirit Sisters
description: The Egyptian Gods have returned. In a world reborn under the influence of ancient deities, the Egyptian Orthodox Church emerges, a devout order striving to honor and sustain this divine resurgence. Wendy, a blue-haired Demigoddess is selected to act as the Vanguard for the Church. Alongside her stands a silver-haired sister of faith, named Hibiki. Together, this unlikely duo faces a sinister cult bent on summoning 7 sinister demons. As battles rage and shadows close in, a bond deeper than faith begins to grow—a love forged in the crucible of danger and destined to challenge the fabric of their beliefs. Will Wendy and Hibiki’s resolve be enough to stem the tide of darkness? And can their newfound connection withstand the weight of their divine mission? This is their story, Spirit Sisters! [From Itch.io]

title: A Vernal Mishap
description: A Vernal Mishap is a short visual novel (Around 14.000 words) where you play as a faerie that keeps falling for the human she's trying to scam. Will she go through with her plan, or give it all up for the one that she loves? [From itch.io

title: Jessica Jane Has A Crush!?
description: Jessica Jane has a crush!? And to make matters worse, a crush on her best friend Rena! Follow Jessica as she navigates these complicated feelings, all while dealing with the struggles of attending an art university and coping with her mum's strict parenting. One day Jessica decides to meet up with Rena at the local halloween themed cafe "Ghoffee", but something seems... off. Rena mentions a surprise, she refuses to reveal it yet, but Jessica can't help but wonder if it's... surely not! Right? [From itch.io]

title: Spring in Her Step
description: [s]Redacted's life is pretty good. With a promising academic career, loving girlfriend, and strong community, the future looks bright. But a realization is looming on the horizon—one that could completely disrupt their paths going forward. Change is scary, but she'll choose to bloom anyway. Join our protagonist on a journey of self-acceptance as she embraces being a transgender woman, chooses a name, and comes out to the people she cares about. This earnest yet lighthearted story will make you laugh, cry, and feel optimistic about the future. [From itch.io]

title: The Cute Girl Next Door Wants to Chain Me Up and Keep Me Prisoner?!!
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: Returning to her hometown after dropping out of university in her final year, Asher is at a pretty low point in her life- her whole family is ashamed of her failure and her former college friends have no time for her at all. Everything just feels like it isn't going right- that is, until she reconnects with her cheerful and energetic childhood friend Ellie, a sweet and fun-loving girl who seems like just about the only person in the world who is happy to see her. But... it's been a really, really long time since Asher's been home. A really long time. And she's about to find out that Ellie has changed in ways she couldn't possibly have imagined. [From itch.io]

title: Christine's Care
description: A slice-of-life yuri visual novel set in early 2000s Canada. After a painful breakup with her boyfriend, Christine moves to a big city and takes on a new role as a nurse. She is assigned to care for Hannah, a woman her own age who is paralyzed from the waist down. Christine is immediately struck by Hannah’s complexity—intelligent, beautiful, yet deeply bitter about her condition. As the story unfolds, the two women grow closer, forging a connection that might transform both of their lives. Will Christine be the one to help Hannah find new hope, or will Hannah end up changing Christine in ways she never expected? Meanwhile, Christine encounters an unusual couple: Marlon, a muscular Latina with a commanding presence, and Liz, a delicate, half-Asian woman in a submissive role. Their dominant/submissive relationship is unlike anything Christine has experienced, but she quickly becomes fascinated by their dynamic. One day, Marlon invites her to take control and dominate Liz, an offer that Christine unexpectedly enjoys. Last but not least, Donna, Christine's boss, is grappling with marital troubles. Suspecting her husband of infidelity, she finds herself on shaky ground. Will Christine step in to support her, offering a helping hand—and perhaps a shoulder to lean on when she needs it most? [From Steam]

title: Toxic Yuri
description: What would you do if you found an abandoned sludge girl in a cardboard box? Take her home, of course! Doku-chan is a sentient pile of sludge that used to stay hidden in alleyways until she met OL-san, an overworked office lady. But will things work out between them, or could this love be lethal? Thus starts the most poisonous but fluffy yuri romance story you'll ever buy and play to completion. [From Steam]

title: Hanye Xia de Bo Bing
description: This is a tragedy cause by illegal plant collecting. The main character, Leng Xiaobing, was a normal shop keeper form a grocery store, but ever things changed after she met a strange man… [From Steam]

title: Diving Bell
description: A woman takes a dive and attempts to control the situation she's found herself in. The only certainties of the cold depths inside a diving bell... are love and hunger. [From Itch.io]

title: The Weight of Ambition.
description: Lira’s ambition has brought her far – but now, to rise higher, she may have to betray her wife, Lute. Is success worth the cost of love? [From Itch.io]

title: The Crown Prince's Pegasus
description: Toyosatomimi no Miko has always wondered what has become of her legendary horse, Kurokoma. What would a reunion entail...? Would Saki still recognize her? Would Saki still love her even if she wasn't Prince Shoutoku anymore...? [From itch.io]

title: Factory Defect
description: Lucky is a combat bot looking for fun after her mechanic pissed her off. She knows what she wants and where to get it, it's just a matter of finding someone else looking for a good time. [Edited from itch.io]

title: Blood of the Future
description: The futuristic utopian city of Elysium stands as a technological marvel. Built by a genius roboticist known only as "Doctor H" and her lesser known partner, "Doctor P", these two scientists find themselves reconnecting after years apart. However, they find themselves haunted by both their pasts and their ambitions for the future. [From Itch.io]

title: Swordmaiden's Elegy
description: A mercenary finds new life as a necromancer's pet. Will love survive decomposition? [From Itch.io]

title: ergo sum
description: For a moment, the world broke open – limitless and strange. But reality closed in fast. Rue, a jaded scientist, still clings to old dreams and silent love for Almond. [From Itch.io]

title: Anomalous
description: Two anomalous entities contained within a secret facility are in tension. Follow the Robot as she struggles to obey the Manager's new orders: handling the Flesh, a stubborn and unserious shape-shifting monster of gore. [From itch.io]

title: Contamination Protocol
description: The Captain of the Soft Touch is dead. Her mission brought to a catastrophic halt at the hands of an unknown attacker and forced back into spaceflight, her crew scrambles to make sense of what has happened. One of two surviving witnesses, your navigator, has been forced into quarantine due to her exposure to the source of the attack. It's up to you, the mission's doctor, to ensure she hasn't been contaminated. Learn the enemy's face. Save your marriage. Ask the right questions, get the right answers. Whatever it takes. [From itch.io]

title: surveillance:servant
description: A game about hypnosis, fragile self-image, and revealing too much. “All you need to do is follow my instructions. Do you understand?” After being called out and excommunicated from her social media circles, avid fangirl Lila struggles to cope with the aftermath. With her feelings of depression and isolation increasing by the day, her ability to function continues to decline. However, when a comforting DM arrives from an internet stranger in her inbox, Lila gets introduced to a whole new method of rest and relaxation... But what this stranger brings into Lila’s life may be more than anything she could have ever imagined. [From itch.io]

title: Miso Shiru!
description: Two gal pals on a normal cruise vacation are charmed by a mysterious woman that they happen to rescue on a stranded life raft. Which lucky girl will win the lady's hand first? [From itch.io]

title: Cumulonimbus - Still the Clouds of My Childhood Remain
description: “I saw her. She had always been beautiful, but today she’s especially pretty under the scarlet sky. I want to hold her, to tell her I loved her, that I didn’t want to see her cry, that I didn’t want to let her go, to say I’m sorry for… I saw her. Underneath the scarlet sky.” [From itch.io]

title: Syzygy
description: Deep in the mountains, three women suffer a chance meeting, and a ritual goes awry. Bound together by the results of their interrupted magic, they must work together and free themselves, or fall victim to a curse of their own making. [From itch.io]

title: Artificial Intimacy
description: Every breakup can be hard, but how far is someone willing to go just to not be alone anymore? Follow Sera's story as she finds out if an artificial love can mend the wounds in her heart, or if it'll only make the pain last longer. [From itch.io]

title: Rumeng Jinse Xue
description: Dreamy Golden Snow is a fantasy mystery-themed visual novel that tells a story among high school girls. The story appears in an ordinary high school. After the incident, the protagonist is also affected, and players will guide her through numerous choices to uncover the truth. [From Steam]

title: skull-rung
description: laura's landed the job of her dreams, but her boss is a little overbearing. say, what's in that tea? skull-rung is the debut release from the rose garden, submitted as an entry into the toxic yuri vn jam it has 4 endings, and it takes about 30 mins or maybe an hour to see em all i hope you enjoy it! [From itch.io]

title: Yuri ni Warikomu Stalker
title_original: 百合に割り込むストーカー

title: #doubleblush
description: entry for vncup.. by squishymoss and violet lafleur girl meets girl and shit gets #gay readtime ~30mins ENJOY!! [From itch.io]

title: Flying High
description: It's the year 2039, and Neo Astra's at the cutting edge of tech. We've got AI that's like talking to a real person, smart buildings that touch the clouds, and cars that don't need roads. People's lives are easier, faster, more connected. But with all this tech comes questions. Big corporations, the ones behind these innovations, they're making life better, sure. But at what cost? They're everywhere, in everything, watching, controlling everything you do. Flying High is a behind the scenes look at our revered superheroes Solar and Eclipse, who despite insurmountable obstacles have a habit of coming out on top… of each other. And what you and I didn't know is that there's only one thing that superheroes love more than fighting crime and that's... fucking. And we have it all on video! [From Steam]

title: Sakura no Kioku
description: Returning the forgotten memories— an Omegaverse mother and daughter yuri story. One day, when I woke up, I was alone. The happiness I thought would last forever ended far too soon. The phone call that came on an early Autumn day was the first crack. Later, it would end up spelling out the loss of everything. [Translated from DLsite]

title: Re-Imagined
description: A short visual novel game about discovering the mystery behind yourself. [From itch.io]

title: Hell of a Date
tags: Heroine Based on a Mythological Character
Protagonist Based on a Mythological Character
description: You’re Heraclea, and after eleven grueling labors, Queen Eurysthea has one last task for you: capture Cerberus and bring it back. You’re exhausted, but hey…how bad could a three-headed dog be? Hades greets you warmly and guides you to the den. Somehow, this feels almost…too easy. [From Itch.io]

title: Nukumori ni Shizumu -The Warmth Meant Just for Me-
title_original: ぬくもりに沈む -The Warmth Meant Just for Me-

title: Alsmic Lizzi
title_original: アルスミック・リズィ
description: Is there such a thing as "love"? —I want to shatter the bond we called "sisterhood". The catalyst for this desire was a play I saw back in middle school, performed by the drama club. The lead actress, Anri Shu, captivated the audience with her beauty and acting. Since then, my feelings kept growing inside me, until I finally realized it was "love". But the closer we were, the harder it became to confess. I was too afraid of losing the unique bond we shared as "sisters"... [Translated from Novelgame]

title: Maneater
description: When the world is overrun by demons, you decide to be a responsible little citizen and stay home. But your girlfriend seems to have other plans. Selfish plans. [From itch.io]

title: Andersen's Absolute Absolution
description: Sumiho was born into a life of expectations, a puppet of family and fate. Scarred and transformed, she must navigate a world where angels guide her but humans misunderstand. To reclaim herself, she must embrace her divine transformation and confront the chains of her past.

title: a dialect for two
description: "The footage depicts two women. They eat together. If it's dessert, they will share the spoon back and forth. One eats, the other waits politely for their turn. When they're down to the last mouthful, the one whose turn it is will halve it and pass it back. They have mastered handholding in all its forms, but their favourites are to intertwine fingers, and to clasp their little fingers together. Most recently, they began to finish each other's sentences. As we understand it, the two are "lovers". They document their lives in film, as follows." [From itch.io]

title: My Darling Dark Elf
description: Nienke is a dark elf who lives in the small, sleepy village of Alpenrose. Though beautiful, Alpenrose is secluded, and it boasts exactly one family of dark elves: Nienke's. Nienke was singled out and teased for most of her childhood owing to her unusual appearance, and it doesn't help that a nasty childhood illness left her shorter and slighter than the rest of her peers. Nienke was always an outcast, but she never minded it - or, at least, she tried not to. She had her best friend Cornelia, and she wasn't lonely... Until Cornelia leaves Alpenrose to attend university, leaving Nienke behind. Nienke would love to attend university herself, but her overprotective parents don't want to let her stray too far afield owing to her delicate health. Nienke has to stay at home instead, where her parents can keep an eye on her, and help out at her parents' café, Fleur de Lys. Nienke is already twenty, but her parents still treat her like a child. Her every day is the same, and she's bored of the daily grind... Until a fellow dark elf called Merel pays Nienke a visit. She claims to be Nienke's childhood friend, though Nienke can't remember her. Did she really used to play with a girl as aggressively cheerful and energetic as Merel... And why is Merel so freaking tall, anyway?! [From Steam]

title: One Day
description: A romantic comedy featuring "Reaper x Spirit Eye"?! (Maybe?) [From Steam]

title: Shiki Ora Ora ~Sekai ni Futari Dake~
title_original: 四季オラオラ ～世界に2人だけ～

title: Love at Vsynth Academy
description: Kasane Teto can't stop getting second place to her class rep and crush, Hatsune Miku. With rumors of a string of murders going around and a best friend who suddenly says she has something to confess, Teto's life has been getting pretty hard lately! [From itch.io]

title: She Couldn't Do Anything
description: Nothing is going Ann's way. No matter how hard she looks, there's nowhere to go, nothing to do, and no one to meet in her depressed, pandemic-ravaged town. And while the job market is bad, the dating market is worse still: Everyone who catches her eye is already taken, happily partnered up long before she ever had a chance to shoot her shot. Meanwhile, the world outside burns, and the community groups where she might would've met someone wither with it. But just as she goes to distract herself anew, there's a sudden knock at the door. Join Ann as loneliness, desperation, and an unexpected visitor take her down a dark, thrilling path that leaves her dazed, breathless, and utterly powerless... [Edited from itch.io]

title: Hai yu Yu - Ocean and Fish
description: Hanhai wakes up in an unfamiliar room, for reasons unknown, her calf cut by some sharp object. As she investigates her surroundings, she finds a male corpse in the bathroom and a mysterious room with an evil magic circle drawn on the floor... What exactly happened here? [Edited from Steam]

title: Bianca Must Die
description: After a year of planning, Whitley attempts to murder her girlfriend, Bianca. [i]“Go ahead,” says Bianca. Will you take her up on that, or listen to what she has to say? [From itch.io]

title: Coils
tags: Modern Day United States of America

title: Becoming My Landlady's Pet
description: You're Amy, a naive 22 year old trans girl trying to navigate college life, and Ashley (age 28) is simultaneously your landlady, and also your smoking hot roommate. How will you act when Ashley strikes a deal to help with your financial issues in exchange for sexual favours? [From itch.io]

title: M0ther//B04rd
description: In a dusty basement, a ratty programmer tinkers away at an android she had managed to scrounge up from the dump. A model this old is barely worth the parts it was made out of nowadays. They don't even have the necessary chips to be able to run a self-conscious schematic that the government always is getting up in arms about. It's a good thing Lydia doesn't care about any of that. Limitations are meant to be overcome, after all. With just a bit of elbow grease and know-how, this tin can is going to behave exactly how she wants it to. [From itch.io]

title: Full Fathom 500
description: A slowburn dark yuri kinetic novel about a lesbian couple who wake up to discover they are trapped one thousand metres below sea level on the morning of their first anniversary. Things may appear indistinct out in the open ocean. Perhaps it's best not to look too hard. [From itch.io]

title: Sanguis Amantis
description: Many moons ago, The Lady of All Sin collided with the Earth, bringing about an age of terror and destruction. Her acolytes, the Vestal Maidens, are beacons of purity-- ridding the wasteland of anyone who does not fall in line with their beliefs. In the cathedral of Sin, one maiden is frustrated by her loneliness, and seeks to create a companion for herself using forbidden rituals. Upon succeeding, there is only one question to be asked. Will her creation love her back? [From itch.io]

title: Original Mindfuck Animation
description: Dr. Neuroflay's finally done it: she's found the specimen of her desires to conduct long-awaited research. The brain and nerves of the physics-warping magical girl, Graviko, are guaranteed to hold the universe's deepest secrets, at least according to the mad scientist. What distorted fruit will Neuroflay's efforts bear? [From itch.io]

title: SWIM4SWIM
description: The 2026 USA Swimming Futures Championships are scheduled to take place from July 29 to August 1, 2026. On a sunny fourteenth of July in Lake Ontario, I keep my promise. [From itch.io]

title: WHAT HATH GOD WROUGHT
description: With the dawn of the 21st century came the Great Crash — a worldwide data catastrophe that wiped entire cities off the map, and swallowed the Internet whole. Three years later, the Chicago post-Crash zone is a carefully monitored wasteland, patrolled by those who seek to contain it. Rachel is a data scientist, running experiments for her thesis. Lori is a fixer, just trying to make ends meet. This is the story of their failure. [From itch.io]

title: catching fish from the bottom of a river
description: Trapped in a mahjong match, two girls must find a way to win – if they don't tear each other apart first. [From itch.io]

title: Half Step Princess
description: Gwendolyn Baker, grade ten, is the new student in her fencing club. Shy and petite, an only child, she's never been very talented at sports, and she finds herself lost and frozen in the shadow of a city which seems to be fading away. Despite her anxieties, delinquent Charlotte (club ace and her upperclassman), Joanna (standoffish private school princess), and Hannah Abigail (know-it-all beauty) all set eyes on her. A haze of suburban angst and foiled romances hangs over the autumn landscape while Gwen falls into a canopy of bitter rivalries. [From itch.io]

title: Rudolf's Very Good, No Bad Day-o
description: A fanmade Umamusume visual novel. Two years after their last encounter, Symboli Rudolf and Sirius Symboli meet in a restaurant.

title: Cage
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: "In a victorian-esque era, Rudolf is the lady's maid of a bride-to-be Sirius..." [From itch.io]

title: NO MATTER HOW STRANGE
description: I KNOW TOO MUCH ABOUT YOU [From itch.io]

title: Calamity Cait
description: "You have to say the words. I can't say them for you." In a sleepy coastal town, Cait watches whales. It's her job, and she might even say she's good at it. But there's more to life than whales, and Cait is on a mission to find out exactly what that means. Her sights are set on Molly, a coworker and friend, or maybe something more. Cait is never really sure where things stand. There's only one way to know for certain. "Mhm. We're all unremarkable. What else?" Step into the shoes of Cait and experience a day of monotony, yearning, subtle glances, absurd conversations, self-loathing, binge-drinking, pub food, and so much more. "We were put on this earth to suffer, but we weren't meant to suffer alone." Littered throughout Cait's life are people with struggles of their own. Each has a story to tell, and Cait is always more than willing to listen. She'll take all the life advice she can get. From the Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4200450/Calamity_Cait/

title: Sokubaku
description: Main heroine is longing for her elite boss sent over from the head office. She gladly accepts her boss' invitation for a meal. The darkness in her heart is growing... [From vndbreview]

title: Kindan no Paradise
description: Saori drifts to the island where the two female tribes confront compete for the selection of a next queen. Saori will search for "the dew of love of the goddess" which is a condition for becoming a queen . [From vndbreview]

title: Gram Cats 2
description: Marine and Sayaka arrive to the Scherer Island which is known as a luxury resort with a great hotel and famous nudist beach. Their goal is to investigate island secretly for the traces of an alien base. [From vndbreview]

title: Datenshi Kyouko Part 1
description: A part of "Sexy voice" series. Three esper fallen angels are sent to Kyoko to play with her. [From vndbreview]

title: Neko wa Eien o Shitteiru no ka.
title_original: 猫は永遠を知っているのか。
description: Office lady x schoolgirl short yuri game. An OL who died inside many years ago is changed by an encounter with a goddess, and meets a cursed schoolgirl... [From DLsite English]
full_description: Office lady x schoolgirl short yuri game. An OL who died inside many years ago is changed by an encounter with a goddess, and meets a cursed schoolgirl... [From DLsite English]

title: Kashimashi ~Girl Meets Girl~ "Hajimete no Natsu Monogatari."
title_original: かしまし ～ガール・ミーツ・ガール～ 「初めての夏物語。」
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: Based on the manga and anime series by Satoru Akahori of the same name. The game's story begins on the outset of summer vacation. Hazumu's homeroom teacher Namiko Tsuki suggests Hazumu and her friends take a one-week trip to a small mountain village with a hot spring resort. Hazumu's grandparents reside in this town, and are two new characters introduced to the story. Three other female characters are introduced as possible love interests for Hazumu; two are the same age as her, and the third is the older landlady of the resort. The goal of the game is to pair Hazumu up with one of the five female cast of characters. The gameplay's main system comes from Hazumu's indecisive personality. If the player shows more interest in a particular character, the other characters get annoyed that Hazumu is ignoring them, which is displayed in a tension meter. The more Hazumu ignores a particular character, the higher the tension between that character becomes. This ensures Hazumu stays good friends with the possible love interests. In order to view the ending of a particular character, a certain amount of tension will have to be between the other characters, but this cannot be too great or the ending will not show. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Osaragi Hazumu
characters.description: Osaragi Hazumu is a student, born male, at Kashima high school in the fictional setting of Kashima ward in Tokyo, and is the main character in the series. Hazumu is very selfless, thinking of others before herself and worries about her friends greatly. One day Hazumu is pressured by his friends Tomari and Asuta to confess to Yasuna. She rejects him, which hurts Hazumu heavily. He goes up to Mt. Kashima, but while up there an alien spacecraft crash-lands on him, seriously injuring him. In order to rectify this mishap, and in accordance with his own laws, the alien resurrects Hazumu, but in the process unexpectedly changes his sex to be completely female, right down to the DNA level. Shortly after Hazumu's transformation, she is unsure on how to live life as a girl and is initially very clueless about typical female matters. Despite Hazumu's physical change, there is not much change in her

characters.name: Kamiizumi Yasuna
characters.description: Kamiizumi Yasuna is a student at Kashima high school and has been Hazumu's classmate since their first year of high school. [spoiler]Ever since she was born, Yasuna has had a unique affliction which makes her incapable of seeing males, and instead to her males are covered in a gray, hazy blur, which makes it extremely difficult for her to tell one male apart from another except through the sound of their voice. Due to this, she was never able to get along well with others; on top of not being able to see the boys in her class at school, the girls who would normally interact with them were different compared to Yasuna, which built up a divide between her and everyone else. She ended up staying alone for years, and she thought she did not mind it; she did not intend to befriend anyone anyway. However, when she stumbled across Hazumu one day in her first year of high school, she was shocked

characters.name: Kurusu Tomari
characters.description: Kurusu Tomari is a student at Kashima high school and is a classmate of Hazumu's in their second year. Tomari is also Hazumu's childhood friend. Hazumu would often get bullied as a child, and Tomari would have to come to his rescue, saying that she would protect him forever. Tomari is very athletic and competitive, so in high school she joined the track and field club. In contrast to Hazumu and Yasuna who are not athletes and rather feminine, Tomari is a tomboy who does not often partake in traditionally feminine things such as clothing, shopping, or cosmetics. At least two of Tomari's female friends on the track team consider her very masculine, and like her cool character; one of these friends even says that if Tomari were a boy that she would have a huge crush on her. [From Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Mari Ayuki
characters.description: Mari Ayuki is a student at Kashima high school and is a classmate of Hazumu's in their second year. As a child, she used to love watching caterpillars leave their chrysalises and turn into butterflies. However, she never once thought that she herself would want to be in a similar position—changing into something else—so she merely just enjoyed watching the transformation before her. That by itself is enough for her, she recounts to Hazumu. Using this as a metaphor, Ayuki tries to explain to Hazumu that watching her loved one from afar is its own variety of love, though Ayuki never explicitly states just who she admires from a distance. Ayuki is good friends with Tomari, and Ayuki will often give her, and others, advice and help in regards to relationships. characters.description: Jan Pu is an artificial intelligence owned by Hitoshi Sora as the automatic pilot of his spaceship. [spoiler]Her first appearance has her in disembodied form as the navigator of Hitoshi's ship and she is responsible for the crash landing on Earth and for nearly killing Hazumu. When Hitoshi comes to Earth to live in Hazumu's house, he constructs a gynoid modeled after Hazumu's own new female body, so Jan Pu looks about the same age as Hazumu, and their faces bear a striking resemblance. Jan Pu has the unique ability of levitation, and is able to bend light around her so others cannot see her. Other than technically being an artificial being, she generally acts like a human child due to being enthusiastic about meeting new people and possessing little to no social skills for a girl who looks to be the age of seventeen. characters.description: Tsuki Namiko is an English teacher at Kashima high school, and is the homeroom teacher of Hazumu's class. As she often proclaims, she has lived for thirty-five years and has never had a single boyfriend. This has enabled her to devote most of her time and energy into her students at school, but she is still lonely. When Hitoshi starts to work as her coworker at school, she becomes instantly infatuated by him, and goes to extreme lengths to show her devotion and mania towards her precious Hitoshi Sora. Namiko's attraction towards Hitoshi borders on obsession as she hangs large pictures of him on her walls at her home, and constantly is thinking or dreaming about him. However, since Hitoshi's species cannot express emotions, the attraction is entirely one-sided. [From Wikipedia.]

characters.description: Asuta Soro is a student at Kashima high school and is a classmate of Hazumu's in their second year. After Hazumu's transformation into a girl, Asuta suddenly finds his good friend Hazumu very attractive, and cannot help himself when he starts thinking about Hazumu in a sexual way. [From Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Sora Hitoshi
characters.description: Sora Hitoshi is the space alien responsible for transforming Hazumu from male to female. He arrived to Earth via his spaceship run by an artificial intelligence named Jan Pu, but crash lands on the surface [spoiler] where Hazumu is, killing him instantly. Hitoshi rectifies this by regenerating Hazumu, but unexpectedly changes his physical sex in the process. This is a mystery to Hitoshi for some time until he is finally able to confirm that Hazumu's "life grain" count is slowly dissipating, and by the time Hitoshi confirms this, Hazumu only has one month left to live. Hitoshi originally came to Earth as a cultural anthropologist and to study the emotions of the human race since his species has long-since given up any emotion at all. title: Euphoric Create ~Stairs of Affection~
description: Set in the far, far future-- Due to the development of a drug that makes one's fantasies materialize called "DesireIn", the people of the world live their lives soaked in these fantasies, and the concept of social links between people has been lost. Paying attention only to their fantasies, being totally apathetic to others and living a solitary life has become the common sense of the world. The main character, Nadeshiko, is a government worker living in such a world. Unlike the government workers of past times, in this world they act as emotionless machines, caring only for the mechanical means of continuing society. People have no dreams for their lives; and would hardly even notice if they were to die. Nadeshiko lives her life in this world passively, without holding any great dissatisfaction. However, she did nonetheless hold a certain, if only latent, feeling of gloom every now and then. If only to have a certain sense of "living"-- Unconsciously thinking this, she goes through a process of trial and error every day. Eventually, this feeling, this excitement, she begins to feel to some small degree when the numbers of "Insane" people increase rapidly, and they are culled for the good of the state. Then on one such day, Nadeshiko meets a girl named Momo. Momo lives in a way totally idiosyncratic enough to be wholly contrary to this society; pushing through life with a vivacity and earnestness wholly her own. Almost the moment they meet, she gives Nadeshiko a confession of love. Being in contact with Momo to some extent feels like a bother to her; but she also gains a sense of living that far outshines the culling or anything else she knows. However, after this she also comes to that Momo holds a certain deep "darkness" inside of her -- which causes an even greater attraction towards her.

title: Flowers Of Starlight
description: Aster's a simple girl, at her core. All she really wants to do is enjoy her new life at uni, join a club, and spend every possible waking moment playing Magica Fantasia Online (she's not addicted) with her online crush Starsiren. She's gonna tell her, OK? Just... when they meet up for MagiCon. Honest. However, a teeny tiny complication arises on her first day at uni, when Aster just so happens to bump into Maristela, the single prettiest girl she's ever seen in her entire life. And she's not just pretty. Mari's smart, she's funny, and Aster would happily listen to her ramble for hours about whatever the heck she wants to, if only she had a little more courage to do so. Torn between the friend she's loved forever, and the new girl who it feels like she's always known, Aster faces the toughest decision imaginable, and she's not even been here for a week! A game about love, new experiences, and the fact that nerdy neurodivergent girls are cute and you should date them. [From Itch.io]
