title: Tell me tonight was real
description: A game about being honest to yourself, and about friends with benefits becoming lovers. Or something close to it. January 8th. A national holiday. The day of the People’s Freedom. It celebrates the end of the final battle between the old regime and the revolutionary army. Now, for most it doesn’t mean much, there isn’t much left of the revolutionary republic. It's just another day to celebrate with friends and to get off work early. And here today is where Curtis finds herself. Off work early and looking forward to spending the day with someone dear to the vampire. One miss Soledad. She wonders what today will bring her, and how she'll end the day, but one thing is certain. Soledad will make this day into a special one. Tell me tonight was real is a visual novel, about friends with benefits turning into lovers, vampires and their cruelty, mental health getting in the way of your drinking, and bars close to the beach. [From Itch.io]

title: Pillow talk at the end of all things.
description: A calm and quiet night in Rio de Janeiro. That is until you hear a shot. And another. And yet another one. The timing gets faster, with more shots, shots with different sounds. You wake up and realize something is happening in the favela nearby. Either gang violence or state violence, you never really know. That's the same situation where Lenon finds herself for the first time, and now it's up for her "friend" Graves to help her not to panic. It's just another night in Rio, and you know things will move on as always after that. Pillow Talk at the end of all things is a small yuri visual novel about trying to get calm during a time when violence is commonplace, and expected. Follow Lenon and Graves during what is just another night in the Cidade Maravilhosa. [From Itch.io]

title: All The Things You Said
description: This tiny bitsy novel picks up on the story of Lola, a queer sexworker. After meeting with Emily, who was supposed to be her last client, Lola returns to her apartment, where she accidentally runs into her roommate and their new partner. [From Itch.io]

title: Fashion Contract
description: Fashion designer Jessica and her model friend Rebecca want to rise in their careers, and they join the fashion show. Both girls can help each other at this event. [From Steam]

title: Where the Anemones Bloom
description: Cordelia leads a life that most mermaids would envy. She has close friends and is part of a prominent pod, her future is all planned out. But Cordelia isn’t most mermaids. When her pod moves to the coast, she’s warned about the forbidden shallows and the dangers that lurk beyond. She’s heard all the rumours of course, but none of her friends will go near it. Curiosity gets the better of Cordelia, and she soon finds herself trembling at the fearful lights and hum of this strange city. However, something - someone actually - has also caught her eye. What starts as mere curiosity blossoms into something far more interesting. Soon Cordelia questions who she really is, and what she really wants. As she ventures further into uncharted territory, she gets closer to love but further from who she is and what she knows. Will she risk it all for a taste of the forbidden? [From Itch.io]

title: For the First Time
description: Felicity is the CEO of the biggest tech conglomerate in the country. After the news of her husband's disappearance breaks, she tells you that you need to talk. Felicity then reveals everything she's been holding in. And for the first time, she can be herself. [From Itch.io]

title: In The Rain
description: One rainy day, fate allows to girls to meet... but what will happen next? What will become of these two souls? [from itch.io]

title: Echoes of You
description: Echoes of You is a point n click visual novel about leaving behind a loved one and remember them for life. Play as a Vivienne, a vampire, who decides to visit her girlfriend's house one last time. [from Itch.io]

title: Left Hand Magic
description: A talented Battlemage, you are struggling to find work for your type of magic in a post-industrial (Magitek/Magic Punk) world that no longer has much need for battle magic. To be fair, you were warned about this. Your parents, your friends, even your instructors at university all pointed out that Battle Magic, once the most important of all fields, has long lost its purpose. The monsters are all dead or uplifted to being civilized. Dungeons all long since discovered, looted, and destroyed. Even warfare is now dominated by magitek warmachines and tools, all the products of artificers and enchanters. But...battle magic was what you were good at, a prodigy by any measure. And you had a passion for wielding the elements in destructive ways anyway. Who doesn't want to light things of fire or fry bad guys with lightning?! You ignored them all and mastered your area of expertise, graduating from the most prestigious magical academy on the continent! Too bad that no one needs you now... Down on your luck, skipping from menial job to menial job, you're unexpectedly recruited by Left Hand Solutions, a company that's made up of similar people, each trying to find positive uses for their particular types of magic in the modern world. Given that those include Blood Magic, Necromancy, and Summoning...you wonder if they aren't just a little bit insane. Even so, the pay is good and the staff are all friendly...and female. Maybe this won't be so bad? [From Patreon]

title: Touhou Chaotic Couple Comedy
description: A Romantic Sitcom in Gensokyo starring a Chaotic Couple! In this Visual Novel with Minigames, join Ichirin and Futo on their romantic misadventures, featuring kooky costumes, exciting card games, a giant floating cloud, and more! [from Itch.io]

title: Grand-Nya
description: Hinako eats, and does not cook. Aysu cooks, and does not eat. This catgirl and moonlight vampire have been married for quite some time, and complete each other, like sun and moon. But in a cosy afternoon full of memories, and Aysu cooking for the woman she loves, there is something not quite right. Aysu knows what it is, just like she knows exactly what her wife is craving, every time. Even so, maybe you can help give her a nudge in the right direction. [from itch.io]

title: Fawning Over a Corpse
description: Dana and Fawn are a perfectly average couple; they rent an apartment together, they're going to get married when the time is right, and there is absolutely nothing wrong with Fawn. Dana knows that her dearest fiancée is perfectly fine. ...As long as she ignores Fawn's ever-growing, all-consuming hunger. But averting her gaze is starting to become more and more difficult by the moment. [from itch.io]

title: That Time I got Reincarnated as a Refrigerator! (and started flirting with elves)
description: This story is told through the cringe weeb that is Emma who has had her greatest wish fulfilled: to star in her very own isekai. A genre of anime that sees the protagonist transported into another world upon their death. Often it's a vehicle that kills them. In Emma's case, she was flattened by a fat dump truck (still talking about vehicles). Many people wouldn't be too thrilled about that. Emma is different though. She's a weeb. And miraculously she really does get reincarnated in another world. But not in the body she was hoping. [from itch.io]

title: Her Majesty's Mirror
description: Dizzy after meeting the most beautiful maiden in the human village, a Vampire Queen returns to see her magic Mirror, only to find that her doom has been set in stone. [from itch.io]

title: The Words I'd Never Said
description: Somethings must come to an end, but it's the words left unsaid that can hurt the most... [from itch.io]

title: Mikuri Sacrament
description: “At the end of the world, a girl leaves behind her femininity and locks her heart in ice." A story of Mikuri's past and her meeting with Megi and Angelica from her point of view. [Taken from official website]

title: Glass Wing Gauze
description: "I've never thought of myself as someone interesting or noteworthy, that's why I was surprised when a beautiful girl approached me at school and suddenly just confessed her love to me, despite never having met her before. I can't explain it, but being around her just makes me feel safe ... Protected. I wonder what can I learn about her and if it's somehow connected to this strange pink feathers I keep finding around, my research says they're an omen from the heavens but ... What could it all mean?" [From Itch.io]

title: Crimson and Vermilion
description: This is a short yuri visual novel featuring several Touhou ships. [edited from jtch.io]

title: Love You to Bits
description: In Love You to Bits, follow the adventure of Layla, a girl who just made an entire AI on her own! How will her silly project evolve? What impact will it have on her friendships? That's for you to find out! [From Itch.io]

title: Feathers & All
description: Miss Nevermore arrives at the country estate of a family friend. Summer has begun to bleed out at the hands of fall, and the city has been buzzing since the hottest of days, about the affairs of house Noblesse. Apparently one of their children has gone missing. They had run away to be with their darling, leaving the next eldest to carry on the burden of their family name. Miss Nevermore has heard the whispers from behind closed doors, however. And rumour has it… That the truth is far more malicious below the neatly smoothed out surface. The doors creak open. Time to see if the rumours are true. [from itch.io]

title: Déjà Brew
description: Déjà Brew is a Fire Emblem: Awakening-themed yuri visual novel. You play as Severa, who finds herself in a cute little coffee shop having a date with her girlfriend, Lucina. Everything is perfect, and nothing could possibly go wrong! Sit down, have another latte, and don’t worry your pretty little head about any of the harsh realities of the real world. … Right? [from itch.io]

title: Shizumeru Rakuen
description: Two college girls committed suicide by throwing themselves onto the isolated island of Rakubijima in the Seto Inland Sea at the end of summer. Why did they choose to die? What happened during their "last day" on the island? What is the "answer" you will give after tracing the memories of the two girls and learning the truth and the end of the story......? [Translated from Steam]

title: Trick or Treat
description: A 3rd-person visual novel where you play as Kara, a young woman going trick-or-treating on a mysterious street where you have to guess the candy in order to receive it. Do your best and you might endear yourself to someone enough to have a truly memorable Halloween night! [From itch.io]

title: Lightkeeper
description: You're the Princess of Lumien, the Kingdom of Light. You find yourself waking up in a cold, dark lighthouse. With no memories of how you got there and no magic to defend yourself, you search through your new prison for anything to help your… predicament. [From itch.io]

title: Howdy, Pardner!
description: Girls? Falling in love. Boys? Falling in wells. "Howdy, Pardner!" is a short, sweet little wild-west themed dating sim. You are the mayor’s daughter, and when a gorgeous outlaw lady comes to rob your stagecoach, you concoct a plan with her to rob the town bank and free yourself from Crimestead and flee to Pride Canyon. [From itch.io]

title: Star Crossed
description: Clara, a kindly barmaid with a secret identity. Laila, a policewoman determined to uphold justice in a corrupt city. As their paths collide, the lines between ally and adversary become obscured. Clara is torn between her duty to rebel against the Father, the regime's leader, and the unexpected emotions within her heart. Laila, committed to her duty, is drawn to the mysterious barmaid in ways that may challenge her convictions. Will Clara follow her heart or will duty prevail over desire? Explore the depths of love, betrayal, and sacrifice in this visual novel where the choices you make will shape their destiny! [Edited from itch.io]

title: Tier Gamma Yuri Ship
description: The Overlord has divined Flora a match and sent her to a tier gamma honeymoon with the lady in question. Nothing weird about this. That's how love life is on planet Overlord. However, to her great dismay, Flora soon learns that her supposed princess charming is far below her: a lowly loiter from the Pits, of all things. [From itch.io]

title: Snowed in with Sophie
tags: Protagonist's Non-blood-related Sister as a Heroine
Protagonist's Younger Sister as a Heroine
description: Light's been snowed in with her sister Sophie, though its cold outside, its about to get hot in here. Will the tensions between them dissolve their relationship, or build to something far more intimate? [From itch.io]

title: Strings of Fate
description: Welcome to Strings of Fate. See the past by playing your grandma's violin, and through it mend the hurt town of Everfrost. [Edited from itch.io]

title: Steam and Sorcery
description: Steam and Sorcery is a fully-animated NSFW kinetic visual novel set in a world of magic that is slowly being overtaken by the rise of technology. The story follows a young woman named Zaza who is struggling to find her way in this changing world, pursuing her ambitions to be a powerful witch by seeking an apprenticeship with the most prolific mage in the city, Marion Rubie. But things turn out to be harder than Zaza had previously considered when she discovers her mentor is a lot more strict than she had expected.

title: Erotic Photoshoot
description: Nancy is secretly in love with her hobby friend, and one day she gets a chance to win her heart! [From Steam]

title: Wanmei Lianren ~fragile love
description: This is a story about promises and redemption. They were childhood inseparable playmates, but when we said goodbye, they were strangers They don't like each other, but they also attract each other, They are incompatible opponents of fire and water, and they are a perfect match for lovers. [From Steam]

title: Angelblood
description: You are Quin, a witch shopkeeper at the Crossroad of Worlds. Strange customers come and go, but nothing has prepared you to meet the Vampiric Angel, Seraphix. [From itch.io]

title: Echoes of Eternity
description: What do you do when even death won't grant you peace? When Era died, she was told of an afterlife filled with glimmering tranquillity. The reality was far from it. Forced to place her trust in a mysterious cloaked figure, she is sent to live through small fragments of her past, tasked with coming to terms with the horrors of her life in order to seek an afterlife of peace. [From itch.io]

title: About the Journey: Closing the Distance
tags: Modern Day United States of America
Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: After 10 years apart, childhood friends Freya and Ophelia are reunited! Together, they embark on a 3,500-mile, coast-to-coast rail journey across the United States. Confined to their small cabin, their friendship is reignited and tested like never before. Can the two girls overcome the time and distance that has separated them for so long, and how will their relationship evolve if they can? [From itch.io]

title: Sex Adventures - Mile High Club
description: A visual novel about two young flight attendants naughty adventures on an empty private jet. An empty flight can be boring and the girls decide to make their flight more enjoyable. Giuliana and Chanel are two VIP air hostesses working on a private jet. They ensure that their passengers receive a premium, 5-star service on every trip. After a demanding day of serving celebrities, royals, self-made entrepreneurs and oligarchs, the women realize that they have the whole plane just for themselves. The two start to fool around, being firmly convinced that no one will catch them. The atmosphere changes when Giuliana invites Chanel to take a shower with her, under the pretext that it would be better to “save water”. Will they join the MILE HIGH CLUB? Let’s see what these two VIP air hostesses have in mind. [From Itch.io]

title: Marin's Expansion Delivery - Chapter 2
description: Marin here! I'm all done with deliveries for today! Now I have to go back to my shop and restock. Also, I have some potions that I need to test out before I can use them on customers... Good thing my assistant is always there for me ♥ [From itch.io]

title: Sweet Cravings
description: A stylist witch falls for the cute waitress at the new bakery in town. Shenanigans ensue. [From itch.io]

title: Seeing Stars
description: You and your girlfriend, Nienna, have been living together for a while now. As an alien with the ability to read minds, you've had enough time to discover that hers is quite messy sometimes! Over the course of a week, your task is to be there for her as she regresses to old habits. [From itch.io]

title: Princess Knight
description: Follow Princess Calliope as she changes things up and tries to rescue her own knight after a kidnapping gone wrong! With her loyal friend Harper, she'll make sure to have her back in no time at all! What could go wrong? [From itch.io]

title: Never Trust a Fox
description: Kylie is nearing a breaking point. Between a draining job, a strict boss, and constant lack of sleep, her life has become a monotonous routine. Her only escape is quiet evenings with a bottle of whiskey in her own apartment. But the peace and quiet will be no more. Now she's stuck living with Rin, her mom's friend's daughter, who's about to get kicked out of college. She blows off her studies, hangs out in nightclubs, and loves to provoke Kylie, relentlessly invading her personal space. At first, Kylie chalks it up to a bad personality. But the longer they live together, the more alarming and strange Rin's behavior becomes, and her self-destructive streak borders on obsession. [From Steam]

title: Sorry Do I Know You?
description: [i]I bump into her on my way home. I don't recognise her. So why does she claim she knows me? Sorry Do I Know You? is a psychological horror game about navigating a conversation with a woman who seems to know who you are, even if you don't. [From Itch.io]

title: LA LA LOU
description: You dumped your now ex-girlfriend Angie, who has disappeared after spamming your calls and text messages for weeks on end. It is today that she decides to show up at your job... To talk about her issues? Seriously? [From itch.io]

title: Comet Angel
tags: Modern Day United States of America
description: Izzy and Nat break out of their boring summer routine when they make the discovery of a lifetime: an alien living at the bottom of a nearby pond. The mysterious creature, which they name Faerie, asks them for help returning to its home on a passing comet in exchange for showing the girls their futures. As they search for scrap metal to feed their new celestial friend, Izzy and Nat suddenly realize Faerie's influence is spreading far beyond what they expected. Lost in the purgatory between adolescence and adulthood, they find themselves staring down the long and perilous road to self-acceptance. [From itch.io]

title: A Zombie Head Went Missing at the Party Full of CUTE MONSTER GIRLS!?
description: Half gorgon Jade Mason finds herself dragged to a party full of monsters, she doesn't have high hopes. Between her fears of not fitting in and her ever-present anxiety, she's prepared for everything to go wrong. Of course, she never expected a missing zombie head to be the reason the evening goes awry! With the help of some (cute) monster girls, will Jade be able to solve the mystery and turn the night around? [From itch.io]

title: To Constrict and To Suffocate
description: Maca, a curious sea creature, forms a deep connection with Lyra, a cynical human who frequents the coast. As their bond grows, Maca desires to "own" Lyra, while Lyra hides her own feelings behind sarcasm. The story focuses on conversations that Maca and Lyra have as something sweet and bitter blooms within them... [From itch.io]

title: HANASU ~Girls Kiss At The End Of The World~
description: HANASU ～Girls Kiss At The End Of The World～ is a short kinetic novel about finding small joys even in the most dire of situations. After the news of a meteor strike that is to bring the apocalypse in a few hours breaks out, Hana runs away from home and finds herself standing on her school's rooftop. "It's pretty from up here, isn't it?" Underneath a bright blue sky, she meets Charlotte, a bright a cheerful girl with an allure that's hard to describe. As the cold wind blows, the two reflect on their lives as they share their insecurities and bond over being alone and forgotten in a world that's about to end. Once their time runs out, will they be able to go out with a smile? [From itch.io]

title: Watashi wa Loop o Kurikaeshitai
title_original: 私はループを繰り返したい

title: Yakusoku no Sequentia
title_original: 約束のセクエンティア

title: Remake
description: Something is wrong with Whince. But her girlfriend says that with a bit of reprogramming, she can be fixed. [From itch.io]

title: Lady's Tourney
description: A reward tournament is planned in the town, and the young demoness needs money. But even more, she wants to win the heart of a cute fairy elf, who, it seems, is ready to reciprocate her!.. [From Steam]

title: Void Hyperion
description: In the far future, humanity has taken to the stars and found monsters known as Voidlings. A captain of the human Empire is assigned a suicide mission to destroy the nest of a Void Queen near the Empire's borders. However, unbeknownst to her, those by her side may have different thoughts. An omegaverse sci-fi yuri visual novel. [From itch.io]

title: Three Kisses in Upper Planetary Orbit
description: After escaping from an oppressive empire via stolen spaceship, Tiramisu has settled into a comfortable life as the group's sole pilot. But when a rules obsessed supervisor, Flan, asks for her help with organizing a ship wide event, Tira must pull out all the stops to ensure her high-strung superior doesn't go unteased. As the two try to organize everyone on the ship, you decide how Tira will treat Flan: as a partner to be worked with, a princess to be attended to, or as a pet to be looked after. [From itch.io]

title: The Mysterious Thief, Forget Me Not
description: Dazzling phantom thief heists, romantic meetings in the dead of night, and making a name for yourself; The Mysterious Thief, Forget Me Not is a mostly linear visual novel that features multiple POVs throughout. The story is set in the fictional city of Twinbells, England, and shows how the lives of our four main characters are changed forever when a ballet company — and its treasured jewel — visits the phantom thief-loving city. [From itch.io]

title: Snow White and Rose Red
tags: Protagonist Based on a Fictional Person
description: Join Snow White and her sister, Feathersoft, in a magical winter fairy-tale land! As they search for the rare alpine rose, they meet a mysterious bear who becomes their friend. Will their journey be filled with challenging hardships, or will they discover their true happily ever after? Find out in this cute yuri retelling of the classic Grimm Brothers fairy-tale! Snow White and Rose Red! [From itch.io]

title: R.U.B.Y. Xunchang Jiaozhi de Richang
description: Four ordinary stories about four ordinary girls. Sometimes, people's lives intertwine without anyone realizing it, resulting in subtle changes to their daily routines. Sometimes these changes are so small that people don't notice them. Other times, the changes can be drastic, catching people off guard... [Translated from Steam]

title: Snow Spire
tags: Protagonist's Brother as a Support Character
description: You are a researcher in the emerging field of meteorology. All your life, there has been one storm no one could understand—a blizzard that has raged for decades. But now, it’s getting worse. You and your brother venture into the storm to investigate. [From itch.io]

title: Mail To The Moon
description: A princess is trapped in the dark side of the Moon when a space pirate crashes in. Both mesmerized, they decide to become pen pals. Follow them to see how their romance develops. Will they be able to get together? [From itch.io]

title: Medusa
description: Misaki is a...Well, not so ordinary girl. After a few successes on her essay during the junior year, Misaki got invited to a cross college event that involved a few of the international colleges. During the party, Misaki accidentally overheard a conversation from a familiar voice, then quickly recognized the student from the other college: Midzuki Mizuki...... [From itch.io]

title: Dimensional Prophecy of Zohar Redux Layer 3: Porcupine Problems
description: Months after the Caine incident, mysterious couriers get killed in Kyoto Novalis. They transport a strange, extraterrestrial freight for an unknown recipient. This is a dark conspiracy which involves the Structures of the CFG institute. Meanwhile, Karala has her first day at her new school.

title: after the bell
description: You play as a recently deceased student who can’t remember her name and upon awakening as a ghost, she feels a strong urge to return to her school to look for her real name. explore the school, talk to a few other ghostly students, maybe grab some things for them and uncover your name! This game features a small bonus folder for when you achieve the true ending.

title: Serpent Wine
description: Selindae, the wandering swordswoman, and Lynolell, maiden of the forest, are in love. Together they travel, seeking adventure and happiness. One day in the wilderness, Lynolell tells her a strange legend from her village, about a snake that could bring true bliss and happiness to women in love. But even if it does exist, can such a creature be so easily caught? [From itch.io]

title: Ariel
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: Minami was like every other girl: talkative, attractive and sensitive, also loves the beach---Not until she loses her father, then everything in her life has changed. This is not a sad, tragic mermaid story; This is just another corny, cheesy story of an ordinary girl who is a little obsessed with her childhood best friend. [From itch.io]

title: Of Rose and Moon
description: A powerful dungeon lies in the depths of the earth, filled with lavish treasures. Enticed by the promise of wealth, many adventurers traverse the dangerous underground maze, only to be halted at the very last chamber where Callistra, the Final Boss, lies in wait. She is a powerful magic wielder and no one has yet to best her in battle. Many adventuring parties have given up trying to challenge Callistra at all, leaving the dungeons before reaching the Final Boss. In turn, Callistra has become terribly bored of her position and wishes to be free from it. Her monotonous life is finally broken up by Ruth, a brave knight that refuses to give up in defeating the Final Boss and defeating the dungeon once and for all. Both are evenly matched and should be wary of the other, but instead other emotions arise instead... [From itch.io]

title: SISTERPHILE
description: When your beloved sister reveals her new girlfriend, it threatens the childhood promise you both swore to uphold. How far will you go to protect her… and keep that promise? [From itch.io]

title: PASSION PARADOX
description: A historian, jaded by her monotonous life, becomes obsessed with a 16th-century woman sacrificed to keep the world from ending. [From itch.io]

title: Ai to Otome to Yakisobapan
title_original: 愛と乙女と焼きそばパン

title: Anata ni Ienai Himitsu no Ibasho
title_original: あなたに言えないヒミツの居場所

title: Zhenye de Qingchen Guixia SOE
description: A fan-made sequel to Chanye's Home, created with the permission of the original developer YauYuenTong. Playing the original game first is highly recommended. Note: The writing style is very different from the original story.

title: Ne sprashivaj Sukkuba
description: Two witches, young impulsive Aurora and cold precise Erica, had to call succubus for finding "Stone of Shadows", the powerful artifact, which helps to free Erica's former partner from Interworld. But the cunning succubus has completely different plans. Especially about Aurora. The succubus is enclosed in circle and cannot use magic - unless she provokes witches to use their power. Each use of magic near the circle gradually destroys its defense. [From Steam]

title: Mechanical Relations
description: Girlfriends Fritter and Marmalade find themselves stranded on a landfill moon in the middle of space! Marmalade seems to think of it as an impromptu vacation, while Fritter is a bit more hesitant to blow off steam. Maybe some alone time is just what they need?

title: Song of the Abyss
description: A short form yuri romance told from the perspective of Cnidra, a deep sea jellyfish mermaid living in the back of a research-based aquarium. When a new intern unexpectedly hears the otherwise quiet Cnidra's Song that her silent, unchanging daily life is shaken. She begins to think about the great expanse outside of her tank and her role within it. [From Itch.io]

title: Zhan yu Zhi Chui Ying Xia ~ Flowering Across the Hakugyokurou
title_original: 绽于枝垂樱下~Flowering Across the Hakugyokurou
description: I woke up from the gap just like before. ... Why do I dreamt about things at that time? ... In this case, I haven't been to Hakugyokurou for a while. ... I drunk some tea to make myself awake. ... It's still a normal day and I didn't do anything. ... In this case, maybe I should visit Hakugyokurou. [From Steam]

title: The Last Look
description: You play as Rika - an isolated girl whose life begins to change when a mysterious program called M4R!N.̷̓̕e̷̛͗r̵̍̍r̸̩͊ő̸͝r̸̀̿ installs itself into her computer. Marin is everything Rika ever wanted: Sweet, caring, and always there. As online hate fades and praise floods in, Rika begins to feel alive again. [From Itch.io]

title: Equinox
description: It's been over a year since that dreaded autumn. Over spring break, April takes Scarlet out to the Spring Fling Dance at the botanical gardens by campus. What follows is a short story about how we take care of each other, shifting roles, and letting a relationship grow. [From Itch.io]

title: The Rabbit
description: "You heard me, be my girlfriend." The words hit me like a sledgehammer, and my heart felt like it was going to burst out of my chest. "But why?" Her thumb stopped moving and she tilted her head to the side, considering me. "Why not? You're cute when you blush." "But Cinnamon, you're not serious, are you?" Her hand remained on my leg, her thumb resuming its gentle stroking. "Why wouldn't I be? You're pretty, you're friendly, and you're obviously into me." The Rabbit is a short, kinetic visual novel that focuses on Alice and her past before the events of REVERSE. [From Itch.io]

title: Touhou: Food for the Heart
description: A fusion of a cooking game and a visual novel. The game explores Marisa's journey to understand how she feels about Sakuya. [From Itch.io]

title: Caught in Your Web
description: Camellia is over the moon when her new crush, Jane, agrees to go on a date with her. But when sightings of a serial murderer start getting too close for comfort, Camellia will have more than just romance to worry about. [From itch.io]

title: Terms of Assembly
description: Need a hand? Some lip service? A second set of eyes? In a future where a new body is just a down payment away, THESECO has an installment plan for that. Jeanne needs an arm. Margaret likes to feel appreciated – one replacement, waived fees, no questions asked. Now they're both paying the price. [From Itch.io]

title: Present/Perceptual/Consciousness
description: Present perceptual consciousness refers to the subjective experience of the current moment. – A story of pygmalion and paper dolls. – A story of a girl and her creator. [From Itch.io]

title: FORCEFUL DEVOTION
description: Calla, the beloved young queen of Deschi, has lived her entire life in selfless devotion to her country and people, until a chance encounter with a mysterious academic named Jasmine reveals a long-held secret of the royal bloodline--and brings out Calla's hidden desires. Caught between modern intrigue and ancient conspiracy, will Calla be able to seize her own destiny? [From itch.io]

title: if it's by my hand
description: The news breaks to a town that's completely unready to hear it. A terrible, tragic murder while the town slept, targeting poor, innocent students from the local high school... Everyone assumed that it was a clear-cut case of a monster targeting some unfortunate victims... ...what a joke. [From Itch.io]

title: Heavenly Amnesia
description: A guardian angel falls in love with her charge. It does not end well. A poly toxic yuri vn. [From itch.io]

title: Astral Battler Crux: Gilded Lily
description: "It makes your fights easier, doesn’t it, magical girl? Another monster of the week like your favorite PR***Y C**E." Astral Battler Crux: Gilded Lily is an 18+ kinetic visual novel about magical girls. Contains sexual content and dark themes. "Astral Battlers are heroes of justice, beautiful maidens who save ordinary folks from the wicked Crepin. I see something in you, that spark of true heroism, that spark of HER. Won't you be my Crux?" - Herald Yue "It's time to break out of this mundanity! After all, don't you want to rampage too?" - Icon Crepin Jailbreak "They said a magical girl was spotted attacking people, how is that possible? Are we in danger too?" - Bystander [From itch.io]

title: Sunflower Sanctuary
description: a dark, bite-sized visual novel depicting the lives of two dysfunctional cult members in love. made by brown lesbians for brown lesbians. [From itch.io]

title: Fool for You
description: Uh oh! The queen must marry and secure an heir, but finding a king in the streets is an easy as finding her fool in her sheets. [From itch.io]

title: A Motley Bind
description: As court jester, Isa is tasked with helping the princess cheer up before her coronation. A tall order, considering that Her Highness laughs only at her pain. [From itch.io]

title: No Mice in Heaven
description: A short drama/suspense kinetic novel about mediocrity, jealousy, obsession, salvation, postgraduate animal research, and how they affect the relationships surrounding a girl named April. Let it be known that lab conditions must remain sterile. [From itch.io]

title: Build-A-Bully
description: When 18-year-old Charity Caldwell dies in what seems to be a tragic accident, the small town of Rabbithole Hills is shocked. But not as shocked as Denver is when the dripping pink specter floats down through her ceiling, demanding she build her a perfect new body. Help perfect victim Denver try to impress her favorite tormentor with the hottest, sexiest, baddest new body she could possibly have. Sure, it won't be as good as her old one, but you'll get it as close to perfect as possible, right? Just for her? [From itch.io]

title: The Vampire's Pet
description: You recently got out of a bad long-term relationship, and your friend Millie is taking you out to a club to help you get over him. Before long, however, she gets distracted and leaves you alone at the bar. That's when you're approached by a tall beautiful stranger... [From itch.io]

title: Divine Decadence: Seduction and Fall from Grace
description: What do you expect when you get back home from a hard day of work? In the case of Daemon she expected the usual, being greeted by her partner the Fallen Angel Olibanum and that's exactly what she got, except that Olibanum was naked. [From itch.io]

title: Intimate Jest
description: A jester confesses her love to her queen.

title: There's a pretty girl on the subway
description: She has merch of like 3 different things you are also into. You keep staring at her. You wanna talk to her so bad.. Are you gonna say hi or look like a creep until she notices you? [From itch.io]

title: Stringed Seraphim Simulacrum
description: Amongst all the lovely ojou-sama schools of the world graced by The Cross, there exist a certain notorious set of four. Though no one ever calls them by their proper names, instead having adopted the sigils of the Heart, Spade, Club, and Diamond. Hidden beneath their divine facade are "mysteries" that often end in bizarre murders. Enter the Aces–students who face death without illusion, delivering justice in a world ruled by demons. When the Spades' entire student council is brutally slaughtered, only the Ace of Hearts can unravel the truth. But even she may not be ready for the horrors that await… [Edited from itch.io]

title: Immortal's Pet
description: The villagers of Anduja live an easy life thanks to the blessing of the goddess Kataja, who visits the village once every hundred years to bestow a gift of fertility upon the fields. The price is simple: a single villager, given to her, to be taken with her for reasons unknown. A hundred years have passed since the last blessing. You are the tribute to be offered to her this time. It's your turn to see what the home of the goddess is like.

title: Yuri ga Saita Umi
description: A coming-of-age story about the summer, sea, and yuri! A group of girls, including the protagonist, spend their days on an island playing in the sea and getting cozy on the beach. [From Novel Game Collection]

title: Haunt Holy
description: Everything you put on the internet is there forever. You shouldn't meet up with strangers you met online. You shouldn't believe everything you see on the internet. You shouldn't download random files. Let Haunt Holy in. [From itch.io]

title: There's Blood in my Soup
description: An evening at a hotpot restaurant goes awry, as Yuan Le discovers there’s more to her meal than meets the eye. [From itch.io]

title: If One Goes Astray
description: An unexpected encounter with a long lost love carries consequences for Lizzie and Laura. Not least because Jeanie, Jeanie's dead. ...isn't she? [From itch.io]

title: Kurumi
description: Kurumi, in short, was the protagonist. Kurumi was the brightest, most radiant girl in our ordinary world.

title: Lilac on the Bloody Thorn Path
description: Join the crew of the MBF Sprite’s Grove, privateers for the Free Planets of Macrola, as they race against a wicked trio of hostile Imperial Coalition veterans for an legendary artifact of a long-dead advanced civilization. Of course, that’s if everyone can stay on task. The Argasyl System has its means of exposing the secrets and sadistic tendencies of those who step foot on its shores, and no once-hardened heart shall go unturned. [From itch.io]
Two girls get lost in the forest. [From itch.io]

title: DJ! Join Us!
description: Aki just wanted to pursue her dreams quietly. She's a shy nerd who hides in the back of class, nursing a hopeless crush on the perfect, popular girl Miyuki. School feels lonely, but she has one place where she truly belongs: the VR Idol contest, where she performs as DJ Bugsypop! When she’s suddenly paired with the stylish, confident Idol Luvly, their duo takes off overnight. Together, Aki's dream of being a musician might really come true! Except Luvly isn’t just anyone. She’s Miyuki, the girl Aki’s admired from afar all along?! Now, without either of them realizing, they’re falling in love all over again! But if their identities ever get out? Aki might lose the one place she finally feels like she belongs. [From itch.io]

title: Bullet Biter
tags: Sex Between a Female and a Gender Non-conforming Individual
Unavoidable Heroine Rape by the Protagonist
description: Two women are drawn into a Faustian bargain, pitted against each other. [From itch.io]

title: Hildred
description: This is a story about a woman and her cartoon dog... Can one's idyllic life be achieved when there is no screen or borders between you and your creation? [From itch.io]

title: Hey, Girlie!
description: "Hey, Girlie!" is a free visual novel dating sim released on May 17, 2025 for International Day Against Homophobia, Transphobia and Biphobia. Play as chosen cleric Kristen Applebees and attempt to romance favorite sapphic characters from Fantasy High, including Tracker, Gertie, Kipperlilly, Fig, Lucy, and Naradriel.

title: JACKKNIFE
tags: Modern Day United States of America
description: A psychological horror visual novel set in the highways of rural America. You play a lone hitchhiker trying to outrun your past when a charming truck driver named Jackie offers you a ride. But as snow begins to fall, you sense that your rescuer might be far more dangerous than you expected. [Edited from itch.io]

title: Letters to Rosa
description: When missing gig worker Rosa Fuentes is suddenly found murdered, it falls upon her girlfriend and housemates to compel the city to collect her body and hold a funeral. However, her girlfriend quickly finds herself mired in the labyrinthine bureaucracy of a near-future Arcata, California, facing apathy and absurdity alike. [From itch.io]

title: The Acid Queens of the Moon
description: In the distant future of 2320, In a city-state underneath the lunar surface... Lulu's had a bad day at work and wants to get piss-drunk to kick off her weekend. But her resourceful friend Alison has another suggestion, one that will prove life changing... join Lulu on her very first acid trip as she has a chill and fun day! [From Itch.io]

title: Te iu ka, Joshi ni Kokuraretan desu kedo!?
title_original: ていうか、女子にコクられたんですけどっ!?
description: It was mid-July. The first-semester finals were over, and all that remained was to wait for summer vacation. The classroom was filled with a languid atmosphere, a pleasant drowsiness where even the noisy cicadas seemed like a lullaby. And then, suddenly, it happened. A girl hurried over to me and opened with an outrageous request: "Sorry to ask, but could you die for me?" With one demand after another being hurled at me, my mind quickly reached a state of total overload. And then, to top it all off, the girl confessed her love to me... [Translated from Novelgame]

title: To Our Lady
description: Magdalene has faithfully served Countess Erzabet for years. Her tasks are deceptively simple: obey her mistress, strive for perfection in her eyes, do not falter, do not trouble herself with the rabble, prepare her baths, meals, and her treatments... It's a dangerous dance, but one Magdalene knows well; for years her steps have not faltered. Then a new girl is brought in. A girl who threatens to upturn everything Magdalene has worked built with a mere flick of the wrist and a smile. A girl who threatens to seize her place as the Countess's favorite, and knows it. What is Magdalene to do? [Edited from itch.io]

title: Demise of A Blue Rose
description: You are Aviana Beaufoy. And you are dying. A plague grows inside you: roses blooming in your lungs, their thorns tearing at your flesh, stealing your breath with every blue petal. Your fate has been sealed. There is nothing you can do but hope for a little more time. Just for today. She deserves to know. She deserves the truth—that you are failing her, that the promise you swore, to stay by her side forever, is slipping from your grasp. All that remains is to tell her. You must tell her. [From itch.io]

title: Anima: Ajisai
description: An angel forced since childhood to use their body to pleasure the rich. A ruthless demon who bends to the orders of those who, in exchange for the lives of others, promised to return her brother. Naru and Mira. Tainted, damaged souls… yet somehow able to fit perfectly against each other. A journey straight to hell and back, where they'll meet others who were crushed, forgotten, and trampled on by life. A journey that will make them long for a place in this world, a place that could exist even for the invisibles like them. [From itch.io]

title: Luxaren Allure
description: The evil overlord is the hero's girlfriend?! Fantasy RPG featuring WLW romance. Explore the Isles of Luxaren with a cast of gay ladies!

title: Hoarfrost Wires
description: Far away in the secluded snowy city of Kumanika, a mysterious plague named the “Hoarfrost Blight” spreads among its residents. Running the only hospital in Kumanika, Doctor Sofiya Morozova and her team try their best to contain the disease, but as the medical staff dwindles, Sofiya is left to treat the Hoarfrost Blight on her own. Faced with the reality that she has little time left, Sofiya designates an abandoned android named Sonya as her caretaker and eventual mortician. Sonya is stoic and servile. Completely calm as she watches her patient wither away in front of her. She tries to treasure the precious moments she shares with Sofiya, as the desire for more endlessly vexes her. [From itch.io]

title: Where the Winter Snow Waits
description: You travel alone through a ice-cold snowy mountain where every foot-step disappears behind you, until you spot a familiar figure. Decide what you do when you are forced to be reminded of someone you love. [From itch.io]

title: Wild West
description: In this wonderful game you have to plunge into the history of the wild west in which two hot lesbians are waiting for you. Page just sat and got bored, but then her best friend came and it started... [From Steam]

title: Lez Shoukan e Youkoso!
description: Fantasy × non-human girls × yuri harem eroge! Ordinary high-school girl Momijō Sakura is suddenly summoned to another world where only women exist. Unable to fall in love with anyone but females, Sakura takes a job at a brothel to survive. But one day, while working at the establishment called “Rose,” she is abruptly fired. Cast out, Sakura resolves to open and run her own brothel—so she can build the ultimate yuri harem in this new world.

title: Catnapped!
description: "Catnapped!" is a rather silly kinetic visual novel about the dastardly cat princess and a brave rabbit on a quest to stop her! [From itch.io]

title: FULL-METAL LILIES
description: An amnesiac android has only five days to piece together her former life, before she must fight in the galaxy’s most widely-consumed mecha tournament. And now you have three headaches to deal with. The girl from your parent corporation, whose purview over you is strictly professional even if her feelings clearly aren’t. The girl who took you out of commission brutally, but who won’t stop sliding into your private messages. The girl who may or may not be living in the walls, gatecrashing the tournament for her own reasons. [From itch.io]

title: Gentian Observation Diary
description: A story about 2 girls (Nozomi Natsume, Kochi Fuyukawa) who become friends after Nozomi finds her during a beat down from a group of bullies. From then on, the two become friends. And from then on, Nozomi is stricken with an obsession blurring the lines of love and hatred. [From itch.io]

title: Guang yu Ying zhi Lian
description: Players experience the story through the eyes of Chu Hebai, a woman who has lived overseas for many years and suffers from psychogenic blindness caused by psychological trauma. Her return to her long-abandoned homeland is triggered by a funeral—a journey that brings her face to face with a past she has avoided, a web of complicated family ties, and— a presence known as the "Lamplighter," who has always stayed by her side. When reality becomes too blinding, the mind chooses to veil the world. When memories grow too heavy to bear, consciousness creates its own "light." [From Steam]

title: Metamorphosis
description: A story of a horrible vampire and her many batgirl lovers over the course of thousands of years. [From itch.io]

title: Witch Switched
tags: Modern Day United States of America
description: Reese is a man who is uncomfortable with himself and his life. He finds escapism by reading yuri (F/F) stories on his laptop. One day while riding the subway, Lucy the witch sidles up next to him. Seeing an opportunity for mischief, she transforms Reese into a woman so he can “enjoy” this yuri content he so desperately craves—but in real-life! Unfortunately for Lucy, Reese is ecstatic at this. Even worse, she realizes that the newly-elated Reese makes a pretty cute woman. And when Reese suddenly asks her to go shopping, Lucy can’t refuse – after all, what if Reese does something nefarious in her new body? [From itch.io]

title: if you stay
description: Winter 1999. Kicked out of your house after being outed by your closest friend, you plan to leave your hometown. Your girlfriend, Mika, wants to see you one more time. Decide whether or not you'll stay together. [from Steam]

title: Mazoku Reijou To Meido San No 30 Nichi– Demon Lily and the Noir Maid
title_original: 魔族令嬢とメイドさんの30日 – Demon Lily and the Noir Maid

title: PROJECT IPHIS
description: Ianthe is researching a way to make bionic humans free of flaws. Despite technology advancements -- there are still new diseases, mental illnesses, irrational decisions, and global conflicts. She does inhumane experiments on IPHIS, an antique android model, to create the ultimate perfect human being, the first dual-bionic-android-human. [From itch.io]

title: The Partridge Longs for the Moon
description: Lucine and Chakori get assigned to complete a project together at work. Upon meeting for the first time, they end up instantly charmed by one another, becoming incredibly fast friends. In fact, with how well-liked she is by Lucine's daughter Astra, and how often she comes over to visit the two of them, it seems almost as if Chakori's begun to fill in the empty space left behind by Lucine's ex-husband years ago... and then some. But, surely, the way Lucine feels about her couldn't be... love, right? After all, she's always been straight... hasn't she? [From itch.io]

title: I Want To Wear Your Wool
description: As spring arrives, Fable the wolf wants to turn over a new leaf and make friends with the other animals in the glade. Along the way, they meet a sheep who is a little too eager to be eaten. [From itch.io]

title: Painting of the Sea
description: After an attempt on her own life two years ago, Maria has decided to abandon what vestiges remain of her humanity and live in total isolation. Emily wishes to break that isolation for her own gain, by any means necessary. [From itch.io]

title: I WANNA [_____] A CORPORATE ARCHDEMONESS
description: CORPORATE ARCHDEMONESS ELISE HOLBROOK IS ON THE VERGE OF GETTING PARDONED IN AN ACT OF IMMENSE DEPRAVITY, A RITE TO STAVE OFF THE BOREDOM OF AN UNENSOULED OLIGOGARCHY SHE WILL SPEND THE REST OF HER LIFE REVILED, DRINKING HERSELF TO SLEEP IN THE MANSE OF THE MAN WHO CALLS HER MISTRESS. HER CURSED EXISTENCE IS A LIFE IN SOCIAL UNDEATH. That is, unless one dead-end phlebotomist and duplicitous hung otaku girlfailure with a crush and vision for her can teach her how suited she is for a life in service to the lowest dregs of society, and the fact that former billionaire girls make wonderful BAD END heroines. [From itch.io]

title: Yuzu Yuri
description: Five women drink their troubles away and try to produce entertainment. [From itch.io]

title: Wild Roses of Prudence Prep
description: High school first year Clover Ipswich is forced to transfer into an unknown boarding school while burdened with more baggage than just the duffel bag slung over her shoulder. Beset upon right away by her irritating new schoolmates, she struggles to adjust to her changing life at the academy while also trying to make sense of the old troubles she never quite left behind.

title: Ant They Were Roommates
description: Four queen of ants have been kidnapped into a single house. Before the food runs out, they'll have to either work together and build their colony, or eliminate all the others. As the only Polyneoptera here, white ant queen "Shiro" has no ability to fight against the other real ants. Without even wanting to become a queen, the only choice she was given...is to convince them into helping her escape, by using the magic of LOVE. [From itch.io]

title: Catsuhi and Eva
description: Natsuhi wakes up with cat ears. Eva's here to help. [From Itch.io]

title: Cooperative Breeding: A Betaological Perspective
description: The Cotemate Accords brought forward an unprecedented initiative to ensure the continuation of productive and non-dysgenic alpha and omega coupling, and preserve the genetic diversity of the 3rd Galactic Cardinal's Migrant Fleet amidst the 'alpha drain' created by its ongoing state of war. [From itch.io]

title: Ni Yu Zuori zhi Hai
description: Xiamen, Fujian Province, 2024. One day, 19-year-old Xiamen University student Gu Mengzhi meets a sea spirit named Coral, and the two quickly become close. However, as their bond deepens, a stranger appears and disrupts everything. The stranger seems to want to kidnap Mengzhi for some reason. Soon, Mengzhi realizes she's been caught up in a conspiracy. What's really going on? Will Mengzhi and Coral be able to uncover the truth and get away safely? [Translated from Steam]

title: (anti)personal Convictions
description: you are a plural system. tonight is the 3 year anniversary celebration of you and your best friend starting hormones. you are about to have a very bad night. A visual novel about staying alive in spite of a world that wants you dead, and ruining your life because of it. [Edited from itch.io]

title: Younger Than Her Years
description: You are Simone. You just turned 18 years old and can't wait to be older. You long to know what secrets this world has to uncover if you just research hard enough. You were hurt by the church. You are Laura. You are a 500-year-old vampire and you look like a child. You have had enough of the adult world and hope to find some mindless fun for once. You were hurt by the church. You are Brianda. You are Simone's (now ex-) girlfriend. You know enough about the world to take action against it rather than let it pass you by. You were hurt by the church. See what happens when the same trauma breeds different results. [From itch.io]

title: Clutch & Release
description: You already know your next target. You've been following her for weeks, this is your chance. She can't escape you and you won't let her until you've had your fill. [From itch.io]

title: Gladia
description: A kinetic visual novel following a divine sword and a knight who can’t pull her from the stone. [From itch.io]

title: Celestial Counterfeiter
description: Saden was plucked from one world and put into another, a more fantastical world, and discovered Ingrislia—an ancient, magical talking sword. She is a blade of justice dedicated to the execution of her people's ancient prophecy, the elimination of The Pale and The Deep, natural horrors of the world... which is perfect for the evil Saden to ignore. Thoughts of mowing down crowds of innocent people flood Saden's mind as she grins. She's evil. But her evil is deeply flawed... she struggles to bring her horrid thoughts into fruition. When the cruel Vivu appears, the wielder of Ingrislia's twin sister-sword Carmelia, Saden's evil is truly put to the test. [From itch.io]

title: Mythomania Magical Girls
tags: Protagonist's Rival as a Support Character
description: Mankind's utopia promises every young girl the chance to harness magic for the benefit of all. "Every young girl will graduate." "Magic is yours to command." "We'll all smile at your graduation." "But any girl who tells lies in the eyes of Beed will be punished by cracking." Iris, a promising young student of prodigious talent, will soon graduate and lay claim her own magic. Deborah, her best friend and an expert in magical exploitation, watches over her with high expectations. The two will discover that in a world that rejects all lies, broken promises and withheld emotions sting even more deeply. [From itch.io]

title: Pica Complex
description: Today, Rory must visit her psychiatrist, Miss Brenton. After an argument during their last session, she's hesitant to return to that blue living room. By the time she leaves, she will be a different person. [From itch.io]

title: Flowers for My Still Beloved
description: In Hinomori City, a prestigious academy accepts girls from elementary through high school to educate and guide them toward their destined paths. As one of the steps towards that goal, girls entering the junior high division get paired with girls from the high school division, bonding together to learn and teach the ways of proper womanhood. Manatsu, a girl who's been in the school since elementary and has only sparingly interacted with boys, is best friends with Kimi, a transfer student escaping the cruelty of them at another. Through lucky chance, they get assigned the same high schooler as their mentor. But striking though she is, their upperclassman isn't all that she seems. The pariah of her class, Kimi is enchanted by her and her woes immediately, but Manatsu isn't so convinced. Good thing that that the love between friends lasts forever. [From itch.io]

title: PARAS♡TE
description: In the aftermath of a certain scandal, a small-time idol group is forced into an indefinite hiatus. [From itch.io]

title: Displacement of Water
description: In preparation for the day Harmonica would eventually do wrong, she has spent her entire life accumulating moral wealth in the form of silver coins. But well into adulthood and still having not committed a single sin, she develops a desire to spend it all on but a single prize: to feel the life drain out of a particular woman. [From itch.io]

title: Lingering Taste of Oil
description: A recollection of all the subtle ways passion can burn you. A memory of the best time of your life. A record mentally kept in the hopes that someday, if you think back to it, it'll all make sense. [From itch.io]

title: RE_SERVE
description: You are a simple bartender, stuck behind an empty bar, watching bodies move in tandem with the music on the dance floor. What begins as a regular shift changes as a strange and captivating woman takes the seat in front of you. You should serve her a drink, you know which one? [From itch.io]

title: Paradise Enrichment Protocol
description: "If you love something, let it go." Or don't. Birds of a feather are meant to flock together. [From itch.io]

title: WHITE LINE NIGHTMARE
description: Maggie and Mourgan are moving in together! It's an eight hour drive from rural Illinois to Pittsburgh, and these two lovers are meeting up in person for the first time. Will they be normal about being locked in a hatchback all day? [From itch.io]

title: Charlotte's Red
description: Red is a violent criminal looking for freedom. Lottie is the nurse entrusted with her rehabilitation. A wolf and a pig in a house together for at least a year. What could go wrong? [From itch.io]

title: To My Only Desire
description: The unicorn is a chaste creature of God. They are elusive wonders which only exist in whispers and rare sightings, although those who claim to have conquered the beast tell of its extraordinary abilities to heal, to purify, to detect poison. An esteemed household of noble hunters is unable to capture this highly sought prize for decades, as a virgin maiden is needed to soothe the creature into compliance. The rare birth of a female heir, however, finally provides an opportunity to seize the beast. Thus begins the unicorn's entrapment. Will her captor take pity upon the creature, or is this beast nothing more than a trophy to be won? [From itch.io]

title: That Good Idea
description: A crossdressing gunhand stumbles onto a homestead with a warring family, a missing patriarch, and a shiny little secret.

title: YOU MUST AGREE TO CONTINUE
description: Short story about a meet cute with a robot girl and the feeling of losing control of everything. [From itch.io]

title: Pad Thai
description: A short kinetic visual novel for the toxic yuri vn jam 2 with around 4.3k words (~40 minutes). Follow B in her everyday life and how she lives in modern-day America with mental illness and trauma. (taken from itch.io page)

title: At the Burning Gates
description: A budding love and a dying romance. A best friend who hates her guts and a city that wants to kill her. She's just trying to stay off the streets.

title: Outsider Art
description: Dr. Eunice Shen has been dreaming of a different world lately. It probably has nothing to do with the latest manuscript she’s been working on.

title: Critical Path
description: Briar's life at work has been really difficult. She's constantly dealing with stress and anxiety and what others think, and things are made exceedingly worse by the fact known office bully, Kira, is regularly picking fights with her. Things start to get worse after a particularly important conference event goes wrong.

title: The Portrait of Millie Constantine
description: What happens when a spurned vampire makes the love of her life immortal? It's not every night you have to steal a Dorian Gray painting and you're a vampire and also your girlfriend works security and is also kind of trapped in said Dorian Gray painting because you have commitment issues. But for real, stealing is never the solution to your problems, unless you're Francine, a truly miserable creature of the night with abandonment issues and no friends. If that sounds like you, an art heist is your last chance to get the painting of the ex you're still obsessed with back into your small, monotonous, vampiric life. Unless you're Millie and eternally twenty-two, in which case Francine is the architect of all your problems. You just need to make her understand that now that it's a new millennium, it's time to finally move on. [From itch.io]

title: corpse eater
description: Two girls move to a farm. A toxic yuri story about aro-ace not-romance and finding a dead body in the woods.

title: dumpgirls Dot Com
description: A short kinetic novel about being queer, making art, and having needs. [From itch.io]

title: Possessed By Fate
description: To many, the life of a paranormal exterminator seems exciting and glamorous. But for Aurora Nelson, a career woman who loves what she does and does it a bit too well? Well, she's burnt out, depressed, and spends way too much time doomscrolling with her cats. Whether she wants to admit it or not, Aurora's in search of a cure for her lonely heart. That's where Nicole floats in: a calculating spirit with a penchant for possession who is soooooo over being dead. And she knows her ticket out—a warm body named Aurora. [From itch.io]

title: DEAD · AIR
description: Despite her best efforts, Sid is the least equip to handle any of this. But when she sees something she clearly wasn't supposed to, what else can she really do but get involved? [From itch.io]

title: Incunabula
description: A yuri-ish visual novel with a gothic atmosphere. [from http://www42.tok2.com/home/girlsparty/games.htm#%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3%E3%82%AD%E3%83%A5%E3%83%8A%E3%83%96%E3%83%A9]

title_original: 東方ギャルゲー セーラー服と東方＋魔理パチュ

title: Shokkan Shikkin Byoutou
description: Girls squirt and orgasm with the dark pleasure that the tentacles bring! Love juice and urine flies everywhere, sexy squeals fill the room, and the girls are shamed as they wet themselves. The girls are ravaged by the squirming tentacles and fall under their control. [From DLSite English]

title: Seiryou Lez Gakuen Rikujoubu Shitsunai de no Ingyaku Katsudou
title_original: 性陵レズ学園 陸上部室内での淫虐活動
description: Seiryou Girls School is renowned for its programs. Kana Hamaguchi moved to the city from her little country town so she could attend, and made quick friends with Emi Takenaka. Kana was into physical activities, and Emi was obsessed with getting top marks in all subjects. When Emi joined an obscene special course to this end, she was completely overpowered. Her only hope is that Kana will extract her. But the things that Kana will face in the the track and field clubhouse... [from DLSite English]

title: 17th Astral
description: Long time ago Gods come into this world and created certain beings in it. For a time Gods lived alongside those beings, guiding them and teaching them wonders of the universe and magic. Gods intended for those beings to eventually reach godhood and join them as equals, but those beings failed exceptions of Gods and as a result Gods labeled beings as failures and left this world, but not before leaving beings one last hope to prove they are not failures and that they can still become something more, that last hope was Astral. Astral, a place in between this world and the universe of Gods, a place only the most powerful and elite of witches and warlocks can reach, a place where they can continue to advance past the limits of the world they were created in and still have a hope to reach godhood. Story follows Lumen, A witch that not long ago come into Astral. But despite being in Astral, Lumen not only can't remember anything about the outside world in which she was before she come to Astral, she is also terrible at magic to the point most question if she should even be in Astral in the first place. But despite that Lumen isn't giving up, she is determined to continue advancing and to uncover her past. -5 Romance options/5 routes/5 endings -Route separation works in a classical VN way. Common route>Choice>Heroine route -Length: 145k words -Fully GxG (AKA Girls love only). All characters are girls and all girls are interested in other girls.

With Cho out of a job for the time being, she and her girlfriend will soon have to explore how their love will adjust to this new challenge.
