description: Hatsune Miku has risen to become a top idol charts. Luka Megurine is developing his talent as a detective. "I only play a detective in a TV series" His thoughts and feelings intersect. A short novel about a diva's love life. "I want you to be everyone's diva forever." a translate from vector.co]

title: Withering Flowers
description: In a world of spellcasters and sorcerers, Shira, a magical prodigy, made a bold choice that engendered dislike in her family - and dropped out of school to live with her girlfriend Laren. Her life seemed like a paradise, until the day her beloved suddenly asked for them to breakup, without an explanation. As if that weren't bad enough, she was immediately afflicted with a terrible illness that left her comatose. Without a second thought, Shira sets out on a journey deep into the heart of the forest in search of her mysterious teacher Loic - and her estranged sister, the tyrant of flames. Along the way, she will be able to count on the help of her dear but cowardly friend Luka, as well as a powerful and daring rival named Jareth. Her goal is to find answers, a cure for Laren, and if possible, a way to mend their relationship in the process. [From Itch.io]

title: Akari to Matsuri no xxx Jijou.
Towa no Shirayuri ~Rasen no Kanata~
title_original: 永久の白百合～螺旋の彼方～

title: Towa no Shirayuri ~Eien no Setsuna~
title_original: 永久の白百合～永遠の刹那～

title: Towa no Shirayuri ~Yuuen no Hinata~
title_original: 永久の白百合～悠遠の日向～

title: Towa no Shirayuri ~Sousei Ai Kokoro~
title_original: 永久の白百合～双生の愛心～

title: Towa no Shirayuri ~Senkou no Seimei~
title_original: 永久の白百合～閃光の生命～

title: Seirei Tenka ~Kimi to Koso Haru Kuru Koto mo Mata Shika~
title_original: 聖霊天華～君とこそ 春来ることも 待たれしか～

title: Liu-mang Dengta
description: This is the story of a prophet who - having predicted that she would die in ten days - pursues the cause of her own death. Mingdeng is a person who desires nothing, just like an empty shell. She does not fear her own death, but still wants to pursue the reason for her death or something she wants during her last days. During the ten-day pursuit, Mingdeng also develops a relationship with the people who accompany her beyond what they once were... At the same time, Mingdeng and the people around her also meet with all kinds of people in their quest, witnessing several new worlds that they have not witnessed, and countless people who want to change the world. And, those people also seem to be associated with Mingdeng... "My happiness... Where is it..." --This is the story written down for the sake of Mingdeng and the people around her. Is it the cause of her death that she is after, or is it... her unseen happiness? [Translated from itch.io]

title: The Bull and Mouse
description: This short romance story follows a minotaur named Tory. She's a female womanizer with an edge whose favorite pastime is picking up girls. If she isn't chatting them up in a bar she's playing them a song somewhere private with her guitar. But today she'll be forced to use new methods to charm someone... [From Itch.io]

title: Halloween in Hollywood
tags: Modern Day United States of America
description: Things have been hard for aspiring screenwriter Martina Alvarez. Ever since she’s moved to Los Angeles three years ago, she’s been pitching her screenplays all over town and has seemingly not progressed an inch. Working as a barista to make ends meet, she’s depressed and losing hope about making her dream come true. This is until her roommate comes home one day with a cunning plan to get her film greenlit. Halloween in Hollywood is a romantic comedy Yuri Visual Novel and Dating sim. Play as witty writer Martina Alvarez as she manoeuvres her way around epic events on Halloween night as she rubs shoulders with Los Angeles elite to do what she can to get her screenplay produced. [From Steam]

title: Her Miracle
tags: Heroine Based on a Fictional Person
description: When Izzy Halliday was a little girl, she saw a strange white-haired girl in her living room when she went to peek at Santa. Now, twenty years later, that girl is back, asking for Izzy's help in creating a Christmas Miracle so she can become a Santa. Will Izzy fall in love with this odd woman? Or will she find love with the cute cafe worker she's known for several years? [From Itch.io]

title: Wendy
tags: Heroine Based on a Fictional Person
Protagonist Based on a Fictional Person
description: Wendy is a young girl who has just been told she'll have to grow up. Conflicted about her feelings, she is surprised that very night by Petra Pan: a young girl who proclaims she shall never grow up. And Wendy won't either, if she goes to Neverland. [From Itch.io]

title: sweet tooth.
description: Lindsey Henson messages her field partner Hallie Macleod for some comfort and a distraction during a particularly shitty night. [From Itch.io]

title: Things Are Grim
description: Things Are Grim is a supernatural queer romcom about falling in love first and asking questions later. Follow Clara, local barista, as she meets the cool and somewhat delusional woman of her dreams. Could it possibly be true that the mysterious Lady Luna is actually a grim reaper...? It's hard to say, but Clara isn't about to let this real-life fairytale escape her! [from itch.io]

title: suzumebachi
description: Suzume and Hachi flirt, fret, and frantically self-aware their way through being friends+ in moody Kyoto late spring weather. [edited from Itch.io]

title: Paris no Sakura
description: Maeda Sakura, a columnist living in Tokyo, has just been dumped by her girlfriend of two years, Megumi, who claims that Sakura has problems committing. Realising that Megumi might have a point, Sakura meditates on this and concludes that her father abandoning her and her mother when she was a young child may have led to Sakura’s problems committing. A few days later, she helps her mother move from her home to an apartment and discovers a box labelled “Jean-Luc Dupont”. Inside the box she finds a photo of Jean-Luc, Sakura, and her mother from a few years back. Realising that Jean-Luc is her father and seeing that the box has plenty of clues that indicate that Luc moved back to Paris, she goes on a trip of a lifetime to Paris to confront her father. Along the way, she meets some beautiful women in Paris and perhaps she might even fall in love with one of them. [Edited from Steam]

title: Formidable Alice
description: Marisa's a smooth talker, but can she smooth-talk her way into Alice's heart? Chat with Alice and find out! [from Itch.io]

title: Modern Cavegirl Midsummer
description: You're a deadpan lesbian, Anna, who somehow agrees to go camping with a cheerful girl who you hardly even know. The girl doesn't like you that way, so it's just gals being pals, though. Also, you time travel back to the stone age while at it. Totally for reals. [from itch.io]

title: HyperStar X Duel
description: Join the first 'HyperStar X Duel Universal Tournament' and look for your childhood friend who taught you how to play the HyperStar X Duel card game and you totally had a crush on! P. S. It's in space, ace cards fight for real against each other, you might die if you lose. But you made a promise, and that's the most important thing! [from itch.io]

title: Crimson Nights
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: Eternal life, enhanced abilities, and… navigating relationships? This is your life as a vampire. You wake up changed- you’re a vampire now. Journey through your small town by night, learning what new powers you have, fending off your thirst for human blood, and avoiding dangerous vampire hunters. Most importantly, you have the chance to get to know and romance the two lovely ladies in your life, in this sapphic, supernatural dating sim! [from itch.io]

title: Sapphic Space
description: The ship needs repairs! Play as Miss Yournamehere, the ship computer, and help the ship's android, Susu, get it up and running again! [From Steam]

title: Oh My Cod!!: We Mer-Made For Each Other!
description: Elise, an introverted marine biology student wins a 3 month trip to Papua New Guinea to study the Coral Sea! However, upon her first expedition, she meets a mermaid caught in plastic in the waters who offers to teach her all about life deep under the surface from a first-hand-resident. Elise eagerly takes this opportunity to learn, and the opportunity to talk to a charming girl her age! She might be sacrificing facts for fondness because her source unfortunately isn’t very reliable… [from itch.io]

title: Golden Sushi Night
description: Take control of Addy, a farm girl who had just moved to the big city, as she stumbles through her first week of being a sushi chef at the Golden Nori. It's not that the job itself is difficult, it's the pretty customers that'll trip her up. Even before settling into her new apartment Addy has been eager to chat up one of the local girls. It's the whole reason she made the move. It was slim pickings at the isolated farm she grew up on so she's eager to find a soulmate. The five potential partners she meets at the Golden Nori are as varied as they come. Addy is a dork who has trouble flirting. It'll be your job as the player to choose the correct things to say. Then you'll choose who Addy will spend the rest of her life with at the end of the game. In paying tribute to Halloween, your options range from a witch to a scarecrow inhabited by a ghost. [from itch.io]

title: Tugging at Knots
description: Tugging at Knots is a fan-VN based off of NomnomNami's Lonely Wolf Treat Series, acting as a continuation of the ending of Chapter 7's ending, made for Moxie's birthday, 2023!!! The fox has been getting used to her new life with her girlfriends and Treat's pack, but some things have been made that new life rather difficult to become accustomed to... [from itch.io]

title: Ghost Sweet as Sugar
description: Penny Bun has just moved to a new apartment, but it soon becomes clear to her that the rent was cheap for a reason: The place is haunted! But little does she know what the ghost really wants of her... [From itch.io]

title: Homecoming: My monster-hunter girlfriend
description: The shy werewolf lady Ida of the Bloodhounds enjoys the quiet of her apartment and the cuddles of her outgoing human girlfriend, Xen Lovebird, a descendant from an ancient lineage of monster hunters. The couple has never met each other's parents. Ida is forced to face her trauma when her girlfriend finally demands that they take the next step in their relationship and visit her werewolf parents. [From itch.io]

title: Nowhere Fast: On the Horizon
description: The sun is rising... Angel has been on the road for a while. Long drives and making her lonely way in the world are second nature to her. What's new is her growing thirst for blood and the distant threat of immortality. Now, morning brings more than just the light of a new day - with it comes a sense of dread that she just can't shake. While contending with fears for her future, Angel has an unexpected encounter at a highway gas station with a fiery stranger caught up in her own troubles - and this chance encounter may just set Angel on a new path entirely. [From itch.io]

title: A Lesbian Harvest Moon
description: Fara recently moved into her grandpa's old farm, and becomes suddenly aware of the various attractive women, and their hungry interest in her. [From itch.io]

title: Ina's Halloween Dilemma
description: A Hololive fangame about Ninomae Ina'nis discovering the true value of Halloween with Takanashi Kiara.

title: Drop Dead, Gorgeous
description: In the middle of the end of the world, Amelia's new girlfriend (of 1 day) has just been turned into a zombie. But is she still in there? Somewhere? [From Itch.io]

title: Loving Memories
description: Loving Memories is a visual novel about the relationship formed between two women, one an elf named Elin who has a thing for love and wishes to experience a romantic relationship and Neha, the deity of love who visits her frequently. Experience key moments of their relationship to see how it evolves through time and see if it turns to something else, or not. [From itch.io]

title: Weekend in Waimanalo
title_original: ウィークエンド・イン・ワイマナロ
description: Rachel and Zoe have just had their second anniversary and things are not going well for them. A lot of the romance and passion has left their relationship and while they have talked about breaking up, they simply cannot imagine a life without one another. So, thanks to a recommendation from a friend, they book a weekend at a luxurious lesbian-only resort in the Hawaii to receive couple’s therapy from the legendary Dr. Mia Arroyo. During their sessions, Dr. Arroyo finds the curious reason why their relationship is not quite working and gives them a surprising recommendation as to how to save their marriage and re-discover themselves and each other! Weekend in Waimanalo is a romantic comedy yuri visual novel and dating sim. This is a game about love, respect, friendship, self-exploration, and mental health. Explore this hidden side of Oahu, get to know interesting characters, and see how your decisions affect where Rachel ends up and with who!

title: Tales From The Under-Realm: Lilith
description: This dark fantasy yuri visual novel is the third and last game in the Tales From The Under-Realms trilogy. While there are a few references to the other two games, it can be enjoyed as a stand-alone story. In this installment, the enigmatic Nameless God tracks the odyssey of three heroines: Lilith, the half-demoness; Odette, a devout warrior-monk of the Goddess of Truth, Irijo; and Evelyn, a formidable half-elf pyromancer and familiar face from TFTU: After Midnight. As the tale unfolds, our trio finds themselves in dire straits, ensnared by ‘The Seven’—a cabal of sorcerers who have seized control of Grimoire and exert their will over much of the fantastical realm of Aravorn. Despite the grim outset, the combined valor and cunning of the heroines fuel a daring escape from Grimoire, toppling a swath of the wizardry dominion in their wake. Now fugitives, their sole beacon of hope lies in reaching Shacklesplit, a haven nestled across the ocean on the shores of Zoltar. The story will follow the adventures of Lilith, Odette and Evelyn, as they navigate through numerous challenges to achieve different potential outcomes. Set in a dark fantasy world, this game intensifies the tone established by its predecessors, offering a blend of joyous, sorrowful, and bittersweet moments and endings. [From Steam]

title: The Fast and the Flirtatious: LA Drift
description: FBI Agent Briana Walker is looking for some redemption. A failed sting operation has led to some of her teammates getting injured and the escape of famous drug runner Gianna Silva. Upon discovering that Gianna traded her final shipment of contraband for a souped-up Ford Mustang, the team deduces that Gianna has probably escaped to Los Angeles to join the underground illegal racing and drifting community to try to win her money back there. Briana decides to go undercover and investigate the subculture by trying to join the “Long Beach Lionesses” a famous underground lesbian racing community. On this adventure Briana meets beautiful lesbian women and becomes involved with LA’s underground illegal racing and drifting subculture. [From Steam]

title: Summer With You
description: The story follows two girls who end up on a deserted island that seems to have strange properties. Distraught by the situation and troubled by her not-so-platonic feelings toward her best friend, Terra is faced with a few tough choices. [From itch.io]

title: REALITY
tags: Modern Day United States of America
description: Alex is a loner college student that works hard to live up to society's standards. One day she meets a mysterious woman, Helen, who gifts her more food and things than she knows how to handle! What does this woman want from Alex? [From itch.io]

title: Prey Animal
description: Stressed salary woman Danika is put on a mental health leave after having a breakdown and fainting at work, perhaps a trip to a bathhouse is just what she needs? [From itch.io]

title: A Midnight Stroll
description: Doce, a tailor in Rio de Janeiro, is not having the best of nights, she got a few new wounds to add to her history. Now her girlfriend Casbah will try to get the pieces together. Hey, nothing like a stroll in the middle of the night with your woman can't solve, right? [From itch.io]

title: Um Jammer Lammy - We Should Jam Together!
vampires and garlic
description: Ameline, a vampire, has dinner with Clara, a human. And it escalates from there. [From itch.io]

title: Trout of Order
description: Play as Gina, an office worker who likes marine biology -- and her beautiful co-worker Quinn Brown! (Un)Luckily, she gets stuck with an elevator with her, and now it's up to her to make sure she doesn't pass by her dream girl. [From itch.io]

title: I'd Do Anything
description: Kylli is cursed with immortality. Messalina is cursed with an insatiable appetite. Kylli is trying to find a cure while Messalina relies on her to help assuage her hunger. This cycle has been going on for two years. How much longer can it go on? [From itch.io]

title: Be Safe With Me
description: Two women going on their first date together, navigating their anxieties and stresses while trying to have a fun day together. A short sweet visual novel about queer romance. [From itch.io]

title: Seaflower
description: A short sapphic visual novel about a selkie who washes up on a remote scottish island and her friend, a total selkie chaser. [Edited from itch.io]

title: Magical Mooncakes
description: In the mystical embrace of ancient China, where the autumn wind carries both a chill and a promise, the village of Yuehua celebrates the Mid-Autumn Festival with a flurry of colors and lights. Here, in this lantern-lit haven, two souls, Luo Ye and Si Qiu, both adept in the arcane arts and the ancient craft of mooncake baking, find themselves in a gentle rivalry woven with threads of potential romance. [From Itch.io]

title: Engaging Snowflakes
description: Rainn and Skye are a couple living in the snowy Lily Peaks of the remote Puffball region. Three years ago, they moved there because of Rainn's curse: heavy clouds follow her everywhere, so she cannot stay in any populated areas for a long time. Tonight, they are returning home from Puffball Town after a pizza date. As they drive across the frozen mountain wilderness, talking about everything and remembering events of their lives, something is bound to happen, making today unlike any other day. Note: This 3D visual novel is the sequel to the author's early game Rainn and Skye. Playing the original isn't required to understand the story. This VN includes optional voice acting performed by the author.

title: After The Debate
description: After the presidential debate, Kamala Harris is tired and needs to unwind in the garden behind the venue. When Melania Trump, the former First Lady, appears, what happens next? A blooming romance occurs between the presidential candidate and former First Lady! [From itch.io]

title: Come Towards Me.
description: A tale of one dark forest encircling a small village, one foul Beast dwelling in its heart, and one fateful night upon which one ventured into that very forest and beheld that very Beast. [From itch.io]

title: Jol-eobban Gyogwaseoe Jagbyeol-eul
description: In an inevitable apocalypse, the Holy City-State has come to worship a mechanical god, and Tian, an honor student, is the only member of her study group, the only friend of Hoshi's who is able to leave a country full of rules and religion and find simple happiness. Time is short, and parting is imminent: today is the last day of study group, and Tian must decide. Spend a final night with HER, or Leave with her, forsaking ethnicity, religion, country, and.. family. [Edited from itch.io]

title: Blunt Soul Trauma
description: Blunt Soul Trauma is a kinetic visual novel about home-made angels, friendly kidnappings and being roped into doing a stranger a favor that leaves you feeling shaken afterward. Ferida is making her way back home after some late-night grocery shopping when she's kidnapped, drugged and tied up to a wall by an angel who calls herself Haydee, and who expresses that she has no desire to harm or inconvenience Ferida in any way. She simply wants a favor from her, small and insignificant. She want's Ferida's assistance in making a new angel out of her beloved girlfriend. [From itch.io]

title: Bet on Serendipity
description: A romantic WLW kinetic novel about Seren, a budding artist, and Aoife a cosplayer who "happens" to attend the same convention. Unable to believe her luck Seren can't find the nerve to ask the important questions and take a chance on a new relationship. But when you're standing next to a Lvl 10 goddess, can this sweaty lesbian really put all her bets on Aoife? [From itch.io]

title: Three Peach Hill
description: Three Peach Hill is a cozy, feel-good lesbian romance visual novel about a fox spirit and the human girl who woos her. [From itch.io]

title: Midnight Apple: A Halloween Love Spell
description: "Midnight Apple: A Halloween Love Spell" invites you to unravel the enchanting tale of Carmela and Brunella, a duo of witches whose love has begun to dim. Each Halloween, they honor their tradition of selling caramelized apples, symbols of romance and affection. This year, however, Brunella, a connoisseur of the macabre, stumbles upon the urban legend of the Midnight Apple—a mystical fruit said to rekindle the joy between lovers. Seizing their chance, the pair venture into a mysterious orchard. Here, a cunning fox challenges them with three perplexing riddles. Will Carmela and Brunella succeed in solving the puzzles to secure the apple, and restore their fading love? Join them on this magical quest to discover if true love can indeed be re-sparked. [From Itch.io]

title: Cuddle Quest: Dark Night Cozy Tavern
description: The sun will be gone for a full month. Can two ponies, one human, and a doll live together? Or will things get weird? They're gonna get weird. [Edited from itch.io]

title: Offerings of the Willow Witch
description: Under the shade of a willow, two souls stumble in, looking for the perfect gift between themselves. Yet the past creeps in with them, and it seems like even the most mundane of objects have quite the story with them. [From itch.io]

title: Cuddle Quest: Stupid Poniez Hollow Night Kiss
description: Twilight's tired from the party and goes home to meet her family. Things get weird. [From itch.io]

title: nocturnal fallacy
description: You are Farisa (name can be changed), a tired Esper Order Agent just barely finished a mission, about to return back to HQ. You're thinking to spend your night quietly; maybe just reporting and going back home, then again, you know that your fellow co-workers are still around. How about spending some fun, quality times with them? [From itch.io]

title: Unfinished
description: You're Alex, an artist struggling with art block amidst her final exam. One day she stumbles upon a cheap house - a true fixer upper and sensing this might be the cure for her problems, she strikes. A new place always holds a few challenges, but seeing a mysterious woman appear in her hallway was not on her bingo card. Curious about what this woman wants, Alex is in for a ride that suddenly puts a heavy decision in her hands. [From itch.io]

title: The Witch's Yellow Flower
description: Emberly wants to learn of magic, but as her village has banned it, she has to go through an unconventional method. To go and ask the witch of the woods to teach her magic. [From itch.io]

title: End of the World
description: This is a sad one. It is kind of about the beginning of a world. And kind of about the end of one. Kind of about love and about sacrifice. About life and death. Kind of about a lot of things. But really, just about two people walking together till the end. [From itch.io]

title: Night at the Edge of Daybreak: A Short Visual Novel
description: Two lesbian vampires have a conversation about the loss of someone they both loved. [From itch.io]

title: Unique Ladies
description: Sometimes, the pursuit of love takes us to unexpected places and introduces us to extraordinary people. Unique Ladies is one such story. Step into the shoes of Laura Renaldi, a charming sales manager for a prestigious Italian Fine Food Supplier based in London, as she embarks on a whirlwind trip to an exclusive hospitality conference in Stockholm, Sweden. In the midst of business deals and elegant galas, Laura will cross paths with captivating, eccentric, and stunning women. Will one of them turn out to be the love of her life? Or will her journey be one of personal discovery and unforgettable moments? [From Steam]

title: Take One
description: Play as Tania Rose, and experience the wonders of life! Including: Going outside Meeting new people girl [From itch.io]

title: OL_V
description: Venlee is a hard-working Timey-Wimeyan office lady. One day, she meets someone that changes everything...

title: SNAKE & DRAGON: World's End Parade
description: It's the final confrontation with the villain. The fate of the world hinges on this. But something went wrong, didn't it? Things didn't go as expected. In times like these.... miracles usually happen, don't they? .....So where's the miracle? This is a bad end story, about two robots navigating the apocalypse. [From itch.io]

title: Mail For You, Miss Spider!
description: Dagmar is a young woman with a very important, borderline sacred job: mail delivery! Sure, some have called her dedication 'overly excessive' and 'borderline disturbing' before, but as far as she's concerned, some jobs need to get done. So when she finds a strange package with a set of coordinates to somewhere remote in place of any proper address... it only makes sense for her to take it to where it needs to go. Millicent is a young woman with a job she hates... meat processing. She lives alone, reclusive and burdened with a past full of mistakes and hardship. She has a dark secret that she needs to keep hidden more than anything. So when a mailwoman arrives at her doorstep looking for her to sign for a package... she finds herself dealing with a challenge she is not prepared for. Also, Dagmar is a fly, and Millicent is a spider. [From itch.io] Set in the same world as BugByteGaming's Life Cycles and Bug Bites

title: She Looks So Perfect
description: She Looks So Perfect is a short story about mutual fascination, internal struggles, and the search for connection through physical intimacy. Come along as the two main characters, a dhole and an otter, meet on a dating app for the first time and test the waters of their connection throughout the course of a day. [From Itch.io]

title: Anata ni Ienai Himitsu no Kinenbi
title_original: あなたに言えないヒミツの記念日

title: Anata ni Ienai Himitsu no Omoi
title_original: あなたに言えないヒミツの想い

title: Choose Your Own Valentine!
description: Kamiyah and Valda have been adventuring together for a long time. They've fought through dungeons, they've studied with dragons. There's one thing they've never done: Kiss. Tonight, the will is there. The tavern is there. The lights are low. Unfortunately, a gang of Sanguine Vipers is there, too. What choices will they make to reach their final kissy, kissy destination? More importantly, what choices will you make? Because you can send your own version of this story to that special someone. [From itch.io]

title: Verdemar
description: The royal sorceress Soledad has trapped the crown princess and her surly erstwhile lover—a knight returning from her noble crusade along the coast—inside a locked bedroom inside the palace. With only hours before the royal banquet, will the princess and her knight be able to stop their squabbling for long enough to find a way out? Or will they be doomed to its beige walls and cozy but nondescript furnishings forever? Perhaps a miracle will be needed to help them escape… or at least a little self-awareness. [From itch.io]

title: Seraphic Shadows
description: Of the seven Virtues that nurture the world, the deity of Kindness is the one to grace the earth most frequently. Captivated by the silken saintess she meets in a chance encounter, Kindness's heart begins to clash with her judgement. Will she be able to confront what's underneath the surface? [From itch.io]

title: Saffron and the End of the World
description: You're a baking witch living in a barren magical world, abandoned by occupants who fled from a terrible curse that affects non-witches. You piece together the courage to keep living day by day, the only joy in your life being your long-distance witch girlfriend, who you contact through your crystal ball. But the humans want their normal lives back too, and they will do anything to end the curse, even if that means destroying you in the process. Can you reunite with your girlfriend one last time before it's too late? [From itch.io]

title: Clown Around Love Abound
description: Creamy Dream is going on her first ever date, with the clown milf of her dreams. [From itch.io]

title: All of Us: Her Story
tags: Modern Day United States of America
description: The story focuses more on same-sex love interest routes and is about a group of queer friends trying to stop an LGBT coffee shop in San Francisco from being shut down. [From TV Tropes]

title: Limerence
description: It's that time of year again... The manor has a new guest. For years, Freya's watched those pretty brunette girls go in the large house but never leave again. She waited to see who it would be this time but what will happen when she finds herself waking up in an unfamiliar bed? [From Itch.io]

title: Derelict
description: Lex has been here for too long. The days blend into weeks... into months... into years. An eternity of boredom. She's worried that she might be stuck here forever - until one day she gets an alert that someone is hailing the station. Maybe her luck is finally about to change... [From Itch.io]

title: Wasteland Girls
description: A short erotic visual novel about two awkward tgirls in a crumbling society who want each other so badly. [From Itch.io]

title: My Love Life With Lycanthropy: Elixir for Loneliness
description: Follows the werewolf adventurer Caroline Zervas as she finds herself under the care of a wealthy alchemist. As Caroline decides whether or not she wants to give up her life on the road for a more peaceful one, she starts to admire her host more and more. What follows is a cute, sexy, funny and sometimes heartfelt story about managing mental illness and finding a home in a world that isn't built for you. [From Itch.io]

title: The Secret of Josephine's Soul
description: Ruth came to work as a maid in a mansion that everyone feared. When Ruth sensed danger from her lady, she realized that she had to run away. But could she escape the feelings between them? [From Itch.io]

title: Pomegranate Pearls
description: The game focuses on Indonesian and Malaysian myths of Hantu Air and Pontianak/ Kuntilanak. [From Itch.io]

title: What Becomes of Her
description: Join Daria, as she leaves her familiar village during the Midsummer night to embark on a journey to find the mythical fern flower, which might be the key to her happy future. [From Itch.io]

title: The Lenihan Case
description: Kath and Morgan are co-workers in an investigation company. They're working on a mysterious case of a house fire and have different theories on it. Unbeknownst to the duo, they’re mutually pining. [From Itch.io]

title: Otherwordly Goods Store
description: Three friends find a peculiar store while trick-or-treating. [From Itch.io]

title: bee-side
description: Bee-Side is following Sunni who's determined to become an idol alongside her girlfriend, Bee. Help Sunni down the best path, whether it's becoming an idol herself or supporting Bee. There are currently 4 endings, with more planned in the future. [From Itch.io]

title: Lilith Hall
description: 080 is the pride of Lilith Hall. She does exactly as she's told, she get's perfect grades, and she's never lost a single battle. All her life she was taught the only thing that matters is her future Ringmaster; but when an outsider is brought in, she gets a taste of what the outside world looks like. She must choose between a temptation she's never known, or the life she's always wanted. [From Itch.io]

title: SUPER HOMO!!! Magical Girlfriends
description: Play as Pumpkin, a magical witch warrior and girl skateboarder as she prepares to defeat the evil Candy Cane with the help of her girlfriend Spice. [From Itch.io]

title: The Knight Dance
description: Gather 'round, young and old. Listen as I regale you with the tale of two lovers; one as sure as the other is stubborn. Dancing shoes, a few stolen hours each night. And an important decision to be made. Does love truly conquer all... or is love never enough? [From Itch.io]

title: Chrysalis
description: After waking up from a two-week coma, you’re greeted by Elise Medrano, your girlfriend of a year and a half. However, you don’t remember anything about her, nor about yourself. During the next few days, you relearn aspects of yourself and your relationship with her, but there’s some things that are still difficult to grasp... [From Itch.io]

title: My Coworker is a Devil!
description: Alex Gutierrez is an ordinary girl working an ordinary job in an ordinary company. That is until a new not-so-normal coworker, Nerissa shows up in her life, thrusting her to the supernatural. As the underworld's most wanted mortal, Nerissa offers her a deal. [From Itch.io]

title: Stupid Poniez: Memories of human
description: Lyrica and Bonbon go to work in a research base deep in the Eversong Woods, while they do, Lyrica takes time to reflect on her past, and where she came from. [From itch.io]

title: Anata ni Ienai Himitsu no Akuma
title_original: あなたに言えないヒミツの悪魔

title: Oshikatsu Fanatic
title_original: 推し活ファナティック

title: When it Rains Red
description: For your entire life, the villagers have thought you to be a witch. It isn't your fault that you happen to be smart! Ah well, that doesn't matter: What they think is their reality. Either way, they're tired of you. So tired, in fact, that they wanna watch you burn in Hell. How lovely! Being a living, breathing human, you decide to run away. To where? Who knows. All you know is you feel bad that your girlfriend's coming along for the ride. Even if she seems unusually happy about it. [From Itch.io]

title: Hallow's Eve
description: My name's Eve, and today I say goodbye to this sleepy town before university calls. Fall brings it alive, with Halloween rushing closer each year. Summer's gone before I know it, but I always spend it with Hallow... [From Itch.io]

title: SUBURB HELL VAMPIRE
description: Rumors flutter around the neighborhood about the run down looking house on the corner of the street. Nobody can quite pin down what goes on there, whether it be criminal activity, or perhaps something more supernatural. That is, until a girl named Faith bumps into the resident of the home: The neighborhood's local vampire, Vi. Follow Vi and Faith as their relationship blooms, before it rots away into nothingness. [From itch.io]

title: Teeth of the Wicked
description: The year is 199X, you return to your hometown after your mother's disappearance, and everyone thinks there's something dark lurking amongst their own neighbors. Unfortunately, they're right. Stuck alone with an unpredictable grasp over your own strange powers, you try to find anyone else in town who shares a similar ability; without disappearing yourself. [From itch.io]

title: Demonize on Date
description: It has been awhile - a whole year, in fact! - since four friends hung out with each other, and Sidasta has a lot to say...particularly about Mothiso. [From itch.io]

title: Special Treatment
description: Stacey works in a café and one day meets the beautiful Delilah. It's love at first sight. Soon, Delilah begins regularly offering Stacey food. Due to her lack of self-confidence, Stacey doubts the sincerity of Delilah's feelings – but the truth turns out to be quite surprising. [From Itch.io]

title: The Heart of Our Lagoon
description: A girl lives in a secluded village deep in a lush forest. An encounter with a mermaid will change her forever. A game about love and how it changes you, blood, pus, and all. [From itch.io]

title: Thorns & Roses
description: In this game, you play as an agent named Lee who is a part of a force team named S.T.R.I.K.E. Lee must choose between her loyalty to S.T.R.I.K.E. and the beautiful yet dangerous Rose, whom she has been ordered to kill. [From Itch.io]

title: Until the Universe Explodes
description: A kinetic visual novel/character study about two coworkers fleeing from a dystopian regime in a cyberpunk-ish setting due to the discovery of their underground revolutionary zine. Stuck in a storage crate with no one but each other, the girls are put into an intimate situation like they have never been before, reminiscing the past, present, and future - whether it be together or apart. [From Itch.io]

title: Girls Kiss
description: Claire a retired magical girl has to come back after a new villain appears. [From Itch.io]

title: Queen & Knight
description: A fairytale styled yuri about a Queen and her Knight and what happens when they say they love each other. [From Itch.io]

title: Symbiogenesis
description: Lily is convinced that she's died and the only person who can fix her is a strange woman with an affinity for plants. Only to repair something dissassembly is usually required. [From Itch.io]

title: Maybe Next Year...
description: Two college students suffer through trauma, guilt, anxiety, and jealousy during the last day of finals before graduation. [From itch.io]

title: You Know We Kinda Suck, Right?
description: Fritz and Dinah kinda suck. As a duo, as witches, and, sometimes they think, as people. But right now isn't a time to think about that, not when they need magic tears from Selene in the sky yesterday! And nothing is going to stop that not even... a trip through memory lane on Fritz's end that was triggered from said magic tears due to the tears coming from something, or rather someone, sentient? Who seems to think her boredom might be alleviated from witnessing Fritz and Dinah's frustrating relationship and... helping? In her own way??? That might distract from their goal. Just a little. [From itch.io]

title: mutuAl understandIng
description: A lonely office worker searches for love at her local café. What happens next may surprise you. [From Itch.io]

title: Aletheia
description: The year is 23XX. A former luxury cruiser now serves as a cryo-transport, carrying over 200 passengers on a 120-year journey to a distant planet. Everyone is frozen – except two. You wake up 20 years in, with no memory of who you were. Two women greet you, each with a different version of the truth. [From Itch.io]

title: phoebephobia
description: A story about a lonely girl having a bit of a rocky relationship with a girl in her dreams. [From Itch.io]

title: Regular Maintenance is Required
description: Unit 1277-B is the latest model from a fantastic line of home cleaning robots. She is programmed to love and obey her master no matter what. Her master is very busy, and can't always complete the routine maintenance 1277-B needs to serve at maximum efficiency. How long will 1277-B last before her robot body falls apart? [From itch.io]

title: Killing Me Necromantically
description: Awaking in the dark, your sight blurred in panic, you are met with a face you recognize. You remember her, but the images that flash in your mind the more you remember paint an entirely different picture than the person in front of you. [From Itch.io]

title: I Promise You~!
description: Cia is drowning in feelings she can’t control. She’s hopelessly in love with her childhood best friend, Clover. But—!! Clover’s heart already belongs to someone else! After missing school due to mental health struggles, Cia returns, desperate to reclaim what she lost. Can she win Clover back? Or is she doomed to watch the love of her life choose someone else? [From Itch.io]

title: A Frayed Doll: Yuri Visual Novel
description: Bobby recently was dumped by an ex and cannot get over it! It's up to you to be her right hand (or her left hand) and emotionally guide her through these next three (or more) days in a peculiar plush vessel. [From Itch.io]

title: Different Echoes
description: Navigating a new relationship with her girlfriend Kaitlyn, Marianne just wants to keep her happy so they can be together. But as their relationship advances faster than she's ready for, she realises Kaitlyn's grief continues to haunt her, and threatens to push the duo to their limits. Can they find a way to be happy, or will their traumas ultimately tear them apart? [From Itch.io]

title: We Can't Keep Doing This
description: Sealed in a cave by your village for alleged crimes against the church, you must find your way out before you starve to death. [From Itch.io]

title: My Boss is a Villainess Vampire, & She SUCKS at Her Job
description: Love's a pain – and so is your boss's refusal to let you have a life outside work. But hey, she did create you, so… what choice do you have? DAISY-BOT serves Countess Batta S. DeVila, possibly the most awful villainess in the Kingdom – if only she'd focus on something other than chasing those dumb Heroes who just won't quit. She's rude, reckless, and full of red flags. Still, maybe she likes you? Hard to tell... [From Itch.io]

title: Bad Apples
description: A linear visual novel set in Hollywood in the Roaring 20s. It’s about fruity women who make bad decisions. [From itch.io]

title: Gold Laced Throat
description: Gold marks those who sacrifice their flesh and blood to god. You are Eunokia Malandra, one such holy warrior whose life-long duty is to duel with Katherine Snow, another lamb who gave up everything for ceremonial duty. The pressure of one sacrifice after another without hearing a single divine whisper has piled up over the years, a wall between you and those you should be protecting. [i]You yearn for an answer, whatever it may be. You yearn for her, fellow sacrificial pawn. You yearn for her, chained together in gold and blood. [From itch.io]

title: All That Is Left
description: After the tragic death of her ex-girlfriend Yves, Sera finds herself haunted. As Yves’ presence grows stronger, she begins to manipulate Sera’s thoughts—dragging her deeper into a cycle of guilt and longing, and isolating her from those who still care, including her current girlfriend, Irina. Sera must confront whether Yves ever truly left… or if she ever wanted her to. [From itch.io]

title: Embrace Your Venom
description: Marie Boa is a freak. Covered in sickening scales, with ugly horns and piercing yellow snake eyes, she has no place among humans. But maybe it doesn't have to be that way- At a crossroads in her life, two women each offer her a path forward. It would be so comfortable and easy to just bow her head and accept the chains a subhuman existence deserves. But just as well, there would be such a thrill in finally becoming the monster the world thinks she is. These are the only paths afforded to a hideous creature like her. [From itch.io]

title: Triceratops Necromancer
description: A lonely ice mage develops a crush on her healer while fighting the undead. Everything goes terribly wrong. Also they're dinosaurs. [From itch.io]

title: Electrical Misconduct
description: A story about a robot who was forgotten by her creator, and spends all her time rewatching her memories of their time together. [From itch.io]

title: Fated Love / Fated Death
description: She is your Queen, your executioner, and your soulmate. Have one final conversation with your enemy in this short interactive wlw visual novel. [From itch.io]

title: Rescue Refused
description: Dating a werewolf is always a wild ride–even more so when she’s a princess! But the two of you have been living a surprisingly quiet life in the countryside. Your tranquil life is interrupted, however, when royal guards come knocking, demanding the return of their “kidnapped” princess. You never kidnapped her, and she doesn’t want to go back. Will you escape the guards, or...? [From itch.io]

title: Vampire Lover
description: Suddenly, people in 2025 are turning into vampires. The state responds with street bans and lethal enforcement. Moira is taken in by her girlfriend Valerie – unaware Valerie hunts her kind. Can Valerie keep her secret? What happens when Moira learns the truth? [From Itch.io]

title: les cites de la marta
description: short story about a weird girl trying to date [From Itch.io]

title: Renata The Warrior
description: When the construction worker of a death tournament finds out her wife entered, she must do everything she can to keep her alive. [From Itch.io]

title: Four Hundred Years Since Marriage
description: Camille is a thousand-year-old vampire, adapting to a world in rapid evolution. Habit settles in as she drifts further and further into a simpler, easier routine. But maybe she’s drifted away from something more important than bagged blood and working from home. [From Itch.io]

title: Exactly What You Came Here For
description: Sarah feels her life is over. She is unable to live for herself, but perhaps she can live for another. She takes the only option she can think of, and with nothing left to lose, learns exactly how much can still be taken from her. [From itch.io]

title: Love in Lavender
description: You're a recessive omega hired to take care of an alpha who’s been a shut-in for years. You meet her, and she immediately scurries away to hide in her room on the first day. Oops. It’s awkward at first, but you two eventually start to…become friends? Can you help heal her heart or maybe even capture it? First game of the My Charming Alpha series. [From itch.io]

title: Protocol Smile
description: Jade is a former idol – namely because all the other humans are dead, so there’s no one left for her to perform for. But hey, at least she has her robot friends to keep her company… right? [From Itch.io]

title: Crimson Bonds
description: Four vampire ladies are dying for a taste of you. Who will you choose? [From Dorian app]

title: Deja Vu
description: In this kinetic visual novel, you play as Gwen, an office worker at Pendragon Corporations. Navigate your feelings for your coworker and boss while glimpsing the past and future. [From Itch.io]

title: Hunted
description: Lilian, a hunter in 20XX, grew up on warnings: vampires are dangerous, keep away. Peace treaties made hunting mostly obsolete, but the prejudice remains. One impulsive message on a dating app leads to months of talks, and now a meeting that may prove your family wrong. [From Itch.io]

title: A Sprinkle of Love
description: On a rainy afternoon, Aoi stumbles into a small neighborhood bakery and meets Hana—the quiet girl behind the counter with a love for pastries and shy smiles. What begins as a simple purchase slowly turns into something sweeter, as small conversations and shared moments bring them closer together. [From itch.io]

title: Coffee Cosmos
description: It's hard to start your life over – especially when you're doing it in a new place with nothing to your name. But by a stroke of luck, you landed a position at a prestigious coffee shop downtown. The pay is great, the hours are consistent, and if you can keep up with the workload, you should be able to rent a place nearby in no time at all. Things are looking up. [From Itch.io]

title: Four Fangs Bite Into Her Tender Flesh
description: In a manor behind red curtains lies an abattoir – and a coffin where two women sleep. On a deserted road, Angela’s engine dies. She finds the house, knocks, and asks for help. Elisabetta smiles and lets her in. [From Itch.io]

title: Missile Princess
description: Joan Hudson is the daughter of a billionaire defense contractor. Her dad sends her to a naval warship full of dinosaur women. [From itch.io]

title: The Queen of Phalli
description: In the dark depths of the realms below, power and status depend on passion and promiscuity. It is a world of wonders where only women dwell and the priestesses of the Queen of Phalli rule unmatched. Young Elifael El'Naar must prepare for her Baptism, a perilous ceremony to prove her loyalty to her House and devotion to the Goddess. Should she succeed, she will have taken her first step to becoming a priestess herself. Should she fail, she may lose her status and even her mind. [From Steam]

title: Illusory Haze
description: On a porch that exists outside time, a lonely spirit waits. When a curious girl stumbles through a mysterious mirage, their worlds collide. Through board games, shared jokes, and quiet afternoons, they forge a connection. [From Itch.io]

title: The Final Stew
description: Irone was cooked as Ambia's food, leaving the world of the living. Now, as a ghost, Irone watches Ambia prepare one last meal from Irone's body. [From Itch.io]

title: Fluttershy's Laundromat Troubles
description: A shy pony is trying to make friends at the Laundromat, will things go well? [From itch.io]

title: P.A.G.E
description: This is a short romantic narrative about a young woman on vacation. She's single and exploring a new country, and a generally hopeless lesbian adrift in the world. She stumbles across a small cozy bookstore while out and about, and encounters a few gorgeous women that enrapture her on sight. [From itch.io]

title: SCYTHEBAT
description: A lesbian, mixed-media/experimental visual novel about two girls running away from their past in a post-apocalyptic, zombie-infested world. Follow Maria and Lorelei through their time together and apart, slowly uncovering the reason why they are the way they are. [Edited from itch.io]

title: Dark Lord Verkins
description: Queen Verkins is the dragon queen and one of the three rulers of the underworld. Queen Galzra is the grim reaper queen and also is a ruler. Explore the story and lore about Verkins, ruler of dragons. This is a romantic love story between these two in this short romance visual novel. [From Steam]

title: Garden Of Sunderin
description: Being a transfer student is never easy. It’s even more difficult for Iris, as she has to adapt to Sunderin Academy, where failure is not an option. [From itch.io]

title: A Chef's Oncoming Breakdown.
description: What does it take to become the best girlfriend you can be? How far do you have to go? How much of yourself do you have to sacrifice? How much sleep do you lose? The meals you skip? The medicine you stop taking? The things you leave unsaid? When does one break? Giulia, a cooking school student and girlfriend to a bare-knuckle brawler, wants to be the best she can be for her cool girlfriend (according to Giulia), Fern. She wants to be the person Fern can depend on and count on, and this has been going well for a while, but everything gives in eventually. You only have so much to give, and at some point, things break down. And when they do, they do so violently. [From itch.io]

title: Sweet Treat
description: You're new to this city, having moved to pursue a new line of work. Having come from a quiet village, life here is a bit more exhausting than you expected. You find yourself in need of a quiet place with a cozy atmosphere, to clear your mind while you work and stumble across a maid cafe on your route home. The thing is, the girls here are really cute and your visits for peace and quiet might end up more along the lines of distractions... [From itch.io]

title: Karolina's Confession
description: A wholesome romance (with a tinge of angst) between two young, noble nuns within a women's monastery in the early Middle Ages, who must hide their love from the strictly conservative high priest. [From itch.io]

title: Night Shifts in Silence
description: A favor called in, a week's worth of night shifts at a corner convienence store. Paried with a chill co-worker, seeing little foot traffic. A few quiet nights to let time pass by. Right? [From itch.io]

title: I think my roommate is the Antichrist
description: A young exorcist student finds out that she's sharing a room with the devil. [From itch.io]

title: WYSLLORA
description: A cosy visual novel about a bunny girl and her newfound friend as she figures things out on her first day in the world she finds herself in. [From itch.io]

title: Echoes of a Wildflower
description: Faith arrives in Willowvale looking for answers about Maya’s sudden disappearance. Each Polaroid and personal account reveals both affection for Maya and the hidden pain she carried. Faith follows these threads to find her and help her heal. [From Itch.io]

title: Gina's Heartracing Adventure
description: Join Gina on her temporary job transfer. [From itch.io]

title: The Girl in Red: The Intrusive Chapter
description: One knock. One stranger. And suddenly, Julia’s ordinary evening spirals into a nightmare. [From Itch.io]

title: Wo de Nüyou Naozi You Wenti
A Day To Remember
description: You play as Aino, wanting to confess her feelings for Rain after being around her for so many years. Both haven't had much time together cause of adult life, can they strengthen their bond again like old times and maybe become something more? Or will they remain friends? [Edited from itch.io]

title: Date the Daitengu
description: One day, the festival-loving Great Tengu, Megumu Iizunamaru... isn't invited to a festival?! She decides to act upon this transgression in the most revengeful (and admittedly childish) way possible: By scoring a date at the festival and showing up that stupid organiser! [From itch.io]

title: Nahi's Winter Holidate
tags: Heroine Based on a Fictional Person
Protagonist Based on a Fictional Person
Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: Step into the shoes of Nahi Kikomori, a shut-in vampire girl who is content to spend the holiday season in hibernation. That is, until she receives a message with an invitation to a local tree-lighting event. Who will she choose to spend this romantic evening with? [From Itch.io]

title: Her Willing Sacrifice
description: You are a maid in love with the princess of the castle you work in and she seems rather fond of you as well. Unfortunately for you both, such relations aren't exactly allowed. Will the two of you ever break free from your oppressive circumstances, or will you be cruelly separated? Maybe something supernatural will come to your aid... [From itch.io]

title: Love me, Damn it!
description: The spectacular succubus, Sakura, has fallen in love with a total social shut-in that only leaves her dorm room for music classes. Don't ask how that happened, she barely knows either! All Sakura does know is that Hana, the total music nerd, needs to be hers. No matter what it takes! Of course that includes some liberally applied devil brainwashing magic and fighting Hana's nightmares filled with music. [From itch.io]

title: Yuri Love Dungeon
description: An overpowered succubus has entered a dungeon. Her influence is so strong that half the adventurers sent to remove her are painting hearts (or naughtier things) on the walls instead of fighting monsters, and, when a goblin leaps out, it’s as likely to try and snog you as attack you. Play as either [Cleric] or [Ranger]. Both have been hopeless about love since wizarding school where they met a certain someone they cannot get out of their minds. Surely, the succubus' sensual power will have no effect on them! [From itch.io]

title: 'Til Death Do Us Part (Temporarily)
description: You're going out on a date with your beautiful goth necromantress girlfriend, whom you like very much, and are entirely devoted to. And who, unfortunately, accidentally kills you. A lot. Her hugs break your bones, her kisses stop your heart, minute disagreements over dinner cause you to be pulled under by the hordes of the undead. Luckily, resurrection is easy! [Edited from itch.io]

title: Be Nunner
description: Short romantic comedy VN about a nun, who kisses a succubus, and tries not to go to hell (or not). [From itch.io]

title: The Runner
description: Toxic cyberpunk yuri interactive fiction about friendship, love and transhuman sports. How far should you go for those dear to you? [From itch.io]

title: Once Upon A Kiss
description: Mary has been dreaming of finding her one true love ever since she was a kid. With her stepping up to take care of the farm, will she ever find one? And what do you mean there's a monster who can grant people wishes... [From itch.io]

title: them’s swordfighting words!
description: Brande (pronounced brand-ee) is the best fencer in the entire Holy Union.She's the cream of the crop, the cutting edge. She's the one who will win the championship and earn the right to slay the feral god under their lands--The Almighty Opponent. But when her ex-rival Jaya returns from her years-long mission abroad, Brande's destined victory starts to come into question. [From itch.io]

title: Garden Of Flowers
description: Made for VN CUP #2.

title: TEMPTING FATE: CHASING HIGHS
description: Two girls play a deadly game, only one of them can leave the room alive. Maybe they'll kiss about it along the way? Nothing could possibly go awry! [From itch.io]

title: Amai Yume no Shinigami-san
title_original: 甘い夢のしにがみさん
description: A yuri (girls' love) novel game where there is no such thing as a 100-point perfect happy ending — every ending is a bad ending. Kokomi is a high school senior harboring an unspoken, secret crush on Amami, her best friend from club activities. One night, Kokomi has a strange dream. In it, she and Amami seem to be lovers...? ――Choose. Between the real me, or the me in your dreams. The deadline given by the Amami in her dream happens to fall on the day of their final club activity. One week. As she moves back and forth between dream and reality, Kokomi searches for an answer she won't regret.

title: Melancholy Lake
description: Two girls go on a date in the middle of a violent, collapsing world. Despite their contrasting temperaments, Holly and Isabel carve out a fragile pocket of tenderness, using each other as refuge from everything around them. [From Steam]

title: Divine Light
description: Awakening to a world unfamiliar to her, Uri finds herself living with Cas, an angel who hit her with her car. She's entranced, fixated on her halo, her heavenly glow. Uri asks to stay with her, not knowing what it is she's signing up for. Cas just hit a girl with her car. Whoops. She can't take her to the hospital, and the girl seems to want to live with her. Why not give her a chance? After all, humans are the reason she's here in the first place. [From itch.io]

title: PeriPetEia
description: Two women, one man; the revenge of a flower representing friendship, love, poison, sex and death. Produced for the 2026 Ryona Yuri VN Jam. [From itch.io]

title: Blood drips from the mouth of Sappho
description: Iphigenia gets more than her blood sucked in this visual novel homage to the sleaziest of 1970s lesbian vampire movies.

title: Unmasked
description: After a dozen years of depending on her parents to fulfil her every desire, Sakura (changeable name) has been sent to Wakahisa Academy in order to learn some independence. Or at least that's what her parents claim. Really the school's a bit on the shady side. The dress code requires everyone, even the teachers, to wear a mask at all times. All the people seem to be cheery enough, but it's almost as though they're afraid to feel any other way... Nonetheless, Sakura's got to at least make it through a month of independence, so she might as well make some friends while she's at it. [From Itch.io]

title: Magical Lesbian Academy
description: It's a magical college filled with hot lesbian furries. Can Wonder survive or fall to her own lust? [From itch.io]

title: DRMWRLDGRL
description: Emmett is a regular girl, she lives a regular life and doesn't have many complaints. Nova is a dream imp made from ash and bone. One day they meet. [From itch.io]

title: Tower
description: a story about two (girl) friends on a grey, vertical tower. [From itch.io]

title: We'll Live - Together
description: A linear visual novel following two protagonists on their short journey as they experience a strange alternative reality together. Watch as this world reveals their true feelings, and how one good meal really is the way to a lover's heart. [From itch.io]

title: Monitoring U
description: A toxic yuri visual novel about an immortal alien girl and the scientist trying to kill her. You control Cybin, the scientist that found U-836 in the first place, who wants her dead at all costs. U-836, or simply 'U' for short, is an alien? Mushroom girl? Thing???? Whatever she is, she wants Cybin. Badly. [From itch.io]

title: Nefur Apawrt
description: "Nefur Apawrt" follows Sunny, a laidback dog, and Pumpkin, an anxious (transgender!!!) cat, as they go on a date! Follow one of two paths where they try to have a fun time while navigating personal issues. [From itch.io]

title: The Safest House
description: After getting her hands on a key, Harper invites Rosé to steal from a Shadow Vault safehouse. However, it isn't long before the two women are trapped inside. Their only way out is to solve puzzles hidden within its rooms. Problem is, neither of them brought any puzzle solving skills with them. [From itch.io]

title: Shelly's Future Past
description: Shelly's Future Past is a Sci Fi Erotic Lesbian Time Travel Adventure, about a female protagonist 23 year old lesbian woman, who lives in the year 3077 within Cyber City with her best friend Triss Shelly, who, has lived a emotional rollercoaster life, is special in way that will come to light in this visual novel A Mystery Lady from the future, that knows Shelly very well, travels back in time to find Shelly and asks her for her help to stop the end of the world from 5 very powerful men in the future that have taken control of the Earth Shelly thinks she is travelling back in time to change the past to save the future, but, will quickly find out she is actually needs to correct the time line Shelly is asked to travel back in time, to five very different time lines, to find 5 different woman, one on each time line and find a way to stop them from ever getting pregnant from an alien man, which will stop 5 powerful men from ever being born and destroying humanity in the future, resulting in them never being born, this will then will save the future and end the war But it won't be easy, as one of the powerful men is also travelling back in time [From Itch.io]

title: Guanyu Wo Bei Xuejie Jianhui Jia Dang Nüyou Zhe Jian Shi
title_original: 关于我被学姐捡回家当女友这件事
description: “Bang—!” Tenna, a girl who has just arrived in the big city, barely has time to feel the warmth of this land of opportunity before crashing headfirst into the harshness of reality. In her moment of despair, the one who reaches out to help her… …is a senpai who appears like an angel — Natsu. “Are you okay?!” A single act of kindness. An unexpected connection between girls from the same hometown… “Meeting Senpai Natsu… it must be fate…! (✧ω✧)” But after that fleeting warmth comes a cold, unforgiving bank notification: 【Account Transfer -150,000 ￥】 What is the truth behind this enormous debt? Will you confront your senpai and demand answers… or simply accept your fate? And thus begins a light yuri story of two girls living together and supporting one another — sparked by a single “debt”! “Th-That’s not true! We’re not in that kind of relationship… …probably? (✧ω✧)” [From Steam]

title: Magic Exposure 2
description: After the events surrounding the magic camera, Erika and Bianca's seemingly perfect relationship runs into trouble, leading them to break up. As Bianca processes her feelings, her life takes another turn for the worse when she encounters a second mysterious magic camera and meets Lúcia, the intelligent and polished president of the school council. Will fate rekindle her love for Erika? Or will it lead her down new paths with the newcomer? [From Steam]

title: Xia Ri Shuiguo Tang
description: A Yuri interactive visual novel about "Day and Night Out of Sync." Two girls, living in different rhythms, exchange hearts through letters and fruit candies. A poignant summer tale of youth and hidden feelings. [From Steam]

title: Reflections: Beyond the Canvas
description: You're a game art student. Drawing comes easily to you. Imagining even more so. Framing scenes. Studying light. Turning fleeting ideas into something real. But one morning, a new student walks into your classroom. And she looks exactly like the girl you dreamed about. Exactly like the one you drew. That shouldn’t be possible. [From itch.io]

title: Avenging Angel Hikari Akeldama
description: Since the dawn of mankind, Heaven has been waging a war against the demonic forces of Hell through the use of child soldiers-turned-bioweapons known as "Angels". The year is 201X. In the city of Bethel, when the leader of the St. Abraham's High School Angel Brigade, Hikari Akeldama, begins to unravel the dark truth of the war she's been fighting for years, what she discovers will drive a wedge between her and the rest of the platoon as she tries to find the answer to an age-old question: Is it better to reign in Hell than to serve in Heaven? [From itch.io]

title: Victim Soul
description: A visual novel about violent sex, messy t4t relationships, and Catholicism as a coping mechanism. [From itch.io]

title: Majo Kuruibana
description: Kuro, the protagonist, had lost her mother to a witch at a young age. Driven by a thirst for revenge, Kuro enrolls in the "Witch Academy", an institution where that very same witch reigns supreme as Headmistress. A light-hearted "Revenge Yuri Visual Novel" in which you strive to reach the top of the academy alongside a cast of adorable witches. [Translated from Novelgame]

title: A Taste of Her Blood
tags: Modern Day United States of America
description: Ksenia is a vampire who's lived among humankind for hundreds of years. After attending an unexpected party, she arrives home in the middle of the night and reflects back on her past life and how she originally met her wife: Eve. A Taste of Her Blood is a kinetic visual novel developed from March to April 2026 for Sapphic Monster Girl Fluff Jam 2026. [From Itch.io]

Will she love or hate the angel? Free on Itch.io to try https://sharkatto.itch.io/mandibola-demo

title: Ni Shi Wo Zuimei de Tonghua
My Big Bad Wolf
description: On the way to visit her grandma, Ruby Ryder has a choice encounter with the big bad wolf herself. Despite their rocky start, the two form an unlikely friendship. As the lines between romance and platonic affection are blurred, Ruby is forced to make a choice. The expectations of those around her, or her own happiness. [From Itch.io]

title: Lily Trail: A Tale of Spirits that Bloom in the West
description: Guided by a mysterious and recurring dream, a lone Sister leaves her abbey on the small island of Hybraesail and travels across the sea to the West. This is finally her chance to make her dream come true of founding her own school. She joins a wagon driven by the mysterious Ven Barrister who plans to take a secret route. Joining her are Beatrix—a well-to-do young woman, Palmira—a skilled hunter and guide, Euodia—a woman hoping to improve herself, and a young girl named Itzel. However, not everything is that simple. Ven's past is filled with trouble, the other travelers have their own issues, and Itzel keeps talking about...a wish granting dragon? [From itch.io]

title: Masc-erade
description: You're reluctantly going to a work event, but oops! You turned up at the wrong venue! Turns out this venue is double booked for both a masquerade ball and a rave where everyone wears homemade masks. You should leave and get to the work event... but there are too many hot women here!! You've got to stay and talk to a few of them! [From itch.io]

title: Mutualistic Saudade
description: 348 days // 10 hours // 27 minutes That's how long Hazel Hathaway of the American Union[AU] had been aboard the Orbital Space Station[OSS] when the nuclear war came to an end. But this isn't a story about all that. This is the story of what came after. Of the last two survivors: a Beta and an Omega, living out their last days in each others company. [From itch.io]

title: cant help being a gemini
description: Gloria is not an Alpha, not an Omega... she's both? How will she maneuver a world that only sees one or the other? How will she fall in love if only half of her heart is ever considered? And will she ever fix her VCR? [From itch.io]

title: buttgesterone
description: Amber and Lizzy seem like a typical couple, despite their age gap. But Amber's anything but a typical person. In fact, calling it a 'person' is pretty generous. Girls will turn into butts, butts will be in crisis, and somehow, we'll all make it out okay. [Edited from itch.io]

title: i have no mouth and i am feet
description: Something wakes up in a bedroom, its mind foggy and body immobile. Slowly, it pieces together its fate. An erotic horror VN about a girl who turns into a foot forever. [From itch.io]

title: Unfinished
description: A nice little story to snack on, where you play as a lonely anxiety-ridden artist who brought three women to life, and you get a peek into how things are going to play out going forward. [From itch.io]

title: Dengdai Fuchou Ri
description: The story takes place in a fictional world of sword and sorcery. The protagonist, Amelia, comes from a powerful family of magicians, yet she was exiled due to her abysmal magical aptitude. After being forced to move into a haunted house, she encounters the ghost of its former owner, and the story begins. [Translated from Steam]

title: Eververt
description: Three women undergo an experimental surgery that allows them to see a new color called eververt, greener than any green. Jana, an investigative journalist, catches wind of the fact that all three have undergone bizarre changes to their behavior since the procedure, and sets out to craft a story about the experience. It's not long before she finds herself in deep over her head, trying to comprehend the mysterious power this new color holds over the women, and the power that they in turn seem to hold over her. Get sucked into the spiral of obsession and delusion with the moody intellectual Karen, the anxious hypochondriac Jess, or the manic yandere Gabrielle. You are going to discover the power of eververt for yourself, even if they have to make you. [From itch.io]

title: Relationships Are Like Rollercoasters
description: Relationships are like rollercoasters. Sometimes, you turn upside down. Sometimes, you feel sick. Watch a long-time friendship between two women degenerate when one of them gets a girlfriend. [From itch.io]

title: Collar & Chain
description: Needing money to support her ill mother, Abigail applies for a housekeeping job at a mansion. The only issue is, she really sucks at her work... To remedy this, the mansion's owner and her boss, Nora Crescentwood, takes it upon herself to watch over Abigail and whip her into shape. As things worsen at home, how will Nora and Abigail's relationship develop...? [From itch.io]

title: NEUROCHIMERISM
description: Minette is a deeply traumatized individual with no hopes for her future. Vermelia thinks she can change her mind. NEUROCHIMERISM is a visual novel about a desperate woman-thing and her strange relationship with the only person in the world who wants to help her. No options are off limits, nothing is too much. Even if it means changing her from the inside. Even if it means 'Minette' is no longer Minette. [From itch.io]

title: One Must Imagine Pavlov's Dog Happy
description: A visual novel about a dog struggling to move on after her bell has left her life. [From itch.io]

title: Let Dreaming Androids Lie
description: This story centers around the relationship of an android and her creator, exploring trauma and what it means to be a human from the eyes of a machine created to imitate one. [Edited from Bluesky post]

title: Carmilla: Sanguis et Amor
description: When a vampire slowly twists a girls heart to her whims, what's a girl to do? This is the tale of Laura, a Victorian young woman living in a castle in Styria, when she and her father take in an unexpected guest, the beautiful and languid Carmilla. Little do either of them know, Carmilla will be the undoing of their sanity and their lives. [From itch.io]

title: In Her Riptide's Embrace
description: While on an HR-mandated "vacation," a burnt out office worker comes across an injured mermaid. She attempts to rescue the mermaid, only to learn that some wounds are far deeper than physical. [From itch.io]

title: Honey.
description: A primarily kinetic vn following Mackenzie; a 25 year old just trying to adjust to life post break-up alongside her best friend and roommate. Desperate for a job, but she seems to find the perfect position just when she needs it. The only catch is whatever's going on with her new boss. [From itch.io]

title: Stained Lace
description: A maid who is struggling through life happens upon a job that might allow a brief reprieve from her troubled past. But it may also define her future. [From itch.io]

title: Bypassed Affection
description: Graduation has come for Ivy, and with it the final knell in her gradual estrangement from her roommate and best friend, Lilac. In the midst of her rumination, a mysterious figure calling themself a god offers a chance to peer into her memories... [From itch.io]

title: Blood Wine: Astringency
description: A lonely bar-ista fucks a legally dead girl. It hurts. And they both like it. [From itch.io]

title: The Forest of Tangled Threads
description: After their party’s healer is cursed with a mysterious illness, Malen and Valina— a paladin and magician duo— must venture into a demonic forest in order to save her. Tensions rise as Malen ruminates over her own past, as well as her and Valina’s relationship; why is it different ever since Lorel joined their party? Can it be mended again now that she’s out of the picture? Or will The Heart’s trials destroy them both? [From itch.io]

title: Infinite Life
description: "Infinite Life" is a hit new VR sim that's causing a lot of buzz! For Lyra and Klara though, it's causing them confusion! The real world may be a dull, lifeless, sad drone of mundane experiences and false existences, IL is a world popping with color and life! INFINITE life, you could say! Join them on this journey of self-exploration, though be warned... what they find may not be what you like. Or expect! [From itch.io]

title: Cinderbridge
description: Cat Poetry Professor x Wolf Psychology Professor, featuring EVIL HORSE WOMAN who sends their entire relationship into a fucked up tailspin. They both begin to ask themselves the question; is this love a poetic feeling, or a psychological concept? [From Itch.io]

title: EDIFICE ANGELS.
description: An Angelic Tragedy in Three Acts! In this visual novel, immortal angels are bound for life to heavenly megastructures, toiling away in pursuit of God's love and attention. Yet some angels in this undying kingdom seek more beautiful, haunted and sapphic forms of love. How far will they go to change fate?

title: Red Carnation
description: "Congratulations! The love of your life has you locked up in her basement, ready to lavish you with endless affection and attention. The only price you have to pay in return? Your autonomy! Give up your identity and be her perfect "Aster" replacement." *** Freesia finds herself in what appears to be her brother's room, smothered in her brother's girlfriend's embrace. The girl she's been pining for finally decided to give her her love, but the price of having to live life as her brother is too steep for Freesia to be willing to pay. Red Carnarion is an 18+ NSFW yuri (girls love) VN featuring two girls committed to realizing their love even if by grotesque means. Would you accept love knowing it's only "yours" when you forsake yourself? [From Itch.io]

title: Thicc of the Woods
description: Play as Tess Taylor, a 29 year old woman, as she explores the backyard forest of her childhood home, only to discover it leads to the Fairy Realm; a land of mischievous pixies, cackling goblins, and haunting will-o-wisps, all of whom are eager to get closer to Tess, feeding her more and more. A moment on the lips, an eternity on the hips. Help Tess navigate the Fairy Realm before she gets stuck forever in...the Thicc of the Woods. [From itch.io]

title: Porcelain Hearts
description: In the city of Las Vegas a serial killer is on the prowl: The Nightshade Killer. Dana Harding is investigating these killings as an Autopsy Technician. Dana's work is interrupted by a strange girl from her college. What is Valerie after? And why does she seem so familiar? Maybe Nightshade is closer then it seems. [From itch.io]

title: Forever Us
description: Kiran Rinaldi awakens one day, confused about how her surroundings, herself, and life in general. All she knows is she is waiting for her parents to return. As she goes about her routine, she remembers more and more about her life. Taking place in the Rinaldi Sanctum, a centuries-old seaside sanctum dedicated to the goddess of death, she struggles to adjust to a life that feels strangely unfamiliar. Early on, she is reunited with Aizia Callow who presents as an a kind, albeit eccentric and possibly dangerous childhood friend whose fascination with death is matched only by her unwavering devotion to Kiran. As the days pass, forgotten memories begin to resurface, unsettling truths come to light, and the line between grief and obsession grows dangerously thin. Faced with a love that refuses to accept mortality, Kiran must ultimately decide whether to let go... or remain forever. [From itch.io]

title: Lady Lucretia's Mendacious Malpractice
description: About a hundred years ago, one Penelope Belivet walks into the office of intrepid lady psychoanalyst Lucretia Gilman. Lucretia can't seem to cure Penny's melancholia, even as her fondness for her patient grows stronger and stronger. Perhaps if she could act upon her desire, it could improve Penny's outlook? It's a shame that the repressive era she lives in makes it so difficult to do so... About a hundred years ago, one Crocus manifests into the basement of intrepid man psychoanalyst Oliver Crawford. Crocus can't seem to figure out why this era refuses to grant women the freedom to love each other, even as Lucretia and Penny grow closer and closer on the floor above it. Perhaps if it could convince Lucretia to act upon her desire, she could inspire other women to do the same? It's a shame that Lucretia and Penny have such a difficult time understanding each other's needs... [From itch.io]

title: The Heaven Game: Empty Skull Gaiden
