title: A Time of Life
description: Set in the Rebuild of Evangelion universe, "A Time of Life" helps bridge a critical divide between Evangelion 2.22 You Can (Not) Advance and Evangelion 3.33 You Can (Not) Redo. Told from the perspective of Mari Illustrious Makinami. [Edited from Son of Carnelian]
full_description: Set in the Rebuild of Evangelion universe, "A Time of Life" helps bridge a critical divide between Evangelion 2.22 You Can (Not) Advance and Evangelion 3.33 You Can (Not) Redo. Told from the perspective of Mari Illustrious Makinami. [Edited from Son of Carnelian]

title: Cross Ange - Tenshi to Ryuu no Rondo tr.
title_original: クロスアンジュ 天使と竜の輪舞tr.
tags: Future Setting in a Fictional World
description: An original story of the series with a new protagonist called Naomi and which is divided into 10 chapters. The game follows the beginning of the anime but then drifts into an alternative story. The game consists of two parts: Drama and Action. In Drama, you watch the story and events unfold while pursuing one of the heroines, and in Action, you fight against the DRAGONs and other enemies who come in the way. There is also a mode where you can touch the heroines.

characters.name: Naomi
characters.description: A rookie ParaMail rider who has been assigned to the First Unit. She is Miranda's childhood friend. Due to her debts, she runs around day and night in Arzenal to pay them off. In order to survive, she trusts her companions and believes that teamwork can help people survive for longer. Due to this, Naomi is known as the peacemaker within her team.

characters.name: Angelise Ikaruga Misurugi
characters.original: アンジュリーゼ・斑鳩・ミスルギ
characters.description: Nicknamed and widely known as "Ange" in Arzenal, she is the first daughter and princess of the Misurugi Empire. However, on the day she was supposed to inherit the throne, her brother sold her out and revealed that she's actually a Norma. Right after the same event, Ange was stripped of her fame, honor and title and thrown into Arzenal. Due to her status as a former princess, Ange is very prideful and stubborn, and tends to get often into fights with the other members.

characters.name: Hilda
characters.description: The First Unit's second-in-command after Zola, her lover and the ex-captain, was killed and one of the "veteran" ParaMail riders. She acts quite hostile towards Ange and displays a cynical view of the world. However, according to the others, Hilda used to have the same personality as Ange when she first came into Arzenal.

characters.name: Chris
characters.description: A veteran ParaMail rider of the First Unit. Despite her blunt personality, she is also quite shy and negative. Chris is also always hiding behind her two best friends, Hilda and Rosalie, who also happen to be her childhood friends as well. Chris is also very dependant of her friends and starts feeling lonely when she's left alone.

characters.name: Vivian
characters.description: A ParaMail rider of the First Unit who has extraordinarily good combat abilities. Vivian is a naturally cheerful and airheaded girl whose hobby is suddenly making up quizzes and then asking her friends about them. Unlike the rest of the unit, she's also very friendly toward everybody. She is always shown eating lollipops.

characters.name: Salia
characters.description: A ParaMail rider of the First Unit and its captain after Zola's death. A very serious and hardworking soldier who is very skilled, but acts like a complete textbook example of one. She has a secret hobby of cosplaying as a magical girl from the books she reads during her free time.

characters.name: Rosalie
characters.description: One of the "veteran" ParaMail riders and a light artillery member of the First Unit. A childhood friend of Hilda and Chris, Rosalie is always tagging alongside them. She isn't very skilled, but has survived up until now by tagging along with someone who has power, and is shown to love money. After Zola's death, Rosalie shows a grudge against Ange.

characters.name: Ersha
characters.description: A heavy artillery member and one of the "veteran" ParaMail riders of the First Unit. Her cooking skills are better than her combat skills, and she is also rather motherly, acting as the motherly figure of Arzenal and taking care of Vivian. She also takes care of the children living in Arzenal who mean everything to her. When offended or angered, Ersha turns into a very scary person, which is something that the members of Arzenal are always avoiding.

characters.name: Tusk
characters.description: A young man Ange met in the forest under Arzenal. He has some kind of connection with Villikiss, Ange's ParaMail. His parents used to be ParaMail riders who were killed years before the events of the series. He is also knowledgeable about repairing ParaMails.

characters.name: Momoka Oginome
characters.description: Ange's loyal and extraordinarily skilled maid who follows her everywhere. She has served Ange ever since her childhood and was shown to be the one who used Mana instead, hiding the fact that Ange is actually a Norma.

characters.name: Mei
characters.description: A young mechanic who serves as the First Unit's ParaMail management team's leader. Despite her young appearance, Mei is very knowledgeable about machines and ParaMails in general. She claims to be able to somewhat understand the feelings the ParaMail's pilot when she does maintenance on them.

characters.name: Coco
characters.description: A new cadet who was assigned at the same time as Miranda. A dreamy girl who loves daydreams, pudding and picture books. Admires Ange who is just like a beautiful, smart and strong character straight out of a picture book or fairy tale.

characters.name: Miranda
characters.description: A new cadet who was assigned at the same time as Coco. A serious but hardworking girl who strives to become as good as captain Zola. She sees people like Ange as major trouble.

characters.name: Sylvia Ikaruga Misurugi
characters.original: シルヴィア・斑鳩・ミスルギ
characters.description: The youngest daughter of the Misurugi royal empire's family and Ange and Julio's younger sister. She used to admire her sister until she was revealed to be a Norma. Due to her being a paraplegic, she uses a mana powered floating chair to move around.

characters.name: Jill
characters.description: The strict but very competent supreme commander of Arzenal. Due to her rough personality, she is feared by many. Her right arm is mechanical due to a past accident.

characters.name: Julio Asuka Misurugi
characters.original: ジュリオ・飛鳥・ミスルギ
characters.description: Ange's older brother who acts like a kind, easygoing brother, but is actually a sadist and very arrogant. He is the one responsible for getting Ange exiled from the empire and sent to Arzenal. He dislikes anything that is dirty, or in other words, Norma.

characters.name: Salamandinay
characters.description: A miko, princess and DRAGON from another world, the "real Earth" which is 500 years into the future. She is quite popular with many people due to her endearing and proactive personality. Also nicknamed "Salako" by Ange, she wishes to return Aura, the original DRAGON, back to their world.

characters.name: Zola
characters.description: The captain of the First Unit and one of the veteran ParaMail riders. She has escaped death many times in the past, and is a woman who enjoys having sex with new cadets, despite being Hilda's lover. Her right eye is also artificial.

characters.name: Naga
characters.description: A member of Sala's entourage, a swordswoman and DRAGON. She pilots the mecha called Ryu-Shing-Ki Soryugo. She respects and is deeply in love with Salamandinay, to the point where she will become hostile if somebody tries to do something to her dear Sala.

characters.name: Kaname
characters.description: A member of Sala's entourage and a DRAGON. The pilot of the mecha Ryu-Shing-Ki Hekiryugo. She has been serving Salamandinay since she was young alongside Naga, who is her close friend. She is also the staff officer of Sala, a discreet person who has the capacity to see the big picture.

characters.name: Embryo
characters.description: A man who is completely shrouded in mystery who owns lost technology, ancient weapons and techniques from the ancient times. Embryo resents the world from a position which is one step higher than that of the administrators. For some reason, Jill has very bitter feelings towards him.

characters.name: Emma Bronson
characters.description: The only Mana user in Arzenal and second in-command who was sent to monitor the Norma. She looks down on the Norma and tries to manage the girls with her strict training, and takes rules very seriously.

characters.name: Jasmine
characters.description: A retired ParaMail rider who is also Jill's friend. She is the owner of the huge market place in Arzenal called "Jasmine Mall" which sells all kinds of goods she manages to get her hands into. She is also a shrewd businesswoman who takes full advantage of her business monopoly in the island.

characters.name: Maggy
characters.description: The medical officer of Arzenal and the cybernetics repair expert who is also Jill's long-time friend. She is bad-mouthed and a tad cruel as she enjoys the sight of blood. However, her skills are worthy of her name: she has saved the lives of very many Normas.

full_description: An original story of the series with a new protagonist called Naomi and which is divided into 10 chapters. The game follows the beginning of the anime but then drifts into an alternative story. The game consists of two parts: Drama and Action. In Drama, you watch the story and events unfold while pursuing one of the heroines, and in Action, you fight against the DRAGONs and other enemies who come in the way. There is also a mode where you can touch the heroines.

title: Subete no Koi ni, Hanataba o.
description: Nagisa Seishuu has returned from the city to her hometown in the countryside after two years. Feeling at odds with the boring monotony that her life has become, she thinks that perhaps it would be best to simply become a hermit. But then an unexpected encounter changes things. She meets three other girls who are more than what they seem: they're spirits. And, curiously enough, only Nagisa can see or interact with them. None of them, including Nagisa herself, know what love is like. But perhaps they can learn. In an unknown town, an unfamiliar miracle has begun to search a corner of the world for a tiny flame of happiness. [From ANN]

Ambitious and power-hungry, Madeleine will trample anyone to become the Queen of Cordonia.

His friendship with Liam appears mismatched, as he did not have the lineage to be introduced into the Prince's circle of friends. However, he is not ashamed of his background and prides himself in being self-sufficient. [spoiler]Once he opens up, Your Character begins to notice that he is observant, caring, and very loyal to his friends. If romanced, he is also self-deprecating, insecure, and vulnerable around Your Character. [Edited from the Wiki]

Years before, Rashad's fiancée at the time felt neglected and shoved aside as his company was growing, forcing her to leave him. He has not forgotten how miserable the annulment of his engagement made him and so wants to prevent William from potentially experiencing the same thing at Katie's hands. On the way, the girls meet a daughter of the northern lord Liana, who is forced to hide under a wing of a flower seller and be under the strict supervision of her companion Rahl. But first, you must complete four trials with six romanceable immortals who are there to help you, and sometimes lovingly distract you... Pass Eonia’s trials to face your destiny and win eternal life in paradise. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Astrellio
characters.description: God of the Moon. Brooding, sincere, and a creature of the night. When he is not busy governing the tides and charting the cosmos, Astrellio seeks beauty and love to ground him.

characters.name: Aurelia
characters.description: Goddess of the Sun. Beneath her soothing exterior is a burning desire to protect those that she loves. Aurelia's undying optimism and achievements in Eonia are all at once inspiring, contagious, and at times, dangerous.

characters.name: Eeri
characters.description: Deity of Wisdom. Eeri holds so much knowledge in their mind that they sometimes neglect their heart. But if they ever pause in geeking out over their latest discovery, this deity will seek help in their slow and steady explorations of love.

characters.name: Vidas
characters.description: Deity of Intellect. A walking computer and an explosion of charm, Vidas is a witty immortal with a love for play. The only code they have yet to crack is how to truly wear their heart on their sleeve.

characters.name: Calysta
characters.description: Goddess of Strength. While this goddess has wielded all the strength in the realms for eons, she has no need to prove it. Her prowess is solid, unparalleled, and wildly sexy. Calysta is a rock for all who know her. She believes in everyone's potential for greatness.

characters.name: Dalia
characters.description: Eonia's oracle and reader of the Fates, Dalia is the all-knowing guide for deities in the pantheon. Despite her great power to see the future, she is nurturing and helpful, if you can manage to impress her.

characters.name: Leonidas
characters.description: God of Stamina. Leonidas can do just about anything forever, and his sights are set on adding love to that list. Beneath his confidence is a jubilant spirit that drives his infinite energy and zest for life.

description: It's just before 9 PM and the classroom is dark. A month ago, Mayumi started receiving alarming anonymous letters. She teaches at a school for high-class ladies, and suspects the culprit is a student as well — but the contents of the letters are both strange and obscene, detailing dissolute, promiscuous lesbian sex and an unmistakeable, base interest in Mayumi herself entirely unfitting for such ladies. She has summoned them to the classroom; all that remains is to wait for them to arrive, if they dare.

description: William Steele "I was just an ordinary kid when my world blew up." William Steele, a young man with a calling and our first main character, discovers that his region is home and that is worth protecting. Bent on helping his community, he ends up becoming a "fixer", a counselor, sometimes friend, always driven to help people who deserve it. Adeia Berith "It's not time to overthink... Trusting the world she's about to enter is as gentle as her, she's forced to find her way, ultimately discovering a dark reality nobody knew existed. Along the way, both William and Adeia meet a cast of supporting characters that change their fates, for the better and the worse. [From Itch.io]

Explore the camp, enjoying all the activities it has to offer while growing close to a certain special someone. But there's something puzzling about Camp Palut, and unraveling the mystery is the only way to keep you and your fellow campers safe. Will you save the day AND get the girl?

title: Kongmeng
description: "Vain Riser" is an AVG developed by Team Strrationalism. In the game, girls gather in the Victorian coastal town "Golden Sand Town" to achieve their dream of flying into the blue sky step by step. The youthful journey, however, was completely corrupted by the successive emergence of mysterious figures. Entanglements within family-ship and friendship gradually surfaced during these young girls' research, and the misted truth must be revealed. What was hidden in the past history of Golden Sand Town? Perhaps the story will remind you of the days when you had nothing and even confused about the future but still struggling to work hard, the days during which you grow up with your relatives' help. Though the destination may be too illusory to reach, one will finally be more clearer when facing themselves. [From Steam]

title: Moonlit Veil
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Halloween is your favorite night of the year, and you and your friends are more excited for it this year than any other. But you're a bit too old for trick or treating now; being seniors in high school, you've moved on to greener pastures -- the Halloween dance! The three of you still need to finish your costumes, but soon it'll be time. One way or another, you'll have the night of your lives. But... something seems a bit off. As the night draws nearer, you get the feeling there's something going on in the background. One of your friends clearly knows something she's not telling you, and some of the things that have been happening are.. odd. Can you figure out what's going on? Or... do you even need to? Maybe it's fine to just ignore it and have a good time. What's the worst that could happen? [From Itch.io]

title: Nima mislivicja
description: "The Silent Huntress" is a visual novel in the genre of a dark fairy tale with choices and different endings. A young girl named Gerda tracks down the Monster to revenge him for killing her younger brother. On the way, she meets fantastic creatures she has never seen before and in whose existence she did not believe. But this does not shake her determination to hunt down the Monster. [From Steam]

title: Trigaea
description: Could you survive an alien world? Change your genetics and wander the wasteland for answers, all the while aided by your AI companion. Trigaea is an epic 272,000-word piece of interactive fiction. It's a combination of a sci-fi novel and an RPG adventure game, where you are in control of the story. Game Highlights: - Augment yourself with animal, robot or alien parts. - Decide the fate of a planet. Deal with interesting moral dilemmas! - Fifteen different endings to unlock. Over 12 hours of gameplay. - Deal with enemies by talking, subduing, scaring, or fighting them. - Scrounge for microchips to unlock your memories and discover your past. - Play as male/female/non-binary or straight/bi/gay/ace. - Stunning alien landscapes from a range of professional sci-fi artists. [From Itch.io]

title: Courting the Crown
description: Life as heir to the throne of Arvore has always been peaceful, until a violent attack on the castle changes everything. Now as your unexpected coronation looms, you must seek the support of Arvore's greatest allies. But could one of these allies have been responsible for the attack? And is marriage the only way to truly solidify an alliance? With the help of your cunning advisor, devoted best friend, and the mysterious palace wizard, you must decide who can be trusted before it's too late... [From FictIf Wiki]

title: Fool Me Once
description: Revenge is a dish best served cold, and what’s colder than a literal corpse? With your appointment as the royal Summoner, you were to expect glory. Instead, your short career ended with your death. Your achievements and past were buried under the wreckage, somewhere on a plot of barren land called the Crossroads. Death, however, wasn’t your end. It’s only the beginning. Now, stifled under the thumb of Mastravisch Azvael Ories - the supreme ruler of the Overshadow realm, where ghosts and demons run rampant - you are bound by a life contract - that for an undead means eternal servitude. Just when you begin to settle into your new life, building some semblance of normalcy, you are betrayed, left to perish. Though weakened, but with a body that finally belongs to you alone, you vow to get revenge on both your almost-destroyer and the damned tyrant that once held your leash. [From Itch.io]

title: Plastic Trick
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Serena is a cheerful employee for a tech company and she keeps at it to fund her truest love: shopping. A shopaholic and mall shopper extraordinaire, she frequently combats her busy work days by spending time shopping and keeping track of the latest merch drops. After what she presumes was a routine shopping day, Serena is shocked to discover three mannequins coming to life before her very eyes, each inhabiting the soul of a either an interdimensional god integrated into the wrong form, a medieval sculptor who’s escaped her fate to be burned for witchcraft, and a nobody who insists he’s anything but the celebrity of the plastic figure he’s inhabiting. And for some forsaken reason, all three mannequins want Serena to be the one to unleash them from their plastic bodies again. [From Kickstarter]

title: Divine Trials
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: When the angel and devil on your shoulders become their own people, the afterlife becomes a battleground for your soul. In seven days, you will face trials that test your morality, courage and desires, and ultimately determine your ending location. Will you follow your angel to the gates of Heaven? Or will you enjoy the pleasures of the descent into Hell with your devil? Your choice matters–in the end, only one may prevail. The fate of your angel and your devil are in your hands. Who to side with, and who to sentence to their eternal sleep… your afterlife is yours to shape. To follow one path means to stray from another–which path will you take? [From itch.io]

They have no dreams, ambitions, or the strength to change their lives. But all of that is about to end. Without warning, three strangers enter their lives—captivating, magnetic, and intense. Each path is a dive into the unknown, where the line between passion and terror dissolves. Is there a way out? Or, deep down, was this always the only way to feel something real? [From itch.io]

As per the empire’s decree, the candidates must undergo three perilous trials to prove their wits and merits to ascend the throne should they survive. Competitors hail from all parts of the empire with aspirations of their own. Faced with no other choice, Aria must now strive to train alongside other competitors, build her arsenal to gain support from the people, and use her wits to win the title as ruler - for the answers to your fate rest in surviving the trials. description: Hunter is having a very rough week. They've just started a new career as a police officer at the Axon City Police Department, except they've been trained as a conflict de-escalation officer and aren't allowed to carry any weaponry. This has not gone down well with their partner Ember, a fire elemental who usually solves problems by chucking a fireball at it and cleaning up the mess afterwards. If workplace drama wasn't enough, the city has become embroiled in a massive conspiracy involving corrupt government officials, a cult of mysterious witches and an army of militarised pirates who want nothing more than to reduce the city to a smoking pile of ash. Oh, and Hunter also appears to be slowly transforming into a mermaid! Will Hunter be able to work out what's going on with their transformation before it's too late and they wind up stuck as a woman forever? Probably not, but maybe they'll find a way back to their old self! There's a first time for everything, you never know! [Edited from Steam]

title: Codename: TYPHOON
tags: Modern Day Setting in a Fictional World
description: [i][b]Moscow, USSR, 2017. When the Cold War flashed hot at the end of 1953, the United States nuked China and Korea, and the Soviet Union took New York City off the map. But now, even after the psychic revolution of the 1980s, the imperial fortunes of the great powers are waning, and the Cold War is running cold indeed. The USSR, hoping to regain some of its long-lost glory, plans a May Day celebration commemorating one-hundred years of Soviet communism. But the US has its own plans... Agent Angelica Gropius Rhythmic Triad Typhoon is a psychic secret agent, working for the CIA’s secretive spirituality division, codename: The Goatmen. Her mission is to smuggle a nuclear weapon into Moscow and detonate it at the height of celebrations, killing all the Kremlin’s top brass in one fell swoop. However, Agent Typhoon is captured in the course of her mission, and brought to a KGB black site. There, she faces an unexpected enemy: a turncoat Goatmen agent, and her own mentor. Now going by the name of Psycho Soldier Number Seven, she seeks to defeat her former student with her psychic powers. Four hours until the bomb goes off. Can Agent Typhoon make it out? [From itch.io]

title_original: つみみじかん ～狂オシイホド愛シテル～
description: Tsumimi is striving to become a popular streamer so that Mashiro, her partner who suddenly disappeared, might find her. Tsumimi, of the idol unit Wataame Chainsaw, continues streaming in hopes of becoming famous enough for the missing Mashiro to find her. As a viewer, you intervene in her streams—sometimes altering the course of events, sometimes picking up new information, always connecting the scattered fragments. Your only leads are a village erased from the map and the faint irregularities caught on stream. What awaits beyond them...? [Taken from Steam]

title: Toiro Komachi ~Kurenai ni Somaru Sono Toki made~
title_original: といろ小町～紅に染まるそのときまで～
description: Toiromachi is a small mountainous town by the sea that's slightly distanced from the big city. The story begins in a long-standing restaurant in the heart of its shopping district called "Murasaki", which serves eel dishes. The restaurant is flourishing thanks to the happily married couple that run it; the proprietress is popular in the neighborhood while the skills of the restaurant owner, who is also her husband, are well-regarded. Their only daughter and this story's protagonist is a normal university student you'd find anywhere. She doesn't have anything in particular she wants to do and is spending her summer holidays mulling over what to do for her next part-time job. One day however, her hardworking mother collapses and the protagonist becomes Murasaki's substitute proprietress! In the middle of summer, a highly profitable period, she's made to manage the shop while it's understaffed. Though she's only be covering until her mother is discharged from hospital, a lifestyle completely different from the one she's lead so far has begun! On top of that, she accidentally finds a single letter addressed to her mother... "That child... That girl I gave birth to... I wonder if she has been well?" "I'm not Mom and Dad's child?!" Confused and bawling her eyes out, a boy suddenly flies down from the sky and appears before her... As hectic and busy days go by, all of the mysteries gradually unravel. Followed by a strange boy as she navigates the complicated interpersonal relationships between her peers, will this otherwise normal proprietress and student be able to solve the mysteries of her life? [Translation of official website story summary.]

characters.name: Futaai Akane
characters.description: Akane is a university student studying history. She was hoping to relax during the summer holidays, but after her mother collapsed at work, Akane decides to help her family business until her mother gets better. Everything was normal until she discovers a letter addressed to her mother, which revealed that Akane is actually adopted. Shocked, Akane is torn between finding out the whole truth and the fear of finding out things that would be better left untouched. Sully claims that she summoned him, but Akane has no knowledge of doing so. At first, working in place of her mother is tiring and stressful, but she adjusts before she knows it. Her kind, caring and hardworking nature makes her well suited to her post.

characters.name: Cabalef Stanislafmader Sullivan
characters.original: カバレフ・スタニスラフマダー・サリィヴァン
characters.description: Nicknamed Sully, he is an angel prince that was (supposedly) summoned from the moon by Akane. Sully was tasked by his father, the king, to help Akane resolve what is currently bothering her (the truth about her real parents) by the next full moon. Though he is 20, he often gets mistaken as a child, if not, a mid-teenager (Akane described him as "looking around 15-years-old). Not wanting to make Akane's peers suspicious, Sully had somebody from the moon world alter their memories, so he could better carry out his task. Because of this, those close to Akane are arranged to think that Sully is a distant relative of Akane's. Despite his complex and somewhat dignified method of speech, Sully is quite childish and slightly spoiled. However, Sully can be surprisingly obedient at times. He too, ends up helping out the eel restaurant as a waiter and delivery boy as part of his guise.

characters.name: Aoyama Shuichi
characters.description: Shuichi is a new addition to the eel restaurant, making him Akane and Atsunori's kouhai. He decided to work part time for the first time in his life, as he wanted to have more experiences before school starts again. Shuichi is an interior design student at a specialist college. He's cheerful, outgoing and polite, but is sometimes hard to read. Shuichi is quite sharp, and picks up on his surroundings with little effort. He apparently went to the same high school as Akane, but she doesn't remember.

characters.name: Suga Atsunori
characters.description: Atsunori has been working as a chef for the restaurant for five years. He's very laidback, friendly and cheerful. Because of his dedication to his job and the restaurant, he's well-liked by Akane's parents and is even treated like family a lot of the time. He's also the go-to guy when Makoto is away- his juniors trust in and find him to be reliable. In spite of his extroversion, Akane catches him losing his cheer every now and then, and has no idea what's bothering him. Atsunori doesn't think highly of Yuusuke, and seems to know him from before the restaurant workers' first meeting with him.

characters.name: Fujisaki Yuusuke
characters.description: Yuusuke is a businessman that recently moved into the town of Toiro for work purposes. He eventually becomes a regular at the Osaki eel restaurant. Yuusuke has a refreshing personality, which alongside with his friendliness and polite charm, helps him leave excellent impressions upon everyone he meets. Even so, Yuusuke can be surprisingly argumentative. Quick-witted, he never loses in a verbal argument. As well as Atsunori, Moe also has a bad impression of Yuusuke; becoming much ruder than she usually is.

characters.name: Kakitsubata Gorou
characters.description: Very refined, polite and mild-mannered, Gorou is a traditionalist gentleman. He has known Akane's parents for a while; tasked with managing the floral displays of the restaurant. Gorou seems to especially get along with Miyoko. He's very calm and relaxed, and seems to calm those around him as well. Gorou sometimes makes some unexpected observations or statements, which makes Akane occasionally describe him as a "strange man". When he's not busy taking care of the restaurant's flowers, he works as a Kadou (flower arrangement art) teacher.

characters.name: Yamabuki Aoi
characters.description: Aoi is Akane's senpai since their high school days, though they've only recently reconnected. He was her senior in their high school's Japanese archery club. Additionally, Aoi and Akane are childhood friends. Akane used to have a crush on him, but eventually her feelings fizzled out. Now a university student, Aoi is studying to become a vet, and as a result, is frequently busy with his studies, even during the summer holidays. He is the older brother of Moe, the local shrine's miko (shrine maiden). Aoi has a very calm, docile and kind personality, which made him popular with the girls during his school days. He goes about his everyday activities at his own distinctive pace. Maybe because of these traits, Aoi has a tendency to think too hard about even the simplest things. He lacks strong opinions, so he often finds himself going with the flow.

characters.name: Yamabuki Moe
characters.description: She is the same age as Akane, and they went to the same primary school together. Moe is Aoi's younger sister, and works at her family's shrine as its maiden (miko) since she graduated high school. Despite playing together in their childhood, Moe is now cold and rude towards Akane. In fact, her coldness and rudeness isn't limited to Akane- the only person she seems to be amicable with is Aoi.

characters.name: Futaai Makoto
characters.description: Akane's father, and the owner of the Osaki eel restaurant. Though a strict boss, Makoto is personable and kind.

characters.name: Futaai Miyoko
characters.description: Akane's youthful mother. Miyoko is the proprietress of Osaki eel restaurant, alongside her husband Makoto, its owner. She is well-liked by her colleagues due to her cheery and positive attitude. After collapsing from exhaustion during work, Miyoko is hospitalised, but remains in a stable condition- her collapse wasn't a sign of anything life-threatening. [CV: SaRara (friend of the developer's, not a professional voice actress)]

title: Leave You Behind
description: Corin and Von are the latest in the line of the endlessly reincarnated lovers, Galaxia and Prince Xer. Traditionally, the two incarnates will meet, fall in love, and ultimately defeat the similarly reincarnated Lord Velt. Such is their destiny. Corin and Von are less than interested in each other though. They're best friends of course, but romance is a complete non-interest. Fate as a way of sticking them together at very possible turn in hopes of forcing their love to form. Unfortunately for Corin and Von, they are approaching the time in their incarnate lives where Galaxia and Xer first confess their love so the pull of destiny is especially strong. This also happens to be the night of their school's Homecoming dance. It's up to you as Corin to make it through Homecoming without bending to will of destiny. Hey, maybe they could actually go with the people they actually like. [From Itch.io]

A strange man, Mantras, greets you and introduces you to the world's rules and your companions. Your companions are other dead people that represent an avatar of one of the four elements: water, fire, air, earth, and one of the two arcana: life and death. Lily and Ace are the avatars of death. The most powerful avatar, the only one who has the power to activate a strange device, a music box, which can make them remember their past lives, and most importantly, why and how the died. [From Official site]

title: One Hell of a Week
description: One strangely average morning you hear a knock on the door. You open it to find an envelope on the floor. It’s a ticket to Hawaii, and your name's on it baby! But what? When?? Who??? Where?!?! WHO CARES! You take this definitely real, totally not shady gift and get your sweet ass to the airport. The ticket works. You take your seat. Everything is gravy. That is until you're approached by none other than the King of Demons, Satan himself! He reveals that he left you the ticket, and by accepting the trip you activated his trap card! (AKA a non-negotiable contract) The price you must pay is... marriage! That's right, you must find the love of your life and marry her! Otherwise the devil gets your soul! Of course you could always buy your way out with a million big ones, but we all know you can't afford that. The rules are simple: * Don't tell them about your situation * Make sure she's head over heels for you * Oh, and you've only got a week. Have fun in paradise! [From Kickstarter]

title: Ghost#Dialer
description: In response to the oppressive system around them, two high-schoolers create a space for themselves. A secret after-school club where they can explore and express themselves without judgment. Sharing sunsets together, playing JRPGs, and falling in love. Until they realize that they're ensnared in a tangled web of self-hatred, woven by the venomous adults around them. A mysterious number reveals to Kite, our protagonist, the path that they need to break free. Kite isn't sure who they can trust, only knowing that they have to move forward. A proclamation of love leading into a dangerous adventure against unknown forces. Ghost#Dialer is a supernatural mystery about discovering our truths, and discovering the power we all possess inside of us. How we can manifest our truest selves and wield that power against those that would deny our humanity. [From itch.io]

description: It’s like every bachelorette party you’ve ever been to... chasing strippers through casinos, grand larceny, occasional encounters with the mafia, oh and COCKTAILS! [From Choices Wikia]

characters.name: Diana
characters.description: Diana is one of Main Character's best friends from college and first seen in Chapter 1. She is bookish and conservative mainly because it is what is expected of her, especially by her fiancé. Attending cotillion classes has made her well-versed in polite society and etiquette; [spoiler]however, when she drinks more than two shots of tequila, she turns into “Diana the Destroyer” and becomes a metaphorical wrecking ball, eventually dissolving into a blubbering mess. Diana has multiple insecurities, including never finding someone as good as Skip, disappointing her parents, and not being smart enough. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Courtney Van Ness
characters.description: Courtney Van Ness is one of Main Character's best friends from college. She is first seen in Chapter 1. Courtney is bubbly, outgoing, and flirty. She appears to be adventurous as there is little she cannot be dared into doing, and she has no problems throwing out suggestions (especially of an intimate nature) if that is the way to get things done or gain an advantage. She also appears to be easy to manipulate or hypnotize. If the player takes the premium scene to play as her in Chapter 11, [spoiler]she hallucinates an animated version of herself called "Court-Toon" and Fifi the Friendship Fox. Both of them proceed to chastise her for being irresponsible, not having a job, and not knowing necessary skills like cooking her own food. The dialogue also implies she comes from a wealthy family. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Cecil Romano IV
characters.description: Cecil Romano IV (aka The Baron) is a crime lord, vampire, and the leader of Clan Baron. He is the youngest member of The Council, having been born in 1882. Much of his power and influence was gained during the American Prohibition Era, leading to him becoming "the single most powerful mobster in New York City" by 1919. He has little interest in Your Character's affairs, unless they affect his own, and refers to her as "Adrian's little tart."

description: In 2010 humanity is wiped out by the Araburugami, hostile deities manifesting as giant monsters. Only one survivor remains in Tokyo, a city converted into an automated military fortress — warrant officer Aoki Itona, pilot of the 100 meter tall anti-deity robot Shinuchi Mark V, a Deus Ex Machina. Itona enjoys the loneliness, but one day she meets a fellow pilot and the last survivor from another region, Kurenai Touka. Itona's introverted personality keeps clashing with the upbeat and teasing Touka as they grow closer and join hands to fight against the wheels of fate.

Because of her personality and past jobs, Enki is denied a lucrative contract to kill a river monster… unless she works with Freddie, a timid half-giant, in pursuit of the prize. Their partnership is tested by tentacles, the cold river, prejudice, and Enki's hot-blooded behavior. Still, the next morning, the newly-minted girlfriends deal with a different threat: Mystical powers enter the fray and are promptly discovered by the duo. How will they deal with all these challenges? Well, it truly is "An Un-Epic Story"!

title: Breathless Winds
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Set in the lush and magical Two Elk Island, Poppy has long been recovering from an incident that left her bedridden, but her life changes when she finds herself at a crossroads between four branching paths. Will Poppy follow her family’s legacy as a sailor with help from her childhood friend, reunite with a former bully turned healer, prevent a calamity that threatens their island with a mysterious witch, or help the crown prince of the powerful Castle Island with a quest to save the king’s life? [From Itch.io]

title: Planet Stronghold 2
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Several years have passed since the colony of Planet Stronghold was saved from the Descorian threat. Now Lisa/Joshua Nelson have been promoted to Captain, but an increase in rank comes with greater responsibilities. Even without the threat of the Descorians, the colony is at risk of collapsing due to limited water supplies, food scarcity, and political instability. Additionally, there are many alien factions scattered throughout the planet competing with Nelson and her/his team for the precious resources. Of greater concern is also a series of earthquakes which have scientists worried that the planet is on the verge of a big change, one which could wipe out all life on it. Like the first title, you'll need to save your colony of Planet Stronghold from all kinds of threats. Explore the new isometric map, capture resources, craft new items, and fight battles against hostile aliens...and other humans. No matter what you choose at the beginning, in the end you might be lucky to get out of Planet Stronghold...alive. [From Steam]

title: The Beastmaster Princess
description: The Beastmaster Princess is a fantasy visual novel featuring a diverse cast, branching plot and several different endings. It takes place in the fantasy world of Aravorn, already seen in games like Loren The Amazon Princess and Cursed Lands. This is the story of Kunya, the child of Chief Goro, leader of the Desert Snakes tribe. Kunya is a formidable warrior and a future warchief. But even the most formidable need allies. Kunya can count on Luna's motherly cures. There isn't a single thing the shaman can't fix with her potions. On the battlefield, there's no better ally than Takara. Brave and hot-headed, she's always looking to gain more fame and recognition so that her name will be remembered by future generations. Though older than the others, Manila is no less dangerous in a fight. She may be a lone wolf, but she's always willing to share her wisdom and experience. With Lyara about to marry an elven prince, the tribe is in disorder. As a half-elf abandoned in the desert as a child, she has always struggled to fit in with the other nomads despite being adopted as Goro's daughter. Perhaps this marriage can return her to her elven roots. Unfortunately, events conspire against this union. As Prince Merril travels to meet Lyara, his caravan is assaulted by dark elves and he is nowhere to be found in the aftermath. Now it's up to Kunya and the others to track him down. They'll face numerous dangers, using force and cunning to overcome them. In doing so, perhaps Kunya will discover love along with the hidden power of Lyara, the beastmaster princess. [From Steam]

title: The Raven
description: After a stressful week, you, a dispassionate college student become attracted to a stranger met at a Halloween party, only for this encounter to become deadly. Will you survive the night? [From Itch.io]

title: Serenissima
description: As a newly Embraced fledgling - and a Caitiff on top of that - you have a hard path in front of you. Being also a secret agent of the local Second Inquisition doesn't help. Luckily you are - or you were? - their best detective, and you have no intention of letting your old comrades down right before the beginning of the war. Or at least this is what you think at first. Once you get to know what Kindred society is really about and some of its inhabitans, you're going to question everything you used to believe in... [From Itch.io] This game is a parody of Vampire: The Masquerade.

title: Hroniki Izabelly
description: Chronicles of Isabella is a visual novel about how, in the span of a single day, your whole life can turn into hell. Isabella, a young and hot sorceress, comes to visit her best friend to spend some cold December evenings with her. Play snowballs, drink mulled wine, sit by the fireplace and confess your love - all the things that childhood friends usually do together. But Isabella is met not only by her best friend Maria, but also by the already middle-aged Baron von Krautz, who also aims to take the heart of a young lady. Isabella is not the most restrained sorceress in the world - she never reaches into her pocket for a word and does not allow herself to be offended. This is the beginning of the end for their relationship, and a deadly strike to the heart of the unfortunate Isabella. [From Itch.io] Chronicles of Isabella is also a prequel to another game, "Wanderer".

title: Keepers of Astraela
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Eva has a world inside her head: the land of Astraela, where Darkness and Corrupted beasts threaten eternal doom. Vivid dreams have given her four books as an up-and-coming author, but when undead fiends appear on Earth for a killing spree, she is caught in the crossfire between dreams and reality. These creatures shouldn't exist outside the pages of her books—and neither should Emrys, the fictional hero who slips in from the shadows to tell her that Astraela is facing its ultimate destruction. With the fate of her own world at risk, and her main character's life being drained by an age-old curse, the player must guide Eva's actions in order to protect the people she cares about and avoid the total destruction of all she holds dear. [From Steam]

title: A Fairy Tale
description: Pride and Prejudice with fairies... and a little light murder. A Fairy Tale is a 28,000 word visual novel about fairies finding love. Play as the sole heir to a noble (but somewhat underfunded) fairy estate. You have one night to find a marriage which will secure your family's future... or lead everything to ruin. Who—if anyone—will win your hand? [from Itch.io]

One day, you receive an offering on your shrine that grants you more power than you have had in a century, and you set out, determined to grant their wish. Unfortunately, this isn't quite so simple as it seems... [from itch.io]

title: Star-Crosst
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: War is rough. Rebuilding isn’t easy. But we all start somewhere. The year is 2323. Thirteen years ago, the Earth was attacked by an invasive alien species. They used a superweapon that altered the Earth’s atmosphere, causing intense weather changes in the space of hours, creating hurricanes in jungles and blizzards in deserts. They made no attempts to communicate. Humans had taken to calling them ‘riklid.’ And today, the humans won. The riklid retreat after being dealt a decisive blow. You play as Ezra Foy, a young twenty-something coming out of their senior year at university. For Ezra, it feels like time had stopped: the war effort was all anyone could focus on, and now that peace has finally been won again, the time for revelry and relationships has begun. Choose between three love interests, each with their own deep branching storylines and hundreds of lines of dialogue; enjoy a futuristic setting involving people and places of all different walks of life, including a friendly lizard-like alien species known as the Ghians; and decide what the best course of action should be living in a post-war era, and what we as individuals can do for our future. (from Steam)

title: Legendy Savvary: Cvety i Skorpiony
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Nikaria is an agent of Chazir, a servant of the mysterious god Dadar, who after a mystical ritual ceased to be human. Now, her entire body is a weapon, Dadar's weapon. She has no moral boundaries. The end justifies any means, and Dadar's will are above any mortal law. Chazir sends Nikaria to another country as a spy. She will meet other agents, becoming entangled in their internal disputes, which may jeopardize her entire mission. Will Nikaria eliminate everyone who stands in her way? Will she fail the mission? Will she resolve all conflicts? Or will she arrive at a completely different ending? The decision is up to you. [From Steam]

title: A Pinky Problem
description: Skye has lots of friends! That's because she's the coolest girl you've ever met: stylish, and kind, and talented, and bad at keeping her mouth shut when she needs to. You said you'd keep her secret safe, but she hasn't been making it easy. As the years flew by, her secret grew bigger, until you found yourself snarled in a web of lies and questionable choices. With your biggest hurdle looming over the horizon, you've got a stressful three days ahead of you. How far will you go to fulfil your promise? [From itch.io]

title: Mistwinter Bay
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You are the sovereign of a town called Mistwinter Bay. The sovereign you create decides the fate of the town and everyone in it. Decide which buildings to build – and who gets to live in town. Interact with your townsfolk by sending them on missions or hang out one-on-one. Each character is unique, with their own profession, personal history and strengths and weaknesses. Deal with international politics by befriending or becoming enemies with powerful foreign leaders. Watch the seasons pass as you are faced with a unique, random event every month. The way you decide to handle an event not only affects the ending of the event itself, but the entire town. Will you become a sovereign loved by all or will you adapt your choices to please someone in town – or perhaps someone across the sea? [From Itch.io]

title: Under Care of The Forest
description: It is the time of the Matchmaking in the village, when people choose a bride for the Lord of the Forest - Leshy. The young witch Rowan was requested to perform part of the ritual and set off into the forest, where she will have to face moral choices and many dangers. [From Itch.io]

title: MAMA
description: One day, you’ll thank me. After all… mother knows best. Today’s the first day of HimeCon, a Yuri convention. You’re attending with your girlfriend who’s a vendor in the artist alley. At the convention, you receive a text that ends up changing… everything. You find yourself back in your childhood home, except this time, something’s amiss— and you’ve got to escape. She’s always watching you, isn’t she? [From itch.io]

title: My Bed, Your Grave
description: Lethia and Thana can't be within an arms distance without death coming between them. Since the moment they'd met, they've played a violent game of push and pull. After all, they're a vampire and a werewolf, how could they be anything but natural enemies? But after over three hundred years of blood and tears, Lethia decides she no longer wishes to participate in this game, and the only way it ends...is with Thana killing her. [From itch.io]

title: Till Death Do Us Part
description: Your wife, Stella, has 7 days to live - her senses, her sight, eventually her mind. Her final act? Telling you she never loved you, just to spare you the pain of watching her fade away. And you? You just want to hold her hand through it. But love isn't that simple. [From itch.io]

title: Zwei Club Mate bitte
description: It’s one of those lovely summer evenings in Cologne. The sun starts to set around 11 p.m. The temperature has cooled to a comfortable level. The local kiosk is stocked with refreshing drinks. Two trans girls meet up to talk while watching the sunset. [From Itch.io]

title: The Wedding
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Get ready for romance, laughs, and wild choices in 'The Wedding,' an interactive game where your choices matter. Fake date, elope, or sabotage a wedding – your decisions will shape the story. This isn't your usual love story – it's for readers who love a good twist. In this game, you can take revenge on a bully, rekindle with an ex, fake date your business partner, neighbor, or the cute firefighter who is also your friend with benefits. And if you're up for it, you can even run away with the bride or groom if you can make them fall in love with you. [From Kickstarter]

title: The Boo-chelor
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Your favourite Halloween show is back and it's your turn to choose between three, quirky, passionate and... unique dates. Those are costumes right? Ask your three suitors questions, set them challenges and in the end choose one to go on the best date of your life... and it very may well be your last. [From itch.io]

title: DATING OF THE FUTURE
description: The end of the world has come and gone, and humanity’s sex robot underclass are the only ones left. All needs are met, nature has healed, and everyone’s problems are solved… Right? Play as Vee, a robot whose life changes overnight as she goes from being a simple camerawoman to being the next big thing in porn. Surrounded by machines afraid to confront themselves, can Vee’s kindness, experience, and huge rack inspire them to open up and discover their sexual freedom… Or will her own fears consume her? [From Steam]

title: Legally Bi
description: Sensu, as a transfer student from mainland China, has a secret that nobody knows...That he is actually, a she. After accidentally skipping class because of her bully, Sensu met Ai Xin, another problematic student in her school, and quickly they became skipping school buddies----But only a day later, Ai Xin was found dead and appeared in front of Sensu as a ghost. This is a story where a normal high schooler is stuck between genders, politics, and the afterlife. [From itch.io]

title: Rebel Without a Claus
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You’re the director of your small town’s holiday play, and you want everything to be perfect – but the town miscreant has other plans. [From Choices Wikia]

title: My Group Members Suck!!
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: As the appointed group lead for a university usability project, Aini's spent weeks conducting user interviews and compiling notes. But now, with the deadline in 5 days... none of her group members want to work! As the deadline ticks down, Aini must navigate private messages and group conversations. Will she prioritise getting the assignment done or being a compassionate leader? [From itch.io]

title: Thieves Of Dingirra
description: In this strategy/RPG game, assume the role of the Master Thief, establish a Thieves Guild in Dingirra, recruit NPCs, grow in power, delve into your companions’ pasts, and maybe even develop romantic relationships with them. All while aiming to fully conquer the town of Dingirra.

title: Love's Young Dream
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: The Ashbrook family has always been born beneath an unfortunate star. They aren’t destined to lose their lives at sea, nor lose their fortunes to disaster, however. They are only doomed to lose their first loves to unrequited feelings. No Ashbrook to date has had the luck to prove that curse baseless superstition. Yet that doesn’t stop you, the youngest Ashbrook, from trying to defy that fate. Clearly other Ashbrooks of the past just haven’t tried hard enough. Having fallen in love for the first time, you’ve set yourself to the task of throwing aside a tradition of heartbreak and earning the affection of one Prof. Heron Renaude. With the help of your dearest attendant, and with the backdrop of the romantic Reedford Manor, your brother’s countryside home, surely you’ll prove yourself more powerful than fate. ...Won’t you? [From itch.io]

title: Summon a Sweetheart
description: This is a short visual novel-esque game about a depressed loser named Penelope. She gets so lonely… that she summons an eldritch monster to be her girlfriend. Unfortunately, she didn’t read the fine print. She needs a gift, and she needs one fast! Surely, her depression cave of a room should have something, right? I’m sure this won’t go wrong at all! In other words: give the monster lady gifts that suck, and have cruel and unusual things happen to you as a result. [Edited from itch.io]

title: Dual Colors
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Sofia, the princess of S Kingdom is visiting Japan and intends to make the best of her remaining days as a single girl. In one month's time, she is to be married. She intends on using her remaining time having fun. Cain, the man that Sofia has been in love with since childhood has been sent to Japan at her wishes. He has been called to serve in the SP reserve forces for their country. On the other hand, there is another waiting for her in Japan, who is also in love with her: A girl thief. She had tried to steal the princess's ring during her last visit to Japan only to fail and fall madly in love with her. Hearing the rumor of the princess's upcoming wedding, the girl thief wants nothing more than to prevent it from happening. The girl thief hears that the princess always wears a certain necklace that will be necessary for the wedding. She vows to steal this necklace. Thievery on one side and protection on the other: Even though their circumstances are very different, they both love her. You will see the feelings of these two entwined with the expectations of surrounding people. The story begins... [From Gamelex]

title: Puppy Love 3: Wild West Side Story
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: A wild, gleefully implausible tale of the Old West, where tumbledawgs roll among sun-bleached bones, and two new heroes take the stage! A great steam train is winding its way across the scorching sands, carrying the entourage of a visiting foreign dignitary. In the lawless lands, such a procession can only attract the eyes of the vultures… Can the valiant lawmen protect young Princess Yunnie from scheming bandits? Or will a young outlaw be able to realize her dreams, and hit the big time? We follow the story of a new hero, Sovy Wildfoot and his rival - the beautiful and deadly Vedika Vandersmudge - on a train ride across the untamed deserts of the west. Sovy is all new to the Puppy Love games, but we've seen Vedika before when she premiered as the masked vigilante in Puppy Love I! Puppy Love III is a breakaway from the first games in that it features full point and click adventure mode! As both Sovy and Vedika you get to walk around the train and talk to other passengers, exploring the world of Puppy Love click by click, along with some of the old choice menus to spice things up as the action unfolds! There are even fetch quests? Aren't you excited?? Will Sovy save the princess? Get seduced by bandits? Will Vedika seduce the lawmen? Will the entire game get detrailed when the protagonist gets distracted by grumpmuscles? Will he become the manager of an all-singing all-dancing performance troop? Or will he save Vedika from herself? Unlock them all and you’ll be rewarded with a special minigame: Dress-Up Balthazar! [From official site]
plot_tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
full_description: A wild, gleefully implausible tale of the Old West, where tumbledawgs roll among sun-bleached bones, and two new heroes take the stage! A great steam train is winding its way across the scorching sands, carrying the entourage of a visiting foreign dignitary. In the lawless lands, such a procession can only attract the eyes of the vultures… Can the valiant lawmen protect young Princess Yunnie from scheming bandits? Or will a young outlaw be able to realize her dreams, and hit the big time? We follow the story of a new hero, Sovy Wildfoot and his rival - the beautiful and deadly Vedika Vandersmudge - on a train ride across the untamed deserts of the west. Sovy is all new to the Puppy Love games, but we've seen Vedika before when she premiered as the masked vigilante in Puppy Love I! Puppy Love III is a breakaway from the first games in that it features full point and click adventure mode!

description: The 'Vector Rider Series', launched simultaneously, "Shirou Hen" with the male protagonist and "Sayuri Hen" with the female protagonist. A self-raising style simulation game depicting the main characters' first year after entering the military academy. The system and game balance is a little hard, however the world building is very detailed and the story has many serious developments. Shirou Hen has gal game and shounen-ai elements. Sayuri Hen has otome and shoujo-ai elements. [Translated/Edited from Girl Game Wiki]

characters.name: Shirou Aizawa
characters.description: Born 7/25/2033 He lost his family at a young age in an attack by the ESSAR aliens and was raised in an orphanage in India. In order to give back to Professor Kalidasa who raised him he aims to become a highly paid 'Vector Rider'. The protagonist of Shirou Hen and a capturable character in Sayuri Hen.

characters.name: Sayuri Kuonji
characters.description: Born 12/03/2033 The daughter of the president of the global conglomerate 'Kuonji Group'. She joins the UFN army to rebel against her meddling arms dealer father. The protagonist of Sayuri Hen and a capturable character in Shirou Hen.

characters.name: Azzul Torleoni
characters.original: アスール・トレローニ
characters.description: Born 08/27/2033 A bright and honest, sociable guy. He can get pretty emotional sometimes. He loves rock music and plays the guitar when he's in the mood.

characters.name: Rang Primary
characters.description: Born 07/19/2033 A lively naive girl. A bit of an airhead, but she's the type of person that you just can't hate. She's excitable and even when she gets down it doesn't last long. A romanticist that likes gazing at the stars.

characters.name: Red Thrally
characters.description: Born 05/18/2033 A straightforward guy who is really good at moving his body. A reliable guy, but he's pushy and has no brakes even when it comes to women.

characters.name: Rouge Vinstage
characters.original: ルージュ・ヴァンスタージュ
characters.description: Born 04/10/2032 A big sisterly sexy lady. She loves rumors and is always poking her nose into talks about love. At her core she hates being alone. She's good at moving her body, especially her gun skills.

characters.name: Oak Azzrael
characters.original: オーク・アズラーウェル
characters.description: Born 05/28/2036 A genius boy who skipped grades. Farne's younger twin brother. He loves his camera and playing tricks on people. He can be surprisingly reliable however, and his outlook on love is pretty old-fashioned.

characters.name: Farne Azzrael
characters.original: ファン・アズラーウェル
characters.description: Born 05/28/2036 A genius girl who skipped grades. Oak's older twin sister. Usually a dainty intellectual girl, sometimes she disguises herself as Oak and cheekily performs tricks on people.

characters.name: Veer Mikhailobna
characters.original: ヴェール・ミハイロヴナ
characters.description: Born 02/11/2036 A 'Super Elite' boy who already graduated university with great grades. He's kind, but he doesn't open his heart easily. When he was younger his older brother died fighting in space.

characters.name: Ryeuie Sou
characters.description: Born 11/20/2036 A determined and brazen genius girl who skipped grades. She is especially good at piloting mecha. She looks down on people that aren't as smart as her so she isn't good at dealing with other people. Has a bit of a complex about her short height.

characters.name: Blau Meister
characters.description: An engineer that transfers in late in the year. A nihilistic guy who doesn't get influenced by other people easily. He's an excellent cadet, but he's full of mysteries and it feels like he's hiding something.

characters.name: Ssei Tkkana
characters.description: An engineer that transfers in late in the year.

characters.name: Xak Burgess
characters.description: A tactical officer. He's often practicing by himself in the control room. He used to be aiming to become a Vector Ride pilot but he had to give up because of his weak body.

characters.name: Acid Gurnie
characters.description: A mechanic stationed in the Dive Ride hanger. His nickname is Sid. He has an artist's temperament and is adored by the cadets. He used to be a Vector Ride pilot candidate in the past.

characters.name: Coleman Maker 3rd
characters.original: コールマン・メイカー3世
characters.description: A nurse, called 'Doctor' by those around him. He's an old acquaintance of Acid. He used to be a much more serious guy but he got into an accident and lately he's always drinking alcohol at a sidewalk cafe.

characters.name: Airzolver Garland
characters.original: エアゾルバ・ガーランド
characters.description: A Quad Ride instructor and Public Morals advisor. He loves the gym. He can be pretty strict and has a bad mouth. Even though he's the 'public morals' advisor, that no shirt plus necktie combo is probably against the uniform rules.

characters.name: Karl Steif
characters.description: An Avio Ride instructor. His rank is lieutenant colonel. A crisply handsome man, but he's known as a strict devil instructor.

characters.name: Phamu Enforce
characters.original: ファミーユ・エンフォース
characters.description: A tactical officer. She's responsible for making announcements. She's often practicing by herself in the MM room.

characters.name: Kim Rayrien
characters.description: A mechanic stationed in the Quad Ride hanger. She has a bad mouth.

characters.name: Gabriella Pfeffer
characters.original: ガブリエラ・ファイファー
characters.description: A nurse, she's stationed in the infirmary in place of the drunkard Coleman.

characters.name: April Viridian
characters.original: エイプリル・ビリージーン
characters.description: A Dive Ride instructor. She hangs out in the teaching room.

characters.name: Calamity Fawcett
characters.original: カラミティ・フォーセット
characters.description: She runs the PX military shop.

characters.name: Violet
characters.description: An AI that guides you on how to use the navigation system.

characters.name: Opo
characters.description: A dolphin teacher who can communicate through a special 'SIMS' interface.

title: Alice's Reverie
tags: Heroine Based on a Fictional Person
description: Alice’s Reverie is a visual novel following our protagonist, Alice. Alice grew tired of being compared to the protagonist of Alice's Adventures in Wonderland as a child. Now, as a twenty-year-old struggling student and a closeted lesbian, she envies the fictional Alice's carefree childhood days. But when Alice suddenly finds herself in her own bizarre version of Wonderland, will it be the magical adventure and fairy tale romance she's always dreamed of? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Morrigan
characters.description: Morrigan is a wise and demanding woman. She is the crown Princess of Wonderland and the rightful heir to the throne. While she is less cruel than her mother, she is not afraid to deal out punishments as needed. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Reese
characters.description: Reese is an eccentric chatterbox who loves lolita fashion and hosting tea parties. When she isn't throwing a party, she can be found in her room tailoring clothes. She's a social butterfly who attempts to befriend everyone. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Skylar
characters.description: Skylar is a tired and snarky individual. They spend most of their time either sleeping or looking after their flower garden. Skylar's humor is very dry, but showing appreciation for it is the one-way ticket to their heart. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Lulu
characters.description: Lulu is a bright and cheery woman who has enough kindness to spare. She is known as the "mom friend" by her friends because of how hard she cares for their well-being. She will always lend a hand if someone needs one. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Catherine
characters.description: Catherine is a clever, playful woman. She weans her way into people's hearts with her flirtatious and flattering comments, but she has no bad intentions. Her strong intuition lets her know everything about someone. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Vee
characters.description: Vee is a calm and intellectual individual. She has a lot of walls put up, so she likes to be alone most of the time. But, she doesn't hate company. Most of her days are spent reading a book or keeping up her physique. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Wendy
characters.description: Wendy is a careful and bashful person. She is completely devoted to her work and tries hard to make everything perfect. Even so, when she is faced with an unfamiliar situation, she gets nervous and stutters to the finish. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Alice
characters.description: Alice is a kind and careful girl. She is able to adjust to whatever is thrown at her, even stumbling into an unfamiliar place. While she enjoys a bit of adventure every now and then, she also likes being at home with her sisters. [From Itch.io]

description: Venona: A Cold War Affair is a narrative-driven rhythm game in which you play as a young codebreaker embarking on a risky affair in the paranoid atmosphere of post-WWII Washington. As you learn information so sensitive that it's even kept from the president, true intimacy becomes an increasingly difficult challenge--and so does choosing where your loyalty lies. Play as Francine Pesca, a young woman with a mind for numbers and a love of music, as she leaves her small town, travels to Washington, and meets a charming stranger. [From: Itch.io]

title: Head of the Class
description: Monsters lurk in every corner of the world. They work, they study and they live. In Echidna's School for Little Monsters, young monsters learn about the world around them and prepare for adulthood. It is one of the few local schools in the city and it needs more teachers. Class 5C is an average class of monsters facing the worst disaster any little monster has ever faced in school: being held back for a year. Their previous teachers have left them way behind in their studies. Anyone who doesn't meet the required minimum grades will be held back, a devastating blow to the souls of 11-to-13-year-old kids. Enter Caragh Dullahan, a new temporary teacher who comes highly recommended for her ability to swoop in and lead troubled classes to victory. Hopefully, the students of Class 5C will be saved from a situation not born of their own actions. It would be unfair for them to be punished for it. Caragh Dullahan, well-known expert in helping troubled students, is currently facing a crisis of her own; she's sick of constantly moving around. She may have forged a career but she has no home. When she takes the job at Echidna's School for Little Monsters, she finally sees her chance to have a stable life among its many inhabitants. What will she find in her quest? A place to belong to? Love? Friendship? Or will she be back on the road in a month? [From Itch.io]

tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: In "Dear Althea" you will be Althea Vane; a young upper class British woman whose life is turned upside down after the death of her father causes her family to fall apart along with her future. She will be forced to choose a new future, a place to call home and a group to belong to. To get there she will have to face all sorts of situations in Victorian London; however, love and romance fortunately abound and will make her quest more enjoyable. This visual novel, full of decisions and repercussions, is a reinterpretation of the novel "Dear Faustina" (1897) by British author Rhoda Broughton. [From Itch.io]

The two people at the centre of your time in Cauwick Bay are Melani, a mermaid curious about life on land, and Taylor, a young man on the brink of deciding his future. Both have individual romance routes, and can also be romanced together in a polyamorous route. Romance is not required, and you can befriend the characters instead. [From Itch.io]

On her journey to the heart of the kingdom, Serafina discovers a whole new world beyond the shadows of the jungle. As Serafina, you will mingle with noble warriors and salacious nobles to infiltrate the royalty of Castle Krondolee and save Arken. But in the process, you will become entangled in a wide web of relationships, schemes, and beliefs that may set you on a different path than the one you began. Learn the dark truth of Arken's past and thus Serafina's. Decide whom to trust, fight, or love. Your choice will change the fate of the entire kingdom. [From Woodsy Studio]
