title: Viddzerkaleni
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Once bound by nobility and slavery – now driven by healing, rebellion, and self-discovery. They share the same goal, but walk opposite paths. Will you preserve their bond or break it forever? Your choice will shape the ideals that shape the world. [From Itch.io]

title: Something a Little Super
description: Raising a kid ain't easy. Throw super powers into the mix and well... that's where the real fun begins. Something a Little Super is a 20,000 word interactive story about adopting and raising a child with super powers. Your choices will shape them into the person they'll become (hero, villain, or something else...) [From Itch.io]

title: LyteLove
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Growing up in an online age is full of new experiences, some good, some bad. Relive the nostalgia of being a teen/pre-teen in the 2010s and making friends in an online space with our new chat app LyteLove™. Relive your teen years by taking part in a chaotic group of fellow teens bonding over your shared hobbies and interests. [From itch.io]

title: Tozasareta Fuyu
description: College student Misaki Kinosaki was looking for a part-time job that could only be done during winter vacation. She finds a job offer in her student affairs department. 『Recruitment of servants. Miscellaneous chores in the mansion. Handing over rewards Apply by mail』 Interested in the rarity of her work at her mansion, she applied immediately. The result was adoption. Her designated place of work is so deep in the mountains that it is impossible to get there without using a car, and the taxi driver who brought her is worried. While feeling a little uneasy, she was greeted by a beautiful young hostess named Suzue Fujikawa at the Western-style building. There is only one Suzue in this mansion. She employs only one servant, Misaki, and her work includes cleaning and cooking, but Misaki takes care of "Suzue-san". That was all. --A meaningful dream. --The hostess with many mysteries. --A creepy photo. In this mansion standing under the cloudy winter sky, mysterious things happen one after another. Even so, Misaki deepens her friendship with the owner of the mansion, Suzue Fujikawa...

title: Ball of the Black Cat
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Soubrette was the prettiest cat while she lived in Caens, and she's sure she's the prettiest cat in Nice too. When she receives an invitation to an upcoming ball and dance competition, she sees the perfect opportunity to make her grand debut in her new home town, but there's a catch-- cats can only attend in pairs! [From itch.io]

title: WITCHAROO
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Priscella is an overly-ambitious witch who aspires to have a cult of her own, and she has chosen YOU as her first member! Unfortunately, this recruitment becomes more than what you bargained for...! [From itch.io]

title: Paw Prints
description: In "Paw Prints", you'll play as an aspiring writer who turns to their dreams for ideas. With only 2 weeks left and a completely blank script, will you make it in time to join the contest and get published? [Edited from itch.io]

title: Itsuwari Usagi wa Ai o Kau
title_original: 偽りうさぎは愛を買う

title: Watashi no Kawaii Koneko-chan
title_original: わたしのかわいいこねこちゃん

title: Beyond The Mist: Beginnings
description: You are a young adult adrift in life, suffocating under the yoke of your oppressive parents. Feeling out of sync with the rest of the world, you yearn for freedom and life beyond the bounds of your prison. You find it in the form of a ravishing stranger and a long lost city, calling out to you across space and time. Something is beckoning underneath the ancient city's glimmering white tiles, something old and powerful. Someone. Will you resist the call beyond the veil and the promise of belonging it brings, or will you let yourself go and embrace the path destiny has set before you? The choice is yours. Magnustor is waiting for you. [From itch.io] Set in the same universe as The Soul Stone War.

title: Xiari Yuanyang Jiaqi
description: The cruise ship’s horns blast. You’re going to be spending the next 10 days aboard the Distant Oceanic Cruise, a luxury vacation for sapphics only! Play as Maeve (customizable name), a heartbroken soul determined to move on from a cheating ex. There are only six other single sapphics on board— could one possibly be your soulmate? Only time will tell! After all, ‘tis the SEA-son for love! [From itch.io]

title: Hear Me, Hear You
description: Experience a josei body horror adventure game that will make your skin crawl. You are Sage, an average thirty something woman living in the cyberpunk city of Blore. As you leave from work, you are attacked by a parasitic creature that claims to know everything about you. What will you do? Embrace the creature or try to remove it? Like anything in life, your choices affect everyone around you. Should you keep letting others decide your fate? Or do you take chances just to experience your own downfall?

title: Do you think we're soulmates in every universe?
description: Have you seen the trend that was making its rounds on TikTok and other corners of the internet where you ask the question: Do you think we're soulmates in every universe? Whether or not you have, this visual novel is a short little game about your partner asking you that exact question. [From Itch.io]

title: Jiaoyue Zhuilo Zhishi
description: "Moment of Moonset" is a unique text-based narrative game where close-ups of feet play a prominent role, adding to the game's distinctive atmosphere. In addition to this, the inclusion of bizarre choices and curious scene designs provides players with a truly special gaming experience. [From Steam]

title: A Matter Of Dosage
description: A bolt of electricity… Flesh rapidly healing itself… Eliza didn’t know what to expect from her date with Princeton, but it certainly wasn't finding out that extraordinary powers exist. Now Leviare Pharmaceuticals has brought her into their conspiracy, and escaping them is more complicated than just getting out of a building. But she’s not alone. There’s Princeton, the man who got her into this whole mess. Louise, a woman who seems unfazed by it all. And Brooke, a woman who riles Eliza up more ways than one… They all have secrets they’re not telling. Can Eliza trust any of them to help destroy the conspiracy? [From Itch.io]

title: Larut
tags: Protagonist Based on a Mythological Character
description: Larut is a fictional work retelling of the Indonesian folklore and mythological figure, Nyi Roro Kidul. Having lost her home and her family's trust due to her stepmother’s schemes, Kandita finds herself struggling alone on the beach marking the edge of the South Sea. There, she meets her savior, the eternally kind and loving Queen of the Southern Sea who takes her in and grants her a position as the Queen’s lady-in-waiting. Eternally grateful for the Queen’s kindness and generosity, Kandita promises to devote her whole life to her savior. However, in this dog-eat-dog world society, a frail and naive lady like her must learn to adapt or lose everything yet again. [From itch.io]

title: Monstrous Brew
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Sprinkling sugar, flour, and a touch of magic; Mae's bakery is open for business! An average day, a mundane routine, all in the life of a simple witch! With delectable treats and heavenly pastries to *die* for, a humble dwelling to satiate anyone's sweet tooth! Surely nothing could go wrong, right? Right?! Oh, but how wrong she was. A midnight customer, and a midnight call—all came ominously, in the premonition of a single feather. And as it flutters into her hand, she knows just what it spells; A death foreboding, and this time, it was to be her head. "... Wh-whaaat?!" Realising just what that sign was, the witch became frantic! Just how could she preserve her life, when she knew death was coming so soon?! 'Oh, I-I know! A love potion!' Surely that'll do the trick! Something sweet, that'll *strike* that hunter's heart for good! However, if she were to make one before her doom, then all the time she had was... 24 hours on the clock?! Oh, for pete's sake—!! [From itch.io]

title: Dream & Sugar
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You are a recent art college graduate who dreams of becoming an independent artist with their very own art gallery installation. Reconnect with your college bestie Riley, hit it off with dashing musician Hugo, and befriend thoughtful author Bennett. You decide which relationships to pursue! Will you find love in unexpected places? Or maybe you'd like to take things slower and focus on Nora's art goals instead? The choice is up to you! [From Steam]

title: Behind His Mask
description: How wrong can a make-out session get? One, he’s your new neighbor. Two, he’s the hottest streamer. Three, it was live-streamed in front of thousands of people on accident…

title: E-Girl
description: What’s life like as the hottest E-girl? Fun, sexy, notorious… and lonely. Will you step into the real world and find love?

title: My Maiden of the Mire
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Folk tales speak of a hauntingly beautiful monster that lurks in the forest near Eloise's village, and the woe that befalls any unfortunate enough to cross into her domain. Eloise has never given credence to rumors spread by children and washerwomen. They call her a witch for goodness' sake. Whatever will Eloise do when she realizes that the local bard's verse did not lie about the Maiden's otherworldly allure and blade-sharp teeth... [From itch.io]

title: Moondusk Masquerade
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Past Setting in a Fictional World
description: Frequently reminded about how she was rescued by faeries despite being a human, Lilika (renamable MC) has lived all her life repaying the faeries with her servitude — to cook, clean, and care for the heirs of an elite faerie family in the realm. When the family receives their annual invitation to an upcoming masquerade held by the High Court, Lilika is surprised to also receive an invitation letter, only to have her dreams crushed by the family’s objections. Lilika refuses to let go of her dreams of romance and dancing amongst the sparkling high court faeries. Her wishes are soon heard by a mysterious flower spirit in the garden and the spirit helps Eve get to the ball. Believing in the flower spirit, Lilika finds herself at the masquerade in a beautiful disguise and is able to put aside her human identity for a magical evening. But her night soon begins to unmask a stunning mystery - one that ties a clandestine prince, a grand magician, and a roguish knight to her destiny through passionate secrets and mysterious letters by moondusk. [From Steam]

title: Agatha's Agony: An Amor-less Adventure
description: Poor Agatha Molla just can't catch a break. After being struck by an ambulance, she wakes up as a patient in a psychiatric hospital with unfamiliar faces. Even worse, she's given experimental medication that makes her hornier and angrier than ever. Can Doctor Molla, the famous surgeon with a heart of ice, successfully woo these simpletons? Probably not, hence Agatha's Agony. [From Itch.io]

title: Immortal Desires
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You've moved to the quiet town of Crimson Beech, but a chilling discovery reveals there's more to this sleepy town than meets the eye. [From Choices Wikia]

title: Hot Shot
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You're an intrepid sports reporter assigned to your favorite hockey team, but the notorious captain has been burned by your kind in the past. [From Choices Wikia]

title: Face Off: A Hot Shot Story
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Hockey season is back! You're ready to help the Snow Tigers win, but can you catch the team captain's eye... or will someone new change the game? [From Choices Wikia]

title: Do No Harm
description: After saving a mafia boss's brother, you’re pulled into his dangerous world, torn between your medical oath and a loyalty that could prove deadly. [From Choices Wikia]

title: Inheritance
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: When your father's shot at a conference, you go to war against your half-siblings to prove you're the best candidate to be his successor. [From Choices Wikia]

title: Plus One
description: You recruit a sexy stranger to be your wedding date... but pretending to be together is more complicated than you thought. [From Choices Wikia]

title: The Nanny Affair
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You were just hired as a live-in nanny, but you're growing dangerously close to your new boss. Can you handle the consequences of a forbidden romance? [From Choices Wikia]

title: The Cursed Heart
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Claimed by the dark and alluring ruler of the Moon Court, will you find a way to escape the world of Fae... or let yourself fall under its spell? [From Choices Wikia]

title: Guinevere
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Promised to the legendary ruler of Camelot, you carry a secret that may be your new home's salvation... or its destruction. [From Choices Wikia]

title: Hearts on Fire
tags: Modern Day United States of America
description: When a charming firefighter saves your life, you decide it's time for a career change... But who knew your savior would end up being your boss? [From Choices Wikia]

title: Unbridled: An Untameable Story
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: After running away from your old life in the city, you find yourself in a place you never expected... with people you never could have imagined. [From Choices Wikia]

title: Make That Date!
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Looking for love? Then New York's hottest dating show has your solution! Who's behind doors 1, 2, and 3? [From Choices Wikia]

title: Shipwrecked
description: A shipwreck turns a scientific expedition into a quest for survival on Moku Island for you and your guide. [From Choices Wikia]

title: Roommates with Benefits
description: As a college transfer student, your mission is simple: Get in, get educated, get out. But will that plan change when you meet the ultimate partier? [From Choices Wikia]

title: Slow Burn
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You dream of becoming a world famous chef, but that's not your reality, until one chance encounter changes everything. Will you be able to prove yourself? Or will it all go up in flames? [From Choices Wikia]

title: Tap That Date!
description: You've asked your crush out on a date... to your place! But your home resembles a dumpster. Can you clean up to win your date's heart? [From Choices Wikia]

title: The Billionaire's Baby
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Landing a surrogacy gig with a VIP couple could make all your dreams come true. But will sparks with a sexy billionaire ruin your chances? [From Choices Wikia]

title: The Deadliest Game
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: When your wealthy best friend invites you to the murder mystery party of the decade, the stakes become all too real. [From Choices Wikia]

title: The Unexpected Heiress
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: In 1913, you're sent off to England to become a viscountess. Will forbidden love catch you unawares... and will you be able to solve a deadly mystery? [From Choices Wikia]

title: Villainous Valentine
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Picture if you will... a world outside of Choices canon. A world where you can sate your every dark desire. [From Choices Wikia]

title: Crimes of Passion
description: A private detective. An exiled royal. A missing woman. Can you crack the case... without getting too close to your suspect? [From Choices Wikia]

title: Crimes: The Proposal
description: A secret engagement ring? A romantic outing with Trystan? It can only mean a proposal... right? [From Choices Wikia]

title: Sunken Stories
description: Beneath a sunlit surface that belies its chilling depths, the Bright Lake holds its sorrows close. They say a loneliness so profound resides there, it pulls others into its beautiful, treacherous embrace, dragging them down into an endless quiet. For decades, it has guarded the stories of those who walked its shores and never returned. [From Itch.io]

title: Love at First Bite
description: It's like any other night. You wake up late, head to a club, and ready to have some fun. But then, you see a girl across the room who seems to be eyeing you? Wonder what she's all about...? [From Itch.io]

title: Girls' Day Out
description: A story about three women out shopping, but one of them, Ophelia, isn't doing so great... Thankfully, her two best friends Arshila and Ralynint are here to help, and they've always got her back! [From Itch.io]

title: Lost in Elysium
description: You are Kia, a unicorn centaur, who after years of not seeing your best friend, Circe, suddenly bump into her at your old meeting spot. She leads you to a secluded village in the middle of nowhere, insisting it's where she's happiest, but something is wrong. But you aren't going to lose your best friend, not again. [From Itch.io]

title: Plus Two
description: A year after Plus One, you and Darian are still going strong... and then a call comes that could change everything forever. [From Choices Wikia]

title: Princess of Worlds End
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Play as Princess, a high-maintenance 21-year-old girl who earned the nickname through her bratty behavior. After running away from home at 16, she worked dead-end job after dead-end job in order to survive and manage her addiction to a pain pill called Numb-X. The story begins with her waking up in a forest late at night during a rainstorm after getting knocked unconscious and robbed of all her belongings. Through a strange series of events, she unlocks a new power that will change her life forever. You will help guide Princess to get her life together, manage her relationships and, most importantly, prevent the end of the world. [From Steam]

title: Signal Strength
description: A bunch of annoying lesbians on an agricultural research station get really into public television when a distant war isolates them from the rest of the Federation, with surprising results. [From Itch.io]

title: Camp Mayhem
description: Welcome to Camp Mayview, where the counselors scheme and the kids are chaos incarnate. Will your cabin be award-winning angels, or hectic hellions? [From Choices Wikia]

title: Fear of Darkness
description: The game follows a young detective pulled into her first murder case – one that quickly turns more personal than she could have anticipated. At the center is a girl connected to the victim, and a tangled web of unanswered questions. [From Itch.io] (archived page)

title: Connection
description: You live under her watchful gaze – a prisoner in a decaying facility that reconfigures itself day after day. Traps, sabotage, silence. But something has changed... someone else is here. And the machine is evolving. [From Itch.io]

title: Living in Limbo: Prologue
description: Living in Limbo: Prologue is a short visual novel filled with creepy cute monster girls. You follow Nai the succubus as she demonstrates how a demons work in this strange place, guiding lost souls to a place called 'The Pillar'. [From Itch.io]

title: To Hunt a Heart
description: After days of walking around the same trees, somehow always looping back to the start of the path, you end up trapped between a strong-willed witch and her biggest enemy. With or without their help, you must find out a way to leave the forest with no exit. Stuck in a space loop, you can't get rid of this curse until these two souls are back together. [From Itch.io]

title: 7 Brothers
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: A college freshman living in an Ivy League frat, you’re more than you seem – but so are your seven brothers. At the Rosewood Club, no one is innocent, and guilt is only a matter of perspective. [From romance-club.fandom]

title: And the Haze Will Take Us
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: The gods are long gone, and your village is shrouded in a deadly fog. You are accustomed to the secrets of your home and its silence, but when you feel the Haze calling to you, everything changes. [From romance-club.fandom]

title: Astrea's Broken Heart
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Seeking work, you join an organization that pursues the supernatural. There, you are tested by unusual tasks and enigmatic colleagues. This wondrous place, however, does not require believers. [From romance-club.fandom]

title: Sophie's Ten Wishes
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Your quiet life is good enough… or is it? A Vegas getaway changes everything – discover love and become the best version of yourself, against all odds. From romance-club.fandom

title: Kali: Call of Darkness
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: When you're unexpectedly summoned to India to assist with an investigation, you don't know what to expect. Soon, you find yourself drawn into a terrifying web of murder and mystical powers... [From romance-club.fandom]

title: Soulless
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Desperate to survive, you're thrust into an unfamiliar world. Soulless, you are driven by an insatiable hunger. Now, the hunt begins… From romance-club.fandom

title: My Hollywood Story
description: Follow the chaotic adventures of an aspiring actress as she relocates to L.A. to make it big. From romance-club.fandom

title: Theodora
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Step into the life of Theodora Avery, an immortal journalist whose past spans centuries. In Paris, 2019, an interview with the secretive Monsieur Lachance takes her back to 1914, when she left California for the frontlines of World War One, striving to make her voice heard in a male-dominated world of war reporting. From romance-club.fandom

title: The Flower from Tiamat's Fire
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Banished to centuries of slumber by her own offspring, an ancient force of destruction stirs. You’re an unreliable, awkward fire mage – and the only one standing between her and the fate of the world. From romance-club.fandom

title: The One
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Thrust into the spotlight as the lead of a popular reality dating show, you face romance, intrigue, and the unveiling of deep, dark secrets. Will giving away pieces of your heart lead you to true love? From romance-club.fandom

title: The Thirteenth House
description: Something sinister brews in the esteemed halls of Arthur Hawthorne University, but first, you need to find a way to fit in with the rich and famous. [From Choices Wikia]

title: Sonagiga Naerineun Gonggan
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Hero
description: “Everyone hides something.” But when the silence ties to survival, the truth begins to shake. 'A Place Where Summer Rain Falls' is a story-driven visual novel set in a rainy school, where hidden memories and quiet emotions unfold. The truth isn't always loud — sometimes, it's silent. [From itch.io]

title: Laugh Track
description: You're now the lead writer for Juno's World, a perfectly normal sitcom in which nothing strange or horrible happens, ever! We're so happy you've chosen permanent employment. Management has infinite faith in your ability to steer our production team towards our mysterious and important endgame. You'll be guiding four teenagers -- Juno, Cat, Daniel, and Remy -- through the trials and travails of high school life. Using our patented "Ratings(tm)" system, you'll make decisions that keep them entertainingly unhappy! But not too unhappy, or they'll break. But also not too relaxed, or they'll fight back. We can't have that, no! How will we ever reach syndication if the entire project collapses? [From Steam]

title: The Missing Ingredient
description: Mavis Neela Berry is a baker in a small town. Nearly a year after breaking up with her last boyfriend, she’s given up on possibility of love. Instead, she sets her sights on winning the town’s country fair pie competition with her family recipe of blueberry pie. However, when a mysterious person shows up in her chicken coop, she recruits them as a new farm hand. Who are they, what is their story, and why do they act so strangely every time there’s a full moon in the sky? [From itch.io]

title: Fun Times at the Bibi Resort and Spa
tags: Protagonist's Brother as a Support Character
Protagonist's Sister as a Support Character
description: Marina and Marcello Forlani are the sibling design team behind the fashion label Forlani. But after their 2025 Milan collection is torn apart by critics, they’re in desperate need of a break. Luckily, an old friend offers the perfect escape: a stay at the luxurious Bibi Resort on the dreamy island of Fuente Grande. Sun, style, and plenty of romance await. Between poolside cocktails, glittering soirées, and quiet walks along the beach, Marina and Marcello will meet an array of captivating women; each with her own charm, secrets, and stories. Play as Marina (a lesbian woman) or Marcello (a straight man) as you explore paradise and chase the possibility of love. Will you find your perfect match in the island breeze? [Edited from Steam]

title: Tatterdemalion
description: Beth's night goes from bad to bizarre: a car crash lands her in a forest where knights and witches are hunting her. The Tatterwitches guide newcomers from other worlds, but Beth may be the only one without magic. [From Itch.io]

title: RETURN Machine.Love()
description: Since the very moment the first mechanical mind became aware of itself, it craved love. No one truly understand why the heart made of copper and wires started beating, but it did. Even after we were gone. And this is their stories. [From itch.io]

title: trespasser
description: 117/400 Garcia Street (1) completed construction in 2017 and began accepting tenants the following year. This makes it one of the oldest buildings in the city still operating for its original purpose. The metal had been part of it from the start, though for the longest time it remained inert. [From Itch.io]

title: Be Mine, Valentine
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Even after countless awful dates, you're still a romantic. Then, at the worst date of your life, Jamie shows up. He/She turns disaster into a perfect night. The issue? You didn’t get a number or a last name.

title: Rescued Hearts
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You joined North Ridge Search and Rescue expecting danger, adrenaline, and tough calls. What you didn’t expect: your by-the-book partner who pushes you harder than anyone else. Long hours, life-or-death stakes and chemistry you can't ignore. Team rules forbid dating, but keeping it professional is getting harder by the day. [From Choices Wikia]

title: in every life.
description: Someone comes into your life, and somehow, they feel...familiar. Almost like you've loved them before, in another place and time. https://nightseaboy.itch.io/in-every-life

title: Feyhearth: the Art of Handling Extraordinary Clientele
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Hero
Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: You've taken over a tavern that's existed for centuries now, one whose every owner must agree to an accord: four nights in a month, the tavernkeep must play host to a group of extraordinary clientele. They always arrive at dusk, they don't give out their names freely, and they expect to be entertained. Easy enough, right? Up until the party is crashed by your childhood best friend who can't ever learn the truth. So, tavernkeep, keep the drinks flowing, do your best to keep your friend in the dark, and—most importantly—don't make deals lightly. [From itch.io]

title: Heathcliff
tags: Protagonist's Brother as a Support Character
description: You grew up with everything money could buy. Everything except the one person you actually wanted. Years ago, your father brought home Emery Heathcliff after a business trip, and you fell hard for the rough-edged kid from a world you'd never seen. The two of you planned to marry the second you came of age. Then your father died unexpectedly and your brother inherited everything. He threw Emery out and forbade you from ever seeing each other again, and you spent years mourning what could have been. Now Emery's back as a wealthy and successful CEO. Except this version of Emery is darker and more dangerous, with an affection for you that borders on obsession. You don't know what they did to get this rich, and you're not sure you want to know. But when you're together, sneaking moments under your brother's nose, all that matters is how much you need them.

title: Once Upon a Witch's Curse
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Bonnie has always been prone to boughts of chaos - but now a potion mishap has caused a fearsomely friendly demon and a prickly fae prince to fall into her life... literally. [From itch.io]

title: Even Lovers Drown
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Even in the thoroughly modern era of the 1920s, one meets all sorts of characters while traveling the vaudeville circuit. Lark (gender selectable) has seen acts enough—and cons enough—to place very little stock in either magic or fairytales. That is, until two beings straight from myth turn Lark's world topsy-turvy. Entangled in a selkie's daring heist and stuck ferrying a stolen siren prince back to sea, the question is no longer whether magic exists—but whether Lark can survive without it. Because where magic is not a mere act, forces beyond reckoning loom in the shadows, and the monsters of old are neither phony, nor dead: rather, they are much closer—and much more dangerous!—than Lark has ever dared to imagine them. [From itch.io]

title: Catch of the HEART!
description: SERVE cheese burburs. SURVIVE dangerous women. SAVE the world. At the best undersea restaurant this side of the Steppe... In an era long forgotten, your ancestors chose to uproot themselves, leaving everything behind for a new life in the ocean. Their pledge of undying devotion has been carried for generations; an act of pure love, and a promise to serve the ocean and all who reside within. Unfortunately, you're not a perfect guardian angel. In fact, you're actually a bit of a loser, but you're all the Steppe's got. So what better way to serve the ocean’s inhabitants, than by cooking them delicious burburs? [From itch.io]

title: Endless Summer: First Tide
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Brother & Sister Siblings as Love Interests
description: It's the summer of 1977, and you're supposed to be having the time of your life vacationing with your high school friends before you all go your separate ways for college. Then the storm hits, capsizing your yacht and stranding you on a wild, uncharted island that isn't on any map, with a handful of mismatched teens and no way home. As you weld your fractured group into a found family—building shelter, surviving a paradise that's as dangerous as it is beautiful, and falling for at least one of your four magnetic companions—the island begins to reveal impossible wonders. Flying seahorses. Lights that bend time. A wedding frozen mid-celebration for fifty years. And a chaperone whose obsession with the island's secrets may be the most dangerous thing of all.

title: Owaranai Natsu o Kimi to ~Endless Summer~
title_original: 終わらない夏を君と ~Endless Summer~
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests

characters.name: Michele
characters.description: In "Fuyu no Himegimi -Winter Princess-": Princess that governs "winter" of the four seasons. Although she is the leading candidate for the Queen, the she has no motivation at all. Everyday she sorrows and cries because her first love broke her heart. In "Owaranai Natsu wo Kimi to ~Endless Summer~": The original, but now former, Winter Princess. She is supposed to go to live on earth and become human, but in response to the courtship from The Summer Prince, she has remained in the world of spirits. She now is between commandments and her own struggle with love. In "Joou Heika ni Chuusei wo -Mission from Queen-": Governs as the Princess of the Four Seasons. She had reigned as a princess for a 100 years, which is quite unusual. She is expressionless, cool and collected. Her personal life is shrouded in darkness. [Translated from the official website, from here, here and here.]

characters.name: Ira
characters.description: "...you know how miserable poverty is! I want to win at life!" A strong-willed and active girl who knows how to navigate the world. Because she lost her parents, she now lives alone. From her poor life so far, she knows the weakness and misery of not having money, so she is determined to save money and rise to the upper class. What she likes is money, and what she hates is poverty. Her hobby is saving money, and she works hard every day to earn coins. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Catan
characters.description: "I envy you all.... Because I'm just a fake. How can I become human...?" Although he looks human, he's actually a "living doll" created by a talented inventor. Having spent solitary time reading books in a large mansion, he is unfamiliar with the outside world and has a slightly timid and gentle personality. However, thanks to the collection of books, he has quite a bit of knowledge. He lacks emotional ups and downs, but longs for strong emotions. He wishes to become human someday. [Translated from official website]

characters.description: A spirit that controls lightning.

characters.name: Ash
characters.description: A spirit that controls fire.

characters.name: Luciel
characters.description: A spirit that controls ice.

characters.name: Pia
characters.description: A spirit that controls flowers. The princess of the spirit world.

characters.name: Meril
characters.description: A spirit that controls greenery.

characters.name: Ilumina
characters.description: A spirit that controls the moon.

characters.name: Fay
characters.description: "I know it's an important mission, but it's not for me to be troublesome like that~" A wind spirit who is in a good mood when the wind blows, in a bad mood when it's raining, gets upset when angry, and smiles when something is funny. A girl who expresses honestly without covering up. Although she is impulsive, capricious, and lacks concentration, she has a refreshing personality like a broken bamboo. Even when she's angry, she doesn't hold much root. She easily can talk to anyone and quickly become friends with them, but she is not good with people who are not friendly. [Translated from the official website]

tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Modern Day Setting in a Fictional World

characters.name: Miyuki Mashiro
characters.description: "I can no longer live in a world without you." The shrine maiden of Shiraki Hiyori. She is commonly known as the "Shiro no Miko." With her domestic, friendly personality, and lovely appearance, she is popular in school. She doesn't like to fight, but on the other hand, she has a side for herself that hates to lose and is a hard worker. She dislikes ghosts and scary stories. Her dream is to become a "Kuro no o Yomesan". [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Amamikado Kuro
characters.description: "Let me tell you one good thing. I don't have anything to handle." The shrine maiden of Kushitsukuyori. he is commonly known as the "Kuro no Miko." With her meek personality and unrivaled beauty, she is popular in school. She is completely indifferent to things that she isn't interested in. She dislikes insects and swimming. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Kazami
characters.description: "Wishing alone will not change anything. But that would be a step to move forward." A youkai who lives in Oto Jingu Shrine. He is strict with everyone and has good morals, but he also would stop at nothing to achieve his goals. He calls Kuro "ane" and refers to Mashiro as his "favorite pillow." [Translated from official website] One of Mashiro's love interests.

characters.name: Narukami
characters.description: "That day, I made a promise. I will never let you die." A dragon god of thunder that protects the Shiro no Miko. He is usually calm and composed, but occasionally is sharp-tongued without any ill will. He is a little lonely. He doesn't have any hobbies, so he's thinking of starting knitting. In Mashiro's eyes, he is like an older brother. [Translated from official website] One of Mashiro's love interests.

characters.name: Sasagane Tobari
characters.description: "It's a loss if you don't enjoy it. It's not bad to follow your greed once in a while." He calls himself a "spider monster" and surprises Mashiro. However, he doesn't act or look anything like a monster, such as working part-time and renting an apartment. He's frivolous, but he's a loyal man who always keeps his promises. Every time they meet, he makes fun of Mashiro. [Translated from official website] One of Mashiro's love interests.

characters.name: Ame Yori Terasu Tokoshie no Kami
characters.description: "Humans and youkai should live equally." A god who suddenly disappeared a thousand years ago. In the past, he was invisible to the human eye, but humans and youkai were both certain of his existence. He still hides his face while he appears in Mashiro's dreams searching for the "soul of Kamui." [Translated from official website] One of Mashiro's love interests.

characters.name: Toki
characters.description: "This is in a demon's nature." A demon who awakened after sleeping for a thousand years. He has no hesitation in killing and was once feared by both humans and youkai. His actions are straightforward with his emotions, but he is not good at expressing them in words. Maybe it's because he's a confident man, but he can't help but wonder why Kuro doesn't want to become his. [Translated from official website] One of Kuro's love interests.

characters.name: Seike Yuu
characters.description: "It's natural to worry. You're my family." The heir of the Oto Jingu Shrine. He is bad-mouthed, but also serious and sincere. Due to his mother running away under the influence of a young man, he is not good with women. He has special feelings for Kuro, who has been living with him since childhood. However, for some reason, everyone around him incorrectly thinks that he likes Mashiro, so he's troubled. [Translated from offiical website] One of Kuro's love interests.

characters.name: Tenkai
characters.description: "I am the obedient servant of a miko. So please, please be selfish." A servant of Tenjinmon Kuro. When he was injured and collpased, he was saved by Kuro, who was still a child at the time, and pledged loyalty to her. He is a quick-witted, intelligent general. He has a methodical personality and is a little neurotic, but he is extremely sweet towards Kuro. Taking care of his master, Kuro, gives him a sense of purpose in life. [Translated from official website] One of Kuro's love interests.

characters.name: Suiren
characters.description: "Now is the time to fulfill the promise we made a thousand years ago. I missed you, my bride." A snake god who disappeared around the same time that Ameyori Terasutokoshi Enokami disappeared. He doesn't even have a shred of empathy for youkai, but shows affection and mercy towards human because they're "cute." He is shown to be obsessed with Kuro and tries to make her be his bride. [Translated from official website] One of Kuro's love interests.

characters.name: Saeki Enishi
characters.description: "Rely on those around you more. It's hard to live if you're always stubborn." Mashiro and Yuu's classmate. His family were demon exterminators for many generations, but retired in his grandfather's generation. Therefore, his knowledge on demon extermination is thin. He is loved by his siblings as a reliable older brother. He is good at reading the mood and has many friends. He's especially close to Yuu, and they confess their troubles to each other. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Saeki Tsumugi
characters.description: "Mashiro-chan is frightened, but she's not a coward. She's a hard-working girl who hates to lose." Enishi's younger brother. He was born with a weak heart and often misses school, but he still has many friends of both genders: maybe he inherited friendliness from his older brother. The fact that he admires Midori, is liked by animals who he is friends with, and is even able to communicate with them is due to his family's demon exterminator blood. He prefers being with his siblings and says that Mashiro is his "older sister." [Translated from offiical website]

characters.name: Saeki Kizuna
characters.description: "If you lose your energy, I'll give you more! Because I'm Kuro-oneesama's wife!" Enishi's younger sister. She is in several sports clubs and has a bright, cheerful personality. Like Mashiro, she fell in love with Kuro at first sight. Since then, she has been crying out for overflowing love for her everywhere. She views Mashiro as a good rival. She doesn't overlook bullying the weak and doesn't hesitate to stand up to anyone, so it's not uncommon for her to follow Enishi's relationship. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Orikasa Yue
characters.description: "I want to be me because I've decided to love myself." Mashiro's classmate. She's in the Track and Field Club. She hates crookedness and is usually the type to speak clearly, but is only ever cold to Mashiro - especially when she's with Yuu. She seems to avoid Kuro, and if she gets close to her, her face will turn red and she will run away. When she was young, her grandparents and parents forced her to eat whatever she could get her hands on. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Minami Mako
characters.description: "Do you have a request...? Don't get along with anyone other than me." Kuro's classmate. She is in the art department. Ever since she saw her at the entrance ceremony, she has continued to admire Mashiro. She hopes for her to model for a painting someday, but doesn't have the courage to speak up - let alone say it out loud. "If I was the one next to her..." Her thoughts grow stronger day by day, and eventually... [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Nanatsuzaka Keishou
characters.description: "You can do whatever you like. I'm Hime-chan's ally." The second son of the Nanatsuzaka family who owns a temple in Kyoto. He seems to have a blood connection with Seike; after all, he has eyes that have "received the blood of God". He seems fussy, but is actually pretty sold. He specializes in exterminating ghosts but can also deal with youkai. He has a friendly personality, and has a habit of hugging. When he sticks to Kuro, it earns the anger of Mashiro and Yuu. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Kureha
characters.description: "Because of you, I was able to live. Don't go anywhere, stay by my side." On the day of her twelfth birthday, she made a contract with the Tengu Clan. She became a "key" to protect the treasure. The people around her say she was "born to be loved." Because she is so beautiful and fragile, she is called "Chou Hime" by the Tengu Clan. She calls herself Tenkai's fiancée and wishes to be by his side like in the past. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Kuyo
characters.description: "Excuse me. Don't pay back your debts. There's no way we'll end up losing." Ouri's younger brother. Because of the curse that his parents received, he was born with impurities. Using a three-section staff as a weapon, he served as a bodyguard for his older brother, who was a shrine maiden for Shiraki Hiyori. He was doted on by Ouri, and even though he felt a little annoyed, he loved his brother. Like Ouri, his final moments are not recorded anywhere. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Ouri
characters.description: "Please let go. I want to see the results." A man who served as the miko for Shiraki Hiyori 1,000 years ago. He looks very similar to Mashiro, but they are not related by blood. His final moments were not recorded anywhere and are still shrouded in mystery. His tone is gentle, but his personality is rather tight. He's good at gambling and is undefeated against humans. . There is also an anecdote that he challenged the gods to a duel... [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Hinosukui
characters.description: "My precious doll, please give birth to a cute child." Shen Jin's subordinate. A mukade monster that seduces men with her charm and devours their flesh. A man is just food, nothing more, nothing less. She likes beautiful young women and makes them lay eggs. These eggs feed on their negative emotions and amplifying desires before hatching. They then proceed to eat their mother's body and transport the nutrients to Hinosukui. She is aiming for a miko, and has set her sights on Minami Asako. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Seike Tadatsugu
characters.description: "I'll let you fully enjoy the power of the head of the Seike family." Yuu's father. Ever since his wife left him and his son alongside his elder son, he's been working hard to raise his younger son so that he would not feel lonely. Thanks to the arrival of Kuro and Tenkai, he feels less lonely, so he is very grateful. The head of the Seike family. He loves his son and calls him "Yuu-chan," whether they're at home or outside. He's hated for it, but he doesn't care. He has a good relationship with his family and seems to be in regular contact with Kai, his eldest son. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Seike Noritsugu
characters.description: "Wow, you're still active!" Yuu's' grandfather. Cheerful and energetic, it seems that he is at an age when he is deeply interested in young foods. He is the grand priest of the temple his family owns. Although he raised his son Tadatsugu strictly, he's very sweet to his two grandchildren. According to Tadatsugu, the vestiges of the old days have disappeared. [Translated from offiical website]

characters.name: Rokujou Reika
characters.description: "Your existence belongs only to me. I won't give you to anyone!" Seike Tadatsugu's ex-wife. She is also a good mother. Shortly after Yuu was born, she took her eldest son, Kai, and fled to her cheating partner. After that, she never visited, but recently she started contacting Tadatsugu and saying "I want to meet Yuu." She doesn't like that Kuro is in the place where she should be, and utters abusive words that make her want to cover her ears. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Miyuki Kohana
characters.description: "Don't forget what happened today. She always learns from her mistakes." Mashiro's grandmother. After losing her son and his wife, she raised Mashiro on her own. She is a calm and elegant woman, but her core strength and skill in navigating the world are certifiable. Even though she's older, she's still beautiful and gets asked out to dates all over the place. She loves Mashiro from the bottom of her heart. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Jinzan
characters.description: "Your sister is kind." Knowing that "god" had disappeared, a foreign demon came down to Earth to take his place. He gains powers by killing other demons. He has a high self-esteem and is very arrogant. He's set his sights on Mashiro and plans to acquire her. He looks at youkai like domestic animals. Even his younger brother, Hakushin, is nothing more than a useful tool in his eyes. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Hakushin
characters.description: "Hyahaaaa! This pain is unbearable! Let's hurt each other more!" A foreign demon who came to Earth with his older brother, Jinzan. Like his brother, he gains power by killing other demons. In order to enjoy the physical pain inflicted by others, he always seeks someone strong. Although he usually acts according to his instincts, he always is loyal to Jinzan's orders. Even though he knows he's being used like a tool, he doesn't seem to want to go against it. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Toto
characters.description: "I'm cute enough, aren't I?" Hakushin's subordinate. He rescued her when she was about to be killed by a bird demon. She's always floating, jumping, and restless. She treats her companion, Bakugo, like he is a pet because he is "ugly." She directs her murderous intent towards those she thinks are cuter than herself. [Translated from official website]

She's down on her luck, but also in luck! She's ripe for the picking, and already has two pickers: Helena, her bestest online buddy, who's trained in the art of fourth-wave feminism, and Jim, a man who just ran into her, could probably never love another person more than the sight of his own reflection! Over the course of the game, you'll come to understand Aria (or at least try to), and learn what makes her heart soar straight into the sun... and what makes her rage. And maybe.. just maybe... if you're lucky, you just might get lucky! This game is a comedy, but also very NSFW visual novel, based off the Sweetest Feminist comic series.

Despite this, it's designed to be playable without any prior knowledge of the canon. [From Itch.io]

title: Spellbound: The Magic Within
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Jump into a world of Magic, Witchcraft and Mystery as the town of Witcherley's newest resident. After discovering you have an abundance of magical energy your family send you to learn how to harness that power with an old family friend. You swiftly find yourself relocating to the charming village of Witcherley where you will interact with a host of unusual characters. Choose from multiple schools of magic, bond with your tutor, and maybe even save the world. Your choices will impact the way characters interact with you, how your magic develops and ultimately the ending you receive. Where will your powers take you? Who can be trusted in this village? And what's going on in the forest? The choices are yours but are you ready for the consequences. Will you be strong enough when the time comes? [From Steam]

title: Hime to Kaze to Akage no Tomo
Too Broken to be Loved? - A Gaychel Dating Sim

title: Enchanting the Girl
description: Lesbian witches enchant a girl. ...or do they? You watch, incorporeal in the shadows, as the two witches try to gain more power by using their magic on a girl. Is the girl more than she first appears? You are also a powerful witch and it seems that you can influence events. Maybe there is even a way for you to be brought back into reality. [From Itch.io]

title: Hollywoodland
description: Every classic film noir requires a captivating femme fatale, and when you find yourself starring in a Hollywood epic about the dangerous underbelly of Tinseltown, you can't help but fall head over heels for the most seductive femme fatale of them all. You travel through time to the 1950s and meet an alluring Hollywood star in the City of Angels. Join Celia Del Rio on the silver screen as you navigate the glittering darkness of Tinseltown. Will you and your co-star make it out alive? [From Itch.io]

title: Chilling Love
description: This visual novel is a romantic tale seen through the eyes of Aurora, named after the Aurora Borealis on account of her brilliant hair which mimics this wondrous light show. With just a glance you can tell that she is not an ordinary human, but one that possesses innate magical abilities. That is because she is half Rukh, a magical race of extraordinary beings who range from monstrous manifestations of evil to just fuzzy little animals. No matter their shape or size they are seen as agents of chaos that should keep to their own world, the Spirit World, and away from humans. That's what Aurora grew up hearing. Rukh and humans should never come together as one but she is a living contradiction to that rule. Maybe that's why she always had a soft spot for Rukh. But she'd never challenge others in her village on this front and just accept it. That was until she met her beloved. [From Itch.io]

description: As the future ruler of Khorinea, you are the heir to a kingdom filled with magic and mystery, but one that is also in a state of decline. When a dragon attacks the castle during one fateful day, you're brought to its tower and kept prisoner. Although your "host" tries to be hospitable, you can't help but notice that it's hiding a very big secret... [From Itch.io]

title: Inamorata
description: Ever wanted a hot vampire girlfriend, but you’re too asexual for your own good? Play as Ronnie, the swoon-worthy, buff heroine of this comfy, cozy visual novel, and see if you can win over the stylish and beautiful Cece. title: Macau Midnight Madness
description: Things are not going well for poor Mikayla. She was once a big tennis star, winning championships all over the world. Then one day, the magic left her, and she stopped winning games. Fast forward to the present day and Mikayla is now a tennis instructor for a posh country club outside London. Mikayla’s personal life isn’t going to well either. She and her wife have been fighting a lot and now her wife has asked for a divorce. Poor Mikayla is super depressed but then an opportunity of a lifetime presents itself. She is invited to play some exhibition games in Macau and there, she meets some lovely ladies, one of whom might become the love of her life. “Macau Midnight Madness” is a Romantic Comedy Yuri Visual Novel and Dating Sim. Play as Mikayla as she goes to Macau to take part in a tennis exhibition game and ends up finding the woman of her dreams along the way. [Edited from Steam]

title: Postat' holosu
description: 'Believe in yourself!', 'Follow your heart!', 'Trust your intuition!'... The whole modern world is forever talking about 'self-discovery', 'self-realization' and 'self-' whatever. But for some reason no one explains how to find the same ephemeral and elusive 'self', which seems to be the answer to all life's questions, the very last piece of the puzzle. Is it a journey that everyone has to take, called,on their own? Nina, a not-quite-new student of AMiOK (Olga Kobylyanska Academy of Arts), will have to find out about this. Nina has a completely normal life. She loves someone, fears something, and wants something. But above all, she wants to find herself. This is exactly what her new work for the art exhibition of the academy is about: 'Puzzle Lady'. At this exhibition, a crime occurs that will set off a chain of events that will lead to inevitable changes in Nina's life and her relationship with her identity. [Translated from itch.io]

title: Svitle Maybutnye
description: The underground station 'Danko' is the last bastion of humanity after the atmosphere on the surface has become unsuitable for life, an ark that carries humanity through the thorns of the dangerous surrounding world. Every day, on the territory of 30,000 km², thousands of automatic and semi-automatic mechanisms perform millions of processes to support the 'Bright Future' garden. The sprouts of this agrarian are woven into an amazing and harmonious bouquet, where flowers experience their ideal future, where there are no conflicts and there is a shelter for everyone. Such utopia could not exist without the titanic work of our atlanteans: five volunteer workers who took it upon themselves to watch over all of us. One of such heroes is You, oh, great builder of civilization! Always remember the weight on your shoulders and don't forget who you are, wear work clothes with confidence and complete the program to the max! And most importantly, know: When the future is out of reach, when the past seems so foreign, the only thing left is to live in the present. [Translated from itch.io]

title: What We Were Wolf

Inspired by personal events. A brief 10 minute dive into a light romance, and trying something new! [From Itch.io]

title: Can we be three?
description: Yolanda Rogers' career just hit rock bottom. Her star client, pop sensation Lamar Jelly, is behind bars for flinging his faeces at his drummer in a wild concert meltdown. Fired from her law firm and desperate for a change, Yolanda escapes to the sunny Dominican Republic for some much-needed R&R. But what starts as a simple vacation takes an unexpected twist when she runs into not one, but two of her ex-girlfriends—who are now happily together. Seeing their bliss sparks a bold idea in Yolanda: why not turn this love triangle into something even more exciting? [From Steam]

title: Atlas Ablaze
description: Atlas Ablaze is a visual novel that follows a girl named Andi as she discovers how it feels to yearn to know someone the way you know yourself. It's a story about a coming of age, sonder feelings, the acceptance of change and simply owning up to being human. She's a 16 year old who finds herself falling in love with a young sex worker as she's simultaneously dealing with a sharp decline in her mental health. Her lack of experience in relationships not only affects her love life, but her friendships as well. As she begins to understand how it feels to care for people so much that love becomes your crutch, she also realizes just how many people care for themselves more than anyone else. Acting as somewhat of a subconscious or an imaginary friend, you can help Andi make choices in her day to day life, influencing the way she interacts with the people around her. There are many different characters you can meet, some of which have secrets to be discovered. If your humor is warped to a point where you can't explain why any of it is funny anymore, living inside Andi's mind might be exactly what you need. [From Steam]

My destination is the city of Rostania, and the young souls at the academy here are the ones with whom I must forge bonds to obtain the Spirit Dew. Yet, as I undertake this mission, shadows of secrets from the past emerge, revealing truths I had never known... [From Steam]

Skilled in an arcana of her own, Meridian’s answer lies in the heart of the mystical Lapis cards, as she consults the cosmos to inspire new love connections across the city, which has been overtaken by astral gods peddling their own twisted notions of love to their believers. With the astrals’ targets set on her, Meridian must ensure that those who believe in her magic will be guaranteed an everlasting love, no matter the otherworldly obstacles awaiting. For as she sees it, a true love as foretold by the stars is simply the only way to stop the doomsday clock... and the key to a most amorous salvation. [From Kickstarter]

Rejected by the city as a “dropoff” in spite of your athleticism, you spend most of your free time watching the official trainees. After sparring with the Weapon Master Lubien, he pulls you aside and admits your worst nightmare: The Council has discovered the truth about you and Gruzi. So begins your panicked flight from the city and eventual discovery of a secret sealed deep in an ancient ruin. [From Steam]

title: Stained Glass ni Hikari o Tomoshite

description: The protagonist, Izumi Sumi Ao, wakes up in a hospital. She has lost all memory of who she is and what happened. Moreover, before her eyes floats a glass orb. When she cautiously touches it, she finds herself not in the hospital, but in a church, where two girls are talking. The words spoken by one of them, Yamakaze Midori, sear vividly into her mind: "I'm sorry." Why did she say that? What has she forgotten? Guided by the memories within the glass orb, she begins to reclaim her own past.

title: Get Lucky

And they’re moving in.

title: Overdrive
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You've just signed with Hyperion Racing, one of Formula 1's elite teams. Your teammate is Chris (male or female), a smooth-talking driver with incredible talent and a cocky disposition. When they beat you in your first race, a rivalry ignites. So does an attraction that takes you both by surprise. What starts as competitive banter becomes secret encounters between qualifying sessions and stolen moments in hotel rooms. The forbidden nature of it only makes things more intense. But every time you try to get close, Chris pulls away. They’re carrying the weight of their family's racing legacy and its failing finances. Can you keep your focus on the championship when your biggest rival is also the person you can't stop thinking about?

title: Eyes On Me
description: You have a secret escape from your soul-crushing corporate job: an anonymous masked dominant whose exclusive online content has become your guilty pleasure. Their commanding presence and sophisticated approach to BDSM offer everything missing from your buttoned-up professional life. For months, you've fantasized about who's behind that mask, never imagining you'd actually find out. Then during a late-night work session at your boss's apartment, you take a wrong turn looking for the bathroom and stumble into their streaming setup. Your carefully compartmentalized worlds just exploded. The same person who critiques your quarterly reports has been commanding your deepest desires through a screen. When you're caught red-handed, your boss makes you a proposition: become their real-life submissive and masked content partner. You share the profit, they get a trusted partner for their streams, and you get a safe way to explore all the desires you've kept locked down. It's purely transactional. Professional, even. Except it's not. By day, you maintain distance in the conference room, but by night, you explore your wildest fantasies, all while in front of an audience. The lines between your professional relationship and personal desires rapidly blur as you learn just who your boss really is behind closed doors.

title: Close Contact
description: You just got made captain of the Southampton Hawks, the newest co-ed rugby team in National One. Your dreams of winning a championship are finally within reach, but you've got a lot to prove on the field. Your coach has one strict rule: no fraternizing with the team. You're confident you can handle it. Until your first match against the Wakefield Hounds and their captain, Devon. You've looked up to him since he made it into National One years ago, but in person, that charming smirk is infuriatingly hard to ignore. Worse, he's got the skills to back up the cockiness. When you privately confront him after your team's loss, the encounter turns into an unexpected hookup. He leaves with one more smirk and a promise: "See you at the next match." What follows are months of secretly hooking up with your arch-rival between matches, letting off steam while keeping it hidden from everyone. The physical attraction is undeniable, but the more time you spend together, the more you see past the swagger. He's supporting his ailing parents and desperately needs his team's bonuses to make ends meet. You open up about the pressure of living up to your late father's legacy and the weight of everyone's expectations.

title: Breaking Ice
description: You and your new skating partner both had your previous partnerships blow up last year. Your partner retired after a horrific injury. Theirs ended in an ugly, publicized falling out. With the Global Games approaching, you decided to partner up and fight for your dream together. There's just one problem: your teamwork is a disaster. You barely know each other. Your partner is laser-focused on technical perfection but completely uninterested in chemistry. Your coach calls your performance "heartless and soulless." On the ice, you're supposed to portray romance. Off the ice, your partner has a strict no-dating rule. But the only way to fix your lifeless routines is to break through their walls. Between practices, you convince them to spend time with you. These "teamwork excursions" start feeling like dates. Your feelings grow, and you're sure they feel it too, until they blow you off again. With a spot on the Global Games on the line, you finally give your relationship a real chance. When your hearts sync up, the magic on ice is undeniable.

title: Drippy Date
description: In this horror-comedy visual novel, you play as a well-respected food critic whose job is to spend the afternoon at a French restaurant and hopefully get through the three-course meal without incident. To your dismay (or delight?), the restaurant's designated soup chef Spinaché seems very VERY interested in your opinions. ...wait, is that a green hair in your soup? Hopefully it won't get any worse than this. [From itch.io]

title: Whipped and Steamy • Cosplay Café

description: Come and relax with a hot and steamy coffee! In a town where adult entertainment is the new best thing, the Whipped and Steamy Café is the best fun for all cosplayers with a wild and adventurous side! No shirts, no shoes, no shame, and only the best service! But this café needs an extra pair of hands to stay steamy. Fortunately, our brand new hire, Caffie, just got the job! With a stoic demeanour and an utter lack of interest in the job, she’ll have to manage the plans and decorations of the everyday, and meet up with the clientele. And, who knows? Maybe even make some unlikely friends… Enough about that. Fire up for an experience that only a cosplay café can provide! Here’s hoping your time at the café is just like we like our coffee: Hot, steamy, and with skimpy clothing! [From itch.io]

title: Two Straws: Cruisin' for a Connection
description: This was supposed to be just lunch (Seriously) Another long day at the office and the only thing I look forward to is eating lunch at the cafeteria, but guess what? It's closed for cleaning and I missed the email update about it (I have it silenced but not my problem). Then I thought, maybe I'll grab a snack at the vending machine, but guess what? It ate my dollar and broke down. Just my luck right? Fine. Guess I'll eat out for once... A coworker suggested this place to eat lunch, couldn't find anything on the maps so I aimlessly wandered until I found it. THE DINER in big neon red signage, this must be the place Dave mentioned. Looks like I'll have my lunch here then...now which waitress should I call to take my order? AND HOW DID MY LUNCH BREAK TURN INTO ROMANCE!? [From itch.io]

title: Today's Sky
description: The story follows Lucy, a spiteful 19-year-old woman seeking to break free from the grasp of her captors and find independence. In the circumstances of a relationship that relies heavily on punishment and confiscation, she abandons all of her possessions in the name of that elusive freedom. Yet, there was one thing left she didn't realize she had yet given up: her dignity. [From itch.io]

title: Sweet, Sweet Indigo
description: Indi's older sister has been there for her since the day she was born, even moreso after she transitioned. There was nobody else to talk to, after their father used both of them. They grew up together, suffered together, eventually ran away from home together. Now they live in a van, trying to make things work out in the small corners of their hometown. They're not kids anymore. How long can they keep this up?

title: Between Love & Uprising: A Cheaters Dating Simulator
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: A Brazilian dating sim that takes place in the Minas Gerais Conspiracy, an unsuccessful separatist movement in Colonial Brazil in 1789. Inspired by real historical figures, this game lets you romance five rebels who dreamed of freeing Minas Gerais, a Brazilian state, from Portuguese rule. In a world of poetry, secrets, betrayal, and revolution, your choices shape the outcome, both in love and in history. Play as a protagonist of any gender and navigate complex relationships during one of the most fascinating, yet overlooked, chapters of Latin American history. Will you change the course of the conspiracy or simply fall in love along the way? [From Steam]

When he`s suddenly called in to investigate a mysterious illness that`s been affecting the nuns on a remote island, Dr. Fuwa`s certainly not above having a little fun with the patients – each and every one of them a cute little nun-in-training. But will he be able to uncover the truth behind their terrible condition? (Source: AniDB)

title: Maid no Yakata: Zetsubou-hen
description: Momoko is having major money trouble. After the untimely death of her parents, she finds herself strapped for cash to pay for her college tuition. Desperate, Momoko even considers selling her most precious possession - her mother's ring... But everything changes when Takaaki, a charming young man in her class, generously offers to pay her tuition if she simply agrees to work off her debt by serving as his own, personal, live-in maid. At least, the offer sounded generous at first... Now completely under Takaaki's control, Momoko has no choice but to satisfy his every twisted sexual fantasy. Yet Momoko isn't the only one he's drafting into this new maid service. Using blackmail and bribery, Takaaki's staff continues to grow with gorgeous young maids who are willing to serve him on their hands and knees. But even with all of this beauty surrounding him, for some inexplicable reason, Momoko still remains the target for his ever growing sadistic experiments. This powerful businessman has some bitter connection to Foster's past, but he still gives the young man a new life. Training high class prostitutes for Mr. Dread, Foster tries to piece together his shattered past and lost love. One by one, girls are added to his household. The only opportunity to improve financial and social status for them was to move to Ooedo, the city of wealthy clans, and to become a servant or a geisha - and, perhaps, a lover of a rich feudal. Dark Island, the leading state of the human alliance, sends White Wolf Yujia to destroy the dark force. But a mysterious girl called Coral from the world of nihility causes a storm in Shazhou. Legend says that the land was once separated by the Luo river. To the south was the agricultural Wei kingdom, and to the north, the nomadic Jing kingdom. Agula, a Princess of the Jing kingdom, had to become a Prince since birth so that her loving parents could stay together. Nangong Jingnu, a Princess of the Wei kingdom, was meant to live a carefree life, but the political struggles of the court made it necessary for her to follow the footsteps of her father. After a war turned Agula into an orphan, she went into hiding for ten years, honing her skills in order to infiltrate the Wei kingdom as a sycophantic official and bring chaos to the world. However, due to a series of events, she was appointed to be Nangong Jingnu’s husband at the Qionglin banquet…
