Aru Hitotsu no Mado no Naka ni (あるヒトツの窓の中に) 10. Aoiro ga Nokoshita Mono e (青色が遺したものへ) 11. Kuchizuke (くちづけ) 12. Kusare Onna (クサレ女) 13. Paint in Watercolor (ペイント イン ウォーターカラー) 14. Sugar 15. Boku no Naka ni Saku Marude Ga no Youna Hana (僕の中に咲くまるで蛾のような花) 16. Flower 17. Itaitashii Love II (痛々しいラヴ II) 18. Liquitex (リキテックス) 19. Water

title: Nyatto!
description: Yaneda Shigeru is a guy living alone with his cat Konbu until it turns mostly into a human (she keeps her cat tail and ears) for unknown reasons. Though to Shigeru, this isn't a problem; he has a cat-girl fetish. The problem is, his cat, Konbu, is stuck-up and wants everything to be elegant to fit her high-class tastes, even her name to be something more high-class. So, they each want to mold each other to their tastes; Shigeru an elegant butler, and Konbu an obedient, cute cat-girl. Will one of them win, or will they come to some sort of mutual understanding?

title: Uso to Kiss wa Houkago ni
description: When Rin was a child, she lost her warm home when her mother ran away with another man. Rin was taken in and supported by her childhood friend Momoka and her family. However, at some point, Momoka began to go out with one man after another as she became obsessed with the idea of love, just like the mother who left Rin behind. When Rin scolded her, Momoka said, "I can't be satisfied unless I'm loved. But I can have you make love to me instead of my boyfriend." It's a girls' love story that starts with a lie and a kiss. (Source: Big Gangan, translated)

title: Mi-chan to Airi
description: Midori, a corporate office worker, is busy with work day and night. She eats mostly bento from convenience stores, relaxes with cigarettes and alcohol, and spends rough days of no sleep. While on her way home one day, she finds a girl sleeping in a garbage dump. She helps her on a whim, but Airi, who uses mysterious powers and calls herself a "witch", begs Midori to "keep her at home for a while'', and they end up living together...!? The life of an office lady x a fallen witch begins! (Source: Wings Comics, translated)

title: Hogushite, Yui-san.
description: Karin, a new employee at an unethical job-listing magazine publisher, was wrecked both physically and mentally after just half a year. One day, Yui-san, her senior and a health nerd, gave her a massage to relax her body. In return, Yui asked Karin to hug her to warm her body up.

title: Partition
description: Han Yu-Na gave up being a girl, but secretly loves girly things. When a big misunderstanding happened during an encounter with Lee Yu-Na, something brand new is born...

title: Kisaragi Ibun
description: Malice, Unconsciousness, Urban Legends... The crossroads of music and the story of darkness corrupting people!! Nagisa is a girl living in a fierce environment, both at home and school. Through music, she got addicted to the people on the internet. One day, she walked past a mysterious girl at the train station she usually goes to, and the world around her changed. What she wandered into, is exactly the infamous 'Kisaragi Station', an urban tale popular among internet forums. As she fights against the monsters after her, what is the truth unraveling in front of her that makes her want to look away...?! (Source: Ichijinsha, translated) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Junsui Adolescence
description: A student-teacher romance.

title: Ninkoi - Kakurenbo Hichou
description: Mikado Shuuji is just an ordinary guy, but he has a very unusual knife that he uses for cooking. It's actually a famous short sword that marks its owner as the head of the ninjas, and now there are hot ninja girls coming after him to take it back. Hinamori Botan is one of those hot ninja girls, but her efforts to attack Shuuji mostly end up inadvertently stripping her. After she concludes that she does not want to steal the sword and kill Shuuji, she ends up deciding to serve him as a ninja instead. Now she must protect him from the other ninja that come to claim his sword and his life! (Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Yumeguri Yurimeguri
description: Tsubaki starts off her brand-new high school life the right way—by visiting an onsen! In the bath, she has a chance encounter with a beautiful black-haired goddess. "Won't you come to an onsen with me?" Pursuing her with fervor, is it possible to have a relationship with someone before you even become friends? This is the story of two girls who love the onsen and the ups-and-downs of their hot spring days. Note: Chapter count includes 4 extras.

title: Goreijou Takashima Kiyono wa Hisoka ni Tashinamu.
title_original: 御令嬢高嶋清乃は密かに嗜む
description: To Lady Takashima, the breach of etiquette is deserving of the death sentence. As the hate towards the lack of manners arises within her, the feeling of "I want to try it" has also arisen within her. This work is the record of the daily life of the Ojou-sama struggling with her guilt.

title: Awajima Hyakkei
description: Awajima Opera School—where countless girls from across the country flock in hopes of one day standing on the big stage. As they work toward achieving their dreams of stardom, their time at Awajima is filled with as much friendship and admiration as competition and jealousy. The precious feelings of girls who are at once both classmates and rivals, tenderly captured in the portraits of an ensemble cast! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Won the 19th Japan Media Arts Festival Excellence Award in 2015.

title: Manga de Wakaru! Fate/Grand Order
description: An "educational" Fate/Grand Order parody manga, focusing on the antisocial adventures of Gudako, a twisted version of the game's main protagonist. The series gleefully skewers Fate/Grand Order's mechanics, storyline, characters, and obsessed player behaviors.

characters.name: Ritsuka Fujimaru
characters.description: Ritsuka Fujimaru is the protagonist of Fate/Grand Order, acting as the Master of many Servants for the purpose of solving the Grand Order conflicts. He has absolutely no background details or connections to other people or events. He is simply "someone who just happened to see a recruitment flyer at a station, applied and got accepted into the job, and somehow ended up getting taken into the Chaldea Security Organization.'' He is a rather mediocre magus with skills comparable to Lord El-Melloi II. ~!After the events of First Order, Ritsuka is the only magus available to tackle the Singularities thus becoming the epitome of the everyday man tasked with saving the world!~

characters.name: Mash Kyrielight
characters.original: マシュ・キリエライト
characters.description: Mash Kyrielight is a clerk at Chaldea and a Shielder-class Demi-Servant contracted with [Ritsuka Fujimaru](https://anilist.co/character/120734/Fujimaru-Ritsuka) in Fate/Grand Order. The title Demi-Servant indicates that she's a human bonded with a Heroic Spirit's Soul. ~! In the year 2000, Mash was created through artificial fertilization and genetic editing. She is actually a Designer Baby, a magus genetically engineered under the orders of Chaldea's late director, ‎[Marisbury Animusphere](https://anilist.co/character/147492/Animusphere-Marisbury), to be a prime vessel for a Heroic Spirit's soul. Since she's not dissimilar to a Homunculus, her lifespan is limited.!~ ~! The Spirit possessing Mash is none other than [Galahad](https://anilist.co/character/136944/Galahad), Knight of the Round Table, the saint said to be the only one who obtained the Holy Grail only to return it to the Heave

characters.name: Olga Marie Animusphere
characters.original: オルガマリー・アニムスフィア
characters.description: Olga Marie Asmleit Animusphere, also known as Olgamally Animusphere, is the daughter of Marisbury Animusphere and heir to the Animusphere family of magi, one of the top 10 families in the Clock Tower. She joined Chaldea initially as a Master candidate though she had to step up and assume the control of the Grand Order operation after her father's death. Though severe, arrogant and uptight she still shows compassion and cares for her subordinates within the organization. She trusts and relies on Lev Lainur as a fellow researcher and for support in her duties. __In Fate/Grand Order - First Order__ ~! She is apparently Rayshifted to Singularity F together with Fujimaru and Mash but in reality, only her consciousness was shifted while her body died in the explosion that engulfed the laboratory. Returning back to the current era would mean her mind would die. This truth is revealed to her by

characters.name: Ritsuka Fujimaru
characters.description: Ritsuka Fujimaru is the protagonist of Fate/Grand Order, acting as the Master of many Servants for the purpose of solving the Grand Order conflicts. She has absolutely no background details or connections to other people or events. She is simply "someone who just happened to see a recruitment flyer at a station, applied and got accepted into the job, and somehow ended up getting taken into the Chaldea Security Organization.'' She is a rather mediocre magus with skills comparable to [Lord El-Melloi II](https://anilist.co/character/16023/Velvet-Waver). ~!After the events of First Order, Ritsuka is the only magus available to tackle the Singularities thus becoming the epitome of the everyday woman tasked with saving the world!~

characters.name: Artoria Pendragon
characters.original: アルトリア・ペンドラゴン
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1) Artoria Pendragon, better known as Arthur Pendragon and King Arthur, is regarded as a male in history but is actually female. She is the "Once and Future King" and a legendary hero of Britain known as the King of Knights. She used to wield the sword from the stone, Caliburn, but it was eventually destroyed and the Lady of the Lake gifted her with Excalibur and Avalon. __In Fate/Prototype:__ ~!He is presented as male instead, conserving his original name of Arthur Pendragon. Also called Prototype Saber, he is the Saber-class Servant under the control of [Ayaka Sajyou](https://anilist.co/character/54223).!~ __In Fate/stay night:__ ~!Saber is summoned in the Fifth Holy Grail War as the Servant of [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496). Shirou had been having dreams of Excalibur in the days leading up to the start of the Holy Grail War after receiving his C

characters.name: Medea
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm __Servant type:__ Caster ~!An honored guest of the Ryudou family​ permitted to live at their temple until the preparations for her marriage have been finalized. A gorgeous and talented yet mysterious woman of high stature, her presence has attracted the attention of many trainee monks.!~

characters.name: Bedivere
characters.description: __Height:__ 187 cm Sir Bedivere was among the first Knights of the Round table, and he remained faithful to the [King](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) until the end. Although he was the one who closest guarded the King, he never saw her smile nor learned of her identity as a woman. After attending the King's death he found himself initially unable to return Excalibur to the [Lady of the Lake](https://anilist.co/character/333146/Vivian), for that would signal Artoria was truly gone. Though sad the hard work of his King was not properly rewarded, he understood her Fate could not be changed and finally returned the Sword, hoping she would find a peaceful slumber. __In Fate/Grand Order Divine Realm of the Round Table:__ ~!In this version of History he was unable to return Excalibur, making it impossible for Artoria to pass away and reach Avalon. He has been wandering the

characters.name: Lancelot
characters.description: __Height:__ 191 cm __Weight:__ 81 kg In Fate/Zero ~!Berserker is the Servant of Matou Kariya during the 4th Holy Grail War. Berserker is known to have three distinct Noble Phantasms, as shown on his status page. However, due to the enchantment that obscured his identity, his status page was shown blurred, making it impossible to identify the specific names and natures of his Phantasms, save for the sword Arondight. In addition, this Berserker is uniquely able to make anything he chooses into his own Noble Phantasm and effectively wield them, from telephone poles to the Noble Phantasms of other Servants. Berserker's real identity is Lancelot of the Lake. Until his identity was revealed, he had been known simply as the Black Knight. Lancelot, known as the Knight of the Lake, had been loyal to Artoria, knowing both the king and the secrets of her sword well. Lancelot's downfall began when h

characters.name: Nero Claudius
characters.original: ネロ・クラウディウス
characters.description: Nero Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus, the Fifth Roman Emperor, had the reputation of a notorious tyrant whose rule was made up of schemes and poison as she oppressed all religious forces, especially Christians, and the Roman Senate during the period from 50 to 60 AD. She was regarded in the same light as the devil, for the assumed Hebrew pronunciation of her name as emperor, Nero Caesar pronounced as "NRVN QSR", equates with the "Number of the Beast". __In Fate/Extra:__ ~!One of three Servants available to the protagonist of Fate/Extra. While she was notorious as a tyrannical emperor and for her arrogance as an artist with supremacy comparable to the gods, She is a kindhearted individual who wanted what was best for her subjects.!~

characters.name: Tamamo-no-Mae
characters.description: A beautiful woman who served [Emperor Toba](https://anilist.co/character/394909/Toba-Tennou) said to be the disguised figure of the white-faced, nine-tailed fox. Her childhood name was Misukume. Working in the palace since she was 18 years old, she later became a court lady of Emperor Toba under the name of Tamamo-no-Mae. She was said to have gradually gained the favor of Emperor Toba with her beauty and extensive knowledge. In reality, she is a soul that branched off from [Amaterasu](https://anilist.co/character/394908/Amaterasu) and her true identity is not that of a nine-tailed fox, but rather is treated as one of the facets of said goddess. It is wrong to categorize her as a Heroic Spirit though she manifests as such because she wished to "become a good wife" The Tamamo Nine are a group of nine Heroic Spirits consisting of Tamamo-no-Mae and eight Alter Egos of her. __In Fate/Extra__

characters.name: Jack the Ripper
characters.original: ジャック・ザ・リッパー
characters.description: Jack the Ripper is a Servant of the Assassin class and one of the main characters in Fate/Apocrypha. She is a young girl who embodies contradiction itself, combining the dual natures of "day" and "night." She displays a childish manner of speech, but she is truly quick of thought. Rationality dominates her behavior, but there are many inherent weaknesses to her psyche. Her personality is both pure and cruel, and she is inclined to repay cruelty with cruelty and benevolence with benevolence. Her psyche is inherently broken, and mistreatment toward her may result in irreversible deterioration. While needing to feed on the souls of humans to keep herself in existence, she claims that she will only eat evil people because their souls "taste" better.

characters.name: Mordred Pendragon
characters.description: Mordred is the "son" of [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) though, in reality, she is a woman. [Morgan le Fay](https://anilist.co/character/239533/le-Fay-Morgan), Artoria's sister, created Mordred as a homunculus clone of the King. Morgan grew Mordred in secret, inculcating her the desire to usurp the King and ascend to the throne as the rightful heir. To achieve this objective Mordred was made to be one of the Knights of the Round Table. With time Mordred grew to idolize her "father", but the King refused to recognize her as a rightful heir. These clashing feelings of love and hate made Mordred play an important role in the fall of Camelot. __In Fate/Apocrypha:__ ~!Mordred is the Saber-class Servant of [Kairi Shishigou](https://anilist.co/character/122397/Shishigou-Kairi) as part of the Red Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War.!~

characters.name: Jeanne  d'Arc
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'3) Ruler's True Name is Jeanne d'Arc, the Saint of Orleans. A Catholic saint born in Domrémy, France, and the heroine of France who liberated Orléans in the Hundred Years' War. A Ruler Class Servant is the Standard-Bearer who Correctly Guides the Holy Grail War. Jeanne is a special Heroic Spirit summoned by the Holy Grail itself to act as the administrator of the Holy Grail War instead of the Church. Being summoned in the Ruler class also allows her to retain the memories of each repeating "game" unlike other Servants. Jeanne d'Arc was a common farmer's daughter. She claims she had received the command of God to fight. She heard the Lord’s lament that the world changed straight into hell. The Lord wept into sorrow as no one could stop it and people were not even allowed to live simply, and were compelled to become either beasts or food. Conflict never ended, and blo

characters.name: Astolfo
characters.description: **Height:** 164 cm Rider of Black is the Rider-class Servant of [Selenik Icecol Yggdmillennia](https://anilist.co/character/122393/Icecolle-Yggdmillennia-Celenike) as part of the Black Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. Black Rider's identity is Astolfo, the Twelfth Paladin of Charlemagne. ~!In the Charlemagne Legend, he is the son of an English king, and one of [Charlemagne](https://anilist.co/character/259823/Charlemagne)'s twelve faithful Paladins. He is beautiful beyond all compare, but he is also a frightfully unparalleled blabbermouth, prone to speaking on and on until those involved lose all rationality. His conversations, through no ill intent on his part, have a way of meandering toward maximum social awkwardness. His hobby of adventuring gets himself mixed up in an assorted amount of mischief due to him constantly popping up everywhere. He states that his

characters.name: Sieg
characters.description: Sieg was created by Yggdmillennia as one of their many homunculi suited to various purposes. Initially kept in a prana supply tank devised by Gordes Musik Yggdmillennia to grant energy for Servants, he was one of many allowed to be used by Caster of Black for usage as harvesting materials for his golems. Due to his unexpectedly high quality Magic Circuits, he was thought to be a good choice for Caster's Golem Keter Malkuth. Sieg comes into consciousness without anything to form a personality. He is scared of everything but himself, believing to be nothing. He calls himself transparent and colorless because he possesses nothing and had received nothing from his birth. (Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

title: Baby Shachuu Hackers
title_original: ベイビー車中ハッカーズ
description: “I find school kinda stifling.” Fuji Yonagi is a high school girl who struggles to fit in with her class and finds school a bit stifling. Fuji has been “car camping” in her backyard as a way to unwind, but after her encounter with Asahi Ichinose―an extroverted girl from the same school who happens to have a driver’s license―her days are suddenly filled with new possibilities! High school girls meet car camping!! A special coming-of-age outdoor girls’ story, all connected by cars!! (Source: MANGA Plus)

characters.name: Kei Yonagi
characters.description: [Fuji's](https://anilist.co/character/404226) paternal aunt.

title: Joryuusakka to Yuki
description: Young cafe worker Yuki dreams of romance and a life far more wonderful than her own, but has no way to do anything but hope for the future – but a chance encounter with the beautiful, mysterious authoress Azuma Beniko, a woman who seems to know love like the back of her hand, might change the very way she looks at the world… Note: Includes chapter 7.5 (Cat) and an epilogue.

title: Doushi Shoujo yo, Teki wo Ute
description: In 1942, as the war on the Eastern Front intensified, the normal life of Serafima, a young girl living in a rural village near Moscow, is suddenly shattered. An assault by the German forces massacred the villagers, including her mother. Just as Serafima is about to be shot, she is rescued by Irina, a female soldier of the Red Army. Determined to defeat the enemies who killed her family, Serafima, along with her comrades, undergoes rigorous training to become snipers. (Source: HayaComic Web, translated)

title: Okujou no Yurirei-san Side A: Mou Hitotsu no Yuritopia
title_original: 屋上の百合霊さんSIDE A もうひとつのユリトピア
title_en: Kindred Spirits on the Roof SIDE A: Another Yuritopia
description: Mako and Shiori have been best friends since they were children, but when Mako suddenly confesses her love to Shiori, all Shiori can do is run away! One year later, Shiori sees Mako and decides she wants to rekindle their friendship. Can the two girls go back to their relationship the way it was before or are they ready for it to evolve into something else? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Haengbogeun Bitjarureul Tago
description: Dan-Jo is a freshman in a university and lives a monotonous life. On orientation day she goes to the warehouse on an errand for her senior and witnesses a broom that transforms into a human. From that day on, the Broom Ghost persistently asks for help from Dan-Jo, who she has never met, saying she has nowhere to go. In the end, Dan-Jo accidentally gives the Broom Ghost, the name 'Eundohae', and they live together in a small gosiwon. In return the Broom Ghost promises to make Danjo happy. (Source: BOMTOON, translated)

title: Mahou Shoujo Ore
description: "I want to protect the person I love..." -- with that one wish, a girl's life changes completely! Witness the miracle that brings to life her pure wish, and the battle that follows. Saki Uno, aspiring idol.☆ Oh no! My dear Mohiro is being attacked by a demon! At that moment, I decide to sign a magical contract with a scary older ma.... I mean, Kokoro-chan. You can see the result for yourself! The battle is tougher than I expected. It's... hard to explain, but anyway I'll do my best, so thanks for your support in advance! A girl's love is the source of her magical powers. As one demon after another attacks, she faces them in desperate battle. All to protect the one she loves... What will be the conclusion now that her earnest wish has been granted? The girls jump into the fight with hope ringing in their hearts! Their only thought is to protect the people they love with the strength of their slender arms. Saki fighting for Mohiro, and Sakuyo fighting for Saki. As the story reaches its climax... Come, magical girls! Defeat the demon king in the name of love and peace! (Source: INKR)

characters.name: Sakuyo Mikage
characters.description: Sakuyo is a member of the rookie idol unit "Magical Twin" with her best friend since childhood, [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/125371/Saki-Uno), who she has feelings for. She is also the younger sister of [Mohito](https://anilist.co/character/125375/Mohiro-Mikage), who Saki has a crush on. Sakuyo's love for Saki led her to become a magical girl.

characters.name: Saki Uno
characters.description: Saki is a young girl working hard as rookie idol with her childhood best friend, [Sakuyo](https://anilist.co/character/125370/Sakuyo-Mikage), as part of the idol unit "Magical Twin". Saki has a crush on Sakuyo's brother, [Mohito](https://anilist.co/character/125375/Mohiro-Mikage), and her desire to protect him led her to become a magical girl.

characters.name: Hyoue
characters.description: Hyoue is a member of the top idol unit "STAR☆PRINCE" with [Mohiro](https://anilist.co/character/125375/Mohiro-Mikage).

characters.name: Kokoro-chan
characters.description: Kokoro-chan is a magical fairy who recruits [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/125371/Saki-Uno) to become a magical girl. He is also the one who recruited her mother, [Sayori](https://anilist.co/character/125376/Sayori-Uno), in the past.

characters.name: Ruka Kiryuu
characters.description: A responsible and composed idol of the duo PRISMA, Ruka usually keeps her cool—but when it comes to Michiru, her emotions overflow. Deeply devoted and protective, she holds strong feelings for Michiru that she doesn’t always manage to hide. Mahou Shoujo Everything Crazy Beauty is Ruka’s appearance after forming a contract with Happy-chan and transforming into a Mahou Shoujo. Their overwhelming feelings for Michiru have taken the form of pure Love☆Power.

characters.name: Mohiro Mikage
characters.description: Mohiro is [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/125371/Saki-Uno)'s childhood friend and [Sakuyo](https://anilist.co/character/125370/Sakuyo-Mikage)'s older brother. He is a member of the top idol unit "STAR☆PRINCE" with [Hyoue](https://anilist.co/character/125372/Hyoue), and he has a singing voice that attracts people and animals alike. For some reason, he is often targeted by demons.

characters.name: Sayori Uno
characters.description: Sayori is [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/125371/Saki-Uno)'s mother and a former magical girl who made a contract with [Kokoro-chan](https://anilist.co/character/125373/Kokorochan).

characters.name: Konami Yamo
characters.description: Konami is [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/125371/Saki-Uno) and [Sakuyo](https://anilist.co/character/125370/Sakuyo-Mikage)'s manager. He is a huge magical girl fan.

title: Takane no Hana wa Usotsuki desu.
title_original: 高嶺の花はウソツキです。
description: Meguru is an innocent high school gal who has zero luck with guys. One day, she was saved from a molester by a mature and tidy office lady, Yukiho. She seemed like the complete opposite of Meguru in both looks and personality, and Meguru pounced on her, asking Yukiho to be her love teacher! Yukiho was confused, but promised to be her friend, but Yukiho's true nature is actually that of a teasing bully...? This is a love story of two unbalanced people. (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Buna no Mori no Aria
description: The witch Aria is a little shy. She's good at cooking and knitting. And she's a real wiz at growing herbs. As for what she's bad at? Why, that's magic! One fateful day, the sheltered girl encounters a talking wolf, who becomes her very first friend. Watch the witch and wolf snuggle up in this comfy story with a touch of mystery set in the forests of Ireland! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Geomeun Ineo
description: She just wants to start fresh so she can graduate in peace. She just wants to leave behind all the bad memories — her sleepwalking, the trauma from being bullied at school — all of it. She did everything she could to keep to herself, but the class president, Hae-On, just won't leave her alone. One day, when Seul-Bi visits the local lake Hae-On recommended, she comes across something she never imagined seeing in her wildest dreams: a wild, dark mermaid. (Source: WEBTOON, edited) Note: Includes one extra.

characters.name: Ju-Mi Lee
characters.description: [Geon-U's](https://anilist.co/character/379357/GeonU-Lee) mother

characters.name: Adélaïde Arnaud
characters.description: ~![Hae-On's](https://anilist.co/character/379159/HaeOn-Kim) aunt!~

title: Kanojo no Kuchizuke
description: After being hospitalized, Sana, meets a mysterious girl at the vending machine named Kousaka Ayane. They are both interested in each other and start spending time in their rooms. With every meeting Sana experiences new emotions which she hasn't felt before. After Ayane's doctor tells her that she is going to leave hospital she meets Sana one more time...

title: Alcohol Yuri Anthology: Strong!
title_original: アルコール百合アンソロジー・ストロング!
description: Can't be honest? Use alcohol! A slightly naughty yuri anthology centered around alcohol! 1. Sweetly Moved To Tears (Aoki Mutsumi) 2. Sweeter Than The Taste Of Alcohol (Kashikaze) 3. Tonight I'll Rely On The Power Of Alcohol (Mozukuzu) 4. Offline Home (Noyama) 5. Getting Drunk And Twisting The Thread (Tatsunokosso) 6. Love Again (Kuune Rin) 7. 3 Minds Together Will Bring About The Wisdom Of Monju (Yakiniku Teishoku)

title: Jjaksarangui Skill
description: Yuna has kept a secret for ten whole years: she has a crush on her best friend, Da-hye. It’s a secret she intends to keep for the rest of her life, but the new year brings a lot of surprises: including a strange new woman named Zoey, who just might change everything. Caught between two women, Yuna’s one-sided crush just might die down…or turn into something else entirely. After a whole decade of pining, is it time for Yuna to finally find her happy ending? And if so, who will be the one to ultimately grant it to her? (Source: Lezhin US) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Futago Wazurai
description: Ako and Komachi are twin high schoolers who are famous for being close. They look almost exactly the same, except for the length of their hair. They're also similar in terms of academic performance, but in their latest aptitude test, Ako claimed to be in a "slump" that caused her grades to fall. Because of this, she has to take remedial English lessons from the assistant homeroom teacher, Oosawa Maki. When asked about the reason for her declining performance, Ako tells her that she was worried about love.

title: Shinkaigyo no Anko-san
description: Fish people have been welcomed to the town where the human girl Wakasa Otomi lives, and they are integrating well. The fish people can be identified by the physical marks of their fish species, though they take medicine to keep their lower bodies human rather than a fish tail. Otomi loves fish people, and is eager to meet as many as she can! One day, she meets a new transfer student, a lantern fish girl named Tsutsumi Anko. Anko is a bit self-conscious about being a deep sea fish, with a tail that is not cute like some other fish girls. At school, she and Anko deal with various fish problems that intersect with issues an ordinary human high-schooler would face.

characters.name: Anko Tsutsumi
characters.description: An Atlantic footballfish mermaid. Anko is the titular character and protagonist of the series. She is quiet, shy, and quite self-conscious about her tail fin. She is close friends with Wakasa.

characters.name: Otomi Wakasa
characters.description: Otomi is an highschool girl addict of mermaid fins and she's eager to meet as many mermaids as she can to fulfill her dream. She meets Anko and becomes her first human friend.

characters.name: Touna Suzuki
characters.description: Siamese Fighting Fish mermaid. Known by most as Bettako. Has an aggressive nature. Regards everyone she comes across as a rival, and acts overbearingly even with those she meets for the first time. Scared of cats.

characters.name: Akame Fukuda
characters.description: Red-eyed Pufferfish mermaid. After coming in contact with dry land media, her chuunibyou syndrome got worse. Her mysteriously glowing deep-crimson eyes have no special power whatsoever. The truth is, the toxin on her skin isn't even strong enough that she needs to wear gloves.

characters.name: Ran Kanetou
characters.description: Ranchu Goldfish mermaid. Always goes at her own pace. Usually reading light novels. Rarely goes along with what people say. Goes to school with Suzume and Pleko.

characters.name: Pleko Namikawa
characters.description: Sailfin Pleco mermaid. Goes to school with Suzume and Ran. ~! Might seem like the group's voice of reason, but sometimes shows an attachment to Suzume that goes beyond friendship. !~

characters.name: Suzume Taira
characters.description: Blue Discus mermaid. More or less a leader-like presence. ~! Coming from the same middle school as bettako, harbours a rivalry for her that became closer to admiration. !~

characters.name: Una Kabayagi
characters.description: Japanese Eel mermaid. An energetic kouhai. Likes una-juu. Her school grades aren't very good. Her skin gets slimy when nervous.

characters.name: Natsuno Samejima
characters.description: Great White Shark mermaid. A diligent senpai. ~! A troubled person followed by the fame of being the strongest of all fish, whose legends will arbitrarily spread among thugs even without her lifting a finger. !~

title: Watashitachi wa Koi wo Egakenai
title_original: 私たちは恋を描けない
description: Onodera Kano and Nanase Miyuu have recently made their debut as a manga author duo with Kano writing the story and Miyuu drawing the art. However, Miyuu needs some help drawing love scenes, so she gets Kano to agree to act as her "boyfriend" to keep their manga aspirations alive. The only problem is that Kano has mixed feelings about it because she secretly harbors feelings for Miyuu.

title: Lycoris Recoil Koushiki Comic Anthology: Repeat
title_original: リコリス・リコイル 公式コミックアンソロジー リピート
title_en: Lycoris Recoil Official Comic Anthology: Repeat
description: From fresh haircuts to flashy new uniforms, there's always something brewing at Café LycoReco in this official comic anthology! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Takina Inoue
characters.description: Previously an exceptional Lycoris, but for some reason, she now works at Café LycoReco. A realistic person with a distaste for inefficiency, she can be dissatisfied with [Chisato](https://anilist.co/character/260329/Nishikigi-Chisato), who is not a typical Lycoris. She wants to see good results in her job at LycoReco.

characters.name: Chisato Nishikigi
characters.description: Chisato is said to be the strongest Lycoris of all time. She enjoys solving private-sector problems that the DA would not address. At Café LycoReco, she works joyfully and cheerfully as the self-proclaimed poster girl. ~!Chisato has an artificial heart which was developed by Alan Institute, and can be broken by applying high voltages directly to it.!~

characters.name: Mizuki Nakahara
characters.description: Previously a DA Intelligence Division member, she’s been with Chisato for a long time. In her desperate desire to marry, she took the job at the café in hopes of meeting her special someone. Her routine includes a nightly drink while reading wedding magazines.

characters.name: Kurumi
characters.description: A young runaway girl of unknown origins who loves all kinds of games. She’s a terrible employee who reluctantly works in exchange for lodging. She only looks forward to gaming parties with the café’s regulars come closing time. ~!In some later episodes, it is revealed that Kurumi is actually the hacker Walnut.!~

characters.name: Mika
characters.description: Lamenting the worsening of his eyesight as he grows older day after day, he is the surrogate parent gently overseeing his problematic employees. Ohagi mochi and coffee, Japanese clothing and a café. It’s all about expressing a mix of Japanese and Western styles. He is the manager of the café with a traditional Japanese twist, "Café LycoReco”. ~!In episode 7 of the anime, it is revealed that Mika is gay.!~

characters.name: Shinji Yoshimatsu
characters.description: A member of the Alan Institute. A regular at Café LycoReco. [Mika](https://anilist.co/character/268459/Mika)’s old friend. ~!He is later shot and killed by Mika!~

characters.name: Fuki Harukawa
characters.description: A 1st Lycoris of DA Tokyo branch. Previously [Takina](https://anilist.co/character/260328/Inoue-Takina)’s partner. She and [Chisato](https://anilist.co/character/260329/Nishikigi-Chisato) fight like cats and dogs.

characters.name: Sakura Otome
characters.description: A 2nd Lycoris of DA Tokyo branch. She is Fuki's partner instead of Takina.

characters.name: Kusunoki
characters.description: DA Commander.

title: Watashi no Megami ga Kyou mo Oseru: Korekara mo, Itsumade mo
title_original: 私の女神が今日も推せる ～これからも、いつまでも～
title_en: My Goddess is Precious Today, Too
description: They start off as friends, total opposites who watch each other from afar, or maybe they’re locked in a fierce competition. Either way, they can’t stop thinking about one another. These fluttery feelings can only mean one thing: first love! Swoon over these budding teenage romances that celebrate girls loving girls. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Originally self-published, it was picked up for serialization starting in comicGaga Vol. 1 on 2022-03-05, republishing the doujin content.

title: Tawawa na Oppai ni Iroiro Shitai! Anthology Comic
title_original: たわわなおっぱいにいろいろしたい！ アンソロジーコミック
description: Collection of short stories about boobs by various authors.

title: Mikanuji Tanpenshuu: Happy End wa Iranai
title_original: みかん氏短編集　ハッピーエンドはいらない
title_en: I Don't Need a Happy Ending
description: From office workers to high schoolers to a mistress and her maid, dive into a collection of girls love stories from the author of Assorted Entanglements! Mikanuji delivers a tantalizing mix of sweet and spicy in this anthology—including a brand-new epilogue for her short story “I Don’t Need a Happy Ending”! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Candy
description: This charming story follows Kanon Miyamoto who, ignorant of her popularity, is confessed to by Bessho Chiaki, the school's most intelligent and beautiful girl.

characters.name: Kanon Miyamoto
characters.description: A second-year in high school and though not great at her studies, Kanon is well known as the kendo club's ace and is a regular on the competition team. Adding to this a friendly and playful personality, Kanon is popular to where she even has her own fanclub yet she is often confused as to why people like her. With an addictive personality, Kanon consumes large quantities of candy and can become quite dependent on those close to her.

title: Black Lily to Sayuri-chan
title_original: ブラックリリィと白百合ちゃん
description: The all-girls' school Yuri transferred to should have been one of discipline and morals. However, when she arrives, she discovers the girls follow their own rules thanks to a conceited honors student named Lily who believes in the school's "Freedom" and other pleasures!! A comedy about girls loving girls! (Source: Renta!)

title: Sakura no Sono
description: By all appearances, Sakura and her friends are normal, albeit sheltered junior high school girls who enjoy talking about love and walking home from school together. However, they also happen to inhabit a strange and supernatural world populated by mysterious, gigantic beings and unusual plant and animal life. Amid their peaceful lives, Sakura becomes very interested in something only alluded to exist in an old book: dicks.

title: Liberty
description: Honjo Maki is a scenario writer for a game company. One night, while going home from work, she almost ran over a girl. By the end of the night, the mysterious girl writes a time and place on Maki's hand. It turns out that it's the venue for the concert of the band Liberty.

title: Haru no Minuet
description: Nao wants to get closer to her deaf classmate, Tobe-san.

title: Kimi wa Shoujo
description: After her parents divorce, Maki moved from Tokyo to the countryside with her mother and met a mysterious woman.

title: Yige Guanyu Tangguo De Gushi
description: In the hospital convenience store, the blind Bai Xiaoxiao met a girl who smelled of sweets. Their story unfolds in the hospital filled with the scent of disinfectant, as they become dear and help to heal each other. (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Hinamizawa Teiryuujo: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Genten
title_original: 雛見沢停留所～ひぐらしのなく頃に原典～
description: In the recesses of mountain... there's a bus stop at outskirts of a village, it's called "Hinamizawa bus stop". Rika, a female high-school student, together with her junior, Mion visit this place. Twisted relationships that are concerned with the dam construction in Hinamizawa, and the stories of the curse of "Oyashiro-sama" that takes root in this area. What waiting for them is a tragedy, or else...? This manga adapts Hinamizawa Teiryūjo, the unreleased stage play that Ryukishi07 wrote and eventually tranformed into the Higurashi no Naku Koro ni game/anime/live-action franchise.

characters.name: Rika Furude
characters.description: Rika Furude is one of the younger students in [Keiichi's](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi) school, and is in the same grade level as [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko). Naturally, she is great friends with her, as they live together in the same house. She is revered by the villagers as the heir of the local shrine, and plays the role of a miko in the annual Watanagashi Festival. She has been the head of the Furude house since her parents died, but rarely attends town meetings due to her young age. While she does not speak a lot, she likes to say nonsense words such as "mi~" and "nipa~" and often ends her sentences with "-nano desu", which inflames [Rena's](https://anilist.co/character/1427/Ryuuguu-Rena) passion for cute things. Despite her young appearance, she is rather calm and reserved-usually serving as the voice of reason amongst the club mem

characters.name: Mion Sonozaki
characters.description: Mion is the oldest kid in [Keiichi Maebara](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s class. As the elder, she is the class president and everyone looks up to her as the leader. She acts like a perverted tomboy and calls herself old man, but has a hidden girlish side. Mion is next in line to be the head of the Sonozaki household, one of the Three Families which holds tremendous influence in Hinamizawa. Often when playing games with her fellow club members she is known for her ruthlessness, often coming up with the most embarrassing penalties for the losers. Mion also serves as the leader of the main characters' gaming club. ~!Mion is more stable than the other club members, and as such has never herself succumbed to Hinamizawa Syndrome!~

characters.name: Shion Sonozaki
characters.description: Shion is [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion)'s identical twin sister, who currently resides in Okinomiya. In spite of their different personalities, she and Mion often switch places, and it can be difficult to distinguish between them. ~!Their first switch took place when they were little. Right before tattooing the symbol of an oni, which is reserved for the older sister, she was mistakenly identified as Shion, the younger sister, which means that she was actually born as Mion Sonozaki, the older sister. Since then, she switched her identity of Mion with Shion, the younger sister.!~ She was sent by the Sonozaki family to a private boarding school, but escaped and returned to live near her hometown, where she lives with [Kasai](https://anilist.co/character/14928/Kasai-Tatsuyoshi). In spite of all this, she and Mion maintain a close relationship. In most of the arcs, s

characters.name: Rena Ryuuguu
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2'') Rena is a girl who returned from Ibaraki to Hinamizawa one year ago and now is in the same grade level as [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi). She is very kind and capable and takes care of Keiichi and her friends whenever possible, but is also naive and is usually subject to light teasing by Keiichi. She is distinguished by her obsession with things she perceives as adorable, calling them kāii (かぁいい), a slurred form of kawaii (かわいい) meaning "cute." Those tend to be moekko characters or items she finds while scouring the local dump, which are not considered cute by others. Despite this disarming trait, Rena is shown to be amazingly observant and perceptive about the things around her.

characters.name: Satoko Houjou
characters.description: Satoko is a younger classmate in [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s school. She has a distinctive style of speech, ending all of her sentences with 'wa' which, at times, is grammatically incorrect. In spite of her young age, she is quite clever in setting up traps, and likes to practice on Keiichi. Despite her extremely energetic and playful disposition she is actually quite the crybaby, which [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion) and Keiichi often tease her about. Satoko is also very close with [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika), who she lives with. ~!Although her personality is quite energetic and mischievous during the events of the games, Satoko's past was full of trauma; her parents died in an accident, she was abused by her foster parents (her aunt and uncle), and her beloved brother Satoshi disappeared. However, in M

characters.name: Keiichi Maebara
characters.description: Keiichi is the son of a famous and extremely wealthy artist and has recently moved to Hinamizawa after an array of unfortunate events in his hometown. His charismatic, lively attitude and talented tongue allow him to quickly fit in the town and make new friends and also win some club activities. Though he can be somewhat shy and is easily spooked at times. ~! In the first couple arcs, paranoia drives him to murder his friends and others, but in the other arcs, he gains inner strength and faith in his friends, enough to change the fate of Hinamizawa, sometimes by remembering the events of Onikakushi-hen.!~ When in need of a weapon, he wields Satoshi's old bat. Keiichi often receives the butt of the jokes in the club's activities from which he was the correct answer to some games they play, to wearing embarrassing costumes whenever he loses punishment games. Keiichi has brown hair with dar

characters.name: Hanyuu Furude
characters.description: Hanyuu is the mysterious "transfer student" in Matsuribayashi-hen. She has a pair of dark colored horns on her head, one of which is chipped slightly (however, no one seems to notice or mention them, with the exception of [Takano](https://anilist.co/character/4934/Takano-Miyo), who calls her a "monster"). In fact, she has appeared to [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) all her life, but only in Matsuribayashi-hen and Miotsukushi-hen did she gain the power to interact with others, posing as a distant relative of Rika's and given the name "Hanyuu Furude." Like many of the characters, she can be frightening when angered, and with her spirit-like nature, her appearance can change with her mood until she takes a physical form. She is very meek and often makes the noise "Au au, au au…" when she is nervous or uncomfortable, or sometimes while trying to make a point. She also t

characters.name: Miyo Takano
characters.description: Miyo is a nurse at the village clinic who has a keen interest in Hinamizawa's past and culture, recording all her speculation in notebooks. At times, her storytelling can be very mysterious and chilling—she seems to enjoy putting people on edge. ~!In the first six arcs, she consistently disappears on the night of Watanagashi, and an incinerated body thought to be hers is found in the mountains. Later, however, it turns out that she is the mastermind of the events taking place in Hinamizawa who wants to murder [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) so she can prove her grandfather's research. Since her will and manipulations are so strong as to affect the people in the village both directly and indirectly, she infact fakes her death through the first six arcs of the story (the corpse in the barrel being a stolen corpse), and murders Rika in three of the arcs which she uses

characters.name: Rumiko Chie
characters.description: Rumiko is the female teacher of Keiichi's class, who is a parody character of Tsukihime's Ciel-Senpai (permission for her usage was given by Type-Moon). The seiyū for her character in the anime series is the same as the seiyū of Ciel from the Tsukihime anime. Going along with the parody, her favorite food is curry rice, just like Ciel, and will go to great and somewhat scary, lengths to uphold the honor of curry, which is shown in the Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei OVA, where she becomes enraged by Keichi's "offense" to curry. On a stronger note, she is seen wielding wooden T's, shapped, and held, in exactly the same fashion as the Black Keys from Tsukihime.

characters.name: Jirou Tomitake
characters.description: A photographer who frequently visits the village of Hinamizawa (especially during the Watangashi Festival). ~!In every arc, he ends up being the killed victim of Oyashiro-sama's curses on the night of the Festival. During the Festival, he is still alive and looking happy but his manner of death shows that he tore at his own throat with his own fingers. The baffled police autopsies seemingly results with his body having no trace of drugs having been injected to cause him to do such an act of madness. He also has a good partnership with Takano Miyo (who is also a 'victim' of the yearly curses). It is revealed in Kai that he has affections for Takano and she plays along with his attraction for her. He falsely laughs when he tries to avoid a question or is told a foreboding prophecy about himself but looks willing to help Takano to discover the mystery of Oyashiro-sama's curses. !~ Not much

characters.name: Akane Sonozaki
characters.description: Daughter to [Oryou](https://anilist.co/character/9481/Sonozaki-Oryou) and mother to the Sonozaki sisters, she leads the Sonozaki family despite being disinherited for marrying an outsider.

title: Yuunagi Marbled
description: Collected high school girl doujinshi by Yuri manga artist Momomono Moto. (Source: Yuricon)

characters.name: Tachibana
characters.description: The new school nurse. Worked at Mishio's old school.

characters.name: Rika Oikawa
characters.description: The teacher Mishio was in love with and dated at her old school.

title: Ao Hada Kyonyuu to Kuso Bocchi
title_original: 青肌巨乳とクソボッチ
description: Lian is an apprentice angel who attends a high school for angels built in Heaven. Despite continuously working hard to become an archangel, she is unable to make friends and quickly became hated amongst her class. To put it simply, she is a loner. She has a natural enemy: the school idol who looks like a gal demon, Ruri. Although she is not academically competent, Ruri is beloved by everyone. One day, however, Lian suddenly decides to start teaching Ruri! Ruri told her "Let's start as friends," causing Lian to become confused as she previously hated her. This is the beginning of a friendship between a blue gal and a loner, a friendship that has until now been nonexistent, with the two enjoying every day of their youth!!! (Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Iberis no Hanayome
description: A wedding planner is just counting the days until her wedding, but she's just not feeling it. One night, she catches one of her clients, a bride to be, in a compromising and morally-compromising situation. And yet... there's just something alluring about this woman that catches her off guard.

characters.name: Mitsuki Kashiwai
characters.description: Wedding planner at Carmina Hotel Tokyo. She is about to get married to her live-in boyfriend.

characters.name: Nanami Tsuzuki
characters.description: A woman who came to check out the ballroom at Carmina Hotel Tokyo, where Mizuki works. She has a big appetite.

title: Kimi no Sei Nan Dakara, Sekinin Totte yo ne.
title_original: 君のせいなんだから、責任とってよね。
description: I'm an office lady, and a part-time rental girlfriend. I'm good at getting along with people and can do anything. I'm not particularly interested in romance right now, but I imagine I'll get married and have kids someday... Then I met Sui-chan, my first rental girlfriend client. At first, I was hesitant because we're the same sex and she's younger than me... but then I thought, wow, I'm good with women too!? (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Yurikon
description: Omnibus series about several lesbian marriages. Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title: Otome Game no Hametsu Flag shika Nai Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei shiteshimatta...: Girls Patch
title_original: 乙女ゲームの破滅フラグしかない悪役令嬢に転生してしまった… GIRLS PATCH
title_en: My Next Life as a Villainess Side Story: Girls Patch
description: Fans already love the romantic comedy franchise about Katarina Claes, a woman from Earth reborn into an otome game and determined to avoid her villainous end. Although she’s living in a game world full of male love interests, she also develops rich relationships with the women around her–and that’s exactly what this anthology is about. Enjoy these original manga stories about Katarina and her lovely ladies setting the boys aside to explore deeper relationships with each other. This book is a special gift to the fans of this series who dreamed of more love between the women! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Katarina Claes
characters.description: __Magic Type:__ Earth The main villain of the Fortune Lover game, however, after she recalls her previous life as a Japanese student, her personality underwent a massive change and she became much nicer and more humble. Game Description: The quintessential villainess. A selfish, spoiled princess type. Because [Prince Gerald](https://anilist.co/character/129134) injured her during childhood, they had gotten engaged. Because of this scar, she considered the prince to be hers, and bound him to her. In addition, she didn’t think highly of suddenly getting a stepbrother, and often bullied him.

characters.name: Mary Hunt
characters.description: __Magic Type:__ Water The 4th daughter of Marquis Hunt, a feeble and weak character in the otome game Fortune Lover who was supposed to have no contact with Katarina. Mary is Alan’s fiancee, and is also the rival character on his route. She’s a beauty with auburn hair and doll-like eyes. In the game settings, she didn’t think highly of Katarina Claes, and just like Alan, should have had almost no contact with Katarina, but she’s already one of her best friends now. (Source: Destruction Flag Otome Wikia)

characters.name: Sophia Ascart
characters.description: __Magic Type:__ Wind Sophia, Nicol's sister and rival for the path of Nicol. She is as beautiful as her brother and should not have been in contact with Katarina, but now she is her companion, and one of her best friends, like Mary.

characters.name: Maria Campbell
characters.description: __Magic Type:__ Light Maria Campbell was the main character of the game Fortune Lover. Maria worked hard and actively participated in household chores, never complained or said anything selfish, and desperately studied. When she entered magic school, her long years of hopes for magic school were immediately shattered when she learned she was the only commoner. What’s more, she was also bullied for the audacity of having magic powers despite only being a commoner.

characters.name: Gerald Stuart
characters.original: ジオルド・スティアート
characters.description: __Magic Type:__ Fire Gerald is the third prince of the country, and the capture target that is Katarina's fiance. Even though he looks like an orthodox blonde-haired, blue-eyed prince, Katarina thought otherwise that on the inside he’s actually an evil sadistic prince. However, even though Gerald in the game was supposed to be “not interested in Katarina at all, and almost never visited her, before she noticed, he would come over to her house once every three days. And, he even helps Katarina harvest the fruits and vegetables from the field, and would always bring her sweets as presents, and were completely friends now. They have a lot of contact. __Game Description:__ Gerald, though have a prince out of a fairy tale look but his personality was twisted and schemer. He is a genius who can do anything. He has no particular interests and is bored with his everyday life.

characters.name: Keith Claes
characters.description: __Magic Type:__ Earth Keith is the capture target that was adopted into the Claes family seven years ago for his powerful magic. He’s a handsome boy with flaxen hair and blue eyes, and since he was neglected by his stepmother and stepsister, had a lonely upbringing and became a playboy type character because of it. And when he entered school, his loneliness was supposed to be healed by the heroine and he would fall in love, but to prevent that from happening, Katarina has been pulling him out of his room every day. During this time, without Katarina having to pull him out anymore it turned out that they were always together. Game Description: The 3rd capturable character in the game Fortune Lover and the stepbrother of Katarina Claes. He was adopted from a branch family because of his huge magical powers. he is treated coldly by his stepsister and stepmother. As a reaction to this lack o

characters.name: Alan Stuart
characters.original: アラン・ステイア一 ト
characters.description: __Magic Type:__ Water Alan is the fourth prince of this country, and is Gerald’s younger twin brother as well as a capture target. He’s a beautiful prince with a wild streak, with silver hair and blue eyes, and he’s always being compared to Gerald, so he’s constantly in pain from feelings of inferiority, and it should have been set that he hates his brother, but Alan didn’t seem to be troubled by an inferiority complex or anything at all now, and it doesn’t seem like he hates Gerald either. Katarina didn't know she was the reason why the twins relationship has been reasonably good. Although Alan route Katarina didn’t appear as she wasn’t a rival, in the game she should have had hardly any contact with Alan but he would come to visit her almost every day, and his talent for music has completely bloomed so Katarina always receive invitations to his piano and violin concerts and would alway

characters.name: Nicol Ascart
characters.description: __Magic Type: Wind__ The fourth capturable character of the otome game Fortune Lover. He’s the taciturn, expressionless son of the prime minister, and also a capture target. With black hair and eyes, and a perfect doll-like face, he’s a handsome boy with a devilish charm that can even capture men as well as women with his unique atmosphere. Game Description: Nicole Ascarot, the prime minister’s son, Alan and Gerald’s childhood friend. He’s one year older than the heroine, and is a taciturn senpai type of character. (Source: Destruction Flag Otome Wikia)

characters.name: Anne Shelly
characters.description: Anne Sherry is Katarina Claes's personal maid, who has been in her service ever since she was 8 years old.

title: Lionhearts
description: As children, Shishimaru and Leo were inseparable. Shi-chan was so infatuated with Leo that he proposed to him! But as the years went by, they grew up and parted ways—until ten years later, when the two reunite. Have their feelings remained or have they been apart for too long? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Kaguya Hime
description: On Kabuchi-jima, an island ruled by Princess Kaguya, ten children were raised as sacrificial victims. Several of the children thought they had escaped their fate when they escaped the island. But nearly a decade later, the kids are still dying in the order and at the time they would have as sacrifices... Their only hope now is to reunite and return to the island to seek out and destroy the source--the legend, the blood-lusting Moon Princess--before time runs out.

characters.name: Akira Okada
characters.description: The main protagonist, Akira is a woman of androgynous beauty. She is dignified and strong-willed. While attending high school she was more popular with the girls than boys and was often mistaken for a man (for example: she won a magazine's bishounen contest that her classmates entered her in as a joke). As time passes, she flourishes into a young lady. When she was a baby, she was found in a bamboo thicket and taken in by the Kashiwagi family, but the couple divorced when she was three and Akira was abandoned to Kabuchi Island. At the age of five she was adopted by Shoko Okada, an artist who received child support to raise her. By junior high school Akira was forced into a homosexual relationship with her stepmother. To escape the situation with her adopted family, she decides to participate in Camp U.G. She is kidnapped from the camp and forced to assume her role as the donor of a Chine

characters.name: Yui Lindros
characters.description: Possesses superhuman abilities, such as superior eyesight and strength. He, Midori and Akira were particularly good friends during their childhood. Since their escape from Kabuchi island he has been known to suppresses his emotions and is weak in communicating with others. He is gentle but lonely, and gets anxious when separated from Midori. He returns to the island through Camp U.G. with them to break the island's curse and protect his two friends from harm.

characters.name: Midori Matsuzawa
characters.description: Donor for the 9th generation foremost Prince of Thailand. The age difference between he and his "true body" is 10 years. He has a a calm and kind personality and harbors strong feelings toward Akira. He also deeply cares for Yui but sees him as a romantic rival, often acting out coldly when he feels Yui's being extremely affectionate or overprotective. He is diagnosed with stomach cancer and is given the option of having an operation, but instead leaves for Camp U.G. despite his weak medical condition.

characters.name: Mayu Okada
characters.description: Daughter of Shoko Okada and Akira's classmate. She is very possessive of Akira, and doesn't let men or women near her. She has a sweet appearance but will do anything to get her way, such as pretending to be sick and fainting on the spot to get attention.

characters.name: Satton
characters.description: Donor for NBA star player Don Bellamy. He also wanted to become a basketball player like his "true body." He has strong leadership skills and becomes leader of Camp U.G. during their stay (despite Kaede's rejection of the idea). He courted Akira along with the other Donors until realizing his strong feelings toward Miller.

characters.name: Brett Miller
characters.description: Donor for Julian, a blood relative of the British Royal Family. He was used for a kidney transplant at the age of 5. He is a famous Hollywood actor known for his gorgeous looks, but his personality is inconsiderate and rough. He gets upset when he is mistaken for a lady (which happens often) and a director was hospitalized after being assaulted by him in the past. Because of his failing eyesight he had to quit the acting business and cut all ties with his agents before leaving for Camp U.G. His goal was to receive an eyeball transplant and live as Julian.

characters.name: Kaede
characters.description: Donor of Kim Seok-Yong, son of a Korean Nobel Prize recipient. Twin of Katsura. Obstinate and childish, and seemingly aware of these personality flaws. Participated in Camp U.G. in hopes of winning the money to repay a failed business debt.

characters.name: Satoshi Oda
characters.description: Donor of Hiroki Rushton, son of an American Congressman of Japanese descent. Was adopted by a loving Japanese family and did well in school, but killed a classmate just before leaving for Camp U.G. He is quick on comebacks and develops intelligent schemes to get what he wants.

characters.name: Mamoru
characters.description: Donor of Yuri Babanin, a high-ranking member of the Russian mafia. Mamoru is wanted by the law for cheating and stealing, and wishes to have a fresh start at life through Camp U.G. Because of his nearsightedness he kept a distance from people and never took the time to properly take notice of them.

characters.name: Katsura
characters.description: Donor of Kim Seok-Yong, son of a Korean Nobel Prize recipient. Twin of Kaede. Steady in character and keeps Kaede out of trouble.

characters.name: Kourikishi
characters.description: Princess Gyokurei's loyal bodyguard. His family has served the Li family for generations.

characters.name: Maggie McGovern
characters.description: Instructor for pilot trainees at the US Military base.

characters.name: Shunran Kei
characters.description: Princess Gyokurei's servant who harbors romantic feelings for her.

title: K-On! Anthology Comic
title_original: けいおん! アンソロジーコミック
description: An anthology comic of K-On! by various mangaka. Volume 1 (2009/11/27) #Cover illustration: Kokonoka (front), Hoppege (back) #Opening page illustration: Iwami Shoko #Color illustrations: Sou, Marimo, Shiba Yuusuke, Toto Nemigi, Murata Taichi, Kanikamo #Cover 4-koma: Toto Nemigi 1. (りつみお!のどか？) [Sakura Hanpen] 5.Tsumugi Biyori (つむぎ日和, Tsumugi's Nice Day) [Bakutendou] 6. We Are Crazy (We are crazy) [Hoppege] 7. Sawanodo! (さわのど!) [Suzushiro Seri] 8. W-box (W-box) [Lisalisa (リサリサ)] 9. Yume no Scout Daisakusen (夢のスカウト大作戦, Operation Dream Scouting) [Araki Fuu] 10. K-On! (けいおん!) [Shigatake (シガタケ)] 11.
