Upon entering university, she ends up sharing a room with Ichinose Yui, the daughter of her father’s friend and a third-year student at the same university. However, once they start living together, she learns a shocking truth: Yui is a lesbian, and is known for being a notorious womanizer. This is a university roommate story about a straight junior who is seduced by a beautiful, lesbian senior.

title: Koi no Zetsubou Koushinkyoku
description: "Hey, wanna try going out with me?" Rei has feelings for Ami, a girl in her class who's always been kind to her. So when she confesses to Ami, she fully expects to get turned down... until Ami says she likes her back! But now that they're officially a couple, Ami seems a little off. While Rei is head over heels for her, Ami is a player who isn't even sure how to love just one person. Rei is crushed by Ami's seemingly careless approach to their relationship, but even so, she won't give up. Will Rei's earnest but cumbersome feelings for Ami win out in the end? Or is the girl she loves simply too far out of reach? (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Takumi Musashino
characters.description: Takumi suffers from a terminal illness, agrees to try an experimental gene therapy and is changed into a girl.

title: Nyanko Days
description: It's an everyday life of a shy girl called Tomoko Konagai and three "cats" Maa, Roo, Shii. These cats are girls with cats' ears and can speak human language. Note: Includes 1 bonus chapter.

characters.name: Ro
characters.description: One of Yuko's cats. She is a level headed Russian Blue.

characters.name: Maa
characters.description: One of Yuko's cats. She is a mischievous Munchkin who loves to explore.

characters.name: Yuuko Konagai
characters.description: A fifteen-year-old girl who is shy by nature and has 3 cats (Maa, Shii and Ro).

characters.name: Shii
characters.description: One of Yuko's cats. She is a laid back Singapura cat. She is very shy and sweet, but can also be a bit of a crybaby.

characters.name: Azumi Shiratori
characters.description: Yuko's friend/classmate and a popular girl in their class. She is from a rich family and has a cat named Elza.

characters.name: Ran Iketani
characters.description: A gyaru-ish girl and Azumi's self-proclaimed rival, who often challenges her, and has a fear of cats.

characters.name: Elza
characters.description: Azumi's Turkish Angora cat.

characters.name: Iroha Sasase
characters.description: Yuuko's childhood friend.

characters.name: Nana
characters.description: An ex-stray cat who's a bit airheaded

title: Sugar Meets Girl!
title_original: しゅがー・みーつ・がーる！
description: Kanna is the daughter of the head of the gang, who is friendly and a little bit mischievous in appearance. And Miyako is the class president and the most popular girl in the school, the envy of everyone. What are the unexpected secrets that these two have discovered about each other? A sweet and juicy girls' comedy! (Source: Comic Fuz, translated)

title: Mahou Shoujo Madoka★Magica: Anthology Comic
title_original: 魔法少女まどか★マギカ アンソロジーコミック
description: The girls of the popular seinen magical girl series are reimagined in different scenarios across all sorts of genres by various mangaka.

characters.name: Madoka Kaname
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") A 14-year-old girl whose life changes when she encounters the [Puella Magi Homura](https://anilist.co/character/38005/Akemi-Homura) and the familiar [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), who offers to transform her into a Puella Magi herself. She sees herself as a person without special qualities or talents, and after seeing [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) fighting against witches, wants to be a wonderful and cool Puella Magi like her. She is a rather selfless girl who wishes to be a magical girl simply so that she can help others. She allegedly has a large amount of magical potential within her.

characters.name: Homura Akemi
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 - 158 cm Homura is a magical girl who first appears in an apocalyptic nightmare of [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832). She transfers into her school the day after the dream. She is a beautiful, mysterious individual that performs exceptionally well in academics and athletics. This makes her instantly popular even though she is cold to others. She seems to know Madoka well and wishes to prevent her from becoming a magical girl. She attacks [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566) in the first episode, only to be stopped by [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194).

characters.name: Sayaka Miki
characters.description: __Height:__ 158-160 cm __Weapon:__ Cutlass [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832/Kaname-Madoka) classmate who, after helping Madoka rescue [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), ends up getting an offer to become a Puella Magi herself. She cares deeply for her friends, and wants to help an ill boy named [Kyousuke Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/39835/Kamijou-Kyousuke), whom she has a crush on. Before becoming a Puella Magi, Sayaka wields a baseball bat that [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) can enhance with magic to defend herself with while on witch hunts.

characters.name: Kyuubey
characters.description: Kyuubey is a familiar who can grant any wish to a certain girl, on the condition that she becomes a Puella Magi and fights against witches.

characters.name: Junko Kaname
characters.description: Junko is Madoka's mother. She's a successful business woman. She often goes out drinking with friends and co-workers, and comes home from a long day of work drunk. She's also friends with Madoka's homeroom teacher. She and Madoka are close, and she cares for her daughter very much, but ultimately lets her go when she tells her there's something she has to do on Walpurgis Nacht.

characters.name: Kazuko Saotome
characters.description: __Height:__ 155-157 cm Kazuko is Madoka's class teacher. Her relationships with guys don't last very long, and so she's extremely frustrated in these regards. Many of her classes involve her complaining about men. She also seems to be a friend of Junko Kaname, Madoka's mother.

characters.name: Kyouko Sakura
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-158 cm __Weapon:__ Spear Kyouko is a veteran magical girl who comes to the city later in the story. Amusingly, she is always seen eating something, even while she is battling. Having grown up in a poor family, she often has to steal food and hates people who waste it, a logic she also applies to Grief Seeds, as she only goes after fully grown witches. Kyouko has been a Puella Magi much longer than the others, and thus is more skillful; she wields a spear which can extend itself, split into multiple sections, and produce a ball at the end of a chain, which can constrict and hit others at the same time. She also has the ability to put up barriers to protect others or keep them from interfering. She initially clashes with Sayaka, but after learning the truth about Soul Gems, she sympathizes with her and tries to help her.

characters.name: Mami Tomoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-159 cm Mami Tomoe is a veteran magical girl and a third-year student at Madoka's school. She lives alone in a penthouse after her parents were killed in a car crash, which Mami survived after contracting with Kyuubey. Mami is particularly focused on saving, guiding, and protecting those around her, which is a traditionally selfless perspective on the role of magical girl. She is much like a maternal figure to Madoka and Sayaka, being the eldest among them. Her name could be considered a play on the word 'mommy', further supported in the third film, where she has a companion named "Bebe". Though Mami's outward disposition is cheery and confident, Mami feels deeply alone as she has no friends to confide in as she fights.

title: Philia to Eros no Aida
title_original: ピリアーとエロスのあいだ
description: Is it alright to not give up on these feelings...?

title: Salieri and Mozart
description: ... There is a girl, whose dream was to swim, but couldn't win with just her talent alone even if her life was on the line. There is another girl, who started swimming because her life wasn't fun, but then ended up showing genuine promise, even though swimming was just a joke to her. Like this, the two of them met each other, forming the worst relationship, akin to water and oil, the modern version of Mozart and Salieri, leading to the romance of dreams and youth. (Source: Bomtoon, translated).

title: Mikoto to Rei
description: Mikoto, the free-spirited gal, and Rei, the serious student council member. Rei is completely at the mercy of the free-spirited Mikoto…!? But it seems like she doesn’t mind it all that much. Take a peek into the cute—and slightly naughty—daily lives of these two? (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Hatsukoi Shimai
description: During a fateful visit to Tsunojo Girls' School, Chika Matsuzato meets the girl of her dreams--cool upperclassman Haruna Kizaki. Even though they spent only one short day together, Chika will never forget Haruna's kindness, and has made it her life's goal to study hard and get accepted into Tsunojo Girls' School so that they can be together. But will Haruna share Chika’s feelings...? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Touko Hiiragi
characters.description: The suave sensei who brought Chika and Haruna together who always finds time in her day to flirt with Akiho.

title: Destro 246
description: Billionaire Tono Ryuichi, the President of Tono Foods Group, a giant food company, recently acquired two young female assassins from the Mexican cartel. Sui and Ai came from unimaginably poor childhoods and was given a choice between killing people or selling their body. They chose the former and went through an inconceivably extreme training and, at 17 years old, they have become one of the deadliest assassins in the world. They are absolutely obedient to their master and they are given the task of finding the killer that poisoned Ryuichi’s wife and child. They begin attending high school to blend into society and, at the same time, read and study which helps them become even more deadlier on the field. Sui and Ai encounter Matoba Imari who is a high school assassin herself and may be more skilled than both of them. But unlike the two, Imari just wants to lead a normal life. Whatever Imari wishes for her life is not their problem because the only thing Sui and Ai feeds on are bloodthirst and a challenge. (Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Ohime-sama no Ohime-sama
description: Heidi Nanzan dreams of meeting the perfect girl. So she comes to the girls school with one goal, to be a princess for her princess. At Choyuri Gakuen, it's girls as far as the eye can see. A no-boys-allowed yuri comedy! (Source: Manga Cross, translated)

title: Joahaeyo, Seonsaengnim
description: Seon-Min seems like an ordinary college student, but behind closed doors, she lives a secret life as her professor's plaything. When Yu-Jin, the student she tutors, discovers her darkest secret, everything begins to fall apart. Seon-Min's campus life begins to unravel, plunging her once-stable existence into chaos. (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Heroine toka Yoku Wakannai kara, Akuyaku Reijou to Nigemasu.
title_original: ヒロインとかよくわかんないから、悪役令嬢と逃げます。
description: I should be dead but I'm lost in a world that's like an otome game!? The prince proposed to me, but the person I like is...! Note: First published in 'Nobody Told Me My Reincarnation Would Have a Condemnation Start! Anthology Comic' , re-edited and separately released as a one-shot.

title: Cider to Nakimushi.
description: A collection of short doujin stories by Canno. All slightly romantic, with open endings. 1. Hanamaru Happy End 2. Hikkyou Dead End 3. Hirahira Hiraku Himitsu no Tobira 4. Youkoso! Occult Kenkyuukai (Welcome to Occult Research Club) 5. Cinderella 6. Tada Haru wo Matsu 7. Natsu ga Owaru 8. Take ni Tora

title: Ichikoe, Nifuri, Tachiaoi
title_original: いちこえ、にふり、タチアオイ
description: Kataoka Aoi is a cram school teacher whose attractive face and demeanor has attracted attention from others since an early age. So much so that she tries to live an inconspicuous life in order to avoid unwanted drama. One day, she (reluctantly) accepts the principal’s request to appear in their school’s commercial. But it quickly goes viral, resulting in her becoming recognized in the school and out in public, drawing attention wherever she goes. Amidst the attention, the quirky girl Yamada, a clerk in the school's stationery shop, approaches her… (Source: GOTcorporation, translated)

title: Chou Kaguya-hime!
description: In a world just a little further in the future, one night, Iroha, a caring and highly skilled high school girl, picks up Kaguya, a princess from the moon. At Kaguya's invitation, the energetic and unconventional, the two decide to become live streamers (liver) in the virtual world "Tsukuyomi." As the girls deepen their bond through music, their destinies begin to unfold. This is the story of "Princess Kaguya" as no one has ever seen it before. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

characters.name: Kaguya
characters.description: A mysterious girl from the Moon. Looking for fun, she decided to become a livestreamer in Tsukuyomi. She's energetic, outrageous and loves [Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/378972/Sakayori-Iroha).

characters.name: Iroha Sakayori
characters.description: A 17-year-old high school girl. A model student who excelles in both academics and sports. She works hard to pay her living expenses and tutition fees. She's a fan of [Yachiyo](https://anilist.co/character/378973/Runami-Yachiyo), Tsukuyomi's top livestreamer. She's also a talented musician, but doesn't compose anymore.

characters.name: Yachiyo Runami
characters.description: The top livestreamer of the virtual world "Tsukuyomi." A mysterious 8,000-year-old (allegedly) AI who can sing, dance, and even create clones.

title: Cheongjun Yeonswae
description: Jia is an average girl who, along with the majority of her classmates, has fallen head over heels for Yoona, a girl so pretty she's practically the school's idol. They're on two totally different levels, but Jia can ignore her feelings no longer! But who is Yoona, really? Stay tuned to see what romance unfolds between these two! (Source: Lezhin US)

title: By my side
description: Five stories of people and flowers. (Source: Pixiv, translated) Note: First published at COMITIA 128.

title: Shimaism
description: Haruka (14) and Sakura (12) are sisters. Yoshiko (14) and Mai (12) are sisters as well. So what happens when best friends Haruka and Yoshiko have an attraction to each others sisters of the Yuri kind?

title: Xi Yin Li Fa Ze
description: Nan Zhi's day life life is riddled with success and admiration. After work hours, however, her search for a romantic connection of any kind runs rampant. Bored by every encounter she's had, the entertainment company CEO is shocked when a one-night stand imprints itself on her mind. And she's even more shocked when she learns the subject of her infatuation is her best friend's younger sister. (Source: Tapas)

title: Fenhong Duandai
description: When lolita fashion obsessed Loumiao ran into the petite Yu Xuan at the school festival, she wished she could dress Yu Xuan up in her favorite lolita-style clothes. Even though Yu Xuan already liked someone else, Loumiao still schemed to get her to wear the lolita costumes. But when she saw Yu Xuan put on those clothes, Loumiao realized her feelings aren't just about dress-up anymore... (Source: Tongli, translated) Note: Winner of the 10th Golden Comic award in the Best Shoujo and Manga Of The Year categories.

title: Nyahan Namja
description: What if your dream date turns out to be a…cat? Such is the dilemma for Bonnie, a young woman who wanted love and ended up with Claude, a highly needy half-man-half-cat instead. Will they be able to make it work? Is sharing the litterbox going to be a huge problem? And what ARE her friends going to think? Read Meow Man to see how this big ball of yarn unfurls. (Source: WEBTOON) Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

title: Tensei Shitara Akari dake ga Slime Datta Ken
title_original: 転生したらあかりだけスライムだった件
description: The Amusement Club gets transported to another world... and Akari turns into a slime. Notes: - Chapters 13 to 15 and 17 to 20 were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases. - Includes nine extra chapters.

characters.name: Kyouko Toshinou
characters.description: Toshinou Kyouko is the founder of the amusement club. Goes so wild that no one can keep up with her, but it's not as if anyone even tries in the first place, so it's ultimately no big deal. She is actually an otaku who creates her own doujinshi of Mirakurun, an anime character in Yuru Yuri. Her favorite ice cream is rum raisin.

characters.name: Akari Akaza
characters.description: Akari is a polite red-haired girl who is supposedly the main protagonist of the series. However, due to her rather small presence and plain personality, she is often forgotten about or pushed into the background. She is often thought of as having the ability to fire her hair dumplings and turn invisible whilst shouting "Akkari~n!". [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) and [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/35874) are her childhood friends, while [Chinatsu](https://anilist.co/character/35875), [Sakurako](https://anilist.co/character/35878) and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879) are her classmates.

characters.name: Yui Funami
characters.description: A cool-headed girl who often acts as the voice of reason, usually when it comes to keeping [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) in check. She is a reliable friend and usually lives alone in an apartment complex, but actually feels lonely without anyone else around. Although generally quiet, she will sometimes burst into laughter upon hearing [Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/35876)'s puns. She likes playing video games.

characters.name: Chinatsu Yoshikawa
characters.description: Akari's pink haired classmate who originally wanted to join the Tea Ceremony Club, but ended up joining the Amusement Club as the Tea Ceremony Club was already abolished. She is often chased after by Kyōko due to her resemblance to Mirakurun, though she herself has a passionate crush on Yui. She generally acts cute, especially in the presence of Yui, but she occasionally shows dark thoughts and a terrifying lack of artistic skills.

title: Outro
description: Her girlfriend, who she's been dating for seven years, is wallowing in bed with another girl, and her dream of debut has been shattered, so she doesn't have many expectations anymore. Suddenly, ray of hope appears in front of Ji-an; she receives an offer to appear in a program that highly appreciates Jian's self-composed song. Jian is excited about the opportunity to escape from her lover Yoo Won...

title: Line
description: Normal. Carefree. That was Chiko's life before the day she found the cell phone. Before the voice on the other end said she had scant minutes to save the life of someone she'd never met. Now, accompanied by her classmate, Bando, Chiko has just one night to stop a series of gruesome suicides before they can occur.

characters.name: Chiko
characters.description: "I want to live! Doesn't everyone feel the same way?" Pretty, Popular and just looking to have a good time with her friends... that's all Chiko wants... she has no idea that her life is about to change in such a significant way in only one night. "but they've chosen someone to be their last hope.... you"

title: Blue
description: Anna entered the same high school as the person she loved. But that person is in fact her cousin, Reiji. While continuing to conceal her feelings for him, she begins to suspect that Reiji is love with Rui, her best friend. But what is Rui's real secret?...

title: Astral Online: Maou no Noroi de Saikyou Bishoujo ni Natta Ore, Saijaku Shoku da ga Cheat Skill de Chou Seichou Shite Musou Suru
title_original: アストラル・オンライン 魔王の呪いで最強美少女になったオレ、最弱職だがチートスキルで超成長して無双する

title: Nakatani Nio Tanpenshuu: Sayonara Alter
title_original: 仲谷鳰短編集 さよならオルタ
description: Nio Nakatani, known for her delicate and heartwarming portrayal of girls’ love, presents a marvelous collection of short stories that span her whole career. With works including her striking debut title Farewell to My Alter, enthralling tales from the Éclair anthologies, and a hauntingly captivating piece penned exclusively for this volume, Nakatani explores the deeper nuances of loss, identity, and matters of the heart. (Source: Yen Press) 1. Sayonara Alter (さよならオルタ, Farewell to my Alter) 2. Yuusha wa San-kai Sekai wo Sukuu (勇者は三回世界を救, The Hero Saves the World Three Times) 3. Namida Fuumi Escargot (なみだ風味エスカルゴ, Tear-Flavored Escargot) 4. Shiawase wa Kizu no Katachi (幸せは傷のかたち, Happiness in the Shape of a Scar) 5. Itsu datte Yokogao (いつだって横顔, Always in Profile) 6. Komimication (こみみけーしょん, Comm-ear-ication) 7. Watashi Custom Maid (わたしカスタムメイド, I Am Custom-Made) 8. Double Bed (ダブルベッド) 9. Yasashiku Naritai (優しくなりたい, I Want to Be Kind)

title: Yoru wo Tomenaide
description: 1. Yoru wo Tomenaide (夜をとめないで, Don't Stop the Night); Rakuen Le Paradis Vol. 11 2. Karisome no Hana (仮初めの花, Transient Flower); Rakuen Le Paradis Vol. 12 3. Hakanagoto (はかなごと, Fleeting Things); Rakuen Le Paradis Vol. 13 4. Tayuta (たゆた, Fluttering); Rakuen Le Paradis Vol. 14 5. Shampoo Rinse Conditioner (ジャンプーリンスコンディションアー); Rakuen Le Paradis Vol. 15 6. Shiroi Himitsu (白い秘密, White Secret); Rakuen Le Paradis Vol. 16 7. Hakanagoto: Bonus track (はかなごと Bonus track, Fleeting Things Bonus track); kakioroshi 8. Yoru wo Tomenaide: Bonus track (夜をとめないで Bonus track, Don't Stop the Night Bonus track); kakioroshi

title: Majo no Yaen
description: A young lesbian couple ventures into a love hotel to perform an erotic ritual of black magic.

title: Seonuiui Gyeongjaeng
description: Seulgi was no.1 in her old suburban school. Now, having transferred to the prestigious Chaehwa Girls’ High in Seoul, she must engage in fierce, friendly competition with her rich and talented rival Jay. (Source: YLAB) Note: - Belongs to Blue String universe. - includes one extra chapter.

characters.name: Yeong-Su Yu
characters.description: Je-I's father.

title: Nakcha
description: When lifelong criminal Seung-Ji finds herself betrayed by her old boss, she joins an upstart smuggling business to lay low. Her goal is to find the opening to take advantage of the business to score cash and flee the city, but a wrench by the name of Yeong-Won is thrown into her plans. Inexperienced and naive, Yeong-Won is working in her aunt’s stead as Seung-Ji’s superior. Falling in love is a luxury for people in their line of work, but Seung-Ji’s desire for financial gain might be changing into a desire for something that she can’t afford... (Source: Tappytoon)

title: Anne Happy♪
description: At Tennomifune Academy, students with "negative karma"-the kids who are practically weighed down by misfortune-are all collected into one place: Class 1-7. On the first day of school, Ruri Hibarigaoka (Hibari) meets fellow 1-7 classmates Anne Hanakoizumi (Hanako), a girl up to her ears in bad luck, and the all-too-frail Botan Kumegawa (...Botan). These fast friends just want to have a fun high school life, but are they pushing their luck...?! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

characters.name: An Hanakoizumi
characters.description: She's a trouble maker who has bad luck in every aspect of her life. Despite this, she doesn't seem to worry and is very positive. Although she loves animals, they hate her. The only thing she worries about is her lack of breasts.

characters.name: Botan Kumegawa
characters.description: Has an unusually weak constitution, to the point that her bones in her fingers will crack from only shaking hands. As the daughter of a doctor, she is very familiar with medicine. Because she gets injured so much, she is like a one-woman life-saving hospital ward who treats herself on a daily basis. Although she is a gentle princess type person who smiles a lot, she is very negative when it comes to herself.

characters.name: Hibiki Hagyuu
characters.description: She has such a terrible sense of direction that it takes her three hours to commute to school alone. She loves her childhood friend, Ren, as her "Number 1." Because of her unyielding personality, she can't admit that she has no sense of direction. Additionally, she becomes very hostile toward every female who approaches Ren.

characters.name: Ren Ekoda
characters.description: She's a girl, but she has a troubling condition where females of any species are indiscriminately attracted to her. She plays the "straight man" to her childhood friend Hibiki. She always has very little energy and finds most things bothersome. If given the chance, she will take a nap.

characters.name: Ruri Hibarigaoka
characters.description: Her caring and good personality gets her caught up in many unhappy encounters with those who drag her into calamities. She has been attracted to a "certain person" to no avail for a long time. Because both of her parents are currently on assignment abroad, she's living alone. She is very good at cooking.

characters.name: Kodaira
characters.description: The homeroom teacher of Class 1-7, the happiness class.

title: Kawaii Anata
description: A collection of short stories. Each story ranges from unrequited love to curious relationships to love fulfilled. 1. Maple Love Two college students become friends, but one of them has fallen for the other.. 2. Love Letter A girl asks her friend to give a love letter to a boy for her. Too bad she has no idea her friend is in love with her... 3. Cycling Under a Starlit Sky 4. Kawaii Anata (Your Cuteness) This is about a boyish girl who doesn't think she's cute, and her love interest, who does. 5. Winter-tinged Thoughts Shizuru is in love with Matsuri, who in turn is in love with Aya. Oh, dear. 6. A Lunch Made with Love Retells some of the events of "Winter-Tinged Thoughts" from Izumi (Shizuru's best friend)'s point of view.

characters.name: Maria Fujishiro
characters.description: Maria is a very boyish-looking high school student. Due to her looks, she is often typecasted by her classmates, and is immediately slated to play the prince in the class production of the Grimm fairy tale "Maid Maleen" for the cultural festival. Maria is unable to decline due to her penchant to just go along with things to please people, however she does not want to be the main character and definitely does not like the fact that because of her facial features and tallness, she is not considered to be a girl. She is inwardly tormented by memories of growing up where she was picked on for looking less like a girl. She even overhears some schoolmates saying that she looks like a "fag" because of her pretty boy looks, and ends up crying in the library. Maria is very shy and sensitive, though the only person who comes to see that is her classmate and the girl who plays t

characters.name: Kaede Satonaka
characters.description: Kaede is a university student whose main concern is getting something to eat. She is a sophomore History major. She is collected, mature, unperturbed by many things and has a deadpan nature, though she also is rather scrappy and does not care about things like other people's social lives, gossip or her appearance. She enjoys bumming around, and likes to sleep on the grass on campus grounds. She meets Miyaji Erika while doing this. She finds the other woman to be cute, but slaps Erika when she spontaneously kisses Kaede on the lips. However, Kaede does not seem upset about it, and just thinks that someone who does things like that without people's permission deserves a good smacking around. By spending more and more time with Erika, who actively begins pursuing her, Kaeda becomes rather taken with the other woman. She is vaguely aware that she might be falling for Erika, but she

characters.name: Erika Miyaji
characters.description: Erika is a rather cute girl who catches the fancy of most boys in her university. However, she turns them all down because she says, very bluntly, that she only likes other girls. She finds Kaede after catching the other woman accidentally overhearing a confession she was rejecting. After lightly flirting with her, Erika kisses Kaede only to get slapped in the face. However, it seems this action causes her to become quite smitten with Kaede rather than disheartened. She begins a friendship with the other girl though is very dogged in pursuing her. Erika enjoys taking photos. She always carries a camera around with her and likes taking Kaede's picture a lot, though tells the other girl that she is not photogenic at all. She keeps her pictures as a visual diary of sorts and only takes her camera with her to places she likes and only snaps people she likes. She is the subject of a lot

characters.name: Izumi
characters.description: Izumi is a rather eccentric though simple girl. She does not find her lifestyle to be strange, but to the average person, she is rather odd. She calls her mother by her first name, she eats vending machine lunches most of the time, and does not really have any cares or problems. She loves spending her lunch times with her best friend Shizuka, who sometimes gives her some home-made food so Izumi's diet is not so unhealthy. She cares for her best friend a lot, and notices one day that Shizuka is not herself (unbeknownst to her, Shizuka had her heart broken by unrequited love for an upperclassman in her club). Izumi fries her brain over ways to cheer her friend up, and decides to make her a lunch filled with love so she can be happy again; the lunch turns out to be a mostly inedible tasteless disaster made with frozen food, but Izuki is glad to see that Shizuka is willing to eat it. Sh

characters.name: Matsuri
characters.description: Despite her looks (pierced up ears, messy hair, tall stature and grouchy facial features), Matsuri is a rather nice person who befriends Shizuka despite scaring her on their first meeting with her gruffness. She is a member of the crafts club, much to people's surprise. She is rather careless about her emotions and has a severe crush on her upperclassman, Aya. She often drags Shizuka along with her to meet Aya and so has an excuse to spend time with the senior. She is at a loss because she wants to confess to Aya since she will be graduating soon. Matsuri eventually tells Aya her feelings, only for Aya to tell her that she's a cute underclassman and that she does not see her as anything more. She ends up crying and Shizuka comes to her side to comfort her. She has no idea that Shizuka is in love with her until the younger girl confesses to her. Matsuri wonders why would someone

characters.name: Shizuka
characters.description: Shizuka is the shy, quiet type girl. She is small, has light, fluffy hair and wears glasses. She joins the crafts club in high school and there meets Matsuri, an upperclassman who she at first thinks is a little scary but eventually warms up to. Slowly, Shizuka finds herself falling for Matsuri but she recognises that her love is one-sided and that Matsuri herself has a thing for another senior in their club: Aya. Shizuka is very supportive, in an almost self-destructive way, silently having her heart broken but being there for Matsuri when she needs the younger girl. She even goes out of her way to wait around with Matsuri after school just to catch a glimpse of Aya. She also nurses Matsuri's broken heart after hearing that she confessed to Aya but got turned down. She loses confidence in herself especially because she thinks Aya is a wonderful person and a nice, caring, pretty upp

characters.name: Yuuka
characters.description: She is a tall, sporty girl who is the manager of her school's football (soccer) team. She is known among her friends for being a big football fan as well. Yuuka harbours deep feelings for her long time friend Miwa. She tells Miwa that she loves her, though Miwa thinks that she is joking. She harbours her unrequited feelings quietly and is heartbroken when she figures out that her best friend is in love with a guy from the school's football team. She hates herself for loving Miwa so much that she is the link between her and Misumi (the one Miwa likes). Miwa gives her a love letter to pass on to Misumi and Yuuka can only stare at it and get angry before she decides what she wants to do with it. Yuuka tried everything she could to subtly get Miwa to love her back, even cutting off her hair in the style that Misumi wears his own hair, but it seems that her love will forever be one-

characters.name: Misumi
characters.description: He is a member of the school's football team. He is generally cheerful though not much else is known about him. Miwa has a huge crush on him and he seems willing to date her as well, after he gets a love letter from her that was passed on by Yuuka. Misumi does not realise at all that Yuuka is a little embittered towards him and tried to emulate him to please Miwa. [This character appears in the chapter "Love Letter".]

characters.name: Miwa
characters.description: Miwa is a shy girl who cannot hide her feelings very well. She brushes off whenever her best friend Yuuka says "I love you" to her since she thinks Yuuka is teasing her. She and Yuuka have been friends for a long time, and she even is close to Yuuka's mother, running errands for her such as carrying lunch for Yuuka on days the school football team has practice. Miwa affectionately calls Yuuka "Yuu-chan" though she is extremely unaware of her best friend's love for her and especially does not realise how much pain she is causing her when she asks Yuuka to deliver her love letter to the object of her affections, Misumi.

characters.name: Akane Shibasaki
characters.description: Akane is a beautiful, princess-like girl with a very self-assured though cold attitude. She does not see the need in getting along with the rest of her classmates and so just says whatever is on her mind. She says it herself, that she is only considerate to people she likes. She begins speaking to and spending time with the boyish-looking Maria as they are slated to play the prince and princess in a class play. Akane openly elects herself for the role of the princess. The class begrudgingly lets her since she has the perfect aura and looks to be a delicate princess, however they do not like her. She knows that people are not fond of her, but she does not seem to care and only pays attention to Maria. Akane constantly tells Maria that she finds her to be cute, despite Maria's denial. She harbours feelings for Maria and seems surprised that the taller girl does not notice that the rea

characters.name: Shinohara
characters.description: One of the students in Maria and Akane's class. She is in charge of making the costumes and follows Maria around the school sometimes. She is very taken with the idea of Maria being the "perfect prince", so when Akane asks Maria if she'd like to try on the princess' dress, Shino gets annoyed and says (rather tactlessly) that Maria could never pull of wearing a dress and should not bother. Akane calmly tells Shino that she is insensitive and people like her are better off dead. Shinohara hates Akane with a passion, but puts up with her because she is the lead character in the school play. Despite Maria's attempts to convince her that Akane is a nice person, Shino is very determined to remain Akane's enemy. [This character appears in the chapter "Kawaii Anata".]

characters.name: Kaede's Friend
characters.description: Kaede's classmate and close friend at university. She is often there to give Kaede advice (which the latter does not take). She is wary of Kaede's new friendship with the rumoured maneater Erika, but learns through Kaede that most of that is just rumours and slander. She is pretty surprised at Kaede's nonchalant attitude after getting kissed by another girl, but chalks it up to her friend's strangeness and so does not bother with telling Kaede anything about it. She often gets exasperated with Kaede's bluntness, crassness, and obliviousness. She especially finds it frustrated that her friend mostly only cares about getting a next free meal rather than looking good and dating. She is the one who inadvertently allows Kaede to realise that her feelings for Erika might be love. The only interaction she really has with Erika is when she comes to hang around Kaede in school, and when she asks

characters.name: Shimako
characters.description: Izumi's mother. She is a writer and has a very estranged relationship with her daughter who she treats more like a peer rather than a child. Shimako does not mind that Izumi calls her by her first name, and they have a rather close bond. Izumi comes to her often for advice. She laments that Izumi is just as bad in the kitchen as she is, and so they resort to buying their food pre-cooked and are both masters of the microwave dinner. Shimako thinks her daughter is an idiot. Despite this, she cares for her very much and lets her do what she whatever she wants. [This character appears in the chapter "A Lunch Made with Love".]

characters.name: Aya
characters.description: Aya is a third year high school student who is the most prolific member of the school's crafts club. She is gentle and rather kind, and does not realise that her gentility and friendliness might cause people pain. She does not seem aware of Matsuri's feelings for her. Aya is very friendly to Shizuka and affectionately calls her "Shii-chan". She turns down Matsuri's confession, telling the younger girl that she sees her as a cute underclassman with whom she is friends and does not see her as anything more.

title: Gyaru to Nekura no Kyuuketsu Kankei
title_original: ギャルとネクラの吸血関係
description: Hadekawa Iyone failed her high school debut as a wannabe gal. Desperately trying to break out from her outcast status, she tries talking to the girl sitting next to her, Chisui Makuru, who turns out to be the vampire rumored about town! Although Makuru isn't like your typical vampire... And thus begins the slightly strange high school life of a gal in search of a friend, and a vampire in search of an underling. (Source: NicoNico Seiga, translated)

title: Datenshi Soprano-chan no Fukushuu
title_original: 堕天使そぷらのちゃんの復讐

title: Hisokana Hana Emi
description: Because of her eye-catching looks, there are rumors that Yohira Shino plays around with men. Thus, she is both treated as a nuisance and feared by those around her. One day, she meets Yozakura Yuui, a sophomore upperclassman who Shino remembers disliking due to the former being an honors student. Howeover, due to some circumstances, they start to live together in the same dorm room. Though Shino initially opposes, she finds that there's something about Yuui that separates her from everyone she's encountered until now. Includes chapter 0.

title: Zhui Lan
description: Ling Lin is a girl with terrible luck, who can't seem to do anything right. Until she went to college, met the beautiful and kind senpai Fang Wan, and fell for her before she knew it. In this vast universe, there is someone out there connected to you, who will make sure you will never be alone. (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title: Yi Ban
description: The heartwarming story of two different girls brought together over a cat, as they learn about each other, spend time together, and heal one another.

title: Koufuku Graffiti
description: Ryou, a junior high school student, lives alone. She cooks well and builds warm relations with everyone through her cuisine. There will be 4-frames full of minute and accurate depictions of cooking and cuisine, as well as appetizing dining scenes, with tantalizing eroticism during meal time. When lonely, why not eat rice and be warm together?

title: Sensei ni wa Mada Iwanai
title_original: 先生にはまだ言わない
description: A teacher x student yuri story. Iijima has a crush on Takahaya-sensei, a female P.E. teacher. Every day after hours, she makes time for sensei in her office, where the two of them can be alone. The more time she spends with her, the more her feelings grows... but she hasn't been able to tell her about this feeling just yet.

title: Nekomimi Maid-san to Ojou-sama
title_original: 猫耳メイドさんとお嬢様
description: A young lady employs the services of a feline maid, but they both come to realize that the lines dividing them between "mistress" and "servant" are becoming increasingly blurry.

title: Senki Zesshou Symphogear
title_original: 戦姫絶唱シンフォギア
description: Two years ago, a pair of idols, Tsubasa Kazanari and Kanade Amou, collectively known as ZweiWing, fought against an alien race known as Noise using armor known as Symphogear. To protect a girl named Hibiki Tachibana, who got severely wounded by the Noise, Kanade sacrificed herself. Two years later, as Tsubasa has fought the Noise alone, Hibiki ends up gaining the same power as Kanade. (Source: Anime News Network, Wikipedia)

characters.name: Tsubasa Kazanari
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Ame no Habakiri (天羽々斬, lit. "Blade of Heavenly Wings", holy sword of Susanoo) A popular idol singer and part of the Zwei Wing unit. When she's not singing, she's fighting Noise with her partner, [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/51735/Amou-Kanade). ~!She first appeared as a pop star and student with a cold personality. This was due to the fact that her previous partner, Kanade, lost her life two years prior to the series after a Noise attack at their concert. Before Tsubasa was a shy girl who was coming out of her shell with Kanade's helpful and shining personality. Tsubasa refused to accept Hibiki as Kanade's replacement, and prefers to fight alone. Even more so since Hibiki's Gungnir has the same wavelength as Kanade's. Tsubasa even refused to sign an overseas singing contract, as she viewed herself as a weapon who only sings in the battlefield. However, during the

characters.name: Kanade Amou
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Gungnir (lit. "Swaying One", holy lance of Odin) A popular idol singer and part of the Zwei Wing unit. When she's not singing, she's fighting Noise with her partner, [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/51733/Kazanari-Tsubasa).

characters.name: Hibiki Tachibana
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Gungnir (lit. "Swaying One", holy lance of Odin) __Height:__ 157 cm A student who's an avid fan of Zwei Wing. Hibiki is outgoing, friendly, and overwhelmingly optimistic. She treats everyone with kindness, even former enemies. She doesn't want to fight unless she necessarily has to and wouldn't want to have pointless battles when she believes the problem could be talked about calmly first.

characters.name: Chris Yukine
characters.description: __Relic:__ \- Nehushtan(lit. "Serpent of Bronze", holy standart of Moses) __Symphogear:__ \- Ichaival (holy bow of Scandinavian god Ulr) As a result of her harsh life, Chris is hot-headed, antagonistic and aggressive, quick to distrust others, especially adults, who have only ever treated her like objects. However, Chris actually hates the thought of hurting innocent people. ~!Chris wishes to bring about world peace by putting a stop to the flames of war; with Finé's manipulation, Chris initially decides to go about this by destroying everyone else with the power and will to fight and willingly cooperates with Finé in order to achieve that goal, under the false impression that Finé is working for the same goal of bring peace to the world as her. She is the daughter of a famous violinist and a famous singer. Her parents were killed during a conflict in Val Verde and she was kidnapped by t

characters.name: Miku Kohinata
characters.description: Hibiki's best friend, who shares a dorm with her and is often concerned for her safety. Miku is helpful and cheery, but constantly worries about Hibiki due to the danger she frequently finds herself in as a Symphogear user. She has a hidden possessive streak towards Hibiki, borne out of a desire not to see Hibiki get hurt; even so, Miku does all her best to support Hibiki and encourages her to fight for what she believes in and help others, even if it's born of selfish desire, and so Miku works hard to make sure that Hibiki has a warm place to come home to. ~!In AXZ, it is revealed that years before the series, Miku had difficulty considering other people's feelings in general. She only cared about getting ahead of others and winning, and saw others as her rivals, wishing not to "see them from behind", like in her track-and-field races. However, Miku made an exception for Hibiki, with he

characters.name: Genjurou Kazanari
characters.description: The leader of the 2nd Division Mobile Disaster Response Corps. He is also Tsubasa's uncle and a fan of action movies. His physical strength is strong enough to deflect Tsubasa's Symphogear and her Arms Gear alone. After the attack by the girl in the Nehushtan Armor (who was soon figured out to be Chris), he becomes Hibiki's teacher in martial arts at her request. After his encounter with Chris, he vowed to save her for the errors he made in the past. When Chris's parents died eight years back, he gained custody of her because her parents trusted him, but she ran off. Genjuro and Chris made up and she willingly cooperates with Tsubasa and Hibiki under Genjuro's supervision only. He starts to get suspicious of Ryoko's activities.

characters.name: Ryoko Sakurai
characters.description: Head Scientist of the Mobile Disaster Response Corps and creator of the Symphogear. She has the ability to form powerful force-fields. She tends to display some sexual tendencies towards Hibiki. Her loyalties are somehow questionable, as she concerns herself more over the Symphogears and armors. ~!She is soon revealed to be the main antagonist, Finé, who had possessed Ryoko's body long ago to use the power of Kadingir to destroy the moon and bring about chaos on the earth.!~

title: TOY XX BOX
description: Taeyi has a reputation on campus for being extremely beautiful but a hard nut to crack. There’s a reason for that. She’d much rather enjoy the company of her toys than other people. She’s had enough of complicated and bothersome relationships with real humans. That is until a certain underclassman, Kim Ha-on, approaches her. After being convinced that she needs a partner to make the most of her new toy, she reluctantly let’s Ha-on in on her fun. But only on a strictly no strings attached basis! Things were supposed to be purely physical but it was only a matter of time before someone started to catch feelings… Will Ha-on become Taeyi’s new favorite toy or just be thrown back in the box with the rest of them? (Source: Lezhin) Note: chapter count includes four side stories.

title: Nomura Nao to Kyougoku Hina wa
title_original: 野村ナオと京極ヒナは
description: Honourable mention of Magapoke's 103rd Newcomer Manga Awards.

title: Wasureenu Majo no Monogatari
description: In a world where "today" is repeated over and over again, only "I" remembered each day. The events of "today" can be whimsical, and when "today" was over, everything will be reset, and the “today” that comes tomorrow will rarely be the same. Ayaka Aizawa lived with such a curse, until one day. "Your name is Ayaka Aizawa? My name is Michiru Inaba, nice to meet you." After that, Misuzu will continue to connect with her on the next “today.” For the first time in her life, in the repeated “today”, she could have a relationship with a friend. While being perplexed by the distance shrinking little by little, the feeling of "I" was quietly changing... Around the time Ayaka became aware of her uncontrollable emotions, something happening between she and her "girl friend." A slightly fantastical story about the clumsy feelings between "I" and "girl friend", unsure whether it's love or friendship. (Source: MangaUP!, translated)

characters.name: Ayaka Aizawa
characters.description: **Height:** 152 cm

characters.name: Michiru Inaba
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm

title: Souiu Toshigoro ni Nacchatta Toshi no Sa Shimai
title_original: そういう年頃になっちゃった年の差姉妹
description: I have a 10-year-old distant sister. I'm glad you yearn for me as before, but I feel like I'm coming to my heart more recently than my older sister! ?

title: Eolgulcheonjaega Chukgureul Jalham
title_en: This face genius is good at soccer
description: One day a goddess asked Min-Jun, who loved football and chased his dream harder than anyone else, but was left behind due to slow growth and an unimpressive appearance. "I'm the goddess of soccer. What is your wish?" "Sex" On that day, his ordinary life completely changed. (Source: DAYcomics, edited)

characters.name: Min-Jun Hong
characters.description: A soccer player who worked harder than anyone else but was ordinary in everything.

characters.name: Ha-Rin O
characters.description: An illegitimate child of a wealthy family who must have everything she wants.

characters.name: Ji-Gyeong
characters.description: A Cheerleader.

characters.name: Ha-Yeon Kim
characters.description: A cheerleader with a puppy-like charm.

characters.name: Hui-Yeon Yun
characters.description: A tennis goddess who became a national representative with outstanding skills from a young age.

characters.name: Da-Ye Yun
characters.description: Min-Jun's childhood friend and first love.

characters.name: Chukguui Yeosin
characters.description: The Goddess of Football, who gave Min-Jun a new chance in life.

characters.name: So-Yeong Han
characters.description: A female streamer born into a family of soccer players who harbors secret desires.

characters.name: Su-Yeon Kang
characters.description: She works at a magazine.

title: Acro Trip
description: Chizuko, who lives in Sakai City, Niigata Prefecture, is an otaku girl who is a big fan of the magical girl Berry Blossom who protects the city against the evil organisation Fossa Magna. However, nobody was worried about the battle of the two anymore because Chroma, the evil villain, was too lazy and weak. So Chizuko decided “I want to make my magical girl shine more…!” That desire (?) leads the shy junior high school student down a strange, wicked path… Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.

characters.name: Chizuko Date
characters.description: A middle school student who likes [Berry Blossom](https://anilist.co/character/297362) a little too much.

characters.name: Chroma
characters.description: The leader of the evil organization, Fossa Magna, and an enemy of [Berry Blossom](https://anilist.co/character/297362/Berry-Blossom).

characters.name: Kaju Noichigo
characters.description: A magical girl who protects [Chizuko](https://anilist.co/character/297361/Chizuko-Date)'s city from threats.

characters.name: Mashiro
characters.description: A typical magical girl mascot supporting [Berry Blossom](https://anilist.co/character/297362/Berry-Blossom) behind the scenes.

characters.name: Baryuu Oomizo
characters.description: Mysterious CEO of the well known company Oomizo Technica who is hiding a secret.

characters.name: Kokoa
characters.description: A young looking girl who is interested in the magic powers of [Chizuko](https://anilist.co/character/297361/Chizuko-Date) and [Chroma.](https://anilist.co/character/313872/Chroma)

characters.name: Tsuki
characters.description: [Kokoa's](https://anilist.co/character/341029/Kokoa) attendant who is exceptionally skilled

characters.name: Hugh
characters.description: Member of the evil organization Fossa Magna who was suddenly sent by headquarters to replace [Chroma](https://anilist.co/character/313872/Chroma).

characters.name: Suikyou Date
characters.description: [Chizuko's](https://anilist.co/character/297361/Chizuko-Date) grandfather who is exceedingly active

characters.name: Kuma Kaijin
characters.description: Mysterious creatures summoned by [Chroma](https://anilist.co/character/313872/Chroma) who only communicate by saying "Bear" and making animal noises.

title: Pieta to Transi
description: Transi is a smart girl who transfers to Pieta's class, a high school girl living an ordinary life. Transi has a constitution that triggers murders around her, and she is also a detective who solves the cases. Pieta falls in love with her and offers to be her assistant. As people around her die one by one, Pieta, the person closest to Transi, somehow stays alive. This is a story of two girls who celebrate their own lives even if the world is dying.

title: Joshi Shougakusei Hajimemashita
title_original: 女子小学生はじめました
description: A 30-year-old business man makes a wish to be a girl. A chanting object runs toward him, and the next thing he knows he has became a loli elementary school girl.

characters.name: Ricotta Naruse
characters.description: She is also a body used by someone else to stop Ruru and the escaped fairy.

characters.name: Koloko
characters.description: It is the fairy who turned the main protagonist into Ruru. Koloko is friendly to people especially when it's about friends. Koloko mostly loses focus easily and sometimes forgets it's duties when spoiled. Koloko will also do anything to help back its friends and also has a liking for children, it is shown when looking at a cute child, Koloko's nose bleeds.

characters.name: Riri Shiina
characters.description: Riri is always confident and brave about her actions. She mostly can do things without being shy and gets flustered easily when Ruru is talking about her. She is friends with Ruru and Nono.

characters.name: Nono
characters.description: Nono is very shy and doesn't speak much to people even with her friends. She is also very sensitive and gets scared easily. She is the friend of Ruru and Riri.

title: Mahou Shoujo ni Yasashii Gal
title_original: 魔法少女にやさしいギャル
description: Ayame Meita, a socially awkward high school boy who dreams of being a hero, sees news about ‘Magical Girl Majeri’ protecting humanity from monsters. As various speculations swirl about the mysterious magical girl, even becoming a topic in his class, Meita finds himself connecting with Shion Anri—a cute but tsundere gal who's completely isolated—all because of ‘Magical Girl Majeri’...!? When he learns the secret behind her loneliness, a heart-pounding, kindness-filled magical life begins! (Source: Comic Meteor, translated)

title: Houkago Saitensei!
description: Ten years ago, a magic circle suddenly appeared above Earth, connecting it to the parallel world Alterna. This led to the invention of the Alternaphone, which allows people to freely reincarnate between worlds, allowing earthlings to become adventurers and otherworlders to become normal citizens. The series follows two amnesiac girls, earthling Kurami Utaho and otherworlder Melua Solaris, as they go back and forth between ordinary life on Earth and adventuring on Alterna.

characters.name: Melua Solaris
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm

characters.name: Utaho Kurami
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm

characters.name: Elulu Aida
characters.description: __Height:__ 139 cm

characters.name: Bea
characters.description: __Height:__ 182 cm

characters.name: Nico Seto
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm

characters.name: Kei Azufender
characters.original: けい・あずふぇんだー

characters.name: Myuu Camula II
characters.original: ミュー・カミュラ II世

title: Medetai Sensei
description: A yuri comedy about a PE teacher and a new junior teacher.

title: Maria
description: Maria is a high schooler in 70s Japan. Feeling that she doesn't fit into society, she leaves her home to travel across Japan. During her travel, she will meet men and women, some of them she will love, looking for her place in life.

title: Shoujo Shikkaku
description: A mysterious transfer student arrives to the third year, class C for Hanazono Girl's Middle School. Akane is a plain and simple girl who was tired of her over bearing Friends, and silently thinks that it is ok for the world to be destroyed. However, all the girls of the class wake up to find themselves in a desolated school, with countdown timers. Every girl is tied to another one, and this pair must survive a 7 day Battle Royal. As it turns out, Akane is tied down to the mysterious transfer student. Friendships crumbles, hopes are lost and sanity is tested as the game starts of with a bang!

title: Mirai no Fuufu desu kedo?
title_original: みらいのふうふですけど？
description: The story of a future married couple.

title: Tayutau Futari
title_en: A Couple Drifting in the Wind
description: Kaori, a freshman photography student at an all-women's art college, always hoped she would finally find friends once she started classes but instead she's only found isolation and loneliness. But when she comes across Asuka, a striking woman with a centipede tattoo, she's struck with love at first sight! Can a shy outsider like Kaori find a place beside the dynamic Asuka? A spicy campus romance between total opposites! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Chirality
description: The story is set in a not too distant future, in which Earth has been overrun by a horrifying technovirus. Mechanical parasites, mistakenly created in an attempt to advance technology, attach themselves to human spinal cords and turn their hosts into cyborgs. Desperate to rid themselves of this technological terror, the remaining human survivors try to band together and learn to defend themselves against android enemies.

characters.name: Carol Guardian
characters.description: Carol is an artificial being that was created specifically to save mankind. Unfortunately, in him youth he suffered greatly at the hands of the very humans he sought to save and lost sight of his mission. Only through the kindness of one human girl named Shiori was Carol able to find his focus and a reason to save the world; for Shiori's sake. If it goes to Carol gender. Carol is a male, he is in the form of woman because in it he can generate faster.

characters.name: Shiori
characters.description: A human girl who showed kindness towards Carol, and becomes the one thing that Carol strives to protect. She is very brave and compassionate, very close to her family and friends, and wholeheartedly wishes to end the GM threat with Carol and her family. While not trained in combat, she doesn't usually panic in the middle of a battle, and has some skill with firearms. http://en.wikipedia.org/

title: Concerto
description: A series of yuri one-shots. 1. Melody (旋律) A story about two childhood friends who like music and who are asked to perform at the graduation ceremony of their school. 2. Longing (あこがれ) Longing deals with two members of the archery club: Kyoko and her senpai Touko, who is ashamed of her man-like body. 3. Spice (スパイス) Spice is about a young girls-loving teacher who wants to seduce her female students. 4. Innocent (無垢) Innocent is about a nude portrait hanging in an art room, the model and the painter. 5. Rendez-vous (ランデブー) Rendez-vous is about two girls secretly in love who elope together after being found out.

title: Anata wa Itsumo Zurui Hito
title_original: あなたはいつもずるいひと
description: It's a yuri relationship between an OL and her boss. The doujin features light hearted flirting between the characters from Nikurashii Hodo Aishiteru.

characters.name: Ayako Asano
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") Product Planning Division Manager and [Saori Fujimura](https://anilist.co/character/363231/Saori-Fujimura)'s boss. She is currently married and respected by everyone in the office.

characters.name: Saori Fujimura
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") Fujimura is the youngest staff member and the ace of the sales department. Has always been interested in older women. She currently works in the Product Planning Division, with [Asano](https://anilist.co/character/363230/Ayako-Asano) as her boss.

title: Yu☆Gi☆Oh OCG STORIES: Sentouhime-hen
title_original: 遊☆戯☆王OCG STORIES 閃刀姫編
description: The manga is related to the Official Card Game, which is abbreviated as "OCG." The manga will center on Sky Striker Ace - Raye, who resolves to fight in order to protect her beloved family.

characters.name: Raye
characters.description: A young girl fighting for her family and her homeland.

characters.name: Roze
characters.description: Roze is a character appearing in the Yu-Gi-Oh! OCG Stories, and one of the major characters of the "Sky Striker" story. She is based on the card "Sky Striker Ace - Roze". As Raye's Sky Striker equipment vastly outclasses AI in combat but can only be used by a human operator, Roze was created by the pillars of Spectra solely to go toe-to-toe with her by using the same technology.

title: Osananajimi no Watashi wa Mob de Itai Noni, Naze ka Heroine no Renai Taishou ni Natteiru.
title_original: 幼馴染のわたしはモブでいたいのに、なぜかヒロインの恋愛対象になっている。
description: When Mashiro Yukizuki is reincarnated into the world of a gal-game as “Ryona Amezuki,” one of the heroines of the game, she decides she wants to live as inconspicuously as possible. But when she helps to rescue “Ririnri Hinahoshi” from being harassed by a man downtown, she finds herself in the middle of a love affair. Now everything she tries backfires, as Ryona finds herself attracting the love interest of more and more heroines… (Source: Digicata, translated)

title: A Yeong-Jae-in?
title_en: Sora & Haena: Side Story - Ah Young & Jae-In?
description: Side story about how is going Ah Young and Jae-In relationship.

title: Shoujo Nyuumon
description: A unique romantic comedy, full of laughter and excitement, featuring two "boys who have turned into girls"! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Daisy, Mata Ashita
description: A frail girl recovers with the help of an unlikely friend.

title: Huan Yin
description: A recurring dreams prelude to a destined encounter. A police officer Lou Ji has a hidden secretive BDSM sexual fantasy with some woman in her dreams....only if this would become a reality. Lou Ji finally met the girl from her dream at the police station. What will become of it? (Source: Tapas)

title: Shinda Kareshi ga Joushikousei ni Natte Kaettekita
title_original: 死んだ彼氏が女子高生になって帰ってきた
description: A man has a girlfriend but he dies, and then he possesses a school girl and rushes to meet his girlfriend. (Source: Manga-Updates)

title: Matazoro.
description: It's a youthful comedy about three girls stuck repeating high school! After being a recluse for a year, Koto will be a high school freshman for the second time in the spring. She is lazy in the morning, forgetful, not good at studying, and not good at interpersonal relationships. She is a fragile and wounded creature, full of weaknesses. But with the help of her new friends who are also repeating their first year, she tries to start a normal school life. (Source: Nico Seiga, translated) Notes: - Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2021 Award in the Print Manga Category. - Volume 1 won the 2021 Rookie 4-Koma Of The Year award. - Volume 2 won the 2022 4-Koma Of The Year award.

title: Hitozuma Kyoushi ga Oshiego no Joshikousei ni Dohamari Suru Hanashi
title_original: 人妻教師が教え子の女子高生にドはまりする話
description: Itsuki Ichigohara is a married high-school teacher in her late 20's, who finds herself involved with a high school girl, her student, who is 10 years younger. The student's name is Rin Togawa. She is taller than Itsuki, with a beautiful face, mild-mannered but a little childish. She is a good girl, but she has had problems in her family life, and as Itsuki tried to counsel her, they somehow ended up kissing each other in bed. This is definitely an adulterous betrayal, not to mention a crime. How could she have got herself into so much trouble that could only lead to her own destruction? — How could I have let this happen? It is a lewd and immoral, but somehow warm relationship. A love story between a female teacher and her female student. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

characters.name: Itsuki Ichigohara
characters.description: Homeroom teacher for Rin's class. She is beautiful and popular with her students. She has a good relationship with her husband, but their sex life is a bit lacking, so they do not have any children.

characters.name: Rin Togawa
characters.description: A first-year high school student who was caught hanging out late at night by her teacher Itsuki.

title: DOUBLE HELIX BLOSSOM
description: Kiku Shinonome was a policewoman seriously injured during a case, and she was forced to go into hibernation for 60 years because it was impossible to treat her injuries with the technologies at the time. Sixty years later, Japan is a very different place, and Kiku's police force has been privatized. Kiku and Kyou Tsukisagari, a convicted felon, decide to team up as partners... This is a near-future police buddy story featuring Kiku, who has just awakened from a long sleep, and Kyou, who wields supernatural powers! (Source: Corocoro, translated)

title: JC no Life!
description: A present day, girl's secret story, effective in life.

title: Chouchou Nannan
description: After hitting it off at the entrance ceremony, romance had no place in the school life four friends shared… It was just lively, noisy fun. While Aoi keeps her feelings for Chihiro hidden, Nao takes notice. And when Nao tries to cheer Aoi up with a kiss, it only makes things more complicated.

title: Kai to AlternaRock
description: AltRock is a story between two office ladies, a senpai and her kouhai.

title: Bu Xiaoxin Jiule Jianghu Gongdi
title_en: Saved the Public Enemy by Mistake
description: The peaceful life of Lu Jiu is brought to an end when a teenage cultivator turns up before his medical hall, badly injured. The young physician saves the boy, not knowing that he's Liu Jianghe, a notorious man whom many want dead. Is it too late to kill him now? (Source: Bilibili Comics)

characters.name: Jianghe Liu
characters.description: The notorious Paradise Pavilion lord, who has committed numerous crimes. He was attacked by an alliance of established sects and had his spirit core removed. Liu Jianghe faked his death by jumping off Qianxing cliff. Severely injured, he is now only able to maintain a teenage form. Liu Jianghe currently resides in the Peach Blossom Wharf medical hall.

characters.name: Jiu Lu
characters.description: A physician who owns a small medical hall at Peach Blossom Wharf. He hates trouble, but trouble often comes looking for him. Due to the blade wounds on his wrists, he is unable to wield swords or other heavy weapons. However, there’s an exceptional sword hidden in his medical hall.

title: Jugil Su Eopdamyeon Saranghaseyo
title_en: If You Can't Kill Me, Love Me
description: In a kingdom scarred by a historical rebellion, Penny, an assassin masquerading as a servant, aims to break free from Queen Nyla's grasp by executing a perilous mission: the theft of the king's ring from Princess Cher, known as the wicked Princess of Death. Yet her intentions take a turn as she slowly becomes captivated by the princess. As their destinies become entwined, Penny grapples with a dilemma, torn between her pursuit of freedom and the unexpected connections she forges with Cher. (Source: Tapas)

characters.name: Penny
characters.description: Penny is Princess Chell's personal maid and an assassin in disguise tasked to kill her.

characters.name: Chell
characters.description: Princess Chell is the daughter the first queen, Viatan. Chell is the sole survivor of the rebellion, and is now known as the Princess of Death.

title: Youkai Izakaya Nonbereke.
title_original: ようかい居酒屋 のんべれケ。
description: Girls cry! Laugh! And get harassed! Young female college student, Hino Motogane, starts a part-time job at a small late night Izakaya. However the shop’s clientele–were youkai. These youkai do all kinds of things to their favorite Hino, sometimes they strip her, sometimes they cover her in spit, no matter what they work her to death! After all, she wants her paycheck…. Come on in under the curtain into an Izakaya comedy where girls are full of laughter, tears, sweat, spit, and who knows what fluids that are flying about. Note: Chapter count includes 5 extras.

title: Lilies Complex
title_original: リリィズコンプレックス
description: The beautiful flowers of the lily are actually poisonous!? Have a peek into the slightly spicy lives of these beautiful girls, each a whirlwind of emotions and moods. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Sayonara Lara
description: Once upon a time, a mermaid princess named Lara fell in love with a human prince. To be with him, she used a witch’s potion to become human—but the magic came at a cost: If she failed to find true love, she would vanish into sea foam forever. Now, 200 years later, Lara awakens in Lake Biwa with one final chance at life and love. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Lara
characters.description: __Height:__ 165cm Lara was once a mermaid princess who fell in love with a human prince and disappeared into sea foam before her love could be fulfilled. She has now been reborn as a human being off the shore of Lake Biwa in Shiga Prefecture roughly 200 years later. With her new life, she is once again looking for true love.

characters.name: Mari Ootsu
characters.description: __Height:__ 150cm A high school girl living in Ootsu City, Shiga Prefecture who does boxing. After the loss of her mother at a young age she lives with her grandmother, father, and older brother. One day she encounters [Lara](https://anilist.co/character/368281/Lara) and invites her to live with her family.

title: Oshikake Nyoubou, Kodomo Tsuki!
title_original: 押しかけ女房、コドモ付き！
description: Hanako, a first-year high school girl, was leading a perfectly normal life. But then a girl with a baby appears at her door. She claims that the baby is their child...? (Source: Manga Time Kirara Carat, translated)

title: Elixir
description: Eunha is heartbroken when she finds out her high school sweetheart, Siyeon, used an elixir to make her fall in love. When the two reunite 10 years later at a business meeting, Siyeon asks for a second chance. But before they can talk things out and rebuild their trust, greater magical forces interfere. (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Sakuma Junsa to Hanaoka Junsa wa Tsukiai Hajimeta
title_original: 佐久間巡査と花岡巡査は付き合いはじめた
description: Officers Ruru Sakuma (senior) and Shiori Hanaoka (junior) work together at the Minami Akihabara Koban. They were curious about each other's lives, until one day, by chance, they decided to start dating! This is a story of daily life in Akiba between two people who are gently trying their best, both in their daily duties as police officers and in their love for each other! (Source: Dengeki Comic Regulus, translated) Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title: Shakunetsu no Takkyuu Musume
description: The manga follows middle school students Koyori Tsumuzikaze and Agari Kamiya as they enter the world of girls' middle school ping pong. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Agari Kamiya
characters.description: She is a second year at Suzumegahara Middle School in the table tennis club who was the undisputed ace prior to [Koyori Tsumujikaze](https://anilist.co/character/90204/Tsumujikaze-Koyori) joining the club.

characters.name: Kumami Tsukinowa
characters.description: A second year who was formerly part of Suzemegahara's table tennis club, before transferring to Tsumebame after being enticed by their captain. On the day she left, Agari asked her to play one match with her before leaving but refused. She has a talent for ventriloquism that involves talking with her hairpin she calls Kumanosuke. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Mayuu Kanenashi
characters.description: __Birthday:__ September 10th

title: Urihyeongeun Jonjallim
description: As the youngest member of hit idol group LoverU, Ryeojoon never suspected that a book gifted by a fan would be... riveting fan fiction starring himself and the other LoverU members! Drawn deeper into the mysterious world of fanfics, he just can't stop himself anymore... How long can this bookworm keep his not-so-innocent hobby a secret? Superstar turns superfan as Ryeojoon walks a dangerous line between idol and fanboy! (Source: Tappytoon) Note: Includes a prologue.

title: Naui Bolam
description: The school's fastest track star, Namsu. An old friend from the past, Hye-Yeon. Everyone's adorable sweetheart, Joy. High-school romance at it's best! The comic that made Pito one of the best in the GL genre. (Source: Lezhin)

characters.name: Bo-Ram Kwon
characters.description: Everyone loves the lovely Boram. Childhood friend of Hye-Yeon, and admirer of Namsu.

characters.name: Nam-Su Min
characters.description: The fastest runner at school is the star of all, Namsu. She dreams of winning the nationals.

characters.name: Hye-Yeon Lim
characters.description: Boram's childhood friend.

title: Man Ji Chuanyue De Wo Weisheme Shi Mushi Xiaojie A
title_original: 满级穿越的我为什么是牧师小姐啊
description: A top-level player accidentally transmigrates into the game character "he" was playing, a max-level priestess. She will team up with a dragon-maid to venture into this brand new world! However — why do all these girls keep looking at her in this funny way?! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

characters.name: Chocola
characters.description: **Breed:** Black Cat Mix **Height:** 152 cm Chocola is a cheerful and energetic catgirl as [Kashou](https://anilist.co/character/130309/Minazuki-Kashou) himself describes her, 'happy-go-lucky.' She doesn't usually get upset, and even when she does, she often swings back to being as cheery as usual, though occasionally she can be genuinely sad about something. She is curious, and has a childlike outlook on things, which is fitting as she and [Vanilla](https://anilist.co/character/88788/Vanilla) are mentioned to be only 9 months old in human terms. She likes Kashou.

characters.name: Vanilla
characters.description: **Breed:** White Cat Mix **Height:** 149 cm Vanilla is quiet, calm and very stoic. She rarely expresses her emotions, making her a somewhat of a kuudere character, as opposed to her sister's energetic, playful personality. She loves her twin sister [Chocola](https://anilist.co/character/88787/Chocola), and will accompany her always due to her siscon-like relationship towards her.

title: under one roof
description: Miho Yoshida has been looking for a place to live. After some searching, she visits the home of Fuuka Asou, who is renting out a room on the second floor. The two discuss their situation, including the history of Fuuka's roommates—most of whom were male. Feeling the need to let her know up front, Fuuka comes out to Miho as a lesbian. With the sexuality of her roommate not an issue to the open-hearted Miho, she promptly moves in. Flirty jokes directed at her from Fuuka and her attractive female friends become commonplace. But as feelings change and the jokes become more serious, Miho is put in a dilemma. When Fuuka romantically closes in, why does Miho feel so happy? (Source: MAL Rewrite)

title: Hadomae
description: While posing as a nude model for a croquis class, Jaehee spots a man staring a little too intently at her body. More specifically, at her feet. She later finds out the man is a shoemaker and foot fetishist. Though Jaehee is initially taken aback by his fetish, the more she gets to know the man, the more she wishes he would caress the rest of her body...and not just her feet. (Source: Lezhin US) Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

title: Yodaka, Meguru
description: Yukako, a housewife tired of the pressure put upon her by the people in her life, has an unexpected reunion with a woman from her past. This meeting makes Yukako yearn for the touch of another woman again as she tries to keep her affair a secret from her husband.

title: Tankobu
description: Kobushi Jun was sleeping on the train and she caught a scent that reminded her of the time back in middle school. Jun bumped into a girl from the other team during a basketball match. Three years later, Jun bumped into the same girl and the love story begins.

characters.name: Jun Kobushi
characters.description: Hot-tempered and nosy. She enjoys cooking and is a dog person. She has three siblings: an older brother, a younger sister, and a younger brother.

characters.name: Terumi Tanba
characters.description: She isn't very good at expressing herself. She is an only child who lives with her aunt. She enjoys looking at abandoned buildings and model houses.

title: yrhm Yuri-Hime 20th Anthology
title_original: yrhm 百合姫20thアンソロジー
description: An anthology of all-new manga by nine of the finest authors who have graced Comic Yuri-Hime to celebrate its 20-year anniversary. Cover Illustration: Hechima 1. Seishun CONTINUE? (青春CONTINUE？) [Saburouta] 2. Puppet Date (パペット・デート) [Miman] 3. Uso (嘘) [Shimo Aono] 4. I no Naka no Sora wo Shiranai (井の中の空を知らない) [Yuama] 5. Douse Futari Bocchi (どうせ二人ぼっち) [Kashikaze] 6. Shoujo Shinjuu (少女心中) [Naoko Kodama] 7. Usotsuki (うそつき) [Manio Hanasaki] 8. Tantan to Anne (端々と安寧) [Kiyoko Iwami] 9. Bunny Girl Hiroimashita. (バニーガール拾いました。) [Eku Takeshima]

title: 1 RT de Nakawarui Nonke Joshitachi ga 1 Byou Kiss Suru Series
title_original: １ＲＴで仲悪いノンケ女子たちが１秒キスするシリーズ
description: Two straight girls who don't get along will kiss 1 second for every 1 retweet

title: Renzao Tiwen 36.7℃
description: Su, born in prison, has always wanted to see the "crow" from the story her mother told her. On the day she was going to be secretly executed, Gill, an artificial intelligence with a database of everything outside the prison, was thrown into prison for a test run. Su develops a special feeling for Gill, not caring whether her words are programmed or self-conscious, and not trying to tell if she has human emotions. Unable to distinguish her own human feelings... in this small cell, the lonely Su got her first doll--she met a "person" who could comfort her soul.

title: Shoujo Seikan Hyouryuuki
description: A spaceship in the shape of a horse-drawn carriage travels across the galaxy. Riding in the carriage is Ridley, the scientist who built this eccentric spaceship, and her partner Watari, a shy girl. The two leave Earth, which has become uninhabitable due to environmental pollution, and set off in the carriage. Their goal is to find a safe planet to settle. However, all the planets they visit are very strange! A planet with a god who can bring all things back to life, another planet where the luckiest people are considered the greatest, and a planet with countless libraries… The two girls are sometimes thrown for a loop by these strange worlds… Even today, they continue to explore the vast galaxy. "Maybe the next world will be the one to settle on." (Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

title: Watashitachi no Owari to Seikatsu
title_original: 私たちの終わりと生活
description: Two girls reflect on how they want to live the rest of their lives now that they're the only people left on Earth.

title: Koko wa Tengoku ja Nai kedo
title_original: ここは天国じゃないけど
description: A woman working at a girls bar encounters an angel that has fallen into a pile of trash.

title: WEAKNESS
description: She has a good personality, is popular, and has a lot of money: Gu Do-Yeon, the daughter of the perfect G company president. However, Do-Yeon's step-sister Gu Yi-Seo is just unlucky and annoying. Who in the world is perfect? In the end, Yi-Seo secretly hides in an office to dig up Do-Yeon's weakness.
