There, she discovers a completely different side to the Do-Yeon she knew. (Lezhin, translated) Note: - Chapter count includes a prologue. - Part of Lezhin's Gwanggong Collection (광공단편선). A gwanggong (광공, hanja: 狂攻) character is obsessed with the object of their desire, similar to the Japanese "yandere". Scanlations have erroneously translated this to "GwangGong Apartment/Industrial Complex", which may have caused confusion.

title: Tetsudo Shoujo Manga
description: All aboard! This book is your ticket to seven romances―from confessions in Iriuda to proposals in Enoshima and all points in between. Beloved josei and boys love mangaka Asumiko Nakamura returns to the English market with a unique collection of romance shorts each set around Kanagawa's railway system, the Odakyu. Combining moments of contemporary women, lesbian romances and coming-of-age tales, Maiden Railways is a ride to romance rarely seen in manga these days. (Source: Denpa) 1. Rouman Hikou ni Nottotte (浪漫避行にのっとって, All Aboard for a Romantic Getaway); Melody 2008-10 2. Kare no Sumu Iryuuda (彼の住むイリューダ, He Lives in Iriuda); Melody 2009-04 3. Rittai Kousa no Eki (立体交差の駅, Overpass Crossing); Rakuen Le Paradis Vol.1 (2009/10) 4. Ao to Shiro no Ream (青と白のリーム, Blue and White Ream); Rakuen Web Zoukan 2009/12/17 5. Mokuyoubi no Savarin (木曜日のサバラン, Savarin Thursdays); Rakuen Le Paradis Vol.2 6. Yoru wo Kasaneru (夜を重ねる, Night After Night); Rakuen Le Paradis Vol.3 (2010/6) 7. Aru Kyuujitsu (ある休日, A Day Off) Note: Nakamura later published a spin-off series, Kimi Youbi, which was subtitled "Tetsudo Shoujo Manga 2," etc. The series was based on the one-shot "Mokuyoubi no Savarin" (Savarin Thurs

title: Harmony
description: In the future, Utopia has finally been achieved thanks to medical nanotechnology and a powerful ethic of social welfare and mutual consideration. This perfect world isn't that perfect though, and three young girls stand up to totalitarian kindness and super-medicine by attempting suicide via starvation. It doesn't work, but one of the girls—Tuan Kirie—grows up to be a member of the World Health Organization. As a crisis threatens the harmony of the new world, Tuan rediscovers another member of her suicide pact, and together they must help save the planet...from itself. (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Miach Mihie
characters.description: Miach is one of Tuan's best high school friends. She is brilliant and intelligent, who doesn't agree with present world. Her personality is that of a calm and philosophical girl; she is very charismatic and capable of manipulating those around her to an impressive extent. She was a problem student with the best grades in the class, who only conversed with Tuan and Cian. Miach is the one who influenced them in order attempt suicide as the ultimate act of rebellion against the world.

characters.name: Tuan Kirie
characters.description: Tuan Kirie is a Helix Inspector for the Japanese branch of the Admedistration, which governs society. She spends most of her time on peacekeeping missions to escape the stultifying nature of the normal world. ~!In her past she had entered a suicide pact with her two friends Miach Mihie and Cian Reikado into to rebel against society, but only Miach died.!~

title: Shinigami Alice
description: Returning home late in the evening, Kanogawa Masaki is attacked by a murderer! Just in time to save her, a cute doll-like girl with deadly scissors kills the attacker, with the explanation that she is just doing her job. Unfortunately, part of this strange girl's job is also killing any witnesses. For reasons unknown, she allows Masaki to run away. Now Masaki can't stop thinking about her, and about finding a way to see her again...

characters.name: Masaki Kanogawa
characters.description: Masaki is a highschool student with a part-time job. Late one night, she has a mysterious encounter with a doll-like girl. From then on, Masaki goes out every night to hopefully encounter this girl once more because she can't get the girl off of her mind!

characters.name: Hinageshi
characters.description: Hinageshi is an assassin who kills people that have disobeyed the "puppeteer". One late night, Masaki Kanogawa witnesses a murder by her. One fateful encounter leads to another and Hinageshi finds herself perplexed by the feelings she has for Masaki, trying to figure out what those feelings are.

characters.name: Camellia
characters.description: A mysterious girl who attacked Masaki in her apartment.

title: Project Yuriforming!
title_original: プロジェクト・ユリフォーミング！
description: In search of new stimulus, the yuri-addict alien Lily sets her sights on two childhood friends, Iori and Runa, who can't be honest about their feelings, to create "real yuri" by her own hands! (Source: Houbunsha, translated)

characters.name: Lily
characters.description: The yuri alien who came all the way to Earth in search of yuri.

characters.name: Iori
characters.description: Iori is a serious honor student. She can't help but meddle in Runa's business out of worry.

characters.name: Runa
characters.description: Runa is a delinquent(?) at an age where she doesn't want to be treated like a kid.

characters.name: Kanoko
characters.description: Kanoko is the the narcissistic student council president. She loves girls.

characters.name: Matsuba
characters.description: Matsuba is Lily's caretaker and disciplinarian.

characters.name: Hime
characters.description: Hime is a girl who looks up to delinquents, and is honest to a fault.

characters.name: Iori Mama
characters.description: Iori's mother. She has a strict personality, but...

title: Corpse Party Cemetery 0: Kaibyaku no Ars Moriendi
title_original: コープスパーティーCEMETERY0 〜開闢のアルス・モリエンディ〜
description: There is a website for suicides appearing on the internet only at midnight and when certain specific keywords are searched. Although it is supposed to be only a mere urban myth, girls who have performed the ritual suddenly disappeared. High school paranormalist Naho Saenoki launches an investigation to shed light on this gruesome incident while the amount of victims keeps increasing. And then, it happened to Naho herself...

characters.name: Kou Kibiki
characters.description: __Height__: 178 cm (5' 10") __Weight__: 62.0 kg (136 lbs) A paranormal novelist and a victim trapped in the Heavenly Host Elementary School. He is the guardian and mentor of Naho Saenoki, a student whom adores Kibiki.

characters.name: Naho Saenoki
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm (5' 3") Naho is a student from Paulownia Academy's high school class 2-1 and a victim trapped inside Heavenly Host. Naho plays a cool, calm and wise character if yet dubious and sinister. She cares for Kibiki, her mentor, while seen as a mentor and student relationship she would see it as a father-and-daughter relationship but to extreme cases, lovers. ~!However inside her, Naho is driven by desire and obssession for Kibiki and his fame is what motivates her and is her main weakness and finally leads to her possession to the Darkening. Selfish as well she is willing to sacrifice people and even her best friend Sayaka to their deaths to find Kibiki.!~

title: Mermaid Line
description: Mermaid Line is a collection of stories that ran in Yuri Hime magazine. They are collected together as short mini-series, done in an episodic, almost soap-opera-y way. In "Megumi and Aoi " Megumi confesses to her friend Aoi that, despite her ungainly swimming, she feels as if she is a mermaid. Aoi finds herself fantasizing about being the prince to Megumi's mermaid, but Megumi runs to the arms of a boy, trying to put a beard on her feelings. Ayumi, in "Ayumi and Aika," wants to get married to her boyfriend so naturally, she's shocked when he tells her that he wants to become a woman. "Yukari and Mayuko" are both OLs. Mayuko's between boyfriends and bored, so she asks Yukari to pretend to be her girlfriend. It works out well, until Yukari realizes that her feelings for Mayuko are more than just pretend. And finally, in "Miura-san and Me" Okabe loves Miura's beautiful hair. When Miura-san cuts it all off, Okabe learns to love her for herself. (Source: Okazu)

title: Warm Summer
description: Kitanai Kimi ga Ichiban Kawaii doujin by Manio for Comic Market 100

characters.name: Airi Sezaki
characters.description: She places heavy importance on her social standing, and puts lots of effort into maintaining popularity and a clean image around her classmates. However, this behavior is mostly an act: she reveals her true self in private, where she puts Hinako through various degrees of suffering for her own amusement. She can be described as a perverted, sadistic and manipulative person. ~! Later, she sinks into a deep depression and becomes highly dependent on Hinako. She eventually runs away with Hinako and tries to commit double suicide with her. !~

title: Kim Daeri Chatgi
description: Note: Part of the 2023 Postype Winter Anthology (포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).

title: Furidashi ni Ochiru!
description: The manga centers on Hato Aoi, a 16-year-old high school girl who just wants to enjoy her school life. But it turns out she doesn't really act like a high school girl. The manga is a light story about a girl who tries her hardest to become a real high school girl. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: 100-nichi Go ni ××× suru Onna Shachou to Shinyuu Shain
title_original: 100日後に×××する女社長と新入社員
description: Mai is a new employee who made a bad mistake in front of the beautiful company president, Eri. Eri asked Mai to take responsibility, by going out with her, even though they are both women. What will happen with their relationship over the next 100 days!? It's a yuri pure love comedy between the company president x a new employee! (Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

title: Jibe Ganeun Gire USB-reul Juwotda
description: Hwa-Won knows better than to pick things off the street, even if it is just an innocent-looking USB. In an effort to find the owner, Hwa-Won discovers that the USB belongs to her favorite GL writer, Kim Yuri, and has unreleased chapters of the latter’s new sequel! As a zealous fan, Hwa-won can hardly resist herself from devouring the chapters in one setting. However, she seems to have forgotten that curiosity is not just hazardous to cats! Because the USB doesn’t just contain the chapters to the sequel. It also contains things that leave Hwa-Won upset. Now Hwa-Won needs answers and Kim Yuri’s the only one who has them. But Kim Yuri is a staunch recluse who refuses to leave her house! How is Hwa-Won to meet her?! Soon, online meets offline, fiction meets reality and as the pages turn, it is no longer Hwa-Won doing the chasing! (Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title: Koroshi Korosare Sankaku Kankei ni Watashi ga Ima kara Hairun desu ka?
title_original: 殺し殺され三角関係に私が今から入るんですか？
description: Kohaku was a loner in junior high school, and she dreams of a more fulfilling social life in high school. However, on her first day of school, she falls down the stairs and ends up hospitalized for a month! This means that everyone else has already made friends and formed groups at school... In order to avoid being left all alone, she summons up the courage to talk to the only odd-numbered clique in her class. But it turns out that they are at the top of the school social caste, and they are caught up in a blood-splattered yuri love triangle...!? A suspenseful high school comedy about trying to fit in! (Source: ComicWalker, translated)

characters.name: Samael
characters.description: She is a fallen angel.

characters.name: Belphegor
characters.description: She is a demon

title: Kinoko Ningen no Kekkon
description: Our story begins on an all-woman planet of intelligent fungi, where Ariella and Eriella are about to get married! But they've got a long road ahead of them: illness, surgery, and even a dastardly royal plot that seeks to split them apart. Is their love strong enough to weather any storm? This offbeat, adorable, and dramatic one-shot is sure to please fans of yuri, monster girls, and enduring romance! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Do M Joshi to Gakkari Joou-sama
title_original: ドM女子とがっかり女王様
description: Nakamura is a high school girl with masochist tendencies and she thought she'd found her perfect dominatrix in the tall, beautiful Kumegawa. But it turns out that Kumegawa's personality isn't quite as domineering as she seems. A yuri dom-sub reversal comedy from a genius newcomer! (Source: Young Ace, translated)

characters.name: Misuzu Kumegawa
characters.description: An airheaded and shy but attractive girl.

characters.name: Sayo Nakamura
characters.description: A demanding masochist with a sadistic side.

title: Chotto Mune ga Dekakute Kao ga Yoi Onna
title_original: ちょっと胸がデカくて顔が良い女
description: Morishima decides to confront a couple of girls that are gossiping about her.

title: Mao Yu Hai De Bi Duan
title_en: See You There, Beyond the Ocean
description: In third grade, Wu Xiaorong was the class outcast, an introverted girl who hated going to school. But all that changed when she met Tong Kewei, the cheerful and outgoing popular girl. The two couldn't be more different, and Wu Xiaorong assumed they'd never interact—but to her surprise, they began bonding over their shared love for drawing comics. Thus begins the story of a beautiful, bittersweet friendship, the ups and downs of childhood, and a project left forever unfinished... (Source: Yen Press) Notes: - Silver Award winner in the 16th Japan International Manga Award. - Includes one extra chapter.

title: Watashi no Oshi wa Akuyaku Reijou. Maid Kitchen
title_original: 私の推しは悪役令嬢。メイドキッチン
description: A short cooking-focused spin-off series of Watashi no Oshi wa Akuyaku Reijou. Oohashi Rei, once an ordinary office worker, found herself in the body of the protagonist of her favorite girls’ otome game, Revolution, and she's determined to romance her favorite character, the villainess Claire Francois! Using the knowledge and experience of the game she accrued in her previous life, Rei's successfully managed to become one of Claire's maids. Now dutifully serving her alongside her senior, Lene Aurousseau, the two make delicious sweets in order to satisfy their cute yet selfish master's reckless demands!

characters.name: Claire François
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm (5'2") Claire François is a proud noble who in the original [Revolution] is the villainess who bullies the heroine. ~!In the original Revolution game, she is doomed to be executed, along with the rest of nobility, as a result of the revolution.!~ Claire is prideful with a competitive side to prove her worth as well as her family name. Her threatening behaviour conceals her fragile heart that comes from her childhood experiences. Becomes more prone to jealously as people she cares for may leave her. Her arrogant personality is mainly influenced by her father doting on her in her childhood more than anything.

characters.name: Rae Taylor
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm (5'4") An ordinary office worker who finds herself in the body of the protagonist of her favorite otome game, Revolution. She aims to become a couple with her favorite character, [Claire François](https://anilist.co/character/149900/Claire-Franois). Rae deliberately plays herself up as being a foolishly happy-go-lucky girl who is obsessed with gaining Claire's affection. However, in reality, this is more of a coping mechanism brought about by her early experiences with exploring her sexuality. She is actually far less open with her true feelings, often bottling them up and covering it with humor.

characters.name: Lene Aurousseau
characters.description: **Height:** 154 cm (5'1") Lene is the eldest daughter of a wealthy merchant family, Aurosseau. She loyally serves Claire François as her personal maid. Lene seems very patient, and comes off as meek and subservient, but in reality, she just knows how to handle Claire very well after years of serving her.

title: Nae Choeaeneun Agyeogyeongae: Another Revolution Story
description: A woman is reincarnated as the main character Rae Taylor in her favorite otome game Revolution . Given all the princes to romance, Rae's true favorite isn't any of them, but rather… the villainous lady Claire François! Leaving behind her cold and lonely past life, she will become the heroine of Revolution and adore Claire François to her heart's content! Will Rae be able to befriend and save Claire, using all of her wits and game knowledge of Revolution ? “No matter what happens, I will protect Lady Claire!” (Source: Ridibooks, translated)

characters.name: Rae Taylor
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm (5'4") An ordinary office worker who finds herself in the body of the protagonist of her favorite otome game, Revolution. She aims to become a couple with her favorite character, [Claire François](https://anilist.co/character/149900/Claire-Franois). Rae deliberately plays herself up as being a foolishly happy-go-lucky girl who is obsessed with gaining Claire's affection. However, in reality, this is more of a coping mechanism brought about by her early experiences with exploring her sexuality. She is actually far less open with her true feelings, often bottling them up and covering it with humor.

characters.name: Claire François
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm (5'2") Claire François is a proud noble who in the original [Revolution] is the villainess who bullies the heroine. ~!In the original Revolution game, she is doomed to be executed, along with the rest of nobility, as a result of the revolution.!~ Claire is prideful with a competitive side to prove her worth as well as her family name. Her threatening behaviour conceals her fragile heart that comes from her childhood experiences. Becomes more prone to jealously as people she cares for may leave her. Her arrogant personality is mainly influenced by her father doting on her in her childhood more than anything.

title: Futsuu no Koi tte Nani?
description: "I" fell in love at first sight during my high school entrance ceremony. But it wasn't a normal kind of love... A yuri romance portrayed from the perspective of three high school girls. (Source: Michikusa Comics, translated)

title: Nakigoe Kikasete? Kanade-san
title_original: なきごえ聞かせて？ かなでさん
description: Note: Chapter count includes two extras.

characters.name: Yuma Okazaki
characters.description: Yuma is in her second year of high school with her childhood and best friend Hotaru. She is in a relationship with Takeda, but she's very inexperienced as he's her first boyfriend and often times asks Hotaru for advice but gets unexpected responses instead.

characters.name: Hotaru Mizushina
characters.description: Hotaru is Yuma's childhood and best friend. Yuma was always around to protect her from various things such as bullying at school, but over time she has changed and even ended up having many boyfriends (though Yuma noticed she seemed uninterested).

title: rain
description: "Because I love you." On a rainy day, when Mai got stood up by the guy she likes she met a beautiful girl who told her that she was the Rain and that she had come because of her tears. After that Mai's days were filled with the bitterness of betrayal, only the memory of the girl called Rain can somehow ease her heart. A story of a brief love affair under the rainy season. (summary by kiumi from The Evil Empire)

title: Hentai Yoku Dekimashita
title_original: へんたいよくできました
description: Student council secretary Kumazawa Koiko writes down her HENTAI feelings for the student council president she admires in a notebook. It was supposed to be a secret fantasy... but then the student council president's sister, Nika, picked up the notebook...!? A comedy about becoming a toy for the sister of the person you love♪ Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

title: Shinohayu: the dawn of age
title_original: シノハユ the dawn of age
description: A prequel to the Saki series, focusing on the childhoods of future professional mahjong players and their peers, among them Shino Shiratsuki, a young girl with an affinity for the 1-sou who is seeking out her missing mother.

characters.name: Shino Shiratsuki
characters.description: Shino Shiratsuki is an alumna of Asakumi Girls' High School and the main protagonist of the Shinohayu the Dawn of Age series. Shino is ambidextrous.

characters.name: Hayari Mizuhara
characters.description: Hayari Mizuhara is a professional mahjong player and supporting character in the manga "Saki". Hayari was first mentioned in passing in the anime adaptation of "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A" when she attempted to recruit Harue Akado into her professional team instead of coaching the Achiga mahjong club.

characters.name: Shizuku Nozu
characters.description: A second-year student at Yumachi Middle and the president of their mahjong club.

characters.name: Kyouka Inamura
characters.description: Kanna's best friend a member of Yumachi Middle's mahjong team.

characters.name: Harue Akado
characters.description: Harue Akado is the mahjong club coach at her alma mater Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and is a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". Harue was once known as the "Legend of Achiga" for taking the school to the national high school team mahjong tournament. After the team's defeat, she lost confidence and stopped playing mahjong for some time, leading to the team's eventual disbandment. She was later scouted by a professional team but returns home several years later when the company decides break the team up. ~!Harue's defeat in the national semifinal came at the hand of Sukoya Kokaji, who would eventually become a professional player and commentator in subsequent national high school tournaments in the main "Saki" manga.!~

characters.name: Sukoya Kokaji
characters.description: Sukoya Kokaji is a professional mahjong player and a supporting character of the manga "Saki" and its spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She provides commentary alongside Kouko Fukuyo during the East Tokyo prefectural qualifying tournament and the national tournament. She is also a friend of professional player Yasuko Fujita. Although she is a skilled player, Sukoya does not play in many ranked tournaments, thus her world rank remains at number 973. She previously earned a silver medal in a freestyle tournament in Rio de Janeiro and was a member of the national high school tournament champion team ten years prior. She is the youngest person to hold eight titles in mahjong and was seen on the way to winning a record eight titles four years prior to the main story. ~!During her national high school tournament championship year, Sukoya Kokaji who plays for Tsuchiura Girl's

characters.name: Uta Mihirogi
characters.description: Uta Mihirogi is a professional mahjong player and a supporting character of the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She provides commentary alongside Eri Hariu during the national tournament. Uta is usually seen wearing a kimono and holding a hand fan.

characters.name: Yoshiko Kainou
characters.description: A professional mahjong player.

characters.name: Risa Noyori
characters.description: Risa Noyori is a professional mahjong player and a supporting character of the manga "Saki". She provides commentary alongside Misaki Murayoshi during the national tournament.

characters.name: Kokoro Oroku
characters.description: A young girl with a twisted style of playing mahjong. Despite her cute appearance, she's incredibly competitive and rude.

characters.name: Kazumi Zenno
characters.description: The coach of Himematsu's mahjong team. During the events of the interhigh, she is ill and thus unable to perform her usual coaching duties.

characters.name: Aina Moriwaki
characters.description: A strong but young mahjong player from Shimane.

characters.name: Yuzuha Yukinaga
characters.description: A player for Komosawa Middle School, and Chihiro's best friend.

characters.name: Chihiro Mukunoki
characters.description: Komosawa Middle School's ace, an incredibly skilled mahjong player.

title: Null Meta
description: Kurumi, the dumb android. Chiaki, her guardian with a few screws loose. Sakina, calm, composed, and easily amused. Shiyuki, the only sane(?) girl. Follow their exciting high school life as they tinker with and pamper Kurumi, as well as talk about nothing in particular.

characters.name: Kurumi Uozumi
characters.description: An adorable and enigmatic android created by Chiaki. Despite being an ai, she’s quite dumb.

characters.name: Chiaki Souen
characters.description: A foul-mouthed high school girl and the creator of Kurumi. She modifies Kurumi how she pleases, despite how absurd the modifications may be. She has a few screws loose.

characters.name: Sakina Agoshi
characters.description: A bookish and unsociable high school girl. Chiaki’s childhood friend.

characters.name: Shiyuki Takada
characters.description: A polite high school girl who seems to be the only one in the group who possesses common sense and a functioning moral compass.

title: Outsider Paradise
title_original: アウトサイダーパラダイス
description: A funny and slightly absurd coming-of-age ensemble drama about five outcast high school girls! (Source: Comic Action, translated)

characters.name: Nazuna Saegusa
characters.description: A third-year and the vice-president of the Newspaper Club.

characters.name: Neru Toshiya
characters.description: She is the president of the art club and used to cover her face with a mask in her first appearances. She seems to be addicted to some kind of psychedelic "grass", and is seen using it during artistic euphoria. She's also very fond of Hanako Honda and calls her "Princess Hanako". The student council president thinks her personality resembles Hanako's — similarly bizarre and unhinged.

title: Eromanga Sensei: Yamada Elf Dai-Sensei no Koisuru Junshin Gohan
title_original: エロマンガ先生 山田エルフ大先生の恋する純真ごはん
description: Although Elf Yamada harbors feelings for her rival author, Masamune Izumi, she has never been able to capture his heart, despite trying various tricks. Eromanga-sensei: Yamada Elf Daisensei no Koisuru Junshin Gohan focuses on Elf as she tries to find a way to Masamune's heart through his stomach. Pouring her feelings and sincerity into each dish, will she be able to win his love once and for all?

characters.name: Masamune Izumi
characters.description: __Height:__ 176cm Izumi Masamune is the protagonist of the story. He is a novelist that goes by the pen name "Izumi Masamune," his same name. He started out his novels in middle school after winning a light novel writing contest. He hopes to get closer to his younger step-sister.

characters.name: Elf Yamada
characters.description: Yamada Elf is [Izumi Masamune](https://anilist.co/character/121470)'s fellow author and neighbor. ~!Her actual first name is Emily, as she confesses to Masamune during a stroll through the forest that served as the model for the Elven Forest in Emily's debut novel.!~

title: Hajimete Koi wo Shita.
title_en: I fell in love for the first time.
description: 1-3. Hajimete Koi wo Shita. A girl falls for a woman she sees on the train. A sweet, smutty story. 4. Yuugiri Haruka (Distant Evening Mist) A student and teacher partake of an unusual tradition at a girls school. 5. Harukaze ga Kikoeru 6. Hakui wa Tenshi no Amai Sayaki 7. Piano to Sensei 8. Giniro no Yuki

title: Ikenai Hito
description: Shiraishi is a middle school teacher who is fed up with everything. She was dumped by her longtime girlfriend, and she hates her job. Every day she deals with bratty students and their irrational parents, and today was no different. She was making her usual rounds to her students' homes to speak with their parents, as she approached the last house. Here we go, another crazy parent...she thought to herself. But the woman who came to the door was...beautiful, calm, and extremely her type. (Source: eManga) Note: Originally released as a One Shot online.

title: Tsukiatte Nai Kedo Yarimashita
title_original: 付き合ってないけどやりました

characters.name: Saeko Sawatari
characters.description: Whether concerts or theme parks, she just like things that stimulate her. She dresses like she doesn't really care. Despite that, women love her.

characters.name: Miwa Inuzuka
characters.description: **Height:** 166 cm (5'5") She got her hair styled like [Shiina Ringo](https://anilist.co/staff/103213) in order to fuel her creative process. Likes the fine arts and literature, but also enjoys more niche, sub-cultural hobbies.

title: Joshi-man.
description: Two high school girls spring into erotic manga! Tanaka is a pure-hearted gal who likes to draw Shoujo Manga, and Terao is a plain, expressionless girl who is active as an erotic manga artist. Watch two complete opposites step into the depth and potential of the of erotic manga world! Note: Includes two extras chapters.

title: Gakuen Police
description: As a child, Sasami Aoba fantasized about becoming a defender of justice, like the magical girls and "Sentai Rangers" she admired on TV. Years have passed and now Sasami has become a police officer herself. Her first assignment is to infiltrate Hanagaki All-Girls High School and ferret out any trouble she may find. On her first day posing as a student, Sasami is shocked to discover that an apparent book thief at school is actually another undercover police officer, Sakuraba Midori. What's more, Midori insists that she herself is the officer in charge of the school, not Sasami. Will the two girls become rivals, partners...or something more? (Source: Seven Seas)

title: Qiguai De Qingdi Zengjia Le
description: I was hit by a car... then transmigrated into my favorite game?! It seems I have some major issues! First of all, I don’t remember who I was before the accident. Second, I’m the villainess in this game! Luckily, I transmigrated to a point in the story where I’m still a child, so there is still time to change my fate. I know those close to me will betray me, and I remember what turns me wicked. If I can just lift my mother’s curse and master my powers, maybe I can turn my life around. I just have to save myself before it’s too late! (Source: Tapas)

title: EARTH GIRLS
description: Saqina sets out for Smoky Mountain to follow in her mother's footsteps as a hunter, but on the way, she rescues--and instantly falls for--a frail but sharp-tongued girl named Yume, who happens to live there herself. When Yume leads her to the village, Saqina is shocked to find out that there are no men there, just girls and lesbian couples. Not only that, her new crush is married to the chief Kidaha, who happens to be a lazy philanderess with several wives and counting! Can Saqina win Yume's love even if it means stealing from her new leader? (Source: Coolmic)

title: Sakisome Complex
title_original: 咲きそめコンプレックス
description: Riko Kohinata has never been particularly interested in romance. However, she doesn't make a big deal about it, unwilling to admit it to herself or others. One day, while studying at her classmate Tomoka's house, a young girl wearing a school backpack comes in! It turned out that Tomoka has a younger sister who's an elementary school student. Riko is so captivated by the cute little girl that time seems to stand still, but the younger sister reacts to Riko with hostility instead… A heartwarming story of a high school girl who loves children and an elementary school girl who wants to grow up. This age-gap girls' love comedy is about to begin! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mayu no Uta
description: "I'll be your mother." After losing her biological mother, Mayu Kanda was abused by her guardian uncle every day, and could barely eat properly, but she just laughed it off. Until she met a mysterious beauty, Kamakura Komachi, who suddenly appeared. Is she, who acts like a mother, a ray of hope for Mayu? Or...? (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: White Lilies in Love: BRIDE's - Shinkon Yuri Anthology
title_original: White Lilies in Love BRIDE's 新婚百合アンソロジー
description: This is an anthology full of newlywed yuri themed stories. The book includes Haru Hisakawa’s Yome ga Toutoi (lit. My Bride is Precious), which is about a woman being concerned about her bride who is avoiding sex immediately after getting married. Kozumi Miura’s Watashi no Kanojo ga Kawaii Riyuu (lit. The Reason Why My Girlfriend is so Cute) depicts a couple’s newlywed feelings, who has been in love for 10 years and has just started to live together. Ryo Tsuzu’s Kitsune no Yomeiri tells the story of a woman who lost her lover just shortly before their wedding. This volume includes the following chapters: 1. Yome ga Toutoi (嫁が尊い) [Hisakawa Haru] 2. Watashi no Kanojo ga Kawaii Riyuu (私の彼女が可愛い理由) [Miura Koizumi] 3. Hodokeru Kesshou (ほどける結晶) [Inui Ayu] 4. Cinderella Matchmaking (シンデレラマッチメイキング) [Ahiru] 5. Kitsune no Yomeiri (狐の嫁入り) [Tsuzura Ryou] 6. Kaku Shite Futari wa Kono Saki mo (斯くして二人はこの先も) [Kiriyama Haruka] 7. Kekkon-Rikon wa Goshichaku no Ue (結婚・離婚はご試着の上) [Hazuki Ruri]

title: Akogare no Maid-san wa Tabaco ga Niau
title_original: 憧れのメイドさんはタバコが似合う
title_en: The Maid I Admire Looks Good with a Cigarette
description: Veteran maid Hijiri is admired by her junior coworker and rookie maid, Suu. Through Hijiri, Suu is sucked into a new world of heart-pounding moments! A smoking-sweet romance brought to life by a cast of uniquely charming maids. (Source: Manga UP!)

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Hirukowashi-hen
title_original: ひぐらしのなく頃に 昼壊し編
description: Hirukowashi-hen is based on Higurashi Daybreak. The main characters are Keiichi Maebara and Rika Furude, and this story is set in a parallel world. One day, Rena accidentally swallows something in her mouth during her usual treasure hunting. According to Rika, the seal of the sacred "Fuwarazu Magatama" pairs were broken and Rena must have accidentally swallowed one of them. The magatama holds mysterious magical powers in which a person that has the red magatama will blindly fall in love with anyone with the white magatama. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Rena Ryuuguu
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2'') Rena is a girl who returned from Ibaraki to Hinamizawa one year ago and now is in the same grade level as [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi). She is very kind and capable and takes care of Keiichi and her friends whenever possible, but is also naive and is usually subject to light teasing by Keiichi. She is distinguished by her obsession with things she perceives as adorable, calling them kāii (かぁいい), a slurred form of kawaii (かわいい) meaning "cute." Those tend to be moekko characters or items she finds while scouring the local dump, which are not considered cute by others. Despite this disarming trait, Rena is shown to be amazingly observant and perceptive about the things around her.

characters.name: Rika Furude
characters.description: Rika Furude is one of the younger students in [Keiichi's](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi) school, and is in the same grade level as [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko). Naturally, she is great friends with her, as they live together in the same house. She is revered by the villagers as the heir of the local shrine, and plays the role of a miko in the annual Watanagashi Festival. She has been the head of the Furude house since her parents died, but rarely attends town meetings due to her young age. While she does not speak a lot, she likes to say nonsense words such as "mi~" and "nipa~" and often ends her sentences with "-nano desu", which inflames [Rena's](https://anilist.co/character/1427/Ryuuguu-Rena) passion for cute things. Despite her young appearance, she is rather calm and reserved-usually serving as the voice of reason amongst the club mem

characters.name: Mion Sonozaki
characters.description: Mion is the oldest kid in [Keiichi Maebara](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s class. As the elder, she is the class president and everyone looks up to her as the leader. She acts like a perverted tomboy and calls herself old man, but has a hidden girlish side. Mion is next in line to be the head of the Sonozaki household, one of the Three Families which holds tremendous influence in Hinamizawa. Often when playing games with her fellow club members she is known for her ruthlessness, often coming up with the most embarrassing penalties for the losers. Mion also serves as the leader of the main characters' gaming club. ~!Mion is more stable than the other club members, and as such has never herself succumbed to Hinamizawa Syndrome!~

characters.name: Satoko Houjou
characters.description: Satoko is a younger classmate in [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s school. She has a distinctive style of speech, ending all of her sentences with 'wa' which, at times, is grammatically incorrect. In spite of her young age, she is quite clever in setting up traps, and likes to practice on Keiichi. Despite her extremely energetic and playful disposition she is actually quite the crybaby, which [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion) and Keiichi often tease her about. Satoko is also very close with [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika), who she lives with. ~!Although her personality is quite energetic and mischievous during the events of the games, Satoko's past was full of trauma; her parents died in an accident, she was abused by her foster parents (her aunt and uncle), and her beloved brother Satoshi disappeared. However, in M

characters.name: Keiichi Maebara
characters.description: Keiichi is the son of a famous and extremely wealthy artist and has recently moved to Hinamizawa after an array of unfortunate events in his hometown. His charismatic, lively attitude and talented tongue allow him to quickly fit in the town and make new friends and also win some club activities. Though he can be somewhat shy and is easily spooked at times. ~! In the first couple arcs, paranoia drives him to murder his friends and others, but in the other arcs, he gains inner strength and faith in his friends, enough to change the fate of Hinamizawa, sometimes by remembering the events of Onikakushi-hen.!~ When in need of a weapon, he wields Satoshi's old bat. Keiichi often receives the butt of the jokes in the club's activities from which he was the correct answer to some games they play, to wearing embarrassing costumes whenever he loses punishment games. Keiichi has brown hair with dar

characters.name: Hanyuu Furude
characters.description: Hanyuu is the mysterious "transfer student" in Matsuribayashi-hen. She has a pair of dark colored horns on her head, one of which is chipped slightly (however, no one seems to notice or mention them, with the exception of [Takano](https://anilist.co/character/4934/Takano-Miyo), who calls her a "monster"). In fact, she has appeared to [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) all her life, but only in Matsuribayashi-hen and Miotsukushi-hen did she gain the power to interact with others, posing as a distant relative of Rika's and given the name "Hanyuu Furude." Like many of the characters, she can be frightening when angered, and with her spirit-like nature, her appearance can change with her mood until she takes a physical form. She is very meek and often makes the noise "Au au, au au…" when she is nervous or uncomfortable, or sometimes while trying to make a point. She also t

characters.name: Kuraudo Ooishi
characters.description: Kuraudo Oishi is a veteran police investigator at Okinomiya who has vowed to solve the mystery of the Hinamizawa murders before his retirement, due to personal reasons. Due to his uncouth tactics and the lengths that he goes to in order to solve the mystery, he is looked upon as a nuisance by the villagers. ~!He approaches one of the main characters to become his informant in several arcs, and is sometimes unwittingly responsible for triggering their paranoia.!~

characters.name: Miyo Takano
characters.description: Miyo is a nurse at the village clinic who has a keen interest in Hinamizawa's past and culture, recording all her speculation in notebooks. At times, her storytelling can be very mysterious and chilling—she seems to enjoy putting people on edge. ~!In the first six arcs, she consistently disappears on the night of Watanagashi, and an incinerated body thought to be hers is found in the mountains. Later, however, it turns out that she is the mastermind of the events taking place in Hinamizawa who wants to murder [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) so she can prove her grandfather's research. Since her will and manipulations are so strong as to affect the people in the village both directly and indirectly, she infact fakes her death through the first six arcs of the story (the corpse in the barrel being a stolen corpse), and murders Rika in three of the arcs which she uses

characters.name: Rumiko Chie
characters.description: Rumiko is the female teacher of Keiichi's class, who is a parody character of Tsukihime's Ciel-Senpai (permission for her usage was given by Type-Moon). The seiyū for her character in the anime series is the same as the seiyū of Ciel from the Tsukihime anime. Going along with the parody, her favorite food is curry rice, just like Ciel, and will go to great and somewhat scary, lengths to uphold the honor of curry, which is shown in the Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei OVA, where she becomes enraged by Keichi's "offense" to curry. On a stronger note, she is seen wielding wooden T's, shapped, and held, in exactly the same fashion as the Black Keys from Tsukihime.

characters.name: Mamoru Akasaka
characters.description: He is a young police investigator at the Metropolitan Police Department in Tokyo. He befriended [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) while investigating a case in Hinamizawa four years ago, all due to a prophecy about his wife which came true, though he just brushed it off as coincidence.

characters.name: Jirou Tomitake
characters.description: A photographer who frequently visits the village of Hinamizawa (especially during the Watangashi Festival). ~!In every arc, he ends up being the killed victim of Oyashiro-sama's curses on the night of the Festival. During the Festival, he is still alive and looking happy but his manner of death shows that he tore at his own throat with his own fingers. The baffled police autopsies seemingly results with his body having no trace of drugs having been injected to cause him to do such an act of madness. He also has a good partnership with Takano Miyo (who is also a 'victim' of the yearly curses). It is revealed in Kai that he has affections for Takano and she plays along with his attraction for her. He falsely laughs when he tries to avoid a question or is told a foreboding prophecy about himself but looks willing to help Takano to discover the mystery of Oyashiro-sama's curses. !~ Not much

characters.name: Yasunori Ryuuguu
characters.description: Rena's Father

title: citrus Special Anthology: LOVELY PARTY
description: Anthology added as a bonus book with the special edition of Citrus volume 8. Story 1 : a sign (Kunerin) Story 2 : Cry, Baby, Cry (Kiyoko Iwami) Story 3 : How it looks in the heart ( Yayoi Osawa) Story 4 : I wanna know more (Aya Oryu) Story 5 : Does as the king demands! (Yuki Yukio) Story 6 : Girls Love Lesson (Naoko Kodama) Story 7 : Change! (Hibiki Aoto) Story 8 : Panic attack (merryhachi) Story 9 : Continue (Yuki Goto) Story 10 : In and Out (Ako Katakura) Story 11 : An excuse that I'm honest with (tMnR)

characters.name: Mei Aihara
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Mei Aihara is an honor student, the chairman's granddaughter, and the stern and cold student council president. She is often calm and composed but she can be rather sensitive and mature to some extent. At first, there is little to know about her and a bad impression of Mei washes over [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/83367/Aihara-Yuzu), which causes Yuzu to take interest for Mei later on. Though Mei seems to be hard to approach, she is rather sensitive and lonely which makes Yuzu want to care for Mei more.

characters.name: Yuzu Aihara
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm The self-proclaimed Gyaru and only child, Yuzu transfers to an all-girls school after her mother is remarried. Yuzu is outspoken, daring, and shameless to some extent. She is often seen wearing her uniform that runs against the rules thus far. Unfortunately for her, she is bothered by the Student Council President's dress code enforcement. Yuzu eventually comes home to hear that she is now the older sister of the Student Council President, [Mei Aihara](https://anilist.co/character/83209/Aihara-Mei). Despite showing irritation towards Mei, she becomes concerned for her in which transitions into infatuation and deep care. Though she is rebellious in school, she means well and is often acting on behalf of Mei in a sense of protection. Also, her closest friend in school is [Harumin](https://anilist.co/character/83387/Taniguchi-Harumi).

characters.name: Harumi Taniguchi
characters.description: Harumi, most known as "Harumin", befriends Yuzuko being that she is a "Gyaru in Disguise". As she isn't one of the students who have been attending the academy since Elementary School, she takes no interest in following around the Student Council President and often packs items within her cleavage. As an individual, Harumi is perky, caring and an overall good friend towards Yuzuko.

characters.name: Matsuri Mizusawa
characters.description: Matsuri is a second-year in middle school and Yuzu's childhood friend who lived close to her before she moved to the Aihara residence. Matsuri makes her first appearance in chapter 8. She is a pretty girl who is always seen with a pair of headphones around her neck. being very sly and fake toward an unidentified friend. She comes across Yuzu and Harumin at an arcade and invites them out to karaoke. Harumin is appears to be quite wary and suspicious of her. Upon deducing the nature of Yuzu's feelings toward Mei, Matsuri professes a romantic interest in Yuzu and kisses her in front of Mei. She sells masturbation videos she finds on the Internet to old men through a phone app, and tells them they are hers, as a means of income. She considers men to be dense and believes that all can be manipulated easily.

characters.name: Himeko Momokino
characters.description: Himeko is a Student Council Member and Mei's childhood friend. Himeko has a rather stuck-up and stubborn personality, and despises people who don't follow the school regulations.

title: Gu Xiaojie He Qu Xiaojie
description: "I'm actually doing this because of you, Miss Gu." Top actress Qu Xizhi makes an unconventional decision to take on a male lead role so she can work with Gu Xizhi, another actress who shares her name. The talented yet envious Gu Xizhi worries that Qu will once again outshine her in this new drama, but is determined to give her all to the show. Once the filming begins, Gu must shoot numerous intimate scenes with Qu, whose cross-dressing is remarkably convincing. Can Gu keep up the act, or will it lead to something more... real? (Source: Tappytoon)

title: Kutsuzure Sensen: Majo Vasenka no Sensou
title_original: 靴ずれ戦線 -魔女ワーシェンカの戦争-
description: It is 1943 in Soviet Russia during the war. Nadya, an officer, and Vasenka, a witch, are looking for their allies. All they can do is walk until they find them. In the mean time, they get into silly little adventures and experience some weird stuff.

characters.name: Vasilisa Medvedeva
characters.description: One of the two protagonists of the manga. Young slavic pagan witch. Descendant of Pagan god Veles and famous russian witch Baba Yaga(Old hug Yaga). Vasilisa is eccentric and carefree but always proactive and cares a lot of her comrades.

characters.name: Nadejda Norshtein
characters.description: Young chekist(soviet secret police) officer and Vasen'ka's friend. She is strict and takes her duties high in contrast to carefree Vasilisa. Nadya dislikes "unscientific" things despite common encounters with different spirits and magic. She is quite skilled shooter and subversive.

title: Shinyuu ni Sukina Hito ga Dekitarashii
title_original: 親友に好きな人ができたらしい
description: Ayame was dumped by her boyfriend and decides to move in with her best friend, Emma. On the day of the move, Emma cut her hair short, saying, "I want to do everything I can for the person I love." This is the story of Ayame, who longs for "ordinary" happiness, and Emma, ​​who is more of a free spirit. (Source: Pixiv, translated)

title: Kousoku Play
description: "Will you be my dog?" What connected two girls hiding the darkness in their hearts is…a collar and a red rope... (Source: Coolmic)

title: Betsukiss
description: April is a vampire who is freeloading at Hikari's house. She needs food to sustain her body, and that is...

characters.name: April
characters.description: April is a vampire girl who free loads at Hikari's house. She uses Hikari's "body fluid" to sustain her vampiric hunger. She likes red things.

title: Kotoba no Tsuujinai Kimi to
description: Two women from different countries find each other in the Philippines. Even if they can't directly communicate with each other, some feelings can be understood without words.

title: Geunyeowa Geunyeoui Jeon Namjachingu
description: I was never curious about my girlfriend's past...until that incident! Now I'm just dying to know! Who is this ex-boyfriend? Why is he acting so friendly? What happened between them in the past?! It sure isn't your typical love triangle. (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Air Master
description: By day, highschool girl Aikawa Maki is a normal girl who has fun with her classmates Yuu, Michiru, Renge and Mina. By night however, where streetfights take place, she becomes an unrivaled lethal air-borne attacks user with a succession of victories: Airmaster. Various strong people, fascinated by this girl's strength, will come to challenge her in battle...this vivid street-fighting comic starts here!!!

characters.name: Maki Aikawa
characters.description: Formerly a gymnast who trained under her now-deceased mother, Maki uses her acrobatic skills in her fighting style to increase her freedom of movement. She has the ability to replicate nearly any move she gets hit with or sees. In Tojima Wants to be a Kamen Rider she always wears a tiger mask. She is a martial artist and [Futaba's](https://anilist.co/character/382892/Futaba-Shimamura) master.

characters.name: Mina Nakanotani
characters.description: One of Maki's shyer friends, who goes to a presumably rich, private school. Mina has ridiculously exaggerated, large breasts, normally used as a source of humor rather than fan service, and she is extremely self conscious about it. In addition to this, Mina is hopelessly in love with Maki, who is not sure how to handle the matter, making this the main reason her friends make fun of her. However, like Maki, she has her share of admirers as well; including Reiishi Mishima and many members of Kinjirou's Black Suit gang. She has been a fan of Nanjou Remon's novels since she was a kid. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Renge Inui
characters.description: The group's extremely short friend. Renge has a penchant for eating obsessively, yet she is always thin (Although, sometimes, when she eats a lot, she is shown to have a belly). Renge is the stereotypical, overexcited kid, with a tendency to whine, but she mostly serves as a cheering squad. She later acquires a kitten that she carries with her most of the time. Much to her friends surprise, she has two younger sisters named Men-Men and Mikan, who both look identical to Renge. She is good friends with Tsukio, and usually gives him money for breakfast. Her features resemble that of "Astro Girl." (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Julietta Sakamoto
characters.description: A scruffy but handsome ghost writer who becomes obsessed with Maki (romantically), while the latter is totally uninterested in him and finds his behavior very creepy. He is a smooth talker but prone to overly aggressive declarations of love, sometimes bordering on assault, towards Maki, who he calls "My Jenny". He tends to always kiss her and declare his love for her when they're together, even during their fights, throwing her off balance. This is usually done for comedic effect. He has three women who are head over heels for him: Uzumi Mika (a famous singer), Nono Rakuko (a famous model), and Nanjou Remon (a famous novelist). He ignores them all since he's fixed on marrying Maki and making her move in with him. Maki is physically capable of beating him down in his insane-like "distracted" state of mind (Julietta rarely gets serious with anyone—he&#03

characters.name: Shinnosuke Tokita
characters.description: A guy who challenges Maki early on, but later temporarily joins the group. He seems to have a crush on Maki. He fights with a long staff that can separate into three parts connected with a chain. He seems to know the art of the Drunken Fist.

characters.name: Kinjirou Kitaeda
characters.description: Leader of the League of Black-suited Gentlemen. He claims to hate women yet he likes Maki because he thinks she's different. He's a good fighter and has great punching power. He once took down a bear with one punch. He has a technique where he can create an afterimage of himself attacking so the opponent will be fooled into acting prematurely. He had his first kiss stolen by one of his male subordinates, Nagato the long fist, while Nagato fights Fukamichi. Kinjiro is ranked ninth within the Fukamichi rankings.

title: Sakana no Miru Yume
description: Since their mother's death, sisters Tomoe and Mikage have been mostly raising each other. The older sister, Tomoe, is determined to get good grades and work her way into a good college. However, she's disturbed by the trouble Mikage sometimes gives her. For instance, at the beginning of the manga, Mikage sneakily locks a collar around her older sister's neck, forcing her to go through the day wearing it. Mikage wants Tomoe to think only of her, and her affection may be beyond sisterly love. However, at school, Mikage has made a new female 'friend' that has a serious crush on her. The two sisters have their separate lives at their respective schools, but their life together and their relationship may be most important of all. Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

title: Steps
description: Ah-chan and Ryouko, childhood friends eight years apart, are now teacher and student. Though Ryouko wants to rush into things, Ah-chan can’t take one step beyond her role as a teacher. After receiving a matching cellphone charm as a present, Ah-chan buys paired rings for a return gift, only to realise that she’s lost the charm…!? The distance between them shrinks away in “STEP UP”; a girl in love with Ryouko appears in “STEP FORWARD”; and then “step by step” calls for tears of joy with wedding dress x wedding dress… The road to love between Ryouko and Ah-chan is bountiful. Also included are “Leave Hickey?”, about the radiant proof of love school girl Kimu carves into the body of the art teacher Miyano-sensei; and “Secret Love”, not previously published in a commercial magazine!

title: Koi to Yobu ni wa Aosugiru
title_original: 恋と呼ぶには青すぎる
description: A working girls' love story between an izakaya waitress and an office lady. Kyoko, who works at an izakaya, has a crush on Midori, a regular customer at the bar. Kyoko worries about Midori, who gets pushed around by her unfaithful boyfriend, but she kept her feelings to herself. One day, however, Midori's boyfriend comes to the bar with another woman, and......? (Source: it Comics, translated) Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title: Ise-san to Shima-san
description: Ise and Shima, both in their fourth year of working, are sharing a room. In order to escape their boring lives, they decide to "challenge" each other every month to do various things. One day, the challenge is to "fall in love"? Be cute! The challenge is to become a more conscious member of society! This is a comedy about living together, where every day turns into something fun little by little!

title: Sae-ism
title_en: The Love and Creed of Sae Maki
description: In the month since she transferred to a new school, Misao hasn't made any friends. Instead, she's been teased and bullied by some of the more aggressive girls in class. This all changes on the day Sae returns to school. Sae is good at everything, and everyone at school adores her—but Sae seems to want only to be friends with Misao. All the bullying stops immediately, and Misao is thrilled to be best friends with the most popular girl in school. Sadly, things really are too good to be true. Sae starts to become more and more domineering, preventing Misao from making other friends and insisting on controlling how she spends all her time. As Sae's friendship becomes more and more nightmarish, someone reaches out to Misao to try to help her break free. But is it already too late? (Source: MangaHelpers) Note: Originally completed with 17 chapters in four volumes in 2016, serialization was continued starting 2018-05-22.

title: Yuliqueur: Alcohol x Yuri Anthology
title_original: ユリキュール　アルコール百合アンソロジー
description: An anthology featuring the love of alcohol and girls from Ichijinsha. Cover illustration: Haruka Kiriyama Chapter 1: Itadakenai hito by 2C=Galore Chapter 2: Konya wa horoyoide by Kaya Yoshino Chapter 3: Dosokai wa karasawagi!? by Yuuki Gotou Chapter 4: Uwaki (Unfaithful) by Mochi Au Lait Chapter 5: Kijo ni suki o ataetara by Chikore Chapter 6: Tasukete! O sake shoshinshadesu! by Kashikaze Chapter 7: O sake no Chikara wa idaidesu by Yuki Yukio Chapter 8: Enjerukisu in za daku by Yonurime Chapter 9: Gogatsu no koto by Ori Mita Chapter 10: Shokora (Chocolate) by Imai

title: Fushigi na Neko no Machi Meltier
title_original: ふしぎな猫のまちメルティア
description: This is the cat town of "Meltier". Moco, who has no memories of the past, starts helping out at a café in the town. There, she encounters many unique and delightful kitten friends! A slightly mysterious and exceptionally happy heartwarming everyday fairy tale fantasy! (Source: Ciao, translated)

characters.name: Moco
characters.description: An orphan girl with no memories. She ended up in Meltier Town thanks to a mysterious letter from Makia.

characters.name: Makia
characters.description: The boss at Cafe Katze. She takes care of orphan kittens.

characters.name: Lucola
characters.description: A girl that lives in the house next door to Cafe Katze, and is an usual client at the Cafe. She is proficient at levitation magic.

characters.name: Nagi
characters.description: Nagi is a talented magician that loves lazing around. She can act mean if her rest is interrupted, but she cares about her friends deeply.

characters.name: Suzu
characters.description: A little girl found by Nagi who becomes very attached to Moco. ~!She adopts this form after being cured from Crantia by Moco!~

characters.name: Loco
characters.description: Lucola's sister. She lives outside the town and is a researcher.

characters.name: Haru
characters.description: An orphan kitten being taken care of at Cafe Katze

characters.name: Fuu
characters.description: An orphan kitten being taken care of at Cafe Katze, while also helping out.

characters.name: Hime
characters.description: A young kitten living in the town of Meltier. She has been raised by a kind old lady and dreams of becoming someone like her.

characters.name: Naa
characters.description: A lost kitten found by Moco in a forest. She seems to have amnesia.

title: Kamisama no Ekohiiki
description: To gain the confidence to confess his love to his crush, high school student Yashiro visits a secluded shrine for 100 days straight. This earns him the attention of the enshrined deity and his fox attendant Ukon who follow Yashiro on the 100th day to see how the confession turns out. However, they are surprised to see him confess to a guy, Yashiro's longtime friend Kenta, only for Kenta to turn him down. Although heartbroken, Yashiro tries to joke around with Kenta, but he accidentally gets killed when a truck runs into him. Yashiro awakens in the presence of the shrine's god and Ukon, and as a show of gratitude, the god decides to restore him back to life to give him a second chance with Kenta. In doing so, the god grants his wish to be reborn as a high school girl and gives her the name Kagura Tendou. However, she soon discovers that the god and Ukon plan to watch over her relationship with Kenta, although she's the only one who can see and hear them.

title: Blue Archive: Game Kaihatsubu Daibouken!
title_original: ブルーアーカイブ ゲーム開発部だいぼうけん！
title_en: Blue Archive: The Grand Adventure of the Game Development Department
description: From the hit game Blue Archive, a spinoff manga about the Millenium Science School’s Game Development Department! Follow the four members of the GDD—Momoi, Midori, Yuzu and Aris—as they navigate the springtime of their youth full of friendship, adventure and hilariously chaotic mishaps on the daily. Brought to you by the masterful comedy manga creator Asato Mizu, an adorable story that will make you laugh and cry! (Source: Manga UP!)

characters.name: Momoi Saiba
characters.description: __Academy:__ Millennium Science School __Year:__ 1st Year __Height:__ 143cm (4'8") The scenario writer for the Game Development Department at Millennium. Both she and her younger twin sister, Midori are in charge of developing video games for the group. Although her cheerful personality is the polar opposite to her shy sister, their passion for games are strikingly similar, which make them both great partners.

characters.name: Midori Saiba
characters.description: __Academy:__ Millennium Science School __Year:__ 1st Year __Height:__ 143cm (4'8") She is the illustrator for the Game Development Department, and works alongside her twin sister Momoi to develop video games. She is very shy and reserved, in contrast to her sister's cheerful and excitable demeanor. Despite their differences, they have unrivaled passion in working together when it comes to games, and have grown close as a result.

characters.name: Alice Tendou
characters.description: **Height**: 152cm Alice Tendou is a student of Millennium and member of the Game development club. She is a mysterious girl who was found sleeping inside some ruins. All information regarding her origin and age is unknown. Currently, she enjoys playing videogames with [Momoi](https://anilist.co/character/292756/Momoi-Saiba), [Midori](https://anilist.co/character/292757/Midori-Saiba) and [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/292759/Yuzu-Hanaoka) and has become a serious video game fanatic. The majority of her inarticulate speech is comprised of dialogue from retro games.

characters.name: Yuzu Hanaoka
characters.description: __Academy:__ Millenium Science School __Year:__ 1st Year __Height:__ 150cm President of Millennium's Games Development Department Yuzu struggles with social anxiety and finds it difficult to deal with people, so she spends most of her time in a cabinet in the Games Development Department. Despite that, her passion for games is second to none. She loves making and playing games. Yuzu's hobbies is she likes to make video games.

characters.name: Yuuka Hayase
characters.description: __Academy:__ Millennium Science School __Year:__ 2nd Year __Height:__ 5'1" The treasurer of Seminar, the student council of the Millennium Science School. Yuuka has a mathematical acumen that is notable even among Millennium's high ratio of STEM students. She oversees the entirety of Millennium's budget. Her special talent is the abacus, and she has a habit of fiddling with the beads when dealing with emotional or mental conflicts.

title: Weight Lovers
description: "Did you know that when someone is united with the person they love, their body weight increases by 1.6 pounds?" A short story about the weight of love. Source: Manga Updates

title: Ne Nampyeoneul Jugigo Sipeo
description: So should we kill your husband? Your shaky demeanor, the bruises on your face... It killed me to see how you'd changed after getting married. Maybe we should just kill your husband. But how? Will our lives ever be the same again? Fate must have been on our side, because everything went smoother than expected. (Source: Manta) Note: This series contains upsetting contents such as murder and domestic abuse. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: I Segyeneun Naui Geot
description: U-Yeon is a reclusive web fiction writer. Her mundane life is changed forever when Princess Charlize Rod Crosel, a minor character in one of her bestselling web fictions, decides to take destiny into her own hands by kidnapping U-Yeon and bringing her into the fictional world. Will U-Yeon and Charlize be given the opportunity to change the future and find their happy ending? (Source: POCKET COMICS, edited)

title: Kaede to Suzu
description: A miracle occurs when they sync up...!? (Source: Fakku!) Notes: - Published in Comic Bavel 2018-04, 2019-01, 09, 2020-10, 11, 2021-08, 2022-05, 2023-08, 2024-08, 2025-01 - Chapter 1 & 2 were included in Bavel Comics "Lovely ♡" - Chapter 3 & 4 were included in Bavel Comics "Love Me ♡" - Chapter 5 & 6 were included in Bavel Comics "Love You ♥" - A live-action AV adaptation (MUDR-278) was released on November 11th, 2024.

title: Kanaria wa Kiraboshi no Yume wo Miru
title_original: カナリアは綺羅星の夢をみる
description: Ayano, a schoolgirl who dreams of a career in fashion, meets a beautiful girl on the day she attends her first ball. Attracted to the girl known as Tsubakihime, who looks unlike any Japanese person, Ayano's dreams grow. However, her mother, who is not a fan of Ayano's hobbies, plots to block her path, while Tsubakihime seems to have her own circumstances... A romantic tale of girls chasing their dreams set in the Taisho era. (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Watashi no Tomodachi ga Sekai-ichi Kawaii.
title_original: 私の友達が世界一かわいい。
description: Saionji Koharo is an admirable student council president. A beautiful and flouncy lady that happens to always be followed around by a girl named Mirai.

title: Furumapura
description: Energetic girl Kyou meets quiet girl Makoto, who only communicates using sign boards numbered 1 to 10. At first, these polar opposites interact rather one-sidedly, but gradually become able to understand each other's feelings. Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Aru Hi Kareshi ga Onnanoko ni Natte Shimatta Couple no Nichijou
title_original: ある日彼氏が女の子になってしまったカップルの日常
description: One day, my boyfriend became a girl......!? I wondered what would happen, but surprisingly, having a girl as my boyfriend is pretty nice......? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Yuri Yuri
description: A series of yuri one-shots by Namori. Note: Originally self-published starting at Comiket 75, it was picked up for serialization in Comic Yuri-Hime starting 2019-06-18. Volume 1: 1. Yuri Yuri 1 (ゆりゆり１) 2. Yuri Yuri 2 (ゆりゆり２) 3. Yuri Yuri 3 (ゆりゆり３) 4. Yuri Yuri 4 (ゆりゆり４) 5. Yuri Yuri 5 (ゆりゆり５) 6. Yuri Yuri after (ゆりゆりafter) Volume 2: 7. Ayumi to Misaki no Baai (あゆみと美咲の場合) 8. Nao to Chika no Baai (奈央と千佳の場合) 9. Shiho to Kanako no Baai (志保と佳奈子の場合) 10. Ema to Midori no Baai (恵真と翠の場合) 11. Natsuki to Rika no Baai (夏樹と梨花の場合)

title: Yingye Zhong Qing San Lian
description: When a struggling vlogger meets a superstar writer, what could go wrong? Everything! Nothing has gone right since meeting her! Hu Luoluo, on the brink of losing her vlogger contract, gets involved with the scandal-ridden writer Song Li purely by accident. All of a sudden, they've become a trending topic, touted as a couple, and blowing up her viewer traffic... Is this what it takes to finally make it as a vlogger? (Source: Dongman, translated)

title: Yuki wa Jigoku ni Ochiru no ka
title_original: ユキは地獄に堕ちるのか
description: The "military history story concerning boys and girls" revolves around Yuki, a girl who has lived in the rural area of Kyoto with her five childhood friends who all share a secret that they cannot tell anyone. On her 16th birthday, Yuki's fate begins to change.

characters.name: Akira Mibu
characters.description: Akira Mibu, also known as Aki-chan, is a very dear childhood friend of Yuki, whom he mostly listens to.

title: Valkyrie Drive: Mermaid
title_original: ヴァルキリードライヴ マーメイド
description: Tokonome Mamori is transferred to "Mermaid"—an artificial quarantine island for people with superpowers. When Mamori is attacked, a newly transferred girl named Mirei saves her. The enemy doesn't stop, however, and the two are soon cornered. Just when they think all hope is lost, Mirei kisses Mamori, and Mamori turns into a sword. Mirei then wields the sword and launches a counterattack against their enemies. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Kimi no Tame ni Sekai wa Aru
title_original: きみのために世界はある
description: A oneshot collection. 1. Kimi no Tame ni Sekai wa Aru (きみのために世界はある) 2. Arashi ga Kitarite (あらしが来たりて) 3. Friday Night Cinema (フライデー・ナイトシネマ) 4. Secret Closet (シークレットクローゼット) 5. Cast a Spell 6. Jewel of You

title: Kono Sankaku Love Kome wa Shiawase ni Naru Gime ga Aru.
title_original: この△ラブコメは幸せになる義務がある。
description: The unprecedented, most precious love-triangle romantic comedy in history, is about to begin! In the new school year, Tenma Yashiro, an ordinary high school boy, is in the same class with two most beautiful girls in school, Reira Tsubaki and Rinka Kou. Rira is happy and innocent, while Rinka is cool and stand-offish. Tenma wants to keep his distance from these two overwhelmingly beautiful girls and lead a peaceful school life, but one day, he discovers Rinka's forbidden secret, and his life changes drastically...? (Source: Comic Alive, translated)

title: Brain Damage
description: Brain Damage collects four new short manga stories, a tantalizing blend of the hilarious and the macabre. In “Labyrinth Quartet,” four identical young women trapped in an eerie building must solve the mystery of why they’ve been gathered there — while being hunted by a knife-wielding stalker. In “Curse Room,” a plucky health aide is tasked with keeping zombies peaceful, lest they go on a brain-eating rampage. In “Family Portrait,” people throughout town are strangely disappearing without a trace, and the key to it all is a senile and perverted old man. Finally, in “Blood Harvest” a series of gruesomely mangled bodies are found in pristine cars — and it appears something sinister lurks within these masses of glass and steel. (Source: Fantagraphics) 1) 4-nin no Meikyuu (4人の迷宮) 2) Noroi no Heya (呪いの部屋) 3) Kazoku no Shouzou (家族の肖像) 4) Chi no Shuukaku (血の収穫)

title: Tenbin wa Hana to Asobu
description: Lotus Girls' Academy. A school whose aim is to educate young girls to be pure and modest. Youko is a new transfer student here, and immediately takes a liking to Shuu, who shows her around the school. However, Youko discovers a big secret about Shuu... she's a vampire! Youko then does her best to be the best friend she can be and help Shuu protect her secret... whether Shuu likes it or not! But how does Shuu really feel about Youko... and why does her blood taste so different? And to what lengths will Youko go to help Shuu?

title: Orange Yellow
description: We walk hand-in-hand in the yellow morning sunlight and in the orange sunset… What wonderful school days we spend together. Fujino Miyuki and Mizutani Jun are childhood friends and next door neighbors. This is their short love story in a literature club. Contains the short stories Tear Potion , Katakoi Hime , Magical Chocolate and The Proof of Her Love .

characters.name: Mizuno
characters.description: She believes she is a 'reincarnation' of a mermaid. She is popular in the class. Mizuno also likes her teacher, Fukami, but she knew her feelings won't be returned since Fukami is getting married to the math teacher of their school.

characters.name: Ooishi
characters.description: She believes it's easier not to love. In the beginning, she rejects a confession from a guy. She falls in love with Mizuno at the end of the one shot.

characters.name: Fukami
characters.description: Teacher of the Classic Literature class. She is getting married to Nakata, a math teacher in the school.

title: Ame to Kimi no Mukou
title_en: The Rain and the Other Side of You
description: Yuka Kano, a 27-year-old junior high school teacher, has never dated a man in her life. One rainy afternoon, whilst tutoring one of her students, Yuka suddenly finds herself being kissed on the cheek by Aki Madarame. Aki confesses that in order to be alone with Yuka, she purposely failed the test. Confused as to why her student would do such a thing, Yuka decides to visit Aki at her house, where she finds out the ugly truth… Notes: - Originally published on Nico Nico seiga and collated by Galette for print release. - Includes two extra chapters.

title: MELTY BLOOD: Rojiura Nightmare
title_original: MELTY BLOOD 路地裏ナイトメア
description: Melty Blood: Rojiura Nightmare is a spin-off and sequel to the Melty Blood fighting games and manga, as well as the Fate/Grand Order mobile game.

characters.name: Sion Eltnam Atlasia
characters.original: シオン・エルトナム・アトラシア
characters.description: **Height:** 161 cm Originally named Sion Eltnam Sokaris, Sion is an alchemist of Atlas located in Egypt, one of the three main branches of the Mages Association. She is a genius scientist, given a position equal to the representative of ATLAS at an extremely young age. This event gave her the name of Atlasia, allowed to be used only by those who were the head of the Atlas. She is presently being chased both by the Church organization and Mage's Association. She enters [Shiki Tohno](https://anilist.co/character/2212/Tohno-Shiki)'s town during her search for [Arcueid Brunestud](https://anilist.co/character/2213/Brunestud-Arcueid), hoping that she may know a cure for vampirism. ~!In Tsukihime Worlds Sion takes the name "Atlasia" after becoming director of Atlas, while the Sion of Fate Worlds keeps her "Sokaris" surname. Within the World of Fate/stay night, she encounters [Lord El-Melloi II]

characters.name: Satsuki Yumizuka
characters.description: [Shiki's](https://anilist.co/character/2212) classmate, who has had a crush on him since middle school. She takes a slightly larger role in Tsukihime the game and Melty Blood.

characters.name: Riesbyfe Stridberg
characters.original: リーズバイフェ・ストリンドヴァリ
characters.description: Shield Knight. An official vampire hunter from the Church. She uses a pile bunker shaped like a string instrument a.k.a. Spear Key, Gun Shield. She gets mentioned in Melty Blood as Sion's friend who died protecting her from Wallachia, but her name wasn't revealed until the Tsukibako version of PLUS-DISC. She was supposedly the main heroine of Melty Blood and would have appeared as Ciel's rival character, but since TM came up with Sion, she was never used. You can see her by using Vampire Sion's Last Arc special move in Melty Blood Re-ACT. The reason Sion can make her appear is because she is awakening to her power as Tatari. In one point of the story, she uses a shard of her weapon as a bullet of her gun to kill Wallachia. She appears in the Melty Blood manga when Sion has a flashback of the time Ries saved her from Wallachia.

characters.name: Neco-Arc
characters.description: Neco-Arc is a running TYPE-MOON parody character that has been going since Tsukihime, and is a cat version of Arcueid Brunestud.

characters.name: Olga Marie Animusphere
characters.original: オルガマリー・アニムスフィア
characters.description: Olga Marie Asmleit Animusphere, also known as Olgamally Animusphere, is the daughter of Marisbury Animusphere and heir to the Animusphere family of magi, one of the top 10 families in the Clock Tower. She joined Chaldea initially as a Master candidate though she had to step up and assume the control of the Grand Order operation after her father's death. Though severe, arrogant and uptight she still shows compassion and cares for her subordinates within the organization. She trusts and relies on Lev Lainur as a fellow researcher and for support in her duties. __In Fate/Grand Order - First Order__ ~! She is apparently Rayshifted to Singularity F together with Fujimaru and Mash but in reality, only her consciousness was shifted while her body died in the explosion that engulfed the laboratory. Returning back to the current era would mean her mind would die. This truth is revealed to her by

characters.name: Lev  Flauros
characters.original: レフ・ライノール・フラウロス
characters.description: Lev Lainur Flauros (レフ・ライノール・フラウロス, Refu Rainōru Furaurosu, Localised as Leff Lynor Flauros), also known as Professor Lev (レフ教授, Refu-kyōju), is the antagonist involved in the Grand Order conflicts of Fate/Grand Order. ~!Lev was born from an old magus' family line that continues before the Christian era. When Solomon died, the King of Magic made a rule, the Grand Order and their primary directive passed down through a magus' family line. In reality, Goetia arranged the Demon God to be placed in the lines of mages 3000 years ago. The magi born from mankind will pass on their myriad beliefs and theories to their descendants, but those magi who separated from the "King of Magic" have survived through the ages for the sake of this point in time. Lev was born from that line and his genes were engraved with a curse which will allow possession by the Demon God Flauros, to persist and survive un

characters.name: Rani VIII
characters.description: Rani VIII is the Master of Berserker in Fate/Extra. She is a young girl who appears to be of Indian descent with wavy light purple hair with part of it tied into a ponytail. She has purple eyes, a tan complexion, wears glasses and has a bindi on her forehead as worn in India. ~Rani is a homunculus created by Sialim Eltnam Re-Atlasia with the intention to see if it was possible for not just alchemists, but for humanity to continue existing in the cyber world.~ (Source: TYPE-MOON Wiki)

characters.name: Sialim Eltnam Re-Atlasia
characters.original: シアリム・エルトナム・レイアトラシア
characters.description: Sialim Eltnam Rey-Atlasia is the last alchemist of the Atlas Temple in the world of Fate/EX series. Sialim had a twin elder sister who died at birth. As an Atlasian alchemist she was devoted only to her own research, her goal is to avoid the future of destruction. Essentially, this means that it's okay for humanity to change or decline as a species if it means surviving. She created the homunculus known as Rani VIII with the intention to see if it was possible for not just alchemists but for humanity to continue existing in the cyber world, which would mean having to give up their physical bodies. After sending Rani to the moon, she succumbed to a terminal disease and passed away in a month. She gave Rani two orders: to judge whether the Moon Cell was useful or not and to look for someone who could make Rani understand what her emotions were.

characters.name: Arcueid Brunestud
characters.original: アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッド
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm Arcueid Brunestud is the main heroine of Tsukihime, being the eponymous Moon Princess (月姫, Tsukihime). Arcueid is a mysterious vampire princess. She lacks some vampiric qualities, such as that of needing to consume blood to survive (though she suppresses the desire), and being nocturnal.
