In her elementary school days, she befriended [Nodoka Haramura](https://anilist.co/character/17275/Haramura-Nodoka) and together played mahjong in Achiga's mahjong club. She was the club's second best player before it was disbanded. Upon seeing Nodoka on television as the middle school individual champion, she decides to re-establish the club upon entering high school. Her goal is to go to the national high school team tournament and play against Nodoka. ~!Her special ability allows Shizuno to block other players abilities. The more tiles is taken from the corner of the wall, the stronger her ability is. Literary "the deeper players go in the mountains, the closer they to her territory". That's why she was cal

characters.name: Kuro Matsumi
characters.description: Kuro Matsumi is a second-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and is a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". Before the club was disbanded, Kuro was its number one player. She kept the room clean in hopes that someone would eventually return to the club. She is the younger sister of Yuu Matsumi. ~!Kuro's abilities are briefly commented on. During a match with Nodoka Haramura, Ako states that it was never possible to her to get any dora because they all gather toward Kuro. Because of this she has earned the nickname The Dragon Lord. The downside to this is that she can't discard any dora. If she does, Kuro will not be able to get a single dora for several games.!~

characters.name: Ako Atarashi
characters.description: Ako Atarashi is a first-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She is an elementary school friend of Shizuno Takakamo and Nodoka Haramura. She was the third best player in Achiga's mahjong club as an elementary school student. When the club disbanded, she attended a different middle school in order to continue playing and intended on entering mahjong powerhouse Bansei High School. When Shizuno re-established the club, she decided to return to the school. ~! Ako likes to play fast and has a good sense for the flow of the game. Ako is the most skilled player on the Achiga team but is overlooked because of the upperclassmen's special abilites. !~

characters.name: Arata Sagimori
characters.description: Arata Sagimori is a second-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and a protagonist of the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She is a childhood friend of Kuro and Yuu Matsumi; her family owns a bowling alley in the area. As a kindergartener, she grew up playing mahjong with adults at the Matsumi inn but stopped playing after her first year of elementary school. She is an admirer of Harue Akado and thus lost interest in the game after Harue stopped playing following Achiga's loss in the national tournament. When Kuro informs her that Harue has begun playing mahjong again, Arata agrees to join Achiga's mahjong club. She was assigned on the position of Achiga mahjong club president by Harue as most level-headed member of the team.

characters.name: Yuu Matsumi
characters.description: Yuu Matsumi is a third-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She is Kuro Matsumi's older sister. When she was younger, she wanted to join others in Achiga's mahjong club but felt it would be awkward because she was older. Yuu is very sensitive to the cold and covers herself head to toe when she goes anywhere, even in the summer. ~! Yuu's ability is that she can draw alot of manzu and chun tiles, so her hand is manly composed of these tiles. She also draws these tiles because she feels warmer drawing in warm tiles. As a result, her tile possession distribution is generally skewed toward the character tiles. When that playing style fails, Yuu draws in all red tiles and becomes difficult to defend against. According to Kuro, Yuu is just as good as she is at mahjong. According to Toki

characters.name: Harue Akado
characters.description: Harue Akado is the mahjong club coach at her alma mater Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and is a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". Harue was once known as the "Legend of Achiga" for taking the school to the national high school team mahjong tournament. After the team's defeat, she lost confidence and stopped playing mahjong for some time, leading to the team's eventual disbandment. She was later scouted by a professional team but returns home several years later when the company decides break the team up. ~!Harue's defeat in the national semifinal came at the hand of Sukoya Kokaji, who would eventually become a professional player and commentator in subsequent national high school tournaments in the main "Saki" manga.!~

characters.name: Saki Miyanaga
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") __Position:__ Captain Saki Miyanaga is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and the title character of the manga "Saki". She grew up playing mahjong with members of her family but came to dislike the game because she would lose her _otoshidama_ (New Year's money) if she lost and be scolded if she won. Because of this Saki, developed the ability to end her games with a net score of ±0 in order to avoid winning and losing against them. Over the years, this playing style became a subconscious habit, and she no longer attempts to win a mahjong match. After her parents separated, Saki remained with her father in Nagano while her older sister Teru moved to Tokyo with her mother. She eventually lost touch with her sister but is aware that Teru has become a top mahjong player in her high school. Upon entering Kiyosumi, Saki is invited by her

characters.name: Nodoka Haramura
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") __Position:__ Vice captain Nodoka Haramura is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and a protagonist in the manga "Saki". She is also a supporting character in the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She has played online mahjong since a young girl and develops a eventually passion for it. Her father, who works as an attorney, disapproves of Nodoka's interest but does not prohibit it. Because of her mother's work assignment, her family usually moves to a different city every two to three years. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 原邑和加 instead

characters.name: Yuuki Kataoka
characters.description: __Position:__ Vanguard Yuuki is a high school first-year student who attends the same school as Saki and is a member of the mahjong club. She is highly skilled, though cannot stay focused and makes more mistakes as the game progresses, so she is made the first to play at the mahjong tournament. She is often seen eating tacos, which increases her skill when playing mahjong. Additionally, food with names similar to tacos, like takoyaki can increase her skill partially as well. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 片丘優季 instead

characters.name: Hisa Takei
characters.description: __Position:__ Lieutenant A third year student and the president of the Kiyosumi Mahjong Club. She is also the president of the Student Congress Coucil at Kiyosumi High School, heavily emphasizing the "Congress" part of the name. A very intelligent and confident girl, she is able to effectively read the weaknesses and strengths of people, inside and outside of Mahjong, and apparently is a seasoned veteran of Mahjong, even to the point of being on friendly terms with a Professional Mahjong player. She is also able to comprehend concepts quicker than most, ~!the most prominent example being that she mostly, if not fully, understood what was going on behind Touka's misplays against Momoko in the finals sooner than most of her fellow players.!~ Her playstyle revolves around taking chances; while risky, she takes her time, waiting for effective hands that often come out of nowhere, surprising

characters.name: Mako Someya
characters.description: __Position:__ Sergeant A second year student and member of the Kiyosumi Mahjong Club, being the first member to join under Takei Hisa's leadership. Her family runs a mahjong cafe, which was former mahjong parlor. Being surrounded by Mahjong ever since she was young, Mako is familiar with many scenarios during the course of a game and is able to recall them during gameplay when taking off her glasses. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 染屋真工 instead

characters.name: Mihoko Fukuji
characters.description: A third year student serving as the Captain of the Kazekoshi Mahjong Club as well as being the team's ace player. She has a very kind nature, being nice to everyone she meets regardless of who they may be; her kindness extends even to the point where she offers Yuuki, an opposing player from the contending school team, Kiyosumi, her bento so that she would calm down. She even becomes very teary when her teammates help her out, as she feels that it was her fault that her teammates had to work in her place because it was her responsibility. She has been revealed to be very ineffective when working with technology. ~!She keeps her right eye closed to hide her heterochromia from others; while her left eye is reddish-gold, her right eye is actually sapphire blue. She never opens her right eye unless confronted with a dire situation during a Mahjong game. With both eyes open, she is shown to a

characters.name: Koromo Amae
characters.description: Premier member of the reigning champion Mahjong team, Ryuumonbuchi, and one of the most idolized yet feared players in the game. She is said to be possessed by a demon when playing; she even outranked a professional Mahjong player at a previous tournament. She is also the key player that brings an end to Kazekoshi's winning streak. She has a bad habit of wanting to crush her opponent's pride. ~!Her mahjong playing style pressures her opponents and her abilities can prevent them from reaching tenpai. This, together with the mahjong move she favors most, Haitei Raoyue or "last tile win" is a combination that slowly drives her opponents into despair. Haitei Raoyue's literal meaning is "to scoop up the moon from the seabed." Her abilities include being able sense when her opponents are in tenpai and the approximate value of their hands. She usually goes for big hands.!~ She is Touka's cousin

characters.name: Jun Inoue
characters.description: One of Ryuumonbuchi's four heavenly kings. Plays the game by reading the flow and manipulating it. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 井丿上惇 instead

characters.name: Tomoki Sawamura
characters.description: One of Ryuumonbuchi's four heavenly kings. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 澤村智貴 instead

title: JUNK LAND
description: 1) Omae to Atashi no Escape (オマエとアタシのエスケプ); kakioroshi 2) Omae ni wa Atashi ga Oniai da♥ (オマエにはアタシがお似合いだ♥); Comic Megastore H 2012-01 3) Finder-goshi no Kimi (ファインダー越しのキミ, You Behind the Viewfinder); 2011-09 4) Benkyou suru yori Baka ni Naru (勉強するよりバカになる); 2011-05 5) SEXYSTREAM ; 2011-01 6) Shikaeshi Kids (しかえしキッズ); 2011-11 7) Bishoujo Tantei Chouraku no Kiki (美少女探偵凋落の危機); 2011-07 8) Kochira koso Yoroshiku (こちらこそよろしく); 2011-03 9) Shiryou ja Shikata nai ne? (資料じゃ仕方ないね？, For the Data, Okay?); 2010-11 10) Meitei☆Free Time (酩酊☆フリータイム); kakioroshi

title: Ano Ko ni Yasashii Sekai ga Ii
title_original: あの子に優しい世界がいい
description: 1. An no Niwa 2. Futari de Akete 3. Kanojo no Hahen 4. Ame 5. After the Fuschia

title: Serenade
description: A professor living a successful life with a secret. Two students who each have a hold on their mentor: one who knows her secret and another who reminds her of her first love... A romantic thriller that will leave you hanging for more. (Source: Lezhin) Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title: Touko-san wa Kaji ga Dekinai.
title_original: 塔子さんは家事ができない。
description: When Akari is sent to live with her mom's old friend, she's surprised to find that the hard-working Touko-san she's heard so much about is actually a reckless adult with no knowledge of housekeeping whatsoever! What's to become of Akari now that she's a highschooler with the world's most unreliable roommate?

title: Iono-sama Fanatics
title_original: いおの様ファナティクス
description: There's one small kingdom ruled by a Queen Iono, who has a rather peculiar ambition: to establish a harem with 1000 pretty GIRLS from around the world. Now, the Queen has arrived Japan, looking for girls with beautiful black hair. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Iono Archeline
characters.description: The queen of a small unknown European country. She likes cute girls and has surrounded herself with a harem of sobame. She travels to Japan in search of black-haired girls to add to her harem.

characters.name: Seriho Inukai
characters.description: Inukai Seriho is a 25-year-old lady who is owner of the Amber Teahouse, a small tea shop she opened in Tokyo after winning a lottery. Although skilled in creating tea, she has trouble managing her shop, shown when she forgets to take down the "Closed" sign on the building. She takes on one of her regulars, Sarasa Kotoori, to work with her in the shop, and slowly begins falling for the younger girl. Has a short cameo appearance in chapter 2 of Kotonoha no Miko to Kotodama no Mahou to. Also appears in chapter 1 of Iono-sama Fanatics when Eto and Iono meet at the Amber Teahouse.

title: Kimi no Kaori
description: When a girl passes by her classmate in a corridor, she notices a sweet fragrance she's never smelled before. She asks the other girl about her shampoo but still can't find the scent's origin. Just where did it come from?

title: Koi no Kaori
description: Collection of one shots: 1. Tsuushin Omachishite Orimasu (I Await Your Reply) 2. Ki ni Nacchatte Gomen Nasai (Sorry I'm Obsessed) 3. Sweet Temptation 4. Sweet Desire 5. love*aroma 6. love*preparation 7. love*aroma:2 Note: love*aroma and love*preparation continue in the steps collection.

title: Tae-chan to Jimiko-san
title_original: たえちゃんとじみこさん
description: In the second volume is included the one-shot "Okaasan Yubi" (おかあさんゆび), previously published in the yuri anthology "My Sweet Home"

title: Chijeong
description: The royal palace is no place for fun and games—here, only the most cunning and powerful survive. After Soon-ock becomes queen consort thanks to the machinations of her scheming father and his allies, she finds herself in the middle of a bloody fight between the king and the crown prince. Despite her precarious position, Soon-ock is determined to survive and will do anything to ensure the safety of herself and her lover, Hyang-yi. She soon makes a deal that could either make her life heaven or hell. The only catch? Part of the plan involves using her beloved Hyang-yi. A gripping tale of conspiracy, lust, and desire set in the royal court of medieval Korea. (Source: Lezhin US) Note: An adaptation of the 2016 novel of the same name by Eun-Mi Hyeon.

title: Shirotae-sama, Himitsu desu yo
description: Utao Hananoi is a student at a prestigious academy—that’s meant for vampires! As a human, she must keep her identity a secret as humans are still considered food for the supernatural beings. But despite her best attempts, her secret is discovered by Shirotae… the progenitor of vampires! Thankfully, Shirotae offers to keep Utao’s secret, for now. Will Utao be able to keep her secret and her life or does Shirotae have other ideas in mind? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai: side stories
title_original: きみが死ぬまで恋をしたい side stories
description: A volume compiling the side stories of Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai .

characters.name: Sheena Totsuki
characters.description: Because of her class number, she is in the same room with [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi) and is partnered with her. She hates war and anyone getting hurt, and has doubts about her mission as a weapon. Her magical power is low, and she can only use magic to move a book by floating it in the air...

characters.name: Mimi Kagari
characters.description: __Height:__ 143 cm A mysterious girl who came to [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena). She is said to be the school's immortal secret weapon. She possesses unimaginable power despite her young appearance and innocent words and actions, and she has no reservations about killing her enemies. She has the ability to revive herself even after being injured to the point of losing her original human form.

characters.name: Seiran Lizzy
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm She is a serious person with a strong sense of justice. Whenever one of her classmates behaves in a frivolous manner, she scolds them. But every time she does so, [Ali](https://anilist.co/character/229291/Maud-Ali) calms her down. She shows glimpses of a strong connection with Ali that goes beyond friendship.

characters.name: Ali Maud
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm She has a calm personality, always smiling, and is more mature than the other students. She has a bold personality and expresses her thoughts directly, which makes [Seiran](https://anilist.co/character/229290/Lizzy-Seiran) worry about her.

characters.name: Halfred Anhalt
characters.original: アンハルト・ハルフレズ
characters.description: __Height:__ 148 cm [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi) and [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena)'s classmate. When younger, they disliked wearing the hand-me-down skirts from their older sisters, and asked for their brother's shorts instead, leading them to be criticized for not acting "like a girl" and causing problems for their family. At present, they are still figuring out their identity, and about relationships. They are intrigued by Mimi and Sheena's bond. Their favorite food is anything easy they can carry to their room.

characters.name: Esta Nino
characters.description: __Height:__ 158cm An upperclassman from class 16. Esta puts on a cheery demeanor and is kind to both her juniors and classmates. She would often ignore her own health and lets others have priority when it comes to getting treatment, regardless of how bad her own condition might be. She is roommates with a classmate named [Heather](https://anilist.co/character/402132/Heather).

characters.name: Omi
characters.description: The homeroom teacher for Class 14, to which [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena) and the others belong. Despite her detached demeanor, she truly cares about her students.

characters.name: Fran
characters.description: The school nurse at the school [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena) and her friends attend. She is skilled in healing magic and is indispensable to the school. She’s always looking out for [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi).

characters.name: Heather
characters.description: An upperclassman from class 16. She is roommates with a classmate named [Esta](https://anilist.co/character/380872/Nino-Esta).

title: Haru no Regista
description: Once hailed as a soccer prodigy, high school girl Arai Haru transferred to a school far from her hometown, hoping to start a new life away from soccer. However, a new student, Osanai Satsuki, who admired Haru's past glory, appeared before her and declared her intention to join the Soccer Club, which is on the verge of disbandment. This is a girls' soccer story about a girl who gave up her dream and a girl who chases after it!

title: Nana Yuri
description: Kaharu and Hinako's parents are best friends, so they've been with each other from elementary school to middle school. Now that they've entered high school, their relationship has started to change. A little desperate, but very sweet, this is a sickeningly sweet story about two friends who become much more after reaching a certain age.

title: RKGKMDK
description: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica doujinshi by original character designer Aoki Ume.

characters.name: Madoka Kaname
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") A 14-year-old girl whose life changes when she encounters the [Puella Magi Homura](https://anilist.co/character/38005/Akemi-Homura) and the familiar [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), who offers to transform her into a Puella Magi herself. She sees herself as a person without special qualities or talents, and after seeing [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) fighting against witches, wants to be a wonderful and cool Puella Magi like her. She is a rather selfless girl who wishes to be a magical girl simply so that she can help others. She allegedly has a large amount of magical potential within her.

characters.name: Homura Akemi
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 - 158 cm Homura is a magical girl who first appears in an apocalyptic nightmare of [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832). She transfers into her school the day after the dream. She is a beautiful, mysterious individual that performs exceptionally well in academics and athletics. This makes her instantly popular even though she is cold to others. She seems to know Madoka well and wishes to prevent her from becoming a magical girl. She attacks [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566) in the first episode, only to be stopped by [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194).

characters.name: Mami Tomoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-159 cm Mami Tomoe is a veteran magical girl and a third-year student at Madoka's school. She lives alone in a penthouse after her parents were killed in a car crash, which Mami survived after contracting with Kyuubey. Mami is particularly focused on saving, guiding, and protecting those around her, which is a traditionally selfless perspective on the role of magical girl. She is much like a maternal figure to Madoka and Sayaka, being the eldest among them. Her name could be considered a play on the word 'mommy', further supported in the third film, where she has a companion named "Bebe". Though Mami's outward disposition is cheery and confident, Mami feels deeply alone as she has no friends to confide in as she fights.

characters.name: Sayaka Miki
characters.description: __Height:__ 158-160 cm __Weapon:__ Cutlass [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832/Kaname-Madoka) classmate who, after helping Madoka rescue [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), ends up getting an offer to become a Puella Magi herself. She cares deeply for her friends, and wants to help an ill boy named [Kyousuke Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/39835/Kamijou-Kyousuke), whom she has a crush on. Before becoming a Puella Magi, Sayaka wields a baseball bat that [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) can enhance with magic to defend herself with while on witch hunts.

characters.name: Kyouko Sakura
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-158 cm __Weapon:__ Spear Kyouko is a veteran magical girl who comes to the city later in the story. Amusingly, she is always seen eating something, even while she is battling. Having grown up in a poor family, she often has to steal food and hates people who waste it, a logic she also applies to Grief Seeds, as she only goes after fully grown witches. Kyouko has been a Puella Magi much longer than the others, and thus is more skillful; she wields a spear which can extend itself, split into multiple sections, and produce a ball at the end of a chain, which can constrict and hit others at the same time. She also has the ability to put up barriers to protect others or keep them from interfering. She initially clashes with Sayaka, but after learning the truth about Soul Gems, she sympathizes with her and tries to help her.

title: .traeH
description: After being abandoned by first her father then her mother, Yuu has become a girl who refuses to get close to anyone. There is one girl, however, who won't leave Yuu alone. The energetic, popular Ayumu inexplicably can't resist approaching Yuu at every opportunity. Will Ayumu be able to break down the walls that Yuu has created around herself?

title: Anata ga Watashi wo Terasu kara.
title_original: あなたが私を照らすから。
description: Kanomata Akie's dream is to fall in love, so she enrolls at Sakuraba Academy, a high school famous for its couples' festival, to make her dream a reality. Then, on her very first day, under the falling cherry blossoms, her springtime begins. Note: Chapter count includes a bonus chapter in vol. 2.

title: Shinkon-san no Ecchi na Tokoro wo Michau: Anthology Comic
title_original: 新婚さんのエッチなところを見ちゃう アンソロジーコミック
description: Cover illustration: Suihei Sen 1. Niizuma-chan Cosplay Daisakusen (新妻ちゃんコスプレ大作戦) [Touka Riri] 2. Kamisama ni Datte Kikasetakunai (神様にだって聞かせたくない) [Gotou Masaki] 3. Daiji na Mono Daiji ni Shimasu (大事なもの大事にします) [Miyabi Akino] 4. Watashi wa Kanojo no Ohimesama (私は彼女のお姫様) [Hazuki] 5. Hakuchuu no Hana (白昼の花) [Uenoryuu] 6. Shimekiri Chikashi, Yoru Haeyo Otome. (締切近し、夜這えよ乙女。) [Kamura Yuuichi (嘉村夕壱)] 7. Manpuku Shinkon Seikatsu (まんぷく新婚生活) [Hokuto Sui (北斗すい)]

title: Eguchi-san Chi no Junjou Succubus
title_original: 江口さんちの純情サキュバス
description: Eguchi Hibiki is a manga artist who has knowledge, but no understanding of erotica. As Hibiki struggles with what exactly erotica is, she meets Yozaki Mia, a succubus who is also struggling with eroticism. The two similar people decide to work together to understand "true eroticism," but...

title: Damdam!!
description: Villagers are disappearing in the mountains of M prefecture. “Something is slicing people apart” was the final message a desperate police officer managed to yell through the radio before disappearing. Specialized in hunting monsters, two highschool girls begin their hunt!

title: Love Live! Sunshine!!
title_original: ラブライブ！サンシャイン!!
description: Uranohoshi Girls' High School, a private school in the seaside neighborhood of Uchiura at Numazu city, Shizuoka prefecture. A small high school in a corner of Suruga Bay, it is home to nine teens, led by second-year student Chika Takami, driven by one seriously big dream: To become the next generation of bright, sparkling "school idols"! As long as we don't give up, any dream can come true... All we have to do now is keep pushing hard for fame and glory! Now their "School Idol Project" begins to make their dreams come true! (Source: Official Site)

title: Tenshi ga Ita Kyoushitsu
description: There's something unusual about my class. Our beautiful and perfect angel classmate, Amane, just died. That's why everyone is holding a "funeral" for her. Everyone seems to be scared but doesn't say anything. I'm sure they're hiding something. Before she died, Amane said something strange... are there are traitors among us? Well, let's hold a "class meeting"! No one should leave the room before we know who's behind this...

title: Wo Suo Xiangwang De Ta
description: Dream chaser Nuo En accidentally bumped into the queen of fashion Jun Ling one day, and since then accidentally interlocked their fates. Two individuals from completely different backgrounds began living together after that. However, conspiracy after conspiracy slowly unveil themselves over time; will timid Nuo En alone be enough to save Jun Ling's heart from freezing forever? (Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Shikabane Shoujo to Ai ga Omoi Seikishi no Toubatsu Gakuen Life
title_original: しかばね少女と愛が重い聖騎士の討伐学園ライフ
description: In a world where humans and fantastical creatures coexist. Shurika, a zombie, enters a boarding school where students learn to battle the "kyoujuu," monsters that threaten all races. There, for three years, the students live in pairs with members of another race. Shurika is paired with Marie, a human paladin with whom she has a certain affinity. But for some reason, Marie's affection for her is strangely overbearing...? (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Kyoumei Suru Echo
description: Kyoumei Suru Echo is a collection of shorts from Tsubomi magazine, that are intertwined by mutual acquaintance but otherwise don't intersect. 1. Runner's High (ランナーズハイ) 2. Unbalance (アンバランス) 3. Asymmetry (アシンメトリー) 4-6. Lonesome Echo (ロンサム・エコー) (Source: Okazu)

title: Sheets no Sukima
description: Between the Sheets features the unusual friendship from the nearly inseparable Saki and Minako. Minako carries a fervent torch for the other girl - a passion of which Saki is initially ignorant. But when Minako sleeps with Saki's boyfriend Ken (just to see what Saki sees in him), the true nature of Minako's obsession begins to reveal itself ... provoking an understandably strong reaction from Saki. (Source: TOKYOPOP)

title: Peridot
description: Akira Shindo has been transferred to Fuga High School where she is almost raped by a group of young thugs. She meets Mahiru Suruga, a mysterious but beautiful girl with both arms in bandages. Mahiru is aloof and cold. Her motto is, "I will neither rely on others nor have anything to do with others." The two girls get caught up in a series of incidents at school and Mahiru, a strong fighter, always manages to sort them out. Mahiru starts to soften up, as she becomes friends with Akira, who loves to stick her nose into other people's business. Mahiru's school life is turned upside-down as many people approach her. Kaede is a high school student training as a swordmaster under a senile old man, who turns out to be a real pervert and a fake. Mahiru's father also comes into the story and things get chaotic. One day, Satoru Tsunami, a high school student, and an aspiring reporter start following Mahiru. He deeply respects Mahiru and considers her the strongest high school student and a rebel against adults. Why is Mahiru so strong? Satoru tries to find out her secret. Why has Mahiru shut herself out? What is going on inside Mahiru's mind?

characters.name: Akira Shindo
characters.description: Akira Shindo has been transferred to Fuga High School where she meets Mahiru only to become her best friend. She tags along with Mahiru to take down delinquents and save their school, while facing other problems as they arise.

characters.name: Mahiru Suruga
characters.description: Mahiru is one of the main characters, and the mystery girl of Fuga High. With no motivation what so ever she does whatever she likes, acting as a delinquent. Never going to classes, sleeping on the roof, and wearing mysterious bandages. However there is a hidden potential that lies within her; she is an extremely good martial artist!

characters.name: Kaede Inuzuka
characters.description: Kaede is the tag along member Mahiru's group. She is normally clueless to everything that goes on around her, but makes up for it with her skills in the sword. She lost her parents at a young age and was brought up under an old perverted man who taught her the ways of the sword. She can always be found following Mahiru and carrying around her sword.

title: Saikyou no Kyuuketsuhime wa Imouto ga Hoshii!!
title_original: 最強の吸血姫は妹が欲しいっ！
description: Long ago, on the continent of Ephenia, there existed the feared tribe of vampires called "True Bloods," whose great strength allowed them to reign supreme over all other tribes. However, a millennium has passed, and any trace of them has vanished off the face of the planet. That is, until the youngest and most talented royal daughter of the True Bloods awakens in the modern day. Vampire Princess Ristia has only one wish—a cute little sister! Monstrously strong, skilled in magic, and incredibly beautiful, people regard her as an "angel," but she assures everyone she's just a normal girl. Can this "normal girl" be the elder sister she so desires? Follow this (unusual) vampire through a fanservice-filled sibling-searching fantasy adventure. (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Osoto Gohan wo Goissho ni
title_original: おそとごはんをご一緒に
description: Fuuka, a college student who enjoys cooking but is confined by her apartment's small kitchen, meets Yomogi, a wild outdoor girl who isn't particularly good at cooking. Their outdoorsy meal that started by chance is somehow very delicious and heartwarming.... This is the start of a gourmet outdoor manga about two women helping each other out!

title: Oshi ga Hataraku Cafe de Shachiku OL ga Iyasareru
title_original: 推しが働くカフェで社畜OLが癒される話

title: Itazura Privacy
description: The pretty and popular Hana bullies the plain loner Yuki in front of everyone in class. But they have a very different relationship in private. (Source: Yuri Navi, translated)

title: H na Ane to NEET na Boku to
title_original: Hな姉とニートなボクと

title: Spice Girls
description: 1. Spice Girls 2. Mizuiro Method (Blue Method) 3-4. Sensei, Sotsugyou. (Teacher, Graduation) 5. Tonari no Oyome-san (My Next-door Bride)

title: Morangwa Dohwaui Gyejeol
description: Two young girls at a renowned boarding school depend on and despise each other for the attention they both desperately want—and the love they cannot sustain. Every rose has its thorns, each dazzling flame burns in this period thriller set in turn of the century Seoul, during Japan’s colonial occupation of Korea. (Source: Tappytoon)

title: LOVE WINS
description: Da-yeon was excited by the news of legalization of same-sex marriage. She ended up filing a marriage registration with a woman she didn't know because she was drunk...?!

title: Chiyo-chan no Yomeiri
description: A collection of short stories originally published as doujins. 1. Shuujuu Yuri Hon (Mistress-Servant Yuri Book) 2. Haru ni Furu Yuki (Snow of Spring) 3. Chiyo-chan no Yomeiri

title: Bunkou no Hitotachi
description: The story of two students that are the only attendees of a rural school. To their curiosity, a female transfer student has recently joined.

title: Ijimete Ijirarete
description: Himeri Shishido is a tough, popular delinquent girl with confidence in her strength. She spends her days harassing Ui Odagiri, an otaku girl in her class, with the excuse of just "playing around". However, something unexpected will put them into a secret relationship! May it be Violence? Or maybe a Master & Slave relationship? Anything can happen in this bullying love story.

title: Yukemuri Sanctuary
title_original: 湯けむりサンクチュアリ
description: Stories from the Oniyuri Hot Spring, a no-name hot spring which slowly starts to gain fame as more women come to visit.

title: Fukushoku Joshi
description: Uehara is a normal girl member of the student council. She could hardly believe it when discovers that president, the girl who she admires most in school, actually... is a zombie clothing eater!

title: Eve no Okusuri
description: One-volume compilation of FLOWERCHILD's stories published over the last 5 years in the Mebae yuri anthologies

title: Honto wa Ecchi na Onnanoko.
title_original: ホントはえっちな女の子。
title_en: Ren Arisugawa Is Actually a Girl
description: "D-...! Don't tell her. I'll do anything..." The popular talent, Ren Arisugawa... is actually a girl! This situation, I'll use it to my advantage... okay? (Source: Coolmic) Volume 1: Honto wa Ecchi na Onnanoko. (ホントはえっちな女の子。) Volume 2: Honto wa Ecchi na Onnanoko.: Sweet Scandal-hen (ホントはえっちな女の子。～スイートスキャンダル編) Volume 3: Honto wa Ecchi na Onnanoko.: Gossip Night-hen (ホントはえっちな女の子。～ゴシップナイト編) Volume 4: Honto wa Ecchi na Onnanoko.: Melty Scoop-hen (ホントはえっちな女の子。～メルティスクープ編) Notes: - Includes 4 extra chapters. - Originally serialized as a web manga under the title Arisugawa Ren tte Honto wa Onna nanda yo ne. (有栖川煉ってホントは女なんだよね。). - Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 171 episodes and 57 chapters respectively. - The first 6 chapters were previously given a tankoubon release as Ore dake ga Shitteru Aitsu no Himitsu (俺だけが知ってるアイツの秘密) under the publishing label Comic Gloss.

characters.name: Kyouhei Arisugawa
characters.description: A university student whose only claim to fame is being the cousin of [Ren Arisugawa](https://anilist.co/character/380639/). He’s insensitive and irresponsible, but deep down, he’s kind-hearted. After discovering that Ren is actually a girl, he ends up having to work as her assistant.

characters.name: Ren Arisugawa
characters.description: Ren Arisugawa is a hugely popular male celebrity—except she’s actually a girl. She’s kept her true gender a secret, even from her cousin [Kyouhei](https://anilist.co/character/380638/), though he has always been important to her. She’s self-conscious about her femininity.

title: Hei Ye Qing Wen Wo
description: Clark, a vampire who had been sleeping for 800 years, was dug out by the young Taoist Jiang Lai and successfully bound to a contract. Trying to find a way to kill this vampire, Jiang Lai starts living with her and tries various methods, but she ends up falling for Clark's seductive charm. A chance encounter turns out to be an inevitable reunion… In that past life and in this one, the one who hated her is reborn. Love and hate are like the two sides of the moon. "Clark, come to me." (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Sailor Fuku, Tokidoki Apron
title_original: セーラー服、ときどきエプロン
description: Honoka Aono is an attractive 17-year-old high-school sophomore. One summer day, suitcase in tow, she arrives at Musashi Koganei Station. A little away from this station, deep in a quiet suburban town, is the apartment her grandfather built. That's right – starting today, Honoka is going to be a landlord! Wearing her sailor school uniform by day and her landlord's apron after school, Honoka sets out to manage this building... which happens to be home to some very beautiful women. What kinds of heart pounding, exciting adventures await Honoka?! Sailor Fuku, Tokidoki Apron was simultaneously published in Japanese, Chinese and in English (as Schoolgirl Landlord Honoka) on DeNA's Manga Box app, though English translation was halted after 31 chapters.

title: Konai Renai
description: This school is full of tangled relationships, students and teachers each with their own secrets. (Source: U-NEXT, translated)

title: CottonCandy
description: A collection of short stories by Hamano Ringo. 1-3. Cotton Candy (CottonCandy); Galette Vol.1~3 (2017) 4. Bitter or Sweet? (BITTER or SWEET?); COMITIA111 5. Haru to Miniskirt (春とミニスカート); COMITIA111 6. 37℃ (37℃) 7. Aki Iro Irozuku (あき・いろ・いろづく) 8. Tori no Yukue (鳥のゆくえ) 9. Countdown (カウントダウン) 10. Cotton Candy 1.2.3 (cottoncandy-1.2.3-); COMITIA122

title: Kodoku no Kochou wa Donna Yume wo Miru no ka?
title_original: 蠱毒の胡蝶はどんな夢を見るのか？
description: This world has been invaded by bugs. With the appearance of the "Armored Bugs," mutating insect monsters that can overcome all modern weapons, humanity has been robbed of much of its living space. The only ones who can stand against such adversaries are the "Noble Butterflies," girls who harbor "Insects" that have gone through evolutions differing from the armored bugs. One of the candidates to become a Noble Butterfly, Odamaki Ayumi, still suffers from the fact that she is unable to become one. Her best friend, who was supposed to be with her and was her object of admiration, has left her and no longer seeks her company. Those days of despair came to an end when she was on the verge of death in a battle with armored bugs. "Don't think that I... will die without doing anything!" With the end near, the girl's body transformed into a butterfly one. And the flapping of her wings will bring about a revolution in the world...!

title: Namae wa Mada Nai
description: 1. 3-byou Rule (3秒ルール, The Three-Second Rule) 2. Uracoi (Sitting Behind The Girl I Love) 3. Koi wa Oshizuka ni (恋はお静かに, Love Me Softly) Yuki is hit with a ball and passes out. When she recovers in the infirmary she is visited by the class representative and begins to hear a voice in her head... 4. Keshisaru Koi to Negaigoto (消し去る恋と願い事, Erasing Love and Wishes) 5-7. Namae wa Mada Nai (名前はまだない, As Yet I Have No Name) 8. Recalculation Amemori hears a rumor that her classmate, Kisaragi, has gotten a boyfriend. 9. Tokumei Prologue (匿名プロローグ)

title: Kimi to Sekai no Owari wo Tazunete
title_original: きみと世界の終わりを訪ねて
description: Hundreds of years have passed since a weather control satellite went haywire and started a war that destroyed the human race. After waking up from a long sleep, the android Laliberta met a clone girl named Speranza. Since Speranza could not live in the open air, the two interact with each other through a window... This is a series of stories depicting the thoughts and feelings of the girls surrounding the apocalypse. (Source: Ichijinsha, translated) 1. Saiteigi Suru Kibou (再定義する希望) 2. Tsugihagi no Kibou wo Idaite (継ぎ接ぎの希望を抱いて) 3. Tomoshibi no Kikaitachi (灯火の機械たち) 4. Kimi to Sekai no Owari wo Tazunete (きみと世界の終りを訪ねて)

title: Ore wa Koisuru Onnanoko
description: Yuri Onagawa (male) is unable to forget his first love, Kyoko-chan. He is about to give up on his crush when he discovers that Kyoko hates men. One day, when he prays for love at a shrine, a mysterious power transforms him into a girl...? (Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Joushi to Dousei shiteimasu
title_original: 上司と同棲しています
description: It's a yuri comic about an OL and her boss living together. Official doujin for Nikurashii Hodo Aishiteru.

characters.name: Ayako Asano
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm (5'4") Product Planning Division Manager and [Saori Fujimura](https://anilist.co/character/363231/Saori-Fujimura)'s boss. She is currently married and respected by everyone in the office.

characters.name: Saori Fujimura
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") Fujimura is the youngest staff member and the ace of the sales department. Has always been interested in older women. She currently works in the Product Planning Division, with [Asano](https://anilist.co/character/363230/Ayako-Asano) as her boss.

title: Linkage
description: "Do you remember, the moment your love first began?" Two office workers who misunderstand their importance to one another, a young flautist and the woman who loves her, a rebellious schoolgirl who falls for a blind girl, two sisters who have always been close, and an AI researcher and her creation. None of these really has any 'link' to one another. The links are forged between the women in the relationships, and between them and us as we watch their love blossom into something real. 1. Kakera Two sisters that are living in the same room. Their connection is a bit more than a normal sister-sister relationship. One of them eventually has some cruel reactions. What will be the end of it all, well read and see. 2. Hearing the Sound of Bells Hirose Tomoko, a music conservatory student, never found the time to forge new friendships because of how dedicated and hardworking she was as a flute player. Then again, she was never a social bee like her active friend and fellow student-flute player, Okamoto Hiromi. Will Okamoto-san be able to convince Tomo-chin of her sincerest intentions or will Tomo-chin spend another Christmas alone with her flute? 3. Linkage 4. Kusari wa Mou Iranai 5. Prese

title: Binzume no Jigoku
description: 1-2. Binzume no Jigoku (The Inferno in Bottles) 3. Sei Anthony no Yuukai (The Temptation of Saint Anthony) 4-5. Koganemochi 6-7. Kawaisou na Ane (Poor Big Sister)

title: Josei ga Suki na Josei to Otoko datta Josei no Hanashi
title_original: 女性が好きな女性と男だった女性の話

title: Boita Boine
description: The Invincible Tomboy JK VS The Self-Centered Tomboy JK Hagoromo, the handsome-type tomboy high school girl. Her ambition is to build her very own yuri harem. From her first day of school, Hagoromo gets cocky after helping a girl, but standing right before her is Shizuka, the prince-like tomboy high school girl who unconsciously steals girls' hearts! Defeat Shizuka! Aim for your very own high school yuri harem! A ruthless, mud-slinging yuri comedy where two different types of tomboyish JKs clash!! (Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Mai-Otome
description: Mashiro-hime has just transferred to the all-girls school, Garderobe...but little do the other students know, she's actually a boy. Desperate to escape an all-boys school where he was looked down upon, he disguised himself as the late Mashiro-hime to get in. Unfortunately, due to "her" royal status, members of an organization known as Shwarz are trying to assassinate him, and all the while, he's trying to break his Contract with Arika Yumemiya, who unexpectedly became his Otome to protect him from a member of Shwarz.

characters.name: Erstin Ho
characters.description: Both Arika's and Nina's roommate. During the series's first episodes, Erstin mostly served as a bridge between the clumsy and spontaneous Arika, and the introverted and obstinate Nina, thus the trio became close friends, but she hides a dark secret that can shatter this friendship. Erstin harbors romantic feelings for Nina which was most evident in episode 6. During a pool scene, a creature was swimming around tickling the girls. Erstin thought it was Nina who was behind her and told her that if it's her, she's fine with it. Erstin quickly acquainted herself with Arika Yumemiya and didn't hesitate to help her in the best ways possible. She comforted Arika who at the time was being plagued by thoughts about her love towards Sergay. Erstin herself knew she wasn't as strong as Nina or Arika, so she did her best to support them in the best ways possible. During episode 16, Erstin found out t

characters.name: Arika Yumemiya
characters.description: Arika is the protagonist of the series My-Otome. She is first introduced in the first episode where she travels through the desert to Windbloom to find out more information about her mother, whom she was told was an Otome. After seeing the power of the 3rd Column, Shizuru, she decides to follow her mother and become an Otome. She is sometimes nicknamed Anty (Arinko-chan in Japanese) because her name, Arika, could be "蟻か" in Japanese, which means ant. The way her head turns into an ant's head is a way to show how she feels when someone calls her this nickname (which must have followed her all her life). She is cheerful and optimistic, but lacks the sophistication and "common sense" to deal with the royalty (due to her being a country bumpkin). She quickly gets acquainted with the other Corals and Pearls in Garderobe and becomes good friends with most of them, mainly Nina Wáng and Erstin H

characters.name: Nina Wáng
characters.description: Nina Wáng the top student in the Coral class and also one of Arika's roommates. She hails from Artai, a poorer kingdom than Windbloom with no Otome of its own. She and Nao are intended to fill this void and serve their country after graduating. Her father is Sergay Wáng , Nagi's right-hand man who is also part of the military. Arika found out that Nina was very sensitive to being tickled, which she enjoys exploiting. Nina is serious, determined and hard working because she wants to win the love of her adoptive father Sergay. Nina holds mixed feelings towards Arika. She is jealous of Arika's connections with Sergay and often annoyed with her cluelessness, but she shows friendship towards her on occasion. Nina's friend, Erstin Ho, was also her roommate who was in love with her.

characters.name: Mashiro Blan de Windbloom
characters.original: マシロ・ブラン・ド・ヴィントブルーム
characters.description: In the Mai-Otome manga, Mashiro is a boy who really resemble the real princess of the kingdom, Mashiro. The manga starts when the princess is declared dead and it's decided that a fake princess should be choose to avoid a war and administration problems, and Mashiro-boy is the chosen one. Mashiro is initially a weak-willed adolescent boy, typically running away from problems and giving up. The manga's central plot is his development from a fake princess into a strong ruler. When he thinks to himself, he often pretends he is talking to his mother. His real name has never been revealed.

characters.name: Mai Tokiha
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm Mai is a transfer student and new to the Fuuka Academy. Ever since both of her parents died, the main heroine has been taking care of her younger brother [Takumi](https://anilist.co/character/4052/Tokiha-Takumi) who is suffering from a heart condition. Mai hates to burden others with her troubles and therefore always tries to smile, hiding her own anxiety from her friends as well as from her brother. Her child is named Kagutsuchi, a flaming dragon with sword in the middle of its head. When involved into battles, both of them can control fire and use it for a number of attacks.

characters.name: Nao Yuuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm __Child:__ Julia A 14 year old schoolgirl delinquent who is also a HIME. She hates men and will flirt with them, only to rob when invited into their homes with the help of her child. She becomes an antagonist towards the other HIME after she is mistakenly accused of attacking [Yukariko](https://anilist.co/character/4055/Sanada-Yukariko) and loses an eye from the retaliation of the other HIME. Her element takes the form of claws that can create glowing "threads" which are strong enough to cut steel. Her child Julia is a giant spider with the upper body of a human and attacks with its webs and jaws.

characters.name: Miyu
characters.description: A mysterious traveler who watches over Arika. Her uniform is similar to her Searrs "Mithril Dress" from My-HiME except it has long pants instead of shorts. Overtime, she would stay with Mai Tokiha and the Crystal Princess, Mikoto, in the Black Valley. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shizuru Fujino
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm __Child:__ Kiyohime Not only that she's a senior at Fuuka Academy, Shizuru is also the President of the Fuuka Academy student council. She has her own fanclub that follows her everywhere, thanks to her cool yet inviting disposition and distinctive Kyoto accent which had made her quite popular with students of both genders.

characters.name: Shizuru Viola
characters.description: #3 of the Five Columns, known as the Charming Amethyst. Her interest in Natsuki seen in the original Mai-HiME seems to be upgraded in this series to an actual relationship. She permanently resides with her in the Principal building, when she's not on missions for Garderobe. Shizuru is from Wind Bloom, and she was classmates and rivals with Haruka. Her element is a naginata double-edged sword whose blades can extend in a whiplike fashion, much like her naginata did in Mai-HiME. Her reason for fighting is to "protect her most precious person." (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Natsuki Kuga
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm __Child:__ Duran Natsuki is typically portrayed as a serious, rational blue-haired female, as a foil to the lighthearted Mai Tokiha. Natsuki's beauty is the target of several jokes, usually involving her becoming embarrassed in a situation. She usually has Shizuru Fujino as a close friend. Natsuki always uses some type of gun as her weapon and she is usually associated with wolves, silver and the element ice. She also has a habit of flicking her hair with her right hand. Running gags include her hobby of collecting lingerie, her fondness of mayonnaise, and her tendency to become irritated easily. Natsuki s relationship with Shizuru go deeper when time goes on. (wikipedia)

characters.name: Midori Sugiura
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm __Child:__ Gakutenou Midori first appears as one of [Mai's](https://anilist.co/character/315/Mai-Tokiha) co-workers at the Linden Baum diner. She claims to be 17 years of age, even though she is really 24, and no one believes her. She is friends with school nurse [Yohko Sagisawa](https://anilist.co/character/4054/Youko-Sagisawa) from their college days and she eventually becomes a teacher at Fuka Academy. Though she appears to be goofy and more of a gung-ho justice fighter than a serious leader, she is actually the most experienced HiME, being the eldest of the group, and reveals herself to be a more than capable leader and far more intelligent than she lets on.

characters.name: Shiho Munakata
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm __Child:__ Yatagarasu

characters.name: Akane Higurashi
characters.description: **Height:** 156 cm **Child:** Harry A classmate of Natsuki's who works with Mai and Midori in the cafe.She has a crush on Kazuya, and tends to put her hair up in a short ponytail. When fighting her ponytail becomes undone and her hair becomes shoulder length. Her element takes the form of a pair of tonfa's which allow her to create wind attacks while her child Harry takes the form of a tiger and attacks by sucking an enemy into its mouth and shredding them. Akane was also the first to discover the consequences of a HiME losing a battle, and dissapeared with Kazuya during the school festival.

characters.name: Yuuichi Tate
characters.description: Yuuichi is a member of the Fuuka Academy Student Council. He first appears in Episode One on the same ferry that Mai Tokiha is taking and the two quickly form bad impressions of each other. Shiho Munakata calls him her older brother even though they are not related by blood. He works with the Student Council doing odd jobs for them (prompting Mai to label him a "lackey") and sits next to Mai in class. Yuuichi used to be a member of the Fuuka kendo club and regularly made it into the nationals until he was suffered a severe injury to his knee at some point in the past, though the exact circumstances and nature of the injury are never explained in the anime. Masashi Takeda of the kendo club is seen looking sadly at Yuuichi's name card on the wall of the kendo dojo at one point during the anime. Disenchanted, after his injury Yuuchi became a feared delinquent, but Shiho manag

characters.name: Takumi Tokiha
characters.description: **Height:** 152 cm The son of the shogun of Zipang who ran off to experience Windbloom as his sister had experienced it, disguising his identity to do so with the help of Sergay Wang, indicating that Sergay was probably the one who fell in love with Mai. He is strongly opposed to the system and use of the Otome as he does not believe in putting the weight of an entire nation on a single girl. The crest on his uniform is the same symbol associated with Mai and is probably a national/royal symbol. Both his name and Akira's are written in Kanji and in the Japanese style. The probable reason for this is because Zipang is based off of Japan. (Japan was originally called Cipango by the western world.) Note: Takumi's full "name" in Japanese, "Tokiha Takumi no Kami Tadayori", is his full title as the son of a shogun and not his actual whole name.

title: Inu mo Arukeba Hime ni Ataru
title_original: 犬も歩けば姫に当たる

title: Pairing Gear
description: Shin-O Ward—a city ruled by androids. One day, Miyamoto, a scientist plotting to exterminate androids, encounters Ribbon-chan, a mysterious android dressed in a Lolita outfit. In a city where humans are oppressed by machines, the two girls take up arms to win their freedom! (Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Aido
description: A josei manga from the artist of Pure Shadow (from Yuri Shimai 1) and Dessin (from Nico Says). Ureha's boyfriend proposed to her three months ago, but she hasn't given him an answer yet. While visiting a cosmetics shop, she sees a woman, Sawori, who suddenly makes her remember a lesbian experience from high school. She's not sure that's something she wants to repeat, but will she be able to resist Sawori's advances?

title: Yuri Seijin Naoko-san
description: The surreal gag manga follows a quiet, timid girl named Misuzu whose older sister Naoko is returning from studying aboard. However, when she hurries home to meet her sister, Misuzu instead encounters Naoko-san, the strange alien from Yuriland who loves eroticism, yuri, and girls.

title: Syrup NIGHT: Shoya Yuri Anthology
title_original: シロップ　NIGHT　初夜百合アンソロジー
description: This volume contains the following chapters: Cover illustration: Fly 1. Inari no Kekkon (いなりの結婚) by Itou Hachi 2. Shoya - After (初夜・After) by Homura Subaru 3. Kimi to Futari de Nobosetai (君とふたりでのぼせたい) by Kawanami Izumi 4. Kanojo no Yubiwa (彼女の指輪) by Chiruda Shimako 5. Doutei Joshitachi no Yoru (童貞女子たちの夜) by Yoshidamaru Yuu 6. Aikagi (あいかぎ) by Iwami Kiyoko 7. Hishochi nite (避暑地にて) by Ikeda Takashi 8. Himitsuteki Kousatsu (秘密的考察) by Sal Jiang 9. Saisho de Saigo no Yoru no Hanashi (最初で最後の夜の話) by Canno 10. Anata nara Nandemo Ii (あなたならなんでもいい) by Morinaga Milk

title: Non-chan to Akari
description: Akari isn't wild about moving into an eerie old house...until she meets Non-chan, a cursed doll! And what's this? Non-chan says she wants them to be together forever?! (And maybe something else about “haunting” and “eternal regret”? That's probably not important.) Akari, as bewildered as she is, accepts Non-chan's proposal. Now Non-chan seems confused, too, but no matter. Akari just knows she's found her new BFF! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Jintian Yiding Yao Dui (Rang) Ni Gaobai
title_original: 今天一定要对（让）你告白
description: The life of two "normal" high school girls? Su Mu wants to overcome her anxiety and confess to Lin Daixue. On the other side Daixue keeps leaving openings for Su Mu to confess. Both of them know each other's feelings but neither of them is willing to be truthful to the other.

title: Jing Ji Zhi Xin
description: One day, Liu Hai unexpectedly finds a beat-up book of magic. When she tries to draw a magic circle from the book, she accidentally summons a monster girl named Chi Xiaoliu. Xiaoliu has been imprisoned to provide the source of power for the Kingdom of Chi. She had wanted to escape for a long time and finally succeeded in escaping, just as Liu Hai was drawing the magical circle in the human world… and that's how the two girls met. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Slut Onna
description: Meet Sayoko — better known as Slut Girl — a drop-dead beauty that knows what she wants and has the attitude to get it. By sheer chance she meets her benefactor/boyfriend, Satoru, and this is where the hilarity begins. Satoru is the biggest little mealy-mouthed pushover on the planet and Slut Girl takes full advantage of her raging sexuality to use her boyfriend for living space and money.

title: Witch Guild Fantasia
title_original: ウィッチギルド ファンタジア
description: Monica's first witch execution awakens something in her. Without understanding how or why, she rescues the witch and flees the city with her, leaving behind everything she's ever known. She arrives at the witch's guild along with the witch, Gloria. This is where their journey begins.

characters.name: Monica
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm

characters.name: Clauria
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm

title: Kyuuketsuki Chanto Maid-san
title_original: 吸血鬼ちゃんとメイドさん
description: This volume includes the following chapters: 1-16. Kyuuketsuki Chanto Maid-san (吸血鬼ちゃんとメイドさん) 17-25. Nekomimi Maid-san to Ojou-sama (猫耳メイドさんとお嬢様) 26. Where You Belong (Where You Belong)

title: Kinenbi Manga
description: A series of comics focusing on the different holidays celebrated every day, starting in January.

title: Seijun Shoujo Paradigm
description: Paradigm Girls Academy, a famous catholic combined middle and high school. Not interested in love, Aoi hopes a school life among the virtuous Ojou-sama would turn her into a graceful and high-class lady herself. Riri thought joining a girls’ school would allow her to finally find love. Bonding over having their dreams meet a harsh reality, a beautiful friendship(?) begins.

title: Momo to Botan to Yuri no Hana
description: In a certain town there is a slightly odd maid café named Sasanqua. The most popular maid in the shop, Botan, has just received a love confession from the new girl, Momo, and can't help but have Momo on her mind. W-w-w-w-what if this is love!? E-even though we're both girls!? Why am I having these feelings!? This is a clashing-style maid café love (?) comedy.

characters.name: Botan
characters.description: Botan is the star of the café Sasanqua and represents the typical moe maid. But actually, Botan's personality is not cute at all, she is selfish, lazy and easily annoyed, yet is willing to work if it's for money. After being confessed by Momo, she eventually falls in love with her.

characters.name: Momo
characters.description: The new maid who started working in Botan's café because she has fallen for her. She is very clumsy and not very self-confident.

title: Syrup SECRET: Kindan x Yuri Anthology
title_original: シロップ　ｓｅｃｒｅｔ　禁断×百合アンソロジー
description: This volume contains the following chapters: Cover illustration: Fly 1. Kagerou no Koe (かげろうの声) by Kawanami Izumi 2. Hishatai Izon (被写体依存) by Goumoto 3. Toshoshitsu no Anoko wa, (図書室のあの子は、) by Tsuji Megumi 4. Sore ga Ano Musume no Hoshii Mono (それがあの娘のほしいもの) by Canno 5. Oshigoto Ganbaru Kimi ga Suki (おしごとがんばるキミがスキ) by Amano Shuninta 6. Hidari no Ashikase (ひだりの足枷) by Itou Hachi 7. Imouto no Ice Cream (妹のアイスクリーム) by Takahashi Mako 8. 4-ninme no Onna (４人目の女) by Matsuzaki Natsumi 9. Ageha, Tobu (揚羽、翔ぶ) by Yoshidamaru Yuu 10. Slit (Slit) by Ikeda Takashi 11. Doko kara to ka Koi ka to ka (どこからとか恋かとか) by Morinaga Milk

title: He Qin Gongzhu Bu Tai Xing
description: For my country, I was prepared to sacrifice myself, even for marriage. But the one I had to marry happened to be a girl. I had thought I had pranked the goddess pranker, but unexpectedly the goddess had pranked me.

title: Sweet Magic Syndrome
title_original: スイート マジック シンドローム
description: Amako is a young girl who has a great love of sweets. Due to her father's job, she had to move many times during her childhood, which prevented her from making close friends. Now she's fifteen and starting high school, and it looks like she'll finally be able to have a normal school life! She intends to join the tea ceremony club, but it's going to be abolished this year, due to the lack of members. All seems lost, when a strange young girl named Pudding appears out of a pudding cup! She says she's run away from her home, in the Kingdom of Sweets, and she agrees to be in Amako's club in exchange for a place to stay. Soon, Pudding's sisters, Cream and Chocolate, arrive to bring her home, but they find that Pudding's way home is lost! Will Pudding be stuck in Amako's world permanently? This 4-koma features Pudding, Amako, and other visitors from the Kingdom of Sweets, as they enjoy school life and tasty snacks together.

title: Toki
description: A Saki spin-off series. It follows the characters Toki Onjouji, Ryuuka Shimizudani and other girls from Osaka during their elementary and middle school years.

characters.name: Toki Onjouji
characters.description: A third-year student at Senriyama Girls' High School in North Osaka and the protagonist of the manga "Toki". She was named one of Senriyama's ace players for the 71st Inter High School Mahjong Tournament despite being a relatively unknown player prior to it. She's a very sickly and unathletic girl, and is often seen lying face down in her teammate Ryuuka's lap. ~!Toki possesses the ability to see one round into the future, predicting the draws discards of herself and her opponents, allowing her to call __riichi__ immediately prior to take advantage of the win bonus. During her game against Teru, the champion, Toki's ability evolves, allowing her to look more than one turn into the future, and afterwards, she gains the ability to view multiple alternate futures at once. However, this exhausts her, and it can cause her to faint if she overuses it.!~

characters.name: Ryuuka Shimizudani
characters.description: Ryuuka Shimizudani is a third-year student at Senriyama Girls' High School in North Osaka and a supporting character in the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A".

characters.name: Sera Eguchi
characters.description: Sera Eguchi is a third-year student at Senriyama Girls' High School in North Osaka and a supporting character in the spin-off manga Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A. Sera is a real tomboy. Not only that her body and haircut are like a boy's, she also wears male uniform. Her behavior is very boyish as well. She is so boyish she refers to herself as "ore". ~!Whenever she needs to go to a match, she is forced to wear a girl's uniform in order to represent her school (which is a girls-only school). Every time she has to do that, she gets very embarrassed and even blushes. Sera is Senriyama's ace last year, when she was second year.!~

characters.name: Hiroe Atago
characters.description: Hiroe Atago is a third-year student at Himematsu High School in South Osaka and a supporting character in the manga "Saki". She presents herself as a boastful character and can be seen by others as somewhat rude and tactless. She is the older sister of teammate Kinue Atago. ~!Hiroe uses traps and bluffs to trick her opponents into playing into her hand. She can also anticipate her opponents' hands very accurately. This makes her a very efficient player, and she can accumulate points very quickly.!~

characters.name: Kinue Atago
characters.description: Kinue Atago is a second-year student at Himematsu High School in South Osaka and a supporting character in the manga "Saki". She is the younger sister of teammate Hiroe Atago and is very fond of her. Kinue declined a middle school scholarship for playing football as goalkeeper in order to join her. Fellow teammate Kyouko Suehara encouraged Kinue to improve her skills during the first year in order to join her sister in the core Himematsu team.

characters.name: Izumi Nijou
characters.description: Izumi Nijou is a first-year student at Senriyama Girls' High School in North Osaka and a supporting character in the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A".

characters.name: Hiroko Funakubo
characters.description: Hiroko Funakubo is a second-year student at Senriyama Girls' High School in North Osaka and a supporting character in the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She is the strategist of the Senriyama team and carefully researches the performance and skills of opposing players prior to tournaments. She is a cousin of Hiroe and Kinue Atago of Himematsu High School in South Osaka. She is also a niece of Senriyama mahjong club supervisor which weighs a lot on her because people outside the team think that she got her position because of relations and not skill.

characters.name: Masae Atago
characters.description: Masae Atago is a professional mahjong player and a supporting character in the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She is the head coach of the mahjong club at Senriyama Girls' High School in North Osaka. Her daughters Hiroe and Kinue Atago attend Himematsu High School in South Osaka.

title: Eonniui Chwihyang
description: Unrequited love! Who is the one who makes the bottom of the heart every day? Until the taste of an adult's taste to the taste of a sister's sister. Note: Includes 3 side stories.

title: Puku Yuri
description: Collection of original doujin. 1. Puku Yuri ~Pierce~ (ぷくゆり～pierce～) 2. Puku Yuri ~Kiss~ (ぷくゆり～kiss～) 3. Yuurii (ゆうりい) 4. Futari dake (ふたりだけ) 5. Futari nara (ふたりなら) 6. Zutto Futari de (ずっとふたりで)

title: citrus: Wedding Invitation
description: Part of the special edition to the final volume. Includes one short comic.

characters.name: Mei Aihara
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Mei Aihara is an honor student, the chairman's granddaughter, and the stern and cold student council president. She is often calm and composed but she can be rather sensitive and mature to some extent. At first, there is little to know about her and a bad impression of Mei washes over [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/83367/Aihara-Yuzu), which causes Yuzu to take interest for Mei later on. Though Mei seems to be hard to approach, she is rather sensitive and lonely which makes Yuzu want to care for Mei more.

characters.name: Yuzu Aihara
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm The self-proclaimed Gyaru and only child, Yuzu transfers to an all-girls school after her mother is remarried. Yuzu is outspoken, daring, and shameless to some extent. She is often seen wearing her uniform that runs against the rules thus far. Unfortunately for her, she is bothered by the Student Council President's dress code enforcement. Yuzu eventually comes home to hear that she is now the older sister of the Student Council President, [Mei Aihara](https://anilist.co/character/83209/Aihara-Mei). Despite showing irritation towards Mei, she becomes concerned for her in which transitions into infatuation and deep care. Though she is rebellious in school, she means well and is often acting on behalf of Mei in a sense of protection. Also, her closest friend in school is [Harumin](https://anilist.co/character/83387/Taniguchi-Harumi).

title: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica -manuscriptus-
description: Welcome to the World of "Ave Mujica"――. This is the official comic adaptation of TV anime "BanG Dream! Ave Mujica". “Will you give me the rest of your life?” (Source: Comic Growl) Note: Chapter count reflects the original serialization. The chapters were later combined into 17 chapters for the tankōbon release.

characters.name: Sakiko Togawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") Sakiko is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School. She is a refined person who comes from a rich family, and used to attend Tsukinomori Girls' Academy. She often plays the piano in the school's music room. Sakiko is currently the producer, composer, and keyboardist of the band Ave Mujica. She used to be a member of CRYCHIC.

characters.name: Uika Misumi
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") In addition to being the guitarist, Uika is also in charge of composing and writing lyrics for sumimi's songs. She is quite popular due to her cool appearance. She loves stargazing. ~!Born as Hatsune Misumi, she is the illegitimate child of [Sadaharu Togawa](https://anilist.co/character/352933/Togawa-Sadaharu) and one of the Togawa family housekeepers. She was raised on an island by her biological mother and foster father, alongside her half-sister Uika. Upon arriving in Tokyo, she was scouted and debuted as an idol using her sister's name.!~

characters.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm (5'0") A first-year high school student. Mutsumi used to be a member of the band CRYCHIC, where she was in charge of the guitar. She is very stoic and a taciturn. Her father is a famous comedian called Wakaba, and her mother is Mori Minami, an actress. One of her hobbies is ballet.

characters.name: Umiri Yahata
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") Umiri is one of Taki's classmates. She is somewhat playful as she enjoys teasing Taki. Umiri is an exceptionally proficient bassist who has played as a support artist for over 30 different bands.

characters.name: Nyamu Yuutenji
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'5") Nyamu is a popular beauty influencer and the drummer of Ave Mujica.

characters.name: Soyo Nagasaki
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm Soyo Nagasaki is a first-year student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and the bassist of **[MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)** Soyo is a very kind and mature girl and she is often compared to an older sister. Due to this, she is often relied on by her peers. She has a habit of fiddling with her fingertips when she's thinking or planning something. Although not outwardly hostile, Soyo can be quite cunning at times.

characters.name: Tomori Takamatsu
characters.description: **Height:** 155 cm Tomori Takamatsu is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and the vocalist and lyricist of **[MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)**. Tomori is a kind but sensitive girl who has an awkward personality. She has a tendency to stutter while talking and not make eye contact. She also tends to blame herself for the conflicts that happen around her, even if they weren't caused by her. She is infamously known as "Haneoka's Weirdo Girl" due to her peculiar personality. She likes collecting all sorts of things, such as band-aids (especially ones with animals such as pandas or penguins on them), slippery things, just-the-right-size things, and even rocks and fallen leaves that she picks up from the ground. She also likes pill bugs and has been shown often drawing them in her notebooks.

characters.name: Taki Shiina
characters.description: **Height:** 156 cm Taki Shiina is a first-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the drummer and composer of **[MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)**. Taki is a loner who enjoys being all alone. She works part-time at RiNG, but due to her blunt personality, short temper and the fact she has a tendency to glare at people, she isn't good at customer service. She is a bit of a perfectionist, but at the same time has an inferiority complex towards her older sister.

characters.name: Anon Chihaya
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Anon Chihaya is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and the rhythm guitarist of [MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/). Anon is an honor student who is very social and also assertive at the same time. Despite this, it is shown that she has had a hard time making friends. Anon also loves following and trying out the newest trends. She approaches [Tomori](https://anilist.co/character/302095/Takamatsu-Tomori) after learning about her in hopes of creating a band together with her. Although she initially created the band in order to gain attention, to the point where she wanted to name the band after herself, she ends up becoming dedicated to her band activities and taking practicing seriously.

characters.name: Mana Sumita
characters.description: Mana became popular thanks to her cute smile and pure personality. She loves eating donuts.

characters.name: Minami Mori
characters.description: Minami is Mutsumi's mother. She's a famous actress.

characters.name: Kiyotsugu Togawa
characters.description: Sakiko's father.

characters.name: Mizuho Togawa
characters.description: Sakiko's late mother.

characters.name: Sadaharu Togawa
characters.description: Sakiko's grandfather.

characters.name: Mashiro Kurata
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") A first-year student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and the vocalist of the band Morfonica. Mashiro is a quiet and reserved girl. Though she aspired for Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and managed to get in, she was overwhelmed by the talented individuals around her. As a result, she felt depressed daily until she stumbled upon a band. She's also full of imagination and tends to get lost in her fantasies. (Source: BanG Dream! Wikia)

title: Sasori
description: A tale of one woman's revenge. After being sent to prison for attempted murder, Nami Matsushima struggles to survive torture from the guards and her cellmates, so that she can escape and take revenge on the man who's responsible for all her pain.

title: Chun Yu Alice
description: June, an oriental girl in a foreign country, becomes the queen's dress-up doll to make a living! June wants to escape once she earns enough money, but she gets caught up in a bigger conspiracy struggle for power. (Source: WebComics) Note: Chapter count includes 2 bonus chapters.

title: Anata no Imouto
description: Yuuka has recently started going out with Kouta, the childhood friend she's always had a crush on. Two months into their relationship, they go to Kouta's house to have sex for the first time, but because both of them are inexperienced, it doesn't go well. In front of a troubled Yuuka appears Kouta's younger sister. "Become my ideal girl." A boyfriend, a girlfriend, and his younger sister. It's the start of a love triangle that's so sensual you can't look away, but so immoral that you'll wish you could. (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Himegami
title_original: 箱館妖人無頼帖 ヒメガミ
description: During the beginning of the Meiji Era, a strategic town in the North, Hakodate, has become the nesting ground of mysterious monsters known as “youjin”. It seems the world’s Great Powers are pulling the strings of the youjin. Hyou, a 15 year old girl has been fighting the youjin alone up until now under the guise of the master samurai “Miburo”… One evening, as Hyou was fighting for her life, she was saved by a noble, beautiful fighter, Himegami. Their meeting would affect each of their destiny. And now, the hidden truth behind history is going to start!

title: Shuujuu Yuri Anthology: Rhodanthe
title_original: 主従百合アンソロジー　Rhodanthe
description: A Yuri anthology focusing on romances between masters and servants/lords and retainers, some include period settings or fantasy themes.

title: Gonglüe Mowang De Nüsheng Qinshi
description: The modern-day lady-assassin found herself transmigrated into a trashy European-fantasy otome game, where she has to make the Demon Lord fall in love with her in order to save the world. Instead, she trained the villainess Lady Lisa in assassin's skills, hoping that Lisa would eventually kill her and allow her to return to the real world. But all that intimate physical contact and her own earnestness during the training caused Lisa to fall in love with her instead?

title: Manga no Tsukurikata
description: Asuka, who debuted as a manga artist at the age of 13 but has not had work since then and is now 19. Fresh off from graduating high school, she gets inspired by the works of Sachi, and decides to quit her job in order to become a manga artist again. Since girl's love and boy's love are currently popular genres, she decides to go out with a former co-worker, Morishita who is in love with her, in order to gain experience. Later, she finds out that Morishita is actually Sachi.

characters.name: Morishita
characters.description: Morishita previously worked with Kawaguchi and professed her love for her. It is later revealed that Morishita is also a manga artist and writes under the pen name Sachi.

characters.name: Asuka Kawaguchi
characters.description: Kawaguchi published her first manga at 13. Now 6 years have passed and she has yet to produce anything else. Thinking she doesn't have enough experience to write about anything, she decides to change that. Noticing that boys love and girls love manga have been popular recently she decides to ask a former co-worker out to get some inspiration.

title: Tamao no Koi
description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2026 January issue.

title: Wake Ari na Kanojo-tachi
description: A story set in a world where non-humans live among normal humans, focusing on a titan named Kara and a vampire named Vivi.

title: Blood Time
description: Yeon-woo can’t help stumbling into pervy situations. What a creep would call a blessing is her curse. Case in point: going through an alley one night, she walks in on a couple making out. Except this time it’s worse—the couple is actually a vampire and her victim! The vampire, Hayang, is willing to let it slide… for some of Yeon-Woo’s blood! Could this be the start of a bloody good time? (Source: Tapas)

title: Girl's Ride
description: Isomoto Tsuyoshi's Girl's Ride is about the relationship between the athletic Nan and the clutzy Sei. (Source: Lililicious)
